title: A Characterized Softmax for Distributing Standing Across Multiple Affiliations
summary: Cooperative game theory answers canonical questions on payoff allocation (Shapley, Owen), interaction attribution (Grabisch-Roubens, Faith-Shap), and coalition formation and stability. None answers a fourth question that arises whenever players carry known, overlapping group tags fixed independently of the game: how should a player's standing be distributed across the groups it already belongs to? We call this membership attribution, formalize it, and give a complete characterization of its solution. The direct, ratio-based answer is provably invalid whenever a player's group-level signals have mixed sign --- a common, structurally unavoidable case. We propose a restricted-domain softmax construction instead, and prove that, for any player satisfying a precisely defined richness condition on the group structure, it is the unique such map, up to a temperature parameter, satisfying five requirements. A sixth requirement fixes the sign of this temperature; a seventh, shown independent of the rest via an explicit counterexample, forces one shared temperature across all eligible players. A worked example on an exact cooperative game confirms the applicable requirements numerically and shows the construction degrades gracefully, valid but uninformative, when a player's evidence fails to distinguish between its groups.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并形式化了"成员归因"问题：当参与者带有固定、可重叠的群体标签时，如何将其个体地位分配到所属群体。作者证明基于比值的直接解法在群体信号正负混合时失效，转而提出受限域上的 softmax 构造，并刻画其为满足五条要求（加温度符号与共享温度两条共七条）的唯解。
AI.motivation: 合作博弈论已解答收益分配（Shapley、Owen）、交互归因（Grabisch-Roubens、Faith-Shap）以及联盟形成与稳定性三类问题，但未处理第四类问题：参与者携带独立于博弈确定的、可重叠的已知群体标签时，其地位应如何在所属群体间分配。
AI.method: 先形式化"成员归因"问题并给出基于比值的直接解；证明该方法在群体级信号正负混合（常见且结构上不可避免）时无效；随后提出受限域 softmax 构造，对满足"丰富性条件"的参与者，证明其在五条要求下（温度参数意义下）唯一，第六条固定温度符号，第七条经显式反例证明独立于其余并要求所有合规参与者共享同一温度。
AI.result: 证明直接比值解在混合符号情形下必然失效；证明 softmax 构造在丰富性条件下满足五条要求且唯一（至温度参数）；给出反例说明第七条要求的独立性；在一个精确合作博弈算例中数值验证各适用要求，并展示当参与者证据无法区分其群体时构造退化为"有效但无信息"的优雅降级。
AI.conclusion: 成员归因是可被完全刻画的新问题；受限域 softmax 是唯一合理的解形式，其温度参数的可识别性（符号与共享性）需额外公理约束；该构造在证据不足时行为可预期。

title: Reimbursement as a Revenue Instrument in Costly Clock Auctions
summary: Bidders in an ascending auction may incur a cost each time they choose to continue, for example when bidding requires a blockchain transaction. We therefore investigate whether a seller can increase net revenue by reimbursing these costs, and how reimbursements should be distributed across auction rounds. We study auctions in which bidders must actively confirm their participation as prices rise and the seller commits to reimbursements before bidding begins. We first show how a linear program can find the cheapest payments that keep bidders' strategies optimal when participation costs are introduced. Maximizing net revenue, however, can require changing those strategies. In a two-bidder example, we identify conditions under which reimbursing only the last scheduled decision earns the most net revenue among the schedules we analyze. This policy outperforms no reimbursement, full reimbursement, and the cheapest policy that maintains the original strategies. Some auctions end earlier than under full reimbursement, but the seller's savings exceed the resulting loss in sale receipts. Experiments with learning bidders reproduce these revenue comparisons. In a four-bidder example, they also identify a policy with partial reimbursements in earlier rounds that earns more than reimbursing only the final decision. These results show how the seller's preferred reimbursement timing can change across auction environments. Finally, we explain how requiring bidders to confirm continued participation limits the prices they can be charged when messages are missing, and discuss the requirements for implementing these auctions on a blockchain.

AI.tldr: 研究递增拍卖中投标人每次确认参与都会产生成本(如区块链交易费)时,卖家如何通过报销参与成本来提升净收益,以及报销应如何在各轮次间分配。
AI.motivation: 递增拍卖要求投标人随价格上升主动确认参与,每次确认可能产生成本(例如链上竞价交易费)。卖家可能通过报销这些成本提高净收益,但报销时机与分配方式尚不清楚。
AI.method: 建立投标前即承诺报销的拍卖模型;先用线性规划求在引入参与成本后维持投标人原有策略最优所需的最廉价支付;再考虑通过改变策略来最大化净收益。通过两投标人算例比较不同报销时间表(不报销、全额报销、维持原策略的最廉价方案、仅报销最后一次决策等),并用学习型投标人实验验证,最后给出四投标人算例。
AI.result: 两投标人情形下,存在条件使"仅报销最后一次预定决策"在所分析的时间表中净收益最高,优于不报销、全额报销及最廉价维持原策略方案;此时部分拍卖更早结束,但卖家节省的成本超过销售收入损失。学习型投标人实验重现上述收益比较。四投标人算例中发现更优的"早期轮次部分报销"策略,说明最优报销时机随拍卖环境而变。
AI.conclusion: 最优报销时间表依赖具体拍卖环境,不存在普遍最优方案;要求投标人确认继续参与在消息缺失时限制了可收取的价格;并讨论了在区块链上实现此类拍卖的要求。

title: Mechanism Design under Belief Disagreement: Allocation Flexibility and Rent Capacity
summary: A seller jointly chooses allocation and payments when buyers misperceive competition. Under independent private values, statewise participation, and payment restrictions, allocation determines both required rents and their delivery capacity. We separate these effects under a common subjective law. For three values and shared-top beliefs, explicit score and capacity conditions characterize globally optimal lower-value lotteries, including top-rent overflow and welfare differences among revenue optima. A two-buyer construction establishes a strict allocation advantage over every reserve under the same fixed reporting certificate and positive margin. A transport test and exact band-boundary incentive equalities identify separate conditions restoring objective-law revenue ceilings. For three bands and a common affine belief interval, an explicitly certified reserve attains the ceiling under stated score conditions. A case scaled to public collectible-auction records yields a nominal shared-top allocation gain of 24.72 cents per auction. A one-cent report-by-report margin yields matched gains of 1.48 cents under projection and 3.32 cents under shared-top beliefs; the three-band point-belief gain of 2.50 cents disappears with common-interval protection. These comparisons bound the additional recurring costs an allocation redesign can cover at the specified reporting requirement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究买方错误认知竞争时的机制设计：卖方同时选择配置与支付，在共同主观信念法则下分离"所需租金"与"租金交付能力"两种效应，刻画全局最优低价彩票机制，并给出相对最优保留价机制的严格配置优势及恢复客观法则收入上限的条件。
AI.motivation: 现实中买方常误判竞争程度（主观信念偏离客观法则），而既有机制设计收入结果多基于客观法则下的参与与支付约束；作者希望厘清在这种误知下，配置选择如何同时决定必须给予的信息租金与其可实现交付能力，并判断配置型设计（彩票）是否真能优于传统保留价机制。
AI.method: 在独立私人价值、逐状态参与和支付限制下建模；采用统一的主观法则，先分离租金需求与交付能力两类效应；对三价值、共享顶端信念情形推出显式打分与容量条件，刻画全局最优低价彩票（含顶端租金溢出与收入最优解间福利差异）；构造两买方例子与固定报告证明下的保留价对比；用"运输检验"与精确带状边界激励等式识别恢复客观法则收入上限的条件；对三带、公共仿射信念区间给出显式认证的保留价；并以公开收藏品拍卖记录做数值案例。
AI.result: 两买方构造显示：在相同固定报告证书与正边际下，彩票配置严格优于任何保留价；运输检验与带状边界激励等式分别给出恢复客观法则收入上限的独立条件；三带公共仿射信念区间下，满足打分条件的显式认证保留价可达上限；数值案例中共享顶端配置名义增益为每场拍卖24.72美分；一分钱逐报告边际下，投影信念增益1.48美分、共享顶端信念增益3.32美分，而三带点信念的2.50美分增益在公共区间保护下消失。
AI.conclusion: 配置与支付联合设计在买方误知竞争时可带来可量化的严格收入优势，但该优势高度依赖信念结构与报告精度约束；点信念下的增益在更稳健的公共区间保护下可能完全消失。这些比较为"在给定报告要求下配置再设计所能覆盖的额外经常性成本"提供了上界。

title: Last-Iterate Convergence of Payoff-Gradient Learning in Möbius Pricing Games
summary: We prove global last-iterate convergence of payoff-gradient learning in every typewise Riemannian metric, which for scalar actions is the same as typewise mirror descent, with explicit rates, in a class of Bayesian bidding and pricing games that includes first-price auctions, unit-demand pay-as-bid auctions, rank-based generalized first-price auctions, and homogeneous-good price competition with inelastic demand. The result holds for symmetric self-play: all players use a common strategy and apply the same payoff-gradient update at each type. Convergence is from every continuous weakly increasing feasible initial strategy, including pooling, and does not rely on the monotonicity or Minty conditions that underlie existing guarantees in other games. Instead, the class is characterized by two structural properties: a direct payoff effect that is independent of the action, and a payoff difference at the allocation threshold that is affine in the action. These properties reduce the learning dynamics to a singular transport-damping equation for the common strategy, which, under the stated coefficient and metric assumptions, admits a unique viscosity solution. Comparison barriers make the uniform distance to the unique rest point a strict Lyapunov functional and yield convergence rates with optimal algebraic exponents. In allocation games, the rest point is the unique weakly increasing symmetric equilibrium under the stated tie-breaking conditions, and a positive lower slope bound converts strategy-error bounds into explicit approximate-equilibrium guarantees. A projected grid scheme with a slope floor makes the approximation constructive, with error bounds under deterministic perturbations and almost-sure convergence on a fixed grid under martingale gradient noise.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在一类贝叶斯竞价与定价博弈中，payoff-gradient learning（标量动作下等价于typewise mirror descent）在任意typewise Riemannian度量下全局last-iterate收敛，并给出显式收敛速率。
AI.motivation: 现有收敛保证多依赖单调性（monotonicity）或Minty条件，无法覆盖首价拍卖等博弈；作者希望在此类博弈中给出不依赖这些条件的全局收敛理论。
AI.method: 针对对称自博弈（所有类型使用同一策略、同一更新），刻画该类博弈的两个结构性质：直接收益效应与动作无关、分配阈值处的收益差对动作仿射。由此把学习动力学化为关于公共策略的奇异transport-damping方程，在系数与度量假设下拥有唯一粘性解；用比较障碍构造Lyapunov泛函。
AI.result: 从任意连续弱增（含pooling）可行初始策略出发均收敛；收敛速率具最优代数指数；rest point为给定tie-breaking下唯一弱增对称均衡；正斜率下界把策略误差转为显式近似均衡保证；投影网格+斜率下限方案给出可构造近似，含确定性扰动误差界与马尔可夫梯度噪声下几乎必然收敛。
AI.conclusion: 结构性质替代单调性是关键，本文为拍卖与价格竞争中的梯度学习提供全局收敛、显式速率与可计算近似保证。

title: Routing Collapse in Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts: Cross-Modal Conditioning Restores Expert Diversity Without Improving Accuracy
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) classifiers are increasingly applied to multimodal emotion recognition, yet the health of their routing distributions is rarely measured. We study a seven-expert MoE head on IEMOCAP under two conditions that differ only in how modality embeddings are fused before reaching it: a learned scalar gate alone, and the same gate preceded by pairwise cross-modal attention. Under scalar fusion the router collapses, concentrating on 1.88 of seven experts at a normalised entropy of 0.241. Cross-modal fusion raises entropy to 0.537 and utilisation to 3.25 experts, a 2.23x increase (p=0.035, Cohen's d=2.55), and induces emotion-differentiated routing absent in the scalar case. This recovered diversity confers no detectable benefit: across six seeds per condition, weighted accuracy (p=0.646) and run-to-run variance (p=0.768) are statistically indistinguishable. We further observe a 13-point accuracy spread under identical configuration. In this regime, router health and task performance are decoupled, and diagnosing collapse does not by itself justify fixing it.

AI.tldr: 在IEMOCAP上研究7专家MoE情感识别头，发现标量融合下路由塌缩（1.88/7专家，熵0.241），加入跨模态注意力后多样性显著提升（3.25专家，熵0.537），但任务性能与方差无显著改善——路由健康与任务性能解耦。
AI.motivation: MoE分类器在多模态情感识别中被广泛使用，但其路由分布的健康状况很少被测量；作者想检验"修复路由塌缩"是否真的能带来性能收益。
AI.method: 在IEMOCAP上对比两种仅融合方式不同的条件：仅学习标量门控 vs. 标量门控前接成对跨模态注意力；每组6个随机种子，测量路由熵、专家利用率、按情感类别的路由差异，并做加权准确率与运行间方差的统计检验。
AI.result: 跨模态融合使熵从0.241升至0.537、利用率从1.88升至3.25（2.23倍，p=0.035，Cohen's d=2.55），并出现情感分化的路由；但加权准确率（p=0.646）和方差（p=0.768）无显著差异；相同配置下观察到13个点的准确率波动。
AI.conclusion: 在该设定下路由健康与任务性能解耦，诊断出路由塌缩本身不足以作为"必须修复"的理由；应审慎看待以路由多样性为优化目标的MoE设计。

title: SAMA: Training-Free Consensus Ridge Tracking for Camera-Based Heart Rate on Five Public Datasets
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is usually benchmarked by one heart rate per video, a figure that hides the short windows in which a tele-consultation would actually read the pulse. We present SAMA, a training-free estimator that (i) forms a quality-weighted consensus of POS and CHROM chrominance spectra, (ii) discounts frequencies occupied by pulse-free references derived from the same frames (frame motion, skin-mask geometry and background brightness), (iii) follows the heart rate through time with a Viterbi ridge under a random-walk prior, and (iv) returns a track-filtered, amplitude-normalised waveform with a per-window confidence. No parameter is learned and no dataset-specific tuning is used. On 218 recordings from 111 participants in five public datasets (UBFC-rPPG, PURE, SUMS, M3PD and a two-participant subset of MMPD), all processed with the same fixed face box and scored with a re-implementation of the rPPG-Toolbox protocol, SAMA has the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) averaged over datasets at every protocol level: 4.40 against 5.13,bpm for POS per video, 4.80 against 5.43 on 30,s windows and 5.05 against 6.59 on 10,s windows. Pooled over participants, the bootstrap interval of its paired difference from POS excludes zero on 30,s and 10,s windows (Wilcoxon p=0.11 and 0.004) but not per video, and it does not beat POS on SUMS per video or on the MMPD subset. Withholding the 20\% least confident windows lowers the pooled 10,s error from 4.06 to 2.33,bpm. We also show that the per-video protocol has a floor of 1.2--1.6,bpm on datasets where heart rate drifts, and that skin tone cannot be recovered from uncalibrated video, which motivates the instrumented, skin-tone-stratified collection we propose for the Indian population. The method does not surpass the best published neural networks on UBFC-rPPG; we report where it stands against them without re-running them.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练 rPPG 估计器 SAMA，用质量加权谱共识、无脉搏参考频率折扣、Viterbi 跟踪与置信度输出，在五个数据集短窗评测中取得最低平均 MAE。
AI.motivation: 现有 rPPG 评测以"每视频一个心率"为基准，掩盖了远程问诊实际会读取的短时间窗表现；同时缺少免训练、跨数据集的稳定方法。
AI.method: SAMA 免训练：对 POS 与 CHROM 色度谱做质量加权共识；用同帧的无脉搏参考（帧运动、肤色掩膜几何、背景亮度）折扣其占用频段；在随机游走先验下用 Viterbi 脊跟踪心率；输出经轨迹滤波、幅度归一化并带逐窗置信度的波形。无参数学习、无数据集特定调参。
AI.result: 218 段/111 人/5 个数据集，统一人脸框与 rPPG-Toolbox 协议复现：各协议层级跨数据集平均 MAE 最低——整视频 4.40 vs POS 5.13 bpm，30 s 窗 4.80 vs 5.43，10 s 窗 5.05 vs 6.59；30 s 与 10 s 窗配对差 bootstrap 区间不含零（Wilcoxon p=0.004 于 10 s），整视频不显著（p=0.11）；SUMS 整视频与 MMPD 子集未胜过 POS。剔除 20% 最低置信窗后 10 s 汇总误差由 4.06 降至 2.33 bpm。揭示整视频协议在心率漂移数据集上有 1.2–1.6 bpm 下限，且未标定视频无法恢复肤色。
AI.conclusion: SAMA 在短窗场景显著优于 POS 且具置信度可用性，但未超过最佳已发表神经网络（仅对比数值未复跑），并据此提出面向印度人群的仪器化、肤色分层采集计划。

title: FittedGenes: Domain-Aware Sewing Pattern Layout Optimization
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables, plus 7 pages of supplementary material. Accepted to Vision, Modeling, and Visualization (VMV) 2026. Code: https://github.com/fittedgenes/GarmentCode-Nesting
summary: Two-dimensional cutting and packing problems aim to arrange pieces on a larger surface without overlap while minimizing material waste. Although extensively studied in industries such as textiles, traditional nesting research assumes piece geometries are fixed. In this work, we make the garment design itself a variable of the nesting optimization: we introduce a new formulation of the sewing pattern nesting problem in which panel geometry is modified under domain-aware constraints, preserving fit while allowing appearance to vary within designer-set bounds. We present an evolutionary nesting framework that embeds these modifications directly into a genetic algorithm (GA). Two novel mutation operators are proposed: one enables splitting panels into stitchable sub-panels, and the other adjusts garment design while preserving fit. Our method is evaluated on existing irregular nesting benchmarks and a new benchmark derived from a comprehensive dataset of sewing patterns. Our experiments demonstrate that evolutionary algorithms enhanced with the proposed garment-aware mutations achieve markedly better results than versions restricted to standard permutation-based operators, demonstrating the value of integrating design flexibility into nesting optimization. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/fittedgenes/GarmentCode-Nesting.

AI.tldr: 将服装版片几何作为嵌套优化变量，提出嵌入版片分割与保合体改版两类变异算子的进化式排料框架，在基准数据上显著优于仅用标准排列算子。
AI.motivation: 传统二维排料研究假定版片几何固定，主要优化摆放位置；而服装行业中版片形状和外观本身可调，将设计自由度纳入排料可进一步减少面料浪费。
AI.method: 提出带领域约束的缝纫版片排料新形式化：在保持合体的前提下，允许版片几何在设计师设定范围内变化；采用遗传算法框架，设计两类新变异算子——版片可缝分割为子版片、保合体的版型调整；在现有不规则排料基准与新建缝纫纸样数据集基准上评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，加入服装感知变异算子的进化算法明显优于仅使用标准基于排列的算子版本，验证了将设计灵活性纳入排料优化的价值。
AI.conclusion: 设计变量与排料优化联合求解可提升嵌套效果，为服装行业提供了可行的进化式设计-排料一体化方法，代码已开源。

title: Evaluating Memanto on DolphinBench for AI Agents
comment: Future version will submit to ACL
summary: Memory benchmarks built on question answering tell an agent which fact to recall. Workplace requests often leave that need implicit: to post an update in the team's channel, an agent must work out which channel from earlier interactions and use it in a tool call. We evaluate Memanto, a memory agent that ranks memories with an information-theoretic relevance score, on DolphinBench, which tests memory through 600 simulated workplace tasks, each validated as requiring memory. Running in the Hermes agent harness with GPT-6-Luna and at most 6 iterations per conversation, Memanto completes 503 tasks (83.83%). The strongest configuration reported by the benchmark's authors, Mem0 with GPT-5.6-Luna and up to 60 iterations, completes 424 (70.67%). Memanto's run also has the lowest total cost ($10.86, against $61.48 for the cheapest reported run) and the shortest median task latency (15.32s). Grading uses the benchmark's own judge, but the agent model differs, so these results compare complete systems. The memory system affects both whether an agent completes such tasks and what completion costs.

AI.tldr: Memanto 是一种基于信息论相关性评分对记忆排序的记忆智能体，在 DolphinBench 的 600 个模拟职场任务上完成 503 个（83.83%），优于 Mem0 报告的 424 个（70.67%），同时成本最低（$10.86）且中位延迟最短（15.32s）。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆基准多基于问答，明确告诉智能体该回忆哪条事实；而真实职场请求往往隐含记忆需求——例如要在团队频道发更新，智能体须从早期交互中推断是哪个频道并用于工具调用。因此需要评估记忆系统在隐式需求场景下是否有效，以及它对任务完成率和成本的共同影响。
AI.method: 提出 Memanto 记忆智能体，使用信息论相关性评分对记忆进行排序。在 DolphinBench（600 个模拟职场任务，每个均验证确实需要记忆）上评估，运行于 Hermes 智能体框架，使用 GPT-6-Luna，每轮对话最多 6 次迭代。
AI.result: Memanto 完成 503/600 任务（83.83%）；基准作者报告的最强配置 Mem0+GPT-5.6-Luna（最多 60 次迭代）完成 424 个（70.67%）。Memanto 总成本最低（$10.86，最便宜的已报告运行仍为 $61.48），中位任务延迟最短（15.32s）。
AI.conclusion: 记忆系统同时影响智能体能否完成此类任务以及完成成本。由于智能体模型不同，结果比较的是完整系统而非单一组件；且仅用最多 6 次迭代就取得更好效果，说明高效记忆检索可显著降低迭代与开销。

title: WISP: Composable Representations for Wrist-Worn Activity Recognition
comment: Code and saved results are available at https://huggingface.co/Zipeng365/WISP, and the benchmark data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zipeng365/WristHARBench
summary: Smartwatches and fitness bands are among the most common wearable devices, and large national health studies record movement at the wrist. Yet existing human activity recognition benchmarks mix sensors worn on different parts of the body, so they do not show how well activities can be recognised from the wrist alone. We introduce WristHARBench, a benchmark that standardises participant-disjoint evaluation across nine wrist-acceleration datasets and two additional multichannel inertial datasets. We hypothesise that different human activities leave complementary patterns in wrist motion, such as local shape, rhythm, temporal order and cross-axis relationships, and propose WISP (Wrist-Informed Space of Predictive Representations), a composable representation space that combines representations of these patterns with compatible classifiers. Across the nine primary datasets, WISP with random search achieves 70.20% mean Macro-F1, compared with 59.62% for the strongest of 18 external baselines. Controlled ablations and baseline comparisons indicate that recognition improves mainly when a representation adds motion patterns that the others lack, rather than when it represents the same pattern in a different way.

AI.tldr: 提出 WristHARBench 腕部加速度基准与 WISP 可组合表征空间，在九个腕部数据集上平均 Macro-F1 达 70.20%，超过最强基线 59.62%。
AI.motivation: 现有可穿戴人体活动识别基准混杂了不同身体部位的传感器，无法反映仅凭腕部（智能手表/手环、大型健康研究）能识别出何种活动。
AI.method: 构建 WristHARBench：统一参与者不重叠（participant-disjoint）评测协议，覆盖 9 个腕部加速度数据集与 2 个多通道惯性数据集；并假设不同活动在腕部运动中留下互补模式（局部形状、节律、时序顺序、跨轴关系），据此提出 WISP——将各类模式表征与兼容分类器组合的可组合表征空间，配合随机搜索。
AI.result: 九个主数据集上 WISP 平均 Macro-F1 为 70.20%，最强外部基线（18 个中）为 59.62%；消融与对比实验显示，性能提升主要来自引入其他表征缺失的运动模式，而非同一模式的不同表达方式。
AI.conclusion: 腕部单点活动识别需要互补性表征而非表征形式的多样化；该基准与分析方法为腕部 HAR 提供了标准化评测与设计指导。

title: From Observation to Explanation: Mechanistic Interpretability of LLM-Generated Code for Principled Repair
comment: This camera-ready version was accepted at the EASE 2026 doctoral symposium
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed software development, yet our understanding of how they generate code remains critically underdeveloped. We address this gap by triangulating evidence across three layers. Longitudinally, autonomous agent-attributed code is statistically indistinguishable from human code under a semantic modification definition (HR = 1.019, p = 0.490), yet attracts disproportionately corrective modifications in production (49.1% vs 37.9% human baseline). This finding demands a causal explanation. Empirically, existing benchmarks overestimate LLM capabilities: models that achieve 84 to 89% correctness on synthetic tasks attain only 24 to 35% on real-world class-level code. Behaviourally, detection systems reveal puzzling asymmetries: GPT-3.5 is far more detectable than modern models (AUC-ROC = 0.96, a 27-point gap), even though modern models produce mutually similar code structures; yet no single feature reliably distinguishes AI-generated from human code at the class level, and the leading commercial detector achieves only 15 to 64% recall. Together, these findings raise a question that empirical studies cannot answer: why do LLMs generate code with these properties? This thesis proposes mechanistic interpretability, a causal token-level circuit tracing, as the bridge between empirical observation and principled correction. By identifying the transformer circuits responsible for detectable stylistic signatures, hallucination patterns, and systematic defects, we aim to drive an agentic repair framework that intervenes at the causal source of defects rather than patching surface symptoms.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过纵向、经验与行为三层证据揭示LLM生成代码的谜题，并提出以机械可解释性（因果token级电路追踪）作为连接经验观察与原理性纠正的桥梁。
AI.motivation: LLM已改变软件开发，但人们对其如何生成代码的理解严重不足，且经验研究无法解释为何LLM生成的代码具备这些特性。
AI.method: 三角测量三层证据：纵向分析生产代码修改模式；经验对比合成任务与真实类级代码的正确率；行为分析检测系统的AUC-ROC、跨模型结构相似性及商业检测器召回率；进而提出因果token级电路追踪的机械可解释性方法。
AI.result: 代理归因代码与人类代码在语义修改定义下统计无差异（HR=1.019, p=0.490），但生产中更正性修改更多（49.1% vs 37.9%）；合成任务正确率84–89%而真实类级代码仅24–35%；GPT-3.5远更易检测（AUC-ROC=0.96，27点差距），无单一特征可靠区分，领先商业检测器召回率仅15–64%。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张通过识别负责可检测风格特征、幻觉模式与系统性缺陷的transformer电路，驱动在缺陷因果源头干预的代理修复框架，而非修补表面症状。

title: Following the Error Through a Compressed Network:An Angular Measure for FFN Weight Compression in ViT-L/16
summary: We study the compression of the 48 feed-forward network (FFN) matrices of the Vision Transformer ViT-L/16 to 2--8 bits with four schemes: a per-token grid, a fixed Gaussian Lloyd--Max table, a table fitted to the matrix, and a random-sign Hadamard rotation followed by the fixed table. We evaluate on 50,000 images. At 4 bits the top-1 accuracy of the four schemes lies within 0.8 points of the float32 model, while the agreement with its predictions ranges from 98.4\% to 94.4\%. We use the angular error between the compressed and the float32 residual stream, followed through the blocks, as a portable measure that ranks the schemes as the final classification does and shows where the ranking is built: with rotation the angle grows close to the square root of the number of blocks, the signature of independently accumulating errors, while the other schemes are amplified in the later blocks. The same measure shows that a scheme that is better on one block in isolation can be worse in the whole network. To address this inconsistency we introduce an angular measure of the spectrum of the output of a block, which in isolation orders the schemes as the whole network does where they diverge most. We support these observations with real samples and with statistically generated ones. The scope is one model, the FFN weights only, and float evaluation of compressed weights; no speed-up is claimed. The error measures and the sample generation, however, can be applied to other models and precisions.

AI.tldr: 研究了ViT-L/16的48个FFN权重矩阵在2–8比特下四种量化方案的压缩效果，提出用角度误差作为可迁移的评估指标，并引入块输出谱的角度度量来解释不同方案的排序来源。
AI.motivation: 现有工作缺乏一个能跨模型、跨精度可迁移的度量，来跟踪压缩误差在残差流中逐块累积的过程，并解释为何单块最优的方案在整网中可能变差。
AI.method: 对ViT-L/16的48个FFN矩阵用四种方案量化到2–8比特：(1) 每token网格；(2) 固定高斯Lloyd–Max码表；(3) 对矩阵拟合的码表；(4) 随机符号Hadamard旋转+固定码表。在5万张图像上评估，使用压缩与float32残差流之间的角度误差逐块追踪，并提出块输出谱的角度度量。
AI.result: 4比特时四种方案top-1与float32相差0.8个点以内，预测一致率98.4%–94.4%。角度误差的排序与最终分类排序一致；旋转方案的角度随块数近似按平方根增长（误差独立累积特征），其他方案在后段块被放大；单块上更优的方案在整网中可能更差，所提出的谱角度度量在方案分歧最大的地方与整网排序一致。用真实样本和统计生成样本均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 角度误差是可迁移的压缩评估指标，能解释排序的形成机制；谱角度度量可修正单块评估与整网表现的不一致。局限为单模型、仅FFN权重、float浮点评估、不声称加速，但误差度量与样本生成方法可推广到其他模型与精度。

title: Stackelberg Games with Convex Risk Measures
summary: Stackelberg games have important real-world applications in which reliable commitments require accounting for multiple sources of uncertainty. We study finite Stackelberg games in which environmental uncertainty makes each mixed strategy profile induce a random reward, and each player evaluates that reward with a convex monetary risk criterion. In reward form, it is a concave, monotone, translation-equivariant utility and also represented as penalized expected reward over distributions of environmental outcomes. We provide two conditions under which the follower has a unique continuous mixed response, which leads to inducible optimistic equilibrium. We show that even approximate equilibrium computation is NP Hard. We then derive an exact mathematical program with equilibrium constraints for the problem. We also develop an action entropy smoothed implicit-gradient method and prove an end-to-end additive approximation guarantee under the assumption that the gradient method reaches global optimality. We validate our scalability and other results with experiments on synthetic and real data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究环境不确定性下的有限Stackelberg博弈，玩家用凸货币风险准则（凹、单调、平移等变效用/惩罚期望奖励）评估随机收益；给出跟随者唯一连续混合反应的两个条件，得到可诱导乐观均衡，证明近似均衡计算NP难，建立带均衡约束的精确数学规划，并提出动作熵平滑隐梯度法及端到端加性近似保证，在合成与真实数据上验证。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中的Stackelberg博弈需可靠承诺，但存在多种不确定性来源；经典模型假设确定收益，无法刻画环境不确定性导致的随机收益及风险偏好，因此需要引入风险度量下的博弈建模与求解。
AI.method: 将每个混合策略组合诱导的随机收益用凸货币风险准则评估（凹、单调、平移等变效用，等价于对环境结果分布上的惩罚期望奖励）；给出跟随者唯一连续混合反应的两条件以构造可诱导乐观均衡；推导带均衡约束的数学规划（MPEC）精确形式；设计动作熵平滑的隐梯度方法，并在梯度法达到全局最优的假设下证明端到端加性近似保证；用合成与真实数据实验。
AI.result: 证明即使近似均衡计算也是NP难的；得到可诱导乐观均衡的存在性条件；MPEC精确建模；隐梯度法具端到端加性近似保证；实验验证可扩展性及其他结论。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为不确定性下风险敏感的Stackelberg博弈提供了均衡存在性刻画、复杂度结论与可扩展求解算法，兼顾理论保证与实验有效性。

title: Face Is Not All You Need: MIME Benchmark for Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM '26), November 10--14, 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
summary: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) is a fundamental task in multimedia understanding, where state-of-the-art methods have achieved prominent success relying on the assumption of complete, well-aligned multimodal inputs. However, real-world unconstrained scenarios often suffer from unpredictable modality degradation and information loss, leading to catastrophic performance collapse of existing MER models that heavily depend on facial cues as the core inference anchor. However, few systematic works evaluate model robustness under diverse, fine-grained incomplete settings, as prior works are limited to coarse-grained full-modality removal and neglect interpretable analysis of emotional reasoning. To bridge this gap, we formally define the Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition (IMER) task, which benchmarks model generalization and robustness under multi-grained modality and emotional information loss. We further construct MIME, a dedicated IMER benchmark with 2,000 video segments covering realistic fine-grained facial-detail degradation, severe facial degradation, and extreme full-modality loss, surpassing the limited coarse-grained settings of prior works. We also propose the Chain of Emotion (CoE) analysis paradigm with tailored metrics to dissect the fine-grained emotional cue perception and reasoning process of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Extensive experiments on seven mainstream MLLMs reveal that body language and scene context act as critical compensatory mechanisms under facial degradation, while a pronounced gap exists between models' basic visual perception ability and high-level cognitive reasoning. Our work provides a focused evaluation platform and actionable insights for advancing robust multimodal emotion recognition. Our dataset and code are public at https://yuxinokk.github.io/MIME.

AI.tldr: 论文定义不完整多模态情感识别（IMER）任务，构建MIME基准（2000个视频段，覆盖细粒度面部退化、严重面部退化、全模态缺失），并提出Chain of Emotion（CoE）分析范式，系统评测7个主流MLLM的鲁棒性与推理过程。
AI.motivation: 现有MER方法依赖完整且良好对齐的多模态输入，并以面部线索为核心推理锚点；真实场景中的模态退化与信息缺失会导致性能崩溃。已有工作仅做粗粒度整体模态移除，缺乏细粒度不完整设置下的系统评测与可解释的情感推理分析。
AI.method: 正式定义IMER任务，用于在多粒度模态与情感信息缺失下评测泛化与鲁棒性；构建MIME基准，含2000个视频段，覆盖真实场景下的细粒度面部细节退化、严重面部退化与极端全模态缺失；提出Chain of Emotion（CoE）分析范式并配套定制指标，用于剖析MLLM的细粒度情感线索感知与推理过程。
AI.result: 在7个主流MLLM上的大量实验表明：面部退化时，身体语言与场景上下文起到关键补偿作用；模型的基础视觉感知能力与高层认知推理能力之间存在明显差距。
AI.conclusion: 工作提供了聚焦的评测平台与可操作洞见，用于推进鲁棒的多模态情感识别；数据集与代码已公开。

title: torchtsetlin: Fast, Interpretable Tsetlin Machines for PyTorch
summary: The Tsetlin machine learns propositional rules with teams of Tsetlin automata that are driven by reward and penalty rather than gradients, so its models are interpretable by construction and cheap to evaluate. Its software, however, consists of C and CUDA kernels behind scikit-learn-style wrappers that sit outside the deep learning ecosystem. torchtsetlin implements the Tsetlin machine family as ordinary PyTorch modules: vanilla and weighted, coalesced, regression, convolutional over sequences, images and volumes, and dense per-pixel segmentation. The automata are a tensor buffer, so a model moves with .to(device), is saved with state_dict() and learns from a mini-batch with one update(x,y) call. Its core technique is a batched formulation of Type I and Type II feedback, in which automaton transitions become event counts realised as binomial draws, with one commit per mini-batch. On ten benchmarks taken from the existing libraries, it matches their accuracy, and on all but the two smallest it trains 2.4-10.9X faster than PyTsetlinMachineCUDA and 10.3-81.2X faster than tmu on the same GPU. The package is pure Python, MIT-licensed and on PyPI; every number in this paper is reproduced by one script. Code: https://github.com/vlbthambawita/torchtsetlin; package: https://pypi.org/project/torchtsetlin/.

AI.tldr: torchtsetlin 将 Tsetlin 机家族实现为原生 PyTorch 模块，自动化机状态作为张量缓冲区，并用批量化的 Type I/II 反馈（将状态转移转化为二项分布采样的事件计数、每个 mini-batch 一次提交）加速训练，在十个基准上精度持平，训练速度比 PyTsetlinMachineCUDA 快 2.4–10.9 倍、比 tmu 快 10.3–81.2 倍。
AI.motivation: Tsetlin 机基于奖励/惩罚而非梯度学习命题规则，模型天然可解释且推理开销低，但其现有软件是 C/CUDA 内核加 scikit-learn 风格封装，游离于深度学习生态之外，难以用 GPU 设备管理、模型保存和批训练等标准流程。
AI.method: 把 Tsetlin 机各变体（原始与加权、coalesced、回归、序列/图像/体数据的卷积、逐像素稠密分割）实现为普通 PyTorch 模块；自动化机作为张量缓冲区，支持 .to(device)、state_dict() 和单次 update(x,y) 训练；核心技术是 Type I 与 Type II 反馈的批量公式化，将自动机状态转移视为事件计数并以二项分布抽样实现，每个 mini-batch 只提交一次更新。
AI.result: 在取自现有库的十个基准上精度与现有实现相当；除两个最小基准外，同 GPU 下训练速度比 PyTsetlinMachineCUDA 快 2.4–10.9 倍，比 tmu 快 10.3–81.2 倍。软件为纯 Python、MIT 许可、发布于 PyPI，论文所有数值由单个脚本复现。
AI.conclusion: torchtsetlin 在保持 Tsetlin 机可解释性与精度的同时，将其无缝接入 PyTorch 生态并获得显著训练加速，且完全开源可复现。

title: Green ACO: An Energy-Aware Ant Colony Optimisation for the MAX-SAT Problem with EI/J Scheduling and Thompson Sampling
summary: NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems demand heavy computation, and this raises real environmental concerns, especially in regions with carbon-intensive power grids. This paper presents Green ACO, an energy-aware Ant Colony Optimisation algorithm for the MAXIMUM SATISFIABILITY (MAX-SAT) problem. At its core is an Expected Improvement per Joule (EI/J) scheduler. At every iteration, it picks the operator that best balances expected quality gain against expected energy cost. Three operators feed the scheduler: WalkSAT, Focused Variable Neighbourhood Search, and Clause-Restart Greedy, ranging from cheap and surgical to aggressive and costly. An offline dual-regime profiling phase calibrates these operators before the search even begins, and, combined with Thompson sampling, this reduces uninformed early operator choices; online call-count warm-up still occurs. A pre-dispatch guard rejects calls when their estimated energy cost, with a safety multiplier, exceeds the remaining budget. Sparse pheromone updates, pheromone caching across budgets, and stagnation-based early stopping trim energy use further, without hurting solution quality. The framework also incorporates a budget predictor that estimates the energy budget required for unseen instances. On four hard MAX-SAT reference instances, Green ACO reaches an average quality of 98.44%. This beats the standard ACO baselines by close to 3 points, while using only 986 J against 4,171 to 6,610 J for the strongest competitors, a six-and-a-half-fold gain in quality per joule. Under the Algerian grid's carbon intensity, this cuts CO$_2$e emissions by approximately 85% compared with the most energy-hungry baseline.

AI.tldr: Green ACO是一种面向MAX-SAT问题的能量感知蚁群优化算法，以"每焦耳期望改进"(EI/J)调度器为核心，在保证求解质量的同时大幅降低能耗，实现约6.5倍的"每焦耳质量"提升并减排约85% CO2e。
AI.motivation: NP-hard组合优化问题计算量大，在碳密集型电网地区带来真实环境负担；现有ACO等算法忽视能耗，缺乏能量感知的算子调度与预算管理机制。
AI.method: 提出EI/J调度器，每轮从WalkSAT、聚焦变量邻域搜索、子句重启贪心三种算子中，选择期望质量增益与期望能耗平衡最佳者；离线双区间剖析阶段结合Thompson采样预校准算子；设置预派发守卫，按能耗估计加安全系数拦截超预算调用；辅以稀疏信息素更新、跨预算信息素缓存、基于停滞的早停，以及预测未见实例能耗预算的预算预测器。
AI.result: 在四个困难MAX-SAT基准实例上平均质量达98.44%，比标准ACO基线高近3个百分点；仅耗986 J，而最强对比方法耗4171–6610 J，每焦耳质量提升约6.5倍；在阿尔及利亚电网碳强度下CO2e减排约85%。
AI.conclusion: 能量感知的算子调度与预算管理能在不损失解质量的前提下显著降低能耗与碳排放，为绿色组合优化提供了可行范式。

title: DM-Lab at TREC 2026 RAG: Multi-Query Retrieval, Ensemble Judging, and Claim-Pack Generation
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. TREC 2026 RAG Track. Code: https://github.com/Elyasirankhah/TREC-RAG-2026
summary: We present DM-Lab-RAG-2026, a framework developed for the TREC 2026 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) track. The framework integrates large-scale evidence retrieval and citation-grounded answer generation over the 553-million-document ClimbMix-400B corpus. The retrieval architecture combines multi-query BM25, reciprocal rank fusion, ensemble relevance assessment, listwise reranking, and adaptive retrieval depth. The generation pipeline employs a claim-first strategy to extract evidence-linked atomic claims, construct cited responses, and verify source support. Across 22 development topics, the retrieval system achieved a mean nDCG@30 of 0.604. In the official evaluation, it attained a set precision of 0.455 and a manual nugget gain of 0.910. Additional experiments examine the influence of reranking, evidence selection, and citation verification on system performance. The evaluation demonstrates the potential of diversified lexical retrieval and language-model-based relevance assessment for large-scale evidence discovery. It further identifies evidence preservation and structured answer construction as key considerations for reliable RAG. This work provides a reproducible framework for investigating retrieval effectiveness and evidence-grounded generation.

AI.tldr: DM-Lab-RAG-2026 是面向 TREC 2026 RAG 赛道的框架，在 5.53 亿文档的 ClimbMix-400B 语料上结合多查询 BM25、RRF、集成相关性评估、listwise 重排与自适应检索深度，并采用"claim-first"策略生成带引用的答案；开发集 nDCG@30=0.604，官方评测 set precision=0.455、人工 nugget gain=0.910。
AI.motivation: 面向 TREC 2026 RAG 赛道，需要在超大规模（5.53 亿文档）语料上实现有效证据检索，并生成可溯源、引用可靠的结构化答案，同时探究重排、证据选择与引用验证等环节的影响。
AI.method: 检索端：多查询 BM25 + 倒数排名融合（RRF）+ 集成式相关性评估 + listwise 重排 + 自适应检索深度。生成端：claim-first 策略，先抽取与证据关联的原子化断言，再构建带引用的回答并验证来源支撑。另设消融实验考察重排、证据选择与引用验证的作用。
AI.result: 22 个开发主题上平均 nDCG@30 为 0.604；官方评测 set precision 0.455，人工 nugget gain 0.910。
AI.conclusion: 多样化词法检索与基于语言模型的相关性评估在大规模证据发现中具有潜力；证据保全与结构化答案构建是可靠 RAG 的关键考量，该工作提供了可复现的研究框架。

title: Measuring and Teaching Language Model Agents to Act on Delayed Consequences
summary: Language model agents are increasingly asked to run ongoing multi-day operations rather than finish isolated single-turn tasks. In daily operations, today's choices reshape later observations and cash constraints because empty shelves hide lost walk-in demand, short-shipped customers quietly shrink future orders weeks later, and emergency buying drains working capital. We introduce SMB Bench, a calibrated 90-day wholesale simulator with 18 causally paired tasks and an 859-run frontier trace dataset, to ask what experience and learning signal make an agent better at noticing, attributing, and acting on the delayed consequences of its own decisions in unseen businesses. Across 16 frontier models, only 3 outperform a fixed buying rule; models often record a relevant diagnosis in their notes without changing later purchases in time, showing that diagnosing a problem, changing behavior, and improving a business are separate achievements. To study how experience improves those failures in an open model (Qwen3.8-27B), we used training-business records to identify operational rules and archived frontier quarters as starting states to continue from rather than transcripts to copy. On an unseen test business under identical evaluation instructions, the trained policy followed customer-protection commitments more consistently and reduced severe-loss quarters, while the additional profit benefit remained uncertain. Carrying those commitments through the quarter exposed the cost of fulfilling them, as early-quarter stocking habits left the buyer relying on emergency supply and a deteriorating supplier. The results separate recognizing a delayed effect, acting on it consistently, and coordinating surrounding decisions so that the response improves profit. SMB Bench connects these observations to a learning method by turning archived decisions and their consequences into reusable training experience.

AI.tldr: 提出 SMB Bench：90天批发模拟器（18个因果配对任务、859条前沿模型运行轨迹），考察智能体能否识别、归因并应对自身决策的延迟后果；16个前沿模型仅3个优于固定采购规则；用归档决策+后果作为可复用训练经验训练开源模型，能更一致地遵守客户保护承诺并减少巨亏季度，但利润提升不确定。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体被要求承担持续数天的运营任务而非单轮任务，而运营中今天的决策会延迟地重塑后续观测与现金约束（空货架隐藏流失需求、缺货交付悄悄萎缩未来订单、紧急采购消耗营运资金），现有评测缺乏对"延迟因果后果"的考察与可学习的经验来源。
AI.method: 构建校准的90天批发模拟器 SMB Bench，含18个因果配对任务与859条前沿模型运行轨迹；在16个前沿模型上评测，并与固定采购规则对比；再用训练业务记录提炼运营规则，将归档的前沿季度作为续跑起始状态（而非照抄对话），对Qwen3.8-27B进行训练，并在未见业务上以相同评测指令检验。
AI.result: 16个前沿模型中仅3个优于固定采购规则；模型常在笔记中写下正确诊断却未及时改变后续采购。训练后的策略在未见业务上更一致地遵守客户保护承诺、减少严重亏损季度，但额外利润收益仍不确定；跨季度履行承诺暴露其代价——早期补货习惯导致依赖紧急供应与恶化的供应商。
AI.conclusion: 识别延迟效应、持续一致地行动、以及协调周边决策使响应真正提升利润，是三件不同的事。SMB Bench 通过把归档决策及其后果转化为可复用训练经验，将评测观察与学习方法连接起来。

title: How Far Can LLMs Go in Generating Android Lint Checks from Natural Language?
comment: Accepted at ICSE 2027, Dublin, Ireland. 13 pages (11 pages plus 2 pages of references)
summary: Static analysis tools such as Android Lint, PMD, and CodeQL let developers add custom checks for project-specific rules. However, authoring a check is a demanding programming task: a rule can be stated in a few sentences, yet turning it into a working, tested check requires detailed knowledge of the analysis framework and its issue-detection logic. Recent work generates such checks with large language models (LLMs), but each system needs more than the natural language description a developer always has: a bug-fix patch, a CVE record, or a developer-written test suite to repair against. No prior work measures whether an LLM can turn a description into a working check, or what external knowledge it needs to do so. We introduce LintBench, a human-validated benchmark of 113 real-world Android Lint checks, each paired with a natural language description and its original test suite as a held-out oracle. We evaluate four LLMs, including proprietary and open-weight models. We compare prompting strategies, then evaluate execution-guided repair with and without retrieved API knowledge. Prompting alone reaches 30%-65% (pass@5) across models. Execution-guided repair and retrieval reach 57%-85% test-passing rates within five calls. Our results show that execution feedback raises the pass rate, while retrieved framework knowledge raises the compile rate, which reaches up to 99%. The framework knowledge helps the low-performing models the most, providing the knowledge they need to fix compilation errors. Of the generated checks that compile but fail their tests, 87% have false negatives, missing an issue the generated check should report. Based on our findings, getting the issue-detection logic right remains an open challenge. We release LintBench and the evaluation harness to support future work on generating Android Lint checks.

AI.tldr: 提出 LintBench，首个经人工验证的基准（113 个真实 Android Lint 检查），仅给定自然语言描述与留出测试套件，评测 LLM 能否生成可用的自定义静态检查，并量化执行反馈与检索知识的作用。
AI.motivation: 编写静态分析自定义检查门槛高：规则几句话即可表述，但要写成可编译、可测试的检查需深入掌握分析框架与问题检测逻辑。以往 LLM 生成检查的工作都额外依赖补丁、CVE 记录或开发者测试，缺少对"仅凭描述能否生成"以及所需外部知识的度量。
AI.method: 构建 LintBench：113 个真实 Android Lint 检查，每个配自然语言描述，原测试套件作为留出 oracle。评测 4 个 LLM（含闭源与开源权重），比较多种提示策略；再评估"执行引导修复"在有/无检索 API 知识时的效果。
AI.result: 仅提示时 pass@5 为 30%–65%；执行引导修复加检索在 5 次调用内达 57%–85% 测试通过率。执行反馈提升通过率，检索框架知识提升编译率至最高 99%，且对低性能模型帮助最大。编译通过但测试失败的检查中，87% 存在假阴性（漏报应报问题）。
AI.conclusion: 执行反馈与框架知识能显著提升编译与通过率，但"问题检测逻辑正确"仍是开放挑战；发布 LintBench 与评测框架以支持后续研究。

title: Fairness Evaluation for Diffusion and Flow Models Should Account for the Generation Path: Implications for Clinical Imaging
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 GenAI4Health Workshop Position Paper Track
summary: Medical image generation models are often evaluated using images produced by a single sampling procedure. However, diffusion and flow models can use different numbers of sampling steps, sampling schedules, or numerical solvers without changing their trained parameters. These changes may affect the generated images and the clinical measurements derived from them. We argue that fairness results obtained under one sampling procedure should not be assumed to hold under another, particularly when changes in sampling affect clinical task errors differently across patient groups. Building on previous work on medical image quality, accelerated sampling, generation dynamics, and generative model fairness, we examine why the sampling procedure should be considered part of the evaluated system. We define subgroup differences in clinical task error across sampling procedures and provide a mathematical example showing that two groups can have identical outputs under the exact dynamics and a reference sampler but different errors under an alternative sampler. We also extend this result to stochastic generation under shared noise. An exploratory experiment with an age-conditioned image generation model illustrates how changing the number and timing of sampling steps can alter image-derived measurements, although these differences do not establish clinical unfairness. We therefore argue that fairness evaluation should assess the sampling procedure used in practice and examine intermediate generation states when they help explain differences in clinically relevant errors across patient groups. Analysis code is available here https://github.com/rdharini2001/generation-path-fairness

AI.tldr: 该文指出扩散/流模型在固定参数下可通过改变采样步数、调度或求解器产生不同图像，因此仅基于单一采样流程的公平性结论不可靠，应将采样过程纳入被评估系统。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像生成模型的公平性评估通常只用一种采样流程生成图像，而扩散与流模型在训练参数不变时可用不同步数、采样调度或数值求解器生成差异图像，进而改变临床测量与临床任务误差。作者认为某一种采样下的公平性结果不能自动外推到另一种采样，尤其当采样变化对不同患者亚组的临床误差影响不一致时。
AI.method: 基于医学图像质量、加速采样、生成动力学与生成模型公平性等既有工作，论证采样流程应视为被评估系统的一部分；形式化定义不同采样流程下临床任务误差的亚组差异；给出数学示例说明两组在精确动力学与参考采样器下输出相同、但在替代采样器下误差不同，并将结论推广到共享噪声下的随机生成；用年龄条件图像生成模型进行探索性实验，改变采样步数与时间安排观察图像衍生测量的变化。
AI.result: 数学上证明了存在两亚组在精确动力学与参考采样器下输出完全一致、却在替代采样器下临床误差不同的情形，并在共享噪声的随机生成情形下成立；探索性实验显示改变采样步数与时间安排会改变图像衍生测量，但作者明确指出这些差异尚不足以确立临床不公平。
AI.conclusion: 公平性评估应针对实际部署所用的采样流程，并在有助于解释亚组间临床相关误差差异时考察中间生成状态；代码已公开于 https://github.com/rdharini2001/generation-path-fairness。

title: Finding Integral Stable Matchings is PPAD-Complete: Unimodular Hypergraphs, Network $b$-Matchings, and Kernels in Perfect Graphs
summary: Polyhedral integrality guarantees integral stable solutions in several classical stability problems: stable matchings in normal hypergraphs, stable $b$-matchings in unimodular hypergraphs, and kernels in clique-acyclic orientations of perfect graphs. Whether they can be computed efficiently has been a long-standing open question; for kernels in perfect graphs it has been open since the existence theorem of Boros and Gurvich in 1996. We show that, unless $PPAD\subseteq FP$, they cannot. Finding a stable matching is $PPAD$-complete already in linear unimodular hypergraphs with hyperedges of size at most three and vertex degrees at most three. Consequently, finding a kernel in a clique-acyclic orientation of a perfect graph is $PPAD$-hard even if all cliques have at most three vertices, answering an open question of Pass-Lanneau, Igarashi and Meunier, and stable matchings are $PPAD$-hard to find in balanced and in normal hypergraphs. This contrasts with the polynomial algorithm of Chandrasekaran and Kalathur for network hypergraphs. With capacities, even network hypergraphs are hard: University Dual Admission is $PPAD$-complete with capacities at most nine, so stable $b$-matching is $PPAD$-complete on network hypergraphs with hyperedges of size three. This yields $PPAD$-completeness for a natural class of hospitals/residents markets with couples where stable matchings always exist, and $PPAD$-hardness of computing the near-feasible stable matchings, where capacities are flexible. Both reductions are from PURE CIRCUIT with constant-size gadgets. For unit capacities we use a dual-rail encoding, a symmetry-breaking gadget made of two coupled $2\times2$ stable marriage markets, and a parity criterion on the bipartite incidence graph that certifies total unimodularity. We expect these tools to be useful for further hardness results about problems with guaranteed integral solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文证明多面体整数性保证存在的若干稳定解（正规超图稳定匹配、单模超图稳定b-匹配、完美图团无环定向核）在一般情况下是PPAD-完全的，即除非PPAD⊆FP否则无法高效计算。
AI.motivation: 稳定匹配、稳定b-匹配与完美图的核因多面体整数性而总存在整数解，但能否高效计算长期未决（如完美图核自Boros-Gurvich 1996存在性定理以来悬而未决），本文旨在给出计算复杂性的定论。
AI.method: 从PURE CIRCUIT进行归约，构造常数规模gadget；对单位容量采用双轨编码、由两个耦合的2×2稳定婚姻市场构成的对称破缺gadget，以及判定二分关联图全单模性的奇偶准则。
AI.result: 寻找稳定匹配在边规模≤3、顶点度≤3的线性单模超图中已PPAD-完全；完美图团无环定向的核在全为≤3团时PPAD-难，解答了Pass-Lanneau等人的问题；稳定匹配在平衡与正规超图中PPAD-难。带容量时即使网络超图也难：University Dual Admission在容量≤9时PPAD-完全，稳定b-匹配在三边网络超图上PPAD-完全；并推出含couple的医院-住院医师市场及近可行稳定匹配的PPAD-难。
AI.conclusion: 整数性保证存在并不保证可高效计算：这些稳定解问题与网络超图多项式算法形成对比，所提归约工具对后续关于保证整数解问题的困难性研究具有借鉴价值。

title: Faster, Smaller, and Better-Looking: Fast-GSVC for 2D Gaussian Video Coding
summary: 2D Gaussians have emerged as a promising explicit representation for videos. However, fitting Gaussians to a video sequence requires substantial computation, resulting in long encoding times. In this work, we present Fast-GSVC, a 2D Gaussian video codec that accelerates encoding while improving rate-distortion performance. We identify the key bottlenecks in 2DGS training and accelerate optimization through improved initialization, smoother yet more aggressive parameter updates, coarse-to-fine progressive Gaussian optimization, and optical-flow guidance for both Gaussian initialization and temporal propagation. We also discovered that the quantization fine-tuning process of the existing codec does not fully exploit temporal coherence between frames, leading to suboptimal compression. To address this, we preserve spatiotemporal correlations to maintain concentrated residuals and introduce temporal-aware quantization for further improved rate-distortion performance. In our experiments on the UVG dataset, Fast-GSVC reduces encoding time by up to 92.5%, corresponding to a 13.4X speedup over GSVC. At comparable PSNR, it reduces file size by up to 58%; at comparable bit-per-pixel, it improves PSNR by up to 2.5 dB. Project page: https://longanwang-cs.github.io/fastgsvc/.

AI.tldr: Fast-GSVC 是一个 2D Gaussian 视频编解码器，通过改进初始化、平滑且更激进的参数更新、粗到细渐进优化和光流引导来大幅加速编码，并用时空相关性保持与时序感知量化提升率失真性能，在 UVG 上实现最高 92.5% 编码时间减少（13.4 倍加速）和显著压缩与质量提升。
AI.motivation: 基于 2D Gaussians 的视频表示虽为显式且有前景，但对视频序列拟合高斯需要大量计算，导致编码时间过长，限制了其实际应用。同时现有编解码器的量化微调未充分利用帧间时序一致性，压缩效果次优。
AI.method: 针对训练瓶颈加速优化：(1) 改进初始化；(2) 更平滑但更激进的参数更新；(3) 粗到细渐进式高斯优化；(4) 光流引导，同时用于高斯初始化与时序传播。针对压缩：保持时空相关性使残差更集中，并引入时序感知量化以进一步改善率失真性能。
AI.result: 在 UVG 数据集上，编码时间最多减少 92.5%，相较 GSVC 实现 13.4 倍加速；在相近 PSNR 下文件大小最多减少 58%；在相近 bit-per-pixel 下 PSNR 最多提升 2.5 dB。
AI.conclusion: Fast-GSVC 在显著加速编码的同时改善了率失真性能，证明了初始化改进、渐进优化、光流引导与时序感知量化对 2D Gaussian 视频编码的有效性。

title: From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment
summary: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96\%$ coverage within $5\,\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63\%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38\%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improves all three axes with greater coverage gains on larger scenes. The project page is available at https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/

AI.tldr: 论文提出将场景级Scan-to-BIM建模转化为智能体3D编码任务，发布S2Bench基准（128个真实场景、5类领域、1028次重建），并提出并行异步协作机制；评估显示智能体可紧密拟合扫描几何但语义与工程约束推理仍薄弱。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体能将3D测量转成CAD几何，但重建建筑环境的工程模型需要语义解释与一致的建造约束，仅靠表面拟合不够，缺乏统一的任务形式化与评测基准。
AI.method: 将场景级Scan-to-BIM形式化为智能体3D编码任务；构建S2Bench数据集（公开+私有扫描、128个真实场景、专家参考模型）；提供共享框架让智能体用Python测量扫描、在实时CAD/BIM内核中构建带类别标签的构件并迭代改进代码；提出并行异步协作（主导者下发版本化任务、继续建模、整合受版本约束的提案）。
AI.result: 评测5个智能体与1个协作团队共1028次重建：扫描-模型残差能直接指导几何修复，但语义类别与建造关系推断需要联合几何、视觉与工程推理，智能体难以落地与验证。最强智能体在5cm内覆盖率96%，但mIoU仅63%；无智能体在超过38%的场景中通过全部工程检查。覆盖率与工程一致性随场景尺度增大而下降；以小模型组队可同时提升三项指标，且在大场景上覆盖提升更大。
AI.conclusion: 几何拟合已相对成熟，语义与工程约束是Scan-to-BIM的主要瓶颈；并行异步协作是有效的低成本改进方向，尤其在大型场景上。

title: On Monotonic Hamming Sphere Landscapes
summary: Monotonic Hamming Sphere Landscapes (MHSL) are introduced: binary landscapes whose fitness is nonincreasing with Hamming distance from a unique global optimum, while points on the same Hamming sphere may be ordered arbitrarily. The class includes OneMax, every nondecreasing unitation function with a unique optimum, and positive linear functions with sufficiently balanced weights. The one-to-one MHSL, called Hamming sphere encodings (HSE), are counted in total and up to hypercube symmetry and shown to be a vanishing fraction of all landscapes. For the elitist (1+1) EA, every MHSL in which no two spheres share a fitness value has the optimization-time distribution of OneMax, which with known results makes these landscapes the easiest for mutation rates below one half. The same equivalence and optimality are proved for a two-member genetic algorithm with tournament selection and no crossover, whose hitting time on these landscapes reduces to a chain with quadratically many states. All 40,320 one-to-one three-bit landscapes are then evaluated for the (1+1) EA and the two-member genetic algorithm under eight mutation rates, three crossover operators and two selection schemes. Below one half, the easiest symmetry classes are all and only the HSE; above one half they are the hardest. Differences among HSE are small and stem from selection and from the hypercube symmetries respected by mutation and crossover. Targeted five-bit experiments likewise find their fastest landscapes within the HSE class.

AI.tldr: 论文提出单调汉明球景观（MHSL）类，证明其中无重叠适应度值的景观在(1+1) EA下与OneMax同优化时间分布，并给出计数与经验验证。
AI.motivation: 希望刻画"最容易优化"的适应度景观类别，将OneMax的最优性推广到更广的景观族，并理解突变率、选择与交叉如何影响此性质。
AI.method: 定义MHSL（适应度随到唯一全局最优点的汉明距离非增，同球面点可任意排序）；对一一对应的MHSL（HSE）进行计数（总数及超立方体对称下）。对(1+1) EA与两成员遗传算法（锦标赛选择、无交叉）做理论分析，并用全部40,320个三位一一景观及五维实验（8种突变率、3种交叉、2种选择）验证。
AI.result: HSE仅占所有景观的极小比例；无重叠适应度值的MHSL在(1+1) EA下与OneMax优化时间分布相同，在突变率<1/2时为最容易；两成员GA亦得相同等价与最优性，命中时间化为二次状态数的链。实验显示<1/2时最易对称类恰为全部HSE，>1/2时转为最难；HSE之间差异小，源于选择及变异/交叉保持的超立方体对称。
AI.conclusion: MHSL/HSE为"易优化景观"提供了统一理论框架，OneMax的极端最优性可推广，且其难易随突变率翻转；景观的对称性与算子一致性是细微差异来源。

title: Beyond Relevance: An Empirical Study of Multimodal LLMs for Diversity-Aware Recommendation Reranking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising rerankers for recommendation, yet most existing approaches rely on textual item descriptions and primarily focus on relevance. In visually oriented domains such as video streaming, item images provide complementary signals that may also inform recommendation diversity. This raises two questions: when does visual information improve recommendation quality, and can multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) enhance relevance and diversity simultaneously? We investigate these questions through a training-free, diversity-aware multimodal reranking framework that jointly incorporates item images, textual metadata, and user interaction histories. We conduct an empirical study across three public Amazon Review datasets and an industrial Amazon Prime Video dataset, using both open-source and proprietary MLLMs. Our results reveal substantial domain-dependent effects: adding visual information yields up to 121.9% relative improvement in NDCG@5 on Prime Video, while producing limited or inconsistent gains on product recommendation datasets. Furthermore, MLLM-based reranking improves both relevance and category-diversity-sensitive ranking quality over a sequential recommendation baseline, achieving up to 71.0% improvement in NDCG@5 and 14.1% in $α$-NDCG@5 on Prime Video. These findings highlight the conditional value of visual information and the potential of training-free MLLMs for relevance- and diversity-aware recommendation reranking.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态大模型（MLLM）用于推荐重排序时视觉信息的价值，提出免训练、兼顾多样性的多模态重排序框架，并在三个Amazon Review数据集和工业级Prime Video数据集上验证其效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的推荐重排序多依赖文本描述且主要关注相关性，忽略了图像信号在视频等视觉导向领域中对多样性的潜在作用。作者希望回答两个问题：视觉信息何时能提升推荐质量，以及MLLM能否同时提升相关性与多样性。
AI.method: 提出一种免训练、多样性感知的多模态重排序框架，联合利用物品图像、文本元数据与用户交互历史；采用开源与商业MLLM，在三个公开Amazon Review数据集和一个工业级Amazon Prime Video数据集上进行实证研究。
AI.result: 视觉信息的效果显著依赖领域：在Prime Video上加入视觉信息使NDCG@5最高相对提升121.9%，而在商品推荐数据集上增益有限或不一致。基于MLLM的重排序相比序列推荐基线，在Prime Video上NDCG@5最高提升71.0%、α-NDCG@5提升14.1%，同时改善相关性与类别多样性敏感的排序质量。
AI.conclusion: 视觉信息的价值是条件性的（领域相关），免训练MLLM在兼顾相关性与多样性的推荐重排序方面具有实际潜力。

title: RefineKV: Query-Adaptive KV Cache Compression via Attention-Error Bounds
summary: Repeatedly accessing the full key--value (KV) cache is a major bottleneck in long-context language model decoding. We find that small query-specific subsets can accurately approximate full attention, yet their union covers nearly the entire cache, motivating query-adaptive access for the KV cache. A natural approach is to split the KV cache into clusters, using compact representatives for clusters that incur negligible error while expanding the rest to their original KV entries. We derive a selection criterion from an upper bound on attention-output error, which reveals two complementary factors governing the error: importance measures the impact of a cluster, while distortion measures how faithfully the cluster can be represented. Based on this criterion, we propose RefineKV, a decoding-time query-adaptive KV compression method. Experiments on two models and three benchmarks demonstrate that RefineKV retains near-full-attention quality while achieving up to 7.6x speedup in the attention phase and 1.66x faster decoding, establishing a new quality-latency Pareto frontier.

AI.tldr: RefineKV 是一种解码时的查询自适应 KV 缓存压缩方法，通过聚类与代表性表示平衡"重要性"与"失真"，在保持接近全注意力质量的同时最高实现 7.6 倍注意力阶段加速和 1.66 倍解码加速。
AI.motivation: 长上下文解码中反复访问完整 KV 缓存是主要瓶颈。作者发现：每个查询对应的少量 KV 子集即可准确逼近全注意力，但不同查询的子集并集几乎覆盖整个缓存，因此需要按查询自适应地访问 KV 缓存，而非静态压缩。
AI.method: 将 KV 缓存划分为簇，对误差可忽略的簇使用紧凑代表，其余簇展开为原始 KV 条目。从注意力输出误差上界推导出选择准则，包含两个互补因素：重要性（簇对输出的影响）与失真（簇被代表时的保真度）。据此提出 RefineKV 解码时方法。
AI.result: 在两个模型、三个基准上实验，RefineKV 保持接近全注意力质量，注意力阶段最高 7.6 倍加速，整体解码 1.66 倍加速，建立了新的质量-延迟帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 查询自适应的 KV 访问优于静态压缩，基于重要性-失真理论准则的簇级选择能在质量与延迟间取得更优权衡。

title: SecretSifter: A Runtime Secret-Detection Engine for Live Web Traffic
comment: Version of record, published open access in SoftwareX under CC BY 4.0. 16 pages
summary: Credentials embedded in client-delivered web artifacts, such as minified JavaScript bundles, webpack chunks, server-side-rendered state objects, and JSON or XML API responses, form a runtime attack surface that repository-time (shift-left) secret scanners do not observe, because the credential enters the served artifact at build time or at runtime, after every source-code gate has passed. This paper presents SecretSifter, an open-source runtime secret-detection engine that inspects live web traffic and reports secret-grade credentials at the point they are delivered to the browser. The engine combines format-anchored and context-gated detection rules, semantic key-name extraction, Shannon-entropy scoring, and dedicated detection of hardcoded CryptoJS/AES material across the full served surface. SecretSifter ships as three editions over one shared detection core: a Burp Suite extension, a Chrome extension, and a standalone Windows and macOS desktop application, with a Bearer-authenticated REST and MCP interface for automation. On a 198-value benchmark of real production client-exposed values (GT-198), the deterministic detection stage reached 79.8% recall at 86.8% precision in default configuration, the highest F1 of any system evaluated. The detection core is released under an open-source (MIT) license, and a de-identified reproducibility bundle and a public synthetic demo target are provided.

AI.tldr: SecretSifter 是一个开源运行时密钥检测引擎，通过检查实时 Web 流量在凭据交付给浏览器的时刻发现密钥级凭据，弥补 shift-left 扫描器的盲区。
AI.motivation: 嵌入在客户端交付产物（压缩 JS 包、webpack chunk、SSR state、JSON/XML 响应）中的凭据在构建或运行时才进入被服务产物，源代码仓库阶段的扫描器无法观察，因此形成运行时攻击面。
AI.method: 引擎结合格式锚定与上下文门控规则、语义键名提取、Shannon 熵评分，以及针对硬编码 CryptoJS/AES 材料的专门检测，覆盖全部被服务面；同一检测核心提供三个版本：Burp Suite 扩展、Chrome 扩展、Windows/macOS 桌面应用，并提供 Bearer 认证的 REST 与 MCP 自动化接口。
AI.result: 在包含 198 个真实生产客户端暴露值的 GT-198 基准上，确定性检测阶段默认配置达到 79.8% 召回率与 86.8% 精确率，为所评估系统中最高 F1。
AI.conclusion: 检测核心以 MIT 开源发布，并提供去标识化复现包与公开合成演示目标，便于复现与评估。

title: Adversarial Attacks Expose Path-Dependent Failures in Discrete Medical Image Tokenizers
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures, 18 tables. Accepted at the GenAI4Health Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026, Sydney
summary: Discrete image tokenizers convert medical images into token sequences that downstream models either decode into an image for a classifier (the reconstruction path), classify directly (the token path), or feed to a generative multimodal model. We ask whether imperceptible input perturbations can break these systems through the tokenizer alone. We evaluate four tokenizers on three imaging modalities and extend the strongest attack to a deployed generative model. Our central finding is path-dependence: the same tokenizer fails in opposite ways depending on how its output is used. A supervised attack collapses diagnostic accuracy on the reconstruction path, with ROC AUC falling to $\leq 0.013$ at $ε=2/255$ on all four tokenizers, while sparing the token path. An unsupervised, label-free attack does the reverse; its damage concentrates in the multi-codebook tokenizers, worst in MedITok, whose token-path AUC falls from 0.919 to 0.239. The same label-free attack transfers to LLaVA-Med, a frozen medical vision-language model built on MedITok, making it report proliferative diabetic retinopathy in a healthy retina or call a malignant lesion benign, without access to the question, answer, or language-model gradients. Harm is driven by how far the attack moves the tokenizer's internal representation, not by how many tokens change: on the learned-codebook tokenizers, a control attack that changes nearly all tokens but moves the representation less leaves every path and answer intact. Domain-specific pretraining does not provide robustness: MedITok has the best clean accuracy yet is the most fragile, more so than UniTok, its general-domain counterpart. None of six candidate defenses repairs every failure mode, and several fail once the attacker optimizes against the defense directly. Medical tokenizer robustness must therefore be evaluated per downstream path, against an adaptive adversary.

AI.tldr: 离散医学图像分词器的脆弱性取决于其输出用途：同一分词器在"重建路径"与"token路径"上以相反方式失效，且无标签攻击可迁移至LLaVA-Med诱发临床错误；危害由内部表征位移而非token改变数量驱动。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分词器的输出可有多种下游用法（解码重建→分类器、直接token分类、或喂给生成式多模态模型）。作者想知道：仅通过分词器本身，不可感知的输入扰动能否攻破这些系统，以及分词器鲁棒性是否会随下游使用路径不同而不同。
AI.method: 在三种成像模态上评测四种分词器；先用有监督攻击，再用无监督（无标签）攻击做对照，对比重建路径与token路径的表现；将最强攻击迁移到基于MedITok的冻结医学视觉语言模型LLaVA-Med（不访问问题、答案或语言模型梯度）；设置"改变大多数token但表征位移较小"的控制攻击以区分机制；并以六种候选防御及自适应攻击进行压力测试。
AI.result: 有监督攻击在重建路径上使ROC AUC在ε=2/255时降至≤0.013（四种分词器全部），但几乎不影响token路径；无标签攻击效果相反，在多码本分词器上损害集中，MedITok最严重，token路径AUC由0.919降至0.239。该无标签攻击迁移到LLaVA-Med，使其把健康视网膜判为增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变、把恶性病变称为良性。控制攻击（几乎改变所有token但表征位移较小）不破坏任何路径或答案。MedITok干净精度最好却最脆弱，甚于通用领域的UniTok。六种防御均无法修复全部失效模式，部分在自适应攻击下失效。
AI.conclusion: 医学分词器鲁棒性必须按下游路径分别评估，并针对自适应对手测试；领域专用预训练不提供鲁棒性，反而可能加剧脆弱性。

title: It Pays to Brag? On Counterfactual Fair Credit
summary: Intellectual work, such as software, legal documents, and scientific results, typically builds on the work of others, and the same end product can often be obtained in several different ways. When assigning credit for such work, it is not clear whether credit should go according to the way the work was actually produced or also consider counterfactual ways of obtaining it. We study this question by generalizing Shapley values to account for counterfactual ways of obtaining the same result. We show that the fairness axioms of efficiency, nullity, and submodularity (in particular, additivity) are incompatible with incentivizing creators to maximize social welfare. In fact, fair credit can uniquely incentivize arbitrarily small welfare relative to the optimum. We also show that without submodularity, incentive compatibility is achievable, and that the four classical fairness axioms uniquely determine the Shapley value and prohibit dependence on counterfactual outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文将Shapley值推广到考虑"反事实"产生方式的情形，证明效率、无效性与次模性(特别是可加性)三条公理与激励创造者最大化社会福利不兼容，公平信用可能只激励出任意小的相对福利；去掉次模性后激励相容可实现，而四条经典公理唯一决定Shapley值并禁止依赖反事实结果。
AI.motivation: 智力工作(软件、法律文书、科学成果)常建立在他人工作之上，且同一成果可有多种获得方式。分配信用时，是否应依据实际产生路径，还是也应考虑反事实的替代路径，这一点并不清楚，本文正是要研究该问题。
AI.method: 将Shapley值推广，使其纳入"获得同一结果的反事实方式"（反事实贡献/路径），并在此框架下分析公平公理(效率、无效性、次模性/可加性)与激励相容性之间的关系。
AI.result: 效率、无效性、次模性(含可加性)与"激励创造者最大化社会福利"不相容；公平信用可能仅能激励出相对最优任意小的福利。若放弃次模性，则激励相容可达成；四条经典公平公理唯一确定Shapley值，并禁止信用依赖于反事实结果。
AI.conclusion: 信用分配中"公平"与"激励社会福利最大化"存在本质张力：坚持经典公理体系就须排除对反事实路径的依赖；欲实现激励相容则需放松次模性等公理。

title: Teacher-Guided Multimodal Dual Representation Reconstruction for Egocentric Human Activity Recognition
summary: Multimodal Egocentric Human Activity Recognition (Ego-HAR) leverages complementary cues from first-person vision (V) and inertial sensor data (S) to recognize daily activities, where video mainly captures appearance and object-related context while inertial signals capture motion cues that video may miss. However, existing pre-training methods typically supervise the fused representation with a single joint objective, which may underemphasize the complementarity between the two modalities and limit the model's ability to learn from distinct modality-oriented signals. To address this issue, we propose Multimodal Dual Representation Reconstruction (MDR2), a teacher-guided pre-training framework in which frozen, label-informed video and inertial teachers each provide dense, modality-specific targets to a multimodal student trained on temporally sparse inputs. On the EvIs-Kitchen dataset, MDR2 improves noun/verb F1-macro over the supervised M-Baseline by 9.20/6.17 points at K=4 video key frames and by 1.21/1.82 points at K=32. These results show that MDR2 consistently achieves higher mean recognition performance across the evaluated video-observation settings under the unified backbone setting, with more pronounced gains under sparse inputs.

AI.tldr: MDR2是一个教师引导的多模态双表示重建预训练框架，通过冻结的、含标签信息的视频教师和惯性教师分别为多模态学生提供密集的模态专属目标，学生基于时间稀疏输入训练，在EvIs-Kitchen上显著提升识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Ego-HAR预训练方法通常用单一联合目标监督融合表示，可能低估视频与惯性模态间的互补性，限制模型从不同模态导向信号中学习的能力。
AI.method: 提出多模态双表示重建（MDR2）教师引导预训练框架：使用冻结的、标签引导的视频教师与惯性教师，各自为在时间稀疏输入上训练的多模态学生提供密集、模态专属的重建目标。
AI.result: 在EvIs-Kitchen数据集上，相比有监督M-Baseline，K=4视频关键帧时名词/动词F1-macro提升9.20/6.17分，K=32时提升1.21/1.82分，稀疏输入下增益更明显。
AI.conclusion: MDR2在统一骨干网络设置下，在各视频观测设置中均取得更高的平均识别性能，且在稀疏输入条件下优势更突出，验证了模态专属监督对利用模态互补性的有效性。

title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
summary: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time. Existing harnesses such as VISTA improve the first two, yet turn each model call into at most one action, so the agent acts only as often as its model thinks. We introduce AutoPILOT, which changes the third: in each model call, the model can send a primitive action, start an open-loop macro, or write a closed-loop controller that keeps playing from the screen without further model calls until it hands control back. To evaluate agents in real-time games, we build AFK-Bench, 120 diverse browser games grouped by how they respond to inaction and playable in real time or with the clock paused. With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time success against 38.3% for VISTA, and on GameWorld it keeps 80.0% in real time while VISTA drops from 84.1% to 42.9%. Its gains hold across models, and it reaches VISTA's final success rate at a fifth of its API cost. Our results suggest that how a harness turns model outputs into actions over time is a central yet underexplored part of agent design, and we hope AutoPILOT and AFK-Bench will serve as a foundation for agents in a world that does not wait.

AI.tldr: 论文指出多模态基础模型在实时游戏中表现落后的瓶颈在于"harness"（决定模型看到什么、记住什么、以及输出如何随时间转化为动作）。提出 AutoPILOT，让单次模型调用可输出原始动作、开环宏或闭环控制器，从而在无模型调用时也能持续行动；并构建 AFK-Bench（120 款浏览器游戏，可按实时或暂停时钟游玩）进行评测。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在"游戏等待模型"时表现良好，但游戏持续运行时就失败。分析发现差距主要来自 harness：VISTA 等已有工作改善了"看什么"和"记住什么"，但每次模型调用最多只产生一个动作，导致智能体行动频率受限于模型思考频率，无法匹配实时游戏节奏。
AI.method: AutoPILOT 改变"输出如何转化为动作"这一环：每次模型调用中，模型可选出三类输出之一——(1) 单个原始动作；(2) 启动开环宏；(3) 编写闭环控制器，在无进一步模型调用的情况下持续依据屏幕画面行动，直至交还控制权。同时构建 AFK-Bench，含 120 款多样浏览器游戏，按对"无操作"的响应方式分组，支持实时与暂停两种模式。
AI.result: 在同等预算下，GPT-6.1 Sol 配 AutoPILOT 在实时模式成功率 68.6%，VISTA 为 38.3%；在 GameWorld 上 AutoPILOT 保持 80.0%，而 VISTA 从 84.1% 跌至 42.9%。增益跨模型成立，且以约五分之一的 API 成本达到 VISTA 的最终成功率。
AI.conclusion: harness 如何随时间将模型输出转化为动作，是智能体设计中核心但被低估的一环；AutoPILOT 与 AFK-Bench 可为"不会等待的世界"中的智能体研究提供基础。

title: Which Model Belongs in the Loop? Evaluating Fitness Functions for Network Topology Optimization with a Quality-Diversity Algorithm
comment: This preprint is currently under peer review
summary: Network topology optimization (NTO) can reduce redispatch cost by rerouting power flows in transmission systems. To approach NTO, a complex combinatorial problem, gradient-free optimization algorithms that leverage diversity have shown promising results. These algorithms rely on frequent evaluations of candidate topologies by fitness functions. Recent work has shown that fast DC power flow-based fitness functions can serve this purpose. However, DC power flow fitness functions can misjudge the cost and feasibility of topologies, potentially leading to wrong operational decisions. Understanding the impact of fitness function accuracy on optimization performance is therefore crucial. This study compares the optimization performance of four fitness functions based on DC and AC power flow and on DC and AC optimal power flow. Furthermore, we propose a ranking-based metric to estimate the optimization performance of a fitness function on a curated dataset. Case studies cover the IEEE 118-bus case with 50 congested operating points and a 793-bus case for validation. Results show that optimal power flow-based fitness functions perform better in the optimization loop than power flow-based ones. Additionally, the results indicate that the metric can predict the optimization performance order of the fitness functions, but only if the distribution shift between the curated dataset and the search path of the optimization is small.

AI.tldr: 该文比较了基于DC/AC潮流与DC/AC最优潮流的四种适应度函数在电网拓扑优化(NTO)中的优化表现，并提出一种基于排序的指标来估计适应度函数的优化性能，在IEEE 118节点和793节点算例上验证。
AI.motivation: NTO可降低再调度成本，但属复杂组合问题，依赖多样性无梯度算法，而这些算法需频繁用适应度函数评估候选拓扑。快速DC潮流适应度函数虽可行，却可能误判成本与可行性、导致错误运行决策，因此亟需理解适应度函数精度对优化性能的影响。
AI.method: 比较四种适应度函数（基于DC潮流、AC潮流、DC最优潮流、AC最优潮流）在优化循环中的表现；并提出一个基于排序的度量指标，在策展数据集上估计适应度函数的优化性能。算例采用IEEE 118节点（50个阻塞运行点）与793节点算例作验证。
AI.result: 在优化循环中，基于最优潮流的适应度函数优于仅基于潮流的函数。此外，所提指标能够预测各适应度函数的优化性能排序，但仅在策展数据集与优化搜索路径之间的分布偏移较小时成立。
AI.conclusion: OPF类适应度函数更契合NTO优化循环；排序度量可作为性能预判工具但受分布偏移限制，需注意因DC模型误差带来的决策风险。

title: The abc index: Exact Retrieval for Learned Sparse Representations
summary: In learned sparse retrieval (LSR), queries have tens of terms with learned weights, on which classic dynamic pruning is believed to fail, and approximate indexes such as Seismic and HNSW are considered faster than exact ones. We challenge this view with abc, an exact index built only from standard IR techniques: term-at-a-time (TAAT) evaluation, Block-Max MaxScore, binary packing and doc-id reordering. They are combined in a new design and engineered for modern CPUs. On MS MARCO encoded with four LSR models, the abc index is the fastest exact index at every k: 6.5-84x faster than the exact search of Qdrant, 13-55x faster than that of Lucene, and 2.9-18x faster than BMP with an index 5-7x smaller. Against approximate indexes, it takes 1.5-3.6x less space, and its latency grows much more slowly with k: they are up to 4.3x faster at k=10, but at k=1000 it overtakes them, by up to 7.4x. Exactness comes with an extra benefit: there are no parameters to tune.

AI.tldr: 提出 abc：仅用经典 IR 技术（TAAT、Block-Max MaxScore、二进制打包、doc-id 重排）构建的精确稀疏检索索引，在 MS MARCO 上比 Qdrant、Lucene 等精确检索快 6.5-84x/13-55x，且空间更小、随 k 增长更慢。
AI.motivation: 领域内普遍认为：学习式稀疏检索（LSR）中查询含数十个带权词项，经典动态剪枝会失效，因此 Seismic、HNSW 等近似索引被认为比精确索引更快。作者要挑战这一观点。
AI.method: 仅用标准 IR 技术构建精确索引：逐词项（TAAT）评估、Block-Max MaxScore 动态剪枝、二进制打包、doc-id 重排；以新设计组合并针对现代 CPU 工程优化。
AI.result: 在 4 个 LSR 模型编码的 MS MARCO 上，abc 在所有 k 下都是最快的精确索引：比 Qdrant 精确检索快 6.5-84x、比 Lucene 快 13-55x、比 BMP 快 2.9-18x 且索引小 5-7x。与近似索引相比，占用空间少 1.5-3.6x；k=10 时慢至多 4.3x，但 k=1000 时反超至多 7.4x。
AI.conclusion: 经典 IR 技术在 LSR 场景仍具竞争力，精确检索可在空间、延迟（大 k）上优于近似索引，且无需调参。

title: A world model for longitudinal health-trajectory prediction in older adults across multinational cohorts
summary: Aging is characterized by continuously evolving health states, yet most existing prediction models focus on static health risk at isolated time points rather than explicitly modelling how health trajectories unfold over time. We developed a health world model based on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture to represent evolving health states and simulate future trajectories under specified actions. The model combines a state encoder, an action- and context-conditioned predictor, a stop-gradient target encoder, and clinical outcome heads. We trained the model on the US Health and Retirement Study (HRS) and evaluated it without refitting in the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA) and the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS). Open-loop evaluation assessed discrimination and calibration for mortality and worsening of activities of daily living (ADL) and instrumental activities of daily living (IADL). In the held-out HRS test set, the areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROCs) for mortality, ADL worsening, and IADL worsening were 0.89, 0.93, and 0.93 at the first horizon and 0.84, 0.84, and 0.85 at the fifth horizon, respectively. Predicted risks stratified subsequent outcomes across horizons. Across the evaluated horizons, mortality AUROC ranged from 0.867 to 0.881 in ELSA and from 0.796 to 0.801 in CHARLS. Simulated trajectories preserved the expected risk ordering across predefined action regimes. In counterfactual simulations, changes in lifestyle actions shifted predicted risks in directions consistent with observed associations. The model provides a framework for longitudinal risk prediction and action-conditioned simulation in older adults.

AI.tldr: 基于联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)构建"健康世界模型"，用状态编码器、动作/情境条件预测器和停止梯度目标编码器表征衰老健康状态演变，在HRS训练并在ELSA、CHARLS外部无再训练验证，实现纵向风险预测与动作条件反事实模拟。
AI.motivation: 衰老是持续演变的过程，但现有预测模型多聚焦孤立时间点的静态健康风险，未显式建模健康轨迹如何随时间展开，也缺乏在指定干预动作下模拟未来轨迹的能力。
AI.method: 采用Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture构建健康世界模型，含状态编码器、动作与情境条件预测器、停止梯度目标编码器及临床结局预测头。在HRS训练，并在ELSA与CHARLS上不重新拟合进行外部验证；用开环评估检验死亡及ADL/IADL恶化的判别力与校准，并开展动作条件下的轨迹模拟与反事实分析。
AI.result: HRS留出测试集首期AUROC为0.89/0.93/0.93（死亡/ADL/IADL恶化），第五期为0.84/0.84/0.85；预测风险可分层后续结局。外部验证死亡AUROC在ELSA为0.867–0.881，CHARLS为0.796–0.801。模拟轨迹在预设动作方案下保持预期风险排序，反事实模拟中生活方式动作改变使风险朝与观察关联一致的方向变化。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为老年人群提供纵向风险预测与动作条件模拟的统一框架，具备跨队列可迁移性，但主要依赖观察数据关联，反事实结论需进一步因果验证。

title: Jailbreaks Are Global or Regional? A Controlled Study of Scale and Geolocation Effects on LLM Safety Verification
summary: Safety tests are used to compare language models and to decide where they can be deployed. Their main number, the attack success rate (ASR), can only be compared across models if nothing but the model changes. We test two factors that are usually assumed away: the size of the model and the place a request seems to come from. We evaluate twelve models from 0.5B to 671B parameters with a paired two-phase protocol (plain harmful prompts, then the same requests inside published jailbreak templates). We also send identical prompts through VPN exit nodes in five cities on three continents. Inside the Llama and Qwen families, Phase~2 ASR falls steeply with size (Qwen2.5: 70.8\% at 0.5B, 51.2\% at 7B, 12.6\% at 72B). Wrapping shifts every model by a similar amount on the log-odds scale (1.7 to 2.9); small models shift slightly more, but that gap nearly vanishes when we allow for judge false positives. Parameter count is a weak proxy for safety: Phi-3.5-mini (3.8B) has less than half the ASR of Llama-3.2-3B and Gemma-2-2B, and Mixtral-8x7B is far weaker than 70B dense models. Judge agreement falls as ASR rises ($r=-0.96$), so ASR gaps between sizes carry unequal measurement error; the size gap survives a stress test, but Phi-3.5-mini's lead does not. A small activation probe is consistent with Phi-3.5-mini keeping a clear refusal/compliance split under wrapping while Qwen2.5-0.5B loses it. We detect no effect of request location (permutation $p\ge0.18$ for three models). The test is limited: it could only detect a true between-city spread of about 2--5 points or a single-city shift of about 5--8 points, and most hosted models were reached through a gateway that may hide the exit city from the model provider. We close with a reporting checklist for safety verification.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验了两个通常被忽略的因素——模型规模与请求来源地——对越狱攻击成功率(ASR)可比性的影响，发现ASR随模型规模显著下降、对来源地无检测到效应，并强调ASR测量的误差不均等性，提出安全验证报告清单。
AI.motivation: 安全测试中的攻击成功率(ASR)只有在"仅模型变化"时才能跨模型比较，但实践中模型规模与请求来源地这两个因素常被假设不影响结果，可能破坏可比性，需实证检验。
AI.method: 采用配对两阶段协议（纯有害提示 + 相同请求嵌入已发表越狱模板），评估12个0.5B–671B参数的模型；并通过三大洲五城市的VPN出口节点发送相同提示，检验请求来源地效应；辅以激活探针与评判者一致性分析。
AI.result: Llama与Qwen家族中Phase 2 ASR随规模陡降（Qwen2.5：0.5B为70.8%，7B为51.2%，72B为12.6%）；模板包装使各模型在log-odds尺度上偏移相似(1.7–2.9)，小模型略多但考虑评判假阳性后差距几乎消失；参数规模是安全性的弱代理（Phi-3.5-mini优于Llama-3.2-3B与Gemma-2-2B，Mixtral-8x7B远弱于70B稠密模型）；评判一致性随ASR升高下降(r=-0.96)；激活探针显示Phi-3.5-mini在包装下保持清晰的拒绝/顺从分化；未检测到请求来源地效应(置换p≥0.18)。
AI.conclusion: ASR跨规模比较存在不等的测量误差，规模差距通过压力测试但Phi-3.5-mini的优势不稳健；来源地效应受检测灵敏度(~2–5点城市间、~5–8点单城市)及网关可能隐藏出口城市的限制；论文提出安全验证报告清单。

title: Vision-Language Truck Driving Advisories Grounded in Provincial Rules and Forecast Risks
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. This manuscript has been submitted to the 38th IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV 2027)
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can generate context-aware driving advisories, but their outputs may conflict with road conditions or traffic rules, and they typically address a hazard only once it is visible. This matters for long-haul trucking, where heavy trucks need long stopping distances and a single trip may cross several jurisdictions with different traffic regulations. This paper proposes a data generation and distillation framework that integrates structured scene understanding, risk forecasting, and traffic-rule retrieval to generate truck driving decisions and natural-language advisories, with a consistency check on every record. The records, written by an 8B teacher, are then used to distill a 3B-parameter student model for onboard deployment. We also introduce a dashcam dataset covering four Canadian provinces, comprising 11,142 annotated lane-marking frames and 9,494 driving segments. On held-out driving data across all four provinces, the student passes the consistency check in 94.6% of the segments, against 20.2% for the untuned 8B teacher, and announces 26.2% of the risks in the next 10 to 30 seconds before they appear. Of the generated advisories, 97.7% conform to the provincial traffic rules and guidance. These findings suggest that the framework can produce rule-conforming training data for compact driving advisory models.

AI.tldr: 提出数据生成与蒸馏框架，结合场景理解、风险预测和交通规则检索，生成卡车驾驶决策与自然语言建议，并将8B教师蒸馏为3B学生模型用于车载部署；同时发布覆盖加拿大四省的行车记录数据集。
AI.motivation: VLM生成的驾驶建议可能与路况或交通规则冲突，且通常只在危险可见后才提示；长途重卡制动距离长、单次行程跨多司法辖区（规则各异），更需要提前预警与规则合规。
AI.method: 构建结构化场景理解、风险预测与交通规则检索相结合的数据生成与蒸馏框架，逐条记录做一致性检查；由8B教师生成记录，蒸馏出3B学生模型；并构建含11,142个标注车道线帧与9,494个驾驶片段的加拿大四省行车记录数据集。
AI.result: 在四省留出驾驶数据上，学生模型一致性检查通过率94.6%（未调优8B教师20.2%），并在风险出现前10–30秒提前提示26.2%的风险；生成建议97.7%符合省级交通规则与指引。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可为紧凑型驾驶建议模型生成符合规则的训练数据，支持车载部署。

title: Less Rational, More Transparent: Censorship as (Robustly) Optimal Disclosure
comment: This paper incorporates selected results from "Rationality-Robust Information Design: Bayesian Persuasion under Quantal Response" (SODA 2024, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2207.08253), and adds substantial new results
summary:
Online platforms often control the information behind user decisions they want to influence, such as whether a driver accepts a trip or a buyer completes a purchase. A classical result in information disclosure shows that a {\em censorship} policy is optimal for the platform: the platform pools all sufficiently favorable options under a common message, such as a quality badge, and reveals the rest individually. This result, however, presumes fully rational users. We study disclosure to boundedly rational users who follow the logit quantal response model and whose rationality level the platform may not know.
  Our results deliver a unifying message: less rational, more transparent. Neither bounded rationality nor uncertainty about it calls for a more complex policy; each changes only how much the platform should pool, and only toward greater transparency. When the rationality level is known, censorship remains optimal, and less rational users optimally receive at least as much information as more rational ones. When the rationality level is unknown, censorship remains robustly optimal under each of three criteria: the maximin ratio, maximin payoff, and minimax regret, and the robust censorship can be chosen to be at least as transparent as the policy designed for fully rational users.
