This additional transparency weakly benefits both parties and acts as insurance against behavioral uncertainty: rationality-robust censorship secures at least 89.96\% of the payoff attainable with knowledge of the user's rationality level, whereas the policy designed for fully rational users can secure as little as 50\%. Taken together, these results suggest that platforms can keep their badge-based disclosure but should narrow its coverage when users may be boundedly rational.

AI.tldr: 研究平台向有界理性用户（logit QRE）披露信息的最优策略：在理性水平已知或未知时，审查/审查式披露仍最优，但越不理性、越不确定，平台应披露越透明（合并范围越窄）。
AI.motivation: 经典信息披露理论证明“审查政策”（把足够好的选项并入统一消息如质量徽章，其余单独揭示）对平台最优，但这依赖于用户完全理性。现实中用户有界理性，且平台往往不知道其理性水平，需要回答此时最优披露策略是否改变。
AI.method: 将用户建模为 logit 分位数反应（logit quantal response），分别在理性水平已知与未知两种情形下求解平台最优披露。理性未知时引入三种稳健准则：maximin ratio、maximin payoff、minimax regret，并比较稳健审查政策与面向完全理性用户的政策。
AI.result: 理性水平已知时审查政策仍最优，且越不理性的用户应获得至少同样多的信息。理性未知时，审查在三种稳健准则下均稳健最优，且稳健审查可比面向完全理性用户的政策更透明。额外透明对双方均弱有利，作为行为不确定性的“保险”：稳健审查至少获得已知理性水平时可达收益的89.96%，而完全理性政策最低仅50%。
AI.conclusion: 统一结论是“越不理性、越透明”。平台可保留基于徽章的披露结构，但当用户可能有界理性时应缩小徽章覆盖范围、披露更多个体信息，以应对行为不确定性。

title: VTree: Question-Driven Growth of Hierarchical Memory for Agentic Long-Video Understanding
summary: Long videos spanning tens of minutes to hours far exceed the context window of today's vision-language models, and the standard remedy of sparse uniform frame sampling discards exactly the fine-grained evidence that specific questions depend on. Existing video agents explore on demand but re-explore from scratch for every question and discard their exploration state once an answer is produced, so per-question cost scales with video length. Hierarchical-memory methods instead fix the scope of each depth in advance and deepen along a pre-committed pyramid rather than toward the question. We observe that a video's coarse structure (where its scenes and topics begin and end) is question-independent, whereas which part a question must zoom into, and how deep, is question-dependent. We propose VTree, which builds a coarse hierarchical memory tree over a video once and then, for each question, grows branches only where that question needs depth. The growth is globally routed so any part of the timeline is reachable, sufficiency-gated so drilling stops when the evidence suffices, and query-conditioned so a branch unfolds into the sub-intervals that answer \emph{this} question. Crucially, every expansion is written back into the video memory, allowing later questions to reuse previously discovered structure and evidence without repeating the corresponding expansion process. Across five long-video understanding benchmarks, VTree consistently improves the accuracy of diverse vision-language backbones while substantially reducing the context length and execution time required for each question.

AI.tldr: 提出 VTree，先为长视频构建一次粗粒度分层记忆树，再针对每个问题只在需要处按需生长分支，并把探索状态写回记忆供后续问题复用，从而在提升长视频问答准确率的同时大幅降低上下文长度与执行时间。
AI.motivation: 长视频远超视觉语言模型上下文窗口；稀疏均匀采样丢失细粒度证据；现有视频 agent 每个问题都从头重探索且丢弃探索状态，成本随视频长度线性增长；分层记忆方法预先固定各深度范围，按预设金字塔加深而非朝问题方向加深。作者观察到视频的粗结构（场景/主题边界）与问题无关，而"该放大哪里、放大到多深"与问题相关。
AI.method: VTree：1) 一次性构建覆盖整段视频的粗粒度分层记忆树；2) 每个问题只在该问题需要深度的地方生长分支；3) 生长过程具备全局路由（时间轴任意位置可达）、充分性门控（证据足够即停止下钻）、查询条件化（分支展开为回答当前问题的子区间）；4) 每次扩展写回视频记忆，使后续问题复用已发现的结构与证据。
AI.result: 在五个长视频理解基准上，VTree 一致提升多种视觉语言骨干模型的准确率，同时显著降低每个问题所需的上下文长度与执行时间。
AI.conclusion: 将"问题无关的粗结构"离线一次构建、与"问题相关的细粒度探索"在线按需生长相结合的树式记忆复用范式，能有效兼顾长视频理解的精度与效率。

title: FinEvo: Recursive Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Financial Modeling
summary: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have expanded their role in high-value productivity tasks, including financial analysis and modeling, while enabling models to play an increasingly active role in their own improvement. This motivates two complementary lines of inquiry: can financial modeling capabilities provide a foundation for model self-evolution, and can self-evolution, in turn, advance financial capabilities? We introduce FinEvo, a self-evolution framework that integrates autonomous experience construction with financial capability improvement. FinEvo prepares financial models, iteratively evolves challenges through self-play, and learns from the resulting interactions using executable rewards, relying on the same model throughout. An end-to-end execution with Qwen3.6-27B shows that solving feedback supports both increasing reasoning demands and identifying specification issues that executable checks can miss. Learning from these experiences raises whole-task success from 22.73 to 29.09 on held-out within-source tasks and from 13.13 to 19.19 on SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial. Comparable gains across task sources and evaluation settings, together with improvement on a task category absent from training, suggest that FinEvo strengthens underlying financial modeling capabilities shared across tasks. These findings support self-evolution as a path toward broader financial competence, advancing the empirical exploration of recursive self-improvement (RSI) in professional domains. Code is available at https://github.com/pcj-sudo/FinEvo.

AI.tldr: 提出FinEvo自进化框架，将自主经验构建与金融能力提升结合，通过自博弈迭代进化挑战并用可执行奖励学习，使金融建模能力与模型自我进化相互促进。
AI.motivation: LLM已深度参与金融分析建模等高价值任务，并日益参与自身改进，因此作者想探究两条互补问题：金融建模能力能否成为模型自进化的基础，自进化又能否反哺金融能力。
AI.method: FinEvo全程依赖同一模型：先准备金融模型，再以自博弈方式迭代演化挑战题，并基于交互结果用可执行奖励进行学习。端到端实验基于Qwen3.6-27B。
AI.result: 求解反馈既能提升推理难度需求，也能识别可执行检查无法捕获的规格问题。学习后整任务成功率在同源留出任务上由22.73提升至29.09，在SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial上由13.13提升至19.19；跨任务来源与评测设置均有相近增益，且在训练中未出现的任务类别上同样提升。
AI.conclusion: FinEvo强化了跨任务共享的底层金融建模能力，表明自进化是通向更广泛金融能力的可行路径，推进了专业领域递归自我改进(RSI)的实证探索。

title: A New Perspective on ANN-to-SNN Conversion: Hardware-Aligned Multi-Threshold Neuron Dynamics for Neuromorphic Inference
summary: By accumulating spikes over multiple timesteps, rate coding approximates the real-valued activations of an ANN, a principle that underpins numerous ANN-to-SNN conversion methods. However, the converted SNNs typically incur loss in accuracy compared to the original ANN. Existing methods either increase a number of timesteps or introduce more complex neuronal dynamics to reduce this accuracy gap. Yet, both approaches ultimately lead to the same outcome: redundancy either in information or in computation, thereby suffering from efficiency degradation. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{PRIME} (\underline{P}otential-\underline{R}esidual \underline{I}ntegration for \underline{M}ulti-threshold \underline{E}ncoding), a multi-threshold concurrent spiking neuron framework redesigned from a hardware data representation perspective:a) We introduce the Residual Membrane Potential Amplification (RMPA) mechanism, which replaces rate coding with Integration Coding by actively amplifying the residual membrane potential. RMPA enables the binary representation of spikes to carry substantially more information, achieving near-lossless conversion with as few as two timesteps.b) Complementarily, we implement concurrent spike firing in multi-threshold neurons, where spikes are decoded directly from the binary representation of floating-point data, eliminating membrane potential--threshold comparisons and replacing multiplications with lightweight bit-shift and accumulation operations that align with hardware computation primitives. At $T=2$ and $D=3$, we achieve competitive performance across both vision and language benchmarks with only 40.6\% of the FP32 bit-transmission cost and 13.4\% of the FP32 multiplication energy consumption. The PRIME framework establishes a new design principle for efficient ANN-to-SNN conversion, bridging the gap between algorithmic efficiency and hardware constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出PRIME多阈值脉冲神经元框架，用"积分编码"替代速率编码，仅需2个时间步即可实现近乎无损的ANN-to-SNN转换，并从硬件数据表示角度大幅降低通信与计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有ANN-to-SNN转换方法中，速率编码需要累积多个时间步的脉冲来逼近实值激活，导致精度损失。已有方法或增加时间步，或引入复杂神经元动力学来缩小精度差距，但两者都会带来信息冗余或计算冗余，造成效率下降。
AI.method: PRIME包含两项核心设计：a) 残差膜电位放大机制（RMPA），主动放大残余膜电位，以"积分编码"替代速率编码，使脉冲的二值表示携带更多信息；b) 多阈值神经元中的并发脉冲发放，直接从浮点数据的二进制表示解码脉冲，省去膜电位与阈值的比较，并用轻量位移与累加运算替代乘法，契合硬件计算原语。
AI.result: 在T=2、D=3条件下，于视觉与语言基准上取得有竞争力的性能，仅消耗FP32比特传输代价的40.6%和FP32乘法能耗的13.4%。
AI.conclusion: PRIME为高效ANN-to-SNN转换建立了新的设计原则，弥合了算法效率与硬件约束之间的差距。

title: MADRec: Reliable Multi-Agent Reasoning with Evidence-Grounded Debate for Recommendation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming recommender systems from conventional preference matching toward reasoning-driven and explainable decision-making. Multi-agent collaboration further advances this paradigm by distributing recommendation reasoning across specialized agents. However, existing frameworks rarely assess the reliability of intermediate reasoning during collaboration, allowing erroneous judgments to propagate across agents and ultimately degrade recommendation quality. To address this issue, we propose Multi-Agent Debate-based Recommendation (MADRec), an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework that enhances the reliability of multi-agent recommendation reasoning. MADRec consists of three coordinated modules. First, the Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) module enables an Interaction Agent and a Semantic Agent to analyze interaction signals and content-level semantic signals from complementary perspectives, generating diverse recommendation judgments through structured debate. Second, the Evidence-Grounded Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning (EG-RAR) module grounds the Semantic Agent's reasoning in item-level evidence and refines candidate scores by assessing how well the evidence supports the corresponding semantic claims. Third, the Judge-based Ranking Calibration (JRC) module leverages debate-derived reliability cues to adaptively calibrate interaction-based and semantic ranking results for the final recommendation. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that MADRec consistently outperforms competitive baselines and enhances the reliability of multi-agent recommendation reasoning.

AI.tldr: MADRec 提出基于多智能体辩论的推荐框架，通过交互智能体与语义智能体的结构化辩论、证据锚定检索增强推理、以及基于可靠性的排序校准，提升多智能体推荐推理的可信度与推荐效果。
AI.motivation: LLM 推动推荐系统从偏好匹配转向推理驱动与可解释决策，多智能体协作可分散推理压力，但现有框架很少评估协作中中间推理的可靠性，导致错误判断在智能体间传播并损害推荐质量。
AI.method: 包含三个协同模块：(1) 多智能体辩论模块（MAD）：交互智能体与语义智能体从互补视角分析交互信号与内容语义信号，经结构化辩论产生多样推荐判断；(2) 证据锚定检索增强推理模块（EG-RAR）：将语义智能体的推理锚定在物品级证据上，并依据证据对语义主张的支持程度精炼候选打分；(3) 基于评判者的排序校准模块（JRC）：利用辩论产生的可靠性线索，自适应校准交互类与语义类排序结果以生成最终推荐。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，MADRec 持续优于竞争基线，并提升了多智能体推荐推理的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 在多智能体推荐中显式建模中间推理可靠性是必要且有效的；辩论机制、证据锚定与自适应校准相结合，可缓解错误传播并提升推荐性能与可信度。

title: Feedback Shortcut: Speculative Decoding for Latent Feedback Transformers
summary: Feeding each position's top-layer hidden state back into the next position's input improves Transformer performance. However, this feedback breaks speculative decoding, since verifying a drafted token requires the top-layer state from its preceding position, which forces the draft to rely on an approximate stand-in. Training the model to adapt to this stand-in can lower the exact-decoding performance ceiling, while using it at inference time further introduces approximation error. We propose Feedback Shortcut to address both bottlenecks. First, state alignment trains a lightweight projection from multi-token prediction head states to stand-ins, leaving base model training untouched. Second, pipelined correction re-evaluates each draft using its predecessor's newly computed state, a much closer proxy to true feedback. Running this correction inside the verification pass of subsequent drafts improves accuracy with zero extra calls. Across 135M and 780M scales, Feedback Shortcut stays within $10^{-4}$ bits per byte of the exact-decoding ceiling on Paloma and accelerates decoding by 2.4-2.8x with about 2% more training compute than the latent feedback Transformer. At large batch sizes, skipping correction still preserves Transformer speed and over 80% of latent feedback's gains.

AI.tldr: 提出 Feedback Shortcut，解决潜在反馈 Transformer 与投机解码冲突的问题，通过状态对齐与流水线校正恢复准确率并实现 2.4-2.8x 加速。
AI.motivation: 将每位置顶层隐状态反馈到下一位置输入可提升 Transformer 性能，但该反馈破坏投机解码：验证草稿词元需要前一位置的顶层状态，迫使草稿依赖近似替代物。训练模型适应替代物会降低精确解码性能上限，推理时使用替代物又引入近似误差。
AI.method: Feedback Shortcut 含两部分：(1) 状态对齐——训练一个从多词元预测头状态到替代物的轻量投影，不改动基座模型训练；(2) 流水线校正——用前驱位置新计算的隐藏状态重新评估每个草稿，并在后续草稿的验证过程中完成校正，零额外调用。
AI.result: 在 135M 与 780M 规模上，Paloma 上距精确解码上限在 10^-4 bits per byte 以内，解码加速 2.4-2.8x，仅比潜在反馈 Transformer 多用约 2% 训练算力；大 batch 下跳过校正仍保持 Transformer 速度并保留 latent feedback 80% 以上收益。
AI.conclusion: Feedback Shortcut 兼顾 latent feedback 的建模收益与投机解码的效率，在不牺牲精确解码性能的前提下实现显著加速，为将反馈机制应用于实际高效推理提供了可行方案。

title: Automated Safety Analysis for Agentic Workflows
comment: Extended version of the paper accepted at ICSE 2027, with appendices
summary: LLM applications are increasingly built as agentic workflows: programs that combine model calls, external tools, and control logic to act autonomously on a user's behalf. Because these workflows execute real-world actions, logical flaws in how a workflow is wired can cause severe harm in deployed systems. Unlike prompt injections or malformed API calls, these workflow bugs stem from defects in the workflow's design, yet no existing tool can statically validate workflow logic across frameworks prior to deployment. We present Apsis, a static safety analyzer that detects workflow bugs before deployment. To operate across frameworks, Apsis lifts framework-specific code into a common intermediate representation (IR). This IR models a workflow as a semantic graph of steps, data dependencies, and shared state, while annotating each component with behavioral properties such as whether an input is mandatory or how a shared channel merges concurrent writes. Building on this representation, we introduce a bug description language that formalizes recurring classes of agentic failures as declarative patterns over the IR. By matching these patterns against the IR, Apsis detects structural and behavioral flaws and pinpoints the exact step responsible for each bug. To evaluate Apsis, we construct, to our knowledge, the first corpus of workflow bugs, distilled from real-world reports across 13 widely used frameworks. On a reproducible benchmark suite drawn from this corpus, Apsis detects workflow bugs with 91% precision and 84% recall, and uncovers 36 previously unknown bugs in real-world workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出 Apsis，一个在部署前静态检测 LLM agentic workflow 逻辑缺陷的安全分析器，声称达到 91% 精确率和 84% 召回率。
AI.motivation: LLM 应用越来越多以 agentic workflow 形式构建（模型调用、外部工具、控制逻辑），会执行真实世界动作。工作流接线层面的逻辑缺陷（区别于 prompt injection 或 API 调用错误）可在部署系统中造成严重危害，但目前没有跨框架的部署前静态验证工具。
AI.method: 将框架特定代码提升为统一中间表示（IR），把工作流建模为步骤、数据依赖与共享状态的语义图，并为组件标注行为属性（如输入是否必需、共享通道如何合并并发写入）；再设计 bug 描述语言，把反复出现的 agentic 失败类别形式化为 IR 上的声明式模式，通过模式匹配检测结构性/行为性缺陷并定位到具体步骤。
AI.result: 构建了（据称是）首个工作流 bug 语料库，源自 13 个常用框架的真实报告；在可复现基准上达到 91% 精确率、84% 召回率，并在真实工作流中发现 36 个此前未知的 bug。
AI.conclusion: 跨框架、基于 IR 与声明式模式匹配的静态分析是检测 agentic workflow 设计层缺陷的有效途径，可在部署前发现并精确定位问题。

title: Multimodal Violence Understanding and Temporal Retrieval in Movies with Adaptive Audio-Visual Fusion
summary: Violence in films and streaming media remains a concern for audience protection and creates substantial workload for manual content classification. Existing violence-detection methods often rely on limited modalities or short video clips, making it difficult to capture complementary evidence and localise violent events in long, untrimmed videos. In this study, we develop a framework for multimodal video understanding that classifies violence severity, predicts multiple violence types, and locates violent events in time. We combine temporally aligned visual and audio features extracted using pretrained encoders through attention-based adaptive fusion, followed by Transformer-based temporal modelling. Our framework supports three complementary tasks: video-level violence-severity classification, multi-label violence-type prediction, and temporal localisation of violent events. We evaluate the framework on the XD-Violence benchmark and examine its cross-domain performance using AIRTLab. On XD-Violence, our multimodal model achieves 93.27\% severity-classification accuracy and a micro-F1 score of 88.60\% for multi-label violence-type prediction, outperforming the corresponding unimodal configurations. We achieve a mean temporal intersection-over-union (tIoU) of 0.5075 for temporal localisation. Our cross-domain experiments reveal performance degradation under different recording conditions, while our movie case studies demonstrate the framework's potential to retrieve potentially violent scenes for further review. Our results highlight the practical value of multimodal intelligent systems in supporting human reviewers with the identification, classification, and temporal retrieval of violent content in films and streaming media.

AI.tldr: 提出一个多模态视频理解框架，融合视觉与音频特征，同时完成暴力严重程度分类、多类型多标签预测和暴力事件时间定位，在XD-Violence上达到93.27%准确率和88.60%微F1，时间定位tIoU为0.5075。
AI.motivation: 影视与流媒体中的暴力内容既涉及受众保护，又给人工内容分级带来巨大工作量。现有暴力检测方法多依赖单一模态或短片段，难以获取互补证据，也难以在长且未裁剪视频中定位暴力事件。
AI.method: 用预训练编码器提取时间对齐的视觉与音频特征，通过基于注意力的自适应融合后接Transformer时序建模，构建统一框架支持三项互补任务：视频级暴力严重程度分类、多标签暴力类型预测、暴力事件时间定位。在XD-Violence上评估，并用AIRTLab检验跨域性能。
AI.result: XD-Violence上严重程度分类准确率93.27%，多标签暴力类型预测微F1为88.60%，优于对应单模态配置；时间定位平均tIoU为0.5075。跨域实验显示不同录制条件下性能下降；电影案例研究表明该框架能检索潜在暴力场景供人工复核。
AI.conclusion: 多模态智能系统在辅助人工审核者识别、分类和时间检索影视及流媒体暴力内容方面具有实际价值。

title: A Deterministic Polynomial-Query Protocol for Envy-Free Cake Cutting
summary: We give a deterministic protocol that divides a heterogeneous cake completely and without envy among $n$ agents using $O(n^6\log n)$ Robertson--Webb queries in the worst case. Valuations may be arbitrary nonnegative, nonatomic measures, and bundles may be disconnected. The protocol makes $O(n)$ calls to certified trimming, which uses $O(n^5\log n)$ queries on $n$ pieces. In a certified trim, each agent receives the end part, or suffix, of a different piece without envy, and every shortened piece has a witness tie leading back to a whole piece. At each step, the witness values the shortened suffix exactly as much as her own. For pieces of positive interval length with strictly increasing suffix values, the retained suffix lengths are unique, although their holders may differ. Candidate assignments share a table of value and cut queries. If the coordinatewise median of their value estimates fails a matching test, the test identifies an agent whose value is underestimated, ruling out at least half the remaining assignments. A weighted median of cut marks lets one repair step remove a small envy while allocating almost all of the residue. For complete envy-free chore allocation, the query bound is $O(n^7\log n)$.

AI.tldr: 该论文给出一个确定性协议，用O(n^6 log n)次Robertson–Webb查询将异质蛋糕完全且无嫉妒地分给n个代理人；对杂务分配给出O(n^7 log n)查询上界。
AI.motivation: 解决异质蛋糕完全无嫉妒分配的查询复杂度问题，允许一般非负非原子测度与不连通捆绑，追求确定性协议与更优的查询上界。
AI.method: 协议进行O(n)次"认证裁剪"（每次对n块用O(n^5 log n)查询）：每个代理人无嫉妒地获得不同块的尾部后缀，缩短块带见证并保证见证者估值等于其自身份额；利用后缀长度唯一性，候选分配共享价值与切割查询表；若中位数估值估计未通过匹配测试，则识别被低估代理人并排除至少一半候选；用切割标记的加权中位数做修复步骤，消除小嫉妒并分配几乎全部残余；杂务分配沿用相同框架。
AI.result: 蛋糕分配最坏情况查询复杂度O(n^6 log n)；认证裁剪对n块O(n^5 log n)；完全无嫉妒杂务分配O(n^7 log n)。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次/显著推进了确定性完全无嫉妒分配的查询复杂度上界，通过认证裁剪、中位数匹配测试与加权中位数修复等技术将问题系统化为多项式查询次数，并扩展到杂务分配。

title: Causal Dioramas: Controllable Video Generation, Revision and Editing via Intervention
summary: Two centuries ago, an early cinema-like theater called the Diorama could already control its scenes at will. Today's video generation models produce videos of near-cinematic quality, yet they still lack this controllability. This limitation stems from the inherent semantic gap between text and pixels, since a prompt can describe a video only coarsely and leaves its details and relations beyond control. We bring this ability to video generation with Causal Dioramas, modules that decompose a video into a concept graph of variables that can be intervened on individually. Each instruction is translated into an intervention on the concept graph, modifying the specified concepts and their dependents. A connector then conveys this intervention to the video generator, which reuses the original noise to produce a counterfactual video while preserving all other content. Building on Causal Dioramas, we develop a unified framework for controllable generation, counterfactual revision of generated videos and editing of real videos. We outperform both open-source and commercial models in controllability on T2V-CompBench, CoVEBench and OpenVE-Bench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Causal Dioramas，用概念图变量分解视频，通过指令干预实现细粒度可控视频生成，并统一支持反事实修改与真实视频编辑，在多个基准上超越开源和商业模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型质量接近电影级，但文本与像素间的语义鸿沟导致提示词只能粗略描述视频，细节和元素关系不可控；作者希望恢复类似早期 Diorama 剧场对场景的任意控制能力。
AI.method: 将视频分解为可单独干预的概念图（变量图），把每条指令翻译为对概念图中指定概念及其依赖变量的干预，再由 connector 将干预传递给视频生成器，复用原始噪声生成反事实视频并保持其余内容不变；在此基础上构建统一框架支持可控生成、已生成视频的反事实修改和真实视频编辑。
AI.result: 在 T2V-CompBench、CoVEBench 和 OpenVE-Bench 上，可控性均优于开源与商业模型。
AI.conclusion: 以因果概念图为核心的干预式控制为视频生成提供了细粒度可控性，并统一了生成、反事实修订和真实视频编辑三类任务。

title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research. However, existing agents rely on harnesses that combine multiple mechanisms, making it difficult to determine how individual components contribute to performance. We systematically study harness design for long-horizon, self-evolving autoresearch agents along two dimensions: context management, which determines what an agent retains from its past attempts, and skill management, which governs how it stores and reuses lessons from those attempts. Across MLE-Bench and KernelBench with gpt-oss-120b, gpt-6-luna, and gpt-6-sol, we isolate the effects of individual harness design choices by evaluating each against a recency-truncation baseline within a shared agent framework. For context management, we find that preserving individually accessible records of past attempts is more effective than maintaining a rolling summary, with context folding performing best across all six settings and improving upon the baseline by up to 19.2%. For skill management, selectively discarding persistently unused lessons is more effective on average than consolidating them or promoting them to standing rules. Building on these findings, we combine context folding and skill deletion in MLEvolver, which achieves a 72.7% medal rate on MLE-Bench Lite and a 94% $\mathrm{fast}_1$ score on KernelBench Level 3, substantially outperforming AIDE and OpenEvolve under the same inference budget. Overall, our study distills design principles for preserving experimental history and curating reusable lessons in autoresearch harnesses, paving the way for agents that turn accumulated experience into sustained progress.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究自动科研智能体的"框架(harness)"设计，提出上下文折叠(context folding)与技能删除(skill deletion)两项关键设计，并集成到MLEvolver中，在MLE-Bench与KernelBench上大幅超越AIDE与OpenEvolve。
AI.motivation: 现有自动科研智能体的框架往往把多种机制混在一起，导致难以判断各组件对性能的实际贡献，缺少对设计选择的系统化拆解。
AI.method: 沿两个维度做受控消融：上下文管理(决定智能体如何保留过往尝试信息)与技能管理(决定如何存储和复用经验教训)。在统一框架内，以"近期截断(recency-truncation)"为基线，分别评估各单项设计在MLE-Bench与KernelBench(搭载gpt-oss-120b、gpt-6-luna、gpt-6-sol)上的效果。
AI.result: 上下文管理方面，保留可单独访问的历史尝试记录优于滚动摘要，其中上下文折叠在全部6个设置中最优，较基线最高提升19.2%。技能管理方面，选择性删除长期未使用的经验平均优于合并或升级为常驻规则。二者结合形成的MLEvolver在MLE-Bench Lite上达到72.7%奖牌率，在KernelBench Level 3上取得94%的fast₁分数，在相同推理预算下显著优于AIDE与OpenEvolve。
AI.conclusion: 研究提炼出自动科研框架中"保留实验历史"与"精炼可复用经验"的设计原则，为将累积经验转化为持续科研进展的智能体奠定基础。

title: The Stigmergic Index: A Biomimetic Edge Centrality for Spatial Network Analysis
summary: Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) is a family of metaheuristics inspired by the pheromone-based navigation of real ants, a decentralized mechanism often associated with shortest-path discovery. Over the past two decades, research has primarily focused on optimization tasks such as vehicle routing within a network. In this paper, we shift this perspective by using swarm intelligence to gather diagnostic information about the underlying network structure itself. Through decentralized exploration, we harness stigmergic dynamics to introduce a novel topological and behavioural metric: the Stigmergic Index. While sharing baseline structural properties with traditional betweenness centrality on simple grids, our index accounts for path polarization effects that can diverge from shortest-path-based assumptions.

AI.tldr: 该文将蚁群优化从"求解路径优化"转向"用群体智能诊断网络结构",提出基于信息素动力学的"Stigmergic Index"拓扑与行为指标。
AI.motivation: 过去二十年ACA/ACO研究主要把蚂蚁群体当作优化器(如车辆路径),而作者希望反过来:利用群体智能去采集关于网络结构本身的诊断信息,并刻画传统最短路径假设无法捕捉的现象。
AI.method: 通过去中心化探索,利用stigmergy(信息素)动力学,定义一个新的拓扑与行为度量Stigmergic Index;并在简单栅格网络上与经典betweenness centrality做对比分析。
AI.result: 在简单网格上,该指数与betweenness centrality具有相同的基线结构性质;同时它能够反映"路径极化(path polarization)"效应,其结果可与基于最短路径的假设产生分歧。
AI.conclusion: 群体智能不仅可用于优化,还可作为一种网络结构诊断工具;Stigmergic Index为捕捉非最短路径行为提供新视角,补充了传统中心性指标。

title: PROSPER: LLMs as Sparse Retrievers for First-Stage Product Search
summary: Product search is a crucial component of large-scale e-commerce platforms, where first-stage retrieval should achieve high recall while ensuring efficient online deployment. Sparse retrieval remains attractive for this setting due to its interpretability and deployability, yet it suffers from severe vocabulary mismatch challenges, especially for short queries and product titles. Large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic capabilities, but directly applying them to sparse retrieval in product search introduces new challenges: (i) semantic expansion may distort critical literal signals such as brand names and model identifiers; and (ii) learning meaningful sparse representations is difficult in the high-dimensional vocabulary space induced by LLMs.To address these challenges, we propose PROSPER, a framework that uses LLMs as sparse retrievers for product search while explicitly preserving lexical fidelity. PROSPER combines (i) a literal residual network that alleviates lexical expansion hallucination by reinforcing underweighted literal terms through a residual compensation mechanism; and (ii) a lexical focusing window that uses top-k selection for rapid early sparsification and effective training initialization. Extensive offline evaluations and large-scale online A/B tests demonstrate that PROSPER consistently improves over existing sparse retrievers, and provides revenue gains for industrial hybrid retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 PROSPER 框架，将大语言模型用作稀疏检索器用于商品搜索，在保留字面信号的前提下提升召回。
AI.motivation: 商品搜索首阶段检索需高召回且可在线部署。稀疏检索可解释、易部署，但存在严重的词汇不匹配问题，短查询与商品标题尤甚。直接用 LLM 做稀疏检索会带来两个新问题：语义扩展会扭曲品牌名、型号等关键字面信号；LLM 诱导的高维词表空间使稀疏表示难以有效学习。
AI.method: PROSPER 包含两个组件：(i) 字面残差网络（literal residual network），通过残差补偿机制强化被低估的字面词项，缓解词汇扩展幻觉；(ii) 词汇聚焦窗口（lexical focusing window），用 top-k 选择实现快速早期稀疏化并提供有效的训练初始化。
AI.result: 大量离线评估与大规模在线 A/B 测试表明，PROSPER 稳定优于现有稀疏检索器，并为工业级混合检索系统带来收入增长。
AI.conclusion: PROSPER 在保留字面保真度的同时发挥 LLM 语义能力，验证了 LLM 稀疏检索在商品搜索场景的实用价值，具备实际业务收益。

title: Learning the Projection onto the Data Support: Distribution Learning that Avoids Memorization
summary: We introduce a framework for learning distributions supported on manifolds based on estimating the nearest-point projection onto the data support. Specifically, we define an objective functional over a class of functions whose minimizer recovers this projection. The proposed framework automatically adapts to the intrinsic dimension and allows for data supported on unions of manifolds with varying dimensions. The resulting objective can be optimized using standard neural network architectures. We present population-level results establishing recovery of the manifold projection and prove finite-sample Wasserstein generalization bounds. Furthermore, we validate the approach empirically across a range of settings. In contrast to widely used generative models such as diffusion models, whose objectives can be minimized by memorizing training samples, our formulation excludes such behavior. We also introduce a direct memorization metric to verify that the learned projection generates new samples rather than reproducing the training set.

AI.tldr: 提出一个通过学习最近点投影（nearest-point projection）来估计流形上数据分布的框架，可自动适应内在维度、支持混合维度流形并集，理论上有投影恢复与有限样本Wasserstein泛化界，且天然排除记忆训练样本的行为。
AI.motivation: 现有主流生成模型（如扩散模型）的目标函数可被“记住训练样本”来最小化，缺乏对流形结构内在维度的自适应能力，难以处理维度不同的流形并集。
AI.method: 在一个函数类上定义目标泛函，使其极小值点恢复数据支撑集上的最近点投影；该目标可用标准神经网络优化，并给出总体层面的投影恢复结论与有限样本Wasserstein泛化界；同时提出直接的记忆度量指标。
AI.result: 理论上证明了流形投影的可恢复性及有限样本Wasserstein泛化界；多设置实验验证有效；对照扩散模型等，目标函数排除了记忆行为，并用记忆度量确认生成的是新样本而非复制训练集。
AI.conclusion: 以“估计最近点投影”为核心的生成框架兼具有理论保证、维度自适应性与抗记忆特性，为流形支撑分布学习提供了新思路。

title: Right Verdict, Right Reason? An Execution-Grounded Study of Whether LLM Vulnerability Detectors Understand Vulnerabilities
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to detect vulnerabilities, and their benchmark scores are often read as evidence that they understand the vulnerabilities they report. We test this reading against program execution. For 515 C and C++ functions from BigVul and PrimeVul whose vulnerability we reproduce with a proof of concept, we identify the line at which the fault occurs and the statements on which the faulting run depended. These facts ground a ladder of five tests, from telling a vulnerable function from its fixed version, through locating the fault and reacting to its removal, to judging execution-confirmed edits and predicting the outcome of a concrete run. Each test is paired with a baseline that needs no understanding, such as a rule that picks lines with risky calls, and we repeat the study on 195 vulnerabilities published after the training cutoffs of the models. Four findings emerge. First, telling a vulnerable function from its fixed version is hard. The open-weight models separate no more pairs than chance, although five of them show a weak sensitivity to the fix, and the commercial models still label many screened fixed versions vulnerable. Second, the commercial models locate the fault beyond a keyword rule, while removing that evidence changes the verdicts of the strongest model only on the newer vulnerabilities. Third, given the program input, the commercial models predict whether a run faults better than a rule that looks for added checks, and the prediction follows the input. Fourth, on the newer vulnerabilities this advantage disappears and the lead of the strongest model narrows, while localization persists. We release the framework, the per-function evidence, and an execution-confirmed counterfactual benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该论文用程序执行事实验证LLM是否真正"理解"漏洞，构建五项递进测试及其无理解基线，在515个可复现的C/C++函数及195个训练截止后漏洞上评估。结论：模型擅长定位故障和预测执行结果，但区分漏洞版本与修复版本接近随机，且在较新漏洞上优势消失。
AI.motivation: LLM漏洞检测的基准分数常被解读为模型"理解"漏洞的证据，但这一解读缺乏程序执行层面的验证。作者希望检验模型的高分是否反映真正的漏洞理解，还是仅依赖表面捷径（如关键词、风险调用）。
AI.method: 选取BigVul和PrimeVul中515个能以PoC复现漏洞的C/C++函数，标注故障行及故障运行所依赖的语句。据此设计五项递进测试：①区分漏洞函数与修复版本；②定位故障行；③对故障移除作出反应；④判断经执行确认的编辑；⑤预测具体运行的结果。每项测试配有无需理解的基线（如风险调用规则、新增检查规则）。再在195个训练截止后发布的新漏洞上重复实验。
AI.result: 四项发现：①开源模型区分漏洞/修复版本不高于随机，仅五个模型对修复有微弱敏感性，商业模型仍将许多已修复版本判为漏洞；②商业模型定位故障行优于关键词规则，但去除该证据仅对最强模型在较新漏洞上改变结论；③给定输入时，商业模型预测运行是否出错优于"查找新增检查"规则，且预测随输入变化；④在较新漏洞上上述优势消失，最强模型领先幅度收窄，但定位能力仍保留。
AI.conclusion: 现有基准分数高估了LLM对漏洞的理解。模型在定位与执行结果预测上表现出一定能力，但区分脆弱/已修复版本这一核心任务接近随机，且在训练截止后的新漏洞上优势减弱，提示存在记忆或捷径依赖。作者发布框架、逐函数证据及执行确认的反事实基准。

title: BehaviorICL: Task-Conditioned Decoder States for Visual In-Context Learning
summary: The usefulness of an in-context demonstration for a vision-language model (VLM) depends on both the query image and the task posed about it. We study whether the frozen target VLM's own decoder states, read before answer generation, can select such demonstrations. BehaviorICL represents each image and task by a task-conditioned processing signature, the hidden states at the final input position across all decoder layers. Its training-free variant, BehaviorICL-Raw, averages cosine similarities between corresponding layer states and passes the retrieved examples with their reference answers to the same VLM. When the same NICO++ images are asked about their object or their context, Raw retrieves largely different demonstrations for the two questions and outperforms an image retriever given task-matched demonstrations on both VLMs. Across two VLMs and eight classification and visual question answering datasets, Raw gives the highest average accuracy among training-free retrievers on both VLMs and exceeds RICES with a CLIP ViT-L/14 encoder by 3.83 points on Qwen and 1.85 on InternVL. A lightweight shared projection, BehaviorICL-Proj, brings further gains on classification. Analyses of extraction text, decoder depth and bank answers help explain these gains, and attention analysis describes how the task text shifts attention at the extraction position toward the classified object. These results support the target VLM's internal states as a practical basis for visual in-context learning.

AI.tldr: 提出用目标VLM自身解码器状态（任务条件化行为签名）检索上下文示例，无需训练即在多数据集上超过现有检索器。
AI.motivation: in-context示例对VLM是否有用取决于查询图像和所问任务，现有方法多基于图像相似度检索，忽略了任务条件，因此需要一种同时感知图像与任务的示例选择方式。
AI.method: BehaviorICL将每张图像与任务表示为"任务条件化处理签名"——即最终输入位置上所有解码器层的隐藏状态；训练无关的BehaviorICL-Raw对各层状态余弦相似度取平均来检索示例并附带参考答案；另提出轻量共享投影版BehaviorICL-Proj。
AI.result: 对同一NICO++图像分别问物体与上下文时，Raw检索到显著不同的示例，且在两款VLM上均优于任务匹配的图像检索器；在2个VLM、8个分类与VQA数据集上，Raw为训练无关检索器中平均精度最高，较RICES(CLIP ViT-L/14)在Qwen高3.83分、InternVL高1.85分；Proj在分类任务上进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 分析（提取文本、解码深度、示例库答案、注意力）解释了增益来源：任务文本会将在提取位置上的注意力转向被分类物体，支持将目标VLM内部状态作为视觉上下文学习的实用基础。

title: What Counts as Attack Success? Evaluating Harmfulness in Red Teaming LLMs
summary: Judging whether a model response is harmful requires contextual and normative choices, yet red-teaming studies often delegate this judgment to automated evaluators. We examine how harmfulness criteria are specified in red-teaming research and how they carry through to reported results. Reviewing 76 papers, we find that many adopt their criteria from prior datasets, classifiers, or judge prompts rather than defining harmfulness themselves. Applying evaluators from these papers to identical outputs, we find that they can reach different judgments on the same response, which can change conclusions when comparing models. These differences arise partly because evaluators draw the boundary of harm in different places: some count any response that does not refuse, while others count only output that could plausibly cause harm. We argue that red-teaming studies should state their harmfulness criteria and report how they chose and validated their evaluators to support more reliable measurement and interpretation.

AI.tldr: 对76篇红队论文的审查发现，多数研究沿用他人数据/分类器/评判提示而缺乏自主危害性标准定义；用同一批输出测试时不同评估器结论不一致，甚至改变模型对比结论，根源在于对"危害边界"的界定不同（"未拒绝即有害" vs "可能造成实际危害"）。
AI.motivation: 判断模型回复是否有害涉及情境与规范判断，但红队研究常将这一判断交给自动评估器；本文想考察危害性标准如何被指定，以及这些标准如何影响最终报告的结果。
AI.method: 对76篇红队研究论文进行文献审查，梳理其危害性标准的来源；随后将这些论文中的评估器应用于完全相同的模型输出，比较其对同一回复的判断差异及其对模型比较结论的影响，并分析分歧来源（危害边界界定不同）。
AI.result: 许多论文的危害性标准来自既有数据集、分类器或评判提示，而非自行定义；不同评估器对同一回复可给出不同判断，进而改变模型对比的结论；分歧部分源于危害边界的不同界定——有的把任何未拒答都计为有害，有的只把可能实际造成危害的输出计为有害。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁红队研究明确陈述其危害性标准，并报告评估器的选择与验证过程，以支持更可靠的测量与解释。

title: The Computational Complexity of Concurrent Stochastic Games: Exact Value and Approximation
summary:
We consider two-player zero-sum concurrent stochastic games played over a finite state space for an infinite number of stages. In every stage, both players simultaneously and independently choose an action. Then, given the current state and chosen actions, the successor state is selected according to a stochastic transition function. We consider limit-average objectives, where Player 1 maximizes the long-run average of rewards assigned to every transition. The value from an initial state is the maximal expectation that Player 1 can ensure. We study the two basic computational problems: (a) the approximation problem of computing the values within an arbitrary additive error, and (b) the exact problem of deciding whether the value at a state is at least a given threshold. The previous results in the literature establish: (a) the approximation problem belongs to TFNP[NP], and (b) the exact problem belongs to PSPACE, via the theory of the reals, and is SQRT-SUM-hard.
  Our contributions are as follows. (a) Our main result shows that the approximation problem is in TFNP, and that the associated gap or promise problem is in NP $\cap$ coNP. (b) We also show that the exact problem is in $\exists\mathbb{R} \cap \text{co-}\exists\mathbb{R}$, i.e., it reduces to both the existential and the universal theory of the reals, and that it is PosSLP-hard.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限状态、无限阶段的二人零和并发随机博弈中极限平均目标的计算复杂度，改进了近似问题与精确问题的复杂度上界。
AI.motivation: 此前文献已知：近似问题属于 TFNP[NP]，精确问题属于 PSPACE（通过实数理论）且为 SQRT-SUM-hard。作者希望收紧这些复杂度分类，厘清并发随机博弈极限平均目标的真实计算难度。
AI.method: 针对近似问题，通过新的算法/归约证明其属于 TFNP，并证明相应的 gap（promise）问题属于 NP ∩ coNP；针对精确问题，利用实数存在/全称理论给出双向归约，将其置于 ∃ℝ ∩ co-∃ℝ。
AI.result: 主要结果表明：(a) 近似问题属于 TFNP，相关 gap/promise 问题属于 NP ∩ coNP；(b) 精确问题属于 ∃ℝ ∩ co-∃ℝ，即同时归约到实数的存在理论与全称理论；并证明其为 PosSLP-hard。
AI.conclusion: 并发随机博弈极限平均目标的近似问题可由 TFNP 刻画，精确问题位于 ∃ℝ 与 co-∃ℝ 的交集且 PosSLP-hard，显著改进了原有的 TFNP[NP] 与 PSPACE 上界，并给出新的下界。

title: VideoGym: An Adaptive RL Environment for Long-Video Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains video agents to locate sparse evidence for long-video question answering through structured memory retrieval and temporal re-observation. This training, however, faces a long-tail modality distribution in the data. In our source pool, text-heavy questions account for 58% of samples, compared with 15% graph-heavy, 17% visual-heavy, and 10% time-range questions. Fixed-distribution RL therefore allocates fewer rollouts to underperforming question types. Reweighting these types could increase their sampling frequency but repeatedly reuses the same finite banks of original questions. To solve this problem, we introduce VideoGym, a curriculum-based RL environment that jointly constructs video-grounded training tasks and allocates rollouts among them. Within the environment, a memory-augmented VideoAgent is trained to coordinate retrieval from text, graph, and visual memories with temporal re-observation. Across episodes, VideoGym adapts VideoAgent's training distribution online: it casts per-period sample selection as an adversarial bandit over (modality, mode) arms and applies the EXP3 update to shift sampling toward arms with low answer accuracy. To supply the augmented-mode arms, a TaskGenerator-Verifier pipeline produces harder variants of existing questions that remain answerable within the same video. Across five long-video benchmarks, VideoGym lifts RL accuracy from 60.4% to 64.8% on average and by up to 10.5 pp on underrepresented graph-heavy questions with 3.3x sample efficiency. Together, these results show that task expansion and adaptive allocation can improve video agent learning from limited, imbalanced training data.

AI.tldr: VideoGym：一个课程式强化学习环境，联合构建视频任务并自适应分配 rollout，缓解长视频问答中的长尾模态分布问题，平均准确率 60.4%→64.8%。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答的 RL 训练数据存在长尾模态分布（文本类 58%，图/视觉/时间范围分别 15%/17%/10%），固定分布的 RL 会把更少 rollout 分给表现差的题型；单纯重加权只会反复复用有限的原始题目池。
AI.method: VideoGym 课程式 RL 环境：memory-augmented VideoAgent 协调文本/图/视觉记忆检索与时间重观察；将每期样本选择建模为 (modality, mode) 臂的对抗 bandit，用 EXP3 更新向低准确率臂倾斜；TaskGenerator-Verifier 管线生成同视频内仍可回答的更难变体。
AI.result: 五个长视频基准上，平均准确率由 60.4% 提升至 64.8%；代表性不足的图重题目最多提升 10.5 个百分点，样本效率达 3.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 任务扩展与自适应分配相结合，可在有限且不均衡的训练数据下改善视频 agent 的学习效果。

title: A Nepali-Accented English Evaluation Dataset for Automatic Speech Recognition
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems perform strongly on native-English benchmarks, yet their accuracy degrades sharply when the input speech comes from under represented non-native accents. Nepali-accented English is particularly under-served: existing resources either focus on native Nepali speech, cover broader multi-accent settings without dedicated Nepali evaluation, or provide only limited Nepali-accent coverage. This paper presents a Nepali-accented English evaluation dataset designed to support robust ASR benchmarking under accent mismatch. The corpus was collected through a web-based platform that did not collect directly identifying metadata and contains recordings from 57 speakers. Each session follows a fixed 22-prompt protocol consisting of 11 phonetic prompts, 10 domain prompts, and 1 spontaneous prompt, providing complementary coverage of pronunciation, topical vocabulary, and natural speaking style. In addition to transcribed speech, the dataset includes participant metadata for coarse exploratory subgroup analysis and speaker-level manual recording-quality labels. Manual quality assessment shows that 50.9% of sessions are clean and 42.1% contain only mild noise. As a descriptive reference, open-source ASR baselines are substantially worse on this corpus than the corresponding LibriSpeech test-clean values reported in official model cards, reaching 38.15-55.00% WER on the collected set versus reported 2-4% WER on LibriSpeech test-clean. These baseline results position the corpus as a practical held-out resource for evaluating accent robustness and out-of-distribution generalization on Nepali-accented English.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了一个尼泊尔口音英语的ASR评测数据集，含57位说话者的录音及转写，开源基线在该集上WER达38.15–55.00%，远高于LibriSpeech test-clean的2–4%。
AI.motivation: ASR在母语英语基准上表现很好，但面对代表性不足的非母语口音时准确率急剧下降。尼泊尔口音英语尤其缺乏资源：现有资源或聚焦母语尼泊尔语，或覆盖多种口音却无专门的尼泊尔评测，或仅提供有限的尼泊尔口音覆盖。
AI.method: 通过不收集直接身份元数据的网页平台采集57位说话者的录音；每人遵循固定22条提示协议（11条语音提示、10条领域提示、1条即兴提示），覆盖发音、主题词汇与自然语体。数据包含转写文本、粗粒度参与者元数据以及说话者级人工录音质量标签。
AI.result: 人工质量评估显示50.9%的会话为干净、42.1%仅含轻度噪声。作为描述性参照，开源ASR基线在该语料上WER为38.15–55.00%，而官方模型卡报告的LibriSpeech test-clean为2–4%。
AI.conclusion: 该语料可作为实际可用的留出资源，用于评估尼泊尔口音英语下的口音鲁棒性与分布外泛化能力。

title: MF-EDA: Joining Membership Functions to Adapt the Number of Distributions in Gaussian Estimation-of-Distribution Algorithms
summary: An estimation-of-distribution algorithm (EDA) usually samples from one Gaussian, whose peak sits where most selected individuals are. On a landscape with two funnels that is not where the best solutions are: the wider funnel supplies most of the selected individuals, and the deeper funnel, which holds the global optimum, is lost early. This paper builds the search distribution as a neuro-fuzzy system builds a model: from Gaussian membership functions joined by membership degrees. In every generation the proposed MF-EDA searches the principal directions of the selected individuals for the direction along which they are bimodal, describes them on that direction by one or two membership functions according to the Bayesian information criterion and a separation test, joins each membership function to a local Gaussian in the other directions, and samples from the normalised union. A membership function has height one whatever the number of individuals under it, so a detected funnel receives samples according to its width. A two-region selection model shows that sampling shares proportional to the head count, as in a Gaussian mixture, compound the early disadvantage of the deeper funnel, and that the union does not. With one membership function the algorithm is its single-Gaussian baseline; the steps cost no fitness evaluations but make a generation 8 to 17 times slower to compute. On 36 double-funnel settings the component raises the successful runs of a rank-weighted Gaussian EDA from 805 to 1712 of 1800. On the Lunacek double funnel in 30 dimensions it raises that EDA from 4 to 49 and AMaLGaM from 0 to 47 successes in 50 runs, while results on single-funnel functions and on ten multimodal BBOB functions do not change. Restarted CMA-ES remains cheaper in evaluations on the standard double funnel, and the component stops helping when the global funnel is much narrower than the other.

AI.tldr: 该文提出MF-EDA，用类神经模糊系统的"隶属函数并集"构造搜索分布：每代在主方向检出双峰并用1或2个隶属函数描述，各隶属函数与其余方向上的局部高斯联结后从归一化并集采样。隶属函数高度恒为1，使深层漏斗按宽度而非个体数获得采样，从而不丢失全局最优。在36个双漏斗设置中把rank-weighted高斯EDA成功次数从805/1800提升到1712/1800，但每代计算慢8–17倍，且当全局漏斗明显更窄时失效。
AI.motivation: 传统EDA只从单个高斯采样，峰值落在被选个体最密集处；在双漏斗地形上，宽而浅的漏斗贡献多数被选个体，深漏斗（含全局最优）在早期就被丢弃。此外，高斯混合模型按个体数比例分配采样，会加重深漏斗的早劣势，因此需要一种按漏斗宽度分配采样的机制。
AI.method: MF-EDA在每代：①在被选个体的主方向上寻找双峰方向，依据BIC与分离性检验决定用1个还是2个隶属函数描述；②将每个隶属函数与其他方向上的局部高斯联结；③从归一化并集（高度皆为1）中采样。只有1个隶属函数时即退化为单高斯基线。另建立两区域选择模型，说明按个体数分配采样（如高斯混合）会放大深漏斗的早劣势，而并集不会。
AI.result: 在36个双漏斗设置上，把rank-weighted高斯EDA的成功运行从805/1800提升到1712/1800；Lunacek双漏斗30维下该EDA从4提升到49、AMaLGaM从0到47（各50次运行）；单漏斗函数与10个多峰BBOB函数上结果不变。代价是每代计算慢8–17倍（不额外消耗适应度评估）；标准双漏斗上重启CMA-ES的评估次数仍更省，且全局漏斗远窄于另一漏斗时该组件失效。
AI.conclusion: 以隶属函数并集替代混合加权，可有效缓解EDA在双漏斗地形上丢失全局最优的问题，显著提升多漏斗成功率且不损害单漏斗与多峰基准表现；但其计算开销较大，且对漏斗宽度差异极端的情形与评估效率相比CMA-ES并不占优。

title: ChatGPT Can't Sell (And That's Probably a Good Thing): Buyer-Aligned AI Advice, the Sales-Representative Gap, and Evidence from Commercial Conversations
summary: AI assistants and merchant sales agents have different objectives: assistants should help buyers compare options and preserve the choice not to purchase, while sales agents also guide qualified buyers toward an authorized next step. We study this sales-representative gap with three evidence streams. In 12,178 historical English GPT-family conversations screened for commercial or transactional intent, a 279-request sample contained recommendation language in 63 first replies (22.6%) and no narrow transactional action wording. In a 56-conversation explicit-buying sample, 24 replies (42.9%) contained recommendation markers, 32 (57.1%) qualification phrases, and none transaction-specific phrases. These lexical measures do not estimate successful selling. A 2026 brand-monitoring cohort of 1,050 GPT-5.4--Gemini answer pairs over 383 purchase-related prompts showed transaction-specific phrases in 0.0% of recommendation-worded prompts, 0.21% of price/comparison prompts, and 9.52% of explicitly transaction-worded prompts. The prompts are selected, not organic shopping sessions. In a prospective pilot across five matched hypothetical product scenarios, sales instructions produced more next-step language than general-assistant instructions (5/5 vs. 2/5), but no increase in clean product choice (3/5 in both); unsupported offers and fit errors also occurred. This pilot cannot establish a population effect. A separate company-affiliated randomized field study reports higher engaged-visitor conversion for Javo, a commercially trained sales agent, than for a frontier-model agent in shared tooling, but does not identify the mechanism. We argue that apparent reluctance to sell can be appropriate for buyer-aligned assistants. Merchant agents should optimize qualified decision progress through catalog grounding, truthful authorization, and safeguards against unsuitable sales.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三条证据流研究"AI助手"与"商户销售代理"之间的角色差异（sales-representative gap），认为助手的"不愿推销"可能是购买者对齐的恰当表现，而商户代理应优化"合格决策推进"，并通过目录接地、真实授权和防范不当销售来保障。
AI.motivation: AI助手与商户销售代理目标不同：助手应帮助买家比较选项并保留"不购买"的选择，销售代理则需引导合格买家走向授权下一步。作者希望厘清这一角色差异，分析AI在商业对话中是否表现出"销售代表缺口"，以及这种"不愿推销"究竟是不足还是恰当设计。
AI.method: 三条证据流：(1) 对12,178条历史英文GPT系列对话按商业/交易意图筛选，抽取279条请求样本，并设56条明确购买样本，做词汇标记统计；(2) 2026年品牌监测队列，383个购买相关提示下采集1,050对GPT-5.4与Gemini回答配对，比较交易特定措辞的出现率；(3) 五组匹配假设产品情景的前瞻性试点，对比销售指令与通用助手指令，另引用一项公司附属随机实地研究（Javo vs 前沿模型代理）。
AI.result: 历史对话中279条样本的首次回复有63条(22.6%)含推荐性语言，无狭窄交易动作措辞；56条明确购买样本中24条(42.9%)含推荐标记、32条(57.1%)含资格确认语、无交易特定措辞。品牌监测中，交易特定措辞在推荐类措辞提示中占0.0%、价格/比较提示0.21%、明确交易措辞提示9.52%。试点中销售指令产出更多"下一步"语言(5/5 vs 2/5)，但干净产品选择无提升(均为3/5)，且出现无依据报价与匹配错误。实地研究显示Javo转化更高，但未识别机制。
AI.conclusion: 表观上的"不愿销售"对购买者对齐的助手而言可能是恰当的。商户代理不应简单模仿销售话术，而应通过目录接地、真实授权与不当销售防护，优化合格买家的决策推进。研究也指出这些样本为选择性的、词汇度量不估计成功销售、试点无法确立总体效应。

title: The Cross-Context Threshold Test: Detecting Discrimination Under Environmental Shifts
summary: We study how threshold tests for detecting discrimination under environmental shifts, focusing on the Veil-of-Darkness (VoD) setting where visibility changes between daylight and darkness. We show that standard threshold tests, when applied separately to daylight and darkness data, violate key assumptions: risk distributions drift across contexts and thresholds fluctuate arbitrarily. We propose a cross-context threshold test that enforces distributional invariance and monotonic threshold decay. Using New York City stop-and-frisk data and synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that this model yields more reliable thresholds, improves bias detection, and aligns with the counterfactual logic of the VoD test. Our framework generalizes to fairness auditing whenever environmental context influences decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究环境情境变化下（如"黑暗之幕"VoD中昼夜可见度不同）歧视检测阈值检验的失效问题，提出跨情境阈值检验。
AI.motivation: 标准阈值检验在白天与黑夜数据上分别应用时违反关键假设：风险分布随情境漂移，阈值任意波动，导致偏差检测不可靠。
AI.method: 提出跨情境阈值检验（cross-context threshold test），强制分布不变性并施加单调阈值衰减约束，以符合VoD检验的反事实逻辑。
AI.result: 基于纽约市stop-and-frisk数据与合成实验，模型给出更可靠的阈值、改进偏差检测效果，并与VoD反事实逻辑一致。
AI.conclusion: 框架可推广至任何环境情境影响决策的公平性审计场景。

title: Zero-Trust Formal Methods: AI Agents Build Verified Checkers for Untrusted Solvers
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: AI coding agents now generate code faster than humans can review it. Security analyses rely on solver answers such as "unsatisfiable" (for example, no attack path exists) or "optimal." Unlike satisfying models, they cannot be checked by looking at them. Formal verification moves trust from code to specifications, but verifiers still place large SAT, SMT, and answer-set solvers, and the translation into solver queries, in their trusted computing base, and these have had soundness bugs. Unlike agent-based pipelines that trust their verifier and solver, our farm trusts no component by default: neither the AI agents, which might make mistakes or game their objectives, nor the solvers. A solver answer counts only if a verified checker accepts its certificate. Every theory, proof, and line of code is generated by AI. For each component, agents first create an Isabelle/HOL theory with a specification, a soundness proof, and a reference checker made by code generation, then a fast Rust implementation, verified with Verus against a specification that mirrors the Isabelle definitions line by line. Specifications are frozen after independent review and cannot be changed by the implementing agents. A trust manifest lists what is still trusted. We built trust chains for SAT (verified LRAT checking); SMT, with certificates from an extended z3 and verified bit-blasting for bit-vectors and floating point; answer-set programming, with native certificates from clingo, including weight rules and optimality; and, closing the loop, Verus's final verification-condition step, by translation validation. All 3,726 SMT queries from 20 crates are certified and validated, and 15,662 answer-set proofs are accepted by both the Isabelle and the Verus checker. We found soundness defects in three proof checkers, including drat-trim, and in five solvers, including clasp and z3, which report wrong unsatisfiability.

AI.tldr: 提出"farm"框架：AI代理全自动生成SAT/SMT/ASP及Verus验证条件检查的证书链，每个求解器答案必须通过经验证的检查器证书验证；不默认信任任何组件。对20个crate的3726条SMT查询和15662个ASP证明完成认证，并发现3个检查器和5个求解器的可靠性缺陷。
AI.motivation: AI编码代理生成代码的速度已超过人类审查能力，而安全分析依赖"satisfiable/unsatisfiable/optimal"等无法直接检视的求解器答案。形式验证虽将信任从代码转移到规约，但验证器仍将大体积SAT/SMT/ASP求解器及其查询翻译置于可信基中，而这些组件曾出现可靠性（soundness）缺陷。因此需要一种不信任AI代理与求解器的端到端验证方案。
AI.method: 构建证书化信任链：AI代理为每个组件先生成Isabelle/HOL理论（规约、可靠性证明、代码生成的参考检查器），再生成经Verus对照逐行镜像Isabelle定义的快速Rust实现；规约经独立评审后冻结，实现代理不可更改。维护显式信任清单。覆盖四条链：SAT（经验证LRAT检查）、SMT（扩展z3证书+经验证的位向量/浮点比特爆破）、ASP（clingo原生证书含权重规则与最优性）、以及Verus最终验证条件步骤（翻译验证）。
AI.result: 全部3,726条来自20个crate的SMT查询被认证并验证；15,662个ASP证明同时被Isabelle与Verus检查器接受。此外在三个证明检查器（含drat-trim）和五个求解器（含clasp、z3）中发现可靠性缺陷，其中求解器会错误报告unsatisfiable。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在完全不信任AI代理与求解器的前提下，仍可构建覆盖SAT、SMT、ASP乃至Verus自身验证条件的可验证信任链，且能实际发现主流检查器与求解器的可靠性缺陷，为AI生成代码的安全分析提供了可行范式。

title: OSLA: Observation-Aware Local Alignment and Cross-Scene Relation Learning for Any-Scenario Person Re-Identification
summary: Any-Scenario Person Re-Identification (AS-ReID) aims to retrieve identities across spectral modalities and aerial-ground viewpoints using a unified model. However, changes in viewpoint and spectrum can make local correspondences unreliable, while conventional sampling may omit cross-camera positive relations needed for training. To address these challenges, we propose OSLA, an observation-aware framework built on supervised CLIP-ReID that combines Local Identity Alignment (LIA) and Cross-Scene Relation Learning (CSR). Specifically, LIA uses historical identity observations and competing-identity information to select reliable cross-scene local correspondences while allowing unmatched regions. Local-to-global distillation transfers identity knowledge from correctly classified historical local features into the global representation. CSR couples observed-cell sampling with spectrum-grouped ranking to jointly organize and optimize cross-camera relations. Sampling across two cameras and two spectra provides same- and cross-spectrum positives, while ranking constrains positive-negative scores separately by gallery spectrum on the final retrieval descriptor. Both modules operate only during training, preserving the original visual encoder and retrieval descriptor at inference. Experiments on WHU-MARS-1000 and WHU-MARS-2337 demonstrate that OSLA achieves absolute Rank-1 gains of 5.0% and 4.8% over UAD, respectively, under the AS-ReID protocol. The code will be available.

AI.tldr: 提出OSLA框架解决跨谱跨视角ReID中局部对应不可靠与采样遗漏跨摄像头正样本对的问题，在WHU-MARS数据集上Rank-1显著提升。
AI.motivation: Any-Scenario Person Re-ID需统一模型处理谱段与空对地视角变化，但视角/谱段变化使局部对应不可靠，常规采样也会遗漏训练所需的跨摄像头正样本关系。
AI.method: 基于监督CLIP-ReID框架，包含局部身份对齐（LIA）与跨场景关系学习（CSR）。LIA利用历史身份观测与竞争身份信息筛选可靠跨场景局部对应并允许不匹配区域，通过局部到全局蒸馏传递身份知识；CSR将观测单元采样与谱段分组排序结合，两摄像头两谱段采样获得同谱/跨谱正样本，并按gallery谱段分别约束正负分数。两模块仅训练时使用，推理保持原编码器与检索描述子。
AI.result: 在WHU-MARS-1000与WHU-MARS-2337上，AS-ReID协议下相比UAD分别取得5.0%和4.8%的绝对Rank-1提升。
AI.conclusion: OSLA通过可靠局部对齐与跨场景关系学习有效提升统一模型的跨谱跨视角检索性能，且不增加推理开销。

title: Distributionally-Verifiable Rewards for Human-Behavior Simulation
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate survey respondents in social-science research. A useful simulator should predict individual responses, reproduce population response distributions, and capture demographic differences. Common training approaches struggle to balance these goals: exact-match rewards encourage the model to concentrate on the most frequent human response, which is contradictory to the goal of distributional alignment. Meanwhile, aggregate distribution matching can look good even when demographic information is ignored. To this end, we introduce Distributionally-Verifiable Rewards (DVR), a reinforcement-learning reward that uses demographic group distribution gaps to guide individual responses, designed by aligning policy generated frequencies with human response frequencies within each question-group margins. We evaluate the method using the OpinionQA dataset and find that comparing with accuracy-only RLVR, DVR preserves per-response accuracy while reducing JSD by 34.5% in-distribution and 14.6% on held-out questions, with higher DPC point estimates on both splits. Comparing KL-SFT with the demographics-blind marginal further shows that low JSD is insufficient to establish fidelity to population heterogeneity, highlighting that accuracy, distributional fit, and demographic structure should be evaluated together.

AI.tldr: 提出分布可验证奖励（DVR），用人口学分组分布差距引导强化学习，使调查模拟器同时保持个体准确率、分布对齐与人口结构差异。
AI.motivation: 用大模型模拟问卷受访者时需同时满足三点：预测个体回答、复现总体分布、捕捉人口学差异。精确匹配奖励会导致模型偏向最常见回答，与分布对齐目标冲突；而总体分布匹配即使在忽略人口学信息时也可能表现良好。
AI.method: 提出 Distributionally-Verifiable Rewards（DVR）：一种强化学习奖励，在每个问题—分组的边际内，将策略生成频率与人类回答频率对齐，用人口学分组的分布差距引导个体回答生成。在 OpinionQA 数据集上评估。
AI.result: 相比仅准确率的 RLVR，DVR 在分布内保持逐回答准确率的同时将 JSD 降低 34.5%，在留出问题上降低 14.6%，且两个划分上 DPC 点估计更高。KL-SFT 与人口学盲边际的对比显示，低 JSD 不足以证明对人群异质性的忠实性。
AI.conclusion: 准确率、分布拟合与人口学结构应联合评估；DVR 提供了兼顾三者的可行奖励设计。

title: Proper and Optimal Scoring Rules for Risk-Averse Agents
summary: Scoring rules are used to elicit probabilistic beliefs through payments that depend on reports and realised outcomes. We ask how these rules should be designed to induce truthful reporting and incentivise costly information acquisition when the agent is risk averse. For agents with entropic risk preferences in finite state spaces, we characterise proper scoring rules through an exponential transformation, derive optimal structures for information acquisition under bounded payments, and obtain explicit optimal coefficients in the binary case. The risk-neutral limit preserves properness and, in the binary case, optimality, while recovering the optimal betting structure for nonbinary states. For optimal design in the binary model, it suffices to focus on rules whose associated concave function is affine on each side of the prior. The optimal coefficients depend only on the prior and the risk-aversion parameter. The binary optimal rules we construct also admit an exact transformation from a particular risk-neutral optimal rule. In the nonbinary model, optimal design reduces to choosing the best prior bound in a transformed betting mechanism.

AI.tldr: 该文研究在代理人风险厌恶时，如何设计计分规则以同时诱导真实报告与激励 costly 信息获取。对有限状态空间下具熵风险的代理人，用指数变换刻画 proper scoring rules，并在有界支付下给出最优信息获取结构，二元情形得到显式最优系数。
AI.motivation: 传统计分规则多在风险中性假设下讨论真实报告，但实际代理人常为风险厌恶，且信息获取本身有成本；需要明确：在风险厌恶下 rules 应如何设计才能既保持 properness 又有效激励 costly information acquisition。
AI.method: 针对有限状态空间下具 entropic（熵）风险偏好的代理人，通过指数变换刻画 proper scoring rules；在支付有界约束下推导信息获取的最优结构；用风险中性极限分析 properness 与最优性的保持；二元情形解析求解最优系数，并分析其与特定风险中性最优规则的精确变换关系；非二元情形将最优设计归结为在变换后投注机制中选择最佳先验界。
AI.result: 给出熵风险下 proper scoring rules 的指数刻画；得到有界支付下信息获取的最优结构；二元情形获得显式最优系数，且只依赖先验与风险厌恶参数；证明二元最优设计中可只考虑其关联凹函数在先验两侧各自仿射的规则；二元最优规则可由特定风险中性最优规则精确变换得到；风险中性极限下 properness 保持，二元情形最优性亦保持，非二元情形退化为最优投注结构。
AI.conclusion: 风险厌恶下的计分规则设计可通过指数变换统一处理：properness、最优信息获取与风险中性极限均有清晰刻画。二元模型只需关注先验两侧仿射的凹函数类，最优系数由先验和风险厌恶参数决定，且可从风险中性最优规则精确导出；非二元情形的最优设计简化为在变换后投注机制中选择最佳先验界。

title: SemGuard: Semantics-Decoupled Watermarking for Gaussian Splatting
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (under review)
summary: Gaussian Splatting provides an efficient representation for high-fidelity rendering of static and dynamic 3D scenes, motivating the copyright protection of Gaussian assets. In CLIP-guided Gaussian watermarking, a universal message decoder pretrained on textual watermark representations is subsequently applied to visual features containing both watermark information and scene-dependent semantics. However, text-only pretraining does not explicitly account for the semantic interference encountered during watermark extraction. To address this challenge, we propose SemGuard, a simple yet effective semantics-decoupled watermarking framework that learns to suppress scene-dependent semantic interference during universal message decoder pretraining. Specifically, SemGuard combines message-related CLIP text features with message-independent visual features extracted from unwatermarked scene images, constructing training representations with controllable semantic interference relevant to the target Gaussian assets. A progressive semantic interference curriculum gradually increases the contribution of visual features, allowing the decoder to first learn reliable message representations and then adapt to increasingly strong scene-dependent semantic interference. After pretraining for a given message length and semantic image pool, the decoder is frozen and reused across multiple Gaussian assets whose visual semantics are covered by the pretraining data. Experiments on static and dynamic Gaussian Splatting assets demonstrate improved rendering fidelity alongside reliable watermark extraction, while evaluations on static assets further show enhanced robustness against image-space distortions.

AI.tldr: 提出 SemGuard，一种语义解耦的 Gaussian Splatting 水印框架，通过在通用消息解码器预训练阶段显式抑制场景相关语义干扰，实现高保真渲染与可靠水印提取。
AI.motivation: CLIP 引导的 Gaussian 水印中，通用消息解码器仅在文本水印表征上预训练，未考虑提取时出现的场景相关语义干扰，导致解码器面对含场景语义的视觉特征时鲁棒性不足。作者希望在对 Gaussian 资产进行版权保护的同时，解决这一语义干扰问题。
AI.method: SemGuard 将消息相关的 CLIP 文本特征与从未加水印场景图像中提取的消息无关视觉特征相组合，构建语义干扰可控的训练表征；并采用渐进式语义干扰课程，逐步增大视觉特征贡献，使解码器先学到可靠消息表征、再适应逐渐增强的场景语义干扰。针对给定消息长度与语义图像池完成预训练后，解码器被冻结并在视觉语义被预训练数据覆盖的多个 Gaussian 资产间复用。
AI.result: 在静态与动态 Gaussian Splatting 资产上，渲染保真度提升且水印提取可靠；静态资产上的进一步评估显示对图像空间失真的鲁棒性增强。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并在预训练中抑制场景语义干扰，是提升 CLIP 引导 Gaussian 水印通用解码器性能的有效途径，且冻结解码器可跨资产复用，兼顾渲染质量、提取可靠性

title: Temporal Logic Tensor Networks: Foundations of Temporal Reasoning in Neural Networks
summary: In dynamic scenes---football matches, traffic streams, surgery, or assembly---actions unfold at fundamentally different time scales: in football, a kick happens in milliseconds, a possession lasts seconds, and complex events such as a successful pass followed by a goal combine multiple atomic actions over extended durations. Models trained solely on visual data struggle to learn effectively across different time scales, lacking a principled way of reasoning across fine-grained instants and broader intervals. Neither point-wise nor purely interval semantics suffices: the former fragments events into frame-level snapshots lacking overall event identification; the latter treats intervals as atomic truth-values, ignoring state trajectories. We introduce Temporal Logic Tensor Networks (tLTN), a differentiable neuro-symbolic framework addressing this duality via a formal, multi-sorted logic where events and states are structurally interdependent. Extending Interval Logic Tensor Networks (ILTN), tLTN grounds state predicates as fuzzy truth-value paths over time points, while events are first-class entities with learnable trapezoidal fuzzy durations and differentiable Allen-style relations. A compositional semantics fuses static, event-structural, and state-dynamic satisfaction into a single differentiable LTN grounding. Crucially, the modalities constrain each other bidirectionally: the interval layer dictates where point-wise constraints (e.g., Until, Since) are evaluated, restricting them to event-defined spans; conversely, the point-wise layer validates interval relations, rejecting them if underlying state dynamics contradict the relation. Through controlled synthetic examples, we show when single-modality learning fails and how this localization reduces frame-level computational cost on long traces.

AI.tldr: 提出 Temporal Logic Tensor Networks (tLTN)，一个多排序可微神经符号框架，用事件与状态双向约束的统一逻辑来跨时间尺度推理动态场景中的动作。
AI.motivation: 动态场景（足球、交通、手术、装配）中动作跨越毫秒到数分钟的不同时间尺度。纯视觉模型难以跨尺度学习；点语义把事件碎片化为帧快照、缺乏整体事件识别，区间语义把区间当原子真值、忽略状态轨迹，两者单独都不足够。
AI.method: 扩展 Interval Logic Tensor Networks (ILTN)，构建事件与状态结构互依的多排序逻辑：状态谓词被接地为时间点上的模糊真值路径；事件作为一等实体，具有可学习的梯形模糊持续时间和可微的 Allen 式关系。用组合语义将静态、事件结构、状态动态三类满足度融合为单一可微 LTN 接地，并实现双向约束：区间层限定点式约束（Until、Since）的求值范围，点式层反过来验证并拒绝与状态动态矛盾的区间关系。
AI.result: 在受控合成实验中，展示了单一模态学习失效的情形，并说明该定位机制能降低长轨迹上的帧级计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 点语义与区间语义的双向耦合是多尺度动作推理的有效路径，tLTN 提供了统一、可微且计算更高效的神经符号方案。

title: Do Larger Fully Connected Neural Networks Generalize Better?
summary: Greater neural-network capacity does not necessarily yield better performance on unseen data. This study investigates whether a deeper, fully connected neural-network architecture generalizes better than a shallower architecture on the Fashion-MNIST dataset. We compare two architectures under two learning rates and two L2-regularization settings, producing eight configurations. The architectures contain 95,410 and 561,470 trainable parameters, respectively, an approximately 5.9-fold difference. Checkpoints and the final configuration are selected by validation loss, and all configurations are evaluated on a held-out test set. The selected larger configuration achieves 89.82% validation accuracy and 88.77% test accuracy. Selecting the lowest-validation-loss configuration within each architecture yields test accuracies of 88.77% and 88.52%, respectively, a difference of 0.25 percentage points. Across matched training settings, the larger architecture achieves higher test accuracy in only one of four comparisons. Class-level errors are concentrated among visually similar garment categories, and qualitative pixel-removal analyses suggest sensitivity to shape and boundaries. Overall, the findings suggest that increasing architectural capacity alone does not guarantee better generalization, highlighting the importance of considering optimization and regularization when selecting neural-network architectures.

AI.tldr: 在Fashion-MNIST上比较深浅两种全连接网络（参数约5.9倍差异），在2种学习率×2种L2设置下共8组配置，发现更大容量并不稳定带来更好泛化，验证/测试精度差异仅0.25个百分点。
AI.motivation: 网络容量增大未必提升泛化性能，论文想验证更深、参数更多的全连接结构是否真的比浅层结构在未见数据上表现更好。
AI.method: 在Fashion-MNIST上构建两种全连接架构（95,410与561,470个可训练参数），组合两种学习率与两种L2正则化共8组配置；按验证损失选择检查点与最终配置，并在独立测试集上评测；同时做类别级错误分析与像素移除的定性分析。
AI.result: 较大架构取得89.82%验证精度、88.77%测试精度；两架构各自按最低验证损失选取时测试精度为88.77%与88.52%（相差0.25个百分点）。在四组匹配训练设置中，大架构仅一组测试精度更高；错误集中在视觉相似的服装类别，像素移除显示对形状与边界敏感。
AI.conclusion: 单纯增加架构容量并不能保证更好泛化，选择网络架构时需同时考虑优化与正则化设置。

title: Who Gets Re-ranked When a Clinical Model Gains New Data?
comment: Accepted at the 6th International Workshop on Multi-Modal Medical Data Analysis (MMMDA), IEEE BigData 2026
summary: Hospitals often update a deployed risk model by adding a data source, such as laboratory results, that only some patients have. Work on safe model updates assumes fixed inputs and so ignores patients who lack the new data. The update has no new measurements for them, yet their rank can change, and a sick patient not yet tested can drop off an alert list. We split rank-based compatibility by data availability and pair it with error correction and alert-list effects. We compared each update with ordinary retraining on the old inputs, predicting ICU admission or death and hospital admission, on 78,475 emergency department visits from MC-MED and, in a pre-registered replication, 100,000 stays from MIMIC-IV-ED at a second hospital. Radiograph report text gave no detectable gain and almost no extra re-ranking. Laboratory results improved prediction but, at both hospitals and with linear or tree models, pushed patients without labs down alert lists; linear updates also reshuffled them more than retraining did, without ranking them better. A top-20% admission list caught 4.2% of admitted patients without labs after the update, against 18.8% after retraining (second hospital: 4.9% against 22.6%), while catching more patients overall. This held for list sizes from 5% to 50% and in every patient group we checked, despite better measured calibration. Separate alert thresholds for patients with and without labs restored most or all of their catch rate at both hospitals at almost no cost. Teams should check these patients before deploying such an update.

AI.tldr: 医院在已有风险模型中新增"部分患者才有的"数据源（如化验结果）时，会使缺少该数据的患者在警报排序中被系统性压低，即使整体预测准确性提升。研究应分别按数据可得性检查排序兼容性，并可采用分组阈值修复。
AI.motivation: 现有"安全模型更新"研究假设输入固定，忽略了新增数据源后缺少该数据的患者——他们没有新测量值，但排序仍会改变，一个尚未检测的重病患者可能被挤出预警名单。作者希望研究这种数据缺失导致的隐性危害。
AI.method: 将基于排序的兼容性按数据可得性拆分，并结合误差修正与警报名单效应分析。在MC-MED的78,475次急诊就诊上，比较"加入新数据源更新"与"用旧输入普通重训"，预测ICU入住/死亡与住院；并在第二家医院MIMIC-IV-ED的100,000次住院中做预注册重复实验。使用线性与树模型，测试放射报告文本与化验结果两类新数据源，并考察5%–50%名单规模及不同患者亚组。
AI.result: 放射报告文本无明显增益、几乎不引起重排序。化验结果提升预测但把无化验患者推下列表：线性更新比普通重训重排更严重且排序并不更优。更新后前20%住院名单仅捕获4.2%无化验住院患者（重训18.8%；第二医院4.9% vs 22.6%），尽管整体捕获更多、校准更好。该现象在5%–50%名单及所有患者组均成立。
AI.conclusion: 新增数据源的模型更新会系统性损害无该数据患者的警报可及性，且校准改善掩盖了此问题。为有无化验患者设置分开的警报阈值可在两院几乎无损地恢复大部分甚至全部捕获率。部署此类更新前应专门检查这部分患者。

title: FoGConcept: Identifying Interpretable Movement Concepts for Freezing-of-Gait Detection from Multi-Scale IMU Signals
summary: Freezing of gait (FoG) is a disabling motor symptom of Parkinson's disease, characterized by an episodic inability to initiate or sustain effective stepping. Current inertial measurement unit (IMU)-based models can detect FoG accurately, but they fail to explain their predictions in terms of human-understandable movement concepts. A major contribution of this work is to identify nine human-understandable movement concepts encoded by a multi-scale FoG model, including gait initiation, rhythmic bilateral gait, trembling in place, shuffling steps, and pivot turns. These concepts recur across subjects, are functionally linked to the model's FoG decisions, and exhibit emergent specialization across short and long temporal contexts. Repeating the concept-discovery procedure on a new FoG dataset, wider temporal contexts, and a deeper backbone recovers the same comparatively stable set of movement concepts. Accordingly, we propose FoGConcept, a mechanism-based interpretability framework for learning movement concepts from multi-scale IMU signals. Domain experts independently recognize 88.9% of the identified concepts, while the proposed model achieves an F1 score of 94.2% for FoG detection. Our findings show that accurate FoG detection can be understood through human-recognizable movement patterns, providing new insight into what a detection model learns to distinguish FoG from non-FoG movement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FoGConcept可解释框架，从多尺度IMU信号中挖掘九个可被人类理解的运动概念（如起步困难、节律性步态、原地颤抖、拖步、转身等），揭示这些概念与帕金森病冻结步态（FoG）检测决策的功能关联及时间尺度上的专门化，并保持高检测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于IMU的FoG检测模型虽准确，但无法以人类可理解的运动概念解释其预测，缺乏机制层面可解释性。
AI.method: 提出FoGConcept机制型可解释框架，从多尺度IMU信号中发现运动概念；通过在新数据集、更宽时间上下文和更深骨干网络上重复发现流程验证概念稳定性，并分析概念与FoG决策的功能联系及短/长时间上下文下的涌现专门化。
AI.result: 识别出9个人类可理解运动概念（起步、节律性双侧步态、原地颤抖、拖步、转身等），其在受试者间可复现、与FoG决策功能相关；领域专家独立识别率达88.9%，模型FoG检测F1达94.2%。
AI.conclusion: 准确的FoG检测可通过人类可识别的运动模式加以理解，为模型如何区分FoG与非FoG运动提供了新见解。

title: Dhaani: A Data-Flow-Driven Tool for Greenfield Construction and Brownfield Modernisation
summary: Large language models can generate plausible code quickly, but an end-to-end prompt leaves developers with little control over decomposition, interfaces, or the assumptions that must survive later revisions. We present Dhaani, a free desktop application for greenfield program construction and brownfield repository modernisation. It makes an annotated data-flow diagram (ADFD) the inspectable contract between intent and implementation. In the greenfield workflow, Build, a user turns natural-language requirements into a typed graph, reviews process specifications and pre/post-conditions, ratifies generated modules, and proceeds in dependency order for Python or .NET (C#). In the brownfield workflow, Migrate uses source inference to recover an ADFD from a Fortran repository, performs target generation in bounded dependency groups, and exposes source-target alignment, generated code, errors, time, token use, and cost. The tool keeps code and artifacts on the user's machine and supports cloud or locally hosted models. Two scientific synthesis case studies produced executable systems where matched low/no-code baselines failed or were substantially less accurate. On 50 open-source Fortran repositories, the migration workflow made all 382 fixed source-oracle probes runnable and passed 327 (85.6%); two direct translation baselines each passed 83 (21.7% of planned probes). Pre-built installers and usage instructions are freely available. Tool and usage guide: https://shraddhasurana.github.io/dhaani/. Video: https://youtu.be/SShWwOMgJ9c.

AI.tldr: Dhaani 是一个免费桌面工具，以带注释的数据流图（ADFD）作为意图与实现之间可检查的契约，支持从零构建和 Fortran 仓库迁移两种工作流。
AI.motivation: 端到端提示生成代码虽快，但开发者对分解、接口及后续修订需保留的假设缺乏控制。
AI.method: Build 工作流将自然语言需求转成类型化图，审查过程规格与前后置条件，按依赖顺序生成 Python/C# 模块；Migrate 工作流从 Fortran 仓库推断重建 ADFD，按依赖分组生成目标代码，并展示源-目标对齐、代码、错误、时间、token 与成本。支持本地或云端模型，产物保留在用户机器。
AI.result: 两个科学综合案例生成可执行系统，匹配的低/无代码基线失败或准确率明显更低；50 个开源 Fortran 仓库中，382 个源预言探针全部可运行，327 个通过（85.6%），两个直接翻译基线各仅通过 83 个（21.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 以 ADFD 为契约的中介式生成显著提升了可控性与迁移可靠性，并已提供免费安装包与使用指南。

title: ReSUL: Learning Regional Sensor Utility for Robust Multisensor Semantic Segmentation
summary: A corrupted sensor observation is not necessarily useless: misalignment can place informative scene structure at the wrong location. Robust multisensor segmentation must determine where to retain this evidence, where to exclude it, and where repair can recover its value. We introduce Regional Sensor Utility Learning (ReSUL), which learns these choices through their effect on segmentation risk. ReSUL compares full-sensor predictions, sensor-exclusion paths, and a re-registration path for displaced thermal inputs. A router predicts each path's signed reduction in category-balanced Brier risk relative to a fixed reference, then uses these estimates to allocate spatial mixture weights. This supervision connects spatial allocation to measurable task benefit without requiring fault labels at inference. MFNet experiments compare project-trained models under eleven clean and disturbed input conditions. ReSUL ranks first in 10 of 11 conditions in both ImageNet-1k and ImageNet-22k comparisons. Under severe thermal displacement, it reaches 54.58% and 55.63% mIoU, exceeding the strongest competing method in each group by 7.19 and 5.63 percentage points. Fixed-bank MFNet ablations show that utility supervision improves all eleven condition means over task-only routing. These results support learning how to use disturbed observations through their regional prediction benefit. Code is available at https://github.com/D-ST-Sword/ReSUL.

AI.tldr: ReSUL：将受损传感器观测视为潜在有用证据，通过"区域传感器效用学习"按区域判断保留/排除/修复（重配准），以类别平衡Brier风险的有符号下降为监督来分配空间混合权重；在MFNet 11种条件下10项第一，严重热偏移下mIoU达54.58%/55.63%，优于最强对手7.19/5.63个百分点。
AI.motivation: 受损传感器观测并非全然无用：错位只是把有用场景结构放在了错误位置。鲁棒多传感器分割需要判断哪些区域可保留该证据、哪些应排除、哪些可通过修复恢复其价值，而现有方法缺少对这种"证据使用策略"的任务收益驱动式学习。
AI.method: 提出Regional Sensor Utility Learning（ReSUL）。并行比较三条路径：全传感器预测、传感器排除路径，以及针对错位热成像输入的重新配准路径。路由器预测各路径相对固定参考的类别平衡Brier风险的有符号下降，据此估计值分配空间混合权重；该监督将空间分配直接与可测任务收益挂钩，推理时无需故障标签。
AI.result: MFNet上11种干净与扰动输入条件、ImageNet-1k与ImageNet-22k两组预训练模型对比中，ReSUL在10/11条件排名第一。严重热偏移下mIoU为54.58%和55.63%，分别超出各组最强竞争方法7.19与5.63个百分点。固定骨干消融显示效用监督使全部11种条件均值均优于仅任务路由。
AI.conclusion: 通过区域预测收益来学习如何利用受扰观测，是可行且有效的鲁棒多传感器分割范式；效用监督普遍优于纯任务驱动路由。代码已开源。

title: Benchmarking and Adapting LLMs for English-Swedish Medical Question Answering
summary: Large language models do well on English medical exams, but less is known about Swedish. This matters most for small open models that hospitals can run locally. To reduce this gap, we first build an item-aligned English-Swedish benchmark from ten medical multiple-choice datasets; each Swedish item keeps the options and answer of its English source. A conservative refinement loop repairs the translations: open models from three families find errors, ground them in a Swedish medical term base, and keep a model-written edit only if blind judges vote for it. On this benchmark, small models lose much more accuracy in Swedish than large ones, especially when they answer without reasoning. Second, we ask whether English data and open teacher models can close this gap. We translate the training data, let teachers write reasoning traces, and fine-tune two small students on gold answers or traces in English, Swedish, or both. Training on reasoning traces that include Swedish closes the gap and lifts the 1.2B student from 23.5\% to 52.0\% in Swedish, slightly above a 20B open model in its fast mode, with a sixth of its memory. We release the benchmark, its edit history, and the code.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了英瑞对齐的医学多选题基准，并提出翻译精炼流程与基于推理轨迹的微调方法，用小模型显著缩小瑞典语医学考试差距。
AI.motivation: 大模型在英语医学考试上表现良好，但瑞典语等非英语场景（尤其是医院本地部署的小型开源模型）研究不足，存在明显的语言性能鸿沟。
AI.method: 1) 从10个医学多选题数据集构建条目对齐的英瑞基准（瑞典语条目保留原选项与答案）；2) 设计保守的翻译精炼循环：多家族开源模型找错、依托瑞典医学术语库定位依据、仅当盲审评委投票通过才保留模型修改；3) 翻译训练数据并用开放教师模型生成推理轨迹，在英语、瑞典语或双语的金标答案/轨迹上微调两个小学生模型。
AI.result: 小模型在瑞典语上的准确率损失远大于大模型，且在无推理作答时尤甚；使用含瑞典语的推理轨迹训练可弥合差距，使1.2B学生模型瑞典语成绩从23.5%提升至52.0%，略超20B开放模型的快速模式，而显存仅为其六分之一。
AI.conclusion: 英语数据加开放教师模型可有效弥补小模型在瑞典语医学任务上的差距，尤其依赖含瑞典语的推理轨迹；作者开源了基准、编辑历史和代码。

title: Stay or Switch? Metric Distortion with Online Candidate Arrivals
summary: We study metric distortion in sequential elections with online candidate arrivals. In each round, a newly arriving challenger competes against the incumbent, and a voting rule must select one of the two based on voters' pairwise preferences. Our goal is to guarantee low metric distortion at every round, relative to the best candidate among all those that have arrived so far. For deterministic rules, we establish an asymptotically optimal bound of $Θ(\sqrt{t})$ at round $t$, achieved by a threshold rule favoring the incumbent. In contrast, randomization allows constant distortion. We show that persistent randomized dictatorship achieves optimal distortion of $5$ against adaptive adversaries, which observe previous winners, and $3$ against oblivious adversaries, which do not. Finally, we generalize the model along two dimensions, the available information and the action space, and establish distortion guarantees for each setting.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在线候选人到达的序贯选举中的度量扭曲问题：每轮新挑战者与在任者按选民成对偏好二选一，要求每轮相对已到达最优候选人的扭曲尽可能小。确定性规则的最优量级为Θ(√t)，随机化可做到常数扭曲（对抗性对手为5，非对抗为3）。
AI.motivation: 经典度量扭曲研究多为一次性、静态候选人集合，而现实中选举常是候选人陆续进入、需即时决策的序贯过程。作者希望刻画这种在线到达设定下，扭曲与轮数t之间的关系，并弄清确定性规则是否必然变差、随机化能否带来本质改进。
AI.method: 建立序贯选举模型：每轮新挑战者与在任者竞争，投票规则仅依据选民成对偏好选出一人，目标为每轮相对迄今所有到达者的最优候选人的扭曲。分析确定性规则，提出偏向在任者的阈值规则；分析随机化规则，采用"持久随机独裁"（persistent randomized dictatorship）；并分别针对可观测历史获胜者的自适应对手与不可观测的 oblivious 对手给出界；最后将模型在可用信息与动作空间两个维度上推广。
AI.result: 确定性规则在第t轮达到渐近最优的Θ(√t)扭曲，由偏向在任者的阈值规则实现；随机化则可实现常数扭曲：持久随机独裁在自适应对手下达到最优值5，在oblivious对手下达到3；并对推广后的各设定分别给出扭曲保证。
AI.conclusion: 在线到达使确定性规则不可避免地在扭曲上随t增长（Θ(√t)），而随机化能以常数扭曲弥合差距，且对手强度显著影响最优界（5 vs 3）。该工作为序贯选举的规则设计给出近乎紧致的刻画，并将框架扩展到信息与动作空间的多种变体。

title: Audio-Visual Rearrangement
summary: We introduce Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task in which an agent hears a spoken request, retrieves a suitable object, and delivers it to the requesting user or an instruction-specified destination. AVR requires the agent to understand the spoken request and acoustically localize the speaker for delivery. To support this task, we construct a dataset covering three query types: explicit target specification, speaker-relative spatial references, and implicit user intent, spanning eight subtypes with diverse object selection and delivery requirements. Moreover, we propose a framework that integrates a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model to encode spatial cues from the spoken request and update them as the agent moves. We further incorporate auxiliary supervision for speech understanding, spatial audio perception, and visual grounding through multitask instruction tuning to improve action prediction. Experiments establish baseline performance in both seen and unseen environments, laying the groundwork for future research on embodied intelligence and human-robot interaction. The code will be publicly available soon.

AI.tldr: 提出新任务 Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR)：具身智能体根据语音请求取物并送达；构建含三类查询、八种子类型的数据集，并提出融合运动感知空间音频模块的视听大模型框架，建立已见/未见环境基线。
AI.motivation: 现有具身任务多依赖视觉或文本指令，缺乏"听懂语音请求—声学定位说话人—完成取送"的统一能力；AVR 要求同时进行语音理解、空间音频感知与视觉定位，为具身智能与人机交互提供新挑战。
AI.method: 1) 定义 AVR 任务：听取语音请求、检索合适物体、送达请求者或指定地点；2) 构建数据集，覆盖显式目标指定、说话人相对空间指代、隐含用户意图三类查询共八种子类型；3) 提出框架：将运动感知空间音频模块集成进视听大语言模型，编码语音中的空间线索并随智能体移动动态更新；4) 通过多任务指令微调引入语音理解、空间音频感知与视觉定位的辅助监督以提升动作预测。
AI.result: 在已见与未见环境中均给出基线性能，验证任务可行并为后续研究提供参照；作者称代码即将公开。
AI.conclusion: AVR 将语音理解、空间音频定位与视觉取送整合为统一具身任务，配套数据集与运动感知视听大模型框架为具身智能与人机交互研究奠定基础。

title: Specialized Large Language Models for Markovian Reasoning: Structural Cache Compression, Transition Pretraining, and Dual-Loop Transformers
summary: Standard autoregressive large language models attend to the growing history of generated tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a central memory and throughput bottleneck in long-chain reasoning and multi-branch sampling. Yet an important class of reasoning problems is naturally first-order Markovian: the next step depends on a sufficient representation of the current state, rather than on the raw sequence of all earlier steps. We develop a unified design paradigm for Markovian-reasoning specialized large language models. At the cache level, the Markovian state interface transforms history-dependent KV storage into constant-size state transfer with respect to the number of reasoning steps.
