To integrate modalities, we introduce a hierarchical cross-modal attention mechanism in which textual features are used to guide audio-visual fusion as a semantic reference modality. Experiments on the IEMOCAP dataset show that AV-FLARE improves over a no-reliability baseline, achieving 90.81\% accuracy and 81.69\% F1-score, corresponding to gains of +4.41% and +8.56%, respectively. These results suggest that incorporating explicit input reliability estimation may improve robustness in multimodal emotion recognition under the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: AV-FLARE 在时序建模前显式估计音视频在时间与特征维度上的细粒度可靠性，并据此调制特征，结合文本引导的层次化跨模态注意力进行融合，在 IEMOCAP 上取得 90.81% 准确率与 81.69% F1。
AI.motivation: 现有 MMER 系统依赖隐式注意力权重，未显式考虑输入可靠性，而音频含噪、视觉遮挡、情感线索稀疏且事件驱动，导致鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 可靠性由两部分互补构成：(i) 与分类目标联合训练的监督网络；(ii) 建模全局特征分布的无监督高斯混合模型，二者融合得到任务驱动与分布感知的可靠性估计；再在时序建模前用其对特征进行调制。融合阶段引入层次化跨模态注意力，以文本特征作为语义参考引导音视频融合。
AI.result: 在 IEMOCAP 数据集上优于无可靠性基线，准确率 90.81%、F1 81.69%，分别提升 +4.41% 与 +8.56%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在所评估设定下引入显式输入可靠性估计可提升多模态情感识别的鲁棒性。

title: fx(hash): Salvaging The Source Code of 28k Generative Artworks
summary: fx(hash), the most radically inclusive generative art NFT platform, went bankrupt and shut down on August 17, 2026. The ownership of its 2,705,350 artworks is immutable on the Tezos and Ethereum blockchains, but the source code that generates them is off-chain and in peril. We salvaged all 28,193 generative programs contributed by 5,532 international artists and archived them in Software Heritage. Here we explain why NFT generative art is fragile and the steps we took to salvage these software cultural landmarks.

AI.tldr: 伴随 fx(hash) 平台于 2026 年 8 月 17 日破产关停，其链下生成源代码面临永久丢失风险。作者抢救并归档了 5,532 位艺术家贡献的全部 28,193 个生成程序至 Software Heritage，并阐释了 NFT 生成艺术的脆弱性及抢救措施。
AI.motivation: NFT 作品的"所有权"记录在 Tezos 和 Ethereum 区块链上不可篡改，但真正决定作品长什么样的生成程序却保存在链下中心化服务器中，平台一旦倒闭，代码即可能永久消失，形成"链上凭证永存、作品本体消亡"的悖论。
AI.method: 以 fx(hash) 关停事件为案例，系统性地抓取平台上全部 28,193 个生成程序（来自 5,532 位国际艺术家），将其归档进 Software Heritage 长期保存基础设施，并分析 NFT 生成艺术在架构上的脆弱点。
AI.result: 成功保存了 fx(hash) 全部生成艺术的源代码遗产，使其脱离单一平台的存续依赖；同时揭示出链上不可变性并不等于作品可保存性这一结构性缺陷。
AI.conclusion: NFT 生成艺术需要超越区块链的保存策略，软件遗产归档机构应成为数字艺术文化记忆的常规组成部分；此案例为后续平台关停提供了可复用的抢救范式。

title: When Recognition Meets Discovery: Learning Need Not Be Entangled in One Representation Space
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to recognize known classes while discovering novel categories from unlabeled data containing both old and novel samples. Existing methods typically optimize recognition and discovery within a shared representation space, implicitly assuming that the same representation geometry can serve both objectives. Through controlled spectral analysis, we uncover a striking asymmetry: old-class discrimination is increasingly concentrated in the dominant singular directions, while novel-class structure is better preserved in the complementary residual space. More importantly, strengthening the former can even degrade the latter, revealing that recognition and discovery compete for representation capacity rather than merely for optimization weight. Motivated by this observation, we propose Dual-Space Spectral Routing, which dynamically decomposes the representation via online SVD and routes supervised recognition and unsupervised discovery to complementary discriminative and general subspaces. We further exploit their distinct responses to old and novel samples to construct a dual-space novelty signal, which guides Subspace Relation Aggregation (SRA) for organizing candidate novel categories. Extensive experiments across multiple GCD baselines, backbones, and benchmarks demonstrate a consistently improved recognition-discovery balance without introducing additional inference parameters. Code will be open source.

AI.tldr: 论文发现广义类别发现(GCD)中识别与发现争夺表示容量，提出双空间谱路由(DSSR)，用在线SVD把监督识别和无监督发现分别路由到主判别子空间与残差通用子空间。
AI.motivation: 现有GCD方法在共享表示空间中同时优化识别与发现，隐含假设同一表示几何可服务两个目标；但谱分析显示旧类判别集中于主导奇异方向，新类结构更多保留在残差空间，二者相互竞争甚至冲突。
AI.method: 通过受控谱分析揭示识别-发现的不对称性；提出Dual-Space Spectral Routing，利用在线SVD动态分解表示，将监督识别路由至判别子空间、无监督发现路由至通用子空间；并利用两空间对新旧样本的差异化响应构建双空间新颖性信号，驱动子空间关系聚合(SRA)组织候选新类。
AI.result: 在多种GCD基线、骨干网络与基准上实验，识别-发现平衡持续改善，且不引入额外推理参数。
AI.conclusion: 识别与发现应解耦到互补子空间而非共享表示，谱分解为GCD提供有效且参数开销低的新范式。

title: Language models compress human preference geometry while political structure remains prompt-sensitive
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 34 pages of supplementary material
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to construct synthetic publics. Prior work has documented errors in individual responses, population heterogeneity, and prompt robustness, but whether these failures reflect a common loss of fidelity or distinct properties of synthetic populations remains unclear. We tested this using matched pairwise policy choices from 1,991 Chilean, 843 French, and 434 Brazilian adults replayed through three open-weight model families. Across a 27-condition Chilean grid and cross-country factorial replications, no condition jointly reproduced individual choices, population heterogeneity, and political organization. The most consistent result was compression of the latent preference space: synthetic participant variance was only 0.4-10.5% of the corresponding human reference in the primary comparisons and remained below human variance in all 270 matched refits. Political structure was much more sensitive to how choices were elicited. Reversing proposal position changed 12.3-31.2% of decoded choices. Explicitly labeling the endpoints of the numeric left-right self-placement scale changed 20.5-28.1% of choices and moved an independent proposal-level measure of left-right cleavage toward the human pattern in all three settings. Yet matched agreement improved by only 3.1-4.2 percentage points and participant geometry remained compressed. In Chile, the same intervention compressed the synthetic population further. These results separate political legibility from population fidelity: language models can recover salient political divisions while failing to preserve the breadth of human preference variation. Synthetic-public fidelity is therefore a property of the checkpoint, prompt, and setting, not of a checkpoint alone, and must be evaluated separately at individual, population, and political-structure levels.

AI.tldr: LLMs can reproduce salient political divisions but systematically compress the variance of human preference space, so synthetic-public fidelity depends on checkpoint+prompt+setting and must be assessed at individual, population, and political-structure levels separately.
AI.motivation: Synthetic publics built from LLMs show documented failures (individual errors, population heterogeneity, prompt sensitivity), but it is unclear whether these stem from one common loss of fidelity or are distinct properties. The paper asks whether any model/prompt condition can jointly reproduce individual choices, population heterogeneity, and political organization.
AI.method: Matched pairwise policy choices from 1,991 Chilean, 843 French, and 434 Brazilian adults were replayed through three open-weight model families, across a 27-condition Chilean grid plus cross-country factorial replications. Analyses compared synthetic vs. human participant variance, decoded choice stability under proposal-position reversal and left-right scale endpoint labeling, and proposal-level left-right cleavage measures.
AI.result: No condition jointly reproduced all three fidelity levels. Synthetic participant variance was only 0.4–10.5% of human variance, and below human variance in all 270 matched refits. Political structure was highly elicitation-sensitive: reversing proposal position changed 12.3–31.2% of choices; scale endpoint labeling changed 20.5–28.1% and moved left-right cleavage toward human patterns in all three countries, yet matched agreement rose only 3.1–4.2 pp and participant geometry stayed compressed (further compressed in Chile).
AI.conclusion: Political legibility and population fidelity are separable: LLMs recover salient political divisions while failing to preserve the breadth of human preference variation. Synthetic-public fidelity is a property of checkpoint, prompt, and setting jointly—not of a checkpoint alone—and must be evaluated separately at individual, population, and political-structure levels.

title: Decision models for UAVBench and the viability of edge deployment
summary: Small language models are often proposed for reasoning onboard a drone. However, a good benchmark score does not tell us whether a model will actually run, and run usefully, on an edge computer. In this paper we study three related questions using the UAV decision benchmark, UAVBench. First, are small structured decision models good candidates for these tasks? Second, can an ordinary local machine (a Mac) screen candidate models before we test them on physical devices? Third, what software and resource limits govern deployment? Our main Mac evaluation covers 24 model configurations on the same 2,000 validated multiple-choice questions from UAVBench. These include 20 size-and-precision configurations of 11 generative models, plus four open-weight structured decision models that received no additional UAVBench-specific training. A structured decision model, H2O Lightning 4B, achieved the highest accuracy we observed, scoring 77.65% on the Mac. This shows that these models are well suited to this kind of task. However, when we tried to deploy the decision models, we ran into conversion and runtime limits on the edge devices we tested, which we describe in detail. To test local screening, we ran matched evaluations of two generative models on both the Mac and a Qualcomm RB3 board. The accuracies did not match exactly, but the ranking did. LFM2 2.6B ranked above Qwen2.5 1.5B on both platforms. This supports using a local machine to shortlist candidates. That said, individual answers still differed between platforms, so testing on the actual hardware remained necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文基于UAVBench基准，研究无人机机载推理中小型语言模型的可用性、Mac本地筛选可行性及边缘部署限制。24种模型配置在2000道题上测试，结构化决策模型H2O Lightning 4B以77.65%取得最高准确率；Mac与RB3板卡排名一致但具体答案不同，边缘设备存在转换与运行时限制。
AI.motivation: 好的基准分数无法说明模型能否在边缘计算机上实际运行并有效地发挥作用，因此需要系统考察小型模型在无人机决策任务上的适用性、本地预筛能力以及真实部署约束。
AI.method: 使用UAVBench的2000道已验证多选题，在Mac上评测24种模型配置（11个生成模型的20种尺寸-精度组合，外加4个未经UAVBench专门训练的开源结构化决策模型）；并在Mac与Qualcomm RB3板卡上对LFM2 2.6B和Qwen2.5 1.5B做配对评测。
AI.result: 结构化决策模型H2O Lightning 4B在Mac上取得最高准确率77.65%；Mac与RB3的准确率不完全一致但模型排名一致（LFM2 2.6B高于Qwen2.5 1.5B），个体答案存在平台差异；实际部署决策模型时在边缘设备上遇到格式转换和运行时限制。
AI.conclusion: 结构化决策模型适合此类UAV任务；可用普通本地机器（Mac）对候选模型进行初步筛选，但最终仍需在真实硬件上测试；边缘部署受软件转换与资源限制制约。

title: Ask Again: Answer-List Instability in Generative Engines
summary: Visibility in generative search engines is measured by which entities appear in responses, and in what order. Ask an engine the same question twice and the answer list can change: a different ordering, or different items altogether. Across 60,000 responses, we find that answers to the same prompt name a different first item 32% of the time, and even two answers with the same items disagree on which comes first. The first position is a measurement target of its own. A "clear leader" emerges after seven or eight runs, which are the budgets recommended for brand and source monitoring, but a "close leader" only about half the time. After 25 runs, a close leader is identified only 60% of the time. Variability between engines is larger than within the same engine. For open-ended prompts, the gap is more than double that for determinate ones. Search queries and cited sites observed leave most of the disagreement unexplained. Visibility measurement should report, for each engine, which items appear and how often each comes first, each with its own quantification of uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 生成式搜索引擎的可见性测量高度不稳定：同一提示32%的情况下首位条目不同，八次运行仅约半数能确定"接近型领先者"，25次运行也只有60%。建议对每个引擎分别报告条目出现频率与登顶频率，并附各自的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 生成式搜索引擎的可见性通常以"哪些实体出现在回答中、顺序如何"来测量，但同一问题重复提问时，回答列表的顺序甚至条目本身都会变化。现有做法（如品牌与来源监测推荐的七八次运行预算）默认少量重复即可得到稳定结论，但这一假设缺乏检验，且同一引擎内部与不同引擎之间的变异性差异未被量化。
AI.method: 基于60,000条回答的实证分析：对同一提示的重复回答进行比较，统计首位条目不一致的比例；以"清晰领先者"与"接近领先者"的识别率为指标，考察所需运行次数（7–8次、25次）对结论稳定性的影响；比较引擎间与引擎内变异性；区分开放式提示与确定性提示的差距；并检验搜索查询与被引站点能在多大程度上解释分歧。
AI.result: 同一提示的回答有32%的情况下首位条目不同，即使条目集合相同，首位归属也可能不一致。七八次运行可稳定识别"清晰领先者"，但"接近领先者"仅约半数情况被识别；运行25次后仍只有60%能识别接近领先者。引擎间变异性大于同一引擎内部；开放式提示的分歧差距是确定性提示的两倍以上；搜索查询与被引站点只能解释少部分分歧。
AI.conclusion: 首位位置本身就是一个独立的测量目标。可见性测量应按引擎分别报告：哪些条目出现、每个条目以多高频率排在首位，并各自给出不确定性量化；少量重复运行不足以支撑接近型领先者的判断，监测预算需据此重新设定。

title: TabK: Amortized Bayesian Estimation of the Number of Clusters in Tabular Data
summary: Estimating the number of clusters, $k$, is a fundamental prerequisite for most clustering algorithms. Traditionally, this estimation has relied on computationally expensive grid searches over internal cluster validity indices (CVIs) or adaptive clustering algorithms, both constrained by specific statistical assumptions. We introduce TabK, a zero-shot, permutation-invariant transformer architecture that frames the estimation of $k$ as an amortized Bayesian inference problem for tabular data. TabK leverages a novel Quantile Feature Encoder (QFE) to extract position-free, content-derived representations from empirical marginal distributions. By learning a generalized structural bias over a diverse synthetic prior, TabK estimates the number of clusters in a single forward pass per ensemble member. Evaluated across 50 diverse real-world benchmarks, TabK outperforms all competing methods, achieving a mean absolute error (MAE) value of 1.04 compared to 2.14 for the closest competitor. TabK also achieves the lowest average inference time, producing estimates in less than one second on average and running $2\times$ faster than TabClustPFN and $30\times$ faster than traditional CVIs such as Silhouette and Calinski-Harabasz. Code is available at https://github.com/mrbakhtyari/TabK.

AI.tldr: 提出TabK——零样本、置换不变的Transformer，将聚类数k估计建模为表格数据的摊销贝叶斯推断，借助分位数特征编码器(QFE)单次前向即可估计k，在50个真实基准上MAE 1.04(次优2.14)，平均推理<1秒。
AI.motivation: 聚类数k的估计是多数聚类算法的前提。传统方法依赖对内部聚类有效性指标(CVI)做昂贵网格搜索，或采用自适应聚类算法，且受特定统计假设约束，计算与假设两方面均有局限。
AI.method: 提出TabK，零样本、置换不变的Transformer架构，把k的估计表述为表格数据的摊销贝叶斯推断。核心是新颖的分位数特征编码器(QFE)，从经验边际分布中提取与位置无关、由内容导出的表示；通过在多样化合成先验上学习广义结构偏置，每个集成成员单次前向传播即可给出k的估计。
AI.result: 在50个多样真实基准上超越所有对比方法：MAE 1.04，最接近的竞争者2.14。同时推理时间最低，平均<1秒，比TabClustPFN快2倍，比Silhouette、Calinski-Harabasz等传统CVI快30倍。
AI.conclusion: TabK表明摊销贝叶斯+置换不变Transformer可作为快速、准确的零样本聚类数估计方案，兼顾精度与效率，优于网格搜索式CVI与传统自适应方法；代码已开源。

title: AutoRPG: Harnessing Systematic AI for Non-Intrusive Low-Latency Mobile RPG Combat
summary: Automated combat in mobile RPGs plays a critical role in game quality assurance, requiring real-time behavior control that closely resembles human gameplay. However, existing approaches fail to satisfy these requirements, either because they lack fine-grained behavioral control or because they incur high inference latency. To address these challenges, we incorporate user gameplay experience to design AutoRPG, a systematic AI framework for automating mobile RPG combat. At a high level, AutoRPG decomposes the combat process into two stages: a high-level strategic planning phase that formulates the overall combat strategy, followed by a systematic execution phase powered by a suite of carefully designed lightweight modules encompassing target tracking, character movement, dodge maneuvering, and abnormal-state handling. Experiments on three popular mobile RPGs, i.e., Genshin Impact, Wuthering Waves, and Arknights: Endfield, demonstrate that AutoRPG consistently outperforms four competitive baselines across both combat quality and generalization capability, while behaving the most similarly to human players among all evaluated agents.

AI.tldr: AutoRPG是一个面向移动RPG自动化战斗的系统性AI框架，采用"高层战略规划+系统化执行"两阶段设计，在质量保证场景下实现类人实时战斗控制，并在三款热门手游上超越四个基线。
AI.motivation: 移动RPG的自动化战斗是游戏质量保证的关键环节，需要实时且高度类人的行为控制。现有方法要么缺乏细粒度行为控制，要么推理延迟过高，均无法满足需求。
AI.method: 结合用户游戏体验设计AutoRPG框架：将战斗过程分解为两个阶段——高层战略规划阶段负责制定整体战斗策略；系统化执行阶段由一组精心设计的轻量模块驱动，包括目标追踪、角色移动、闪避机动和异常状态处理。
AI.result: 在《原神》《鸣潮》《明日方舟：终末地》三款热门移动RPG上实验，AutoRPG在战斗质量和泛化能力上均稳定优于四个竞争基线，且在所有评测智能体中与人类玩家行为最为相似。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层"规划—执行"架构与轻量模块化设计，AutoRPG在低延迟与细粒度控制之间取得平衡，验证了该框架在移动RPG自动化测试中的有效性与类人表现。

title: Muted Distillation: Sealing Reasoning from Teacher Unlocks Token-Efficient Agents
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is commonly adopted as one of the components in post-training of large language models (LLMs), but in multi-turn agentic tasks we find that the student model increases their reasoning lengths after training. Our empirical analysis shows that the reasoning token lengths is affected by how much the student can distract the teacher's scores. We introduce Muted Distillation (MD), a simple variant of OPD that hides the student's reasoning from the teacher, so the teacher judges what the student does without the interference of student's reasonings. MD takes a few lines of code and adds no extra data or hyperparameters. On the knowledge-work benchmarks OfficeQA Pro and SpreadsheetBench, it reduces output tokens per episode by 57\% and 53\% compared with standard OPD, making the student more concise than it was before training. At the same time, it matches OPD's accuracy on OfficeQA Pro and improves pass@1 by 4.8 points on SpreadsheetBench.

AI.tldr: 在多轮智能体任务中，标准on-policy蒸馏(OPD)会使学生模型推理长度增加；作者提出Muted Distillation (MD)，将学生的推理内容对教师隐藏后再评分，几行代码即可实现，显著缩短输出长度并保持/提升准确率。
AI.motivation: OPD常用于LLM后训练，但在多轮智能体任务中观察到学生模型训练后推理长度反而增长。作者发现推理token长度受"学生能在多大程度上干扰(distract)教师评分"影响，即学生冗长的推理会影响教师反馈的信号质量。
AI.method: 提出Muted Distillation (MD)，是OPD的简单变体：评分时把学生的推理过程对教师隐藏，让教师仅基于学生实际行动来判断，避免学生推理内容的干扰。实现仅需少量代码，不增加额外数据或超参数。
AI.result: 在OfficeQA Pro上每episode输出token较标准OPD减少57%，SpreadsheetBench减少53%，使学生比训练前更简洁；同时OfficeQA Pro上准确率与OPD持平，SpreadsheetBench上pass@1提升4.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过隔离学生推理、避免其干扰教师评分，可以同时实现输出简洁性与性能提升，MD是一种低成本且有效的OPD改进方案。

title: When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development. 12 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables
summary: Tool-using LLM agents must recover when a tool call fails, by retrying, switching tools, or revising their plan. We study how agents fail when tools fail, using RetryRealistic, a sandboxed yet realistic testbed for controlled fault injection in which agents operate on a real OS filesystem with genuine permission enforcement, SQLite databases, a deterministic local HTTP server, and a constrained shell, across 8 tools, 9 fault types with controlled persistence, and 30 multi-step tasks. Evaluating four agents over 2,100 faulted runs against ground truth, we find that recovery is unreliable (19-68% correct) and frequently silent: 6-26% of runs end in a confident fabrication, a wrong answer asserted as fact. The failure mode is governed more by the fault type than by the model: faults that return partial data drive fabrication (up to 38%), while hard denials drive honest failure. The mechanism is what we call silent ingestion: the agent accepts faulted data as valid on first contact without retrying or flagging the problem, then builds a fabricated answer on top of it. We show that fabrication is reducible: a verification-first Monitor, grounding checks in structured tool outputs and issuing corrective directives rather than hard blocks, raises correct recovery from 45.6% to 56.3% and cuts fabrication from 17.3% to 10.8%. Removing chain-of-thought increases fabrication (+8.3pp), so deliberation guards against silent ingestion. We release RetryRealistic, the fault-injection toolkit, and all annotated traces at https://github.com/Kingsford-Group/RetryRealistic

AI.tldr: 研究LLM工具智能体在工具故障下的恢复能力，提出RetryRealistic真实沙盒测试床，发现恢复不可靠（19-68%）且常出现"静默吞入"导致自信编造（6-26%），并提出验证优先的Monitor可将正确恢复从45.6%提升至56.3%、编造从17.3%降至10.8%。
AI.motivation: 工具调用的失败在真实部署中不可避免，智能体需通过重试、换工具或改计划来恢复，但"工具失败时智能体如何失败"缺乏可控、真实且带标注的评测环境。
AI.method: 构建RetryRealistic：真实OS文件系统与权限、SQLite、确定性本地HTTP服务器、受限shell，覆盖8种工具、9种故障类型（含持久性控制）、30个多步任务；对4个智能体在2100次故障运行中与ground truth对比，并分析故障类型与模型的影响；提出结构化输出接地+纠正性指令（而非硬阻断）的Monitor；做CoT消融。
AI.result: 正确恢复率19-68%；6-26%运行以自信编造结束；部分数据返回类故障导致编造高达38%，硬拒绝则导致诚实失败；Monitor将正确恢复45.6%→56.3%、编造17.3%→10.8%；移除CoT使编造增加8.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 故障类型比模型更能决定失败模式，"静默吞入"是核心机制；编造可通过验证优先的监控缓解；推理链对抵御静默吞入有保护作用；开源测试床、注入工具与全部标注轨迹。

title: From Head to Tail: LLM-Augmented Sequential Recommendation and Trade-off Optimization
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at GRAIL 2026: Workshop on Generative, Retrieval-augmented, and Agentic Intelligence for Personalization, held at CIKM 2026
summary: Recommender systems exhibit popularity bias, often under-serving long-tail and cold-start items with sparse interaction data. We propose a group-specific data augmentation approach that leverages LLMs to generate synthetic interactions, formulated as a constrained optimization problem, maximizing group-specific NDCG@20 and coverage while bounding overall NDCG@20 degradation within an acceptable threshold. Items are partitioned by interaction frequency to find the optimal augmentation strategy for each group. We further study combining the augmentation across groups simultaneously and find that while individual optimal strategies navigate the multi-group augmentation design, they are not simply additive. We further ablate on the LLM-based augmentation itself, comparing LLM scales, augmentation configuration under token constraints, finding that augmentation quality scales with contextual richness, albeit at a proportionally higher cost. Experiments with SASRec demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, achieving over 100% and 60% improvement in group-specific NDCG@20 for extreme and regular long-tail items, respectively, on our industrial dataset, and 40%, 25% for MovieLens-32M, while increasing their coverage without significant overall degradation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM的分组数据增强方法，按交互频次分组并求解约束优化，显著提升长尾与冷启动物品的分组NDCG@20与覆盖率，同时控制整体性能不显著下降。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统存在流行度偏差，长尾与冷启动物品交互稀疏、服务不足；需要针对不同频次分组定制增强策略。
AI.method: 用LLM生成合成交互做数据增强；将增强策略建模为约束优化问题——最大化分组NDCG@20与覆盖率，并将整体NDCG@20的下降限制在阈值内；按交互频率切分物品分组寻找各组最优策略，并研究多组增强的组合（非简单可加）；进一步消融LLM规模与token约束下的增强配置。
AI.result: 在SASRec上，工业数据集极端长尾与常规长尾物品的分组NDCG@20分别提升超100%和60%，MovieLens-32M上分别提升40%和25%，覆盖率提升且整体性能无显著退化；增强质量随上下文丰富度提升但成本也相应增加。
AI.conclusion: 分组约束式LLM数据增强能有效缓解流行度偏差，但各组最优策略并非简单叠加，需整体考量多组设计及成本-质量权衡。

title: Which Loans, Not How Many: Exactly Level-Invariant, Anytime-Valid Monitoring of Deployed Risk Models
summary: A refinancing wave can change the number of mortgage prepayments without changing the relationship between scores and prepayment. In a logistic model, conditioning on the monthly count removes the intercept from the likelihood of which loans prepay. Our fixed-start slope product tests a lower bound on the calibration slope. At threshold 20 its probability of ever crossing under the null is at most 5%. The restarted level sum tracks departures from intercept tolerance. A confidence sequence estimates a constant slope, and the restart-intersection rule detects changes in that slope. A continuous mixture avoids the off-grid width floor of a discrete prior. On Freddie Mac loans, fixed-slope resampling reproduces 78% of maintained-model monthly AUC variance in development and 70% in the holdout (95% intervals 57-100% and 48-100%). From fresh holdout starts, the restarted level sum crosses on both paths, and the fixed-start slope product stays below threshold on both. The restart-intersection rule signals a downward change for the frozen model in April 2018 and an upward change for the maintained model in a supplementary run in August 2019.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套用于抵押贷款违约/提前还款模型的在线监控统计工具：固定起点斜率乘积检验校准斜率下界，重启水平和对数检测截距容忍度偏离，置信序列与重启相交规则检测斜率变化；并在Freddie Mac数据上验证其能分离"再融资浪潮"带来的样本组成变化与分数-风险关系的变化。
AI.motivation: 再融资浪潮会改变提前还款数量，却不改变分数与提前还款之间的关系，因此传统按月度AUC等指标监控会被样本构成漂移误导。需要能在条件于月度计数（消除截距）下检验斜率、并区分截距偏离与斜率变化的监控方法。
AI.method: 逻辑模型中条件于月度计数可从似然中消去截距。构造固定起点斜率乘积检验，给出校准斜率下界的检验（阈值20下原假设下任意时刻越界的概率≤5%）；用重启水平和对数追踪截距容忍度偏离；用置信序列估计常数斜率，并以重启相交规则检测斜率变化；用连续混合先验避免离散先验的离网格宽度下限。
AI.result: 固定斜率重抽样解释了维护模型月度AUC方差的78%（开发集）和70%（留出集），95%区间分别为57–100%和48–100%。在新的留出起点上，两条路径的重启水平和对数均越界，而固定起点斜率乘积始终低于阈值。重启相交规则对冻结模型在2018年4月检测到斜率下降，对维护模型在2019年8月的补充运行中检测到斜率上升。
AI.conclusion: AUC波动主要由样本构成（计数）变化而非分数-风险关系变化驱动；所提在线检验能在控制误报的前提下区分截距类偏离与真正的斜率变化，适用于实际部署模型的持续监控。

title: ReqSeek: Transformer-Based Automatic Requirements Identification for Building Large Requirements Datasets
comment: Accepted for publication in ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM), 2026
summary: Large, diverse, and high-quality datasets are significant for advancing AI in requirements engineering, yet automated identification of requirements from Software Requirement Specifications (SRS) remains a challenge. Automatic Requirements Identification (ARI) methods demonstrate limited generalization to unseen documents across heterogeneous SRSs. This work presents ReqSeek, a transformer-based, domain-agnostic ARI model for recognizing ISO 29148-style requirements in SRS documents, supporting dataset construction. We curated the Automatic Requirements Identification Dataset (ARID), comprising 2,396 training instances from 23 heterogeneous SRSs, and fine-tuned four transformer architectures. RoBERTa was selected as the base model for ReqSeek and achieved 95% precision, recall, F1, and F0.89 on the held-out evaluation set. Exploratory human-model benchmarking showed performance comparable to humans while requiring substantially less prediction time than manual annotation. Post-hoc evaluation on out-of-domain (OoD) SRSs provided evidence of requirement identification beyond ARID. Robustness analysis demonstrated ReqSeek's insensitivity to minor linguistic variations while maintaining sensitivity to major ISO 29148-style violations. We applied ReqSeek to construct the Software Requirements Dataset (SwaRD), identifying 10,201 ISO 29148-style requirements from 231 industrial SRSs. SwaRD aligns with textual and semantic properties of human-curated datasets while exceeding them in scale and domain diversity. Our results suggest that transformer-based ARI can provide precise and generalizable requirements identification.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Transformer的领域无关自动需求识别模型ReqSeek，构建ARID数据集并微调RoBERTa，F1达95%，并据此构建10,201条需求的SwaRD工业数据集。
AI.motivation: 需求工程领域缺乏大规模、多样、高质量数据集，而SRS中自动识别需求（ARI）方法在异构SRS的未见文档上泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 构建ARID数据集（23个异构SRS、2,396条训练实例），微调四种Transformer架构并选用RoBERTa作为ReqSeek基座，识别ISO 29148风格需求；开展人机对比、域外（OoD）评估与鲁棒性分析，并应用于构建SwaRD数据集。
AI.result: ReqSeek在留出集上精度、召回率、F1均达95%（F0.89），性能与人工相当但预测时间大幅缩短；在域外SRS上仍具识别能力；对轻微语言变化不敏感、对重大ISO 29148违规敏感；从231个工业SRS中识别出10,201条需求构建SwaRD，规模与领域多样性优于人工数据集。
AI.conclusion: 基于Transformer的自动需求识别可实现精确且可泛化的需求识别，有助于规模化构建需求工程数据集。

title: LightOnOCR for AMNLT: Reading Chant Notation and Lyrics in One Pass, from Single Staves to Whole Pages
summary: Aligned music notation and lyrics transcription (AMNLT) asks for the notes of a chant, its sung text and the assignment of syllables to notes in one output. Fuentes-Martínez et al., who defined the task, found that the one vision-language model they tested fell far behind specialised recognisers. We fine-tune LightOnOCR-3-1B, a page OCR model with one billion parameters, end to end, vision encoder included, to write a staff as a GABC string whose letters denote staff positions. Trained on the published AMNLT training split alone, it more than halves the best published aligned music and lyrics error rate (AMLER) on Solesmes, the one directly comparable dataset (9.9 against 21.0 %); on Einsiedeln and Salzinnes, measured in a different encoding, its figures are also lower. The benchmark does not measure generalisation to unseen manuscripts: while the pitch error on AMNLT validation stays between 1.7 and 1.9 %, on 200 staves from five unseen manuscripts it falls from 24.9 to 1.3 % as we add chant aligned through CantusDB, Transkribus ground truth and silver staves kept only where two readers agree. Trained also on multi-staff images, it reads whole pages without staff detection (pitch error 3.3 to 3.8 % on validation and test pages, 1.9 % on pages of unseen manuscripts). Remaining errors include Gothic F clefs read as C clefs, notes dropped with abbreviated or illegible text and lower accuracy on pages with small notation. Controlled ablations are needed to explain the gains.

AI.tldr: 本文端到端微调 10 亿参数的页面 OCR 模型 LightOnOCR-3-1B，使其把五线谱输出为表示音高的 GABC 字符串，从而在 AMNLT 任务上以 9.9% 的 AMLER 大幅优于已发表的 21.0%。作者同时指出基准未测试跨手稿泛化，并通过加入外部金标/银标数据将未见手稿音高错误从 24.9% 降到 1.3%。
AI.motivation: AMNLT 任务要求同时输出音符、唱词及其音节—音符对齐。任务提出者 Fuentes-Martínez 等人发现其所测的唯一一个视觉语言模型远落后于专用识别器，因此需要探索更强的建模范式。
AI.method: 将页面级 OCR 模型 LightOnOCR-3-1B（含视觉编码器）整体端到端微调，让模型直接把谱表写成 GABC 字符串，字母表示谱表位置；先仅在公开的 AMNLT 训练集上训练，随后加入经 CantusDB 对齐的圣咏、Transkribus 真值以及仅保留双读者一致的银标谱表，并加入多谱表整页图像训练，以实现无需谱表检测的整页识别。
AI.result: 在唯一可直接比较的 Solesmes 数据集上，AMLER 由 21.0% 降至 9.9%；Einsiedeln 与 Salzinnes（不同编码）指标亦更低。AMNLT 验证集音高错误为 1.7–1.9%，但在 5 份未见手稿的 200 个谱表上从 24.9% 降至 1.3%。整页模型在验证/测试页音高错误 3.3–3.8%，未见手稿页面 1.9%。残余错误包括哥特式 F 谱号误读为 C 谱号、文字缩写或不可辨时漏音、小字号谱面精度较低。
AI.conclusion: 单一端到端微调的 OCR 模型即可显著超越已有 AMNLT 结果，并可通过外部对齐数据与银标数据显著改善对未见手稿的泛化，且能整页识别而无需谱表检测。但作者强调基准本身不衡量泛化性，且各增益的成因尚需受控消融实验来解释。

title: Digital Knockoffs
summary: Social simulations often use language model agents to represent people who differ on several measurable traits. However, describing a trait profile in a prompt does not guarantee the agent will express each trait at its intended level. We propose a method that calibrates agents to multidimensional profiles using activation steering: (i) extract steering directions for each trait, (ii) learn a shared mapping from steering strengths to measured trait scores, and (iii) search for a steering intervention for each target. We use Bayesian optimization for this search and evaluate the method on the Big Five personality scores of 500 OpenPsychometrics respondents. In each of five rounds, the assigned interventions yield lower mean absolute error across respondents than the prompting and steering baselines. Further, the model's responses to a given intervention yield the same trait profile regardless of whose target motivated it, so a poor match for one respondent can be the best match for another. When we match each respondent to the closest profile found across all tested interventions, Bayesian optimization yields 16.6% lower mean absolute error than uniform random search at the same evaluation budget. Our method thus offers a way to build social agents whose measured traits dovetail with those of the people they seek to represent. Whether this closer fit translates to improved predictions of downstream behavior remains an open question.

AI.tldr: 提出用激活引导(activation steering)+贝叶斯优化，将语言模型智能体校准到多维人格画像，在Big Five上比提示和引导基线MAE更低。
AI.motivation: 社会模拟中用语言模型智能体代表不同特质的人，但仅在提示词中描述特质画像并不能保证智能体按目标水平表达各特质，存在描述与行为不一致的问题。
AI.method: 三步校准：(i) 为每个特质提取引导方向；(ii) 学习从引导强度到实测特质分数的共享映射；(iii) 为每个目标用贝叶斯优化搜索引导干预。在500名OpenPsychometrics受访者的Big Five分数上评估。
AI.result: 五轮中分配干预的MAE均低于提示与引导基线；同一干预产生的特质画像与被试无关，因此某被试的差匹配可能是另一被试的最佳匹配。在所有干预中为每被试选最近画像时，贝叶斯优化比同等预算的随机搜索MAE低16.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可构建实测特质与被代表人吻合的社会智能体；这种更贴合是否带来下游行为预测的改善仍待研究。

title: SMAD: A Semantics-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Unsupervised Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) lacks a one-size-fits-all detector for heterogeneous data and anomaly types. Existing automation is limited by implicit objectives, potentially unreliable historical knowledge, or high computational costs. More fundamentally, it selects how to detect anomalies without explicitly defining what to detect. We propose SMAD, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that translates anomaly intent into executable, testable detection pipelines. Rather than selecting detectors against an implicit target, SMAD establishes a natural-language semantic contract grounded in measurable time-series properties, specifying target event patterns, expected score responses, and validation questions. This contract governs both detector construction and evaluation: LLM agents propose pipelines, while contract-matched synthetic interventions provide label-free evidence from the target series to assess semantic coverage and guide iterative self-refinement. A semantics-aware ensemble integrates validated candidates and attributes each alert to contributing detectors and supporting evidence. On univariate and multivariate TSAD benchmarks, SMAD improves detection performance over the strongest baseline by 11.5% and 9.6%, respectively, while outperforming general-purpose coding agents at 2-5x lower language-model token cost.

AI.tldr: SMAD是一个基于LLM的多智能体框架，通过将"异常意图"转化为以可测量时间序列属性为语义契约的可执行、可测试检测流水线，在单变量和多变量TSAD基准上分别较最强基线提升11.5%与9.6%，并以低2-5倍的token成本优于通用编码智能体。
AI.motivation: 时间序列异常检测缺乏通用的检测器，现有自动化方法存在目标隐式、历史知识不可靠、计算成本高等问题；更根本的是它们只选择"如何检测"而未明确定义"检测什么"。
AI.method: 提出SMAD框架：以自然语言语义契约（指定目标事件模式、期望得分响应和验证问题）明确检测目标，该契约同时约束检测器构建与评估——LLM智能体提出流水线，契约匹配的合成干预提供无标签证据来评估语义覆盖并引导迭代自我精炼；最后用语义感知集成方法融合通过验证的候选，并将每个告警归因到贡献检测器及证据。
AI.result: 在单变量和多变量TSAD基准上，检测性能较最强基线分别提升11.5%和9.6%，同时以低2-5倍的LLM token成本优于通用编码智能体。
AI.conclusion: 显式定义"检测什么"（语义契约）而非仅自动选择检测器，是提升异构时间序列异常检测的有效且经济的路径。

title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.

AI.tldr: 提出CO-GRAFT框架，用Shapley值与Möbius交互项在闭环检索下分解RL对搜索智能体的增益到四类功能角色，发现查询生成贡献不超过15%，增益主要由预RL答案有效性、检索保留、模型规模与任务级检索预算决定。
AI.motivation: RL将搜索智能体总体准确率提升最多32 EM点，但总体指标无法揭示哪些功能能力在训练中改善或相互作用，需要可归因的功能级分析。
AI.method: 奖励无关的干预式归因：让RL训练后策略与预RL初始化在闭环执行+实时检索下联合生成单条轨迹，各自独占四类角色（中间推理、搜索或作答决策、查询生成、最终答案抽取）；穷举2^4=16种角色分配（不改权重、不重训）构成合作博弈，用Shapley值分解总增益，用Möbius交互项区分独立改进与多角色耦合。
AI.result: 在Search-R1上覆盖Qwen2.5与Llama-3.2（两种规模、base与指令微调、GRPO与PPO、NQ与HotpotQA）发现：查询生成贡献始终≤15%总增益；增益受预RL答案有效性、检索保留、模型规模与固定任务级检索预算主导；大模型或作答格式良好的检查点信用从推理转向答案抽取，较小base模型依赖推理–决策耦合。
AI.conclusion: 总体EM增益掩盖了角色间的异质贡献；功能级干预归因能揭示RL对搜索智能体的真实作用机制，并说明提升查询生成未必是关键瓶颈。

title: Toward Adversarially Robust World Models
summary: Latent dynamic world models have proven to be highly versatile tools for embodied artificial intelligence systems, enabling online action planning, safe policy evaluation, and scalable policy learning. However, this versatility makes world models a vulnerable and centralized point of failure as a compromised model can impact planning, evaluation, and training at once. Therefore it is critical that the security and robustness properties of world models are properly understood before they are universally deployed in embodied AI systems. In this work we take a unifying approach towards this understanding, developing two novel attacks against world models, named state hallucination and dynamic shift attacks, aimed directly at impacting downstream systems, and proposing a new theoretical lens through which to study the robustness of latent dynamic world models. Through our analysis we identify robust latent space encoders as the key component of robust world models. We empirically validate this finding on four separate latent dynamic world model families, studying Dino World Model, Le World Model, r2Dreamer, and Cosmos 3, demonstrating significant improvements in robustness through adversarial encoder model training.

AI.tldr: 论文研究具身AI中潜动态世界模型的安全鲁棒性，提出状态幻觉与动态偏移两种针对下游系统的攻击，并给出新的理论分析视角，指出鲁棒的潜空间编码器是鲁棒世界模型的关键。
AI.motivation: 潜动态世界模型同时支撑在线动作规划、安全策略评估和可扩展策略学习，这种多用途性使其成为集中式、单点失效的脆弱环节；一旦模型被攻破，规划、评估和训练会同时受损。因此在广泛部署前必须厘清其安全与鲁棒性质。
AI.method: 以统一视角开展工作：提出两种直接作用于下游系统的新型攻击——状态幻觉攻击和动态偏移攻击；同时建立新的理论视角来分析潜动态世界模型的鲁棒性，并据此定位关键组件。
AI.result: 理论分析识别出鲁棒的潜空间编码器是世界模型鲁棒性的核心；在Dino World Model、Le World Model、r2Dreamer和Cosmos 3四个模型族上的实证验证支持该结论，且通过对抗性编码器训练显著提升了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的脆弱性主要可归因于潜空间编码器，针对编码器的对抗训练是提升世界模型鲁棒性的有效途径，为具身AI系统安全部署提供了理论与实证依据。

title: Admitted Is Not Effective: Lessons from a Notary-Gated Retrospective Loop in an Agentic Pipeline
summary:
Agentic software development pipelines with frozen prompts can repeat the same mistakes across pull requests (PRs), yet ungoverned additions to instruction files grow without bound and do not generally improve task success. We present a retrospective loop for a four-stage large language model (LLM) pipeline in which a Retrospective agent proposes edits to learned rules every ten PRs and a Notary admits, merges, or rejects them while recording each decision in a provenance ledger. In a pre-registered study of 880 PRs on two Python repositories, the loop ran end to end and the Notary admitted 55 of 89 proposals, rejecting 8 that cited nonexistent evidence.
  However, held-out review comments and hidden-test resolution did not improve after ten retrospectives. Tracing each step of the loop, we found that sparse review signal (0.45 comments/PR) left little to learn from and that rules admitted on their stated evidence did not show measurable held-out effects. We derive six lessons and argue that governed loops should admit and retire every learned rule as a testable hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 提出四阶段LLM流水线的"回顾循环"（Retrospective提议规则、Notary审核并入档），在880个PR上端到端运行，但回顾十轮后留出评审意见和隐藏测试通过率未提升，归因于评审信号稀疏与规则缺乏可测效应，主张将每条学习规则当作可检验假设来准入与淘汰。
AI.motivation: 固定提示词的智能体开发流水线会跨PR重复同样错误，而无治理的指令文件膨胀失控且通常不提升任务成功率，因此需要一种受治理的规则学习机制，并检验其是否真正有效。
AI.method: 构建四阶段LLM流水线中的回顾循环：Retrospective智能体每10个PR提出规则编辑，Notary负责准入/合并/拒绝，并将每次决策记入溯源账本；在预注册研究中于两个Python仓库的880个PR上进行端到端评测，并逐步追踪循环各环节。
AI.result: 循环端到端跑通，Notary准入89条提案中的55条，拒绝8条引用不存在证据的提案；但十轮回顾后留出评审意见与隐藏测试解决率均无改善。追踪发现评审信号稀疏（0.45条评论/PR）可供学习的信息有限，且按其所述证据准入的规则未显示可测的留出效应。
AI.conclusion: 总结六条经验教训，主张受治理的规则循环应将每条学习规则作为可检验假设来准入与退役，即以可测的留出效果而非仅凭声明证据来决定规则存废。

title: ORDO: Fine-Grained Motion Understanding in Video LLMs via Order-Dependent Supervision
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Video large language models (video LLMs) answer a wide range of questions about real videos, yet they remain weak at fine-grained motion such as whether an object speeds up or slows down. Existing methods train these models on synthetic motion clips, on order pretext tasks such as reordering shuffled clips, or with rewards that compare ordered and perturbed frames. None of them requires that the label be unrecoverable from the frames once their order is discarded, so a model can fit such data from static cues without learning to use frame order. We propose ORDO, a framework that builds this requirement into the training data. We define order-necessary supervision as data in which the unordered set of frames has the same distribution under competing labels, and we realise it for motion attributes with three constructions, time-reversal pairing, matched spatial extent and uniform interval coverage. A procedural curriculum of six motion primitives instantiates these constructions, and low-rank adapters of the language model are trained on it with an answer-level objective and self-distillation replay on real videos. With 4,000 synthetic clips, ORDO raises the mean accuracy over four motion benchmarks by +7.6, +4.9 and +5.1 points on Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3-VL-8B and Molmo2-8B, while the same training with shuffled frames changes it by less than one point. Code and generator will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 ORDO 框架，通过构造"顺序必要监督"数据（无序帧集合在竞争标签下分布相同），迫使 video LLM 真正依赖帧顺序学习细粒度运动，在三个骨干模型四个基准上平均提升 +5~7.6 分。
AI.motivation: Video LLM 在细粒度运动（如加速/减速）判断上表现薄弱。现有方法用合成运动片段、乱序重排 pretext 任务或对比有序/扰动帧的奖励来训练，但都不要求"标签在丢弃帧序后不可恢复"，模型可仅凭静态线索拟合数据而学不到对帧顺序的利用。
AI.method: 定义 order-necessary supervision：无序帧集合在竞争标签下同分布。针对运动属性用三种构造实现：时间反转配对、匹配空间范围、均匀间隔覆盖；由六种运动原语的程序化课程实例化，仅训练语言模型低秩适配器，采用答案级目标，并在真实视频上做自蒸馏回放。
AI.result: 用 4,000 个合成片段，ORDO 在四个运动基准上的平均准确率分别提升 +7.6（Qwen3.5-9B）、+4.9（Qwen3-VL-8B）、+5.1（Molmo2-8B）；而同样训练但打乱帧顺序时变化不足 1 分，验证顺序信息是增益来源。
AI.conclusion: 以数据构造保证"顺序必要性"是提升视频模型细粒度运动理解的有效且可验证的路径；打乱帧序即失效的对照证明了增益来自帧顺序利用而非静态线索。代码与生成器将公开。

title: Digital Twins for Multi-Agent Systems: When to Trust, What to Change
summary: Digital twins of agent networks need to flag unreliable forecasts and help users choose interventions. Both decisions depend on what happens over several steps: an error can spread through the network, and an edit whose trajectory is easy to predict may still yield a poor collective outcome. We ask when information about error propagation improves failure detection and whether a learned twin can select effective network edits despite imperfect forecasts. We propose Propagation-Aware Validation for Networked Digital Twins (PAV-Twin). Its monitor combines Jacobian-based propagation features with recent errors and ensemble disagreement to estimate the risk that a forecast exceeds an error threshold. Its planner simulates each candidate edit and ranks the edits by their predicted collective outcomes. In simulations, the monitor gained 0.13 in area under the precision-recall curve on larger oscillator networks with familiar topologies and 0.09 on larger networks with held-out topologies, relative to a graph baseline without propagation features. Gains were small in contractive consensus. Giving the graph baseline the same features narrowed the gap. In a separate planning study, ensemble simulation recovered about 99% of the possible improvement over random intervention selection in oscillators and nearly all of it in consensus. With a simplified oscillator twin, selecting by predicted outcome also gave lower regret than selecting by trajectory fidelity. These results show when propagation features help flag unreliable forecasts and why the quality of intervention choices should be measured directly.

AI.tldr: 提出PAV-Twin，用误差传播特征提升网络数字孪生中的失败检测，并用模拟排序挑选有效干预，强调干预质量应直接度量。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生需判断预测何时不可靠、并帮用户选择干预；两者都取决于多步动态——误差会在网络中扩散，而轨迹易预测的编辑未必带来好的集体结果。
AI.method: 监控器将基于雅可比的传播特征与近期误差、集成不一致度结合，估计预测超过误差阈值的风险；规划器模拟每个候选编辑并按预测的集体结果排序。
AI.result: 较大振荡器网络（熟悉拓扑）上PR-AUC比无传播特征的图基线高0.13，留出拓扑上高0.09；收缩共识中提升很小，且给基线同样特征后差距缩小。规划研究中，集成模拟恢复约99%（振荡器）及几乎全部（共识）随机干预可获提升；简化孪生下按预测结果选择比按轨迹保真度选择后悔更低。
AI.conclusion: 传播特征在特定条件下有助于标记不可靠预测，且干预选择质量应直接以集体结果度量而非轨迹保真度。

title: Engram: Multi-Stage Memory for Agentic Tuning of Heterogeneous Models
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can now tune neural networks, yet without cross-session memory they spend costly trials rediscovering known lessons. Reuse is difficult because production models differ in architecture, training setup and inference budget. We present Engram, a memory system that links past trial outcomes with the hypotheses and rationale behind them and assesses whether this evidence applies to the current model. An online agent curates evidence at the decision points where it is needed: Initial Guidance supplies validated lessons at the start, Session Retrieval supplies related past sessions before each batch of hypotheses is generated, and Trial Candidate Review checks each trial candidate against matching past trials. Between sessions, an offline agent distills validated lessons, making the memory self-improving. On two ads models, Engram reaches the 32-trial result of a no-memory control with 47% fewer trials and also ends with a better model on average.

AI.tldr: Engram 是一个为 LLM 智能体设计的跨会话记忆系统，将过去试验结果与其背后的假设和理由关联，并判断这些证据是否适用于当前模型，从而在神经网络调参中减少重复试错。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体虽能调参，但缺乏跨会话记忆，每次都要重新试错、重复发现已有经验；且生产模型在架构、训练设置和推理预算上各不相同，导致经验难以直接复用。
AI.method: 系统包含在线与离线两类智能体。在线智能体在关键决策点按需整理证据：Initial Guidance（开始时提供已验证经验）、Session Retrieval（生成每批假设前检索相关历史会话）、Trial Candidate Review（用匹配的历史试验校验候选）；离线智能体在会话间提炼已验证经验，使记忆自我进化。
AI.result: 在两个广告模型上，Engram 用少 47% 的试验次数即达到无记忆基线第 32 次试验的效果，且平均最终模型更优。
AI.conclusion: 将试验结果与推理理由结构化关联并做适用性判断，可有效实现跨模型、跨会话的经验复用，显著降低调参成本并提升结果质量。

title: Close the Loop on the Retrievability Gap
summary: A frozen vision-language encoder now guides image restoration and later indexes what it produced. Over a fixed set of eighteen pansharpening systems on one WorldView-III test set, the fidelity index that ranks them, $Q2^n$ with a reference and HQNR without one, picks the less retrievable of two systems one time in three and one in two; the disagreement lies between the pixel-supervised and the language-conditioned family, and even the best system falls short of the reference, small objects first. We call this the retrievability gap and trace it to the area weighting of position-averaged losses. LEDGER closes the loop around the encoder: it indexes the input into a set of named concepts, generates, re-encodes the output alone with the same frozen encoder, and minimises a set-level soft-Jaccard loss on the coverage of that set, a label-free target available at test time, so that every present concept of a scale receives a gradient share independent of its area. Measured outside the loop by label-grounded probes, held-out retrievers, language-free evaluators, detectors and human raters, LEDGER matches or exceeds the strongest baselines in fidelity on four sensors, raises retrieval by seven to nine points within its vocabulary and two to five outside it, closes two thirds of the reduced-resolution gap to the reference, lifts extraction on raw SpaceNet imagery above the vendor product in each of four cities, and transfers to existing generators as a training-only loss at no inference cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，融合图像质量评价指标（有参考的 Q2^n、无参考的 HQNR）并不总能反映图像的可检索性，并将其命名为 retrivial gap；作者提出 LEDGER，用冻结视觉-语言编码器做概念级软 Jaccard 损失来消除该差距。
AI.motivation: 在冻结的视觉-语言编码器同时承担引导图像复原与索引其输出的场景下，现有保真度指标对“小目标”类内容与可检索性不一致：在同一 WorldView-III 测试集的 18 个 pansharpening 系统中，这些指标有 1/3 至 1/2 的概率选出可检索性更低的系统。作者将此归因于位置平均损失的面积加权，并提出“retrievability gap”这一概念，强调需要一种与面积无关、可在测试时使用且无需标签的目标。
AI.method: 1) 将输入用编码器索引为命名概念集合；2) 仅由输入概念集指导生成，生成后单独用同一冻结编码器重新编码输出；3) 在概念覆盖率上最小化集合级软 Jaccard 损失，使每个存在的概念无论面积大小都获得独立梯度份额，形成无需标签、测试时可用且仅在训练时施加的目标（可迁移到已有生成器，无推理开销）；4) 在闭环之外使用标签接地探针、留出检索器、无语言评测器、检测器与人工评分进行评测。
AI.result: 在四个传感器上保真度匹配或超过最强基线；词表内检索提升 7–9 分，词表外 2–5 分；缩小达到参考图差距的三分之二；在原始 SpaceNet 影像上抽取表现于四个城市均超过厂商产品；作为仅训练期损失可迁移至现有生成器且不增加推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 保真度指标与语言条件下沉的可检索性存在系统性错配（retrivial gap），尤其体现在小目标上；LEDGER 通过在冻结编码器的概念空间上施加集合级软 Jaccard 损失，将优化目标从面积加权像素误差转变为概念覆盖，在多项外部闭环指标上均有收益，可作为通用训练期损失嵌入现有 pansharpening 生成器。

title: Coupling-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Co-Evolving Graph Games
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Building hydrogen station networks, electric vehicle charging grids, or vaccine distribution systems requires coordinating two separately operated graphs, demand-side facilities and the supply-side networks they depend on, where each operator's payoff depends on the other's choices. We formalize this as the Co-Evolving Graph Game (CEGG), a setting that sits between facility location, interdependent-network analysis, and graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) but is not jointly addressed by any of them. We propose Cross-Graph Attention with Policy Mirror Descent (CGA-PMD), pairing cross-graph attention, which lets each agent read only the partner-graph nodes structurally coupled to its own, with a policy mirror descent update for stable training. Across three reward domains and a range of practical network scales, we find that the structure of the coupling selects which method wins: at small scale most methods are competitive, but as scale grows or coupling becomes irregular, CGA-PMD is the one method that stays reliable: it attains the highest success count on each of five real city networks, while own-only, unmasked-attention, and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)-based variants degrade in distinct ways. Our theoretical analysis addresses the optimizer side: the Kullback-Leibler (KL)-regularized update admits an iteration-uniform cumulative drift bound, whereas the clip update admits no such bound on the iterations where the clip does not bind. The implementation is available at https://github.com/Mina-Kim-Github/cegg-cga-pmd.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"协同演化图博弈"（CEGG）框架，用于刻画需求侧设施图与供给侧网络图需协同规划的问题，并提出交叉图注意力+策略镜像下降（CGA-PMD）方法，在大规模/不规则耦合下保持稳定性与最佳成功率。
AI.motivation: 建设加氢站网络、充电网或疫苗分配系统需协调两张独立运营的图（需求侧设施与供给侧网络），双方收益互相依赖。该问题处于设施选址、互依赖网络分析与图多智能体强化学习（MARL）之间，但三者均未联合解决。
AI.method: 提出CEGG形式化框架；设计CGA-PMD：交叉图注意力使每个智能体仅读取与其结构耦合的伙伴图节点，配合策略镜像下降（KL正则）更新以稳定训练。理论分析对比KL正则更新与clip更新的累积漂移界。
AI.result: 在三种奖励域与多种实际网络尺度上，耦合结构决定方法优劣：小规模多数方法具竞争力；规模增大或耦合不规则时，CGA-PMD在五个真实城市网络上成功率均最高，而仅本图（own-only）、无掩码注意力与PPO变体分别以不同方式退化。理论上KL正则更新具有迭代一致累积漂移界，而clip更新在其未生效的迭代上无此界。
AI.conclusion: CGA-PMD是应对大规模、不规则耦合的双图协同问题的可靠方法；结构感知的交叉图注意力和KL正则镜像下降分别从建模与优化两方面提供保障，代码已开源。

title: Agentic Root Cause Reasoning and Localization of Unsoundness in Static Call Graph Analysis
summary: Static call graph tools cannot soundly model every dynamic language feature, yet rarely reveal when, where, or why their results are unsound. We present CGRizz, an agentic framework that diagnoses unsoundness for developers and warns users about it. During training, CGRizz compares static and dynamic call graphs to identify boundary edges: calls observed at runtime but missing from the static graph. For each edge, an LLM agent proposes a root cause, including the unmodeled program pattern and responsible tool location. CGRizz validates each proposal using three independent forms of evidence: runtime instrumentation detecting the pattern, a test case reproducing the missing edge, and a warning inserted at the implicated tool location. Validated reports help developers diagnose limitations, while the warnings form an instrumented build that flags potential unsoundness in new programs without dynamic analysis. We evaluate CGRizz on three benchmark suites using WALA, OPAL, and Soot. Of 1,459 boundary edges, CGRizz reasons about 10.3% directly, all confirmed by manual audit, and resolves another 84.1% by grouping edges with validated root causes. Tool maintainers confirmed several limitations, some of which have been fixed. The warnings flag 74%-92% of unsoundness in held-out programs. Guided by CGRizz reports, a coding agent refactored programs to remove 64% of targeted root-cause patterns while preserving functionality.

AI.tldr: CGRizz：诊断静态调用图不健全性的智能体框架
AI.motivation: 静态调用图工具无法健全地建模所有动态语言特性，但很少指出何时、何处、为何不健全。
AI.method: 对比静态与动态调用图找出"边界边"（运行时出现但静态缺失的调用）；由LLM智能体提出根因（未建模的程序模式+工具位置），并用运行时插桩检测模式、复现缺失边的测试、在工具位置插入警告三种独立证据验证。
AI.result: 在WALA/OPAL/Soot三套基准上，1459条边界边中10.3%被直接推理（全部人工确认），另有84.1%通过分组已验证根因而解决；工具维护者确认了若干局限（部分已修复）；警告能标记留出程序中74%-92%的不健全性；编码智能体据此重构去除64%目标根因模式且保持功能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架既能帮助开发者诊断局限，又能生成无动态分析即可标记潜在不健全性的插桩版本，实用价值高。

title: SupportChain: Trace-Calibrated Aggregation of Quote-Grounded Reasoning Chains for Multi-Hop RAG with Small Readers
summary: Strong results in multi-hop retrieval-augmented question answering come from graph indexes read by models of 70B parameters or more, and building such an index calls a large language model over the whole corpus. We present SupportChain, which splits a question into hops, binds each hop's answer to a sentence quoted from a retrieved passage, estimates how reliable each execution is from its own trace, and merges several executions by the support of their answers, the pooled reliability of the executions that agree, stopping once support is high enough. With a 9B reader under the HippoRAG~2 protocol, SupportChain reaches 63.0 F1 on MuSiQue, above the best earlier result of 59.2, which used a 20B reader. With the same reader and embedder, it is significantly better than HippoRAG~2 on all five datasets, by up to 17.2 F1, and it builds no index. Merging by support is significantly better than majority voting, and than letting the reader choose among the candidates, on three of the five datasets and level with both on the other two. The reliability model needs only 100 answered training questions.

AI.tldr: SupportChain 用"分跳+句子级答案绑定+可靠性估计+支持度合并"取代大模型读图索引，在 9B 读者下超过 20B 图索引方案，且无需建索引。
AI.motivation: 现有多跳检索增强问答的强结果依赖 70B 以上模型读取图索引，而构建索引本身要用大模型跑整个语料，成本高、门槛高。作者希望用较小的读者模型、不建图索引也达到甚至超过这类方法。
AI.method: 将问题拆成多个 hop；每个 hop 的答案必须绑定到检索段落中引用的一句原文句子作为支撑；利用执行自身轨迹估计该次执行的可靠性；多次执行后按答案的支持度合并——以一致执行池化后的可靠性作为支持度，达到足够支持度即停止。
AI.result: HippoRAG 2 协议下用 9B 读者在 MuSiQue 上达 63.0 F1，超过此前最好 59.2（20B 读者）；同读者同嵌入器下在全部五个数据集显著优于 HippoRAG 2，最多提升 17.2 F1，且不建索引。按支持度合并在五个数据集中的三个显著优于多数投票和让读者自选，另两个持平。可靠性模型仅需 100 道有答案的训练题。
AI.conclusion: 句子级支撑绑定与支持度合并是可靠且低成本的替代方案，可在小模型、无索引条件下取得更强多跳问答性能，数据需求极低。

title: Schedule, Rank, Profile: Continuous Evaluation of LLM Agents in Games
summary: Games are a robust test for large language model agents: they require sequential decisions, adversarial or cooperative interaction, state tracking, reasoning under uncertainty, and long-horizon planning. However, a one-time game benchmark can go stale as models, prompts, environment implementations, and evaluation policies change, and refreshing it is costly: full round-robin evaluation scales poorly in the number of model pairs, and the resulting outcomes live on incompatible per-game scales. We present a framework for continuous evaluation of LLM agents in game settings, organized around three coupled components. First, an adaptive scheduler that maps pairwise Bradley-Terry uncertainty to reduced per-pair match targets, concentrating budget on comparisons that remain unresolved. Second, a Unified Leaderboard (ULB) that reduces heterogeneous outcomes to pairwise evidence and fits a game-balanced Bradley-Terry model by minorization-maximization with bootstrap intervals, so that high-throughput games cannot dominate the aggregate ranking. Third, a game skill-profile methodology that scores each game along diverse skill dimensions, making the capability coverage of the suite explicit and turning game selection into a design decision rather than an artifact of availability. In this paper, we specify the research design and outcome reduction of the current implementation and evaluate the framework on a ten-game suite spanning perfect-information board games, imperfect-information games, and social/language settings, reporting LLM capability profiles, evaluation-cost savings across model-refresh cycles, and an empirical Pareto frontier relating model performance to inference cost. As deployed, the scheduler saved 61.7% of episodes; it counted each episode in the two team games as four records, overstating their savings, and the other eight games save 61.9%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向大模型智能体的游戏持续评测框架，包含自适应调度器、统一排行榜（ULB）与游戏技能画像三部分，在十款游戏上验证，调度器节省约61.7%的回合。
AI.motivation: 一次性游戏基准会随模型、提示、环境实现与评测策略变化而过时，而重测代价高：全循环赛随模型对数量增长迅速，且各游戏结果尺度互不兼容。
AI.method: 1）自适应调度器，将成对Bradley-Terry不确定性映射为缩减的每对比赛目标数，把预算集中于未决比较；2）统一排行榜ULB，将异构结果化为成对证据，用minorization-maximization拟合游戏均衡的Bradley-Terry模型并给出bootstrap区间，避免高吞吐游戏主导总排名；3）游戏技能画像方法，从多技能维度给每款游戏打分，明确评测套件的能力覆盖。实验在十款游戏（完全信息棋类、非完全信息博弈、社交/语言场景）上进行。
AI.result: 报告了LLM能力画像、模型刷新周期下的评测成本节省，以及模型性能与推理成本之间的实证帕累托前沿。部署中调度器节省61.7%回合；两团队游戏每回合计为四条记录导致其节省被高估，其余八款游戏节省61.9%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使游戏评测可持续、可对比且成本可控，并将游戏选择从可用性驱动转为显式的设计决策；但团队游戏的记录计数方式存在口径问题，需修正后评估。

title: Cross-Site Transformers Are Robust Heart Rate Estimators
summary: Single-site heart-rate estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) degrades sharply under real-world motion. Multi-site PPG provides a natural solution, but existing models fuse sites as generic sensor channels rather than exploiting their hemodynamic structure: each heartbeat propagates along the arterial tree, appearing across body sites as delayed and transformed copies of the same cardiac event. We propose the Cross-Site Transformer, which introduces a hemodynamically informed inductive bias by restricting multi-sensor fusion to cross-attention between PPG sites. On WildPPG, the largest in-the-wild benchmark available, our model establishes a new single-model state of the art, reducing error by 21% over the previous best and 35% over the best prior transformer. The same cross-site restriction makes the trained network directly auditable. Because each cross-attention head lies on one directed pathway between sites, causal resample ablation can isolate and test each direction of information flow. Ablating the chest-to-wrist pathway doubles error, whereas the reverse costs far less. Encoding hemodynamic structure into attention routing thus improves real-world sensing robustness and enables rigorous auditing of multi-sensor fusion.

AI.tldr: 提出Cross-Site Transformer，将多部位PPG融合限制为部位间cross-attention，编码血流动力学结构，在WildPPG上取得新的单模型SOTA（误差降低21%），并使网络可审计。
AI.motivation: 单部位PPG心率估计在真实运动下性能急剧下降；多部位PPG是自然解，但现有模型把各部位当作普通传感器通道简单融合，未利用其血流动力学结构（每次心跳沿动脉树传播，在各部位表现为延迟且变换后的同一心事件副本）。
AI.method: Cross-Site Transformer：只允许PPG部位之间的cross-attention进行多传感器融合，以此引入血流动力学先验的归纳偏置。由于每个cross-attention head对应一条站点间的有向路径，可用因果重采样消融（causal resample ablation）单独隔离并检验每个信息流方向。
AI.result: 在WildPPG（最大真实场景基准）上取得新的单模型SOTA：较此前最佳误差降低21%，较最佳先验Transformer降低35%。消融胸部→腕部通路使误差翻倍，反向消融代价小得多。
AI.conclusion: 将血流动力学结构编码进注意力路由，既提升真实场景传感鲁棒性，又实现对多传感器融合的严格审计。

title: Can Vibe Coding Produce Accessible Websites: An Empirical Study on LLM Coding Agents and Skills
summary: Large language model (LLM) coding agents increasingly allow developers and non-professionals to create websites through natural-language instructions, with limited inspection of the generated source code. Although this ``vibe coding'' workflow lowers barriers to software creation, it may also propagate accessibility defects at scale. We investigate the accessibility of websites generated end-to-end by contemporary coding agents and whether agent-level accessibility interventions improve their output. We generated 90 websites for three projects using combinations of three coding agents, four language models, and multiple reasoning-effort levels. We evaluated complete interaction journeys using axe-core, IBM Equal Access Accessibility Checker, and QualWeb, and converged reports to observe violation prevalence and violated WCAG Success Criterion (SC). None of the 90 baseline websites was fully accessible, with an average of 80.43 violated interface elements. 13 WCAG SCs were violated at least once across the runs. Color contrast was the most prevalent issue, followed by labeling, semantic-structure, keyboard, and visualization failures. We reran 24 matched configurations with a general accessibility Skill and a contrast-specific Skill. Both significantly improved accessibility scores, but neither eliminated violations. User testing with blind individuals corroborated the experiential effects of the detected inaccessibilities. Moreover, functional correctness decreased with the inclusion of Skills. Our findings show that accessibility does not reliably emerge from vibe coding, and agentic interventions can both improve some accessibility issues and introduce new functional ones.

AI.tldr: 研究测评了"vibe coding"（自然语言指令生成网站）产出的可访问性：90个由编码智能体端到端生成的网站无一完全可访问，平均80.43个元素违规，涉及13项WCAG成功准则；通用与对比度专用Skill能显著改善可访问性但无法消除违规，且会降低功能正确性。
AI.motivation: LLM编码智能体让开发者与非专业人士仅凭自然语言即可建站，且很少检查生成的源码。"vibe coding"虽降低了软件开发门槛，却可能在规模化场景下传播可访问性缺陷，因此需研究这类网站的可访问性现状，以及智能体层面的可访问性干预是否有效。
AI.method: 使用3种编码智能体、4种语言模型及多种推理强度组合，为3个项目生成90个网站；用axe-core、IBM Equal Access与QualWeb对完整交互旅程进行评测并汇总报告，统计违规普遍性与违反的WCAG成功准则。随后以通用可访问性Skill和对比度专用Skill重跑24个匹配配置，并对盲人用户开展测试验证体验影响。
AI.result: 90个基线网站均未完全可访问，平均每个有80.43个违规界面元素，13项WCAG成功准则至少被违反一次；颜色对比度问题最常见，其次为标签、语义结构、键盘与可视化缺陷。两种Skill均显著提升可访问性得分但未消除违规，盲人用户测试印证了检测到的可访问性问题；此外引入Skill后功能正确性下降。
AI.conclusion: 可访问性不会从vibe coding中可靠地自发产生；智能体层面的干预既能改善部分可访问性问题，也可能引入新的功能性问题。

title: VidRouteBench: A Benchmark for Budgeted Video-Generation Routing
summary:
Text-to-video generators differ by two orders of magnitude in price, and a cheap configuration of a strong model is often good enough for a prompt. Routing prompts across such arms (model x sampling configuration) should buy quality at fixed budget, but no dataset supports studying it: public video-preference sets contain only closed models, one configuration each.
  We release VidRouteBench: 16 arms from 7 open families spanning 121x in measured cost ($0.0025-$0.298 per clip), 27,110 clips (1,421 A800-hours) over 1,625 grouped prompts, a quality score frozen after calibration against human preferences (68.7% CV accuracy vs 66.2% for the best single scorer), per-clip scores on 9 identifiable quality dimensions, repeated seeds, an encrypted test split, and a sealed newest family for cold start. The evaluator compares a router against the best prompt-agnostic mixture of arms, not the best single arm. Per-prompt specialisation here is real and predictable (oracle gap 0.642, 47% reproducible across seeds, prompt-arm interaction F=4.47 at p=1.6e-63), unlike LLM-routing arms, where the same pipeline finds none.
  We then propose OPMU (one probe, many utilities): label a new arm on K probe prompts, predict its 9 dimensions once, and serve any scenario utility by scalarising afterwards. Over 215 utility directions OPMU Pareto-dominates the prompt-agnostic baseline for 94% of directions versus 90% for per-scenario routers, with no per-scenario retraining. Three baselines fail instructively: bag-of-words features lose almost all routing gain in the low-data regime (0.009 vs 0.168); crediting a new arm with its probe average is harmful (-3.32 recovery) although it is the strong baseline on RewardBench-style arms (0.786); Chebyshev scalarisation does not help, our cost-utility front being convex.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视频生成提示路由基准 VidRouteBench（16 个模型-配置臂、121 倍成本跨度、27,110 个片段），并发现提示级专门化真实可预测；继而提出 OPMU 方法：只需在 K 个探测提示上标注新臂的 9 维质量，即可服务任意场景效用方向，无需逐场景重训。
AI.motivation: 文生视频生成器价格相差两个数量级，便宜配置往往已够用，按提示路由应能在固定预算下换取质量；但公开视频偏好数据集只含闭源模型、单一配置，无法支撑此类研究，且现有视频路由缺少可学习信号。
AI.method: 构建 VidRouteBench：7 个开源家族共 16 个臂，成本跨度 121 倍（每片段 $0.0025–$0.298），1,625 个分组提示、27,110 个片段（1,421 A800 小时），质量分数经人类偏好校准冻结（68.7% CV 准确率），含 9 个可识别质量维度、重复种子、加密测试集和用于冷启动的封存最新家族。评估以最佳提示无关混合为基线，而非最佳单臂。随后提出 OPMU：在新臂的 K 个探测提示上标注，一次性预测其 9 维质量，再通过后置标量化服务任意效用方向。
AI.result: 提示级专门化真实且可预测（oracle gap 0.642，47% 跨种子可复现，提示-臂交互 F=4.47，p=1.6e-63），而 LLM 路由臂上同样流程找不到该效应。OPMU 在 215 个效用方向上对 94% 方向帕累托优于提示无关基线（逐场景路由器为 90%），且无需逐场景重训。三个基线失败具启发性：词袋特征在低数据下失去几乎全部路由收益（0.009 vs 0.168）；用探测均值给新臂计分有害（-3.32 恢复率），尽管在 RewardBench 类臂上是强基线（0.786）；Chebyshev 标量化无帮助，因成本-效用前沿为凸。
AI.conclusion: 视频生成的成本感知提示路由具有可预测的专门化收益，OPMU 以一次探测、多维预测、后置标量化的范式实现免重训的多效用服务，优于提示无关混合与逐场景路由，同时揭示了低数据特征、探测均值计分和 Chebyshev 标量化等直觉做法的失效原因。

title: Information Access and Gain-Loss Framing in Six Large Language Models and Human Decision Makers
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures. Code and model outputs: https://github.com/aadycm/Humans-Vs-LLM-Research
summary: A risky choice can be described by what will be saved or what will be lost, and people often choose differently depending on that wording. We test whether six large language models (LLMs) show this gain-loss framing effect, and whether it shrinks when they can first read more about the options. GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3 235B and Llama 4 Maverick made 11,519 choices across four risk scenarios, each in its original wording, two paraphrases and a mirrored version in the opposite wording. Before choosing, a model could open up to 0, 2, 3 or 4 of seven information cards. With no cards, all six models showed large framing effects: the share choosing the safe option was 27 to 79 percentage points lower under loss than under gain wording. The gap was smaller at 2 cards than with no cards in every model. Against a 10-point threshold set in our analysis plan, GPT-4.1 fell within it at 4 cards and Qwen3 only at 2 cards; in the plan's pooled comparison over all versions, GPT-4.1 was within it from 2 cards and GPT-4o from 3. GPT-4o-mini and Llama 4 Maverick kept gaps of 28 to 66 points with cards, and for GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3 the gap grew again from 2 to 4 cards. Part of the drop from 0 to 2 cards may reflect a change in prompt format, and most card content counted against the risky option, which may favor the safe choice. In an exploratory comparison with 198 students who saw the same scenarios and cards but opened cards one at a time and chose how many, decisions made after opening 0 or 1 cards showed a 19-point difference between the gain scenarios, asked first, and the loss scenarios, asked later, and no clear difference appeared in decisions made after opening more, though this design cannot show that cards reduced framing in people. With these cards, in the balanced comparison 17 of 18 card gaps were below the model's no-card gap, but few were within the threshold.

AI.tldr: 研究检验六个大语言模型在风险决策中是否表现出得失框架效应，以及提供信息卡后效应是否缩小；无卡片时框架效应巨大（27–79个百分点），加卡片后多数模型差距缩小但很少达到预设阈值。
AI.motivation: 风险选择会因"获益"或"损失"表述不同而改变（框架效应）。作者想知道LLM是否复现这一人类偏差，以及在可先阅读更多选项信息时偏差是否会减弱，并与人类被试做探索性比较。
AI.method: GPT-4.1、GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen3 235B、Llama 4 Maverick 在四个风险情景下共做出11,519次选择，每个情景含原表述、两种改写和一种反表述的镜像版本；选择前可打开0/2/3/4张（共7张）信息卡。以分析计划中预设的10个百分点阈值为判据，另与198名学生（逐张开卡、自选数量）做探索性对照。
AI.result: 无卡片时六模型均出现大框架效应（损失表述下选安全项比例低27–79个百分点）；2张卡时差距在所有模型中都小于0张。按10点阈值，GPT-4.1在4张卡时达标，Qwen3仅在2张卡时达标；汇总比较中GPT-4.1从2张卡、GPT-4o从3张卡起达标。GPT-4o-mini与Llama 4 Maverick即使有卡片仍保留28–66点差距，且GPT-4o-mini和Qwen3的差距从2张到4张卡反而回升。0→2张卡的下降部分可能源于提示格式变化，且多数卡片内容不利于风险选项。平衡比较中18个"有卡差距"有17个低于无卡差距，但很少低于阈值。人类样本在开0/1张卡后，先问的获益情景与后问的损失情景有19点差异，开更多卡后无明显差异。
AI.conclusion: LLM普遍存在得失框架效应；补充信息卡通常能缩小但难以消除该效应，且效果因模型、卡片数量和比较方式而异。人类对照设计无法证明卡片降低了人的框架效应，模型结果也受提示格式与卡片内容偏向的混杂影响。

title: CausalNTP: A World-Model Recipe for Causal Next-Token Prediction under Noisy Training-data
summary: This paper shows that transformer networks trained with next-token prediction (NTP) and gradient descent do not learn to make predictions using only causally-relevant tokens in the left context, irrespective of the causal ordering of tokens during training, and identifies the learning deficiencies responsible. We introduce a causal world-model setup, for which, we characterize the Bayes-optimal predictor under the causal view of the data. We then prove that, a function that distills its predictions to non-causal views of data, when realized under Occam's Razor, recovers the true causal predictor. Based on this analysis we propose CausalNTP, a practical training algorithm that approximates this theoretical recipe and trains transformers to depend only the causally relevant tokens in left-context. Empirically in the world-model setup, CausalNTP achieves out-of-distribution generalization that vanilla NTP cannot due to its theoretical limits, regardless of data and model scale. We show similar gains and behavior in the natural language question-answering setting as a proof-of-concept.

AI.tldr: 论文指出标准下一词预测训练无法让Transformer仅依赖因果相关的左侧上下文，提出理论分析与CausalNTP算法以恢复真正的因果预测器。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer用NTP+梯度下降训练时，前向预测会利用因果无关的左侧上下文，且与训练时token的因果顺序无关，存在本质学习缺陷，导致分布外泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 提出因果世界模型设定并刻画其贝叶斯最优预测器；证明将预测蒸馏到非因果数据视图、在奥卡姆剃刀下可实现时可恢复真正因果预测器；据此设计CausalNTP实用训练算法，近似该理论方案，使Transformer仅依赖左上下文中因果相关token。
AI.result: 在世界模型设定中，CausalNTP实现vanilla NTP因理论限制而无法达到的分布外泛化，且不受数据与模型规模影响；在自然语言问答场景中也观察到类似收益与行为。
AI.conclusion: vanilla NTP存在因果学习局限，所提理论与CausalNTP能有效使模型聚焦因果相关token，提升OOD泛化，并在NLP任务上具可行性。

title: HME-PFD: Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to transfer knowledge from large teacher models to smaller student models, facilitating efficient serving of machine learning systems. In the context of ads recommendation, privileged features distillation (PFD) extends KD by allowing the teacher model to leverage privileged features, i.e., features available only during training, to enhance distillation performance. However, in real-world scenarios, privileged features often have limited coverage and exhibit heterogeneous distributions, resulting in training examples of varying importance for distillation and model learning. We propose Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation (HME-PFD), a novel approach that incorporates privileged features into the routing module of a Mixture-of-Experts-based student model. Our method introduces both hard-coded and learnable routing modules, enabling the student to dynamically determine expert assignment based on the availability and values of privileged features. This design allows the student model to better handle the heterogeneous data scenario, where privileged features are partially observed, by differentiating between high- and low-signal samples. Extensive experiments on two post-click conversion prediction tasks demonstrate that HME-PFD consistently outperforms baseline methods. Our results show that leveraging privileged features for expert routing in the student model leads to improved model performance, even when privileged features are incomplete or sparse.

AI.tldr: 提出HME-PFD，将特权特征引入MoE学生模型的路由模块，用硬编码与可学习路由结合的方式按特权特征可用性动态分配专家，应对特权特征覆盖不全、分布异构的问题。
AI.motivation: 广告推荐中PFD可利用仅训练期可见的特权特征提升蒸馏，但真实场景下这类特征覆盖率低、分布异构，导致样本对蒸馏与学习的价值差异很大，现有方法未充分利用该信号。
AI.method: 基于MoE学生模型，把特权特征纳入路由模块：设计硬编码路由与可学习路由两类模块，使学生根据特权特征是否可用及其取值动态决定专家分配，从而区分高信号与低信号样本。
AI.result: 在两个后点击转化率预测任务上，HME-PFD 一致优于基线方法；即使特权特征不完整或稀疏，利用其进行专家路由仍能带来模型性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 将特权特征用于学生模型的专家路由是有效方向，可缓解特权特征覆盖有限与分布异构带来的异质性问题，提升推荐蒸馏效果。

title: Data-Dependent Probability Estimation via Sample Amplification
summary:
Can we estimate the probability of an event chosen after seeing the data, without using any fresh samples? Its empirical probability can be arbitrarily misleading, while learning the entire distribution to constant accuracy requires $Θ(d)$ samples on a domain of size $d$. We show that $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d})$ samples suffice for constant mean squared error, provided the rule choosing the event is known. More generally, our estimator handles arbitrary $[0,1]$-valued queries and runs in polynomial time given evaluation access to the rule. This sample complexity matches the known lower bound up to logarithmic factors and resolves the open question posed by Feldman, Kale, Raman, Talwar, and Tewari (arXiv:2610.41244).
  Our estimation framework relies on a new combination of sample amplification (arXiv:1904.12053 and arXiv:2201.04315) with distribution learning via online optimization. Our estimator achieves mean squared error $O(d^{3/4}/n)$ when $d\leq n$ and $\widetilde{O}(d^{1/4}/\sqrt{n})$ when $d>n$. We complement this with a lower bound of $Ω(\min\{1,\sqrt{d}/n\})$ on the mean squared error. Using our framework, we also design an efficient estimator for data-dependent queries on Gaussian distributions with unknown mean and identity covariance. Finally, we show that a smoothed variant of the problem is much (exponentially) easier. For discrete distributions, if the sample size is chosen uniformly from $\{n,\ldots,2n-1\}$, then $n=O(\log d)$ suffices for constant mean squared error.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"在看到数据后再选择事件"的置信估计问题，证明在已知选择规则时，用 Õ(√d) 个样本即可达到常数均方误差，打破了学习整个分布所需的 Θ(d) 下界，并给出匹配的下界与多项式时间估计器。
AI.motivation: 实际中常需估计一个事后（data-dependent）选定事件的概率，但其经验概率可能严重误导；而用常数精度学习整个分布又需要 Θ(d) 样本。作者旨在回答 Feldman 等人提出的开放问题：能否不用新样本、以远少于 d 的样本量实现可靠估计。
AI.method: 提出新的估计框架，将"样本放大"（sample amplification）与基于在线优化的分布学习相结合；估计器在给定规则求值访问下多项式时间运行，并支持任意 [0,1] 值查询，进一步推广到未知均值、单位协方差的高斯分布上的数据依赖查询。
AI.result: 常数均方误差下 Õ(√d) 样本即可，匹配已知下界（差对数因子）；当 d≤n 时 MSE 为 O(d^{3/4}/n)，d>n 时 Õ(d^{1/4}/√n)；下界为 Ω(min{1,√d/n})。此外，若样本量从 {n,…,2n-1} 均匀选取，离散分布下仅需 n=O(log d) 即可达到常数均方误差，说明平滑版本呈指数级更易。
AI.conclusion: 论文解决了数据依赖事件概率估计的开放问题，给出样本复杂度上与下界基本匹配的多项式时间估计器，并揭示平滑化可大幅降低问题难度。

title: Landscape and Taxonomy of Prompt Engineering Patterns in Software Engineering
comment: Published in IEEE IT Professional, vol. 27, no. 1, pp. 41-49, 2025. Recipient of the IT Professional 2025 Best Paper Award. 8 pages, 2 figures
summary: Advancements in large language models (LLMs) have enhanced their ability to handle ambiguous user instructions. However, effective prompt patterns remain crucial for usability and comprehension. This article presents a taxonomy of prompt engineering patterns for software engineering. It is based on a systematic literature review that was conducted in early 2023, when LLMs still faced significant limitations in context length and inference capabilities. Our study explores techniques that enhance the usability and reliability of LLMs, emphasizing the ongoing importance of well-designed prompts in optimizing task performance. Our findings highlight the critical role of prompt patterns in maximizing LLM's potential, even as their capabilities continue to evolve.

AI.tldr: 提出面向软件工程的提示工程模式分类法，基于2023年初的系统文献综述，强调即便LLM能力进化，精心设计的提示模式仍对可用性与任务性能至关重要。
AI.motivation: LLM虽能处理模糊指令，但有效提示模式对可用性和理解仍很关键，软件工程领域缺少系统的提示模式分类整理。
AI.method: 基于2023年初开展的系统文献综述，归纳并提出软件工程领域的提示工程模式分类法（taxonomy）。
AI.result: 识别出提升LLM可用性与可靠性的多种技术，形成提示模式分类，阐明提示设计在优化任务表现中的作用。
AI.conclusion: 提示模式对最大化LLM潜力具有关键作用，即使模型能力持续演进，良好设计的提示依然不可或缺。

title: You Only Think Once: Rescuing Hybrid Vision-Language Models Lost in Thought
summary: Thinking at length before answering is expected to strengthen the visual reasoning of vision-language models (VLMs), yet hybrid VLMs often get lost in thought: their thoughts loop or exhaust the budget without an answer, so thinking can score below answering directly. Existing early-exit methods watch a thought for the moment its answer is ready and force the answer out of it, but in a hybrid VLM that moment often never comes. We find that the remedy is not to stop a failing thought earlier, but to stop taking its answer: once a thought is given up, the model's own direct answers decide. Based on this, we propose **YOTO (You Only Think Once)**, a method that answers first and thinks at most once. YOTO draws direct answers until a probe-weighted vote settles; only an unsettled problem receives a single thought, which a failure head on the hidden state monitors and stops as soon as it predicts failure, handing the problem back to direct answers. At a matched 20k-token budget, YOTO is up to 5.9 points more accurate than the strongest early-exit baseline, using one failure-head threshold across model sizes. Keeping the released weights frozen, it adds only two linear probes. On the full MathVision benchmark, YOTO improves Qwen3.5-2B from 40.1% to 57.3% and Qwen3.5-4B from 68.3% to 73.7%, above the 72.8% that Qwen3.5-9B, a model more than twice its size, reaches with thinking. Its gains carry over to five further benchmarks and a second model family. These results suggest that hybrid VLMs reason better by answering first and thinking once than by thinking longer.

AI.tldr: 提出YOTO方法：先直接作答，仅对未决问题思考一次，并用失败检测头及时终止失败思考；在等预算下显著优于早退方法。
AI.motivation: 混合式VLM长思考常陷入循环或耗尽预算仍无答案，思考反而可能不如直接作答；现有早退方法依赖"答案就绪时刻"，而在混合VLM中该时刻常不出现。
AI.method: YOTO采用"先答后思、至多思一次"：多次直接作答并由探针加权投票决定是否已决；仅未决问题进入一次思考，由隐藏状态上的失败检测头监控，一旦预测失败即停止并交回直接作答。权重冻结，仅新增两个线性探针，阈值跨模型尺寸通用。
AI.result: 20k token等预算下比最强早退基线最高提升5.9分；MathVision上Qwen3.5-2B由40.1%升至57.3%，4B由68.3%升至73.7%，超过9B带思考的72.8%；另在五个基准和第二个模型家族上验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 混合式VLM"先作答、只思一次"优于"思考更久"，提示关键不在提前停止思考，而在于放弃失败思考的答案。

title: BIRD-Persona: A Persona-Aware Benchmark for SQL and pandas Analytics Code Generation
summary: Production text-to-code systems use large language models to turn natural-language analytics requests into executable SQL and pandas code. Existing benchmarks cover both tasks but do not isolate when performance diverges between them. We introduce BIRD-Persona, a persona-stratified extension of BIRD-Python that adds novice and expert rewrites to tasks with matched SQL and pandas ground truth, along with schema variants and task-structure annotations. Across 1,534 tasks, nine models, and 245,592 evaluations, SQL outperforms pandas for eight of nine systems. The gap varies by condition: expert, schema-explicit prompts improve both paradigms but help SQL more; schema representations have mixed, model-dependent effects; and selected-column burden widens the gap while subqueries do not. By making user phrasing a controlled benchmark dimension, BIRD-Persona supports persona-aware and paradigm-aware evaluation of natural-language analytics systems. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/optum-cognition-lab/BIRD-Persona.

AI.tldr: BIRD-Persona 是一个按用户画像分层的基准，用匹配的 SQL 与 pandas 标准答案比较两种范式，发现九个系统中八个 SQL 优于 pandas，且差距随提示专业性、模式表达和列选择负担而变化。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到代码基准虽同时覆盖 SQL 与 pandas，但无法隔离出两者性能在何种条件下出现分化，也缺乏对用户表述方式这一维度的控制。
AI.method: 在 BIRD-Python 基础上扩展，加入新手与专家两种改写、匹配的 SQL/pandas 标准答案、模式变体及任务结构标注；评测 1,534 个任务、9 个模型，共 245,592 次评估。
AI.result: 九个系统中有八个 SQL 优于 pandas。专家级、显式给出模式的提示对两者都有提升但更利于 SQL；模式表示的影响因模型而异；需选择列的负担会扩大差距，而子查询不会。
AI.conclusion: 将用户表述作为受控基准维度，可支持画像感知与范式感知的自然语言分析系统评测；数据集已公开。

title: The Effect of Security-Focused Prompts on Reported Findings: A Controlled Experiment on 400 AI-Generated Web Applications
summary: Agentic coding tools turn a specification into a running web application, so their defaults for authentication, sessions, input validation, and dependencies become its security posture. This study asks whether appending a fixed block of OWASP-aligned security requirements to the prompt changes what such tools produce, by how much, and with what side effects. Each of 100 frozen specifications was realized four times: two agentic tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI) crossed with two prompts sharing a byte-identical functional core, without (A) and with (B) the security block. A fixed static and dynamic pipeline scanned the 400 applications, yielding 6,721 triaged findings, analyzed with count and logistic mixed models and with a dependency diff. The block cut findings per application by a third (incidence-rate ratio 0.65, 95% CI 0.60-0.71), equally through both tools, and roughly doubled the declared dependency surface, so variant-B applications carried more high-severity dependency advisories. Adjusted for that surface the advisory rate did not rise (flat per application, 18% lower in aggregate), while high-severity findings in first-party source fell by nearly half. Security-focused prompting is therefore an inexpensive and portable improvement, but it enlarges the dependency surface that has to be audited against it, an effect of library selection rather than of the security requirements themselves.

AI.tldr: 向编码智能体提示中加入固定的OWASP安全需求块，可将每应用安全发现减少约三分之一（IRR 0.65），且对两种工具效果一致；但会使声明依赖面扩大约一倍，带来更多高危依赖告警——按依赖面归一后告警率未上升，说明这源于库选择而非安全需求本身。
AI.motivation: 智能体编码工具把规格直接变成可运行的Web应用，其认证、会话、输入校验与依赖的默认设置即成为应用的安全姿态。作者想知道：在提示中附加一段符合OWASP的安全要求，是否会改变产物、改变多少、以及有什么副作用。
AI.method: 100份冻结规格×4种条件：两种工具（Claude Code、Codex CLI）×两种提示（功能核心逐字节相同，无安全块A / 有安全块B），共400个应用。用固定的静态+动态流水线扫描，得到6,721条经分诊的发现；采用计数模型与logistic混合模型分析，并做依赖差异比较。
AI.result: B组每应用发现数下降约三分之一（IRR 0.65，95% CI 0.60–0.71），两种工具效果相同；声明依赖面约翻倍，故B组应用携带更多高危依赖告警；但按依赖面调整后告警率未上升（每应用持平，总量低18%），且第一方源码中的高危发现减少近一半。
AI.conclusion: 以安全为中心的提示是一种低成本、可移植的改进；但它会扩大需审计的依赖面，这是库选择带来的副作用，而非安全需求本身所致，因此落地时需配套依赖审计。

title: Bridging Blind Spots With Words: Decentralized Multi-View Spatial Reasoning via Language-Constrained Communication
summary: As multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) get increasingly used as collaborative partners across embodied robotics, AR/VR, and multi-user systems, spatial reasoning is now often distributed across agents with partial environment visibility, necessitating spatial reasoning integration. Prior work in language-mediated spatial integration is however strictly limited to simplified two-agent scenarios.
