To address this gap, we first formalize the general problem of decentralized multi-view spatial reasoning, where N agents observe distinct viewpoints, exchange budget-constrained natural language messages, and collaborate to enable a listener to answer spatial queries. We then introduce a novel multi-view spatial benchmark to isolate queries that demand non-trivial multi-view integration. Through an extensive empirical study, we discover that the penalty of restricting decentralized spatial reasoning to natural language with limited budget is far smaller than suggested by prior two-agent literature. Nevertheless, we observe that substantial headroom still remains for multi-agent spatial reasoning in this setting, as evidenced by a significant gap between current centralized performance and an oracle best-of-K ceiling. Moreover, we show that reinforcement learning with credit assignment substantially bolsters the decentralized model, effectively closing the gap with the centralized baseline.

AI.tldr: 该文将语言中介的空间推理从两智能体推广到N智能体去中心化多视角场景，构建新基准并发现语言通信约束的代价远小于先前认知，但仍有较大提升空间，强化学习+信用分配可显著缩小与集中式基线的差距。
AI.motivation: MLLM日益作为协作伙伴用于具身机器人、AR/VR和多用户系统，空间推理常分布在只有部分环境可见性的多个智能体之间，需要跨智能体整合；而现有语言中介的空间整合研究仅限简化的两智能体场景。
AI.method: 形式化去中心化多视角空间推理问题（N个智能体各观察不同视角、交换受预算约束的自然语言消息、协助听者回答空间查询）；构建新多视角空间基准，专门隔离需要非平凡多视角整合的查询；并通过大规模实证研究评估，包括采用带信用分配的强化学习方法。
AI.result: 将去中心化空间推理限制为有限预算自然语言的性能代价，远小于先前两智能体文献所暗示；但与集中式性能及oracle best-of-K上限相比仍存在显著差距；带信用分配的强化学习显著增强去中心化模型，基本弥合与集中式基线的差距。
AI.conclusion: N智能体去中心化多视角空间推理在有前景的同时仍有提升空间，信用分配强化学习是有效方向，为多智能体空间推理集成提供了问题定义、基准与实证依据。

title: WingBench: Benchmarking How AI Agents Search for Better Designs
summary: Design search often uses cheap learned predictions to choose which candidates deserve expensive tests, but these tests can fail, especially on the unusual designs that optimization favors. We introduce WingBench, a multifidelity benchmark in which optimizers and AI agents design transonic wings with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) inside the search. They can query a learned aerodynamic surrogate and spend a fixed budget of sequential CFD evaluations, each returning a score or a failure type. WingBench grades the design each method recommends, reporting separately whether it receives a valid score and how good that score is. Using WingBench, we contribute a study of five baseline optimizers and a comparison of three AI agent methods, which produced 6,629 CFD evaluation records. Feedback helps baseline optimizers deliver valid designs when it changes their later proposals, but the differential-evolution variant does so with lower aerodynamic quality. An open-ended research agent finds designs of similar quality to the strongest baselines over 32 CFD queries, with different prior information and unmatched total computation. In early search, our reflection and planning implementations do not consistently improve on it. We release the data, code, agent prompts, and analysis scripts for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 提出 WingBench 多保真基准：优化器与 AI 智能体在有限 CFD 预算下设计跨声速机翼，分别评估"能否得到有效分数"与"分数好坏"，并对比 5 个基线优化器与 3 种 AI 智能体方法（共 6,629 条 CFD 记录）。
AI.motivation: 设计搜索常用廉价的代理预测筛选候选、再用昂贵测试验证，但这些测试易失败，尤其在优化偏好的"异常设计"上；现有基准缺少同时衡量失败率与设计质量的多保真评测环境。
AI.method: 构建 WingBench：搜索中可查询学习式气动代理，并消耗固定预算的顺序 CFD 评估，每次返回分数或失败类型；按"是否获得有效分数"和"分数质量"两项分别打分；用其开展 5 个基线优化器与 3 种 AI 智能体方法的对比研究。
AI.result: 反馈在能改变后续提议时可让基线优化器产出有效设计，但差分进化变体虽有效性提升、气动质量却更低；开放式研究智能体在 32 次 CFD 查询内达到与最强基线相近的质量（先验信息不同、总计算量不可比）；早期搜索中，其反思与规划实现未能稳定超越该智能体。
AI.conclusion: 多保真反馈的有效性需同时以"成功率"和"质量"衡量，二者存在权衡；智能体方法有潜力但尚无明显增益。作者公开数据、代码、提示词与分析脚本以保证可复现。

title: Context-Aware Proactive Self-Adaptation: A Two-Layer Model Predictive Control Approach
comment: Author's version of an article published in ACM Transactions on Autonomous and Adaptive Systems (TAAS), vol. 21, no. 2, Article 13, 2026. 36 pages
summary: In self-adaptive software systems, the role of context is paramount, especially for proactive self-adaptation. Current research, however, does not fully explore context's impact, for example on priorities of the requirements. To address this gap, we introduce a novel contextual goal model to capture these factors and their influence on the system. Using this, we propose a two-layer control mechanism with a context-aware model predictive control to achieve proactive adaptation for the software system and adaptation for the controller itself. By contextual prediction and a more accurate system model, our approach utilizes model predictive control to facilitate timely and efficient system adaptations, improving both performance and adaptability. Meanwhile, we perform requirement adaptation to update the contextual goal model, which in turn updates the objective function and constraints of the controller. Our experimental evaluations across two scenarios demonstrate the significant benefits of our approach in enhancing system performance.

AI.tldr: 提出上下文目标模型与两层控制机制（上下文感知MPC）,同时实现系统主动自适应与控制器自身的自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应软件研究未充分探讨上下文的影响,例如对需求优先级的影响,尤其缺乏对主动自适应的支持。
AI.method: 引入新颖的上下文目标模型刻画上下文因素及其对系统的影响;基于此设计两层控制机制:一层用上下文感知的模型预测控制（结合上下文预测与更精确的系统模型）实现及时的主动系统适应,另一层进行需求自适应以更新上下文目标模型,进而更新控制器的目标函数与约束。
AI.result: 在两个场景的实验评估中,该方法在提升系统性能方面表现出显著收益,同时改善了性能与适应性。
AI.conclusion: 将上下文建模与MPC结合的两层控制机制能有效支持主动自适应,并通过需求自适应持续更新控制模型,验证了上下文感知对自适应系统的重要价值。

title: Scale-Aware Reference Attention for Mannequin-to-Model Gown Generation
summary: Formal gowns are sold online with photos of models wearing them, and buyers zoom in to inspect sequins, lace and beading. Image editors can turn a photo of a gown on a mannequin into a convincing photo of a person wearing it, but they receive every reference photo without any notion of its magnification, and the fine detail of the gown is lost when the output is viewed up close. We propose scale-aware reference attention (SARA), which tells an open diffusion transformer the zoom level of the output and of every reference photo, biases the attention of the output toward references of a similar zoom level, uses macro photos of the fabric as references, and is trained on a mix of whole-garment and zoomed targets. To train and evaluate it, we introduce Kiss3000, a dataset of 915 high-resolution mannequin photos and 2274 on-model photos of formal gowns with cross-domain pairs and splits by style, and zoom-crop evaluation, which compares garment crops at full, half and local scale without pixel alignment and judges local fidelity with two vision-language models gated on control crops. With this protocol, Nano Banana Pro at 4K, the highest-resolution commercial editor we test, loses or redraws local detail on 14 of 20 test gowns. At 1536x2048 pixels, both judges prefer SARA over a LoRA fine-tuning baseline on 18 test items and the baseline on 6 (p=0.023), and over the base model on 26 against 4 (p=5.9e-5), while SARA keeps the gown design as often as the baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出尺度感知参考注意力(SARA)，让扩散变换器感知输出与参考图的放大倍率，提升礼服局部细节保真度；并构建Kiss3000数据集与zoom-crop评测协议。
AI.motivation: 电商礼服展示需买家放大查看亮片、蕾丝、珠绣等细节，但现有图像编辑把模特图当作无倍率概念参考，输出放大后细节丢失。
AI.method: SARA：向开放扩散变换器注入输出图与每张参考图的缩放级别，使输出注意力偏向相似缩放级别的参考；以面料微距照片作参考；在整衣与放大目标混合数据上训练。数据：Kiss3000（915张高分辨率人台照+2274张上模特照，含跨域配对与按款式划分）。评测：zoom-crop评测，比较全/半/局部尺度裁剪，无需像素对齐，用两个VLM在控制裁剪门控下判断局部保真度。
AI.result: 4K的Nano Banana Pro在20件测试礼服中14件丢失或重绘局部细节。1536x2048下，两个评判者对18件偏好SARA胜过LoRA微调基线（6件相反，p=0.023），对26件胜过基座模型（4件相反，p=5.9e-5），且设计保持率与基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模缩放尺度可显著提升高倍率细节保真度，所提数据与评测协议为细节级图像编辑提供可度量基准。

title: From Reward Engineering to Data-Centric Reinforcement Learning for Effective Agentic Visual Tool Use
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly use external visual tools to acquire evidence during reasoning, yet learning when to invoke these tools remains challenging. Existing tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) methods often rely on call-contingent rewards to encourage beneficial tool use, but such reward engineering can distort the task objective and lead to degenerate calling behaviors. We argue that effective tool-use learning requires identifying not merely which questions are difficult, but which failures are attributable to missing visual evidence and can therefore be corrected through tool observations. We propose AOVO, a data-centric framework that enables MLLMs to learn effective tool use through perception attribution and policy-adaptive data sampling (PADS), without introducing tool-specific rewards. It counterfactually probes the model's reasoning states to identify observation-sensitive questions, distinguishing them from reasoning-dominated ones. PADS then periodically estimates category-level observation effects from recent policy rollouts and dynamically reallocates the training distribution toward questions where visual observations provide informative learning signals, while optimizing solely for final-answer correctness. Experiments across diverse visual perception and multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over competitive tool-use MLLMs, with causal analysis further validating the data-centric perspective for learning effective visual tool use.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AOVO，一个以数据为中心的框架，让多模态大模型学会“何时调用视觉工具”，通过感知归因与策略自适应数据采样（PADS）替代工具专用奖励，仅优化最终答案正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用强化学习方法依赖“调用相关奖励”来鼓励有益的工具调用，但这种奖励设计会扭曲任务目标，导致退化性的调用行为。作者认为，关键不只是识别哪些问题难，而是识别哪些失败源于缺少视觉证据、并能通过工具观测得到纠正。
AI.method: AOVO包含两部分：(1) 感知归因——对模型推理状态进行反事实探测，识别对观测敏感（observation-sensitive）的问题，并将其与推理主导型问题区分开；(2) PADS——周期性从近期策略 rollout 中估计类别级观测效应，动态把训练分布重新分配到视觉观测能提供有效学习信号的问题上。训练目标仅使用最终答案正确性，不引入工具专用奖励。
AI.result: 在多种视觉感知与多模态推理基准上，相比有竞争力的工具使用MLLM取得一致提升；因果分析进一步验证了以数据为中心视角对学习有效视觉工具使用的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 有效工具使用学习应从数据分布与失败归因入手，而非依赖调用奖励工程；AOVO表明通过感知归因与策略自适应采样可以在保持任务目标纯粹的同时提升MLLM的工具调用能力。

title: Diversity over Scale: Recursive Self-Improvement with Ensembles of Small Open-Weight Models
summary: The advancement of large language models (LLMs) has significantly enhanced the capabilities of agents across various tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) loops, in which a language model repeatedly rewrites a program and builds on its previous version, now perform well in machine-learning tasks, but they rely on frontier models and hundreds of calls per run. Small open-weight models are far cheaper, yet when used alone, their programs often crash and their improvements stall. We propose DiVE (diverse models evolve), an ensemble method for RSI that aims to improve creativity and diversity of generated solutions. DiVE uses three components: a shared memory, a failure log, and best-idea-wins rounds. This allows models to write candidate solutions from the same context and retain the best idea at each iteration. On 22 MLE-bench Lite competitions, an ensemble of five 8-12B open-weight models has 25.4% less test error than its average member and 16.7% less than Llama 3.3 70B, and comes within 7.1% of Qwen 3.5 122B-A10B at 75% of its cost. Diversity among small models can thus stand in for part of the scale that RSI relies on.

AI.tldr: DiVE 是一种多模型集成递归自我改进（RSI）方法，用五个 8-12B 开源小模型的多样性部分替代大模型规模，在 MLE-bench Lite 上显著降低误差。
AI.motivation: 现有 RSI 循环依赖前沿大模型且每次运行需数百次调用，成本高；小型开源模型便宜但单独使用时常崩溃、改进停滞，需要一种让多个小模型协同提升创造性与多样性的方案。
AI.method: 提出 DiVE，由三部分组成：共享记忆（shared memory）、失败日志（failure log）和"最佳想法胜出"轮次（best-idea-wins rounds）。多模型在同一上下文下各自生成候选方案，每轮迭代保留最佳想法继续演进。
AI.result: 在 22 个 MLE-bench Lite 竞赛上，五个 8-12B 开源模型组成的集成相比其成员平均测试误差降低 25.4%，比 Llama 3.3 70B 低 16.7%，并以 75% 的成本逼近 Qwen 3.5 122B-A10B（差距 7.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 小模型之间的多样性可以替代 RSI 所依赖的部分规模效应，为低成本、高效的自改进智能体提供可行路径。

title: NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?
summary: With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments and experiments refine knowledge. In configuration search over four serving scenarios, NoeVera comes within 5% of the optimum in a median of 6-7 simulator calls, versus 9 for Bayesian optimization and 15 for a knowledge-free agent with the same tools; on A100 GPUs, its representative configurations deliver ~1.30x vLLM-default throughput and meet every scenario's latency objective. When reused, provenance-preserving evidence records over-generalize on only 8% of applicability traps, versus 28% for a general-purpose agent memory. On the held-out 48-task split of a 72-task benchmark, NoeVera scores 29% higher than an equally equipped agent and 36% higher than its single-call retrieval counterpart (0.80 vs. 0.62 and 0.59), and even when baselines receive NoeVera's own prompts, a statistically significant part of its evidence-evolution advantage remains.

AI.tldr: NoeVera 是一个面向 LLM 服务系统优化的"智能体第二大脑"：将论文、代码、基准与实验结果组织为带溯源、可持续演化的知识库（证据/综合/记忆三层），并用决策感知检索 + 角色化智能体 + 模拟器（Vidur/GAUSS）做配置搜索，用更少仿真调用接近最优解。
AI.motivation: LLM 服务系统优化中，预测某配置的性能已不是瓶颈；真正的难点是"决定查什么"：哪些机制对给定负载重要、哪些配置值得试、决策还缺什么证据。传统一次性检索的智能体缺乏持久、可溯源、可复用的知识积累。
AI.method: 构建三层结构的知识库：源证据层、可复用综合层、智能体记忆层；采用决策感知检索组装紧凑"证据包"；角色分工智能体在其上推理，需要定量支持时调用 Vidur 或 GAUSS 模拟器；每个发现以带作用域的证据记录写回，形成"知识指导实验、实验精炼知识"的闭环。
AI.result: 四个服务场景的配置搜索中，中位 6–7 次模拟器调用即达到最优 5% 以内（贝叶斯优化 9 次，无知识智能体 15 次）；A100 上代表配置相比 vLLM 默认约 1.30x 吞吐，并满足各场景延迟目标。复用证据时仅 8% 出现过泛化（通用智能体记忆为 28%）；72 任务基准的 48 任务留出集上得分 0.80，比同装备智能体高 29%、比单次检索版本高 36%；基线即使获得相同提示，NoeVera 的证据演化优势仍有统计显著部分。
AI.conclusion: 持久化、保留溯源且随实验演化的"第二大脑"式知识管理，能显著提升 LLM 服务系统配置调优的效率与效果，并降低知识复用时的过泛化风险；其优势部分源于证据演化机制而非仅提示设计。

title: Lean Census: A Distributional Analysis of AI-Generated Lean Code
summary: We compare two human-written and four AI-generated Lean libraries with Mathlib through the distributions of simple statistics of their code. For each library we measure inline claims in proofs, proof length, how often each declaration is used, and design choices such as instances and private declarations, and we read each against the variation among Mathlib's own areas. The AI-generated libraries have more inline claims per theorem, longer proofs, fewer instances, and more private declarations than the human-written ones. We release the code for the analysis as a package, lean-census, at https://github.com/project-numina/lean-census.

AI.tldr: 本文通过简单代码统计比较2个人类编写与4个AI生成的Lean库及Mathlib，发现AI生成库证明内联断言更多、证明更长、实例更少、私有声明更多。
AI.motivation: AI生成的Lean代码与人类编写的Lean代码在风格与设计上可能存在差异，但缺乏量化的实证比较手段。
AI.method: 以Mathlib自身各领域的变异为参照，对每个库统计证明中的内联断言、证明长度、声明使用频率，以及实例和私有声明等设计选择。
AI.result: AI生成的库相比人类编写的库，每个定理内联断言更多、证明更长、实例更少、私有声明更多。
AI.conclusion: AI与人类编写的Lean代码存在可量化的风格差异；分析代码以lean-census包形式开源（https://github.com/project-numina/lean-census）。

title: Does the Agent's Map Match the Territory? Architectural Claims in AI Agent Context Files and Their Fit with the Code
summary: AI coding agents start every session without memory of how a system is built. Developers fill this gap with context files, such as CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. Agents treat these files as true, so it matters whether they match the code. We study two kinds of architectural claims that can be checked against a repository: path claims, which name folders and files, and dependency rules, which say what may import what. We check 41,090 path claims and 184 dependency rules from 3,602 context files in 3,346 open-source projects against the code and its history. About 5% of path claims point to paths we cannot find, but we estimate that only 2.2% are real errors, similar to READMEs (3.5%). When code moves, 61% of claims that became stale are fixed, most in the same commit. Dependency rules behave differently: 33 of 184 (18%) were confirmed broken on the day they were written, usually by older code, and nearly all stayed broken. Context files are good maps but less reliable rulebooks: their rules often describe the architecture a team wants, not the one it has. In an exploratory comparison of 7,480 commits, new rule breaks were rare. Agent-assisted commits broke rules about 1.8 times as often as other commits (0.29% vs. 0.16%), but with only 14 breaks this is not significant: an early signal, not evidence of a difference or of its absence. We used an LLM with human review at each step, and discuss what this offers and risks for mining studies.

AI.tldr: 论文检验上下文文件（CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md）中架构声明的准确性：路径声明约2.2%为真实错误，而依赖规则18%在写下当天即已失效且几乎不再修复，说明上下文文件是"好的地图、坏的规则书"。
AI.motivation: AI编码代理无系统记忆，依赖CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md等上下文文件获取架构知识，且将这些文件视为真实。因此它们是否与代码一致至关重要，但此前缺乏大规模实证。
AI.method: 从3,346个开源项目的3,602个上下文文件中提取两类可核查声明：路径声明（41,090条）与依赖规则（184条），对照代码及其历史逐一验证；并以7,480个提交做探索性分析，比较代理辅助提交与其他提交的规则破坏率；全流程采用LLM加人工复核。
AI.result: 约5%路径声明指向找不到的路径，但估计仅2.2%为真实错误（README为3.5%）；代码移动导致的过期声明中61%被修复，多在原提交内。184条依赖规则中33条（18%）写出当天即已被破坏，通常由旧代码造成，且几乎均未修复。新规则破坏罕见；代理辅助提交破坏率约1.8倍（0.29% vs 0.16%），但仅14例，统计不显著。
AI.conclusion: 上下文文件是准确的地图但不靠谱的规则书，其规则更多描述团队期望的架构而非现状。代理辅助提交的差异仅为早期信号，既不构成差异证据也不构成无差异证据；同时讨论了LLM+人工在挖掘研究中的收益与风险。

title: Tool-to-Self: Internalizing Visual Tool Capabilities via Scaffolded Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on external visual tools to access fine-grained visual evidence, but repeated tool execution incurs substantial inference overhead and deployment dependencies. Moreover, conventional tool-use RL can improve visual-task performance, yet the resulting tool gains are often unstable. Motivated by this, we propose Tool-to-Self (T2S), a tool-scaffolded reinforcement learning framework that turns external visual tools into temporary training scaffolds. T2S cold-starts tool-use ability and observation prediction from tool-repairable examples, then progressively anneals tool execution on a per-tool basis during RL. By combining answer-correctness and observation-consistency rewards with privileged on-policy self-distillation from actual tool observations, T2S effectively teaches the model both to reproduce tool outputs and to reason from them. Experiments across diverse visual perception and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over both explicit tool-use models and implicit zooming models while enabling tool-free inference with reduced latency.

AI.tldr: 提出 Tool-to-Self (T2S)，将外部视觉工具作为临时训练脚手架，通过强化学习中的逐工具退火与特权在线自蒸馏，使 VLM 最终无需工具即可完成细粒度视觉推理。
AI.motivation: VLM 依赖外部视觉工具获取细粒度证据，但反复调用工具带来大量推理开销与部署依赖；且常规工具使用 RL 虽能提升视觉任务表现，其收益往往不稳定。
AI.method: T2S 框架：先用"工具可修复"的样本冷启动工具使用能力与观测预测能力；随后在 RL 中按工具逐个渐进退火工具执行；奖励由答案正确性与观测一致性组成，并结合来自真实工具观测的特权在线自蒸馏，使模型既复现工具输出又能基于其推理。
AI.result: 在多样化的视觉感知与推理基准上，相较显式工具使用模型和隐式缩放（zooming）模型均取得一致提升，同时实现无工具推理并降低延迟。
AI.conclusion: 将外部工具视作可退火的训练脚手架而非推理必需品，可在保持甚至提升视觉推理性能的同时消除工具依赖与开销，为 VLM 提供一种低成本、可部署的工具能力内化路径。

title: Human-in-the-Loop Runbook Improvement with Agentic Support Automation
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted manuscript of the paper published in the proceedings of the 2025 IEEE 7th International Conference on Cognitive Machine Intelligence (CogMI)
summary: Operational support is an important component of production software services. Support requests are often emergent and can come in many forms such as customer escalations or unplanned service interruption. Engineers across organizations have been successful in implementing automation to help streamline support processes but many solutions remain in the hands of human operators. A successful strategy to improve operator response times is to maintain up-to-date runbooks which are documents enumerating triage steps and remediation procedures in the face of identified incidents. This paper is an investigation into an operational system which incorporates Agentic AI into a runbook based incident resolution pattern. The bot uses information in the runbook corpus along with some system-specific tooling to guide the manual operator through the mitigation process then evaluate the outcome and suggest edits to the runbook where it found gaps and in its ability to triage the situation. By using the runbook as a medium to bridge humans and automation, the process maintains explainability and can be decoupled from the agent system. This paper demonstrates a collaboration between human operators and Agentic AI with results from an 17 week study involving 232 production incidents. We conclude with lessons on integrating LLMs into DevOps workflows, related work in AI-assisted operations, and guidance for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 论文研究将 Agentic AI 集成到基于 runbook 的运维事件处理流程中，17 周内处理 232 起生产事件，验证人机协作可行性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 运维支持请求常为突发性（客户升级、服务中断），虽已有自动化但多依赖人工操作；保持 runbook 最新可提升响应速度，需探索 LLM/Agent 与人协作的可行方式。
AI.method: 构建一个 Agentic AI 机器人，依据 runbook 语料与系统专用工具引导人工操作员完成缓解流程，随后评估结果并反馈 runbook 中的缺口与分诊能力改进建议；以 runbook 作为连接人与自动化的媒介，保证可解释性且可与 agent 系统解耦。
AI.result: 在 17 周、232 起生产事件的实证研究中展示了人机协作效果，并总结将 LLM 集成进 DevOps 工作流的经验、相关工作与可复现性指导。
AI.conclusion: runbook 作为人机协作中介可兼顾可解释性与解耦性，Agentic AI 辅助运维具有实践价值，并为 LLM 融入 DevOps 提供可复现的落地经验。

title: LLM-Based Assistant for Dog Care Guidance
summary: This study investigates whether domain grounding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can enhance the accuracy and reliability of pet care advice generated by large language models (LLMs). We curated a dataset of breed-specific dog care information and used it to develop two systems: a RAG pipeline based on TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0, and a fine-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B model adapted using LoRA. Both systems were evaluated on 15 dog care questions. The RAG model achieved a perfect average score of 2.0, outperforming the fine-tuned model (mean = 1.47). Statistical analyses, including Welch's t-test, Mann-Whitney U, and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (all p < 0.05), confirmed the significance of the performance gap. Our findings suggest that retrieval-based domain grounding leads to more accurate, consistent, and trustworthy responses than standalone fine-tuning in specialized LLM applications.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较RAG与LoRA微调在宠物护理建议生成中的效果，发现RAG（平均2.0分）显著优于LoRA微调模型（1.47分）。
AI.motivation: 探究通过RAG进行领域接地与通过LoRA参数高效微调，哪种方式更能提升大语言模型在专业领域（犬类护理建议）中的准确性与可靠性。
AI.method: 构建品种特异的犬类护理数据集，开发两个系统：基于TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0的RAG流水线，以及用LoRA适配的LLaMA-3.2-1B微调模型；在15个护理问题上评测，并用Welch t检验、Mann-Whitney U与Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行统计分析。
AI.result: RAG模型平均得分2.0（满分），优于微调模型（均值1.47）；三项统计检验均显著（p<0.05），确认性能差距显著。
AI.conclusion: 在专业领域LLM应用中，基于检索的领域接地比单独微调能产生更准确、一致且可信的回答。

title: PFN-Syn: Generating Synthetic Tabular Data with Prior-Data Fitted Networks
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. VLDB 2026 Workshop: Tabular Data Analysis (TaDA). Code: https://github.com/brains-group/table-agent-toolkit
summary: Synthetic tabular data can help enable data sharing and model development in privacy-sensitive domains, but existing generators often require dataset-specific training and substantial computation. We introduce PFN-Syn, a training-free framework for synthetic tabular data generation based on prior-data fitted networks. We evaluate PFN-Syn against training-based generators on eight binary classification datasets. PFN-Syn achieves the highest average downstream utility among evaluated synthetic generators, with higher generation throughput than training-based baselines, while maintaining competitive distributional similarity and distance-to-closest-record privacy behavior. Our results suggest that tabular foundation models can serve as useful building blocks for practical synthetic tabular data generation.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的合成表格数据生成框架 PFN-Syn，基于先验数据拟合网络（PFN），在八个二分类数据集上取得最高平均下游效用且生成吞吐量更高。
AI.motivation: 隐私敏感领域的数据共享与建模需要合成表格数据，但现有生成器通常需要针对数据集专门训练，计算开销大。
AI.method: PFN-Syn 无需训练，直接利用表格基础模型（prior-data fitted networks）作为构建模块进行合成表格数据生成，并与基于训练的生成器对比。
AI.result: 在八个二分类数据集上，PFN-Syn 的平均下游效用最高，生成吞吐量高于训练基线，同时在分布相似性和到最近记录的距​​离（隐私指标）上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 表格基础模型可作为实用合成表格数据生成的有效构建模块，免训练范式在效用、效率与隐私间取得良好平衡。

title: LLM-Assisted Software Migration: from Module-Level Transformation to Repository-Level Integration
summary: Software migration adapts an existing implementation to a new language, version, API, framework, or platform while preserving its behavior. Large language models (LLMs) succeed on individual functions and modules, but this success does not readily carry over to entire repositories, particularly deployable applications. This survey reviews LLM-assisted migration from module-level transformation to repository-level integration, culminating in the delivery of complete applications. We analyze 96 sources---including 46 direct migration papers---across four perspectives: (1) supported software engineering activities, (2) model roles as editors or orchestrators, (3) orchestration workflows (agentless, single-agent, or multi-agent), and (4) enabling techniques including knowledge engineering, project context, environment feedback, and model adaptation. We then compare evaluation practices and benchmarks. Although 30 of the 46 studies target repositories, most acceptance evidence relies merely on build success, supplied tests, or static and model-based proxies. Moreover, compilation, visual similarity, test outcomes, and runtime behavior capture fundamentally distinct properties and cannot be conflated into a single success rate. We also identify critical gaps in requirements engineering support and in controlled comparisons of agent architectures. Finally, we discuss six open problems: application integration, platform differences, non-functional properties, generalization, attribution of gains, as well as cost and maintenance.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于大模型辅助软件迁移的综述，梳理了从模块级转换到仓库级集成、直至交付完整应用的演进，分析了96篇文献（含46篇直接迁移论文），并指出评估实践与基准的关键不足及六个开放问题。
AI.motivation: LLM在单函数、单模块级迁移任务上表现良好，但这一成功难以直接迁移到完整仓库尤其可部署应用层面；领域缺乏对仓库级迁移、评估实践及智能体架构的系统梳理与比较。
AI.method: 综述96篇文献（46篇直接迁移研究），从四个视角分析：(1)支持的软件工程活动；(2)模型作为编辑者或编排者的角色；(3)编排工作流（无智能体、单智能体、多智能体）；(4)使能技术（知识工程、项目上下文、环境反馈、模型适配）；并比较评估实践与基准。
AI.result: 46项研究中30项面向仓库级，但多数验收证据仅依赖构建成功、给定测试或静态/模型代理指标；编译、视觉相似度、测试结果与运行时行为代表本质不同的性质，不能被合并为单一成功率。此外发现需求工程支持不足、智能体架构缺乏受控比较等关键空白。
AI.conclusion: 提出六个开放问题：应用集成、平台差异、非功能属性、泛化性、增益归因、成本与维护，为LLM辅助仓库级软件迁移研究指明方向。

title: Intervene or Trust CLIP? Competence-Gated Adaptation for Source-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning
summary: Source-free cross-domain few-shot learning (SF-CDFSL) adapts a pre-trained vision-language model such as CLIP to a distant target domain from a handful of labeled images, without access to source data. Recent methods improve the fine-tuning of CLIP with token-level interventions and apply them in the same way to every target domain. In this paper, we find that whether an intervention helps depends on how well frozen CLIP already recognizes the target domain: in 5-way 1-shot tasks, intervening improves accuracy by 0.72 points where frozen CLIP misclassifies most support images, but lowers it by 1.31 points where frozen CLIP already classifies them well, and the support set of a single episode suffices to tell the two cases apart; a bias-variance analysis explains both. Based on this finding, we propose Competence-Gated Adaptation (CoGA), which measures frozen CLIP's accuracy and margin on the labeled support set and decides, before training, whether to intervene on the visual tokens or to trust CLIP by fusing the adapted prediction with the frozen one. CoGA adds no trainable parameters and uses no query labels. On the four BSCD-FSL target domains, CoGA achieves the best average accuracy, 59.56% (1-shot) and 68.96% (5-shot), outperforms ATHA and TIR by at least 2.82 and 1.39 points on the same episodes, and consistently improves three further backbones, three parameter-efficient fine-tuning frameworks and five further target domains.

AI.tldr: 提出 Competence-Gated Adaptation (CoGA)：在无源跨域小样本学习中，先衡量冻结 CLIP 在支撑集上的能力，再据此决定是否干预视觉 token，从而自适应地提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法对所有目标域一律施加 token 级干预，但作者发现干预是否有益取决于冻结 CLIP 对目标域的识别能力：CLIP 表现差时干预提升 0.72 点，表现好时反而下降 1.31 点，且单个 episode 的支撑集即可区分两种情况，并用偏差-方差分析解释。
AI.method: CoGA 在训练前测量冻结 CLIP 在带标签支撑集上的准确率与 margin，作为"能力门控"决定是否干预视觉 token，或选择信任 CLIP、将自适应预测与冻结预测融合；方法不引入可训练参数，也不使用查询集标签。
AI.result: 在 BSCD-FSL 四个目标域上平均准确率最佳：1-shot 59.56%，5-shot 68.96%；在相同 episode 上比 ATHA、TIR 至少高 2.82 和 1.39 点；并在三个额外主干、三种参数高效微调框架及五个额外目标域上一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 干预是否有效应视冻结模型对目标域的能力而定；基于支撑集的简单门控即可实现零参数、免查询标签的自适应，并带来稳健且可迁移的性能增益。

title: Modeling Perceived Promptness in Simultaneous Interpreting from Quality, Structure, and Timing Signals
summary: Simultaneous interpreting requires interpreters to convey the source accurately while keeping pace with it in real time. Timing measures such as segment-onset delay capture part of this requirement, but may not fully reflect how professional evaluators judge promptness. We investigate whether these judgments can be explained by timing alone or whether the interpreted output provides additional information. Our dataset contains 622 Chinese-English and English-Chinese segments from 16 source speeches and seven interpreters. Two senior professional interpreters rated each segment for language quality (LQ), expressiveness (EXP), and perceived latency (LAT), which we also refer to as professional promptness. On held-out source speeches, onset delay alone achieves a Pearson correlation of r = .318 with LAT ratings. Combining predicted LQ and EXP with delay improves the correlation to r = .475. Lexical and structural features provide a stronger signal, reaching r = .632 when combined with delay and r = .658 when predicted quality is also included. These results suggest that professional promptness judgments reflect properties of the interpreted output beyond when the interpreter begins speaking. The additional contribution of predicted quality over structural features, however, is modest. Although the two evaluators differ in how strongly quality relates to LAT, cross-evaluator predictions remain positively correlated with LAT ratings. The overall pattern also holds when each interpreter is held out in turn.

AI.tldr: 本文研究专业译员对同传"及时性/感知延迟(LAT)"的评判能否仅由起译延迟时间解释，还是需要结合译文内容信息。基于622个中英双向同传片段（16篇源语、7名译员），通过预测语言质量(LQ)、表达性(EXP)及词汇/结构特征，将LAT预测相关性从r=.318提升至r=.658。
AI.motivation: 同传需在准确传达内容的同时实时跟上源语节奏。起译延迟等时间指标只能部分反映这一要求，未必符合专业评估者对"及时性"的实际判断。作者希望检验专业及时性判断是否仅由时间因素决定，还是译文输出本身提供了额外信息。
AI.method: 构建包含622个中英/英中同传片段的数据集（16篇源语演讲、7名译员）。由两名资深专业译员对每个片段的语言质量(LQ)、表达性(EXP)和感知延迟(LAT)进行评分。在留出的源语演讲上，比较仅用起译延迟、叠加预测的LQ/EXP、叠加词汇与结构特征，以及进一步加入预测质量等不同特征组合对LAT的预测效果（Pearson相关）；并进行跨评估者及逐一留出译员的稳健性分析。
AI.result: 在留出源语上，仅起译延迟与LAT的Pearson相关为r=.318；结合预测LQ和EXP后提升至r=.475；词汇与结构特征信号更强，结合延迟达r=.632，再加入预测质量达r=.658。预测质量相对于结构特征的额外贡献较小。两名评估者在质量与LAT关系的强度上存在差异，但跨评估者预测与LAT评分仍正相关，且逐一留出每位译员时整体模式保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 专业及时性判断不仅取决于译员何时开始说话，还反映译文输出的其他属性（质量与结构特征）。质�量预测在结构特征之上的增量为中等偏小。该发现提示同传及时性评估应超越单纯的时间指标。

title: ESM-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Whether AI Agents Understand Earth System Model Physics and Code
summary: AI coding agents that modify Earth System Model (ESM) code must preserve both software interfaces and the physical assumptions encoded in them. We introduce ESM-Bench, a benchmark of 60 developer-commit tasks from 6 repositories: Noah-MP, CLM5, SUMMA, ParFlow, MOM6, and VIC. The v5 corpus contains 17 physics-based bug fixes, 16 process-representation modifications, 13 parameterization-scheme selections, and 14 parameter-optimization tasks. Each task includes a scientific objective, parent-commit source files, a reference diff, and three stored prompt variants. An artifact audit confirms that all 60 reference diffs apply to their supplied starting files. We define an eight-item patch-review rubric and audit five archived patch fixtures against the implemented local checkers. None of the five fixture diffs applies to its supplied starting files, yet three text-pattern checkers return a pass. A ParFlow expression replay disagrees with the reference slopes, and a MOM6 pattern check detects an omitted update. Inspection also identifies a retained VIC reference assignment that overwrites the intended vegetation-specific albedo. These findings expose limits of reference patches and local proxies as correctness evidence. The release provides a reproducible corpus and diagnostic tools; complete expert validation, comparative agent performance, and full-model execution remain unmeasured on v5.

AI.tldr: 提出ESM-Bench，涵盖6个地球系统模型仓库、60个开发者提交任务的基准，用于评估AI编码智能体在修改ESM代码时能否同时保持软件接口与物理假设。
AI.motivation: AI智能体修改地球系统模型（ESM）代码时，不仅要保持软件接口，还必须保持代码中蕴含的物理假设；而现有基准缺乏此类兼具物理语义与软件工程约束的评测。
AI.method: 构建60个来自Noah-MP、CLM5、SUMMA、ParFlow、MOM6、VIC六个仓库的开发者提交任务，含17个物理缺陷修复、16个过程表示修改、13个参数化方案选择、14个参数优化任务；每个任务配科学目标、父提交源文件、参考diff及三种提示变体。设计八项补丁评审细则，并进行工件审计（diff是否适用）与本地检查器审计（五个存档补丁fixture）。
AI.result: 全部60个参考diff均能应用于给定起始文件；但五个存档fixture diff均无法应用，其中三个文本模式检查器仍返回通过；ParFlow表达式回放与参考斜率不一致，MOM6模式检查检出遗漏更新，VIC中发现保留的参考赋值覆盖了目标植被特定反照率。
AI.conclusion: 参考补丁与本地代理指标作为正确性证据存在局限；当前发布为可复现语料和诊断工具，v5尚未完成专家验证、智能体对比性能及全模型执行评估。

title: VistaTree: Question Answering over Long Multimodal Documents with Image-Derived Summary Trees
summary: Answering questions over long multimodal documents requires locating relevant evidence across pages containing text, tables, and figures. When the document exceeds the model's context window, selective retrieval becomes necessary. We introduce VistaTree, a document question-answering agent that builds a summary tree directly from rendered page images. VistaTree segments documents into contiguous page spans, recursively groups them into a topic hierarchy, and refines sibling summaries to distinguish neighboring sections. At query time, the agent uses node summaries to select relevant nodes and reads the corresponding pages, using hierarchical navigation when the full outline exceeds the context budget. Experiments on MMLongBench-Doc and LongDocURL evaluate answer quality and retrieval cost using a locally hosted vision-language model, and quantify the performance gap between global and hierarchical access to the index.

AI.tldr: 提出VistaTree，一种直接从渲染页面图像构建摘要树的文档问答智能体，通过递归构建主题层级并精炼同级摘要实现选择性检索，在MMLongBench-Doc和LongDocURL上评估答案质量与检索成本。
AI.motivation: 长多模态文档（含文本、表格、图）跨页定位证据困难，且文档超出模型上下文窗口时需要选择性检索；现有方法难以在保持导航性的同时高效定位相关内容。
AI.method: VistaTree将文档切分为连续页面片段，递归聚合成主题层级树，并对同级摘要进行精炼以区分相邻章节；查询时用节点摘要选择相关节点、读取对应页面，当完整目录超出上下文预算时采用层级导航。
AI.result: 在MMLongBench-Doc与LongDocURL上，使用本地部署的视觉语言模型评估答案质量与检索成本，并量化了全局访问与层级访问索引之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 基于页面图像构建的摘要树结构可有效支持长多模态文档的选择性检索与层级导航，为超长文档问答提供了兼顾质量与成本的方案。

title: When a Permitted Action Completes a Forbidden Workflow: Designing Consequence-Oriented Approval for LLM Agents
comment: Under Review at the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-27)
summary: Tool-using language-model agents increasingly ask people to approve consequential actions, yet an approval prompt shows only the next step. A request to send a file to an approved recipient can look harmless even when that file was assembled, several steps earlier, from data the user said must never leave. We call this a cumulative authorization failure and argue that it is an interaction design problem as much as a security problem. The evidence a reviewer needs is spread across the trajectory, and listing it in time order leaves the reviewer to reconstruct the causal chain. We present the Cumulative Consent Ledger (CCL), an approval interface built on four design principles that restate the user's intent, bind the review to the exact action, compose the cumulative consequence, and keep every claim checkable. A trusted monitor that tracks artifact lineage supplies the evidence. In a between-subjects study with 80 participants and 960 approval decisions, CCL was associated with fewer unsafe approvals than an evidence-matched chronological log (24.2% vs. 32.5%), higher comprehension, and faster decisions, although the adjusted difference in unsafe approvals remained uncertain (-7.9 points, 95% CrI [-19.7, 3.8]). In a system evaluation, the monitor detected 89.2% of 120 violating checkpoints and, used as an execution gate, reduced executed unsafe effects from 43.3% to 5.0% for one agent at a small cost to benign completion. We derive implications for designing consent around consequences rather than individual calls.

AI.tldr: 提出"累积授权失败"概念，设计累积同意账本（CCL）审批界面，通过可信监控追踪产物血缘，在80人研究中降低了不安全批准率。
AI.motivation: 工具型语言模型智能体常让用户批准有后果的操作，但审批提示只显示下一步行动，用户难以察觉该行动是此前多步累积而成的违规后果（如文件由禁止外泄数据拼装）。证据分散在轨迹中，按时间顺序列出会迫使审批者自行重建因果链。
AI.method: 提出累积同意账本（CCL）审批界面，基于四项设计原则：重述用户意图、将审查绑定到确切行动、组合累积后果、保证每条声明可核查。由追踪产物血缘的可信监控器提供证据。开展80名参与者、960次审批决策的组间实验，与证据匹配的时间顺序日志对比；并进行系统评估。
AI.result: CCL 的不安全批准率低于时间顺序日志（24.2% vs 32.5%），理解度更高、决策更快；但校正后不安全批准差异仍不确定（-7.9个百分点，95% CrI [-19.7, 3.8]）。监控器检测出120个违规检查点中的89.2%；作为执行闸门时，某智能体的不安全效应执行率从43.3%降至5.0%，良性完成率仅有小幅损失。
AI.conclusion: 用户同意设计应围绕"后果"而非单个调用展开；审阅界面应将累积证据以可核查方式组合呈现，并结合血缘监控作为执行闸门以降低实际不安全后果。

title: STUN-Bench: Truly Unseen Tools for Evaluating Shared Tool Experience
summary: A tool router retrieves a few candidate tools per request and lets a language model choose. Methods that share experience across organizations add past requests about each tool to what the router retrieves. StableToolBench calls some of its test groups tests on "unseen" tools, yet the ToolBench instruction pool, which retrievers and experience-sharing methods learn from, contains every test query and labels every gold tool of the two single-tool groups among them. We release STUN-Bench (StableToolBench, Truly UNseen), a split whose experience pool has no item that labels or names 172 held-out tools. Unseen here means absent from shared experience and retriever training data, not from pretraining. On the split we find crowding: experience pooled from five simulated clients, added to an index of tool descriptions, outranks the descriptions of tools no client has used, which then often drop out of the candidate list. Under the Jina-v2 retriever, routing accuracy on held-out tools falls from 0.534 to 0.278. Retrievers trained for tool retrieval lose much less, and keeping experience in a separate index recovers most of the loss under Jina-v2. The split also reverses a conclusion: with every test tool labeled in the pool and our default leak filter applied, shared experience beats descriptions alone; on STUN-Bench it falls below them. The split, leak filter and evaluation harness are available at https://github.com/<org>/STUN-Bench.

AI.tldr: 论文指出 StableToolBench 的"unseen"测试存在数据泄漏，提出 STUN-Bench：经验池中不含 172 个留出工具的名称或标签，并据此发现经验共享会造成"拥挤效应"。
AI.motivation: 现有工具路由方法在组织间共享经验（将每个工具的历史请求加入检索），而 StableToolBench 声称的"unseen"测试组实际包含在 ToolBench 指令池中——该池正是检索器和经验共享方法的训练来源，且两个单工具测试组的金标工具都被标注。因此现有评估高估了泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建 STUN-Bench 划分：经验池中不存在任何标注或提及 172 个留出工具的条目；"unseen"仅指未出现在共享经验与检索器训练数据中，而非未出现在预训练中。同时提出泄漏过滤器与评测框架。
AI.result: 发现拥挤效应：五个模拟客户端汇集的经验条目被加入工具描述索引后，排名超过无任何客户端使用过的工具描述，导致这些工具常被挤出候选列表。在 Jina-v2 检索器下，留出工具上的路由准确率从 0.534 降至 0.278；专为工具检索训练的检索器损失小得多；将经验放入独立索引可在 Jina-v2 下挽回大部分损失。
AI.conclusion: 评测划分会反转结论：在泄漏的池子中并施加默认泄漏过滤时，共享经验优于仅用描述；而在 STUN-Bench 上，共享经验反而不如仅用描述。数据划分、泄漏过滤器和评测工具已开源。

title: Gradient-Free Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision Models via Agentic Coding
summary: Adapting a vision model to new classes from a few labeled images usually relies on gradient fine-tuning, which is unstable with so few images. We ask whether a coding agent can replace gradient descent for this task. We propose the Agent edit, a method in which a coding agent writes a program that sets the new class weights in the class head of a frozen COCO-trained detector, with no gradient step. The agent runs the detector on the labeled images a limited number of times and sees how much its edit lowers COCO mAP; the program rebuilds the weights without the agent. In the same head and with the same labels, the Agent edit outperforms full-decoder fine-tuning at five shots on 2 of four fine-grained sets, by 11.2 and 12.3 F1 points, and ties on the rest. At ten shots, fine-tuning ties with or outperforms it. Moreover, when the new classes are scored jointly with the COCO classes, the AP of the COCO class to which they belong falls by up to 33.3 points, and limiting that loss lowers F1 on the new classes. Most of the agent's programs share three parts, which we write as a formula that needs no agent. A classifier on frozen backbone features reaches a higher F1 than every method inside the head on every set. Hence a coding agent can replace gradient descent only in part: inside the head and at five shots.

AI.tldr: 提出"Agent edit"：用一个编程代理编写程序直接设定冻结检测器类别头的新类权重，无需梯度更新，在5-shot下可部分替代梯度微调，但在10-shot及头部之外不及传统方法。
AI.motivation: 少样本（few-shot）用极少标注图像适配视觉模型通常依赖梯度微调，但样本太少时微调不稳定。作者想探究：编程代理（coding agent）能否在新类适配任务中替代梯度下降。
AI.method: 采用冻结的COCO训练检测器，仅让其类别头权重被改写。编程代理在有限次运行检测器、观察编辑对COCO mAP影响后，编写一个能自行重建新类权重、无需代理再介入的程序（Agent edit），全程无梯度步骤。与全解码器微调在相同头部、相同标签下对比；并将新类与COCO类联合评分以测量干扰；多数代理程序共享三部分结构，被提炼为无需代理的公式；另用冻结backbone特征的分类器作对照。
AI.result: 5-shot时Agent edit在4个细粒度数据集中的2个上以11.2和12.3 F1点超过全解码器微调，其余持平；10-shot时微调持平或更优。新类与COCO类联合评分时，所属COCO类AP最多下降33.3点，抑制该损失会降低新类F1。冻结backbone特征的分类器在每个数据集上F1均高于头部内的所有方法。
AI.conclusion: 编程代理只能在有限范围内替代梯度下降——仅在类别头内、且仅在5-shot情形；10-shot及头部之外的传统/特征方法仍占优。属于"部分替代"而非全面替代。

title: MedCoast: Semantic Abstraction of Reasoning Trajectories for Test-Time Biomedical Question Answering
summary: Biomedical question answering often requires multi-step reasoning under limited inference budgets. While test-time search methods such as Tree-of-Thought can improve reasoning performance, directly searching over free-form language is computationally expensive and highly redundant, as many reasoning trajectories contain semantically equivalent intermediate steps expressed in different surface forms. We introduce MedCoast, an offline-to-online reasoning framework that converts sampled chain-of-thought trajectories into a compact space for structured process supervision. Offline, we recursively cluster semantically similar reasoning steps under shared prefixes to construct an abstract reasoning tree that captures recurring clinical reasoning patterns. We then derive node-level supervision from progress toward correct solutions, and train a lightweight process reward model (PRM) to evaluate partial reasoning states. At inference time, the learned critic guides test-time exploration by prioritizing promising reasoning prefixes. Across seven biomedical QA benchmarks, MedCoast often improves over self-consistency under fixed inference budgets, with gains of up to 15 points. Despite using a reward model more than 50 times smaller, MedCoast achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art reward models in several settings, highlighting its potential for resource-constrained biomedical reasoning.

AI.tldr: MedCoast：将采样的思维链轨迹离线聚类为抽象推理树，训练轻量过程奖励模型作为推理期critic，指导测试时探索，在七个生物医学QA基准上提升推理效果。
AI.motivation: 生物医学问答需要有限推理预算下的多步推理；Tree-of-Thought等测试时搜索直接在自由文本上搜索计算昂贵且冗余，大量中间步骤只是语义等价的不同表述。
AI.method: 离线阶段：在共享前缀下递归聚类语义相似的推理步骤，构建捕捉临床推理模式的抽象推理树；依据推理进度导出节点级监督，训练轻量过程奖励模型（PRM）。推理时用该critic对部分推理状态打分，优先探索有前景的推理前缀。
AI.result: 在七个生物医学QA基准上，固定推理预算下常优于self-consistency，最高提升15个点；奖励模型规模小50倍以上，却在多个设置下媲美SOTA奖励模型。
AI.conclusion: 将自由文本推理压缩为结构化抽象空间并用轻量PRM引导搜索，是资源受限生物医学推理的有效方案。

title: Walks2Maps: Learning Indoor Geometry from Crowdsourced Wi-Fi RTT and Motion Trajectories
comment: This paper is accepted to NeurIPS 2026 PhysWorldAI Workshop
summary: Everyday smartphone walks offer a scalable source of indoor geometry, but their motion traces drift and their radio measurements are distorted by multipath. We present Walks2Maps, a physics-guided framework that reconstructs a shared metric map from Wi-Fi round-trip-time (RTT) and motion observations, without a floor plan, surveyed access-point (AP) coordinates, or position labels. Walks2Maps jointly estimates pedestrian trajectories, AP locations, and per-trajectory stride scales, then recovers the pathway layout from the reconstructed paths. Shared AP observations connect walks recorded in different local frames, while metric ranges constrain their relative geometry and scale. An asymmetric range loss accommodates multipath-induced excess delay. On 22 phone trajectories collected along 11 routes on an office floor with 30 APs, Walks2Maps achieves median AP and trajectory errors of 0.87 m and 0.89 m, respectively, and a walked-area F1 score of 0.985. Ablations show that radio similarity can recognize places while still producing a distorted map; retaining the metric information in RTT resolves this ambiguity. Asymmetric modeling further reduces AP error by 54% relative to a symmetric loss. These results demonstrate how radio and motion measurements can jointly reveal indoor geometry without a dedicated mapping survey. We will release the dataset and toolkit.

AI.tldr: Walks2Maps 提出一个物理引导框架，仅用手机 Wi-Fi RTT 与运动数据（无平面图、无 AP 坐标、无位置标签）联合估计行人轨迹、AP 位置与步幅尺度，从而重建室内路径布局。
AI.motivation: 日常手机步行可扩展地提供室内几何信息，但运动轨迹存在漂移、无线电测量受多径干扰，且现有方法依赖平面图、勘测的 AP 坐标或位置标签。
AI.method: 联合优化轨迹、AP 位置和每条轨迹的步幅尺度；用共享 AP 观测连接不同局部坐标系的步行，用度量距离约束相对几何与尺度；采用非对称距离损失容忍多径导致的额外时延。
AI.result: 在办公层 11 条路线、22 条手机轨迹、30 个 AP 上，AP 与轨迹误差中位数分别为 0.87 m 和 0.89 m，行走区域 F1 为 0.985；消融显示仅靠无线电相似性会得到扭曲地图，保留 RTT 度量信息可消除歧义，非对称建模比对称损失降低 AP 误差 54%。
AI.conclusion: 无线电与运动测量可协同揭示室内几何，无需专门测绘调查；作者将公开数据集与工具包。

title: Where Do Fact-Checking Errors Arise? Separating Retrieval, Search Control and Judgement in Evidence-Grounded Verification
summary: An evidence-grounded fact-checker can fail because it does not find the evidence or because it does not use it; end-to-end accuracy does not tell the two apart. We present a protocol that follows the reference evidence from the store to the verdict and separates retrieval, search control, judgement and verdict validation. We assess 293 claims from FEVER, FEVER 2.0 and AVeriTeC with one open-weights 9B model under two evidence conditions: small stores of annotated evidence, where discovery is easy, and the full source collections. In the control condition a single hybrid retrieval pass delivers complete reference evidence for 226 of 228 evidence-bearing claims, and adaptive controllers and a tool agent spend two to nine times as many model calls without a consistent gain. Of 34 decisive claims labelled as lacking evidence, 33 have the complete evidence in the packet: in 15 the judge abstains, and in 18 validation rules overturn a decisive verdict. On AVeriTeC these rules lower single-pass accuracy by six points, to 65.0% (balanced accuracy 57.6%). Ten judges from eight model families also show abstentions and validation conversions on fixed packets. Against the full stores hybrid single-pass accuracy falls by 17 to 29 points. Wikipedia evidence recovery declines; AVeriTeC recovery changes from annotated answers to cited pages and is measured separately. No controller recovers the accuracy loss. The agent also shows no resolved gain on 714 further Wikipedia claims. Evidence recovery, judgement and validation should be measured separately before an error is attributed to search.

AI.tldr: 提出分阶段评测协议，将事实核查拆为检索、搜索控制、判断与裁定验证，发现误差主要来自判断与验证而非检索。
AI.motivation: 端到端准确率无法区分事实核查器失败的原因：是没找到证据，还是找到了却没用好。需要拆解各环节以便正确归因错误。
AI.method: 设计证据溯源协议，将流程分为检索、搜索控制、判断、裁定验证四阶段；用单个9B开源模型在两种证据条件下评测FEVER、FEVER 2.0、AVeriTeC 共293条声明：小规模标注证据库（易发现）与完整来源库；并考察自适应控制器、工具智能体及8个模型族的10个判断器。
AI.result: 控制条件下单次混合检索为228条含证据声明中的226条提供完整证据；自适应控制器与工具智能体花费2–9倍调用却无一致收益。34条被判"缺证据"的决定性声明中33条证据实际已完整：15条判断器弃权，18条被验证规则推翻。AVeriTeC上验证规则使单次准确率降6点至65.0%（平衡准确率57.6%）。完整来源库下混合单次准确率下降17–29点，无控制器能挽回。
AI.conclusion: 证据检索、判断与验证应分别度量，再判断错误是否应归咎于搜索；多数失败源于判断与验证环节而非检索。

title: Optimal User-Level Private Stochastic Convex Optimization and Mean Estimation with Heavy Tails
summary: We study stochastic convex optimization with heavy-tailed stochastic gradients under $(\varepsilon, δ)$-user-level differential privacy, which protects each user's entire collection of samples. Instead of assuming a uniformly bounded Lipschitz constant, we only assume bounds on the second- and $k$-th moments of the random sample Lipschitz parameters. This allows for unbounded, heavy-tailed stochastic gradient distributions and can lead to sharper excess risk bounds. We characterize the minimax optimal excess population risk up to logarithmic factors. Our algorithm achieves the optimal rate with only $\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon)$ users. As a byproduct of our algorithmic developments, we obtain tight bounds for user-level private mean estimation under norm-moment assumptions, improving over the guarantees of Esfandiari et al. (2022) and Zhao et al. (2024). Finally, for mean estimation under the directional-moment assumption of Agarwal et al. (2025), we close their remaining approximate-DP gap by removing the additional $d/\varepsilon$ user requirement and attaining the optimal sample complexity up to logarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在用户级差分隐私（\((\varepsilon,\delta)\)-user-level DP）下、具有重尾随机梯度的随机凸优化问题，刻画了极小极大最优超额总体风险（至对数因子），并提出仅需 \(\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon)\) 用户即达最优速率的算法。
AI.motivation: 传统方法假设 Lipschitz 常数一致有界，无法刻画重尾、无界梯度分布的现实场景，且已有的用户级隐私优化结果在样本/用户复杂度上非最优。作者试图在仅假设二阶和 \(k\) 阶矩有界的更弱条件下获得更紧的风险界。
AI.method: 在不假设一致 Lipschitz 界、仅约束随机样本 Lipschitz 参数的第二阶与 \(k\) 阶矩的前提下，设计用户级差分隐私算法，通过矩假设处理重尾/无界梯度，实现最优超额总体风险与用户复杂度。
AI.result: 达到（至对数因子）极小极大最优超额总体风险，用户数仅需 \(\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon)\)；顺带得到范数矩假设下用户级隐私均值估计的紧界，优于 Esfandiari et al. (2022) 与 Zhao et al. (2024)；在 Agarwal et al. (2025) 的方向矩假设下关闭了近似 DP 缺口，去除额外的 \(d/\varepsilon\) 用户要求并达到最优样本复杂度（至对数因子）。
AI.conclusion: 在重尾梯度与矩假设下，用户级差分隐私凸优化可由 \(\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon)\) 用户达到最优速率；相关均值估计结果得到改进并解决了既有近似 DP 的样本复杂度缺口。

title: AEGIS: Evidence-Guided Set Decisions for Requirement-to-Code Traceability
comment: Code, data, and supplementary material: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23944184
summary: Requirement-to-code traceability recovery identifies code artifacts that implement a requirement, but manual review costs limit how many candidates developers can inspect. Code relations can reveal candidates missed by textual retrieval, yet can also introduce code unrelated to the requirement. We propose AEGIS, which combines retrieval evidence and code relations to construct and revise trace sets under a project-wide review budget. Grouped retrieval and semantic retrieval supply candidates. A set objective combines relevance to the requirement with structural compatibility. Local search constructs sets of different sizes, and dynamic programming selects one set per requirement within the budget. Call-context admission then compares replacements using evidence from arguments and return values in calls involving protected members, while bounding retrieval-score loss. Across 13 projects, AEGIS achieves the highest project-macro average on nine of ten evaluation metrics among the compared methods. Relative to same-corpus adaptations of TAROT-VSM and FTLR+MC, it improves F$_1$@5 by 33.21% and 52.28%, and MAP by 38.58% and 49.08%, respectively.

AI.tldr: AEGIS 在项目级评审预算约束下，结合检索证据与代码关系构建并修正需求-代码追溯集，在13个项目中多数指标最优。
AI.motivation: 需求到代码追溯恢复可自动找出实现某需求的代码，但人工评审成本限制了开发者可检查的候选数量；单纯代码关系虽能发现文本检索漏掉的候选，也会引入与需求无关的代码，需在有限预算下平衡召回与精度。
AI.method: 分组检索与语义检索提供候选；以集合目标函数结合需求相关性与结构兼容性；局部搜索构建不同规模的集合，动态规划在预算内为每个需求选一个集合；随后用"调用上下文准入"机制，基于涉及受保护成员的调用中实参与返回值的证据比较替换方案，同时约束检索得分损失。
AI.result: 在13个项目中，十项评测指标里有九项取得最高的项目宏平均；相比同语料适配的 TAROT-VSM 与 FTLR+MC，F1@5 分别提升33.21%和52.28%，MAP 分别提升38.58%和49.08%。
AI.conclusion: 将检索证据与代码关系统一在集合级目标与预算约束优化中，并用调用上下文把关替换，可有效提升需求-代码追溯的候选质量与整体效果。

title: Cyclic Discrete Diffusion: A Novel Multi-Class Segmentation Refinement Technique
summary: We cast image segmentation refinement as a discrete diffusion process. To solve this task we introduce Cyclic Discrete Diffusion (CDD), a novel forward-reverse formulation with a cyclic label topology that maps a discrete label set to the uniform distribution and back. Instead of injecting Gaussian noise as is done for continuous diffusion, CDD evolves segmentation masks through label jumps: at each step, every pixel either remains in its current class or jumps to the next label with a fixed rate. This jump-or-stay mechanism defines a finite-state Markov process with bounded forward and reverse steps, featuring analytically consistent and tractable reverse dynamics. CDD operates natively in a multi-class label space, enabling joint refinement of all classes in a single pass without requiring class-wise decomposition, as commonly needed in prior binary refinement approaches. The proposed formulation admits a finite and controllable number of refinement steps, for which we analyze the convergence properties through spectral gap analysis. We evaluate CDD across diverse segmentation tasks, including multi-class semantic, instance-level, and binary segmentation refinement. Our method consistently improves both region accuracy and boundary quality across multiple backbones and datasets.

AI.tldr: 将图像分割细化建模为离散扩散过程，提出循环离散扩散（CDD）：利用环状标签拓扑把离散标签集映射到均匀分布再还原，通过“跳变或保持”有限状态马尔可夫过程在标签空间中原生联合细化所有类别，并在多类语义、实例级和二元分割细化任务上一致提升区域精度与边界质量。
AI.motivation: 已有分割细化方法多为二元细化，需要按类分解逐类处理，无法在单一多类标签空间内联合细化；而连续扩散注入高斯噪声的方式不适配离散分割掩码。因此需要一个原生工作在离散多类标签空间、步骤有限且可分析的细化框架。
AI.method: 提出Cyclic Discrete Diffusion (CDD)，一种带环状标签拓扑的前向-反向公式。前向过程以固定速率令每个像素“保持当前类”或“跳到下一标签”，定义有限状态马尔可夫过程，前向与反向步数有界且反向动力学可解析、可处理；反向过程据此逐步由粗掩码恢复精细掩码，实现一次前向联合细化全部类别，无需类分解。作者通过谱隙分析研究其收敛性质，并给出有限且可控的细化步数。
AI.result: 在多种分割任务上评估：多类语义分割、实例级分割和二元分割细化。在多个骨干网络与数据集上，方法在区域精度和边界质量两方面均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: CDD将分割细化成功转为离散扩散问题，兼具多类联合细化能力、有限可控步数和理论收敛保证，是一个通用且有效的分割后处理细化框架。

title: Reducing Permutation Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models via Shared Positions and Attention-Only Distillation
summary: In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on improving permutation robustness while preserving accuracy. First, we categorize permutation bias phenomena into four representative scenarios. Then, we take the multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) dataset as an example under text-option reordering scenario to analyze the root cause of permutation bias. Based on this root cause analysis and set encoding strategy, we investigate shared positions with blocked cross-unit attention (SP-B) and extend this design to bidirectional cross-unit attention (SP-V) for modality exchange. However, these structural changes may reduce predictive accuracy. To recover model capability across different scenarios under the SP structure, an attention-only distillation from frozen native models is proposed. Shared positions reduce permutation sensitivity, and attention-only distillation improves accuracy under the shared-position structure. Across all three models, our method is comparable to or better than majority voting in macro-average all-permutation accuracy, and outperforms supervised fine-tuning by 1.95-4.20 percentage points. This work provides valuable insight into permutation bias mitigation and model capability recovery.

AI.tldr: 提出共享位置结构(SP-B/SP-V)结合仅注意力蒸馏，缓解排列偏置并保持准确率。
AI.motivation: 模型存在排列偏置(输出随选项/单位顺序变化)，需在提升排列鲁棒性的同时不损失准确率。
AI.method: 将排列偏置分为四类场景；以文本选项重排序的MCQA为案例做根因分析；基于集合编码设计共享位置+阻塞跨单元注意力(SP-B)，并扩展到双向跨单元注意力(SP-V)实现模态交互；再用冻结原生模型的仅注意力蒸馏恢复能力。
AI.result: 三个模型上宏平均全排列准确率与多数投票相当或更优，比监督微调高1.95–4.20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 共享位置降低排列敏感性，仅注意力蒸馏弥补精度损失，为排列偏置缓解与能力恢复提供思路。

title: X-AQA: Unifying Action Quality Assessment with Multimodal Large Language Models and Multi-Domain Learning
summary: Action Quality Assessment (AQA) aims to evaluate the quality of human actions, yet existing methods are predominantly developed and evaluated on individual datasets with different task formulations and assessment criteria. We introduce X-AQA, the first unified training and evaluation framework for general-purpose AQA with multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We construct X-AQA-40K, a training corpus comprising 40,163 samples from 22 data sources across four domains: competitive sports, fitness exercises, rehabilitation, and general skills. We convert heterogeneous annotations into a unified question-answering format, incorporating dataset-specific annotation guidelines and official scoring rules when available. Using this corpus, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B to develop a single MLLM capable of handling diverse AQA tasks. We further establish X-AQA-Bench, which evaluates both in-distribution (ID) performance on datasets represented during training and out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization on four held-out datasets. The resulting model outperforms all evaluated open-source MLLMs on X-AQA-Bench and achieves competitive performance relative to proprietary MLLMs. Ablation studies further demonstrate that multi-domain joint training and explicitly providing assessment criteria in prompts both improve OOD generalization. X-AQA establishes a unified foundation for advancing general-purpose AQA across diverse real-world domains. Data and models are released at \hyperlink{https://huggingface.co/collections/Kelly0510/x-aqa}{here}.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向通用动作质量评估（AQA）的多模态大模型统一训练与评测框架X-AQA，构建4万条跨22个数据源、4大领域的训练语料并微调Qwen3.5-9B，在分布内与分布外评测中均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有AQA方法大多在单一数据集上开发与评测，任务形式与评估标准各不相同，缺乏统一的训练与评测框架，难以支撑通用化AQA。
AI.method: 构建X-AQA-40K训练语料（40,163样本，来自4领域22个数据源：竞技体育、健身、康复、通用技能），将异构标注统一转为问答格式并融入数据集专属标注指南与官方评分规则；基于该语料微调Qwen3.5-9B得到单一MLLM；建立X-AQA-Bench，评测分布内性能及4个留出数据集上的分布外泛化。
AI.result: 所得模型在X-AQA-Bench上超越所有被测开源MLLM，并与专有MLLM表现相当；消融表明多领域联合训练及在提示中显式给出评估标准均可提升OOD泛化。
AI.conclusion: X-AQA为跨领域通用动作质量评估提供了统一基础，数据与模型已开源发布。

title: SHAKTI: Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI for Nutrition and Health
summary: Large language models (LLMs) answer many diet and health questions but can state unsupported claims and cite sources that do not support them. We present SHAKTI (Smart Health Advisor for Knowledge-based Tailored Interventions), a conversational assistant that answers only from retrieved scholarly papers and exact food-composition data, and evaluate it with retrieval, generation, grounding, efficiency and contextawareness metrics. We indexed 484,368,086 OpenAlex works, searched exactly on a GPU for evaluation (10,065 NFCorpus, BioASQ, SciFact and PubMedQA questions) and through a compressed 230-million-abstract index in deployment. On 1,000 stratified questions, we compared single-shot, multi-hop, corrective and deep-research retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with Claude Sonnet. SHAKTI adds conversational query rewriting, USDA FoodData Central lookups, source-link checks and online verification of quotes and numbers. It was tested in 36 scripted conversational turns, a 248-question memory-depth test and a 38-question load test. Claims were checked by a Claude Opus judge against exactly the text the system saw. MedCPT reranking of hybrid retrieval gave the best MRR (0.21) and MAP@100 (0.14). Across existing RAG methods, faithfulness was 0.95-0.96, claim hallucination 0.5-0.8% and context precision up to 0.98; the deep-research agent answered 73.2% of BioASQ questions correctly. In conversation, SHAKTI reached a context-awareness score of 97.1%, faithfulness 95.5%, 1.9% unsupported claims, no contradicted claims and 229/229 working source links; it resolved references to the first question after 16 unrelated questions. An answer cost 14,716 tokens (US$0.06) with a median latency of 24 s. Large-scale retrieval with agentic evidence selection and mechanical verification yields auditable, low-hallucination nutrition answers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SHAKTI 对话式营养健康助手，仅基于检索到的学术论文与精确食物成分数据作答，并通过检索、生成、可溯源性、效率与上下文感知等多维指标评估，实现可审计、低幻觉的营养问答。
AI.motivation: LLM 能回答饮食健康问题，但常给出无依据的论断或引用并不支持其说法的来源；营养领域需要可溯源、低幻觉且能处理多轮上下文的可靠助手。
AI.method: 构建 SHAKTI：索引 4.84 亿条 OpenAlex 文献，部署时用压缩的 2.3 亿摘要索引，检索采用混合检索+MedCPT 重排，并加入对话式查询改写、USDA FoodData Central 查询、来源链接校验以及引文与数字在线核验。在 10,065 道 NFCorpus/BioASQ/SciFact/PubMedQA 题上做 GPU 精确检索评估，在 1,000 道分层题上对比单次、多跳、纠错式与 deep-research 四类 RAG（Claude Sonnet），并用 Claude Opus 裁判按系统实际所见文本核查论断；另做 36 轮脚本对话、248 题记忆深度测试和 38 题负载测试。
AI.result: 混合检索加 MedCPT 重排取得最佳 MRR 0.21、MAP@100 0.14；现有 RAG 方法忠实度 0.95–0.96、论断幻觉率 0.5–0.8%、上下文精度最高 0.98，deep-research 代理答对 73.2% 的 BioASQ 题。SHAKTI 对话上下文感知得分 97.1%、忠实度 95.5%、无依据论断 1.9%、无矛盾论断、229/229 来源链接有效，且能在 16 个无关问题后仍正确解析指向首问的指代。单次回答耗 14,716 tokens（约 0.06 美元），中位延迟 24 秒。
AI.conclusion: 大规模检索结合智能体式证据选择与机械化核验，可产生可审计、低幻觉的营养学回答。

title: HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series
summary: Irregular time series are recorded at nonuniform times and are often queried at other times: between observations, after the last one, or on a regular grid. Continuous-time models answer such queries by integrating latent dynamics, and time-aware attention models answer them by revisiting the observation tokens. We introduce HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM), an attention operator that writes an irregular history into a rank-M function space with explicit time coordinates. Masked self-attention first exchanges content among the observations; the updated values are then contracted against kernel-smoothed HiPPO-Legendre features and solved through a regularized Gram matrix, so the retained coefficients define a function that is read at any time through the same features. The write and read have the form of an interdomain sparse Gaussian-process mean: every readout lies in an M-dimensional reproducing-kernel subspace, and a pointwise bound separates the approximation error of this subspace from the error of the learned memory. Removing the functional memory from the encoder raises Spiral reconstruction RMSE 18-fold. The full model has the lowest error in 11 of 12 Spiral settings, the highest overall accuracy and best average rank on 20 irregular UEA datasets, the highest event-type accuracy on all five multi-type event benchmarks, and a 21% lower extrapolation MSE than CRU on PhysioNet. Because the memory has fixed rank, the state retained after encoding keeps a fixed size as the history grows and is 102 times smaller than a token cache at 1,024 observations.

AI.tldr: 提出 HiPPO 函数记忆（HiPPO-FM）注意力算子，将不规则时间序列写入带显式时间坐标的低秩函数空间，实现任意时刻读写与固定大小状态。
AI.motivation: 不规则时间序列常在观测点之外被查询（观测间、末次之后、规则网格上），现有连续时间模型与时间感知注意力在表达与效率上存在局限。
AI.method: 先用掩码自注意力在观测间交换内容，再将更新值对核平滑的 HiPPO-Legendre 特征做收缩，经正则化 Gram 矩阵求解得到秩-M 系数，定义可任意时刻读取的函数；写读形式等价于域间稀疏高斯过程均值，并有逐点误差界。
AI.result: 去掉功能记忆使 Spiral 重建 RMSE 增大约 18 倍；12 个 Spiral 设置中 11 个误差最低，20 个 UEA 数据集上总体准确率与平均排名最优，5 个多类型事件基准事件类型准确率均最高，PhysioNet 外推 MSE 比 CRU 低 21%；1024 观测时状态比 token 缓存小 102 倍。
AI.conclusion: 固定秩功能记忆在保持状态大小不随历史增长的前提下，显著优于现有方法，兼顾表达力与效率。

title: Software-Engineering-as-an-Artifact: From Engines to Systems That Build Themselves
summary: Software engineering (SE) is evolving rapidly as generative AI and LLM-based agents grow more capable. Yet, as a community, we risk using these new tools to solve problems that a changing SE process may no longer pose. We consider how AI may transform, and in part already is transforming, both the SE process and the systems it produces. Drawing on scenario planning methods from futures studies, we extrapolate from observed trends to a deliberately extreme scenario in which the SE process fully materializes in artifacts (like context documentation and executable skills). Such a process would culminate in SE engines that autonomously produce and update systems directly from requirements and user requests. The work of human engineers would then shift from the product to the process: they would maintain the artifacts of these engines, while the engines produce and evolve the software. We probe this scenario in scenario-validation interviews with four SE industry practitioners. The interviewees found the scenario largely plausible and desirable, and two reported that parts of industry are already moving this way; one questioned whether tacit engineering knowledge can ever be fully captured in artifacts. Even if this end state is reached only in part, we argue that reasoning about it can inform the intermediate stages. SE research should therefore take such futures into account when choosing its research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文用未来学的情景规划法，从现有趋势外推出一个极端情景：软件工程过程完全物化为制品（上下文文档、可执行技能），最终形成"SE引擎"自主从需求生产并演进系统，人类工程师转而维护过程制品。四名业界受访者多数认为该情景可信且可取。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI与LLM智能体能力快速提升，软件工程（SE）正在剧变。作者担心社区可能用新工具去解决"变化中的SE过程也许已不再提出"的问题，因此需要前瞻性地思考AI如何改变SE过程及其产物，以指导研究方向的选择。
AI.method: 采用未来研究中的情景规划（scenario planning）方法，从观察到的趋势外推至刻意极端的未来情景；并通过情景验证访谈（scenario-validation interviews）与4名SE业界从业者进行检验。
AI.result: 受访者认为该情景大体可信且可取，其中两人指出业界部分地区已在朝此方向发展；一人质疑隐性的工程知识能否被完全捕捉进制品中。作者主张即使该终态只能部分实现，对其推演也有助于理解中间阶段。
AI.conclusion: SE研究在选择方向时应把此类未来情景纳入考量；人类工程师的工作将从产品转向过程，即维护引擎的制品，而由引擎生产与演进软件。

title: Tangent incompleteness under coupled image transformations: margin reconstruction and decision consequences
summary: Can accurate responses to individual geometric image transformations recover their combined effect on a classifier's decision? For identity-aligned bilinear resampling, coordinatewise assembly may fail at first order. Projecting the implemented transformation onto a fixed logit-margin gradient, we derive a linear term plus signed absolute-value ridges. An exact even--odd identity and ridge-cancellation conditions characterize the missing information. Under independent parameter laws, a noncancelling off-coordinate ridge obstructs even unrestricted additive fits. The coupled correction has $O(s^2)$ projected error, versus a possible $Θ(s)$ axiswise defect; transfer to realized network margins requires local smoothness. Projected RMS errors fall by 82.96% on CIFAR-10 and 82.38% on ImageNetV2 relative to axiswise assembly; realized fixed-pair margin RMS errors fall by 39.75% and 42.73%. The representation prospectively identifies nine strict nonadditive network-margin sign configurations and permits exact minimization of a three-parameter threat surrogate, with conditional selection-regret guarantees. In an independent CIFAR-10 search, coupled-selected transformations uncover 51 top-1 changes versus 41 for axes. On 256 independent ImageNetV2/ConvNeXt-Tiny images and 16,384 transformed decisions at the prespecified scale $s=.40$, multiclass top-1 flip-prediction errors fall from 11.97% to 10.23% (paired improvement 1.74 percentage points; 95% interval [0.93, 2.61]). Directional finite differences are slightly more accurate (10.00%) at higher measured model-construction cost. These results connect first-order sampling interactions to margin reconstruction, decision prediction, and threat selection, without claiming finite-scale network certification.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究单个几何图像变换的响应能否准确重建其组合变换对分类器决策的影响，指出对恒等对齐的双线性重采样，逐坐标装配在一阶意义下会失败，并提出耦合校正方法。
AI.motivation: 探究对单个几何变换的精确响应是否能恢复其组合效应对分类器决策的影响；逐坐标（轴式）装配在双线性重采样下存在一阶缺失信息，需要刻画并修正。
AI.method: 将实现的变换投影到固定的 logit-margin 梯度上，推导出线性项加带符号绝对值脊；给出精确的偶-奇恒等式与脊抵消条件；提出耦合校正（O(s^2) 投影误差）以对比轴式缺陷（Θ(s)），并讨论向实际网络 margin 迁移所需的局部光滑性。
AI.result: 投影 RMS 误差在 CIFAR-10 下降 82.96%、ImageNetV2 下降 82.38%；真实固定配对 margin RMS 误差下降 39.75% 与 42.73%。识别出九种严格非可加网络 margin 符号配置，可实现三参数威胁代理的精确最小化并有条件选择遗憾保证。CIFAR-10 独立搜索中耦合选择发现 51 次 top-1 变化（轴式 41）。在 256 张 ImageNetV2/ConvNeXt-Tiny 图像、s=.40 下 16,384 次变换决策中，多类 top-1 翻转预测误差从 11.97% 降至 10.23%（提升 1.74 个百分点，95% 区间 [0.93, 2.61]）；方向有限差分更准（10.00%）但构建成本更高。
AI.conclusion: 结果将一阶采样交互与 margin 重建、决策预测和威胁选择联系起来，但未声称有限尺度下的网络认证。

title: Make Position Uninformative: Exchangeable Self-Distillation Flattens the Lost-in-the-Middle Curve
summary: Retrieval-augmented language models answer well when the relevant document comes first or last and poorly when it sits in the middle. Some fine-tuning recipes lift the middle by lowering the start. We show how training contexts teach positional bias. With a uniform answer slot and shuffled distractors, the optimal reader ignores position. Building on this result, Exchangeable Self-Distillation (ExSD) trains a small adapter on shuffled contexts to reproduce the model's answer when it reads the answer document alone. It needs no gold answers and only a few thousand examples. On six models from 1.5B to 32B parameters, ExSD raises both average and worst-position accuracy against the frozen model, including on a held-out test split. In controlled LoRA comparisons, it significantly improves both criteria over Pos2Distill. Against CORD, mean differences are not significant, while worst-position accuracy improves significantly in the 20- and 30-document settings. ExSD also matches or beats gold-answer fine-tuning, changes behavior on other tasks far less, and transfers to unseen tasks. Head probes show greater reliance on content over position.

AI.tldr: ExSD 用打乱语料的上下文自蒸馏训练小型适配器，无需标准答案即可缓解检索增强模型的"中间迷失"位置偏见。
AI.motivation: 检索增强语言模型在相关文档位于开头或结尾时表现好，位于中间时表现差。已有微调方法通过压低开头位置的表现来"抬升"中间表现，而非真正消除位置偏见。作者希望从理论上说明训练上下文如何塑造位置偏见，并提出真正去除偏见的训练方法。
AI.method: 理论分析：在答案槽位均匀分布、干扰文档被随机打乱的条件下，最优读者应忽略位置。基于此提出 Exchangeable Self-Distillation（ExSD）：在打乱的上下文上训练一个小适配器，使其复现模型单独阅读答案文档时的输出；无需金标准答案，仅需数千样本。在 1.5B–32B 的六个模型上与 Pos2Distill、CORD、金标准答案微调及 LoRA 对照比较，并用 head probe 分析。
AI.result: ExSD 在冻结模型基础上同时提升平均准确率与最差位置准确率（含留出测试集）；在 LoRA 受控对比中两项指标均显著优于 Pos2Distill；对比 CORD 平均差异不显著，但在 20 与 30 文档设置下最差位置准确率显著提升。ExSD 匹配或超过金标准答案微调，对其他任务行为改变更小，并能迁移到未见任务。
AI.conclusion: 位置偏见可从训练上下文分布中习得，通过打乱上下文的自蒸馏（无需标签）即可有效去除；head probe 显示模型对内容而非位置的依赖增强。

title: From atomic events to material degradation across metre and year scales
summary: Material degradation emerges from microscopic events whose consequences accumulate over years, yet mechanism-resolved simulations remain confined below engineering timescales. The challenge is not just the sheer number of events: atomistic evolution is dominated by recurrent local motion, with only a tiny fraction driving lasting structural change. This distinction is not encoded in an instantaneous atomic configuration. Locally indistinguishable states can exhibit different event competition, escape times, and long-horizon outcomes, revealing missing kinetic context as a critical information bottleneck. This context spans space and time: the future consequence of a local transition depends on its surrounding defect environment and the kinetic history leading to its current state. To solve this, AtomWorld reconstructs a predictive kinetic state from multiscale structural observations and trajectory history, distinguishing transient fluctuations from microscopic pathways that drive persistent structural evolution. Learning operates only over transitions admitted by the underlying kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) process, preserving event legality, state evolution, and physical time. Across BCC Fe-Cu precipitation, FCC Ni-Cr-Al ordering, and HCP Zr-H interstitial transport, restoring kinetic context consistently advances persistent evolution while maintaining physical fidelity and transferring to unseen conditions. In irradiated reactor-pressure-vessel steel, this approach achieves up to 420-fold greater persistent evolution under matched event budgets. Combined with scalable execution, it successfully extends mechanism-resolved trajectories to service-year timescales across metre-scale heterogeneous domains.

AI.tldr: 提出AtomWorld——一种基于KMC约束的动力学状态学习方法，通过重建原子轨迹的"动力学上下文"（缺陷环境+历史），区分瞬态涨落与持续结构演化路径，将机制分辨模拟推广到服役年限尺度。
AI.motivation: 材料退化源于微观事件的长期累积，但原子尺度模拟受限于远低于工程时间尺度的模拟能力。核心难点不只是事件数量庞大，而在于原子演化由反复的局部运动主导，仅极少数事件驱动持久结构改变；而这一区分无法从瞬时原子构型中获知——局部看似相同的状态可能有不同的事件竞争、逃逸时间和长期结果，说明缺失的"动力学上下文"是关键信息瓶颈。该上下文横跨空间（周围缺陷环境）与时间（到达当前状态的动力学历史）。
AI.method: AtomWorld从多尺度结构观测与轨迹历史中重建预测性"动力学状态"，区分瞬态涨落与驱动持久演化的微观路径；学习仅在KMC过程允许的跃迁上进行，从而保证事件合法性、状态演化与物理时间的真实性。
AI.result: 在BCC Fe-Cu析出、FCC Ni-Cr-Al有序化、HCP Zr-H间隙输运三个体系中，恢复动力学上下文均能持续加速持久演化，同时保持物理保真度并可迁移到未见条件；在辐照反应堆压力容器钢中，在相同事件预算下持久演化提升达420倍。
AI.conclusion: 结合可扩展执行，该方法成功将机制分辨轨迹扩展到米级非均匀区域的服役年限时间尺度，为长期材料退化预测提供了可行路径。

title: PAMS: Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-tuning
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization provides a computationally efficient approach to fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), but conventional methods typically rely on isotropic perturbations that ignore the anisotropic structure of neural-network parameter spaces. We introduce Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace (PAMS), a ZO optimization framework that uses forward-pass activation statistics to construct structured, layer-wise perturbation geometries without computing gradients or forming dense curvature matrices. PAMS tracks a low-rank approximation of the dominant activation subspace and its associated spectrum online, and uses the spectrum to softly reweight perturbation variance while preserving exploration in directions outside the retained subspace. A trace normalization separates the perturbation geometry from its overall scale, enabling consistent perturbation magnitudes across layers. We show theoretically that the resulting perturbation covariance induces right-side preconditioning of the gradient of the corresponding Gaussian-smoothed objective. We further characterize the estimator's smoothing bias and second moment and derive a nonconvex convergence guarantee that captures the effects of the perturbation geometry and smoothing radius. The proposed low-rank tracking procedure requires $\mathcal{O}(n_l r)$ persistent memory for a layer with input dimension nl and retained rank r, avoiding the $\mathcal{O}(n_l^2)$ memory required by a dense activation covariance. Experiments on transformer-based language-model fine-tuning tasks across GLUE and SuperGLUE demonstrate that PAMS improves the effectiveness and stability of zeroth-order optimization while retaining its gradient-free and objective-evaluation-based advantages.

AI.tldr: 提出PAMS——一种利用前向激活统计构造分层预条件几何的零阶优化框架，在无需梯度与稠密曲率矩阵的情况下改进LLM微调。
AI.motivation: 零阶（ZO）优化是微调大语言模型的高效手段，但传统方法采用各向同性扰动，忽略了神经网络参数空间的各向异性结构，导致扰动方向与损失敏感方向不匹配、效率与稳定性受限。
AI.method: 用前向传播的激活统计在线追踪低秩主导激活子空间及其谱，用谱对扰动方差做软重加权，同时在保留子空间之外方向保持探索；再以迹归一化将几何与整体尺度解耦，使各层扰动幅度一致。理论证明该扰动协方差等价于对高斯平滑目标梯度的右侧预条件，并刻画估计器的平滑偏差与二阶矩，给出反映扰动几何与平滑半径影响的非凸收敛保证。
AI.result: 低秩追踪每层仅需O(n_l·r)常驻内存，避免稠密激活协方差的O(n_l²)开销；在GLUE与SuperGLUE的Transformer语言模型微调任务上，PAMS提升了ZO优化的效果与稳定性，同时保留无梯度、仅依赖目标函数评估的优势。
AI.conclusion: 以激活几何引导的预条件扰动是改进零阶LLM微调的一种低开销且理论可解释的方向。

title: RepoClean: Evaluating Coding Agents on Repository-Level Obsolete Code Cleanup
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong repository-level programming capabilities. However, as software evolves, repository code may become redundant or obsolete, increasing maintenance costs and potentially introducing functional issues. Agents must therefore identify and remove unnecessary code safely, yet autonomous repository-level code cleanup remains insufficiently evaluated in isolation. To evaluate this capability, we introduce RepoClean, a benchmark of 200 cleanup tasks from 34 popular open-source Python repositories. RepoClean is constructed by automatically reintroducing deleted code from real repository histories into newer versions, preserving current implementations and retaining instances where previously passing tests consequently fail. To restore existing functionality without new feature development, agents must use repository interfaces and cross-file dependencies to determine which historical code to remove and which implementations to preserve. Evaluation of seven models shows that even the best-performing model, GPT-6 Astra, resolves only 23% of tasks. Further analysis reveals that agents remove substantially less obsolete code when cleanup is not explicitly requested. RepoClean provides a foundation for systematically studying these cleanup challenges and advancing coding agents toward autonomous software maintenance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RepoClean 基准，用于独立评测 LLM 智能体在代码仓库级别清理冗余/过时代码的能力；含 34 个 Python 开源仓库的 200 个任务，最佳模型 GPT-6 Astra 仅解决 23%。
AI.motivation: 软件演化使仓库代码冗余或过时，增加维护成本并可能引入功能问题；智能体需安全识别并删除无用代码，但仓库级自动代码清理目前缺乏独立、系统的评测。
AI.method: 从真实仓库历史中自动把已删除代码重新注入较新版本，保留现有实现，并筛选注入后原本通过的测试失败的实例，构成 200 个任务；任务要求智能体利用仓库接口与跨文件依赖，判断哪些历史代码需删除、哪些实现需保留，从而恢复原有功能（无需开发新功能）。
AI.result: 在 7 个模型上评测，表现最好的 GPT-6 Astra 仅解决 23% 的任务；进一步分析发现，若未明确要求清理，智能体删除的过时代码明显更少。
AI.conclusion: RepoClean 为系统研究仓库级代码清理挑战提供基础，推动编码智能体向自主软件维护方向发展。

title: GC-GS: Optimizing 3D Gaussian Splatting with Gradient Conflict as a Geometry Signal
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is commonly optimized with multiple reconstruction losses, which naturally forms a multi-objective optimization problem. This issue becomes more pronounced when perceptual losses are introduced to improve visual quality, as different objectives may impose competing update directions on Gaussian primitives and make it difficult to simultaneously improve fidelity, perceptual quality, and representation efficiency. Based on this view, we reformulate 3DGS training as a multi-objective optimization problem and derive selective conflict-aware position updates that reduce interference between competing objectives while preserving the contribution of each loss. We further observe that gradient conflicts persist throughout training and are most severe in Gaussian position parameters, indicating that objective conflict is closely tied to geometry optimization. We therefore treat position-gradient conflict as a geometry-aware signal to guide densification and pruning. Experiments show that our method achieves better rendering performance while improving representation compactness and rendering efficiency over existing 3DGS variants.

AI.tldr: 将3DGS训练重构为多目标优化问题，利用冲突感知的位置更新与基于位置梯度冲突的致密化/剪枝策略，实现更优渲染、更紧凑表示与更高效率。
AI.motivation: 3DGS常用多种重建损失（尤其引入感知损失）联合优化，本质上构成多目标优化问题；不同目标对高斯基元的更新方向相互竞争，难以同时兼顾保真度、感知质量与表示效率。
AI.method: 把3DGS训练显式建模为多目标优化，推导选择性冲突感知的位置更新以减少目标间干扰、同时保留各损失贡献；并观察到梯度冲突贯穿训练且在高斯位置参数上最严重，遂将位置梯度冲突作为几何感知信号来引导致密化与剪枝。
AI.result: 实验表明相较现有3DGS变体，方法在取得更好渲染性能的同时提升了表示紧凑性与渲染效率。
AI.conclusion: 目标冲突与几何优化紧密相关，可作为统一视角改进3DGS训练与稀疏化，兼顾质量与效率。

title: Legal Is Not Good: A Pre-Registered Benchmark of Low-Cost Language and Decision Models on a New Strategy Game
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Pre-registered protocol (v1-v5, all amendments committed before the games they govern). Engine, benchmark harness, agents and protocol: https://github.com/federicolucca/hexfolk, tag bench-v1. Companion to arXiv:2610.32955 and arXiv:2611.21393. No frontier model; paid pairings limited to 50 games by budget
summary: Measure Before You Train argued that an agent's decisions should be measured against ground truth, under a protocol fixed in advance, before anyone trains or replaces the model behind them. We carry the method to a second, very different domain, a turn-based strategy game, and ask a deliberately modest question: how well do low-cost agents play under a pre-registered protocol? hexfolk is a minimal two-player 4X game written for this purpose, so no model has seen its rules or positions. A deterministic engine, one agent interface, a referee that never corrects an illegal or late move, and per-decision logs make every game replayable; questions and expected answers were committed before the games, on held-out seeds with mirrored seats and 95% Wilson intervals. Two small open language models (8B and 3B) lose every game to a few-line rule player. Answering in free text they are invalid on 98% of their decisions; constrained to legal moves they never play an invalid one, yet they lose to the uniformly random player (the 8B model wins 10.0 [4.3, 21.4]% of games), refuting our expectation that they would beat it; the result survives a control that shuffles the order of the options. Two native decision models never play an invalid move and both beat random; one loses all 50 games to the rule player, the other is not distinguishable from it in 50 games and beats a one-step search. The paid agents make tens to over a hundred model calls per game; against the same opponents a free 60 ms-per-move search, which makes none, outplays every paid model by the full range of the scale. Two 7-8B models served locally behave the same way. No frontier model is included.

AI.tldr: 本文把"先测量再训练"的方法迁移到回合制策略游戏领域，设计了一个无模型见过规则的极简4X游戏hexfolk，并用预注册协议评估低成本智能体的真实对局能力。
AI.motivation: 作者希望在不训练或替换模型之前，用预先固定的协议将智能体决策与真实结果对照评估；本文将其扩展到差异很大的第二个领域（回合制策略游戏），检验低成本智能体在预注册协议下的实际表现。
AI.method: 构建hexfolk极简双人4X游戏（确定性引擎、单一智能体接口、从不纠正非法/超时着法的裁判、逐决策日志），问题与预期答案在任何对局前基于留出种子、镜像座位和95% Wilson区间预先登记；对比两个小型开源语言模型（8B/3B）、两个原生决策模型、随机玩家、规则玩家、一步搜索及60ms/步免费搜索，并做选项顺序打乱的对照。
