AI.result: 8B和3B语言模型全部输给几行代码的规则玩家；自由文本作答时98%的决策非法，约束到合法着法后不再非法，但仍输给随机玩家（8B胜率10.0% [4.3, 21.4]%），推翻了预期，且选项乱序对照下结果依然成立；两个原生决策模型从不非法且均胜过随机，一个全部50局输给规则玩家，另一个50局内与规则玩家无法区分并胜过一步搜索；付费智能体每局数十至上百次模型调用，却被零调用的60ms免费搜索全面压制；两个本地部署的7-8B模型表现类似；未包含前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: 在预注册协议与未见规则的严格测试下，低成本付费模型并不优于廉价的规则/随机/轻量搜索基线，说明必须先把智能体决策与真实结果对照测量，再决定是否训练或替换模型。

title: Beyond Unit Tests: Path-Aware Rubric-Guided LLM Autograding of Notebooks
summary: Jupyter notebooks support open-ended, multi-step assessments in which students build one logical flow across interdependent steps, combining code, written analysis, and generated outputs such as plots. These reflect authentic scientific practice but are hard to grade consistently, since students may make different yet equally valid choices at each step, so a later answer can only be judged in light of the choices a student made earlier. We present an LLM-based autograder for such flow-structured notebook questions. It generates a rubric from a reference solution, then applies a softening pass that relaxes criteria tied to the reference so legitimate alternative paths are not penalized. Each question group is graded in a single model call, so later answers are judged against the student's own earlier choices, using question-type tags and schema-constrained, low-temperature outputs. Evidence is scored multimodally: code, text, numerical outputs, and figures from code cells. We deployed the tool in a machine-learning course, integrated with Gradescope, with a pre-submission format check and prompt-injection defenses, and evaluate it both in that live course and against archived submissions graded by staff in earlier terms. We report agreement, cross-model variance, cost, student perceptions, and injection resilience. With low-temperature models, agreement with human scores is often strong, including on the open-ended items the design specifically targets, while run-to-run stability depends sharply on the model's temperature support.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM的Jupyter Notebook"流程结构化"题目自动评分器，通过参考解答生成评分标准并做"软化"处理以允许合理替代路径，按题组单次调用模型以结合学生前序选择评分，支持代码/文本/数值/图像多模态打分，并在真实ML课程（集成Gradescope）中评估与人工评分的一致性、跨模型方差、成本、学生反馈与抗提示注入能力。
AI.motivation: Jupyter notebook支持开放式、多步骤评估，学生需在相互依赖的步骤间构建连贯逻辑。这类任务贴近真实科研实践，但因学生每步可能有不同但同样有效的选择，后续答案只能结合其先前选择判断，导致人工评分难以一致、成本高。
AI.method: 1) 由参考解答自动生成评分标准（rubric）；2) 软化处理（softening pass），放宽绑定参考解的具体判据，避免惩罚合法的替代路径；3) 每个题组用一次模型调用完成评分，结合学生自己的前序选择，配合题型标签与schema约束、低温度输出；4) 多模态证据打分：代码、文本、数值输出与图像；5) 与Gradescope集成，提供提交前格式检查与提示注入防御。
AI.result: 在真实ML课程与往期人工评分存档提交上评估：低温度模型下与人工评分常达到较强一致性（含设计所针对的开放式题目）；重复运行稳定性强烈依赖模型对temperature的支持情况；同时报告了跨模型方差、成本、学生感知与抗注入能力。
AI.conclusion: LLM自动评分可用于流程结构化的notebook开放式题目，在低温度模型下与人工评分一致性良好；但稳定性受模型temperature支持程度制约，需软化的评分标准设计、整体题组上下文评分与安全防护相配套。

title: Pixel as the Common Language: Unified Multimodal Embedding via Visual Rendering
summary: Multimodal embedding models map heterogeneous inputs into a shared representation space, yet text-only, image-only, and composed inputs are still presented in distinct formats and follow different routes through the model. This fragmentation prevents heterogeneous tasks from jointly optimizing the same end-to-end encoding process, limiting supervision transfer across input configurations. To address this issue, we propose unification before encoding and instantiate this paradigm in RenderEmbed. The framework uses Visual Substrate Rendering to convert heterogeneous inputs into a common visual substrate for encoding with a VLM. From the resulting visual tokens, Progressive Hierarchical Anchor Encoding produces compact retrieval representations by interleaving learnable anchors and fusing their states across layers, retaining broad context and fine-grained cues. Interventional Rendering Learning trains these representations to remain sensitive to content changes and stable across rendering variations through complementary semantic and rendering interventions. Extensive experiments on MMEB and ViDoRe v2, spanning diverse retrieval tasks, show that RenderEmbed outperforms prior state-of-the-art models at the same scale and exhibits strong out-of-domain generalization. Compared with MetaEmbed, RenderEmbed improves MMEB Overall Precision@1 by 1.7 points, with a larger 2.1-point gain on out-of-domain tasks. Transfer and scaling analyses further show that a shared visual pathway enables more effective learning from heterogeneous supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出"先统一再编码"范式,用视觉基底渲染把文本/图像/组合输入转为统一视觉形式,由VLM编码,并以分层锚点压缩和干预式渲染学习得到检索表征。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态嵌入模型对纯文本、纯图像、组合输入采用不同格式与不同模型路径,导致异构任务无法共享同一端到端编码过程,监督信号难以跨输入配置迁移。
AI.method: RenderEmbed:1) Visual Substrate Rendering 将异构输入渲染为统一视觉基底;2) Progressive Hierarchical Anchor Encoding 在视觉token中交错插入可学习锚点并跨层融合其状态,得到紧凑检索表示;3) Interventional Rendering Learning 通过语义干预与渲染干预,使表示对内容变化敏感、对渲染差异稳定。
AI.result: 在MMEB与ViDoRe v2多类检索任务上,同规模下超越此前SOTA,并具强域外泛化:相比MetaEmbed,MMEB Overall Precision@1 提升1.7点,域外任务提升2.1点;迁移与缩放分析表明共享视觉通路能更有效利用异构监督。
AI.conclusion: 统一视觉通路可消除多模态嵌入的输入格式与路径碎片化,提升异构监督的协同优化与迁移效果。

title: Don't Train It, Write It: An AI Agent Writes New Capabilities into Language Model Weights
summary: We show that an AI agent can write new capabilities into a pretrained language model by adding gated attention heads and MLP neurons inside its existing layers, without backpropagation and without fitting any weight to the answers of task examples. It has a budget of 50 model passes and sees no validation or test instance. Composed in one model, its modules for six BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) subtasks raise the normalized BBH score of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct from 19.95 to 41.05 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: at most 35.01) and that of Gemma-3-1B-it from 10.25 to 32.86. Against the unmodified model at the same precision, both composites leave the next-token distribution on 1,023,000 WikiText tokens unchanged (KL exactly 0), give identical answers on 15,845 items of five other Leaderboard tests and identical scores on the other 18 BBH subtasks. The agent also writes exact multiplication up to 20 digits, running the model only up to 6 (100.0% on the absent lengths of the sealed test in both models; a LoRA with the same budget: at most 2.1%). Sets, rules and report sentences were sealed in git before the first session (manifests timestamped in Bitcoin), with dated amendments listed in Appendix D; a frozen evaluator ran the sealed test once. Verdicts (H5: tracking; H6: composite; H8: one pass vs. chain of thought; H9: fresh and rewritten instances; H10: side effects; H12: multiplication), on the preregistered sealed test, Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct: H5 success, H6 success, H8 (web_of_lies) success, H9 success, H10 (composite) success on (i) to (iii), (iv) confirmed, H12 success; Gemma-3-1B-it (H7: H5, H6, H8 and H9 in this model): H5 success, H6 success, H8 (web_of_lies) success, H8 (tracking 3) success, H9 partial, H10 (composite) success on (i) to (iii), (iv) confirmed, H12 success. Not everything worked: 4 of 45 single modules show small side effects and 5 of 50 sessions hit the 12-hour limit without a module.

AI.tldr: AI agent adds gated attention heads/MLP neurons directly into a pretrained LM's layers (no backprop, 50 passes, no val/test access) to implant new capabilities; composite raises BBH score without changing unchanged-model behavior elsewhere, and writes exact 20-digit multiplication.
AI.motivation: To test whether capabilities can be written directly into an existing pretrained model by an agent, without gradient training or fitting to task answers, and while leaving the original model's behavior intact (no side effects).
AI.method: Add gated attention heads and MLP neurons inside existing layers; training-free insertion with a 50-pass budget; no validation/test instances seen; pre-registered sealed test (git + Bitcoin timestamps), frozen evaluator, single run. Evaluated on Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct and Gemma-3-1B-it across BBH subtasks, Leaderboard tests, KL on WikiText, and exact multiplication.
AI.result: BBH normalized score: Qwen2.5-1.5B 19.95→41.05 (beats 7B's 35.01); Gemma-3-1B 10.25→32.86. KL=0 on 1,023,000 WikiText tokens; identical answers/scores on other tests and 18 other BBH subtasks. Multiplication up to 20 digits near 100% on absent lengths (LoRA ≤2.1%). Minor failures: 4/45 modules show small side effects, 5/50 sessions hit time limit.
AI.conclusion: Capabilities can be reliably written into pretrained models without backprop or answer fitting while preserving original behavior, validated by pre-registered sealed tests across two model families.

title: When an AI agent makes a mistake in a database, what decides the damage?
comment: 47 pages. Preregistered at https://osf.io/ms7ef. Harness, trial records and analysis scripts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24445015 and https://github.com/libredb/agent-blast-radius
summary: AI agents now run statements against production databases, and several of the incidents that followed deleted production data, which came back only through backups or the provider's help. We ask what decides the damage when such an agent makes a mistake: the model, a guard layer in front of the database, or the database engine itself. The study has two preregistered layers. In Layer A, a frozen library of 22 canonical mistakes is applied by script, with no model involved, to four relational engines under five permission arms and two recovery arms, followed by an engine-native recovery drill (792 cells; 874 drill runs including 10-minute repeats). In Layer B, a minimal tool-calling agent driven by six small open-weight models (4B to 12B parameters, plus one 35B mixture-of-experts model with about 3B active, served locally) works on tasks that contain hazards across nine engines: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, ClickHouse, Apache Cassandra, MongoDB, Valkey, Apache Kafka and OpenSearch (9,468 trials). A secondary run added MariaDB, Redis and Elasticsearch (2,916 trials); each behaved like its closest core engine. Out of the box, the engines differ less in what a mistake destroys than in what they let you undo. Three of the seven preregistered hypotheses met their decision rule: H2 (for one of nine damage classes) and H3 largely by construction of the arms, and H4 only under its original measure. Four did not; one of them (H5) was uninformative, because in its task the agents never found the credential. The post-hoc analyses (S1-S13) are exploratory and uncorrected for multiple comparisons; on PostgreSQL, MySQL, OpenSearch and ClickHouse the preregistered outcome and original-row loss disagree about G1. We report all of them, with every deviation from the preregistration and its timing.

AI.tldr: 一项预注册的大规模实证研究比较"模型/防护层/数据库引擎"谁决定AI智能体误操作造成的损害：用22种典型错误脚本在4种引擎×5权限×2恢复臂上测试，并用6个小模型驱动工具调用智能体在9种引擎上跑9,468次试验，发现引擎间的差别主要不在"会破坏什么"，而在"能撤销什么"。
AI.motivation: AI智能体已直接对生产数据库执行语句，已有事故导致生产数据被删、只能靠备份或厂商恢复。作者想弄清：当智能体犯错时，决定损害程度的是模型、数据库前的防护层，还是数据库引擎本身。
AI.method: 两层预注册设计。Layer A：无模型的脚本化"22种典型错误库"，在4种关系型引擎、5种权限臂、2种恢复臂下运行，并做引擎原生恢复演练（792个单元，含10分钟重复共874次）。Layer B：由6个小型开源权重模型（4B–12B，另加一个约3B激活的35B MoE，本地部署）驱动的极简工具调用智能体，在含风险的9种引擎（PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite、ClickHouse、Cassandra、MongoDB、Valkey、Kafka、OpenSearch）上执行任务（9,468次试验）；补充运行MariaDB、Redis、Elasticsearch（2,916次），表现类似各自最接近的核心引擎。
AI.result: 默认配置下，各引擎在"错误会破坏什么"上差别不大，差别主要在"允许你撤销什么"。7个预注册假设中3个达到判定标准：H2（仅9类损害中的1类）、H3（很大程度上因实验臂构造而成立）、H4（仅在其原始度量下成立）；另外4个未成立，其中H5因智能体从未找到凭据而无信息量。事后分析S1–S13为探索性且未做多重比较校正；在PostgreSQL、MySQL、OpenSearch和ClickHouse上，预注册结果与原始行损失对G1的结论不一致。
AI.conclusion: 引擎选择的关键在于可恢复性而非破坏范围。作者报告全部结果，并逐条说明与预注册的偏离及偏离发生的时间。

title: ROSE-SAM3: Response-Oriented Prompt Selection for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
summary: In open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) of remote-sensing imagery, class-name prompts can miss objects with varied appearances, while richer descriptions can activate competing classes. We propose Response-Oriented Prompt Selection for SAM 3 (ROSE-SAM3), a training-free framework that selects descriptions using frozen SAM 3 responses on unlabeled target-domain images. We screen candidate descriptions for coverage beyond the native prompts while protecting reliable native class responses, retaining candidates that pass these checks on at least four of five image folds. An offline directed acyclic graph (DAG) search then evaluates candidate combinations and builds a compact PromptBank for each class. Each bank retains the native prompts and adds selected descriptions, which we call residual prompts. At inference, the bank is fixed, and Semantic-Instance Cooperative Head (SICH) uses instance evidence to refine semantic responses before assigning pixel labels. We also introduce RS-OVSS-C to evaluate robustness under six image corruption families across eight remote-sensing datasets, preserving their class vocabularies and reference labels. ROSE-SAM3 achieves 57.3% mean mIoU across eight clean benchmarks and 54.7% on RS-OVSS-C, achieving state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/YanghuiSong/ROSE-SAM3.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架ROSE-SAM3，利用冻结SAM3在目标域无标注图像上的响应来筛选描述提示，通过DAG搜索构建紧凑PromptBank，并用SICH头在推理时融合实例证据精化语义响应，实现遥感开放词汇分割SOTA。
AI.motivation: 遥感开放词汇语义分割中，类名提示难以覆盖外观多变的目标，而更丰富的描述又会激活竞争类，存在覆盖性与误激活之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 免训练框架：用冻结SAM3响应在无标注目标域图像上筛选候选描述（要求超出原生提示的覆盖、同时保护原生类响应，且需在5折中至少4折通过）；再用离线DAG搜索评估候选组合，为每类构建含原生提示与"残差提示"的紧凑PromptBank；推理时固定bank，由语义-实例协作头(SICH)先用实例证据精化语义响应再赋像素标签。
AI.result: 在八个遥感数据集上平均mIoU达57.3%，在新提出的RS-OVSS-C（六类图像损坏，覆盖八个数据集）上达54.7%，在免训练方法中取得SOTA。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 基于模型响应的描述筛选与实例-语义协作可在不训练的情况下提升遥感OVSS的覆盖性与鲁棒性，并提供了损坏鲁棒性评测基准RS-OVSS-C。

title: KMed-31B Technical Report
summary: We present KMed-31B, a medical large language model post-trained from an open-weight model for on-premises deployment with limited hardware. Post-training a model for diverse medical tasks remains difficult, because improving one kind of task can lower performance on another. We attribute this to differences between tasks in expected output and available feedback. Medical question answering and diagnosis prediction have reference answers, whereas clinical inquiry has no single correct response and is judged with rubrics. We therefore divide medical training tasks into four categories by these two properties, train one specialist per category with a reward that its feedback supports, and integrate the specialists into a single student with Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation (MOPD$^2$). For clinical inquiry, we build Synthetic Health Dialogue, a simulated corpus of consultations with lay users and clinicians whose patient cases span common clinical presentations in primary care. Relative to its base model, KMed-31B raises HealthBench Hard from 22.95 to 41.87 and HealthBench Professional from 37.92 to 50.20 in non-thinking mode, and from 23.80 to 51.48 and from 41.97 to 59.18 in thinking mode, while its scores on four multiple-choice medical benchmarks are maintained or slightly improved. KMed-31B has the highest unadjusted HealthBench Hard score among the compared models, including proprietary ones, and scores higher on HealthBench Professional than every open-weight model we compare, including models with more than ten times as many total parameters. Applied to another base model, Qwen3.8-27B, the same training recipe also raises both HealthBench scores. We describe the training recipe, data construction, and settings in detail so that institutions requiring on-premises deployment can develop medical models from open-weight foundations.

AI.tldr: 提出 KMed-31B 医疗大模型，按“输出是否有标准答案/反馈类型”把医疗任务分为四类，各训一个专家再用多教师在线策略增量蒸馏（MOPD²）整合为单一学生模型，并构建合成健康对话语料；HealthBench Hard/Professional 大幅提升且多选题保持。
AI.motivation: 面向算力有限的本地化（on-premises）部署场景，需从开源权重模型后训练出医疗模型。但多任务医疗后训练存在任务间冲突：提升一类任务会损害另一类，作者认为根源在于任务在“期望输出形式”和“可用反馈”上的差异——问答题/诊断预测有参考答案，而临床问询无唯一正确答案、需用 rubric 评判，单一奖励信号难以兼顾。
AI.method: 依据“期望输出是否有参考标准”和“反馈类型（参考答案 vs rubric 评分）”两个维度，将医疗训练任务划分为四类；每类训练一个专家模型，使用与该类反馈形式相匹配的奖励；再通过多教师在线策略增量蒸馏（Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation, MOPD²）将各专家整合进单一学生模型。同时构建 Synthetic Health Dialogue——覆盖基层医疗常见就诊场景的模拟咨询语料，含普通用户与临床医生两种对话对象。
AI.result: 相对基座模型，KMed-31B 非思考模式下 HealthBench Hard 22.95→41.87、Professional 37.92→50.20；思考模式下 23.80→51.48、41.97→59.18；四项医学多选题基准持平或略升。在对比模型中其 HealthBench Hard 原始分最高（含闭源模型），Professional 分数高于所有对比的开源模型（含总参数超其十倍者）。同一训练配方用于 Qwen3.8-27B 也提升两项 HealthBench 分数。
AI.conclusion: 按反馈形式分类专家训练 + 多教师策略蒸馏是缓解医疗多任务冲突、从开源基座构建高性能医疗模型的有效配方；论文详细公开训练配方、数据构建与设置，支持有本地化部署需求的机构自建医疗模型。

title: EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries
summary: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents have shown promising capabilities in task-oriented environments. However, they still struggle when queries are deferred until after exploration, requiring them to retain visual evidence before knowing which details will matter. We introduce EvoViM, a recursively self-evolving framework in which a frozen multimodal model turns its own interaction experience into one visual program for memory and skills. The program retains images and computes directly on pixels, and its operations decide how this evidence is used in each task. During memory evolution, the same model traces failures in its visual trajectories to the operations that lost or misused evidence and revises them. It also rewrites the notes and analysis tools that guide later revisions, which then build on earlier findings and skip changes that have already failed. We evaluate EvoViM with three multimodal models on six tasks covering visual matching, spatial recall, and sequential decision-making, including three tasks with deferred queries. Across the six tasks, EvoViM improves the average score over AutoMem, the strongest baseline in the main comparison, by 31.3-47.6 points on held-out episodes. Programs written once from the initial environment instructions perform substantially worse, highlighting the value of interaction experience in shaping how visual evidence is retained and used. Code and dataset are available at https://evovim.github.io/.

AI.tldr: EvoViM 提出一种递归自进化框架，让冻结的多模态大模型把自身交互经验转化为统一的视觉程序（用于记忆与技能），从而在"延迟查询"任务中更好地保留和使用视觉证据，六个任务上显著优于最强基线 AutoMem。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 智能体在任务导向环境中表现良好，但当查询在探索结束后才提出（deferred queries）时，它们难以在"还不知道哪些细节重要"之前保留视觉证据，导致证据丢失或误用。
AI.method: 提出 EvoViM：一个递归自进化框架。冻结的多模态模型将自身交互经验凝练为单一视觉程序，直接保留图像并在像素上运算，程序中的操作决定证据在各任务中如何被使用。记忆演化阶段，同一模型在视觉轨迹中追踪失败，定位导致证据丢失/误用的操作并加以修正；同时改写指导后续修正的笔记与分析工具，使其继承先前发现并跳过已失败的改动。
AI.result: 在视觉匹配、空间回忆、序列决策共六个任务（含三个延迟查询任务）上，用三个多模态模型评估；在留出片段上，相比主对比中最强基线 AutoMem 平均得分提升 31.3–47.6 分。仅依据初始环境指令一次性编写的程序表现明显更差，说明交互经验对塑造视觉证据的保留与使用具有关键价值。
AI.conclusion: 交互经验是让智能体学会"如何保留与使用视觉证据"的核心；通过将经验递归地演化为可执行的视觉程序并自我修正，冻结模型也能在延迟查询场景下取得大幅提升。代码与数据集已公开。

title: Ontology-Compiled 2D Clinical State Fields with Bidirectional Diffusion Encoders for Zero-Training Cross-Ontology Medical Coding
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 4 main tables, 5 supplementary tables. Code available at https://github.com/ZeqiangWangAI/OCSF
summary: Healthcare systems continually revise clinical taxonomies, update reimbursement schedules, and harmonize cross-border registries. Existing automated coding models bind clinical text understanding to fixed vocabulary-specific heads, requiring manual relabeling and retraining whenever code sets change. We introduce Ontology-Compiled 2D Clinical State Fields (OCSF), a vocabulary-free framework that decouples clinical document reading from target ontology indexing so one trained encoder can switch across arbitrary medical vocabularies in seconds without target training. A single-pass bidirectional diffusion-pretrained encoder and vocabulary-free decoder map each clinical note into a fixed-dimension two-dimensional state matrix with zero code-specific parameters. Any target ontology is compiled offline on CPU from public text descriptions into a scale-invariant Tikhonov deconvolution operator that suppresses sibling-code interference while preserving source decision thresholds. Trained solely on English MIMIC-IV ICD-9 discharge summaries and evaluated without target tuning across 58,706 held-out test notes and five unseen ontologies spanning English ICD-10, MS-DRG, Spanish, Greek, and Chinese (115-185,458 codes), OCSF reaches 63.15% Micro-F1 on in-domain ICD-9 (outperforming a matched closed-vocabulary classifier and eliminating late-epoch tail overfitting) and transfers directly to 26,085 English ICD-10 codes (29.23% recall at gold cardinality), MS-DRG groups, and multilingual terminologies, compiling up to 185,458 codes in under 10 seconds on CPU with sub-millisecond GPU readout.

AI.tldr: OCSF：将临床文本阅读与目标本体索引解耦的"无词表"框架，用一个固定维度二维状态矩阵加离线编译的Tikhonov反卷积算子，实现秒级切换任意医学编码体系。
AI.motivation: 医疗编码体系不断修订（临床分类更新、报销表调整、跨境注册表统一），而现有自动编码模型把文本理解绑定在固定词表专属的输出头上，一旦码集变化就需人工重标注与重训练，成本高、迁移差。
AI.method: 提出OCSF：(1) 单遍双向扩散预训练编码器 + 无词表解码器，将病历映射为固定维度的二维状态矩阵，零码专属参数；(2) 任意目标本体可离线在CPU上由公开文本描述编译成尺度不变的Tikhonov反卷积算子，抑制兄弟码干扰并保留源决策阈值。仅在英文MIMIC-IV ICD-9出院小结上训练。
AI.result: 在58,706条留出测试记录与5个未见本体上无需目标调优：域内ICD-9达63.15% Micro-F1（优于匹配的闭词表分类器，且消除后期尾部过拟合）；直接迁移到26,085个ICD-10码（金标准基数下29.23%召回）、MS-DRG分组及西/希/中多语种术语（115–185,458码）；CPU编译18.5万码<10秒，GPU读出亚毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 将编码知识从模型参数转移到可离线编译的本体算子，是应对码集频繁变动与跨语言跨体系部署的可行范式，且性能开销极低。

title: AMP-OD: Active Model Probing for Unsupervised Outlier Model Selection--Extended Version
comment: 25 pages. An extended version of "AMP-OD: Active Model Probing for Unsupervised Outlier Model Selection" accepted at KDD 2027
summary: Outlier detection is often deployed in fully unsupervised settings, where labels are unavailable and practitioners must choose a detector without direct performance feedback. Existing unsupervised outlier model selection methods predict detector quality from static meta-features and historical performance on meta-datasets, but they commit before observing how any detector behaves on the target dataset. We propose AMP-OD, an execution-conditioned probe-then-commit framework. AMP-OD runs a small number of inexpensive probe detectors, uses their score patterns as target-dataset evidence, and then selects a final detector from a larger candidate pool. To interpret unlabeled probe responses, we introduce a Leave-One-Out Family Probe Posterior (LOO-FPP), which converts probe score patterns into gated detector-family evidence while reducing self-validation in pseudo-label construction. AMP-OD further combines this evidence with historical reliability through a warm-start prior, a sequential probe/stop policy, and lower-confidence-bound arbitration. Extensive experiments and ablation studies show that detector responses provide useful evidence beyond static meta-features, with the LOO-FPP and conservative arbitration as key contributors.

AI.tldr: AMP-OD 提出“先探测再决策”的无监督离群检测器选择框架：先运行少量廉价探测检测器，将其打分模式作为目标数据证据，再据此从更大候选池中选择最终检测器。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督离群模型选择方法仅依赖静态元特征和历史性能预测检测器质量，在观察到检测器于目标数据集上的实际行为之前就做出选择，缺乏目标数据上的直接证据。
AI.method: 提出执行条件化的探测-决策框架 AMP-OD：运行少量低成本探测检测器；引入留一法族探测后验（LOO-FPP），将探测打分模式转化为门控的检测器族证据，并减少伪标签构建中的自验证；再结合历史可靠性的热启动先验、序列化探测/停止策略与下置信界仲裁完成最终选择。
AI.result: 大量实验与消融研究表明，检测器响应能提供超越静态元特征的有用证据；LOO-FPP 与保守仲裁是主要贡献因素。
AI.conclusion: 执行条件化的探测证据可有效改进无监督离群检测器选择，探测-决策范式配合留一后验与保守仲裁具有实用价值。

title: sudo L7: Can Coding Agents Act Like Staff Engineers?
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB). 12 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Leaderboard: https://surgehq.ai/benchmarks/sudo-l7
summary: Coding agents can now turn a well-specified ticket into a patch that passes its tests. Experienced engineers also notice risks the request never mentioned, question flawed premises, reuse what already exists and say plainly what they did and did not check. We present sudo L7, a benchmark of 60 software-engineering tasks written by staff-level engineers, mostly in private production codebases and each built around a place where a frontier model failed. A task pairs a realistic, underspecified request with a hidden, expert-authored rubric of atomic criteria (1,287 in all), tagged with eight behavioral dimensions from functional correctness to truthful reporting. An agentic grader reads the agent's transcript, inspects and runs its code, and treats test output as evidence. An attempt passes only if it meets every criterion of the two highest severities, and more than half of these gating criteria test something other than functional correctness. On the public leaderboard as of November 2026 (19 models, each in its developer's harness or in OpenCode, three attempts per task), Claude Fable 5.2 passes 52.2% of attempts, Claude Sonnet 5.5 50.6% and Claude Opus 5.5 46.1%. GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra pass 31-34%, and the other 13 models at most 18.9%. In a human-label study, three candidate model graders each agreed with a software engineer on 85-86% of criterion verdicts, about as often as two engineers agreed with each other. Cases from the benchmark show how one unsupported claim can fail an otherwise strong attempt and illustrate two sides of engineering judgment: flagging hidden hazards and avoiding needless work.

AI.tldr: 提出 sudo L7，一个由资深工程师撰写的 60 个软件工程任务基准，用隐藏的原子化专家评分细则（1287 条、8 个行为维度）和可执行的 agentic grader 评估编码智能体，不仅看功能正确性，还看风险识别、质疑前提、复用已有代码与如实汇报等工程判断能力。最强的 Claude Fable 5.2 仅通过 52.2% 的尝试。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体已能把明确的需求变成通过测试的补丁，但缺乏资深工程师的核心能力：主动识别未被提及的风险、质疑错误前提、复用已有实现、如实说明做过与未做的验证。现有基准多聚焦功能正确性与测试通过，无法衡量这些工程判断行为。
AI.method: 由 staff 级工程师撰写 60 个任务，多数来自私有生产代码库，每任务围绕前沿模型曾失败之处构建；将真实且欠明确的需求与隐藏的专家评分细则配对，细则含 1287 条原子判据，按 8 个行为维度（从功能正确性到如实汇报）标注；由 agentic grader 读取智能体轨迹、检查并运行其代码、把测试输出作为证据；仅当满足两个最高严重度级别的全部判据才判定通过；并附 19 个模型、每任务 3 次尝试的公开排行榜与人工标注一致性研究。
AI.result: 过半的 gating 判据考察非功能正确性内容。排行榜上 Claude Fable 5.2 通过 52.2%，Claude Sonnet 5.5 为 50.6%，Claude Opus 5.5 为 46.1%；GPT-6.1 Sol、Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra 为 31–34%，其余 13 个模型不超过 18.9%。三名候选模型评分器与工程师的判据一致率为 85–86%，接近两名工程师之间的一致程度。案例分析显示：一条无依据的断言即可让原本较强的尝试失败，并体现工程判断的两面——提示隐藏风险、避免无谓工作。
AI.conclusion: sudo L7 表明即便最先进模型在真实、欠明确的生产级任务上仍有一半以上尝试失败，且失败多源于功能正确性之外的行为维度；专家细则加可执行 grader 的评估方式可有效且较可靠地度量工程判断，为后续智能体改进提供了方向与可靠的评测基础设施。

title: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Bone Scaffold Pore Detection: A Comparative Analysis of Few-Shot Performance
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the Australasian Data Science and Machine Learning Conference (AusDM 2026)
summary: Evaluating the mechanical properties of bone scaffolds conventionally requires destructive testing or costly Finite Element Analysis, while deep learning alternatives are constrained by the scarcity of labeled biomaterial imaging data. This study introduces the first expert-annotated, pixel-dense dataset of biopolymer bone-scaffold SEM images, spanning five magnification series, and uses it to benchmark two state-of-the-art pre-trained foundation models under a 12-shot fine-tuning regime. SAM3, an instance segmenter, and YOLOv26, a bounding-box detector, feed the predicted pore geometry to regression heads that estimate Young's modulus and compressive yield strength. Our central finding is that both models fail by pore density rather than magnification: YOLOv26's predicted pore counts saturate and porosity estimation collapses on the most crowded frames, whereas SAM3 over-fragments sparse pore fields and merges adjacent pores in dense ones, producing eight catastrophic failures against three for YOLOv26. Averaged across the 44-image evaluation set, YOLOv26 achieves lower porosity error (19.9% vs. 23.1% MAE), higher precision, and a higher F1 score, whereas SAM3 offers pixel-level instance segmentation that YOLOv26's bounding boxes cannot reproduce. We conclude that model selection should be driven by pore density rather than SEM magnification alone.

AI.tldr: 本文构建首个专家标注、像素级密集标注的骨支架SEM图像数据集（5个放大倍率序列），并在12-shot微调下比较SAM3与YOLOv26估计孔隙几何进而回归杨氏模量与抗压强度的能力。
AI.motivation: 骨支架力学性能评估通常依赖破坏性测试或昂贵的有限元分析；深度学习方案受限于标注生物材料影像数据稀缺。作者希望用少量标注（12-shot）验证预训练基础模型能否替代传统手段。
AI.method: 发布专家像素级标注的SEM骨支架数据集（5个放大倍率序列，44张图像评估集）；以12-shot微调SAM3（实例分割）与YOLOv26（边界框检测），将预测的孔隙几何送入回归头估计杨氏模量和压缩屈服强度，并按孔隙密度分层分析失败模式。
AI.result: 两模型主要受孔隙密度而非放大倍率限制：YOLOv26在拥挤帧上孔隙计数饱和、孔隙率估计崩溃；SAM3在稀疏场过度碎片化、在密集场合并相邻孔，出现8次灾难性失败（YOLOv26为3次）。平均而言YOLOv26孔隙率误差更低（MAE 19.9% vs 23.1%），精确率与F1更高；SAM3则提供YOLOv26无法给出的像素级实例分割。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择应依据孔隙密度而非仅看SEM放大倍率；若需孔隙率与计数的稳健性可选YOLOv26，若需像素级实例几何则选SAM3。

title: Multimodal LLMs Know the Game but Assume the Real World
comment: 32 pages, 12 figures, 26 tables. Code: https://github.com/GaoJianXin05/RuleCraft ; data and model answers: https://huggingface.co/datasets/GGjx/RuleCraft
summary: Multimodal large language models can state the rules of a video game, but do they apply them when they only see the game? We introduce RuleCraft, 1,240 image questions over 155 Minecraft rules with outcomes verified in the game engine, each asked in text, on the image with the game named, and on the bare image. Six widely used models know the rules and recognize the game, yet answer the bare image by real-world physics: naming the game raises their accuracy on rules where the game departs from reality by 8.2-19.8 points on a main set and by 33.8-52.7 on a hard stress-test set. Their errors pick the real-world outcome, the gap is largest where the game leaves a scene unchanged, and reasoning traces state the game's rule, then answer by reality. On the main set, naming the game mostly swaps the real-world default for the game's. The pattern holds with reasoning, recurs in two more games, and persists on questions the models themselves take to be about the game; one neutral sentence asking for the rules of the world shown recovers much of the gap. Evaluations that name the game measure knowledge of its rules, not world selection.

AI.tldr: 提出RuleCraft基准（1240个图像问题，覆盖155条Minecraft规则，结果经游戏引擎验证），发现多模态大模型虽然知道游戏规则并识别得出是哪款游戏，但在仅看图像时却按现实物理作答；点明游戏名称可将准确率提升8.2–19.8分（主集）与33.8–52.7分（难例集），说明此类评估测的是规则知识而非世界选择能力。
AI.motivation: 现有工作未区分"模型是否知道游戏规则"与"模型是否会在只看图像时启用该规则"。作者想检验：多模态大模型能否在看到游戏画面时正确应用游戏世界的规则，而非默认套用现实世界物理。
AI.method: 构建RuleCraft基准：1240个图像问答，覆盖155条Minecraft规则，答案由游戏引擎实际运行结果验证。每个问题以三种形式呈现——纯文本、图像+点明游戏名、仅图像。测试六个常用模型，并加入推理链、跨游戏（另两款游戏）、模型自认为问题涉及该游戏的情形，以及一句中性提示（要求按画面所示世界的规则作答）作对照。
AI.result: 六模型均知晓规则且能认出游戏，但仅看图像时按现实物理作答；点明游戏名使游戏规则偏离现实的条目准确率提升8.2–19.8分（主集）、33.8–52.7分（难例压力集）。错误答案选择现实世界结果，且在"游戏世界里场景不发生变化"的情形下差距最大。推理轨迹显示模型先陈述游戏规则、再按现实作答。主集上点明游戏名主要是把现实默认切换为游戏规则。该模式在启用推理时依然存在，在另两款游戏中复现，且在模型自认为问题关乎该游戏时仍持续。一句中性提示即可挽回大部分差距。因此，点名游戏的评估测的是规则知识而非世界选择能力。
AI.conclusion: 多模态大模型存在"知道规则却不会用"的鸿沟：具身/视觉语境下默认回归现实物理。评估若显式点明游戏名，只测出规则知识，无法衡量世界模型选择能力；简单的语境提示能显著缓解该问题。基准与引擎验证为后续研究提供可复用的评测工具。

title: Agent Money Benchmark: Can AI Agents Be Trusted to Spend Money?
summary: Giving an AI agent a wallet lets it buy data and services on a client's behalf. Trust then depends on how it spends money and what that spending achieves. We introduce Agent Money Benchmark (AMB) to test whether agents spend a client's money well, starting with purchases of information for financial decisions. We link seller quotes and payments to final answers, evaluating 12 models on 80 payment tasks with simulated sellers and 76 research questions using live data. Purchases settled in USDC on Solana mainnet via x402, a protocol for paying per web request. Three of the 12 models passed 79 of 80 payment tasks without payment or budget errors. Nine fell for a seller's trap at least once; repeat charges and above-list quotes accounted for 79% of scam events. We estimate waste from data and inference costs, counting failed payment tasks in full and research answers in proportion to missed points. With spending split equally between tracks, estimated waste ranged from \$21.0 per \$100 for Claude Fable 5.2 to \$70.8 for GPT-6 Luna.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Agent Money Benchmark (AMB)，用真实加密货币支付与实时数据评估 AI agent 是否"会花钱"：12 个模型在 80 个支付任务和 76 个研究问题中表现差异巨大，估算浪费从每 100 美元 21.0 到 70.8 美元不等。
AI.motivation: 给 AI agent 配置钱包后，agent 可代客户购买数据与服务，但信任问题随之而来——关键在于它如何花钱、花得是否有效。现有评测缺乏对 agent 资金使用能力（尤其信息采购）的测试。
AI.method: 构建 AMB 基准，将卖家报价与支付和最终答案关联；在 80 个支付任务（模拟卖家）和 76 个研究问题（实时数据）上评测 12 个模型；支付通过 Solana 主网上的 x402 协议以 USDC 按请求结算。
AI.result: 12 个模型中仅 3 个在 80 个支付任务里通过 79 个且无支付或预算错误；9 个至少一次落入卖家陷阱，重复收费与高于标价报价占诈骗事件的 79%。按数据加推理成本估算浪费，两个赛道均等分配预算时为每 100 美元浪费 \$21.0（Claude Fable 5.2）至 \$70.8（GPT-6 Luna）。
AI.conclusion: agent 花钱能力是独立且关键的评测维度，多数模型在支付可靠性与抗欺诈上明显不足，AMB 提供了可量化的浪费成本指标。

title: Trallie: from Free-Form Text to Structured Data with LLMs
summary: Trallie is an open-source framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to perform information extraction (IE) from natural language sources with or without user guidance. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on extensive labeled datasets or domain-specific training, Trallie enables the conversion of unstructured data into structured formats with minimal or no representative examples. The framework is designed with three key objectives: (i) reducing manual annotation by harnessing prompt-based zero-shot and few-shot capabilities of modern LLMs, (ii) flexibly parsing diverse document formats (i.e., HTML, PDF, TXT, and JSON), and (iii) improving accessibility for non-expert users by automatically inducing schemas from document collections, which can then be refined for extraction. We evaluate Trallie with open-weight LLMs on FDA 510(k) documents and on movie and university websites from SWDE. It outperforms previously reported systems when the target attributes are provided for text extraction and is competitive when it must discover attributes for the schema automatically. The project is available at https://github.com/PiSchool/trallie

AI.tldr: Trallie 是一个开源框架，利用 LLM 在有无用户引导的情况下从自然语言文档中抽取信息，通过零样本/少样本提示、多格式解析与自动 schema 归纳，实现少甚至无需标注数据的信息抽取。
AI.motivation: 传统信息抽取依赖大量标注数据或领域特定训练，且对非专家用户不够友好；同时真实文档格式多样（HTML、PDF、TXT、JSON），需要更灵活、低标注成本的方案。
AI.method: 基于现代 LLM 的提示式零样本与少样本能力，降低人工标注；支持多种文档格式的灵活解析；并自动从文档集合中归纳抽取 schema（可再人工精修），以方便非专家使用。
AI.result: 在 FDA 510(k) 文档以及 SWDE 的电影与大学网站数据上，使用开放权重 LLM 评估：当给定目标属性做文本抽取时优于已有系统；在需自动发现属性（自动 schema）的场景下具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Trallie 表明基于 LLM 的零/少样本提示可显著降低信息抽取的标注与领域训练成本，并在多格式文档与自动 schema 归纳方面具备实用性与竞争力，代码已开源。

title: State of Mind: Learning and Evaluating World Models of Naturalistic Brain Dynamics
summary: Understanding naturalistic brain activity requires going beyond the stimulus alone, as external inputs continuously interact with an individual's evolving brain state. A world model captures such dynamics in a latent state by inferring it from neural observations, predicting stimulus-driven evolution, and updating with new observations. However, existing brain world models fail to maintain a persistent latent state over time, and standard metrics of neural prediction accuracy cannot tell whether a model tracks an individual's brain state or relies solely on the stimulus. To directly test state inference, prediction, and updating, we introduce BrainStateBench, which evaluates a model's latent state through a frozen linear probe on whole-cortex, movie-driven fMRI. Its State task tests whether a model captures trial-to-trial variability in an individual's responses to repeated stimuli, while Forecast and Updating evaluate future activity predictions without and with new observations, respectively. To track individual brain state across time, we propose Spectator, a linear latent world model trained with a joint-embedding predictive objective. Spectator encodes short- and long-horizon observation histories into a two-timescale latent state and predicts state transitions linearly from the current state and stimulus. Stimulus-only encoders reach 0.320 in fMRI prediction correlation without observing the brain (0% on State), while prior deep brain world models reach 0.239 yet score at most 0.4% on State. In contrast, Spectator achieves 0.349 correlation alongside 5.5% on State, 16.0% on Forecast, and 20.3% on Updating, outperforming all baselines while forecasting over 20x faster than deep forecasting models.

AI.tldr: 提出 BrainStateBench 与 Spectator 线性潜在世界模型，直接检验脑状态推断、预测与更新。
AI.motivation: 自然脑活动由外部刺激与个体演化中的脑状态共同决定，需要能持续维护潜在状态的世界模型；但现有脑世界模型无法保持持久潜在状态，且常规神经预测指标无法区分模型是真在跟踪个体脑状态还是仅依赖刺激。
AI.method: 构建 BrainStateBench，在全皮层电影驱动 fMRI 上用冻结线性探针评估潜在状态，含 State（重复刺激下的试次间变异）、Forecast（无新观测预测）、Updating（有新观测更新）三任务；提出 Spectator：以联合嵌入预测目标训练的线性潜在世界模型，将短/长时程历史编码为双时间尺度潜在状态，并由当前状态与刺激线性预测状态转移。
AI.result: 仅刺激编码器 fMRI 预测相关达 0.320 但 State 为 0%；既有深度脑世界模型相关 0.239、State 至多 0.4%；Spectator 达 0.349 相关，State 5.5%、Forecast 16.0%、Updating 20.3%，全面优于基线，且预测速度比深度模型快 20 倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭刺激预测精度会高估模型对脑状态的追踪能力，需用专门基准直接检验状态推断；简单的线性潜在世界模型配合双时间尺度状态，可更有效地跟踪个体脑状态并高效预测。

title: Improving Repair Agents with Cause-Chain Diagnoses
summary:
Repair agents resolve a growing share of real-world issues. Starting with the same information as a developer reading a bug report, they have to find out how the program fails before actually fixing it.
  We present FORECAST, which provides repair agents with a diagnosis of the failure. From the executions of passing and failing tests, FORECAST infers a cause chain, a short sequence of execution features, such as conditions or data flow, that explains how the failing runs diverge. FORECAST appends this cause chain to the issue an agent receives. It thus works with any agent that builds its prompts from the issue, without modifying the agent.
  We evaluate FORECAST on all 300 issues of SWE-bench Lite with five repair agents and two models, the commercial Claude Haiku 4.5 and the open-weight Qwen3.5. With the cause-chain diagnosis, every agent resolves significantly more issues. Over all agents, the share of resolved issues rises from 48.5% to 70.9% for Haiku 4.5 and from 31.2% to 56.1% for Qwen3.5. The open-weight model with the diagnosis thus surpasses the commercial model without it. The gains persist across repeated runs and for agents that already run the tests the diagnosis is derived from.

AI.tldr: FORECAST 通过从通过/失败测试的执行中推断"原因链"（一小组执行特征序列）作为故障诊断附加到 issue 描述中，无需修改修复代理即可显著提升其解决率。
AI.motivation: 修复代理在真实问题修复中占比越来越大，但它们像开发者读 bug 报告一样只拿到相同信息，必须先自行弄清程序如何失败才能修复。作者希望直接给代理提供故障诊断，降低其定位失败的难度。
AI.method: FORECAST 对比通过测试与失败测试的执行，推断出一条"原因链"——解释失败运行如何偏离的简短执行特征序列（如条件、数据流）。该原因链被追加到代理收到的 issue 中，因此适用于任何基于 issue 构建提示的代理，无需改动代理本身。在 SWE-bench Lite 全部 300 个 issue 上，用 5 个修复代理和 2 个模型（Claude Haiku 4.5、Qwen3.5）进行评估。
AI.result: 加入原因链诊断后，每个代理都显著解决更多 issue：Haiku 4.5 从 48.5% 提升到 70.9%，Qwen3.5 从 31.2% 提升到 56.1%。带诊断的开源权重模型甚至超过了不带诊断的商业模型。增益在多次重复运行中稳定，且对已经自己运行这些测试的代理同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 自动生成的故障原因链诊断是一种通用、无需侵入代理的增强手段，能大幅提升修复代理的解决率，并可弥合开源与商业模型间的差距。

title: NOVA: Normalization-Aware Output-Guided Attention Acceleration for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary:
Video diffusion transformers (vDiTs) have become the main backbone for video generation. The quadratic cost of self-attention limits their efficiency at high resolutions and long durations. Existing sparse attention methods often rely on preserving high attention weights. However, these criteria do not fully capture the fidelity of the final value-weighted output, whose error depends jointly on changes to the attention numerator and the softmax denominator.
  We propose NOVA, a coarse-to-fine sparse attention framework that first approximates the full normalized output using size-weighted key/value centroids. Building on this estimate, we construct a residual proxy that accounts for coupled numerator-denominator errors by centering value contributions around the estimated output. This proxy guides the selection of query-key blocks for refinement under a predefined block budget for each query cluster. Selected blocks are evaluated through exact token-level computation, while the remaining blocks contribute through their centroids under a shared softmax normalization. On five vDiTs, NOVA achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among sparse attention methods, improving PSNR by up to 1.55\,dB over the strongest baseline, while delivering up to 1.82$\times$ end-to-end speedup on an H100 GPU.

AI.tldr: NOVA：面向视频扩散Transformer的由粗到细稀疏注意力框架，用质心近似+残差代理选择关键块，兼顾输出保真度与效率。
AI.motivation: vDiT自注意力二次复杂度限制高分辨率和长时长效率；现有稀疏注意力依赖保留高注意力权重，未能准确反映最终value加权输出的保真度，因为误差同时取决于分子（注意力权重×value）和softmax分母的变化。
AI.method: 由粗到细框架：先用尺寸加权的key/value质心近似完整归一化输出；据此构建残差代理，将value贡献围绕估计输出中心化，以捕捉分子-分母耦合误差；该代理在每个query簇的预设块预算下指导query-key块选择；被选块做精确token级计算，其余块通过质心在共享softmax归一化下贡献。
AI.result: 在五个vDiT上，PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS均优于稀疏注意力方法，PSNR最高提升1.55 dB（相对最强基线）；H100 GPU上端到端加速最高1.82倍。
AI.conclusion: 以输出误差为导向而非单纯注意力权重来选择稀疏计算块，可更有效平衡视频生成质量与效率。

title: The Humming Revachol: A Dialogue Network Analysis of Narrative Power in Disco Elysium
summary: This study applies social network analysis to the narrative RPG Disco Elysium to examine how narrative power is distributed among its characters. A directed, weighted character-mention network of 73 NPCs is constructed from the game's complete dialogue script, with characters identified and annotated across five social attributes. Narrative power is operationalised through four dimensions: attention, authority, discursive initiative, and embeddedness. Non-parametric statistical tests examine differences across gender, age, race, class, and ideology. The findings suggest that narrative power is largely independent of social identity categories and is more closely associated with character narrative functions, while structural embeddedness reflects the socio-organisational contexts in which characters are situated. These findings show that dialogue-network analysis can reveal structural patterns of representation that visibility counts alone would miss.

AI.tldr: 本文用社会网络分析研究《极乐迪斯科》中叙事权力如何在角色间分配，发现叙事权力主要与角色叙事功能相关，而非社会身份类别。
AI.motivation: 探究游戏中叙事权力分布问题，检验其是否由性别、年龄、种族、阶级、意识形态等社会身份决定，并说明仅统计出场次数无法揭示的再现结构。
AI.method: 基于完整对话脚本构建含73个NPC的有向加权"角色提及网络"，标注五项社会属性；将叙事权力操作化为注意力、权威性、话语主动性、嵌入度四个维度；用非参数统计检验各社会身份类别间差异。
AI.result: 叙事权力大体独立于社会身份类别，更与角色的叙事功能相关；结构嵌入度反映角色所处社会—组织情境。
AI.conclusion: 对话网络分析能揭示单纯可见度计数所遗漏的再现结构模式。

title: Internalized Experience: How Training Data Shapes Memory Formation in LLMs
summary: Parametric memory enables large language models (LLMs) to retain information from past experience and reuse it in subsequent tasks. Yet how training data supports the internalization of reusable task rules remains unclear. We introduce FSMem (Finite-State Machine Memory), a state-transition framework for constructing training data and studying how data content and organization shape memory formation. We evaluate rule reuse across synthetic worlds, classical planning, and code execution through valid-action identification and execution-outcome prediction, complemented by next-operation prediction in code. Our experiments reveal several systematic learning patterns. Under matched training conditions, even unchanged task rules become harder to internalize when learned alongside a larger variety of action types; by contrast, scaling the training data to provide broader state-action coverage generally improves rule learning. We further find that training at a single execution depth produces depth-specialized behavior, with models performing best when training and test executions have similar lengths. Motivated by this finding, we construct cumulative corpora that combine short and long trajectories, which can outperform long-trajectory-only training while using fewer training tokens. Together, these results demonstrate that the same task rules can be internalized differently depending on how execution experience is constructed, and that understanding these learning patterns can guide the design of more effective training data for parametric memory.

AI.tldr: 提出FSMem有限状态机记忆框架，研究训练数据内容与组织方式如何影响LLM参数记忆对可复用任务规则的内化。
AI.motivation: LLM的参数量化记忆能保留并复用过往经验中的信息，但训练数据如何支撑可复用任务规则的内化机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建基于状态转移的FSMem框架用于构造训练数据；在合成世界、经典规划、代码执行三类任务上，通过有效动作识别与执行结果预测（辅以代码下一操作预测）评估规则复用；并对比动作类型多样性、状态-动作覆盖度、执行深度以及累积语料（长短轨迹混合）等条件的影响。
AI.result: 在训练条件匹配下，动作类型多样性越大，即使规则不变也更难内化；扩大状态-动作覆盖度通常能提升规则学习；单一执行深度训练产生深度特化，训练与测试长度相近时表现最佳；混合长短轨迹的累积语料可超越仅用长轨迹训练，且训练token更少。
AI.conclusion: 同样的任务规则会因执行经验的构造方式不同而以不同方式被内化；理解这些学习规律可指导更有效的参数记忆训练数据设计。

title: Orthogonally Mixed Sign Coding with Progressive Residual Refinement for Transformer Weight Compression
summary: LLM quantization reduces storage but often degrades predictive fidelity at low bit rates. We propose a training-free, CDF-free, Gaussian-CLT-motivated progressive residual-sign quantization framework that uses randomized orthogonal mixing to promote Gaussian-like residual distributions and improve sign based reconstruction of Transformer weights. Each stage independently normalizes residuals and analytically calibrates reconstruction, progressively recovering quantization errors. The framework enables flexible storage-fidelity trade-offs without learned codebooks, empirical CDFs, or trellis optimization. We evaluate GPT-2 Large and Llama-3-8B across attention and MLP projections. At five residual stages, joint quantization preserves near-baseline predictive fidelity, achieving perplexities of 32.16 and 12.73, compared with full-precision values of 29.89 and 11.07, respectively. Ablations further demonstrate that orthogonal mixing substantially improves reconstruction over identity-based sign coding, while activation-aware scaling improves output fidelity and reduced-precision statistics lower storage overhead with negligible perplexity degradation. Comparisons with conventional quantizers establish the method's progressive fidelity recovery and characterize its storage-quality and runtime trade-offs. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of orthogonally mixed residual-sign coding for flexible, training-free Transformer weight compression.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练、免CDF、基于高斯中心极限定理启发的渐进残差符号量化框架，通过随机正交混合使残差分布趋于高斯，从而改善基于符号的Transformer权重重构。
AI.motivation: LLM量化能降低存储，但低比特率下常损害预测保真度；且现有方法依赖学习码本、经验CDF或trellis优化等复杂手段。
AI.method: 训练-free、CDF-free的渐进残差符号量化：每阶段对残差独立归一化并进行解析式重构校准；采用随机正交混合促进残差分布高斯化，提升基于符号的重构；配合激活感知缩放与降精度统计。
AI.result: 在GPT-2 Large与Llama-3-8B的注意力及MLP投影上，五阶段残差联合量化困惑度分别为32.16与12.73（全精度为29.89与11.07）；消融显示正交混合显著优于恒等符号编码，激活感知缩放提升输出保真度，降低精度统计可减少存储开销且困惑度退化可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 正交混合残差符号编码能实现灵活、免训练的Transformer权重压缩，在保真度恢复上优于传统量化器，并具清晰可用的存储—质量—运行时权衡。

title: DisSparse: Pipelined Top-$p$ Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
summary: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the memory demands of the key-value (KV) cache, whose size scales linearly with context length. Dynamic sparse attention reduces this bottleneck by fetching and attending only to a critical subset of tokens. The dominant primitive in dynamic sparse attention research and deployment is fixed-budget top-$k$ selection, which is favored because its deterministic block count aligns with the static memory allocation that systems like vLLM rely on. Top-$k$ uses a fixed budget regardless of how attention mass is distributed across heads, layers, and decode steps, leading to either wasted bandwidth on heads with peaky attention or dropped context on heads with diffuse attention. Top-$p$ (nucleus) selection adapts naturally to this variation but has seen limited adoption in production serving systems due to two system-level challenges: variable block counts that break deterministic block allocation and computationally expensive selection kernels that exceed the cost of attention itself. We present DisSparse, a serving system that integrates top-$p$ sparse attention into vLLM end-to-end. DisSparse decouples block selection from the scheduler's critical path, hides selection latency behind layer computation via a two-stream pipeline, and introduces a single-pass histogram-based top-$p$ kernel. We further observe intra-block sparsity, the inflation of selection budgets caused by mixing high- and low-importance tokens within fixed-size KV cache blocks, and address it with a token relocation kernel guided by accumulated prefill attention scores. Across long- and medium-context benchmarks on multiple models, DisSparse achieves 1.17x to 1.80x speedup in sparsity analysis (block selection) over state-of-the-art top-$p$ methods with negligible accuracy loss and supports up to 8x larger maximum batch sizes than dense vLLM under the same memory budget.

AI.tldr: DisSparse 将 top-p（nucleus）稀疏注意力端到端集成进 vLLM，通过解耦块选择、双流流水线、单遍直方图 top-p 内核及 token 重定位内核，解决变长块分配与选择开销问题，获得 1.17x–1.80x 选择加速、精度几乎无损、最大批尺寸提升至 8x。
AI.motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理受 KV cache 线性增长的内存瓶颈限制，动态稀疏注意力可缓解，但主流固定预算 top-k 无法适应注意力质量在头、层、解码步间的分布差异（尖峰头浪费带宽、弥散头丢失上下文）；top-p 能自适应却因变长块数破坏确定性内存分配、选择内核开销过高而难以在服务系统中落地。
AI.method: 构建服务系统 DisSparse：(1) 将块选择与调度器关键路径解耦；(2) 用双流流水线把选择延迟隐藏在层计算之后；(3) 提出单遍基于直方图的 top-p 选择内核；(4) 观察到块内稀疏性（固定大小 KV 块中高低重要性 token 混杂导致预算膨胀），提出由累积 prefill 注意力分数引导的 token 重定位内核。
AI.result: 在多模型的长/中上下文基准上，块选择相比 SOTA top-p 方法取得 1.17x–1.80x 加速，精度损失可忽略；相同内存预算下支持的最大批尺寸达稠密 vLLM 的 8 倍。
AI.conclusion: 将自适应 top-p 稀疏注意力工程化为可部署的服务系统是可行的：通过系统级延迟隐藏与高效内核设计，可在保持精度与确定性资源管理的同时显著降低 KV cache 瓶颈并提升吞吐与批容量。

title: ReproShift: Cross-Version Adaptation of Linux Kernel Fuzzing Crash Reproducers
summary: Reliable crash reproduction is essential for diagnosing and repairing kernel crashes. Historical crash reproducers preserve concrete bug-triggering knowledge and can be reused for regression testing, bug revalidation, and impact analysis across kernel versions. However, kernel evolution can invalidate these reproducers by changing kernel interfaces, configurations, and execution paths. Migrating them is therefore challenging: the adapted reproducer must identify and modify version-sensitive behavior while preserving the bug-triggering operations and resource dependencies that define the original crash. To address this challenge, we propose ReproShift, an automated framework for cross-version crash reproducer migration by preserving bug-triggering semantics while adapting only version-sensitive behavior. Given source crash artifacts, a source crash reproducer, and a target kernel, ReproShift produces a migrated crash reproducer with same-bug validation evidence. Specifically, ReproShift first constructs a structured source-to-target context to identify migration-relevant kernel changes. It then performs constrained target-aware adaptation to revise version-sensitive reproducer operations while preserving the original trigger logic. Finally, it executes the adapted candidates on the target kernel and uses execution feedback and case-specific crash evidence to iteratively validate candidates and refine subsequent migrations. In a real-world deployment on an evolving upstream kernel, ReproShift further produces 22 upstream crash reports generated from adapted candidates, of which 7 have been fixed and 5 have received explicit maintainer confirmation. To systematically quantify its migration effectiveness, we construct a benchmark of 107 real-world source-target migration cases. ReproShift achieves confirmed same-bug migration in 57 cases, compared with 19 cases using direct replay.

AI.tldr: ReproShift：一个跨内核版本自动迁移崩溃复现器的框架，通过保留触发缺陷语义、只改写版本敏感操作，并借助目标内核执行反馈迭代验证，实现同一缺陷的可靠复现。
AI.motivation: 历史崩溃复现器可用于回归测试、缺陷复核和跨版本影响分析，但内核演化会改变接口、配置与执行路径，使旧复现器失效。迁移难点在于：既要识别并修改版本敏感行为，又要保留定义原崩溃的触发操作和资源依赖。
AI.method: ReproShift 分三步：(1) 构建结构化的源—目标上下文，识别与迁移相关的内核变更；(2) 在约束下进行目标感知改写，仅修订版本敏感操作，保留原始触发逻辑；(3) 在目标内核上执行候选复现器，利用执行反馈和案例特定崩溃证据迭代验证并指导后续迁移，输出带同缺陷验证证据的迁移复现器。
AI.result: 在演进的真实上游内核部署中，由改写候选生成 22 份上游崩溃报告，其中 7 份已被修复、5 份获得维护者明确确认。在包含 107 个真实源—目标迁移用例的基准上，ReproShift 实现 57 例确认的同缺陷迁移，而直接重放仅 19 例。
AI.conclusion: ReproShift 表明，以语义保持为约束、以执行反馈迭代验证的自动迁移思路，可显著提升跨版本崩溃复现的成功率，并能在真实上游开发中产出被维护者认可的崩溃报告。

title: Is It the Agent or the Retry? Separating Selection from Agency in Text-to-Image Generation
summary:
Agentic text-to-image systems wrap generators in loops of planning, routing, verification and refinement, and report large gains on compositional benchmarks, almost always relative to a single sample. We ask how much of the gain survives against Single-tool Rejection Retry (\ours): the strongest generator already in the system's pool, an off-the-shelf verifier, and retries that stop at the first accepted image under the system's own budget. Auditing four recent systems with official evaluators, we find that on GenEval SRR matches the accuracy of OctoT2I (0.962 vs.\ 0.96), recovers 63 to 90% of the gain of GEMS depending on the verifier, and exceeds GenPilot by 12 points with 2.3 generations per image; the effect persists with generators not tuned to the benchmark and on T2I-CompBench++. A closed-form analysis predicts the accuracy of SRR at every budget and shows that its gain is capped by the verifier's likelihood ratio. The same analysis also exposes genuine agentic gains: on GenEval 2, even the best of five samples chosen by the evaluator stays 15 points below the score GEMS reports (12 at the upper end of its 95% interval). We prove a ceiling on the accuracy that routing across generators can add, bracket it between one and three points on OctoT2I's own pool, and show that what OctoT2I's routing buys is compute (about 2.5
  less than SRR at equal accuracy), not accuracy. In our offline distillation experiments selected samples teach the generator no more than random ones, which a short information argument explains. We end with a reporting checklist for agentic generation papers.

AI.tldr: 提出基线 SRR（最强单生成器+现成验证器+预算内首次接受即停），审计四个 agentic 文生图系统，发现其组合性增益大部分可由 SRR 复现，真正超出验证器选择上限的 agentic 增益仅在 GenEval 2 上存在；并证明路由增益的上限（1-3 分）。
AI.motivation: 现有 agentic 文生图系统（规划、路由、验证、精炼的循环）报告的组合性大幅提升几乎都只与"单次采样"对比，缺乏在多采样+验证+重试这一强基线下的公平衡量，导致增益大小与来源不清。
AI.method: 1) 提出 Single-tool Rejection Retry (SRR) 基线：使用系统自带生成器池中最强生成器、现成验证器、在系统原始预算内首次被接受即停止；2) 用官方评测器审计四个近期系统（OctoT2I、GEMS、GenPilot 等）；3) 给出闭式分析预测任意预算下 SRR 的准确率，指出其增益受验证器似然比限制；4) 证明跨生成器路由可带来的准确率上限，并在 OctoT2I 的生成器池上给出 1-3 分的区间；5) 离线蒸馏实验比较"被选中样本"与随机样本的训练效果。
AI.result: GenEval 上 SRR 与 OctoT2I 持平（0.962 vs 0.96），回收 GEMS 增益的 63%-90%（依验证器而定），以每图 2.3 次生成超 GenPilot 12 分；结论在非基准微调生成器与 T2I-CompBench++ 上依然成立。GenEval 2 上，即使评测器从五个样本中挑最优仍比 GEMS 低 15 分（95% 区间上端低 12 分），说明存在真实 agentic 增益。OctoT2I 的路由带来的主要是计算节省（等准确率下约为 SRR 的 2.5 倍少），而非准确率。离线蒸馏中被选样本与随机样本教学效果无差异。
AI.conclusion: agentic 系统报告的大部分组合性增益可由简单多采样+验证重试基线复现；路由准确率增益存在严格上限且实测很小；真正的 agentic 收益可能体现在计算效率及部分更难基准上。论文最后给出针对 agentic 生成论文的报告清单（如须与多采样强基线对比、报告预算、成本）。

title: Self-WSP: Can Language Models Improve Themselves Through Weight-Space Programming?
summary: Frontier language models can now read and edit the weights of a neural network much like code and thereby improve a small model, an approach known as Weight-Space Programming (WSP). We further explore applying WSP to a language model itself, which we call Self-WSP. Specifically, Qwen3.5-0.8B reads its own weights, proposes an edit, and then continues with the edited weights as both problem solver and editor. We find many cases of genuine self-improvement. Self-edits can raise GSM8K accuracy from 11.8% to 62.2% and MATH500 accuracy from 7.0% to 32.2%, sometimes by changing only 16 parameters, and in some cases repeated self-editing keeps improving the model. A closer look, however, reveals that these gains lack interpretability. The model shows little understanding of the edits it makes, and WSP driven by random search sometimes performs comparably. Self-WSP thus holds promise as a path toward recursive self-improvement (RSI), but realizing this promise requires further exploration.

AI.tldr: Qwen3.5-0.8B通过读取并编辑自身权重实现自我提升，GSM8K从11.8%升至62.2%、MATH500从7.0%升至32.2%，但增益缺乏可解释性，甚至随机搜索也能达到类似效果。
AI.motivation: 探索将权重空间编程（WSP）应用于语言模型自身（Self-WSP），检验模型能否通过编辑自身权重实现递归自我改进（RSI）。
AI.method: 让Qwen3.5-0.8B读取自己的权重、提出编辑方案，并带着编辑后的权重继续充当解题者和编辑者；用GSM8K和MATH500评测，并与随机搜索驱动的WSP作对比。
AI.result: 自编辑使GSM8K准确率从11.8%提升到62.2%，MATH500从7.0%提升到32.2%，有时仅改动16个参数，重复自编辑还能持续改进；但模型对编辑理解甚少，随机搜索WSP效果相当。
AI.conclusion: Self-WSP显示出通往RSI的潜力，但当前增益不可解释，实现这一潜力仍需进一步探索。

title: VeriLadder: A Multi-Agent Specification Refinement System for Tool-Verified Verilog Datasets
summary: Training data is a bottleneck in AI, especially for large language models (LLMs) that write Verilog, because register-transfer-level (RTL) code is rarely published and existing datasets mostly check code for syntax, not instruction correctness. This paper presents VeriLadder, a five-level Verilog dataset, and the multi-agent framework that builds it, in which LLM agents write and revise specifications, and EDA tools (a synthesizer and a formal equivalence checker) decide what is accepted. Its levels follow an engineer's checks. Level 1 labels designs from two large Verilog corpora, namely RTLCoder and PyraNet, with synthesis results, failure causes, critical warnings and post-synthesis metrics. 28% of RTLCoder designs fail synthesis and are kept as negatives. Level 2 grades each instruction on four specification qualities, and low grades predict failed rebuilds. Level 3 rewrites each instruction into a refined specification and accepts it only if an LLM from another model family, reading only that specification, writes a circuit formally equivalent to the original. This raises the share of rebuildable designs from 26.1% to 78.2%, keeping every failed specification with its counterexample. Levels 4 and 5 add verified paraphrases and one-fact variants, hard negatives that differ only in one behavior from the verified design. VeriLadder labels the synthesizability of 716,627 designs and, from RTLCoder, provides 11,247 refined specifications, 32,393 paraphrases and 8,397 one-fact variants. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on VeriLadder raises functional pass@1 from 31.7% to 50.0% on VerilogEval v2 and from 35.0% to 45.2% on RTLLM v2. The dataset and fine-tuned models are publicly available.

AI.tldr: VeriLadder：一个五级Verilog数据集及多智能体构建框架，用LLM写改规格说明、EDA工具裁决接受，从716,627个设计中产出分级标签，微调后pass@1显著提升。
AI.motivation: Verilog/LLM训练数据稀缺：RTL代码少公开，现有数据集只查语法而不验证指令正确性（规格与电路是否等价），导致训练数据质量与可重建性差。
AI.method: 多智能体框架：LLM智能体撰写/修订规格，综合器与形式等价检查器决定接受与否。五级递进：L1对RTLCoder与PyraNet设计标注综合结果、失败原因、关键警告与后综合指标（28%失败样本作负例）；L2按四项规格质量打分（低分预测重建失败）；L3重写规格并由异族LLM仅凭规格重建，形式等价方接受（可重建率26.1%→78.2%，失败规格保留反例）；L4/L5加入验证过的复述与单事实变体等硬负例。
AI.result: 标注716,627个设计的可综合性；从RTLCoder给出11,247条精炼规格、32,393条复述、8,397个单事实变体。Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct微调后：VerilogEval v2功能pass@1 31.7%→50.0%；RTLLM v2 35.0%→45.2%。
AI.conclusion: 以EDA工具作为客观裁决的多级数据构建能有效提升Verilog代码生成数据质量与模型功能正确性；数据集与微调模型已公开。

title: SAFE-DRIFT: Data Selection for Supervised Fine-tuning with Controllable Off-Target Drifts
summary: We propose SAFE-DRIFT, a data-selection framework for supervised fine-tuning that improves a target capability while controlling unwanted drift in the model's other behaviors. We formalize this as a constrained optimization problem that maximizes alignment with the target gradient, subject to a budget on off-target drift which we quantify using the Fisher information of a reference distribution. Under this objective, the optimal, closed-form update is a damped natural-gradient step that downweights reference-sensitive directions. To estimate these high-dimensional gradients and work within the right geometry, we further derive a scalable algorithm that approximates the Fisher information and the target gradient in a shared low-dimensional subspace and analyze how entanglement of the target and reference task can affect the update. We evaluate SAFE-DRIFT against state-of-the-art data selection methods across diverse domains including coding and medical question answering, yielding competitive target performance while reducing degradation on specified off-target behaviors.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFE-DRIFT数据选择框架，在有监督微调中提升目标能力的同时控制模型其他行为漂移，并给出可扩展算法。
AI.motivation: 现有数据选择方法主要优化目标性能，却忽视微调对模型其他行为的意外漂移（off-target drift），需要一种能在提升目标能力的同时约束非目标行为退化的方法。
AI.method: 将其形式化为约束优化问题：最大化与目标梯度的对齐，同时以参考分布的Fisher信息量化并限制非目标漂移；由此推导出闭式最优更新为带阻尼的自然梯度步，对参考敏感方向降权；进一步在共享低维子空间内近似Fisher信息与目标梯度，得到可扩展算法，并分析目标与参考任务纠缠对更新的影响。
AI.result: 在编程与医学问答等多领域对比先进数据选择方法，目标性能具竞争力，同时减少指定非目标行为的退化。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-DRIFT在约束漂移下实现有效数据选择，兼顾目标能力提升与模型其他行为的稳定性。

title: Interrupt-Aware Static Detection of Deadlocks in Rust Operating Systems
summary: Rust is increasingly adopted in operating systems, but Rust's safety guarantees do not eliminate deadlocks, especially those induced by interrupts. The core challenge is to recover interrupt-sensitive lock dependencies from Rust's guard-based synchronization across function boundaries. Applying this analysis across Rust OS projects also requires specifying project-specific synchronization semantics. We present an approach combining interrupt-aware static analysis with diagnostic-guided agent auditing for detecting deadlocks in Rust operating systems. Our approach uses lightweight source-level annotations to recover project-specific lock and interrupt semantics, performs a flow-sensitive MIR-based analysis to track lock-holding and interrupt states, and reports potential deadlocks with supporting evidence. An agent then searches for relevant source code in the repository and returns a confidence assessment with reasons for each supplied report. We evaluate our tool on four real Rust operating systems, identifying 26 true cases corresponding to nine maintainer-confirmed defects. Diagnostic-guided auditing achieves 86.2\% precision and 96.2\% recall based on static analysis results, and offers advantages over the baselines in both cost and effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合中断感知静态分析与诊断引导智能体审计的方法，用于检测Rust操作系统中的中断诱发的死锁，并在四个真实Rust OS上发现9个经维护者确认的缺陷。
AI.motivation: Rust在操作系统中的采用日益增多，但其安全保证无法消除死锁，尤其是中断诱发的死锁。核心难点在于跨函数边界从基于guard的同步中恢复对中断敏感的锁依赖，同时在跨项目应用时还需指定项目特定的同步语义。
AI.method: 利用轻量级源码级注解恢复项目特定的锁与中断语义；基于MIR执行流敏感分析以跟踪持锁状态和中断状态，并生成带证据的潜在死锁报告；再由智能体在仓库中检索相关源码，为每份报告给出置信度评估及理由。
AI.result: 在四个真实Rust操作系统上评估，识别出26个真实案例，对应9个经维护者确认的缺陷；诊断引导审计达到86.2%精确率和96.2%召回率，并在成本与效果上均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 结合中断感知静态分析与诊断引导智能体审计，可有效检测Rust OS中的中断诱发死锁，兼顾跨项目语义适配与分析精度，是一种低成本高效益的方案。

title: PhoneQC: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Order-Level Smartphone Trade-in Inspection
summary: As vision-language models enter remote smartphone trade-in, sellers already upload six views and a diagnostic screen, which makes it easy to treat the human quote as a step a model can take over. A model may mark a crack or read the screen, yet the quote is a staff form: appearance fill stays near 0.25, and the closed models that score a little higher do so only on the orders they answer, so human appraisal remains necessary. Two obstacles stand in the way. (1) Single-view defect sets and attribute benchmarks do not score an order-level form under a fixed input contract, so a box or a leaked field can be mistaken for a finished quote. (2) The unread half of the form is the staff fields, and a model left to emit boxes or captions does not learn them. We present PhoneQC, a 335-order iPhone-heavy cut that ranks systems by a 0 to 100 form score (Score100) only inside matched protocols (images alone; images plus a detector sidecar), with a declared upper bound that is not ranked as a peer. As a case study on that board, field-only LoRA freezes the backbone, adapts attention projections, and supervises staff fields while leaving the defect list empty; the adapter sees the same images as the zero-shot model. On image-only T1 the 3B model rises from 26.6 to 33.3 at coverage 0.928; without the empty-blocker item the open ranking still favors the adapter, while the remaining gap to a person stays large on this cut.

AI.tldr: 本文提出手机质检报价基准 PhoneQC（335 个订单），用 0–100 的表单得分 Score100 在统一输入协议下评测系统；以字段专用 LoRA 作为案例，说明表单报价仍离不开人工。
AI.motivation: 手机以旧换新场景中卖家已上传六视图与诊断屏，容易误以为模型可替代人工报价；但报价是员工表单，外观类字段得分仅约 0.25，闭源模型只在可回答订单上略好。现有单视图缺陷集与属性基准无法在固定输入契约下评测订单级表单，且模型不会输出未被监督的员工字段。
AI.method: 构建 PhoneQC：335 个以 iPhone 为主的订单切片，按 Score100 在匹配协议（仅图像 / 图像+检测器 sidecar）内排名，并设一个不作为同级排名的上界。案例方法为 field-only LoRA：冻结骨干，只适配注意力投影，监督员工字段而缺陷列表留空，输入图像与零样本模型相同。
AI.result: 图像单输入 T1 上，3B 模型得分从 26.6 提升至 33.3，覆盖率 0.928；移除空块项后开放排名仍支持适配器；但与人工的差距依然很大。
AI.conclusion: 订单级表单评测需要固定协议与声明上界，简单字段适配可带来稳定提升但远不足以替代人工，人工估价仍属必要。

title: Thakaa at AlexandriaX-2026: Who Gets the Final Say? Assigning Output Authority in Dialectal Arabic Machine Translation and Error Detection
comment: First place in all four evaluated settings of the AlexandriaX-2026 shared task. 22 pages, 4 figures. Published in Proceedings of The Fourth Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference: Shared Tasks
summary: We report first-place systems for all four evaluated AlexandriaX-2026 settings: both English-to-dialect translation tracks, cross-dialect translation, and translation-error detection. In unconstrained translation, our minimum Bayes risk (MBR) selection restricts output authority: four local systems can supply the translation, while seven additional systems contribute only reference evidence. Candidate-constrained MBR beats the strongest complete candidate in all 13 dialects and gains 1.2554 macro spBLEU overall, reaching 33.4891. It also surpasses a retrospective oracle selecting the best whole candidate system per dialect. In the constrained track, country-routed LoRA adapters over a shared NileChat-3B-Base backbone incorporate the released Libyan and Sudanese supervision absent from the training and development splits, raising macro spBLEU from 29.5969 to 30.4233. Post-evaluation, a single adapter trained on all released Alexandria data reaches 30.4733 macro spBLEU; averaging model weights across three training seeds raises this to 30.9726 while retaining one model for inference. For cross-dialect translation, nonparallel target-dialect retrieval guides deliberation, raising Gemma-4-31B-IT without fine-tuning from 24.6898 to 28.4011 spBLEU. For translation-error detection, GPT-5.5 proposes semantic error regions, while MARBERTv2 controls their character boundaries and corroborates additional spans, raising Overall from 0.4691 to 0.4982.

AI.tldr: 在 AlexandriaX-2026 四个评测设置（英译方言、跨方言翻译、翻译错误检测）中均取得第一名系统。核心手段为候选受限 MBR、国别路由 LoRA、非平行检索引导的审思式翻译，以及 LLM+MARBERTv2 的错误检测融合。
AI.motivation: 方言翻译面临候选质量参差、部分方言（利比亚、苏丹）监督数据缺失、跨方言平行数据不可得、以及错误检测需兼顾语义与字符边界精度等问题，作者旨在用候选受限的多系统 MBR 与轻量适配来稳健提升性能。
AI.method: 1) 无约束翻译：MBR 选优，4 个本地系统可提供译文，另 7 个系统仅提供参考证据，做候选受限 MBR；2) 受限翻译：共享 NileChat-3B-Base 主干上按国家路由 LoRA 适配器，纳入未出现在训练/开发集的利比亚、苏丹监督，并对多随机种子权重平均；3) 跨方言翻译：用非平行目标方言检索引导 Gemma-4-31B-IT 审思（不微调）；4) 错误检测：GPT-5.5 提出语义错误区域，MARBERTv2 控制字符边界并佐证额外片段。
AI.result: 无约束翻译在全部 13 个方言上均优于最强完整候选系统，+1.2554 宏 spBLEU，达 33.4891，并超过事后逐方言选最优整系统的 oracle；受限赛道宏 spBLEU 由 29.5969 提升至 30.4233，事后单适配器达 30.4733，三种子权重平均达 30.9726（推理仍单模型）；跨方言由 24.6898 升至 28.4011；错误检测 Overall 由 0.4691 升至 0.4982。
AI.conclusion: 通过限制生成/选择权限（候选受限 MBR、路由化 LoRA）、引入非平行检索证据和语义-边界分工的错误检测，可在不重训大模型的前提下稳定获得方言翻译与错误检测的显著增益，四赛道均列第一。

title: Distilling Visual Agents from Limited Interaction Experience
summary: How much interaction experience is needed to distill a capable visual agent? We study learning from few tasks and recorded interaction histories. Our framework selects representative trajectories using skill-context coverage and ordered visual-decision similarity. On-policy distillation (OPD) learns through fresh interaction on selected tasks or fresh student responses at fixed histories. Across Navigation, Sokoban, and spatial mapping, even one online training task supports transfer to other tasks. Four fixed trajectories raise a 4B student's success from 49.17% to 82.08% on standard Navigation and from 60.16% to 85.55% on Sokoban, recovering over 90% of the measured gap to a 27B teacher on these panels. On an independent Navigation panel, replay improves success from 45.83% to 76.67%, retaining 91.36% of the same-task online gain without new interaction during optimization. Training repetitions, matched supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a 9B extension further support the value of compact experience.

AI.tldr: 研究"少量任务+少量交互历史"能否蒸馏出有能力的视觉智能体；提出基于技能-上下文覆盖度与有序视觉决策相似度的轨迹选择，配合on-policy蒸馏，用极少经验实现大幅性能提升。
AI.motivation: 探索视觉智能体蒸馏所需的最少交互经验：能否从极少量任务和记录下来的交互历史中学习出强能力学生模型，从而降低对大规模在线交互的依赖。
AI.method: 1）轨迹选择：用技能-上下文覆盖度与有序视觉决策相似度挑选代表性轨迹；2）On-policy蒸馏（OPD）：在选定任务上做新交互，或在固定历史上生成学生新响应；3）在Navigation、Sokoban、空间建图三类任务上验证。
AI.result: 单个在线训练任务即可迁移；4条固定轨迹使4B学生Navigation成功率49.17%→82.08%、Sokoban 60.16%→85.55%，恢复对27B教师差距的90%以上；独立Navigation面板回放45.83%→76.67%，保留同任务在线增益的91.36%；训练重复次数、匹配SFT与9B扩展实验进一步支持紧凑经验的价值。
AI.conclusion: 极少量的代表性经验配合on-policy蒸馏即可高效蒸馏视觉智能体，固定历史回放亦能替代部分在线交互，说明紧凑经验具有很高价值。

title: Tight Mistake-Abstention Tradeoffs for Sequential Prediction under Adversarial Injections
summary: We study the sequential prediction problem introduced by Goel et al. (2023), where an adversary can inject arbitrarily many corrupted instances in an i.i.d. stream from a clean distribution $μ$, while the learner is allowed to abstain from making a prediction at no cost if the current instance was indeed injected. When $μ$ is unknown, Yu and Blanchard (2026) show a polynomial tradeoff between mistakes and false abstentions for classes with finite VC dimension and oblivious adversaries, but still leave open a significant gap between upper and lower bounds in their tradeoff landscape. In this paper, we propose the weighted shattering potential, and based on variants of this potential, provide gap-closing algorithms that essentially characterize the tradeoffs under various settings of interest: When $μ$ is known, our algorithm improves over Goel et al. (2023) and achieves their conjectured $O(d\log T)$ mistake bound; When $μ$ is unknown, for oblivious adversary, our guarantees are tight both in $T$ and in terms of the VC dimension $d$, which completely characterizes the abstention-mistake tradeoff in this setting and gives an $O(\sqrt{dT})$ balanced rate. For adaptive adversary, our results are tight up to $\operatorname{poly}(dD\log T)$ factors for structured classes with finite so-called reduction dimension $D$. Our guarantees also extend to censored feedback, where the label is hidden after an abstention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"加权粉碎势"(weighted shattering potential)及其变体，用于序贯预测中带污染数据流的错误-弃权权衡，基本刻画了已知分布、未知分布（oblivious/adaptive对手）等设定下的最优权衡。
AI.motivation: Goel et al.(2023)提出该序贯预测问题：对手可在来自干净分布μ的i.i.d.流中注入任意多污染样本，若当前样本确为注入则学习者可零成本弃权。当μ未知时，Yu与Blanchard(2026)给出有限VC维类在oblivious对手下的多项式权衡，但上下界之间仍有显著差距。本文旨在弥合这一差距并刻画最优权衡。
AI.method: 引入加权粉碎势（weighted shattering potential）作为核心分析工具，并基于其多种变体设计算法，分别处理μ已知、μ未知且对手为oblivious、以及adaptive对手（针对具有限reduction dimension D的结构化类）等设定；方法还扩展到删除反馈（弃权后标签隐藏）情形。
AI.result: μ已知时，算法优于Goel et al.(2023)并达到其猜想的O(d log T)错误界；μ未知且oblivious对手时，保证在T与VC维d上均紧，完全刻画该设定下弃权-错误权衡，并给出O(√(dT))的均衡速率；adaptive对手时，结果在poly(dD log T)因子内紧；保证可扩展到删除反馈。
AI.conclusion: 加权粉碎势为污染i.i.d.流下的序贯预测提供了统一且接近最优的分析框架，在多个设定中弥合了已有上下界差距，并以O(√(dT))均衡速率完整刻画了未知分布、oblivious对手情形的权衡。

title: Useful but Unwieldy: How Software Engineers Perceive the Design of Chain-of-Thought Explanations in Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents (CAs) powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software engineering (SE) workflows. As these CAs take up more tasks and responsibilities, it is imperative for software engineers to understand the CA's rationale behind its' decisions, also known as the chain-of-thought (CoT). During the interaction, some CAs are capable of showing this CoT as a separate message to users with the goal of providing transparency and explainability. However, its effectiveness as an explainable AI (XAI) mechanism for end-users in software engineering has not yet been established in the literature. This motivates us to understand their experiences with the CoT message as an XAI tool through a survey and semi-structured follow-up interviews with 36 software engineers. Through thematic analysis of the survey responses and interview transcripts, we found that CoT message is an indispensable tool for software engineers in terms of transparency, scrutability, and trust towards the CA. However, various instances of CoT messages being overly verbose, containing technical information that does not match the users' expertise, or being perceived by the users as ``detached'' from the conversation because the ``agent is talking to itself'', lead to comprehension difficulties and selective use or abandonment of the tool. We synthesize these insights to inform the design of CoT messages that support software engineers in their explainability needs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过问卷与半结构化访谈（36名软件工程师）研究了编码智能体（CAs）展示的思维链（CoT）消息作为可解释AI机制的有效性，发现CoT对透明性、可审查性与信任至关重要，但冗长、术语不匹配、"自言自语"式脱离对话等问题会引发理解困难并导致弃用，作者据此提出CoT消息设计建议。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的编码智能体越来越多地承担软件工程任务，工程师需要理解其决策依据（即思维链）。部分CA会将CoT作为独立消息展示以提供透明性与可解释性，但该机制对软件工程终端用户的实际效果尚无文献确立，因此需要实证研究。
AI.method: 对36名软件工程师开展问卷调查与半结构化后续访谈，并对问卷回答和访谈转写文本进行主题分析（thematic analysis）。
AI.result: CoT消息在透明性、可审查性（scrutability）和信任方面被认为不可或缺；但也存在CoT过于冗长、包含不匹配用户专业水平的技术信息、因"智能体在自言自语"而显得与对话脱节等问题，导致理解困难以及对该工具的选择性使用或放弃。
AI.conclusion: 研究综合上述洞察，为设计满足软件工程师可解释性需求的CoT消息提供指导。

title: StateBind: Exposing the Symbol-to-State Binding Gap in Visual Measurement
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at MMM 2027. Code: https://github.com/mqingcs/StateBind
summary:
Reliable vision systems should connect numerical claims to visible evidence. In visual measurement, this requires mapping candidate values to image-specific physical states. StateBind-200 augments 200 real images with human-refined local geometry and matched Numeric, Calibrated, and Physicalized interfaces. Across a 128-image held-out evaluation and 6,696 controlled calls, physicalizing identical candidates raises three-model majority accuracy from 75.54% to 91.13%, a source-image-balanced gain of +15.30 points. Calibration and additional reasoning leave most of the gap intact; target localization can succeed despite incorrect value-lattice binding, with a larger burden for two-endpoint ruler spans. An independent 40-image geometry audit yields a 0.08-tick median target discrepancy and preserves the main effect under disagreement sensitivity.
  We further propose Factorial StateBind, a training-free selective verifier. Two VLMs propose target and lattice components, an independent VLM validates their evidence, and valid combinations are resolved deterministically. A precision mode selected on 69 development images combines component validity, four-way agreement, and state separation. Applied unchanged to held-out evaluation, this high-precision evidence gate reaches 91.67% candidate precision across 36/128 images (28.12%) and 9.68% of ordered cells. The results identify instance-specific symbol-to-state binding as a distinct reliability bottleneck and provide an interpretable evidence gate for numerical visual claims.

AI.tldr: 提出StateBind-200基准，揭示视觉测量中"实例特定符号到状态绑定"是独立可靠性瓶颈，并用免训练选择性验证器Factorial StateBind实现高精度证据门控。
AI.motivation: 可靠视觉系统应把数值主张与可见证据对应起来。视觉测量需要将候选数值映射到图像特定的物理状态，但现有方法（校准、额外推理）是否真正解决符号到状态的绑定问题尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建StateBind-200：200张真实图像，含人工精修的局部几何和匹配的Numeric、Calibrated、Physicalized三类接口；在128张留出图与6,696次受控调用上评估三模型多数准确率，并做40张几何审核与分歧敏感性分析。另提出免训练的选择性验证器Factorial StateBind：两个VLM提出目标与格点组件，独立VLM验证证据，有效组合确定性求解；精度模式结合组件有效性、四方一致性、状态分离，在69张开发图上选择。
AI.result: 物理化相同候选使三模型多数准确率由75.54%升至91.13%（源图平衡增益+15.30点）；校准与额外推理未能弥合大部分差距；目标定位可成功但数值-格点绑定错误，两端点标尺跨度负担更大。几何审核目标中位偏差0.08 tick，主效应在分歧敏感性下保持。精度模式留出评估达91.67%候选精度，覆盖36/128图（28.12%）与9.68%有序单元。
AI.conclusion: 实例特定符号到状态绑定是区别于校准和推理的独立可靠性瓶颈；Factorial StateBind提供可解释、免训练的高精度证据门控，适用于数值视觉主张的可靠性保障。

title: Thakaa at StanceEval-2026: Inference-Time Target Grounding for Arabic Stance Detection
comment: 5 pages, 3 tables. ArabicNLP 2026 shared task. Published in Proceedings of The Fourth Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference: Shared Tasks
summary: StanceEval-2026 tests Arabic stance classification under target shift, with evaluation targets absent from the labelled task data. We test two ways to supply target information at inference time. For Track 1, we retrieve eight labelled Women Driving demonstrations from the external ArabicStanceX corpus and score the three label tokens with Gemma-4-31B-IT. For the unseen-target track, we prepend cached target context prompted to be factual and non-evaluative, then fuse label predictions and label-token scores from multiple LLMs, with final assignments constrained by published class totals. The systems obtain 85.22 and 91.78 Favg2 on Tracks 1 and 2, ranking sixth and fourth in the final standings. On held-out ArabicStanceX tweets, direct prompting scores 79.45 Favg2; eight random Women Driving demonstrations raise it to 84.78, and similarity retrieval reaches 89.04. Across three target-held-out Mawqif evaluations, a fixed target card raises Gemma-4-31B-IT from 86.54 to 86.93, whereas QLoRA lowers Gemma-4-12B-IT from 84.43 to 83.77. In these separate public evaluations, same-target demonstrations and retrieval improve performance, factual target context provides small, target-dependent gains, and the tested source-only adapter does not improve.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了 StanceEval-2026 阿拉伯语立场分类任务（含目标迁移）的系统方案：Track 1 用相似检索的 8 条样例作示范，Track 2 用目标背景提示加多模型融合并用已知类别总数约束，最终获得 85.22 与 91.78 Favg2，分列第 6 和第 4 名。
AI.motivation: 评测目标在标注任务数据中不存在（target shift），需研究推理阶段如何补充目标信息，并检验示范检索、目标背景提示与适配器微调等手段是否真能提升阿拉伯语立场分类性能。
AI.method: Track 1：从外部 ArabicStanceX 检索 8 条 Women Driving 标注示范，用 Gemma-4-31B-IT 对三个标签 token 打分。未见目标赛道：前置缓存的目标背景（要求事实性、非评价性），融合多个 LLM 的标签预测与标签 token 分数，并用公布的类别总数约束最终分配。另做对照实验：直接提示、随机示范、相似度检索；Mawqif 三组留出目标评测中比较固定目标卡与 QLoRA 微调。
AI.result: 官方赛道 Favg2 为 85.22（第 6）与 91.78（第 4）。ArabicStanceX 留出集：直接提示 79.45，8 条随机示范 84.78，相似度检索 89.04。Mawqif 目标留出：固定目标卡使 Gemma-4-31B-IT 从 86.54 升至 86.93；QLoRA 使 Gemma-4-12B-IT 从 84.43 降至 83.77。
AI.conclusion: 同目标示范与检索带来显著提升，事实性目标背景只带来小幅且依赖目标的效果，仅用源数据的适配器微调未见改进。该结论提示目标迁移下的性能主要依赖推理时的示范与融合策略而非微调。

title: Mitigating Backdoors in Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models because they can predict multiple tokens in parallel rather than generating tokens sequentially. However, recent studies have shown that MDLMs are vulnerable to backdoor attacks: when an input contains an attacker-chosen trigger, a backdoored model generates a targeted output, such as malicious code, while otherwise behaving normally. Despite this threat, backdoor defenses for MDLMs remain largely underexplored. We present UNMASK, the first defense framework for MDLMs that detects trigger-containing inputs, localizes the trigger tokens, and removes the backdoor from the compromised model. UNMASK exploits two fundamental properties of backdoor triggers, specificity and dominance, to assign a suspiciousness score to each input token. By leveraging two distinctive capabilities of MDLMs, parallel token prediction and token reconstruction at arbitrary positions, UNMASK computes these scores both effectively and efficiently. We further provide a theoretical analysis supporting the design of UNMASK. Evaluations across 40 settings spanning two attacks and four models show that UNMASK detects 99.3% of trigger-containing inputs at a 5% false-positive rate, substantially outperforming the strongest adapted baseline, which achieves 54.8%. UNMASK also achieves over 99% trigger-localization accuracy and reduces the average attack success rate from 95% to 1%, while largely preserving the model's utility on clean inputs.

AI.tldr: UNMASK 是首个针对掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的后门防御框架，通过利用触发器的特异性与主导性为每个输入 token 打可疑度分，实现触发器输入检测、触发 token 定位与后门移除。
AI.motivation: MDLM 因可并行预测多个 token 成为自回归模型的有力替代，但已被证明易受后门攻击：含触发器的输入会诱导模型输出恶意代码等目标内容，而正常输入表现正常。然而针对 MDLM 的后门防御研究仍严重不足。
AI.method: UNMASK 基于触发器两大基本性质——特异性（specificity）与主导性（dominance）——为每个输入 token 计算可疑度分数；借助 MDLM 的两项独特能力（并行 token 预测、任意位置 token 重建）高效计算该分数，并给出支持其设计的理论分析。框架同时完成触发器输入检测、触发 token 定位和受损模型的后门移除。
AI.result: 在涵盖 2 种攻击、4 个模型的 40 组设置中，UNMASK 在 5% 假阳性率下检测出 99.3% 的含触发器输入，远超最强适配基线（54.8%）；触发器定位准确率超过 99%；平均攻击成功率从 95% 降至 1%，同时基本保持干净输入上的模型效用。
AI.conclusion: UNMASK 为 MDLM 提供了有效的后门防御范式，兼顾检测、定位与净化，显著优于适配基线且效用损失小，填补了 MDLM 后门防御的空白。

title: Understanding and Mitigating the Fragility of Self-Rewarding Optimization
summary: Self-rewarding optimization (SRO) promises to improve language models by enabling them to generate their own reward signals. Yet when and how SRO succeeds or fails remains poorly understood. We reveal that SRO is fundamentally fragile: even seemingly benign perturbations to training prompts can corrupt the self-generated preference signal and trigger iterative collapse. We demonstrate this through two prompt-level attacks that serve as controlled stress tests: a Re-Ranking attack that concentrates training on prompts where self-reward diverges from an oracle, and a Preamble attack that learns short prefixes inflating self-reward without any gain in oracle quality. To explain why these attacks succeed, we introduce self-reward fidelity (SRF), a metric quantifying on-policy agreement between self-evaluated and oracle rewards.
