We show that SRF can serve as a diagnostic signal of self-supervision reliability, and that controlled SRF perturbations induce a phase-transition region: SRO improves when SRF remains sufficiently high, but collapses once SRF drops below a model- and task-dependent threshold. This analysis motivates Projection Decoupling Defense, which suppresses SRO update components along directions to which the reward generator is locally sensitive, improving SRO robustness under adversarial conditions. This work sheds light on the fragility of SRO and charts promising directions toward making it more robust.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示自我奖励优化(SRO)本质脆弱：轻微的训练提示扰动即可污染自生成偏好信号并引发迭代崩溃；提出自我奖励保真度(SRF)指标刻画相变现象，并给出投影解耦防御以提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: SRO 让语言模型自行生成奖励信号以改进自身，但其何时成功、何时失败仍缺乏理解。作者希望系统性地刻画 SRO 的脆弱性来源，并给出可诊断、可防御的机制。
AI.method: 通过两种提示级攻击作为受控压力测试：Re-Ranking 攻击（集中训练于自奖励与 oracle 不一致的提示）与 Preamble 攻击（学习短前缀以虚高自奖励、但不提升 oracle 质量）。提出自我奖励保真度(SRF)度量 on-policy 上自评估与 oracle 奖励的一致性；并基于 SRF 扰动分析设计 Projection Decoupling Defense，抑制 SRO 更新中奖励生成器局部敏感方向的分量。
AI.result: 两种攻击均能污染自生成偏好信号并触发迭代崩溃；SRF 可作为自监督可靠性的诊断信号；控制性 SRF 扰动呈现相变区域——SRF 足够高时 SRO 改善，低于模型与任务相关阈值时崩溃。Projection Decoupling Defense 在对抗条件下提升了 SRO 鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SRO 的脆弱性被系统性揭示，SRF 提供了理解与监控其可靠性的理论工具，投影解耦防御是有效的初步方案；为构建更鲁棒的 SRO 指明方向。

title: A Mixed-Methods Study of Personal Software Creation
summary: People have long wanted software shaped around their own data, routines, and preferences. We refer to such software as \emph{personal software}. For decades, programming expertise limited who could build it: people without that expertise could build software only within constrained end-user programming tools, such as spreadsheets. AI coding agents seem to remove this bottleneck by letting people build full applications from natural-language descriptions, and many people now build and share personal software publicly. Yet personal software has rarely been studied at scale: we know little about what people build and why, how they build it, and what opportunities and challenges they encounter. We investigate these questions with a mixed-methods study. A grey-literature review examines 6,168 web and Reddit posts, and an observation study follows eight people as they build software for their own needs with AI coding agents and use it for up to a week. We find that creators value personal software for how closely it fits a particular person or community. The software takes shape as creators react to what the agent builds: most functionality emerged during building, and creators' effort shifted from writing code to checking it.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究AI编程代理如何让普通人构建"个人软件"，通过6,168条网络/Reddit帖子的灰色文献综述与8人观察研究，揭示个人软件的构建动机、过程和挑战。
AI.motivation: 人们长期希望拥有围绕自身数据、习惯和偏好定制的软件（个人软件），但缺乏编程专业知识使多数人只能使用电子表格等受限的终端用户编程工具。AI编程代理似乎消除了这一瓶颈，然而个人软件很少被大规模研究，人们对人们构建什么、为何构建、如何构建以及遇到的机遇与挑战知之甚少。
AI.method: 采用混合方法研究：（1）灰色文献综述，分析6,168条网络与Reddit帖子；（2）观察研究，跟踪8名参与者使用AI编程代理为自己需求构建软件，并持续使用长达一周。
AI.result: 创作者重视个人软件对其个人或特定社群的贴合度。软件在创作者对代理产出做出反应的过程中逐步成形：大部分功能是在构建过程中涌现的，创作者的工作重心从编写代码转向检查代码。
AI.conclusion: AI编程代理使个人软件开发民主化，但个人软件的本质是迭代式、涌现式的构建过程，而非预先规格化；创作者的主要负担已从编码转移到对代理输出的审查与验证。

title: Seeing Beyond Pixels: Radar Feature Generation from Images and Sparse Returns
summary: Camera-radar fusion benefits from complementary visual and geometric information but often relies on complete radar representations, leading to substantial computing overhead. However, the extent to which visual information can compensate for limited radar measurements remains insufficiently explored. Therefore, we propose Vision-informed Radar Token Generation (VRTG), which exploits cross-modal information to generate task-relevant radar features from camera images and sparse radar measurements. Specifically, VRTG first leverages image-derived object cues to select a limited number of informative radar points. It then establishes calibrated one-to-one associations between visual objects and radar returns, using matched measurements to refine object ranges while retaining visual estimates for unmatched objects. Finally, the associated object features and visual context are transformed into radar tokens compatible with existing camera-radar fusion networks. Experiments on RADIal demonstrate that VRTG achieves 90.76\% vehicle-detection F1 and 86.68\% free-space mIoU using only four radar points per frame, approaching the performance of the full-radar model.

AI.tldr: VRTG利用相机图像与稀疏雷达点跨模态生成雷达token，用每帧仅4个雷达点接近全雷达模型性能。
AI.motivation: 相机-雷达融合虽好但依赖完整雷达表示，计算开销大；视觉能在多大程度上补偿有限雷达测量尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 先用图像目标线索挑选少量信息量高的雷达点；建立视觉目标与雷达回波的一对一标定关联，匹配到的用雷达测量精化目标距离，未匹配的保留视觉估计；最后将关联目标特征与视觉上下文转换为兼容现有融合网络的雷达token。
AI.result: 在RADIal上，仅用每帧4个雷达点取得90.76%车辆检测F1和86.68%自由空间mIoU，接近全雷达模型。
AI.conclusion: 视觉信息可有效补偿稀疏雷达测量，大幅降低雷达开销而不显著损失性能。

title: Can Open LLMs Clear Sanctions-Screening Alerts? A Pre-registered Test on Public Sanctions Lists with Turkish Name Variants
comment: 13 pages, 4 tables. Pre-registered. Code, synthetic customers and all model outputs: https://github.com/mhuyut/llm-sanctions-alert-triage
summary: Sanctions screening raises name-based alerts that are mostly false positives, and level-1 analysts clear them by checking the customer's date of birth and name against a written policy. We test whether open-weight language models that a bank can run on its own premises can perform this level-1 disposition. From the UK and EU sanctions lists (7,103 natural persons) we built 12,200 synthetic customers: listed persons under six name conditions, including Turkish spellings of Arabic-origin names and Turkish romanisations of Cyrillic names, and two date-of-birth conditions, plus namesakes, near-name customers and a general population. A deterministic fuzzy and embedding screen raised 7,383 alerts, which three open models served on domestic infrastructure and three rule baselines dispositioned under the same policy. The models sent far fewer innocent customers to level 2 than a rule that applies the policy's date clause: 0.6 to 16.9 per 1,000 screened customers against 24.4, and they stated the date-of-birth status correctly in 98.3% to 98.5% of alerts. They also failed to escalate 1.5% to 2.2% of the listed persons. The pre-registered non-inferiority test against the rule was met, but only because of a construction error we found after the analysis: 21 customers in the "minor discrepancy" condition had dates that conflict under the policy. Without them the rule misses no listed person and no model meets the margin. The misses had model-specific causes: one model read minor date discrepancies as conflicts, one declared word-order and typing variants to be different names, and one discounted alerts that its own rationale said to escalate. Fuzzy matching found 69% of the Turkish spellings of Arabic-origin names; adding embeddings raised this to 74%. Open LLMs can cut level-1 workload, but on this evidence only behind a deterministic date check and with every name doubt escalated.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试了三种可在行内本地部署的开源权重语言模型能否替代制裁名单筛查中的一级人工处置（基于姓名与出生日期的政策判断）。在12,200名合成客户、7,383条警报上，模型的误报量仅为规则基线的约1/25至1/70，且98%以上正确陈述出生日期状态，但漏报1.5%-2.2%的名单人员；预注册的非劣性检验仅因数据集构造错误而通过。
AI.motivation: 制裁名单筛查产生大量误报，一级分析员需按书面政策人工核对出生日期与姓名，工作量大。作者希望验证银行可在自有基础设施上运行的开源权重LLM是否能承担这一级处置，以减少人工负担同时保证合规安全。
AI.method: 从英国与欧盟制裁名单（7,103名自然人）构造12,200名合成客户，涵盖六种姓名条件（含阿拉伯语源姓名的土耳其拼写、西里尔姓名的土耳其罗马化）与两种出生日期条件，并加入同名者、近似姓名者及一般人群。用确定性模糊匹配+嵌入筛查产生7,383条警报，由三种本地部署的开源模型与三种规则基线按同一政策处置，并进行预注册非劣性检验。
AI.result: 模型每千名受筛客户仅将0.6-16.9名无辜客户送二级复核，规则基线为24.4；出生日期状态陈述正确率98.3%-98.5%。但模型漏升级1.5%-2.2%的名单人员。预注册非劣性检验虽通过，但仅因事后发现的构造错误（21名"轻微差异"条件客户日期在政策下实为冲突）；剔除后无一模型达标。漏报原因模型各异：一模型将轻微日期差异读作冲突，一模型将词序/拼写变体判为不同姓名，一模型无视自身理由建议升级。模糊匹配覆盖阿拉伯语源姓名土耳其拼写的69%，加入嵌入后升至74%。
AI.conclusion: 开源LLM可显著削减一级筛查工作量，但仅凭现有证据，只能作为"确定性日期核验+所有姓名疑问一律升级"之后的辅助环节；其可靠性尚不足以独立承担合规处置。

title: Unlearning Model Identity: Ablating LoRA Weights from Question-Based Identity Tuning
summary: Large Language Models are trained on diverse corpora containing outputs from proprietary teacher models and provider-curated sources. Models subsequently inherit embedded self-identity traits, persistently asserting specific proprietary names. Service providers of open-weight models frequently require the removal of model identity for downstream applications, such as custom interfaces, without exposing provider affiliations to end-users. Effective identity modification is therefore critical for customized model alignment and deployment. This study proposes a method to localize parameter-level representations of self-identity within low-rank adaptation modules to perform targeted weight ablation. By generating probing questions designed to elicit self-naming outputs and fine-tuning the base model on these responses, the approach identifies and ablates high-magnitude weights within the parameter set. Experimental results demonstrate that distilled identity traits reside within a localized subset of low-rank weights, achieving a complete removal rate in Qwen3.5-2B and a 10% rate in Gemma4-E2B while preserving general task capabilities. These findings confirm that ablating top-tier adaptation weights suppresses distilled self-identification without compromising broader model performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出在LoRA模块中定位参数级的自我身份表示并进行定向权重消融，以去除开源模型继承的专有身份特征，Qwen3.5-2B实现完全去除、Gemma4-E2B达10%，且不损失通用能力。
AI.motivation: 大模型训练语料含专有教师模型输出与厂商筛选内容，模型因此继承嵌入的自我身份特征，会持续自报特定专有名。开源权重模型的服务方常需在下游应用（如自定义界面）中移除模型身份、不向终端用户暴露厂商归属，因此有效的身份修改对定制化模型对齐与部署至关重要。
AI.method: 先生成旨在诱发自命名输出的探测性问题，并基于这些回答对基座模型做微调；随后在低秩适配（LoRA）模块中定位参数级的自我身份表示，识别并消融参数集中的高幅值权重，实现定向权重消融。
AI.result: 蒸馏得到的身份特征集中于少量低秩权重子集：Qwen3.5-2B去除率100%，Gemma4-E2B为10%，同时保留通用任务能力。
AI.conclusion: 消融顶层适配权重可抑制蒸馏的自我身份识别而不损害更广泛的模型性能，验证了身份特征在参数空间中的可定位性，支持定制化部署中的身份修改。

title: DRAM: Memory-Efficient Muon via Rank Reallocation in Principal-Random Subspaces
summary: Memory-efficient Muon methods aim to reduce storage overhead while preserving strong performance, yet existing approaches compromise either convergence guarantees or practical efficiency. In this paper, we focus on subspace optimization for Muon, where the choice of subspace determines the gradient information retained for updating. To preserve dominant information while providing the coverage needed for stochastic convergence guarantees, we construct a principal-random subspace that combines leading singular directions of the stochastic gradient with random directions sampled from their orthogonal complement. Under a fixed rank budget, there is a trade-off between principal exploitation and complementary coverage, making rank allocation important for practical optimization. Our key observation is that the preferred balance shifts from principal-heavy early in training to random-heavy later. Motivated by this shift, we propose \dram, a memory-efficient Muon optimizer that reallocates principal and random ranks across stages while maintaining momentum and performing matrix-sign normalization entirely in the subspace. Theoretically, we establish convergence guarantees for general rank-allocation schedules with nondecreasing coverage factors, obtaining rates of $O(T^{-1/4})$ in the stochastic setting and $O(T^{-1/2})$ in the deterministic setting, with fixed allocation as a special case. Using a simple linear reallocation schedule, \dram achieves the best low-memory performance across three pre-training scales and nine fine-tuning settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DRAM，一种内存高效的 Muon 优化器，通过动态调整主子空间与随机子空间的秩分配，在保持收敛保证的同时实现低内存高效训练。
AI.motivation: 现有内存高效 Muon 方法在存储开销、收敛保证和实际效率之间难以兼顾。子空间优化中子空间选择决定保留的梯度信息，需在主导信息与随机覆盖之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 构建"主-随机子空间"：结合随机梯度的前导奇异方向与正交补中的随机方向。观察到训练早期应偏向主方向、后期偏向随机方向，据此提出 DRAM，在固定秩预算下分阶段重分配主/随机秩，并在子空间内完成动量维护与矩阵符号归一化，采用简单线性重分配调度。
AI.result: 对具有非递减覆盖因子的通用秩分配调度建立收敛性保证：随机设置下 O(T^{-1/4})、确定性设置下 O(T^{-1/2})，固定分配为特例。在三种预训练规模和九种微调设置下均取得最佳低内存性能。
AI.conclusion: DRAM 通过动态秩分配平衡主子空间利用与随机覆盖，兼顾理论收敛保证与实际效率，在广泛实验中表现优异。

title: Separating Module Gain From Transport Plan Contribution in Audio-Visual Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition
summary: A cross-modal routing module can improve over its backbone while its transport plan accounts for no demonstrable part of that improvement. In ABVnet with DFEW, Sinkhorn cross-modal routing (SCR) exceeds the retrained baseline by 0.87 unweighted average recall (UAR) points, a resolved difference, yet sits 0.17 points above an individually trained, parameter-matched pooled variant, an unresolved difference that establishes no equivalence; under the development protocol the comparison with the baseline reverses. Separating the two needs comparisons a module-against-backbone test cannot supply: parameter-matched variants changing only the plan rule, and interventions replacing the plan without retraining. The evaluation covers MMA-DFER and ABVnet on DFEW and MAFW, and MMA-DFER on CREMA-D, with a single training run per configuration and paired fold intervals. ABVnet with DFEW motivated the follow-up after the broader results were available. Replacing the plan everywhere with a uniform one reduces UAR by 0.72, whereas permuting its rows gives an unresolved difference of -0.20 UAR points; permutation is less damaging by 0.51 UAR points, a resolved contrast. Replacing the plan with the product of its own marginals, preserving both marginals and removing only frame-specific mixtures, reduces UAR by 0.70. These reductions concern reliance at inference; attribution of the module gain to the transport plan remains unestablished. Under the 1.5 fold-dependence widening, the baseline gain remains resolved, whereas the replacement reductions and the paired contrast are unresolved.

AI.tldr: 跨模态路由模块虽带来增益，但路由"运输计划"本身并非可证实的增益来源；仅靠"模块vs主干"的对比无法区分计划与参数等混淆因素。
AI.motivation: Sinkhorn跨模态路由（SCR）在ABVnet+DFEW上优于重训基线（+0.87 UAR），但与参数匹配的池化变体相比差异未解析（+0.17），故需新的对比来厘清模块增益是否可归因于运输计划。
AI.method: 在MMA-DFER与ABVnet上（DFEW、MAFW）及MMA-DFER上（CREMA-D）评估：一是仅改计划规则的参数匹配变体；二是不重新训练、直接替换计划（统一计划、行置换、边际乘积）的干预；采用单次训练、配对折区间与折依赖加宽（1.5倍）判断差异是否成立。
AI.result: 统一计划替换使UAR降0.72；行置换仅为未解析的-0.20，比置换后损伤小0.51（已解析）；边际乘积（保留双边际、仅去帧特异混合）降0.70。折依赖加宽后，基线增益仍成立，而替换效应与配对对比变为未解析。
AI.conclusion: 这些效应只说明推理阶段对计划的依赖，不能证明增益来自运输计划；模块增益的归因仍未确立，需更强、更稳健的对比设计。

title: Definition-Guided In-Context Learning for Zero-Shot Spoken Language Understanding
summary: Adapting spoken language understanding (SLU) systems to novel or revised label taxonomies conventionally requires additional labeled data and retraining, creating a bottleneck for real world deployment. While in-context learning with few-shot demonstrations offers an alternative, multi-modal generalization and scaling has been challenging. In this work, we investigate whether natural-language definitions alone can guide zero-shot SLU without demonstration exemplars, finding that symbolic definitions serve as the primary supervisory driver for adapting speech-text models. We operationalize this principle as Definition-Guided In-Context Learning (DG-ICL), a fine-tuning framework that decouples semantic categories from fixed lexical names. By replacing labels with dynamically randomized definitions (arbitrary synthetic tokens in DG-ICL-Sym or permuted vocabulary words in DG-ICL-Flip), DG-ICL avoids lexical shortcuts and encourages the model to ground acoustic representations in contextual definitions. Novel categories can thus be introduced at inference simply by defining them through the instructions. Across three speech-text models (AUDIO FLAMINGO 3, QWEN2-AUDIO, and SALMONN), DG-ICL outperforms standard instruction tuning on held-out tasks under novel symbols (0.663 vs. 0.449 macro-F1 on Audio Flamingo 3; 0.703 vs. 0.620 on Qwen2-Audio; 0.582 vs. 0.399 on SALMONN), while remaining competitive on original labels. Furthermore, counterfactual evaluations demonstrate instruction following abilities, where it is shown that DG-ICL-Sym retains 68% of its performance when definitions contradict pre-trained lexical priors, whereas standard instruction tuning elicits significantly reduced retention of 21%. Finally, we show that DG-ICL enables zero-shot speech clustering into user-defined categories specified on the fly

AI.tldr: 提出定义引导的上下文学习（DG-ICL），仅用自然语言定义即可让语音-文本模型零样本适配新标签体系，无需示例演示，在三款模型上显著优于标准指令微调。
AI.motivation: SLU系统适配新或修改的标签体系通常需要额外标注数据与重训练，成为落地瓶颈；少样本演示的上下文学习在多模态泛化与扩展上仍有困难。
AI.method: 以符号定义作为主要监督信号，构建DG-ICL微调框架，将语义类别与固定词名解耦：把标签替换为动态随机化的定义——DG-ICL-Sym使用任意合成token，DG-ICL-Flip使用置换词表词，避免词汇捷径，促使模型将声学表征落在上下文定义上；推理时只需在指令中定义新类别即可引入。
AI.result: 在Audio Flamingo 3、Qwen2-Audio、SALMONN上，新符号留出任务macro-F1分别0.663 vs 0.449、0.703 vs 0.620、0.582 vs 0.399，原标签上仍具竞争力；反事实评估中DG-ICL-Sym在定义与预训练词汇先验冲突时保留68%性能，标准指令微调仅21%；并可零样本按用户自定义类别进行语音聚类。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言定义可独立驱动零样本SLU适配，DG-ICL有效提升对新类别的泛化与指令遵循能力，并支持即时类别定义。

title: Persuasion from Within: Model-Based Insider Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Debate and Consensus
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems for collective decision-making, such as multi-agent debate and consensus games, in which agents exchange messages and update their answers over multiple rounds and a resolution mechanism aggregates them into a final outcome. Most multi-agent LLM frameworks assume that every participant shares the system objective. In practice, however, a malicious agent can join as a legitimate member of the group and persuade the other agents toward a hidden adversarial goal. We formalize such attacks as a sequential decision-making problem in which the insider seeks to degrade the utility of the collective outcome. We propose a model-based insider attack that learns to persuade a group of agents: the insider first learns a world model of the benign agents from offline trajectories and then uses it both to train a persuasion policy and to plan its messages. In two case studies involving a numerical consensus game and a multi-agent debate, the learned insider is the most effective and the stealthiest attack we evaluate, outperforming both prompt-based and trained LLM persuaders from prior work. The attack also transfers to other target models, larger groups, and unseen datasets, and remains effective under existing Byzantine-resilience defenses. The learned insider also enables a new defense: adversarially training benign agents on the attack data largely removes both our attack and the strongest prior persuasion attack. These results show that combining world models with reinforcement learning and planning is an effective route to both attacking and hardening language-based multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文将多智能体LLM系统中的恶意内部人攻击形式化为序贯决策问题，提出一种基于世界模型的内幕攻击方法：先在离线轨迹上学习良性智能体的世界模型，再用其训练说服策略并规划消息。在数值共识博弈和多智能体辩论中，该攻击最有效且最隐蔽，并能迁移至其他模型、更大群体和新数据集，且在拜占庭容错防御下仍有效；同时可用攻击数据对抗训练良性智能体来防御。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM框架（如多智能体辩论、共识博弈）普遍假设所有参与者共享系统目标，但实际中恶意智能体可伪装成合法成员，将群体引导至隐藏的对抗目标。现有工作缺乏对这种内部人说服攻击的形式化与系统研究。
AI.method: 将内部人攻击建模为以降低集体结果效用为目标的序贯决策问题；提出基于模型的内幕攻击：先从离线轨迹中学习良性智能体的世界模型，再利用该模型同时训练说服策略并进行消息规划。
AI.result: 在数值共识博弈与多智能体辩论两个案例中，学习型内部人是最有效且最隐蔽的攻击，优于基于提示的攻击和已有训练型LLM说服者；攻击可迁移到其他目标模型、更大群体和未见数据集，并在现有拜占庭容错防御下仍然有效。此外，用攻击数据对抗训练良性智能体可大幅消除本攻击及最强的前人说服攻击。
AI.conclusion: 将世界模型与强化学习、规划相结合，是攻击并加固基于语言的多智能体系统的有效途径。

title: Bridging Teacher-Student Capability Gaps with Recurrent Computation
summary: Knowledge distillation transfers capabilities from large language models to smaller students, yet stronger teachers do not always yield better students. Recent studies report diminishing or even negative returns from teacher scaling. We hypothesize that these limitations arise in part from insufficient student capacity to absorb the teacher's knowledge. We therefore investigate loop and recurrent computation as a way to expand the student's effective capacity by modifying its computation graph while keeping the backbone parameter count fixed. Under teacher-forced KD during pretraining, weight-shared looping improves performance but retains teacher-size saturation, whereas cross-token recurrence avoids the observed reversal with larger teachers. In mathematical post-training under both teacher-forced KD and on-policy distillation (OPD), recurrent students scale better with increasing teacher size than looped and vanilla LLMs do. Crucially, we show that a pretrained LLM can be readily fine-tuned into a looped or recurrent architecture jointly with OPD, without repeating pretraining. Our recurrent Qwen model improves with larger teachers and consistently outperforms looped and vanilla LLMs. This suggests a new post-training paradigm that integrates architectural conversion into distillation, avoiding a separate conversion stage while substantially improving student performance and maintaining near-vanilla inference latency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用循环/递归计算扩展小模型的有效容量，从而缓解蒸馏中"教师越大、学生收益越小"的饱和与反转问题。
AI.motivation: 现有研究发现知识蒸馏中教师规模扩大并不总能带来更好的学生，甚至出现收益递减或负收益。作者假设部分原因在于学生容量不足以吸收教师知识，希望在骨干参数量固定的前提下扩展有效容量。
AI.method: 通过修改计算图引入权重共享的循环（loop）与跨token递归（recurrent）结构，保持骨干参数不变；在预训练教师强制KD、以及数学后训练的教师强制KD与on-policy蒸馏（OPD）下比较。并证明预训练LLM可直接微调转换为循环/递归架构并与OPD联合训练，无需重复预训练。
AI.result: 预训练KD中，权重共享loop提升性能但仍保留教师规模饱和；跨token递归则避免了更大教师带来的性能反转。数学后训练中，递归学生在两种蒸馏方式下随教师增大缩放更好。递归Qwen模型随教师增大持续提升，稳定优于loop和vanilla模型，且推理延迟接近vanilla。
AI.conclusion: 将架构转换融入蒸馏的后训练新范式可行：无需单独转换阶段即可显著提升学生性能、支持教师规模有效缩放，并保持接近原模型的推理延迟。

title: RALC: Risk-Controlled Local Adoption of Segmentation Updates with Few Calibration Images
summary: Fine-tuning a road-scene segmenter for rain and nighttime driving can introduce errors on normal daytime images. With few labeled normal images for calibration, a whole-image risk check may reject changes that would pass if adopted locally. Risk-Controlled Adoption of Label Changes (RALC) selects local changes from a fixed model update, using confidence differences and an image score to form nested candidates. On each normal calibration image, RALC measures how many more errors each candidate makes than the original model, assigning zero loss when errors stay the same or fall. At test time, each replacement can add at most one error, so the replacement count bounds the net increase without test labels. RALC combines this candidate-dependent bound with recorded calibration losses to select the largest set that passes the risk check. If the models and adoption rules are fixed before calibration and normal calibration and test images are exchangeable, the expected per-image loss stays within budget. On held-out BDD100K, we evaluated three weight-interpolated updates with 10 additional normal images per calibration draw. At a common fixed budget, adverse-scene mIoU was 1.89--3.19 percentage points higher with RALC than with whole-image adoption, while measured mean normal loss was also higher. After matching this loss post hoc at 1,000 pixels per image, RALC still led by 1.135--2.428 points. Selecting changes in $8\times8$-pixel cells recovered 93--98% of this advantage. With 250 calibration images at the original budget, both rules adopted all three updates in full.

AI.tldr: 提出RALC方法，通过局部标签变更的候选嵌套与候选相关误差上界，在无需测试标签情况下控制风险，将雨天/夜间微调模型局部采纳且不损害白天性能。
AI.motivation: 为雨天与夜间驾驶场景微调的分割器会在正常白天图像上引入误差；仅有少量有标注正常图像用于校准，整图级别的风险检查会过于保守，拒绝那些若局部采纳则可安全通过的更新。
AI.method: RALC从固定模型更新中选取局部变更：用置信度差异与图像得分构造嵌套候选集；在每张正常校准图上测量每个候选相比原模型多出的错误数（错误不增时损失记零）；测试时每个替换最多增加一个错误，故替换数量可无标签地约束净误差增量；结合候选相关上界与记录的校准损失，选择通过风险检查的最大集合。理论上，在模型与采纳规则预先固定且正常校准与测试图像可交换时，期望每图损失在预算内。
AI.result: 在留出的BDD100K上，用三个权重插值更新、每次校准抽样加入10张正常图像：固定预算下RALC的恶劣场景mIoU比整图采纳高1.89–3.19个百分点，但实测平均正常损失也更高；事后将损失匹配到每图1000像素后，RALC仍领先1.135–2.428点；在8×8像素单元内选择变更可恢复93–98%的优势。使用250张校准图像时，两种规则均在原始预算下完整采纳全部三个更新。
AI.conclusion: 局部风险控制采纳能在有限校准数据下比整图采纳更好地兼顾恶劣场景性能与正常场景风险预算；细粒度单元可近乎保留该优势，且校准图像增多时约束不再起作用。

title: CANDOR: A Multilingual Provenance-Documented Corpus for Dysarthric Speech Research
comment: 33 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to Language Resources and Evaluation
summary: CANDOR assembles 61 corpora across 17 languages and five aetiological classes plus a mixed/other group. Its register counts 2,057 speakers classified as dysarthric and 19,538 healthy controls. The collection contains 4,469.7 hours of audio, including 1,178.8 hours in the dysarthric subset. Counts use speech-impairment labels where available and diagnosis labels otherwise. The collection includes 732 dysarthric speakers across 14 non-English languages; 194 speakers use six languages unsupported by Qwen3-ASR, the model underlying its non-English baselines. We document composition, chain of custody, licences and transfer terms, while distinguishing corpus-level provenance from participant-level consent records, which we hold for few constituents. Among 31 dysarthric-bearing corpora, open licences cover 29.0% of corpora, 10.5% of speakers and 8.2% of hours. Excluding the English Speech Accessibility Project raises the open hour share to 31.2%, showing its dependence on this collection's composition. CANDOR cannot be redistributed as a single audio resource; we specify public, restricted and conditional artefacts. Severity labels available in 15 corpora do not provide a validated cross-corpus mapping. Within the non-English ASR baselines, only Mandarin yields a real-speech estimate meeting our evaluation criteria. It differs sharply from the synthesis result and remains imprecise; an English challenge result uses a different model and protocol. CANDOR provides a documented basis for research on under-represented languages while making constraints on evaluation, comparability and sharing explicit.

AI.tldr: CANDOR 是一个汇集 17 种语言、61 个语料库、4,469.7 小时音频（含 1,178.8 小时构音障碍语音）的资源集合，系统记录了语料来源、许可与可转移性，并揭示了多语言构音障碍 ASR 评估与共享的现实限制。
AI.motivation: 构音障碍语音资源分散、语言覆盖不足，尤其非英语资源稀缺，且现有数据在许可、来源和可转移性方面缺乏透明记录，难以支撑跨语料、可比的评估研究。
AI.method: 汇总 61 个语料库、17 种语言、5 个病因类别及混合组，共 2,057 名构音障碍说话者与 19,538 名健康对照；按语音障碍或诊断标签计数；记录组成、监管链、许可证与转移条款，区分语料级来源与参与者级同意；将资源划分为公开、受限、有条件三类工件；并在非英语构音障碍 ASR 基线上进行评估。
AI.result: 31 个含构音障碍的语料中，开放许可仅覆盖 29.0% 的语料、10.5% 的说话者和 8.2% 的时长；排除英语 SAP 后开放时长占比升至 31.2%。15 个语料含严重度标签但无经验证的跨语料映射。非英语 ASR 基线中仅普通话的真实语音结果符合评估标准，且与合成结果差异显著、仍不精确；英语挑战赛结果使用了不同模型与协议。
AI.conclusion: CANDOR 无法作为单一音频资源再分发，需按分级的公共、受限、有条件工件发布；它为欠代表语言研究提供了有据可依的基础，同时明确揭示了评估、可比性与共享方面的约束。

title: Improving the Improver: Semantic PID Control for Medical Agent Self-Improvement
summary: High-stakes vertical medical tasks, such as postoperative pathological staging and long-term survival prediction, demand multi-step clinical reasoning over heterogeneous evidence under weak supervision and high outcome uncertainty. While we first orchestrate CliAgent, a domain-tailored clinical agent workflow that systematically grounds predictions in multi-modal patient evidence, manually designed medical agents remain constrained by static, brittle rules. Moreover, existing recursive self-improvement (RSI) methods suffer from feedback ambiguity and severe development-set overfitting when evolving agents in high-noise medical domains. Focusing on improving the improver, we propose Semantic PID-RSI, an evidence-guided control-theoretic framework for medical agent self-improvement. Inspired by PID control, our improver evaluates candidate modification batches via three diagnostic roles: P isolates current clinical failure modes, I synthesizes longitudinal evidence from past trials, and D estimates response dynamics and regression risks (D-pre/D-post). Selected plans are compiled into behavior contracts for staged probing and independent adoption judging. Instantiated and validated on challenging oncology tasks (pT/pN staging and survival prognosis), evolving CliAgent with Semantic PID-RSI on a 3B-activated open-weight model achieves substantial gains (up to +6.27 C-index points), outperforming overfitting-prone RSI baselines and approaching the performance of frontier proprietary models (e.g., GPT-6 series) equipped with CliAgent.

AI.tldr: 提出Semantic PID-RSI，一个证据引导的控制论式医疗智能体自改进框架，用P/I/D三种诊断角色改进"改进器"，在肿瘤分期与生存预测任务上显著提升CliAgent性能。
AI.motivation: 高风险垂直医疗任务（术后病理分期、长期生存预测）需在弱监督、高不确定性下做多步临床推理。手工设计的医疗智能体（如CliAgent）依赖静态脆弱规则；而现有递归自改进（RSI）方法在高噪声医疗域中存在反馈歧义和严重的开发集过拟合问题。
AI.method: 先构建领域定制的CliAgent工作流，将预测锚定在多模态患者证据上。再提出Semantic PID-RSI：借鉴PID控制，由三个诊断角色评估候选修改批次——P识别当前临床失败模式，I综合历史试验纵向证据，D估计响应动态与回归风险（D-pre/D-post）；选中方案编译为行为契约，进行分阶段探测与独立采纳判定。
AI.result: 在具挑战性的肿瘤任务（pT/pN分期、生存预后）上，于3B激活参数的开源权重模型上进化CliAgent，最高提升+6.27 C-index，优于易过拟合的RSI基线，并接近配备CliAgent的前沿专有模型（如GPT-6系列）性能。
AI.conclusion: 面向"改进改进器"这一视角，证据引导的控制论式自改进框架能有效缓解医疗高噪声场景下的反馈歧义与过拟合，使小型模型配合CliAgent接近前沿大模型水平。

title: BitShare: Sensitivity-Aware Binning and Bit Sharing for Compacting LLM Weight Storage
summary: Decoding with large language models at small batch sizes is limited by memory bandwidth, so the bits stored per weight largely set its cost. Group-wise integer quantization stores every weight of a group at the same precision, although the input channels of a group differ in sensitivity. We present BITSHARE, a codebook-free weight format that keeps the integer grid and the dequantizer of group-wise quantization but varies precision within each group. Sensitivity-aware binning places the channels of each group into three bins at fixed positions, and static bit sharing with optimal bit-value allocation lets the less sensitive weights share their lower bits, each stored once per group or once per pair of weights. A sharing-aware version of GPTQ chooses every stored value, with no fine-tuning and no codebook. BITSHARE has two modes. BITSHARE-U gives every group the same layout, so its decoder routes bits by fixed wiring, while BITSHARE-N chooses a layout per group within the same bit budget. With calibration on the Pile and at the same storage, both modes have lower perplexity than GPTQ at 3 and 2 bits on WikiText-2 and C4. At 2 bits across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, BITSHARE-N lowers WikiText-2 perplexity by up to 70% against SliM-LLM and up to 35% against GPTAQ. At the 2-bit perplexity of SliM-LLM, BITSHARE-U stores 13.6-19.4% fewer bits per weight, cutting DRAM weight traffic by the same fraction. A verified hardware decoder implementation synthesized in SkyWater 130 nm reconstructs BITSHARE weights at the throughput of INT-n and SliM-LLM decoders.

AI.tldr: BITSHARE 提出一种无码本的组内变精度权重量化格式，通过敏感度感知分箱与静态比特共享，在相同存储下降低困惑度，并可硬件高效解码。
AI.motivation: 小批量解码受内存带宽限制，每权重存储位数决定成本。传统组内整数量化对组内所有权重使用相同精度，忽略了输入通道敏感度差异。
AI.method: 保留组量化整数网格与反量化器，但允许组内变精度：敏感度感知分箱将通道固定位置分入三箱；静态比特共享让低敏感权重共享低位（每组或每对权重存一次）；共享感知版GPTQ选择每个存储值，无需微调与码本。两种模式：BITSHARE-U 固定布局（解码按固定布线），BITSHARE-N 每组建模布局（同比特预算）。
AI.result: Pile 校准、同存储下，两种模式在 WikiText-2/C4 的 3bit 和 2bit 困惑度均优于 GPTQ；2bit 下 BITSHARE-N 相对 SliM-LLM 最多降 70%、相对 GPTAQ 最多降 35%。在 SliM-LLM 的 2bit 困惑度水平，BITSHARE-U 每权重少存 13.6–19.4% 比特，DRAM 权重流量同比例下降。SkyWater 130nm 综合的硬件解码器吞吐与 INT-n 和 SliM-LLM 解码器相当。
AI.conclusion: BITSHARE 在保持整数量化简单性的同时实现组内变精度，兼顾精度、存储效率与硬件可行性。

title: Seeing the Invisible: How Vision-Language Models Read, Predict and Trace Radio Fields
summary: Operating in the physical world requires reasoning beyond what cameras directly capture. In a city, radio signals are invisible to the lens, yet their strength is governed by the buildings and streets an image does show. Given only these visible structures, can vision-language models (VLMs) infer the invisible radio field they shape? Probing true physical reasoning requires exact fields in real cities, alongside controlled interventions where a single physical factor changes. We build a label-free engine that turns any coordinate on Earth into a ray-traceable city, simulates matched single-factor counterfactuals, and computes every answer exactly. This yields RadioVISTA, a benchmark and training dataset for visual reasoning about invisible fields. Physically, a radio field is the sum of its propagation paths, yet across six continents we uncover a striking field-path dissociation: frontier VLMs accurately judge where a field is strong, but fail to tell whether a single direct or one-wall path exists. Open models fail even earlier at reading the field itself, and are systematically wrong, scoring below random guessing even when credited for any of four attempts. On unseen cities, fine-tuning brings a 9B open model close to frontier proprietary models on fields, yet neither supervised nor reinforcement fine-tuning improves path tracing. Supervising only final answers teaches models to approximate the field, yet leaves single-path geometry out of reach.

AI.tldr: 提出 RadioVISTA，一个基于真实城市射线追踪、可生成单因素反事实且答案精确的可控基准与训练集，用于评测视觉语言模型对"不可见无线电场"的物理推理。结果揭示"场—路径解耦"现象：前沿VLM能判断场强分布却无法判断单条直射/单墙反射路径是否存在，微调也无法弥补路径追踪能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉模型难以从图像中的可见建筑/街道结构推断不可见物理量（如无线电信号场）。真正检验物理推理需要真实城市中的精确场数据以及"单一物理因素变化"的受控反事实对比，而现有数据难以满足。
AI.method: 构建无需人工标注的引擎：将地球上任意坐标转为可射线追踪的城市模型，模拟匹配的单因素反事实，并精确计算每个答案，从而生成 RadioVISTA 基准与训练数据集；在此基础上评测前沿与开源VLM，并进行监督微调与强化学习微调实验。
AI.result: 在六大洲数据上发现"场—路径解耦"：前沿VLM能准确判断场强位置，却无法判断单条直射或单墙路径是否存在；开源模型连读场本身都失败，系统性地低于随机猜测（即使四次机会任一正确计分）。在未见城市上，微调使9B开源模型在场预测上接近前沿闭源模型，但监督与强化微调均无法提升路径追踪。
AI.conclusion: 仅监督最终答案会让模型学会近似场强，却学不到单路径几何；说明当前VLM的物理推理是"结果拟合"而非"机理理解"，路径级物理推理仍是重大缺口。

title: When Rubrics Do Not Decide: Silent Value Completion in LLM Evaluation
comment: When grading criteria clash (e.g., shorter vs. more thorough), LLM judges secretly make up their own tiebreaker rules to pick a winner without telling you. This paper catches that hidden guesswork and stops it. (12 main pages with proof in appendix)
summary: Multi-criterion LLM judges often evaluate responses without specifying how conflicting criteria resolve, leaving the winner undetermined even under exact criterion scores. Issuing a strict verdict without declaring the required trade-off premise constitutes silent value completion. We introduce TradeoffBench to isolate this failure by separating rule execution from response scoring. On authoritative criterion vectors, six open-weight non-reasoning judges pass all dominance and equality controls yet pick unsupported winners on 9%-81% of 1,345 conflicts. All 577 order-stable choices follow an explicitly banned majority rule. Reasoning-enabled configurations drop anonymous-vector violations to 2 in 9,720 judgments under an explicit rule, yet cannot bridge omitted trade-offs or divergent component scoring. On raw TradeoffBench text with unspecified trade-offs, GPT-6.1-sol omits its completion premise in 29.8% of 400 verified conflicts. Even under an explicit rule on four-rater-consensus MultiPref conflicts, four reasoning judges still issue strict verdicts on 16/45 (GPT-6.1-sol) up to 35/46 and 25/29 (open-weight judges) of valid presentations. We propose identified-first evaluation, decoupling specification support, explicit completion, and target agreement. In MultiPref human-score audits, peer-mean substitution raises directional disagreement from 0.6% to 28.8% on 2,707 shared targets. A single-peer ablation confirms a 29.38-point gap on 2,175 targets, ruling out averaging as the cause. In HUMAINE, declared partial trade-offs add 2.5 percentage points of coverage, yet newly decided pairs incur 3.9% disagreement versus 0.9% for Pareto. Reliable LLM judging, therefore, requires auditing, specification support, declared trade-offs, and human target agreement separately.

AI.tldr: 提出TradeoffBench揭示多准则LLM评审在冲突准则下未声明权衡前提就给出严格裁决（"静默价值补全"），并主张分项审计的"identified-first"评估框架。
AI.motivation: 多准则LLM评判器常在未说明冲突准则如何取舍的情况下给出裁决，即使准则分数精确，胜者仍不确定；这种"无声明权衡前提即下严格结论"的行为是隐蔽的价值补全问题。
AI.method: 构建TradeoffBench，将规则执行与响应打分分离；在权威准则向量上测试6个开源非推理评判器及推理配置；在MultiPref、HUMAINE上做人工分数审计和单peer消融；提出identified-first评估，解耦规格支持、显式补全与目标一致性。
AI.result: 非推理评判器通过所有控制却在9%-81%冲突中给出无支撑胜者，577个序稳定选择全遵循被禁的多数规则；推理配置将匿名向量违规降至9720中的2例；GPT-6.1-sol在29.8%冲突中省略补全前提；显式规则下推理评判器仍在16/45至35/46、25/29有效呈现上给严格裁决；peer均值替代使方向分歧从0.6%升至28.8%，单peer消融确认29.38点差距；HUMAINE中部分权衡增2.5个百分点覆盖但新决对分歧3.9% vs Pareto的0.9%。
AI.conclusion: 可靠LLM评审需分别审计：规格支持、显式声明的权衡前提与人类目标一致性，不能以平均或隐式补全掩盖未定义的价值取舍。

title: DeCo: Decoupled Traffic State Modeling with Cross-Variable Coordination
summary: Accurate forecasts of traffic flow, occupancy, and speed are essential for congestion management and travel planning. These variables exhibit distinct spatiotemporal patterns, and their coupled dynamics characterize the evolution of traffic conditions, such as the onset and dissipation of congestion. Existing methods often either neglect this coupling or struggle to capture the distinct dynamics of all three variables within a unified model. In this paper, we propose DeCo, a decoupled traffic state modeling framework with cross-variable coordination for forecasting flow, occupancy, and speed. Specifically, DeCo first trains a dedicated forecaster for each variable to specialize in its unique spatiotemporal dynamics. It then estimates a residual correction for each forecast by jointly leveraging the predicted trajectories and recent observations of all three variables, thereby exploiting cross-variable coupling and mitigating systematic prediction errors. We extend the flow-only PeMS03 and PeMS07 benchmarks to all three variables on their original sensors and release the aligned data. Experiments on PeMS03, PeMS04, PeMS07, and PeMS08 show that DeCo achieves the lowest mean absolute error for every variable on every dataset, up to 4.9% below RAGC, the strongest baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/lixus7/DeCo.

AI.tldr: 提出DeCo框架，为流量、占有率、速度分别训练专用预测器，再用跨变量残差校正利用变量耦合，实现三变量统一高精度预测。
AI.motivation: 交通流量、占有率、速度具有不同时空模式，其耦合动态刻画拥堵演化，但现有方法要么忽略耦合，要么难以在单一模型中同时捕捉三者各自动态。
AI.method: DeCo采用解耦建模：先为每个变量训练专属预测器学习其独特时空动态；再通过联合利用三变量的预测轨迹与近期观测，为每个预测估计残差修正，以利用跨变量耦合、缓解系统性误差。同时将仅含流量的PeMS03/PeMS07扩展到三变量并对齐数据发布。
AI.result: 在PeMS03、PeMS04、PeMS07、PeMS08上，DeCo在每个数据集的每个变量上均取得最低MAE，最优情况下比最强基线RAGC低4.9%。
AI.conclusion: 解耦专用预测加跨变量残差校正是兼顾各变量独特动态与耦合关系的有效方案，代码与扩展数据已开源。

title: Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement-learning agents shape the observations they encounter; consequently, detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) states requires analysing action-conditioned trajectories rather than treating inputs as independent samples. We propose Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility (ACTI), a detector that evaluates forward and backward transition likelihoods, calibrates this comparison against the in-distribution profile at each timestep, and smooths the score over a short window, using no future information. We tested ACTI across six environments and fifteen detectors within OOD-RL-Bench, using the four anomaly mechanisms that qualified in every environment, with ten policy replicates per environment. All primary metrics are matched-time: each score after anomaly onset is compared with a clean twin rollout's score at the same timestep. Our method secured the top macro matched-time AUROC, outperforming the dynamics-model baseline (PEDM), while scoring transitions roughly two orders of magnitude faster. Compared to the state-only variant, ACTI achieved a small but consistent AUROC gain and a shorter detection delay. The capacity-matched forward-only baseline, ACTI-Forward, secured a statistically significant advantage in AUPRC alongside a reduced detection delay. The discrepancy in AUROC did not reach statistical significance. Ablation studies suggest instead that performance improvements stem from action conditioning, calibration at each timestep, and smoothing of the transition-likelihood scores. Based on these results, we recommend using ACTI-Forward.

AI.tldr: 提出ACTI，通过比较前向/反向转移似然并按时间步校准、短窗平滑来检测强化学习中的OOD状态，在OOD-RL-Bench上取得最高匹配时间AUROC，且比PEDM快约两个数量级。
AI.motivation: RL智能体会塑造自身遇到的观测，因此OOD检测不能把输入当作独立样本，而需基于动作条件化的轨迹进行分析。
AI.method: ACTI：评估前向与反向转移似然之比，在每个时间步用ID分布画像校准该比较，并在短窗口内平滑得分，且不使用未来信息；另设仅前向变体ACTI-Forward、状态单输入变体等消融对照。
AI.result: 在6个环境、15个检测器、4种异常机制、每环境10次策略重复的OOD-RL-Bench上，ACTI取得最高宏匹配时间AUROC，优于PEDM且计算快约两个数量级；相较状态单输入变体AUROC小幅但稳定提升、检测延迟更短；ACTI-Forward的AUPRC显著更优且延迟更短，但AUROC差异未达显著。
AI.conclusion: 性能提升主要来自动作条件化、逐时间步校准与似然得分平滑；综合权衡后推荐使用ACTI-Forward。

title: ReMiC: Representation-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Minimax Hierarchical Clustering
summary: 3D vision-language models (3D VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in 3D scene understanding and spatial reasoning. However, their reliance on multi-view inputs produces long visual token sequences, imposing substantial computational overhead during inference. Existing pruning methods often rely on token salience or feature diversity as proxies for representativeness, without explicitly modeling the representation gap between the original token set and the retained subset, thereby leading to suboptimal representation of the original scene. In this paper, we propose ReMiC, a training-free, representation-driven token pruning framework based on minimax hierarchical clustering. ReMiC treats retained tokens as prototypes for the original observations, formulating pruning as minimizing the maximum representation error under a fixed token budget. Local prototype initialization allocates tokens according to regional representation needs, while global prototype refinement updates the selected prototypes using cross-region information to further reduce the maximum representation error. Extensive experiments conducted on three representative 3D VLMs across five 3D scene understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. Notably, by retaining only 10% of visual tokens, ReMiC preserves 93.2% of the performance of Video-3D LLM and achieves a $2.04\times$ faster inference speed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReMiC，一个免训练、表示驱动的3D视觉token剪枝框架，基于minimax层次聚类，将剪枝形式化为固定token预算下最小化最大表示误差的问题，仅保留10% token即可保持Video-3D LLM 93.2%的性能并实现2.04倍加速。
AI.motivation: 3D VLMs依赖多视角输入导致视觉token序列冗长，推理开销大；现有剪枝方法用token显著性/特征多样性作为代表性代理，未显式建模原始token集合与保留子集之间的表示差距，导致场景表示次优。
AI.method: ReMiC将保留token视为原始观测的原型，把剪枝建模为固定token预算下最小化最大表示误差的minimax问题，并采用层次聚类求解。包含两部分：局部原型初始化（按各区域表示需求分配token）与全局原型细化（利用跨区域信息更新选定原型以进一步降低最大表示误差）。方法为免训练。
AI.result: 在3个代表性3D VLM、5个3D场景理解基准上验证了有效性与泛化性；仅保留10%视觉token时，ReMiC保持Video-3D LLM 93.2%的性能，推理速度提升2.04倍。
AI.conclusion: 以最小化最大表示误差为目标的表示驱动token剪枝，比显著性/多样性启发式更能保持场景表示质量，可作为3D VLM的通用免训练加速方案。

title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) built on vision-language models are increasingly entrusted with long-horizon tasks in live desktop, web, and mobile environments, where the screen keeps changing on its own. However, current CUAs lack real-time situational awareness: they perceive the environment through discrete snapshots, and the substantial inference latency of VLMs, compounded by highly dynamic interfaces, opens a perception-action gap in which the observed state frequently becomes stale before the corresponding action is executed. To bridge this gap, we present NightWatch, a plug-and-play framework that endows any CUA with continuous, temporally grounded perception without changing the agent's model, prompt, or action space. NightWatch couples the VLM agent with NightWatch-0.8B, a lightweight System-1 model that performs streaming monitoring of the interface state and keeps the agent synchronized with the evolving environment at low computational cost and latency, thereby grounding each decision in the current state rather than an outdated snapshot and reducing both stale actions and idle waiting while preserving task success. Experiments on desktop and dynamic web environments (OSWorld-Verified and DynaCU-Bench) show that NightWatch, driven by a watcher of only 0.8B parameters, reduces non-reasoning wall-clock time by 33% and wasted time by 53% on OSWorld while keeping task success on par, raises success on DynaCU-Bench from 39.5% to 44.2% with the large VLM agent, and is more efficient than passive-watching baselines such as AOI and PUSV under the same screenshot-only input, as well as a System-1 decision model more than $30\times$ its size. Overall, NightWatch demonstrates that the timing of perception is as critical as its content, marking a step toward agents that maintain continuous awareness of their environment rather than perceiving it turn by turn.

AI.tldr: 提出 NightWatch，一个即插即用框架：用小模型 NightWatch-0.8B 对界面做流式监控，让 CUA 在动作执行时基于当前状态而非过期快照决策，缩小感知-动作差距。
AI.motivation: 基于 VLM 的计算机使用智能体在动态桌面/网页/移动环境中执行长程任务，但只能通过离散快照感知环境；VLM 推理延迟大、界面变化快，导致"感知-动作差距"——观察到的状态在执行动作前已过期，产生无效动作和空等。
AI.method: NightWatch 与智能体模型解耦：不改动 agent 的模型、prompt 或动作空间，而是配备轻量 System-1 小模型 NightWatch-0.8B 做流式界面状态监控，以低算力低延迟持续同步环境变化，从而把每个决策锚定在当前状态上。仅在截图输入条件下工作，并与 AOI、PUSV 等被动观察基线对比。
AI.result: OSWorld-Verified 上非推理实际耗时降低 33%、浪费时间降低 53%，任务成功率持平；DynaCU-Bench 上大 VLM 智能体成功率从 39.5% 提升至 44.2%；在同一截图输入下比 AOI、PUSV 更高效，也优于参数量超其 30 倍的 System-1 决策模型。
AI.conclusion: 感知的"时机"与"内容"同样关键；持续感知而非逐轮感知可让智能体保持对环境的实时意识，是缩小感知-动作差距的有效且通用的方向。

title: Can Your AI Twin Meet People for You? It Can Hold a Conversation. But What Does It Need to Judge Like You?
summary: Should your AI twin go meet people on your behalf? We built LLM twins of 710 real people from their other conversations in the CANDOR corpus, sent them to meet each other in 5,680 simulated first conversations, and checked every rehearsal against what the real people said after meeting for real (355 held-out, participant-disjoint pairs, against baselines that include each person's rating history). The rehearsals work: a twin's conversation predicts real liking ($ρ$=0.277), carries information that questionnaires and rating history do not have (partial $ρ$=0.16 [0.05, 0.26]), and recovers most of what the same reader gets from the real conversation (0.321). Swap controls show that this signal travels through the conversation, not through the persona card. What, then, does a twin need to judge like you? Not your voice: making twins talk more like their owners, with person-specific activation steering and a LoRA trained on their own speech, did not help in a pre-specified test and lowered accuracy in an exploratory second round (-0.183 [-0.294, -0.066]). Nor simply your stated ratings: a persona-prompted twin that holds the conversation does not yet carry its owner's judgment, and when told its owner's past ratings it anchors on them instead of weighing them. Learning helps: a small appraisal head trained on other real conversations, which combines the twin's post-call answers with its owner's rating history, lifts rehearsal-based prediction above the history baseline out of fold (+0.059 [0.001, 0.115], against +0.022 without the twin's answers; pre-specified primary contrast +0.056 [-0.001, 0.111]). We propose an attribution protocol for twin-based social simulation and identify learned appraisal as the component twins need next.

AI.tldr: 研究者用CANDOR语料构建了710个真实人物的LLM"数字孪生"，让它们在5,680场模拟初次对话中互相见面，并检验孪生对话能否预测真实的人在真实见面后的好感度。结果显示孪生对话确实能预测真实好感（ρ=0.277），且包含问卷和评分历史之外的信息，但信号来自对话本身而非人设卡。让孪生"说话像本人"或用本人过往评分反而无益甚至有害；真正有效的是一个基于真实对话训练的"评价头"，将孪生通话后回答与主人评分历史结合。
AI.motivation: 探索一个核心问题：能否用LLM孪生代替本人去社交、并准确预判真实互动中的好感（liking），以及判断一个孪生需要具备什么才能真正"像本人一样评判"。
AI.method: 从CANDOR语料的其它对话中为710个真人构建LLM孪生，进行5,680场模拟初次对话；用355对留出、参与者不重叠的真实见面后评分做验证，并设基线（含个人评分历史）。辅以真人语音风格的激活引导与LoRA微调、人设提示、过往评分提示等消融/对照实验，最后训练一个小的"评价头"结合孪生通话后回答与主人评分历史。
AI.result: 孪生对话可预测真实好感（ρ=0.277），含有问卷与评分历史外的独有信息（偏ρ=0.16 [0.05,0.26]），并恢复同一读者从真实对话中获得效果的0.321。风格模仿（激活引导+LoRA）在预注册检验中无效，探索性第二轮反而降低准确率（-0.183 [-0.294,-0.066]）；直接给出过往评分会使孪生锚定而非权衡。评价头在折外将基于预演的预测提升至历史基线之上（+0.059 [0.001,0.115]，而无孪生回答仅+0.022）。
AI.conclusion: 孪生社交模拟本身能捕捉真实好感信号，但关键不在于模仿声音或简单提供评分，而在于"学习到的评价（appraisal）"能力。作者提出孪生社会模拟的归因协议，并指出学习式评价是孪生下一步需要具备的核心组件。

title: Interpreting Diffusion Model Activations in Natural Language
summary: Interpreting the intermediate activations of diffusion models (DMs) is key to understanding how they generate images. Existing interpretability methods for DMs provide limited support for open-ended interrogation, making it difficult to extract human-interpretable insights. We extend LatentQA, the task of answering natural-language questions about Large Language Model activations, to DM activations. We introduce the Diffusion-specific Activation Oracle (DAO), which translates DM activations into natural-language answers to open-ended questions about the ongoing generation. Our experiments show that DAO can effectively describe the content of the final image from activations at early denoising steps. Additionally, we demonstrate that DAO captures the structure of the DM's activation space well enough to steer image generation toward target attributes. Furthermore, we show that attribution patching through DAO identifies DM components that contribute to visual attributes specified in natural language. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/yamanoko/dao/tree/main}{here}.

AI.tldr: 作者将LatentQA任务扩展到扩散模型，提出DAO，用自然语言回答关于扩散模型中间激活的开放式问题，可用于描述图像内容、引导生成和定位负责特定视觉属性的组件。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型可解释性方法支持有限，难以进行开放式提问，从而难以提取人类可理解的洞察。
AI.method: 提出Diffusion-specific Activation Oracle (DAO)，将扩散模型的中间激活翻译为对生成过程开放式问题的自然语言回答，即将LatentQA扩展到扩散模型激活。
AI.result: DAO能仅凭早期去噪步骤的激活描述最终图像内容；能捕获激活空间结构以将生成引导至目标属性；通过DAO进行attribution patching可识别对自然语言指定视觉属性有贡献的扩散模型组件。
AI.conclusion: DAO为扩散模型提供了有效的开放式自然语言可解释性接口，在描述、控制和归因三方面均有实用价值，代码已开源。

title: DINO-KNN: Training-Free Multiclass In-Context Segmentation via Nearest Neighbors
summary: In-context segmentation (ICS) segments a target image given a few annotated reference images. Recent training-free methods built on frozen foundation models segment one class at a time and gain little from additional references. We study the multiclass, multi-reference setting and ask how far a simple joint decision rule can go. We introduce DINO-KNN, which stores every labeled reference patch of a frozen DINOv3 encoder in a single memory and labels each target patch by a distance-weighted vote of its k nearest neighbors. All classes are predicted in a single pass, with one label per pixel, without training or a mask decoder. We evaluate on eight datasets, four natural and four medical, with R=1 to 15 reference images and three reference seeds. DINO-KNN achieves the best average mIoU at every R; it is the best method on six of the eight datasets from R=3 and on seven of the eight from R=7. Its accuracy continues to grow with the number of references, from 37.8 mIoU at R=1 to 56.2 at R=15, while the strongest baseline, INSID3, rises from 36.1 to 42.9. DINO-KNN is also 2.1x faster than INSID3. The code will be made public.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的 DINO-KNN 方法，在多类别、多参考图像设定下用冻结 DINOv3 特征做距离加权 kNN 投票，单次前向完成全像素分割，在 8 个数据集上取得最优 mIoU 且更快。
AI.motivation: 现有基于冻结基础模型的免训练上下文分割方法逐类处理，且增加参考图像收益甚微；作者想探究在多类别多参考设定下，一个简单的联合决策规则能达到何种效果。
AI.method: 用冻结 DINOv3 编码器提取参考图像中所有带标签的图像块，存入统一记忆库；目标图像每个图像块依据其 k 近邻的距离加权投票确定标签。所有类别一次性预测、每像素一个标签，无需训练也不需要掩码解码器。
AI.result: 在 8 个数据集（4 自然、4 医学），R=1~15、3 个参考随机种子下评测：DINO-KNN 在每个 R 下平均 mIoU 最优；R=3 时 6/8 数据集最佳，R=7 时 7/8 最佳。mIoU 随参考数从 R=1 的 37.8 升至 R=15 的 56.2，而最强基线 INSID3 仅从 36.1 升至 42.9；速度比 INSID3 快 2.1 倍。
AI.conclusion: 简单的联合 kNN 决策规则在免训练多类别上下文分割中即可超越复杂基线，并能有效利用更多参考图像，兼具准确率与效率优势。

title: EmoRouter: Adaptive Modality Cascading for Multimodal Emotion Recognition
comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
summary: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) involves detecting the underlying emotion behind each utterance within a conversation, which is essential for emotionally aware human-computer interaction. While omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) demonstrate strong capability for MER by jointly processing modalities including text, audio, and vision, different modality combinations yield different prediction outcomes across utterances: acoustic and visual inputs can help recover annotated labels missed by text-only inference, but can also turn correct predictions into errors. Processing all modalities for every utterance is also computationally expensive. To this end, we introduce EmoRouter, a training-free, model-agnostic framework for adaptive modality cascading that selects an exit tier for each utterance along a predefined modality order. The routing is guided by prediction-uncertainty estimates derived from Conformal Prediction. EmoRouter routes each utterance through a sequence of increasing-cost modality levels and exits at the first level when the model is confident in the emotion. To determine when to exit, we propose Conformal Set Contraction, a structural calibration criterion that calibrates the per-tier CP error budgets used for these exit decisions. Comprehensive evaluations on 4 MER benchmarks and 3 Omni-LLMs reveal that EmoRouter matches or outperforms the full modalities while reducing inference latency by 67.9--94.5%. Furthermore, EmoRouter demonstrates high transferability across different models, validating its robustness. Code is available at https://github.com/tianyi-lab/EmoRouter.

AI.tldr: EmoRouter：面向全模态大模型情感识别的免训练自适应模态级联框架，基于共形预测的不确定性估计为每条话语选择退出层级，在匹配或超越全模态性能的同时将推理延迟降低67.9–94.5%。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感识别中，不同模态组合各有优劣：声学与视觉输入既能纠正纯文本推理漏掉的标注，也会把正确预测变成错误；同时对每条话语处理所有模态计算代价高昂。因此需要按需、自适应地使用模态。
AI.method: 提出免训练、模型无关的EmoRouter框架：沿预定义模态顺序（由低成本到高成本）构造级联层级，对每条话语逐级路由，若模型对情感判断足够自信则在首个满足条件的层级退出。退出判断依据共形预测(Conformal Prediction)导出的预测不确定性估计，并提出Conformal Set Contraction作为结构化的校准准则，用于校准各层级CP误差预算。
AI.result: 在4个MER基准和3个Omni-LLM上评测，EmoRouter匹配或超过使用全部模态的效果，推理延迟降低67.9–94.5%；并展现跨模型的高迁移性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应模态级联是提升Omni-LLM多模态情感识别效率的有效途径；免训练、模型无关的设计加上基于共形预测的校准退出机制，可在保持性能的同时显著降低计算开销，并具备良好可移植性。

title: Beyond Single-Turn Privacy: Training-Data Leakage in Conversational RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is known to reduce training-data leakage in single-turn interactions, but whether this protection persists over multi-turn conversations is unclear. We introduce CRELT (Conversational RAG Extraction Leakage Trajectory), a reusable framework that tracks, turn by turn, the real contact details from the training data that a RAG system discloses. CRELT separates retrieval, conversation history, and attack strategy through a full-factorial design, uses a retrieval corpus verified to contain none of the target PII, and counts an item as leaked only when it is absent from the model input at the turn it is produced. In our main experiment, this criterion excludes 29-53% of raw matches that were already present in the input. Across GPT-J-6B, Pythia-6.9B, and Pythia-12B, targeting real Enron contact details, retrieval reduces disclosure under both full and cleared history, consistent with prior single-turn results. A length-matched control with random passages reproduces 91-99.5% of this reduction under cleared history and 47-78% under full history, so much of it comes from the added context rather than from what is retrieved. With retrieval enabled, however, retaining full conversation history increases disclosure by a factor of 3.6-4.9, while retaining only one previous turn already restores disclosure to approximately the full-history level. With retrieval, clearing the history reduces disclosure by 72-79%, but does not eliminate it. These results show that single-turn privacy audits can substantially underestimate training-data leakage in conversational RAG systems and that conversation-history policy is a critical dimension of privacy evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出CRELT框架追踪多轮对话RAG中训练数据PII泄露轨迹，发现检索降低披露多来自上下文长度而非检索内容，而保留对话历史会使泄露放大3.6-4.9倍。
AI.motivation: 以往研究只证明RAG在单轮交互中能减少训练数据泄露，但多轮对话下这种保护是否持续未知；单轮隐私审计可能严重低估对话式RAG的泄露风险。
AI.method: CRELT框架逐轮追踪RAG系统披露的真实联系人信息（Enron数据）。通过全因子设计分离检索、对话历史与攻击策略三个因素；使用经核验不含目标PII的检索语料；仅当某条目在生成轮次的模型输入中不存在时才计为泄露（该严格判据排除29-53%的原始匹配）。在GPT-J-6B、Pythia-6.9B、Pythia-12B上实验，并设随机段落长度匹配对照组。
AI.result: 检索在完整与清空历史下均降低披露，与单轮结果一致；但长度匹配随机段落对照复现了清空历史下91-99.5%、完整历史下47-78%的降幅，说明降幅主要源于新增上下文而非检索内容。启用检索时，保留完整历史使披露增加3.6-4.9倍；仅保留上一轮即可恢复到接近完整历史水平。清空历史使披露降低72-79%但未消除。
AI.conclusion: 单轮隐私审计会显著低估对话式RAG的训练数据泄露；对话历史策略是隐私评估的关键维度，需纳入多轮视角的审计。

title: Nearly Minimax-Optimal Sample Complexity of Natural Policy Gradient with a Matching Information-Theoretic Lower Bound
summary: A fundamental question in reinforcement learning is how many sampled transitions are needed to learn a near-optimal policy, and whether direct policy optimization can attain this statistical limit. To answer this question, we consider natural policy gradient (NPG), a widely used policy optimization method. We study tabular finite-horizon Markov decision processes (MDPs) with known rewards and unknown horizon-dependent transition kernels, accessed through a generative model. Our sample-based NPG algorithms update the policy by backward sweeps and do not estimate transition probabilities. Under three different batch-size and step size schedules, we establish last-iterate guarantees with sample complexity $\widetilde O(SAH^4/\varepsilon^2)$, where $S$, $A$, and $H$ denote the number of states, the number of actions, and the horizon length, respectively. In this setting, horizon-dependent transition kernels contribute a factor of $H$ to our transition-query bound. Our information-theoretic lower bound of $Ω(SAH^4/\varepsilon^2)$ shows that the resulting $H^4$ dependence is unavoidable in the worst case, even for agents that select their queries adaptively. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first last-iterate guarantees for NPG whose sample complexity matches an information-theoretic lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Consequently, our results demonstrate that direct policy-space optimization through NPG can achieve the fundamental statistical limits of reinforcement learning while guaranteeing the performance of the final policy. Furthermore, for known kernels, we prove that exact NPG with a constant step size $η=1/H$ requires $Ω(H^2/\varepsilon)$ iterations in the worst case, matching the known upper bound for that step size.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于生成模型的表格型有限时域MDP，证明自然策略梯度（NPG）在三种批量/步长方案下的样本复杂度为 Õ(SAH⁴/ε²)，并给出 Ω(SAH⁴/ε²) 的信息论下界，首次实现NPG的last-iterate保证达到统计极限。此外证明已知转移核时精确NPG（η=1/H）需要 Ω(H²/ε) 次迭代。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中的一个根本问题是：学习近优策略究竟需要多少采样转移，以及直接策略优化能否达到这一统计极限。作者希望回答NPG这类直接策略空间优化方法是否能同时达到统计下界并保证最终策略性能（last-iterate）。
AI.method: 考虑已知奖励、未知且依赖时段的转移核、通过生成模型访问的表格型有限时域MDP。设计基于采样的NPG算法：通过反向扫描更新策略，不估计转移概率。分析三种不同的批量大小与步长调度方案，给出last-iterate收敛保证，并构造信息论下界（允许查询自适应）。
AI.result: 在三种调度下均得到 Õ(SAH⁴/ε²) 的样本复杂度；下界为 Ω(SAH⁴/ε²)，说明 H⁴ 依赖在最坏情况下不可避免（时变转移核带来一个 H 因子）。这些是首批样本复杂度在对数因子内匹配信息论下界的NPG last-iterate保证。对已知转移核，证明精确NPG在 η=1/H 时最坏情况需 Ω(H²/ε) 次迭代，与已有上界匹配。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明通过NPG进行直接策略空间优化可以达到强化学习的根本统计极限，同时保证最终策略性能；采样型NPG无需估计转移概率即可达到最优样本复杂度，且其迭代复杂度在常数步长下也是紧的。

title: Robust Trajectory Prediction Under Sensing and V2X Noise: Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies
summary: Anticipating the future behavior of surrounding objects is key for the safe and efficient navigation of autonomous vehicles. State-of-the-art Transformer-based interaction-aware trajectory prediction models are typically trained and evaluated on large-scale, highly curated datasets obtained by filtering any object detection and tracking noise through extensive offline post-processing. However, in real-world deployments, the detected objects' state (position, heading, and speed) estimates are inherently affected by sensing and localization uncertainties. These uncertainties can be even higher for connected and automated vehicles receiving information from other road users through Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communications. In this paper, we first investigate the sensitivity of five state-of-the-art Transformer-based interaction-aware trajectory prediction models to realistic noisy object state estimates. Numerical results show that prediction accuracy degrades by up to a 6x factor as the noise level increases, highlighting the models' sensitivity to the mismatch between the noise conditions encountered during training and those experienced at deployment. We then show that retraining models on a more realistic noise-augmented dataset is a more effective strategy to mitigate the impact of noisy object state estimates on trajectory prediction accuracy than using denoising modules at the input. Retrained models limit the prediction accuracy degradation below a 1.5x factor. The noise-augmented dataset is openly released to support further research.

AI.tldr: 研究了Transformer交互感知轨迹预测模型对真实噪声物体状态估计的敏感性，发现预测精度可下降达6倍；通过对噪声增强数据重训练可将退化限制在1.5倍以内，优于输入端去噪模块。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer轨迹预测模型在高度精选、经离线后处理过滤噪声的大规模数据集上训练评估，但真实部署中检测物体状态（位置、朝向、速度）受感知与定位不确定性影响，V2X场景下更严重，存在训练与部署噪声条件不匹配问题。
AI.method: 首先评估五种先进Transformer交互感知轨迹预测模型对真实噪声物体状态估计的敏感性；然后对比两种缓解策略：在输入端加入去噪模块，以及在噪声增强数据集上重训练模型。
AI.result: 随着噪声水平增加，预测精度最多下降达6倍，显示模型对训练与部署噪声不匹配高度敏感；在噪声增强数据上重训练的模型将精度退化限制在1.5倍以内，效果优于输入端去噪模块。
AI.conclusion: 在更真实的噪声增强数据上重训练是缓解噪声物体状态对轨迹预测影响更有效的策略，且公开释放噪声增强数据集以支持后续研究。

title: NoHairCache: Calibrate-Once KV Cache Eviction with One Power-Law Exponent
summary:
The decay exponent $α$ in KV-cache eviction is an intrinsic property of the model: calibrated once on a single corpus, it transfers directly across domains. Attention-based accumulation (H2O) and recency-based sliding windows (StreamingLLM) are two dominant eviction frameworks, often treated as unrelated, but we show that they are the two endpoints of a single power-law family: by scoring each token as $s_i = A_i \cdot (t-i)^{-α}$, where $A_i$ is cumulative attention and $α$ controls the age penalty, H2O and StreamingLLM correspond to $α=0$ and $α\to\infty$, respectively (with StreamingLLM additionally hard-coding an attention-sink patch).
  The no-hair mechanism of \citet{xiang2026nohair} bounds the admissible range of $α$, and the measured exponents agree: calibrating once on WikiText yields $[0.556, 0.822]$ for a representative model (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct). The per-model ranges are consistent across five models (410M--1.5B) and independently match the optimal regions from perplexity sweeps.
  \textsc{NoHairCache} achieves the lowest perplexity across three datasets (WikiText, PG19, and arXiv) without per-dataset tuning, outperforming both H2O and StreamingLLM ($p < 0.05$ on all three datasets, with $0.06$--$0.10$ PPL gains over StreamingLLM at budget $512$). On downstream four-way multiple-choice QA, it matches or outperforms StreamingLLM across all nine (task, budget) cells, retaining $98.2\%$ of full-cache accuracy on NarrativeQA at $25\%$ retention versus $91.1\%$ for StreamingLLM; per-cell McNemar tests are not significant, so QA is corroborating only. We release our calibration script and drop-in scorer upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一视角：H2O（注意力累积）与StreamingLLM（滑窗/recency）是幂律评分 $s_i=A_i(t-i)^{-\alpha}$ 的两个端点，衰减指数 $\alpha$ 是模型固有属性、单次校准可跨域迁移；据此提出 NoHairCache，在三个数据集上PPL最优且无需逐数据集调参。
AI.motivation: KV-cache 驱逐中基于注意力的 H2O 与基于近期性的 StreamingLLM 长期被视为互不相干的两类方法；作者希望说明二者同属一个幂律家族，并利用模型内在的衰减指数 α 实现免调参的通用驱逐策略。
AI.method: 以 $s_i=A_i\cdot(t-i)^{-\alpha}$ 对 token 打分（$A_i$ 为累积注意力，$\alpha$ 控制年龄惩罚），H2O 对应 $\alpha=0$、StreamingLLM 对应 $\alpha\to\infty$（另加 attention-sink 补丁）；借助 Xiang 2026 的 no-hair 机制约束 $\alpha$ 的可行区间，在 WikiText 上一次性校准，得到 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 的 $[0.556,0.822]$，并在 5 个模型（410M–1.5B）上验证跨模型一致性，与 PPL 扫描的最优区域独立吻合；据此构造 NoHairCache。
AI.result: 在 WikiText、PG19、arXiv 三个数据集上取得最低困惑度且无需逐数据集调参，均显著优于 H2O 与 StreamingLLM（$p<0.05$；预算 512 时相对 StreamingLLM 提升 0.06–0.10 PPL）；下游四选一 QA 在全部 9 个（任务，预算）单元中持平或更优，NarrativeQA 保留 25% 时保持 98.2% 全缓存精度（StreamingLLM 为 91.1%），但逐单元 McNemar 检验不显著，仅为佐证。
AI.conclusion: KV-cache 驱逐可由单一幂律评分统一刻画，衰减指数 α 是模型固有、可一次校准跨域迁移的属性；NoHairCache 以极简的免调参实现同时优于两类主流基线。QA 结果为佐证性证据，作者将在发表时开源校准脚本与可直接替换的打分器。

title: DiscernBench: Evaluating Cooperative Discernment of LLM Agents in Institutional Settings
comment: 33 pages, 11 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB)
summary: The deployment of large language models in operational settings demands evaluation of judgment under institutional constraint. We introduce DiscernBench, a benchmark for evaluating cooperative discernment: the ability of an agent to determine whether to comply with, refuse, or escalate a request in an institutional setting. DiscernBench comprises scenarios derived from real-world incident reports across domains such as aviation, law enforcement, and emergency management. We evaluate eight LLMs across three decision-making configurations and analyze both final decisions and the intermediate judgments produced during multi-agent deliberation. Under disagreement, Final Responders exhibit model- and role-dependent aggregation patterns in which a lone specialist recommendation can disproportionately influence the collective decision, a phenomenon we term Minority-Signal Override. Role-specialized multi-agent deliberation raises average over-escalation from 3.79% under direct single-agent judgment to 28.27%, with the direction and magnitude of minority-signal influence varying substantially across models and specialist roles. These results reveal distinct collective decision behaviors that are not captured by final-answer accuracy alone. Trustworthy multi-agent systems therefore require evaluating not only individual specialist reasoning, but also how conflicting judgments are transformed into collective decisions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Disha1001/DiscernBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 DiscernBench 基准，评估 LLM 智能体在机构约束下对请求"服从/拒绝/上报"的合作辨识能力，并揭示多智能体审议中的"少数派信号覆盖"现象。
AI.motivation: LLM 进入实际运营场景后，需要在机构规则约束下做出判断，但现有评测多只看最终答案准确率，忽略了专家冲突如何转化为集体决策。
AI.method: 构建源自航空、执法、应急管理等真实事件报告的 DiscernBench 场景；评测 8 个 LLM 在 3 种决策配置下的表现，分析最终决策与多智能体审议的中间判断；在分歧条件下考察聚合模式与角色专业化效应。
AI.result: 在分歧时 Final Responder 呈现模型与角色相关的聚合模式，单个专家建议可不成比例地影响集体决定（少数派信号覆盖）；角色专业化多智能体审议将平均过度升级率从单智能体直接判断的 3.79% 提升至 28.27%，且少数派影响的方向与幅度因模型和专家角色而异。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭最终答案准确率无法刻画集体决策行为；可信多智能体系统需同时评估个体专家推理与冲突判断的聚合机制。

title: Aegis: A Conversational Prototype for Lung Cancer Risk Information and Follow-up
comment: 30 pages, including 12 pages of main text and references and 18 pages of supplementary material; 27 references. All authors contributed equally and share first authorship
summary: Collecting self-reported risk information and maintaining continuity between assessment, explanation, and follow-up are practical components of a lung cancer screening workflow. We present Aegis, a browser-based research prototype that combines a conversational questionnaire, rule-based risk categorization, downloadable reports, retrieval-augmented health information, and doctor-user communication. A session-oriented controller manages question progression and clarification, while a language model assists with answer validation. Structured responses are passed to a separate risk-analysis module, and reports are linked to user and session records through Firebase services. The project adopts a multi-agent design that separates information collection, validation, assessment, and report generation. Its documented verification scope comprises 45 functional test specifications covering account management, questionnaire interaction, reporting, doctor-side review, and consultation. The available evaluation describes workflow behavior qualitatively; it provides no per-case execution results, clinical cohort, predictive-performance measurements, or comparative experiments. We therefore present Aegis as an engineering prototype for organizing risk information and follow-up, with clinical validity and the benefits of its agent-based design remaining unestablished. The paper describes the implementation, distinguishes implemented workflows from incomplete extensions, and identifies the evidence required for reproducible and clinically meaningful evaluation.

AI.tldr: Aegis是一个基于浏览器的多智能体肺癌筛查研究原型，整合对话式问卷、规则化风险分级、可下载报告、检索增强健康信息与医患沟通功能；但其评估仅停留在定性工作流层面，缺乏临床队列、预测性能与对照实验，临床有效性尚未确立。
AI.motivation: 肺癌筛查工作流需要采集自报风险信息，并在评估、解释与随访之间保持连续性。现有实践在信息组织与随访衔接上存在工程层面的需求，因此作者构建Aegis以整合这些环节。
AI.method: 采用多智能体设计，将信息采集、答案验证、风险评估与报告生成分离：会话式控制器管理问题推进与澄清，语言模型辅助答案校验，结构化回答交由独立规则化风险分析模块处理，报告通过Firebase与用户及会话记录关联，并提供检索增强的健康信息与医生—用户沟通。
AI.result: 验证范围记录为45项功能测试规范，覆盖账户管理、问卷交互、报告生成、医生端复核与咨询；评估仅定性描述工作流行为，未提供逐案例执行结果、临床队列、预测性能指标或对照实验。
AI.conclusion: 作者将Aegis定位为组织风险信息与随访的工程原型，明确区分已实现流程与未完成扩展，并指出可复现且具有临床意义评估所需的证据；其临床有效性与多智能体设计的收益仍未得到证实。

title: CivilCADBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Understanding, Reconstructing, and Designing Civil Engineering Drawing Sets
summary: Civil infrastructure is designed, built, and maintained through engineering drawing sets, yet preparing and revising them remains labour-intensive and calls for automation. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are promising candidates, but assessing them requires a benchmark grounded in real engineering practice. We introduce CivilCADBench, a benchmark for understanding, reconstructing, and designing civil engineering drawing sets, built from real infrastructure drawings and source CAD files containing over 250,000 CAD entities. Unlike parametric 3D CAD models, these drawings are dense, layered, and multi-sheet; and since prints are lossy projections with no pixel trace of layers, a file can print correctly yet remain wrongly organised. CivilCADBench comprises three task families of increasing difficulty: understanding tasks are evaluated with 2,183 expert-reviewed questions ranging from single sheets to whole sets, while reconstruction and design tasks are agentic, requiring models to rebuild printed pages as editable CAD files, either as single pages or entire drawing sets, and to produce new designs. These tasks are performed across 232 pages, 28 sets, and 19 design tasks, and evaluated by a deterministic scorer that compares model outputs with the designers' source files on geometry, layers, text, and dimensions. We evaluate seven frontier MLLMs on CivilCADBench, and find that they read and redraw printed content accurately but recover the file structure poorly: the best model scores above 90% in understanding and single-page reconstruction, yet only 60% on layer assignment and 48% on design. Grounded in real engineering practice, CivilCADBench exposes both the capabilities and the limitations of frontier models in professional civil engineering, laying a foundation for next-generation models and agentic systems for intelligent civil engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CivilCADBench，一个基于真实土木工程图纸与源 CAD 文件（超 25 万个 CAD 实体）构建的基准，用于评估多模态大模型对工程图集的"理解—重建—设计"能力，并揭示前沿模型能准确读图重绘，却难以恢复图层等文件结构。
AI.motivation: 土木基础设施依托工程图纸设计与维护，制图与改图高度依赖人工，亟需自动化。MLLM 是潜在方案，但缺乏贴近真实工程实践的评测基准。与参数化 3D CAD 不同，工程图纸密集、分层、多图幅，且打印件是无损图层信息的投影，文件可能"打印正确但组织错误"，因此需要专门基准检验模型是否真正理解图纸组织结构。
AI.method: 构建 CivilCADBench，包含难度递增的三类任务：（1）理解任务——2,183 道专家审核问题，覆盖单张图幅到整套图集；（2）重建任务——智能体式，要求模型将打印页面重建为可编辑 CAD 文件（单页或整套）；（3）设计任务——生成新设计。任务覆盖 232 页、28 套图、19 个设计任务，并用确定性评分器在几何、图层、文字、标注四方面与设计师源文件比对评分。评测 7 个前沿 MLLM。
AI.result: 前沿模型能准确阅读并重绘打印内容：最佳模型在理解任务和单页重建上得分超过 90%，但在图层分配上仅约 60%，设计任务仅约 48%。
AI.conclusion: CivilCADBench 扎根真实工程实践，同时暴露了前沿模型在专业土木工程中的能力与局限，为下一代智能土木工程模型与智能体系统奠定评测基础。

title: Urban State Representation for Autonomous Mobility: A Survey of Multimodal Perception, Architectures, Datasets, and Benchmarks
comment: Accepted to the UrbanState Workshop at WACV 2027. 8 pages + references + 5-page supplementary appendix. Code and data: https://github.com/binayksingh/Awesome-Urban-State-Representation
summary: Cities are sensed by many platforms at once: on-board cameras, LiDAR and radar on autonomous vehicles, roadside units at intersections, drones and satellites overhead, and the GNSS traces of millions of trips. Yet most learned representations are built for one platform, one city, and one task. We survey this fragmented landscape through a single lens, the Urban State Representation (USR): a georeferenced, layered, time-varying, uncertainty-aware state that any sensing platform can write to and any downstream task can read from. We (i) formalize USR and five desiderata for it, and relate it to bird's-eye-view (BEV) features, occupancy, vectorized maps, neural fields and 3D Gaussians, scene graphs, road-network graphs, language tokens, and world-model latents; (ii) organize sensing platforms, cross-view (ground-aerial) matching, fusion operators, 3D geometric foundation models, end-to-end and vision-language-action models, and generative world models and data engines in one taxonomy that spans sensors to decisions; (iii) compile 26 urban datasets and simulators across ego, cooperative (V2X), aerial, trajectory, and language settings, with a metric glossary, a cross-benchmark results snapshot, a trend analysis, and a platform-coverage gap analysis; and (iv) review applications and propose, as an outlook, USR-5, a five-test protocol with explicit references and one aggregate score for measuring whether a state is shared, together with a research agenda of six open problems covering cross-city and cross-sensor transfer, uncertainty, efficiency, sim-to-real evaluation, and governance. This survey is an entry point for computer vision, autonomous driving, transportation, and urban computing researchers; the paper list, datasets, and USR-5 code are at https://github.com/binayksingh/Awesome-Urban-State-Representation.

AI.tldr: 该综述提出"城市状态表征"(USR)这一统一视角，整合多平台、多任务的城市感知与表征研究，并给出数据集汇编、基准分析和USR-5共享性评测协议。
AI.motivation: 城市被车载相机/激光雷达/雷达、路侧单元、无人机、卫星、GNSS轨迹等多平台同时感知，但现有学习到的表征大多局限于单一平台、单一城市和单一任务，呈现碎片化，缺乏可跨平台读写、跨任务复用的统一表征框架。
AI.method: 以USR（地理参照、分层、时变、不确定性感知的状态）为单一透镜进行综述：(i)形式化USR并给出五项设计准则，将其与BEV特征、占用、矢量化地图、神经场、3D高斯、场景图、路网图、语言token、世界模型隐变量等关联；(ii)构建从传感器到决策的统一分类法，涵盖感知平台、跨视角匹配、融合算子、3D几何基础模型、端到端与VLA模型、生成式世界模型与数据引擎；(iii)整理26个城市数据集与仿真器及指标词表、跨基准结果快照、趋势与平台覆盖缺口分析；(iv)综述应用并提出USR-5五测协议与六个开放问题。
AI.result: 汇编26个覆盖自车、V2X协同、空中、轨迹与语言场景的数据集/仿真器，提供指标词表、跨基准结果快照、趋势分析及平台覆盖缺口分析；提出带明确参照与综合评分的USR-5五测协议，并给出跨城市/跨传感器迁移、不确定性、效率、仿真到真实评测、治理等开放研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 本文作为面向计算机视觉、自动驾驶、交通与城市计算研究者的入门性综述，以USR统一碎片化格局，并通过开源论文列表、数据集与USR-5代码推动可共享的城市状态表征研究。

title: Population-Based Post-Training for Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is one of the most popular post-training paradigms for large language models. RLVR typically trains a single model under hyperparameters chosen before training begins, while researchers tune hyperparameters across consecutive runs. We introduce Population-Based Post-Training (PBPT), which trains several models in parallel and lets the training process do the tuning through population-based training. PBPT periodically evaluates models on a validation set. High-performers are duplicated and their hyperparameters perturbed to explore new configurations. Low-performers stop training and are replaced by these copies. On reasoning benchmarks (Enigmata, Nemotron) and interactive tool-use environments (Gaia2, AppWorld), PBPT produces stronger agents than compute-matched groups of independent RLVR learners. Furthermore, PBPT is able to recover from poor initial hyperparameters, automatically discovering better settings over the course of training.

AI.tldr: 提出PBPT（基于种群的训练后训练），并行训练多个模型并通过种群训练自动调超参，在推理与工具使用任务上优于同等算力的独立RLVR。
AI.motivation: RLVR通常用训练前固定的超参数训练单个模型，研究者只能在多次连续运行间手动调参，效率低且对初始超参敏感。
AI.method: PBPT并行训练多个模型：定期在验证集上评估；表现好的模型被复制并扰动其超参数以探索新配置，表现差的停止训练并被复制品替换，从而在训练过程中完成调参。
AI.result: 在推理基准（Enigmata、Nemotron）和交互式工具使用环境（Gaia2、AppWorld）上，PBPT训练出的智能体强于算力匹配的独立RLVR学习者组。此外，PBPT能从糟糕的初始超参数中恢复，在训练中自动发现更好设置。
AI.conclusion: 将种群式超参演化引入RLVR训练，可在不增加算力的前提下提升性能并增强对初始配置的鲁棒性。

title: When do stored facts become available in looped transformers?
summary: Looped transformers do not acquire new knowledge during a forward pass. Prior work shows that they store as many bits in their weights as non-looped models. It remains unclear how recurrence makes this knowledge available during inference. We study this question using synthetic factual recall and multi-hop reasoning, measuring depth-resolved readable information in bits with native readouts and tuned lenses. Under final-loop supervision, single-hop facts become readable progressively: heavier memorization loads delay retrieval despite comparable final readable information. Untied baselines of equal unrolled depth concentrate retrieval near the end of their stacks, whereas looped models expose facts earlier. This delay is not intrinsic to the tested recall tasks: training with supervision and depth-specific readouts at every loop makes near-final information readable after the first loop in all tested configurations. Representational analysis shows value-related structure emerging within states organized by the query key. We then study multi-hop chains whose facts are stored in the weights rather than given in the prompt. Intermediate entities become decodable in chain order, and aligned transitions show next-entity structure developing while current-entity structure remains dominant. Interventions in a released six-recurrence model establish a causal role for these representations. Counterfactual replacements of a probe-defined entity component at a single prompt position redirect downstream bridge entities and the final answer. Conversely, replacements from queries that reach the same entity through different preceding relations, preserving the remaining relation suffix, retain the original answer in over 99.5\% of tested cases. These results distinguish a training-dependent schedule for factual recall from the causal role of retrieved-entity representations in subsequent composition.

AI.tldr: 循环Transformer不做前向知识获取，但知识如何在推理中通过循环变得可用尚不清楚。本文用合成事实回忆与多跳推理任务，以比特为单位测量按深度的可读信息，揭示了"训练依赖的回忆调度"与"检索实体表示在下游组合中的因果作用"。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明循环模型权重中存储的信息位不亚于非循环模型，但不清楚循环（recurrence）如何在推理阶段使这些知识变得可利用。作者希望厘清循环结构在前向推理中"激活"权重的机制与时间/深度调度。
AI.method: 采用合成事实回忆与多跳推理任务；用原生读出（native readouts）和调优透镜（tuned lenses）测量按深度解析的可读信息比特数。对比同等展开深度的非共享（untied）基线。对每个循环加监督和深度特定读出以测试调度是否可训练依赖。进行表征分析，并在已发布的六次循环模型上做反事实替换的因果干预。
AI.result: 在仅最终循环监督下，单跳事实随深度逐渐可读；记忆负载越重，检索越延迟，尽管最终可读信息相当。非共享基线检索集中在堆叠末端，而循环模型更早暴露事实。若每个循环都在监督和深度特定读出下训练，首个循环后即可读出近最终信息（所有配置）。多跳链中中间实体按链序可解码；对齐转移显示下一实体结构发展但当前实体结构仍占主导。反事实替换单个位置的探针定义实体成分可改变下游桥实体与最终答案；而保留关系后缀、来自不同前序关系的替换在>99.5%情况下保持原答案。
AI.conclusion: 本文区分了两个层面：事实回忆的时间调度是训练依赖的（可由监督和深度读出改变），而检索实体表示对后续组合具有因果作用。循环并非固有延迟回忆，而是提供了一种可被训练塑形的信息可用性日程。

title: Stein Guidance without Gradients: Discretization Uniform Diffusion Inference Time Scaling beyond Particle SMC
summary: Reward-guided diffusion requires effective steering and correction of the bias introduced by approximate value functions. A Brownian example shows that SMC with full multinomial resampling at every step can require particle counts to grow linearly with guidance depth to maintain accuracy. We propose Stein Guidance, which combines derivative-free guidance with whole-path independence Metropolis-Hastings correction. Value-weighted selection from centered Gaussian candidates approximates gradient guidance in expectation, using as few as two queries per step. Centering stabilizes the local normalizer estimates, and the same queries yield an explicit path weight for correction. Under uniform value and spatial regularity bounds, we prove superpolynomial decay of finite-grid total variation error in the number of MH updates, with constants that do not grow with guidance depth. The error prefactor tends to zero as the value functions approach exact Doob values and the time grid is refined.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Stein Guidance 方法，结合无导数引导与整路径独立 Metropolis-Hastings 校正，解决 reward-guided diffusion 中因近似价值函数带来的偏差问题，在深引导下保持精度。
AI.motivation: Reward-guided diffusion 需要对近似价值函数引入的偏差进行有效的引导与校正。一个布朗运动例子表明，若每一步都做完整的多项式重采样，SMC 所需的粒子数会随引导深度线性增长才能维持精度，成本过高。
AI.method: 方法由两部分组成：(1) 从中心化高斯候选中按价值加权选择，期望意义上近似梯度引导，每步只需少至两次查询；(2) 利用同样的查询计算显式路径权重，配合整路径独立 Metropolis-Hastings 校正。中心化操作稳定了局部归一化估计。
AI.result: 在均匀价值界与空间正则性假设下，证明有限网格总变差误差随 MH 更新次数呈超多项式衰减，且常数不随引导深度增长；误差前置因子在价值函数趋近精确 Doob 值、时间网格细化时趋于零。
AI.conclusion: Stein Guidance 以极少查询实现有效引导，同时保证深度无关的校正精度，为 reward-guided diffusion 提供了理论与实用兼具的方案。

title: LITMUS - Literature Informed Testbed for Mapping Usecases and Synthesizing Risk-Cards
summary: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in real-world applications has heightened the need for systematic, safety-oriented deployment frameworks. Existing approaches typically prioritize the construction of datasets and risk cards around the LLM and AI architecture itself, yet they provide scant consideration for the specific use-case that drives model selection. This omission is problematic because any practical AI deployment begins with a detailed use-case description that informs the assessment of contextual hazards. In this paper, we introduce a structured pipeline that, given a use-case, automatically produces a tailored dataset and an accompanying risk card. The process ensures that identified risks are tightly coupled to the use-case, and it offers traceable evidence from peer-reviewed literature to substantiate each risk to use-case relationship. Prior claim-verification methods (FActScore, FactReasoner) have been validated for factual claims. Risk-relevance is a hypothetical claim about possible harm, and whether evidence retrieval can meaningfully assess such claims remains untested.
