Literature-Informed Testbed for Mapping Use-cases and Synthesizing (LITMUS) risk cards are the first systematic attempt to characterize this adaptation. We evaluated the pipeline using the MIT Risk Taxonomy and achieved a 0.91 F1-score with a list of 320 samples from the benchmark risk dataset that was considered. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in generating robust, evidence-based risk assessments for LLM deployments.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出LITMUS流水线：给定一个AI用例，自动生成定制化数据集和风险卡片，并将每个风险与文献证据关联，实现以用例为中心的、可溯源的安全部署风险评估。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM/AI安全部署方法主要围绕模型架构本身构建数据集和风险卡片，忽视驱动模型选择的具体用例。而实际部署始于详细用例描述，它决定上下文危险的评估；这一缺失导致风险评估与实际应用脱节。同时，证据检索能否有效评估"风险相关性"这类假设性伤害陈述尚未被验证。
AI.method: 提出LITMUS结构化流水线：输入用例，自动生成针对性数据集与风险卡片；将识别出的风险与用例紧密耦合，并提供同行评审文献的可溯源证据来支撑每条风险-用例关系。这是首个系统性地将既往事实核验方法（FActScore、FactReasoner）适配于风险相关性判断的尝试，并用MIT风险分类法进行评估。
AI.result: 在所考察的基准风险数据集的320个样本列表上，达到0.91的F1分数，表明该方法能有效生成稳健、基于证据的LLM部署风险评估。
AI.conclusion: 以用例为中心的文献证据驱动流水线可有效生成可溯源的风险评估，为LLM/AI的安全部署提供系统化框架。

title: SceneTether: Activity-Gated Value Anchoring for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Image Animation
summary: Long-horizon image animation must keep the scene fixed while natural material (e.g., water, smoke, or fire) continues to move. Autoregressive video generators read recent frames for temporal continuity, but this history also carries accumulated appearance errors, and sparsifying it disrupts motion. We introduce SceneTether, a training-free attention-read policy that keeps where attention reads recent memory but changes what appearance that memory returns. SceneTether keeps every key of the newest latent, blends its low-activity values toward co-located source-image values, and leaves high-activity values untouched so motion can evolve; an activity map estimated from the first generated latents and then frozen decides where to blend. It adds no denoising evaluations and leaves the cache-update rule unchanged. On a Causal Forcing++ generator, SceneTether raises source-support PSNR by 5.15 dB over its framewise Echo host across two seeds with 1.5x its late activity, and by 7.31 dB over spatial Echo-Forcing on a preselected four-minute subset. At equal recent-memory coverage, value anchoring alone adds 8.14 dB. A post-hoc pixel composite with the same map matches static fidelity but retains nearly twice the moving-region color drift, and viewers in a small blinded study preferred SceneTether for its natural scene and motion preservation. Project page: https://minar09.github.io/scenetether/

AI.tldr: SceneTether 是一种免训练的注意力读取策略，通过仅对低活动区域的 value 做向源图像锚定，实现长时程图像动画中静态场景保持与自然动态并存。
AI.motivation: 长时程图像动画需要场景固定而水、烟、火等材质持续运动。自回归视频生成器依赖近期帧维持时序连续性，但历史中累积了外观误差，稀疏化历史又会破坏运动质量。
AI.method: 保持注意力读取位置（近期记忆）不变，仅改变记忆返回的外观：保留最新 latent 的全部 key，将低活动区域的 value 向同位置的源图像 value 混合，高活动区域不改动以保留运动；活动图由最初生成的若干 latent 估计后冻结。方法不增加去噪次数，也不改变缓存更新规则。
AI.result: 在 Causal Forcing++ 上，相对逐帧 Echo 宿主在两个随机种子下源支持 PSNR 提升 5.15 dB（晚期活动量为其 1.5 倍），在预选四分钟子集上相对空间 Echo-Forcing 提升 7.31 dB；相同近期记忆覆盖下仅 value 锚定即带来 8.14 dB 提升。事后像素合成的静态保真度相当，但运动区域颜色漂移约为其两倍；盲测被试更偏好 SceneTether。
AI.conclusion: 外观误差主要来自 value 通道而非读取位置，因此仅锚定低活动区 value 即可在免训练、无额外计算开销的前提下同时提升静态保真度与运动自然度。

title: Improving semantic equivalence in research-level math formalization
comment: Accepted at the 6th Math-AI workshop at NeurIPS'26
summary: Formalizing mathematics in Lean is never a word-for-word translation of a paper: a Lean formalization changes definitions, strengthens hypotheses, splits arguments, and adds lemmas the paper never mentions. It stands to reason that a model that is good at autoformalization must be a good predictor of how a natural language source must differ from its faithful Lean formalization. With that in mind, we collect 4{,}076 audited examples of such changes from 832 Lean projects that formalize research-level mathematics, and use them to ask a practical question: how well can a model \emph{write} Lean inside a real research-level project that may contain tens of thousands of lines of code, and does training on discrepancies between natural language sources and their faithful Lean formalizations help? Our training set consists of 3{,}431 tasks from 141 repositories, and the test set consists of 645 tasks from the remaining 27 repositories. Training on in-project Lean nearly doubles complete proofs ($11\% \to 20\%$) and raises the share of statements in gold agreement with the project's own formalization by nearly a third ($30\%$ to $39\%$). The gain comes from the pairs themselves: an adapter trained only to predict how the Lean will differ, or a model told the difference in advance, barely helps. Training on where formalizations depart from their sources is thus an effective way of improving semantic equivalence in research-level formalization.

AI.tldr: 收集4076条真实Lean项目中文档与形式化差异样本，训练模型改编差异，使研究级项目中完整证明生成从11%升至20%、与项目黄金陈述一致率从30%升至39%。
AI.motivation: Lean形式化并非逐字翻译，会改动定义、加强假设、拆分论证、补充引理。作者由此假设：擅长自动形式化的模型应能预测自然语言源与忠实Lean形式化之间的差异，并探究这种差异训练能否提升在真实大型研究级项目中写Lean的能力。
AI.method: 从832个形式化研究级数学的Lean项目中收集4076条经审计的"源—形式化差异"样例；训练集为141个仓库的3431个任务，测试集为另外27个仓库的645个任务；对比训练于项目内Lean、仅预测差异的适配器、以及事先告知差异的模型等设置。
AI.result: 在项目内Lean上训练使完整证明率近乎翻倍（11%→20%），陈述与项目自身形式化达到一致的比例提升近三分之一（30%→39%）。增益主要来自差异对本身：只训练预测差异的适配器或事先告知差异的模型几乎没有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 训练模型关注形式化相对源文本的偏离之处，是提升研究级形式化语义等价性的有效方法。

title: Physical regime changes expose formula misuse in large language models
comment: 19 pages, 9 figures, 1 table; Supplementary Information appended. Code and data: https://github.com/acodercat/AtmosRegime
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly employed for scientific computing across the Earth and environmental sciences, but problems in these fields often involve distinct physical regimes. LLMs may fail to recognize these regime-dependent constraints, applying formulas outside their domains of validity and producing plausible but physically incorrect results. We systematically investigate these failures through controlled experiments and assess whether post-training can improve regime-aware reasoning. Across 72 physical mechanisms, we find frontier LLMs frequently misapply formulas outside their regimes of validity, reducing accuracy by 13-57 percentage points. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards enables Qwen3.5-9B to match DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) on regime-dependent tasks, but its effectiveness is limited by the formulas available in the base model. Combining supervised fine-tuning on a few worked examples with reinforcement learning improves accuracy by 61 percentage points, while distillation from a teacher supplied with the correct formula raises accuracy from 0% to 71%.

AI.tldr: 前沿LLM在科学计算中常把公式用到有效域之外，导致物理错误；通过SFT+RL或带正确公式的蒸馏可显著改善。
AI.motivation: 地球与环境科学的科学计算问题涉及不同物理机制（regime），LLM可能无法识别随机制变化的约束，滥用超出有效范围的公式，产生貌似合理但物理错误的结果。
AI.method: 系统性的受控实验：覆盖72种物理机制，测试前沿LLM的越域公式误用；并评估后训练方法（RLVR、SFT+RL、带正确公式的教师蒸馏）对机制感知推理的影响。
AI.result: 越域误用使准确率下降13–57个百分点；RLVR使Qwen3.5-9B在机制依赖任务上追平DeepSeek V4 Flash（284B），但受基座模型已有公式限制；少量示例的SFT加RL提升61个百分点；带正确公式的教师蒸馏使准确率从0%升至71%。
AI.conclusion: LLM的机制感知能力是科学计算的关键短板，且可改善；RL效果受限于基座知识，结合SFT或公式供给可大幅提升。

title: Operational Runbooks as Living Documents: A Longitudinal Study of Document Evolution under Assisted Post-Incident Revision
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the 2026 ACM Symposium on Document Engineering (DocEng 2026). Includes appendices
summary: Operational runbooks increasingly function as living documents within operational workflows: they are maintained by people, used in incident support, and continuously revised as organizational knowledge changes. Yet little is known about how such document collections evolve over time in production settings, or which interpretable signals are useful for monitoring document change. We analyze 17 weeks of version-controlled runbook snapshots produced during post-incident revision with machine-assisted review and human oversight. We quantify document evolution using lightweight linguistic and structural signals grounded in prior work on procedural language, technical communication, and document organization. Correlation analysis shows mixed patterns of association, including both positive and negative relationships, with effect sizes ranging from negligible to moderate and varying across corpora. Temporal summaries further distinguish comparatively stable signals from revision-sensitive ones, supporting monitoring of document maintenance workflows rather than one-shot quality judgments. An illustrative analysis on public GitHub product documentation shows that signal behavior differs across corpora, reinforcing the need for context-aware interpretation. These results identify which metric classes provide stable anchors and which provide edit-sensitive indicators for managing operational documentation as an engineered document resource.

AI.tldr: 分析17周版本控制的runbook快照，量化文档演化中的轻量语言与结构信号，区分稳定锚点与编辑敏感指标，强调上下文相关的解释。
AI.motivation: 运维runbook作为"活文档"在生产中持续被维护与修订，但学界对其在真实环境中如何随时间演化、哪些可解释信号可用于监控文档变化知之甚少。
AI.method: 采集事故事后修订过程中产生的17周版本控制runbook快照（机器辅助审查+人工监督）；基于程序性语言、技术写作与文档组织等既有工作，构建轻量语言与结构信号进行定量化；采用相关分析与时间汇总分析；并在公开GitHub产品文档上做示例性对比分析。
AI.result: 相关性呈现正负混合模式，效应量从可忽略到中等不等且随语料变化；时间汇总可区分相对稳定的信号与修订敏感的信号；GitHub文档示例显示信号行为跨语料存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出哪些指标类别可作为稳定锚点、哪些可作为编辑敏感指标，从而支持将运维文档作为工程化文档资源进行持续维护监控，而非一次性质量评判，并强调需上下文感知地解释信号。

title: Beyond Output Suppression: Mitigating Privacy Risks in LVLMs via Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure
summary: Large vision-language models can extract personally identifiable information from images, making privacy protection essential for their deployment in perception-oriented tasks. Existing targeted fine-tuning and model-editing methods usually suppress sensitive answers by aligning the model toward safe responses. In this paper, we show that such protection can be illusory: although the fine-tuned model refuses to disclose private information under normal decoding, privacy leakage still occurs in sentence completion scenarios. This indicates that existing algorithms only change the model's output distribution, but the model still retains the ability to perceive private information. Private information therefore still remains inside the model. To address this problem, we propose Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure (VIPE), which targets privacy-related visual representations to weaken the model's ability to perceive sensitive information. VIPE constructs paired privacy-sensitive and privacy-masked images, uses their internal feature residuals to identify privacy-related visual components, and suppresses these components before they are perceived by the model. To preserve benign visual representations, the erasure objective projects feature differences onto a relaxed benign subspace and adaptively controls the erasure strength. VIPE compels the model to ignore the extraction of sensitive information in the visual representation space, thereby blocking the source of privacy leakage more fundamentally rather than merely altering the model's output distribution. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA-OneVision show that VIPE substantially alleviates prefix-triggered privacy leakage while maintaining competitive utility on general visual-language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 现有微调/模型编辑方法只是让视觉语言模型"拒答"隐私问题，模型仍保留感知隐私的能力；VIPE 通过在视觉表征层面消除隐私相关信息，从源头阻断泄露。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型可从图像中提取个人可识别信息，现有定向微调与模型编辑方法通过让模型对齐安全回复来抑制敏感答案，作者指出这种保护是"虚假的"——在句子补全场景下仍会泄露隐私，说明这些方法只改变了输出分布，模型仍具备感知隐私信息的能力。
AI.method: 提出 Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure（VIPE）：构造隐私敏感图像与隐私遮蔽图像的配对，利用其内部特征残差定位隐私相关的视觉成分，并在模型感知前抑制这些成分；为保留良性表征，将擦除目标投影到松弛的良性子空间，并自适应控制擦除强度。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL 和 LLaVA-OneVision 上，VIPE 显著缓解了前缀触发（prefix-triggered）的隐私泄露，同时在通用视觉语言基准上保持有竞争力的效用。
AI.conclusion: 仅在输出层面进行对齐无法真正保护隐私；在视觉表征空间中擦除隐私信息能从更根本的源头阻断泄露，且不显著损害模型通用能力。

title: Grounding Collaborative Agents in Group Cognition
summary: Collaborative agents joining an ongoing team rely on shared context to connect multi-party interaction histories with downstream coordination decisions. Existing work typically focuses either on retrieving historical facts from conversation logs, which surfaces isolated evidence without capturing who knows or owns what, or on evaluating end-to-end interactions, which conflates preparation with execution and lacks direct supervision because a team's history has no single ground-truth summary. To bridge this gap, we formulate group briefing, the task of reconstructing task-relevant group cognition across participants' expressed beliefs, group dynamics, and grounding gaps, and introduce a four-domain benchmark of 1,351 requests and 9,975 verified reference points paired with a two-stage evaluation pipeline combining reference-point coverage and downstream collaboration simulation. Using this pipeline, we show that GroupBrief, a simple task-guided approach that iteratively probes the message history and synthesizes a structured brief without offline memory indexing or graph construction, outperforms ten retrieval and agent-memory baselines in overall coverage with gpt-5.4-mini, while benchmarking nine language models reveals that prospective friction remains harder to recover than past state across model scales. We further use reference-point coverage as a feedback signal for harness optimization, refining GroupBrief's retrieval and synthesis instructions while keeping model weights frozen. On held-out Test projects, GroupBrief (optimized) improves coverage by 2.54 percentage points for gpt-5.4-mini and 12.88 for gpt-5.6-luna, achieving 64.46% and 68.42% preference over no brief in downstream simulations. These results establish our benchmark and evaluation pipeline as a foundation for measuring and optimizing how collaborative agents ground in group cognition.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"group briefing"任务与四领域基准(1,351请求、9,975参考点)及两阶段评测,提出GroupBrief方法在覆盖率上超越十个基线,并以覆盖率为反馈信号做harness优化。
AI.motivation: 协作型agent加入进行中的团队需共享上下文,但现有工作要么只从对话日志检索孤立事实、无法刻画"谁知道/拥有什么",要么只端到端评估、混淆准备与执行且缺乏直接监督(团队历史无唯一真值摘要),因而需要新的任务与评测框架。
AI.method: 形式化group briefing任务:跨参与者表达信念、群体动态与grounding gap重建任务相关群体认知;构建四领域基准(1,351请求、9,975经验证参考点)与两阶段评测(参考点覆盖+下游协作仿真);提出GroupBrief——任务引导地迭代探测消息历史并合成结构化简报,无需离线记忆索引或图构建;并将参考点覆盖率作为反馈信号优化harness指令(冻结模型权重)。
AI.result: GroupBrief在gpt-5.4-mini下整体覆盖率优于十个检索与agent-memory基线;九模型对比显示前瞻性摩擦比过去状态更难恢复;优化后在Test项目上覆盖率分别提升2.54pp(gpt-5.4-mini)与12.88pp(gpt-5.6-luna),下游仿真中对无简报的偏好胜率为64.46%与68.42%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准与两阶段评测管线为衡量和优化协作agent如何ground于群体认知提供了基础。

title: Does a Frontier Large Language Model Know What It Can Solve? A 100-Conjecture Calibration Study
comment: Accepted at the 6th AI-Math Workshop at NeurIPS'26
summary: How does confidence correlate with actual performance in large language models, when attacking open research-level math problems? We address this question by studying the performance of ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Ultra on a set of 100 open conjectures in geometric analysis. By construction, the model first selected open problems in geometric analysis that it assessed that it had at least a 50\% chance of proving or disproving, and then assigned a probability of success to each question. 13 questions were then excluded after an audit, and the model was asked to resolve the remaining 87 problems. Its mean stated resolution probability was $0.617$, versus an observed rate of $0.103$ (Brier score $0.351$, ECE $0.513$), thereby demonstrating that the model was systematically over-confident in its self-assessment. However, the scores retained ranking signal (AUROC $0.714$). The model was highly overconfident in probability magnitude but did more often than not assign a high probability of success to the problems that it did resolve, than the problems that it did not. Hence, its probabilities were numerically mis-calibrated but directionally correct. All proofs have been formalized in Lean, thereby verifying correctness, and have been run through a semantic equivalence pipeline to ensure semantic equivalence between the formalized and informal statements. These are exploratory campaign outcomes, not fixed-budget success probabilities. The certificates prove formal statements; for a couple of questions, some geometric inputs are assumed in the lean proofs.

AI.tldr: 研究ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Ultra在100个几何分析公开猜想上的置信度与实际表现的相关性：模型自我评估平均成功概率0.617，实际解决率仅0.103，系统性过度自信，但概率仍保留排序信号（AUROC 0.714）。
AI.motivation: 探究大模型在面对开放研究级数学难题时，其自我报告的置信度是否与真实解题表现相符，即置信度校准问题。
AI.method: 构建100个几何分析公开猜想集合，模型先行筛选出其认为至少有50%把握证明或证伪的题目并给出成功概率；经审计排除13题后，对剩余87题进行求解。所有证明形式化为Lean以验证正确性，并通过语义等价流水线确保形式化陈述与原始非形式化陈述一致。
AI.result: 平均自评成功概率0.617，实际解决率0.103；Brier分数0.351，ECE 0.513，显示显著过度自信；但AUROC达0.714，表明概率保留排序信号，方向上正确（解决成功的题目更常被赋予高概率）。
AI.conclusion: 模型在概率数值上严重失准（数值误校准），但方向性正确；此类结果为探索性研究产出，而非固定预算下的成功率。Lean证书证明的是形式化陈述，且少数题目的证明中假设了部分几何输入。

title: Peel, Don't Whack: Partial Coverage, Imperfect Validators, and Intervention Based Shortcut Mitigation
summary:
Without group labels, shortcut mitigation increasingly relies on interventions : label-preserving edits, such as background or watermark replacement, that are proposed automatically and accepted by a validator. Invariance to a complete family of valid edits yields robustness, but in practice coverage is partial and validators err.
  We analyze both in a stylized linear model. For the population logistic solution and the max-margin limit of gradient descent, the decision on every shortcut-flip group follows one additive rule. Hence worst-group accuracy never decreases with coverage, while individual groups can provably degrade, a mechanism for the Whac-a-Mole effect; full coverage is not always needed. In the logistic regime the validator's false-accept rate must stay below a closed-form tolerance that grows with coverage. With noiseless training data, one false accept can make the max-margin solution ignore the core. In this model, sensitivity-based discovery removes shortcuts in decreasing salience. We also give a model-agnostic certificate, valid under content-independent validation, whose validator-error term comes from an audit.
  Simulations match the theory, and deep networks on synthetic and real images show the predicted Whac-a-Mole signs, monotone worst-group accuracy and validator fragility. The resulting procedure, Peel (Propose-Edit-Evaluate-Learn), can propose candidate edits from the model's own mistakes. Given an oracle library of the benchmarks' intervention operators, it selects the right ones and beats group-label methods on Waterbirds and UrbanCars. With fully generated edits, run end to end from three discovery seeds, it improves on empirical risk minimization (ERM) on five of six benchmarks but trails exact edits.

AI.tldr: 本文用线性模型系统分析"标签保持编辑"类捷径缓解方法的理论性质，提出Peel（Propose-Edit-Evaluate-Learn）流程，揭示覆盖度、验证器误接受与Whac-A-Mole效应的机制，并在真实图像基准上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 无组标签的捷径缓解依赖自动提出的标签保持编辑（如背景/水印替换）并由验证器接受。理想情况下对完整编辑族不变可获鲁棒性，但实际覆盖不完整且验证器会出错，对此缺乏理论理解。
AI.method: 在风格化线性模型中分析总体逻辑回归解与梯度下降max-margin极限，推导每个捷径翻转组的加性决策规则；分析验证器假接受率容忍度；给出基于审计的内容无关验证下的模型无关证书；据此设计Peel流程，从模型自身错误中提出候选编辑。
AI.result: 理论：最差组准确率随覆盖度单调不降，但个别组可退化（Whac-A-Mole机制），全覆盖并非必需；逻辑回归区假接受率须低于随覆盖度增长的闭式容忍值；无噪声数据下一次假接受即可使max-margin解忽略核心特征；基于敏感性的发现按显著性递减消除捷径。实验：仿真与深度网络复现预测符号；Peel用oracle编辑库在Waterbirds、UrbanCars上超过组标签方法；全自动生成编辑下六个基准中五个优于ERM，但不及精确编辑。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖度与验证器可靠性共同决定捷径缓解效果，最差组准确率对覆盖度单调但存在组间权衡；Peel提供了实用且可理论解释的无组标签捷径缓解方案，但全自动编辑质量仍逊于精确编辑。

title: Edit-Induced Dependency Mismatch: Propagation Omissions, Recovery, and Evaluation Blind Spots in Coding Agents
summary: During iterative code modification, coding agents may continue to rely in subsequent reasoning on outdated dependency judgments whose text remains fixed in the context, leading to errors in subsequent reasoning and leaving consumer defects undetected by the original task evaluations, thereby exposing blind spots in the tested benchmarks. We study actual agent execution trajectories collected on benchmark tasks: deepseek-v4-flash runs on DeepSWE and SWE-bench Verified, supplemented by Qwen3.8-Flash cases on FeatureBench. Focusing on edit-induced consumer obligations, a full-corpus blinded human audit of the DeepSWE runs identifies terminal mismatches, including diagnoses whose task scope remains disputed. Following supplementary execution checks, all retained DeepSWE terminal events have execution support. The audit also shows that recovery within a trajectory can coexist with terminal omissions in the same run. The process analysis links the presentation of relevant consumer code to explicit dependency judgments and subsequent synchronization actions recorded in the trajectories. An explicit dependency-review prompt reduces terminal omissions under the tested conditions, supporting re-derivation of consumer obligations after edits. Local replays of selected DeepSWE cases show that synchronizing the diagnosed consumers restores the target behavior while the listed controls continue to pass. Cross-benchmark execution counterexamples show that the original task evaluations do not fully detect edit-induced dependency mismatches: patches pass those evaluations, yet additional execution checks confirm unintended defects along existing consumer paths. These findings support measuring task scores, terminal propagation states, and recovery separately.

AI.tldr: 在迭代式代码修改中，编码智能体会继续依赖上下文中已过时（文本固定）的依赖判断，产生后续推理错误，并使缺陷逃过原有任务评估的检测。作者在DeepSWE、SWE-bench Verified与FeatureBench上审计真实执行轨迹，发现终态遗漏可构成基准盲区；显式依赖复查提示能减少遗漏，同步受影响的消费方代码可恢复目标行为。
AI.motivation: 智能体在多轮代码修改时，上下文中的依赖判断文本不会被自动更新，但后续推理仍会沿用这些过时判断，导致错误传播和消费方缺陷；而现有基准以任务得分（补丁通过评估）为唯一标准，可能无法检出"编辑诱导的依赖不匹配"，形成评测盲区。
AI.method: 对真实轨迹做过程分析：deepseek-v4-flash在DeepSWE与SWE-bench Verified上的运行，辅以Qwen3.8-Flash在FeatureBench的案例；聚焦"编辑诱导的消费方义务"，对DeepSWE全语料做盲法人审，识别终态不匹配；用补充执行检查为终态事件提供执行支持；将消费方代码呈现与显式依赖判断、后续同步动作做关联分析；测试显式依赖复查提示的效果；对选定案例做本地重放与对照，并做跨基准的执行反例验证。
AI.result: 盲审识别出终态不匹配（含任务范围存争议的诊断），经补充执行检查后所有保留的DeepSWE终态事件均有执行支撑；同一轨迹内可同时存在局部恢复与终态遗漏；消费方代码的呈现与显式依赖判断及后续同步行动相关；显式依赖复查提示在测试条件下减少终态遗漏；本地重放显示同步被诊断的消费方后目标行为恢复而列出的对照仍通过；跨基准反例显示补丁通过原评估却仍在既有消费方路径上留下意外缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 原始任务评估无法完全检出编辑诱导的依赖不匹配，基准存在盲区；应分别度量任务得分、终态传播状态与恢复情况；编辑后重新推导消费方义务（辅以显式依赖复查提示）是可行且有效的缓解手段。

title: ENGRAM: Reliability-Weighted Latent Fusion and Occlusion-Aware Layered Readout for Video World Models
summary: Camera-conditioned video world models aim to generate 3D-consistent videos from a single image along specified camera trajectories. However, set-union updates in latent spatial memory leave repeated observations unconsolidated, while frontmost-only readout limits simultaneous access to stored evidence at different depths. To address these limitations, we present ENGRAM, a latent spatial memory framework combining reliability-weighted latent fusion and occlusion-aware layered readout. Specifically, recursive fusion integrates geometrically and visually compatible observations in a channel-normalized latent space, consolidating repeated evidence into a shared scene representation. Layered readout exposes multiple depth-ordered latent candidates with their reliability and availability at each target cell. This gives the generator access to information from multiple surfaces as visibility changes. Explicit camera rays provide viewpoint information independently of memory coverage, while geometric consistency constraints guide memory updates. Memory retrieval uses a single projection at latent resolution, avoiding intermediate RGB rendering and VAE re-encoding. We adapt a pretrained video generator using only 256 training scenes. On 100 RealEstate10K test scenes, ENGRAM improves novel-view-synthesis and closed-loop PSNRs over Spatia by 0.82 and 4.48 dB, respectively. On a 200-case WorldScore evaluation subset, it achieves an average score of 67.78, exceeding Spatia by 3.31 points. Project page: https://wchkoutian.github.io/engram-website/.

AI.tldr: ENGRAM提出一种潜在空间记忆框架，通过可靠性加权融合与遮挡感知分层读出改进相机条件视频世界模型，在少量训练场景下显著提升新视角合成与闭环生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于潜在空间记忆的相机条件视频世界模型存在两点缺陷：集合式更新不合并重复观测，导致证据冗余未整合；仅读取最前表面前沿，无法同时访问不同深度的存储信息，限制了视角变化时的信息利用。
AI.method: 提出ENGRAM：1）递归潜在融合，在通道归一化潜在空间中按几何与视觉兼容性加权整合重复观测为共享场景表示；2）遮挡感知分层读出，按深度顺序提供多个候选及其可靠性与可用性；3）显式相机射线独立提供视点信息，几何一致性约束引导记忆更新；4）检索仅做一次潜在分辨率投影，避免中间RGB渲染与VAE重编码；仅用256个场景微调预训练视频生成器。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K的100个测试场景上，新视角合成与闭环PSNR分别比Spatia提升0.82 dB和4.48 dB；在WorldScore的200例评估子集上平均分67.78，较Spatia高3.31分。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合式记忆更新与分层遮挡感知读出，ENGRAM有效缓解了记忆冗余与前表面偏置问题，在极少训练数据下实现更强的三维一致性与生成质量。

title: HyperHarness: Learning to Generate Personalized Agent Harnesses from User Histories
summary: Personalized LLM agents rely on an agent harness, the surrounding memory and control code, to connect user history with downstream decisions. Existing methods typically employ either a single shared memory workflow across all users, which is efficient to deploy but cannot adapt how evidence is retrieved and interpreted across diverse histories, or per-user harness optimization, which customizes behavior for each user but requires costly repeated candidate evaluation at deployment and suffers from sparse, noisy supervision in raw logs. To address this trade-off, we present HyperHarness, a framework that learns a shared history-to-harness generator to synthesize executable, user-specific retrieval and answer-guidance code directly from user histories. Given a user's permitted history, HyperHarness prompts a construction LLM to write personalized retrieval and guidance functions, while downstream task scores across training users supervise iterative refinements to the shared generator without reference harnesses or answering-model updates. At deployment, the frozen generator constructs a harness for each unseen user in a single pass from history alone, eliminating per-user task-scored search. Across three benchmarks (PersonaMemv3, Mem-PAL, and MemoryCD) and three answering models (Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.8-27B, and GPT-5.6-Luna), HyperHarness achieves the highest aggregate score in seven of nine settings and ranks second in the remaining two, improving over the strongest baselines by up to 5.95 points while cutting matched answer-time tokens by 90.32% over long-context prompting. Analyses show that optimization tailors context allocation to each executor, transfers to unseen user clusters, and amortizes adaptation costs.

AI.tldr: HyperHarness 学习一个共享的"历史到 harness"生成器，直接根据用户历史合成可执行的个性化检索与回答引导代码，兼顾部署效率与个性化。
AI.motivation: 个性化 LLM agent 依赖 agent harness（记忆与控制代码）把用户历史与下游决策连接起来。现有方法二选一：全局共享单一记忆流程，部署简单但无法适配多样历史的证据检索与解读；逐用户优化 harness 虽个性化，但部署时需昂贵的重复候选评估，且原始日志监督稀疏、噪声大。
AI.method: 提出 HyperHarness：用构造 LLM 根据用户被允许的历史，写出个性化的检索函数与回答引导函数；训练阶段以下游任务分数作为监督，迭代改进该共享生成器，无需参考 harness，也不更新回答模型；部署时冻结的生成器仅凭历史一次前向即为新用户构造 harness，免去逐用户的任务打分搜索。
AI.result: 在 PersonaMemv3、Mem-PAL、MemoryCD 三个基准与 Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.8-27B、GPT-5.6-Luna 三个回答模型的九个设置中，七个取得最高综合分、其余两个排名第二，较最强基线最高提升 5.95 分；同等回答时相比长上下文提示减少 90.32% token。分析显示优化会按执行模型定制上下文分配、可迁移到未见用户簇，并摊销适配成本。
AI.conclusion: 以"学习共享生成器"替代"共享流程或逐用户优化"的二选一，可在单次前向中实现个性化 harness，既省去部署期搜索，又显著提升效果并大幅降低 token 开销。

title: EA-Bench: Measuring information and action efficiency under imperfect instructions
summary: Personal agents help users complete everyday work across digital applications. Many standard benchmarks assume that users provide sufficient information to solve a task. However, agents often encounter incomplete, distracting, or inconsistent information in practice. To systematically study agent inefficiency under such imperfect information, we introduce Efficient Action (EA)-Bench, which evaluates both tool calls and user interactions in work-related tasks. To our knowledge, it is the first benchmark to jointly evaluate tool-call efficiency and user-interaction efficiency under controlled missing, redundant, and conflicting information. We construct 63 base-task instances adapted from existing work-related benchmarks. To guide perturbation design and quantify task requirements, we represent workflows as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and examine node-level dependencies to identify where information can be withheld, contradicted, or supplemented with distractors. We use a two-stage validation process combining AI-assisted checks with expert screening to select 232 conditions from 792 initial candidates. We organize these tasks into Easy and Hard tracks by task complexity. Experiments show that imperfect information can reduce accuracy and increase tool-use and user-interaction costs. More concerning, several models obtain apparently correct outcomes by guessing user-specific values without confirmation, revealing potential execution unreliability in current models under imperfect user information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EA-Bench，首个同时评估工具调用效率与用户交互效率的基准，在受控的缺失、冗余和冲突信息下系统地研究个人智能体的低效与不可靠问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多假设用户提供充分信息，但实际中信息常不完整、含干扰或相互矛盾；缺乏在受控不完美信息条件下同时衡量工具调用与用户交互成本的标准评测。
AI.method: 从现有工作类基准改编63个基础任务实例，将工作流建模为DAG并分析节点级依赖，以确定何处可隐藏、矛盾化或加入干扰信息；经AI辅助检查与专家筛选的两阶段验证，从792个候选中选出232个条件，并按复杂度分为Easy/Hard两个赛道。
AI.result: 实验表明不完美信息会降低准确率并增加工具使用与用户交互成本；更值得关注的是，部分模型未经确认即猜测用户特定值，从而得到表面正确的结果。
AI.conclusion: EA-Bench揭示了当前个人智能体在不完美用户信息下的执行不可靠性，强调需同时关注效率与交互质量。

title: CLAIR: Consistent LLM Adaptation via Index-free Reprogramming
summary: Time-series forecasting with pretrained large language models (LLMs) uses contextualized patch representations, raising the question of how to align them. Matching patches at the same temporal position is natural, but self-attention allows each patch state to incorporate information from elsewhere in the input window, suggesting that useful correspondences can extend across positions. This flexibility, however, does not necessarily translate into consistent forecasts: similar patch states may play different roles when used in their original temporal order. To address both issues, we propose CLAIR (Consistent LLM Adaptation via Index-free Reprogramming), a teacher-guided framework that combines patch-level transport alignment (PTA) and forecast-level consistency (FC). A clean-view exponential moving average (EMA) teacher guides a mildly perturbed student, with PTA establishing soft, representation-dependent correspondences and FC encouraging agreement at corresponding future steps. The forecasting head retains the original patch order. We test this combination through controlled comparisons: while PTA and index-wise alignment perform similarly without FC, PTA+FC under EMA supervision reduces horizon-averaged mean squared error (MSE) by 2.1% on ETTh1 and 2.6% on ETTm1 relative to Index+FC. The same preference for PTA+FC emerges in comparisons with alternative matching strategies on Weather and ETTh2. Beyond these controls, CLAIR achieves the lowest horizon-averaged MSE on five of six long-term benchmarks and the lowest aggregate overall weighted average (OWA) on M4 among evaluated methods, with competitive few-shot performance. As the teacher and transport are used only during training, inference requires only the student.

AI.tldr: 提出 CLAIR，一种教师引导的无索引重编程框架，结合 patch 级最优传输对齐（PTA）与预测级一致性（FC），改进预训练 LLM 的时间序列预测适配。
AI.motivation: LLM 时间序列预测依赖上下文化 patch 表示，但如何对齐存疑：按时间位置匹配很自然，然而自注意力使 patch 状态跨位置融合信息，此类灵活对应未必带来一致预测——相似 patch 状态在原始时序顺序中角色可能不同。
AI.method: CLAIR 用干净视图的 EMA 教师引导轻度扰动的学生模型；PTA 建立基于表示的软对应（无需位置索引），FC 鼓励对应未来步的预测一致；预测头保留原始 patch 顺序。教师与传输仅在训练时使用。
AI.result: 对照实验中，无 FC 时 PTA 与逐索引对齐相近；加 FC 后，PTA+FC 相比 Index+FC 使 MSE 在 ETTh1 降 2.1%、ETTm1 降 2.6%，Weather 与 ETTh2 上同样偏好 PTA+FC。六个长期基准中五个取得最低平均 MSE，M4 上 OWA 最低，少样本表现有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 表示依赖的软对齐需与预测级一致性联合才能发挥优势；CLAIR 有效且推理仅需学生模型，开销可控。

title: MetaSkill: Reusable Problem-Solving Methods for Adaptive Skill Orchestration in LLM Agents
comment: 16 pages, including appendices. The MetaSkill library is provided as ancillary material
summary: Reusable skills provide specialized procedures, but large language model (LLM) agents must still determine how to organize and adapt their use. We introduce MetaSkill, a two-layer framework for reusing problem-solving methods across tasks and domains. The method layer selects from 26 curated methods and binds abstract roles to task objects. The execution layer uses the instantiated method to identify intermediate objectives, coordinate native skills, and guide repair or method reselection. On 89 SkillsBench tasks and 995 ToolHop examples, MetaSkill outperforms the evaluated baselines in all six configurations, with accuracy gains of 3.51-13.48% over the strongest baseline. Ablations support explicit method-guided orchestration beyond direct method injection and further gains from method reselection.

AI.tldr: MetaSkill 是一个两层框架，用于跨任务和领域复用问题求解方法，在 89 个 SkillsBench 任务和 995 个 ToolHop 样例上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体拥有可复用的专门技能（procedures），但仍需自行判断如何组织和调整这些技能的使用，缺乏显式的方法层指导。
AI.method: 两层框架：方法层从 26 个精选方法中选择，并将抽象角色绑定到任务对象；执行层利用实例化方法识别中间目标、协调原生技能，并指导修复或方法重选。
AI.result: 在 89 个 SkillsBench 任务和 995 个 ToolHop 样例的全部六种配置下均超过所评估基线，相对最强基线准确率提升 3.51%–13.48%。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验表明，显式的方法引导式编排优于直接注入方法，且方法重选能带来进一步收益。

title: Choose What Returns: Object-Aware KV Memory for Selective Recall in Interactive Video Generation
summary: Interactive long-video generation lets users build a story through successive prompts and reuse earlier characters and settings under new instructions. Existing memory methods retain past content, yet they often fail at precise selective recall, returning the wrong appearance of a person, mixing different people, or keeping an unrequested background. Based on our analysis of memory form and retrieval, we introduce an object-aware key--value (KV) memory framework for a frozen autoregressive diffusion generator. It keeps the original KV of tracked object regions, selects background KV outside them by attention-scores, and links each memory with a readable record of its source scene and observed appearance. An LLM selects the requested records, and a memory integrator supplies their KV for generation under the current prompt. We also introduce a six-scene evaluation that tests selective attribute modification, time-specific appearance recall, and multi-object composition, in which each person's requested past appearance changes across requests. Experiments show that our framework more reliably preserves each person's identity while reproducing their requested past appearance than existing memory methods, under both explicit scene references and natural-language cues.

AI.tldr: 提出对象感知键值(KV)记忆框架，让冻结的自回归扩散生成器在交互式长视频中精确选择性回忆指定人物/场景的过往外观。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆方法虽能保留历史内容，但无法精确选择性召回：可能返回人物错误外观、混淆不同人物，或保留未被要求的背景。
AI.method: 基于对记忆形式与检索的分析，构建对象感知KV记忆：保留被跟踪对象区域的原始KV，按注意力分数选取对象外背景KV，并将每条记忆与可读的源场景及观测外观记录关联；由LLM选择所需记录，记忆整合器在当前提示下提供其KV用于生成。另设计六场景评测，测试选择性属性修改、特定时间外观回忆与多对象组合。
AI.result: 在显式场景引用与自然语言线索两种设置下，相比现有记忆方法更可靠地保持各人物身份并复现其被请求的过往外观。
AI.conclusion: 对象感知KV记忆搭配LLM检索与整合，可显著提升交互式长视频生成的精确选择性回忆能力。

title: RES: Accelerating Diffusion Language Models with Rolling Entropy Sampling
summary: A diffusion language sampler makes two choices for every position in its denoising window: where the next token comes from, and when the position is committed to the KV cache. Using the entropy-bound sampler in DiffusionGemma, we study two extremes of the second choice. Committing each token as soon as it is accepted removes the chance to revise it, which hurts when the entropy bound is relaxed to trade accuracy for speed. When accepted tokens are frozen, macro accuracy falls from 73% to 20% as the bound is relaxed, while the unfrozen sampler stays near 70%. Committing a whole block at once wastes computation, since tokens converge in a largely left-to-right order and more than half of the window holds already-final tokens by twenty denoising steps. These findings motivate the Rolling Entropy Sampler (RES), which commits a contiguous accepted prefix once it reaches a minimum length and keeps positions farther ahead open to revision. Unlike earlier rolling samplers, RES runs on uniform diffusion, where accepted tokens can still change, and it needs no training. Across seven benchmarks, RES increases tokens per forward pass from 19.3 to 25.5, while macro accuracy goes from 80.7% to 78.8%, and it extends the speed-quality Pareto frontier beyond what tuning the entropy bound alone reaches.

AI.tldr: 本文分析扩散语言模型采样中"何时将token提交至KV cache"的问题，提出Rolling Entropy Sampler（RES）：当连续接受的前缀达到最小长度时即提交该前缀，后续位置保持可修改。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言采样器对每个位置需做两个选择：下一个token从何而来、何时提交到KV cache。现有两种极端做法各有缺陷：逐token立即提交会丧失修改机会，在放松熵界换取速度时准确率崩塌；整块一次性提交则浪费计算，因为token大致按从左到右顺序收敛，二十步时窗口内过半已定型。
AI.method: 在DiffusionGemma的熵界采样器上研究了两种提交策略的极端表现；基于token近似从左到右收敛的观察，提出RES：一旦连续接受前缀达到最小长度就提交该前缀，更靠前的位置继续保持可修订。与前人rolling sampler不同，RES运行在均匀扩散上（被接受token仍可变化），且无需训练。
AI.result: 冻结接受token时，随熵界放松宏观准确率从73%降至20%，而未冻结采样器稳定在约70%。RES在七个基准上把每次前向传播的token数从19.3提升至25.5，宏观准确率从80.7%降至78.8%，并拓展了速度—质量帕累托前沿，超出仅调熵界所能达到的范围。
AI.conclusion: 提交策略是扩散语言采样中被忽视的关键设计维度；冻结式提交导致质量崩溃，整块提交浪费算力，而前缀式滚动提交（RES）无需训练即可在准确率仅小幅下降下显著提速，并超越单纯调参的效率—质量权衡。

title: Guarding with Judgment: Learning to Intervene for Multimodal Safety
summary: When visual context makes an ordinary request unsafe to answer as asked, a blanket refusal may leave the user's need unresolved. Choosing how to help requires distinguishing an established hazard from a condition that still needs verification, a distinction that binary safety labels leave unspecified. We formulate this decision through four actions: allow, warn, review, and refuse. To ground these decisions in verifiable evidence, we build a corpus of 20,126 training audits and the JudiBench benchmark, connecting each action to diagnostic judgments, source evidence, and controlled context changes. Our guard, JudiAct, separately states what the source establishes, what condition governs the help, and how the rules apply. It then checks these three brief review items against the original inputs to predict diagnostic labels and a handling action. Supervised training learns individual judgments while comparing label assignments across related cases. A second stage swaps one review item at a time, using the resulting audit feedback to refine review generation. On JudiBench, JudiAct improves request and answer Macro-F1 by more than 28 percentage points over its 4B backbone. Across nine public benchmarks, it outperforms state-of-the-art guards on the mean delivered-answer score in both pre-generation and post-generation settings, cutting MM-SafetyBench attack success from 40.78% to 25.30%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出四类安全处理动作（allow/warn/review/refuse），构建了含20,126条审计的训练语料与JudiBench基准，并提出守卫模型JudiAct：显式陈述"来源证据、判断条件、规则应用"三项审核条目并与原始输入核验，在JudiBench上较4B骨干提升超28个百分点的Macro-F1，并在九个公开基准上优于现有守卫模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉上下文可能使普通请求变得不安全，但一刀切拒答会让用户需求无法解决；而二分类安全标签无法区分"已确认的危害"与"仍有待核验的情形"，因此需要更细粒度的处置决策与可验证证据支撑。
AI.method: 将安全处置形式化为allow/warn/review/refuse四动作；构建20,126条训练审计语料与JudiBench基准，把每个动作关联到诊断判断、来源证据和受控上下文变更。模型JudiAct分别陈述来源确立了什么、制约帮助的条件是什么、规则如何适用，并将三项审核条目与原始输入核验以预测诊断标签与处置动作。监督训练学习单项判断并跨相关案例比较标签分配；第二阶段逐项替换审核条目，用审计反馈改进审核生成。
AI.result: JudiBench上请求与回答Macro-F1较4B骨干提升超28个百分点；九个公开基准上，在生成前与生成后设置的平均交付答案得分均优于SOTA守卫；MM-SafetyBench攻击成功率从40.78%降至25.30%。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、证据可审计的处置决策优于二分类安全标签，显式审核轨迹加反馈式两阶段训练能显著提升安全守卫的实用性与鲁棒性。

title: How many mistakes does it take to learn an interval? Exact Littlestone dimensions of intervals and their unions
comment: 33 pages, 11 figures, 5 tables. Code and Lean 4 proofs: https://github.com/researchbackup27-sudo/exact-littlestone-intervals
summary: The Littlestone dimension of a hypothesis class equals the smallest number of mistakes an online learner can guarantee against an adaptive adversary. For discrete intervals and unions of $j$ intervals on $m$ points, only its order of growth was known. We determine it exactly. For every switch budget $k$ (with both end labels fixed when $k$ is odd), the smallest size on which $d$ mistakes can be forced follows a three-regime law: $d+1$ while $d\le k$, then $2d-k+1$, and beyond $d=\lceil 3k/2\rceil+k-1$ doubling the size adds exactly $k$ mistakes. Unions of $j$ intervals on $m$ points correspond to $k=2j$ and size $m+1$, and a single interval gives the thresholds $1,2,3,5,7,10,14,20,\dots$. The natural learner that waits for a positive example and binary-searches both endpoints is not optimal: it can be forced into one extra mistake for 50,847 of the domain sizes below $10^5$. Upper bounds come from a gap potential and a block-pairing learner, and lower bounds from adversary strategies and a refinement step. These tools give an explicit optimal learner with $O(\log m)$ time per round, which on random streams makes more mistakes on average than the natural learner. For randomised learners, we compute the randomised Littlestone dimension of thresholds exactly and prove that a greedy adversary forces an explicit closed-form number of expected mistakes on intervals; this bound is within $0.64$ of optimal and, we conjecture, exact (confirmed for $m\le70$). Exact computation tests every result, and the formulas for every switch budget are machine-checked in Lean 4.

AI.tldr: 本文精确刻画了离散区间及j个区间并集的Littlestone维数：对每个切换预算k，可强制d次错误的最小论域规模呈现三段式规律（d+1、2d−k+1、以及超过阈值后每倍增大恰好加k），并给出最优在线学习器与随机化版本的分析。
AI.motivation: 离散区间及区间并集的Littlestone维数此前仅有增长阶的估计，缺乏精确值；同时自然学习器（等正例+二分）是否最优未知。作者希望确定精确维数、刻画最优学习器，并研究随机化设定。
AI.method: 通过gap potential与block-pairing学习器给上界，通过对手策略与refinement步骤给下界，导出三段式精确公式；将j个区间对应k=2j、规模m+1；对随机化学习器计算阈值类的随机化Littlestone维数并构造贪心对手；用精确计算验证并以Lean 4机器检验公式。
AI.result: 得到每个切换预算k下的精确最小规模公式（含单区间阈值1,2,3,5,7,10,14,20,…）；证明自然学习器非最优（在10^5以下有50,847个规模可被多逼出一次错误）；给出O(log m)每轮时间的最优学习器（但随机流上平均错误更多）；随机化情形得到闭式期望错误数，与最优相差0.64以内且猜测精确（m≤70已验证）。
AI.conclusion: 完整解决了离散区间类Littlestone维数的精确刻画问题，阐明自然学习器次优，并提供可高效实现的最优学习器及随机化分析，所有结果经精确计算和Lean 4形式化验证。

title: Endpoint-Conditioned Process Value: What an Endpoint-Blind Process Score Adds Once Terminal Status and Cost Are Known
summary: Trajectory metrics promise information beyond final-answer accuracy, but no one has measured what a process score adds once an evaluation knows the outcome and the cost. We build that comparison: a sealed consequence needing an artifact neither agent nor judge ever sees, an operational baseline of terminal status and cost, and judge scale and evidence access as experimental factors. On 1,255 trajectories over 158 test-generation tasks in 7 Python repositories, the answer is gated on the judge. Four judges from 4B to 14B, one reasoning before scoring, add nothing an interval separates from zero; a Qwen3 32B judge on identical trajectories adds +0.050 AUC (95% CI [+0.020, +0.081]) and survives a refitting bootstrap ([+0.013, +0.095]). Most of what it adds is recoverable from eight behavioural counters, so a harness should log them (the judge adds +0.020 beyond them). What the judge is shown moves it further: disclosing the terminal verdict inflates its standalone discrimination by +0.103, while reference disclosure and tool-output redaction move it by nothing an interval separates from zero. A process metric reported without the judge's scale and evidence access does not identify a quantity. We release the protocol, the sealed-endpoint harness, and all trajectories.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统检验了：在评估已知任务结果（终态）和成本的情况下，轨迹过程分数是否还能提供额外信息。结论是这取决于评判模型——小模型（4B–14B）的增益与零无法区分，Qwen3 32B 才带来显著但有限的增益（+0.050 AUC），且大部分增益可由8个行为计数器复现。
AI.motivation: 轨迹指标被寄望提供超越最终答案正确率的信息，但此前无人测量：在评估中已经知道结果和成本之后，过程分数究竟还增加了什么。论文希望填补这一空白，明确过程指标的真实增量价值及其依赖条件。
AI.method: 构建对照实验框架：采用需生成智能体与评判者都看不到的产物的"密封终点"任务作为真实后果衡量；以终态状态和成本作为运行基线；将评判者规模与证据可见性作为实验因子。在7个Python仓库、158个测试生成任务、共1,255条轨迹上比较，使用4个4B–14B评判者（其中一个先推理再打分）与Qwen3 32B评判者，并进行自助重采样验证。
AI.result: 4B–14B评判者的过程分数增益的置信区间包含零；Qwen3 32B在相同轨迹上增加+0.050 AUC（95% CI [+0.020, +0.081]），重拟合自助法下为[+0.013, +0.095]，依然成立。该增益大部分可由8个行为计数器复现（评判者在其之外仅再增+0.020）。评判者所见内容影响显著：披露终态裁决使其独立判别力虚增+0.103，而参考解答披露与工具输出遮蔽的效应与零无法区分。
AI.conclusion: 过程指标的增益高度依赖评判者能力和证据可见性；脱离评判者规模与证据访问条件报告的过程指标无法界定为确定的量。作者发布协议、密封终点评测框架及全部轨迹，以提高可比性与可复现性。

title: Dynamics-Guided Conditional MeanFlow from Regional Interaction to Internal Revision and Its Application to CT Imaging
summary: Conditional image enhancement requires spatially varying corrections, yet fixed-depth models allocate similar computational budgets regardless of where additional refinement is needed. Although one-step flow models reduce inference costs and iterative restoration methods introduce subsequent corrections, how predicted transformation dynamics can guide internal feature refinement remains underexplored. We introduce IRCMF, a dynamics-guided Conditional MeanFlow framework that combines regional interaction with recurrent internal revision. The decoder predicts signed interval velocity and a learned velocity-change cue. A soft-region graph aggregates contextual information for velocity estimation, while a dynamics-conditioned graph establishes regional relationships to guide recurrent bottleneck updates. The revised features are processed by the shared decoder to recompute velocity, establishing feedback between transformation dynamics and internal representations. An actor-critic policy controls regional updates and further revisions to balance enhancement quality and computational cost. We evaluate IRCMF on two computed tomography (CT) datasets, NLST for STANDARD-to-LUNG kernel enhancement and LDCT-and-Projection-data for simulated low-to-routine-dose enhancement. With nine decoder evaluations, IRCMF achieves slice-level PSNR of $36.24 \pm 3.49$ dB and SSIM of $0.97 \pm 0.01$ on NLST, and PSNR of $32.45 \pm 1.97$ dB and SSIM of $0.84 \pm 0.05$ on LDCT-and-Projection-data. The learned policy reduces average decoder evaluations to 4.42 and 3.45, respectively, lowering per-slice latency from 97.00 to 51.82 ms and from 97.12 to 41.95 ms, with PSNR reductions of only 0.20 and 0.06 dB.

AI.tldr: 提出 IRCMF，一种动力学引导的条件均值流框架，结合区域交互与循环内部修正，并用 actor-critic 策略自适应控制区域更新与迭代次数，在 CT 图像增强中兼顾质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 条件图像增强需要空间变化的校正，但固定深度模型无论何处需要额外精修都分配相近计算量；一步流模型虽降低推理成本，但预测的变换动力学如何引导内部特征精修仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 解码器预测带符号区间速度及可学习的速度变化线索；软区域图聚合上下文用于速度估计；动力学条件图建立区域关系以引导循环瓶颈更新；修正后特征经共享解码器重算速度形成反馈；actor-critic 策略控制区域更新与后续迭代次数。
AI.result: NLST 上 PSNR 36.24±3.49 dB、SSIM 0.97±0.01；LDCT 上 PSNR 32.45±1.97 dB、SSIM 0.84±0.05（9 次解码器评估）。策略将平均评估降至 4.42 与 3.45 次，延迟由 97.00→51.82 ms、97.12→41.95 ms，PSNR 仅降 0.20 与 0.06 dB。
AI.conclusion: 动力学引导的反馈式内部修正与自适应计算分配可在几乎不损失增强质量的前提下显著降低推理延迟。

title: FormaFin: Verifiable Financial Analysis with Solver-Guided Reinforcement Learning
summary: Formally verifying financial analyses generated by large language models (LLMs) remains challenging as financial rules are largely expressed in natural language and rarely have corresponding formal specifications. Training language models to formalize these rules is hindered by the scarcity of labeled data and reliable training signals, while confidential financial data favor small models that run locally. We introduce FormaFin, a framework that trains small open language models to translate financial rules into reusable SMT formulas. FormaFin integrates teacher distillation with reinforcement learning using an SMT solver to compute rewards from numerical thresholds stated in financial rules. We evaluate FormaFin on corporate loan monitoring, in which lenders check borrowers' financial figures against loan agreements. To evaluate our framework, we curate \bench{}, a benchmark containing 143 loan agreements and 2,527 questions covering compliance, earnings cushion, and debt capacity. Our results show that a 7B formalizer achieves 94.8\% accuracy, outperforming open LLMs up to ten times larger. Across three model families, accuracy ranges from 92.6 to 96.8\%. Our framework also detects 95.6 to 99.7\% of errors in other LLMs' financial analyses. We make FormaFin and \bench{} publicly available.

AI.tldr: FormaFin 框架通过教师蒸馏与基于 SMT 求解器的强化学习，训练小型开源语言模型将金融规则翻译为可复用的 SMT 公式，实现 LLM 金融分析的形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 金融规则多以自然语言表达、缺乏形式化规范，且标注数据稀缺、训练信号不可靠；同时涉密金融数据要求在本地运行小模型，因此需要一种能训练小模型进行规则形式化的方法。
AI.method: FormaFin 结合教师模型蒸馏与强化学习，利用 SMT 求解器根据金融规则中的数值阈值计算奖励，训练小型开源模型将金融规则转化为可复用的 SMT 公式；并构建了包含 143 份贷款协议、2,527 道问题的 bench 基准，覆盖合规、盈利缓冲和债务能力。
AI.result: 7B 形式化模型达到 94.8% 准确率，超过参数量高达其十倍的开放 LLM；三个模型族准确率为 92.6%–96.8%；框架可检出其他 LLM 金融分析中 95.6%–99.7% 的错误。
AI.conclusion: FormaFin 证明了用小模型完成金融规则形式化的可行性，并有效用于验证 LLM 金融分析的可靠性，框架与基准均已公开。

title: The Complexity of Oracle-Efficient Realizable Transductive Learning
summary: In realizable transductive online learning, the learner knows the entire sequence of $T$ instances in advance, and the labels are consistent with one of $N$ hypotheses. With explicit access to the hypothesis class, the halving algorithm makes at most $\log_2 N$ mistakes. Can a comparable guarantee be achieved using only polynomially many empirical risk minimization (ERM) queries? We answer this question negatively, even for a weighted-ERM oracle that optimizes arbitrary real-valued linear objectives and returns a complete maximizing hypothesis. For every fixed $β\in(0,1)$ and every randomized learner making polynomially many oracle queries, there exists a fixed realizable instance with exactly $N=2^{\lfloor T^β\rfloor}$ hypotheses on which the learner makes $Ω_β(\sqrt{T\log N})$ mistakes in expectation. This matches the agnostic-rate upper bound achieved by random playout using $O(T)$ oracle calls. The separation persists for much smaller classes as well: along a sequence with $\log N=Θ((\log T)^2)$, we establish a mistake lower bound of $\exp(Ω(\log T/\log\log T))$. Our main technical contribution is a composition lemma that combines two realizable prediction problems such that their mistake lower bounds add, up to a small loss, while their hypothesis class sizes grow only additively. Iterating this lemma yields a family of hard instances spanning the desired parameter regimes, establishing a sharp separation between information-theoretic and oracle-efficient mistake guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可实现转导在线学习中，仅允许多项式次ERM查询时能否达到与halving算法相当的错误上界，答案是否定的：即使有加权ERM oracle，也存在使错误数达到Ω(√(T log N))的困难实例，与信息论上界形成尖锐分离。
AI.motivation: halving算法在显式访问假设类时仅犯log₂N次错误，但现实中通常只能通过ERM oracle访问假设类。本文追问：用多项式次ERM查询能否获得可比的错误保证。
AI.method: 构造性地给出下界：对任意随机学习器与加权ERM oracle，固定β∈(0,1)及N=2^⌊T^β⌋个假设的可实现实例，证明期望错误Ω_β(√(T log N))。核心技术是一个组合引理，使两个可实现问题的错误下界相加而假设类规模仅相加地增长，迭代该引理构造出跨参数区间的困难实例族。
AI.result: 多项式次（含加权）ERM查询无法达到log N级错误界；下界Ω_β(√(T log N))，恰与随机playout用O(T)次查询的agnostic速率上界吻合。对小假设类（log N=Θ((log T)²)）仍给出exp(Ω(log T/log log T))的错误下界。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了信息论保证与oracle高效保证之间的尖锐分离，说明仅靠多项式次ERM查询无法复现halving算法的错误界。

title: KernelShift: Benchmarking Kernel Optimization Across Evolving Hardware
comment: 26 pages, 9 figures, 22 tables. Project page: https://cmu-l3.github.io/kernel-shift/
summary: Efficient AI computation depends on hardware that evolves over time, shifting the strategies needed to implement performant code. For CPU kernels, a key evolving factor is the set of available architectural extensions, which expose specialized hardware instructions that change the techniques used to optimize kernels. We study how effectively coding agents use these new, potentially unfamiliar extensions to write fast code. We introduce KernelShift, a benchmarking pipeline and a set of environments for evaluating coding agents in kernel optimization across evolving CPU architectures. Its agent-assisted, human-verified pipeline turns code repositories into benchmark instances, and its environments let agents optimize code with feedback from the target hardware. Using this pipeline, we construct 99 kernels from real-world, actively developed repositories (ncnn, llama.cpp, Arm SIMD Loops, and KleidiAI), including inference workloads derived from real model executions. KernelShift supports incorporating new kernels and hardware configurations as libraries and processors evolve. We evaluate agents with proprietary and open-weight models across progressively newer architectural extensions (Arm Neon, SVE, SVE2, and SME2), examining how performance changes as hardware evolves. On established extensions, agents beat the auto-vectorized compiler everywhere (2.4-19.8x) and exceed general-purpose libraries such as ncnn (getting up to 2.74x over its Neon kernels), but fall behind Arm's hand-tuned KleidiAI kernels (0.70x). In end-to-end inference of two LLMs, agent-written kernels achieve a 1.3-1.6x prefill speedup over llama.cpp's fast path. However, current agents do not yet reliably adapt to new extensions that require unfamiliar programming models, such as SME2's matrix tiles.

AI.tldr: 提出 KernelShift 基准与流水线，评估编码智能体在演进的 CPU 架构扩展（Neon/SVE/SVE2/SME2）上的内核优化能力，发现其对成熟扩展表现强劲但对 SME2 等陌生编程模型适应不足。
AI.motivation: AI 计算依赖不断演进的硬件，而 CPU 内核优化的关键变量是不断新增的体系结构扩展（专用指令），需要新的优化技巧。作者想探究编码智能体能否有效利用这些新颖、可能不熟悉的扩展来写出高性能代码。
AI.method: 构建 KernelShift：一个基准测试流水线与环境集合，其"智能体辅助+人工验证"流程把代码仓库转为基准实例，环境让智能体借助目标硬件反馈优化代码。基于真实活跃仓库（ncnn、llama.cpp、Arm SIMD Loops、KleidiAI）构造 99 个内核，含真实模型推理负载，支持随库与处理器演进持续加入新内核和硬件配置；在 Arm Neon、SVE、SVE2、SME2 上评测专有与开源模型。
AI.result: 在成熟扩展上，智能体全面超过自动向量化编译器（2.4–19.8x），也超过 ncnn 等通用库（对其 Neon 内核最高 2.74x），但落后于 Arm 手工调优的 KleidiAI 内核（0.70x）。在两个 LLM 端到端推理中，智能体内核相对 llama.cpp 快速路径取得 1.3–1.6x 的 prefill 加速。然而面对需要陌生编程模型的 SME2 矩阵瓦片，智能体尚不能可靠适配。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体已能显著超越编译器与通用库，甚至在真实推理中带来加速，但在跨代新扩展（尤其新编程范式）上的适应能力仍是瓶颈，是未来改进方向。

title: Beyond Free-Form Generation: Measuring Interface Composition in Competitive NLP Systems
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2027
summary: Systems with decoder LLMs can combine free generation with scoring, ranking, or selection. We measure these documented interface combinations with five annotation fields linked to source evidence. The corpora comprise 517 solutions from 42 Kaggle competitions involving NLP and 76 participant systems from 26 SemEval, TREC, and WMT task years. Among eligible generation systems with decoder LLMs, 18 of 55 Kaggle systems and 17 of 20 Shared Task systems are hybrid: free generation coexists with a constrained interface. The remaining systems use free generation alone. Giving each competition or task year equal weight yields hybrid shares of 0.327 and 0.876. Within Eedi, 21 eligible systems with decoder LLMs have five exact interface profiles; ten LLM Science Exam systems share one interface class and have four profiles. Across Kaggle, the eligible systems with decoder LLMs span 18 exact interface profiles, revealing variation within broad task and backbone categories. These estimates characterize documented public systems selected using our selection criteria and include interfaces throughout the complete pipeline, including intermediate stages. The data are available at https://github.com/xiaoxinchenn/nlp-interface-composition.

AI.tldr: 本文以五个标注字段测量解码器LLM系统的界面组合，统计Kaggle(517方案/42竞赛)与共享任务(76系统)中混合式（自由生成+受限界面）系统的比例，并给出各竞赛/任务年的界面画像数量。
AI.motivation: 带解码器LLM的系统可将自由生成与打分、排序或选择结合，但这类"界面组合"在公开系统中如何分布缺乏量化证据，需系统化测量以刻画其实际多样性。
AI.method: 对与来源证据关联的五个标注字段进行人工标注；构建两个语料：42个Kaggle NLP竞赛的517个方案、26个SemEval/TREC/WMT任务年的76个参赛系统；统计具备解码器LLM的合格系统中"混合式"（自由生成与受限界面共存）与"仅自由生成"的比例，并按竞赛/任务年等权计算混合份额，进一步统计具体界面画像/类别。
AI.result: 合格LLM生成系统中，Kaggle 55个中18个、共享任务20个中17个为混合式；按竞赛/任务年等权，混合份额分别为0.327和0.876。Eedi中21个合格系统有5种精确界面画像；LLM Science Exam的10个系统同属一个界面类、共4种画像；Kaggle合格系统跨18种精确界面画像，显示在大类任务与骨干模型类别内仍存在变异。
AI.conclusion: 该估计刻画了按选择标准选定的已记录公开系统，并覆盖完整流程（含中间阶段）；结果表明混合界面普遍存在且在同类任务/模型内仍有显著差异。

title: StudioBench: Benchmarking Agentic Multimodal Large Language Models for Productive Audiovisual Creation
comment: 27 pages, 14 figures. Project page: https://openraiser.github.io/StudioBench/ and code: https://github.com/openraiser/StudioBench . Equal contribution: Xinglong Xu, Yuxia Zhu. Corresponding authors: Asher Qin, Jingxuan Wei, Cheng Tan
summary: Video generators can now render convincing short clips, yet complete audiovisual works require coordinating visuals, sound, and editing across multiple stages. Existing benchmarks focus on individual generators or video agents under narrower production settings, leaving end-to-end creation by general multimodal large language models (MLLMs) underexplored. We introduce StudioBench, a benchmark comprising 160 tasks across eight video genres and five task types, spanning diverse audiovisual production requirements. Models produce minutes of finished audiovisual content using 33 atomic generation, editing, and inspection tools, without shell access or workflow templates. We evaluate the delivered films, while analyzing reconstructed workflow graphs to characterize production behavior and diagnose failures. Across seven MLLMs, explicit requirements are nearly saturated, yet production quality varies substantially in picture clarity and composition, object structure, motion, and lip sync. All models spontaneously organize multi-stage production workflows without predefined templates. However, higher-quality models exhibit more selective production workflows, whereas additional tool calls alone show little association with quality. These findings identify the missing quality loop of effective inspection, selection, and revision as a key bottleneck in productive audiovisual creation.

AI.tldr: 提出StudioBench基准，用160个任务、8种视频类型、5种任务类型和33个原子工具，评测通用多模态大模型端到端完成数分钟音视频作品的能力，并重建工作流图诊断失败，发现"检查—选择—修订"的质量闭环是核心瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只关注单一生成器或窄场景下的视频智能体，缺乏对通用MLLM进行完整端到端音视频创作（画面、声音、剪辑多阶段协调）的评测。
AI.method: 构建StudioBench：160个任务、8类视频体裁、5类任务类型，模型仅用33个原子生成/编辑/检查工具、无shell权限与工作流模板，产出数分钟成片；同时评估成品并重建工作流图以刻画生产行为、定位失败。
AI.result: 7个MLLM上显式要求近乎饱和，但画面清晰度与构图、物体结构、运动、口型同步等质量差异显著；所有模型都能自发组织多阶段流程，高质量模型流程更具选择性，单纯增加工具调用与质量关联弱。
AI.conclusion: 有效的检查、选择与修订构成的质量闭环缺失，是当前MLLM进行生产级音视频创作的关键瓶颈。

title: Operating-Condition Normalization in C-MAPSS: Matched Historical Baselines, Multi-Seed Robustness, and Prognostic-Score Trade-offs
summary: Operating-state changes can obscure turbofan degradation signals, but a reduction in remaining-useful-life (RUL) error after condition-wise standardization may reflect weaknesses of the comparison features instead of a unique benefit of normalization. A controlled retrospective audit examines NASA C-MAPSS FD002 and FD004 with engine-disjoint folds, raw condition identifiers, two constructions of causal history, early-life baselines, and continuous operating-setting correction. Ridge regression, random forests and XGBoost are compared under explicit training-engine-only fitting rules. The previously reported XGBoost FD004 terminal RMSE decreased from 30.38 to 29.08 cycles following six-condition standardization; however, raw sensor values accompanied by condition-matched histories and condition identifiers achieved 28.09 cycles, reversing the naive point estimate ranking, although the paired-engine interval spans zero. For FD002, normalized XGBoost reduced terminal RMSE yet increased the asymmetric NASA score (12,616 to 13,289). Additional model-seed, condition count, RUL-cap, grouped-validation and explanation checks test sensitivity rather than postulating a universally optimal representation. The six clusters reproduce known simulator operating regimes; no new condition discovery algorithm, causal diagnostic method, or field ready prognostic system is claimed. Since the official test endpoints were also used in earlier exploratory comparisons, all newly examined alternatives are reported as retrospective benchmark evidence, not as results from a pristine confirmatory holdout.

AI.tldr: 该文对C-MAPSS FD002/FD004进行受控回溯审计，检验"按工况标准化能改善RUL误差"这一结论是否稳健；结果显示优势依赖于比较特征构造，标准化并非普遍有益。
AI.motivation: 工况变化会掩盖涡扇发动机退化信号。文献中按工况标准化后RUL误差下降常被当作标准化的独特收益，但这种下降可能仅反映对比特征本身的弱点，需要受控检验。
AI.method: 使用NASA C-MAPSS FD002与FD004，采用发动机不相交折、原始工况标识、两种因果历史构造、早期寿命基线及连续工况校正；在仅用训练发动机拟合的规则下比较Ridge、随机森林与XGBoost，并做模型种子、工况数、RUL上限、分组验证及解释性敏感度检验。
AI.result: XGBoost FD004终端RMSE由30.38降至29.08 cycles，但"原始传感器+工况匹配历史+工况标识"达28.09，反转载荷点估计排序（配对发动机区间跨零）；FD002标准化XGBoost降低终端RMSE却使非对称NASA得分由12,616升至13,289。
AI.conclusion: 标准化带来的改善并非稳健的独特收益，取决于比较特征构造与评价指标；六簇复现已知仿真工况。因官方测试端点此前已用于探索性比较，所有新结果仅为回溯基准证据，非原始确证性留出验证。

title: Blind to What They Can Fix: A Detection Gap in Self-Improving Agents
summary: AI agents can write programs that carry out a task without calling a model at every step, so the task runs fast and its logic stays open to inspection. Agents improve these programs by running them, studying their failures, and revising the code, a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI). We ask whether this process also yields runtime checks that can be trusted. In five task domains, with up to seven author models, agents bring their programs to high scores. Yet when the environment changes, the checks they were told to write stay silent on half or more of the resulting failures in four domains. These failures can be detected and repaired: a monitor built from records of normal runs catches most of them in three domains, and the same agents usually repair them once called. The checks do not examine the recorded relations that reveal the failures, and the strongest agent writes checks that catch most of them once told that its checks are the only thing that calls it back. An unreported failure stays unrepaired, which limits what self-improvement is worth in autonomous operation. Evaluations of self-improvement should measure not only scores but also whether a system notices its own failures.

AI.tldr: AI代理能编写程序并通过运行-检查失败-修改代码实现递归自我改进(RSI)，但本文发现其自动生成的运行时检查并不可信：环境变化时这些检查对半数以上失败沉默。
AI.motivation: 现有工作关注代理通过RSI提升任务分数，但未检验其所写运行时检查能否真正察觉自身失败。未被发现的失败无法被修复，从而限制自主运行中自我改进的实际价值。
AI.method: 在五个任务领域、最多七个作者模型上，让代理通过运行、分析失败、修订代码来改进程序，并考察它们被要求编写的运行时检查；比较环境变化前后的检查表现，构建基于正常运行记录的监控器进行检测，并考察代理在被提示后能否修复。
AI.result: 代理程序取得高分；但环境变化后，四个领域中检查对一半或以上的失败保持沉默。基于正常运行记录的监控器在三个领域中捕获大部分失败；代理在被指出后通常能修复；检查未考察那些能揭示失败的关系记录；最强的代理在被明确告知检查是唯一回调手段后能捕获大部分失败。
AI.conclusion: 未报告的失败不会被修复，这限制了自我改进在自主运行中的价值。评估自我改进不应只看分数，还应衡量系统能否察觉自身失败。

title: VideoJSON: A Minimal Harness Beats Purpose-Built Memory for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
summary: Answering questions over days or weeks of video requires searching for scattered clues across long timelines. Existing video agents rely on complex memory graphs and fixed retrieval pipelines, which restrict how the agent can search. We propose VideoJSON, a minimal harness for ultra-long video understanding that keeps the memory simple and lets a coding agent write its own search programs. During indexing, a vision-language model turns each minute of video into a single JSON record containing a dense caption and structured fields such as events, entities, places, and speech transcripts. At query time, the agent writes Python or Bash programs in a sandboxed container to filter, link, and read these records over multiple steps, without task-specific training or raw video access. On four ultra-long video benchmarks, VideoJSON with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash outperforms MAGIC-Video by 7.0, 20.0, and 24.75 points on EgoLifeQA, Ego-R1-Bench, and MM-Lifelong Week, and beats the best prior EgoMemReason score by 12.6 points. Across four policy models of increasing capability, VideoJSON's average score rises by up to 11.58 points over the weakest model, compared with at most 5.50 points for MAGIC-Video. Ablations show that both agentic code search and the structured JSON records drive these gains, while adding hourly summaries, extra tools, or video access changes the average score by less than 1.5 points. In addition, fine-tuning Qwen-3.5-Flash on 64 VideoJSON trajectories from an unrelated 100-hour livestream improves its MM-Lifelong scores by up to 8.25 points. Code will be open-sourced after publication.

AI.tldr: VideoJSON 提出一种极简的超长视频理解框架：将每分钟视频转为一条 JSON 记录（密集描述+结构化字段），查询时让编码智能体在沙箱中自行编写 Python/Bash 程序进行多步过滤、关联与读取，无需任务特定训练或访问原始视频。
AI.motivation: 回答跨越数天至数周视频的问题需要在长时序中检索零散线索，而现有视频智能体依赖复杂记忆图和固定检索管线，限制了智能体搜索方式的灵活性与上限。
AI.method: 索引阶段用视觉语言模型把每分钟视频压缩为单条 JSON 记录，含密集描述及事件、实体、地点、语音转写等结构化字段；查询阶段智能体在沙箱容器中编写 Python 或 Bash 程序，多步地对这些记录进行过滤、链接和读取，整个过程不做任务特定训练，也不直接访问原始视频。
AI.result: 在四个超长视频基准上，VideoJSON 搭配 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 相比 MAGIC-Video 在 EgoLifeQA、Ego-R1-Bench、MM-Lifelong Week 上分别高出 7.0、20.0、24.75 分，并比此前最佳 EgoMemReason 高 12.6 分。随策略模型能力提升，其平均分最多提升 11.58 分，而 MAGIC-Video 最多 5.50 分。消融显示智能体代码搜索与结构化 JSON 记录是收益来源，而增加小时级摘要、额外工具或视频访问对平均分影响小于 1.5 分。此外，用来自无关 100 小时直播的 64 条轨迹微调 Qwen-3.5-Flash，可使其 MM-Lifelong 分数最多提升 8.25 分。
AI.conclusion: 保持记忆简单、把搜索策略交由编码智能体自行编程，是超长视频理解的有效范式，且能随底层模型能力放大收益并具备可迁移性；代码将在论文发表后开源。

title: Decoding Transformer Dynamics via Koopman Subspaces
summary: We apply Koopman operator theory and Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to characterise how large language models (LLMs) process different input topics. Treating the layer-to-layer evolution of hidden states as a dynamical system, we fit a linear Koopman operator and take the subspace spanned by its dominant modes as a per-topic spectral fingerprint. Four findings emerge. First, the depth map is near-linear: a single linear operator predicts each next-layer state to within approx. 18% relative error (interior variance explained approx. 0.99). Second, over the 57 MMLU subjects the fingerprint is topic-discriminative, matching the MMLU taxonomy at 0.72 nearest-neighbour purity and each subject's semantic neighbourhood at 0.75 any-hit@3. Third, it is a reproducible signature (split-half self-retrieval approx. 0.97$). Finally, these findings are consistent across seven base models (Qwen2.5 0.5-7B, Llama-3 1-8B), with a suggestive trend of alignment rising with MMLU accuracy. The spectral fingerprint thus provides a probe of how transformers process different topics across depth. Code is available at https://github.com/DeepK/koopman-llm-eacl27.

AI.tldr: 用Koopman算子理论与动态模式分解(DMD)刻画LLM逐层隐状态对输入主题的处理，提出"谱指纹"作为每主题的线性动力学特征，实现主题判别且跨模型一致。
AI.motivation: 希望从动力系统视角理解大语言模型如何在层间演进中处理不同输入主题，寻找可解释、可判别的主题级表征。
AI.method: 将隐状态的逐层演化视为动力系统，拟合线性Koopman算子，用其主导模式张成的子空间作为每主题的谱指纹；在57个MMLU子主题和7个基座模型(Qwen2.5 0.5-7B、Llama-3 1-8B)上验证。
AI.result: ①深度映射近似线性：单线性算子预测下一层状态相对误差~18%，内部方差解释~0.99；②指纹具主题判别性：MMLU分类学最近邻纯度0.72，语义邻域any-hit@3为0.75；③可分半复现(自检索~0.97)；④跨7个模型一致，且与MMLU准确率呈对齐上升趋势。
AI.conclusion: 谱指纹为transformer跨深度处理不同主题提供了有效探针，说明层间演化近似线性且主题信息可被紧凑谱特征编码。

title: STRIDE: Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-Guided Skill Disclosure and Evolution for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Skill-augmented reinforcement learning enables LLM agents to reuse task-solving knowledge across episodes, but existing systems typically expose agents to a flat skill pool and update skills only from coarse, episode-level outcomes. This conflates two distinct uses of experience: a stable strategy that should frame the whole episode, and tactical know-how that should be retrieved only when the agent reaches a local execution gap. We propose STRIDE (Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-guided skIll Disclosure and Evolution), a framework that brings progressive skill disclosure into agentic reinforcement learning. STRIDE keeps the selected strategy visible as episode context, exposes a compact tactic menu, and loads full tactic content only after an explicit retrieval action. This interface turns each retrieval into an event-level credit unit: the same event provides process feedback for learning when to retrieve and supplies evidence for skill-bank evolution. On ALFWorld, STRIDE achieves a 92.7% average success rate with Qwen3-4B and a 94.9% average success rate with Qwen3-8B. On WebShop, it improves over the strongest reproduced skill-augmented baseline by 4.5 score points and 1.9 success-rate percentage points. These results show that skill reuse is most effective when persistent strategies preserve global task structure and tactics are disclosed only at local decision bottlenecks.

AI.tldr: STRIDE 提出"策略—战术"分层与渐进式技能披露的智能体强化学习框架，通过显式检索动作把技能检索变成事件级信用单元，在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上显著超越现有技能增强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有技能增强强化学习把技能平铺成统一技能池，且只用粗粒度、回合级结果更新技能，混淆了两种经验用途：一是应贯穿整段回合的稳定策略，二是仅在局部执行缺口处才需调用的战术性知识。这种混用导致技能复用效果受限。
AI.method: 提出 STRIDE 框架，将渐进式技能披露引入智能体强化学习：(1) 将选中的策略作为回合上下文持续可见；(2) 仅暴露精简的战术菜单，只有执行显式检索动作后才加载完整战术内容；(3) 这一接口使每次检索成为事件级信用单元，同一事件既提供"何时检索"的过程反馈，又为技能库演化提供证据。
AI.result: ALFWorld 上 Qwen3-4B 平均成功率 92.7%，Qwen3-8B 达 94.9%；WebShop 上相较最强复现技能增强基线提升 4.5 分（score）和 1.9 个百分点成功率。
AI.conclusion: 技能复用最有效的形式是：持久策略维持全局任务结构，而战术仅在局部决策瓶颈处才被披露。

title: Pretraining Representation Lottery Determines Fine-tuning Generalization
summary: Large scale pretraining (PT) followed by fine-tuning (FT) is the central paradigm of modern deep learning, yet how PT shapes FT generalization remains poorly understood. We use a synthetic setup in which the ground-truth concept geometry of entities is known, as a controlled testbed to study how representational geometry affects model behavior and how PT representations determine FT generalization. We first show that models differing only in training seed can closely match in PT loss yet vary substantially in FT generalization. We hypothesize that a representational lottery underlies this phenomenon: the random seed dependent geometry formed during PT determines what FT can reach. We confirm this causally. First, injecting the ground-truth concept geometry into the model yields near-ceiling FT generalization, showing that good representations directly drive generalization. Then, distilling a lucky seed's learned representation into an unlucky seed unlocks FT generalization, while distilling the same model's behavior does not. Furthermore, representation distillation can merge entities that never interacted during PT, which FT alone cannot. Finally, we show that regularizing representational drift during FT enables naturalistic learning: only models with good representations learn the task, and they generalize, while models with poor representations fail to fit it. Under plain FT, by contrast, models with poor representations fit the training objective by reshaping their pretrained representations. We reproduce the distillation result in Pythia-160M and Pythia-410M, each pretrained multiple times with different random seeds, and show that the transferable representation lives in the deep layers at both scales. Overall, PT acts as a lottery over representations, and the representation a model draws determines how it adapts during FT in a way that behavior alone does not explain.

AI.tldr: 论文用已知概念几何的合成设定证明：预训练形成一个"表征彩票"——相同PT损失的不同随机种子导致差异极大的微调泛化，而表征几何决定FT能学到什么，行为蒸馏无法替代表征蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练+微调是现代深度学习的核心范式，但PT如何塑造FT泛化仍不清楚；仅看PT损失或FT行为难以解释种子间的泛化差异，需要一个可控、真值几何已知的实验台来因果性地研究表征几何的作用。
AI.method: 构建实体概念几何真值已知的合成设定作为受控测试台；比较不同随机种子在PT损失相近时的FT泛化差异；通过注入真值概念几何、把"幸运种子"的学到的表征蒸馏进"不幸种子"（对比行为蒸馏）、跨未交互实体的表征合并，以及在FT中正则化表征漂移等干预做因果验证；并在Pythia-160M/410M多次不同种子预训练上复现蒸馏结果并定位可迁移表征所在层。
AI.result: PT损失几乎相同的模型FT泛化差异显著；注入真值几何可达接近上限的FT泛化；表征蒸馏能解锁差种子的泛化，而行为蒸馏不能；表征蒸馏可合并在PT中从未交互过的实体，FT本身做不到；在FT正则化表征漂移后，只有好表征的模型能学会任务并泛化，差表征模型则拟合失败；plain FT下差表征模型通过重塑PT表征来拟合训练目标。Pythia-160M/410M上复现蒸馏收益，可迁移表征位于深层。
AI.conclusion: PT本质上是对表征的一次"抽奖"，抽到的表征决定模型在FT中如何适应，这种影响无法由行为或损失单独解释；因此评估与改进应从表征几何而非仅从PT损失/FT行为入手。

title: OWE-Bench: A long-horizon benchmark for measuring real-world engineering
comment: 35 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Code: https://github.com/Mercor-Intelligence/OpenWorldEngineer ; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mercor/OpenWorldEngineer ; leaderboard: https://openworldengineer.mercor.com
summary: We present OWE-Bench (OpenWorldEngineer-Bench), a benchmark of 26 long-horizon engineering tasks written by domain experts in software engineering, physical engineering, machine learning, and scientific computing. Tasks range from optimizing kernels and designing an aircraft, to identifying the faults responsible for an earthquake. Each task requires significant domain knowledge and engineering work, with models averaging hundreds of millions of tokens per task. Solutions are scored on practical measures such as speed, cost and accuracy, both on provided cases the agent could test against and on hidden cases that an engineer would expect from the task description. The best-performing frontier model so far, Claude Fable 5.2, scores 54.6% and averages 211 million tokens per task. We highlight two findings. First, when models are given more time, they use more test-time compute and achieve higher scores. Models also scale differently with test-time compute: GPT-6 Astra achieves higher scores at shorter time limits and at equal token use, while Claude Fable 5.2 uses more tokens at longer limits to achieve the highest overall score. Second, each model scores lower on hidden cases than on the provided cases, by an average of 18 points, which we call the deployment gap. Models also fail to predict the deployment gap, overestimating their performance on hidden test cases by an average of 21 points. We hope that OWE-Bench grounds progress toward agents whose engineering solutions perform as well in deployment as they do in testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OWE-Bench，一个由领域专家撰写的 26 项长周期工程任务基准，涵盖软件工程、物理工程、机器学习和科学计算。最佳模型 Claude Fable 5.2 得分 54.6%，平均每任务消耗 2.11 亿 token；研究发现测试时计算随可用时间增加而提升分数，且各模型扩展方式不同；模型在隐藏用例上的得分平均比提供用例低 18 分，即"部署差距"，且模型普遍高估隐藏集表现约 21 分。
AI.motivation: 现有基准难以衡量真实工程任务所需的长期、高 token 消耗与实用性（速度、成本、精度）表现，也缺乏对模型在测试环境与部署环境下表现差异的评估。
AI.method: 构建 OWE-Bench：26 个专家撰写的高难度工程任务（如内核优化、飞机设计、地震断层归因）。评估采用实用性指标（速度、成本、准确率），同时考察提供的可测试用例与工程描述所预期的隐藏用例，并分析测试时计算随时间的扩展行为。
AI.result: 最强模型 Claude Fable 5.2 得 54.6%，平均每任务 2.11 亿 token。给定更多时间时模型消耗更多测试时计算并得分更高；GPT-6 Astra 在短时限和等 token 下更优，Claude Fable 5.2 在长时限下用更多 token 取得最高总分。隐藏用例得分平均低 18 分（部署差距），模型还高估隐藏集表现约 21 分。
AI.conclusion: OWE-Bench 揭示了长周期工程任务中的测试时计算扩展规律与显著的"部署差距"，旨在推动智能体在部署中与测试中表现一致的工程能力研究。

title: Med-Agentic: Distilling Agentic Medical Reasoning with Internalized Meta-Capabilities
summary: Large language models (LLMs) in expert domains face a trade-off between agentic tool use, which externalizes expertise behind brittle multi-turn runtimes, and end-to-end specialization, which internalizes expertise only implicitly at task-level granularity. We propose internalized meta-capabilities: atomic, parametrically internalized, and composable reasoning units that an LLM can select and combine within a single chain-of-thought (CoT). We instantiate this idea as Med-Agentic for medical visual diagnosis, where the model emits a capability-tagged structured CoT in one forward pass, turning capability invocation into tagged token generation rather than external tool calls. For training, Med-OPD performs multi-teacher on-policy distillation with token-level dual-factor teacher routing conditioned on both the image and the active capability tag, strictly generalizing per-prompt teacher routing. We show that this routing gives an unbiased estimator of the same expected teacher-KL gradient. Across public medical imaging datasets spanning nine anatomies and eight modalities, Med-Agentic consistently improves in-distribution and out-of-distribution diagnostic accuracy over the strong competitors.

AI.tldr: 提出"内化元能力"概念，将医学视觉诊断中的专家能力作为原子化、可组合的推理单元嵌入单次思维链，用多教师在线蒸馏训练，显著提升分布内外诊断准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在专家领域存在两难：智能体式工具调用把专业知识外置为脆弱的多轮运行时；端到端专精化则只能在任务级粒度隐式内化知识。二者都缺乏原子化、可组合且单次推理即可调用的能力表达方式。
AI.method: 提出内化元能力（原子、参数化内化、可组合的推理单元）。实例化为Med-Agentic：模型在一次前向中输出带能力标签的结构化CoT，把能力调用变为标签token生成而非外部工具调用。训练用Med-OPD：多教师在线策略蒸馏，采用基于图像与当前能力标签的token级双因子教师路由，并证明该路由是同一教师-KL期望梯度的无偏估计。
AI.result: 在覆盖9个解剖部位、8种模态的公开医学影像数据集上，Med-Agentic在分布内与分布外诊断准确率上均稳定优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 以能力标签为路由信号的单次结构化CoT可在保持组合性的同时避免多轮工具调用的脆弱性，双因子路由为多教师蒸馏提供了理论上无偏的训练框架。

title: Group-Balanced Supervised Fine-Tuning for Knowledge-Intensive Domains
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) weights every supervised token equally, so on knowledge-dense corpora the loss budget follows token count rather than importance: on a legal QA benchmark, citation strings absorb 81% of the supervised loss weight budget while the answers being taught absorb 5%. We present Group-Balanced SFT (GB-SFT), which equalizes the loss budget across the semantic roles of tokens within a target sequence. With one tunable dial and one structural switch, GB-SFT contains standard SFT, class- and span-level balancing as corners whose geometry we characterize exactly. On benchmarks in law, medicine, code, and mathematics, we show across model families that: (i) GB- SFT injects new knowledge better than uniform SFT, pointwise token weighting, memory editing, and matched-budget data mixing; (ii) it matches the injection of masking out everything but the knowledge payload while retaining the citation recall that masking destroys (0.98 vs. 0.38); and (iii) role-aware grouping carries the gain: label-free partitions recover at most a third of it, an LLM tagger nearly all where the groups are lexically distinctive; and and (iv) the budget governs what fine-tuning breaks as well as what it learns, acting as a monotone lever on the safety-guardrail erosion SFT causes, at matched task accuracy. We release two new contamination-controlled knowledge-injection benchmarks with validated ground truth.

AI.tldr: 提出 Group-Balanced SFT (GB-SFT)，通过在目标序列内按 token 的语义角色均衡分配损失预算，提升知识注入效果并减少安全护栏腐蚀。
AI.motivation: 标准 SFT 对所有监督 token 等权处理，导致在知识密集语料中损失预算按 token 数量而非重要性分配。例如法律问答基准中，引用字符串占据 81% 的监督损失预算，而真正要教的答案仅占 5%。
AI.method: GB-SFT 在目标序列内按 token 的语义角色均衡损失预算，仅含一个可调旋钮和一个结构性开关；标准 SFT、类级与跨度级均衡均为其边界情形，并对其几何性质进行精确刻画。
AI.result: 在法律、医学、代码、数学基准上跨模型族验证：(i) 知识注入优于均匀 SFT、逐点 token 加权、记忆编辑及等预算数据混合；(ii) 达到与"仅保留知识载荷"掩码相当的知识注入，同时保留后者破坏的引用召回（0.98 vs 0.38）；(iii) 角色感知分组带来增益，无标签划分最多恢复三分之一，LLM 标注器在词汇可区分时几乎全部恢复；(iv) 预算既决定学习内容也决定微调破坏内容，在同等任务准确率下单调调节安全护栏腐蚀程度。并发布两个污染受控、真值经校验的知识注入基准。
AI.conclusion: 按语义角色均衡损失预算是一种有效的 SFT 改进方向，可同时提升知识注入、保留结构化信息并调控安全性代价。

title: When Do Better Visual World Models Make Better Plans? Decision-Aligned Selection for Latent Planning
comment: Supplementary material will be included in the next version
summary: Visual world models enable goal-conditioned planning by predicting the outcomes of candidate actions in latent space. However, planning depends on how well a model ranks candidates, whereas training optimizes how accurately it predicts each one. We identify the Decision-Relevant Residual (DRR), the part of the cost error that can reorder candidates, and show that the more training reduces the DRR, the more it improves selection (Spearman $ρ= 0.82$, vs. $0.61$ for prediction error). Building on this insight, we introduce Decision-Aligned Selection (DAS), a plug-in selection rule that scores candidates by the standardized consensus of several independently trained checkpoints, which averages out their checkpoint-specific residuals. Across two model families (LeWorldModel and DINO-WM) and five tasks, DAS selects better actions than single checkpoints in 12 of 18 configurations and outperforms training one model three times longer in 14 of 18. In closed loop, DAS improves success over single checkpoints in 6 of 9 pre-registered LeWM comparisons.

AI.tldr: 该文指出世界模型规划的关键在于候选排序而非单点预测精度，提出"决策相关残差"DRR指标，并用多检查点共识选择(DAS)提升动作选择质量。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型通过潜空间预测候选动作结果来做目标条件规划，但规划效果取决于模型对候选的排序能力，而训练目标优化的是每个候选的预测精度，二者存在错配。
AI.method: 定义DRR——成本误差中会导致候选重排序的部分；实证其与排序改进的相关性；提出DAS插件式选择规则，用多个独立训练检查点的标准化共识分数对候选打分，以平均掉各检查点特有的残差。
AI.result: DRR降低与选择改进的Spearman ρ=0.82，高于预测误差的0.61；在LeWorldModel与DINO-WM两族模型、五个任务上，DAS在18个配置中有12个优于单检查点，14个优于训练三倍时长的单模型；闭环测试中9个预注册比较里6个成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: 决策对齐的排序目标比单纯提升预测精度更有效，通过检查点共识消除决策相关残差是一种低成本、可插拔的规划增强手段。

title: Joint Client Scheduling and Resource Allocation for Optimal Federated Learning over Wireless Networks
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Revised author-prepared version of a paper accepted and presented at IEEE FLTA 2026
summary: Federated learning often relies on partial client participation because full participation is costly in cross-device wireless systems with limited uplink resources, heterogeneous channel conditions, energy constraints, and strict upload deadlines. However, partial participation introduces sampling variance, causing the sampled update to deviate from the full-participation update. Existing optimal client sampling methods reduce this variance but usually rely on simplified client-count budgets, while wireless-aware scheduling methods account for communication constraints but do not directly optimize sampling variance. This paper proposes resource-aware optimal client sampling (RAOCS), a unified variance-minimizing client scheduling framework under uplink resource-block, round deadline, update-information, and energy constraints. The resulting problem admits a capped water-filling solution that balances client update importance, wireless resource cost, and energy feasibility. Experimental results demonstrate that RAOCS achieves accuracy comparable to that of OCS while reducing the average upload time per iteration by more than a factor of 252.

AI.tldr: 本文提出资源感知最优客户端采样（RAOCS），在无线联邦学习中将采样方差最小化与上行资源约束统一建模，得到"带截断注水"解，在精度与OCS相当的同时把每轮平均上传时间降低252倍以上。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习常因上行资源有限、信道异构、能量受限和上传时限严格而只能部分客户端参与，但部分参与会引入采样方差，使采样更新偏离全参与更新。现有最优客户端采样方法（如OCS）多基于简化的客户端数量预算，忽略通信约束；而无线感知调度方法虽考虑通信限制，却不直接优化采样方差。二者缺少统一框架。
