AI.method: 提出RAOCS——一个统一的方差最小化客户端调度框架，同时考虑上行资源块、轮次截止时间、更新信息量和能量四类约束。该优化问题可解析为"带截断的注水（capped water-filling）"解，在客户端更新重要性、无线资源代价与能量可行性之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 实验表明RAOCS达到与OCS相当的精度，同时将每次迭代的平均上传时间降低超过252倍。
AI.conclusion: 将采样方差优化与真实无线资源约束融合是可行且高效的，RAOCS在保持统计效率的同时显著提升通信效率，为受限无线环境下的联邦学习客户端调度提供了统一且实用的方案。

title: VADE: A Verifiable Agent Data Engine from Professional Sources
comment: 40 pages, 6 figures, 32 tables. Project page: https://tiger-ai-lab.github.io/VADE/
summary: Language agents have shown their practical value, particularly in software engineering, where abundant public code and executable tests support training and evaluation at scale. Extending this success to other professional domains, such as law and finance, is not straightforward: many agent tasks involve open-ended analysis, making outcomes hard to verify and, in turn, hard to use as scalable supervision. As a result, high-quality tasks in these domains are still largely expert-authored, making them expensive to scale and limiting their use for training. To address this bottleneck, we introduce VADE, a data engine that automatically constructs verifiable analysis tasks from public sources used in professional practice. VADE exploits a simple asymmetry: professional analyses are difficult to solve because the relevant evidence must first be found and interpreted, but much easier to verify once that evidence is fixed. During task synthesis, the engine constructs a reference analysis from source evidence and asks an independent agent to reproduce its conclusions from the same evidence without seeing it. Only after the analysis is verified is it compiled into an open-ended task with an item-level scoring contract, allowing the same task to support both evaluation and training. We apply VADE across four professional domains; in an independent expert review of 186 finance tasks, 93.5% meet a high bar for source fidelity, answer correctness, and evaluation fairness. In finance, these tasks expose substantial remaining model errors, particularly unsupported facts and inferences, while training on verified solver trajectories improves held-out performance and yields gains that transfer to public finance benchmarks such as Finance Agent Benchmark v2. Together, these results suggest a practical path toward scalable, verifiable supervision for open-ended professional tasks.

AI.tldr: VADE是一个数据引擎，从公共专业资料自动构造可验证的开放式分析任务，将难解但易验的专家分析转化为可扩展的监督信号，并在金融等领域验证有效。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体在软件工程中因有海量代码与可执行测试而易于规模化训练评估；但法律、金融等专业领域的任务多为开放式分析，结果难以验证，导致高质量任务只能靠专家撰写，成本高、难扩展，成为训练瓶颈。
AI.method: 利用"分析难解但证据固定后易验"的不对称性：先从源证据构建参考分析，再让独立的智能体在不看答案的情况下仅凭同一证据复现结论；验证通过后，将其编译为带条目级评分契约的开放式任务，可同时用于评估与训练。
AI.result: 应用于四个专业领域；186个金融任务的独立专家评审中93.5%在来源忠实度、答案正确性和评估公平性上达标；金融任务揭示模型仍有大量错误（尤其是不支持的事实与推断）；用验证过的解题轨迹训练可提升留出集表现，并迁移至Finance Agent Benchmark v2等公开基准。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为开放式专业任务提供了可扩展、可验证监督的可行路径。

title: Don't Test Where You Trained: Geographic Overlap Inflates End-to-End Driving Scores
summary: In NAVSIMv1, the standard benchmark for end-to-end driving, $89.6\%$ of the test scenes lie within 4m of a training scene. We show that this geographic overlap inflates the reported scores. We propose a geographically disjoint split of NAVSIMv1 and an evaluation that compares models trained on either split on the same scenes, which neither has seen in training. All sensor-based models we test, DiffusionDrive, Latent TransFuser, and DrivoR, lose 3.4 to 6.1 PDMS points on these scenes, mainly by leaving the road and coming close to other objects, against 1.5 points for a baseline without sensors. The loss concentrates where a training drive of the original split passed the same place. At all other places, models trained on the original split are no better than those trained on the geographic split. Models trained on the original split predict road geometry that no camera can see. The gap persists when the auxiliary map loss is removed, so the models memorize locations even without being supervised to. On nuScenes, the geographic split cuts SparseDrive's mapping accuracy by $59\%$ and also degrades its planning. Driving scores on logged scenes thus partly measure how well a model remembers the test locations. We release the split to evaluate generalization to new places.

AI.tldr: NAVSIMv1测试集中89.6%的场景距训练场景不足4m，地理重叠抬高分数；作者提出地理不相交划分并证明主流模型分数虚高。
AI.motivation: 检验端到端驾驶基准中的地理重叠是否导致测试分数被高估，即模型是否在"记忆地点"而非真正泛化。
AI.method: 将NAVSIMv1划分为地理不相交的训练/测试集，并在同一批双方均未见的场景上对比"原始划分"与"地理划分"训练出的模型（DiffusionDrive、Latent TransFuser、DrivoR及无传感器基线）；另在nuScenes上验证SparseDrive的地图精度与规划。
AI.result: 所有基于传感器的模型掉落3.4–6.1 PDMS点（无传感器基线仅1.5），主要因驶离道路和近距离接触物体；损失集中在原划分训练轨迹经过的地点；模型还能预测相机不可见的道路几何，去除辅助地图损失后差距仍存在；nuScenes上SparseDrive建图精度下降59%且规划退化。
AI.conclusion: 驾驶基准分数部分反映的是对测试地点的记忆而非泛化能力；作者发布地理划分数据集以评估对新地点的泛化。

title: Medical Specialty Prediction from Bangla Patient Narratives: A Comparative Study of ML, DL, Transformers, and LLMs
comment: Accepted and presented at the 3rd International Conference on Sustainable Development Through Excellence in Higher Education: Contemporary Global Perspectives
summary: Timely access to appropriate medical specialists remains a bottleneck in Bangladesh's healthcare system, as patients describe symptoms in informal Bangla rather than clinical terms, leading to ineffective referrals. This paper compares four model families for predicting medical specialties from Bangla patient narratives: six machine learning (ML) models using hybrid TF-IDF features, four deep learning (DL) models using Word2Vec embeddings trained on the corpus, four fine-tuned transformers, and five large language models (LLMs) evaluated zero-shot. From a corpus of 3798 patient records covering 20 specialties, we retained the five with the most records (Medicine, Gynecology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Gastroenterology) and split the resulting 2730 records 80:20 into training and test sets shared by all families. The best transformer was XLM-RoBERTa (86.26% accuracy, 86.21% macro-F1), the best ML model was SVM (84.98%, 84.92%), the best DL model was Bidirectional GRU (80.77%, 80.83%), and the best LLM was Gemini (90.29%, 90.15%). Holm-corrected paired McNemar tests show SVM significantly outperforming Bi-LSTM (adjusted p = 0.004), whereas the Gemini-versus-Grok gap does not survive correction (adjusted p = 0.104), and neither the strongest transformer versus the weakest LLM (Grok) nor SVM versus the strongest transformer reaches significance. A tuned classical model is thus statistically indistinguishable from the strongest transformer, so accuracy rankings alone should not be read as evidence of one family's superiority. The findings provide a comparative baseline for Bangla medical text classification.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较四类模型（传统ML、DL、微调Transformer、零样本LLM）在孟加拉语患者自述症状中预测就诊专科的效果，发现最佳LLM（Gemini）准确率最高，但经统计检验，调优的SVM与最强Transformer无显著差异，提示单看准确率排名不足以断定某一类模型更优。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国医疗系统存在专科转诊瓶颈：患者用非正式孟加拉语描述症状而非临床术语，导致转诊低效。需要可靠地从患者自述文本预测应就诊的专科，但缺乏针对孟加拉语的系统性比较基线。
AI.method: 构建3798条患者记录、覆盖20个专科的语料，取记录最多的5个专科（内科、妇科、皮肤科、儿科、消化科）共2730条，按80:20划分共享训练/测试集。比较四类模型家族：(1) 6个基于混合TF-IDF特征的ML模型；(2) 4个使用语料训练Word2Vec嵌入的DL模型；(3) 4个微调Transformer；(4) 5个零样本LLM。采用Holm校正的配对McNemar检验做显著性分析。
AI.result: 最优Transformer为XLM-RoBERTa（86.26%准确率，86.21% macro-F1）；最优ML为SVM（84.98%，84.92%）；最优DL为BiGRU（80.77%，80.83%）；最优LLM为Gemini（90.29%，90.15%）。McNemar检验显示SVM显著优于Bi-LSTM（校正p=0.004）；Gemini与Grok差距经校正后不显著（p=0.104）；最强Transformer与最弱LLM（Grok）之间、以及SVM与最强Transformer之间均无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 调优的经典ML模型在统计上与最强Transformer不可区分，因此不应仅凭准确率排名就断言某一模型家族更优越。本研究为孟加拉语医学文本分类提供了可比较的基线，并强调需要配合显著性检验进行模型评估。

title: OmniDecisionBench: Evaluating and Benchmarking the Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
summary: Multimodal System One models answer visual tasks with typed decisions and native probabilities, yet no holistic evaluation compares them with general VLMs or maps either class's capability boundaries. We introduce OmniDecisionBench, a holistic benchmark of multimodal System One models. Its main evaluation assigns 45 datasets (192,975 records) to five capability families and twelve primary angles across four typed interfaces, scoring accuracy and candidate-probability calibration. A validation layer adds three single-factor diagnostics varying visual presentation, textual evidence sufficiency, and target dataset. Across three System One models and two general VLMs, three regularities emerge. First, strengths depend on angle and metric: System One models lead discrete tasks overall with lower ECE15 on most perception, reading, and reasoning angles (Jev 1.14: 80.14% accuracy, 4.50% ECE15), while general VLMs lead ordinal grading and outperform Jev 1.14 among the three models tested on direct Box grounding. Second, multi-image and abstract reasoning bound every model, where confidence rather than accuracy separates them. Third, reliability shifts with the input: rendering only options nearly triples Jev 1.14's selective risk at nearly flat mean signed bias, and donor risk cutoffs often exceed target risk across unseen datasets and task families. OmniDecisionBench thus maps which model class suits each angle and where reliability ends. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/Glax147/OmniDecisionBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniDecisionBench，一个面向多模态 System One 模型的整体评测基准，覆盖 45 个数据集、12 个评测角度、4 类结构化接口，联合衡量准确率与概率校准，并揭示三类模型的性能规律。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态 System One 模型能够以类型化决策和原生概率回答视觉任务，但缺乏与通用 VLM 的整体对比评测，也缺少对该两类模型能力边界的系统刻画。
AI.method: 构建 OmniDecisionBench：主评测将 45 个数据集（192,975 条记录）划分为 5 个能力族、12 个主角度，跨 4 种类型化接口，同时评估准确率与候选概率校准；另设验证层，用三个单因素诊断分别改变视觉呈现、文本证据充分性和目标数据集。
AI.result: 在 3 个 System One 模型和 2 个通用 VLM 上发现三点规律：(1) 优势取决于角度与指标，System One 整体领先离散任务且在多数感知、阅读、推理角度 ECE15 更低（Jev 1.14: 80.14% 准确率，4.50% ECE15），通用 VLM 领先序数打分并在直接 Box 定位上优于 Jev 1.14；(2) 多图与抽象推理是所有模型的瓶颈，区分点在于置信度而非准确率；(3) 可靠性随输入变化，仅渲染选项使 Jev 1.14 的选择性风险近三倍而平均符号偏差几乎不变，跨未见数据集与任务族时源域风险阈值常高于目标域风险。
AI.conclusion: OmniDecisionBench 刻画了不同模型类别各自适合的评测角度及其可靠性边界，代码与数据将开源。

title: ArrythML-II: An Optimized TinyML Framework for ECG Arrhythmia Detection and Multi-Class Beat Classification on Wearable Devices
summary: This paper presents ArrythML-II, an optimized TinyML framework for on-device ECG arrhythmia detection and multi-class beat classification on wearable platforms. A systematic hyperparameter optimization framework is developed to identify compact autoencoder architectures for binary ECG arrhythmia detection. A custom scoring mechanism jointly considers detection performance, reconstruction-error thresholds, and model size to guide architecture selection. The framework is further extended to six-class ECG beat classification using a lightweight classifier derived from the optimized autoencoder architecture. Both models are INT8 quantized and deployed using TensorFlow Lite Micro on a custom-developed, battery-operated, single-lead ECG device based on the PSoC~6 microcontroller. The deployed autoencoder and classifier have model sizes of approximately 44~KB and 22~KB, respectively, with end-to-end processing times of 5.1~ms and 4.7~ms per ECG segment. Model inference accounts for 3.95~ms and 1.38~ms of these processing times, respectively. In the refined arrhythmia detection evaluation using the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database, the autoencoder achieved an accuracy of 84.76\%, precision of 82.68\%, and recall of 77.99\%. The multi-class classifier achieved 82.29\% accuracy, weighted precision of 90.18\%, and weighted recall of 82.29\%. Beyond offline model evaluation, the wearable platform is validated using preloaded ECG segments, live ECG signals, and an ESP32-S3-based ECG emulator that replays annotated MIT-BIH recordings as analog waveforms. The results demonstrate the feasibility of integrating optimized TinyML models into wearable platforms for real-time ECG analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ArrythML-II，一个面向可穿戴平台片上 ECG 心律失常检测与多类心搏分类的优化 TinyML 框架，通过系统化超参数优化+自定义评分机制选出紧凑自编码器，并扩展为六分类轻量分类器，INT8 量化后部署于 PSoC 6 单导联 ECG 设备，模型仅约 44KB/22KB，单段处理 5.1ms/4.7ms，验证了实时可穿戴 ECG 分析的可行性。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴 ECG 设备资源极度受限（内存、算力、功耗），需要在保证检测性能的同时压缩模型尺寸并满足实时性；现有工作往往缺乏对架构选择、重建误差阈值与模型大小的系统性权衡，且少有在真实硬件上端到端验证。
AI.method: 1) 构建系统性超参数优化框架，搜索紧凑自编码器架构用于二分类 ECG 心律失常检测；2) 设计自定义评分机制，联合考虑检测性能、重建误差阈值与模型大小以指导架构选择；3) 基于最优自编码器架构派生轻量分类器，扩展到六类心搏分类；4) 两模型均 INT8 量化，用 TensorFlow Lite Micro 部署于基于 PSoC 6 的自研电池供电单导联 ECG 设备；5) 通过预载片段、实时 ECG 信号及 ESP32-S3 ECG 模拟器（回放带标注 MIT-BIH 模拟波形）三种方式进行平台验证。
AI.result: 模型大小约 44KB（自编码器）与 22KB（分类器）；端到端单段处理时间 5.1ms 与 4.7ms，其中推理分别为 3.95ms 与 1.38ms。基于 MIT-BIH 的改进评估中，自编码器准确率 84.76%、精确率 82.68%、召回率 77.99%；六分类器准确率 82.29%、加权精确率 90.18%、加权召回率 82.29%。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明将优化后的 TinyML 模型集成到可穿戴平台进行实时 ECG 分析是可行的，端到端硬件验证支持其实际部署潜力。

title: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code at https://github.com/Arist12/SWE-Gym-Verified and dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Arist12/SWE-Gym-Verified
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains coding agents on software tasks whose hidden tests decide the reward, yet task collections check these tests only against the reference fix. We ask what makes a task good training data, focusing on the correctness of its reward labels. We audit SWE-Gym with two LLM families, and a suspected error counts only if execution reproduces it. We find that unsolved often means mislabelled: 74% of the tasks that a 9B base model never solves have a test that rejects correct fixes (a false negative), versus 20% of those it sometimes solves. We repair or remove such tasks, and the audited tasks that remain train better policies. At equal size and matched difficulty, models trained on them score 2.4 and 2.7 points higher on held-out tasks from SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro than models trained on the original tasks, whereas simply dropping the never-solved tasks shows no such gain. We further find that wrong patches that pass (false positives) make up about a quarter of all passing patches, and that new tests that catch a quarter of them do not change held-out scores detectably. A pass rate shows whether a task yields reward, not whether that reward is right, so the reward labels themselves must be checked. To this end, we release SWE-Gym-Verified with its 1,087 audited tasks, every verdict with its executed evidence, our training sets, and the full audit pipeline.

AI.tldr: 审计SWE-Gym发现，9B模型从未解出的任务中74%存在假阴性测试（错误地拒绝正确修复），这解释了"未解出"往往是标签错误；修正/移除这些坏任务后，同等规模、同等难度下训练出的策略在SWE-bench Verified/Pro上分别高出2.4和2.7分，而单纯丢弃未解出任务无此收益；同时约四分之一通过补丁为假阳性，新增测试能抓到其中四分之一却不影响held-out分数。发布SWE-Gym-Verified（1,087个审计任务）及审计流水线。
AI.motivation: RL训练编码智能体依赖隐藏测试作为奖励信号，但现有任务集仅用参考修复验证测试，未检验测试本身是否正确。作者追问"什么样的任务才是好的训练数据"，聚焦奖励标签的正确性，怀疑"任务未解出"可能是测试误判而非模型能力不足。
AI.method: 用两个LLM家族审计SWE-Gym，疑似错误须经执行复现才确认；区分假阴性（正确修复被拒）与假阳性（错误补丁通过）；对任务进行修复或移除，再在等规模、难度匹配条件下比较不同训练集训练出的策略在SWE-bench Verified与Pro上的表现，并做"仅删除未解出任务"的对照实验。
AI.result: 9B基座模型从未解出的任务中74%存在假阴性测试，而偶尔解出的任务中仅20%；假阳性约占所有通过补丁的四分之一；新增能抓住四分之一假阳性的测试对held-out分数无可检测影响。审计后任务训练的策略在SWE-bench Verified和Pro上分别高出2.4与2.7分，单纯丢弃未解出任务则无增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过率只说明任务能否产生奖励，不说明奖励是否正确，因此必须审计奖励标签本身。作者发布SWE-Gym-Verified（1,087个审计任务、每条判定及其执行证据、训练集与完整审计流水线）。

title: BReD: BEV Residual Diffusion for Feed-Forward Road Gaussian Reconstruction
summary: Accurate road surface reconstruction is essential for autonomous-driving mapping and simulation, but existing methods trade reconstruction quality for cross-scene inference. Optimization-based methods recover detailed surfaces through costly per-scene optimization, while feed-forward methods lack road-specific constraints and often produce large elevation errors. We propose \textbf{BReD}, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing road elevation, appearance, and semantics from calibrated six-camera sequences. BReD first estimates coarse elevation through LiDAR-supervised depth learning and BEV lifting, using only cameras at inference. A lightweight BEV residual diffusion model then conditions elevation refinement on a camera-derived depth--elevation discrepancy and elevation-aware image features. Diffusion-indexed perturbations expose the model to different discrepancy corruption levels during training, while inference performs one deterministic refinement from the clean discrepancy. The refined elevations are temporally aggregated to anchor road-aligned Gaussians, whose attributes are predicted by a geometry-prior-guided decoder without test-time optimization. On four held-out nuScenes scenes, BReD achieves 7.34 cm elevation RMSE and 90.92\% semantic mIoU, compared with 14.43 cm for RoGS without test-time LiDAR and 8.88 cm for its test-time-LiDAR-assisted variant; both RoGS variants require per-scene optimization.

AI.tldr: BReD是一个前馈框架，从六相机序列重建道路高程、外观和语义，通过LiDAR监督的快糙高程估计、BEV残差扩散精化及时间聚合锚定道路高斯，无需测试时优化即在nuScenes上取得7.34cm高程RMSE与90.92%语义mIoU。
AI.motivation: 道路表面精确重建对自动驾驶建图与仿真至关重要，但现有方法在重建质量与跨场景推理之间取舍：基于优化的方法需昂贵的逐场景优化且泛化差，前馈方法缺乏道路特定约束、高程误差大。作者希望兼顾高质量与跨场景前馈推理。
AI.method: BReD采用三阶段前馈流程：（1）通过LiDAR监督的深度学习和BEV提升估计粗糙高程，推理仅用相机；（2）用轻量BEV残差扩散模型，以相机导出的深度-高程差异和含高程信息的图像特征为条件进行高程精化；训练时用扩散索引扰动模拟不同差异腐蚀水平，推理时从干净差异做一次确定性精化；（3）将精化高程时间聚合以锚定道路对齐高斯，属性由几何先验引导的解码器预测，无需测试时优化。
AI.result: 在四个留出的nuScenes场景上，BReD达到7.34 cm高程RMSE和90.92%语义mIoU；对比RoGS在不使用测试时LiDAR时为14.43 cm，其测试时LiDAR辅助变体为8.88 cm，且两种RoGS变体均需逐场景优化。
AI.conclusion: BReD以纯前馈方式实现了高精度道路高程、外观与语义重建，精度显著优于需逐场景优化的RoGS系列方法，兼顾了重建质量与跨场景推理效率。

title: ContextFact: Remembering Facts in Context for Long-Term Conversational Agents
summary: Agents built on large language models must maintain continuity across repeated interactions with users. However, long-term conversations scatter facts across turns and sessions, making it difficult to retrieve the right evidence with enough context. Memory for such conversations must therefore preserve facts with their context while keeping evidence selectively accessible. We first study how memory construction and retrieval-unit boundaries affect answerability and evidence access. Reading the entire memory bank reveals gaps that cannot be resolved by retrieval selection alone, showing that some context must be preserved during memory construction. Adjacent-turn grouping improves evidence access at matched unique-turn budgets, while wider windows do not consistently help. This motivates keeping fact-specific context local while organizing cross-session evidence separately. We propose ContextFact, which links context-preserving fact memories with source-grounded entity representations. Within sessions, it gathers the context needed to interpret each fact. Across sessions, it aligns recurring referents and revisits the source dialogue to reconstruct coherent entity representations linked to the supporting facts. At query time, ContextFact retrieves fact and entity views, reranks them independently, and uses entity-linked expansion to surface related facts; complete entity representations then provide organized cross-session evidence. With Qwen3.5-27B as the backbone, ContextFact achieves state-of-the-art performance while using only $21\%$ of the evidence tokens consumed by the strongest evaluated baseline, obtaining $86.49\%$ overall judge accuracy on LoCoMo and $91.00\%$ on LongMemEval-S. Controlled ablations support context-preserving fact boundaries and source-grounded entity reconstruction, while entity readout improves multi-hop accuracy beyond adding more facts.

AI.tldr: 提出 ContextFact，将保留上下文的"事实记忆"与基于原文的"实体表示"结合，在长对话中同时保证事实可解释性与跨会话证据组织，检索时代价小且效果最优。
AI.motivation: 长对话中事实分散在多个轮次和会话里，检索时难以取到足够上下文的正确证据。作者发现即使读取整个记忆库仍存在"不可解答"的缺口，单靠检索选择无法弥补，说明记忆构建阶段就必须保留上下文。
AI.method: 1）先分析记忆构建与检索单元边界的影响：相邻轮分组在相同唯一轮预算下提升证据获取，更宽窗口无稳定收益。2）据此提出 ContextFact：会话内围绕每个事实收集解释所需上下文；跨会话对齐重复指代并回溯源对话重建与事实关联的连贯实体表示。3）查询时分别检索事实视图与实体视图、独立重排，并用实体链接扩展召回相关事实，最后输出完整实体表示作为跨会话证据。
AI.result: 以 Qwen3.5-27B 为骨干，在 LoCoMo 上总体 judge 准确率 86.49%，LongMemEval-S 上 91.00%，达到 SOTA，且仅消耗最强基线 21% 的证据 token。消融实验支持"保留上下文的事实边界"和"基于原文的实体重建"有效；实体读出在多跳问题上优于单纯增加事实数量。
AI.conclusion: 记忆构建需保留事实局部上下文，跨会话证据宜单独以实体为中心组织；ContextFact 以低 token 代价实现更准确、更具证据可访问性的长对话记忆。

title: STEdgeFormer: MCU and NPU Deployable Transformer Architecture
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, Neurips 2026 workshop- SLM Agents
summary: Transformer-based sequence models have achieved strong performance in language and time-series modeling, but self-attention remains computationally and memory intensive for deployment on resource-constrained edge accelerators. We propose STEdgeFormer, a lightweight, hardware-aware sequence architecture designed for efficient execution on embedded neural accelerators. STEdgeFormer combines polynomial mixture layers and DyT normalization with an accelerator-aware causal memory block, replacing pairwise self-attention with compact causal aggregation. On TinyStories, the fully NPU-supported STEdgeFormer (MW) achieves a perplexity of 7.39 with 4.12M parameters and 6.51 MB RAM, with an end-to-end latency of 40 ms. In comparison, the standard 4.12M-parameter configuration achieves a lower perplexity of 6.79 but requires CPU fallback for unsupported operators, resulting in 1450 ms latency. Vanilla Transformer, on the other hand, achieves a perplexity score of 5.71 using a 4.40M-parameter model, but it cannot be deployed on the hardware. On downstream tasks, STEdgeFormer achieves 94% accuracy on ECG5000 and 93% accuracy on Speech Commands with 1.39M parameters. These results demonstrate that hardware-aware architectural choices and operator compatibility can have a substantial impact on practical inference latency, beyond model size and task accuracy alone. Rather than targeting state-of-the-art accuracy on individual benchmarks, STEdgeFormer is designed to provide a deployable sequence modeling architecture under the memory, computational, and operator constraints of embedded neural accelerators.

AI.tldr: STEdgeFormer 是一个面向嵌入式神经加速器的轻量级硬件感知序列模型，用多项式混合层、DyT 归一化和因果记忆块替代自注意力，在 TinyStories 上以 PPL 7.39、4.12M 参数、6.51MB 内存实现 40ms 端到端延迟，远优于需 CPU 回退的基线（1450ms）。
AI.motivation: 基于 Transformer 的序列模型虽性能强，但自注意力计算与内存开销大，难以部署在资源受限的边缘加速器上。作者真正关注的是硬件算子兼容性带来的实际推理延迟，而非单纯追求 benchmark 上的 SOTA 精度。
AI.method: 提出 STEdgeFormer 架构：将多项式混合层（polynomial mixture layers）与 DyT 归一化结合，并用加速器感知的因果记忆块（causal memory block）以紧凑的因果聚合替代成对自注意力，保证所有算子可在 NPU 上原生支持。
AI.result: TinyStories 上：全 NPU 支持的 STEdgeFormer(MW) 在 4.12M 参数、6.51MB RAM 下 PPL 7.39、延迟 40ms；同参数标准配置 PPL 6.79 但因算子不支持需 CPU 回退，延迟 1450ms；4.40M 参数的 Vanilla Transformer PPL 5.71 但无法部署。下游任务：ECG5000 准确率 94%、Speech Commands 93%，仅 1.39M 参数。
AI.conclusion: 硬件感知的架构设计与算子兼容性对实际推理延迟的影响可能超过模型规模和任务精度本身；STEdgeFormer 的目标不是单项 benchmark 的 SOTA，而是在嵌入式加速器的内存、算力与算子约束下提供可部署的序列建模方案。

title: Synthetic EHR Generators Should Be Audited Like LLMs
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Generative AI for Health (GenAI4Health) Workshop
summary: Synthetic electronic health record (EHR) generation is increasingly adopting large autoregressive models, yet privacy evaluation has not kept pace, relying heavily on similarity-based heuristics and aggregate metrics that can obscure patient-specific memorisation. We argue that these models should additionally undergo LLM-style memorisation audits at the level of individual patient records. We support this position by comparing membership-inference evaluations across four prominent autoregressive EHR generators, highlighting inconsistent evaluation practices in patient representations and attack procedures. We evaluate trajectory reconstruction from partial context and introduce randomly assigned patient-level canaries to distinguish memorised associations from clinical generalisation. We examine these methods in a GPT-2-style model deliberately overfit to 1,000 MIMIC-IV patient trajectories, creating a controlled setting in which memorisation should be readily detectable. The model systematically recovers training patients' canaries, and their trajectory reconstruction approaches perfect accuracy with increasing context. Held-out patients show no systematic canary recovery, while reconstruction remains low and improves only marginally with additional context. These experiments establish a positive-control baseline for further evaluation of these methods in realistically trained models.

AI.tldr: 论文主张合成EHR生成模型需增加患者级的LLM式记忆审计，并在过拟合的GPT-2模型上验证金丝雀与轨迹重建两类方法可有效区分记忆与临床泛化。
AI.motivation: 合成电子健康记录生成已广泛采用大型自回归模型，但隐私评估滞后，依赖相似度启发式与聚合指标，掩盖了患者级别的记忆现象。
AI.method: 对比四个主流自回归EHR生成器的成员推断评估实践，指出患者表示与攻击流程不一致；采用部分上下文轨迹重建和随机分配的患者级金丝雀；在故意对1,000条MIMIC-IV患者轨迹过拟合的GPT-2式模型上建立正控实验。
AI.result: 模型系统性恢复训练患者的金丝雀，轨迹重建准确率随上下文增加趋近完美；留出患者无系统性金丝雀恢复，重建率低且随上下文仅微弱提升。
AI.conclusion: 该实验为这些审计方法在真实训练模型中的进一步评估建立了正控基线。

title: LeanReviewBench: Semantic Alignment Review in Mathematical Lean Projects
summary: Lean verifies that a proof establishes its formal proposition, but whether that proposition preserves the mathematical content of an informal source requires separate review. In project-scale formalizations, this correspondence can depend on definitions and constraints distributed across many declarations. We introduce LeanReviewBench, a benchmark for project-level semantic alignment review containing 197 versioned inputs collected from 18 real Lean projects, with 87 aligned and 110 misaligned reference judgments. Each input binds an informal mathematical target to selected formal declarations and an extracted dependency context. Construction combines development-history discovery, independent target binding, reconstruction under a common Lean environment, and Astra annotation with human review of uncertain cases. The collection spans diverse mathematical domains and includes 69 historical pairs. We evaluate six language models with Direct and ReForm prompts on all 197 inputs against final human-reviewed reference labels. GPT-6.1 Sol with Direct prompting achieves the highest reported accuracy of 0.827 and misalignment-detection F1 of 0.844; the effects of prompting vary across models. LeanReviewBench provides a testbed for reviewing semantic correspondence in existing mathematical formalization projects. LeanReviewBench is available at https://github.com/MechMath/LeanReviewBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LeanReviewBench基准（197个来自18个真实Lean项目的版本化输入，87对齐/110错位参考判断），用于项目级"形式命题是否保持非形式数学内容"的语义对齐审查，并评测6个语言模型的Direct与ReForm提示。
AI.motivation: Lean只能验证证明可推出形式命题，但形式命题是否忠实保留非形式来源的数学内容需另行审查；在项目规模形式化中，这种对应关系依赖跨大量声明分布的定义与约束，缺乏系统评测手段。
AI.method: 构建LeanReviewBench：采集18个真实Lean项目共197个版本化输入，将非形式数学目标绑定到选定形式声明及抽取的依赖上下文；流程结合开发历史挖掘、独立目标绑定、公共Lean环境下重建、Astra标注及不确定案例人工复核；含69个历史配对，覆盖多数学领域。并以Direct与ReForm提示评测6个语言模型。
AI.result: GPT-6.1 Sol + Direct取得最高准确率0.827、错位检测F1 0.844；提示方式的效果因模型而异。
AI.conclusion: LeanReviewBench为现有数学形式化项目中的语义对应审查提供测试平台，代码公开于GitHub。

title: FastD4RT: Training-Free Acceleration of Dynamic 4D Reconstruction and Tracking
summary: Query-based 4D reconstruction models such as D4RT encode a video once into a global scene representation and obtain outputs by decoding independent point queries. However, inference is often influenced by dense outputs and long videos. Although D4RT separates encoding from decoding, a dense output still requires one decoder query for every pixel of every frame, and a long video is still encoded as many overlapping segments. In this work, we analyze the inference cost of D4RT and show that a large part of it is redundant. In particular, we find that the later decoder blocks attend to a small set of tokens shared by all queries. Based on these findings, we propose FastD4RT, a training-free framework that accelerates D4RT. By exploiting the smoothness of the outputs over time and across pixels, FastD4RT encodes and decodes only at sparse anchors and recovers the remaining outputs via interpolation. It decodes the remaining queries against a shared token set selected once per segment. We further characterize the errors introduced by both components. Experimental results show that FastD4RT accelerates D4RT by about 5 times on average across all its tasks with competitive accuracy, and further improves accuracy on long videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lycheemeng/fastd4rt.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 FastD4RT，通过稀疏锚点编解码+插值恢复、以及共享 token 集合，将 D4RT 推理加速约5倍且精度相当。
AI.motivation: D4RT 类基于查询的4D重建模型推理受密集输出与长视频影响：每帧每像素都需一次解码器查询，长视频被编码为多个重叠段，推理成本中很大一部分存在冗余。
AI.method: 分析 D4RT 推理开销，发现后段解码器块仅关注所有查询共享的小规模 token 集合；据此在输出随时间与跨像素平滑的假设下，仅在稀疏锚点处编解码并用插值恢复其余输出；剩余查询对每段只选一次的共享 token 集合进行解码；并对两部分引入的误差进行理论刻画。
AI.result: 在所有任务上平均加速约5倍，精度具有竞争力，并在长视频上进一步提升精度。
AI.conclusion: D4RT 推理存在显著冗余，FastD4RT 以无需训练的方式有效加速并保持/提升精度，代码已开源。

title: PruneNAS: Constraint Aware Neural Architecture Search based Pruning
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, British Machine Vision Conference, Lancaster, 2026
summary: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse tasks, but its high computational cost remains a major barrier. We introduce PruneNAS, a novel framework that integrates structured pruning into NAS to efficiently explore high-performing architectures while leveraging pretrained models. Unlike conventional NAS methods that train each candidate from scratch, PruneNAS generates a candidate pool by pruning pretrained networks at multiple granularity levels and formulates the selection as a global optimization problem using training-free importance metrics. This approach enables rapid evaluation of candidate architectures under strict resource constraints, dramatically reducing search time from hundreds of GPU hours to mere minutes. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that PruneNAS discovers compact, high-accuracy architectures that nearly halve the computational cost (MACs) of prior methods on ResNet-50, while also showing strong generalization on object detection tasks with YOLO. Our method bridges structured pruning and NAS, offering a practical solution for resource-constrained model deployment.

AI.tldr: PruneNAS 将结构化剪枝与神经架构搜索结合：通过对预训练网络多粒度剪枝构建候选池，用免训练重要性指标做全局优化选择，把搜索时间从数百 GPU 小时降到几分钟。
AI.motivation: 传统 NAS 计算成本极高，每个候选架构都要从零训练，成为其落地的主要障碍。
AI.method: 以预训练模型为基础，在多个粒度层级上进行结构化剪枝生成候选架构池；利用免训练的重要性指标将候选选择形式化为全局优化问题，从而在严格资源约束下快速评估候选架构。
AI.result: 在标准基准上发现紧凑且高精度的架构，相比先前方法在 ResNet-50 上计算量（MACs）近乎减半；在 YOLO 目标检测任务上表现良好泛化性；搜索时间从数百 GPU 小时降至数分钟。
AI.conclusion: 该工作打通了结构化剪枝与 NAS，为资源受限场景下的模型部署提供了实用方案。

title: RadAG: Reward-Adversarial Attention Guidance for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment of Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion and flow-based models have achieved remarkable success in generation, yet their samples often remain suboptimal in fidelity and text alignment. Two lines of inference-time methods address this: extrapolation guidance, such as classifier-free guidance (CFG) and its variants, and reward guidance, which aligns samples with reward models of human preference. Extrapolation guidance needs only forward passes, but it builds its reference by heuristic rules unrelated to the reward and therefore cannot steer sampling toward a given reward. Gradient-based reward guidance steers sampling directly toward a higher reward, but backpropagates through the entire generator at every step. This trade-off raises the question of whether extrapolation guidance can steer sampling toward a higher reward without a full backward pass. To answer this, we introduce Reward-Adversarial Attention Guidance (RadAG), which constructs the reference by perturbing the attention logits of a single block against their reward gradient and extrapolates away from it. We prove that this update increases the reward of the clean estimate to first order, while its backward pass stops at the perturbed block instead of traversing the entire generator. On FLUX.2-klein-4B and 9B with PickScore and aesthetic rewards, RadAG achieves the highest target reward in every setting with 30-65% less time than gradient-based and candidate-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Reward-Adversarial Attention Guidance (RadAG)，通过沿奖励梯度扰动单个注意力块的注意力logits构建参考点并外推，实现只需局部反向传播的奖励引导采样，在FLUX.2-klein上取得最高目标奖励且耗时减少30-65%。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流模型生成样本在保真度和文本对齐上仍不理想。外推引导（如CFG）只需前向传播但依赖与奖励无关的启发式参考，无法朝特定奖励引导；基于梯度的奖励引导能直接提升奖励但每步需对整个生成器反向传播，计算代价高。因此核心问题是：外推引导能否在不做完整反向传播的情况下将采样导向更高奖励。
AI.method: RadAG把参考点构造为：对单个注意力块的注意力logits施加与其奖励梯度相反的扰动，再沿远离该参考点的方向外推。理论上证明该更新能一阶提升干净估计的奖励，且反向传播止于被扰动的块，而非贯穿整个生成器。
AI.result: 在FLUX.2-klein-4B与9B上，使用PickScore和美学奖励，RadAG在所有设置下取得最高目标奖励，且比基于梯度和基于候选的基线快30-65%。
AI.conclusion: RadAG表明外推式引导可与奖励对齐结合：仅用单块局部梯度即可构造有奖励感知的参考，兼顾外推引导的低开销与奖励引导的有效性，为高效推理时奖励对齐提供了新思路。

title: Video-as-Weights: Compiling a Video Once into Parametric and Token Memory
summary:
Vision-language models (VLMs) represent videos as thousands of visual tokens, creating a large key-value cache whose memory grows with video length. At the same time, small VLMs that fit on limited hardware understand video far worse than large models. Existing compression methods shorten visual tokens into a brief prompt to save memory, yet the small model still processes them through fixed weights and cannot close this capability gap.
  To address both challenges, we introduce Video-as-Weights (VaW), which compiles a video once without seeing any question into the parametric and token memory of a frozen interpreter VLM. Specifically, a compiler VLM watches the video, and a single weight decoder jointly generates the interpreter's LoRA weights and optional prefix tokens from every compiler layer, enabling both same-model compilation and strong-to-weak transfer across model sizes and depths.
  Across six video QA benchmarks, a 0.8B interpreter beats full in-context reading by 1.7 points when compiled by itself and by 4.3 points with a 9B compiler, reducing context from up to 8,192 visual tokens to 64 prefix tokens while using 5.5x less memory than the video's key-value cache. Generated weights add 3.9 points over token compression alone, and all-layer decoding outperforms layer-wise generation by 2.9 points. Mechanistic analysis shows that with prefix tokens, the weights mainly alter attention queries and MLP down projections to guide retrieval and store a baseline summary, whereas without tokens, they shift to attention output projections to write video content directly into the residual stream.

AI.tldr: Video-as-Weights (VaW) 将视频一次性"编译"为冻结解释器 VLM 的 LoRA 权重与前缀 token，兼顾小模型能力提升与内存效率。
AI.motivation: VLM 用成千上万视觉 token 表示视频，KV cache 内存随视频长度膨胀；同时小 VLM 视频理解能力远逊于大模型，现有 token 压缩仅缩短成简短 prompt，小模型仍以固定权重处理，无法弥合能力差距。
AI.method: 用编译器 VLM 观看视频（不看问题），通过单一权重解码器从编译器各层联合生成解释器的 LoRA 权重及可选前缀 token，支持同模型编译与强到弱（跨规模/深度）迁移；解释器保持冻结。
AI.result: 六个视频 QA 基准上，0.8B 解释器自编译超完整上下文 1.7 分，由 9B 编译器编译超 4.3 分；上下文由最多 8192 视觉 token 降至 64 前缀 token，内存比 KV cache 少 5.5 倍；生成权重比仅 token 压缩高 3.9 分，全层解码优于逐层生成 2.9 分。机制分析：有前缀 token 时权重主要改变注意力 query 与 MLP down projection（引导检索、存储基线摘要），无 token 时则转向注意力输出投影将视频内容直接写入残差流。
AI.conclusion: 将视频编译为参数化记忆是缓解小 VLM 视频理解与内存瓶颈的有效途径，权重与 token 互补，且可解释地作用于不同子模块。

title: Seeing Is Not Acting: WARD Diagnoses the Evidence-to-State-to-Action Gap in Longitudinal Clinical Agents
summary: Large language models for longitudinal clinical care must revise their assessments and actions as patient information accumulates. However, benchmarks centered on isolated responses or final task outcomes provide limited insight into intermediate failures in evidence use, state updating, and action selection. We introduce WARD, a benchmark for evaluating how clinical agents translate accumulating evidence into patient-state judgments and timely, safe actions. WARD comprises 4,560 clinical tasks across seven clinical output domains, organized into 240 checkpoints from 40 longitudinal clinical trajectories spanning 95 hospitalizations. Its Longitudinal Track evaluates these tasks under controlled cumulative evidence. Its Interactive Track evaluates end-to-end, tool-mediated clinical management across 271 verifiable evidence items and 141 reference transitions. Across 12 models with scorable checkpoint outputs, evidence recognition consistently outpaces downstream state and action decisions, with linked-evidence nonresponse reaching 74.47--90.90\%. Models also struggle to retain and update information over time, while in the Interactive Track only 11.46\% of executed actions advance a reference transition. These results reveal a persistent evidence-to-state-to-action gap and highlight the need for process-level evaluation of longitudinal clinical agents.Code and data: https://github.com/Dingsuper-creator/WARD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WARD基准，用于评估纵向临床智能体如何将累积证据转化为患者状态判断与及时安全行动，揭示"证据—状态—行动"鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现有基准聚焦孤立回答或最终任务结果，难以洞察证据使用、状态更新与行动选择中的中间失败；而纵向临床护理要求模型随患者信息累积不断修正判断与行动。
AI.method: 构建WARD基准：包含40条纵向临床轨迹（95次住院）、240个检查点、7个临床输出域的4560个任务。设两个赛道——Longitudinal Track在受控累积证据下评估任务；Interactive Track通过工具中介评估端到端临床管理（271个可验证证据项、141个参考状态转移）。
AI.result: 在12个可评分模型中，证据识别能力始终优于下游状态与行动决策，关联证据无响应率达74.47%–90.90%；模型难以随时间保留和更新信息；Interactive Track中仅11.46%的执行动作推进了参考转移。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了持续存在的"证据→状态→行动"鸿沟，强调需要对纵向临床智能体进行过程级评估。

title: When Wrong Answers Remain Unsettled: Failure Dynamics in Recurrent Reasoners
summary: When a recurrent reasoner returns a wrong answer, is its computation finished or merely stopped? We test this on a trained Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM; 27M parameters, Sudoku-Extreme) by running the recurrence for one more inference budget and comparing with an unperturbed control. Solved answers persist (0.95 of 512 endpoints). Wrong answers mostly do not: 0.42 of near-miss answers (n=170) and 0.18 of all 512 wrong endpoints keep their answer. Perturbations from 0.05x to 20x the terminal-update scale barely change these rates, so the measurement reflects continued recurrence, not noise sensitivity. The solved-above-wrong ordering also holds in five further settings (a second seed, TRM, Maze, GRAM-guided TRM, N-Queens), but a fixed 1/2 persistence threshold does not, and neither do HRM's endpoint-spectrum and fast-versus-slow predictability patterns, which are not universal diagnostics. Perturb-and-reselect (known from prior work) is consistent with this: frozen noise gains 4.8 accuracy points (197 gained, 2 lost), but compute-matched extended depth gains 5.6 and Sudoku symmetry augmentation 34.6, so noise is not the best use of the budget. Conclusions are limited to finite horizons and one primary HRM checkpoint; they do not exclude asymptotic attractors.

AI.tldr: 通过在 Sudoku-Extreme 上对已训练 HRM（27M）额外运行一个推理预算，作者检验“错误答案究竟是计算结束还是仅仅被停止”，发现正确解稳定持续、错误解大多不持续，且该效应跨多种设置稳健，但若干诊断指标并非普适。
AI.motivation: 探究循环推理模型（如 HRM）输出错误答案时，是真正收敛到某个结果，还是仅仅在有限计算预算下被截停；并检验“正确比错误更持久”这一现象是否具有普适性。
AI.method: 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上对已训练 HRM（27M）延长一个推理预算，与未扰动的对照组比较端点答案的保持率；施加 0.05x–20x 终端更新尺度的扰动以排除噪声敏感性；在第二随机种子、TRM、Maze、GRAM 引导 TRM、N-Queens 五个设置上复现；并对比 perturb-and-reselect、等计算量延深与对称增强三种预算使用方式。
AI.result: 正确解保持率高（512 个端点中 0.95）；错误解大多不保持（近错答案 n=170 中仅 0.42、全部 512 个错误端点中仅 0.18 保持）。扰动幅度变化对保持率影响很小。“正确高于错误”的排序在五个额外设置中成立，但固定的 1/2 保持阈值不普适，HRM 的端点谱与快慢可预测性模式也不普适。Perturb-and-reselect 提升 4.8 点（197 得 2 失），而等计算量延深提升 5.6 点、Sudoku 对称增强提升 34.6 点。
AI.conclusion: 错误答案多为“被停止”而非“已结束”，正确解具有更强持续性；但该现象的量化阈值与部分诊断模式不普适。噪声重选不如延深与数据增强高效。结论限于有限时域与单一主 HRM 检查点，不排除渐近吸引子。

title: Pixel Auto-Encoder: Reconstructing Language Model Activations Through Pixel Art
summary: Interpreting the high-dimensional internal representations of large language models (LLMs) remains a challenging problem. Recent approaches have explored translating these representations into human-understandable forms, particularly natural language. In this work, we explore the use of images as an alternative target modality for interpreting LLM activations. As a first step toward this goal, we introduce Pixel Auto-Encoder, which converts intermediate LLM activations into $32 \times 32$, 32-color pixel art and reconstructs them for subsequent computation within the model. By encouraging the intermediate representations to resemble predefined concept images, we investigate whether LLM activations can be expressed visually while preserving the model's language capabilities. We find that the model can produce target-aligned images for some concepts, and that replacing pixel representations with concept images can influence next-token predictions. However, we also observe a trade-off between visual alignment and language-model performance, as well as sensitivity to pixel-level changes that are difficult to interpret visually. These findings demonstrate the feasibility and limitations of image-based representations of LLM activations.

AI.tldr: 提出Pixel Auto-Encoder，将LLM中间激活转为32×32、32色像素画并可重建回模型，探索用图像而非自然语言解释LLM表征的可行性与局限。
AI.motivation: LLM高维内部表征难以解释；已有工作多将激活翻译为自然语言，本文探索图像作为替代目标模态来解释LLM激活。
AI.method: 设计Pixel Auto-Encoder：把LLM中间激活编码为32×32、32色像素画，再解码重建以继续参与后续计算（替代原激活）；通过鼓励中间表征接近预定义概念图像，检验激活能否被视觉化表达且不丧失语言能力；并测试用概念图像替换像素表示对下一token预测的影响。
AI.result: 模型对部分概念能生成与目标对齐的图像；用概念图像替换像素表示可影响下一token预测；但存在视觉对齐与语言模型性能之间的权衡，且对难以视觉解释的像素级改动较为敏感。
AI.conclusion: 图像作为LLM激活解释模态具有可行性，但存在明显局限：视觉对齐与语言能力难以兼得，且像素级敏感性削弱可解释性，为后续研究指明了方向。

title: A Closed-Form Temporal Readout for Surgical Triplet Recognition
summary: Surgical triplet recognition requires identifying which instrument performs which action on which anatomical target, and following these interactions as they unfold over time. The task is challenging because several triplets can occur at once, their components span very different durations, and the evidence for an interaction is rarely complete in a single frame. We introduce STRIDE, a post-hoc temporal readout that adds temporal context to any trained recogniser. It averages the recogniser's features and logits over a few fixed temporal windows and combines them with the current frame through ridge regression, solved in closed form on a CPU. Applied as a plug-and-play readout to nine existing methods, STRIDE improves $AP_{IVT}$ in 24 of 27 method-dataset pairs, by up to 7.4 points. Moreover, we propose a simple pipeline consisting of an adapted foundation vision encoder with a linear classifier and STRIDE. Across thirteen encoders, STRIDE improves 37 of 39 encoder-dataset pairs by up to 7.2 points. STRIDE reduces false alarms by 41%, at the cost of a slower response at interaction boundaries. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: STRIDE是一种即插即用的后处理时间读出模块，通过对任意已训练识别器的特征与logits做多尺度时间窗平均并用闭式岭回归融合当前帧，为手术三元组识别补充时间上下文。
AI.motivation: 手术三元组识别需同时判断器械-动作-解剖目标的组合并跟踪其随时间演化；难点在于多个三元组并发、各组件持续时间差异大、单帧证据不完整。
AI.method: 将识别器在若干固定时间窗上的特征和logits求平均，与当前帧特征通过岭回归（CPU闭式求解）组合，作为可加在任何已训练识别器上的后处理读出；并给出"适配的基础视觉编码器+线性分类器+STRIDE"的简洁流水线。
AI.result: 作为即插即用读出应用于9种现有方法，27个方法-数据集组合中24个提升AP_IVT，最高+7.4；在13个编码器上，39个组合中37个提升，最高+7.2；误报降低41%，代价是交互边界处响应变慢。
AI.conclusion: 时间上下文可低成本显著提升三元组识别性能，方法通用性强、无需重训练；但存在边界响应延迟的固有权衡。

title: Dual-Side Uncertainty Estimation: Calibrating Data and Model Uncertainty into a Shared Probability Space
summary: Multimodal user intention analysis infers latent goals from heterogeneous behavioral observations but faces cross-modal input mismatch and output semantic errors. Existing uncertainty estimators focus on input reliability or output confidence and often reduce token uncertainty to simple statistics, overlooking structured dependencies. We propose DUE (Dual-Side Uncertainty Estimation), which jointly estimates input-side aleatoric and sentence-level epistemic uncertainty. From a single generation, Dirichlet perturbations of cross-layer representations produce an ordered token uncertainty sequence. A sequence-aware Normal-Inverse-Gamma estimator uses this sequence to quantify epistemic uncertainty and confidence in its estimate. Evidential multimodal alignment captures aleatoric uncertainty from noisy, incomplete, or inconsistent inputs. DUE calibrates both heterogeneous scores into a shared error-probability space and sequentially fuses them to estimate overall generation risk. Experiments demonstrate strong performance in input-mismatch detection, output semantic-error detection, and overall reliability estimation without repeated generation.

AI.tldr: 提出DUE框架，联合估计输入端偶然不确定性与句级认知不确定性，并融合为统一风险以检测多模态意图分析中的输入失配与输出语义错误。
AI.motivation: 多模态用户意图分析中存在跨模态输入失配和输出语义错误；现有不确定性估计器只关注输入可靠性或输出置信度，常把token不确定性简化为统计量，忽略结构化依赖。
AI.method: DUE：对跨层表示做Dirichlet扰动，从单次生成得到有序token不确定性序列；用序列感知的Normal-Inverse-Gamma估计器量化认知不确定性与置信度；用证据式多模态对齐捕获输入噪声/缺失/不一致带来的偶然不确定性；将两类异质分数校准到共享的错误概率空间并顺序融合。
AI.result: 在输入失配检测、输出语义错误检测和整体可靠性估计上均表现良好，且无需重复生成。
AI.conclusion: 双端不确定性联合建模与分数校准融合可有效提升多模态意图分析的可靠性估计。

title: Learning from Another Angle: Rotation-Based Test-Time Training for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on vision-language tasks but often remain vulnerable to distribution shifts due to their fixed parameters during inference. While Test-Time Training (TTT) offers a pathway for dynamic adaptation, existing approaches suffer from prohibitive computational overhead due to multiple sampling and the risk of error reinforcement from biased self-generated supervision. In light of this view, we propose RoTTT (Rotation-based Test-Time Training), a simple and efficient TTT approach that enables instance-specific refinement at inference time. For each test instance, RoTTT performs a small number of gradient updates by predicting the rotation angle of the input image. The known rotation angles naturally serve as a reliable self-supervised signal, enabling lightweight and stable adaptation without requiring additional annotations. Extensive experiments across multiple vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that RoTTT consistently improves performance across different MLLMs, providing a practical and efficient paradigm for on-the-fly MLLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: RoTTT：用"预测图像旋转角度"作为可靠自监督信号，在推理时对多模态大模型做少量梯度更新，实现轻量稳定的测试时自适应。
AI.motivation: MLLM 参数量在推理时固定，面对分布偏移易失效；现有测试时训练（TTT）方法因多次采样导致计算开销过大，且依赖模型自生成伪标签带来误差强化的风险。
AI.method: 对每个测试样本进行少量梯度更新，训练目标为预测输入图像被旋转的角度；旋转角度本身已知，天然构成无偏、可靠的自监督信号，无需额外标注，从而避免多采样和伪标签偏差。
AI.result: 在多个视觉-语言基准上，RoTTT 对不同 MLLM 均带来一致的性能提升，同时保持较低计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 旋转预测这一简单任务可作为高效稳定的测试时自监督信号，为 MLLM 的即时自适应提供了实用范式。

title: Hidden Sensitivity in LLM Pre-training: A Dynamic System View
summary: In Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training, loss curves can conceal substantial instability, i.e., even small perturbations may lead to dramatically different predictions while leaving loss nearly unchanged. To investigate this phenomenon and reveal the underlying mechanisms, we first formulate LLM pre-training as a non-autonomous dynamical system that jointly evolves model weights and Adam optimizer states. Based on this formulation, we introduce a normalized sensitivity score in optimizer-relative coordinates to identify sensitive training checkpoints. At one such checkpoint, a weight perturbation of only 10^(-5) leads to 35.7% disagreement in top-1 predictions and 16.2% disagreement in benchmark answers after 200 training steps, with only 0.8% of greedy generations remaining identical despite similar validation losses. Furthermore, we find that perturbations to Adam's first and second moments induce comparably large effects, with similar sensitivity patterns observed in OLMo-1B. Finally, guided by our diagnostic, targeted stabilization reduces top-1 disagreement to 0.83% and increases generation exact match to 88.3%, at the cost of a 0.11-nat increase in validation loss. Our findings reveal a hidden form of optimizer-state-dependent sensitivity in LLM pre-training that conventional loss-based evaluations may overlook, while demonstrating its potential for diagnosis and mitigation.

AI.tldr: LLM预训练中损失曲线会掩盖不稳定性；作者用非自治动力系统刻画权重与Adam状态的联合演化，提出优化器相对坐标下的归一化敏感度分数来定位敏感检查点，并据此进行定向稳定化。
AI.motivation: 预训练损失看似平稳，但小幅扰动即可导致预测剧烈变化而损失几乎不变，这种"隐藏不稳定性"未被传统基于损失的评价捕捉，其机制也不清楚。
AI.method: 将预训练建模为权重与Adam一阶、二阶矩联合演化的非自治动力系统；在优化器相对坐标下定义归一化敏感度分数以识别敏感检查点；在敏感点施加10^-5量级权重扰动及对Adam两个矩的扰动进行对比，并在OLMo-1B上验证；最后依据诊断结果做定向稳定化。
AI.result: 敏感检查点上10^-5权重扰动经200步训练后导致top-1预测35.7%不一致、基准答案16.2%不一致、仅0.8%贪婪生成保持一致（验证损失相近）；Adam一阶、二阶矩扰动影响相当，OLMo-1B呈类似敏感模式；定向稳定化将top-1不一致降至0.83%、生成精确匹配升至88.3%，代价是验证损失增加0.11 nat。
AI.conclusion: LLM预训练存在依赖优化器状态的隐藏敏感性，损失类评价可能遗漏；该诊断方法可定位并缓解此类不稳定性。

title: DeFlowCritic: Dense Latent Reward Alignment for Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models
summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for aligning text-to-image flow matching models with complex user intent. However, existing methods typically rely on sparse rewards computed only from final decoded images. This delays credit assignment across the denoising trajectory and makes training computationally expensive. Moreover, simply combining multiple rewards does not reliably produce a Pareto trade-off, where gains in compositional accuracy often degrade aesthetic quality. In this work, we propose DeFlowCritic, an efficient online RL framework based on Dense Latent Reward Alignment. Unlike prior work, our method provides dense supervision on intermediate latents, enabling early-stage guidance for the denoising trajectory. To achieve this, we introduce an internal critic that evaluates noisy latents using features extracted directly from the diffusion model, a representation inherently better suited for latent-space reward estimation than standard image encoders. We construct a high-quality reward-modeling dataset with continuous scores for critic training, capturing compositional correctness on high-quality reference images. The resulting dense reward enables efficient online RL training and inference-time scaling. Experiments show that our method achieves a superior balance between prompt faithfulness and visual quality on GenEval2 and T2I-CompBench++ benchmarks. The approach also generalizes across text-to-image flow matching models, including SD3.5-Medium, SD3.5-Large, and FLUX.1-dev.

AI.tldr: 提出DeFlowCritic，一种基于稠密隐空间奖励对齐的高效在线RL框架，用于文本到图像流匹配模型对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有在线RL方法仅用最终解码图像的稀疏奖励，导致去噪轨迹上的信用分配延迟、训练昂贵；且简单组合多奖励难以获得帕累托权衡，组合准确率提升往往损害美学质量。
AI.method: 在中间隐变量上提供稠密监督，实现去噪轨迹的早期引导；引入内部critic，利用扩散模型自身提取的特征评估带噪隐变量；构建高质量含连续分数的奖励建模数据集用于critic训练。
AI.result: 在GenEval2和T2I-CompBench++上实现提示忠实度与视觉质量更优平衡，并可泛化到SD3.5-Medium、SD3.5-Large和FLUX.1-dev。
AI.conclusion: 稠密奖励支持高效在线RL训练与推理时扩展，可作为跨多种流匹配模型的通用对齐方案。

title: Do You Even Know What I Want? Improving LLMs Ability to Detect Hidden User Intent
summary: As with conventional AI agents, a common source of misalignment between Large Language Models (LLMs) and their human users is misspecified goals. Often, this happens when the human has skewed beliefs about the system's model and provides it with information that causes behavior different from what they expected, with potentially unwanted side effects. To ensure goal alignment, one solution would be for the LLM to ask the human questions about their objectives. However, it has been well-documented that LLMs most often provide default responses to user requests rather than try and ask questions to clarify their true intent. In this paper, we address these challenges by adapting a novel formulation for the objective misspecification problem to work with LLMs. We then test if LLMs that are prompted to ask questions about a user's true underlying objectives are better at identifying them compared to those that do not. We evaluate our method using four state-of-the-art LLMs tested on five standard IPC domains, showing that for some domains, asking questions greatly improved model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文将目标错误指定问题重新表述并适配到LLM场景，测试提示LLM主动提问澄清用户真实目标是否能改善目标对齐，在四个SOTA LLM与五个IPC领域上验证其效果。
AI.motivation: LLM与用户之间存在目标错配，常因用户对系统模型持有偏差信念而给出误导信息。理论上LLM应主动提问澄清意图，但已有研究表明LLM倾向给出默认回答而非追问，因此需要研究提问机制能否缓解目标错误指定问题。
AI.method: 作者为LLM场景适配了一种新的目标错误指定问题表述，并对比两类LLM：被提示就用户真实底层目标提问的模型，与不做提问的模型，评估其识别真实目标的能力。实验使用四个最先进LLM，在五个标准IPC规划领域上进行测试。
AI.result: 在部分IPC领域中，提问显著提升了模型性能，说明主动提问有助于LLM识别用户真实目标；但改进幅度因领域而异，并非普遍有效。
AI.conclusion: 提示LLM提问是缓解目标错误指定的可行手段，但效果依赖具体领域，未来需研究何时、如何提问才能稳定提升目标对齐。

title: AgriManager: A Framework and Benchmark for LLM-RL Generalization in Agricultural Management
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: Agricultural management is heterogeneous along two axes. The first is distributional shift within a fixed task interface: weather, crops, and prices vary across years and locations while sensors, actions, and objective stay fixed. The second is structural shift across interfaces: different farms expose different observed variables, available actions, and management objectives. We formalize the second axis as schema shift: variation in the policy-facing schema $Σ= (Σ_O, Σ_A, Σ_R)$ between training and deployment. We test whether LLM-RL generalizes across both axes with AgriManager, to our knowledge the first framework that trains LLM policies with RL across multiple process-based crop simulators, unifying DSSAT, WOFOST, and Cycles. We design a three-tier generalization ladder: Tier 1 within-schema distributional shift, Tier 2 single-axis schema shift along $Σ_O / Σ_A / Σ_R$, Tier 3 compositional schema shift across simulators, all scored on a frozen held-out test suite with three training seeds per method. Within fixed schemas, Qwen3-4B trained by RL with explicit reasoning exceeds neural-network PPO trained with the same interaction budget; without reasoning, training stalls near no-action where the reward penalizes input use. Under single-axis schema shift, $Σ_O$ transfer needs decision-critical state, $Σ_A$ results are consistent with joint action-menu coverage, and with reasoning a policy trained on yield alone transfers to unseen objectives. Under compositional schema shift, single-source training mostly hurts zero-shot transfer across simulators, and a unified policy trained only on other combinations of the same components recovers about 86% of the gain of a specialist trained on the target combination on DSSAT and stays below the specialists on the WOFOST and Cycles profit targets. Project page: https://agrimanager-framework.github.io

AI.tldr: 论文提出AgriManager框架，首次用强化学习在多个基于过程的作物模拟器（DSSAT、WOFOST、Cycles）上训练LLM策略，并将农业管理的异质性形式化为"分布位移"和"模式位移"两轴，设计三层泛化阶梯进行系统评测。
AI.motivation: 农业管理在真实部署中面临两类异质性：同一任务接口内的分布位移（天气、作物、价格变化），以及跨接口的结构性位移（不同农场观测变量、可行动作、管理目标不同）。作者希望检验LLM-RL能否同时泛化于这两轴，而现有工作缺乏统一框架来训练和评测这一能力。
AI.method: 形式化"模式位移"为策略所面对的模式Σ=(Σ_O, Σ_A, Σ_R)在训练与部署间的变化；构建AgriManager框架，统一DSSAT、WOFOST、Cycles三个作物模拟器进行LLM策略RL训练；设计三层泛化阶梯：Tier 1同模式分布位移，Tier 2沿Σ_O/Σ_A/Σ_R的单轴模式位移，Tier 3跨模拟器的组合式模式位移；在冻结的留出测试集上评测，每种方法用三个训练种子。对比Qwen3-4B+RL与相同交互预算的神经网络PPO。
AI.result: 固定模式下，带显式推理的Qwen3-4B经RL训练超过同预算的神经网络PPO；无推理时训练停滞在"不行动"附近（奖励惩罚投入即如此）。单轴模式位移下：Σ_O迁移依赖决策关键状态；Σ_A结果符合联合动作菜单覆盖的解释；有推理时仅用产量目标训练的策略可迁移到未见目标。组合式模式位移下：单源训练多半损害跨模拟器零样本迁移；仅在同一组件其他组合上训练的通用策略，在DSSAT上恢复了目标组合专家约86%的增益，但在WOFOST和Cycles的利润目标上仍低于专家。
AI.conclusion: LLM-RL在农业管理上能处理模式内分布位移，并在单轴模式位移下展现有条件的泛化（依赖决策关键状态、动作覆盖与推理能力）；但组合式模式位移下零样本迁移困难，通用策略虽接近专家却未在利润类目标上超越专家，说明结构泛化仍是开放挑战。

title: eSPG: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Event Speckle Plethysmography
summary: Non-contact measurement of vital signs such as heart rate (HR) is valuable for patient monitoring and rescue operations. However, existing methods struggle with ambient illumination and motion, and have been demonstrated only at distances of tens of meters. Here we introduce event speckle plethysmography (eSPG), which illuminates a body part with a low-power (0.5-5 mW) laser and captures the resulting dynamic speckle pattern using an event camera. Event cameras, with their high dynamic range, temporal resolution, and sensitivity to intensity changes, are well-suited to capturing rapid speckle fluctuations that encode the physiological signal, even under challenging illumination and imaging conditions. We demonstrate HR estimation at 1 km with a mean absolute error of 5 beats per minute, and 90% of estimates satisfy an AAMI-defined HR estimation criterion. This distance exceeds previous remote plethysmography demonstrations by an order of magnitude and previous speckle plethysmography demonstrations by over three orders of magnitude. We also study and characterize robustness to motion and ambient illumination. Our theoretical analysis and experimental results demonstrate that resolving dynamic speckle fluctuations enables accurate heart rate estimation even at kilometer-scale distances, establishing a new direction toward robust, non-contact physiological monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出事件散斑光电容积描记（eSPG），用低功率激光照射身体部位并以事件相机捕捉动态散斑，实现1公里距离心率估计，平均绝对误差5 bpm，90%估计满足AAMI标准。
AI.motivation: 非接触生命体征测量（如心率）对病人监护和救援有价值，但现有方法易受环境光和运动干扰，且仅在数十米距离验证，无法满足远距离需求。
AI.method: 用0.5-5 mW低功率激光照射身体部位产生动态散斑，利用事件相机高动态范围、高时间分辨率和对强度变化敏感的特性捕获快速散斑波动并解析生理信号；同时对运动和光照鲁棒性进行了理论分析与实验表征。
AI.result: 在1公里距离实现心率估计，平均绝对误差5 bpm，90%的估计满足AAMI心率估计标准；比以往远程PPG演示远一个数量级，比散斑PPG远三个数量级以上，并表征了对运动和光照的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 解析动态散斑波动可在公里级距离准确估计心率，为鲁棒的非接触生理监测开辟新方向。

title: Beyond Omission: Measuring Critical-Information Fulfillment of Large Language Models in Bengali and English
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Data, rubrics, responses, scores and code: https://github.com/HeyAvijitRoy/multilingual-trustworthiness-study
summary: Evaluations of multilingual trustworthiness often ask whether a model leaves out information that a user needs. We examine whether that question is sufficient. Using 157 matched tasks written in English (EN), natural Bengali (BN) and Bengali-matrix Bengali-English code-switching (BN-CS), we scored 1,413 responses from three models (GPT-6.1 Sol, Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma 4 12B) against required information units (RIUs) fixed before any model was run. The scoring separates outright omission from content that is present but incorrect, insufficient or only partly met. The prespecified primary estimand, the domain-equal paired difference in critical omission rate (BN - EN), showed no detectable difference (+0.003, 95% CI -0.014 to +0.015), with omission near zero in every condition. The Bengali deficit appeared in fulfillment instead. Critical coverage was 0.050 lower in Bengali (95% CI 0.022 to 0.079) and strict complete-task success 0.093 lower (95% CI 0.055 to 0.131); both gaps came from the two open-weight models, and Sol showed none. Code-switching recovered part of the loss in RIU coverage (+0.028, 95% CI 0.012 to 0.045). On these data, an omission count alone would have shown no language gap. The automated judge passed prespecified agreement gates after a documented failed first attempt. A blind native-speaker rating of 60 study responses agreed with it on RIU scores (alpha 0.84) and critical RIUs (98% exact) but fell short on Bengali RIU agreement (alpha 0.77) and on the unsupported-content check (93% exact), and a blind check of its reason codes agreed on whether a critical unit was omitted for 79 of 81 units. Data, rubrics, responses, scores and code are released.

AI.tldr: 本文检验"遗漏信息"这一评测标准是否足以衡量多语言可信度：在多语言（英/孟加拉语/孟英混合）匹配任务中发现遗漏率几乎为零且无语言差异，孟加拉语的真实劣势体现在答案满足度与完整成功率上。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言可信度评测通常只问模型是否遗漏了用户需要的信息（omission），作者质疑这一单维度指标是否足够，尤其是在低资源语言与代码转换场景下可能掩盖真实的语言能力差距。
AI.method: 构建157个英/自然孟加拉语/孟英代码转换三语匹配任务，预先固定"必需信息单元"（RIU）；对三个模型（GPT-6.1 Sol、Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma 4 12B）的1,413条回答打分，区分"完全遗漏"与"存在但错误/不足/部分满足"。主要指标为领域等权的关键遗漏率配对差（BN−EN），辅以关键覆盖率与严格完整任务成功率，并做自动评审一致性检验与盲评母语者人工验证。
AI.result: 关键遗漏率BN−EN差为+0.003（95%CI −0.014~+0.015），各条件下遗漏近乎为零；孟加拉语劣势出现在满足度：关键覆盖率低0.050（0.022~0.079），严格完整成功率低0.093（0.055~0.131），且差距全部来自两个开放权重模型，Sol无差距。代码转换挽回部分RIU覆盖损失（+0.028）。自动评审通过预设一致性门槛；母语者盲评在RIU分数（α=0.84）与关键RIU（98%完全一致）上相符，但孟加拉语RIU一致性（α=0.77）与无依据内容检查（93%）略低，原因码在81个单元中79个一致。
AI.conclusion: 仅统计遗漏会使语言差距"隐形"；多语言可信度评测需纳入覆盖率与完整满足度等细粒度指标。研究数据、评分规则、回答、分数与代码均已公开。

title: The Retry Tax: Why Static Same-Task Retries Can Cost More per Completion
summary: Retrying an agent after failure can complete more tasks while increasing the cost per completion. We study a static policy that stops at verified success or an attempt cap and otherwise resets the original prompt and workspace without passing feedback to the next request. Under stationary task success probabilities, independent attempts conditional on the task, and a common attempt cost, easier tasks tend to succeed earlier. When task success probabilities differ, the unresolved mix shifts toward harder tasks. Specializing classical survivor selection, we show that cost per completion is at least as high as in one-shot serving and that marginal cost per additional completion is nondecreasing wherever the completion increments are positive. These are different quantities: one averages spending over all completions, while the other prices the completions added by another attempt. We then arrange each task's existing benchmark runs in different orders, stop each sequence at verified success or the attempt cap, and average the resulting completion and spending at each supported cap. For one OpenHands configuration, replay estimates completion of 59.7 percent with one attempt and 70.0 percent with four, while cost per completion rises from about USD 0.70 to USD 1.32. The recorded trade-off describes fixed configurations on the available tasks. Choosing a cap requires comparing the additional spending with the application's value for the additional completions.

AI.tldr: 论文研究智能体重试失败的静态策略（验证成功或达尝试上限即停止，不传递反馈），证明每次完成的成本不低于单次服务且边际成本非递减，并用OpenHands数据回放量化了完成率与成本间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 重试可提高任务完成率但也会抬升单位完成成本，需要从理论上厘清重试策略的成本性质，并给出可操作的完成率—成本权衡证据，以便应用中据此选择尝试上限。
AI.method: 设定静态策略：验证成功或触及尝试上限即停止，否则重置原始提示与工作区、不传递反馈。在任务成功率平稳、任务内各次尝试独立、单次尝试成本相同的假设下进行理论分析；通过"幸存者选择"刻画未解决任务组成向更难任务漂移，推导每次完成成本与边际成本性质。实证上对每项任务已有的基准运行按不同顺序重排，按上限截断至验证成功或上限，再对各上限平均完成率与花费。
AI.result: 理论上，每次完成的成本至少与一次性服务一样高，且在完成增量为正处其边际成本非递减；二者含义不同：前者对所有完成平均分摊花费，后者为额外一次尝试新增完成的定价。实证上，某OpenHands配置回放估计：1次尝试完成率59.7%、4次为70.0%；每次完成成本从约0.70美元升至1.32美元。
AI.conclusion: 所记录的权衡描述的是固定配置在现有任务上的表现。选择尝试上限需将额外花费与应用对额外完成的价值相比较，而非只看完成率提升。

title: Dynamic Model Merging with Multi-Layer Aggregated Routing Evidence
summary: Dynamic model merging aims to retain the efficiency of a unified model while better preserving task-specific expertise through input-dependent routing at both the task and head levels. However, even the routing components of the state-of-the-art approach remain limited: the task routing is highly sensitive to the choice of routing layer, whereas the head routing relies on simple max-logit competition. To address these limitations, we propose multi-layer aggregated routing evidence (MATE) as a unified mechanism for improving both task and head routing. Specifically, we first introduce a metric to quantify task routing separability across different layers. Empirical analysis of this metric reveals that different layers provide complementary evidence for identifying the tasks relevant to an input. Motivated by this observation, MATE selects multiple informative layers according to their routing separability and aggregates their layer-wise routing scores to produce a more robust signal that can be directly used for task selection. Moreover, we observe that this signal also encodes useful information about the suitability of the corresponding classification heads. This motivates us to further combine the MATE signal with the max-logit score to guide classification head selection. Extensive experiments on vision benchmarks demonstrate that MATE consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出多层级聚合路由证据(MATE)，通过选择多个信息层并聚合其路由分数，统一改进动态模型合并中的任务路由与头路由。
AI.motivation: 现有动态模型合并方法的路由组件存在局限：任务路由对路由层选择高度敏感，头路由仅依赖简单的最大logit竞争。
AI.method: 提出量化不同层任务路由可分性的指标；据此选择多个信息层，聚合各层路由分数形成稳健信号用于任务选择；同时将该信号与max-logit分数结合指导分类头选择。
AI.result: 在视觉基准上的大量实验表明MATE一致性达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 不同层提供互补的任务识别证据，多层级聚合路由可同时提升任务路由与头路由的鲁棒性与效果。

title: Learning a Rule Bank to Revise 3D CT Reports with Independent Evidence
summary: Vision--language models can generate fluent radiology reports from 3D chest CT scans, yet they may still omit abnormalities or misstate findings. Independent image analysis using models separate from the report model provides additional observations, but acting on uncertain evidence may introduce new errors. We propose an agent system that learns a revision policy represented as an executable rule bank for each report model. Inspired by experience banks, the agent proposes and refines rules using revision outcomes across development cases. During inference, the retained rules guide local edits using independent classifier predictions and quantitative image measurements without retraining the report model. Unedited sentences are preserved, and each change is linked to the rule that triggered it. On CT-RATE, revision increases CE-F1 by 11.5 points for SelfCue-KD and 0.9 points for NV-Reason-CT, with gains across five draft-sampling seeds. SelfCue-KD's CT-FineBench score also increases by 15.2 points. Draft-only rule learning yields limited gains, while the two image-evidence sources provide complementary benefits for abnormality detection. Measurements also supply numerical details missing from the drafts. These results support learning model-specific rules to control how independent image evidence informs report revision. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/CT-RuleBank.

AI.tldr: 提出智能体系统，为每个报告模型学习可执行规则库形式的修订策略，利用独立图像证据选择性修订3D胸部CT报告。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型生成的放射报告可能遗漏或误述异常；引入独立图像分析可提供额外观察，但盲目采纳不确定证据会引入新错误，需控制证据使用方式。
AI.method: 智能体借鉴"经验库"思路，在开发病例上根据修订结果提出并精炼规则，形成每个报告模型专属的规则库；推理时保留规则引导局部编辑，借助独立分类器预测与定量图像测量，无需重训练报告模型，未编辑句子保留且每处修改可追溯到触发规则。
AI.result: CT-RATE上CE-F1分别提升11.5点(SelfCue-KD)与0.9点(NV-Reason-CT)，五个采样种子均有效；SelfCue-KD的CT-FineBench提升15.2点；仅用草稿学习规则收益有限，两类图像证据互补，测量补充数值细节。
AI.conclusion: 学习模型专属规则以控制独立图像证据如何影响报告修订是有效的，兼顾可追溯性与不重训练。

title: From Vanishing Gradients to Recursive Self-Improvement: Evaluating the Most Influential Papers in Large Language Model Evolution (1997-2026)
summary: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Model (LLM) research makes it increasingly difficult to distinguish incremental refinements from true paradigm shifts. This review evaluates 22 of the most influential publications spanning nearly three decades (1997-2026), organized through a causal, chronologically anchored taxonomy centered on the author's birth year (1999). Beginning "before 1999" with how recurrent neural networks (RNNs) forgot earlier context (much like forgetting Chapter 1 by the time a reader reaches Chapter 9), we trace how Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks introduced a "bouncer" mechanism of forget, input, and output gates to selectively preserve long-term memory. We then examine how Word2Vec turned language into vector mathematics (king - male + female ~ queen), why sequential RNNs hit a parallelization wall, and how the Transformer's all-to-all attention weights launched the modern LLM era alongside a quadratic bottleneck. Next, we analyze why scaling parameters alone leaves capacity under-trained unless data scales equally (Chinchilla), how Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) left alignment superficial, and how that gap compounded into adversarial jailbreaks and single-direction refusal subspaces (J-space), where instructing a model not to think of a restricted concept surfaces it much like the human "red ball" paradox. Finally, we synthesize the current state of AI (2024-2026), encompassing recursive model collapse, autonomous reasoning-model jailbreak agents, machine-speed agentic intrusions, and closed-loop recursive self-improvement (AIDE^2).

AI.tldr: 该综述以作者出生年1999为时间锚点，用因果式分类将22篇近三十年（1997-2026）最具影响力的LLM文献串成一条主线：RNN遗忘→LSTM门控→Word2Vec向量化→Transformer注意力→缩放定律→RLHF对齐局限→越狱与拒答子空间→递归崩塌与自主智能体风险。
AI.motivation: LLM研究爆发式增长，使人们难以区分渐进式改进与真正的范式转移；需要一个有时间锚点、有因果逻辑的谱系梳理，帮助把握领域演进的主线与当前风险格局。
AI.method: 文献综述：选取22篇高影响力出版物，构建以1999年为锚点的按时间排序的因果分类体系，逐一分析各里程碑的动机、机制与遗留瓶颈，并强调前后节点之间的因果关系（如RNN并行化瓶颈催生Transformer、对齐表层化衍生越狱与拒答子空间）。
AI.result: 形成了一条清晰的演进链条：LSTM门控解决长程遗忘；Word2Vec实现语言向量化；Transformer以全对全注意力突破串行瓶颈但引入二次复杂度；Chinchilla揭示参数与数据需同步缩放；RLHF对齐偏表层，导致对抗越狱与单向拒答子空间（J-space）；2024-2026阶段出现递归模型崩塌、自主推理越狱智能体、机器速度智能体入侵与闭环递归自我改进（AIDE²）。
AI.conclusion: 理解LLM须把握各里程碑间的因果承接而非孤立罗列；当前安全与能力风险的根源多可追溯到早期架构与对齐方式的遗留缺陷，未来研究需在缩放、对齐深度与智能体自主性上协同推进。

title: MVAgent: Per-Video Agents under Global Coordination for Multi-Video Understanding
summary: Multi-video understanding requires systems to combine evidence from different videos for cross-video reasoning. Answering such questions involves two kinds of decisions. Observation decisions must adapt to each video's content, whereas cross-video judgments require relating evidence from different videos based on the question. Most existing agents make both kinds of decisions in one controller, whose context accumulates observations from every video. We separate them in MVAgent, a training-free Multi-Video Understanding Agent framework with one LocalAgent per video. Each LocalAgent plans observations of its own video and keeps a private observation history. A GlobalAgent coordinates cross-video reasoning by instructing the LocalAgents and combining their reports with joint observation. We evaluate MVAgent on CVBench, MVU-Eval, and CrossVid, using three Qwen3.5 models of different sizes and GPT-6-sol. With Qwen3.5, our framework improves aggregate benchmark scores by 5.1 points on average over Single-pass inference with the same model and by 5.0 points over the strongest prior agent using the same model. With GPT-6-sol, the average gain over Single-pass inference with the same model is 4.3 points. On the same hardware, MVAgent also runs 1.8-2.7 times faster than prior agents of comparable size.

AI.tldr: MVAgent是一个无需训练的多视频理解智能体框架，通过每个视频配一个LocalAgent、再由GlobalAgent协调跨视频推理，分离"观察决策"与"跨视频判断"，在三个基准上平均提升约5分且提速1.8-2.7倍。
AI.motivation: 多视频理解需综合多个视频的证据进行跨视频推理，包含两类决策：观察决策需适配各视频内容，跨视频判断需基于问题关联不同视频证据。现有智能体把两类决策放在同一个控制器中，导致上下文累积所有视频的观察，相互干扰、效率低。
AI.method: 提出MVAgent，训练-free的Multi-Video Understanding Agent框架。为每个视频配置一个LocalAgent，各自规划本视频的观察并维护私有观察历史；由一个GlobalAgent指导各LocalAgent并整合其报告与联合观察，完成跨视频推理。
AI.result: 在CVBench、MVU-Eval、CrossVid上评测，使用三种不同规模的Qwen3.5模型及GPT-6-sol。Qwen3.5下综合得分平均比同模型单遍推理高5.1分，比同模型最强先前智能体高5.0分；GPT-6-sol下比单遍推理平均高4.3分。同硬件下运行速度比规模相当的先前智能体快1.8-2.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 将观察决策与跨视频判断解耦、采用分层多智能体结构，可有效提升多视频理解性能并显著提高效率，且无需额外训练、对多种模型规模具有泛化性。

title: PhyMind: Physics-Informed Masked Autoencoding for EEG Foundation Models
summary: EEG foundation models are pre-trained almost exclusively with masked reconstruction through a free-form decoder, sometimes with hand-crafted spectral targets added, as in MANAS-2. We study what happens when that decoder is replaced by a generative forward model of EEG. PhyMind keeps a standard masked transformer encoder, but its decoder must explain the masked signal through 68 cortical regions, each driven by damped stochastic oscillators and an aperiodic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, projected to the recording's own montage by a fixed boundary-element lead field evaluated per derivation. Training combines masked reconstruction with a Whittle spectral likelihood, an oscillator-dynamics residual, a minimum-norm source prior and a penalised neural residual. In a controlled comparison (same encoder, data, steps and seed), the physics decoder produces encoder tokens whose spectral content is far more linearly decodable than with a masked-autoencoder decoder or with the MANAS-2 objective: mean R^2 on a token-level spectral probe with amplitude-normalised targets is 0.67/0.77/0.77 on three datasets, against 0.24/0.50/0.50 (MAE) and 0.48/0.67/0.66 (MANAS-2 objective), approaching the released 92.8M-parameter MANAS-2 (0.71/0.81/0.80). Downstream gains in the controlled setting are small (four-task mean balanced accuracy 56.6 vs. 53.8 for MAE frozen, 63.8 vs. 62.7 fine-tuned). Region-level features from the physics decoder raise frozen four-class motor-imagery accuracy by 7-14 points, so a 7.2M-parameter model pre-trained on 3k hours of open EEG is comparable to the released MANAS-2 with frozen features (63.0 vs. 61.6). After full fine-tuning, MANAS-2 remains better (66.8 vs. 65.4 for our best model). The inferred sources do not reproduce the lateralisation that a classical inverse solution finds in motor imagery, so we do not claim anatomical interpretability. Code and weights are released.

AI.tldr: PhyMind用生成式EEG前向模型（68个皮层区域、阻尼随机振荡器+非周期OU过程，经固定边界元导联场投影到各导联组合）替换MAE的自由解码器，在同一编码器/数据/步数/种子的受控对比下，编码器token的频谱可线性解码性显著优于MAE与MANAS-2目标（三数据集R² 0.67/0.77/0.77 vs 0.24/0.50/0.50 和 0.48/0.67/0.66），接近92.8M参数的MANAS-2（0.71/0.81/0.80）；下游小样本增益有限，但冻结特征在运动想象上提升7-14点。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG基础模型几乎只用自由形式解码器的掩码重建预训练（有时加手工频谱目标，如MANAS-2）。作者想探究：若把解码器换成EEG的生成式前向模型，编码器表征会怎样变化、是否更具物理/频谱结构。
AI.method: 保留标准掩码Transformer编码器；解码器须通过68个皮层区域解释被掩码信号，每个区域由阻尼随机振荡器和非周期Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程驱动，并用按导联组合评估的固定边界元导联场投影到记录自身蒙太奇。训练损失结合掩码重建、Whittle谱似然、振荡器动力学残差、最小范数源先验与惩罚神经残差。
AI.result: 控制实验（同编码器、数据、步数、种子）：token级频谱探针（幅度归一化目标）平均R²为0.67/0.77/0.77，对比MAE的0.24/0.50/0.50与MANAS-2目标的0.48/0.67/0.66，接近92.8M参数的MANAS-2（0.71/0.81/0.80）。下游增益较小：四任务平均平衡准确率56.6 vs MAE冻结53.8，微调63.8 vs 62.7。物理解码器的区域级特征使冻结四类运动想象准确率提升7-14点；7.2M参数模型（3k小时开放EEG）冻结特征达63.0，可比公开发布的MANAS-2（61.6）。完整微调后MANAS-2仍更优（66.8 vs 65.4）。推断源未复现经典逆解在运动想象中看到的偏侧化。
AI.conclusion: 用生成式物理前向模型作解码器可显著提升编码器token的频谱线性可解码性，小模型冻结特征即可比肩大模型，但端到端微调优势不明显；推断源缺乏解剖可解释性，作者明确不作此主张。代码与权重已开源。

title: HandXFM: Semantic-Structural Distillation for Hand Radiograph Foundation Models
summary: Hand radiographs support diverse clinical tasks, including skeletal maturity assessment, rheumatoid arthritis scoring, abnormality screening, and anatomical localization, yet existing models are typically trained separately for each task and dataset. We present HandXFM, a domain-specific foundation model that leverages cross-modality knowledge for comprehensive hand X-ray understanding. HandXFM distills semantic priors from BiomedCLIP and structural cues from a chest X-ray Vision Transformer (ViT) through a unified alignment framework, integrating complementary medical knowledge in an interpretable way. After pretraining, HandXFM can be adapted to a range of musculoskeletal tasks, including bone age estimation, SvH score prediction, abnormality detection, joint localization, bone segmentation, and visual question answering. It consistently outperforms task-specific and single-expert baselines, achieving up to 0.11 improvement in Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) for bone age prediction and a 12\% accuracy gain in abnormality classification. Moreover, HandXFM generalizes to unseen datasets and yields cross-attention maps linking clinical terms to anatomical regions. These results demonstrate that multi-expert distillation effectively unifies semantic and structural supervision within a single pretrained model, establishing HandXFM as an interpretable and generalizable foundation model for hand radiograph analysis.

AI.tldr: HandXFM是一个手部X线领域专用基础模型，通过统一对齐框架同时蒸馏BiomedCLIP的语义先验和胸部X线ViT的结构线索，在骨龄估计、SvH评分、异常检测、关节定位、骨分割和VQA等多项任务上超越任务专用和单专家基线。
AI.motivation: 手部X线支撑骨成熟度评估、类风湿关节炎评分、异常筛查和解剖定位等多种临床任务，但现有模型通常针对每个任务和数据集单独训练，缺乏可统一、可迁移的基础模型。
AI.method: 提出HandXFM：在手部X线领域构建基础模型，采用统一对齐框架从两个专家模型蒸馏知识——从BiomedCLIP提取语义先验、从胸部X线ViT提取结构性线索，以可解释的方式融合互补医学知识进行预训练，再适配到下游任务。
AI.result: 在骨龄估计、SvH评分预测、异常检测、关节定位、骨分割和VQA任务上一致优于任务专用与单专家基线；骨龄预测PCC最高提升0.11，异常分类准确率提升12%；并可泛化到未见数据集，产生将临床术语关联到解剖区域的交叉注意力图。
AI.conclusion: 多专家蒸馏能够将语义监督与结构监督有效统一于单一预训练模型，使HandXFM成为可解释、可泛化的手部X线分析基础模型。

title: GameAnything: From Any Inspirations to Playable Game Worlds
summary: AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences. However, existing systems and benchmarks primarily focus on explicit development specifications, with limited support for adapting multimodal references and evaluating actual gameplay experiences. We introduce GameAnything, an open-source agentic platform that transforms multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games through iterative development. GameAnything integrates coding agents with an independent playtesting critic, persistent development state, and reusable experience memory to support continuous refinement. We further present GameAnything-Bench, a benchmark spanning diverse reference modalities, game creation objectives, and gaming environments, with exploratory gameplay testing to assess both functional correctness and gameplay quality. Evaluations of nine coding agent configurations reveal that current agents can adapt reference content but still struggle with playable interactions and precise modifications. Moreover, multimodal references improve content fidelity, while iterative refinement yields substantial but varying improvements across agents. These findings highlight both the potential and remaining challenges of inspiration-driven game development.

AI.tldr: GameAnything：将多模态灵感转化为可玩游戏扩展的开源智能体平台，及配套基准 GameAnything-Bench。
AI.motivation: 现有系统与基准侧重显式开发规范，缺乏对多模态参考的适配支持，也缺少对真实游戏体验的评估。
AI.method: 构建智能体平台，集成编码智能体、独立试玩评审（playtesting critic）、持久化开发状态与可复用经验记忆，通过迭代开发将多模态灵感转化为既有游戏的可玩扩展；并提出覆盖多种参考模态、创作目标与游戏环境的基准，采用探索式试玩测试评估功能正确性与游戏质量。
AI.result: 评估九种编码智能体配置：现有智能体能适配参考内容，但在可玩交互与精确修改上仍有困难；多模态参考提升内容保真度，迭代精化带来显著但随智能体而异的改进。
AI.conclusion: 研究既揭示了灵感驱动游戏开发的潜力，也指出了尚存挑战。

title: Interaction Retention and Output-Likelihood Training in Parallel Sampling
comment: 44 pages (35-page paper followed by a 9-page online appendix), 3 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research
summary: Parallel samplers such as masked diffusion language models generate several coordinates per step from conditional marginals and randomize which coordinates are generated together, so even exact conditionals return a distorted distribution. We give an exact local account of this distortion. Around any full-support product law, the Gram operator of the sampler's response is diagonal in the interaction decomposition, and its eigenvalues are retention probabilities: the probability that an interaction has a unique latest-revealed coordinate. This retention spectrum determines the exact frontier between output accuracy and conditional calibration, its regularization path, and the population response of finite-mixture likelihood training. For pairwise interactions it yields a sharp dichotomy. Under homogeneous retention, output-likelihood training is equivalent to a single context gain; heterogeneous retention opens correction directions beyond any scalar, with an advantage bounded by an explicit heterogeneity gap. On binarized digits and MNIST, output-likelihood training within a heterogeneous schedule library lowers calibrated test negative log-likelihood in all twelve paired comparisons, and the gain survives pair-specific recalibration and a stronger path optimizer. For a frozen 169.6-million-parameter masked diffusion language model, serially normalized context gains are 1.070 and 1.056 at 8 and 16 rounds, against the predicted values 1.134 and 1.058.

AI.tldr: 论文给出并行采样器（如掩码扩散语言模型）分布扭曲的精确局部刻画：在满支撑乘积律附近，采样器响应的Gram算子在对偶分解下对角化，特征值为"保留概率"，由此确定输出精度与条件校准的精确边界，并在实验中验证。
AI.motivation: 并行采样器每步生成多个坐标并随机化其组合，即使使用精确条件分布，输出分布也会被扭曲。作者希望精确理解这种扭曲的结构，而非仅作经验性修正。
AI.method: 在满支撑乘积律附近做局部展开，将采样器响应视为线性算子，在对偶（交互）分解下证明其Gram算子对角，特征值为某交互具有唯一"最后被揭示"坐标的概率（保留谱）。进一步分析该谱对精度—校准前沿、正则化路径及有限混合似然训练总体响应的影响；成对交互情形下给出同质/异质保留的二分类结果。
AI.result: 同质保留下输出似然训练等价于单一上下文增益；异质保留带来超越任何标量的修正方向，优势受显式异质性间隙界定。二值化数字与MNIST上，异质调度库内的输出似然训练在全部12组配对比较中降低校准测试NLL，且增益在配对重校准与更强路径优化器下仍存在。冻结的1.696亿参数掩码扩散模型上，8/16轮串行归一化上下文增益为1.070与1.056，接近预测值1.134与1.058。
AI.conclusion: 并行采样的分布扭曲可由保留谱精确解释，并直接指导训练策略：异质调度能提供标量修正无法达到的改进，理论预测在视觉与大模型实验中均得到定量支持。

title: When Video Verifier Scores Mislead: Capability Assessment and Verifier Selection
summary: Video verifiers judge whether a candidate answer or trajectory agrees with a video, and are themselves chosen by a score. We show that this score depends on two choices in the test, the type of negative and the judgment interface, strongly enough to reverse conclusions about what a model can do and which verifier to deploy. We separate the two with controlled constructions that have exact truth conditions: endpoint-matched negatives, wrong only in their internal states, and a truth-switch test, in which the same two candidates swap correctness between two videos. Under direct judgment, where the verdict is read from answer scores, models that reject a visibly wrong start fall to near chance against endpoint-matched negatives. When the frames disclose each event, writing out reasoning before the answer lifts three of four models from under 10% to 70-100% on the truth-switch test, and staged inputs trace the direct failure to one step, composing events into states. But when the event must first be found, on human-validated natural video, the same change brings no significant gain under a protocol common to all models and can lower accuracy if one candidate denies that the event occurs.
