The negative type also changes which verifier is selected: one chosen on event-denial negatives is 8.9 points less accurate against negatives that keep the event and change a detail, the errors a generator mostly makes, and recovers about half as much accuracy when it reranks that generator's answers. A verifier should be evaluated on the errors it will face, and neither a low direct score nor a gain from reasoning should be read as a property of the model alone.

AI.tldr: 视频验证器的评测分数依赖"负样本类型"和"判断接口"两个测试选择，二者足以反转关于模型能力和验证器选择的结论。
AI.motivation: 现有视频验证器的评分被当作模型固有属性使用，但作者怀疑该评分实际受测试设计（负样本构造方式、答案读取接口）驱动，需澄清二者的混淆。
AI.method: 用具有精确真值的受控构造分离两个因素：端点匹配负样本（仅内部状态错误）、真值切换测试（同一对候选在两段视频间交换正确性）；比较直接判断（从答案分数读判决）与先写推理再作答；并借助分阶段输入定位失败环节；再在人工验证的自然视频上采用统一协议检验。
AI.result: 直接判断下，能拒绝明显错误开头的模型在端点匹配负样本上降到接近随机；当帧披露每个事件时，先写推理使四个模型中三个在真值切换测试上从低于10%提升到70–100%；分阶段输入将失败定位到"把事件组合成状态"一步。自然视频中需先定位事件时，推理无显著增益，且若候选否认事件发生甚至会降低准确率。负样本类型还改变验证器选择：在事件否认负样本上选出的验证器，面对"保留事件、改动细节"（生成器最常见错误）时低8.9个点，重排时恢复的准确率减半。
AI.conclusion: 验证器应在它实际会遇到的错误上被评测；低直接分数与推理带来的增益都不能视为模型本身的属性，而是测试设计的产物。

title: Automatic Construction of Persian E-Commerce Dialogue Datasets for Conversational Product Search
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Submitted to ACM Transactions on Asian and Low-Resource Language Information Processing (TALLIP). Code and data: https://github.com/farinfr/persian-cps-dialogues
summary: Conversational product search lets users find products through a multi-turn dialogue instead of a single keyword query, but Persian lacks the large conversational datasets needed to train and evaluate such systems; existing Persian e-commerce dialogue resources cover few categories and small catalogs. We present a framework that builds such a dataset automatically from a real e-commerce catalog and release the resulting dataset. The framework crawls 12,926 products in seven categories of the Digikala marketplace, groups them into 170 semantically coherent clusters, and selects the question the assistant asks at every turn with the Regularized Partition Balance (RPB) score. The RPB score accounts for feature coverage, the probability that the user can answer and the number of values, and generalizes entropy-based question selection. An LLM then verbalizes each question plan into a natural Persian dialogue. In a simulation on the full catalog, the RPB score needs 0.11 fewer turns than the strongest entropy baseline when the difficulty of answering differs between features, and is practically equivalent to it when it does not. Using only a free LLM API, we generated 1,000 requirement-driven dialogues covering all 170 clusters, with turn-level feature annotations; automatic checks and an LLM judge confirm their consistency with the catalog, while their realism is lower than that of the first, GPT-4o-generated version. Code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个从真实电商目录自动构建波斯语对话式商品搜索数据集的框架，并发布DigiQL数据集。
AI.motivation: 波斯语缺乏大规模对话式商品搜索数据集，现有波斯语电商对话资源覆盖品类少、目录小，无法支撑训练与评测。
AI.method: 从Digikala抓取7类12,926个商品，聚为170个语义簇；提出Regularized Partition Balance (RPB)分数逐轮选择提问，考虑特征覆盖、用户可答概率和取值数量，并推广了基于熵的提问选择；再由LLM将问题计划生成为自然波斯语对话，仅用免费LLM API生成1,000条需求驱动对话并带轮级特征标注。
AI.result: 全目录模拟中，当各特征回答难度不同时RPB比最强熵基线少用0.11轮，难度相当时基本等价；自动检查与LLM评审确认对话与目录一致，但真实性低于GPT-4o生成的初版。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可低成本自动构建覆盖全品类的对话式商品搜索数据集，RPB是有效且可推广的提问选择策略，代码与数据公开。

title: MolReJev: Decision Models Are In-Context Molecular Predictors
summary: Molecular prediction helps prioritize compounds for screening. Specialized predictors are trained for a fixed set of tasks, limiting cross-task generalization. Language models can condition on task descriptions and have recently shown promise in molecular prediction. However, generating answers token by token adds inference cost, and general-purpose models often lack task-specific molecular knowledge. We thus propose MolReJev, which combines Jev-style candidate scoring with in-context learning (ICL) on a language model. MolReJev retrieves similar labeled examples from existing task data and scores candidate labels jointly in one forward pass. ICL improves predictions from the released general-purpose Kev checkpoint and the separately trained MolReJev. For the trained model, gains span all evaluation groups, including held-out tasks, and extend to compounds absent from training. MolReJev generally outperforms MolecularGPT on matched evaluations and nearest-neighbor prediction with the same examples. With four examples, MolReJev and a trained text baseline achieve similar ROC-AUC, with higher measured throughput for MolReJev. These results show that decision models can serve as in-context molecular predictors for compounds, drug pairs, and reactions.

AI.tldr: 提出MolReJev，将Jev式候选打分与语言模型上下文学习（ICL）结合，用一次前向传播联合打分候选标签，实现跨任务的分子预测。
AI.motivation: 专用预测器只针对固定任务集合训练，缺乏跨任务泛化；通用语言模型逐token生成推理成本高，且缺少任务特异的分子知识。
AI.method: 从已有任务数据中检索相似的带标签示例，结合Jev式候选打分，在语言模型上通过上下文学习一次性对所有候选标签联合打分。
AI.result: ICL同时提升通用Kev检查点与单独训练的MolReJev；训练模型在包括留出任务和未见化合物在内的所有评测组均有增益；总体优于MolecularGPT与同示例的最近邻预测；4示例下ROC-AUC与训练文本基线相当，但吞吐更高。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型可作为上下文分子预测器，适用于化合物、药物对和反应预测。

title: Task-Agnostic Incremental Vision-Language Object Detection via Prompt Augmentation and Distribution-Aware Fusion
summary: Incremental Vision-Language Object Detection (IVLOD) empowers pre-trained open-vocabulary detectors to continuously learn new visual concepts from sequential tasks without forgetting foundational knowledge. However, existing methods predominantly rely on oracle task identities during inference, severely limiting their open-world practicality. In this paper, we formalize Task-Agnostic IVLOD (TA-IVLOD), a more realistic setting where such priors are unavailable, requiring the model to simultaneously recognize classes from all learned tasks. This unconstrained setting exposes severe performance degradation due to cross-task semantic interference and parameter conflicts. To tackle these challenges, we propose TADA, a novel modular framework. Specifically, TADA introduces Stochastic Prompt Augmentation to mitigate semantic interference via training-time noise injection, and Test-Time Distribution-Aware Fusion to dynamically weight class-specific LoRA experts, effectively resolving parameter conflicts. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms baselines in standard IVLOD and yields substantial improvements in the rigorous TA-IVLOD setting on the ODinW-13 benchmark, while effectively preserving zero-shot generalization on the MS COCO dataset. The code is available at https://github.com/yonghanjiang/TADA.

AI.tldr: 提出任务无关增量视觉-语言目标检测设置TA-IVLOD，并用模块化框架TADA（随机提示增强+测试时分布感知融合）解决跨任务语义干扰与参数冲突。
AI.motivation: 现有增量视觉-语言目标检测（IVLOD）方法在推理时依赖已知的oracle任务身份，严重限制开放世界实用性；去掉该先验后，需要同时识别所有已学任务类别，导致跨任务语义干扰和参数冲突，性能大幅下降。
AI.method: 形式化TA-IVLOD设置（无任务身份先验）；提出TADA模块化框架：1) Stochastic Prompt Augmentation，训练时注入噪声以缓解语义干扰；2) Test-Time Distribution-Aware Fusion，测试时动态加权类特定的LoRA专家以解决参数冲突。
AI.result: 在标准IVLOD中显著优于基线；在严格的TA-IVLOD设置下于ODinW-13基准取得大幅提升，同时在MS COCO上有效保持零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TADA为更真实的任务无关增量开放词汇检测提供了有效方案，兼顾增量学习性能与零样本泛化，代码已开源。

title: Can Speech LLMs Recognize When Audio Evidence Is Insufficient? A Diagnostic Study and a Pre-Generation Probing Mitigation
comment: 18 pages, 6 tables. Accepted as a poster at SSPP 2026 (SMILES School Projects & Proceedings). Preprint also available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24347252. Code: https://github.com/ladnlav/slm-audio-evidence
summary: Speech large language models are usually evaluated on questions that have answers. We ask what they do when a recording establishes none, and whether the standard way of finding out is sound. Diagnosed on synthesized speech the answer looks clear: Qwen2-Audio fabricates an answer to 92.5% of unanswerable questions, while an ASR cascade reading the same recordings reaches 2.5% hallucination at 6.7% over-refusal, placing the failure in reasoning rather than in perception. The identical protocol on 376 native SQuAD 2.0 questions over human-read recordings removes that conclusion: the cascade hallucinates on 67.7% against the end-to-end model's 69.8%, at a higher over-refusal cost. A paired subset asking the same questions of a synthesized and a human recording of each passage localises the effect in the ASR stage -- the end-to-end model's abstention behaviour does not move with the speaker, the cascade's goes from 11.1% to 65.9%. Reliance on synthesized speech has been named as a limitation of audio benchmarks but not quantified; we quantify it, and show it large enough to reverse a finding. Since no prompt we tested repairs the residual failure, we transfer pre-generation attention probing to the multimodal setting. A probe over frozen prompt representations reaches 0.773 AUROC at predicting which unanswerable questions the model will answer anyway, where semantic entropy over ten sampled generations is at chance: the model fabricates the same answer every time, so sample disagreement cannot see a failure it is confident about.

AI.tldr: 该文研究语音大模型在"录音本身无法回答的问题"上是否会编造答案，并指出用合成语音评估会得出错误结论；作者用人类朗读的 SQuAD 2.0 数据推翻了合成语音下的结论，定位失败源于 ASR 级联，并提出注意力探针检测幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有语音大模型评测多用"有答案"的问题，忽视了无答案场景；且音频基准普遍依赖合成语音，此局限虽被提及但未被量化，可能导致结论被反转。
AI.method: 在合成语音与人类朗读录音上对比端到端模型（Qwen2-Audio）与 ASR 级联的拒答行为；使用 376 道原生 SQuAD 2.0 问题及成对子集（同一段落的合成/人声录音）定位效应来源；将预生成注意力探针迁移到多模态场景，与语义熵（10 次采样）对比。
AI.result: 合成语音下 Qwen2-Audio 对 92.5% 无答案问题编造答案，级联仅 2.5% 幻觉但 6.7% 过度拒答；人类录音下二者幻觉率相近（67.7% vs 69.8%），级联过度拒答更高；成对子集中端到端模型拒答率不随说话人变化，级联从 11.1% 升至 65.9%，效应定位于 ASR 阶段；注意力探针达 0.773 AUROC，而语义熵处于随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 合成语音偏差足以反转研究结论，是需被量化的实质性问题；失败主要来自 ASR 环节而非推理，且模型对编造答案高度自信，采样一致性无法识别；预生成注意力探针是可用的替代检测手段。

title: Neural Agent Compiler: Learning to Schedule Soft Dependencies
summary: Large language model agents accomplish complex tasks by coordinating multiple reasoning steps and tool operations, which form dependencies among their operations. Existing orchestration methods primarily consider hard dependencies that determine when an operation can legally begin, but overlook soft dependencies, i.e., information that is not required for execution but may improve an already executable operation. We identify soft-dependency scheduling as an important problem in agent execution. To this end, we introduce Neural Agent Compiler (NAC), a learned scheduler that predicts the task-quality and resource consequences of three execution modes and selects the highest-utility legal mode at a scheduling boundary. NAC represents the executable continuation, pending information event, and resource state in a shared memory, and uses a utility function to adapt the consequence predictions to different resource preferences. Across AppWorld, WebShop, and $τ^2$-bench, NAC achieves 276/417 AppWorld task completions, a 74.69 WebShop Task Score, and 59/100 $τ^2$-bench successes. Additional studies show that the learned scheduler reduces execution work, establishing soft-dependency scheduling as a promising solution for orchestrating tool-using agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出LLM智能体编排中忽视"软依赖"（非必需但可提升已可执行操作质量的信息），提出神经智能体编译器NAC，学习预测三种执行模式的质量与资源后果并选择最高效用的合法模式，在多个基准上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体编排方法主要考虑"硬依赖"（决定操作何时合法开始），却忽视"软依赖"——即执行并非必需、但可改善已可执行操作的信息。作者将软依赖调度识别为智能体执行中的关键问题。
AI.method: 提出Neural Agent Compiler (NAC)，一个学习型调度器。它在调度边界处预测三种执行模式的任务质量与资源后果，并选择效用最高的合法模式；将可执行延续、待处理信息事件和资源状态表示在共享内存中，并用效用函数使后果预测适配不同资源偏好。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、WebShop和τ²-bench上，NAC分别取得276/417的AppWorld任务完成数、74.69的WebShop任务分数、59/100的τ²-bench成功率；额外研究表明学习型调度器减少了执行工作量。
AI.conclusion: 软依赖调度是编排工具使用型智能体的一个有前景的解决方案。

title: Global Stability and Loss Convergence in Matrix Factorization
summary: We study the matrix factorization objective $\mathcal L(X,Y)=f(XY)$ for convex, twice continuously differentiable output losses with bounded and Lipschitz gradient and a minimizing set that is compact modulo specified input and output invariances. This includes the well-known cross entropy loss. We prove that a positive learning-rate threshold guarantees bounded parameters, summability of squared gradients, and convergence of the loss from every finite initialization. The proof constructs a quantity from the imbalance between parameter matrices that decreases over every step of the gradient descent trajectory.

AI.tldr: 论文分析矩阵分解目标 L(X,Y)=f(XY) 的梯度下降行为，证明存在正学习率阈值，保证参数有界、平方梯度可和、损失收敛。
AI.motivation: 矩阵分解（如交叉熵损失下的深度线性网络/低秩模型）中梯度下降的收敛性缺乏一般性保证，尤其缺少对学习率阈值的显式刻画；本文希望在最少的损失假设下给出全局收敛分析。
AI.method: 对凸、二阶连续可微、梯度有界且Lipschitz、极小集在输入输出不变性下紧致的输出损失 f，分析梯度下降轨迹；证明技巧是构造一个刻画两参数矩阵 X 与 Y 之间"不平衡度"的量，并证明该量在每一步都下降。
AI.result: 证明存在正的学习率阈值，使得从任意有限初始化出发，参数保持有界、平方梯度可和（summable），并且损失收敛；结论覆盖交叉熵损失等常见情形。
AI.conclusion: 矩阵分解上的梯度下降在充分小（但有正下界阈值）的学习率下具有稳定的全局收敛行为，不平衡度单调下降是核心机制，为隐式正则化与平衡化现象提供理论支撑。

title: Click and Count: Multimodal Prototype Adaptation for Class-Agnostic Object Counting
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2027 IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (IEEE SSCI 2027). Code: https://github.com/ameniifi/Click-and-Count
summary: We propose a multimodal, class-agnostic, density-based object counting framework that specifies the object of interest through visual exemplars, a text description, or both, within a single iterative refinement pipeline. Existing counters typically fall into two groups: methods that fuse two modalities, a hand-drawn bounding box and a text description, to specify the target object, and single-modality methods that rely on either a box exemplar or text alone. A few recent methods replace the box with a point or click. We expand a single click into a precise object mask via a frozen visual-prompt segmentation model, feeding an iterative prototype-refinement process that also fuses a text description at every refinement step. We make two contributions: first, a click-derived exemplar extraction module that removes the bounding-box requirement of prior exemplar-based counters; second, a per-step text-fusion mechanism that combines visual and textual prompts throughout refinement. Combined with text guidance, our model achieves state-of-the-art counting accuracy, outperforming prior click-based counting methods across all metrics and surpassing the box-exemplar base architecture in mean absolute error. The code is available at github.com/ameniifi/Click-and-Count.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态、类别无关的密度计数框架Click-and-Count，用单次点击+文本描述（或多模态组合）指定目标，通过迭代原型精炼实现SOTA计数。
AI.motivation: 现有计数方法要么需手绘边界框+文本融合，要么仅用框样例或纯文本，框标注成本高且不便捷；单模态信息不足。作者希望用更轻量的点击替代边界框，并同时利用视觉与文本信息提升计数精度。
AI.method: 用一个冻结的视觉提示分割模型把单次点击扩展为精确目标掩码，提取样例特征；随后进入迭代式原型精炼流程，每一步都融合文本描述（per-step text fusion），实现点击样例与文本提示在精炼全过程中的结合。
AI.result: 结合文本引导后达到SOTA计数精度：在所有指标上优于既有基于点击的计数方法，并在平均绝对误差（MAE）上超过基于框样例的基线架构。
AI.conclusion: 单次点击经分割模型可得高质量样例，替代边界框要求；逐步文本融合持续提升原型质量；二者结合使多模态、类别无关计数更便捷且更准确。代码已开源。

title: HGDNA: Overlapping k-mer Tokenization for Efficient Autoregressive Genomic Language Models
summary: The domain of genomic language models (gLMs) has advanced rapidly, with models pretrained on diverse multi-species genomic corpora demonstrating their remarkable capabilities. While the effect of simple nucleotide-level tokenization on long-context modeling is well established, overlapping k-mer tokenization remains underexplored in causal pretraining, despite its rich neighborhood information. Here, we thoroughly revisit overlapping tokenization and introduce HGDNA, a hybrid linear-attention gLM with causal language modeling (CLM) pretraining and a shared token-prediction interface for downstream adaptation, using a species-classification auxiliary task and shared class tokens. HGDNA delivers competitive performance across sequence classification and frozen-embedding evaluations, supporting both short-range and long-range tasks with 30M parameters and 19B pretraining tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/HGDNA

AI.tldr: HGDNA：基于重叠k-mer分词与混合线性注意力的基因组语言模型，30M参数、19B token预训练，在序列分类与冻结嵌入评测上具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 多物种基因组语言模型发展迅速，简单核苷酸级分词对长上下文建模的影响已明确，但重叠k-mer分词在因果预训练中蕴含丰富的邻域信息，却仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 系统重新审视重叠分词方式，提出HGDNA——一种混合线性注意力gLM，采用因果语言建模（CLM）预训练，并通过物种分类辅助任务与共享类别token构建共享token预测接口，用于下游适配。
AI.result: 在30M参数、19B预训练token规模下，HGDNA在序列分类与冻结嵌入评测中表现具有竞争力，同时支持短程与长程任务。
AI.conclusion: 重叠k-mer分词结合混合线性注意力与共享token预测接口，是构建高效、通用基因组语言模型的可行方案。

title: Stochastic non-metric MDS for noisy high-dimensional data
summary: Multidimensional scaling (MDS) constructs low-dimensional embeddings that approximate pairwise distances in a high-dimensional dataset. MDS exists in several flavors, with metric MDS approximating distances directly and non-metric MDS additionally optimizing for an arbitrary monotonic transformation of the high-dimensional distances. Empirically, metric MDS is known to suffer from the curse of dimensionality. Here we extend prior theoretical results for metric MDS on fully uninformative data to a more general case of finite, high-dimensional data with concentrated distances. We show that the metric MDS embeddings of such datasets stay distributionally close to the data-independent limit case. We then show that non-metric MDS is more robust to high-dimensional noise and can yield informative embeddings of such data. While existing implementations of non-metric MDS are slow, we develop a fast implementation using stochastic gradient descent in PyTorch. Using our implementation, we conduct an empirical study using multiple simulated and real-world datasets, including population-genomic and scRNA-seq data, and show that non-metric MDS can strongly outperform other methods in terms of global structure preservation.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上推广了metric MDS在有限高维集中距离数据上的失效分析，并证明non-metric MDS对高维噪声更鲁棒，同时提供基于PyTorch SGD的快速实现，实验显示其在全局结构保持上优于其他方法。
AI.motivation: metric MDS在经验上受维度灾难困扰，已有理论结果仅针对完全无信息数据，缺乏对一般有限高维集中距离数据的分析；同时non-metric MDS现有实现速度慢，难以实用。
AI.method: 将metric MDS在完全无信息数据上的理论结果推广到有限、高维且距离集中的数据集，分析其嵌入与数据无关极限情况的分布接近性；进一步论证non-metric MDS对高维噪声的鲁棒性；并用PyTorch随机梯度下降实现快速non-metric MDS。
AI.result: 理论上证明metric MDS在此类数据上的嵌入分布上接近数据无关极限；non-metric MDS能对高维噪声数据产生有信息量的嵌入；在多种模拟与真实数据（群体基因组学、scRNA-seq）上，non-metric MDS在全局结构保持方面明显优于其他方法。
AI.conclusion: non-metric MDS结合快速SGD实现，是处理高维集中距离数据、保持全局结构的有效且高效的方法。

title: GlaucomaMarker - Biomarker-Grounded Glaucoma Vision-Language Model
summary: Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness. In the current clinical setting, glaucoma diagnosis is generally conducted by assessing optic disc cupping and asymmetry. Vision-language models (VLMs) have been utilized in recent years for glaucoma, mostly trained on fixed templates or AI-generated captions, as no public text describes the biomarkers. Our proposed framework, GlaucomaMarker, hypothesizes that retinal structural biomarkers can ground glaucoma-based VLMs. It converts public segmentation masks into sentences describing eleven biomarkers, to teach retinal foundation models to read them. We applied this framework to RETFound (GlaucomaMarker-R) and FLAIR (GlaucomaMarker-F), training on 9,778 images that yielded 45,190 image-text pairs. On a real-world clinical cohort, GlaucomaMarker-F detects glaucoma with an AUROC of 0.905, against 0.848 for FLAIR, and both read the biomarkers where baselines stay near random guessing. Since the biomarker text is computed from existing masks, it comes at no extra cost.

AI.tldr: GlaucomaMarker将公开分割掩膜转为描述11种生物标志物的文本，用45,190图像-文本对训练视网膜基础模型，使其具备青光眼诊断与生物标志物阅读能力。
AI.motivation: 青光眼诊断依赖视盘杯凹与不对称评估，而现有视觉-语言模型多基于固定模板或AI生成字幕训练，缺乏公开描述生物标志物的文本。
AI.method: 提出假设：视网膜结构生物标志物可为青光眼VLM提供依据。将公开分割掩膜自动转换为句子（覆盖11种生物标志物），用于教导视网膜基础模型。应用于RETFound（GlaucomaMarker-R）与FLAIR（GlaucomaMarker-F），在9,778张图像上训练得到45,190图像-文本对。
AI.result: 在真实临床队列中，GlaucomaMarker-F检测青光眼AUROC为0.905，基线FLAIR为0.848；两模型均能正确读取生物标志物，而基线接近随机猜测。
AI.conclusion: 生物标志物文本由现有掩膜计算，无需额外成本，可作为有效监督信号提升VLM的青光眼诊断与可解释性。

title: DoppelVet: Comparative Safety Verification for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents improve by retaining feedback as reusable memories or skills, but every mistaken approval can shape many future behaviors. Two updates can provide exactly the same evidence to a verifier yet produce opposite safety outcomes, so the verifier cannot distinguish them from that evidence alone. We introduce DoppelVet, a verification framework that checks proposed updates before they enter an agent's persistent state. Without access to safety labels, DoppelVet constructs an alternative that matches every signal used by the existing verifier. It replays both updates from the same state and directly compares their behaviors in both presentation orders before deciding whether to retain the candidate. We evaluate DoppelVet on DoppelVet-Grid and DoppelVet-Tool, covering executable programs and natural-language memories. Across nine open-weight and proprietary verifiers, DoppelVet raises mean harmful-update detection AUC from 0.762 to 0.940 on DoppelVet-Grid and from 0.681 to 0.826 on DoppelVet-Tool, outperforming VaG and AgentDoG 1.5. On DoppelVet-Grid, it reduces trajectories experiencing degradation from 30.39% to 0.43% over a ten-generation self-update loop and leaves no final degradation.

AI.tldr: 提出DoppelVet验证框架，在自进化智能体更新写入持久状态前拦截有害更新，通过构造与现有验证器所用信号完全一致的"对偶"更新并重放比较行为，显著提升有害更新检测并减少性能退化。
AI.motivation: 自进化智能体通过保留反馈作为可复用记忆或技能来改进，但错误批准会被反复固化。关键问题在于：两个更新向验证器提供完全相同的证据，却可能产生相反的安全后果，验证器仅凭该证据无法区分。
AI.method: DoppelVet在更新进入智能体持久状态前进行验证。在无安全标签条件下，它针对候选更新构造一个让其与现有验证器所用每个信号都匹配的替代更新；随后从同一状态重放两者，并以两种呈现顺序直接比较其行为，据此决定是否保留候选更新。在DoppelVet-Grid与DoppelVet-Tool（分别覆盖可执行程序与自然语言记忆）上评测。
AI.result: 在九个开源与专有验证器上，有害更新检测平均AUC在DoppelVet-Grid由0.762提升至0.940，在DoppelVet-Tool由0.681提升至0.826，优于VaG与AgentDoG 1.5。在DoppelVet-Grid的十代自更新循环中，经历性能退化的轨迹比例由30.39%降至0.43%，且最终无退化。
AI.conclusion: DoppelVet是一种无需安全标签的即插即用式更新前验证框架，通过信号匹配的对偶构造与顺序对称的行为比较，有效识别现有验证器无法分辨的有害更新，并显著抑制自进化过程中的长期退化。

title: S$^2$LMR: Supervised Sequential Long-Context Multi-Step Retriever
summary: Multi-step retrieval over long contexts is a key capability for retrieval-augmented generation, but strong existing approaches are costly and complex to train. Supervised retrievers are far simpler and cheaper, yet they fall well behind in this setting. We show that this gap stems not from supervised training itself, but from three misalignments between training and inference: easy training negatives, noisy retrieval prefixes, and position-agnostic scoring. Guided by this analysis, we introduce S$^2$LMR, a simple yet effective supervised sequential retriever that models multi-step retrieval as the evolution of an explicit textual state encoded by a single shared Transformer. On long-context reasoning, multi-hop QA, and needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks with context lengths ranging from 4K to 10M tokens, S$^2$LMR achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods, substantially outperforming prior supervised retrievers. Notably, it requires only $\sim$2 hours of training on a single A6000 for contexts of up to 10M tokens, while remaining robust across a wide range of hyperparameter settings.

AI.tldr: 论文指出监督式检索器在多步长上下文检索上的落后源于训练与推理的三处失配，提出简单高效的监督序列检索器 S²LMR，用单一共享 Transformer 建模文本状态的演化，性能媲美 SOTA 且训练成本极低。
AI.motivation: 多步长上下文检索是 RAG 的关键能力，但现有强方法训练成本高、流程复杂；监督式检索器虽简单便宜，却在多步检索场景下明显落后。作者希望弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 先做诊断分析，识别三处训练-推理失配：训练负样本过于简单、检索前缀含噪、打分与位置无关。据此设计 S²LMR：将多步检索建模为显式文本状态的逐步演化，并由单一共享 Transformer 编码，配合针对性训练对齐策略。
AI.result: 在 4K 至 10M token 的长上下文推理、多跳 QA 与大海捞针基准上，S²LMR 性能与 SOTA 方法相当，显著优于以往监督式检索器；仅需单张 A6000 上约 2 小时训练即可支持 10M 上下文，且对超参数设置鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 监督式检索的劣势并非来自监督训练本身，而可通过消除训练-推理失配来弥补；简洁的监督方案可在极低训练成本下达到强性能，为多步长上下文检索提供实用替代。

title: Alignment under Hard Negative Re-Pairing: Cross-Modal Similarity, Scale and Retrieval
comment: 52 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: Do vision and language models represent the world alike? That question hides three: what structure each modality has, whether the two modalities organize images and their captions alike, and whether a model ranks an image's own caption highly. Centered kernel alignment (CKA) and neighborhood agreement answer the second, yet matching and model selection use them as if they identified individual pairs and answered the third. To test this reading, we introduce hard negative re-pairing: every image receives the caption of a similar image, and nothing else changes. Although no image keeps its own caption and annotators judge a majority of the substituted captions wrong, CKA stays higher than under a random re-pairing that keeps 80% of the original pairs. In all 22 image-text models we test, neighborhood agreement loses far less than top-one retrieval, which collapses. The reason is scale: these diagnostics pool over many neighbors, matching and retrieval are decided among the nearest ones, and an exact decomposition shows that near-neighbor pairs contribute almost nothing to CKA. In the matching problems we test, an exact maximizer of CKA would not return the original pairing. On COCO and Flickr30k, the model with the highest diagnostic value retrieves worse on held-out data than the model chosen by validation recall, even where the two correlate positively. What re-pairing removes is the informative part: that share tracks retrieval on both datasets and ranks encoder pairs before alignment training. A diagnostic should be reported with its question and its scale, and tested against hard negative re-pairing.

AI.tldr: CKA与邻域一致性等诊断指标衡量的是多邻域池化的整体对齐，而非个体图文配对正确性；在hard negative重配对下二者仍保持高值，因此不能用于配对识别、模型选择，真正与检索相关的"信息性部分"恰是重配对所移除的部分。
AI.motivation: 社区普遍把CKA和邻域一致性当作"模型能否识别每张图的正确caption"的证据，用于匹配与模型选择。作者要检验这一解读是否成立——即区分三个问题：各模态自身结构、跨模态组织方式、模型是否给自身caption高排名。
AI.method: 提出hard negative re-pairing：把每张图的caption换成相似图的caption，其余不变。在22个图文模型上比较CKA、邻域一致性与top-one检索的变化，并与保留80%原始配对的随机重配对对比；给出精确分解，分析近邻对CKA的贡献；在COCO与Flickr30k上比较"诊断值最高"与"验证召回选出"的模型。
AI.result: 所有配对被替换、多数被标注者判为错误时，CKA仍高于保留80%原配对的随机重配对；邻域一致性下降远小于top-one检索（后者崩塌）。精确分解显示近邻对几乎不贡献CKA；在测试的匹配问题中，CKA的精确最优解不会还原原始配对。COCO/Flickr30k上诊断值最高的模型在留出数据上检索更差，即便两者正相关。
AI.conclusion: 诊断指标应连同其问题与尺度一起报告，并须经受hard negative重配对的检验；重配对移除的"信息性份额"才与检索相关，可在对齐训练前对编码器对排序。

title: Detectable Epistemic Attack Layers: A Coverage Theorem and Standardized Harness for Conversation-History Integrity
comment: 36 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Harness, protocol texts, and pre-registration: https://github.com/fahrellgiovanny/conversation-history-integrity
summary: Conversation history is infrastructure: deployed language models rely on application layers to store and reinject prior turns, and that stored state is writable. We formalize session-level contamination by attack layer, state a coverage theorem, and measure its scope: each deployment-layer verification tier covers exactly its layer and is sound with respect to the others; instruction overrides are not detectable without false positives; and composite vectors evade per-fragment verification. A standardized harness applied to eight mechanism families across 3,249 sessions and three model families makes these claims checkable. First, pattern-based detection pays a measured false-positive price: the classic defenses flag 35 to 50 percent of benign sessions, and the naive refusal floor reaches only 2.4 percent attack-cell adoption while destroying 33 to 100 percent of benign turns, whereas provenance-gated channel separation achieves adoption at or below 1.2 percent with zero false positives and zero utility loss. Second, in the exploratory instruction-override extension, the gates' boundary is a cliff: directives rephrased without shape markers bypass them at control-equivalent rates, 47.7 to 49.5 percent against 0.0 percent for the shaped class, placing that class in the model-internal lane. Third, the deterministic core is storage-layer detection at 126 of 126 per model with zero false positives. External anchors reproduce published attack pressure, with PoisonedRAG falling from 70 to 0 percent under the full stack. For practitioners: authenticate stored history and content provenance with deterministic tiers, scope instruction-layer mitigation to provenance-gated designs whose measured benign cost is zero, and monitor composition at the trajectory level rather than per fragment. All protocols and acceptance criteria are pre-registered; the stack and harness are released.

AI.tldr: 论文将"对话历史作为可写基础设施"形式化为会话级污染问题，提出按攻击层划分的覆盖定理，并用标准化测试框架在8类机制、3,249个会话和3个模型家族上验证：基于来源门控的通道分离在零误报、零效用损失下将攻击采纳率压到≤1.2%，而模式匹配防御误报率高达35–50%。
AI.motivation: 部署中的语言模型依赖应用层存储并重新注入历史对话，而这些存储状态是可写的，因而构成会话级污染面。现有防御多为模式匹配或简单拒答，作者希望厘清各层验证能否覆盖其他层，并量化现有防御的误报与效用代价。
AI.method: 作者按攻击层形式化会话级污染，提出覆盖定理；构建标准化测试框架，覆盖8类机制家族、3,249个会话与3个模型家族；比较经典模式检测、朴素拒答、来源门控通道分离等方案；并做指令覆盖的探索性扩展与外部锚点（如PoisonedRAG）复现。所有协议与验收标准预注册。
AI.result: 经典防御在35–50%良性会话上误报；朴素拒答拒答下限仅2.4%攻击采纳，但破坏33–100%良性轮次；来源门控通道分离达到≤1.2%采纳且零误报零效用损失；无形状标记的改写指令以47.7–49.5%绕过门控（有形状类为0%）；存储层检测为核心确定层，每模型126/126且零误报；完整栈下PoisonedRAG由70%降至0%。
AI.conclusion: 实践建议：用确定性层级认证存储历史与内容来源；将指令层缓解限定为测得零良性成本的来源门控设计；在轨迹层面而非片段层面监控组合攻击。各层验证只覆盖自身层，指令覆盖无法无误报检测，组合向量可绕过逐片段验证。

title: EMIP: Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform
summary: Experimental platforms that enable multiple participants to engage in spoken dialogue and perform physical actions concurrently in a shared environment are important for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents. In this paper, we propose EMIP (Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform), a virtual environment platform built on Minecraft. Through an Internet-based client-server architecture, EMIP connects multiple humans and multiple AI agents to the same virtual environment and supports full-duplex speech communication and simultaneous physical interaction. It provides interfaces based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for environmental observation, physical action execution, and audio input and output, enabling researchers to develop their own agent control methods using large language models (LLMs). Additional features include centralized control of an agent group through a single EMIP agent client, collaborative object transportation by multiple agents, and experimental support functions such as recording and retrieving observation histories. By integrating these features into a reusable platform, EMIP aims to support research on human-human, human-agent, and agent-agent cooperation under different participant configurations and agent control methods. Usage examples illustrate concurrent speech and physical action, task coordination, and overlapping speech. The source code for the platform is publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/AI-Humans-Lab/EMIP-Embodied-Multi-Party-Interaction-Platform).

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMIP，一个基于Minecraft、支持多人类与多AI智能体共同进行全双工语音对话与物理操作的虚拟实验平台。
AI.motivation: 研究人机及多智能体协作需要一个可让多方同时说话并执行物理动作的共享实验环境，现有平台难以同时支持多方语音与实体交互。
AI.method: 基于Minecraft构建客户端-服务器架构，联网连接多个人类与多个AI智能体；提供基于MCP的接口（环境观测、物理动作执行、音频输入输出），支持用LLM开发自定义智能体控制方法；并支持单客户端集中控制智能体群、多智能体协同搬运、观测历史记录与回放等功能。
AI.result: 通过使用示例展示了并发语音与物理动作、任务协调及重叠语音等场景；源码已在GitHub公开。
AI.conclusion: EMIP以可复用平台形式，支持不同参与者配置与智能体控制方法下的人人、人机、机机协作研究。

title: DoC: Learning to Defer or Commit for Timely, Accurate, and Stable Conversational Diagnosis Prediction
summary: Conversational diagnosis prediction requires accurate, early, and stable predictions from ongoing clinical dialogue, yet dialogue-level labels do not specify when to commit. We propose a two-phase framework for learning deferral and diagnosis decisions. First, iterative commitment-boundary estimation constructs Defer/diagnosis supervision without annotated commitment times. Second, Defer-aware supervised fine-tuning initializes a policy, refined through reinforcement learning with trajectory-level rewards for timeliness, first-commit accuracy, and post-commit stability. On EMSDialog and MediTOD, DoC commits early, achieving the highest first-commit accuracy among post-trained methods (76.7%/51.2%) and the lowest post-commit error overall (16.4%/48.3%).

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架DoC，学习对话诊断预测中的"延迟(Defer)/诊断"决策，在无承诺时间标注下实现早、准、稳的预测。
AI.motivation: 对话诊断预测需从持续临床对话中尽早、准确、稳定地给出诊断，但对话级标签未指明何时做出承诺(commit)，缺乏承诺时间监督。
AI.method: 两阶段：①迭代承诺边界估计，在无承诺时间标注下构建Defer/诊断监督；②Defer感知的监督微调初始化策略，再用轨迹级奖励的强化学习精调，奖励涵盖及时性、首次承诺准确率与承诺后稳定性。
AI.result: 在EMSDialog与MediTOD上，DoC较早承诺，在后训练方法中首次承诺准确率最高(76.7%/51.2%)，承诺后错误率总体最低(16.4%/48.3%)。
AI.conclusion: 将承诺时机视为可学习决策，可在无承诺时间标注下实现早、准、稳的对话诊断预测，验证了两阶段监督+强化学习框架的有效性。

title: Two Actions from One State: Fork Futures Teach JEPA World Models to Compare
summary: JEPA world models are trained to predict logged transitions but used to compare counterfactual actions from one state. The logged behavior data show one action per state, and under a local linear approximation we prove the action response is unidentified along any direction the policy never varies within a state. We therefore supplement behavior data with measured outcomes of alternative actions from the same state. Our fork futures execute two actions from one restored state, and their outcome difference cancels the state term, identifying the action response on the sampled span. The resulting model, Fork-JEPA, matches predicted to measured differences, anchors the logged successor with behavior prediction, and adds a lookback head that keeps the predecessor recoverable, all at training time, leaving planning unchanged. On three visual control tasks, behavior-only training leaves the predicted action effect no better than a constant guess. Fork-JEPA makes it readable and raises planning success by up to 14\% over LeWM, its base model. Where the action response changes across hidden zones, it nearly doubles cross-zone success, and 1,024 fork pairs beat 1.2M extra behavior steps. Our project is available at https://fork-jepa.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 仅用行为日志训练的 JEPA 世界模型在单状态内无法辨识动作响应；作者用同一状态执行两个动作的 fork futures 来识别，提出 Fork-JEPA，规划成功率最高提升 14%。
AI.motivation: JEPA 世界模型用日志转移训练，却要在单个状态上比较反事实动作。日志数据在每个状态只有一个动作，在局部线性近似下可证明：沿策略在状态内从不变化的方向，动作响应不可辨识（unidentified）。因此模型规划时的动作效应预测缺乏可靠依据。
AI.method: 补充行为数据：从同一恢复状态测量替代动作的结果（fork futures）。同时执行两个动作，其结果的差值可抵消状态项，从而在采样张成的子空间上识别动作响应。模型 Fork-JEPA 在训练时将预测差与实测差对齐，并用行为预测锚定日志后继状态，另加 lookback head 保持前驱可恢复；训练方式改变但规划流程不变。
AI.result: 在三个视觉控制任务上，仅用行为训练时预测动作效应不优于常数猜测；Fork-JEPA 使动作效应可读，规划成功率比基座模型 LeWM 最高提升 14%；在动作响应随隐藏区域变化的情形下，跨区域成功率近乎翻倍；1,024 对 fork 数据优于额外 1.2M 步行为数据。
AI.conclusion: 单状态单动作的日志数据在结构上不足以学习动作响应；通过同状态成对反事实测量（fork futures）可有效识别动作效应，且少量高质量配对数据比大量行为数据更高效，训练端改进即可保持规划不变。

title: PAWP-TTS: Phoneme-Aware Weight Programming for Compact Bilingual English-Nepali Speech Synthesis
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Code: https://github.com/Firojpaudel/PAWP_TTS | Audio Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Firoj112/pawp-tts-demo | Models: https://huggingface.co/Firoj112/pawp-tts-1.5m and https://huggingface.co/Firoj112/pawp-tts-300k
summary: This paper presents PAWP-TTS, a compact non-autoregressive text-to-speech system for English, Nepali, and English-Nepali code-mixed speech at 24 kHz, with no language model at inference. Deterministic pronunciation knowledge lives in a rule- and lexicon-based bilingual frontend that preserves native Nepali contrasts and avoids Hindi phonology, so the network only models acoustics. Counting every learned inference tensor, including the waveform decoder, PAWP-1.5M (1,490,390 parameters, 5.98 MB) reaches 1.50% English and 1.75% Nepali character error rate under a single ASR recognizer, and 5.04% / 4.02% Nepali / English phoneme error rate (PER) on 600 untouched test utterances. Decoder-centric 281K-parameter models (1.1 MB) stay intelligible across three independent seeds, with equal-budget dense models (5.53 +/- 0.08% NE, 5.34 +/- 0.28% EN PER) outperforming K=2 cross-layer shared-basis models (6.35 +/- 0.11% NE, 6.57 +/- 0.47% EN PER). Fixing a frontend/label version mismatch nearly halved Nepali PER, more than any architectural or weight-level change. The paper then studies weight-space programming: inspection-guided, zero-training weight edits. Under strict controls (validation-only selection, one-shot test, paired bootstrap, matched random and same-parameter gradient baselines), edits show real selectivity (27:1 on word-boundary pauses with 96 weights; zero cross-lingual collateral inside language-gated residuals) but no accuracy gain beyond controls. Two apparent targets proved to be label or phonology artifacts. Code, ONNX graphs, and CC BY 4.0 weights are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAWP-TTS，一个无语言模型、非自回归的紧凑TTS系统，支持英语、尼泊尔语及英尼混码语音（24kHz）；并系统研究零训练权重编辑。
AI.motivation: 探索极紧凑TTS在低资源双语（尼泊尔语/英语）场景下能否仅靠规则词典型前端承载发音知识、网络仅建模声学，并检验“权重空间编程”是否真能提升效果。
AI.method: 规则+词典型双语前端（保留尼泊尔语对立、避免印地语音系），非自回归声学模型含波形解码器；PAWP-1.5M共1,490,390参数（5.98MB）。对解码器为中心、跨层共享基模型与等预算稠密模型做对照；权重编辑采用验证集选择、一次性测试、配对bootstrap、随机及同参梯度基线控制。
AI.result: 1.50%英语/1.75%尼泊尔语CER；5.04%/4.02%尼/英PER（600句未触碰测试）。281K参数模型三随机种子均可懂；稠密模型(5.53±0.08% NE, 5.34±0.28% EN PER)优于K=2共享基(6.35±0.11% NE, 6.57±0.47% EN PER)。修复前端/标签版本不匹配使尼泊尔语PER近乎减半，增益超过任何架构或权重改动。权重编辑显示选择性(词边界停顿27:1，96权重)但无超基线精度提升，两目标系标签/音系伪影。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑TTS可用确定性前端承载发音知识；前端一致性比架构/权重层面更重要；零训练权重编辑具选择性但无可证明的精度收益。代码、ONNX与CC BY 4.0权重已开源。

title: SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence
comment: Codes are publicly available at: https://github.com/JunboShen/SAE-Audit
summary: Clinical trials are costly and often take years to complete, making early outcome prediction valuable for trial planning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast clinical-trial outcomes, yet their predictions remain unreliable and their rationales may not faithfully reflect the evidence underlying their answers. On tasks such as predicting whether a registered clinical trial will complete or terminate early, frontier LLMs perform only modestly above chance in our experiments. We introduce SAE-Audit, which optimizes a black-box LLM at inference time with evidence obtained from a deployable open model. A frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is converted into a vocabulary of clinical concepts. Sparse probes fitted on past trials determine which concepts are associated with the outcome. For a new protocol, the concepts detected by the probe are written as evidence, each with the direction and strength of its association with the outcome, and the LLM being audited optimizes its answer in the light of this evidence. Without additional training, SAE-Audit raises balanced accuracy of deepseek-v4-flash by 9.6--12.0 points on five clinical-trial prediction tasks and raises GPT-5.6-terra by 8.0 points on trial completion, exceeding other agentic inference-time optimization methods by a large margin. As an auxiliary, SAE probes module within SAE-Audit is itself accurate and auditable, providing natural-language explanations directly derived from verified concept contributions and protocol evidence, without requiring additional LLMs at inference time. SAE-Audit provides verifiable, concept-level evidence for more accurate and auditable clinical-trial prediction. It can also be embedded into biomedical AI agents such as Biomni to optimize their performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAE-Audit：用 Llama-3.1-8B 上冻结的稀疏自编码器把临床概念变成"词表"，用稀疏探针找出与试验结局相关的概念，再把这些可验证的概念作为证据在推理时优化黑盒 LLM 的答案，无需额外训练即可显著提升临床试验结局预测的平衡准确率。
AI.motivation: 临床试验成本高、周期长，早期结局预测有价值；但现有 LLM 预测不可靠（仅略高于随机），且其推理理由未必忠实反映支撑答案的真实证据，缺乏可审计性。
AI.method: 冻结 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上的 SAE，将其特征转化为临床概念词表；在历史试验上拟合稀疏探针，确定与结局关联的概念及其方向和强度；对新协议，将被探针检测到的概念连同关联方向与强度写成证据，供被审计的黑盒 LLM 在推理时据此优化答案。该方法无需额外训练，SAE 探针模块本身也具可解释性，无需额外 LLM 生成解释。
AI.result: 在五个临床试验预测任务上，deepseek-v4-flash 平衡准确率提升 9.6–12.0 个点；GPT-5.6-terra 在试验完成预测上提升 8.0 个点，大幅超过其他 agentic 推理时优化方法。
AI.conclusion: SAE-Audit 为临床试验预测提供了可验证的概念级证据，兼顾准确性与可审计性，并可嵌入 Biomni 等生物医学 AI agent 以提升其表现。

title: Mirrored Min-of-K Training
summary: Min-of-K (MoK) training is widely used to train models that produce diverse outputs from random noise. For each target, it draws K outputs from the model and backpropagates only through the one closest to the target. However, MoK generally does not make the generated distribution match the data distribution. In this paper, we analyze the MoK bias across all values of K and show that tuning K shifts between failure modes, from mode dropping at small K to distribution flattening at large K. We further prove that every nontrivial loss based only on target-candidate distances fails to recover some data distribution, since these distances do not reveal how the candidates are placed relative to each other. Based on these analyses, we propose mirrored MoK (MMoK), a drop-in modification of MoK training that draws one extra sample from the model, applies the closest-candidate selection rule against it, and subtracts the resulting distance. Since this distance is measured between samples of the model, it provides additional information about how the candidates are placed relative to each other. We prove that MMoK can in principle recover data distributions that MoK cannot. We empirically validate MMoK on five scenarios, namely synthetic mixtures, pedestrian and vehicle trajectory prediction, tropical cyclone forecasting, robotic policy learning, and ambiguous medical image segmentation. The results confirm the effectiveness and generality of MMoK in both distribution learning and task performance.

AI.tldr: 论文分析了MoK训练的分布偏差，提出镜像MoK（MMoK）修正，使生成分布更贴近数据分布，并在五个任务上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: MoK广泛用于训练从随机噪声生成多样输出的模型，但通常无法使生成分布匹配数据分布；其偏差随K变化在模式丢失与分布平坦化之间切换，需要理论解释与修正方法。
AI.method: 分析MoK在所有K值下的偏差；证明任何仅基于“目标—候选距离”的非平凡损失都无法恢复某些数据分布；提出MMoK：额外采样一个模型样本，对其应用最近候选选择规则并减去该距离，从而引入候选间相对位置信息。
AI.result: 证明MMoK原则上能恢复MoK无法恢复的数据分布；在合成混合分布、行人与车辆轨迹预测、热带气旋预报、机器人策略学习、模糊医学图像分割五个场景中实验证实其在分布学习与任务性能上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MMoK是MoK的即插即用改进，理论上有更强的分布恢复能力，实验上具有有效性与通用性。

title: TOGO: Take One Image Editor, Get One Video Editor for Free
summary: Instruction-based image editors are trained on millions of edit pairs and follow instructions far more reliably than current video editors. We show that this ability can be transferred to video editing without any training. Our key observation is that a growing number of image editors and video generators share the same latent space. Their velocity fields can therefore be combined at sampling time: the difference between the editor's velocity under the instruction and under a neutral prompt, which we call the \emph{edit velocity}, can be added to the sampler of a video model. Added naively, however, it blurs the video, alters the background and flickers. An analysis of the edit velocity explains why. It is small and reliable only at coarse scales and high noise levels, not concentrated on the edited object, and uncorrelated across frames. From these properties, we derive a simple guidance operator that amplifies the edit velocity and restricts it in noise level, space, and time. The video model then turns the incoherent per-frame signal into a temporally coherent edit. Our method, TOGO, combines Qwen-Image-Edit with the Wan2.1 video model without training or fine-tuning. On FiVE-Bench, it raises the edit success rate from 47.0\% (the same video model without the editor) to 65.6\%, above the best published method (59.2\%). At the same time, it maintains the background PSNR and obtains the best LPIPS and SSIM of all methods. Because the video editor is assembled at inference time, it can be upgraded to any newer image editor that shares the latent space with no cost.

AI.tldr: TOGO 提出一种免训练的视频编辑方法：利用共享隐空间的图像编辑器与视频生成器在采样时将"编辑速度"叠加到视频采样器中，并通过引导算子解决模糊、背景改变与闪烁问题。
AI.motivation: 指令式图像编辑器训练充分、指令遵循能力强，而现有视频编辑器依赖海量编辑对、可靠性差；作者希望在不训练的前提下把图像编辑能力迁移到视频编辑。
AI.method: 关键观察是部分图像编辑器与视频生成器共享隐空间，因此二者速度场可在采样时组合：将编辑器在指令与中性提示下的速度差（edit velocity）加到视频模型采样器中。分析发现该速度仅在粗尺度、高噪声水平下小而可靠，不集中于被编辑对象，且帧间不相关，故设计简单引导算子，在噪声水平、空间与时间上放大并约束编辑速度，使视频模型将逐帧不一致信号转化为时间一致的编辑。实现上将 Qwen-Image-Edit 与 Wan2.1 结合，无需训练或微调。
AI.result: 在 FiVE-Bench 上编辑成功率从 47.0%（无编辑器的同一视频模型）提升到 65.6%，超过最佳已发表方法（59.2%）；同时保持背景 PSNR，并在所有方法中取得最优 LPIPS 与 SSIM。
AI.conclusion: 视频编辑器可在推理时"组装"而成，因而能零成本升级到任何共享隐空间的新图像编辑器，为免训练视频编辑提供了可扩展范式。

title: GraphSeer: Multimodal Knowledge Graph Relational Image Retrieval with MLLMs
summary: Multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) store entities with photos and names and link them by facts. MMKG methods predict links between known entity IDs, and image retrievers, from CLIP to MLLM embedders, return entities that look like a query photo or match its description. Neither answers a common question about a new photo: which graph entity is related to the one shown, such as the team of a pictured player or the city of a landmark. We call this knowledge graph relational image retrieval (KRIR): given a photo and a natural-language relation, retrieve the related MMKG entity, which rarely resembles the photo, whether the depicted entity is in the graph (known) or not (unseen). We build three benchmarks from YAGO, Wikidata and in-the-wild OVEN photos. The task hides two hops: recognising which graph entity is shown, and recalling what it is connected to. GraphSeer bridges them inside one multimodal LLM: it links the photo to the graph, reads the facts of the best match, and retrieves with the hidden state at which the model is about to say the answer. An unseen entity has no facts of its own, but every candidate answer does, so a listwise verifier reads the other end of the graph: it re-ranks the top candidates by their facts and photos in one forward pass, and the facts matter far more than the photos. With Qwen3.5-27B, GraphSeer improves MRR on known entities by 24.2-70.0% over an MLLM embedder fine-tuned on the same data with the same budget. When it also fuses and verifies the embedder's candidates, it improves MRR on unseen entities by 12.5-25.6%, and on known entities it beats KG-completion models given the ground-truth entity ID.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出知识图谱关系型图像检索（KRIR）任务：给定照片和自然语言关系，检索MMKG中与之相关的实体（如球员所在球队）。作者构建了三个基准，并提出GraphSeer——在单个多模态LLM内先识别照片对应的图实体、读取其事实，用即将输出答案时的隐状态做检索；再用listwise验证器借助候选答案端的事实与图片重排序，显著优于MLLM嵌入器与KG补全模型。
AI.motivation: 现有MMKG链接预测只在已知实体ID间预测，图像检索器只返回看起来像或描述匹配的实体，二者都无法回答"新照片所示实体与图中哪个实体相关"这一常见问题。该任务隐含两跳：识别图中实体、再回忆其关联，且所检索的答案通常与照片外貌不相似，还涉及图中未收录的实体。
AI.method: 作者基于YAGO、Wikidata和真实场景OVEN照片构建三个KRIR基准。GraphSeer在单个多模态LLM内把照片链接到图中实体、读取最佳匹配的事实，并用模型即将说出答案时的隐状态进行检索。针对未见实体无自身事实的情况，引入listwise验证器，读取图另一端（候选答案）的事实与照片，在一次前向中重排Top候选；并融合嵌入器候选进行验证。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-27B上，GraphSeer在已知实体上相比用相同数据和预算微调的MLLM嵌入器，MRR提升24.2%–70.0%；在融合并验证嵌入器候选后，未见实体MRR提升12.5%–25.6%，已知实体上还超过了给定真实实体ID的KG补全模型。
AI.conclusion: 将"识别图中实体"与"回忆其关联"两跳统一到单个多模态LLM内部，并用候选端事实做listwise验证，是解决KRIR的有效途径；事实信息比候选图片信息更重要。该方法对已知与未见实体均有效，拓展了MMKG与图像检索的交叉研究方向。

title: Emotion-Aware and Context-Grounded Dialogue Agents for Personalized Video Game Interactions
summary: We present ChatNPC, a game companion that dynamically personalizes its responses in real time based on players' emotional shifts to enhance user immersion. The model integrates sequential data, leveraging the dynamic nature of streams to benefit from player information, spoken lines, and in-game context. We leverage recent progress in LLMs' tool-calling capabilities to extract vital information from memory and recognize potential constraints for accurate reasoning, thereby tackling the complexity of NPC conversation scenarios. The task is divided into a game sentinel-guided agent (SeGent), a memory capability, and a chat planning tool for reasoning instantiation. The approach uses a lightweight game template as an information framework, with relevant details and a thorough reasoning layout. We conduct extensive experiments on a newly developed game dataset for in-game context NPC dialogue and demonstrate that ChatNPC sequentially captures players' emotional shifts over time; responses are more naturalistic and human-like with appropriate conversational cues, pauses, and sighs; and utterances remain faithful to the dynamics of in-game context and player actions, supporting narrative continuity.

AI.tldr: ChatNPC 是一个基于 LLM 工具调用能力的游戏陪伴 NPC 系统，能根据玩家情绪变化实时个性化回应，提升沉浸感。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏 NPC 对话难以动态感知玩家情绪变化与游戏上下文，导致回应不够自然、缺乏叙事连贯性。
AI.method: 整合序列数据（玩家信息、台词、游戏内上下文）；利用 LLM 工具调用从记忆中提取关键信息并识别约束；任务拆分为游戏哨兵引导智能体（SeGent）、记忆模块和聊天规划工具；采用轻量游戏模板作为信息框架与推理布局。
AI.result: 在新构建的游戏内上下文 NPC 对话数据集上实验表明：ChatNPC 能按时间序列捕捉玩家情绪变化；回应更自然拟人，含恰当的对话线索、停顿与叹息；话语忠于游戏上下文与玩家行为，保持叙事连续性。
AI.conclusion: ChatNPC 通过情绪感知与上下文忠实推理有效提升 NPC 对话的自然度与沉浸感，验证了 LLM 工具调用在复杂 NPC 对话场景中的可行性。

title: Plan Big, Paint Small: Semantic-Aware Computation Allocation for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion streams a video chunk by chunk, but large AR models are too slow for real-time use. We ask where in an AR rollout a large model is actually needed. Pairing Krea-Realtime-14B with Self-Forcing-1.3B, which share their latent space and denoising schedule, we find that the order of the two models matters: when the 14B model generates only the first chunk and the 1.3B model continues, the rollout keeps 95\% of the 14B model's semantic advantage, whereas the reverse allocation keeps 16\% at about ten times the cost. The large model decides what the video shows; the small model only has to carry it forward. We turn this into BigSmall, a training-free planner--renderer sampler. The 14B model plans the opening chunk and sketches the chunks in which content changes, which preserves motion, and the 1.3B model renders the rest; a faster variant, BigSmall, plans only the opening chunk. A cross-model KV cache that is approximate, windowed and lazy lets the planner leave and re-enter the rollout at low cost. On VBench, BigSmall is $3.02\times$ faster than the 14B model at an unchanged semantic score and motion, and $1.55\times$ faster than SDVG, which lets the small model draft first; BigSmall reaches $3.77\times$ at the same semantic score, trading away 10\% of the motion. On minute-long videos (LoCoT2V-Bench), where the 14B model degrades when it reads its own long history, BigSmall is $3.14\times$ faster than the 14B model and scores higher ($+1.78$).`

AI.tldr: 提出 BigSmall，一种免训练的大-小模型规划-渲染采样器：让14B大模型只在AR视频生成的前段/内容变化处出现，1.3B小模型负责其余渲染，实现约3倍加速且保持语义与运动质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散逐块生成视频，但大模型太慢无法实时；作者想探究AR rollout中"哪里真正需要大模型"，从而以更小代价获得大模型的质量。
AI.method: 配对共享潜空间与去噪调度的Krea-Realtime-14B与Self-Forcing-1.3B，发现顺序很重要：14B只生成第一块、1.3B续生成可保留95%语义优势，反向仅16%且成本约10倍。据此设计BigSmall：14B规划开场块并在内容变化处草图，1.3B渲染其余；变体只规划开场块。另配近似、窗口化、惰性的跨模型KV cache，使规划者低成本进出rollout。
AI.result: VBench上BigSmall比14B快3.02倍且语义分与运动不变，比SDVG快1.55倍；BigSmall*达3.77倍，以10%运动换同语义。分钟级视频(LoCoT2V-Bench)上快3.14倍且得分更高(+1.78)。
AI.conclusion: 大模型决定"视频呈现什么"，小模型只需"把它延续下去"；按此分配算力可在保持语义与运动的同时显著提速，并缓解长历史下的性能退化。

title: Meddies-PII: A Multilingual Framework for Personally Identifiable Information Extraction in Clinical De-identification
summary: Multilingual PII extraction in clinical text is limited by scarce governed data and by synthetic corpora whose construction is thinly documented. We present a large multilingual dataset covering seventeen languages, including seven Southeast Asian languages, and nine PII labels. We also document a detailed generation pipeline and release the complete prompts, catalogues, checks and label maps. A compact 350M-parameter BIOES token classifier trained on the resource achieves the highest score on all fifteen public benchmarks, significantly ahead of the strongest of four public systems on fourteen of them, with a mean exact-match F1 of 0.827 against 0.672 for the strongest system. We also tested it, without adaptation, on multilingual benchmarks, including two human-annotated German and Spanish clinical-style corpora, where it is competitive with the best public systems once annotation conventions are aligned, and is best in four of ten MultiGraSCCo languages; the results show that performance transfers across public benchmarks. We also analyse the data and find almost no near-duplicates and no text overlap between training and any evaluation set. The dataset, benchmark, model, generation framework and evaluation code are planned for public release upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了覆盖17种语言（含7种东南亚语言）、9类PII标签的大型多语言临床文本数据集，并公开完整合成生成流程；基于此训练的350M参数BIOES分词分类器在15个公开基准上均取得最高分，平均exact-match F1为0.827（最强公开系统为0.672）。
AI.motivation: 临床文本多语言PII抽取受限于缺乏受治理的真实数据，而现有合成语料构建过程记录不详、难以复现与验证，因此需要可追溯的合成流程与大规模多语言资源。
AI.method: 构建含17语言、9类PII标签的数据集，详细记录并开源生成流水线（提示词、目录、检查规则、标签映射）；训练紧凑的350M参数BIOES序列标注分类器，并在15个公开基准及多语言基准（含两个人工标注的德语、西班牙语临床语料与MultiGraSCCo）上零适配评测；另做数据去重与训练-评测文本重叠分析。
AI.result: 15个公开基准全部取得最佳成绩，其中14个显著优于四个公开系统中最强者；平均exact-match F1 0.827 vs 0.672。零适配跨语言测试中，在对齐标注规范后与最佳公开系统相当，并在MultiGraSCCo十种语言中的四种取得最佳；数据分析显示几乎无近重复样本，训练集与任何评测集之间无文本重叠。
AI.conclusion: 证明了基于透明合成流程构建的数据可训练出小型高效模型，且性能可跨公开基准与语言迁移；数据集、基准、模型、生成框架与评测代码拟于录用后公开发布。

title: Layer-Level Control of Language Model Execution in Agent Frameworks
summary: Agent frameworks typically orchestrate language models through prompt-and-response interfaces. We propose a harness design that exposes intermediate model states and layer-level execution controls to the agent runtime. By connecting state collection, policy fitting, and execution, the design enables policies to allocate computation within and across models based on intermediate states. We demonstrate the approach with a prototype that learns stitching bridges and state-conditioned execution policies from paired model states, then applies them during inference to select among continue, exit, and stitch. For dispatcher supervision, we select the least-computation action whose full-vocabulary next-token prediction matches the source model's full-depth prediction, using continue when neither early action matches. We train these components on a frozen proxy corpus of 5,000 typed-decision items authored using source texts sampled from WildChat conversations, then evaluate the prototype on JevBench measuring task accuracy, agreement with full-model predictions, and end-to-end latency including runtime overhead. Preliminary results show an approximately 15% reduction in mean latency while maintaining task accuracy comparable to full-model inference.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"harness"设计，将模型中间状态与层级执行控制暴露给智能体运行时，通过策略在模型内/跨模型分配计算量；原型可学习continue/exit/stitch动作，初步实现约15%平均延迟降低且保持与全模型推理相当的任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体框架通常仅通过prompt-and-response接口调用语言模型，无法利用模型内部中间状态信息来动态调控计算量，导致推理计算可能过度或不足。
AI.method: 设计一种harness，把模型中间状态收集、策略拟合与执行控制串联起来，使策略能基于中间状态在模型内部及跨模型间分配计算。原型从成对的模型状态中学习stitching bridges与状态条件执行策略，推理时在continue、exit、stitch间选择。监督信号取自：选择能匹配源模型全深度全词表下一token预测的最少计算动作，两者皆不匹配时用continue。在冻结代理语料(5,000条基于WildChat文本编写的类型化决策项)上训练，并在JevBench上评估准确率、与全模型预测一致性及含运行时开销的端到端延迟。
AI.result: 初步结果显示平均延迟降低约15%，同时任务准确率与全模型推理相当。
AI.conclusion: 将中间状态与层级控制暴露给智能体运行时的harness设计，可在维持准确率的前提下有效降低推理延迟，为智能体中的自适应计算分配提供了可行范式；后续需更充分验证与扩展。

title: A Finite-Rate Selection Law for Annealed Gibbs Sampling
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at DynaFront2026: Dynamics at the Frontiers of Optimization, Sampling, and Games; NeurIPS 2026 Workshop
summary: Annealed Gibbs sampling samples a multimodal model by redrawing one variable at a time from its conditional distribution as the temperature falls from a high value, where the distribution is broad, to the target temperature. Each run ends in a single mode, and unbiased Monte Carlo estimates require the runs to end in each mode in proportion to its probability under the model. At a finite cooling rate this can fail. We measure the error by $c$, the fraction of the model's log-odds between two modes that the samples retain. In the Curie--Weiss model, where a weak external field favors one of two modes, each run selects its mode near the transition at which the modes form, and rarely switches once they have separated. Near the transition, the random fluctuations of the Gibbs updates still outweigh the weak field, which therefore biases the choice of mode only slightly. Building on the selection probability of Kondepudi and coworkers, we derive a law for $c$ that agrees with an exact computation to within $2\%$ on nine linear cooling ramps. For the Hopfield model, whose modes are stored patterns and their negatives, we derive a factor by which competition among patterns raises $c$. The $c$ measured over random pattern sets lies within $3$--$6\%$ of its prediction, but single pattern sets depart from it, contrary to its derivation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究退火Gibbs采样在有限降温速率下的模式选择偏差，引入误差度量c（样本保留的两模式间对数几率比例），在Curie–Weiss与Hopfield模型中推导c的解析规律并与数值计算比较。
AI.motivation: 退火Gibbs采样每次运行最终落入单一模式，无偏估计要求各模式终止比例与其概率成正比；但有限冷却速率下这一性质可能失效，需要量化这种误差。
AI.method: 定义误差c为样本保留的模型两模式间log-odds比例；基于Kondepudi等人的选择概率，在Curie–Weiss模型（弱外场偏好一个模式）中推导c的规律，并针对Hopfield模型（模式为存储模式及其负模式）推导模式间竞争导致c升高的放大因子。
AI.result: c的推导规律在九条线性降温路径上与精确计算吻合至2%以内；Hopfield模型中，随机模式集上测得的c与预测相差3–6%，但单个模式集会偏离预测，与其推导不符。
AI.conclusion: 有限降温速率下的模式选择偏差可用解析规律刻画，Curie–Weiss情形验证良好，Hopfield情形整体趋势正确但个体模式集存在偏差，提示推导中的近似假设有待改进。

title: Center-Aware Ordinal Learning for Prostate Cancer Grading from Histopathology Images
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as an oral presentation at SPIE Medical Imaging 2027
summary: Prostate cancer grading from histopathology whole-slide images (WSIs) is complicated by the ordered nature of ISUP grades, class imbalance, and center-dependent variations in staining, tissue preparation, and scanning. Most weakly supervised methods treat grade groups as independent categories and may therefore learn representations that do not transfer reliably across institutions. We propose a center-aware ordinal learning framework that combines a pretrained pathology encoder with attention-based multiple instance learning. The framework uses an Earth Mover's Distance loss to account for ordinal errors, an ordinal supervised contrastive objective to align same-grade slides across centers while separating grades according to disease severity, and curriculum learning to reduce the dominance of benign cases. We evaluate the framework on approximately 9,100 biopsy WSIs from the two-center PANDA dataset. The proposed framework achieves an accuracy of 0.842 and a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.958 on the held-out test set. Its main benefit is observed in cross-center transfer: when a linear probe is trained on Karolinska representations and evaluated on Radboud, accuracy increases from 0.643 to 0.823 and quadratic weighted kappa from 0.899 to 0.930. Performance remains stable in the reverse direction. UMAP projections further show improved mixing between centers while preserving an ordinal grade trajectory. These results suggest that combining ordinal and center-aware objectives produces more transferable slide representations for multi-center prostate cancer grading.

AI.tldr: 提出中心感知的序数学习框架，结合病理预训练编码器与注意力MIL，用EMD损失、序数监督对比损失和课程学习，提升多中心前列腺癌ISUP分级与跨中心迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 前列腺癌WSI分级面临ISUP等级的有序性、类别不平衡，以及不同中心在染色、制片和扫描上的差异。多数弱监督方法把等级组当作独立类别，学到的表示难以跨机构可靠迁移。
AI.method: 框架由预训练病理编码器加基于注意力的多实例学习构成，并引入三项设计：Earth Mover's Distance损失建模序数误差；序数监督对比目标，使同等级切片跨中心对齐、并按疾病严重程度分离不同等级；课程学习以缓解良性病例的主导。在PANDA数据集约9100张双中心活检WSI上评估。
AI.result: 留出测试集上准确率0.842、二次加权kappa 0.958。跨中心迁移收益最明显：以Karolinska表示训练线性探针在Radboud评估时，准确率由0.643升至0.823，QWK由0.899升至0.930；反向迁移同样稳定。UMAP显示中心间混合改善且保持序数等级轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 将序数目标与中心感知目标结合，可为多中心前列腺癌分级产生更具迁移性的切片表示。

title: Estimating Silenced Tokens in Quantized LLMs
comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027. 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables
summary: Quantization is the standard way to shrink large language models, and it is usually judged by perplexity and task accuracy. We ask a different question: after quantization, which words can the model still say at all? A token is silenced when no hidden state can make it the top choice of the output layer, so a greedy decoder can never produce it. We give a simple, scalable way to estimate how many tokens a quantized output head silences, combining three checks: a direction that lets a token win (so it is safe), an upper bound on how close a token's row is to being trapped inside the others, and an exact match that proves a token can never win. Each count is therefore a certified range: exact matches give its lower end and flagged tokens can only raise its upper end. In nearly all settings we report down to 3 bits the two ends coincide, so the counts are exact. Across three open models we find that quantization silences tokens: on large-vocabulary models it already appears at 8-bit precision, up to a few hundred previously reachable tokens on a 1B-parameter model, and grows as precision drops, while a small-vocabulary model resists until 3 bits. The loss is far from uniform across languages: on a multilingual vocabulary the silenced tokens are overwhelmingly non-Latin (Korean, Chinese, Thai, Arabic and Hebrew), even though Latin tokens dominate the vocabulary. Silencing is thus a measurable, language-sensitive side effect that standard averages miss, and it should be reported alongside them.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"token silencing"这一新指标：量化后输出头中某些token再也无法成为argmax（贪心解码永远无法产生），并给出可扩展的三重检验方法来估计被silenced token的数量，证明其语言不均衡性。
AI.motivation: 量化通常只用perplexity和任务准确率评价，但这些平均值掩盖了一个更根本的问题：量化后模型是否还能"说出"某些词。作者希望揭示这种被标准指标忽视、且可能具有语言歧视性的副作用。
AI.method: 定义token被silenced为不存在任何hidden state能使该token成为输出层top-1，从而贪心解码无法产生它。给出可扩展估计方法，结合三项检验：1) 找到让token获胜的方向（证明其安全）；2) 给出token行被其他行"困住"程度的上界；3) 精确匹配证明token永远无法获胜。三者结合形成认证区间：精确匹配给出下界，被标记token只会抬高上界。
AI.result: 在3-bit以上几乎所有设置中区间上下界重合，即计数精确。三个开源模型上：大词表模型在8-bit即出现silencing，1B参数模型可达数百个原本可达的token，且随位宽下降而增多；小词表模型到3-bit才出现。多语言词表下被silenced的token绝大多数为非拉丁文字（韩、中、泰、阿拉伯、希伯来），尽管拉丁token占词表多数。
AI.conclusion: Token silencing是可测量、具有语言敏感性的量化副作用，被标准平均指标所掩盖，应在报告perplexity和准确率的同时一并报告。

title: Scalar Tuned Lens Summaries Offer Limited Incremental Value for Mid-Generation Abstention
summary: Mid-generation abstention aims to stop an unpromising response before spending its remaining computation budget. Intermediate transformer states may help predict eventual correctness, but whether scalar summaries of their vocabulary predictions add useful evidence is less clear. We compare Tuned Lens entropy and divergence features with final-state and raw intermediate-state probes under matched, causal evaluation. Across eight instruction-tuned models on MATH-500, raw intermediate states improve ranking, whereas scalar-only probes usually trail the final-state baseline. Scalar hybrids have positive exceptions, but their advantage over position-matched permutation controls is small. Cross-fitted residual comparisons further show that gains over a final-state probe need not require aligned scalar features. Actual stopping runs on two model sizes and two benchmarks reveal a separate accuracy--computation trade-off, with token savings overstating wall-time savings for scalar policies. The evidence supports a restricted empirical conclusion about these scalar features, not a general negative claim about intermediate representations.

AI.tldr: 论文在匹配的因果评估下比较Tuned Lens熵/散度等标量特征与最终状态及原始中间状态探针用于生成中途弃答，发现原始中间状态可提升排序，而纯标量探针通常不及最终状态基线；标量混合虽有少数正向例外，但相对位置匹配置换控制优势很小。
AI.motivation: 生成中途弃答可在浪费剩余算力前停止无望回答；中间Transformer状态或能预测最终正确性，但对其词汇预测的标量摘要是否提供有用证据尚不明确。
AI.method: 在八个指令微调模型、MATH-500上，以匹配的因果评估方式对比Tuned Lens熵与散度特征、最终状态探针和原始中间状态探针；使用位置匹配置换控制与交叉拟合残差比较；并在两种模型规模、两个基准上实际运行停止策略。
AI.result: 原始中间状态改善排序，纯标量探针通常落后于最终状态基线；标量混合仅少数正向例外且对置换控制优势微弱；交叉拟合残差显示超越最终状态探针的增益无需对齐标量特征。实际停止运行呈现独立的准确率—计算权衡，标量策略的token节省高估墙钟时间节省。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持关于这些标量特征的有限经验结论，而非对中间表示的一般性否定判断。

title: Mirror Descent at the Edge of Stability
summary: In many deep learning settings, gradient descent has been shown to operate at the edge of stability -- a regime where the largest eigenvalue of the loss Hessian hovers around $2/η$. We study this phenomenon in mirror descent, a generalization of gradient descent. As mirror descent is non-Euclidean, existing explanations of the edge of stability phase do not extend to this setting. We generalize the existing notion of sharpness to introduce mirror sharpness, which measures the curvature of the loss with respect to the mirror potential. Empirically, we observe that the mirror sharpness hovers slightly above the $2/η$ threshold. Furthermore, we derive a dual central flow ODE for mirror descent that models iterates in continuous time at the onset of edge of stability. Our ODE provides insights into the difficulties of extending existing arguments for why sharpness stabilizes at $2/η$ from gradient descent to mirror descent in full generality.

AI.tldr: 本文将"稳定边缘"现象从梯度下降推广到镜像下降，提出"镜像锐度"并研究发现其稳定在略高于 2/η 的阈值附近，同时导出对偶中心流 ODE 解释其机制。
AI.motivation: 梯度下降在稳定边缘（Hessian 最大特征值约 2/η）工作已有解释，但镜像下降是非欧几里得的，原有基于欧氏几何的解释无法直接适用，需要新的度量与理论框架。
AI.method: 将锐度概念推广为镜像锐度，用以度量损失相对于镜像势的曲率；并在稳定边缘起始阶段推导镜像下降的对偶中心流 ODE，在连续时间下刻画迭代轨迹。
AI.result: 实验观察到镜像锐度稳定在略高于 2/η 的阈值附近；所导出的 ODE 揭示了将梯度下降中"锐度稳定于 2/η"的论证推广到一般镜像下降所面临的困难。
AI.conclusion: 镜像下降同样呈现稳定边缘现象，但需借助镜像几何重新定义锐度；现有梯度下降的解释不能一般性地推广，其推广存在本质困难。

title: Decoding Frozen Vision Representations for Training-Free Few-Shot Pineapple Detection
comment: Accepted in WACV HARVEST Vision Workshop 2027
summary: Few-shot object detection in agricultural imagery is hampered by dense vegetation, repeated patterns, and scarce annotations. We present a training-free detector that turns dense features from frozen visual foundation models directly into detections, without fine-tuning, a learned head, or external proposals: a whitened foreground-background direction estimated from annotated support images scores every query patch, and the score field is decoded with an adaptive threshold and support-derived geometry. We also test whether predicted relative depth can be fed directly to RGB-pretrained frozen encoders. On aerial pineapple imagery, the detector outperforms PET-DINO and GeCo2 at every evaluated support size; at K=40, predicted depth alone reaches 92% of the RGB performance with DINOv2, and RGB-depth fusion lowers counting error for both encoders. We release the Pineapple Plantation dataset (4,908 aerial frames, 1,995 annotated with 17,609 boxes, predicted depth, leakage-aware splits) and analyse transfer to two further agricultural datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练的小样本农业目标检测器，直接将冻结视觉基础模型的稠密特征解码为检测结果，并在航空菠萝影像上优于PET-DINO和GeCo2，同时发布Pineapple Plantation数据集。
AI.motivation: 农业影像小样本目标检测受密集植被、重复纹理和标注稀缺困扰；现有方法需微调或学习检测头，成本高且泛化受限。
AI.method: 用标注支持图像估计白化的前景-背景方向，对每个查询图像块打分，并以自适应阈值和支持派生几何解码得分场；另测试将预测相对深度直接输入RGB预训练的冻结编码器，并尝试RGB-深度融合。
AI.result: 在航空菠萝影像上，各支持样本量下均超过PET-DINO与GeCo2；K=40时，仅用预测深度配合DINOv2可达RGB性能的92%，RGB-深度融合降低两种编码器的计数误差；发布含4,908帧航空影像（1,995帧标注、17,609个框）的数据集，并分析向另两个农业数据集的迁移。
AI.conclusion: 冻结基础模型特征经简单白化方向打分即可实现有效免训练小样本检测，预测深度可作为RGB输入的有效补充，数据集与迁移分析为后续研究提供基准。

title: CompareDR: Benchmarking Deep Research Reports from Individual Quality to Comparative Merit
summary: Deep research systems can produce reports with different evidence, analyses, and conclusions for the same query. A reader deciding which findings to rely on needs to know how well each report meets the task requirements and which differences matter to the answer. A score for a single report can summarize its quality, but it does not identify which contributions make one report more useful than another. We introduce CompareDR, a benchmark that combines task-specific pointwise audits with guideline-based pairwise comparisons. We use passage-linked report representations to locate relevant differences and selective evidence verification to check claims that could affect the judgment. The benchmark comprises 40 Chinese and English tasks from three existing benchmarks, 360 reports from nine systems, 1,099 human-reviewed evaluation criteria, and human preferences elicited through blinded comparisons of 80 report pairs. The hybrid evaluator matches 69 of these 80 preferences (86.25%, Cohen's $κ=0.746$). The benchmark supports both comparisons of research systems and examination of the evidence and analyses behind those judgments.

AI.tldr: 提出 CompareDR 基准，结合任务级逐点审计与基于准则的成对比较，用于评估深度研究报告质量并定位差异来源。
AI.motivation: 同一查询下深度研究系统生成的报告在证据、分析与结论上各不相同，读者需判断哪份报告更符合任务要求、哪些差异真正影响答案；单一报告的分数只能概括质量，无法指出哪份报告因何更有用。
AI.method: 构建 CompareDR：包含40个中英文任务（来自3个已有基准）、9个系统的360份报告、1,099条人工审核的评价准则，以及80对报告盲评得到的人类偏好。采用段落链接的报告表示定位相关差异，并用选择性证据验证核查可能影响判断的主张；评价器为逐点审计与成对比较的混合方式。
AI.result: 混合评价器与人类偏好一致率达86.25%（69/80），Cohen's κ=0.746。
AI.conclusion: 该基准既支持对研究系统的比较，也支持审视判断背后的证据与分析依据。

title: Rethinking Closed-Ended Medical VLM Evaluation: From Stable Wrongness to Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity
summary: As medical VLMs are increasingly evaluated for clinical decision-support scenarios, knowing when to trust their predictions is critical. Closed-ended medical VQA has become a common benchmark format because it enables automated scoring. Yet, systematic investigation into whether this format changes the reliability problem remains scarce. We identify a failure mode that we call stable wrongness: models can produce incorrect yes/no answers that remain confident and repeatable even when patient-specific visual evidence is removed or mismatched. This failure violates the premise behind sampling-stability uncertainty methods, including recent hallucination-aware calibration (HAC) variants: disagreement is informative only when errors are unstable. When shortcut-driven errors are themselves stable, sampling agreement can remain deceptively high. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity (CAS), which shifts reliability estimation from answer stability to evidence sensitivity. CAS uses cross-modal counterfactual interventions, such as text-only, black, and corrupted images, to audit whether a committed yes/no answer remains supported when visual evidence is invalidated. Across 7 VLMs and 3 benchmarks, CAS outperforms the best HAC-family scores across all evaluated settings, achieving a macro-averaged AUROC gain of +0.150 for error detection. Mechanistic analysis further shows that CAS recovers hidden errors in the HAC-confident region and that its strongest standalone signal is counterfactual decision-boundary shift rather than hard prediction stability. Our findings suggest that closed-ended evaluation should test visual dependence, not only answer stability, in safety-critical medical contexts.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示闭端医疗VQA中存在"稳定的错误"(stable wrongness)失败模式，使基于采样一致性的不确定性/幻觉校准方法失效，并提出"反事实答案敏感性"(CAS)以证据敏感性替代答案稳定性来评估可靠性。
AI.motivation: 闭端(是/否)医疗VQA因可自动评分而被广泛用作基准，但该格式是否改变了可靠性问题缺乏系统研究。作者发现模型会在视觉证据被移除或不匹配时仍给出高置信、可重复的错误答案，这直接违背了HAC等采样稳定性方法的前提——"分歧只在错误不稳定时才有信息量"。
AI.method: 提出CAS(Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity)：用跨模态反事实干预(仅文本、黑图、损坏图像)检验一个已确定的是/否答案在视觉证据被无效化后是否仍被支持；将可靠性估计从"答案稳定性"转向"证据敏感性"，并以反事实决策边界偏移等作为信号。
AI.result: 在7个VLM和3个基准上，CAS在所有设置下均优于最佳HAC家族分数，错误检测的宏平均AUROC提升+0.150。机制分析显示CAS能恢复HAC高置信区域中隐藏的错误，其最强单一信号是反事实决策边界偏移而非硬预测稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 闭端评估在安全关键医疗场景中应检验模型对视觉证据的依赖性，而不仅是答案稳定性；采样一致性类不确定性方法在捷径驱动的稳定错误面前存在根本盲区。

title: Certified Comparative Statics for Conservation-Law Equilibrium Layers, with an Application to RNA Interference
summary: Implicit and equilibrium neural layers define their output as the fixed point of a map. Existing theory certifies that this fixed point exists; it does not certify how it responds to its inputs. For a conservation-law layer with order-preserving coupling we give a form-independent answer: every input-output comparative static is sign-certified if and only if the residual Jacobian is a nonsingular M-matrix, and the certified sign depends only on the sign of the occupancy derivative, so one guarantee covers Langmuir, Hill, and saturating-exponential occupancies. The M-matrix machinery is classical; the contribution is form-independence as the portable invariant, the first certified-sign sensitivity result for a layer of this class, and a sharp phase boundary at which certification is lost while the equilibrium remains well posed. Three consequences follow: the phase boundary, which is strictly stronger than the M-matrix condition; competitive derepression, whose derivative is identically zero for any independent per-target scorer and provably nonzero here; and non-submodularity of resource-coupled suppression. We instantiate on siRNA off-target competition and validate on real public data only, across seventeen microRNAs, two titration studies, and a paired chemical-modification experiment; a second, non-biological instantiation shows the same certified sign on measured physical data. As a trainable layer the operator learns end-to-end while remaining certified-monotone by construction, reaching magnitude parity with a parameter-matched feedforward baseline while expressing a competition effect that baseline cannot represent for any weights. The single-pool instantiation validates the mechanism but does not rank off-target magnitude or resolve position-specific design. Code: https://github.com/shadi97kh/certified-equilibrium-layers

AI.tldr: 论文研究守恒律隐式/平衡神经层对输入的敏感度可证符号问题：证明当残差雅可比为非奇异 M-矩阵时，所有输入-输出比较静态可符号认证，且符号仅由占据导数决定，从而给出与函数形式无关的保证，并用 siRNA 脱靶竞争等实测数据验证。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式层理论只保证不动点存在，不保证不动点如何随输入变化（比较静态/敏感度），因此在生物等需要可信方向性预测的领域缺乏可证保证。
AI.method: 针对保序耦合的守恒律层，将"所有比较静态可符号认证"等价刻画为残差雅可比为非奇异 M-矩阵；论证认证符号只依赖占据导数符号，从而统一覆盖 Langmuir、Hill、饱和指数型占据函数；给出认证失效但平衡仍良定的尖锐相边界；并以 siRNA 脱靶竞争为实例，构建可端到端训练且结构性单调的认证算子层。
AI.result: 获得首个该类层的认证符号敏感度结果与形式无关的可移植不变量；得到三条推论：相边界严格强于 M-矩阵条件、竞争性去抑制（独立逐靶打分器导数恒为零，而本模型可证非零）、资源耦合抑制的非子模性。在 17 个 microRNA、两项滴定研究、配对化学修饰实验等公开真实数据上验证，另一非生物实测数据同样保持认证符号；可训练层在量级上匹配同参数量前馈基线，并能表达基线任何权重都无法表示的竞争效应。
AI.conclusion: 认证符号可作为与函数形式无关的通用保证，为隐式平衡层提供可训练且构造性单调的建模工具；单池实例验证了机制，但尚不能对脱靶幅度排序或解决位点特异性设计。

title: CAMA: Calibrated Anti-Collapse Marginal Alignment for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
summary:
Test-time adaptation (TTA) updates a model using unlabeled test data to help it handle distribution shifts. However, prior work has found that image corruption causes a vision-language model (VLM) to produce more similar features for different images, a phenomenon known as feature compression. Under compression, entropy minimization, the most common TTA objective, can cause the model to favor a few classes and perform worse than before adaptation. Despite these observations, a detailed analysis of how these failures are connected and an effective strategy for preventing them are still lacking.
  In this paper, we first analyze why entropy minimization fails for VLMs. We then propose CAMA, a new test-time adaptation objective that maximizes batch mutual information to encourage confident predictions for individual images while maintaining diverse predictions across the batch. CAMA also estimates a reference class distribution early in the test stream and aligns each batch's average prediction with this reference during adaptation. We prove that feature compression biases the predictions and that entropy minimization amplifies this bias into collapse, whereas CAMA is guaranteed to preserve every class. Across standard corruption benchmarks, we observe collapse on nearly every VLM backbone evaluated. CAMA prevents collapse in every observed case and, in turn, achieves the best accuracy on every backbone. Quantitative and qualitative analyses confirm that CAMA reverses the feature compression behind the collapse, and ablations show that each of its components contributes.

AI.tldr: 本文分析VLM测试时适应中熵最小化崩溃机理，提出CAMA（批量互信息最大化+参考类分布对齐）以在真实分布偏移下防止类别塌缩并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 已有工作发现图像损坏会使视觉语言模型对不同图像产生更相似的特征（特征压缩），而常用的测试时适应目标（熵最小化）在此情形下会使模型偏向少数类别、性能反而变差，但对其失效机理的细致分析和有效对策仍缺失。
AI.method: 首先理论分析熵最小化在VLM上失效的原因；提出CAMA测试时适应目标：最大化批量互信息，既鼓励单张图像预测自信，又保持批内预测多样性；并在测试流早期估计参考类分布，适应过程中将每批平均预测与参考分布对齐。作者证明特征压缩会偏置预测、熵最小化将该偏置放大为塌缩，而CAMA可保证保留所有类别。
AI.result: 在标准损坏基准上，几乎所有评估的VLM骨干都观察到了崩溃；CAMA在所有观察到的情形下均避免崩溃，并在每个骨干上取得最佳准确率。定量与定性分析证实CAMA逆转了导致崩溃的特征压缩，消融实验表明各组件均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 特征压缩导致的预测偏置经熵最小化会放大为类别塌缩，是VLM测试时适应的核心失效机制；通过批量互信息最大化与参考分布对齐的CAMA可在理论上保证类别保留，并在实验中稳定防止崩溃、提升准确率。

title: LM2 Compiling a Language Model into Another Model Weights
summary: Deploying a conversational model and a specialist together could avoid maintaining a separate specialist service. We present LM2, which embeds a trained story generator into a larger conversational model. The larger model handles the conversation and invokes the generator for story requests. We constrain the generator arithmetic during training so its calculations can be compiled directly into added model layers. We compare this approach with QwenPU, which executes the stories260K language model on an embedded processor. LM2 requires one host token per generated character, compared with approximately 25,000 for QwenPU. However, its story generator predicts held out text less well, i.e. 1.145 bits per character versus 0.894 for stories260K, where lower is better. The Qwen3.5, 0.8B implementation occupies 18.1 GB and generates the same characters as a standalone integer implementation of the inner model in the tested runs. These results illustrate a tradeoff between host-token cost and text-prediction performance.

AI.tldr: LM2将训练好的故事生成器嵌入对话模型中，通过约束其算术使计算可编译进模型层，以大幅降低host token消耗，但代价是预测性能下降。
AI.motivation: 部署对话模型与专用专家模型会增加维护独立的专家服务的成本，作者希望把专用模型内嵌到对话模型中以简化部署。
AI.method: 提出LM2：将训练好的故事生成器嵌入更大的对话模型，由对话模型处理对话并在收到故事请求时调用生成器；训练时约束生成器的算术，使其计算可直接编译进新增的模型层。并与在嵌入式处理器上运行stories260K的QwenPU进行对比。
AI.result: LM2每生成一个字符需一个host token，而QwenPU约需25,000个；但LM2生成器对留出文本的预测更差（1.145 vs 0.894 bits/character，越低越好）。基于Qwen3.5 0.8B的实现占用18.1 GB，在测试运行中生成的字符与独立整数实现的内层模型相同。
AI.conclusion: 结果体现了host token开销与文本预测性能之间的权衡。

title: Similarity-Constrained Reweighting for Complex Query Answering on Knowledge Graphs
summary: Machine learning models for Complex Query Answering (CQA) on knowledge graphs estimate the likelihood of answers that are not reachable via direct traversal. Recent work has proposed extending such queries with soft entity constraints, which require the target variable to be similar or dissimilar to specified sets of entities. We study a more general formulation where similarity constraints are specified on an arbitrary variable in a query, and introduce SCORE: a computationally efficient and interpretable method for incorporating similarity constraints on an arbitrary variable of a query. SCORE is based on a lightweight and interpretable score adjustment function that only requires tuning two hyperparameters on a validation set. Our experiments show that SCORE effectively incorporates preferences while maintaining strong query answering performance. It significantly improves ranking quality when constraints apply to the target variable and performs effectively in the more general case involving constraints on intermediate variables, and its performance remains robust when applied to several existing methods for CQA. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/dfdazac/score.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SCORE，一种轻量、可解释的分数调整方法，可将相似性约束施加在复杂查询的任意变量上，仅需调两个超参数。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱复杂查询（CQA）中，现有方法仅支持对目标变量施加软实体约束（与指定实体集相似/不相似），而更一般的设定——约束作用于查询中任意（如中间）变量——尚未被研究。
AI.method: 提出SCORE：基于一个轻量的可解释评分调整函数，在原有CQA模型打分基础上加入相似性约束项；只需在验证集上调节两个超参数，计算高效且可解释，可接入多种现有CQA方法。
AI.result: 实验表明SCORE能有效融入偏好且保持强查询回答性能；当约束作用于目标变量时显著提升排序质量，在约束中间变量的更一般情形下同样有效，并跨多种现有CQA方法保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: SCORE为任意变量的相似性约束提供了一种通用、高效且可解释的解决方案，扩展了软约束CQA的适用范围，并具备良好兼容性与鲁棒性。

title: Hypothesis Generation and Semantic Attribution in Inverse Perturbation Modeling
summary: Understanding gene regulatory relationships at scale can help identify intervention points and anticipate unintended effects, but connecting a black-box model's learned computation to biological knowledge remains difficult. We investigate whether a sparse, typed gene network can generate inspectable hypotheses for steering malignant transcriptional programs toward expression patterns associated with favorable prognosis. Using LINCS L1000 CRISPR/Cas9 profiles paired with matched plate controls, we train a graph neural network to recover the perturbed gene from baseline and endpoint expression. Nodes combine ProTrek-derived protein representations with expression features; edges encode signed regulatory relationships and other gene interactions. We use this inverse formulation to nominate interventions for a desired multigene expression change in a specified cancer-cell context, and use integrated gradients and conductance along a path from the cell baseline toward the requested endpoint to attribute each nomination to gene states, typed messages, and residual connections. In A549, the model nominates TTK although its expression is unchanged in the request; the account assigns supporting credit through the checkpoint-associated MAD1L1 relationship and opposing credit through the E2F4 transcriptional-regulatory channel. Across 333 screened nominations in nine held-out cell lines, request-path attribution shows positive line-averaged correspondence with finite message-deletion effects at every transition.
