A Plan-Conditioned Decoder (PCD), refined by structure-anchored sequence training, then writes the report under these decisions. With 35M parameters, CLASP outperforms retrained report generators and slide-level LLMs of up to 7B parameters, matches the strongest published results, and generalises to lung cancer from unseen hospitals. Its decisions change what the reports state, not only their length, transfer to an LLM decoder, and can withhold what H&E cannot show: withholding receptor status leaves 23% fewer contradictions with clinical records than the same network without decisions.

AI.tldr: CLASP提出"先决策后解码"的全切片病理报告生成框架，显式决定报告的句子结构、长度、陈述哪些发现及其句子位置，再解码成文；仅35M参数即超越重训生成器与7B级切片多模态LLM，并可从未见医院泛化到肺癌。
AI.motivation: 现有全切片病理报告生成器把所有报告级选择（长度、组织方式、陈述哪些发现及位置）都留给解码器。在PathText-BRCA上，这些选择主导了n-gram指标：直接取查询所在医院报告而不学习就能接近SOTA，而解码器倾向少生成并退回到最常见发现。
AI.method: 1) Exemplar Structure Prior (ESP)：从图像相似病例报告中取句子计划与长度；2) Calibrated Claim Decision (CCD)：由校准后的切片后验选择发现；3) Claim-to-Sentence Placement (CSP)：把每个发现分配到计划句子；4) Plan-Conditioned Decoder (PCD)：用结构锚定的序列训练细化，在上述决策条件下生成报告。
AI.result: 35M参数下优于重训的报告生成器和最多7B参数的切片级LLM，与最强已发表结果持平；可从未见医院泛化到肺癌。其决策改变报告陈述内容而非仅长度，并可迁移到LLM解码器；证据不足时可扣留H&E无法显示的受体状态，与临床记录矛盾减少23%。
AI.conclusion: 将报告级选择显式化、每张切片决策一次，是提升病理报告生成质量与可信度的高效路径，小模型亦可超越大模型并能选择性地"不陈述"不可见信息。

title: Grammar Sparsity Sets How Transformers Learn Random Languages
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Principles of Generative Modeling
summary: We study language acquisition by transformers trained on the Random Language Model: a synthetic hierarchical grammar with random production rules, whose sparsity is controlled by a single parameter and whose conditional entropies are known exactly. On depth-two grammars, we find that sparsity sets both the order and the speed of learning. Dense grammars are learnt one level at a time: a token is predicted from its sibling after $t\propto V$ steps and from the full context only after $t\propto V^{3}$, so the two stages are separated by a plateau that widens with $V$. Sparse grammars are learnt all at once, at $t\propto\sqrt V$, with a smaller exponent than even the first stage of a dense one. The exponents $1$ and $1/2$ already appear at depth one, where we derive them for a linear model trained with Adam.

AI.tldr: 论文研究Transformer在随机语言模型（可控稀疏度的层级语法）上的语言习得过程，发现稀疏度同时决定学习顺序与速度：稠密语法逐层学习（V和V³两步、中间有平台期），稀疏语法则一次性快速学会（√V）。
AI.motivation: 语言习得的顺序与速度受什么因素控制尚不清楚。作者希望用一个条件熵可精确计算的合成层级语法，把"稀疏度"这一单一参数分离出来，定量研究其对Transformer学习动态的影响。
AI.method: 构建Random Language Model：具有随机产生式规则的合成层级语法，稀疏度由单参数控制，条件熵可解析求得。在深度为2的语法上训练Transformer，测量不同稀疏度下各层级特征的习得时间尺度；并在深度1上用线性模型加Adam推导指数。
AI.result: 稠密语法逐层习得：先从兄弟token预测需t∝V步，从完整上下文预测需t∝V³步，两阶段间存在随V加宽的平台期。稀疏语法一次性习得，时间尺度t∝√V，指数小于稠密语法第一阶段。指数1与1/2在深度1即出现，并可由线性模型+Adam解析导出。
AI.conclusion: 语法稀疏度决定语言习得的顺序与速度，并在简单线性模型层面即可解释主要指数，为理解真实语言模型的学习动态提供可控的理论基准。

title: Semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Flash on H5N1 One Health questions
summary: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) has re-emerged as a One Health concern since 2024, and the public is increasingly consulting large-language-model (LLM) chatbots for health information during outbreaks. Before a chatbot's accuracy can be meaningfully assessed, its consistency must first be understood, so that any single response can be trusted as a fair representative of the model's behavior. We characterized the semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 (OpenAI) and Gemini 3 Flash (Google) on 15 H5N1 One Health questions sourced from social media discourse by adopting and extending a centroid-based evaluation framework. Each question was submitted 30 times and reformulated using five Chain-of-Thought (CoT) variants with 30 runs each, yielding 5,400 responses. Pairwise cosine similarity was computed on MPNet embeddings, with sensitivity analyses across three additional transformers. Statistical inference combined standard nonparametric tests (paired Wilcoxon and Friedman with Holm--Bonferroni correction) with inter-embedding agreement statistics (ICC(2,k) and Cronbach's $α$) introduced here as a methodological addition. Both models produced high mean consistency (0.93--0.97, rescaled to {[}0, 1{]}). GPT-5 showed reproducibility significantly higher than repeatability (W = 3.0, p = 0.0003), whereas for Gemini 3 Flash the two metrics were statistically indistinguishable (W = 42.0, p = 0.33). Differential Diagnosis ranked among the top two CoT framings for consistency in both models. The tested chatbots behave as semantically stable sources on H5N1 One Health questions, and the developed consistency evaluation framework is portable to other domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于质心的LLM回答一致性评估框架，测量GPT-5与Gemini 3 Flash在15个H5N1 One Health问题上的语义可重复性与可复现性，共5400条回答；两模型平均一致性均很高（0.93–0.97），但GPT-5的可复现性显著高于可重复性，Gemini两者无差异。
AI.motivation: 2024年以来高致病性H5N1禽流感再度成为One Health议题，公众越来越依赖LLM聊天机器人获取疫情健康信息。评估准确性之前必须先理解模型回答的一致性，才能判断单次回答是否可代表模型的整体行为。
AI.method: 从社交媒体话语中选取15个H5N1 One Health问题；每问提交30次，并用5种Chain-of-Thought变体各重述运行30次，共获5400条回答。在MPNet嵌入上计算两两余弦相似度，并用另外三种transformer做敏感性分析。统计上结合配对Wilcoxon与Friedman检验（Holm–Bonferroni校正），并新增嵌入间一致性统计量ICC(2,k)与Cronbach's α。
AI.result: 两模型平均一致性均较高（0.93–0.97，缩放至[0,1]）。GPT-5的可复现性显著高于可重复性（W=3.0, p=0.0003），Gemini 3 Flash两指标无统计差异（W=42.0, p=0.33）。两模型中"鉴别诊断（Differential Diagnosis）"均位列一致性最高的两种CoT框架之一。
AI.conclusion: 被测聊天机器人在H5N1 One Health问题上表现为语义稳定的信息源；所提出的一致性评估框架可迁移至其他领域。

title: Direct Feedback Policy Optimization for AI Coding Agents
summary: AI coding agents generate, modify, and validate code through multi-turn interactions. Existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on sparse terminal rewards, making it difficult to assess how intermediate decisions affect task outcomes, and group-relative methods also require repeated sampling for each task. We propose Direct Feedback Policy Optimization (DFPO), a single-trajectory reinforcement learning algorithm that trains directly from a single trajectory. DFPO achieves higher task resolution rates than GSPO under matched base models and execution harnesses.

AI.tldr: 提出单轨迹强化学习算法DFPO，直接利用一条轨迹训练AI编码智能体，在相同基座模型与执行框架下任务解决率高于GSPO。
AI.motivation: AI编码智能体通过多轮交互生成、修改并验证代码，但现有强化学习方法依赖稀疏的终端奖励，难以评估中间决策对任务结果的影响；同时组相对方法（如GSPO）对每个任务需重复采样，成本高。
AI.method: 提出Direct Feedback Policy Optimization（DFPO），一种单轨迹强化学习算法，直接从单条交互轨迹中进行训练，无需每组多采样，并提供中间步骤层面的反馈信号。
AI.result: 在与基座模型和执行框架匹配的条件下，DFPO的任务解决率高于GSPO。
AI.conclusion: DFPO以单轨迹训练有效缓解稀疏奖励与重复采样问题，展现出优于组相对方法的性能，为编码智能体的多轮RL训练提供更高效的路径。

title: CLOSE: A Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating Verifier for Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
comment: 41 pages (8-page main text and appendix), 25 figures, 24 tables
summary: Vision-language models frequently describe objects absent from the image because of language priors. Yet the model itself is already a strong judge of its own output: asked separately whether an object is present, it rejects 44%-62% of its hallucinations, and its yes probability reaches an AUROC of 0.90-0.95 without training. This judgment, however, is not directly usable: (1) its probabilities lack a common scale across models; (2) for the remaining 38%-56%, the model still answers yes with probabilities that overlap those of real objects, so no threshold separates them. We therefore propose CLOSE, a Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating verifier that enforces this judgment during generation. Its threshold is a quantile of a memory rather than a probability and thus depends only on ranks; the memory is cold-started from unlabeled images and updated online. A scorer self-trained on pseudo-labels from four hidden-state signals is fused with self-asking by rank to separate what self-asking leaves mixed. Refused objects are rolled back and banned through a laddered back-off, and a recognition table intercepts their reappearance under other wordings. On COCO, refusing 20% and 40% of object mentions reduces the CHAIRs of LLaVA-1.5-7B by 42% and 87% (F1 +1.9 and -6.1 points); refusing 20% and 35% reduces the reachable hallucinations of Qwen3-VL-8B (official counts minus CHAIR-script miscounts) by 79% and 96% (F1 +0.5 and -5.3). An external vocabulary further extends the check beyond the official vocabulary.

AI.tldr: CLOSE is a training-free online self-evaluating verifier that enforces VLM's own presence judgment during generation using rank-based quantile thresholds, achieving large CHAIR hallucination reductions.
AI.motivation: VLMs hallucinate objects due to language priors, yet the model itself can partially detect its own hallucinations. However, its self-judgment probabilities are not comparable across models and overlap with real objects, so no fixed threshold can directly exploit this signal.
AI.method: CLOSE uses a threshold defined as a quantile of a memory (rank-only, model-agnostic), cold-started from unlabeled images and updated online. A scorer self-trained on pseudo-labels from four hidden-state signals is fused by rank with self-asking. Refused objects are rolled back and banned via laddered back-off, and a recognition table intercepts reappearance under other wordings.
AI.result: On COCO, refusing 20%/40% of object mentions cuts LLaVA-1.5-7B CHAIRs by 42%/87% (F1 +1.9/-6.1); refusing 20%/35% cuts Qwen3-VL-8B reachable hallucinations by 79%/96% (F1 +0.5/-5.3). External vocabulary extends checking beyond official vocab.
AI.conclusion: Enforcing a VLM's latent self-judgment during generation, with rank-based calibration, effectively and model-agnostically suppresses object hallucinations.

title: Deep Discriminative Feature Fusion of Convolutional and Attention-Based Recurrent Representations for Subject-Independent ECG Stress Recognition
summary: Stress has become a significant concern because of its negative impact on both physical and mental health and therefore drives the need for reliable automated systems to assess stress levels. Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals provide a non-invasive and objective measure of physiological stress responses and have emerged as a promising modality for continuous stress monitoring. While deep learning techniques have achieved encouraging results in ECG-based stress detection, many studies focus only on one type of feature representation, and therefore limit their ability to capture both the morphological patterns and temporal dynamics embedded in ECG signals. To address this limitation, in this paper, we propose three deep learning-based feature fusion frameworks for ECG-based stress classification. These are Residual Feature Fusion (RFF), Bidirectional Feature-Wise Cross-Attention Fusion (BFCAF), and a novel Cross-Attention Residual Fusion (CARF) framework that combines the strengths of residual learning and bidirectional cross-attention within a unified architecture. A 1D Convolutional Neural Network (1D-CNN) and a BiLSTM-Attention network are used to extract complementary morphological and temporal representations from ECG signals, respectively. The proposed fusion frameworks leverage these heterogeneous representations to improve feature interaction, information preservation, and stress discrimination. The proposed frameworks are evaluated using subject-independent Leave-One-Subject-Out Cross-Validation (LOSOCV) on the RML and WESAD datasets for three-class stress classification. Experimental results show that the proposed feature fusion methods consistently improve performance over individual CNN and BiLSTM models, with CARF achieving the highest accuracies of 83.1% and 77.91% on the RML and WESAD datasets, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三种深度学习特征融合框架（RFF、BFCAF、CARF），融合1D-CNN提取的形态特征与BiLSTM-Attention提取的时序特征用于ECG压力三分类，其中CARF在RML和WESAD数据集上分别取得83.1%和77.91%的最高准确率。
AI.motivation: 压力对身心健康有负面影响，需要可靠的自动化压力评估系统；ECG是无创客观的生理信号，但现有深度学习研究多只用单一特征表示，难以同时捕捉ECG的形态模式与时间动态。
AI.method: 用1D-CNN和BiLSTM-Attention分别提取形态与时序的互补表示，提出三种融合框架：残差特征融合（RFF）、双向特征级交叉注意力融合（BFCAF）以及结合残差学习与双向交叉注意力的统一架构CARF；在RML和WESAD数据集上采用被试独立的留一被试交叉验证（LOSOCV）进行三分类评估。
AI.result: 三种融合方法均稳定优于单独的CNN和BiLSTM模型，其中CARF表现最佳，在RML和WESAD上准确率分别为83.1%和77.91%。
AI.conclusion: 异构特征融合能增强特征交互与信息保留，提升压力判别能力，验证了残差学习与双向交叉注意力结合的有效性，为ECG连续压力监测提供了可行方案。

title: THETA: Heat Diffusion as a Structural Prior for Cross-Domain Transfer in Graph Foundation Models
summary: Graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to learn transferable representations across domains with heterogeneous node attributes and graph structures. However, relations inferred from node attributes can rely on domain-specific feature semantics, limiting their transferability to unseen graphs, particularly in low-label regimes. We propose THETA (Topology-aware HEat-based TrAnsfer), a graph foundation model that leverages Heat Kernel Signatures (HKS) as a topology-based structural prior for cross-domain transfer. By characterizing nodes' heat-return behavior across diffusion scales, HKS provides a common structural descriptor across graphs without requiring aligned attribute semantics, complementing feature-based relations with information about local and multiscale connectivity. THETA incorporates this prior into both pre-training and few-shot adaptation. During pre-training, it combines HKS with node attributes to construct refined graph views and trains a shared encoder via contrastive learning. During adaptation, it uses HKS to guide edge-weight adjustment and prototype refinement while keeping the encoder frozen and retaining the contribution of labeled support nodes. Through HKS, THETA uses structural information from heat diffusion to guide both representation learning and few-shot adaptation with unlabeled target-domain data. Extensive experiments across diverse graph domains demonstrate that THETA consistently outperforms existing baselines on downstream tasks, highlighting the value of heat diffusion as a structural prior for transferable graph representations.

AI.tldr: THETA 用热核签名(HKS)作为纯拓扑结构先验，指导图基础模型的预训练与少样本适配，实现跨域可迁移的图表示学习。
AI.motivation: 现有图基础模型依赖节点属性推断关系，而属性语义具有域特异性，难以迁移到未见图，尤其在低标签场景下受限。
AI.method: 以热核签名(HKS)刻画节点在不同扩散尺度下的热回返行为，作为无需对齐属性语义的通用结构描述符。预训练阶段将HKS与节点属性结合构建精炼图视图，用对比学习训练共享编码器；适配阶段用HKS引导边权调整与原型精炼，冻结编码器并保留有标签支持节点的贡献，利用无标签目标域数据进行少样本学习。
AI.result: 在多个图域的大量实验中，THETA 在下游任务上稳定优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 热扩散结构先验可有效提升图表示的可迁移性，为跨域图基础模型提供了一条不依赖属性语义对齐的路径。

title: CAR3T: Generalizable Calibration-Guided Reference-View Attention Reuse for Multi-View 3D Transformers
summary: Feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction relies on global attention for cross-view aggregation, but the attention cost grows quadratically with the number of views, making inference increasingly expensive for larger inputs. Existing acceleration methods compress tokens or sparsify attention, potentially losing geometric detail or restricting cross-view aggregation while leaving redundancy among attention outputs underexploited. We observe similar cross-view attention distributions in certain layers, revealing an opportunity to reduce repeated global aggregation through output reuse. However, the layers suitable for reuse vary with the input, and reusing one layer alters the features received by later layers. Similarity at individual layers therefore cannot characterize the combined effect of multiple reuse decisions on output drift. To address these challenges, we propose CAR3T, a training-free framework combining reference-view attention output reuse with offline risk calibration and online dynamic layer selection. Calibration models cumulative reuse risk, while online selection adapts reuse to each input under a calibrated budget. CAR3T retains all input tokens and attends to the keys and values of all views, reducing the core attention computation in selected layers from quadratic to linear. Experiments on VGGT, DA3, and $π^3$ show forward speedups up to $1.41\times$ with at most 100 views and $1.75\times$ on longer sequences, with accuracy trade-offs across backbones and datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出CAR3T：免训练的跨视图注意力输出复用框架，通过离线风险校准与在线动态层选择加速前馈多视图3D重建。
AI.motivation: 前馈多视图3D重建依赖全局注意力进行跨视图聚合，其开销随视图数二次增长；现有加速方法压缩token或稀疏化注意力，可能丢失几何细节或限制聚合，且忽视注意力输出间的冗余。
AI.method: 观察到部分层跨视图注意力分布相似，可复用输出以减少重复聚合。针对复用层依赖输入、且单层相似度无法刻画多次复用对输出漂移的累积影响，提出免训练框架CAR3T：参考视图注意力输出复用＋离线风险校准（建模累积复用风险）＋在线动态层选择（在校准预算下逐输入自适应复用）。保留全部输入token并仍对所有视图的K/V做注意力，使选中层的核心注意力由二次降为线性。
AI.result: 在VGGT、DA3、π³上，≤100视图时最高1.41×前向加速，更长序列达1.75×，但精度权衡因骨干与数据集而异。
AI.conclusion: CAR3T以输出复用替代重复全局聚合，兼顾输入完整性与跨视图聚合，实现无需训练的推理加速；代价是存在精度损失且依赖校准。

title: Refine, Don't Reinvent: RASA-Bench for Source-Grounded Hindi Prose Refinement
comment: Accepted to EACL 2027. 22 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://abdur75648.github.io/rasa-bench
summary: For a producer of Hindi creative prose, drafting is cheap and editing is not: a machine-written episode, story, or essay reads as under-written and flat, laced with translationese, and it sometimes quietly alters what the source says. RASA-Bench targets that editing task across three Hindi prose forms, measuring how well a model refines an under-written AI draft, a task distinct from writing from scratch. Across 2,050 drafts and eight refiners (16,400 rewrites), a four-layer protocol credits a rewrite only after it passes a faithfulness check against its own source, then ranks the survivors by holistic editorial preference through per-form Bradley-Terry fits whose centered coefficients are standardized before equal-weight averaging. Staying faithful proves to be a decisive test that behaves differently by form: gate-failure rates range from 9.1% on short stories to 29.5% on audio fiction, and the drift that disqualifies a rewrite shifts from events and identity in narrative to claims and evidence in essays. A 600-case human audit puts gate agreement at 0.925 (0.91 to 0.94 across forms), whereas subjective preference is form-sensitive and least settled for essays, among human readers no less than the model judge. The benchmark, evaluation protocol, and Hindi prose diagnostics are available at https://abdur75648.github.io/rasa-bench.

AI.tldr: RASA-Bench：面向印地语散文"润色AI初稿"任务的基准，含2,050份草稿、8个精修模型共16,400次改写，采用四层协议（忠实性门控+分体裁Bradley-Terry偏好排名+标准化等权平均）。
AI.motivation: 印地语创作散文中"起草便宜、编辑昂贵"：机器生成的短篇/故事/随笔显得单薄平淡、带翻译腔，并会悄悄篡改原意。因此需要专门的"精修AI欠写草稿"评测，区别于从零写作。
AI.method: 覆盖三种印地语散文体裁；四层评测协议：改写须先通过与自身来源的忠实性检查（门控），存活者再按整体编辑偏好、经各体裁Bradley-Terry拟合排序，中心化系数标准化后等权平均；并做600例人工审核。
AI.result: 门控失败率随体裁差异大：短篇9.1%至音频小说29.5%；虚构类失格漂移集中于事件与身份，随笔则集中于论断与证据。人工审核门控一致率0.925（各体裁0.91–0.94）；主观偏好在随笔上最不稳定，人类读者与模型评审皆然。
AI.conclusion: 忠实性门控是关键且体裁敏感的检验；主观偏好评估呈体裁依赖、随笔最难收敛。基准、协议与印地语散文诊断工具已公开。

title: Weight Averaging at Small Budgets Confounds Formula-Labeled Pretraining in Microstructure-Property Regression: A Pre-Specified Study with Post Hoc Rechecks
summary: Closed-form physics formulas can label synthetic microstructures at no cost, so supervised pretraining on those labels is an alternative to self-supervised pretraining when labels are scarce. One pre-specified protocol tests this on two public simulated benchmarks, two-phase conductivity and short-fiber stiffness: a ConvNeXt-Small is pretrained on 150,000 synthetic images by formula regression or masked reconstruction and fine-tuned on 100, 400, or 1,600 labels. Five fine-tuning seeds from one formula checkpoint have mean residual correlations of 0.994 (conductivity) and 0.999 (stiffness). On conductivity the formula network compresses its predictions (slope 0.64) and has four times the 400-label error of ImageNet initialization. Two confounds interact: the generator renders the low-conductivity phase with the opposite contrast polarity, and the exponential moving average (EMA; decay 0.995, no bias correction) still holds 16% of the initial weights after the 400-label schedule. Without the EMA the slope is 0.97, and over three subsets and five seeds the mismatched checkpoint has 1.4 times the ImageNet error (0.0119 versus 0.0084). Three pretraining runs per polarity leave the comparison inconclusive: matched means (0.0086, 0.0111, 0.0118) fall below mismatched means (0.0119, 0.0120, 0.0123) in aggregate (0.0105 versus 0.0121) but overlap on two of three subsets, and the matched spread (0.0032) exceeds the mismatched spread (0.0004). On stiffness without the EMA, formula pretraining lowers the 100-label error by 18% versus ImageNet over five seeds, including a re-initialized head, while ImageNet seeds also correlate at 0.992. Weight averages that start at the pretrained weights can dominate small-budget comparisons and should be rechecked at the last weights.

AI.tldr: 论文检验以闭式物理公式标注合成微结构、对ConvNeXt-Small做监督预训练（公式回归 vs 掩码重建），在导电率与短纤维刚度两个基准上仅用100/400/1600个标签微调；发现EMA权重平均与生成器对比度极性两个混杂因素会主导小预算结论。
AI.motivation: 标签稀缺时，自监督预训练是常见替代方案；而物理公式可无成本地为合成微结构生成标签，因此有必要系统检验"公式监督预训练"是否真能在小标签预算下优于ImageNet初始化。
AI.method: 预先设定协议：15万张合成图像上以公式回归或掩码重建预训练ConvNeXt-Small，再在100/400/1600标签下微调，各5个随机种子；同时排查EMA（decay 0.995、无偏置校正）与生成器低导电相颜色极性反转两个混杂因素，并检查"以预训练权重为起点的权重平均"与"最后一个权重"的差异。
AI.result: 同一公式检查点的5个微调种子残差相关达0.994（导电率）与0.999（刚度），即种子方差极小。导电率上公式网络预测被压缩（斜率0.64），400标签误差为ImageNet的4倍；去除EMA后斜率升至0.97，极性不匹配检查点误差为ImageNet的1.4倍（0.0119 vs 0.0084）。每极性3次预训练后，匹配组总体均值更低（0.0105 vs 0.0121），但3个子集中有2个重叠，且匹配组离散度（0.0032）大于不匹配组（0.0004），结论不确定。刚度上去除EMA后，公式预训练在100标签下比ImageNet降低18%误差（含重新初始化头部），而ImageNet各种子相关也达0.992。
AI.conclusion: 公式监督预训练在刚度任务小标签预算下有收益，但在导电率任务上结论受混杂因素影响而不确定；从小预算比较中得出的优势可能来自EMA等权重平均技巧及数据极性失配，应在最后权重处复核，并提高预训练重复次数以降低离散度。

title: NANO: Unifying Missingness and Input Uncertainty in Tabular Learning
summary: Missing values are common in tabular data, yet current approaches to handling them often overlook two dimensions. First, an observed value may be uncertain, while a Not-Observed (N.O.) value may still have a reasonable estimate. Inputs should therefore span a continuous spectrum from no evidence to a fully trusted observation. Second, Not-Applicable (N.A.) means that no meaningful value exists for a record, yet this semantic state often lacks explicit representation. To address both dimensions, we introduce NANO, a unified plug-in for input encoding that fits most token-based architectures. Guided by Bayesian evidence weighting, NANO adjusts the influence of a supplied value according to confidence, with all zero-confidence estimates mapped to the same N.O. representation. NANO accepts, but does not require, per-example confidence information during training or inference. For N.A., a separate representation enables models to encode inapplicability and its schema-defined reasons into context. Experiments across eleven datasets and nine backbones show that mixed-confidence training enables a single NANO model to generalize across inference confidence levels, remaining competitive without estimates and improving steadily as estimate reliability and confidence increase. The effectiveness of NANO's handling of N.A. is further demonstrated on three augmented datasets.

AI.tldr: NANO：一个基于贝叶斯证据加权的统一输入编码插件，处理表格数据中"置信度连续谱"与"不适用(N.A.)"两类缺失语义。
AI.motivation: 现有缺失值处理方法忽视两点：观测值可能不确定、未观测(N.O.)值可有不完全可信的估计（输入应是连续置信谱而非二元）；且不适用(N.A.)语义缺乏显式表示。
AI.method: 提出NANO，适配多数token类架构的输入编码插件。以贝叶斯证据加权调节所给值的影响，零置信估计统一映射到同一N.O.表示；N.A.用单独表示，并将模式定义的原因编码进上下文。置信信息训练/推理时可选项。
AI.result: 在11个数据集、9种骨干上实验：混合置信训练使单一模型泛化到不同推理置信度；无估计时具竞争力，随估计可靠性与置信度提高而稳步提升；在3个增强数据集上验证了N.A.处理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: NANO统一处理置信度连续谱与不适用语义，通用性强（插件式、置信信息可选），为表格缺失值建模提供新范式。

title: When Fog Becomes a Weapon: Atmospheric Attacks on Visible-Infrared Vision-Language Models
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures. Supplementary material (23 pages) is available as an ancillary file
summary: Existing adversarial attacks on vision-language models (VLMs) and cross-spectral perception primarily rely on conspicuous, unnatural artifacts, such as vivid adversarial patches or active light beams, that lack physical stealthiness, whereas prior weather attacks largely overlook how one atmosphere simultaneously affects heterogeneous sensors. This raises a key scientific question: can a purely natural, shared fog environment simultaneously disrupt complementary visible and thermal infrared cues without artificial surface modifications? We introduce Fog Manipulation Attack (FMA), a zero-gradient attack that optimizes a common 3D fog state to induce simultaneous semantic failures in visible-infrared VLMs. FMA links shared, depth- and layer-aware atmospheric propagation along scene paths with band-specific imaging physics---visible airlight scattering and thermal path radiance---allowing one realistic fog state to erode both modalities' distinct cues. Experiments show that FMA more than doubles simultaneous failure rates over fidelity-matched random fog, transfers to captioning and VQA, and removes cross-modal compensation, where restoring a clean companion view recovers 64%--74% of lost dual-input VQA answers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出雾操控攻击（FMA），一种零梯度攻击，通过优化同一3D雾状态同时破坏可见光与热红外VLM的语义理解。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM与跨光谱感知的对抗攻击依赖显眼、不自然的伪影（如明显对抗补丁、主动光源），缺乏物理隐蔽性；而既有天气攻击忽视了同一大气条件如何同时影响异构传感器。核心问题是：纯自然的共享雾环境能否在无人工表面修改的情况下，同时破坏可见光与热红外的互补线索。
AI.method: FMA将沿场景路径的共享、深度与分层感知的大气传播，与各波段成像物理（可见光大气光散射、热红外路径辐射）相耦合，用一个逼真雾状态同时侵蚀两模态各自独特的线索，并采用零梯度优化。
AI.result: 相比保真度匹配的随机雾，FMA使同时失效率高出一倍以上，并可迁移到图像描述与VQA任务；它还消除了跨模态补偿——恢复干净伴随视图可找回64%–74%丢失的双输入VQA答案。
AI.conclusion: 纯自然的共享雾环境即可作为隐蔽且有效的物理攻击，同时破坏可见-红外VLM，并揭示跨模态补偿机制可被消除。

title: Sánchez, Feijóo, or Abascal? Speaker Attribution and Ideological Congruence in LLM Personas Reading Posts on X of the Leaders of the Three Main Parties of the 29N General Election in Spain
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 31 tables. Code and configuration: https://github.com/VictorMYeste/spanish-political-communication
summary: Source cues are central to political communication, yet reception studies with large language model (LLM) personas as synthetic audiences have not tested whether personas respond to who speaks and not only to what is said. With Spain's general election of 29 November 2026 in mind, we run a speaker-attribution experiment using 1,075 anonymised X posts by the leaders of PSOE, PP and VOX on four topics (the economy and employment, household costs, immigration and corruption) and 791 distinct value-grounded, LLM-generated personas. Each post was assigned to 300 topic-selected persona profiles, 150 grounded in the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map and 150 in Moral Foundations Theory, under four conditions: no author, Sánchez, Feijóo or Abascal, yielding 322,470 complete persona-post quartets. Naming any leader lowered support for identical text, with the penalty for Abascal nearly twice as large as those for Sánchez and Feijóo. The penalty follows the persona's elicited left-right self-placement (ideological congruence): left personas spare Sánchez and right personas spare Feijóo, although ideology was never in the message-evaluation prompt. Corruption posts were penalised under every name, whereas on other topics the ideologically closest leader generally produced little or no penalty. The leader order matches public opinion in 48 CIS barometers (2022-2026) in all three groups and the sign of all twelve differences, but fits barometers before the model's 2024 knowledge cutoff better than recent ones. Our findings demonstrate that LLM personas evaluate political speakers through systematic, value-congruent priors: however, while they replicate human candidate rank-orders across survey barometers, this alignment is ordinal rather than quantitative, highlighting their utility for controlled source-effect experiments though not as substitutes for empirical public opinion surveys.

AI.tldr: 用791个价值观锚定的LLM人格模拟受众，对1075条西班牙政党领导人推文做来源归因实验，发现命名任何领导人均降低支持度，惩罚幅度随人格左右立场系统性变化，且领导排序与CIS民调序数一致但数值不可替代。
AI.motivation: LLM人格作为合成受众已用于传播学研究，但尚未验证其是否对"谁在说"（来源线索）而非仅"说了什么"作出反应；本文检验LLM人格能否复现来源效应与意识形态一致性效应。
AI.method: 西班牙2026年11月大选背景下的发言者归因实验：1,075条匿名化X帖（PSOE、PP、VOX三党领袖，四个议题：经济就业、家庭开销、移民、腐败）×791个价值观锚定LLM人格（各半基于Inglehart-Welzel文化地图与道德基础理论）。每条帖分配给300个议题筛选的人格，四条件（无作者／Sánchez／Feijóo／Abascal），共322,470个完整"人格-帖子"四元组。
AI.result: 标注任何领袖名均降低对相同文本的支持，Abascal的惩罚约为Sánchez与Feijóo的两倍。惩罚随人格自报左右立场变化（左翼宽待Sánchez、右翼宽待Feijóo，而意识形态从未进入评估提示）。腐败帖在所有署名下均受罚；其他议题上意识形态最近的领袖几乎不受罚。领袖排序与48次CIS民调（2022–2026）三组顺序及全部12个差值符号一致，但对2024知识截止前的民调拟合优于近期民调。
AI.conclusion: LLM人格通过系统性的价值观一致性先验评价政治发言者，能复现人类候选人排序但仅为序数而非定量对齐；适用于受控来源效应实验，但不能替代真实民意调查。

title: Particle Belief Representations for Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability
summary: Particle filters flexibly represent complex, multimodal beliefs but expose them as weighted, unordered sets incompatible with conventional fixed-dimensional policies. We study particle-belief encodings as inputs to reinforcement-learning policies while holding belief estimation and policy optimization fixed. We compare statistical summaries, cumulant-generating-function (CGF) features, and permutation-invariant set encoders. Trainable encoders are learned end-to-end or pretrained through belief reconstruction or task-specific prediction. Across eight tasks, pooling-based set encoders and gradient CGF features are reliable end-to-end, while the Set Transformer achieves the highest performance with appropriate pretraining. Task-specific pretraining helps when its target captures decision-relevant belief structure, whereas reconstruction pretraining and latent alignment provide more selective benefits. For selecting and training particle-belief encoders in partially observable Markov decision processes, our results show that an encoding that reconstructs the belief well is not necessarily a good input for control.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统比较了将粒子滤波信念（加权无序点集）编码为强化学习策略输入的三类方法：统计摘要、累积量生成函数(CGF)特征和置换不变集合编码器，并考察端到端学习与多种预训练方式的影响。
AI.motivation: 粒子滤波能灵活表示复杂多模态信念，但其输出是加权无序集合，无法直接作为常规固定维策略网络的输入；如何在保持信念估计与策略优化不变的前提下，为控制任务选择并训练合适的粒子信念编码器尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在8个任务中固定信念估计与策略优化，仅替换输入编码方式。对比统计摘要、梯度CGF特征与集合编码器（池化类、Set Transformer），编码器或以端到端方式训练，或通过信念重构、任务相关预测等预训练方式获得。
AI.result: 基于池化的集合编码器与梯度CGF特征在端到端设置下表现稳定可靠；Set Transformer 在合适的预训练下取得最高性能。任务相关预训练在其目标能捕捉决策相关的信念结构时最有帮助，而重构预训练与潜空间对齐的收益更具选择性。
AI.conclusion: 在POMDP中选择与训练粒子信念编码器时，能良好重构信念的编码不一定是好的控制输入；编码器的评价与设计应以决策相关性为准，而非重构精度。

title: Curvature Mismatch and Local Errors in Galaxy Property Estimation
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the 9th Workshop on Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences (ML4PS 2026)
summary: Linear probes are widely used to evaluate learned representations and infer physical quantities from unlabelled data. The probe's predictions are from an affine function in ambient space restricted to the underlying representation, and consequently, even a representation that has complete information needed to predict a target can produce systematic probe errors when that information is encoded in a form inaccessible to the linear probe. Here we share that some of this probing error is due to the innate geometry of the manifold. Linear probes, when evaluated on a curved manifold, generally have a nonzero intrinsic Hessian (what we colloquially call "probe-facing curvature") given by $\langle w_N,\mathrm{II}\rangle$, the manifold's second fundamental form dotted with the probe's normal component. We fit linear probes to galaxy embeddings from five pretrained encoders and intervene on this curvature term to evaluate its contribution to the probe performance. We find that keeping this inherited curvature improves the local fit where it matches the label's curvature. Removing the curvature component of the probe where it does not match the label curvature also provides improvements, and correcting it in every neighbourhood raises held-out local $R^2$ by 0.006 to 0.010 on galaxies, gaining more where the two curvatures disagree. We isolated these gains to be from the underlying geometry and not an automatic guarantee from least squares training.

AI.tldr: 线性探针在弯曲表示流形上的误差部分源于流形的内在几何；作者将其归因于"探针面对曲率"⟨w_N, II⟩，并通过在星系嵌入上干预该曲率项验证，校正后局部R²提升0.006–0.010。
AI.motivation: 线性探针被广泛用于评估表示并从无标签数据推断物理量，但有时代码即使表示包含预测目标所需的全部信息，也会因信息以线性探针无法访问的形式编码而产生系统性误差。作者希望揭示其中一部分探测误差源于表示流形的内在几何。
AI.method: 将线性探针视为环境空间中限制在表示流形上的仿射函数，定义"探针面对曲率"为⟨w_N, II⟩（第二基本形式与探针法向分量的内积）。对来自五个预训练编码器的星系嵌入拟合线性探针，并对该曲率项进行干预实验，以评估其对探针性能的贡献。
AI.result: 当继承曲率与标签曲率一致时，保留该曲率可改善局部拟合；当两者不匹配时，去除探针的曲率分量也能带来改进。在每个邻域校正曲率使留出的局部R²在星系任务上提升0.006至0.010，且两曲率分歧越大收益越大。作者确认这些收益来自底层几何，而非最小二乘训练的自动保证。
AI.conclusion: 线性探针误差的一部分可由表示流形的内在几何（曲率）解释；通过显式干预探针面对曲率可提升探针的局部拟合性能，说明评估表示时应考虑流形的非欧几何结构。

title: OKB-CFM: Observation-Keyed Barycentric Conditional Flow Matching for Unpaired Sparse-to-Dense Cardiac Shape Completion
summary: Completing cardiac segmentations from sparse cine magnetic resonance labels is challenging because acquired planes do not uniquely determine the underlying anatomy and patient-matched dense annotations are rarely available. We propose observation-keyed barycentric conditional flow matching for completion between clinically unpaired cohorts. Independently trained variational autoencoders represent sparse observations and dense shapes. A fixed memory associates simulated sparse keys with their source dense encodings, enabling candidate retrieval within the sparse latent space. A matching network aggregates the retrieved values into a query-dependent barycentric endpoint, toward which an endpoint-conditioned flow transports the sparse encoding. Individual candidate values provide alternative completion endpoints. On 327 real unpaired inputs, the method obtains encoder-feature Fréchet and squared maximum mean discrepancy scores of 7.93 and 2.02 after scaling by 10,000 and 10,000,000, respectively, corresponding to reductions of 47.0\% and 94.2\% relative to contrastive unpaired translation. On a 34-file simulated test partition, evaluation against dense-VAE-reconstructed references yields a five-class mean Dice of 0.889, squared Chamfer distance of 6.15 square voxels, 95th-percentile surface distance of 3.88 voxels, and average symmetric surface distance of 1.50 voxels. These results characterize cohort-level feature agreement, observed-label consistency, and reconstruction under the stated reference construction. By complementing routine cine-based functional assessment with inferred multi-chamber anatomical context, this framework provides a basis for investigating how chamber morphology and spatial relationships relate to cardiac function.

AI.tldr: 提出"观察键控重心条件流匹配"(observation-keyed barycentric conditional flow matching)，可在非同配对队列间由稀疏电影MRI标注补全完整心脏分割。
AI.motivation: 稀疏电影MRI标注无法唯一确定解剖结构，且缺乏病人匹配的稠密标注，因此需要在临床非同配对队列之间完成分割补全。
AI.method: 用独立训练的VAE分别表示稀疏观测与稠密形状；固定记忆库将模拟稀疏键与其源稠密编码关联，在稀疏潜空间检索候选；匹配网络将检索值聚合成查询相关的重心端点，端点条件流将稀疏编码输运至该端点；各候选值也可作为备选补全端点。
AI.result: 327例真实非配对输入上，编码器特征Fréchet与MMD²（×10⁴/×10⁷）为7.93和2.02，较CUT分别降低47.0%和94.2%；34例模拟测试集上对稠密VAE重建参考，五类平均Dice 0.889，Chamfer² 6.15体素²，95%表面距离3.88体素，ASSD 1.50体素。
AI.conclusion: 结果体现了队列级特征一致性、观测标注一致性与指定参考构造下的重建质量；该框架为常规电影功能评估补充多腔室解剖信息，为研究腔室形态及空间关系与心功能的关系提供基础。

title: ComplexIF: A Challenging Multi-Turn, Multi-Constraint Instruction-Following Benchmark
summary: As frontier LLMs saturate existing instruction-following benchmarks, measuring further progress requires harder tests that remain faithful to real use. In practice, users often combine several constraints, add them at different turns of a conversation, and expect all of them to hold in the assistant's response. We introduce ComplexIF, a challenging benchmark for this setting, together with the automatic pipeline that generates it. The pipeline expands seed requests into multi-turn conversations, weaves constraints into their turns, and keeps only tasks that a strong model can solve, so difficulty can be raised by adding constraints or turns while every task stays solvable. ComplexIF's two splits test complementary sides of instruction following: a verifiable split of format constraints, checked by programs, and a rubric split of semantic instructions, such as a tone or an audience, checked with an LLM judge. Across 14 proprietary and open-weight models, even the strongest satisfies every constraint on fewer than half of the verifiable tasks, and no model leads on both splits.

AI.tldr: 提出 ComplexIF 基准及自动生成流水线，测试模型在多轮对话中同时满足多条叠加约束的能力。最强模型在可验证任务上全部满足约束者不足一半，且在两个子集上无模型同时领先。
AI.motivation: 现有指令遵循基准已趋饱和，而真实使用中用户常在一次对话的不同轮次叠加多条约束并要求全部满足，缺少能保持真实性和可解性的更难测试。
AI.method: 构建自动流水线：将种子请求扩展为多轮对话，把约束织入各轮，并只保留强模型可解的任务，从而通过增加约束或轮数提升难度而不失可解性。基准分两子集：格式约束用程序校验，语义约束（如语气、受众）用 LLM 评判。
AI.result: 在 14 个闭源与开源模型上，最强模型在可验证任务中全部满足约束的比例低于 50%，且没有模型在两个子集上同时领先。
AI.conclusion: 多约束、多轮指令遵循仍是前沿 LLM 的显著短板，ComplexIF 为衡量后续进展提供了难度可控且真实可解的高难度测试。

title: Second-Order Dynamics in Noisy RNNs Produce Exploration and Temporal Compression in Replay
summary: Biological neural networks (like the hippocampus) can internally generate "replay" resembling stimulus-driven activity. Recent computational models of replay use noisy recurrent neural networks (RNNs) trained to path-integrate. Replay in these networks is described as Langevin sampling, but this theory alone fails to capture the environmental exploration and temporal compression observed in real biological replay. To close this gap, we re-examine spontaneous noisy RNN activity ("replay") as Langevin sampling, one timestep at a time, from a time-series distribution resembling lived experiences (unlike previous works which defined sampling as Monte Carlo inference over a static distribution). We provide a normative second-order Langevin sampling framework wherein spike-frequency adaptation drives spatial exploration at the cost of speed, and momentum via dendritic input differentiation drives temporal compression. We numerically verify our framework via simulations of noisy RNNs trained on 2D triangular and T-maze navigation activity, and others trained on place cell activity of synthetic rats. Crucially, we observe that simultaneous adaptation and momentum increases both replay exploration and speed, and provide one of the first accounts for biologically plausible temporal compression in rate-based RNN replay. Our findings encourage experiments into whether dendritic input differentiation, or other mechanisms, may support temporal compression in memory circuits like the hippocampus.

AI.tldr: 将噪声RNN中的"replay"重新解释为沿时间序列分布（而非静态分布）的逐步Langevin采样，并给出二阶Langevin框架：spike-frequency adaptation驱动空间探索（牺牲速度），树突输入微分产生的momentum驱动时间压缩；二者同时存在可同时提升探索与速度。
AI.motivation: 生物神经网络（如海马）能自发产生类似刺激驱动的"replay"。现有基于含噪RNN的replay模型用Langevin采样解释，但该理论无法解释真实生物replay中的环境探索与时间压缩现象。
AI.method: 把自发含噪RNN活动逐步建模为来自"经历时间序列分布"的Langevin采样（而非以往对静态分布做Monte Carlo推断）；提出二阶Langevin采样框架：spike-frequency adaptation对应空间探索、以速度为代价，树突输入微分提供momentum以实现时间压缩；在2D三角迷宫与T迷宫导航任务训练的含噪RNN、以及基于合成大鼠位置细胞活动的网络上做数值验证。
AI.result: 模拟验证了框架；发现adaptation与momentum同时作用时，replay的探索范围与速度均提升；并首次（之一）为rate-based RNN replay中生物学上合理的时间压缩提供解释。
AI.conclusion: 二阶Langevin框架可统一解释replay中的探索与时间压缩；建议实验检验树突输入微分或其他机制是否支持海马等记忆环路中的时间压缩。

title: Fuzzy e-Means: Fuzzy c-Means on Large Data with Moving-Average Mini-Batch Updates
summary: Fuzzy c-means (FCM) gives every point a degree of membership in every cluster. Its standard solver, alternating optimization (AO), needs a full pass over the data per iteration and often many iterations, while methods built for large data stop at a worse objective or still need tens of passes. We run FCM with the optimizer of e-means, a recent mini-batch k-means that keeps moving averages of the number and the sum of the points in each cluster and sets its batch size and step size by scaling laws. The optimizer carries over because an FCM centroid is also a weighted sum divided by a total weight, but this direct transfer fails in two ways: the e-means rule that relocates nearly empty clusters also removes the centroids of small, distant groups, and FCM started from random points can settle in poor local minima. Fuzzy e-means (e-FCM) therefore starts with one pass of e-means with hard assignments and then runs fuzzy moving-average passes without relocation. On 28 configurations with up to 109.5 million points and 16,384 clusters, e-FCM reaches the objective of 25 AO iterations in two to four passes when clusters hold several hundred points or more, 11 to 20 times faster than AO on one-million-point embedding sets with 1,024 clusters. It ends within 0.16% of converged AO on these sets and below converged AO where AO from random points lands in poor minima, but it is slower than AO on small low-dimensional problems, where an AO pass takes milliseconds. Finally, the common fuzzifier m=2 makes the centroids collapse or merge on most high-dimensional sets, and e-FCM can choose the fuzzifier by matching a known overlap at about two passes per candidate value.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fuzzy e-means (e-FCM)：借用 e-means 的小批量移动平均优化器来求解 FCM。先用一次硬分配 e-means 做初始化，再运行不带重定位的模糊移动平均迭代。在最多 1.095 亿点、16384 簇的 28 种配置上，2–4 遍即达到 AO 迭代 25 次的目标值。
AI.motivation: FCM 的标准求解器 AO 每轮需遍历全量数据且迭代次数多；面向大规模数据的方法或以更差的目标值收尾，或仍需数十遍扫描。作者希望把 e-means 的高效优化器迁移到 FCM 上。
AI.method: 将 e-means 的移动平均优化器（维护簇内点数与点和的滑动平均，按 scaling law 设定批量大小与步长）迁移到 FCM，因 FCM 质心同样是加权和除以总权重。直接迁移有两处失败：e-means 的"近空簇重定位"规则会删掉小而远簇的质心；随机初始化的 FCM 易陷入差的局部极小。故 e-FCM 先用一次硬分配 e-means 做初始化，再运行不带重定位的模糊移动平均更新。
AI.result: 在 28 种配置（最多 109.5M 点、16384 簇）上，簇内点数达数百以上时，2–4 遍即达 AO 迭代 25 次的目标值；在 100 万点、1024 簇的嵌入集上比 AO 快 11–20 倍，与收敛 AO 差距在 0.16% 以内，且在随机初始化 AO 陷入差极小值的情况下优于收敛 AO；但在小规模低维问题上（AO 一遍仅毫秒级）比 AO 慢。此外发现常用模糊因子 m=2 在多数高维数据上导致质心塌缩或合并，e-FCM 可通过匹配已知重叠度来自动选 m，每个候选值约需两遍。
AI.conclusion: e-FCM 在簇规模较大时显著快于 AO 并保持目标值质量，兼具更好的局部极小鲁棒性；不适用于小规模低维问题；并揭示了 m=2 的高维失效问题及可负担的模糊因子选择方案。

title: VUOD: A Versatile Unsupervised Outlier Detection Framework for Natural, Industrial, Medical Images and Beyond
summary: Unsupervised outlier detection that automatically identifies whether visual systems involve anomalous images is a significant research topic. However, most approaches are limited to natural images because they rely on frozen and pre-trained feature extractors. So that their performance cannot be maintained in practical scenarios, especially for industrial inspection and medical imaging. In this work, we first revisit this task and then introduce a versatile unsupervised outlier detection framework to enrich the application domains. The core idea of this framework is to improve feature discriminativess via exploiting intrinsic distribution priors. Evaluated on 3 domains and 14 benchmark datasets, our proposed solution achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly outperforms existing methods. More importantly, we show its plug-and-play property that can be integrated into diverse visual applications to improve their robustness, such as image classification and 3D reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出一个通用的无监督异常检测框架，通过利用内在分布先验提升特征判别性，摆脱对冻结预训练特征提取器的依赖，在3个领域14个数据集上取得SOTA，并具备即插即用特性。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督异常检测方法依赖冻结的预训练特征提取器，局限于自然图像，在工业检测、医学影像等实际场景中性能无法保持，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 重新审视该任务，构建通用无监督异常检测框架，核心是借助内在分布先验来增强特征的判别性。
AI.result: 在3个领域、14个基准数据集上评估，达到SOTA，显著优于现有方法；同时展示其可即插即用地集成到图像分类、3D重建等视觉应用中提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架拓展了异常检测的应用领域，通用性强，且作为即插即用模块可提升多种视觉任务的鲁棒性。

title: The Temporal Residual: Fast and Effective Retrofitting of Latent Feedback into Pretrained Language Models
summary: A transformer language model computes a deep hidden state for every token but uses it only to sample that token. Existing latent-feedback designs, which feed hidden states back across tokens, are mostly built in during pretraining and gain little when added to a pretrained model. We introduce the temporal residual, a second residual stream that every sublayer reads and writes and that is carried from each token to the next. It adds 2,752 parameters to a 4.2B-parameter model and starts exactly at the pretrained network. Retrofitted onto Qwen3.5-4B-Base with 5B tokens of training, it beats a standard model trained on the same data by 7, 13 and 5 points on AIME 2024, AIME 2025 and AMC 2023, writes shorter solutions, and stays ahead at matched training compute. The separate stream matters: prior designs that feed state into the existing stream recover at most 40% of the gain when retrofitted. Validation loss can mislead: the recipe with the lowest loss gains nothing at decoding. Trained with filler tokens in place of reasoning, the model reasons in its hidden state: its GSM8K accuracy with no visible reasoning rises from 21% to 40%, and falls back when the carried state is zeroed.

AI.tldr: 提出"时间残差"(temporal residual)——一条独立的第二条残差流，被每个子层读写并在token间传递，仅增加2752个参数即可后装到预训练模型上，显著提升推理性能。
AI.motivation: Transformer为每个token计算深层隐藏状态却只用于采样该token，浪费了信息。现有跨token隐状态反馈设计大多在预训练时内置，后装到预训练模型时收益很小。
AI.method: 引入temporal residual：第二条残差流，每个子层都读取和写入它，并从当前token传递到下一个token。该流从预训练网络的初始状态开始，仅新增2752个参数（4.2B模型），后装到Qwen3.5-4B-Base并用5B token训练。
AI.result: 在AIME 2024、AIME 2025、AMC 2023上分别比同数据训练的标准模型高7、13、5分，解答更短，且在同等训练算力下保持领先；把状态喂入现有残差流的设计只能恢复最多40%的增益；验证损失具误导性，损失最低的方案解码无增益；用填充token替代推理训练时，模型在隐藏状态中推理，无可见推理的GSM8K准确率从21%升至40%，清零传递状态后回落。
AI.conclusion: 独立的跨token残差流是有效且参数高效的后装机制，能提升推理能力并实现隐式推理；同时表明验证损失不能可靠预测解码表现。

title: From Patterns to Threats: A Deep Learning Model for Anomaly Detection in Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: Cyber-physical systems increasingly rely on interconnected sensing, communication, and control components, creating a need for reliable detection of abnormal behavior. This study proposes a Deep Autoencoder for anomaly detection using the Edge-IIoTset dataset. After preprocessing the full dataset, 2,219,201 observations and 38 numerical features were retained. The proposed model employed a 38-24-12-6-12-24-38 encoder-decoder architecture and was trained exclusively on normal observations to learn representative patterns of expected system behavior. Anomaly decisions were based on reconstruction error, with the classification threshold selected independently from validation data by maximizing the F1-score. To assess model stability, five independent runs were conducted using different random seeds, and results were reported as mean plus or minus standard deviation. The proposed Deep Autoencoder achieved an accuracy of 0.9195 plus or minus 0.0061, precision of 0.9602 plus or minus 0.0204, recall of 0.7348 plus or minus 0.0095, F1-score of 0.8325 plus or minus 0.0121, ROC-AUC of 0.8825 plus or minus 0.0339, and PR-AUC of 0.8640 plus or minus 0.0286. Compared with a Simple Autoencoder baseline, the proposed model improved recall and F1-score while reducing the false positive rate. The results demonstrate that the proposed reconstruction-based representation learning approach can provide an effective and reproducible method for detecting anomalous behavior in cyber-physical environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究在Edge-IIoTset数据集上提出一种38-24-12-6-12-24-38结构的深度自编码器，仅用正常样本训练，以重构误差为异常判据，在验证集上按F1最大化独立选取阈值。五组随机种子实验显示准确率0.9195±0.0061、精确率0.9602±0.0204、召回率0.7348±0.0095、F1 0.8325±0.0121、ROC-AUC 0.8825±0.0339、PR-AUC 0.8640±0.0286，相比简单自编码器基线在召回与F1上更优且误报率更低。
AI.motivation: 信息物理系统依赖互联的感知、通信与控制组件，异常行为检测需求日益突出；同时需要一种有效且可复现的检测方法，并优于简单自编码器基线。
AI.method: 使用Edge-IIoTset数据集，预处理后保留2,219,201条观测、38个数值特征；构建38-24-12-6-12-24-38的编码器-解码器深度自编码器，仅在正常数据上训练学习期望行为模式；以重构误差作为异常分数，在验证集上独立选取使F1最大的阈值；用5个不同随机种子重复实验，结果以均值±标准差报告；与简单自编码器基线对比。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于重构的表征学习方法可为信息物理环境中的异常行为检测提供有效且可复现的方案。

title: Tissot indicatrix for location encoders: Characterizing local distortion in learned geographic embeddings
summary: With the increasing adoption of geographic artificial intelligence, location encoders are widely used to map geographic coordinates to learned embeddings for tasks in Earth observation and geospatial modeling. Similar to map projections, location encoders can distort geographic space, that is, equal-distance displacements in different directions can result in unequal embedding changes. However, such distortion remains largely unexamined, and it can propagate into downstream applications. We adapt Tissot's indicatrix, a cartographic tool for map projection distortion, to characterize this distortion. At each location, we compare encoder outputs at equal distances in 32 directions and fit a tensor, represented by an ellipse, whose elongation (anisotropy) and orientation describe the local distortion. The fit requires only encoder outputs without access to model internals and is validated against references with known geometry. By applying the method to thirteen released checkpoints of five encoder families, we find that distortions vary across space and inherit the input geometry to varying degrees, closely in GeoCLIP with its Equal Earth input (anisotropy correlation of 0.88) and weakly or moderately in the other encoders. The distortion also affects the locations an encoder treats as neighbors. Within 1km of 20 query sites, the 40 nearest neighbors in geographic and embedding space overlap by a median of only 57.5--87.5% across the checkpoints, while the fitted ellipses select exactly the same embedding neighbors in 265 of 299 comparisons. These findings provide a geographic basis for assessing location encoders, and the accompanying eTissot package implements the methods for user-specified encoders.

AI.tldr: 本文借鉴地图投影中的Tissot指示图形，提出一种仅依赖编码器输出即可量化位置编码器空间畸变的方法，并在5个编码器家族13个权重上验证畸变的各向异性及其对邻居选取的影响。
AI.motivation: 位置编码器被广泛用于将地理坐标映射为嵌入，类似地图投影会产生空间畸变（等距位移导致不等的嵌入变化），但这一畸变几乎未被研究，且会传播到下游应用中。
AI.method: 将Tissot指示图形适配到嵌入空间：在每个位置比较32个方向上等距位移处的编码器输出，拟合一个由椭圆表示的张量，用其伸长率（各向异性）和方向刻画局部畸变。该方法只需编码器输出，无需模型内部信息，并用已知几何的参考对象验证。随后应用于5个编码器家族的13个已发布权重。
AI.result: 畸变随空间变化，并不同程度地继承输入几何：GeoCLIP（Equal Earth输入）继承最强，各向异性相关系数0.88，其余编码器较弱或中等。畸变影响编码器认定的邻居：20个查询点1km内，地理空间与嵌入空间40近邻的中位重叠率仅57.5–87.5%；拟合椭圆在299次比较中有265次选出完全相同的嵌入邻居。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为评估位置编码器提供了地理学基础，椭圆可有效刻画并解释嵌入邻居选择；同时发布eTissot工具包，支持用户自定义编码器。

title: Seeing 3D Occupancy Through Scene-Adaptive Projection
summary: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction infers voxel-wise geometry and semantics from multi-view images, where 2D-to-3D view transformation is a crucial step. Many existing methods adopt a backward-projection paradigm, projecting uniformly distributed 3D reference points onto image planes to aggregate multi-view features. However, their scene-agnostic sampling patterns overlook the non-uniform distribution of scene geometry, allocating many references to empty space and reducing sampling efficiency under a fixed sampling budget. To address this challenge, we propose SAP, a scene-adaptive projection framework that leverages depth-based geometric priors to guide view transformation. Specifically, we back-project metric depth maps predicted by a frozen depth model into 3D space to obtain geometric priors. To leverage these priors, we design a Scene-Adaptive Projection Encoder comprising two complementary components. First, Prior-Guided Reference Generation constructs a hybrid reference set for feature sampling, allocating references within prior-supported height regions and retaining full-range sampling where valid support is unavailable. Furthermore, to account for potential spatial misalignment caused by depth estimation errors, Radial-Structured Feature Aggregation explores multiple candidate locations through learned radial offsets to aggregate potentially displaced feature evidence. Extensive experiments on Occ3D demonstrate that SAP achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently improves results across diverse occupancy frameworks.

AI.tldr: SAP：利用深度几何先验引导2D-to-3D视角变换的场景自适应投影框架，提升3D占用预测的采样效率与精度。
AI.motivation: 现有反向投影方法采用与场景无关的均匀3D参考点采样，忽视场景几何的非均匀分布，将大量参考点分配到空白区域，在固定采样预算下效率低。
AI.method: 将冻结深度模型预测的度量深度图反投影到3D空间获得几何先验，并设计场景自适应投影编码器：①先验引导参考生成，在先验支持的高度区域内分配参考点，无有效支持时保留全范围采样；②径向结构特征聚合，通过学习的径向偏移探索多个候选位置，缓解深度误差导致的空间错位。
AI.result: 在Occ3D上取得SOTA性能，并在多种占用预测框架上均能稳定提升效果。
AI.conclusion: 基于深度先验的场景自适应投影可有效改善参考点分配与特征采样效率，且具良好通用性。

title: GlobalHRBench: Does Changing the Question Language Change the Legal Answer?
summary: Language matters when deploying LLM agents across borders, especially in law, where the governing rules must hold across working languages. Does changing the language of a legal question change answer accuracy? We introduce GlobalHRBench, pairing 240 employment-law problems across eight jurisdictions and eight languages while fixing facts, applicable law and required conclusions. We evaluate nine models on all 1,920 prompts in independent, closed-book, single-answer trials, scoring legal correctness, completeness and answer-language compliance. GPT-6.1 Sol leads at 76.2% strict passes, with a 5.8% relative best-to-worst language decline, compared with 42.2% for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Kimi K3.1 Pro and Claude Sonnet 5.5 reverse order between English and Chinese. A four-model study on 16 paired families compares closed-book answers with governing evidence, added cross-jurisdiction distractors and removal of a governing passage. Governing evidence corrects legal errors and shortens reasoning on recovered answers, yet recognizing an evidence gap does not ensure correct application of the rules that remain. These findings motivate multilingual training for accurate, efficient and evidence-supported answers, and deployment evaluation in the user's working language.

AI.tldr: 提出 GlobalHRBench，用固定事实、适用法律与结论的 240 道劳动法问题（8 法域 × 8 语言，共 1,920 条提示）检验语言切换是否影响法律问答准确性；9 个模型结果显示最高仅 76.2% 严格通过且存在 5.8% 的语言劣化，加入管辖证据可纠错并缩短推理，但察觉证据缺失并不等于能正确适用剩余规则。
AI.motivation: 跨境部署 LLM 智能体时语言差异不可忽视，尤其在法律领域，规则须在多种工作语言下保持一致；而"改变问题语言是否改变答案准确性"此前缺乏控制变量下的系统性证据。
AI.method: 构建 GlobalHRBench：240 道劳动法问题，覆盖 8 个法域与 8 种语言，固定事实、适用法律与应得结论，形成 1,920 条提示；在独立、闭卷、单答案设定下评测 9 个模型，从法律正确性、完整性和答案语言合规性打分；另在 16 组配对题目上对 4 个模型做对照研究，比较闭卷回答与加入管辖证据、加入跨法域干扰项、删除关键管辖条款三种条件。
AI.result: GPT-6.1 Sol 以 76.2% 严格通过率领先，最优与最差语言间相对下降 5.8%；DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 为 42.2%。Kimi K3.1 Pro 与 Claude Sonnet 5.5 在英文与中文之间排名反转。证据对照实验显示：管辖证据能纠正法律错误并在答对的题上缩短推理链，但识别证据缺口并不意味着能正确适用其余规则。
AI.conclusion: 语言切换确实系统性影响法律问答准确性与模型排序；应推进多语言训练以获得准确、高效且有证据支撑的回答，并按用户工作语言开展部署评测。

title: Reward Blindness: A Theoretical Framework for Diagnosing Reinforcement Learning Reward Limitations in Text-to-SQL
summary: Text-to-SQL systems let users without programming expertise query relational databases in natural language. Reinforcement learning has become the dominant way to train such systems, yet progress is still judged by a single number, execution accuracy, which counts correct queries but says nothing about which kinds of semantic error survive training. This paper develops a theoretical framework that examines text-to-SQL from the perspective of reward design. We introduce Reward Error Sensitivity, a measure of how strongly a reward function separates queries that contain a given error type from queries that do not, and prove a Reward Blindness theorem: when this sensitivity is zero, policy-gradient training carries no systematic signal for removing that error. Using fourteen published finegrained error signals for four text-to-SQL systems on the BIRD benchmark, we build error profiles and estimate sensitivities for common reward designs. Predicate and result-level errors are the most frequent, firing on up to 27 percent of queries, while structurally deep errors such as suboptimal joins persist at 5 to 12 percent. Each reward family has a distinct and predictable set of blind spots, and inexpensive database-level checks that need no language model calls detect 45 to 60 percent of semantic errors. Controlled training simulations confirm that executiononly reward leaves output-preserving errors untouched, whereas a signal-grounded reward removes them even when the detectors are noisy.

AI.tldr: 论文从奖励设计视角为Text-to-SQL建立理论框架，提出"奖励错误敏感度"度量与"奖励盲区"定理，并用BIRD基准上14种细粒度错误信号实证表明：仅用执行准确率会掩盖特定语义错误，而数据库级廉价检查可检测45–60%的语义错误。
AI.motivation: 当前Text-to-SQL系统以强化学习训练为主，但仅用单一指标"执行准确率"评估，无法揭示训练后仍残留哪类语义错误，也说不清奖励函数本身是否对某些错误"视而不见"。作者希望解释并量化奖励设计导致的系统性偏差。
AI.method: 提出理论框架：定义Reward Error Sensitivity（奖励函数区分含某类错误与不含该错误查询的强度），并证明Reward Blindness定理（敏感度为零时，策略梯度训练对该类错误无系统性信号）。随后在BIRD基准上，对4个Text-to-SQL系统的14种已发表细粒度错误信号构建错误画像并估计常见奖励设计的敏感度；辅以受控训练仿真验证。
AI.result: 谓词级与结果级错误最频繁，最高出现在27%的查询中；子查询、次优连接等结构性深层错误仍占5–12%。不同奖励族各有可预测的盲区；无需调用语言模型的低成本数据库级检查可检出45–60%的语义错误。仿真显示仅执行奖励无法消除"保持输出不变"的错误，而引入信号驱动奖励后即使检测器有噪声也能消除。
AI.conclusion: 单一执行准确率不足以指导Text-to-SQL训练，奖励设计决定了哪些错误能被正确纠正。作者给出的敏感度工具可帮助诊断奖励盲区，并说明引入廉价数据库级信号作为奖励可有效消除残留语义错误。建议未来报告细粒度错误画像而非仅报一个数字。

title: OAT3D: A Generative Model for 3D Shape- and Resolution-Free Structural Topology Optimization
summary: Topology optimization determines how material should be distributed within a design domain to optimize structural performance under prescribed loads, supports, and constraints. The problems are highly nonconvex, and conventional solvers require repeated finite element analyses, making high-resolution 3D topology optimization computationally expensive. Data-driven approaches face an additional bottleneck: generating training datasets requires solving large numbers of these costly problems, so existing work in data-driven topology optimization primarily focuses on 2D problems. Large-scale 3D datasets remain scarce, and existing models remain limited in problem scale and boundary-condition diversity. Here, we introduce Optimize Any Topology-3D (OAT3D), a generative model for high-resolution 3D structural topology optimization. OAT3D introduces a novel sparse problem encoding to represent load and fixity conditions and combines a sparse volumetric variational autoencoder with a conditional diffusion transformer. We construct a dataset of 501,865 optimized topologies, generated using 51,800 GPU-hours and encompassing structures with up to one million elements and substantially more complex loading and support configurations than any existing structural topology optimization dataset. To our knowledge, this is the largest dataset for 3D topology optimization structures. Trained on this dataset, OAT3D generates structures at 512$^3$ resolution and achieves a $44.9\times$ speedup for raw candidate structure generation or $3.65\times$ speedup to reach similar compliance over conventional topology optimization. These contributions expand the scale and diversity of data-driven topology optimization for three-dimensional structural design.

AI.tldr: OAT3D 是一个面向高分辨率三维结构拓扑优化生成的生成式模型，通过稀疏问题编码、稀疏体素 VAE 与条件扩散 Transformer，并配套构建了约 50 万个样本的超大规模 3D 数据集，可在 512³ 分辨率下生成结构并实现数十倍加速。
AI.motivation: 三维拓扑优化问题高度非凸，传统求解器需反复进行有限元分析，高分辨率 3D 计算代价极高；数据驱动方法又面临训练数据生成的瓶颈（每个样本都需昂贵求解），导致现有工作多局限于 2D，缺乏大规模、边界条件多样的 3D 数据集与模型。
AI.method: 提出 OAT3D 生成模型：引入新的稀疏问题编码表示载荷与固定约束条件，结合稀疏体素变分自编码器与条件扩散 Transformer；并构建包含 501,865 个优化拓扑的数据集（约 51,800 GPU 小时生成，结构最多达百万单元，加载与支撑配置显著更复杂）。
AI.result: 在 512³ 分辨率下生成结构；原始候选结构生成实现 44.9 倍加速，达到相近柔度则相对传统拓扑优化实现 3.65 倍加速；据称是规模最大的 3D 拓扑优化结构数据集。
AI.conclusion: OAT3D 与配套数据集拓展了数据驱动三维结构拓扑优化在规模与多样性上的边界，为高分辨率 3D 结构设计提供了可行的高效生成范式。

title: Self-prediction residuals improve single-pass detection of wrong-object boxes in grounded vision-language models
comment: 35 pages, 5 figures; supplementary material included (65 pages). Code: https://github.com/chen4study-hub/spred
summary: Grounded vision-language models write boxes as text, and the mean probability of their coordinate tokens says little about whether a box is right. We study a single-pass signal for boxes on another object, which matter when only the object counts. A linear map, fitted per model to its own answers without labels, reads a box from the hidden state before writing. Its disagreement with the written box, the self-prediction residual, flags boxes on another object although the read-out is far less accurate; the residual's weight was fixed with labels on two models. On a replication list of 1,200 RefCOCOg test items, the residual, averaged over six models, raises the detection of these errors for each of fifteen single-pass scores, by 0.026 to 0.049 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) on a label-free probe and probes trained on 2,000 labelled items. Over all errors, adding it to the label-free probe moves AUROC, averaged over the models, by less than 0.02 (95% interval). With a fifth of answers reviewed, the share of all errors caught moves from 0.518 to 0.524, that of boxes on another object from 0.505 to 0.607 (post hoc): the residual changes which errors are found, not how many, and in cost-weighted recall it breaks even when such a box costs about 0.86 times another error, and its gain is positive in point estimate at equal costs. These gains come from RefCOCOg lists of MS-COCO images.

AI.tldr: 提出"自预测残差"信号：用无标签拟合的线性映射从隐藏状态读框，与写出的框做不一致性比较，可额外检出"指向另一物体"的框错误。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型以文本形式输出框坐标，坐标token的平均概率难以判断框是否正确，尤其难以识别"框住了另一个物体"这类错误。
AI.method: 对每个模型用自身答案无标签拟合一个线性映射，在写出坐标前从隐藏状态读出框；计算其与写出框的差作为残差。在1,200条RefCOCOg测试项上，用六个模型、十五种单遍分数做复现实验。
AI.result: 残差使各类单遍分数的AUROC在检出"另一物体框"错误上提升0.026–0.049；但对全部错误仅变化<0.02（95%区间）。审查1/5答案时，总错误检出率0.518→0.524，而该子类0.505→0.607（事后分析）。
AI.conclusion: 残差改变的是被发现的错误种类而非数量；在等代价下点估计为正收益，但当该类错误代价约为其他错误0.86倍时才打平。结论仅限MS-COCO图像的RefCOCOg列表。

title: Escriba-OCR: A 1B Vision-Language Model for Error-Preserving Transcription of Handwritten Portuguese Essays
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Model: https://huggingface.co/tardellirs/Escriba-OCR-1B ; code and benchmark: https://github.com/tardellirs/escriba-ocr
summary: Feedback tools and research on learner writing need transcriptions of handwritten essays that keep exactly what the student wrote: misspellings, line breaks, struck-through words and insertions. Vision-language models (VLMs) read handwriting well, but they also tend to rewrite it into correct language. We measure this on BRESSAY, 1,000 handwritten Brazilian Portuguese essays, with a benchmark that adds error preservation, invented errors, edit-markup precision and recall and line structure to the character error rate (CER) and uses paired bootstrap confidence intervals. We restrict the study to open-weight models that schools can run on their own hardware. Of 22 open baselines, the best, Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B, reaches 5.6% CER on the 199 test pages; none reproduces the edit markup reliably, and every VLM replaces 39-78% of the words absent from a Portuguese dictionary with dictionary words. We fine-tune LightOnOCR-3-1B on the 647 training pages in 85 minutes on one GPU. The resulting Escriba-OCR-1B reaches 2.06% CER, 3.5 points below the best baseline (95% CI [-4.2, -2.9]); under the ICDAR 2024 competition metric it reaches 2.1% CER, below the best published page-level results (2.2-2.4%). It recovers 67% of insertions and 77% of illegible deletions, and reproduces the line structure of 97% of the pages, but still normalises 60% of likely misspellings. Three seeds agree within 0.04 CER points, and quantised to 4 bits the model runs on an ordinary CPU at about one minute per page. On 40 letters of another corpus it matches its base model (without that model's appended comments) but misreads unseen words more often; weight interpolation recovers half the gap. A teacher's review finds that 45% of the judgeable apparent corrections are errors in the BRESSAY ground truth, so dictionary-based scores likely understate preservation. We release the model, the benchmark code and the review data.

AI.tldr: 论文提出BRESSAY基准与Escriba-OCR-1B模型，评估VLM对手写作文转写的"错误保留"能力，并微调开源模型显著降低CER、提升编辑标记与行结构还原度。
AI.motivation: 反馈工具与写作研究需要保留学生原样（拼写错误、换行、划掉、插入）的手写转写，但现有VLM倾向于把文本"改写"成规范语言；同时需限定在校园可自托管硬件的开源模型范围内。
AI.method: 构建BRESSAY：1000篇巴西葡语手写作答，在CER之外新增错误保留、虚构错误、编辑标记精确率/召回率与行结构指标，并用配对bootstrap置信区间。评测22个开源基线；在647训练页上对LightOnOCR-3-1B单GPU微调85分钟得到Escriba-OCR-1B，并做4bit量化、跨语料与三seed稳定性测试、教师人工复核。
AI.result: 最佳基线Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B在199测试页上CER 5.6%，但无模型可靠还原编辑标记，且所有VLM把39–78%的词典外词替换为词典词。Escriba-OCR-1B达2.06% CER（比最佳基线低3.5点，95%CI [-4.2,-2.9]），ICDAR 2024指标下2.1% CER，优于已发表页级结果2.2–2.4%；恢复67%插入、77%不可辨删除、97%页面行结构，但仍归一化60%疑似拼写错误。三seed差异≤0.04 CER点，4bit量化在普通CPU约1分钟/页。另一语料40封信上与基模型持平但错读未见词更多，权重插值可弥补一半。教师复核发现45%可判断的"纠正"实为BRESSAY标注错误。
AI.conclusion: 开源可自托管小模型经微调可在保留性转写上超越大模型基线，但拼写错误保留仍是短板；词典类评分会低估保留效果，需更可靠的标注。作者开源模型、基准代码与复核数据。

title: SAEPO: Sparse-Autoencoder-Guided Credit Assignment for Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated strong performance in improving large language model (LLM) reasoning, yet its credit-assignment signal remains coarse. Outcome verifiers provide scalable supervision by judging whether a completed response is correct, but they do not directly indicate which intermediate reasoning tokens contribute to success or failure. As a result, policy optimization can be inefficient, especially when training base models directly from sparse outcome feedback. In this paper, we introduce SAEPO, a Sparse AutoEncoder-guided token-level credit assignment method for outcome-supervised Policy Optimization. Rather than treating correctness only as a rollout-level (sequence-level) signal, SAEPO uses a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to build token-level semantic representations within reasoning trajectories; it scores each token based on the SAE concepts (e.g., penalizing wrong "final-answer" tokens but rewarding correct "reasoning-process" tokens), learned in an unsupervised manner, to achieve fine-grained credit assignment. SAEPO is a plug-in advantage-shaping module compatible with various policy optimization algorithms. We instantiate SAEPO with both GRPO and GSPO, covering token-ratio and sequence-ratio policy-gradient objectives, and evaluate SAEPO across three LLM backbones on six math and two code benchmarks. Empirical results show that SAEPO improves both the math and code benchmark averages over the matched baselines, with gains of up to 6.63% and 5.57%, respectively. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base, training curves also show faster early accuracy growth. Feature and token-level analyses suggest that the SAE-derived signal favors question-relevant concepts and reasoning tokens.

AI.tldr: SAEPO：用预训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）构建 token 级语义表示，为 outcome-supervised 策略优化提供细粒度信用分配。
AI.motivation: RLVR 的结果验证器只给出 rollout 级（序列级）对错信号，无法指示哪些中间推理 token 贡献成败，导致策略优化效率低，尤其从稀疏结果反馈直接训练基座模型时。
AI.method: 用预训练 SAE 在推理轨迹内构建 token 级语义表示，基于无监督学到的 SAE 概念给每个 token 打分（如惩罚错误的"final-answer" token、奖励正确的"reasoning-process" token），实现细粒度信用分配；作为插件式优势塑形模块，兼容多种策略优化算法，文中以 GRPO 与 GSPO 实例化（覆盖 token-ratio 与 sequence-ratio 策略梯度目标）。
AI.result: 在 3 个 LLM 基座、6 个数学与 2 个代码基准上，数学与代码平均分别最高提升 6.63% 与 5.57%；Qwen3-1.7B-Base 上早期准确率增长更快；特征与 token 级分析显示 SAE 信号偏好问题相关概念与推理 token。
AI.conclusion: SAE 衍生的 token 级信号可作为通用优势塑形，弥补结果监督的粗粒度信用分配，提升数学与代码推理的训练效率与效果。

title: Denoised but Not Improved: What EEG Denoising Does to a Downstream Task
comment: Accepted at the IEEE Symposium on CI in Health and Medicine
summary: Scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is routinely denoised before it reaches a downstream model, and the denoising literature scores a method by how closely its output matches a clean reference waveform. That reference does not exist for real scalp recordings: it is synthesized by adding artifact templates to signals merely presumed clean, and even an exact separation would return cortical activity blurred by volume conduction rather than the activity itself. Fidelity to it is therefore an unvalidatable objective, and whether it predicts any downstream benefit has gone largely unexamined. We report an audit that examines it. Holding a seizure-detection pipeline fixed and varying only the preprocessing stage, we find that five standard denoising methods, spanning analytic, cross-channel and supervised deep families, all fail to improve on the unprocessed signal, and most degrade it. To say what such a stage must instead do, we formalize a label-only, classifier-free probe that reads it by the separability geometry it induces on task-relevant features, decomposing any change into a between-class distance and a within-class scatter term. On a transform that does improve the task, the probe attributes the entire gain to a roughly one-quarter reduction of within-class scatter, with class separation statistically unchanged. What a downstream model benefits from is therefore variance suppression on task-relevant structure, which waveform-fidelity metrics neither measure nor reward.

AI.tldr: 论文审计了脑电去噪领域"波形保真度"评价标准的有效性：五种标准去噪方法在固定癫痫检测管线中均未优于不处理信号；作者提出仅用标签、无需分类器的探测方法，发现真正有益的去噪在于压制类内方差，而非提升波形保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG去噪研究以合成"干净参考波形"为评价目标，但真实头皮记录不存在该参考：参考由伪迹模板叠加到"假定干净"的信号上合成，且即使实现完全分离，得到的也只是经体积传导模糊的皮层活动而非真实活动。因此保真度是不可验证的目标，其与下游任务收益的关系也几乎未被检验。
AI.method: 1）审计实验：固定癫痫检测管线，仅更换预处理阶段，测试涵盖解析类、跨通道类与有监督深度类共五种标准去噪方法；2）提出仅依赖标签、无需分类器的探测指标，以任务相关特征上的可分性几何来评估预处理，并将变化分解为类间距离项与类内散度项。
AI.result: 五种标准去噪方法均未能在癫痫检测任务上超过未处理信号，且多数反而使性能下降。对一个确实带来任务提升的变换，探测方法显示全部增益来自类内散度约四分之一（≈25%）的降低，而类间可分性在统计上无显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 下游模型受益的本质是对任务相关结构的方差抑制，而波形保真度指标既不度量也不奖励这一性质。EEG去噪研究应转向以任务相关可分性几何（尤其是类内散度削减）为导向的评价与设计。

title: LoopSeek: Decoupling System One Search from System Two Answering for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long video question answering requires finding relevant evidence before reasoning over it. With a limited frame budget, single-pass frame selection can miss critical evidence, while adaptive search often relies on repeated text generation to decide where to look. We introduce LoopSeek, a framework that decouples evidence search from answer generation through a division of labor between a non-thinking System I and a generative System II. Our key insight is that search can be expressed as a sequence of small, typed decisions, allowing System I to find the evidence that System II needs. Four System I role agents navigate a tree of video windows and coordinate through probability outputs to select frames, assess evidence, and revise the search without generating text. To align search with System II, System I learns from annotated evidence on questions that System II answers correctly only from that evidence, and the verifier's evidence estimates steer the search without calling System II, which stays frozen and answers once from the selected frames. On five long-video benchmarks, with a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B reading 32 frames, LoopSeek improves average accuracy from 53.5 to 63.9 over the uniform baseline and takes 32--80\% less GPU time per question than agentic methods.

AI.tldr: LoopSeek 将长视频问答中的证据搜索与答案生成解耦，用"非思考型 System I"（小型类型化决策、无文本生成）在视频窗口树中导航选帧，再由冻结的"生成型 System II"一次性作答，在五个长视频基准上显著超越均匀采样基线并大幅降低 GPU 开销。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答需先定位相关证据再推理。在有限帧预算下，单次前向的帧选择容易漏掉关键证据；而自适应搜索方法往往依赖反复的文本生成来决定"去哪里看"，带来高计算开销与延迟。作者希望同时解决"选得准"和"算得省"两个矛盾目标。
AI.method: 提出 LoopSeek 框架，通过 System I 与 System II 分工实现搜索与生成的解耦。核心观点是：搜索可表达为一系列小型、类型化的决策，因此可由 System I 完成，为 System II 找出所需证据。具体地，四个 System I 角色智能体在视频窗口树上导航，通过概率输出（而非文本生成）进行协调，完成选帧、证据评估和搜索修正。为使搜索与 System II 对齐，System I 从"仅当给定该证据时 System II 才能正确回答"的问答对上的标注证据中学习；验证器给出的证据估计用于引导搜索，无需调用 System II，System II 保持冻结，仅基于选中的帧回答一次。
AI.result: 在五个长视频基准上，使用冻结的 Qwen3-VL-8B 读取 32 帧，LoopSeek 将平均准确率从均匀采样基线的 53.5 提升到 63.9；相比智能体型（agentic）方法，每问 GPU 时间减少 32%–80%。
AI.conclusion: 将证据搜索重构为轻量、非生成式的类型化决策序列，并让搜索目标与冻结的答案生成器对齐，可在有限帧预算下同时提升长视频问答准确率并显著降低计算成本，为高效的"搜索-推理"分工范式提供了可行方案。

title: Training-Free Interventions for Hallucination in Large Language Models
summary: A frozen language model can give a wrong answer because a fact is unavailable, a reliable passage is ignored, or an unsupported claim survives generation. We review 116 works on inference-time hallucination intervention and its foundations. We trace the development from retrieval and controllable generation to methods that act on input evidence, token scores, internal representations, completed claims, or the decision to answer. For each family we compare its source of evidence, model access, preparation cost, and the task on which a correction can be established. For activation steering, we distinguish estimating a subspace from applying a state-dependent edit and separate interventions on the prompt from those on the generated prefix. Published comparisons show why faithfulness to a source, factual correctness, informativeness, and answer coverage must be measured separately. Applications in time-sensitive question answering, document synthesis, and visual grounding identify when source authority, evidence availability, or capability preservation limits a reported gain.

AI.tldr: 一篇综述，回顾116项关于推理时幻觉干预的工作，按证据来源将干预方法分为作用于输入证据、token分数、内部表示、已完成断言与是否作答决策五大类，并给出跨家族的比较维度与评测、应用层面的洞见。
AI.motivation: 冻结的语言模型会因事实缺失、忽略可靠段落或生成中保留无支撑断言而给出错误答案；现有干预方法分散在不同家族，缺少统一视角来比较其证据来源、模型访问、准备成本与可验证的修正任务，也缺少对忠实性、事实正确性、信息量与答案覆盖率需分开测量的说明。
AI.method: 对116项推理时幻觉干预及其基础工作进行综述；梳理从检索与可控生成到作用于输入证据、token分数、内部表示、已完成断言、是否作答决策的方法演进；对每个家族比较证据来源、模型访问权限、准备成本与可确立修正的任务；对激活引导区分"估计子空间"与"施加状态相关编辑"，并区分作用于提示的干预与作用于已生成前缀的干预。
AI.result: 作者指出，已发表的对比表明忠实于来源、事实正确性、信息量与答案覆盖率必须分别测量；在时效性问答、文档合成与视觉定位等应用中，来源权威性、证据可得性或能力保持会限制所报告的增益。
AI.conclusion: 推理时幻觉干预可沿证据来源与干预作用点形成统一的分类与比较框架；评估应多维分开测量，且应用增益受来源权威性、证据可得性与能力保持的约束。

title: When Learned IDS Model Selection Collapses to a Static Choice: A Measurement Study at the Edge
summary: Runtime model selection trades detection quality against energy and latency. However, comparing a selector only with a more costly static detector conflates detector choice with the benefit of adaptation. We present a framework for analysis and physical measurement that combines a pairwise reward criterion, matched static controls, paired blocks, a fixed load-prevalence factorial design, and reporting of actions outside training support. On one Raspberry Pi 4B with four frozen TON-IoT detectors, tabular Q-learning and a deep Q-network (DQN) both select LightLR throughout. A retrospective audit using validation data only rules out preference reversals for MedRF versus LightLR and HeavyMLP versus LightLR. However, TinyDT has a higher reward than LightLR in seven of the 2,500 windows, so the audit does not establish global LightLR optimality. We also evaluate a causal DeadlineGuard rule under a fixed factorial design with three arrival rates (50, 100, and 4,000 rows/s) and three attack prevalences (0.10, 0.50, and 0.90). Compared with Static-MedRF, DeadlineGuard saves 43.7 J per 500-s run (2.98%; 95% paired CI 41.4--46.0 J) and eliminates all 512 deadline misses among 5,000 windows, at a cost of 1.373 percentage points in F1. Outside training support, Tabular-Q's deterministic tie-breaking rule selects TinyDT, resulting in a false-positive rate of 67.76%. These single-board results motivate joint audits of reward attainability, realized actions, attribution against matched static controls, service feasibility, and default actions outside training support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套运行时检测器选择的分析与物理测量框架（成对奖励准则、匹配静态对照、配对区组、固定负载-流行度析因设计、训练支撑外动作报告），在树莓派4B上对四个冻结TON-IoT检测器进行实测审计。
AI.motivation: 运行时模型选择在检测质量与能耗/延迟之间存在权衡，但以往只将选择器与更昂贵的静态检测器比较，混淆了“检测器选择”与“自适应收益”两个因素，因此需要更严谨的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建包含成对奖励准则、匹配静态对照、配对区组、固定负载-流行度析因设计（3种到达率50/100/4000行每秒 × 3种攻击流行度0.10/0.50/0.90）以及训练支撑外动作报告的分析与物理测量框架；实测表格型Q学习、DQN与因果DeadlineGuard规则。
AI.result: 表格Q与DQN始终选择LightLR；仅用验证数据的回溯审计排除了MedRF/HeavyMLP相对LightLR的偏好反转，但TinyDT在2500个窗口中有7个奖励更高，故无法确立LightLR全局最优。相比Static-MedRF，DeadlineGuard每次500秒运行节能43.7 J（2.98%，95%配对CI 41.4–46.0 J），消除5000个窗口中全部512次截止期违约，代价为F1下降1.373个百分点；训练支撑外，表格Q的确定性打破平局规则选择TinyDT，假阳性率达67.76%。
AI.conclusion: 单板结果说明应联合审计奖励可达性、实际执行动作、相对匹配静态对照的归因、服务可行性与训练支撑外的默认动作。

title: Look Back: Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual World Models
summary: Agents in complex, stochastic environments must contend with dynamics that can exceed their world models' predictive capacity and randomness that obscure the consequences of their actions. We hypothesize that, compared to imagining entirely new trajectories in such complex environments, it can be easier to transform observed trajectories with alternative actions. Counterfactual world models condition on observations to predict alternative outcomes under the same underlying environmental randomness, using experience as a reference for predicting action-dependent changes. We present a policy gradient estimator, REINFORCE Look Back (RLB), that uses counterfactual returns as baselines to distinguish action effects from environmental luck, and prove conditions for unbiasedness and variance reduction. In settings where environmental evolution is harder to predict than action-induced changes, we show that counterfactual world models are easier to learn and support better policy learning than ordinary world models. Our findings suggest that counterfactual thinking can help agents learn effective behavior without independently reproducing the full complexity of their worlds.

AI.tldr: 提出反事实世界模型与RLB策略梯度估计器，用反事实回报作基线，将动作效应与环境运气分离。
AI.motivation: 复杂随机环境中，世界模型难以预测环境动态，随机性又掩盖了动作后果；作者假设：与其凭空想象全新轨迹，不如在已观察轨迹上替换动作进行变换，难度更低。
AI.method: 反事实世界模型以观测为条件，在同一环境随机性下预测替代动作的结果，把经验作为预测动作相关变化的参照；据此提出REINFORCE Look Back（RLB），以反事实回报为基线区分动作效应与环境运气，并证明无偏性与方差缩减条件；在环境演化比动作影响更难预测的设定下比较两类模型的可学习性与策略学习效果。
AI.result: 在环境演化难以预测的设定中，反事实世界模型更易学习，且比普通世界模型更好地支持策略学习。
AI.conclusion: 反事实思维可帮助智能体学习有效行为，而无需独立复现世界的全部复杂性。

title: The Answer Is Not the State: Trajectory-Level Corrigibility in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models generate tokens at many positions on a shared canvas, making unfinished responses appear revisable. We find a counterexample: after the final answer is reopened, previously generated rationale can reconstruct the old decision despite newly available evidence. We isolate this effect by comparing reopening the answer alone with reopening both rationale and answer, and by exchanging rationales between paired trajectories. On a 150-question source-disjoint benchmark, reopening both regions makes decisions follow the evidence currently present--whether correct or deliberately corrupted--across Dream, LLaDA, and iLLaDA. On a new 100-question free-form short-answer evaluation, the same effect remains strong in LLaDA and iLLaDA but is negligible in Dream. Coherent transplanted rationales steer rebuilt decisions, while token-level attribution improves which positions to reopen without producing a compact repair. Corrigibility therefore depends on retained rationale state, not answer openness alone.

AI.tldr: 扩散语言模型的"答案可重审"不等于可纠正；旧有推理状态会重建原决策，除非将推理与答案一并重新开放。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在共享画布上并行生成多位置token，表面上未完成回复似乎天然可修改。作者要检验这种"可修正性"是否真实，即新的证据出现后，模型能否放弃旧决策。
AI.method: 对比"仅重开答案"与"同时重开推理和答案"两种设置，并在配对轨迹间交换推理文本；在150题源不相交基准与100题自由式短答基准上，测试Dream、LLaDA、iLLaDA三个模型。
AI.result: 同时重开推理与答案时，决策会跟随当前证据（无论正确或被故意污染）；该效应在LLaDA与iLLaDA上很强，Dream上可忽略。移植连贯推理可引导重建决策；token级归因能定位应重开的位置，但未形成紧凑修复。
AI.conclusion: 可纠正性取决于被保留的推理状态，而非答案是否开放；仅重开答案不足以实现真正的修正。

title: CARE-3D: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence Grounded Agentic Reasoning in Situated 3D Scenes
summary: Situated 3D reasoning requires embodied agents to interpret objects, scene geometry, and viewpoint dependent spatial relations. Existing methods learn grounded interactions from supervised traces, but largely imitate prescribed evidence acquisition patterns rather than optimizing the support that the returned evidence provides for the correct answer. Moreover, outcome rewards provide limited credit for intermediate tool choices and may leave infrequent tools underexplored. An effective agent should instead adaptively decide what to ground, which tool to invoke, and how to assess the utility of returned evidence. To this end, this paper presents CARE-3D, a reinforcement post-training framework for adaptive grounded reasoning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on grounding instructions first establishes valid interactions, after which Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) optimizes the agent while keeping the 3D grounding module frozen. CARE-3D combines Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence for evidence sensitive credit assignment, and Group Coverage Sampling to preserve tool coverage. Experiments on MSQA and Beacon3D show consistent gains over SFT and GRPO using only answer and format rewards, especially in spatial reasoning and grounding answer coherence. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/xiaoqian-UQ/CARE-3D}{CARE-3D}.

AI.tldr: CARE-3D：用强化后训练提升具身3D场景中的自适应grounded推理，通过反事实证据信用分配和组覆盖率采样优化证据获取策略。
AI.motivation: 现有方法只用监督轨迹模仿固定的证据获取模式，未优化"返回证据对正确答案的支持度"；且纯结果奖励对中间工具选择的信用分配不足，罕见工具探索不足。
AI.method: 先SFT建立合法交互，再用GRPO（3D grounding模块冻结）强化；引入反事实归因（Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence）做证据敏感的信用分配，并用组覆盖率采样（Group Coverage Sampling）保持工具覆盖。
AI.result: 在MSQA与Beacon3D上相较SFT和仅用答案+格式奖励的GRPO稳定提升，尤在空间推理与grounding答案一致性上。
AI.conclusion: 显式优化证据效用与工具探索的强化后训练能有效改善具身3D grounded推理，代码已开源。

title: On the Interplay between Backtracking and Latent Confidence Directions in Reasoning Models
summary: Reasoning models deliberate over multiple answer proposals, often resulting in excessively long traces due to backtracking, even when the correct answer has already been reached (Across three 32B models, ~87% of rollouts contain 1 unique answer yet still make ~8 answer proposals on average). Given this potentially "decorative" chain of thought (CoT) reasoning, can we look to the model internals to determine if the model will backtrack or commit to an answer proposal?
