Comprehensive experiments reveal that: (1) unique training dynamics of vector quantization in DNA space, including the importance of alignment between training corpus and downstream data. (2) superior performance of BQVAE over hand-crafted tokenizers and vanilla VQVAE. (3) remarkable cross-species generalization capability of BQDNA, which achieves state-of-the-art performance with merely 0.1B multi-species training for BQVAE and 1 epoch training on hg38 for BQDNA, outperforming gLMs pretrained with 10$\sim$100x more tokens. Our findings underscore the potential of learned vector quantization for genomic sequence representation. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/BQDNA

AI.tldr: 提出context-aware BQVAE与BQDNA，用学习的向量量化替代手工DNA分词器，实现跨物种泛化的基因组语言模型。
AI.motivation: 长重复DNA序列的生物学信息解码困难；gLM沿用传统预训练-微调范式，但DNA缺乏内在语义分段与先验规则，k-mer、BPE等手工分词器并非最优。
AI.method: 提出上下文感知的BQVAE对DNA进行标量量化（支持多头码本），并基于其构建自回归基因组语言模型BQDNA。
AI.result: 揭示DNA空间向量量化的独特训练动态（训练语料与下游数据的对齐很重要）；BQVAE优于手工分词器与vanilla VQVAE；BQDNA具显著跨物种泛化能力，仅0.1B多物种数据训练BQVAE、hg38上1个epoch训练BQDNA即达SOTA，超过预训练token多10~100倍的gLM。
AI.conclusion: 学习式向量量化对基因组序列表示具有潜力，可显著提升gLM的效果与效率。

title: CHORD: Closed-loop Human-Object Rectified-flow Decomposition
summary: Text-driven 3D human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing whole-body human and object motions that stay coupled through contact. Yet existing generators either entangle the core variables that govern an interaction (object pose, contacting regions, and limb posture) with dozens of subordinate joints, or plan only end-effectors or coarse trajectories. No stage of generation holds the interaction in a form that is both settled and observed, which leaves contact to external guidance, post-hoc refiners, or internal guidance without a surface measurement. We present CHORD, a two-stage rectified-flow framework that settles the interaction in a compact plan and observes that plan against the object surface while it is being generated. First, Draft uses twelve part tokens per temporal patch to jointly plan the 6-DoF object trajectory, contact states, and the end and middle joints of every kinematic chain. At each flow step, Draft decodes the expected interaction from the closed-form clean estimate, measures it against the object surface, and routes this feedback to the responsible part token with zero extra network evaluations. Second, Full keeps this plan unchanged and infills the remaining body and finger joints. On InterAct, CHORD reduces FID by 33% and lifts hand contact F1 from 0.730 to 0.834, while its feedback improves contact on unseen objects and transfers plug-and-play to existing HOI generators.

AI.tldr: CHORD是一个两阶段rectified-flow框架，用紧凑的"十二部件token"计划交互（物体6-DoF轨迹、接触状态、各运动链的末端与中间关节），并在生成过程中把该计划与物体表面做度量与反馈，随后第二阶段补全剩余身体与手指关节。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动3D人-物交互生成要么把物体姿态、接触区域、肢体姿态等核心变量与大量从属关节纠缠在一起，要么只规划末端执行器或粗粒度轨迹；生成过程中缺少一个既已确定又可被观测的交互表示，导致接触只能依赖外部引导、事后精修或无表面测量的内部引导。
AI.method: 两阶段rectified flow。第一阶段Draft：每个时间patch用12个部件token联合规划6-DoF物体轨迹、接触状态及每条运动链的末端与中间关节；每个flow step从闭式clean估计解码期望交互，与物体表面做度量，并将反馈零额外网络评估地路由到对应部件token。第二阶段Full：保持该计划不变，补全其余身体与手指关节。
AI.result: 在InterAct上FID降低33%，手部接触F1从0.730提升到0.834；表面反馈还能改善未见物体上的接触，并可即插即用地迁移到现有HOI生成器。
AI.conclusion: 将交互"落定"为紧凑可观测的计划、并在生成过程中直接以物体表面度量并路由反馈，是提升文本驱动全身HOI生成接触质量的有效途径，且该反馈机制具有通用性与可迁移性。

title: PCC: Pivotal Channel Compensation for Layer Pruning of Large Language Models
summary: Treating independent layers as the minimal pruning unit allows layer pruning to efficiently eliminate many redundant parameters and achieve high compression rates. Layer pruning has become a promising and prevalent structured pruning technique for large language models (LLMs). However, multi-layer removal can lead to significant performance degradation for LLMs. Although some works have explored various compensation methods for pruned layers, they are inefficient and costly. Observing that the expression of a large proportion of information is concentrated on a small number of pivotal channels, we propose a novel post-pruning compensation method for layer pruning, called pivotal channel compensation (PCC). PCC can achieve significant performance improvement by compensating for a small number of channels through learnable linear transformations at the pruning interface. Besides, we propose a new evaluation metric, called channel-wise average performance improvement (CAPI), which can measure the efficiency of channel-wise compensation. Our experimental results across various LLMs demonstrate that PCC can achieve significant and consistent improvements and high CAPI on language modeling and zero-shot question answering for the state-of-the-art cross-layer and consecutive-layer pruning methods. Compared with existing compensation methods, PCC can achieve competitive results with fewer additional parameters and less training cost.

AI.tldr: 提出关键通道补偿(PCC)：在层剪枝接口处用少量可学习线性变换补偿少量关键通道，实现高效后剪枝恢复，并提出通道级平均性能提升指标CAPI。
AI.motivation: 层剪枝能高效去除冗余参数、实现高压缩率，但多层删除会导致LLM性能显著下降；已有补偿方法效率低、成本高。观察到大量信息集中在少数关键通道上。
AI.method: PCC在剪枝接口处仅对少量关键通道施加可学习线性变换进行后剪枝补偿，额外参数和训练开销小；同时提出CAPI指标衡量通道级补偿效率。
AI.result: 在多种LLM上，对SOTA的跨层与连续层剪枝方法，PCC在语言建模和零样本问答任务上取得显著且一致的提升与高CAPI；相较现有补偿方法，以更少参数和更低训练成本获得有竞争力结果。
AI.conclusion: 聚焦关键通道的轻量补偿是层剪枝后恢复的有效且高效方案，CAPI可作为补偿效率的评估指标。

title: Small data machine learning: the trilemma of low-sample tabular regimes
summary: Small tabular datasets leave few observations for choosing a model and assessing its predictions. We examine these competing demands in controlled simulations and on six public datasets, using SmallGBM and SmallMLP as fixed-configuration case studies. Three results illustrate why the choice of evaluation matters. First, at n = 100, five-fold cross-validation overstated the gain from tuning XGBoost by 0.063 ROC-AUC on random labels, while tuning improved independent-test ROC-AUC by 0.0078 on a Gaussian mixture. Second, when 20% of binary training labels were flipped, the median within-trial ROC-AUC loss was 0.0210 for SmallGBM and 0.0778 for a fixed 200-tree XGBoost configuration. A separate regression experiment showed the sensitivity of squared-error training to heavy-tailed responses. Third, in a heteroscedastic regression experiment, locally weighted SmallMLP intervals covered about one percentage point more test responses than ordinary split conformal intervals at both tested dimensions. Their mean widths also increased. On a Gaussian classification task with linear log odds, logistic regression achieved the highest mean ROC-AUC at all seven training sizes. These experiments identify settings in which a small-data model helps and quantify the cost of its assumptions.

AI.tldr: 论文通过受控模拟与6个公开数据集，研究小表格数据在"选模型"与"评估预测"之间的冲突，以固定配置的SmallGBM与SmallMLP为例，说明评估方式的选择会显著影响结论。
AI.motivation: 小表格数据观测极少，既要用于选择模型又要用于评估其预测，二者的资源竞争使评估设计变得关键；现有做法（如CV调参、默认GBM、标准split conformal）在小样本下的代价缺乏量化。
AI.method: 进行受控模拟与6个公开数据集实验；采用SmallGBM和SmallMLP作为固定配置案例，对比XGBoost调参、随机标签、标签翻转、重尾回归、异方差回归及高斯分类等场景，考察CV与独立测试、稳健性与保形区间表现。
AI.result: n=100时5折CV在随机标签上高估XGBoost调参增益0.063 ROC-AUC，而高斯混合上独立测试仅提升0.0078；20%二分类标签翻转时，SmallGBM的折内ROC-AUC损失中位数0.0210，固定200树XGBoost为0.0778；异方差回归中局部加权SmallMLP区间覆盖率比普通split conformal高约1个百分点但宽度增大；线性对数几率高斯分类中逻辑回归在全部7个训练规模下平均ROC-AUC最高。
AI.conclusion: 实验明确了小数据模型在哪些情形下有效，并量化了其假设带来的代价；评估方式本身会实质性改变模型选择的结论。

title: HKD-ACPA: Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation Adversarial Cyber-Physical Attacks in Power Grids
summary: Learning-based algorithms assist power-grid control centers in localizing transmission-line attacks, yet existing adversarial attacks typically require white-box access or repeated online queries. We study a practical zero-query setting in which an adversary coordinates physical, denial-of-service (DoS), and false data injection (FDI) attacks using only local measurements and historical detector outputs. To bridge the input-view asymmetry between local adversarial observations and DoS-masked control-center measurements, we propose Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation Adversarial Cyber-Physical Attacks (HKD-ACPA). HKD-ACPA distills historical detector predictions into a heterogeneous graph surrogate ensemble and trains a residual calibration module to correct the view-induced logit discrepancy. Over this calibrated surrogate, we formulate sparse, magnitude-bounded FDI synthesis with a group-balanced objective that jointly induces missed detections and false alarms, and solve the resulting hybrid discrete--continuous problem via bi-level projected gradient-based proximal policy optimization (PGPPO). Experiments on the IEEE 30-bus and 118-bus systems show that HKD-ACPA outperforms all surrogate-based baselines across every sparsity budget and surpasses online-query attacks in eight of ten system--budget settings without querying the detector model.

AI.tldr: HKD-ACPA提出零查询的对抗性网络物理攻击框架，仅用本地测量和历史检测器输出即可协同物理、DoS与FDI攻击定位电网输电线路并规避检测。
AI.motivation: 现有针对输电线路攻击定位的学习型算法的对抗攻击需要白盒访问或反复在线查询，实际不可行；本文研究仅依赖本地测量与历史检测器输出的实用零查询攻击设定。
AI.method: 提出异构知识蒸馏对抗网络物理攻击（HKD-ACPA）：将历史检测器预测蒸馏为异构图代理集成，并训练残差校准模块修正视图差异导致的logit偏差；在校准代理上构建稀疏、幅值受限的FDI合成，采用组平衡目标同时诱发漏检与误报，并用双层投影梯度近端策略优化（PGPPO）求解混合离散-连续问题。
AI.result: 在IEEE 30节点和118节点系统上，HKD-ACPA在所有稀疏预算下优于所有基于代理的基线，并在十个系统-预算设定中的八个上超过在线查询攻击，且无需查询检测器模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了零查询条件下通过知识蒸馏与校准代理可实现强有效的物理-网络协同对抗攻击，具备实用性与优越性。

title: Rethinking Visual Token Retention in Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Autoregressive Large Vision-Language Models solve multimodal reasoning tasks by retaining hundreds or thousands of visual tokens, allowing every generated token to attend to the visual tokens at any time during the generation process. However, whether continuous access to these visual tokens is necessary remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate how visual token influence evolves along two dimensions: generation time and transformer depth. Using long-form visual reasoning benchmarks and multiple model scales, we first analyze the attention dynamics across generation time and transformer depth. We identify a temporal and depth-wise structure in the use of visual information. Visual attention peaks during the initial generation steps and then rapidly declines as attention shifts toward previously generated reasoning tokens. Across depth, visual influence is concentrated in intermediate layers and becomes very weak in the final layers. We further verify these observations with causal intervention that removes all visual tokens across generation time and model depth. These interventions confirm that visual-token dependence in multimodal reasoning is neither temporally persistent nor uniformly distributed across transformer depth. Thus, retaining the complete visual context at every layer and decoding step may be unnecessary. Our experiments demonstrate that we can remove up to 59\% of tokens from the full input prompt across generation time and 11\% across all transformer layers, while incurring only a very small performance drop. On video benchmarks, up to 65\% of the input prompt tokens can be removed during generation without affecting performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自回归大型视觉语言模型中视觉token的影响如何随生成时间和Transformer深度演变，发现视觉依赖既非持续也非均匀分布，并进行因果干预与剪枝实验，证明可在大幅移除视觉token的同时保持性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM在生成每个token时会持续关注数百至数千个视觉token，但这种持续访问视觉token是否必要尚不清楚，作者希望理解视觉token影响力的时间与深度动态。
AI.method: 在长文本视觉推理基准和多种模型规模上分析注意力随生成步骤和Transformer深度的动态；并通过因果干预，在不同生成时刻和不同层移除全部视觉token以验证观察结果；进一步做跨生成时间和跨全层的token剪枝实验，含视频基准实验。
AI.result: 视觉注意力在生成初期达到峰值后迅速下降并转向已生成的推理token；视觉影响集中在中间层，在最终层很弱。因果干预确认视觉token依赖既非时间持续也非层间均匀。可移除完整输入提示中最多59%的token（跨生成时间）和11%（跨所有层）而仅有极小性能下降；视频基准上生成过程中可移除最多65%的输入提示token而不影响性能。
AI.conclusion: 在每个层和每个解码步骤保留完整视觉上下文可能是多余的，视觉token可按生成时间和深度进行有原则的剪枝以提升效率。

title: Laya-IsoToken: Day-One Clinical Codebook Switching via Closed-Form Operator Compilation
comment: 21 pages, 6 main figures, 4 main tables, 1 algorithm, 2 supplementary figures, 6 supplementary tables. Code available at https://github.com/ZeqiangWangAI/Laya-IsoToken
summary: Healthcare systems periodically revise diagnostic and procedural classifications (ICD-9 to ICD-10/11), update hospital reimbursement groupers (MS-DRG), and deploy clinical coding across languages. Supervised coding networks bind clinical text encoders to fixed per-code classifier weights, forcing hospitals to re-annotate tens of thousands of records before switching codebooks, whereas standalone large language models incur high latency and hallucinate invalid codes. Here we show that day-one clinical codebook switching becomes feasible without target-labeled notes when local clinical evidence reading is decoupled from a strictly frozen multilingual concept space. Laya-IsoToken trains a clinical span reader once on source records with zero per-code classifier parameters, separating text evidence from historical disease prevalence. Given only public target code descriptions, closed-form matrix compilation aligns distributional shifts, compensates for paraphrased definitions, and deduplicates sibling codes in under three seconds, while a pre-deployment geometric residual routes unfamiliar concepts to offline language model verification. Across 32,804 MIMIC-IV ICD-9 discharges, Laya-IsoToken matches published supervised baselines (62.6% Micro-F1) while reducing active calibration error by 32%. Switched with zero target training notes to 13,783 unseen-patient ICD-10 discharges, MS-DRG groups, and multilingual cohorts, it outperforms biomedical dense retrievers, semantic crosswalks (+5.4 F1 points on ICD-10, paired $d_z = 0.49$, $p < 0.001$), and official US CMS equivalence mappings (+3.5 points, $p < 0.001$) at 9.4 ms per admission. Pairing this reader with an offline 31B verifier across 1,000 full discharge summaries lifts zero-training ICD-10 coding to 40.6% Micro-F1 (57.0% category F1, $d_z = 0.66$, $p < 0.001$) with 0.0% invalid code hallucinations.

AI.tldr: Laya-IsoToken 将临床证据阅读与冻结的多语言概念空间解耦，在没有目标标注病历的情况下实现"零训练"的临床编码版本切换（ICD-9→ICD-10、MS-DRG、多语言）。
AI.motivation: 医疗系统需定期更换编码体系（ICD-9 到 ICD-10/11、MS-DRG grouper 更新、跨语言编码），但现有监督编码网络将文本编码器绑定到固定的每码分类权重，换码表前必须重标注数万份病历；单用大语言模型则延迟高且会幻觉出无效代码。
AI.method: 训练一个不含任何逐码分类器参数的临床片段读取器（clinical span reader），仅在源域病历上训练一次，将文本证据与历史疾病流行率解耦；仅凭公开的目标码描述，通过闭式矩阵编译（closed-form matrix compilation）在3秒内对齐分布偏移、补偿释义差异并去重近义码；部署前用几何残差把不熟悉概念路由到离线 LLM 校验；高精度场景可再配一个离线 31B 验证器。
AI.result: 在 MIMIC-IV 32,804 例 ICD-9 出院记录上达到 62.6% Micro-F1，媲美已发表监督基线，并降低主动校准误差 32%；零目标标注切换到 13,783 例未见患者 ICD-10、MS-DRG 分组及多语言队列，优于生物医学稠密检索器、语义 crosswalk（ICD-10 上 +5.4 F1，d_z=0.49，p<0.001）和 CMS 官方等价映射（+3.5 点，p<0.001），每例仅 9.4 ms；配合 31B 验证器在 1,000 份完整出院小结上零训练 ICD-10 编码达 40.6% Micro-F1（类别 F1 57.0%，d_z=0.66，p<0.001），无效码幻觉率 0.0%。
AI.conclusion: 无需目标标注即可实现首日码表切换：解耦的片段读取器加冻结多语言概念空间与闭式编译，兼顾低延迟、高精度与零无效码幻觉，可作为临床编码基础设施的实用替代方案。

title: Could This BE Any More Wrong? Teaching VLMs to Know What They Don't Know in Document Extraction
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at the AI4Finance Summit at ICAIF '26 (7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance), Milan, Italy. An extended version with a revised experimental protocol will follow
summary: Vision-Language Models can extract structured fields from scanned financial documents, yet they provide no indication of when a field might be wrong. We derive per-field confidence estimates from the token log-probabilities the model already produces, via a token-to-span alignment procedure that maps logprobs onto each extracted value within the structured JSON output. Evaluated on two benchmarks (CORD v2 receipts, Kleister NDA legal contracts) with three VLM families, the minimum token probability per field achieves Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC) 0.74-0.91 for error detection, far exceeding verbalized confidence (0.53-0.56). The uncertain fields form a natural training curriculum: fine-tuning via Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) improves accuracy from 78.5% to 87.5% on CORD (67 examples) and from 70.7% to 75.1% on multi-page NDA contracts (259 examples), while substantially improving error detection on Kleister NDA (AUROC 0.70 to 0.85, Area Under the Accuracy-Rejection Curve (AUARC) 0.78 to 0.92). The loop requires no annotation beyond the training-split ground truth, demonstrating that confidence-guided curriculum selection transfers to complex multi-page documents when combined with native multi-image training. A frontier model (Claude Sonnet 4) used as a pseudo-label judge achieves ~92% reward agreement with ground truth on both benchmarks, suggesting this loop can operate without human annotation.

AI.tldr: 从VLM已有的token log-prob中提取逐字段置信度，用于错误检测，并将高不确定字段作为GRPO微调的课程，提升准确率与可靠性。
AI.motivation: VLM能从扫描金融文档中抽取结构化字段，却不告知字段何时可能出错，缺乏可靠性信号。
AI.method: 提出token-to-span对齐流程，把logprobs映射到JSON输出中每个抽取值；用字段内最小token概率作置信度；以不确定字段构成课程，用GRPO微调并配合原生多图训练；另用前沿模型（Claude Sonnet 4）作伪标签裁判。
AI.result: CORD v2与Kleister NDA两基准、三种VLM家族上，最小token概率AUROC 0.74–0.91，远超言语化置信度0.53–0.56；GRPO微调使CORD准确率78.5%→87.5%、多页NDA 70.7%→75.1%，Kleister NDA错误检测AUROC 0.70→0.85、AUARC 0.78→0.92；裁判与真值奖励一致率约92%。
AI.conclusion: 置信度引导的课程选择结合原生多图训练可迁移到复杂多页文档；整个闭环仅需训练集真值标注，且前沿模型裁判暗示可无需人工标注运行。

title: Optimal Bandits with Switching Costs: $(T/\log(T))^{2/3}$ Regret

AI.tldr: 研究带切换代价的对抗性多臂老虎机，证明极小极大遗憾为 Θ(min{T, K^{1/3}T^{2/3}/log^{2/3}(2+T/K)})，表明简单分块策略次优。
AI.motivation: 带切换代价的对抗性bandit中，已有简单分块策略（每块内固定玩一个臂）被认为自然，但其是否最优、真实极小极大遗憾的量级尚不清楚，论文旨在给出精确的遗憾刻画并改进算法。
AI.method: 算法在每个块内于随机时刻进行常数次切换，"绕行"(detour)机制临时采样新臂，观测损失越大越易触发绕行；关键在于给切换时刻附近的观测更大权重以从每次切换中提取更多信息，绕行抵消分块带来的时间相关性；下界由改进的多尺度随机游走构造的精化分析得到。
AI.result: 证明了 K 个臂、T 轮、单位切换代价、 oblivious 损失情形下极小极大遗憾为 Θ(min{T, K^{1/3}T^{2/3}/log^{2/3}(2+T/K)})，并给出匹配的下界。
AI.conclusion: 简单分块策略次优；通过在块内随机切换、加权切换时刻附近的观测并引入detour机制，可达到精确最优的遗憾量级，且与改进下界匹配。

title: CoopOcc: Cooperative 3D Semantic Occupancy Perception via Multi-Agent and Cross-Modal Fusion
summary: Semantic occupancy perception has emerged as a promising paradigm for jointly modeling 3D scene geometry and semantic information. However, this unified representation cannot compensate for missing information caused by occlusion and sensor coverage. Multi-agent cooperation alleviates this limitation, but information from different agents is not equally useful across spatial regions. Meanwhile, feature representations from each agent form the basis of reliable multi-agent fusion. Cross?modal fusion constructs such representations by integrating complementary semantic and geometric information. Despite this complementarity, jointly establishing reliable 3D correspondence across agents and preserving modality-specific structures remains challenging. To address these limitations, we propose CoopOcc, which performs cooperative 3D semantic occupancy perception through multi-agent and cross-modal fusion. CoopOcc uses ego?query cross-agent attention (EQCA) to selectively aggregate aligned features across agents, and anchor-based bidirectional feature interaction (ABFI) for cross-modal exchange at matched coordinates. We further construct SemanticVVSim, a simulation dataset, and establish a unified benchmark. For simulation-to-real transfer, we propose confidence-aware hierarchical occupancy and relational distillation (CHORD). CoopOcc performs best overall among ten evaluated methods on SemanticVVSim. On Occ3D-nuScenes, CHORD improves performance using knowledge from SemanticVVSim. The code is available at https://github.com/LOTEAT/CoopOcc.

AI.tldr: CoopOcc通过多智能体与跨模态融合实现协同3D语义占据感知，并提出语义VVSim仿真数据集与CHORD蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 语义占据感知统一建模几何与语义，但单智能体受遮挡与传感器覆盖限制而缺失信息；多智能体协作虽可缓解，却存在各空间区域信息价值不均、特征表示可靠性不足和跨模态3D对应困难等问题。
AI.method: 提出CoopOcc：(1) 自我查询跨智能体注意力(EQCA)选择性聚合对齐的跨智能体特征；(2) 基于锚点的双向特征交互(ABFI)在匹配坐标处进行跨模态交换；(3) 构建SemanticVVSim仿真数据集及统一基准；(4) 提出置信度感知的层次占据与关系蒸馏(CHORD)用于仿真到真实迁移。
AI.result: 在SemanticVVSim上，CoopOcc在10种评估方法中综合表现最佳；在Occ3D-nuScenes上，CHORD利用SemanticVVSim知识提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协作与跨模态融合可有效提升3D语义占据感知，结合仿真数据蒸馏可进一步增强真实场景泛化能力。

title: When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs
summary: Rendering long text as images lets a vision-language model (VLM) read a document with fewer input tokens, and evaluations often count mainly these prefill tokens. We show that for reasoning models this accounting is incomplete. Across five models and two long-context benchmarks, reading the rendered document makes the model think longer: decode length grows by 1.5-3.5x on the four general-purpose VLMs tested, and under typical output pricing this decode tax makes image input more expensive than text for two of the five models on QuALITY. Unrecoverable information loss is not sufficient to explain the tax at moderate compression: Qwen's OCR of the same images recovers 98.7% of words, and feeding Kimi-K3 its own transcription as text restores text-mode reasoning length and accuracy. Whether compression pays off reduces to an exchange rate, (1-1/c)/(r-1), that must exceed the workload's price-weighted ratio of output to input tokens; this accounting decomposition shows why Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash can benefit and Qwen and GLM cannot. None of the training-free signals we test predicts the tax before generation. As a practical heuristic, an image-first policy that sends only inputs with a per-input compression ratio of at least 1.6 to images and falls back to text once image-mode reasoning costs as much as the input's prefill saving cuts the bill by 6-14% on Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at an accuracy cost of 0.3-1.2 points; on QuALITY, asking for a reasoning budget on both paths is a stronger lever.

AI.tldr: 将长文本渲染为图像虽减少预填充token，但对推理模型会产生显著"解码税"（解码长度增长1.5-3.5倍），使图像输入在部分模型上反而更贵。压缩是否划算取决于汇率(1-1/c)/(r-1)是否超过工作负载的输出/输入价格加权比。
AI.motivation: 现有评估只统计预填充token，认为图像输入因token更少而更省成本；但作者怀疑这对推理模型不完整，解码阶段的额外开销可能被忽略。
AI.method: 在5个模型、2个长上下文基准上对比图像与文本输入的解码长度；用Qwen的OCR（98.7%词恢复率）和把Kimi-K3自己的转写喂回文本做对照，排除信息损失解释；提出汇率公式(1-1/c)/(r-1)做成本分解；测试多种免训练信号能否预测解码税；提出"图像优先"启发式策略（压缩比≥1.6走图像，否则回退文本）。
AI.result: 4个通用VLM解码长度增1.5-3.5倍；QuALITY上2/5模型图像比文本更贵。信息损失不足以解释（OCR恢复98.7%词，回喂文本可恢复长度与准确率）。免训练信号均无法预测解码税。图像优先策略在Kimi-K3和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上省6-14%费用，准确率仅降0.3-1.2点；QuALITY上设置推理预算更有效。
AI.conclusion: 对推理模型而言，图像压缩的成本核算须纳入解码税；能否受益取决于汇率与价格比的比较，解释了Kimi-K3、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash受益而Qwen、GLM不受益；实用上可用基于压缩比阈值的图像优先策略或推理预算来控制成本。

title: RumiFold: Teaching an LLM to Natively Fold Proteins and Reason About Their Function
summary: Can we teach a general-purpose language model to fold proteins? And if so, what does learning to fold enable beyond structure prediction itself? We introduce RumiFold, a pretrained chat model that learns to predict protein structures directly from its own hidden states. RumiFold processes proteins through repeated folding passes, then uses these folded representations to answer questions in natural language. It achieves folding accuracy comparable to dedicated single-representation models such as SimpleFold, alongside state-of-the-art performance on Gene Ontology protein function prediction and free-text function description. We find that folding pretraining organizes the model's hidden states around protein function, creating an internal per-residue workspace that is biologically grounded. Causal interventions show that this folded workspace links structure and language when RumiFold predicts function, providing rich representations for biomolecular reasoning. We see RumiFold as a step toward native biomolecular intelligence: where protein-based computations and language-based reasoning become integrated capabilities of general-purpose language models. Code, data, and models are available at: https://rumifold.baulab.info

AI.tldr: RumiFold 是一个预训练聊天模型，能直接从自身隐藏状态预测蛋白质结构，并将"折叠表示"用于自然语言问答，在结构预测、GO 功能预测和自由文本功能描述上均达优秀水平。
AI.motivation: 探索通用语言模型能否学会折叠蛋白质，以及学习折叠除结构预测外还能带来什么（功能预测、生物分子推理等）。
AI.method: 让模型通过多轮"折叠 pass"处理蛋白质序列，从其隐藏状态直接预测结构；再利用这些折叠表示回答自然语言问题，并通过因果干预分析折叠工作空间与结构、语言的联系。
AI.result: 折叠精度与 SimpleFold 等专用单一表示模型相当；在 Gene Ontology 蛋白功能预测和自由文本功能描述上达到 SOTA；发现折叠预训练使隐藏状态围绕蛋白功能组织，形成具有生物学基础的逐残基内部工作空间，因果干预证明其连接结构与语言。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将结构预测与语言推理整合进通用语言模型，是迈向"原生生物分子智能"的一步，代码与模型已开源。

title: When Local Semantics Disagree: Learning to Detect Fake News through Weakly Supervised Cross-Modal Reasoning
summary: The rapid proliferation of multimodal social media content has made fake news detection a pressing challenge for the vision-language community. Most existing approaches rely on coarse global similarity between text and images, which overlooks subtle, uneven cross-modal inconsistencies -- such as sentiment-scene mismatches, object-level manipulations, or semantic dissonance between visual and textual cues. Moreover, these models treat all inconsistencies as equally informative, ignoring domain-specific variation in how such conflicts manifest, which limits both generalization and interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose DMIL, a dual-branch multiple instance learning framework that formulates multimodal fake news detection as a weakly supervised learning problem. Each news article is treated as a bag of visual and textual instances processed through two complementary branches: an embedding-space branch that aggregates global semantics via expert-guided modality fusion, and an instance-space branch that models cross-modal inconsistencies across local-to-global granularities. A retrieval-augmented, domain-adaptive router further contextualizes inconsistencies using retrieved domain exemplars and dynamically fuses multi-level cues. Extensive experiments on public misinformation benchmarks demonstrate that DMIL achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates strong discriminative capability against fake news across different domains.

AI.tldr: DMIL：将多模态假新闻检测建模为弱监督多实例学习，用双分支（嵌入空间+实例空间）捕捉细粒度跨模态不一致，并以检索增强的域自适应路由器融合多层次线索。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态假新闻检测依赖文本与图像间的粗粒度全局相似度，忽略了细微且不均衡的跨模态不一致（如情感-场景错配、对象级篡改、语义失调）；同时把所有不一致视为同等重要，忽视不同领域冲突表现形式的差异，限制了泛化性与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出DMIL双分支多实例学习框架：每条新闻视为由视觉与文本实例构成的包（bag）。分支一为嵌入空间分支，通过专家引导的模态融合聚合全局语义；分支二为实例空间分支，在局部到全局多个粒度上建模跨模态不一致。另设检索增强、域自适应的路由器，利用检索到的领域示例为不一致提供上下文，并动态融合多层级线索。
AI.result: 在公开虚假信息基准上实验，DMIL取得有竞争力的SOTA性能，并在跨领域场景下对假新闻表现出强判别能力。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、实例级的跨模态不一致建模结合领域自适应融合，是提升多模态假新闻检测泛化性与可解释性的有效途径。

title: iFeST: An Iterative Motion Correction Framework for Fetal Brain Diffusion MRI via Frequency-Spatial-Temporal Modeling
summary: Fetal brain diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (dMRI) is a pivotal non-invasive tool for assessing the development of brain connectivity and microstructure. However, the prolonged acquisition times and complex sampling requirements render dMRI highly susceptible to unpredictable fetal motion. Existing motion correction methods typically process each dMRI volume independently and focus on inter-slice motion. Such strategies fail to utilize the coherent information between dMRI volumes along different diffusion directions and lack the ability to restore the intra-slice corruption. To address these limitations, we proposed iFeST, an iterative framework that combines frequency (k-space), spatial, and temporal (inter-slice) modeling for fetal brain dMRI motion correction. At each iteration, iFeST integrates information across diffusion directions into fiber orientation distributions (FODs). These distributions encode local fiber orientations within each voxel and serve as microstructural priors for intra-slice restoration and inter-slice alignment in the next iteration. To train the framework, we developed a fetal brain dMRI motion simulator that synthesizes compound motion artifacts from FODs. Evaluation on simulated datasets demonstrated that iFeST outperformed four inter-slice networks in motion estimation and three intra-slice networks in image restoration. Further validation on a real-world dataset confirmed significantly better volume reconstruction and FOD estimation than conventional pipelines. Overall, iFeST provides a learning-based framework for fetal dMRI motion correction, restoring motion-corrupted data and improving microstructural reconstruction for downstream diagnostic applications.

AI.tldr: iFeST: 一种迭代框架，结合k空间、空间与时间建模，用于胎儿脑dMRI的运动校正。
AI.motivation: 胎儿dMRI采集时间长、采样复杂，易受胎动影响；现有方法逐体积独立处理且只关注层间运动，未利用不同扩散方向间的相关信息，也无法恢复层内损坏。
AI.method: 提出iFeST迭代框架：每次迭代将不同扩散方向信息整合为纤维方向分布(FOD)，作为微观结构先验，用于层内复原与层间对齐；并开发胎儿脑dMRI运动仿真器，从FOD合成复合运动伪影以训练模型。
AI.result: 仿真数据上，运动估计优于四种层间网络，图像复原优于三种层内网络；真实数据集上，体积重建与FOD估计显著优于传统流程。
AI.conclusion: iFeST提供了基于学习的胎儿dMRI运动校正框架，可恢复受损数据并改善微观结构重建，利于下游诊断应用。

title: Beyond Accuracy: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Hypothesis-Driven Experiment Planning in LLM Agents
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. 41 pages, 6 figures. Project website: https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/
summary: Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents on scientific tasks typically reduces to final-task accuracy, which obscures where reasoning succeeds or breaks down. We introduce a benchmark and diagnostic evaluation framework for hypothesis-driven adaptive experimental planning in closed-world system identification, instantiated in kinetic mechanism identification. The framework goes beyond final accuracy in two ways. First, we evaluate exploration behavior by quantifying the extent to which agents exhibit space-filling or corner-seeking patterns in the experimental design space. Second, we decompose the reasoning process into four interpretable steps: belief update, hypothesis discrimination, discriminative experiment design, and predictive reasoning under interventions, each scored separately on reasoning traces. Across ten LLM agents, we find that stronger agents outperform both adaptive (Bayesian optimization) and non-adaptive (Latin hypercube) baselines and exhibit exploration patterns inconsistent with naive heuristics. Decomposing reasoning reveals that the stronger agents score consistently well across all four steps, whereas weaker agents often succeed at belief update and hypothesis discrimination but are less reliable at translating them into actionable designs and sharp contrastive predictions. Independent expert annotations support predictive reasoning under our stated validation criteria, while evidence for discriminative experiment design is positive but less consistent. The results suggest a gap between recognizing plausible hypotheses and translating them into contrastive predictions, with more tentative evidence for a corresponding experiment-design bottleneck. The benchmark website is available at https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/.

AI.tldr: 提出面向闭环系统辨识（动力学机理识别）的LLM智能体诊断评测基准，超越最终准确率，从探索行为与四步推理分解两方面评估假设驱动的自适应实验规划。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM智能体的科学任务评测多只看最终任务准确率，掩盖了推理在何处成功或失败，无法定位能力瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建基准与诊断框架：一是通过量化实验设计空间中的“空间填充”与“角落寻求”模式评估探索行为；二是将推理轨迹分解为信念更新、假设区分、判别性实验设计和干预下预测推理四个步骤并分别打分，对比十种LLM智能体与贝叶斯优化、拉丁超立方基线，并辅以专家标注。
AI.result: 更强智能体优于自适应与非自适应基线，且探索模式不符合朴素启发式；强智能体四步均表现良好，弱智能体在信念更新与假设区分上尚可，但将之转化为可执行设计与鲜明对比预测的能力较差。专家标注支持预测推理（在既定验证标准下），判别性实验设计的证据为正但一致性较弱。
AI.conclusion: 识别假设与将其转化为对比预测之间存在差距，实验设计瓶颈的证据较初步；逐步骤诊断比单一准确率更能揭示智能体能力结构。

title: Domain-Specific Self-Supervised Learning for Cuneiform Sign Representation
comment: Accepted at the VisionDocs Workshop at WACV 2027
summary: Recognizing cuneiform signs is challenging: sign shapes vary across historical periods, scribal practices, and preservation conditions, while expert annotations are scarce. We study whether domain-specific self-supervised pretraining yields better cuneiform sign representations than generic natural-image pretraining. We pretrain a masked autoencoder, CuneiMAE, on over 900K unlabeled sign crops and compare it with ImageNet-pretrained MAE, CLIP, and DINOv2 on a 218-class sign recognition benchmark. CuneiMAE learns substantially stronger frozen representations (43.7% linear-probe accuracy vs. 25.2% for ImageNet-MAE), with gains over ImageNet-MAE on cross-period transfer. Under fine-tuning, CuneiMAE outperforms ImageNet-pretrained baselines on our internal benchmark, with the largest gains when labels are scarce (+20.4 pp over ImageNet-MAE with 1% of labels). On an external benchmark, CuneiMAE reaches 69.9% top-1 accuracy after fine-tuning, about 8 pp above the ResNet-18 baseline from prior work. Explicit structural priors, such as edge-guided masking and part bottlenecks, do not improve over standard masked reconstruction. Overall, domain-specific self-supervision shows strong performance on cuneiform recognition tasks, particularly when labels are limited.

AI.tldr: 在90万+无标注楔形文字字符图像上预训练MAE（CuneiMAE），发现领域自监督表示显著优于ImageNet等通用预训练，尤其在小样本与跨时期迁移场景。
AI.motivation: 楔形文字字符形状随历史时期、书吏习惯与保存状况而变，且专家标注稀缺，因此需探究领域特定自监督预训练能否比通用自然图像预训练学到更好的字符表示。
AI.method: 在90万+无标注字符切片上预训练掩码自编码器CuneiMAE，并在218类识别基准上与ImageNet预训练的MAE、CLIP、DINOv2比较；同时测试边缘引导掩码、部件瓶颈等结构先验。
AI.result: 冻结表示线性探测43.7%（ImageNet-MAE为25.2%），跨时期迁移有提升；微调后在内部基准上优于ImageNet基线，1%标签时领先+20.4个百分点；外部基准微调后top-1达69.9%，比先前ResNet-18基线高约8个百分点。显式结构先验未带来改进。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定自监督在楔形文字识别上表现强劲，标签有限时优势尤为明显；显式结构先验不如标准掩码重建有效。

title: WASP: Continual Weight Adaptation for Streaming LLM Personalization
summary: Personalized large language models (LLMs) should continually adapt to users' evolving preferences. Yet extracting preference changes from noisy interaction histories while supporting inexpensive updates remains challenging. We introduce WASP (Weight Adaptation for Streaming Personalization), a recurrent framework that captures fine-grained preferences directly from raw user interactions and generates personalized LoRA adapters without expensive per-user optimization. Specifically, WASP achieves this by training a shared hypernetwork that maintains a compact user representation and outputs adapter weights in a single forward pass. As new interactions arrive, WASP updates this representation without reprocessing full interaction history, enabling continual adaptation with per-update costs independent of history length. Experiments on personalization benchmarks and chronological interaction streams show that WASP sustains high-quality personalization over long horizons under fixed compute and storage budgets. Together, these results support efficient streaming personalization and facilitate privacy-preserving on-device deployment.

AI.tldr: WASP 是一种循环式个性化框架，通过共享超网络从原始用户交互中直接生成个性化 LoRA 适配器，实现恒定成本的流式个性化更新。
AI.motivation: 个性化 LLM 需要持续适应用户变化的偏好，但从噪声交互历史中提取偏好变化、同时支持低成本更新仍然困难（逐用户优化代价高昂、重处理全历史成本随长度增长）。
AI.method: 训练一个共享超网络，维护紧凑的用户表征，并在单次前向传播中输出 LoRA 适配器权重；新交互到来时仅更新该表征，无需重处理完整历史，使每次更新成本与历史长度无关。
AI.result: 在个性化基准与按时间顺序的交互流上，WASP 在固定计算与存储预算下，于长时程中持续保持高质量个性化效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持高效流式个性化，并有利于隐私保护的在端侧部署。

title: OnCache: Learning Dynamic Caching Schedules for Efficient Diffusion Inference
summary: Diffusion models have revolutionized generative tasks but incur high inference latency due to iterative denoising. Cache-based strategies accelerate inference by reusing intermediate features, yet they largely rely on static, sample-agnostic schedules. Our empirical analysis reveals two factors that these schedules overlook. (i) denoising dynamics and computational requirements vary across prompts, motivating adaptive computation allocation. (ii) sensitivity to caching errors varies across timesteps, so static schedules may reuse features at error-sensitive steps or waste computation at less sensitive ones. We therefore propose OnCache, a dynamic caching framework that makes prompt-adaptive decisions online about how much computation to allocate and when to refresh cached features. A policy is trained offline on paired compute and cache continuations from identical denoising states, using differences in terminal fidelity and the number of function evaluations (NFE) to account for the downstream consequences of each decision. To further improve the generation quality, a neural corrector compensates for caching-induced errors and mitigates their accumulation throughout the denoising trajectory. Both components are lightweight and introduce negligible additional inference latency. On FLUX.1-dev, OnCache achieves a nearly $3\times$ generation speedup at $1024^2$ resolution, with LPIPS of $0.156$ and SSIM of $0.860$. We further extend OnCache to video generation on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, achieving state-of-the-art efficiency--quality trade-offs across both modalities.

AI.tldr: OnCache 提出一种提示自适应（prompt-adaptive）的动态缓存框架，在线决定计算分配量与特征刷新时机，并用轻量神经校正器补偿缓存误差，在 FLUX.1-dev 上实现近 3 倍加速，并扩展至视频生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型因迭代去噪导致推理延迟高。现有基于缓存的加速方法多采用静态、与样本无关的调度策略，忽视了：(i) 不同提示下去噪动态与计算需求各异，应自适应分配计算；(ii) 不同时间步对缓存误差的敏感度不同，静态调度可能在敏感步复用特征、在非敏感步浪费计算。
AI.method: 提出 OnCache 动态缓存框架：训练一个离线策略，基于相同去噪状态下成对的“计算/缓存延续”样本，以终端保真度差异与 NFE 数来衡量每个决策的下游后果，在线对每个提示自适应决定计算分配与缓存刷新时机；同时引入轻量神经校正器补偿缓存引入的误差并抑制其在去噪轨迹中的累积。两者开销极小，几乎不增加推理延迟。
AI.result: 在 FLUX.1-dev 上，1024² 分辨率下实现近 3 倍生成加速，LPIPS 0.156、SSIM 0.860；在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 视频生成上，两种模态均达到 SOTA 的效率-质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: 样本与时间步自适应的动态缓存策略配合误差校正，可显著降低扩散模型推理延迟并保持生成质量，且可跨图像与视频模态推广。

title: DynFlux: Learning to Dynamically Balance Consensus and Conflict in Multimodal Emotion Recognition
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition remains challenging due to the intrinsic heterogeneity of different modalities. Effectively leveraging both cross-modal consensus (consistency) and conflict (inconsistency) is essential, as they jointly provide complementary cues that enhance emotion understanding from diverse perspectives. Traditional multimodal methods often suffer from semantic ambiguity and rarely explicitly model the interplay between cross-modal consensus and conflict. Moreover, existing approaches struggle to capture and exploit the dynamic interactions between these two complementary factors. To overcome these limitations, we propose DynFlux, a model guided by a temporal heterogeneous graph that encodes both consensus and conflict relationships across modalities. DynFlux introduces a dedicated graph branch that explicitly captures cross-modal dependencies through sparse temporal graphs, and modulates the conventional multimodal emotion recognition pipeline at three hierarchical stages: adaptive feature modulation during feature extraction, guided aggregation modulation during feature integration, and fusion strategy modulation at the multimodal fusion stage. Through this design, DynFlux dynamically balances cross-modal consensus and conflict, enabling richer and more robust emotion understanding. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets confirm that DynFlux consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and its generality is further validated on multimodal intent recognition and multimodal sarcasm detection tasks.

AI.tldr: DynFlux: 以时序异构图为核心的多模态情感识别模型，显式建模跨模态一致性与冲突并在三个层级动态调制，性能优于SOTA且可泛化至意图识别与讽刺检测。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感识别受模态异质性困扰；跨模态"共识"与"冲突"能提供互补线索，但传统方法存在语义歧义、很少显式建模二者交互，也难以捕捉其动态变化。
AI.method: 提出DynFlux，由一个独立的时序异构图分支通过稀疏时序图显式捕获跨模态依赖，并在三个层级调制常规情感识别流程：特征提取阶段的自适应特征调制、特征融合阶段的引导聚合调制、多模态融合阶段的融合策略调制。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上持续优于SOTA；其通用性在多模态意图识别和多模态讽刺检测任务上得到进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并动态平衡跨模态一致性与冲突可带来更丰富、更鲁棒的情感理解，且该范式具备跨任务的可迁移性。

title: StutterStigma-TR: A Novel Turkish Dataset and Target-Aware BERT Framework for Stuttering-Related Stigma Detection
summary: Computational research on disability-related ableist harm remains limited, and condition specific resources for stuttering-related stigma are particularly scarce. This study introduces StutterStigma-TR, a Turkish dataset of 6,019 public X/Twitter posts annotated as Stigmatizing, Non-stigmatizing/contextual, or Supportive using a speech and language therapy-informed protocol with independent lived-experience evaluation. We also propose StutterStigma-BERT, a BERTurk-based target-aware framework that combines explicit target marking, target-span representation, target-conditioned context, character-level and handcrafted orthographic information, and gated discourse cues. The framework is evaluated in complementary three-class and binary settings using controlled three-seed ablation analyses and final 20-seed robustness evaluations. Under the common training protocol, Gated Discourse-OrthoTarget trained with cross-entropy is selected as the final configuration for both tasks based on internal-validation Macro-F1. Across 20 random seeds, the final three-class model achieves a mean Macro-F1 of 73.54%, while the final binary model achieves 85.17% using validation-selected decision thresholds. Task adapted harmful-language comparators are additionally evaluated under the common training protocol, and the proposed model obtains the highest mean Macro-F1 among them. For the primary three-class task, matched backbone analyses show higher internal validation Macro-F1 with BERTurk than with TurkishBERTweet or Turkish Mamba, while substantial train-validation separation persists across all three backbones. Separate direct-transfer and zero-shot experiments examine performance without StutterStigma-TR supervision. Across the task-adapted, direct-transfer, and zero-shot comparisons, the condition-specific supervised systems retain the strongest aggregate performance.

AI.tldr: 本文构建土耳其语口吃污名化数据集StutterStigma-TR（6019条推文，三分类），并基于BERTurk提出目标感知框架StutterStigma-BERT，三分类Macro-F1约73.54%，二分类85.17%，优于任务适配的通用仇恨语言模型。
AI.motivation: 针对残障相关的能力主义伤害（ableist harm）计算研究有限，尤其是口吃污名化的条件特定资源稀缺，现有通用有害语言模型难以捕捉此类语境。
AI.method: 构建由言语治疗协议指导、并有亲历者独立评估的土耳其语X/Twitter数据集（6019条，标注为污名化/非污名化-语境/支持性）；提出BERTurk基座的目标感知框架，融合显式目标标记、目标片段表示、目标条件上下文、字符级与手工拼写特征及门控话语线索，采用三分类与二分类设置、三种子消融与最终20种子稳健性评估。
AI.result: 最终三分类模型20种子平均Macro-F1为73.54%，二分类为85.17%（验证集选阈值）；在任务适配有害语言对照模型中Macro-F1最高；BERTurk优于TurkishBERTweet与Turkish Mamba，但三者均存在明显训练-验证差距；直接迁移与零样本实验表明有监督条件特定系统聚合性能最强。
AI.conclusion: 条件特定的有监督方法对口吃污名检测最有效，数据集与目标感知框架为残障相关有害语言研究提供了可复用资源，但泛化与过拟合问题仍需关注。

title: AutoSECO: Automated Skill Evolution for Cross-Problem Combinatorial Optimization with General-Purpose LLM Agents
summary: General-purpose large language model (LLM) agents can develop complete solvers for combinatorial optimization problems. Their specialization, however, often relies on workflows engineered for individual problems, limiting the reuse of development expertise. We propose AutoSECO, an automated skill evolution method that learns reusable solver-development guidance from experience. The challenge is that external evaluation measures the completed solver, while the skill guides decisions during development. AutoSECO connects this feedback to guidance deficiencies by tracing performance shortfalls through solver code and recorded development decisions. Revisions are expressed as general instructions and retained only if a fresh solver developed under the revised skill achieves a lower mean evaluation gap. Evolved solely on the traveling salesperson problem (TSP), the skill guides fresh agents in developing solvers for capacitated vehicle routing, job-shop scheduling, and three-dimensional bin packing without further skill evolution. On TSP, the final mean benchmark gap is 0.52\%, compared with 0.98\% for the skill-evolution baseline SkillOpt. Across all four problems, the evolved skill achieves better aggregate results than no skill guidance, the initial skill, and SkillOpt. The same frozen skill also supports solver development under alternative model--harness configurations. These findings suggest that solver-development experience can be retained as reusable expertise for general-purpose LLM agents.

AI.tldr: AutoSECO learns reusable solver-development skills from experience, evolved only on TSP yet transfers to CVRP, JSP and 3D-BP.
AI.motivation: 通用LLM智能体可为组合优化问题开发求解器，但现有做法依赖针对单个问题定制的工作流，开发经验难以复用。
AI.method: 提出自动化技能演化方法AutoSECO：利用求解器代码与开发决策记录，将外部评测的性能差距回溯为技能缺陷，并以通用指令形式表述修订；仅当在新技能下重新开发的求解器平均评估差距更低时才保留该修订。
AI.result: 仅在TSP上演化技能，即可指导新智能体开发CVRP、作业车间调度、三维装箱求解器；TSP上最终平均基准差距0.52%，优于SkillOpt的0.98%；四个问题总体上优于无技能、初始技能与SkillOpt；同一冻结技能在替代模型—框架配置下仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 求解器开发经验可沉淀为可复用专长，供通用LLM智能体跨问题迁移使用。

title: Vanishing Initialization Turns Diagonal Tensor Gradient Flow into Greedy Matching
summary: We study gradient-flow (GF) learning of tensors from vanishing initialization in canonical polyadic (CP) factorization models. For tensors of order $ν\geq3$ whose targets are diagonal in mode-wise orthonormal bases, we prove that the limiting learning dynamics follows a simple greedy bipartite matching process. Each rank-one component of the model, called an atom, can potentially learn each rank-one component of the target, called a scalar sector. Every atom--sector pair has an initialization-dependent activation clock, representing the time at which the atom would grow to macroscopic size in that sector if the pair evolved in isolation. Processing these clocks in increasing order and selecting a pair whenever neither its atom nor its sector has been selected before determines the sequence of actual learning events. We prove that the GF trajectory converges to the corresponding staircase of learned target components. The task of learning modular addition by a CP model with complex weights falls exactly into this framework after Fourier diagonalization. Its activation clocks are independent and identically distributed, allowing us to combine the GF reduction with known random matching asymptotics and derive an explicit, distribution-free large-system loss curve after time reparametrization. We also obtain an asymptotic formula relating this curve to the original GF training time. For models with real weights, conjugate Fourier modes instead form two-dimensional blocks with richer internal structure. We characterize their rank and border-rank cascade and conjecture that the corresponding GF dynamics follows interleaved multi-stage learning processes.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究CP张量分解模型从零初始化出发的梯度流学习动力学，证明在特定条件下学习过程等价于贪心二分匹配，并据此导出模加法任务的无分布损失曲线。
AI.motivation: 理解张量分解模型（尤其CP模型）在零初始化下梯度流究竟如何逐个学习目标分量，并解释模加法等任务中的学习行为。
AI.method: 针对目标在逐模正交基下对角的ν≥3阶张量，为每个"原子-扇区"对定义与初始化相关的激活时钟，按时间递增顺序贪心选取未被选中的原子与扇区对，刻画极限学习轨迹；对模加法经傅里叶对角化后套用该框架并结合随机匹配渐近分析。
AI.result: 证明GF轨迹收敛到相应的已学目标分量"阶梯"；模加法（复权重）中激活时钟独立同分布，得到显式且无分布假设的大系统损失曲线及与原GF训练时间的渐近关系；实权重情形下共轭傅里叶模式形成二维块，刻画其秩与边界秩级联。
AI.conclusion: 零初始化下CP模型的GF学习可由贪心匹配简洁刻画，为模加法等任务提供了可解析的学习曲线；实权重情形被猜想为交错的多种学习阶段，留待后续验证。

title: ReCoRain: Reliability-Coupled Content and Noise Conditioning for Event-Guided Video Deraining
summary: Event-guided video deraining depends on reliable cross-frame correspondences, yet events generated by scene motion, rain, and sensor noise can provide ambiguous matching evidence. In diffusion-based restoration, an incorrect match can transfer unrelated content and correlate initial noise between unrelated scene locations. We propose ReCoRain, an event-guided residual video diffusion framework that couples temporal content transfer and noise correlation through a common assessment of correspondence reliability. This assessment combines RGB appearance, interval-event evidence, and forward-backward motion consistency. The content path aggregates neighboring features according to alignment reliability, while the noise path uses composed backward motion fields and their associated reliability estimates to regulate initial-noise sharing across the latent sequence. We use the same conditional noise construction during residual flow-matching training and inference, incorporating temporal noise coordination into the learned restoration process. Temporal supervision matches motion-compensated inter-frame differences in restored and clean videos under the same teacher-estimated flow and visibility mask, accommodating legitimate appearance changes. ReCoRain achieves 32.09 dB PSNR on NTURain-Syn and 28.73 dB on RainSynLight25. Enabling reliability gates in both paths reduces warping error by 33.0% relative to disabling both gates.

AI.tldr: ReCoRain：利用可靠性评估统一耦合时间内容传递与噪声相关的残差视频扩散去雨框架
AI.motivation: 事件相机引导的视频去雨依赖跨帧对应关系，但由场景运动、雨滴与传感器噪声产生的事件会带来模糊/错误的匹配证据。在扩散模型中，错误匹配会传递无关内容，并在无关场景位置间错误关联初始噪声。
AI.method: 提出 ReCoRain 残差视频扩散框架，通过共同的对应可靠性评估（融合RGB外观、区间事件证据、前后向运动一致性）同时驱动两条路径：内容路径按对齐可靠性聚合邻域特征；噪声路径用组合后向运动场及其可靠性约束潜序列初始噪声共享。训练与推理使用相同条件噪声构造，将时间噪声协调纳入残差流匹配学习；并采用时间监督，在相同教师估计光流与可见性掩码下匹配恢复视频与清晰视频的运动补偿帧间差异。
AI.result: 在 NTURain-Syn 达到 32.09 dB PSNR，RainSynLight25 达到 28.73 dB；两条路径同时启用可靠性门控时，相比同时关闭，warping 误差降低 33.0%。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性驱动的统一门控可有效抑制错误对应在内容与噪声两方面的负面影响，显著提升事件引导视频去雨性能。

title: Voyag: Joint Multi-Intent Detection and Execution-Relation Classification for In-Vehicle Voice Assistants
summary: An in-vehicle voice assistant must decide not only which intents an utterance contains but also how co-active intents may be executed: concurrently, in a fixed order, or not at all without arbitration. We present Voyag, a single-forward decision model that jointly predicts ten controlled vehicle-intent slots and a three-way execution relation (parallel, sequential, mutually exclusive) over each co-active intent pair. Voyag combines a multilingual ModernBERT-style encoder (mmBERT-base, 306.9M parameters), a typed per-slot choice head, and a lightweight GroupCalibration relation head (1.61M parameters) that consumes marker hidden states, pooled context, explicit resource-requirement profiles, and symmetrized outer-product conflict features. All objectives are optimized in one joint loss: soft cross-entropy over slot choices, focal cross-entropy over relations, and a mutex-consistency penalty. On a synthetic Chinese vehicle-life benchmark with semantic scene-level splits and a leakage audit (30,017 / 3,473 / 5,000 groups), validation-only selection yields 0.9893 slot accuracy and 0.0526 expected calibration error over 50,000 slot decisions. Conditioned on gold intents, the relation head reaches 0.8548 accuracy, 0.8473 macro-F1, and 0.6062 mutually-exclusive recall over 4,000 pairs; end to end with one encoder forward it reaches 0.8530 accuracy and 0.8464 macro-F1. Against a two-stage rule pipeline, the aggregate end-to-end gain is small and borderline, so we claim no aggregate advantage; the learned head's advantage lies in sequential and parallel recall where surface rules are blind. We report rule baselines with a tautology disclosure and a held-out thermal conflict failure.

AI.tldr: Voyag：单次前向的统一模型，联合预测10个受控车载意图槽位与共激活意图对的三类执行关系（并行/顺序/互斥），在合成中文车载生活基准上验证。
AI.motivation: 车载语音助手不仅需识别语句包含哪些意图，还需决定共激活意图之间如何执行：并行、按固定顺序、还是必须仲裁而不能同时执行。现有两阶段规则管线难以覆盖此类关系判断。
AI.method: mmBERT-base多语言编码器（306.9M）+ 逐槽位类型化选择头 + 轻量GroupCalibration关系头（1.61M，输入标记隐状态、池化上下文、显式资源需求画像与对称化外积冲突特征）；联合损失＝槽位软交叉熵＋关系focal交叉熵＋互斥一致性惩罚，单次前向完成。
AI.result: 合成中文基准（30,017/3,473/5,000组，语义场景级划分并做泄漏审计）：验证集仅选择下槽位准确率0.9893、ECE 0.0526（50,000决策）；给定金标意图时关系头准确率0.8548、macro-F1 0.8473、互斥召回0.6062（4,000对）；端到端单次前向准确率0.8530、macro-F1 0.8464。相对两阶段规则管线总体增益小且处于临界，作者明确不主张总体优势。
AI.conclusion: 作者不宣称总体优于规则管线；学习型关系头的价值在于规则难以覆盖的顺序与并行召回。论文同时披露规则基线中的同义反复问题，并报告一个留出的热冲突失败案例，体现谨慎的证据呈现。

title: ReVAgent: Multi-Agent Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Ruize Han is the corresponding author
summary: A central challenge in generating instructional videos for reasoning-intensive topics is to show how and why the state changes at each step. Even when an animation renders successfully, the depicted object relationships and state transitions can conflict with the explanation, making the reasoning difficult to follow. We present ReVAgent, a multi-agent framework that solves a problem, generates keyframes for its explanation, and synthesizes an instructional video. The agents share the execution record of a solution program, reuse intermediate results and constructions in the scenes, and check rendered keyframes to guide revisions to the solution or the scenes. We also introduce a multidimensional rubric for assessing whether generated videos present the problem clearly, organize the steps coherently, and use visuals to explain the reasoning. We calibrate a multimodal judge using human ratings and apply it to instructional videos for mathematics and algorithms. In the evaluated samples, ReVAgent presents multi-step reasoning coherently and uses diagrams to show how key operations lead to subsequent states.

AI.tldr: ReVAgent 是一个多智能体框架，通过共享解题程序的执行记录、复用中间构造并检查渲染关键帧来迭代修订，从而生成能清晰呈现逐步推理过程的教学视频，并配套提出多维评分标准与人机校准的多模态评判器。
AI.motivation: 为推理密集型主题生成教学视频的核心难点在于展示每一步"状态如何、为何改变"；即便动画成功渲染，所呈现的对象关系与状态转换也常与讲解相冲突，导致推理难以跟上。现有方法缺乏对解题过程与视觉呈现一致性的保障。
AI.method: 多智能体框架：各智能体分工完成解题、生成讲解关键帧、合成教学视频；共享解题程序的执行记录，复用场景中的中间结果与几何构造；对渲染出的关键帧进行检查，并据此回馈修订解题方案或场景。另提出多维评分量表（问题呈现清晰度、步骤组织连贯性、视觉解释推理的有效性），并用人工评分校准多模态评判器。
AI.result: 在数学与算法领域的教学视频样本上评估，校准后的多模态评判器显示：ReVAgent 能连贯地呈现多步推理，并用图示展示关键操作如何导向后续状态。
AI.conclusion: 将解题执行记录与渲染检查闭环结合，可有效提升教学视频中推理呈现的清晰度与一致性；配套量表与校准评判器为该类生成任务提供了可复用的评估手段。

title: Learning Global Probabilistic Explanations
summary:
Interpreting the predictions of complex black-box classifiers remains a central challenge in explainable artificial intelligence.
  While local explanations clarify individual predictions, there is a significant need for global probabilistic explanations that capture a model's overall behavior across the input distribution.
  Such an explanation is a small subset $K$ of features, whose relevance is measured by the expected probability, over a random input $\mathbf x$, that the classifier assigns the same label to $\mathbf x$ and to a random input agreeing with $\mathbf x$ on $K$.
  In this study, we investigate the task of identifying maximally relevant global explanations under a cardinality constraint, focusing on product distributions with full support on discrete feature spaces.
  We introduce a spectral explainer that leverages membership queries to the black-box classifier and employs Fourier-analytic, junta-learning methods to produce probably approximately correct (PAC) explanations.
  Our algorithm is fixed-parameter tractable with respect to the explanation size limit, maximum feature cardinality, and desired accuracy.
  Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets confirm the theoretical guarantees and show that the spectral explainer outperforms a greedy baseline as the explanation size increases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在基数约束下寻找最大化相关性的全局概率解释（特征子集K），针对离散特征空间上的乘积分布，提出基于傅里叶分析与junta学习的谱解释器，利用黑盒成员查询生成PAC解释，算法参数化可处理，实验优于贪心基线。
AI.motivation: 局部解释只能说明单个预测，而缺乏刻画模型整体行为（跨输入分布）的全局概率解释；需要找出在基数约束下最相关的全局解释特征子集。
AI.method: 将全局解释定义为小特征子集K，其相关性为随机输入x与其在K上一致的随机输入被赋予同一标签的期望概率；在全支撑离散特征空间的乘积分布下，提出谱解释器，通过成员查询调用黑盒分类器，采用基于傅里叶分析的junta学习方法得到probably approximately correct (PAC)解释；算法相对解释大小上限、最大特征基数与目标精度是固定参数可处理的（FPT）。
AI.result: 合成与真实数据集实验验证了理论保证，且随着解释规模增大，谱解释器优于贪心基线。
AI.conclusion: 在基数约束下识别最相关全局解释的问题可通过傅里叶/junta方法有效求解，给出PAC保证与FPT复杂度，并实证优于贪心方法。

title: AERIN: Aerial Instance Navigation with a Visual World Model
summary: Searching from high altitude and navigating to a target instance specified by a reference image is a common application for UAVs. In such tasks, high-altitude observations provide broad ground coverage for efficient search, but targets occupy fewer pixels, making instance verification and action selection more difficult. We present AERIN, a visual world model that uses action-conditioned prediction to guide the UAV toward the target while adjusting its viewpoint to obtain higherquality observations for subsequent instance verification. Highaltitude navigation requires fine-grained target details and scene context relevant to visibility, but repeatedly predicting dense visual representations of this information is computationally expensive. AERIN addresses this challenge with a compact, fixedsize, target-conditioned latent state that separately represents both for efficient action evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that AERIN outperforms the evaluated baselines in target approach and observation quality, while requiring substantially less decision time than similar world models.

AI.tldr: AERIN是一种视觉世界模型，通过动作条件预测引导无人机从高空搜索、接近参考图像指定的目标，并主动调整视角获得更高质量观测以利于实例验证。
AI.motivation: 无人机常需从高空按参考图像搜索并导航到目标实例。高空观测覆盖广但目标像素少，导致实例验证和动作选择困难；同时精确建模目标细节与可见性相关场景上下文又计算昂贵。
AI.method: 提出AERIN视觉世界模型，用动作条件预测指导无人机接近目标并调整视角。核心是用紧凑、固定大小、目标条件的潜在状态，分别表示目标细节与场景上下文，从而高效评估动作，避免反复预测稠密视觉表示。
AI.result: 在目标接近和观测质量上优于所评估基线，且决策时间显著少于同类世界模型。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的目标条件潜在状态可在保证导航与验证质量的同时大幅降低世界模型的计算开销，适合高空目标搜索与接近任务。

title: DUET: Dual-MDL Unsupervised Entropy-Trie Segmentation for Low-Resource Languages
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 20th Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (EACL2027 main)
summary: Morphological segmentation, the task of decomposing words into constituent morphemes, becomes particularly challenging under extreme data scarcity, a regime that can arise in language documentation and linguistic reasoning. This difficulty stems from existing approaches' reliance on annotated data, external resources, or recurring patterns that emerge only in larger corpora. To address this limitation, we propose Dual-MDL Unsupervised Entropy-Trie Segmentation (DUET), a deterministic unsupervised algorithm that decouples structural candidate generation from statistical candidate ranking. DUET combines branching entropy with recursive paradigm discovery to generate linguistically plausible candidate segmentations, then ranks them using a dual minimum description length (MDL) criterion: a corpus-level objective rewards morpheme reuse, while a construction-tree objective guards against over-segmentation. On the SIGMORPHON 2023 interlinear glossing shared task, DUET outperforms unsupervised baselines in Morpheme F1 under both the standard and simulated extremely low-resource settings, while providing broader candidate coverage. Augmenting prompts with DUET segmentations improves performance on a linguistic reasoning benchmark, yielding the best overall results among the evaluated segmentation methods.

AI.tldr: 提出确定性无监督的DUET算法，通过分支熵+递归范式发现生成候选切分，再用双重MDL准则排序，在极端低资源下提升形态切分与语言推理表现。
AI.motivation: 极端数据稀缺场景（语言记录、语言学推理）下，现有形态切分方法依赖标注数据、外部资源或仅在大规模语料中出现的重复模式，因而失效。
AI.method: DUET为确定性无监督算法，将结构候选生成与统计候选排序解耦：用分支熵结合递归范式发现生成语言学上合理的候选切分；再用双重MDL准则排序——语料级目标奖励语素复用，构造树目标防止过度切分。
AI.result: 在SIGMORPHON 2023 interlinear glossing共享任务上，DUET在标准与模拟极低资源设置下的Morpheme F1均优于无监督基线，且候选覆盖更广；将DUET切分加入提示后，在语言学推理基准上取得所评估切分方法中的最佳整体效果。
AI.conclusion: DUET无需标注或外部资源即可在极低资源下有效进行形态切分，并可作为辅助信息提升语言学推理任务表现。

title: Same Executions, Different Gaps: Judgment Rules in Web-Agent Evaluation
summary: Success-rate gains guide the development of web agents. Yet knowing which agent ranks first does not tell us how much confidence to place in its reported advantage. We study the comparison itself: how success is defined, what evidence supports the judgments, and how the difference between agents is estimated. On fixed web-agent executions, changing a judge from predicting likely completion to requiring recorded support can remove most of a reported lead without changing the ranking. This effect persists when unresolved completion is distinguished from supported failure. Controlled source additions explain how missing relations between task requirements, objects and observations can conceal a difference or create an apparent advantage. We also find that making both agents' score estimates more accurate can make their difference less accurate, because their original errors partly canceled. To estimate a chosen outcome difference, we combine judge predictions with reference labels for sampled task pairs. Across four released execution systems, regression fitted on the same 50 labeled pairs reduces estimation error relative to direct paired sampling. The results give agent researchers a practical basis for assessing claimed improvements: make the comparison target explicit, retain the evidence needed to check it, and use paired labels to estimate the difference directly.

AI.tldr: 本文不研究哪个智能体排名第一，而研究比较本身：成功如何定义、判断依据是什么、智能体间差距如何估计。作者发现改变判定标准（从"预测可能完成"改为"要求有记录证据"）可在不改变排名的情况下消除大部分报告优势，并给出用配对标签直接估计差距的实用建议。
AI.motivation: Web 智能体研究普遍以成功率提升作为进展依据，但仅凭排名无法判断报告中的优势有多可信。成功定义模糊、证据不足、差距估计方式不当，都可能导致差距被夸大或掩盖，因此需要审视比较过程本身。
AI.method: 在固定的 Web 智能体执行记录上，对比不同判定标准（预测可能完成 vs. 要求有记录支持；区分"未解决的完成"与"有支持证据的失败"）；通过受控地添加证据来源，分析任务需求、对象与观测之间缺失关系如何掩盖真实差异或制造表面优势；并指出分别提高两个智能体的得分估计精度，反而可能降低其差值精度（原误差部分抵消）。最后提出结合判定预测与抽样任务对的参考标签，用回归拟合估计所选定结果上的差距。
AI.result: 改变判定标准可在不改变排名的前提下消除大部分报告优势，且该效应在区分未解决完成与有支持失败后依然存在；缺失关系可双向影响差异估计；分别改进单个智能体估计会损害差值估计。在四个公开执行系统上，基于同样 50 个配对标签的回归拟合，相比直接配对抽样降低了差距估计误差。
AI.conclusion: 评估智能体改进应做到三点：明确比较目标（成功定义与"差距"所指）、保留可核查的证据、用配对标签直接估计差值，而非依赖各自成功率的简单相减或排名。

title: CoHABIT: Complementary Evaluation of Furniture Layouts through Spatial Rules and Household Routines
summary: We introduce CoHABIT, a framework for evaluating furniture layouts through complementary spatial rules and household routines. Static assessment captures geometric validity, ergonomic access, functional organization, and configurable design preferences, including Feng Shui. Dynamic assessment uses learned resident policies to simulate everyday activities, resource sharing, coordination, and individual burdens in multi-agent households. Controlled comparisons show how spatial criteria and household behavior reveal distinct aspects of layout quality, while resident profiles and scheduling influence furnishing rankings. Independent verification of household needs grounds dynamic comparisons in observed outcomes, enabling interpretable assessments of how furnished environments serve different households.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoHABIT 框架，通过静态空间规则与动态家庭日常行为两条互补路径来评估家具布局质量。
AI.motivation: 现有家具布局评估多聚焦几何与功能等静态指标，难以反映多成员家庭在日常活动中对空间的真实使用、协调与负担分配。
AI.method: 静态评估考察几何有效性、人机可达性、功能组织及可配置设计偏好（如风水）；动态评估用学习得到的住户策略模拟多智能体家庭的日常活动、资源共享、协调与个体负担；并通过控制实验比较两类指标，辅以对住户需求的独立验证。
AI.result: 控制对比显示空间指标与家庭行为揭示布局质量的不同侧面，住户画像与日程安排会影响家具排序；独立验证使动态比较锚定于可观察结果。
AI.conclusion: CoHABIT 提供可解释的评估方式，揭示布局如何服务于不同家庭，弥补纯静态评估的不足。

title: Seeing Is Not Planning: Spatiotemporal Planning and Plan Repair in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Planning in a visual world means reading the layout, foreseeing how the state will change, and following the task rules all at once. When a plan fails, a model should also use what went wrong to fix it. We call these two abilities spatiotemporal planning and plan repair, and test them with Railbound-Bench. A model sees a railway puzzle, adds tracks under a budget, and submits one complete layout; a simulator then moves all cars at once and decides whether the layout works. After a failure, the model sees what happened and may submit a new layout, up to five attempts in total. On the 200-puzzle main set, the best of nine models solves 59.5% within five attempts, the next 39.5%, and the other seven at most 10.0%; a 1,000-puzzle extended set with a wider range of difficulty is far easier, at 90.9% for the best model. Controlled studies on 180 fixed puzzles show that knowing the task is not the same as using it. GPT-6.1 Terra copies 97.2% of boards exactly and, given a correct layout as text, predicts all four requested future states in 91.3% of cases, yet only 22.8% of its first layouts work. Planning fails more often as the cars' routes interact, even among puzzles that a search solver finds equally easy. Visual feedback removes the reported fault in 175 of 417 first revisions, but only 43 of these revisions solve the puzzle, and at an equal budget of 40k tokens it does no better than fresh retries. The code and data are open-sourced on GitHub at https://github.com/liaoyanqing666/Railbound_Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出 Railbound-Bench 铁路解谜基准，用"一次性提交完整布局+模拟器统一判定"的方式测试模型的时空规划与失败后修复能力；9个模型中最佳仅59.5%（5次尝试），暴露"理解任务≠会规划"。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界中的规划要求同时读懂布局、预判状态演化并遵守任务规则，失败后还要能利用错误信息修复。现有基准缺少对"时空规划"与"计划修复"这两项能力的统一、可量化评测。
AI.method: 构建 Railbound-Bench：模型观察铁路谜题，在轨道预算内补全轨道并一次性提交完整布局，模拟器同步运行所有车辆判定成败；失败后可见反馈并重交，最多5次。主集200题，另设1000题扩展集；并在180道固定题上做控制实验，分离"知道规则""预测未来状态"与"实际规划"。
AI.result: 主集200题中，9个模型最佳5次内解出59.5%，次优39.5%，其余7个≤10.0%；1000题扩展集最佳达90.9%（更易）。控制实验：GPT-6.1 Terra 复制棋盘准确率97.2%，给定正确布局后预测4个未来状态准确率91.3%，但首次布局仅22.8%可行。车辆路径交互越多规划越易失败（即便搜索求解器判为等难）。视觉反馈在417次首修中去掉所报故障175次，但仅43次真正解题；同等40k token预算下不优于全新重试。
AI.conclusion: 模型具备任务知识与状态预测能力，却难以转化为可行的时空规划与有效修复；交错路径交互是主要难点，单纯视觉反馈在等算力下收益有限。代码与数据已开源。

title: Evaluating Persona Consistency in LLM User Simulators Without External Reference Annotations
summary: Standard evaluations assess LLM-simulated personas against an external ground truth, such as community trait annotations, but that reference is unavailable when the persona is inferred only from a short, task-oriented chat. We ask how persona consistency can be evaluated without such a reference, and propose a self-anchored internal-consistency diagnostic: the persona describes itself once and acts twice. A Likert self-report supplies a soft internal anchor; two behavioral profiles come from constrained scenario choices scored without a judge and from open-ended responses judged by an LLM. Consistency is the correlation between the self-report and each behavioral profile, in a shared six-facet BFI-2 space. The framework compares persona-construction strategies by assessing how consistently their elicited responses reflect their self-reported traits. Across ordinary-user chats (WildChat and LMSYS) and well-documented personas with community annotations (the Personality Database, PDB), profile-enriched representations agree with the anchor more closely than a raw-dialogue baseline. On PDB, this self-anchored ordering reproduces the community-annotation ordering. The pattern is stable across answering and judge models.

AI.tldr: 提出"自锚定内部一致性"诊断框架：人格自我报告一次、行为表现两次，无需外部金标准即可评估LLM人格一致性，且排序与社区标注排序一致。
AI.motivation: 现有人格评估依赖外部ground truth（如社区特质标注），但当人格仅从简短、任务导向的对话推断时，这种参考不可用，需要无参考的一致性评估方法。
AI.method: 以Likert自我报告作为软内部锚点，获取两类行为画像：约束情景选择（无评委打分）和开放式回答（LLM评判）；在共享的BFI-2六维空间计算自我报告与各行为画像的相关性，据此比较不同人格构建策略。
AI.result: 在WildChat、LMSYS和PDB上，画像增强表示比原始对话基线更贴合锚点；在PDB上自锚定排序复现了社区标注排序，且结果对回答模型与评判模型稳定。
AI.conclusion: 自锚定内部一致性可作为外部标注不可得时的有效替代诊断，能可靠区分人格构建策略的质量。

title: Adopting AI Technologies without Traps: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework
summary: AI technologies and AI agents play increasingly important roles in human society, including in education, economics, and research. Adopting AI technologies can bring immediate, and sometimes tremendous, rewards such as through productivity boost, but they can also bring negative effects including but not limited to losses of job and training opportunities, and cognitive capability declines. Thus, it is important to investigate the optimal ways of adopting AI technologies without different traps. In this paper, we develop a general multi-agent Markov decision process (MDP) based reinforcement learning (RL or MARL) modeling framework for determining and analyzing optimal adoption of AI technologies. This framework can model the long-term dynamic effects of AI adoption, and lead to finding the optimal AI adoption strategies. In our modeling framework, the negative effects of AI adoption are modeled by undesirable state transitions or negative rewards in the MDPs. The proposed multi-agent RL MDPs incorporate both human agents and AI agents. The key idea of our models is that incorporating AI technologies may not only increase the immediate rewards for AI agents but also alter the states of the involved human and AI agents. In particular, we apply this framework to analyzing AI offloading leading to skill erosion, to analyzing optimal human resource structures for a firm adopting AI, and to analyzing the economic equilibria in the trading/employment among human and AI agents. Since the multi-agent MDP based RL technique is from control, machine learning and AI, this research is essentially using an AI technique to determine the optimal ways of adopting or co-existing with AI without traps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于多智能体马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的强化学习建模框架，用于分析和确定AI技术的最优采纳策略，兼顾AI带来的收益与负面效应，并以技能侵蚀、企业人力结构优化和经济均衡三个应用为例进行演示。
AI.motivation: AI技术在教育、经济与科研等领域作用日益重要，采纳AI能带来生产力和效率提升等即时收益，但也可能导致失业、培训机会丧失、认知能力下降等负面效应；因此需要研究如何最优地采纳AI以避开各种"陷阱"。
AI.method: 构建通用的多智能体MDP强化学习（RL/MARL）建模框架，同时建模人类智能体与AI智能体。将AI采纳的负面效应表示为不良状态转移或负奖励；核心思想是AI技术的引入不仅提高AI智能体的即时奖励，还会改变人类与AI智能体的状态。该框架可刻画AI采纳的长期动态效应并求解最优采纳策略。作者将框架应用于三类场景：AI卸载导致的技能侵蚀、企业采纳AI时的最优人力资源结构、以及人类与AI智能体之间交易/雇佣的经济均衡。
AI.result: 框架能够对AI采纳的长期动态效应进行建模，并在所应用的三个场景（技能侵蚀、企业人力资源结构、人机经济均衡）中求得最优AI采纳策略与均衡结果。
AI.conclusion: 由于多智能体MDP强化学习技术源自控制、机器学习与AI领域，该研究本质上是"用AI技术来确定与AI共存或采纳AI的最优方式，从而避免各种陷阱"。

title: GeoFusion: An Uncertain Machine Learning Framework for Sensor Fusion
summary: High positioning precision is a critical requirement in many Global Positioning System (GPS) applications, yet achieving it with affordable smartphone sensors remains an open challenge. Existing approaches treat each GPS observation as an absolute point, discarding the uncertainty inherent in the measurement conditions and leaving the cooperative potential of multiple phones observing the same location untapped. In this work, we propose GeoFusion, a three-stage uncertain machine learning framework for cooperative sensor fusion. In the first stage, each GPS observation is modeled as an uncertain object using one of two proposed models: the volcano function, grounded in satellite geometry, and the empirically derived mountain function, built from the statistical structure of real smartphone data. In the second stage, uncertain objects are clustered by location event using partitional and graph-based algorithms. In the third stage, the cluster output is refined using filter-based and learning-based estimators. Experiments on the Google Smartphone Decimeter Challenge dataset show that uncertainty modeling is a primary driver of precision gains: the mountain function significantly outperforms the geometry-only volcano function, and uncertainty-aware UK-medoids significantly outperforms its certain counterpart, k-medoids. A post-clustering deep neural network further refines the cluster estimates, and the recommended configuration achieves a mean absolute error of 2.90 +/- 0.15 meters on held-out test drives, comparable to and on average below the best reported single-phone precision of approximately 3 meters, demonstrating the potential of cooperative uncertainty-aware fusion for affordable GPS sensors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoFusion，一个三阶段不确定性机器学习框架，将每部手机的GPS观测建模为不确定对象，通过聚类与估计器融合多手机协作定位，在Google Smartphone Decimeter Challenge数据集上达到2.90±0.15米平均绝对误差。
AI.motivation: 廉价智能手机GPS精度有限，而现有方法把每条GPS观测当作绝对点，丢弃了测量条件带来的不确定性，也浪费了多部手机在同一地点协作观测的潜力。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：第一阶段用两种不确定性模型表示GPS观测——基于卫星几何的volcano函数和经验统计导出的mountain函数；第二阶段用划分式与图方法按位置事件对不确定对象聚类；第三阶段用基于滤波和基于学习的估计器精化聚类结果。
AI.result: mountain函数显著优于仅用几何的volcano函数；不确定性感知的UK-medoids显著优于k-medoids；聚类后深度神经网络进一步精化估计，推荐配置在留出测试行驶上MAE为2.90±0.15米，平均低于最佳单手机约3米的精度。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性建模是精度提升的主要驱动因素，验证了面向廉价GPS传感器的协作式不确定性感知融合的潜力。

title: Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution for Cost-free Image Enhancement
summary: Image enhancement spans degradations with distinct spectral characteristics. Standard convolutions use fixed kernels, whereas dynamic convolutions gain adaptability at additional inference cost. We propose Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution (DSRC), a plug-and-play module that learns task-adaptive spectral responses during training while retaining standard convolution at inference. DSRC decomposes convolution kernels into frequency bands, applies learnable high/low-pass modulation, and incorporates lightweight residual branches. Owing to the linearity of these operations, all training-time components are analytically fused into a single kernel for inference. Experiments on low-light enhancement, underwater enhancement, and image super-resolution show consistent PSNR gains and generally improved or preserved SSIM and LPIPS across twelve backbone-task configurations, with unchanged deployed parameter counts and theoretical FLOPs, and no additional inference operators.

AI.tldr: DSRC是一种即插即用模块，在训练时学习任务自适应的频谱响应，推理时通过重参数化融合回单一标准卷积核，不增加部署参数、FLOPs或算子。
AI.motivation: 图像增强涉及不同光谱特性的退化：标准卷积核固定缺乏适应性，而动态卷积虽灵活却增加推理成本。作者希望兼得二者之长。
AI.method: 将卷积核分解为频带，施加可学习的高通/低通调制，并加入轻量残差分支；利用这些操作的线性性，在推理时将训练期所有分支解析融合为单一卷积核。
AI.result: 在低光增强、水下增强、图像超分辨率三个任务、十二种骨干-任务配置上，PSNR一致提升，SSIM与LPIPS总体改善或保持；部署参数量与理论FLOPs不变，无额外推理算子。
AI.conclusion: DSRC以零推理开销实现频谱自适应卷积，是一种实用、通用的即插即用增强模块。

title: When Does Reasoning Help Entity Disambiguation? Small LLMs In-Domain and Under Shift
summary: Entity disambiguation (mapping ambiguous mentions in text to entities in a knowledge base) is a foundational step in tasks such as knowledge graph construction, question answering, and information extraction. Recent work has applied LLMs to this problem, achieving stateof-the-art performance. Notably, reasoning LLMs have been shown to perform entity disambiguation in a true zero-shot fashion, generalizing across knowledge bases and domains. However, it is unclear whether this capability survives, or remains competitive, with smaller LLMs, where entity disambiguation has typically relied on reranking rather than reasoning. We ask when reasoning is worth its cost at small scale. We compare pointwise, listwise, and reasoning-based candidate-selection components within a classical coarse-to-fine entity disambiguation pipeline, across the classical, few-shot and true zero-shot settings. The reasoning paradigm is trained with distillation and reinforcement learning recipes. The benefit of reasoning grows with domain shift: negligible in-domain, decisive in the true zero-shot setting. We show that two distinct factors are at work: the reranker's uncertainty over the candidates locates where the paradigms disagree, while shift governs which is right when they do.

AI.tldr: 在小型LLM上系统比较了pointwise、listwise与reasoning三类候选选择组件，发现在域内推理收益可忽略，而在真正的零样本域偏移下推理带来决定性提升，且重排序器的不确定性与域偏移分别解释了两类范式的分歧位置与正确性。
AI.motivation: 已有工作显示推理型LLM能实现真正的零样本实体消歧，但小型LLM上该能力是否保留、推理是否值得其成本尚不清楚（小模型传统上依赖重排序而非推理）。
AI.method: 在经典粗到细实体消歧流程中，对比pointwise、listwise和reasoning式候选选择组件，覆盖经典、few-shot与真正零样本三种设定；推理范式用蒸馏和强化学习配方训练；并分析重排序器不确定性与域偏移的作用。
AI.result: 推理的收益随域偏移增大：域内几乎可忽略，真正零样本设定下具有决定性。两个因素分别起作用——候选上的不确定度定位了两种范式产生分歧的位置，而域偏移决定了分歧时哪一方正确。
AI.conclusion: 小规模下推理并非总是值得其成本：其价值高度依赖域偏移程度，不确定性可预测范式分歧，域偏移决定正确性，为小模型实体消歧的范式选择提供依据。

title: VeriWorld: A Verifiable Visual SWE-Bench for Spatial Reasoning in 3D Environments
comment: 32 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. Code at https://github.com/VITA-Group/VeriWorld and dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/yanyanzheng96/VeriWorld
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for spatial tasks such as navigation and manipulation, where they must infer geometry and object relationships from visual input in order to act correctly. Existing benchmarks usually test perception and reasoning in isolation, making it hard to tell whether failures come from visual understanding, downstream reasoning, or the bridge between them. We introduce VeriWorld, a benchmark for spatial reasoning in interactive 3D environments with executable actions and deterministic verification. For task families where all three channels are well-defined, we evaluate matched visual, structured, and combined input conditions on the same instance, environment, and verifier; families without a clean visual/structured/combined split are reported separately. This design supports controlled comparisons of perception, reasoning, and their interaction. Using this setup, we uncover two diagnostic findings. First, models often perform much better when task-relevant information, such as object identity, current state, or target location, is given explicitly than when it must be read from the rendered scene, revealing a recurring visual-to-structure gap. Second, action-space and harness design can change outcomes even under the same task and information condition, showing that interaction protocol is itself a confounding variable. VeriWorld is open-sourced to support reproducible and fine-grained evaluation of spatial reasoning in VLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出VeriWorld基准，在可执行动作、确定性验证的交互式3D环境中评测VLM空间推理，通过匹配的视觉/结构化/组合输入条件，分离诊断感知、推理及二者交互。
AI.motivation: 现有基准通常孤立测试感知与推理，难以判断失败源自视觉理解、下游推理还是二者之间的衔接，因此需要可控对比的实验设计。
AI.method: 构建交互式3D环境基准，任务带可执行动作与确定性验证器；对三类通道均定义清晰的任务族，在同一实例、环境与验证器下评测视觉、结构化、组合三种输入条件；无法干净切分任务族单独报告。
AI.result: 发现两个诊断结论：(1) 任务相关信息（物体身份、当前状态、目标位置）显式给出时模型表现明显优于需从渲染场景读取时，存在反复出现的"视觉到结构"落差；(2) 即使任务与信息条件相同，动作空间与评测框架设计也会改变结果，交互协议本身是混淆变量。
AI.conclusion: VeriWorld开源，支持可复现、细粒度的VLM空间推理评测，并揭示感知-推理衔接与交互协议设计是影响评测结论的关键因素。

title: Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement asks a system to improve the very system that improves it. Today's language models improve themselves through data, training recipes or scaffolds. Whenever their weights change, gradient descent writes the update, not the model. We let the model write its own weights. In SELFWRITE, each generation the current model studies its own reasoning on fresh training problems, inspects its own weights and activations in a persistent Python session, and writes a program that constructs a low-rank weight edit for itself from white-box primitives (singular directions, activation contrasts between its right and wrong answers, rank-one projections, tensor computations), with no training or gradient tool. Every candidate is graded once on a hidden gate set against the current model; the best strictly improving edit is merged into the weights, and the edited model writes the next edit. On Qwen3.8-27B and math problems from DAPO-Math, five generations of SELFWRITE raise gate accuracy from 73.95% to 76.45% and accuracy on a held-out test split that the loop never sees from 76.30% to 77.75% (avg@4) and from 82.60% to 84.80% (pass@4), without a single gradient step. A language model can author useful changes to its own weights without gradients, and the edited model keeps writing useful edits.

AI.tldr: SELFWRITE让语言模型直接用白盒原语（奇异方向、激活对比、秩一投影等）编写程序，构造低秩权重编辑来改进自身，全程无梯度、无训练，五轮迭代后准确率稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型的自改进依赖数据、训练配方或脚手架，一旦涉及权重更新，真正"写更新"的是梯度下降而非模型本身。作者希望让模型亲自编写对自身权重的修改，实现更彻底的递归自我改进。
AI.method: 每一代中，当前模型在持久Python会话里研究自己在新训练题上的推理、检查自身权重与激活，然后用奇异方向、正确/错误答案间的激活对比、秩一投影、张量计算等白盒原语编写程序，构造低秩权重编辑，不使用任何训练或梯度工具。每个候选只在隐藏门控集上评测一次，取严格提升最优者合并进权重，再由编辑后的模型编写下一次编辑。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.8-27B与DAPO-Math数学题上，五轮迭代把门控准确率从73.95%提升到76.45%；在循环从未见过的留出测试集上，avg@4从76.30%升至77.75%，pass@4从82.60%升至84.80%，全程零梯度步。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可以在无梯度条件下自行为自身权重编写有效修改，且编辑后的模型仍能持续产生有用编辑，展示了递归自我改进的一种可行路径。

title: Learning Optical Flow with Task-Oriented Feature Adaptation
summary: Learning-based optical flow estimation approaches generally rely on both inter-frame correspondence evidence and intra-frame contextual guidance, yet features from general-purpose image encoders may not fully support these roles. Strongly activated but weakly discriminative channels can outweigh more informative ones when computing inter-frame feature similarity, while context feature affinities can be low within motion-coherent regions yet high across motion boundaries. To address these mismatches, this study proposes TO-Flow, a task-oriented feature adaptation framework that aligns matching and context features with their respective requirements through dedicated channel modulation and spatial reorganization approaches. An affinity-based soft partition distinguishes motion-region interiors from boundary-adjacent regions to guide both processes. Channel modulation uses simulated flow refinement to assess whether each channel assigns higher similarity to estimated correspondences than to nearby competing candidates. The resulting similarity differences are aggregated within each region type and averaged across iterations to derive channel weights that emphasize informative channels and suppress ambiguous ones. Spatial reorganization combines affinity-guided feature attraction and repulsion from coarse to fine to simultaneously improve consistency within motion-coherent regions and distinctiveness across motion boundaries, with feature resampling mitigating boundary blurring during cross-scale fusion. Extensive experiments on the MPI Sintel, KITTI 2015, Spring, and LayeredFlow datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and general applicability of TO-Flow across diverse iterative refinement architectures as well as supervised and unsupervised training paradigms. The source code will be publicly available at https://mias.group/TO-Flow upon publication.

AI.tldr: TO-Flow是一个任务导向的特征适配框架，通过通道调制与空间重组，使匹配特征与上下文特征分别满足光流估计的需求。
AI.motivation: 通用图像编码器特征不完全适合光流任务：强激活但弱判别性的通道会干扰帧间相似度计算；上下文特征在运动一致区域内亲和度低、跨运动边界却高。
AI.method: 基于亲和度的软分区区分运动区域内部与边界邻域；通道调制用模拟光流细化评估各通道对估计对应点是否比邻近竞争候选赋予更高相似度，按区域聚合与迭代平均生成通道权重；空间重组从粗到细进行亲和引导的特征吸引与排斥，并用特征重采样缓解跨尺度融合的边界模糊。
AI.result: 在MPI Sintel、KITTI 2015、Spring和LayeredFlow上实验表明，TO-Flow在多种迭代细化架构及监督/无监督范式下均有效且具通用性。
AI.conclusion: TO-Flow通过任务导向的特征通道与空间适配，有效缓解匹配与上下文特征的错配问题，具备跨数据集、跨架构与跨训练范式的适用性。
