title: CLIP-FMoE: Scalable CLIP via Fused Mixture-of-Experts with Enforced Specialization
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as a promising approach for scaling deep learning models while maintaining computational efficiency. However, existing MoE adaptations for Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) models suffer from significant computational overhead during sequential training and degradation of zero-shot capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose CLIP-FMoE, a novel approach that integrates MoE architecture into CLIP fine-tuning. Our method uses Isolated Constrained Contrastive Learning, a pipeline that trains specialized experts on cluster-based data partitions to accelerate expert specialization. Additionally, we introduce a Fusion Gate mechanism to mitigate catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves consistent improvements on downstream tasks while preserving zero-shot capabilities. Furthermore, our method demonstrates robust performance across varying context lengths, making it particularly suitable for diverse real-world applications.

AI.tldr: CLIP-FMoE 将混合专家（MoE）架构引入 CLIP 微调，通过隔离约束对比学习加速专家特化，并用融合门缓解预训练知识遗忘，在提升下游任务性能的同时保持零样本能力。
AI.motivation: 现有面向 CLIP 的 MoE 适配方法在顺序训练时计算开销大，且会导致零样本能力退化。
AI.method: 提出 CLIP-FMoE：1）Isolated Constrained Contrastive Learning，将数据按聚类划分后分别训练专门化专家以加速专家特化；2）Fusion Gate 机制，缓解对预训练知识的灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在多个基准上取得一致的下游任务提升，同时保持零样本能力；在不同上下文长度下表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: CLIP-FMoE 为 CLIP 的 MoE 微调提供了兼顾性能、效率与零样本泛化的方案，适用于多样化的现实应用场景。

title: Adaptation or Poisoning? Security Risks of Conversational Test-Time Learning in Large Language Models
summary: Test-time learning (TTL) enables large language models to adapt to unlabeled inputs during deployment. The model updates a lightweight adapter by minimizing the next-token prediction loss on the input it receives. When these updates persist across conversation turns, every user query serves both as the request answered in the current turn and as adaptation data for later turns. By choosing the queries used for adaptation, an attacker can influence parameter updates and weaken safety alignment through ordinary interactions with a TTL chat service. To demonstrate this risk, we introduce Progressive Test-Time Adaptation Poisoning (P-TAP), a query-only multi-turn attack that jailbreaks the model by poisoning its session adapter through the service's own updates. A sequence of escalating adversarial queries shapes the adapter turn by turn; the final harmful request is then answered under the accumulated state without itself being used for adaptation. Across four open-weight instruction-tuned models, enabling updates raises attack success rates on average by 13.00 percentage points under greedy decoding and by 22.25 points under best-of-10 sampling, relative to matched sessions receiving the same queries without updates. Answering adversarial queries but adapting on unrelated text or on benign text about the same topic removes most of this increase. Among existing safeguards, screening incoming queries flags every attack stream before the final request, while a perplexity-based detector of unsafe adaptation flags none of the successful attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出P-TAP：利用测试时学习(TTL)的会话适配器更新，通过多轮递进对抗查询"投毒"，即可仅用查询越狱LLM。
AI.motivation: TTL让模型部署时用未标注输入更新轻量适配器，且更新跨对话轮持续保留，使每条用户查询既是请求又是后续轮的适配数据。攻击者可借此选择用于适配的查询来影响参数更新、削弱安全对齐，这一风险尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: P-TAP是一种仅需查询的多轮攻击：按顺序发送递进升级的对抗查询，逐轮塑造会话适配器状态；最终有害请求在累积状态下被回答，但本身不参与适配。对比实验中设置相同查询但不更新、回答对抗查询却在不相关或同主题良性文本上适配等对照条件。
AI.result: 在四个开源指令微调模型上，开启更新使攻击成功率平均提升13.00个百分点（贪心解码），best-of-10采样下提升22.25个百分点。仅回答对抗查询但在无关或同主题良性文本上适配可消除大部分提升。现有防护中，入站查询筛查能在最终请求前标记所有攻击流；而基于困惑度的不安全适配检测器未能标记任何一次成功攻击。
AI.conclusion: 持续性的测试时适配构成新型安全攻击面，普通交互即可逐渐侵蚀对齐；有效缓解应针对"被适配的内容"而非仅输入表面，且现有困惑度检测不足，需新防护机制。

title: UNIFY: Unified Learning with One Model via Batch Norm Switching
summary: Neural networks are typically trained separately for individual datasets or tasks, resulting in many task-specific models. This redundancy increases memory footprint, deployment costs, and energy consumption limiting their scalability. We propose UNIFY, a unified learning framework that enables a single model to jointly learn and perform inference across multiple datasets via Batch Normalization Switching (BNS). Instead of maintaining separate models for each dataset, UNIFY shares the parameter-intensive backbone while maintaining dataset-specific BN statistics and parameters, along with dataset-specific classification heads. We validate our framework using five datasets (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet) across six Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) of different sizes (SqueezeNet 1.1, WideResNet-40-2, WideResNet-16-8, ResNet-18, ResNet-34, ResNet-50). Notably, a single UNIFIED ResNet-34 trained on these datasets achieves accuracies of 99.53%, 94.84%, 96.12%, 80.32%, and 67.67%, respectively, outperforming the average performance of the corresponding independently trained task-specific models while reducing the memory footprint by approximately 4.94x, from 428.30 MB (five separate models) to 86.71 MB (one unified model). UNIFY aims not only to consolidate (K) models into a single model but also to enhance model-effectiveness by leveraging complementary knowledge across datasets. It paves the way for scalable, efficient, and unified learning capable of handling diverse image classification tasks. Code is available at: https://github.com/saktx/UNIFY.

AI.tldr: 提出UNIFY统一学习框架，通过批归一化切换（BNS）让单个模型在多个数据集上联合训练与推理，共享骨干参数、保留数据集特有的BN统计/参数和分类头，用一个ResNet-34在多数据集上超过独立模型平均精度并降低约4.94倍内存。
AI.motivation: 神经网络通常按单个数据集或任务分别训练，产生大量任务专用模型，带来内存占用、部署成本和能耗的冗余，限制了可扩展性。
AI.method: UNIFY框架：单一模型共享参数密集的骨干网络，同时为每个数据集保留专属的Batch Normalization统计量与参数以及专属分类头，通过Batch Normalization Switching实现多数据集联合学习与推理。在5个数据集（MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet）和6种CNN（SqueezeNet 1.1、WideResNet-40-2、WideResNet-16-8、ResNet-18/34/50）上验证。
AI.result: 单个统一训练的ResNet-34在上述五个数据集上分别达到99.53%、94.84%、96.12%、80.32%、67.67%的准确率，优于对应独立训练模型的平均性能；内存占用从428.30 MB（五个独立模型）降至86.71 MB（一个统一模型），约减少4.94倍。
AI.conclusion: UNIFY不仅将K个模型整合为一个，还通过利用数据集间的互补知识提升模型效果，为可扩展、高效、统一且能处理多样图像分类任务的学习方式提供了路径。

title: TAP: Policy Interfaces for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models denoise a masked canvas, making them a natural setting for selective generation decisions such as answering, waiting, clarifying, or refusing. We introduce TAP-DiLM, which adds a typed policy variable to masked diffusion LMs, and study how this policy should be attached to the denoising process. Across BERT-base, MDLMOWT, LLaDA-8B, and Dream-7B, we compare shared-vocabulary slots, dedicated slot heads, and CLS-based external heads. The results reveal a clear interface-backbone interaction: dedicated heads provide robust policy learning across scales, while sharedvocabulary heads can be effective when the LM-head geometry is favorable. A simple LMhead sharpness probe predicts when sharedhead policy internalization is reliable, giving a practical diagnostic for interface selection. Causal clamp and slot-injection tests show that dedicated policy slots can influence body denoising through feedback, especially at 8B scale. Safety-refusal experiments further show that TAP-DiLM supports competitive typed refusal behavior when trained with diverse unsafe prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TAP-DiLM，在掩码扩散语言模型中引入类型化策略变量，系统比较三种策略接口（共享词表槽位、专用槽位头、基于 CLS 的外部头），揭示接口与骨干网络的交互规律，并给出 LM 头锐度探针作为接口选择诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通过去噪掩码画布生成文本，天然适合"回答、等待、澄清、拒绝"等选择性生成决策，但如何将这类策略决策接入去噪过程尚无系统研究。
AI.method: 在掩码扩散 LM 中加入类型化策略变量，并在 BERT-base、MDLMOWT、LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B 四种模型上对比三种接口方案：共享词表槽位、专用槽位头、CLS 外部头；同时设计 LM 头锐度探针预测共享头内部化可靠性，并用因果钳制（clamp）与槽位注入实验检验策略槽对主体去噪的反馈影响。
AI.result: 专用头在各规模下均能稳健学习策略；共享词表头在 LM 头几何有利时同样有效；LM 头锐度探针可预测共享头策略内部化是否可靠；专用策略槽可通过反馈影响主体去噪，在 8B 规模上尤为明显；使用多样化不安全提示训练时，TAP-DiLM 具备有竞争力的类型化拒绝行为。
AI.conclusion: 策略接口与骨干网络存在明确的交互关系，需按模型选择接口；锐度探针提供了实用的接口选择诊断；TAP-DiLM 在安全拒绝等选择性生成任务上可行。

title: Learning Heterogeneous Reasoning in Large Language Models: From Mode Compatibility to Local Bottlenecks
summary: Post-training large language models routinely pools reasoning trajectories from diverse teachers or algorithms, yet it remains unclear whether standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can learn such heterogeneous strategies without explicit mode conditioning. We study the learnability and local bottlenecks of heterogeneous reasoning through a formal mixture formulation and controlled experiments. We first formalize the representational compatibility of the optimal autoregressive model with latent reasoning mixtures: the target next-token distribution weights modes by their prefix posteriors and concentrates on a single mode once alternative modes assign negligible likelihood to the prefix. In a verifiable symbolic graph-search environment with paired breadth-first and depth-first search trajectories, no consistent disadvantage is observed for unlabeled mixed SFT relative to homogeneous or labeled baselines under matched token budgets while preserving both modes. Scaling across 0.6B--14B models and data budgets largely eliminates global mode confusion, shifting the primary bottleneck to local state-tracking transitions. Because a local mistake affects the final outcome only when subsequent reasoning is sensitive to that step, we find that only a small fraction of local errors are outcome-determining \emph{Critical Reasoning Nodes (CRNs)}, and that single-step repairs at these nodes rescue failing trajectories across symbolic search and natural language benchmarks whenever the model has sufficient downstream competence to complete the remaining derivation. Our environment is open-sourced at https://github.com/Bowen1911/Symbolic_graph_env.

AI.tldr: 论文研究混合异构推理轨迹的SFT能否在不加模式标签的情况下学习多种策略。作者用形式化混合模型与受控实验表明：无标签混合SFT在匹配token预算下不劣于同质或带标签基线，并能保留两种模式；随模型和数据规模扩大，全局模式混淆基本消失，瓶颈转移到局部状态追踪错误，且仅少数错误为决定结果的"关键推理节点(CRN)"。
AI.motivation: 后训练中常把不同教师或算法的推理轨迹混合池化，但标准SFT能否在不显式指定模式条件的情况下学到这些异质策略仍不清楚，需要研究其可学习性与局部瓶颈。
AI.method: 先将最优自回归模型与潜在推理混合的表征兼容性形式化（下一token分布按前缀后验对各模式加权，当其他模式对前缀似然可忽略时集中于单一模式）；再构建可验证符号图搜索环境，配以成对的BFS与DFS轨迹，在匹配token预算下对比无标签混合SFT与同质/带标签基线，并将模型扩展到0.6B–14B及不同数据预算。
AI.result: 无标签混合SFT未出现一致劣势，且保留了两种模式；规模扩大基本消除全局模式混淆，主要瓶颈变为局部状态追踪转换；仅少数局部错误为结果决定性的CRN，在这些节点做单步修复即可在符号搜索与自然语言基准上救回失败轨迹，前提是模型具备完成剩余推导的下游能力。
AI.conclusion: 异质推理的混合SFT本身是可学的，真正瓶颈是局部状态追踪与少数关键节点；针对性单步修复是高效改进方向。环境已在 https://github.com/Bowen1911/Symbolic_graph_env 开源。

title: Learning Acceptable Lotteries via Queries: Minimizing Aggregated Violation Distances
summary: When deploying an AI system, a developer can randomize over several candidate versions, sending each request to a version chosen at random, to balance the requirements of multiple stakeholders. We study a setting in which each of $n$ stakeholders reveals only whether a proposed lottery over $m$ candidates is acceptable, and each stakeholder's acceptable lotteries lie on one side of an unknown hyperplane. While previous work sought a lottery that every stakeholder accepts, such a lottery need not exist when, for instance, safety and helpfulness requirements are in conflict. We therefore minimize a power mean of the stakeholders' violations; since binary answers reveal neither the size of a violation nor how to compare violations across stakeholders, we measure each violation by a normalized distance to the stakeholder's acceptance boundary. We characterize exactly when accept/reject answers determine these distances. When they do, $\mathcal{O}(nm\log(1/\varepsilon))$ queries suffice to learn them, where $\varepsilon$ is the precision of the utilities, and this bound is tight; when they do not, a natural worst-case approach is optimal up to a constant factor, even compared with methods that make unlimited queries. For limited query budgets, we give a sampling algorithm whose number of queries for a given accuracy does not depend on $n$, and show that a deterministic algorithm cannot guarantee a small loss without querying almost all stakeholders. Synthetic experiments illustrate the resulting tradeoff between querying many stakeholders and learning each of them accurately.

AI.tldr: 研究多利益相关者仅提供接受/拒绝二元反馈、偏好由未知超平面界定的场景，最小化违规度的幂平均；刻画距离可辨识条件，给出紧的查询复杂度，并分析有限预算下的采样与确定性算法权衡。
AI.motivation: 部署 AI 时需在多个候选版本间随机化以平衡多方需求，但现实中每个利益相关者往往只能回答"是否接受"某彩票。当安全与有用性等目标冲突时，不存在被所有人接受的彩票，因此需退而最小化总体违规，而二元反馈不揭示违规大小与跨利益相关者的可比性。
AI.method: 将每个利益相关者的可接受彩票建模为未知超平面一侧的半空间，用归一化到接受边界的距离度量违规，并最小化违规的幂平均。分析接受/拒绝答案何时能确定这些距离；给出学习距离的查询算法并证明下界；不可辨识时采用自然最坏情形方法并与无查询限制方法比较；对有限预算提出查询数不依赖 n 的采样算法，并证明确定性算法须查询几乎所有利益相关者。
AI.result: 精确刻画了二元答案可确定归一化距离的条件；可确定时 O(nm log(1/ε)) 次查询足够且该界紧；不可确定时自然最坏情形方法在常数因子内最优，即便对比无限查询的方法；有限预算下采样算法的查询数不依赖 n 即可达给定精度，而确定性算法不查询几乎所有利益相关者就无法保证小损失；合成实验展示了多查人与精学每人之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 二元接受反馈下的多方随机化部署具有清晰的查询复杂度结构：可辨识情形有紧的 O(nm log(1/ε)) 上界，不可辨识情形最坏情形方法近似最优，有限预算时随机采样优于确定性方法。核心洞见是"广查多个利益相关者"与"精确学习单个利益相关者"之间存在本质权衡。

title: From Pairwise to Collective: Encoder Collections Make Unpaired Vision-Language Alignment Reliable
summary: Strong vision and text encoders can be trained independently, but their representations are not directly comparable. Connecting them usually requires paired image-text data, which may be unavailable. Unpaired alignment instead fits a map between a vision and a text encoder from feature-space geometry alone, enabling text-based retrieval and zero-shot classification without paired data. Treating each pair independently leads to fragile searches, repeated fitting, and uncertain map quality. A collection of encoders supplies additional supervision: all vision encoders embed the same images and all text encoders the same texts. Correspondences within each modality are therefore known exactly, while the cross-modal correspondence remains hidden. ConsensusAlign pools each modality into a shared space, fits one unpaired cross-modal bridge, and transfers it in closed form to every encoder pair. New encoders join through same-modality fitting without repeating the cross-modal search. On 21 vision-text encoder pairs and five seeds, pooled fitting aligns every pair, whereas pairwise fits fail in 68 of 105 pair-seed cells. Mean alignment error (FOSCTTM) falls from 0.1457 to 0.0099, and zero-shot accuracy nearly doubles on ten datasets. Gains persist across the tested within-modality pooling constructions with a WP bridge. New corpora reuse the bridge through native maps fitted to unlabeled target features from every source encoder. Agreement with separately fitted reference maps detects failures on COCO.

AI.tldr: ConsensusAlign通过同模态编码器池化构建共享空间,仅需拟合一个无配对跨模态桥接,并闭式迁移到所有编码器配对,大幅降低对齐误差与提升零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉与文本编码器可独立训练,但表征不可直接比较;通常需成对图文数据做连接,而这类数据可能不可得。无配对对齐仅靠特征空间几何,但对每对编码器独立拟合会带来搜索脆弱、重复拟合和映射质量不确定的问题。
AI.method: 利用编码器集合:所有视觉编码器嵌入同一批图像、所有文本编码器嵌入同一批文本,故同模态内对应关系已知,跨模态仍隐藏。ConsensusAlign将每种模态池化为一个共享空间,拟合单个无配对跨模态桥,再以闭式解迁移到每个编码器对;新编码器只需做同模态拟合即可加入。新语料通过源编码器拟合的native map复用该桥。
AI.result: 在21个视觉-文本编码器对、5个随机种子上,池化拟合使每对均成功对齐,而逐对拟合在105个"对-种子"单元中有68个失败。平均对齐误差FOSCTTM从0.1457降至0.0099,十个数据集上的零样本准确率近乎翻倍;增益在多种同模态池化构造下均保持。COCO上与独立拟合参考图的一致性可用于检测失败。
AI.conclusion: 将多个编码器视为集合、共享一个跨模态桥,可稳定、低成本地实现无配对跨模态对齐,显著优于逐对拟合,并支持新编码器与新语料的便捷扩展。

title: Disclosure Bias in AI Reviewers
summary: AI models increasingly help to review papers, and many conferences and journals now require authors to state how they used AI. Does this AI-use statement change how an AI reviewer rates a paper, and could it change which papers are accepted? In a preliminary study, we varied only the AI-use statement of 150 ICLR 2027 submissions, in up to nine versions adapted from real statements: from no AI, through writing help and coding, to an AI research agent and an AI author. Six AI reviewers rated the versions: the decision model Jev and the language models Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 4 Argon. Across 23,652 reviews, we find that every reviewer rates papers lower on average when the statement says AI did all the work than under a statement of no AI use. The AI research agent statement lowers the rating significantly for Jev, Sonnet and Argon. We find no evidence of a disclosure bias for AI assistance: for writing help, coding and research help, no reviewer's rating differs significantly from its rating under a statement of no AI use. Whether the observed penalty changes which papers are accepted depends on more than the size of the penalty: on how finely and how consistently the reviewer separates the papers near the acceptance boundary, on whether the penalty is spread over all papers or concentrated on a few, and possibly on how many other papers disclose AI use.

AI.tldr: 通过改变150篇投稿的AI使用声明（最多9种版本），让6个AI审稿人共产生23,652条评审，考察AI使用声明是否影响评分与接收结果。
AI.motivation: AI日益参与论文评审，许多会议和期刊要求作者声明AI使用方式，但尚不清楚这类声明是否会影响AI审稿人的评分，进而影响哪些论文被接收。
AI.method: 对150篇ICLR 2027投稿仅改动AI使用声明（从"无AI"到写作辅助、编程、AI研究代理、AI作者等最多9个版本，改编自真实声明），由6个AI审稿人（决策模型Jev及Claude Haiku 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5、Gemini 3.8 Flash、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Gemini 4 Argon）评分，共23,652条评审。
AI.result: 所有审稿人在"AI完成全部工作"声明下平均打分更低；"AI研究代理"声明显著降低Jev、Sonnet和Argon的评分；写作辅助、编程、研究辅助等AI协助情形下，无任何审稿人评分与"无AI"声明存在显著差异，即未发现AI协助的披露偏见。
AI.conclusion: 观察到惩罚是否改变接收结果不仅取决于惩罚大小，还取决于审稿人在接收边界附近区分论文的精细度与一致性、惩罚是分散于全部论文还是集中于少数论文，以及可能取决于其他论文披露AI使用的情况数量。

title: A statistical measure of trust in generative AI
summary: Trustworthiness is a crucial issue for generative AI, as modern models can produce convincing and confident responses even when their outputs are incomplete, unsupported, or wrong. The frequent absence of ground-truth knowledge or labels complicates verification of generative AI outputs. To address this issue, we propose a trustworthiness framework grounded in model-internal confidence calibrated against an external expert reference. We estimate per-token trustworthiness of a student generative model as the statistical typicality of each generated token relative to an expert model's distribution, where the expert is used as a distributional reference rather than as a source of factual verification labels. To this end, we introduce an AI ontology calibrator that leverages the student model's internal latent features and token-level output statistics to compute expert-reference acceptance scores. Combined with traditional token-level confidence, entropy, and perplexity statistics, calibrator scores yield a compact set of $15$ response-level indicators for correctness classification. Evaluated across BF program generation, mathematical problem solving, and medical question answering, combined calibrator and traditional indicators provide complementary reliability signal which could be used to build detectors of untrustworthy outputs and hallucinations. Remarkably, our experiments show that these detectors are transferable across domains, although transferability is not always symmetric.

AI.tldr: 提出以“外部专家模型作为分布参照”的生成式AI可信度框架，用AI本体校准器计算逐token专家参照接受度，结合15个响应级指标实现正确性分类与幻觉检测，并在跨领域迁移中验证。
AI.motivation: 生成模型即便输出不完整、无依据或错误时也能给出自信且具说服力的回答，且真实知识/标签常缺失，导致输出难以验证，需要不依赖真实标签的可信度评估方法。
AI.method: 将学生模型逐token可信度定义为相对专家模型分布的统计典型性（专家仅作分布参照而非事实核验标签）；提出AI本体校准器，利用学生模型内部隐特征与token级输出统计计算专家参照接受分；再与传统token级置信度、熵、困惑度结合，构成15个响应级指标用于正确性分类。
AI.result: 在BF程序生成、数学解题与医学问答三类任务上，校准器指标与传统指标提供互补的可靠性信号，可构建不可信输出与幻觉检测器；检测器可跨领域迁移，但迁移性并不总是对称。
AI.conclusion: 无需外部事实标签，通过专家分布参照与内部特征校准可有效刻画生成输出可信度，并支持跨域泛化的幻觉检测。

title: Think Before You Forecast: Scaling Test-Time Compute for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Test-time compute has become an important paradigm in computer vision and language modeling, where additional computation at inference time enables models to explore multiple candidate solutions and select or refine the most reliable one. However, time series forecasting models typically produce predictions through a single forward pass, leaving them vulnerable to distribution shifts and non-stationarity that frequently arise in real-world temporal data. We propose Time Test Compute for Time Series (TTC4TS), an architecture-agnostic framework that improves the predictive performance of frozen forecasting models at inference time. Given a pretrained backbone, the generator produces multiple candidate forecast trajectories using augmentation, retrieval, adapter. The synthesizer then selects or combines these candidates using aggregation, classification, or candidate-scoring and ranking methods to produce the final forecast. By increasing the number of candidates, TTC4TS scales test-time compute without retraining the forecasting backbone. Beyond improving point-forecast accuracy, TTC4TS can exploit candidate forecasts for uncertainty quantification, which supports improved interval forecasts. We also theoretically analyze when additional test-time computation improves forecasting. Experiments across diverse datasets and backbones demonstrate consistent gains in accuracy and calibration. Code is provided in https://github.com/Anoise/TTC4TS.

AI.tldr: TTC4TS是一个模型无关的测试时计算框架，通过在推理阶段为冻结的预测骨干生成多个候选轨迹并合成最终预测，提升时间序列预测的精度与不确定性校准。
AI.motivation: 测试时计算在视觉与语言领域已被证明有效，但时间序列预测模型大多只做单次前向推理，面对真实世界的分布偏移与非平稳性时较为脆弱。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：生成器利用数据增强、检索、适配器多种手段，从预训练冻结骨干产生多个候选预测轨迹；合成器通过聚合、分类或候选打分排序来筛选/组合候选，得到最终预测。增加候选数量即可扩展测试时计算而无需重训练骨干，并可将候选用于不确定性量化。
AI.result: 在多种数据集与骨干网络上实验，一致带来点预测精度提升，并改善区间预测与校准效果；理论上分析了额外的测试时计算在何种条件下能提升预测。
AI.conclusion: TTC4TS表明以架构无关的方式在推理阶段扩展计算量，可有效增强冻结时间序列模型的鲁棒性与可靠性，并兼具精度与不确定性量化收益。

title: PSC-Gen: Physical Sequence Conditioning for Video Generation via Agentic Visual Planning
summary: Recent advances in video diffusion models have enabled the synthesis of high-fidelity, visually compelling videos. However, despite being trained on internet-scale video data, understanding underlying physical laws and generating physically plausible dynamics remain challenging. To mitigate this, conditioning video generators on explicit physical reasoning has emerged as a promising direction. Nevertheless, existing conditioning approaches often fail to incorporate detailed physical guidance into generation, resulting in physically implausible motion or visual artifacts. We propose PSC-Gen, a training-free framework that employs an agentic approach to synthesize visual conditions and inject their core dynamics via low-frequency filtering. By iteratively planning physical states and verifying generated keyframes, our Physics Agent constructs visually and physically consistent keyframe sequences. We then interpolate these keyframes into a continuous physical sequence and inject only its low-frequency components, steering the video model to preserve physical dynamics while synthesizing fine visual details. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations across physics-informed and robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that PSC-Gen faithfully follows instructions and generates physically plausible videos.

AI.tldr: PSC-Gen 是一个免训练框架，通过智能体（Physics Agent）迭代规划物理状态并验证关键帧，再用低频滤波注入物理动态，引导视频扩散模型生成物理上合理的视频。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型虽在高保真合成上进展显著，但仍难以理解物理规律、生成物理合理的动态。现有以显式物理推理为条件的方法未能将细粒度物理引导融入生成，导致运动不合理或视觉伪影。
AI.method: 免训练框架：Physics Agent 迭代规划物理状态并验证生成的关键帧，构建视觉与物理一致的关键帧序列；将关键帧插值为连续物理序列，仅注入其低频分量作为条件，引导模型保持物理动态同时合成细节。
AI.result: 在物理相关与机器人操作基准上的定性、定量评估表明，PSC-Gen 能忠实遵循指令并生成物理合理的视频。
AI.conclusion: 以智能体构建视觉条件并结合低频注入的方式，可在不训练的情况下有效提升视频生成的物理合理性。

title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Contrastive Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Contrastive decoding (CD) mitigates object hallucination in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by contrasting token distributions under different conditions to adjust token scores. However, existing generative and discriminative benchmarks primarily measure final task scores, which can be confounded by candidate filtering, changes in generation trajectories, and response biases, making it difficult to isolate the effects of the underlying contrastive adjustments. To address these limitations while complementing existing evaluations, we introduce CONCOR (Contrastive Correction Evaluation), a controlled benchmark that directly evaluates the competition between ground-truth and different types of hallucinated candidates using the Contrastive Grounding Margin (CGM). CGM also enables analysis of directional consistency, composition, and reliability of contrastive corrections. Our evaluation reveals that existing CD methods exhibit distinct correction behaviors: some consistently favor ground-truth candidates, whereas others produce strong corrections but also introduce more errors. Crucially, these differences help explain their contrasting responses to increased contrast strength, which improves some methods while degrading others. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating the contrastive correction itself, rather than relying solely on final-output performance, and CONCOR provides a controlled and interpretable framework for understanding and improving CD methods for hallucination mitigation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CONCOR，一个受控基准，直接用 Contrastive Grounding Margin (CGM) 衡量真实候选与不同类型幻觉候选之间的竞争，从而隔离并评估对比解码（CD）本身的纠正效果，而非仅看最终任务分数。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式与判别式基准主要衡量最终任务分数，受候选过滤、生成轨迹变化和响应偏差干扰，难以隔离对比解码中对比调整本身的效应。
AI.method: 引入 CONCOR（Contrastive Correction Evaluation）受控基准，基于 Contrastive Grounding Margin (CGM) 直接评估真实答案与不同幻觉候选的竞争，并分析对比纠正的方向一致性、构成与可靠性。
AI.result: 实验发现现有 CD 方法呈现不同纠正行为：部分方法稳定偏好真实候选，另一些虽纠正力度强但引入更多错误；这些差异也解释了它们对增大对比强度的相反响应——有的方法受益，有的反而退化。
AI.conclusion: 应评估对比纠正本身而非仅依赖最终输出表现；CONCOR 提供了受控、可解释的框架，用于理解和改进面向幻觉缓解的 CD 方法。

title: MMMem: Self-Improving Agents with Task-Aware Multimodal Experience Consolidation
summary: AI agents accumulate conversations, images, and documents through long-term interactions with users. Answering later questions often requires connecting evidence across these records, yet the resulting understanding is rarely retained, allowing mistakes to recur on related questions. Existing multimodal memory methods largely focus on storing and retrieving records, with limited mechanisms for learning from completed tasks and consolidating task-specific experience. We therefore propose MMMem, a task-aware multimodal memory framework that extracts and consolidates experience from completed tasks through four complementary strategies. First, source-linked multi-view memory organizes original text, images, and rendered pages alongside generated scene images that combine clues across records for retrieval. Second, source-generated tasks support knowledge alignment at two levels: warm-up consolidates source knowledge into task-relevant experiences in external memory, while self-training adapts the model's parametric knowledge to task demands. Third, the same vision-language model distills completed tasks into experiences that record the task context, conclusion, and support links. Finally, task-aware retrieval recalls source views and relevant experiences for answering and verification, while source-supported reuse guides long-term retention. Across three memory benchmarks and two vision-language readers, MMMem outperforms eight baselines. With Qwen3.5-9B, MMMem achieves relative gains of 36.9%, 17.6%, and 15.2% over the best-performing baselines on LoCoMo, Mem-Gallery, and LooGLE v2, respectively. Ablations show consistent gains from training and memory warm-up, while case studies illustrate how individual components work in practice.

AI.tldr: 提出MMMem，一个任务感知的多模态记忆框架，通过四种互补策略从已完成任务中提取并巩固经验，在三个记忆基准上超越八个基线。
AI.motivation: AI智能体在长期交互中积累对话、图像和文档，回答后续问题往往需要跨记录连接证据，但由此形成的理解很少被保留，导致相关问题反复出错。现有多模态记忆方法多聚焦于记录的存储与检索，缺乏从已完成任务中学习和巩固任务特定经验的机制。
AI.method: 四类互补策略：(1) 源链接的多视图记忆，将原始文本、图像、渲染页面与融合跨记录线索的生成场景图像一并组织以供检索；(2) 源生成任务，在两层实现知识对齐——warm-up将源知识巩固为外部记忆中的任务相关经验，self-training使模型参数知识适配任务需求；(3) 由同一视觉语言模型将已完成任务蒸馏为经验，记录任务上下文、结论与支撑链接；(4) 任务感知检索，召回源视图与相关经验用于回答与验证，并以源支撑的复用引导长期保留。
AI.result: 在三个记忆基准和两个视觉语言阅读器上，MMMem优于八个基线。使用Qwen3.5-9B时，在LoCoMo、Mem-Gallery、LooGLE v2上相对最佳基线分别提升36.9%、17.6%、15.2%。消融实验显示训练与记忆warm-up带来稳定增益，案例研究展示了各组件的实际作用。
AI.conclusion: 通过将记忆从单纯存储检索扩展为任务经验的学习与巩固，MMMem有效提升了多模态长程记忆问答的能力，且各组件均有贡献。

title: From Learning Rates to Rotational Schedules: Finite-Horizon Theory on the Sphere
summary: How should step sizes be scheduled across a finite training horizon? Cosine and warmup-stable-decay (WSD) schedules are widely adopted in large-scale pretraining, yet their effect on optimization also depends on parameter norms. Normalization can make parameter groups scale invariant, so that the loss depends only on their direction, while their norms still affect how fast the parameters rotate. In this work, we formulate schedule design directly in the space of rotational motion. Working within a geodesically convex spherical setting, we derive a last-iterate convergence guarantee for arbitrary rotational schedules that separates their overall scale from their distribution over time. We derive the unique schedule that minimizes this bound and prove that it approaches linear decay as the horizon grows. Empirically, our rotational interpretation and idealized spherical analysis provide useful predictions for LLM pretraining in practice, including schedule comparisons missed by existing analyses. Our analysis predicts schedule ordering across model scales for both vanilla (Adam, Muon) and Hyperball-style (AdamH, MuonH) optimizers. Our Hyperball experiments support the predicted strong performance of linear LR decay and confirm our prediction that WSD underperforms in this setting. Accounting for parameter norm dynamics, we predict instead the strong performance of WSD for Adam and Muon shown in practice. Guided by our theoretical insights, we also derive a new LR schedule for Adam and Muon, which improves over the established cosine and WSD schedules. All in all, these results support the use of rotational dynamics to understand, predict, and ultimately guide scheduling in LLM pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文从旋转运动（旋转几何）视角重新刻画学习率调度设计，在测地凸球面设定下给出任意旋转调度的一般收敛界，并推导出唯一最优调度，证明其随训练时长趋近线性衰减；该分析能预测Adam/Muon与AdamH/MuonH在不同模型尺度下的调度排序，并据此提出优于cosine和WSD的新调度。
AI.motivation: Cosine和WSD等调度在LLM预训练中被广泛使用，但其效果还依赖参数范数；归一化会使参数组尺度不变、损失只依赖方向，而范数仍影响参数旋转速度。现有分析无法解释实践中的调度排序（如WSD在Hyperball优化器下表现差、在Adam/Muon下表现好），因此需要在旋转运动空间中直接进行调度设计。
AI.method: 在测地凸的球面设定下，将参数更新视为旋转运动，推导对任意旋转调度成立的last-iterate收敛保证，并将该界分解为“总体步长尺度”与“时间上的分布”两部分；通过最小化该收敛界求得唯一最优调度，并分析其随时域增长时的渐近形式。随后用该理想化分析预测不同优化器（vanilla Adam、Muon与Hyperball式AdamH、MuonH）及不同模型尺度下的调度表现，并开展LLM预训练与Hyperball实验进行验证，最终据此设计新的学习率调度。
AI.result: 理论推导出的唯一最优调度随时域增长趋近线性衰减；在Hyperball实验中，线性LR衰减表现强劲、WSD表现较差，与分析预测一致；而在考虑参数范数动态后，可正确预测实践中Adam和Muon上WSD的强劲表现；所提出的新LR调度在Adam和Muon上优于既有的cosine与WSD调度。
AI.conclusion: 旋转动力学可作为理解、预测并指导LLM预训练学习率调度的有效工具，其理论预测与实验结果相互印证，并带来了实际更优的调度方案。

title: Frozen by the Mean: Early Temporal Guidance Unfreezes Motion in Video Diffusion Models
summary: Video diffusion models can render convincing frames while failing to produce the requested action. Increasing classifier-free guidance (CFG) can strengthen motion, but also saturates and shifts colors. Scalar CFG assigns the same coefficient to the averaged and frame-varying components of its prediction difference, limiting independent control of temporal variation. THAW, Temporal Harmonic Amplification during Warm-up, retains stock CFG and adds a separately weighted residual during an initial denoising window. Its dose specifies the added norm relative to the current CFG difference, giving the extra guidance a consistent relative budget across sampling steps. THAW is training-free and reuses CFG's two model predictions with an unchanged network evaluation count. It improves cost-matched motion over scalar and scheduled CFG on five video models, with positive point estimates against existing guidance methods on three of them. On VBench, THAW raises dynamic degree by about 14 to 15 points over stock CFG while increasing total scores on a different set of three models.

AI.tldr: THAW 是一种无需训练的引导增强方法：在去噪初期窗口内对 CFG 的帧变化分量单独加权，从而在不改变网络评估次数的前提下提升视频运动幅度。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型能生成逼真帧，但常无法呈现所要求的动作。提高 CFG 可增强运动，却会导致饱和与色彩偏移；且标量 CFG 对预测差分的均值分量与帧变化分量使用同一系数，无法独立控制时间变化。
AI.method: 保留原版 CFG，在初始去噪窗口内额外加入一个单独加权的残差（时间谐波放大）。新增引导的剂量定义为相对于当前 CFG 差分范数的比例，使额外引导在各采样步具有一致的相对预算。方法无需训练，复用 CFG 已有的两次模型预测，不增加网络评估次数。
AI.result: 在五个视频模型上，THAW 相比标量 CFG 和调度式 CFG 在同算力条件下取得更好的运动表现，其中三个模型相对现有引导方法点估计为正。VBench 上，THAW 在三个模型上使动态度相比原版 CFG 提升约 14–15 点，同时总分上升。
AI.conclusion: 将 CFG 差分中的帧变化分量解耦并仅在去噪初期按相对剂量放大，是一种低成本、即插即用的运动增强手段，可在提升动态度的同时保持或改善整体质量。

title: When Does Continual Pre-Training Help? An Empirical Study of Decoupled Knowledge and Generation Trajectories in Clinical LLMs
comment: EAccepted at EACL 2027 (Main Conference). 26 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables
summary: Continual pre-training (\textit{CPT}) is a standard route for domain adaptation, yet existing studies typically track pre-training loss or multiple-choice question answering (\textit{MCQA}) accuracy alone, offering only a narrow view of how adaptation unfolds. We jointly track factual knowledge via \textit{MCQA} and open-ended behavior via pairwise preference rankings across $18$ checkpoints for each of eight instruction-tuned \textit{Qwen} models ($0.5B$ to $8B$), adapted to German medicine with \textit{CPT} and \textit{SLERP} merging. The two axes converge at consistently different rates, with preference rankings reaching $90\%$ of their total gain after a median of $1.7B$ tokens versus $3.5B$ for \textit{MCQA}. A judge-free token-distribution measure reaches this threshold at $1.9B$ tokens. Per-aspect scores indicate that these early preference gains largely reflect surface alignment, meaning models can sound domain-appropriate before their factual knowledge catches up. Larger adapted models close more of the gap to unadapted next-tier generalists, whereas preference gain per FLOP falls by about an order of magnitude across our size range. We therefore argue that judge-based preference scores, which can plateau while \textit{MCQA} knowledge is still improving, should not be used alone to infer adaptation convergence or domain readiness.

AI.tldr: 该论文联合追踪持续预训练（CPT）中事实知识（MCQA）与开放式行为（成对偏好排序）两条轴，发现两者收敛速度显著不同，偏好分数易提前饱和且主要反映表层对齐，不应单独作为领域适应收敛或可部署的判断依据。
AI.motivation: 现有CPT研究通常只看预训练损失或MCQA准确率，视角狭窄，无法刻画领域适应过程中模型行为如何演变。作者希望用两条互补的评估轴更全面地理解适应动态，并检验"偏好分数提升即代表适应完成"这一隐含假设是否成立。
AI.method: 对8个指令微调Qwen模型（0.5B–8B）在德语医学领域做CPT并用SLERP合并，每个模型追踪18个检查点；同时测量MCQA事实知识、成对偏好排序（judge-based）以及一种无需judge的token分布度量，并做分方面（per-aspect）评分与FLOP效率分析。
AI.result: 两条轴收敛速率持续不同：偏好排序达到总增益90%的中位token数为1.7B，MCQA为3.5B；无judge的token分布度量在1.9B达到该阈值。分方面分数显示早期偏好增益主要来自表层对齐——模型能在事实知识跟上之前就"听起来"符合领域。更大的适应模型能缩小与上一档未适应通用模型的差距，但每FLOP的偏好增益在0.5B–8B范围内下降约一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 基于judge的偏好分数可能在MCQA知识仍在提升时就已经平台化，因此不应单独用于推断适应收敛或领域就绪度；应结合事实知识与无judge分布度量等多轴信号评估CPT进展。

title: MH-RAG-DIVE: Dynamic and Cost-Efficient Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via Tree-Cached Dialogue Simulation
comment: This preprint was accepted for presentation at the 19th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence (ICAART27)
summary: Quality assessment is essential for determining whether changes to a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system improve or maintain its performance. However, existing evaluation approaches often rely on single-turn or single-hop interactions and therefore do not capture the complexity of multi-hop, multi-turn conversations. We introduce MH-RAG-DIVE, a dynamic interactive user simulation framework designed to evaluate RAG systems in more complex multi-hop and multi-turn settings. The framework extends RAG-DIVE with a Context Discoverer, which identifies documents that can be combined to generate multi-hop questions within an ongoing conversation. To address the high computational cost of dynamic user simulation, we further introduce a Conversation Cacher, which reuses turns from previous evaluation runs while preserving the dynamic nature of the evaluation. We evaluate the framework across six distinct RAG configurations and compare its results with the original RAG-DIVE evaluation and the static, human-created CLAPNQ dataset. Our experiments show consistent performance trends across the evaluation approaches, while the more complex multi-hop and multi-turn setting exposes additional challenges for RAG systems. Furthermore, the Conversation Cacher substantially reduces token consumption, demonstrating its potential to make dynamic evaluation more cost-efficient. Finally, we apply MH-RAG-DIVE to an industrial RAG system with domain-specific data, demonstrating its applicability to real-world evaluation scenarios. Overall, our results show that the proposed approach provides a more complex and cost-efficient framework for evaluating RAG systems. All code and experimental data are publicly available in our GitHub repository (https://github.com/Daniel-Innsbruck/MH-RAG-DIVE).

AI.tldr: 提出 MH-RAG-DIVE，一个面向多跳、多轮对话场景的 RAG 动态交互式用户模拟评测框架，并引入 Conversation Cacher 降低评测成本。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 质量评估多依赖单轮或单跳交互，无法反映多跳、多轮对话的复杂性，难以真实判断系统改动是否带来性能提升。
AI.method: 在 RAG-DIVE 基础上扩展：1）Context Discoverer，识别可组合生成多跳问题的文档；2）Conversation Cacher，复用历史评测轮次同时保持动态性，以减少 token 消耗。在 6 种 RAG 配置上与原始 RAG-DIVE 及静态人工数据集 CLAPNQ 对比，并应用于工业域特定数据。
AI.result: 各评测方法性能趋势一致；更复杂的多跳多轮设置暴露出 RAG 系统的额外挑战；Conversation Cacher 显著降低 token 消耗；框架在工业 RAG 系统上验证可用。
AI.conclusion: MH-RAG-DIVE 提供了更复杂且更具成本效益的 RAG 评测框架，代码与数据已开源。

title: How Multi-Timescale Memory Cools Optimization: Theory and Evidence from AdEMAMix
summary: Augmenting AdamW with multiple momentum timescales improves large language model pretraining, yet the mechanism driving these gains remains poorly understood. We identify an interaction between multi-timescale optimizer memory and the geometry of normalized networks: memory changes parameter norms and thereby controls how fast parameters rotate. Starting from exact norm dynamics under decoupled weight decay, we show that the parameter norm depends on the temporal correlation of the updates, with weight decay controlling how long these correlations influence optimization. We show how an independently weighted slow momentum can substantially increase the norm of parameters, while contributing negligible power to the instantaneous update, therefore acting as an endogenous annealing schedule. We study this mechanism in AdEMAMix for language-model pretraining. Controlled interventions show that this scheduling mechanism has clear practical consequences and is an important factor behind AdEMAMix's advantage over AdamW.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示多时间尺度动量优化器（如AdEMAMix）优于AdamW的机制：慢动量通过增大参数范数、调节参数旋转速度，起到内源性退火调度作用。
AI.motivation: 多时间尺度动量增强AdamW能提升大语言模型预训练效果，但其增益背后的机制尚不清楚，本文旨在解释这一现象。
AI.method: 从解耦权重衰减下的精确范数动态出发，分析参数范数与更新时序相关性的关系；并设计受控干预实验，研究AdEMAMix中慢动量的作用。
AI.result: 发现多时间尺度优化器记忆与归一化网络几何之间存在交互；独立加权的慢动量显著增大参数范数，但对瞬时更新功率贡献甚微，因而充当内源性退火调度；受控实验表明该调度机制有明确的实用效果。
AI.conclusion: 该退火调度机制是AdEMAMix优于AdamW的重要因素，为理解多时间尺度动量优化器提供了理论解释。

title: Contrastive Gradient Guidance for Test-Time Multi-Preference Alignment of Diffusion Models
summary: Aligning pre-trained diffusion models with multiple context-dependent preferences requires adapting generation at test time rather than relying on offline fine-tuning, which requires hyperparameter tuning and a new training run for each preference trade-off. Existing approaches compress diverse preferences into a single scalar reward objective for fine-tuning or test-time guidance rather than directly reusing existing generative experts released for different purposes and obtained through different fine-tuning methods. In this work, we propose Contrastive Gradient Guidance (CGG), a test-time compositional generative framework that reformulates multi-preference alignment as a composition of distributions. CGG represents each preference as a contrastive preference pair of favored experts and unfavored anti-experts, whose score difference forms a contrastive gradient guidance signal that combines denoising directions (gradients) from off-the-shelf diffusion models during sampling. Experiments show that CGG reuses pre-trained and fine-tuned models as favored experts or anti-experts to control output style and safety, and that it can be combined with existing sampling-based reward guidance. With a single fixed scale per pair, CGG composes five preferences at once and gives a more balanced trade-off across text-image preference, concept control, photographic fidelity, and safety than offline fine-tuning, weight-space merging, and reward steering.

AI.tldr: 提出对比梯度引导(CGG)测试时组合框架，将多偏好对齐重构为分布组合，通过偏好/反偏好专家对的分数差形成引导信号。
AI.motivation: 多上下文相关偏好对齐需在测试时自适应，而非离线微调（需调参且每种偏好权衡都要重训）；现有方法将多样偏好压缩为单一标量奖励，无法直接复用不同目的、不同微调方式得到的现成生成专家。
AI.method: CGG将每个偏好表示为偏好专家与反偏好专家的对比对，其分数差构成对比梯度引导信号，在采样过程中组合现成扩散模型的去噪方向（梯度）。
AI.result: 复用预训练及微调模型作为专家/反专家以控制风格与安全，可与基于采样的奖励引导结合；每对固定单一缩放即可同时组合五种偏好，在文本-图像偏好、概念控制、照片保真度和安全性上取得比离线微调、权重空间合并、奖励引导更均衡的权衡。
AI.conclusion: CGG为多偏好对齐提供了无需重训的组合式测试时方案，有效复用现有专家模型并实现更均衡的多目标权衡。

title: Quantizing Diffusion LLMs under Parallel Decoding: Commitment Risk and the Parallelism Tax
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are served with accelerated decoders that cache context and commit, in one step, every masked position whose confidence clears a threshold. Yet post-training quantization of dLLMs has so far been calibrated and evaluated under fixed-step samplers without caching. We study W4A4 quantization under the deployed decoder and find that the decoder determines both where quantization harms accuracy and what it costs. Irreversible errors enter chiefly through forced commitments, made when no position clears the threshold: they are a minority of commitments but carry most quantization-induced flips. Quantization also levies a parallelism tax, extra forward passes per response: by compressing top logit gaps, it pushes positions below the threshold while leaving predictions largely intact. We propose DECAL, which reweights layer-wise calibration by a commitment-risk prior measured on the deployed decoder, and an argmax-preserving commit temperature that recovers the tax. On LLaDA and Dream, DECAL attains the best average accuracy among W4A4 methods, with lower run-to-run variance than the closest existing calibration method.

AI.tldr: 研究dLLM在部署解码器（缓存+阈值一步提交）下的W4A4量化，发现量化误差主要经"强制提交"进入，并带来"并行税"（额外前向次数）；提出DECAL，按承诺风险先验重加权逐层校准，并用保argmax的commit温度回收并行税，取得最优平均精度。
AI.motivation: 现有dLLM后训练量化在固定步数、无缓存的采样器下校准与评估，与真实部署的解码方式不符；需要研究部署解码器下量化在何处伤害精度、代价如何。
AI.method: 分析部署解码器（缓存上下文、阈值达标即一步提交）下W4A4量化的误差来源；提出DECAL：以部署解码器上测得的commitment-risk先验对逐层校准进行重加权，并引入保argmax的commit温度以降低并行税。
AI.result: 不可逆错误主要来自无位置达阈值时的强制提交——占少数提交却携带大部分量化导致的翻转；量化压缩top logit间隔导致更多位置低于阈值，造成额外前向的并行税。在LLaDA与Dream上，DECAL在W4A4方法中平均精度最优，且run-to-run方差低于最接近的现有校准方法。
AI.conclusion: 量化评估应贴合部署解码器；针对强制提交与并行税的针对性设计（风险重加权校准+保argmax commit温度）可在W4A4下兼顾精度与效率。

title: PseuDRAGON: Knowledge-Guided Local LLMs for Financial-Data Pseudonymization in Closed Networks
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as a full paper in the AI for Intelligent Financial Technologies (AIFT) track of the 42nd ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing (SAC 2027). Gwangui Hong and Seonho An contributed equally
summary: Staff pseudonymizing financial data in closed networks must interpret abbreviated column names, identify personal information, and choose processing methods. Local language models can assist, but may give different labels for the same input. PseuDRAGON keeps confirmed judgments and corrections outside a fixed model and reuses them through exact-name lookup and learned rules. For expert review, the workflow searches institutional policy, national privacy law, then international sources. Across 92 columns from one institution, rules increase reuse under the same approval checks from 75 to 83 labels without reuse errors when all training judgments are available. With 25% of the training judgments, withholding non-PII rules for unseen names eliminated the extra PII misses in replay at the cost of lower reuse. Revising or withdrawing approvals rebuilds derived rules, and tests on synthetic records verify that selected methods produce the specified outputs. In three paired runs, the history-first baseline cut automated identification time by 83.0% on average versus no reuse.

AI.tldr: PseuDRAGON 是一个将已确认判断与修正保存在固定模型之外、通过精确名称查找与学习规则复用的工作流，用于封闭网络中财务数据的列名消歧与PII识别。
AI.motivation: 金融数据脱敏人员需解读缩写列名、识别个人信息并选择处理方法；本地语言模型虽可辅助，但对相同输入可能给出不一致标签，缺乏可靠性与可复用性。
AI.method: 将确认的判断与修正存于模型外部并复用：精确名称查找＋学习规则；专家复核按机构政策→国家隐私法→国际来源的顺序检索；审批变更时重建派生规则；用合成记录测试验证方法输出。
AI.result: 92列数据中，同等审批检查下规则使复用从75增至83个标签且无复用错误（训练判断完整时）；仅用25%训练判断并拒绝为未见名称发放非PII规则，可消除回放中的额外PII漏判但复用率降低；三次配对运行中历史优先基线的自动化识别时间平均减少83.0%。
AI.conclusion: 外部化知识＋规则复用可提升脱敏标注效率与一致性，规则复用需以审批检查为约束、对未见名称谨慎发放非PII规则，并保证规则可随审批撤销而重建。

title: Aggregation Dispersion: An Information-Geometric Diagnostic of Oversmoothing in Graph Neural Networks
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) learn node representations by iteratively aggregating information from neighbors, but stacking too many layers causes all representations to converge, an effect known as oversmoothing. We propose a geometric perspective on this phenomenon. At each depth $k$, the propagation operator assigns to every node $v$ a walk distribution $p_v^{(k)}$, a probability distribution over source nodes. These walk distributions form a point cloud on the probability simplex, whose contraction to a single point characterizes complete mixing of the propagation operator, and thus oversmoothing. To measure this contraction, we use the Fisher-Rao metric, the unique Riemannian metric on the simplex invariant up to scale under sufficient statistics, whose scaled chordal distance under the square-root embedding $p \mapsto \sqrt{p}$ is the Hellinger distance. The resulting diagnostic, the aggregation dispersion $D_k$, is the variance of the embedded point cloud on the unit sphere. We prove that: (i) $D_k = 0$ if and only if the $k$-th step propagation matrix has rank one, a necessary and sufficient condition for complete operator mixing; (ii) $D_k$ is non-increasing with depth; (iii) the spectral gap of the propagation matrix controls the rate of this decay; and (iv) for contractive MPNNs, the aggregation dispersion upper-bounds the representation dispersion up to graph- and initialization-dependent constants. Across 14 model configurations and 11 datasets, $D_k$ attains the highest mean absolute Pearson correlation with test accuracy across depths among eight diagnostics ($|r| = 0.721$, using log-transformed diagnostic values), numerically comparable to the post-training effective rank ($|r| = 0.688$), while requiring no training.

AI.tldr: 提出用Fisher-Rao几何度量MPNN过平滑：定义"聚合离散度"D_k，证明其零值等价于传播矩阵秩一、随深度单调不增、受谱隙控制，并在14组配置11个数据集上无训练即达最优相关性。
AI.motivation: MPNN堆叠过多层会导致节点表示收敛（过平滑），但缺乏对传播算子混合过程的几何刻画与可解释的量化诊断。
AI.method: 将每层传播视为给每个节点分配的概率单纯形上的游走分布点云；用Fisher-Rao度量（平方根嵌入下Hellinger距离）衡量点云收缩，定义聚合离散度D_k为嵌入点云在单位球上的方差。
AI.result: 证明四条性质：(i) D_k=0当且仅当第k步传播矩阵秩一；(ii) D_k随深度单调不增；(iii) 谱隙控制衰减速率；(iv) 收缩型MPNN中D_k上界表示离散度。实验在11个数据集、14种配置上与测试准确率平均绝对Pearson相关|r|=0.721，优于8种诊断，与训练后有效秩(0.688)相当，且无需训练。
AI.conclusion: D_k是理论上严谨、计算高效、无需训练的过平滑诊断工具，为深度MPNN设计提供几何视角。

title: JevNavAgent: A Single-Forward Visual Navigation Agent with Trajectory-Level RL for Gigapixel Pathology
summary: Gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs) exceed single-pass vision-language model (VLM) capacity at cellular resolution, while multiple instance learning relies on query-agnostic offline patching without interactive reasoning. Multi-step VLM navigation agents inspect regions on demand, yet face two bottlenecks: (1) autoregressive action decoding incurs heavy latency, throttling exploration and online multi-trajectory RL; and (2) offline distillation suffers from an existential-versus-universal stopping asymmetry between positive detection and negative exclusion, inducing thumbnail and kinematic shortcuts while leaving policies prone to passing metastases without stopping. Under the Jev (System One) paradigm, a model predicts distributions over predefined decision spaces in one forward pass (0 generated tokens) while deterministic code executes navigation. We build JevNavAgent, a 2B-parameter agent combining factorized stopping, spatial-candidate, and contextual-bilinear answer heads with overview modality dropout. We pair Stage-1 offline counterfactual trajectory alignment (mitigating depth and panning shortcuts) with Stage-2 online trajectory-level GRPO (Traj-GRPO), using decoding-free rollouts to optimize branch-level lesion discovery, in-polygon stopping, and step-wise confidence gain. On Clean Visual WSI-VQA, JevNavAgent achieves 51.57% multi-scale (50.43% terminal-step) overall and 51.39% focal accuracy, outperforming frontier VLM agents and 4B-11B open-source cascades while running nearly 12x faster than frontier APIs (5.63s vs. 66.64-70.04s). On CAMELYON16 Official Test, Traj-GRPO reaches 22.45% localization (converting 11/12, or 91.7%, of visited tumors into grounded stops) with 93.75% specificity and 69.77% slide accuracy, surpassing Stage-1 SFT under matched stopping rules alongside zero-shot budget scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出 JevNavAgent，一个 2B 参数的全切片图像（WSI）导航智能体，采用"系统一"范式：单次前向直接预测动作分布（0 生成 token），用确定性代码执行导航，结合离线反事实轨迹对齐与在线 Traj-GRPO，在 WSI-VQA 上以近 12 倍速度超越前沿 VLM 智能体。
AI.motivation: 千兆像素 WSI 超出单次 VLM 容量，MIL 依赖与查询无关的离线切块、缺乏交互推理；多步 VLM 导航智能体虽可按需查看区域，但存在两大瓶颈：(1) 自回归动作解码延迟高，阻碍探索与在线多轨迹 RL；(2) 离线蒸馏存在"存在性 vs 普适性"停止不对称，导致缩略图与运动学捷径，策略易漏诊转移灶而不停止。
AI.method: 在 Jev（System One）范式下，模型一次前向预测预定义决策空间的分布（0 token 生成），由确定性代码执行导航。构建 2B 参数 JevNavAgent，含因子化停止头、空间候选头、上下文双线性答案头，并用概览模态 dropout。训练分两阶段：Stage-1 离线反事实轨迹对齐（缓解深度与平移捷径）；Stage-2 在线轨迹级 GRPO（Traj-GRPO），用无解码 rollout 优化分支级病灶发现、多边形内停止与逐步置信增益。
AI.result: Clean Visual WSI-VQA 上，多尺度总体 51.57%（终步 50.43%）、焦点准确率 51.39%，优于前沿 VLM 智能体与 4B–11B 开源级联，且比前沿 API 快近 12 倍（5.63s vs 66.64–70.04s）。CAMELYON16 官方测试集上，Traj-GRPO 达 22.45% 定位率（访问到肿瘤中 11/12，即 91.7% 转为有依据的停止），特异性 93.75%、切片准确率 69.77%，在相同停止规则下超越 Stage-1 SFT，并具备零样本预算扩展能力。
AI.conclusion: 去除自回归解码、改用单次前向的动作分布预测，可同时解决延迟与停止不对称两大瓶颈；离线反事实对齐加在线轨迹级 RL 的两阶段训练，使小规模（2B）智能体在精度与效率上均优于大型通用 VLM 级联，并具备可控的预算扩展性。

title: Does the Mixer Matter ? Paired-Seed Ablations of Tiny Bilingual Language Models
summary: We report paired-seed architecture ablations from the development of Sophea Artemis, our in-house Greek-English model family. Every arm trains on the same 3B targets with a shared tokenizer and recipe; models range from 54M to 759M total parameters and roughly 54M to 124M active parameters. The main finding is that, at this tiny scale, stored capacity matters far more than mixer design. On a fixed held-out test, replacing the dense feed-forward blocks of a recurrent/attention hybrid with sixteen routed experts, at nearly the same approximate active parameters, lowers loss by 0.079 (Greek) and 0.112 (English) nats per target, and doubling to 32 experts lowers it by a further 0.022 and 0.031, at every paired seed. Reusing a four-layer block three times recovers about 40-44% of the gap between a shallow and an independently deep model, consistent with looped-Transformer results. In contrast, the choice among grouped-query attention (GQA), Gated DeltaNet (GDN) hybrids and a Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) hybrid moves loss by only about 0.01-0.02 nats; a 1:1 GDN/GQA hybrid is the one dense variant that improves on GQA in both languages at every held-out seed. In bits per character, Greek and English held-out losses are similar despite a 74.49%/25.51% training split, and synthetic mathematics, which comes from a collection outside the training sources, is the hardest Greek test component and gains least from added experts. Cached decoding needs its own qualification: trained models passed cached-versus-full logit checks only under a fixed-reduction inference policy, which itself changes 1.4-2.8% of next-token argmax choices relative to native evaluation. All results are conditional on one recipe and scale.

AI.tldr: 在 54M–759M 小规模希腊语-英语双语模型上，存储容量（专家数）远比混合器设计（GQA/GDN/KDA）重要；路由专家显著降低loss，循环复用深度可部分弥补深度差距。
AI.motivation: 作者开发内部希腊语-英语模型家族 Sophea Artemis，希望在统一分词器与训练配方下，通过配对种子消融，厘清小规模下架构选择（混合器设计、存储容量、深度复用）对多语言性能的真实影响。
AI.method: 对 54M–759M 总参数（约 54M–124M 激活参数）的模型做配对种子架构消融，全部使用相同 3B token、共享分词器与配方；比较稠密FFN与16/32路由专家的循环/注意力混合架构，比较GQA、GDN混合、KDA混合，以及四层块复用三次的循环深度方案，并考察缓存解码的数值一致性。
AI.result: 用16个专家替换稠密FFN使loss在希腊语/英语分别降0.079/0.112 nats，增至32专家再降0.022/0.031，且每对种子一致；四层块复用三次可恢复浅层与独立深层间约40–44%的差距；混合器选择仅造成0.01–0.02 nats差异，1:1 GDN/GQA是唯一在两种语言所有held-out种子上均优于GQA的稠密变体；按字符计希腊语与英语held-out损失相近；合成数学是最难且受益最少的部分；缓存解码仅在固定归约策略下通过logit校验，该策略改变1.4–2.8%的argmax选择。
AI.conclusion: 在该规模与单一配方下，存储容量是主要性能杠杆，混合器设计影响很小；循环深度复用是有效折中；缓存解码需单独验证。结论受限于单一配方与规模。

title: mini-psych-agent: Evaluating Human-Like Behavior in LLM Agents through Interactive Psychological Environments
summary: A Large Language Model (LLM), its harness, and the test-time compute budget jointly determine its behavior. Consequently, the same underlying model, embedded in different agentic workflows or allocated different amounts of test-time compute, can exhibit markedly different performance. Psychologists face an analogous challenge when evaluating human performance: the same person may behave differently under different incentives and levels of deliberation. Psychological tasks therefore provide an ideal testbed for studying such behavioral variation. However, when adapted to LLMs, these tasks are typically text-transcribed, replaying fixed, language-rendered experiments as static prompts. This format is ill-suited to agent evaluation, where actions can alter future observations and task states. Conversely, although dynamic environments are prevalent in the evaluation of LLM agents, they rarely ask whether the resulting behavior is human-like. Here, we bridge this gap by transforming psychological tasks into dynamic environments in which agents can interact and by using a learned human-policy model to evaluate how compatible the resulting behavioral trajectories are with human behavior. Across these environments, we find that this compatibility varies with an LLM's agentic configuration and the psychological task, and that memory raises it mainly by making choices more predictable rather than more human-like. These findings motivate a more holistic evaluation of LLM agents in psychology-inspired environments, accounting for both the backbone model and its agentic scaffold.

AI.tldr: 作者将心理学任务改造为动态交互环境，并借助学习得到的人类策略模型评估LLM智能体行为轨迹与人类行为的兼容性。结果显示该兼容性随智能体配置与任务类型变化，而记忆模块主要提升可预测性而非拟人性。
AI.motivation: LLM的行为由其模型本体、运行框架（harness）与测试时计算预算共同决定，同一模型在不同agentic workflow或不同计算量下表现差异显著；心理学中"同一人在不同激励与深思程度下行为不同"提供了理想研究类比。但现有把心理任务迁移到LLM时多采用文本转写的静态提示，无法刻画动作改变后续观察与状态的agent场景；而动态环境评测又很少关注行为是否类人，故需弥合这一空白。
AI.method: 把心理学任务转化为智能体可交互的动态环境（动作会影响未来观测与任务状态），并用一个学习得到的人类策略模型（human-policy model）来度量LLM产生的行为轨迹与人类行为的兼容程度；在不同LLM、不同agentic配置与不同心理任务上进行对比，并单独分析记忆机制的影响。
AI.result: 行为与人类的兼容性随LLM的agentic配置和具体心理任务而变化；记忆（memory）提升兼容性，但主要是通过使选择更可预测，而非使其更像人类。
AI.conclusion: 对心理学启发式环境中的LLM智能体需采取更整体的评估方式，同时考虑骨干模型与其agentic scaffold；单纯加入记忆不等于更拟人，需区分"可预测性"与"人类相似性"两个维度。

title: Attacking Tabular Foundation Models: An Experimental Taxonomy of Context Poisoning and Test-Time Evasion
summary: Tabular foundation models condition predictions on labeled examples supplied at inference time, creating an attack surface that differs from conventional model training. We study four manipulation families (label flipping, backdoor context poisoning, clean-label context selection, and test-time evasion) and organize them by attack stage, label consistency, and distributional realism. TabPFN-2.5, TabICL, and XGBoost are evaluated on CIC-IDS2017 and N-BaIoT using a common preprocessing and evaluation pipeline. Backdoor context poisoning provides strong targeted control over the in-context models with little change in clean accuracy, whereas selecting real, correctly labeled boundary-crowding rows causes no systematic accuracy degradation up to a 20% bias fraction. A simplified surrogate-transfer constrained PGD attack inspired by, but not equivalent to, CAPGD also produces test-time evasion, outperforming equal-budget random noise in most settings. The comparison shows that attack effectiveness depends strongly on both where manipulation occurs and how much freedom the attacker has to alter the data.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了表格基础模型（TabPFN-2.5、TabICL）与XGBoost在推理期上下文操纵下的四类攻击，发现后门上下文投毒对上下文模型靶向控制最强，而真实边界样本选择在20%偏置下几乎不降低准确率。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型依赖推理时提供的带标签示例进行预测，形成与传统训练阶段不同的攻击面，而现有工作对这类模型的攻击系统比较不足。
AI.method: 提出四类操纵家族（标签翻转、后门上下文投毒、干净标签上下文选择、测试时逃逸），按攻击阶段、标签一致性和分布真实性组织；在CIC-IDS2017与N-BaIoT上，用统一预处理与评估管线比较TabPFN-2.5、TabICL和XGBoost，并采用受CAPGD启发但不等价的简化替代模型迁移约束PGD攻击。
AI.result: 后门上下文投毒能以极小干净准确率损失实现强靶向控制；选择真实且正确标注的边界拥挤样本，在偏置比例达20%时仍未造成系统性准确率下降；简化迁移PGD在多数设置下优于同等预算随机噪声。
AI.conclusion: 攻击有效性强烈依赖操纵发生的位置（上下文vs测试样本）以及攻击者修改数据的自由度，说明表格基础模型的安全性评估需区分攻击阶段与数据真实性约束。

title: AdapToC: A Unified Framework for Multi-Task Visual Token Communication
summary: Pretrained discrete visual tokenizers supply compact latents for synthesis, recognition, and embodied perception, yet wireless token streaming remains fragile. Under fading and noisy pilots, hard cyclic redundancy check (CRC) erasures turn corrupted blocks into missing tokens while frozen decoders amplify edge errors, which can collapse unequal error protection (UEP) into a binary choice between strong coding and omission under severe fading. Soft bit posteriors break this collapse. We present AdapToC, a single-pass transceiver that restores multi-tier rate-distortion tradeoffs without altering tokenizer weights or differentiating through pixel decoders. We align codebook geometry to the channel via offline frequency-weighted Pseudo-Gray relabeling and Halton dispersion to contract bit and burst errors with zero overhead. Because soft recovery pulls intermediate rates onto the three-tier convex hull, our unit-gated AdaLN sender schedules protection tiers across channel budgets, while our pilot-calibrated receiver feeds factorized codebook posteriors into a ConvNeXt-attention restorer with CRC bypass. We co-train AdapToC solely in latent space via counterfactual utility estimation and codebook cross-entropy regularization. On identical VQGAN-f16 tokens, AdapToC outperforms TONIC and adaptive TokenCom+AMC, cuts multi-SNR Rayleigh LPIPS from 0.6551 to 0.3312 within the frozen-tokenizer PSNR ceiling, and saves 43.8% Rician-K6 symbols at matched quality. Our single-pass restorer runs 8.3x faster than iterative resampling, raises accuracy while accelerating decoder-free recognition 20.6x, and improves fidelity plug-and-play across TiTok, VAR, and zero-shot NuPlan.

AI.tldr: AdapToC 是一个单次前向的无线视觉 token 传输收发器，利用软比特后验和三层级联保护调度，在冻结 tokenizer 下恢复多档率失真折衷，显著优于 TONIC 等基线。
AI.motivation: 预训练离散视觉 tokenizer 的无线 token 流传输在衰落与导频噪声下很脆弱：硬 CRC 擦除使坏块变缺失 token，冻结解码器放大边界错误，导致 UEP 退化为“强编码或丢弃”的二元选择。
AI.method: 离线做频率加权 Pseudo-Gray 重标注与 Halton 散布对齐码本几何（零开销）；利用软恢复把中间码率拉到三层凸包上；用单元门控 AdaLN 发送端按信道预算调度保护层级；导频校准接收端将因子化码本后验送入 ConvNeXt-attention 恢复器并支持 CRC 旁路；仅在潜空间用反事实效用估计与码本交叉熵正则联合训练。
AI.result: 相同 VQGAN-f16 token 下超过 TONIC 与自适应 TokenCom+AMC；多 SNR 瑞利 LPIPS 从 0.6551 降至 0.3312；Rician-K6 同质量省 43.8% 符号；单次恢复器比迭代重采样快 8.3x，识别精度提升且无解码器识别加速 20.6x；即插即用于 TiTok、VAR 与零样本 NuPlan。
AI.conclusion: 软后验+码本几何对齐+潜空间联合训练可突破退化 tokenizer 下的 UEP 瓶颈，实现高效、可迁移的单次传输。

title: From Rewarding What Models Say to How They Think: Attention Process Reward Model for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an important component in large language models (LLMs). However, existing RL approaches focus on final outputs or textual solution trajectories, leading to coarse-grained rewards and unreliable reasoning. Such paradigms focus mainly on what the model outputs while overlooking how the model internally reasons. Therefore, can we reward how a model thinks internally rather than merely what it says? We first reveal the problem of textual reward aliasing in existing reward modeling approaches. Motivated by this, we propose the Attention Process Reward Model (APRM), which assigns internal rewards based on hidden states and attention maps to capture high-quality reasoning patterns. With only approximately 46M parameters, APRM is trained using ranking and counterfactual objectives, and its reward guides RL optimization while being periodically updated to handle distribution shifts. Integrated with representative RL methods, APRM achieved an average pass@8 gain of 2.88\%. Our results demonstrate the promise of incorporating internal reasoning signals into RL for LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出注意力过程奖励模型APRM，用隐藏状态与注意力图对模型"内部思考"给予奖励，缓解文本奖励别名问题，平均提升pass@8 2.88%。
AI.motivation: 现有RL方法只奖励最终输出或文本推理轨迹，奖励粒度粗、易出现"文本奖励别名"（不同内部推理质量对应相同文本奖励），导致推理不可靠。
AI.method: APRM基于模型隐藏状态和注意力图计算内部过程奖励，仅约46M参数；用排序目标与反事实目标训练，奖励用于引导RL优化，并周期性更新以应对分布漂移。
AI.result: 与代表性RL方法结合后，pass@8平均提升2.88%。
AI.conclusion: 把内部推理信号引入LLM的RL训练具有潜力，奖励"怎么想"而非仅"说什么"是可行方向。

title: Trustworthy Speech-Based Autism Screening under Class Imbalance with Uncertainty-Aware HuBERT Ensembles
comment: Accepted version. To appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Early screening of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is critical for timely clinical intervention, although establishing reliable speech based screening systems remains problematic due to limited clinical data, class imbalance, and the need for reliable uncertainty estimation. We propose an uncertainty-aware ASD screening framework based on self-supervised HuBERT representations, combining Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) crossvalidation, balanced k-bagging, and Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout. Multiple HuBERT models are fine-tuned on balanced subsets, with predictions combined through probability-based ensemble averaging and aggregated at the subject level. Experiments on the Child Pathological Speech Database (CPSD) show strong performance, achieving 86.30% balanced accuracy and 93.74% ROC-AUC at the utterance level, and 95.04% and 96.30%, respectively, at the subject level. Furthermore, predictive entropy effectively reflects classification reliability: incorrectly classified segments show higher entropy than correctly classified ones (0.4605 $\pm$ 0.2314 vs. 0.1717 $\pm$ 0.1830), with a significant correlation with errors (r = 0.3981, p = 7.38 x 10 -170 ) and an error-detection ROC-AUC of 0.8359. These results demonstrate the potential of the proposed framework as a robust and uncertainty-aware computer-aided tool for ASD screening.

AI.tldr: 提出基于HuBERT自监督表征的不确定性感知ASD筛查框架，结合LOSO交叉验证、平衡k-bagging与MC Dropout，在CPSD数据集上取得句级86.30%平衡准确率和93.74% ROC-AUC，受试者级达95.04%和96.30%，且预测熵能有效反映分类可靠性。
AI.motivation: ASD早期筛查对及时临床干预至关重要，但基于语音的筛查系统面临临床数据有限、类别不平衡以及缺乏可靠不确定性估计等问题。
AI.method: 基于HuBERT自监督表征构建框架：多个HuBERT模型在平衡子集上微调，采用LOSO交叉验证、平衡k-bagging和MC Dropout，通过概率集成平均并结合受试者级聚合得到预测；以预测熵作为不确定性度量。
AI.result: CPSD数据集上句级平衡准确率86.30%、ROC-AUC 93.74%；受试者级分别为95.04%和96.30%。误分类片段熵显著高于正确分类片段（0.4605±0.2314 vs 0.1717±0.1830），熵与错误显著相关（r=0.3981, p=7.38e-170），错误检测ROC-AUC达0.8359。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可作为稳健且具备不确定性感知能力的计算机辅助ASD筛查工具，预测熵为分类可靠性提供有效依据。

title: How Seasonal Reference Choice Changes the Apparent Gains of Chronos Models in Electricity Load Forecasting
summary: When a forecasting model is said to beat a simple baseline, the size of that win depends on which baseline was used. We measure how much this matters for two zero-shot foundation models, Chronos-Bolt and Chronos-2, on hourly electricity load. The study uses 60 fixed cases drawn from eight series in four public collections, with forecasts 24 and 168 hours ahead and up to 2,048 hours of history. Each model is compared with daily persistence, weekly persistence, a weekday hybrid, a daily-weekly blend, and a reference chosen from these on a validation period. We keep every origin-level forecast and estimate uncertainty with paired circular block bootstrap intervals using 168- and 336-hour blocks. A week ahead, Bolt clearly beats weekly persistence in 21 of 30 cases but the validation-selected reference in only 14, and its median gain falls from 17.3% to 11.9%. For Chronos-2 the clear-win counts are 18 and 15. Chronos-2 has lower week-ahead MAE than Bolt in 24 cases, yet only 12 of those differences are clear. The selected reference is not always the harder baseline, since on some test windows it does worse than weekly persistence. The choice of baseline therefore changes both how large the reported gain is and how sure we can be of it. The results are exploratory: the series and windows are related, an earlier pilot was inspected, pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out, and the case-level intervals are not corrected for multiple comparisons.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了"基线选择"如何影响Chronos-Bolt与Chronos-2在小时电力负荷零样本预测中的优势幅度与显著性判定：对比简单持续性基线与验证集选出的参考基线后，显著胜出案例数和增益中位数均明显下降。
AI.motivation: 当声称预测模型"击败简单基线"时，胜出的幅度取决于所用基线，但这一基线选择的影响在基础模型评测中很少被系统度量。
AI.method: 选取4个公开集合中8条序列构成60个固定案例，预测步长24与168小时，历史最长2048小时；基线包括日持续性、周持续性、星期混合、日-周混合及验证期选出的参考基线；保留所有起点级预测，用168/336小时配对的循环块bootstrap估计不确定性。
AI.result: 168小时预测中，Bolt对周持续性在30例中21例明确胜出，但对验证参考基线仅14例，增益中位数由17.3%降至11.9%；Chronos-2对应为18例与15例。Chronos-2在24例中MAE低于Bolt，但仅12例差异明确。验证参考基线并非总更难，某些测试窗口甚至劣于周持续性。
AI.conclusion: 基线选择同时改变报告增益的大小与可信度。结论为探索性：序列与窗口相关、曾查看早期试点、无法排除预训练重叠、案例级区间未做多重比较校正。

title: Imagine Smarter, Drive Faster: Efficient World Modeling for Decision-Aware Autonomous Driving
comment: 23 pages total, 8 pages main text (4 figures, 8 tables), 12 pages supplementary material (9 figures, 5 tables)
summary: World models hold great promise for autonomous driving planning, yet their ability to imagine the future often comes at a formidable computational cost. Efficiency efforts, such as knowledge distillation and domain-specific pre-training, often shift this burden to costly teachers or training pipelines, leaving lightweight world modeling an open challenge. We introduce FastWorld, a natively lightweight world-model framework for efficient autonomous driving planning. FastWorld reduces computation through compact scene representations, short-horizon action-conditioned prediction, and selective candidate verification and score refinement. These designs support efficient future-informed planning without teacher distillation or additional domain-specific pre-training. On NAVSIMv1, FastWorld achieves 92.2 PDMS at 132 FPS on a single 4090 GPU. It also achieves 89.4 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2 and an average L2 of 0.40 over 3 seconds at 17 FPS on nuScenes. Code and models can be found at https://github.com/MoyangSensei/FastWorld.

AI.tldr: FastWorld 提出原生轻量的世界模型框架，通过紧凑场景表征、短时域动作条件预测和选择性候选验证，在无需教师蒸馏与额外预训练的情况下实现高效自动驾驶规划。
AI.motivation: 世界模型虽有利于自动驾驶规划，但想象未来计算代价高昂；现有提效手段（知识蒸馏、领域预训练）把负担转移给昂贵教师或训练流程，轻量世界建模仍是难题。
AI.method: 采用三项设计：紧凑场景表征、短时域动作条件预测、选择性候选验证与分数精修，从而在无蒸馏、无额外领域预训练下实现未来信息引导的高效规划。
AI.result: NAVSIMv1 上单张 4090 达 92.2 PDMS、132 FPS；NAVSIMv2 上 89.4 EPDMS；nuScenes 上 3 秒平均 L2 为 0.40，17 FPS。
AI.conclusion: FastWorld 证明轻量世界模型可在保持高性能的同时大幅提升规划效率，且不依赖教师蒸馏或额外预训练，代码与模型已开源。

title: Empirical Margin Sensitivity: An Interventional Neuron-Level Probe of Post-Trained Medical LLMs
summary: Medical post-training raises benchmark accuracy, but accuracy does not show which internal components a model's decisions depend on, or whether components that support one benchmark also support another. We apply the weight-space intervention paradigm of ROME and MEMIT at the granularity of one MLP down-projection column. Our measurement, Empirical Margin Sensitivity (EMS), replaces each coordinate magnitude of a column by its mean while preserving the column's sign pattern and L1 scale, and records the resulting change in the logit margin between the correct option and its hardest-wrong competitor. This isolates the margin's dependence on a column's fine-grained coordinate structure while the column stays in place. We discover high-EMS columns (anchors) on MedQA in ten public checkpoints (four general-purpose bases and six medical post-trained variants) across the Gemma, Llama, Qwen, and AFM families, and measure the same columns on MedMCQA and PubMedQA. Mean-ablating each discovered anchor set lowers MedQA accuracy in all six post-trained models, by 6 to 28 points. In the two pure-SFT checkpoints, crushing anchors raises the PubMedQA margin on correctly answered items (negative EMS), and anchors with this property sit significantly deeper than the same model's other anchors; the four checkpoints trained with RL or mixed recipes show positive PubMedQA EMS and no significant depth shift. The depth association recurs in each of three held-out checkpoints. Because the checkpoints differ in data and pipeline as well as objective, we report these as per-checkpoint observations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出经验边际敏感度(EMS)指标，在单个MLP下投影列的粒度上对医学微调检查点做权重空间干预，发现高EMS"锚点"列；消融这些锚点使MedQA准确率下降6–28分，且纯SFT模型的锚点在PubMedQA上呈负EMS并显著更深，而RL/混合训练模型无此深度偏移。
AI.motivation: 医学后训练提升了基准准确率，但准确率无法揭示模型决策依赖哪些内部组件，也无法说明支撑某一基准的组件是否同样支撑另一基准，因此需要组件级别的测量方法。
AI.method: 沿用ROME/MEMIT的权重空间干预范式，细化到单个MLP下投影列：EMS将列中各坐标幅值替换为均值，同时保持符号模式与L1尺度，记录正确选项与最难错误竞争者之间logit margin的变化，从而在列保持原位的情况下隔离边际对其细粒度坐标结构的依赖。在MedQA上对Gemma、Llama、Qwen、AFM四个家族的10个检查点（4个通用基座、6个医学后训练变体）发现锚点，并在MedMCQA、PubMedQA上测同一批列。
AI.result: 均值消融每个锚点集使全部6个后训练模型的MedQA准确率下降6–28分。两个纯SFT检查点中，破坏锚点会提高正确答案项上的PubMedQA边际（负EMS），且这类锚点显著深于同模型其他锚点；四个使用RL或混合配方的检查点则呈正PubMedQA EMS、无显著深度偏移，该深度关联在3个留出检查点中重复出现。
AI.conclusion: EMS提供了一种检查点级别的组件敏感性测量，可区分不同训练目标下锚点的跨基准行为；由于各检查点在数据与流程上也存在差异，作者仅将这些作为逐检查点的观察性结果报告，而非因果结论。

title: Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics for Spatiotemporal Parameter-Update Application in Deep Learning
summary: Standard neural network training typically applies optimizer-generated update signals to model parameters at every iteration. This work introduces a spatiotemporal view of parameter updating and proposes Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics (EPD), which separates candidate-update generation from their application through an intermediate state with accumulation, event-triggered release, and reset. In a canonical coordinate-wise instantiation, accumulation produces temporal integration, release imposes a spatial budget, and reset separates successive inter-release intervals, while conventional dense updating is recovered as a boundary case. Across four model--optimizer configurations on CIFAR-100, EPD maintains final performance close to conventional training even when only a small fraction of coordinates are released at each step, including the 1\% regime. Matched-control experiments further show that temporal accumulation, state-dependent selection, and post-release reset each contribute to the observed behavior. Together, these results identify parameter-update realization as a controllable dimension of optimization and provide a concrete basis for studying its temporal and spatial organization separately from candidate-update generation.

AI.tldr: 提出事件驱动的参数动态（EPD），将"候选更新生成"与"更新施加"分离，通过累积-事件触发释放-重置的中间状态机制，在仅释放少量坐标（低至1%）时仍保持接近常规训练的最终性能。
AI.motivation: 标准训练在每个迭代都把优化器生成的更新信号施加到全部参数上，参数更新的"实现方式"本身未被当作可调控维度研究。作者希望从时空视角重新审视参数更新，把更新的时间组织与空间组织独立出来考察。
AI.method: 提出EPD框架：在候选更新生成与应用之间引入中间状态，包含累积、事件触发释放与重置三个环节。以逐坐标的典型实例化实现：累积形成时间积分，释放施加空间预算，重置分隔相邻释放区间；常规稠密更新作为边界情形被涵盖。在CIFAR-100上对四种模型-优化器组合进行实验，并做匹配对照实验（消融时间累积、状态依赖选择、释放后重置）。
AI.result: 四种模型-优化器配置下，即使每步仅释放很小比例坐标（包括1%情形），EPD的最终性能仍接近常规训练。匹配对照实验表明，时间累积、状态依赖选择与释放后重置各自对观察到的行为有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 参数更新的"实现"是可控制的优化维度；EPD提供了将更新的时间与空间组织同候选更新生成分离研究的 concrete 基础，为稀疏化/事件驱动训练提供新视角。

title: One Checkpoint, Four Converters: Per Input Disagreement After On Device Conversion and a Probe Set That Catches It
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Also archived on Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24433993
summary: A model converted for on device or accelerated inference ships once its top 1 accuracy matches the source model. Accuracy can match while individual decisions change, and the converter, its INT8 recipe and its calibration draw each move them. We convert 5 public checkpoints (four ImageNet classifiers and a sentiment model) with the documented FP32 and INT8 recipes of ExecuTorch, LiteRT, ONNX Runtime and TensorRT and compare every top 1 decision with the PyTorch source on 7,854 images and 1,938 sentences. All 34 strict FP32 conversions reproduce every decision, yet each of the 4 vision INT8 recipes that keeps accuracy equivalent flips more than 1% of decisions: ONNX Runtime static INT8 flips 4.07% (95% CI [3.65, 4.53]) of ResNet 50 decisions while accuracy moves by -0.15 points, and two builds of that recipe from different calibration draws disagree on 3.44% [3.06, 3.88]. Where accuracy is kept, the flipped inputs are the ones the source model barely decides (AUROC of the source margin 0.90 to 0.97 on ResNet 50, every 95% CI inside [0.89, 0.98]), but our preregistered claim that this holds for every recipe fails on the two mobile networks, where INT8 breaks accuracy outright. A probe set of the 200 training inputs with the smallest source margin, chosen before any conversion, flags all 40 vision stacks (recall 95% CI [0.91, 1.00]) and all 6 text stacks that flip at least 0.5% of decisions and none of the exact FP32 conversions, so conversion checks should compare decisions on such a probe set, not accuracy.

AI.tldr: 模型转换（尤其INT8量化）在top-1准确率持平时仍会翻转超过1%的个体决策，转换验证应比较决策一致性而非准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前模型转换流程仅以top-1准确率匹配作为发布标准，但准确率相同不代表逐样本决策一致；转换器、INT8配方与校准输入都会影响个体决策，这在实际部署中可能被忽视。
AI.method: 用ExecuTorch、LiteRT、ONNX Runtime、TensorRT的官方FP32与INT8配方转换5个公开检查点（4个ImageNet分类器+1个情感模型），在7,854张图像与1,938句文本上逐样本对比PyTorch源模型的top-1决策，并进行校准抽样一致性比较与预注册的margin分析。
AI.result: 34个严格FP32转换均完全复现决策；4个保持等效准确率的视觉INT8配方均翻转超1%决策（如ONNX Runtime静态INT8在ResNet-50上翻转4.07%，准确率仅-0.15点；不同校准抽样间不一致率达3.44%）。翻转样本集中于源模型margin很小者（ResNet-50上margin的AUROC 0.90–0.97），但该规律在两个移动网络（INT8准确率直接崩坏）上不成立。预注册的200条最小margin训练探针集可召回全部40个翻转≥0.5%的视觉栈（95% CI [0.91, 1.00]）与全部6个文本栈，且不误报任何精确FP32转换。
AI.conclusion: 转换检查应使用最小margin探针集上的决策一致性测试，而非仅比较准确率；该探针集成本低且检出率高，可作为量化发布门禁。

title: Where Does a Weight-Editing Agent Help? Blind Diagnosis and Repair of Deployment Faults in Vision Models
summary: Language-model agents can read and edit the weights of neural networks without gradients, and this is increasingly presented as a new way of repairing models. We ask what such an agent adds, in a setting with a known answer. A vision model moved into a new system may be broken by a preprocessing, weight-conversion or output-convention fault; an agent restricted to forward passes must decide whether a fault exists, name it, and undo it by editing the weights. Over 183 runs on classification, segmentation and detection, scored against the fault-free model, we find three things. When the kind of fault is known, the agent is not needed: a script written afterwards repairs 30 of 48 faults against the agent's 33. But the agent did not have to be told: on five fault types outside every script it repairs 15 of 15 where that script repairs 4, and it never edits any of 21 fault-free models. And its limits are predictable: it needs a trustworthy per-layer reference for the model's activations and a fault that is an invertible structured transformation; without them, small faults are missed and repairs stay partial. We derive guidance on when to use an agent and when a script.

AI.tldr: 论文在"有已知答案"的受控设定下，考察语言模型智能体通过无梯度权重编辑修复神经网络的能力，并与人工编写的脚本进行对比。
AI.motivation: 当前有大量工作宣称语言模型智能体能"无梯度地读取和编辑网络权重"来修复模型，但究竟这类智能体相比传统脚本有多大增量价值并不清楚。作者希望在故障类型、正确答案都已知的可控场景中，量化这种"智能体修复"到底带来了什么。
AI.method: 构造一个视觉模型迁移到新系统后被预处理、权重转换或输出约定故障破坏的场景；智能体只能做前向推理，需要判断是否存在故障、命名故障并通过编辑权重撤销故障。在分类、分割、检测三类任务上共进行 183 次运行，并以无故障模型为基准打分；同时与事后编写的人工脚本进行对照。
AI.result: 三点发现：(1) 已知故障类型时智能体并非必需——脚本修复 48 个故障中的 30 个，智能体修复 33 个；(2) 但智能体无需被告知故障类型——在脚本从未见过的 5 种故障类型上，智能体修复 15/15，而脚本仅修复 4 个；且智能体从不误改 21 个无故障模型；(3) 其局限可预测——需要可信的逐层激活参考，以及故障必须是可逆的结构化变换，否则会漏检小故障、修复不彻底。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了何时应使用智能体、何时应使用脚本的指导原则：当故障类型已知且可脚本化时应优先用脚本，而当故障类型未知、需要泛化时智能体更有价值；其能力边界可由"是否有可信参考"和"故障是否可逆结构化"来预判。

title: Learn the Effects, Not the Examples: Implicit ICL via Attention Patching
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to adapt to new tasks from demonstrations, but repeatedly including multiple examples increases context length and inference cost. Many existing implicit ICL methods encode demonstrations as fixed vectors, limiting adaptation of the intervention to individual queries and token positions. We propose Attention-Patching, an implicit ICL method that models contextual changes in self-attention outputs through task-specific updates to attention output projections. Using query-answer pairs processed with and without a fixed demonstration set, Attention-Patching fits layer-wise affine transformations from non-contextual attention representations to the demonstration-induced output changes. Across 12 classification benchmarks and four model families, Attention-Patching achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated implicit ICL baselines while maintaining performance comparable to explicit ICL at near zero-shot inference cost. Further experiments on diverse generation tasks demonstrate its applicability to autoregressive multi-token generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Attention-Patching，一种隐式上下文学习（ICL）方法：通过层级的仿射变换，把无示例时的注意力输出表示映射到有示例时的输出变化，从而在近零样本推理成本下达到接近显式 ICL 的性能。
AI.motivation: 显式 ICL 需重复拼接多个示例，导致上下文变长、推理成本上升；现有隐式 ICL 方法把示例编码为固定向量，无法针对每个查询和每个 token 位置自适应地调节干预。
AI.method: 使用带固定示例集与不带示例的查询-答案对，逐层拟合从“无上下文”注意力表示到“示例诱导的输出变化”的仿射变换，即对注意力输出投影施加任务特定的更新，实现查询与位置相关的动态干预。
AI.result: 在 12 个分类基准、4 个模型家族上，平均准确率高于所评估的隐式 ICL 基线，并与显式 ICL 性能相当，而推理成本接近零样本；在多种生成任务上的实验表明其同样适用于自回归多 token 生成。
AI.conclusion: Attention-Patching 通过注意力输出层级仿射补丁有效替代显式示例拼接，兼顾性能与效率，并可扩展到生成任务。

title: Cost-Sensitive Reversibility of Non-Deterministic Actions
summary:
Determining action reversibility requires checking whether the effects of an action can be undone. Recent work has extended reversibility to fully observable non-deterministic (FOND) planning. It distinguishes weak reversibility, where reversal may succeed, from strong-cyclic reversibility, where reversal is guaranteed under fairness. These notions are qualitative: they say whether reversal is possible, but not how costly it is.
  We introduce cost-sensitive reversibility for non-deterministic actions. Given positive action costs, we define weak and strong reversal budgets, $k$-bounded reversibility, and a distinction between finite strong reversal and strong-cyclic reversal with unbounded worst-case cost. We relate the resulting notions in a reversibility lattice, prove cost-aware policy-merging results, and show how to compute restricted weak and strong universal uniform reversal budgets using cost-optimal classical planning and worst-case-optimal FOND search, respectively. We also give an admissible lower-bound test for rejecting $k$-bounded reversibility. These notions support finer-grained safety decisions: a small finite strong budget bounds recovery cost, whereas a small weak budget certifies only a cheap possible recovery path. Actions without an acceptable strong bound may therefore warrant human approval, as in tool-using agent systems.

AI.tldr: 该文将动作可逆性从定性推广到代价敏感的非确定性规划，定义弱/强反转预算、k-有界可逆性与有限强反转，构建可逆性格，并给出计算方法与下界测试。
AI.motivation: 现有 FOND 规划中的弱可逆与强环可逆是定性概念，只说明反转是否可能，不反映反转代价，无法支撑细粒度安全决策（如工具型智能体需评估恢复代价）。
AI.method: 在正动作代价下定义弱与强反转预算、k-有界可逆性，以及有限强反转与代价无界的强环反转的区分；将各概念组织成可逆性格；证明代价感知的策略合并结果；分别用代价最优经典规划与最坏情况最优 FOND 搜索计算受限的弱/强通用一致反转预算；并给出可采纳下界测试以拒绝 k-有界可逆性。
AI.result: 建立了代价敏感可逆性理论框架（含可逆性格与策略合并性质），给出两类预算的可计算算法，并提出可采纳的下界拒绝测试。
AI.conclusion: 小的有限强预算可界定恢复代价上界，小的弱预算仅证明存在廉价可能的恢复路径；缺乏可接受强界时应引入人工审批，适用于工具使用型智能体等安全敏感场景。

title: Exact on Paper: Which LLM Serving Shortcuts Flip Graded Answers, Measured Against the Noise of Reordering the Same Requests
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Also archived on Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24433980
summary: Teams enable serving features such as prefix caching, chunked prefill and speculative decoding after checking that benchmark accuracy is unchanged, because the engine documents them as exact. Accuracy is an aggregate, so a feature can hold it while flipping which requests are answered correctly. We serve one 4B instruction model in vLLM under nine single feature configurations and five replicas of a reference configuration, grade 3,380 requests from five benchmarks in every run, and compare each candidate with a restart floor (fresh process) and a scheduling floor (same requests in a different order). With default kernels every configuration keeps accuracy within one point, and the seven exact features flip the graded outcome of 1.47% (95% CI 1.13 to 1.85) to 1.78% (1.39 to 2.20) of requests, none above the scheduling floor of 1.72%, while the FP8 KV cache flips 3.36% (2.80 to 3.96), as many as FP8 weights.
