With batch invariant kernels all seven exact features, speculative decoding included, reproduce the reference text on every request, while the FP8 KV cache still flips 3.91% (3.28 to 4.53) of graded outcomes. A gate that compares against a single replica pair rejected an unchanged configuration, so we recommend certifying a serving change under batch invariant kernels, where the floor is zero, or against a scheduling floor measured from at least three replicas.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示"精度不变"的聚合指标会掩盖推理服务功能导致的逐请求结果翻转，建议在batch invariant kernels下认证服务变更，或以至少三个副本测得的scheduling floor为基准。
AI.motivation: 团队依赖benchmark整体准确率不变来验证prefix caching、chunked prefill、speculative decoding等推理服务功能，但准确率是聚合指标，可能掩盖具体哪些请求的判定被翻转，导致验证方式不可靠。
AI.method: 在vLLM中服务一个4B指令模型，测试9种单功能配置及参考配置的5个副本，每次运行对5个benchmark的3380个请求评分；与restart floor（新进程）和scheduling floor（不同请求顺序）对比；并比较默认kernel与batch invariant kernel下的表现。
AI.result: 默认kernel下所有配置准确率差异在1个百分点内；7个"精确"功能翻转1.47%–1.78%的判定结果，均不超过scheduling floor的1.72%；FP8 KV cache翻转3.36%，与FP8 weights相当。使用batch invariant kernels时7个精确功能（含speculative decoding）完全复现参考文本，但FP8 KV cache仍翻转3.91%判定。
AI.conclusion: 单副本对比较的门禁会误拒未变更配置；建议在batch invariant kernels下（floor为零）认证服务变更，或基于至少三个副本测得的scheduling floor进行验证。

title: 3DCodeFactory: Scaling Training Data for 3D Code Agents
summary: As code agents evolve, their scope is expanding from generating simple static 3D meshes to constructing structurally complete, complex, interactive 3D scenes. However, existing datasets mainly rely on converting or captioning pre-existing 3D assets, consisting mostly of single-turn code data for static single objects and struggling to scale task diversity and scene complexity, leaving such training data scarce. We present 3DCodeFactory, an automated framework that directly constructs diverse, complex 3D training data from abundant raw text (e.g., diffusion prompts and product descriptions). The framework first leverages an image generator to synthesize 3D reference images from raw text as visual anchors, guiding the generation of concrete modeling specifications and interactive functional requirements; meanwhile, it jointly constructs visual, specification, and functional rubrics from the reference images and requirements to automatically score and filter multi-turn agent rollouts. Based on this framework, we release 3DCodeFactory-Data, comprising 5,045 high-quality task instances and multi-turn interaction trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B on 3DCodeFactory-Data significantly improves performance on BlenderWorld, P3D-Bench, and 3DCodeBench, consistently outperforming models trained on existing open-source 3D code datasets, with our 27B model further surpassing the same-series 2.4T flagship Qwen3.8-Max in overall performance.

AI.tldr: 3DCodeFactory：从原始文本自动构建复杂交互式3D场景代码的多轮训练数据框架，并发布5,045实例数据集，微调后模型超越同系列旗舰。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体的任务范围已从生成简单静态3D网格扩展到构建结构完整、复杂、可交互的3D场景。但现有数据集多基于对已有3D资产做转换或描述，以静态单物体的单轮代码数据为主，任务多样性与场景复杂度难以扩展，导致此类训练数据稀缺。
AI.method: 提出自动化框架 3DCodeFactory：1）先用图像生成器从大量原始文本（扩散提示、商品描述）合成3D参考图像作为视觉锚点；2）由参考图引导生成具体建模规格与交互功能需求；3）联合构建视觉、规格、功能三类评分标准（rubrics），自动对多轮智能体 rollout 打分与筛选。据此发布 3DCodeFactory-Data 数据集。
AI.result: 数据集含5,045个高质量任务实例及多轮交互轨迹。在 Qwen3.5-9B 与 Qwen3.8-27B 上微调后，在 BlenderWorld、P3D-Bench、3DCodeBench 上显著提升，稳定优于用现有开源3D代码数据集训练的模型；27B 模型整体性能超过同系列2.4T旗舰 Qwen3.8-Max。
AI.conclusion: 以"文本→参考图→规格/功能需求→多维度rubric自动打分"的合成流水线，可低成本规模化生产复杂交互式3D场景代码的多轮训练数据，且数据质量带来跨基准的一致增益，小模型亦可超越超大旗舰模型。

title: Synthetic Twins: Closing the Gap Between TTS Test Sets and Real Recordings in Turkish ASR Evaluation
summary: Speech synthesized by text-to-speech engines is a low-cost substitute for recorded test sets in automatic speech recognition, yet an off-the-shelf synthetic test set is worth only a few dozen real recordings for estimating the real error rate of a recognizer. This paper examines which properties of real recordings are missing from synthetic speech and how much of the gap can be closed. For 507 Turkish Common Voice recordings, synthetic twins are built: a ladder of synthetic copies that adds, one factor at a time, the pitch of the speaker, a clone of the same speaker, the real recording channel and the speaking rate. At each step, the agreement between ASR behaviour on the copy and on the real recording is measured. Across three zero-shot cloning engines and panels of six and 19 recognizers, the speaker clone is the step that improves agreement on which sentences are hard, raising the Spearman correlation from .41 to .55 for Chatterbox. Matching the channel or adding generic noise corrects the error level when the synthetic speech is easier than real speech. The twin with the highest worth is equivalent to 70 to 122 real recordings, depending on the recognizer panel, compared with about 9 for a stock voice. The findings replicate on VoxForge, a second corpus in which speaker identity is known rather than inferred: the clone raises sentence agreement from .31 to .50 and the worth from 8 to about 50 recordings. Agreement on which sentences are hard is distinct from agreement on how hard they are. The paper concludes with a practical recipe and a reporting checklist for synthetic ASR test sets.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过构建"合成孪生"阶梯实验，逐项加入说话人音高、说话人克隆、真实信道与语速，检验哪些真实录音属性是合成测试集缺失的关键，发现说话人克隆最能提升ASR评估一致性。
AI.motivation: TTS合成语音是录制测试集的低成本替代品，但现成合成测试集对估计识别器真实错误率的价值仅相当于几十条真实录音，因此需要弄清楚真实录音的哪些属性在合成语音中缺失、以及差距能弥补多少。
AI.method: 对507条土耳其Common Voice录音构建合成孪生阶梯：逐一（1）加入说话人音高、（2）使用同一说话人的克隆、（3）真实录音信道、（4）语速。每一步测量合成副本与真实录音上ASR行为的一致性。实验覆盖三个零样本克隆引擎，以及6个和19个识别器两组面板；并在VoxForge语料（说话人身份为已知而非推断）上复现。
AI.result: 说话人克隆是提升"哪些句子难"一致性最有效的一步，Chatterbox的Spearman相关从.41升至.55；匹配信道或加入通用噪声可在合成语音更简单时校正错误水平。最优孪生相当于70–122条真实录音（视识别器面板而定），而现成声音仅约9条。VoxForge上克隆使句子一致性从.31升至.50、价值从8条升至约50条。
AI.conclusion: "哪些句子难"的一致性不同于"难度有多大"的一致性。论文给出构建合成ASR测试集的实用配方与报告清单。

title: DMC-5: Dual-Model Collaboration with Cache-aware Context Compression for Long-horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents repeatedly feed an ever-growing interaction trajectory to a specialized agent model. Prefix caching reuses computation over repeated history, but cannot prevent context growth or remove information irrelevant to the current decision. This is especially costly when the specialized agent lacks the cached-input discounts available to general-purpose models, making trajectory compression a natural alternative. However, existing compression methods on selective context risk losing global information, recursively rewriting summary leads to semantic drift, while repeatedly recompressing the full history shifts the growing cost to the compressor. Therefore, we introduce DMC-5 (Dual-Model Collaboration with CaChe-aware Context Compression), an asymmetric framework that assigns full-history integration to a general compression model and action generation to a specialized agent model. DMC-5 maintains the raw trajectory as an Append-only Canonical View, preserving global access while allowing the compressor to reuse a stable historical prefix instead of recursively rewriting or recomputing prior context. The agent operates only on a compact Decision View with recent raw interactions, reducing repeated input while retaining the information needed for the next action. DMC-5 further incorporates YAMATO (integritY-Aware Memory Abstractions for Tool Operations) to preserve execution-critical information during lossy compression. Experiments on AppWorld, OfficeBench, and 8-objective QA show that DMC-5 reduces agent model input by 38.5-57.0% and end-to-end cost by 14.5-28.0% with 78.0-85.0% compressor cache-hit rates, while improving task performance by 1.0-5.8% over the uncompressed baseline.

AI.tldr: DMC-5提出一种双模型协作框架，用通用压缩模型做全历史整合、专用智能体模型做动作生成，结合缓存感知的上下文压缩与完整性感知的记忆抽象，在降低输入与成本的同时提升任务性能。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体反复输入不断增长的交互轨迹，前缀缓存虽能复用历史计算，却无法阻止上下文膨胀或剔除无关信息；专用模型缺乏通用模型的缓存输入折扣，代价更高。而现有压缩方法存在丢失全局信息、递归改写导致语义漂移、重复压缩全历史把成本转移给压缩器等问题。
AI.method: 提出非对称框架DMC-5：将全历史整合交给通用压缩模型，动作生成交给专用智能体。维护只追加的原始轨迹规范视图（Append-only Canonical View）以保留全局访问，并让压缩器复用稳定历史前缀而非递归改写或重算；智能体仅在含近期原始交互的紧凑决策视图上运行。另引入YAMATO（工具操作完整性感知记忆抽象）在有损压缩中保留执行关键信息。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、OfficeBench和8目标QA上，DMC-5将智能体模型输入降低38.5-57.0%、端到端成本降低14.5-28.0%，压缩器缓存命中率达78.0-85.0%，同时较未压缩基线任务性能提升1.0-5.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过双模型职责分离与缓存感知的压缩视图设计，DMC-5在减少输入与成本、避免语义漂移与信息丢失之间取得平衡，并能实际提升长程任务表现。

title: CrysLDM: Latent Diffusion Model for Crystal Material Generation
summary: Generating new crystal materials with desirable chemical properties has long been a challenging task. Existing diffusion models operate in feature space, requiring complex diffusion architectures to model the joint distribution of atom types, coordinates, and lattice structures. This complexity increases the number of diffusion steps, leading to higher training and sampling costs. In this work, we aim to generate novel crystal materials within a time- and resource-constrained setup, where existing models are not well-suited. To address this, we propose CrysLDM, a novel latent diffusion model for 3D crystal materials, which integrates a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model. The VAE encoder maps 3D crystal structures into a latent space, where the diffusion model operates. Since CrysLDM leverages a smooth, lower-dimensional latent space, it simplifies the generative process and accelerates both training and inference. Through extensive experiments on benchmark datasets and tasks, we show that CrysLDM generates stable and valid materials with quality comparable to state-of-the-art methods, while being significantly more efficient in terms of computational resources and time.

AI.tldr: CrysLDM 是一种面向 3D 晶体材料的潜在扩散模型，通过 VAE 将晶体结构映射到低维光滑潜空间，再在潜空间中做扩散，从而在保证生成质量的同时显著提升训练与采样效率。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在特征空间直接建模原子类型、坐标与晶格的联合分布，需复杂架构且扩散步数多，导致训练和采样成本高，难以在时间与算力受限的场景下生成新材料。
AI.method: 提出 CrysLDM：结合变分自编码器与扩散模型。VAE 编码器将 3D 晶体结构压缩到低维光滑的潜空间，扩散模型在该潜空间中进行生成，从而简化生成过程并加速训练与推理。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集和任务上的实验表明，CrysLDM 能生成稳定且有效的材料，质量与当前最优方法相当，同时在计算资源和时间上显著更高效。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散过程迁移到晶体结构的低维潜空间，是兼顾生成质量与效率的有效途径，适用于资源受限条件下的新材料生成。

title: ArgsWorld: Unifying 3DGS Scene Reconstruction, Generation and Extrapolation with Autoregressive Diffusion Transformer
summary: Autoregressive diffusion world models deliver strong video generation performance, yet they typically output only RGB frames rather than explicit 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene representations, creating a gap between learned visual world dynamics and usable 3D assets for downstream robotics, simulation and rendering. To bridge this gap, we introduce ArgsWorld, an autoregressive diffusion model that also produces an explicit 3DGS scene. For each generation chunk, the diffusion transformer jointly processes clean historical image latents and noisy latents for new views. It keeps the historical image latents fixed and refreshes the scene features so that the Gaussian representation can be revised as new regions come into view. Our 3D Self-Forcing Distillation trains the model on its own generated histories using a mixture of single-view and multi-view data. Distribution matching supervises direct image latents and latents of Gaussian renderings at both generation and additional cameras. ArgsWorld unifies 3D scene reconstruction from posed images, scene generation from image or text prompts, and scene extrapolation across camera segments with disconnected endpoints. Experimental results demonstrate that ArgsWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple 3D scene modeling tasks. Project page: https://m4a1tastegood.github.io/ArgsWorld/

AI.tldr: ArgsWorld是首个能同时输出RGB帧和显式3DGS场景的自回归扩散世界模型，通过3D自强制蒸馏实现SOTA的3D场景建模。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归扩散世界模型只输出RGB帧，缺乏显式3DGS表示，导致学习的视觉世界动态与下游机器人、仿真、渲染所需3D资产之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出ArgsWorld自回归扩散模型：每个生成块中扩散Transformer联合处理干净历史图像潜变量与新视角噪声潜变量，固定历史潜变量并刷新场景特征以逐步修正高斯表示；采用3D自强制蒸馏（Self-Forcing Distillation），混合单视图与多视图数据在自生成历史上训练，并对直接图像潜变量及高斯渲染（含额外观测相机）潜变量做分布匹配监督。
AI.result: 统一了基于位姿图像的3D重建、图像/文本提示的场景生成、以及端点不连通相机段之间的场景外推，在多项3D场景建模任务上达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: ArgsWorld打通了视频世界模型与可用3D资产之间的桥梁，既能生成高质量视频又能产出显式3DGS场景，具备多任务统一能力。

title: Hard to Translate, Harder to Detect: Human Analysis Remains Essential in AI Meme Translation
comment: 39 pages, 1 figure, 21 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23504282; code: https://github.com/olzama/hard-to-find
summary: We present a dataset and evaluation setup for a problem in creative machine translation: translating culturally loaded passages that carry much of a text's meaning and humor that may depend on subtle or implicit discourse. We study Soviet comedy quotations that function as memes in Russian-language communication. Off-the-shelf difficulty estimators do not find these passages; current models searching the web find most but not all of them, but their own analyses of the difficulty do not help translation as well as a human-validated one. Given a brief human-validated analysis of why each passage is difficult, older models improve modestly; the strongest current translators (GPT-6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5) improve more, and in human evaluation GPT-6 Sol comes close to the approved references on most films. Newer models have thus become much better at using such an analysis while still not reliably producing it themselves. We release (1) a dataset of five films' Russian subtitles with their audience-selected culturally salient passages, human-validated analyses, and reference translations (into English, Galician, and Spanish), together with every full-film LLM translation and evaluation produced in this study; and (2) an item-level MQM-style evaluation protocol that measures translator and evaluator noise to set the number of runs the evaluation needs, and whose automatic version tracks human judgment of these passages, which reference-free neural metrics do not, whether they score the whole text or the passages alone.

AI.tldr: 本文针对"文化负载、依赖隐微话语的幽默段落"这一创造性机器翻译难题，以苏联喜剧引用语（在俄语交流中充当梗）为对象，构建了数据集与评测协议。研究发现现有难度估计器无法识别这类段落，模型自行分析的效果不如人工验证的分析；给出人工验证分析后，新模型（GPT-6 Sol、Claude Opus 5.5）提升明显，GPT-6 Sol 人工评价接近参考译文。作者发布了五部影片的俄语字幕数据集（含受众选出的文化关键段落、人工验证分析、英/加利西亚语/西语参考译文及全部整片翻译与评测），以及一套 MQM 式条目级评测协议。
AI.motivation: 文化负载段落承载了文本大量意义与幽默，且幽默常依赖微妙或隐性的语篇信息，通用难度估计器难以识别此类难点，现有模型虽能找到大部分这类段落，但其自生成的分析对翻译帮助有限，缺少相应数据集与可复现的评测方法。
AI.method: 选取五部苏联喜剧中充当网络梗的引用语作为研究对象；收集俄语字幕并由受众选出文化显著段落，提供人工验证的难点分析与英、加利西亚语、西班牙语参考译文；对多种模型（含老旧模型与 GPT-6 Sol、Claude Opus 5.5）在"无分析/模型自分析/人工验证分析"条件下进行整片翻译与评测；设计条目级 MQM 式评测协议，通过测量译者与评测者噪声来确定所需运行次数，并提供可追踪人工判断的自动版本。
AI.result: 现成难度估计器无法找出这些段落；模型结合网络检索能找出大部分但非全部，其自生成难度分析助益不如人工验证分析。给定人工验证分析后，较旧模型小幅提升，最强翻译模型提升更大，人工评价中 GPT-6 Sol 在多数影片上接近通过审核的参考译文。自动版 MQM 协议能追踪人工判断，而无论整篇还是仅段落打分的无参考神经指标均无法做到。
AI.conclusion: 新模型已大幅提升"利用"难度分析的能力，但仍不能可靠地自行产出此类分析。作者发布数据集与评测协议，为创造性机器翻译中文化负载难点的研究与评测提供基准。

title: TamperCert: A Benchmark for Detecting Text Tampering in Degree Certificates
summary: Degree certificates play a critical role in high-stakes decisions such as university admission, immigration, and hiring. The issuing institution vouches for the holder, so a forged certificate may let its bearer pass these checks. Degree certificate forgery is increasingly prevalent. Yet, many assume that it is easy to spot. Reported cases show otherwise: in 2024, the business school of the University of Hong Kong found that about 30 master's students had enrolled with forged academic credentials. Few studies have looked at how to detect forged degree certificates, partly because public benchmarks are scarce. We present TamperCert, a benchmark built from 400 real degree certificates issued by 38 universities. Each certificate was subjected to 11 publicly available tampering methods to alter the holder's name and further processed with four additional post-processing techniques, resulting in over 20,000 forged images. We evaluate 13 detectors, a commercial multimodal large language model (MLLM), and detectors trained on TamperCert.Our findings reveal that no detector is reliable for every tampering method. Consequently, a determined forger may still evade detection. Moreover, the commercial MLLM misses most forgeries made by general-purpose generative models, and post-processing, such as resizing an image or photographing it with a camera, severely degrades detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TamperCert，一个由 400 份真实学位证书、38 所大学、11 种篡改方法及 4 种后处理构成的伪造检测基准（超 2 万张伪造图像），并评估 13 种检测器及商用多模态大模型。结论是：没有检测器对所有篡改方法都可靠，通用生成模型伪造与后处理是主要漏洞。
AI.motivation: 学位证书用于录取、移民、招聘等高风险决策，伪造现象日益普遍且大众误以为易于识别（如 2024 年港大商学院约 30 名硕士生持伪造学历入学）。但相关检测研究很少，主要原因是缺乏公开基准。
AI.method: 构建 TamperCert 基准：采集 38 所大学签发的 400 份真实学位证书，对每份证书使用 11 种公开可得的篡改方法修改持证人姓名，并叠加 4 种后处理技术，生成 20,000+ 张伪造图像。在该基准上评估 13 种检测器、一个商用多模态大模型，以及用 TamperCert 训练的检测器。
AI.result: 没有任何检测器对所有篡改方法都可靠，有决心的伪造者仍可逃避检测；商用 MLLM 漏检了大多数由通用生成模型制造的伪造；缩放图像、用相机翻拍等后处理会严重降低检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 学位证书伪造检测尚无可靠通用方案，现有检测器与商用 MLLM 均存在明显盲区。TamperCert 为后续研究提供了公开基准，并指出真实场景后处理与通用生成模型伪造是亟需攻克的难点。

title: Towards Global Counterfactual-Based Self-Explainable Graph Neural Networks
summary: Graph Counterfactual Explanations (GCEs) have emerged as an effective approach for interpreting Graph Neural Network (GNN) predictions by identifying minimal graph modifications needed to change predictions. However, existing methods suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) They rely on a post-hoc explanation paradigm, where a separate explainer is trained after the GNN. This sequential optimization prevents the explainer from leveraging how the GNN learned its representations, often resulting in lower-quality explanations. (2) They are largely local, generating counterfactual explanations only for individual samples. Consequently, they fail to capture generalizable patterns across the data distribution, a crucial gap for applications like drug discovery, where global principles enable systematic decision-making across thousands of cases. To address these limitations, we propose GCSGNN (Global Counterfactual-based Self-explainable GNN), a unified framework that integrates counterfactual generation into the GNN architecture, encouraging explanations that faithfully reflect the model's decision-making process. Beyond local explanations, GCSGNN discovers shared latent patterns influencing predictions across graphs, yielding global (i.e., model-level) counterfactual explanations. We further introduce an efficient latent-space counterfactual mechanism that avoids the combinatorial complexity of discrete graph manipulation, enabling scalable discovery of generalizable modification patterns. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that GCSGNN outperforms existing methods in generating effective counterfactual explanations. Our code is available at https://github.com/wendyzheng22/gcsgnn.

AI.tldr: 提出GCSGNN，将反事实生成融入GNN架构，同时利用潜空间机制实现可扩展的全局（模型级）反事实解释。
AI.motivation: 现有图反事实解释存在两大局限：一是事后解释范式，解释器在GNN训练后单独训练，无法利用GNN的表征学习过程，解释质量较低；二是多为局部解释，仅针对单个样本，无法捕捉跨数据分布的普适模式，难以满足药物发现等需要全局规律的应用。
AI.method: 提出统一框架GCSGNN，把反事实生成整合进GNN架构中，使解释忠实反映模型决策过程；通过发现跨图的共享潜模式生成全局（模型级）反事实解释；并引入高效的潜空间反事实机制，避免离散图操作的组合爆炸，实现可扩展的普适修改模式发现。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上大量实验表明，GCSGNN在生成有效反事实解释方面优于现有方法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: GCSGNN通过自解释架构与潜空间反事实机制，统一了局部与全局图反事实解释，兼顾解释忠实性与可扩展性，为跨样本的系统性决策提供了新思路。

title: Inference Dynamics: Image Classifiers Keep Using Visual Cues After They Are Removed
summary: Image classifiers are typically evaluated by their final predictions, treating inference as a static image-to-label mapping. Reliability, however, also depends on whether a model can relinquish evidence after that evidence disappears. We reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: removing a local visual cue from its original location may not remove its influence on the prediction. Once captured by early layers, the cue can become distributed across later representations, making ``no longer visible'' different from ``no longer relied upon.'' We introduce Inference Dynamics, a process-level framework for tracing how cue influence evolves and remains withdrawable across network depth. Given an image and a matched cue-removed reference, we replace cue-aligned states in the original branch with their reference counterparts at successive layers and measure recovery toward the cue-free prediction. The resulting trajectory separates evidence locality from decision-level withdrawability. Across datasets and architectures, we find locality declines before withdrawability collapses: cue-induced information becomes less concentrated at its original support while its effect remains active, before entering an evidence lock-in stage. Consequently, fixed late-stage correction may alter the final readout without removing accumulated cue dependence. We therefore propose Evidence Reset, which selects an input-dependent layer before lock-in and reconstructs cue-aligned states toward their cue-free counterparts. Our results establish evidence withdrawability as a process-level dimension of classifier reliability and suggest a new intervention principle: correction depth should follow the dynamics of evidence rather than be fixed in advance.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了一个反直觉现象：移除图像中的局部视觉线索并不等于模型不再依赖它，因为线索一旦被早期层捕获就会扩散到后续表征中。作者提出"Inference Dynamics"框架追踪线索影响的演化，发现局部性先衰退、可撤销性后崩塌，并据此提出"Evidence Reset"干预方法。
AI.motivation: 传统图像分类器评估只看最终预测，将推理视为静态的图像到标签映射。但可靠性还取决于模型能否在证据消失后放弃对该证据的依赖。作者发现"不再可见"与"不再被依赖"是两回事，因此需要从过程层面刻画证据影响如何随网络深度演化与保留。
AI.method: 提出 Inference Dynamics 过程级框架：给定原图与匹配的去除线索参考图，在逐层将原分支中线索对齐的状态替换为参考分支的对应状态，并测量预测向无线索预测的恢复程度，得到一条轨迹，从而区分证据的局部性与决策层面的可撤销性。基于发现，提出 Evidence Reset：在锁定发生前选择输入相关的层，将线索对齐状态向无线索对应状态重构。
AI.result: 在多个数据集与架构上发现：局部性先于可撤销性衰退——线索信息在原始支撑区域变得不那么集中，但其影响仍然活跃，随后进入"证据锁定"阶段。因此固定的晚期纠正可能改变最终读出，却无法消除已累积的线索依赖。而 Evidence Reset 在锁定前进行输入自适应的纠正效果更好。
AI.conclusion: 论文将"证据可撤销性"确立为分类器可靠性的过程级维度，并提出新的干预原则：纠正深度应遵循证据的动态演化，而非预先固定。

title: CocoonBench: Can Multilingual Search Agents Escape Language Information Cocoons?
summary: Multilingual search agents can access the global Web, yet may remain trapped in a language environment with insufficient evidence; we refer to this failure as a language information cocoon. However, existing search benchmarks largely operate within a single language, especially English, overlooking entity connections across multiple languages. We introduce CocoonBench, a benchmark that evaluates whether multilingual search agents can escape such language information cocoons. CocoonBench mines answer-centered relational paths from a frozen Wikidata-derived graph and selects clue sets that are individually necessary and jointly identify a unique answer. Using language-specific entity names, it records each task's minimum language cover, removes direct identifiers, and renders each task as matched prompts in three languages together with its construction certificate and provenance. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, mean accuracy on CocoonBench ranges from 33.8% (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) to 69.7% (Claude-Opus-4.8), leaving even the strongest system below 70%. The same construction certificates support path-aligned trajectory analysis, enabling diagnosis of model failures in language routing, evidence-path recovery, and answer use. The result shows that escaping a language cocoon requires more than switching languages: successful cross-lingual search depends on both covering the correct languages and connecting the evidence found across them.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CocoonBench 基准，用于评估多语言搜索智能体能否摆脱"语言信息茧房"，即因语言环境证据不足而失败的问题。
AI.motivation: 多语言搜索智能体虽能访问全球网页，但往往仍被困于单一语言环境中、证据不足，形成"语言信息茧房"；而现有搜索基准多局限于单一语言（尤其英语），忽视跨语言的实体关联。
AI.method: 从冻结的 Wikidata 衍生图谱中挖掘以答案为中心的关系路径，筛选"各自必要、联合唯一确定答案"的线索集；使用语言特定的实体名记录每个任务的最小语言覆盖，去除直接标识符，并以三种语言的匹配提示呈现任务，附构建证书与溯源信息。
AI.result: 在 10 个先进模型上，CocoonBench 平均准确率从 33.8%（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）到 69.7%（Claude-Opus-4.8），最强系统仍低于 70%。构建证书还支持路径对齐的轨迹分析，可诊断模型在语言路由、证据路径恢复和答案使用上的失败。
AI.conclusion: 摆脱语言茧房不仅仅是切换语言：成功的跨语言搜索既需要覆盖正确的语言，也需要将跨语言发现的证据连接起来。

title: HWRE-Bench: Can LLM Agents Understand Hardware They Did Not Design?
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Work in progress
summary: Hardware benchmarks for LLM agents all run the design flow forward, from a specification to RTL, a layout or a bug fix. We ask the reverse question: given an implemented artifact, such as a layout, a gate-level netlist or a protected simulation model, can an agent work out what it does well enough to act on that knowledge? We introduce HWRE-Bench, a benchmark for agentic hardware reverse engineering built on one observation. Each step of the forward flow discards information (names, hierarchy, word-level structure, generator parameters, the programming model), and a reverse-engineering task asks the agent to recover what was lost and to prove it with an executable deliverable that the artifact alone cannot supply. Since layout extraction is now mechanical and a correct netlist is already a cycle-exact model, every task carries a mandatory copy-the-netlist control that must score zero. HWRE-Bench spans five tracks (Extract, Abstract, Audit, Interoperate, Modify), four information-loss levels and white- versus black-box access, all on original designs. We report a pilot of 148 rollouts from two agents on four seed tasks under 16 conditions, with stage-annotated trajectories. Agents built their own layout extractors and audited a sanitized layout as reliably as a netlist, at about 27% more turns. Keyless, equivalence-preserving obfuscation changed neither pass rates nor defect-repair scores. Whether agents read the structure at all depended on task framing rather than on necessity, so pass rate alone does not show understanding. Provider safety filters stopped 16% of one agent's runs on the audit tasks. These results argue for deliverables beyond equivalence and for reporting run validity explicitly.

AI.tldr: 提出 HWRE-Bench，一个面向"逆向"硬件任务的智能体基准，按信息丢失层级与黑白盒访问组织五类任务，并强制设置"复制网表"对照项。
AI.motivation: 现有硬件基准都是正向设计流程（规格→RTL/版图/修复），缺少"给定已实现产物，智能体能否推断其功能并据此行动"的逆向问题评估。
AI.method: 基于"正向流程每步都丢失信息（命名、层次、字级结构、生成参数、编程模型）"的观察设计基准：五条轨道（Extract、Abstract、Audit、Interoperate、Modify）、四个信息丢失等级、白盒/黑盒条件，全部使用原创设计；每个任务附带必须得零分的复制网表控制项；在四个种子任务上收集两个智能体、16种条件下的148条带阶段标注的轨迹。
AI.result: 智能体能自建版图提取器，审计去标识版图的可靠性与网表相当但多约27%轮次；无密钥的保等价混淆既未改变通过率也未改变缺陷修复得分；智能体是否真正读取结构取决于任务表述而非必要性，故通过率无法体现理解；某智能体16%的审计运行被服务商安全过滤中断。
AI.conclusion: 硬件逆向智能体评估应采用超越等价性的交付物指标，并显式报告运行有效性（如被过滤中断的比例）。

title: Loop-Count Schedules in Looped Transformers: An Empirical Study
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/kvoyager/gatedloop-transformer. Trained weights and per-token traces: https://huggingface.co/konstank/gatedloop-transformer
summary: Looped transformers apply one block of layers several times with shared weights, trading parameters for repeated computation. We study how the schedule of the loop iteration count R during training determines whether each extra pass acts as a full layer or as a small correction, using a controlled ladder of 46M-110M-parameter models trained on 2B tokens with learned residual gates on every loop pass and three schedules: R fixed to 2, R sampled uniformly from {1,...,6}, and R sampled from {2,3,4}. We find that the lower bound of the sampling range is the decisive choice. If the sampled range includes R=1, so that some training steps run the block only once and compute the loss on that single pass, the gates collapse to 0.1-0.5 and each additional pass becomes a small correction to the first; if the range starts at R=2, so that every training step runs the block at least twice, the gates stay at 0.6-0.9 and each pass keeps the strength of a full layer, while the model can still be run at any R from 2 up to twice the largest trained value with validation loss within a few hundredths of a nat of its best. The {2, 3, 4} schedule gives the best looped model, 2.909 nats against 2.951 for the parameter-matched plain model, and degrades by only 0.038 nats when run at twice its trained depth. We further show that under a fixed R the direction of the residual stream converges geometrically beyond the trained depth while the loss diverges, which refines a recent finding that static-depth training does not converge, and that reusing the first pass's keys and values on later passes costs 0.01-0.03 nats in every regime while making the per-token iteration uniformly contractive and halving the inference cache. The loop recovers about a third of what real depth provides at equal parameters. The code, trained weights, and per-token traces are released.

AI.tldr: 在循环Transformer中，训练时循环次数R的采样区间下界决定额外前向是“完整一层”还是“小修正”：区间含R=1时门崩至0.1-0.5，从R=2起时门保持0.6-0.9，且{2,3,4}调度取得最佳效果，训练后可在更宽的R范围内稳健运行。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer用重复计算换参数，但训练时循环次数R的调度如何影响每一遍前向的作用（是完整层还是小修正）尚不清楚，作者希望系统地搞清这一点，并评估循环相对真实深度的收益。
AI.method: 训练46M/110M参数、2B token的模型阶梯，每个循环遍带可学习残差门，比较三种调度：R固定为2、R从{1,...,6}均匀采样、R从{2,3,4}采样；并分析固定R下超出训练深度时残差流方向与损失的行为，以及后续遍复用首遍key/value的影响。
AI.result: {2,3,4}调度给出最佳循环模型：2.909 nats，对比参数匹配的普通模型2.951 nats；在双倍训练深度下仅退化0.038 nats。含R=1时门塌缩至0.1-0.5、每遍只是小修正；从R=2起门保持0.6-0.9、每遍仍具完整层强度，且可在R=2到最大训练值两倍范围内运行，验证损失与最优值相差仅百分之一nats级别。固定R时，超出训练深度后残差流方向几何收敛但损失发散，修正了“静态深度训练不收敛”的近期结论；复用首遍K/V在各设定下代价0.01-0.03 nats，但使逐token迭代一致收缩并将推理缓存减半。循环在等参数下约恢复真实深度的三分之一收益。
AI.conclusion: 循环训练的关键超参是采样区间下界而非上界：至少两遍训练才能让门保持高值、使额外遍接近完整层；该调度既提升性能又支持测试时加深，同时揭示了超出训练深度时方向收敛与损失发散并存的现象，并给出K/V复用的低成本近似。

title: NavDecision: Parallel Multi-Step Action Prediction with Persistent Self-Referential Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires timely decisions based on instructions and visual observations. However, autoregressive VLN models generate action descriptions token by token, introducing substantial inference overhead. Decision models offer an efficient alternative but face challenges in maintaining short-horizon action coherence and long-horizon goal alignment. To address these challenges, we propose NavDecision, an efficient multi-step VLN decision model. We introduce parallel multi-step action prediction (PMAP) to predict multiple action distributions from a shared vision-language state, and memory-augmented self-referential policy optimization (M-SRPO) to learn from unsuccessful trajectories using successful trajectories as references. A cross-iteration success memory further accumulates historical successful trajectories to provide informative training feedback. NavDecision achieves success rates of 64.60% on R2R-CE and 64.57% on RxR-CE with a 4B backbone. Compared with existing autoregressive VLN methods, it delivers significant inference speedups of up to $22.28\times$ and $18.96\times$ while maintaining comparable navigation performance.

AI.tldr: 提出高效多步VLN决策模型NavDecision，通过并行多步动作预测与记忆增强自参考策略优化，在保持导航性能的同时实现最高22.28倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 自回归VLN模型逐token生成动作描述带来巨大推理开销；直接用决策模型虽高效，但难以兼顾短时动作连贯性与长时目标对齐。
AI.method: 1) Parallel Multi-step Action Prediction (PMAP)：从共享视觉-语言状态并行预测多个动作分布；2) Memory-Augmented Self-Referential Policy Optimization (M-SRPO)：以成功轨迹为参考，从失败轨迹中学习；3) 跨迭代成功记忆：累积历史成功轨迹以提供训练反馈。
AI.result: 4B骨干下R2R-CE成功率64.60%、RxR-CE 64.57%；相比自回归VLN方法推理加速最高达22.28倍和18.96倍，性能相当。
AI.conclusion: NavDecision证明非自回归的多步决策范式可在VLN中兼顾效率与性能，为实时导航部署提供可行方案。

title: Automated Call for Action: RAG-Based Environmental Law Enforcement Screening System
summary: Environmental law inspectors face a structural issue in identifying potential violations from data: they often do not have the capacity to deal with large volume of data present in the emission events. This paper examines to what extent an LLM-based system can support evidence assembly and permit-based screening of such events, using the coke plants of a steel producer and a regional environmental service as a case. A simple puff-trajectory model aligns air quality measurements, weather and citizen complaints with each emission event. A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline then retrieves facility-specific permit conditions and generates event reports and a period report with an investigation recommendation. Across 74 events from March 2025, plant-aware re-ranking reduced reports citing the other plant's conditions from 58.1% (hybrid retrieval) to 0% by rule-based plant labels, while maintaining high RAGAS and LLM-judge metrics. GPT-5-mini performed comparably to GPT-5.1, whereas GPT-5-nano scored lower on legal grounding and legal faithfulness. In an evidence ablation, removing air quality (AQ) data changed judge scores and period recommendations most; citation overlap changed only slightly under any removal, and removing complaint details had no measurable effect. This suggests a need for rules and guidelines that link complaints to incidents and permit conditions, so that community reports can count as evidence. The results support screening of events that may need further investigation. Design implications for involving environmental service experts are derived.

AI.tldr: 本文构建基于LLM的系统，用烟羽轨迹模型对齐空气质量、气象与投诉数据，再用RAG检索企业排污许可证条件并生成排放事件报告，帮助环境执法者筛查疑似违规事件。
AI.motivation: 环境执法人员面对海量排放事件数据时缺乏处理能力，难以从数据中识别潜在违规，需要辅助筛查与证据组装工具。
AI.method: 以某钢铁企业焦化厂及区域环境服务机构为案例：用简单烟羽轨迹模型将空气质量监测、天气与公众投诉对齐到各排放事件；再用RAG管道检索设施特定许可证条件，生成事件报告与含调查建议的周期报告；并进行模型对比（GPT-5-mini/5.1/nano）与证据消融实验。
AI.result: 2025年3月74起事件中，基于规则工厂标签的重排序将引用他厂条件的报告从58.1%（混合检索）降至0%，同时保持较高RAGAS与LLM评判指标；GPT-5-mini与GPT-5.1表现相当，GPT-5-nano在法律依据与法律忠实度上较低；消融显示移除空气质量数据影响最大，引用重叠变化不大，移除投诉细节无可测影响。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对需进一步调查的事件进行筛查，并提示需制定规则与指南把投诉与事件、许可证条件关联，使社区报告可作为证据；论文还给出让环境服务专家参与的设计启示。

title: Learning-Augmented QUBO for Time-Expanded Multi-Commodity Flow
summary: We study energy-aware multi-commodity flow on time-expanded graphs, a problem that captures dynamic routing in layered networks and is NP-hard in general. We formulate the problem as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problem, give an explicit penalty coefficient that provably guarantees feasibility, and show that it is smaller than the standard bound by a factor of roughly the number of active links. The layered structure of the time-expanded graph yields three structural results: a treewidth bound that gives a fixed-parameter tractable exact algorithm in the bag size, a matrix-product-operator representation of small bond dimension, and a proof that the annealing gap of the associated Ising Hamiltonian is strictly positive for every instance with a unique optimum, uniformly over bounded windows. For learning-augmented routing, we bound the Hamming distance between a predicted and an optimal flow by the flow error, and prove a consistency guarantee: a hybrid algorithm that keeps the better of the prediction and the solver output returns a flow whose cost exceeds the optimum by a factor that grows linearly with the prediction error. The results are exact statements about the QUBO and its associated Ising Hamiltonian, and they hold for any physical implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文将时间扩展图上的能量感知多商品流问题建模为QUBO，给出保证可行性的显式惩罚系数（比标准界小约"活跃链路数"倍），并利用分层结构得到treewidth界、低键维MPS表示和正退火间隙等结构结果，同时给出学习增强路由的Hamming距离界与一致性保证。
AI.motivation: 能量感知多商品流在时间扩展图上刻画分层网络动态路由，但一般情形为NP难，需要既保证可行性又尽量紧的QUBO/Ising形式化，并理解其可解性结构，以便与量子退火等物理实现及学习增强路由结合。
AI.method: 将问题表述为二次无约束二值优化（QUBO），推导可证明保证可行性的显式惩罚系数并与标准界比较；利用时间扩展图的分层结构给出treewidth界（关于bag大小的FPT精确算法）、小键维矩阵乘积算子（MPS）表示，并证明唯一最优时Ising哈密顿量退火间隙在有限窗口上一致严格为正；对学习增强路由，用流误差界定预测流与最优流的Hamming距离，并分析取预测与求解器较优者的混合算法的一致性。
AI.result: 惩罚系数比标准界小约活跃链路数倍且仍保证可行性；得到关于bag大小的FPT精确算法、小键维MPS表示，以及唯一最优情形下退火间隙严格为正的结构性结论；学习增强方面给出Hamming距离上界，并证明混合算法代价超出最优的倍数随预测误差线性增长。
AI.conclusion: 这些关于QUBO及其Ising哈密顿量的结论是精确的，且对任意物理实现均成立，为时间扩展图上的能量感知多商品流提供了更紧的形式化、结构可解性与学习增强路由的理论保证。

title: HighwayVerse: A Chain-of-Inspection Benchmark for Highway Infrastructure Anomaly Understanding
summary: Practical highway infrastructure inspection entails progressive diagnostic reasoning from visual perception to maintenance decisions, yet existing benchmarks remain confined to isolated tasks, leaving Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) insufficiently evaluated across sequential inspection stages. Meanwhile, current datasets focus primarily on highway pavement defects, falling short of real-world inspection across diverse infrastructure components such as highway pavements, guardrails, glare screens, and drainage systems. To address these gaps, we formulate the Highway Infrastructure Inspection Progression Chain (HIIP-Chain), spanning Anomaly Detection, Anomaly Recognition, Condition Analysis, and Maintenance Resolution, and introduce HighwayVerse. HighwayVerse comprises 14,143 real-world Ground and Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) inspection records spanning 100 and 17 anomaly categories, respectively, with 84,858 expert-reviewed question-answer pairs. We evaluate 12 open-source and closed-source MLLMs using the chained metric Final, which credits a correct maintenance decision only when all preceding diagnostic stages are completed correctly. Results show that although models achieve relatively high accuracy when initially judging whether an anomaly is present, their markedly lower Final scores expose struggles across downstream recognition, analysis, and decision-making. This discrepancy indicates that current MLLMs do not fully comprehend specific highway anomaly patterns beyond superficial initial judgments. Furthermore, we propose LaneRAG, a training-free retrieval-augmented framework that provides hierarchical reference guidance achieving consistent performance improvements across diverse MLLMs. Our dataset, evaluation benchmark, and source code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出HighwayVerse基准与HIIP-Chain链式评测范式，覆盖多类公路设施，揭示MLLM在序贯巡检诊断中"初判强、深度推理弱"的问题，并提出免训练检索增强框架LaneRAG。
AI.motivation: 现有基准局限于孤立任务，无法评测MLLM在"感知→识别→分析→决策"序贯巡检流程中的能力；且数据集多聚焦路面病害，缺乏护栏、防眩屏、排水系统等真实巡检对象。
AI.method: 构建HIIP-Chain四级递进任务（异常检测、异常识别、状态分析、养护决策）；发布HighwayVerse数据集（14,143条真实地面与UAV巡检记录，100/17类异常，84,858专家审核问答对）；提出链式指标Final及免训练检索增强框架LaneRAG，提供分层参考引导。
AI.result: 评测12个开源与闭源MLLM：初始异常判定准确率较高，但Final分数明显偏低，说明下游识别、分析与决策能力不足；LaneRAG在各模型上均带来一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 现有MLLM对公路异常的理解仍停留在表层判断，缺乏深层诊断推理；链式评测与检索增强是提升实际巡检可用性的有效方向。

title: Task-Dependent Linguistic Measures in Aphasia Discourse: A Comparative Analysis of Narrative, Descriptive, and Procedural Speech
summary: Background: Transcript-based measures such as word counts, lexical diversity and disfluency rates are widely used to describe language ability in aphasia. Each measure comes from a specific elicitation task, and studies use different tasks, so values from different tasks may not be comparable. Aims: To test whether discourse tasks change these measures within the same speakers, and whether the measures follow a gradient from Procedural to Descriptive to Narrative discourse. Methods & Procedures: Baseline transcripts from 61 adults with chronic post-stroke aphasia were taken from the Fridriksson-2 corpus in AphasiaBank (POLAR trial, ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03416738). Each speaker produced a Procedural (Sandwich), a Descriptive (Broken Window) and a Narrative (Cinderella) sample in one session. A rule-based pipeline extracted 13 measures, 10 of which were common enough to test. Friedman, Page and Wilcoxon tests with false discovery rate correction were used, with a speaker-grouped Random Forest classifier as a supporting check. Outcomes & Results: Total words and number of different words followed the full gradient, but the step from Procedural to Descriptive was small. For most other measures, Narrative stood apart, while Descriptive and Procedural did not differ. Among the 31 speakers with at least 25 words in every task, filler rate, repetition rate and total disfluency density were higher in Narrative than in both other tasks. The classifier reached an accuracy of 0.61 (always guessing the most common task would give 0.41), mainly by recognizing Narrative samples. Conclusions: Discourse tasks are not interchangeable, and expressing disfluencies per word does not remove the task effect. The task should be reported with every measure, and values should be compared only within the same task.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验不同话语任务（程序性、描述性、叙事性）是否影响失语症患者的转录语言指标，发现任务不可互换，指标须在同一任务内比较。
AI.motivation: 失语症研究中词数、词汇多样性和不流畅率等转录指标广泛使用，但各指标来自不同诱发任务，研究间任务不一致，数值可能无法比较。作者想验证同一说话者内任务是否改变这些指标，以及指标是否沿"程序性→描述性→叙事性"呈梯度变化。
AI.method: 从AphasiaBank的Fridriksson-2语料库（POLAR试验）获取61名慢性卒中后失语症成人基线转录。每人在同一会话中完成程序性（三明治）、描述性（破窗）和叙事性（灰姑娘）三种任务。用规则化流程提取13项指标，其中10项足够常见可检验。采用Friedman、Page和Wilcoxon检验（FDR校正），并以按说话者分组的随机森林分类器作为辅助验证。
AI.result: 总词数和不同词数呈完整梯度，但程序性到描述性这一步差异很小。多数其他指标中叙事性独树一帜，描述性与程序性无差异。在三种任务均至少25词的31名说话者中，叙事任务的填充词率、重复率和总不流畅密度均高于另两项任务。分类器准确率为0.61（总猜最常见任务的基线为0.41），主要靠识别叙事样本。
AI.conclusion: 话语任务不可互换，按词计算不流畅率也不能消除任务效应。报告任何指标时都应注明任务，且仅在同一任务内比较数值。

title: Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are used in more and more new tasks, context engineering becomes a fundamental method to efficiently steer LLMs by constructing instruction prompts or metadata without intensive training. A growing number of LLM context engineering (LCE) approaches automate the task by casting the LLM itself as the engineer that draws generalizable instructions or experiences from offline trials as context. Although these methods resemble how humans learn from experiences, it remains unclear \textbf{when and how} LLMs can engineer effective context from data. To answer the question, we first establish a benchmark composed of datasets with different reasoning patterns. We compared different LCE methods with different LLM families in 8B size, showing that there is no single winner for all tasks, even compared with simple baselines like chain-of-thought. Even when scaling model capabilities via more parameters or generation iterations, LCEs do not consistently boost existing performance. Across all datasets and models, the performance gains of LCEs are negatively correlated ($r=-0.5, p\le 0.05$) with the diversity of the failure modes of reasoning trajectories. Investigating how LCEs work, we find that (1) the improvement in instruction adherence can explain some success of LCEs; (2) one major bottleneck is whether LLMs can extract effective experiences out of natively diverse failures. Through this study, we uncover the limited capabilities of LCEs in abstracting principled contexts from diverse failure modes and understand how LCEs work, providing guidelines for future work.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建基准系统比较LLM上下文工程(LCE)方法，发现没有一个方法普遍最优，LCE的效果与失败模式多样性负相关，瓶颈在于LLM难以从多样的失败中提炼有效经验。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被用于越来越多新任务，上下文工程成为无需密集训练即可高效引导LLM的手段；越来越多LCE方法让LLM自身作为"工程师"从离线试验中抽取可泛化的指令或经验作为上下文。但LLM究竟在何时、如何能从数据中工程出有效上下文，仍不清楚。
AI.method: 建立包含不同推理模式数据集的基准；在8B规模下对比不同LLM家族上的多种LCE方法与基线（如chain-of-thought）；并考察扩大模型参数、增加生成迭代次数的影响；分析LCE增益与推理轨迹失败模式多样性之间的相关性，并探究其工作机制。
AI.result: 没有单一LCE方法在所有任务上占优，甚至未必优于简单CoT基线；扩大参数量或迭代次数也不能稳定提升性能；所有数据集与模型上，LCE的性能增益与失败模式多样性呈负相关(r=-0.5, p≤0.05)；指令遵从性的提升可解释部分成功，主要瓶颈是LLM难以从天然多样的失败中抽取有效经验。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了LCE在从多样失败模式中抽象出有原则性上下文方面的能力有限，并阐明其作用机制，为未来工作提供指导。

title: From States to Dynamics: Detecting Rule Violations in OthelloGPT
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS workshop, Interpretability as a Science: Toward rigorous foundations for understanding LLMs; 20 pages, 16 figures total (including Appendix)
summary: Sequence models trained on game moves have been shown to encode world models, with structured linear probes revealing the underlying game states. World models, however, are inherently dynamic: in deterministic board games, a set of rules constrain how states evolve over time. We therefore ask if and how OthelloGPT, a transformer trained only on Othello move sequences, manifests the rules of the game in its activation space. We divide the rules of Othello, and symmetrically their violations, into three classes: placing a disc on an empty square (R1), flanking an opponent's disc (R2), and moving in turn (R3). We find that linear probes accurately separate legal from illegal moves, and also distinguish between the three kinds of rule violations. We introduce an unsupervised rule-violation detector based on the step length of activations between consecutive moves, which identifies illegal moves above chance. We further improve our detection metric by computing step length in the latent space of select sparse autoencoders. Together, we find that OthelloGPT follows game rules of Othello to a large extent, and that we can detect rule violations using structured detectors on model activations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究仅在Othello走子序列上训练的OthelloGPT是否在其激活空间中编码游戏规则。作者将规则及违规分为三类（空位落子R1、夹住对方棋子R2、按轮次走子R3），发现线性探针能准确区分合法与非法走子，并区分三类违规；提出基于相邻走子激活步长的无监督违规检测器，并结合稀疏自编码器隐空间改进检测。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明基于棋类走子训练的序列模型编码了世界模型，但世界模型本质上是动态的——确定性棋盘游戏中规则约束状态如何随时间演化。因此作者追问OthelloGPT是否以及如何在其激活空间中体现游戏规则。
AI.method: 将Othello规则及对应违规分为R1（在空方格落子）、R2（夹住对手棋子）、R3（遵守轮次）三类；训练线性探针区分合法/非法走子及不同违规类别；提出基于连续走子间激活步长的无监督违规检测器，并在部分稀疏自编码器隐空间中计算步长以改进检测指标。
AI.result: 线性探针能准确区分合法与非法走子，并能区分三类违规；基于激活步长的无监督检测器以高于随机的水平识别非法走子；在稀疏自编码器隐空间计算步长可进一步提升检测性能。
AI.conclusion: OthelloGPT在很大程度上遵循Othello的游戏规则，其激活空间体现了规则结构，并且可以用结构化检测器基于模型激活来检测规则违规。

title: Not All Directions Are Flat: Decomposed-Gradient Flatness for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Many applications of novel view synthesis, such as augmented reality and robotics, can afford only a few input views, since dense capture is costly. With such sparse views, however, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) overfits the training views and degrades at unseen viewpoints. Among the approaches to this problem, flat-minima optimization treats the Gaussians as trainable parameters and steers training toward flat minima, which generalize better, by perturbing the Gaussians with random noise or along the training gradient. However, these perturbations ignore their direction relative to the other training views. Interestingly, we find that the direction of the perturbation determines whether it improves generalization. Specifically, we decompose the gradient of each training view into a component parallel to the average gradient of all views, on which the views agree, and an orthogonal component, on which they disagree. Perturbing along the orthogonal component improves generalization, whereas perturbing along the parallel component does not. We further find that the flatness correction often opposes the reconstruction gradient, shrinking or even reversing the reconstruction step. Based on these findings, we propose DecoFlat, which perturbs each Gaussian along the orthogonal component together with random noise. Furthermore, we introduce a conflict-aware correction, which removes the part of the flatness correction that opposes the reconstruction gradient, and a rescheduling of the spherical-harmonics color, which suppresses the overfitting of view-dependent appearance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoFlat, as a plug-in optimizer, consistently improves vanilla 3DGS and a wide range of sparse-view 3DGS methods.

AI.tldr: 提出DecoFlat，通过将梯度分解为平行/正交分量，沿正交分量加噪扰动Gaussian实现平坦极小值优化，并引入冲突感知校正与球谐颜色重调度，作为插件优化器持续提升稀疏视角3DGS。
AI.motivation: 稀疏输入视角下3DGS会过拟合训练视角、在新视角退化。现有平坦极小值方法对Gaussian的扰动（随机噪声或沿梯度）忽略了扰动相对其他训练视角的方向，而方向恰恰决定是否能改善泛化。
AI.method: 将每个训练视角梯度分解为与所有视角平均梯度平行的分量（视角一致）和正交分量（视角分歧）；发现仅沿正交分量扰动可提升泛化。据此提出DecoFlat：对每个Gaussian沿正交分量加随机噪声扰动；引入冲突感知校正，去除与重建梯度相冲突的平坦性校正；并对球谐颜色重调度以抑制视角相关外观过拟合。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DecoFlat作为插件优化器，能一致地提升原始3DGS及多种稀疏视角3DGS方法。
AI.conclusion: 扰动的方向比幅值更关键；沿正交分量扰动、消除与重建梯度冲突的平坦性校正以及球谐重调度可有效缓解稀疏视角3DGS的过拟合，具备良好通用性。

title: SARA: An Auditor-in-the-Loop LLM Recommender for Sustainability Reports
comment: Accepted at IEEE BigData 2026 as poster paper. 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table
summary: Auditing corporate sustainability reports requires assurance professionals to map a company-specific checklist drawn from roughly 1,700 regulatory requirements onto the relevant passages of lengthy, repeatedly revised draft reports and to judge compliance. We present SARA (Sustainability Reporting Assistant), a human-in-the-loop recommender system delivered as a Microsoft Word add-in that recommends, for each requirement, the passages addressing it and predicts a compliance verdict while keeping the auditor in full control. SARA casts auditing as content-based recommendation over a fixed regulatory taxonomy and makes per-requirement large language model (LLM) matching cheaper, faster, and more accurate through topic-prediction filtering: on expert-annotated reports, it reduces matching cost about sixfold and runtime by 42% versus feeding the full report to the LLM. It is in production use across PwC Germany's sustainability-assurance practice.

AI.tldr: SARA 是一个嵌入 Microsoft Word 的人机协同推荐系统，将企业可持续报告审计建模为基于固定监管分类体系的内容推荐：针对每条监管要求推荐相关段落并预测合规判定，通过主题预测过滤使 LLM 匹配成本降低约 6 倍、运行时间减少 42%，已在 PwC 德国可持续鉴证业务中投入生产使用。
AI.motivation: 可持续报告鉴证需要将约 1700 条监管要求形成的企业专属清单，映射到冗长且反复修订的报告草稿的相关段落并判断合规性，人工工作量大、成本高；而直接将整份报告送入 LLM 又昂贵且缓慢。
AI.method: 将审计任务转化为固定监管分类体系上的内容推荐问题；构建 SARA——Microsoft Word 插件形式的人机协同推荐系统。对每条要求，先用主题预测进行过滤以缩小候选段落，再调用 LLM 做段落匹配并预测合规判定，最终决定权保留在审计师手中。
AI.result: 在专家标注的报告上，相比将完整报告输入 LLM，主题预测过滤使匹配成本降低约 6 倍、运行时间减少 42%，同时提升准确性；系统已在 PwC 德国可持续鉴证实践中生产部署。
AI.conclusion: 将审计形式化为推荐问题并结合主题过滤，可显著提升 LLM 审计辅助的效率与经济性，且人机协同设计保障了审计师主导，具备实际落地价值。

title: Reproducible by Seed? Not on GPUs: Batch-Dependent Non-Determinism in Text-to-Image Models
summary: In text to image AI models, fixing the prompt and the random seed is widely assumed to fix the image. We show that it does not on GPUs. We evaluate six text-to-image models (diffusion and autoregressive) under four numerical precisions and quantizations on three GPU types (RTX A6000, RTX 6000 Ada, and H100 NVL), across up to 100 prompts per set for all six models. For each configuration we compare, with the prompt and seed fixed, the image generated alone with the image generated inside a batch, and we also compare across GPUs. Every replay control reported here is bit-exact, so the variation is not random noise: the execution setting, mainly the batch composition and the GPU, decides the output. The effect is large and model dependent. Structural similarity between the single-image and the batched output falls to 0.580 for an autoregressive model in bf16 and to 0.551 with int8. For a second autoregressive model in bf16 it falls to 0.261 with sampled decoding and to 0.229 with greedy decoding, and for an fp8 diffusion model to 0.68. A diffusion model in bf16 stays close to the batch-1 output (0.96-0.98) but changes every image. In most cases the batched image is a different but equally valid image; in some, such as prompts with digits and counters, it is visibly worse. Cross-GPU differences are of the same order as the batch effect: for one autoregressive model in bf16 compared across two GPU architectures (RTX 6000 Ada versus RTX A6000), no image is bit-identical and the cross-GPU LPIPS (0.355 to 0.383) matches the batch effect within one GPU (0.347 to 0.381). The consequences are direct: seeds do not make results reproducible, benchmarks and image-quality comparisons that mix batch sizes or hardware can be biased, and safety audits and A/B tests on generated images need the serving setup reported.

AI.tldr: 固定 prompt 与随机种子并不能在 GPU 上保证文本到图像模型输出可复现：批次组成与 GPU 硬件实际决定生成结果，差异可大到 SSIM 0.229，且与跨 GPU 差异同量级。
AI.motivation: 业界普遍假设"固定 prompt + 固定随机种子 = 固定图像"，这一假设是基准评测、A/B 测试和安全审计的基础。作者要检验该假设在多模型、多精度、多硬件下是否成立，并量化非确定性的来源（批次组成、GPU 类型）与幅度。
AI.method: 在三种 GPU（RTX A6000、RTX 6000 Ada、H100 NVL）上，对六个文本到图像模型（扩散与自回归）在四种数值精度/量化下评测，每套最多 100 条 prompt。控制变量为：固定 prompt 与 seed，对比"单图生成"与"批内生成"，以及跨 GPU 对比；并验证重放控制是 bit-exact，从而排除随机噪声。
AI.result: batch 效应显著且模型相关：自回归模型 bf16 SSIM 降至 0.580、int8 降至 0.551；第二个自回归模型 bf16 采样解码 0.261、贪心解码 0.229；fp8 扩散模型 0.68；bf16 扩散模型仍接近 batch-1（0.96–0.98）但每张图都改变。多数情况下批内图像只是"不同但同样合理"，但对数字/计数类 prompt 会明显变差。跨 GPU 差异与 batch 效应同量级：RTX 6000 Ada vs A6000 无一 bit 相同，跨 GPU LPIPS 0.355–0.383，与单 GPU 内 batch 效应 0.347–0.381 相当。
AI.conclusion: 种子无法保证可复现性；混合 batch size 或硬件的基准评测与图像质量比较可能存在偏差；生成图像的安全审计与 A/B 测试必须报告服务端配置（批处理方式、精度、GPU）。

title: Randomized Weighted Distance Nearest Neighbor Classification
comment: Writing-polished version of the SMC'26 paper
summary: The nearest neighbor classifier is known to be memory-inefficient, and a popular solution is to compress its training data. Recently, a compression algorithm based on weighted distance nearest neighbor (WNN) was proposed, which has elegant theoretical properties and effective classification performance. However, its compression process is computationally expensive, for it performs a greedy search of the densest homogeneous balls in data space. In this paper, we propose a randomized variant RWNN. It simply randomizes the ball search process, and results in substantially reduced compression time (often 0.1%--1% of WNN's) and similar classification accuracy. RWNN also inherits several theoretical properties of WNN including consistency and a generalization bound. Experimental results on multiple datasets demonstrate its efficacy.

AI.tldr: 提出随机化加权距离最近邻压缩算法 RWNN，大幅降低压缩时间并保持精度。
AI.motivation: 最近邻分类器内存开销大，常用压缩训练数据解决；WNN 虽有理论保证和有效性，但其基于贪心搜索最密同质球的压缩过程计算代价高。
AI.method: 对 WNN 的球搜索过程进行随机化，得到随机变体 RWNN。
AI.result: 压缩时间显著降低（常为 WNN 的 0.1%–1%），分类精度相近；继承 WNN 的一致性、泛化界等理论性质；多数据集实验验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 随机化搜索可在几乎不损失性能的前提下使 WNN 压缩变得实用高效。

title: ViTrust: Learning 3D Observation Trust for Deformable Physical World Models
summary: Learning deformable physical world models requires dynamics that generalize beyond observed motion. Accurate reconstruction alone does not ensure accurate future prediction, motivating us to learn how observations should influence physical identification. However, visual reliability alone does not determine how informative an observation is about physical dynamics. We propose ViTrust to learn 3D observation trust, determining how strongly each tracked point influences physical identification. Its key design is a visual-contact trust adapter that combines pointwise spatiotemporal evidence with interaction history on a persistent contact graph to predict time-varying observation weights. A single-stage, shared-forward objective jointly optimizes these weights and physical parameters through weighted geometry and correspondence losses, with constraints to prevent observation-weight collapse. All learning uses only the observed prefix. The fitted physics remains fixed for future prediction under supplied controls. Experiments on real-world sequences demonstrate improved future prediction over the evaluated baselines, alongside qualitative demonstrations of novel-control rollouts and cross-object transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出ViTrust，学习3D观测信任度，让每个跟踪点对物理辨识的影响权重动态可变，从而学到可泛化的形变物理模型。
AI.motivation: 仅靠精确重建不能保证未来预测准确，需要学习"观测应如何影响物理辨识"；但视觉可靠性本身无法衡量观测对物理动力学的信息量。
AI.method: 设计视觉-接触信任适配器，将逐点时空证据与持久接触图上的交互历史结合，预测时变观测权重；单阶段共享前向目标，通过加权几何与对应损失联合优化权重与物理参数，并加约束防止权重塌缩；仅用观测前缀学习，拟合后的物理在给定控制下固定用于未来预测。
AI.result: 在真实序列上未来预测优于所评估基线，并定性展示新控制滚动与跨物体迁移。
AI.conclusion: 显式学习观测信任权重可提升形变物理模型的可辨识性与未来泛化能力。

title: Semantic-aware Decoding for Diverse Text-to-SQL under Schema Ambiguity
summary: Real-world text-to-SQL systems often face schema ambiguity, where a question can map to multiple plausible schema elements. To support downstream disambiguation, SQL generation systems should include diverse interpretations among their top-k predictions. However, large language models (LLMs) typically favor a single interpretation, producing highly skewed outputs. We propose Semantic-aware Logit Adjustment (SLA), a training-free decoding method that promotes diverse SQL generation by adjusting token logits based on semantic similarity between schema elements. Unlike prior approaches that rely on reasoning-intensive prompting or task-specific fine-tuning, SLA is efficient, model-agnostic, and easy to deploy. Experiments show that SLA consistently improves interpretation coverage over standard decoding and remains competitive with existing diversity-oriented methods at substantially lower inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练解码方法SLA，通过语义相似度调整logit，使LLM生成多样化SQL解释以支持schema歧义消歧。
AI.motivation: 现实text-to-SQL中存在schema歧义，一个问题可映射到多个合理schema元素；为支持下游消歧，top-k预测应包含多样解释。但LLM输出高度偏斜，倾向于单一解释。
AI.method: Semantic-aware Logit Adjustment（SLA）：一种免训练解码方法，基于schema元素间的语义相似度调整token logits，以促进多样化SQL生成；无需推理密集型提示或任务特定微调，模型无关、易部署。
AI.result: 实验表明SLA持续提升解释覆盖率，优于标准解码，并在显著更低推理成本下与现有多样性方法保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SLA为text-to-SQL多样化生成提供高效、通用、易部署的方案。

title: Splitting Belief Bases Conditionally based on Constraints for c-Representations and their Solutions
summary: Splitting notions for conditional belief bases aim at localizing reasoning and computation tasks to subbases containing only the relevant parts of the belief base. Among the different reasoning mechanisms, c-representations, a special kind of Spohn's ranking models, have been shown to provide high-quality inferences. c-Representations can be conveniently specified via a constraint satisfaction problem. In this article, we introduce the notion of conditional constraint splittings, extending constraint splittings by also allowing the subbases to share conditionals. Taking inspiration from conditional syntax splittings, we identify the subclasses of safe and fully localized conditional constraint splittings, allowing us to locally and independently solve the constraint system on the subbases. We also generalize solution splittings for c-representations to safe conditional c-solution splittings and provide an in-depth analysis of their relationship to conditional constraint splittings. Additionally, we elaborate on the relationship of these new splitting notions to safe and generalized safe conditional syntax splittings and also to safe covers, which have been proposed for localized computation of c-representations.

AI.tldr: 提出条件约束拆分（conditional constraint splittings），通过允许子基共享条件句来扩展约束拆分，识别出安全与完全局部化的子类，使约束系统可在子基上局部独立求解，并将解拆分推广为安全条件c-解拆分，深入分析其与条件约束拆分、条件语法拆分及安全覆盖的关系。
AI.motivation: c-表示（Spohn排序模型的一种）能提供高质量推理，且可通过约束满足问题方便地指定。现有拆分概念旨在把推理与计算任务局部化到只含相关部分的子基，但已有约束拆分要求子基严格划分、不允许共享条件句，限制了适用性。
AI.method: 引入条件约束拆分以扩展约束拆分，允许子基共享条件句；借鉴条件语法拆分，定义安全（safe）与完全局部化（fully localized）两个子类，使约束系统能局部且独立地在子基上求解；将c-表示的解拆分推广为安全条件c-解拆分，并分析其与条件约束拆分的对应关系，及与安全/广义安全条件语法拆分和安全覆盖的联系。
AI.result: 给出条件约束拆分的定义与安全、完全局部化子类的刻画；证明安全条件c-解拆分与条件约束拆分之间的深入关系；厘清这些新拆分概念与安全条件语法拆分、广义安全条件语法拆分以及安全覆盖之间的关系，为c-表示的局部化计算提供理论依据。
AI.conclusion: 条件约束拆分及安全条件c-解拆分通过允许子基共享条件句，拓宽了局部化推理的适用范围，并将约束层面、解层面与语法层面的拆分概念统一到同一框架下。

title: LAF-ECG: Multi-Resolution Lead-Aware Fusion of Time-Series and Language Foundation Models for ECG Classification
summary: Automated electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation has advanced substantially with deep learning, yet many methods remain task-specific and label-dependent. Large language models (LLMs) and time-series foundation models (TSFMs) offer complementary pretrained representations, but integrating them is challenging because of mismatched feature spaces and the lead- and scale-dependent structure of ECG signals. We propose LAF-ECG (Lead-Aware Foundation Fusion for ECG), a dual-foundation framework that extends MedTsLLM with a lead-aware interface to a frozen TSFM backbone while retaining its reprogramming pathway. The proposed framework captures multi-resolution temporal context, fuses temporal and language-aligned ECG representations through adaptive residual integration, and employs branch-specific supervision with cross-branch alignment. LAF-ECG achieves 71.10% accuracy and 62.43% macro-F1 on PTB-XL, and 89.73% accuracy and 65.94% macro-F1 on Chapman-Shaoxing, outperforming MedTsLLM on both datasets. These results highlight the value of preserving lead-specific temporal structure when combining temporal and language foundation representations for ECG classification. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/kkianamm/LAF-ECG.

AI.tldr: LAF-ECG是一个双基础模型框架，通过导联感知接口将冻结的时序基础模型与LLM重编程通路融合，实现ECG分类。
AI.motivation: 现有ECG自动解读方法多为任务特定且依赖标签；LLM与时序基础模型(TSFM)特征空间不匹配，且ECG具有导联与尺度依赖结构，难以直接融合。
AI.method: 在MedTsLLM基础上扩展导联感知接口接入冻结的TSFM骨干，保留重编程通路；捕获多分辨率时序上下文，通过自适应残差集成融合时序与语言对齐表示，并采用分支独立监督加跨分支对齐。
AI.result: PTB-XL上准确率71.10%、宏F1 62.43%；Chapman-Shaoxing上准确率89.73%、宏F1 65.94%，两数据集均优于MedTsLLM。
AI.conclusion: 在融合时序与语言基础表示进行ECG分类时，保留导联特定的时序结构具有重要价值。代码已开源。

title: PointNeXt Adapter Improved Model for BIM Component Defect Association under Construction Images and Design Model Attributes
summary: Construction site defect analysis increasingly requires linking field evidence to the correct BIM object, because a crack, spalling area, missing sleeve or misaligned support is useful for quality control only when it is connected with component identity, location, responsibility and design intent. This paper proposes a PointNeXt Adapter improved model for BIM component defect association under construction images and design model attributes. The method aligns site image crops, local point cloud patches, BIM component identifiers, geometry attributes, material categories, installation stage, inspection distance, viewpoint quality and source reliability tags into component level inspection windows. PointNeXt learns local geometry and deviation from as built point evidence, while the adapter injects BIM attributes so the same geometric irregularity can be interpreted differently for structural, envelope, MEP and embedded components. The fusion head outputs component link, defect class, defect probability, confidence, dominant evidence and recommended review action. A synthetic multisource BIM inspection dataset is used to evaluate repeated layouts, occlusion, sparse point clouds, registration errors and unseen component arrangements. Results show that attribute aware point learning improves association accuracy, defect recall and confidence calibration compared with image only, point only, simple fusion and adapter free baselines. The framework is positioned as traceable BIM issue review support, requiring manual confirmation and staged field validation before operational deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出PointNeXt Adapter改进模型，将施工图像与BIM属性对齐到构件级检查窗口，实现缺陷与BIM构件的关联。
AI.motivation: 施工现场缺陷（裂缝、剥落、缺套管、支座错位）只有在与构件身份、位置、责任和设计意图关联时才有质量控制价值，因此需要将现场证据与正确的BIM对象链接。
AI.method: 将现场图像裁剪、局部点云块、BIM构件标识、几何属性、材料类别、安装阶段、检查距离、视角质量与来源可靠性标签对齐为构件级检查窗口；PointNeXt学习局部几何与as-built偏差，Adapter注入BIM属性使同一几何异常在不同构件类型下得到不同解释；融合头输出构件链接、缺陷类别、概率、置信度、主导证据与建议复核动作。使用合成多源BIM检查数据集评估重复布局、遮挡、稀疏点云、配准误差与未见构件布置。
AI.result: 属性感知点学习在关联准确率、缺陷召回率和置信度校准上优于仅图像、仅点云、简单融合及无Adapter基线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架定位为可追溯的BIM问题复核支持工具，需人工确认与分阶段现场验证后方可投入实际运营。

title: PRIMEAPE: A Multilingual Benchmark for Fine-Grained Meta-Evaluation of Judge Models
summary: Large language models increasingly serve as judges of other models, shaping benchmark rankings and model development. Yet, a judge whose rationale consistently supports its verdict may still disagree with human preferences. To study this, we introduce PRIMEAPE, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating judge verdicts and rationales. PRIMEAPE provides 2,205 response pairs covering 243 instructions in English, French, Spanish, Urdu, Hindi, Norwegian Bokmål, and Yoruba, with 11k human annotations of preferences and rationales across relevance, naturalness, truthfulness, safety, and overall quality. Our evaluation of twelve open- and closed-weight judges reveals that aggregate performance conceals differences across languages and criteria, while requesting rationales does not consistently improve agreement with human preferences. Judges also favor the first position, longer responses, and responses from related models, with effects that vary across criteria and languages. Crucially, judges can justify verdicts that disagree with human preferences while maintaining consistency between their verdicts and rationales. These findings show that consistency with a judge's own verdict does not establish alignment with human judgment. PRIMEAPE enables assessment of both, providing a foundation for more reliable multilingual judges. We release our benchmark and all annotation materials under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license at github.com/Toloka/primeape.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PRIMEAPE多语言基准，系统评估LLM裁判的判定与理由，发现裁判自洽并不意味着与人类偏好一致。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多充当其他模型的裁判并影响排行榜与模型开发，但一个理由与结论自洽的裁判仍可能偏离人类偏好，现有评测缺乏对判定与理由两方面的一致性检验。
AI.method: 构建PRIMEAPE基准：涵盖英、法、西、乌尔都、印地、挪威博克马尔、约鲁巴7种语言的243条指令、2205对回答，以及覆盖相关性、自然性、真实性、安全性和整体质量的1.1万条人类偏好与理由标注；据此评测12个开源与闭源裁判。
AI.result: 总体表现为跨语言、跨标准差异所掩盖；要求给出理由并不稳定提升与人类偏好的一致性；裁判存在首位偏好、偏好更长回答及偏好相关模型回答的偏差，且这些效应随标准与语言变化；裁判能在判定与理由自洽的前提下为与人类偏好不符的判定辩护。
AI.conclusion: 裁判自身判定与理由的一致性不能证明其与人类判断对齐；PRIMEAPE可同时评估二者，为构建更可靠的多语言裁判提供基础，并已以CC BY-NC 4.0开源。

title: Learning What to Change: State-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Educational Agents
summary: Persistent tutoring agents do more than answer questions: they manage course files, practice records, and learner profiles that govern future lessons. In such stateful settings, knowing what to teach does not guarantee knowing what to change. We identify a pervasive failure mode, content-state decoupling, where agents deliver pedagogically sound responses while silently corrupting workspace state through unwarranted updates, missed prerequisites, or unintended side effects. Text-level judges overlook these state errors, whereas isolated tool-call checks break down because whether a write action is valid depends jointly on the learner request, prior state, and execution order. We propose State-Verified Reinforcement Learning, which supervises online policy optimization directly through verifiable workspace transitions. Within isolated sandboxes that snapshot state around every tool call, a deterministic verifier audits tool effects, workflow ordering, and native auto-sync side effects, pairing graded partial credit with a hard gate that zeroes episode reward upon any critical violation. Whenever no critical violation occurs, an evidence-grounded judge scores actual saved artifacts rather than agent claims. We pair 1,000 verifiable training instances with an independently authored, human-reviewed evaluation benchmark of 60 tasks spanning 11 educational categories and 16 native tools. After online GRPO training, Qwen3.8-27B raises category-weighted strict success on our benchmark from 51.47% to 80.74% (+29.27 points), cutting content-pass-only execution failures from 45.6% to 13.7% and required state-check failures from 63 to 1 across 180 trials. The resulting policy outperforms seven reference baselines by over 20 points while reducing output tokens by 17-39% across seven of eight external benchmarks without regressing on general reasoning or tool use.

AI.tldr: 论文识别出"内容—状态解耦"失效模式，提出状态验证强化学习（State-Verified RL），用沙箱快照+确定性验证器直接监督工作区状态转移，使智能辅导代理在保持教学正确的同时不破坏状态。
AI.motivation: 持久化辅导代理需管理课程文件、练习记录与学习者画像，会改变未来课程状态。在状态化场景中，"知道教什么"不等于"知道该改什么"：代理可能给出教学上合理的回答，却通过无依据的更新、遗漏前置条件或意外副作用悄悄破坏工作区状态。文本级评判看不到这类状态错误，孤立的工具调用检查也失效，因为写入是否有效取决于请求、先前状态与执行顺序三者。
AI.method: 提出 State-Verified Reinforcement Learning：在隔离沙箱中于每次工具调用前后快照状态，由确定性验证器审计工具效果、工作流顺序与原生自动同步副作用；采用分级部分奖励加硬性门控（出现关键违规即整回合奖励归零）。无关键违规时，由证据锚定的评判器对实际保存的产物（而非代理声称）打分。以上流程直接监督在线策略优化。作者构建了1000条可验证训练实例，以及独立撰写、人工复核的60任务评测基准（11个教育类别、16个原生工具），并使用在线GRPO训练。
AI.result: Qwen3.8-27B 在基准上的类别加权严格成功率从51.47%提升至80.74%（+29.27点）；"内容通过但执行失败"比例从45.6%降至13.7%，180次试验中必需状态检查失败次数从63降至1。所得策略比七个参考基线高出20点以上，同时在八个外部基准中的七个上输出token减少17–39%，且通用推理与工具使用能力无退化。
AI.conclusion: 状态化辅导代理的评价必须直接检验工作区状态转移，而非仅看文本质量或孤立工具调用。基于可验证环境转移的强化学习可显著降低状态破坏型失败，并在提升任务成功率的同时压缩输出长度、保持通用能力。

title: Deterministic Proper Positive-Only Learning Is Independent of ZFC
summary: Binary classification from positive-only samples is a variant of PAC learning in which the learner receives i.i.d. samples only from the positive region of an unknown target concept, but is evaluated on the full distribution. Improper learnability in this model has a textbook characterization, whereas proper learnability has remained open for decades. Recent work characterized it for learners with access to randomness, and showed that, unlike in PAC learning, some classes are properly learnable with randomness but not without it, leaving the deterministic case open. We show that this case cannot be resolved within the standard axioms of mathematics (ZFC): there is a class of VC dimension two whose deterministic proper learnability is independent of ZFC, even though a randomized learner provably learns it. Moreover, no dimension of finite character, a desirable property shared by most dimensions in learning theory, characterizes deterministic proper learnability. We also show that the size of the domain is decisive. In ZFC, deterministic proper learnability has a combinatorial characterization on every domain whose cardinality is below a certain threshold, including every countable domain. In contrast, this characterization fails on every domain of sufficiently large cardinality. Under the generalized continuum hypothesis, this threshold is sharp: it is the exact cardinality at which the characterization starts to fail. Finally, our proofs introduce new tools, based on the Erdos--Rado partition theorem, that may be of broader interest.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了仅从正样本进行二元分类的确定性proper可学习性独立于ZFC公理系统，并揭示其与定义域基数的深刻联系。
AI.motivation: 仅正样本的二元分类模型中，improper可学习性有教科书式刻画，而proper可学习性数十年悬而未决。近期工作刻画了带随机性学习器的情况，并表明存在依赖随机性才能proper学习的类，但确定性情形仍未解决，作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用集合论与组合数学工具，特别是基于Erdős–Rado划分定理的新技术，分析确定性proper可学习性与域基数之间的关系，并探讨是否存在有限特征的维度刻画。
AI.result: 存在VC维为2的类，其确定性proper可学习性独立于ZFC，尽管随机学习器可证明学习它；没有任何有限特征维度能刻画确定性proper可学习性；域的大小具有决定性作用——在低于某阈值的域（含所有可数域）上存在组合刻画，而在足够大基数的域上该刻画失效；在广义连续统假设下该阈值是精确的。
AI.conclusion: 确定性proper可学习性问题无法在ZFC内解决，其可解性依赖于域的基数，揭示了学习理论与集合论公理之间此前未知的深层联系，所引入的Erdős–Rado方法可能具有更广泛价值。

title: Omni-H3-Image: Constrained Foundation Priors Usher in a New Era of All-in-One Blind Image Restoration
summary: Off-the-shelf unified image models such as 33B MiniMax-H3-Image, FLUX.1-Kontext, and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 synthesize crisp textures yet collapse to 11.33-16.74 dB PSNR across 429 degraded public restoration scenes due to spatial drift, chromatic hallucination, and semantic fabrication. We present Omni-H3-Image (Omni-H3), an approximate three-stage constrained posterior projection framework over unmodified MiniMax-H3-Image and Qwen3-VL-32B using only a 0.92M-parameter auxiliary weather pre-conditioner (<0.003% of backbone weights). Omni-H3 unifies blind physics-VLM sensing with exact-32 px lattice anchoring, joint affine-Wiener-Butterworth projection in opponent YCbCr space, and closed-loop Z=4 text verification with sub-Nyquist abstention. Across 925 blind tasks against 11 external SOTA baselines -- five public benchmarks (N=647), Dev-160, and a held-out locked_test suite (N=118) -- Omni-H3 recovers +4.73 dB degraded-scene PSNR over Base H3 (21.47 vs. 16.74 dB; +6.27-10.14 dB over other omni backbones) while winning overall #1 DISTS (0.207), #1 NIQE (4.45), and #1 Edge-F1 (0.807) on all 429 degraded public scenes (MUSIQ 66.8 vs. 40-44 for discriminative SOTA), 76.59 dB on CBSD68 Clean, -91.6% Urban100 chroma drift, #1 2K Dev Non-Clean DISTS (0.202), and #1 locked_test 2K DISTS (0.173) and 132-ROI SubCER, cutting pre-annotated 132-ROI SubCER from 0.456 to 0.319 under non-Qwen RapidOCR (PP-OCRv4) (with recognizer-dependent tradeoffs under TrOCR-large-str).

AI.tldr: Omni-H3 是一个约三阶段约束后验投影框架，仅用 0.92M 参数的辅助天气预条件器，在未修改的 MiniMax-H3-Image 与 Qwen3-VL-32B 之上实现盲图像复原，显著缓解空间漂移、色彩幻觉与语义伪造。
AI.motivation: 现有统一图像模型（如 MiniMax-H3-Image、FLUX.1-Kontext、Qwen-Image-Edit 等）虽能生成清晰纹理，但在退化复原场景中 PSNR 骤降至 11.33–16.74 dB，出现空间漂移、色度幻觉和语义捏造，缺乏对盲退化场景的精确约束。
AI.method: 提出 Omni-H3 三阶段约束后验投影框架：① 物理-VLM 盲感知配合精确 32 px 晶格锚定；② 在对抗性 YCbCr 空间做仿射-Wiener-Butterworth 联合投影；③ Z=4 文本闭环验证并带亚奈奎斯特弃权机制。仅训练 0.92M 参数天气预条件器（<0.003% 骨干权重），骨干保持冻结。
AI.result: 在 925 个盲任务、11 个外部 SOTA 基线上评测：429 个退化公开场景 PSNR 由 16.74 提升至 21.47 dB（+4.73 dB），优于其他 omni 骨干 6.27–10.14 dB；DISTS 0.207、NIQE 4.45、Edge-F1 0.807 均列第一，MUSIQ 66.8（对比判别式 SOTA 40–44）；CBSD68 Clean 达 76.59 dB，Urban100 色度漂移降低 91.6%；2K Dev Non-Clean 与 locked_test 2K DISTS 分别 0.202、0.173；132-ROI SubCER 从 0.456 降至 0.319（PP-OCRv4），但不同识别器下存在权衡。
AI.conclusion: 以极小参数量的辅助模块配合投影-验证闭环，可在不改动大模型权重的前提下大幅提升盲复原的保真度与感知质量；文本识别指标对识别器存在依赖性，需进一步评估泛化性。

title: LimeTree: Linear-Memory Graph Neural Networks over Tree-Graphs for Resource-Efficient Language Modeling and Context Extrapolation
summary: The search for computationally efficient alternatives to the Transformer has yielded numerous architectures in recent years; however, most exhibit severe weaknesses in associative recall-such as key-value (KV) retrieval-and length extrapolation, where even standard Transformers struggle. This paper introduces LimeTree, a linear-complexity architecture in both memory and compute for sequence modeling. By integrating synthetic KV retrieval tasks directly into standard language modeling training, LimeTree achieves strong perplexity alongside reliable recall. Two variants were evaluated on WikiText-103 and PG-19 under strict compute constraints. On WikiText-103, LimeTree reaches a token-level perplexity of 19 in just 6 hours on four Quadro RTX 8000 GPUs, while maintaining 100\% KV retrieval accuracy even when extrapolating from a training context length of 512 to an evaluation length of 16,384. On PG-19, the model achieves a token-level perplexity of 13 in 35 hours on a single RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU with minimal hyperparameter tuning. These results position LimeTree as a competitive linear-complexity alternative to Transformers, combining superior perplexity and training throughput with robust in-context retrieval and length extrapolation.

AI.tldr: 提出线性复杂度架构 LimeTree，将合成 KV 检索任务融入常规语言模型训练，在低算力下于 WikiText-103/PG-19 上取得有竞争力的困惑度，并在 512→16384 长度外推下保持 100% KV 检索准确率。
AI.motivation: Transformer 计算开销大，近年虽有多种高效替代架构，但普遍在关联回忆（KV 检索）和长度外推上表现糟糕，连标准 Transformer 也难以胜任，因此需要兼顾效率与检索/外推能力的架构。
AI.method: LimeTree 为内存与计算均为线性复杂度的序列建模架构；关键做法是在标准语言建模训练中直接混入合成的 KV 检索任务，使模型同时获得良好困惑度与可靠的检索能力。作者在严格算力限制下评估了两个变体。
AI.result: WikiText-103 上 4 块 Quadro RTX 8000 仅 6 小时即达 token 级困惑度 19，且从训练长度 512 外推到 16384 时 KV 检索准确率仍为 100%；PG-19 上单块 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU、35 小时、极少调参达困惑度 13。
AI.conclusion: LimeTree 是可替代 Transformer 的有竞争力线性复杂度方案，在困惑度、训练吞吐、上下文检索与长度外推方面均具优势；但评测限于 WikiText-103 与 PG-19，规模与通用性仍有待验证。

title: Interrogation Protocols for AI Control
comment: 26 pages (8 main + references and appendix), 21 figures, 4 tables. Under review. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/interrogation-protocols-A11B/
summary: As the intelligence of an AI agent increases relative to a trusted monitor, so does the risk that the monitor will fail to understand the agent's actions or to evaluate them confidently. We introduce interrogation protocols to a high-stakes AI control setting, and allow the monitor to ask the untrusted agent questions about confusing actions. For interrogation to improve safety, a weaker model must be able to distinguish misleading explanations produced by an attack policy from genuine ones produced by an honest policy. We find that on a held-out subset of BashArena, an interrogation protocol improves safety at a 1% audit budget from 72.6% for an actions-only baseline, which does not use interrogations, to 79.5% (+7.0 pp [+0.9, +20.1], 95% paired bootstrap interval), but most of this uplift can be captured by having a trusted model state a specific concern. More broadly, our work suggests that interrogating agents can improve safety, allowing monitors to catch more attacks at a larger capability gap.

AI.tldr: 在BashArena的高风险AI控制场景中引入"审问协议"(interrogation protocols)，让可信监控者就令人困惑的行为向不可信智能体提问，可将1%审计预算下的安全性从72.6%提升至79.5%（+7.0pp），但大部分增益来自"让可信模型陈述具体疑虑"这一简单做法。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体的智能程度相对可信监控者不断提高，监控者越来越难以理解智能体的行为或自信地评估其行为，存在监控失效风险。作者希望探索在监控者能力较弱、能力差距较大的情形下，是否仍能维持AI控制的安全性。
AI.method: 将审问协议引入高风险的AI控制设定，允许监控者就令人困惑的行为向不可信智能体提问。核心前提是：较弱模型必须能区分攻击策略给出的误导性解释与诚实策略给出的真实解释。在BashArena的留出子集上进行实验，与仅依赖行为（actions-only）的基线对比，采用1%审计预算，并用配对自助法（paired bootstrap）估计置信区间。
AI.result: 审问协议将1%审计预算下的安全性从72.6%（actions-only基线）提升至79.5%，即+7.0个百分点（95%配对自助区间[+0.9, +20.1]）。但大部分提升可以通过让可信模型陈述一个具体疑虑来获得。
AI.conclusion: 审问智能体总体上可以提升安全性，使监控者能在更大的能力差距下捕捉到更多攻击；但其增益部分可由更简单的"陈述具体疑虑"机制替代。

title: Why Units Die in the Layer After a Frozen Random Encoder, and What the Number of Live Units Measures
comment: 31 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary material (121 pages) is included as an ancillary file
summary: Reinforcement-learning agents can learn Atari games through a convolutional encoder whose random weights are never trained. They reach expert play in Pong and, without random action repeats, in Breakout, but training takes far longer and few ReLU units in the layer after the encoder stay alive. A dead unit outputs zero for every input and cannot learn. In earlier work we took the number of live units to measure the game's complexity. Here we ask why units die and correct that conclusion. We find that more units die as the layer's inputs lie farther from zero relative to how much they vary. We call this ratio the offset. Earlier work showed this in sparse autoencoders at the start of training. We saw it after training in agents, image classifiers, a reservoir computer and sparse autoencoders on GPT-2. A random encoder leaves the offset of its input roughly unchanged, and a formula predicted its median offset within 25 percent in all 44 cases. So a game with a bright, mostly unchanging screen gives the next layer a large offset. In Pong, subtracting the average screen raised the number of live units from between 3 and 6 of 64 to between 59 and 63, so the number alone cannot show a game's complexity. On unaltered screens none of the agents reached a training score of 18 in 50 million steps. With the subtraction all did within 5 million, about as fast as a trained encoder on unaltered screens. In Breakout the subtraction left more units alive, but average training scores did not clearly improve, and a large gap to a trained encoder remained. So we do not treat their number as something to raise for its own sake. The evidence is from small networks and three games, and in agents and image classifiers changing the offset also changed the size of the inputs. We suggest measuring the offset before training a layer on a fixed front end and, if it is large, trying to subtract the mean input.

AI.tldr: 论文研究随机权重卷积编码器后层ReLU单元大量死亡的原因，指出该现象源于输入相对变化而言偏离零过远（称“offset”），并据此修正了用存活单元数衡量游戏复杂度的结论。
AI.motivation: 先前工作将随机编码器后层的存活ReLU单元数作为游戏复杂度的度量，但训练较慢且单元大量死亡，需解释单元死亡原因并纠正该结论。
AI.method: 定义offset为层输入相对其变化幅度偏离零的程度；在智能体、图像分类器、储备池计算及GPT-2稀疏自编码器中观察；用公式预测随机编码器输入的中位offset；通过减去平均屏幕（零均值化）来减小offset进行干预实验。
AI.result: 公式在44例中以25%误差预测中位offset；Pong中减去平均屏幕使存活单元从64中的3-6个升至59-63个；原屏幕下无智能体在5000万步内达训练分18，减均值后均在500万步内达到，接近训练编码器速度；Breakout中存活单元增加但平均分未明显改善，与训练编码器仍有大差距。
AI.conclusion: 存活单元数不能反映游戏复杂度；建议在固定前端上训练前测量offset，若较大则尝试减去输入均值；证据限于小网络与三个游戏。

title: Spatially Grounded Latent Lookahead for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary:
Vision-language-action (VLA) models benefit from strong semantic representations that support object recognition and instruction understanding. However, precise manipulation also depends on resolving object locations and workspace relations, and on selecting actions with an estimate of how the scene will evolve. Existing geometry-aware methods make the current scene more explicit, while predictive methods model future observations or representations. Yet future information is often neither grounded in a control-relevant spatial state nor directly used to guide action generation. We introduce Spatially Grounded Latent Lookahead (SG-LL), which uses the grounded present as the reference for predicting an actionable near-future representation. A frozen spatial teacher first distills geometric priors into policy-connected spatial tokens. A current-conditioned bottleneck then learns a compact latent that captures future information relative to the present scene. This latent is predicted from the current policy context and initial Action Expert features, without access to future observations or the spatial teacher. Finally, zero-initialized residual fusion incorporates the predicted latent into the Action Expert to refine action generation. Experiments on LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN, and three real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improvements over
  in both simulation and real-robot settings.

AI.tldr: 提出SG-LL（空间接地的潜在前瞻），以"接地的当前场景"为参考预测可操作的近未来表示，并用于改进动作生成。
AI.motivation: VLA模型语义表征强，但精确操作还需理解物体位置、工作空间关系，并在预估场景演化的情况下选动作。已有几何方法只显式化当前场景，预测方法虽建模未来观测/表征，却往往未与控制相关的空间状态接地，也未直接用于引导动作生成。
AI.method: 1) 冻结的空间教师将几何先验蒸馏进与策略连通的空间token；2) 当前条件瓶颈学习相对当前场景的紧凑未来潜在表征；3) 该潜在仅由当前策略上下文与初始Action Expert特征预测，不用未来观测与空间教师；4) 零初始化残差融合将其注入Action Expert以精炼动作生成。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN及三个真实机器人操作任务上，仿真与真机设置均取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 以当前接地的空间状态为参照做潜在前瞻并直接引导动作生成，是提升VLA精确操作的有效途径。

title: Beyond Self-Consistency: Recursive Self-Improvement at Test Time
summary: Large language models (LLMs) that continue improving after deployment (e.g., recursive self-improvement) offer a promising path toward general intelligence.
