Current test-time methods pursue this goal on unlabeled questions, primarily relying on self-consistency: they generate independent solutions and use majority voting to select an answer or construct training targets. This leaves earlier reasoning unused at inference and can reinforce an incorrect majority during training. Humans instead build on earlier attempts to preserve useful reasoning, correct mistakes and improve their problem-solving strategies. Following this principle, we propose Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement (TT-RSI), a label-free framework for improving LLMs at test time through two mutually reinforcing components: (1) In-Context RSI repeatedly re-solves each question using the full previous solution as a reference, letting the model decide whether and how to use it so that inference compute builds on earlier reasoning. (2) In-Weight RSI distills successive refinements into the model's weights, enabling progress beyond an initially wrong majority and theoretically bringing the first attempt toward the model's infinite-step refinement limit. The updated model answers better and refines more effectively, generating stronger references for subsequent training. Extensive experiments show that TT-RSI improves average accuracy by +13.89% over the base model and outperforms the strongest self-consistency-based method by +4.79% under the same test-time scaling budget.

AI.tldr: 提出 TT-RSI，一种无标签的测试时递归自我改进框架，通过上下文内推理改进与权重内蒸馏两个相互强化组件，让模型利用历史推理不断自我提升。
AI.motivation: 当前测试时方法多依赖自一致性：独立生成多个解并用多数投票选答案或构建训练目标。这导致推理时早期推理结果未被利用，训练时可能强化错误多数。人类则会基于先前尝试保留有用推理、纠正错误、改进策略。
AI.method: TT-RSI 含两个互强化部分：(1) In-Context RSI：对每题反复重解，以完整先前解为参考，由模型自行决定如何利用，使推理算力建立在早期推理之上；(2) In-Weight RSI：将逐步精炼结果蒸馏进模型权重，突破初始错误多数，理论上能把首次尝试推向无限步精炼极限。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TT-RSI 相比基座模型平均准确率提升 +13.89%，在相同测试时扩展预算下优于最强的自一致性方法 +4.79%。
AI.conclusion: 递归式、无标签的测试时自我改进（结合上下文精炼与权重蒸馏）是一种有效路径，能持续提升模型并生成更优参考，形成良性循环。

title: JaxNaviSim: A GPU-Accelerated, Data-Driven Simulator and Learning Benchmark for Maritime Navigation
summary: Coordinating vessels through the shared waterways of busy ports grows more challenging as vessel traffic increases. Port authorities need realistic simulations to assess how arrival schedules, anchorage assignments, and routes affect vessel throughput and navigation safety. Existing AIS-based trajectory models predict a vessel's track from its past trajectory in an open-loop fashion. They do not simulate step-by-step responses to other ships or test whether a vessel collides or reaches its goal. To address this problem, we introduce JaxNaviSim, a data-driven simulator and learning benchmark coupling Automatic Identification System (AIS) data with fast, controllable traffic simulation, in which learned models steer vessels through recorded traffic. First, we release a dataset of ~141 million AIS records from over 30K vessels across eight high-density regions of the Singapore Strait, among the world's busiest waterways, with ~6.7 million vessel-hours. Unlike several existing AIS datasets which mostly cover open seas, ours captures close-quarters vessel traffic in the narrow strait. Second, we define a navigation task for each recorded vessel trajectory. A model steers that vessel every 10 s from its recorded state to its anchoring point or region exit, while surrounding ships follow their recorded tracks or are steered by the model. We implement a JAX simulator that runs these tasks in large batches on a GPU. We also incorporate multiple vessel dynamics models and sea surface currents. Finally, we benchmark imitation learning (IL), offline and online RL, and include Predictive Action Refinement (PAR) as a safety baseline that cuts collision rates to 1-3%. The comparison shows that low tracking error does not ensure arrival, and learned policies can reach most destinations yet collide in 20-45% of episodes.

AI.tldr: JaxNaviSim是一个基于新加坡海峡AIS数据的GPU加速交通仿真器与学习基准，用于逐步模拟和评估船舶导航策略（不仅预测轨迹，还考察碰撞与到达）。
AI.motivation: 现有基于AIS的轨迹模型以开环方式预测船舶轨迹，无法模拟对其他船只的逐步响应，也无法检验船舶是否碰撞或到达目标；港口当局需要真实仿真来评估到达计划、锚地分配和航线对吞吐量与航行安全的影响。
AI.method: 发布约1.41亿条AIS记录（30K+船只、新加坡海峡八个高密度区域、约670万船时）的数据集；为每条轨迹定义导航任务（每10秒操舵一次，从记录状态到锚点或区域出口，周边船只按记录轨迹或由模型操舵）；实现JAX GPU批量仿真器，集成多种船舶动力学模型与海面流；基准测试模仿学习、离线/在线强化学习，并引入Predictive Action Refinement (PAR)作为安全基线。
AI.result: PAR将碰撞率降至1-3%；对比显示低跟踪误差并不能保证到达，学习策略虽能到达大多数目的地，但20-45%的回合发生碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的闭环仿真基准揭示了轨迹拟合与航行安全之间的差距，为港口交通管理与安全导航策略研究提供了可复现的测试平台。

title: What Should World Models Plan Over? Learning Geometry-Aligned Representations of Body Motion
summary: We introduce MotionPort, which learns low-dimensional latent representations of body motion for accurate dynamics prediction and effective long-horizon planning. Existing world-model planners often search over action representations learned for prediction, yet we show that predictive accuracy alone does not ensure that optimization can discover successful trajectories. MotionPort addresses this mismatch by representing body trajectories rather than action chunks and organizing the search space by motion similarity, helping predicted improvements translate into successful execution. Without fine-tuning state encoders, MotionPort raises average goal-reaching success from 37.9% to 87.8% across three backbones and seven settings in four domains. On the evaluated AntMaze-OGBench tasks, it achieves 72% success, compared with 4% for the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 MotionPort，用低维身体运动潜表示替代动作分块表示，并按运动相似度组织搜索空间，实现准确动力学预测与有效长程规划。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型规划器常在"为预测而学"的动作表示上做搜索，但预测精度高并不保证优化能找到成功轨迹（预测与规划目标不匹配）。
AI.method: 表示身体轨迹而非动作分块；将搜索空间按运动相似度组织，使预测中的改进更易转化为可执行的成功轨迹；无需微调状态编码器。
AI.result: 在4个领域、7种设置、3个骨干网络上，平均目标到达成功率从37.9%提升至87.8%；AntMaze-OGBench上达72%，最强基线仅4%。
AI.conclusion: 以运动为中心的潜表示与相似度组织的搜索空间能有效弥合预测准确性与规划成功率之间的差距，显著提升长程规划性能。

title: Task-Conditioned Detail Allocation for Synthetic Segmentation Data
summary: Synthetic images sharing a segmentation label can differ in their training value. We propose Task-Conditioned Detail Allocation (TCDA) to select useful candidates and locally edit some remaining images. We ask whether image details provide class-specific cues in the regions marked by the label. We train a small task reference on frozen image features from real training images. We compare its class responses before and after blurring each candidate, and score how well these response changes align with the labeled regions. This detail allocation score ranks candidates from the same source. Comparing their response--label alignment with that of the real source image also guides repair decisions and, in multiclass tasks, the choice of regions to edit. Selected candidates and accepted repairs are used for training with the original labels and the unchanged downstream segmenter. Experiments on camouflaged object detection, degraded salient object detection, and adverse-condition semantic segmentation show that our selection outperforms equally sized random and label-agreement subsets. Combining selection and repair improves over real-only training by up to 0.019 in $S_α$ on COD10K and 2.86 mIoU points on ACDC.

AI.tldr: 提出任务条件细节分配（TCDA）方法，用于挑选有价值的合成图像并局部修复，提升分割训练效果。
AI.motivation: 共享同一分割标签的合成图像在训练价值上差异很大，需要筛选有用样本并修复部分剩余图像。
AI.method: 在真实图像冻结特征上训练小型任务参考模型；对每个候选图像做模糊前后比较其类别响应变化，衡量变化与标注区域的对齐程度形成"细节分配分数"，用于同源候选排序；再与真实源图像的响应-标签对齐比较以指导修复决策和多类任务中区域选择。选定样本与接受修复沿用原标签、不改下游分割器。
AI.result: 在伪装目标检测、退化显著目标检测和恶劣条件语义分割上，选择优于同等规模随机与标签一致子集；选择+修复相比仅真实数据训练，COD10K的S_α提升达0.019，ACDC提升2.86 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 图像细节在标注区域内提供类别相关线索，可据此低成本筛选与修复合成数据，稳定改进分割性能。

title: CART: Clustering-based Analysis of Recurring narratives for Taxonomy construction
summary: We present CART, a computational pipeline for extracting political narratives from parliamentary discourse and organizing them into a data-driven taxonomy without relying on predefined narrative categories. It encodes parliamentary discourse using semantic representations, filters relevant and reliable content through unsupervised confidence estimation, extracts narrative statements using LLMs, and uses narrative clustering and cluster analysis to construct a narrative taxonomy. Applied to Greek Parliament proceedings surrounding the 2023 Tempi train crash, it identifies ten recurring narrative families concerning responsibility attribution, institutional failure, railway safety, accountability, privatization, and the political interpretation of the tragedy. Our results demonstrate how combining unsupervised learning with LLM narrative extraction enables large parliamentary corpora to be transformed into interpretable, data-driven taxonomies of political narratives.

AI.tldr: CART：一个不依赖预设叙事类别的计算流程，从议会话语中抽取政治叙事并构建数据驱动的叙事分类体系。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对政治叙事的分类多依赖预定义的类别框架，难以适应大规模议会语料并可能引入研究者偏见，因此需要一种自动、可扩展且数据驱动的叙事抽取与组织方法。
AI.method: CART 流程包含四步：用语义表征编码议会话语；通过无监督置信度估计过滤相关且可靠的内容；用 LLM 抽取叙事陈述；再通过叙事聚类与聚类分析构建叙事分类体系。
AI.result: 应用于希腊议会关于2023年Tempi火车事故的议事记录，识别出十个反复出现的叙事族群，涉及责任归属、制度失灵、铁路安全、问责、私有化及对悲剧的政治解读。
AI.conclusion: 无监督学习与 LLM 叙事抽取相结合，可将大规模议会语料转化为可解释、数据驱动的政治叙事分类体系。

title: Learning Multimodal Representations from Partially Paired, Small-Scale Data
summary: Modeling multimodal data from partially paired samples is critical for advancing domains like biomedicine, where vast unimodal datasets and foundation models exist but paired data remains scarce. Existing fusion methods rely on large-scale paired datasets, limiting their use in scenarios with incomplete pairing. We introduce CAMEO, an adversarial learning-based modality fusion framework that integrates modalities from small, partially paired datasets. Combining any pre-trained unimodal encoder with a cross-modal latent alignment mechanism, CAMEO learns shared representations requiring only minimal paired samples. Evaluated on computational pathology tasks such as niche classification and cell type composition prediction, CAMEO achieves superior data efficiency, outperforming contrastive approaches like CLIP in low paired-data regimes, and highlighting the benefits of adversarial alignment when paired annotations are scarce. To facilitate further research, we additionally release a fully annotated HuggingFace dataset comprising three organs and paired image and gene expression modalities. By extending fusion methods to address limited pairing and small-scale datasets, we provide a framework that advances multimodal learning and broadens its applicability to real-world biomedical problems.

AI.tldr: CAMEO 是一个基于对抗学习的多模态融合框架，能在配对样本极少的情况下整合预训练单模态编码器，实现数据高效的跨模态共享表征学习。
AI.motivation: 生物医学等领域存在大量单模态数据和预训练基础模型，但配对数据稀缺；现有融合方法依赖大规模配对数据集，难以适用于配对不完整的场景。
AI.method: 将任意预训练单模态编码器与跨模态潜在对齐机制结合，采用对抗学习策略学习共享表征，仅需少量配对样本即可完成模态融合。
AI.result: 在计算病理学的生态位分类与细胞类型组成预测任务上表现优异；在低配对数据场景下数据效率超过 CLIP 等对比学习方法，体现对抗对齐的优势；并发布涵盖三个器官、配对图像与基因表达模态的 HuggingFace 全标注数据集。
AI.conclusion: 通过将融合方法扩展到有限配对与小规模数据场景，为多模态学习提供新框架，拓宽其在真实生物医学问题中的应用。

title: probly: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning
summary: As machine learning systems are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, the question of how to represent and quantify uncertainty has moved from a methodological side issue to a central concern. In practice, however, making a model uncertainty-aware is still surprisingly difficult: relevant tools tend to be scattered across libraries, each tied to a particular framework and a particular approach to modeling uncertainty, and the choice of representation, quantification, and evaluation is typically left to the user without much guidance. In this paper, we present probly, a Python package that addresses these issues in a single, modular framework. probly offers (i) lightweight transformations that turn existing models into uncertainty-aware ones, currently supporting PyTorch, scikit-learn, and Flax, (ii) several representations, including second-order distributions, credal sets, and conformal prediction, (iii) the corresponding quantification measures, and (iv) a number of evaluation protocols, which can be combined more or less arbitrarily. Using probly, we conduct a benchmark study on three standard tasks --- selective prediction, out-of-distribution detection, and active learning. In addition, and unlike existing benchmarks, we evaluate suitable methods on first-order data, i.e., datasets for which the target itself is a distribution over outcomes. We further illustrate the flexibility of the package on a number of less standard case studies, including large language models, graph neural networks, and data streams. The package is publicly available at https://github.com/pwhofman/probly.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Python 包 probly，将不确定性建模的表示、量化与评估统一到一个模块化框架中，并在选择性预测、OOD 检测、主动学习等任务上做基准评测。
AI.motivation: 现实中让模型具备不确定性感知仍很困难：相关工具分散在多个库中，各自绑定特定框架和特定不确定性建模思路；表示、量化与评估的选择缺乏指导，全部依赖用户自行决定。
AI.method: probly 提供四类组件并支持任意组合：(i) 轻量变换，可将现有模型转为不确定性感知模型，目前支持 PyTorch、scikit-learn 与 Flax；(ii) 多种表示，包括二阶分布、credal sets 与 conformal prediction；(iii) 对应的量化度量；(iv) 若干评估协议。
AI.result: 基于 probly 在三个标准任务（选择性预测、OOD 检测、主动学习）上进行基准研究；与现有基准不同，还在一阶数据（目标本身为结果分布的数据集）上评估合适方法；并展示在 LLM、图神经网络和数据流等非标准场景下的灵活性。
AI.conclusion: probly 以单一模块化框架统一了不确定性建模的变换、表示、量化与评估，兼顾标准基准与非标准场景，代码已开源。

title: Learning How a Body Moves: Few-Shot Body Inference for Visual World Models of Animated Characters
summary: Two visually identical animated characters can respond differently to the same action command because their body dynamics differ. For example, a stiff blob and its bouncy twin reach different heights when both receive the jump command. Given only the first frame and the action command, a visual world model has no information to distinguish these twins, because their initial appearances are identical. We therefore propose an in-context world model that encodes clips of a character's other actions into a body representation, using a contrastive loss to separate look-alike characters. We introduce ToonTwins, a benchmark of 144 2D cartoon characters that run, jump, fall, turn and crouch. Its characters form look-alike groups of four that differ only in their dynamics profile, and we also evaluate the model on 32 animated animals from DeformingThings4D. Even with a body code from these clips, the latent pixel world model we tested recovered at most 25 percent of the twins' jump height difference. On new shapes, our model identified the correct twin in 85.9 percent of cases, compared with 76.7 percent for a transformer baseline that reads the same clips without a body summary, and in a controlled ablation the contrastive loss gave more than half of this gain. On the animated animals, it reduced the mean path prediction error by 8.5 percent against a model without body information.

AI.tldr: 提出in-context世界模型，用角色其他动作片段编码身体表征并用对比损失区分外观相同的角色，发布ToonTwins基准。
AI.motivation: 外观完全相同的角色因身体动力学不同，对同一动作指令反应不同；仅凭首帧和指令时，视觉世界模型无法区分这些"双胞胎"。
AI.method: 编码角色其他动作片段形成body code，并在其上施加对比损失，使外观相似但动力学不同的角色在表征空间中分离；构建ToonTwins基准（144个2D卡通角色，含跑跳落转蹲，组成外观相同但动力学不同的四人组），并在DeformingThings4D的32个动画动物上评估。
AI.result: 测试的潜像素世界模型最多还原25%的双胞胎跳跃高度差；新形状上85.9%正确识别双胞胎（Transformer基线76.7%，对比损失贡献过半增益）；动画动物上平均路径预测误差降低8.5%。
AI.conclusion: 显式的body表征虽有用，但现有潜像素世界模型对动力学差异的建模仍远不充分，body code是区分外观相同角色的关键。

title: DKnown-Jev-2: Article-Level Answer-Evidence Classification and Efficient Inference with a Pre-trained Language Model
summary: Evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering requires determining whether a candidate article contains content that directly supports an answer under the applicable conditions of the question. We present DKnown-Jev-2, an article-level answer evidence classifier designed for evidence integration across multiple paragraphs. The model jointly encodes question conditions, article metadata, and paragraph content, and uses a pointer-style classification head to predict Answer Evidence (AE) and Non-answer Evidence (NE) in a single forward pass. Ona manually annotated test set of 972 evaluation instances, DKnown-Jev-2 achieves 91.77% accuracy and 91.28% macro-F1, outperforming Jev by 2.16 and 2.37 percentage points, respectively, while reducing both evidence misses and non-evidence false positives. The test set contains 317 multi-paragraph instances, with a maximum body length of 9,322 characters. Shared article encoding and non-autoregressive classification support low-latency inference. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method for article-level evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering.

AI.tldr: DKnown-Jev-2：一种面向规范性知识问答的篇章级答案证据分类器，联合编码问题条件、文章元数据与段落内容，用指针式分类头单次前向预测AE/NE，准确率91.77%、宏F1 91.28%，较Jev分别提升2.16和2.37个百分点。
AI.motivation: 规范性知识问答中的证据选择需判断候选条款在问题适用条件下是否直接支持答案，且证据常跨多段落，需要篇章级的多段落证据整合判断。
AI.method: 提出DKnown-Jev-2，联合编码问题条件、文章元数据与段落内容，采用指针式分类头在单次前向中同时预测答案证据（AE）与非答案证据（NE）；共享文章编码与非自回归分类实现低延迟推理。
AI.result: 在972个人工标注测试实例上达91.77%准确率与91.28%宏F1，较Jev分别提升2.16与2.37个百分点，同时减少证据漏检与非证据误报；测试集含317个多段落实例，正文最长9,322字符。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在规范性知识问答的篇章级证据选择上有效，兼顾性能与推理效率。

title: ActField: Learning Action Effects as Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics
summary: Learning how actions change visual states is essential for prediction and decision-making in embodied tasks. Existing action-conditioned JEPA world models typically predict future representations at discrete observation intervals, leaving the temporal evolution of action effects implicit. We introduce ActField, a continuous-time JEPA world model that explicitly models latent state evolution through an action-conditioned vector field integrated over physical time. ActField separates action-independent evolution from action-induced changes, with the latter modulated by the latent context. A reference-conditioned representation and multi-step dynamics loss further support accurate long-horizon prediction. Together, these components provide a structured and temporally continuous formulation for predicting action-conditioned visual dynamics. Experiments across LIBERO, DROID, and BEHAVIOR demonstrate improved visual prediction fidelity and more accurate action-induced motion prediction over existing world models. Further evaluations on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate the utility of ActField in improving downstream policy planning through VLM-guided action selection.

AI.tldr: ActField 是一个连续时间的 JEPA 世界模型，用动作条件向量场在物理时间上积分来显式建模潜状态演化，把动作无关演化与动作诱导变化分离，提升长期预测与规划效果。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件 JEPA 世界模型只在离散观测间隔上预测未来表征，动作效应的时间演化被隐式处理，难以刻画动作如何连续地改变视觉状态，而这对于具身任务中的预测与决策至关重要。
AI.method: 提出连续时间 JEPA 世界模型 ActField：以动作条件向量场对物理时间积分来建模潜状态演化；将动作无关演化与动作诱导变化解耦，后者由潜上下文调制；引入参考条件表征与多步动力学损失以支撑长时程预测。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、DROID、BEHAVIOR 上，视觉预测保真度与动作诱导运动预测精度均优于现有世界模型；在仿真与真实机器人操作任务中，通过 VLM 引导的动作选择提升了下游策略规划效果。
AI.conclusion: 连续时间、动作解耦的向量场建模为动作条件视觉动力学提供了结构化且时间连续的表述，可有效服务于长时程预测与具身决策规划。

title: Selecting Stable Sampling Dynamics for Compositional Diffusion: A Feynman-Kac Weight Reduction
summary: Given $K$ separately trained diffusion models, how should one sample from a $β_k$-weighted product of their terminal laws without jointly retraining the experts? Existing Feynman--Kac constructions provide many weighted stochastic differential equations (SDEs) with the correct target marginal. The consequential question is how to select useful proposal dynamics among them. We study an explicit family of weighted diffusions that realizes the same product-of-intermediate-experts trajectory. A scalar parameter $λ$ controls how strongly the proposal drift follows the composed expert score, while an additional Langevin component can be varied independently. Writing $B=\sum_{k=1}^{K}β_k>0$, we identify the distinguished choice $λ=1/B$. At this value, the aggregate squared-score term in the instantaneous Feynman--Kac log-weight rate cancels exactly. For positive expert exponents, the remaining score-disagreement contribution is non-positive. We call this structural cancellation Feynman--Kac reduction. Under bounded-divergence assumptions, it yields an upper bound on the instantaneous unnormalized log-weight rate for all $λ\leq 1/B$. For linear diffusion protocols with compactly supported expert data, $λ=1/B$ yields two-sided bounds at every nonterminal time, for exponents of either sign. A corresponding result holds for a single expert under the same divergence assumption. In these two-sided settings, the selected value is unique within the specified family in a universal worst-case sense. Experiments on Gaussian mixtures and molecular sampling compare the analytically predicted stability with actual sampling quality, including instances in which parameter choices different from $λ=1/B$ perform better empirically.

AI.tldr: 研究K个独立训练扩散模型的β_k加权乘积采样问题，在一族加权扩散中引入标量参数λ，证明λ=1/B（B=Σβ_k）使Feynman–Kac对数权重的平方得分项精确抵消，称"FK reduction"，并据此给出稳定性上界与唯一性结论。
AI.motivation: 现有Feynman–Kac构造能给出正确目标边际的多种加权SDE，但缺少在众多候选提议动力学中挑选"有用"的一个的原则性准则。
AI.method: 构造实现同一"乘积-of-intermediate-experts"轨迹的显式加权扩散族：λ控制提议漂移跟随组合专家得分的强度，Langevin成分可独立调节；分析瞬时FK对数权重速率，在λ=1/B处识别平方得分项的结构抵消，并在有界散度假设及线性扩散协议（紧支撑专家数据、指数可正可负）下推导单/双侧界与唯一性（最坏情形意义）。
AI.result: λ=1/B时聚合平方得分项精确消去；正指数下剩余得分分歧项非正，得到所有λ≤1/B的瞬时未归一化对数权重速率上界；线性扩散协议下λ=1/B在每一非终端时刻给出双侧界，且该取值在该族内具有普适最坏情形唯一性；高斯混合与分子采样实验对照了理论稳定性与实际采样质量，部分情形下偏离λ=1/B反而经验更优。
AI.conclusion: FK reduction为组合扩散模型的提议动力学提供了可分析、可证明稳定性的默认选择λ=1/B，但它是权重方差意义下的准则，未必等价于最佳采样质量，实践中需与经验调参权衡。

title: MQCODet: Modality Quality-Guided Collaborative Optimization for UAV-Based RGB-T Tiny Pedestrian Detection
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based RGB-thermal (RGB-T) remote sensing provides complementary visual and thermal information for pedestrian perception under complex aerial observation conditions. However, detecting tiny pedestrians in UAV-based RGB-T imagery remains challenging due to cross-modal spatial heterogeneity, manifested as modality quality imbalance and spatial position misalignment. Existing RGB-T detectors primarily address these challenges at the feature fusion stage, without establishing an effective coupling between feature fusion and object localization, potentially resulting in suboptimal detection performance. To address this limitation, we introduce a Modality Quality-Guided Collaborative Optimization Detector (MQCODet), which extends modality quality from a fusion prior to a localization supervision cue. Specifically, we propose a Dynamic Calibration and Region-Aware Fusion (DCRF) module that progressively refines cross-modal spatial alignment and performs region-aware fusion to generate reliable multi-scale features and a scene-level modality quality prior. We further design an Efficient Contextual Interaction (ECI) encoder to enhance multi-scale feature interaction while preserving fine-grained spatial details. Moreover, we propose a Modality-Aware Adaptive (MAA) loss that incorporates the modality prior and object scale to adaptively balance spatial consistency and geometric similarity for localization supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MQCODet surpasses state-of-the-art methods on two UAV-based RGB-T tiny pedestrian detection benchmarks while achieving real-time inference on the edge platform.

AI.tldr: 提出MQCODet，将模态质量从融合先验扩展为定位监督线索，解决无人机RGB-T微小行人检测中的跨模态空间异质性问题。
AI.motivation: 无人机RGB-T微小行人检测面临跨模态空间异质性：模态质量不均衡与空间位置错位。现有检测器只在特征融合阶段处理这些挑战，未在融合与目标定位间建立有效耦合，性能受限。
AI.method: 1) 动态校准与区域感知融合模块（DCRF），渐进细化跨模态空间对齐并执行区域感知融合，生成可靠多尺度特征与场景级模态质量先验；2) 高效上下文交互（ECI）编码器，增强多尺度特征交互同时保留细粒度空间细节；3) 模态感知自适应（MAA）损失，结合模态先验与目标尺度，自适应平衡空间一致性与几何相似性用于定位监督。
AI.result: 在两个无人机RGB-T微小行人检测基准上超越现有最先进方法，并在边缘平台实现实时推理。
AI.conclusion: 将模态质量作为定位监督信号可与融合形成有效耦合，显著提升无人机RGB-T微小行人检测性能，且满足边缘实时部署需求。

title: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
summary: Looped Transformers iterate a shared block of layers to increase computation without adding parameters, offering stronger performance and test-time scaling. However, this power has so far required training from scratch and yielded only modest gains for LLMs. Finetuning existing models into loops is far cheaper, yet also brings only marginal gains over SFT. We propose LoopRes, an effective, scalable, and simple approach that turns loops into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs. Building on Attention Residuals, LoopRes lets each looped layer attend directly to the outputs of earlier loops. Since these outputs are iterates of the same layers and become harder to tell apart, we give each a trainable loop-aware key that encodes its structural identity. Attending to all earlier loops also lets layers skip intermediate ones, so we restrict each layer to a residual window of the latest W loops, forcing every loop to build incrementally on recent ones. Across 6 pretrained LLMs from 3 model families and 9 benchmarks, LoopRes delivers significant and consistent gains: at 2x compute, it improves Qwen3-1.7B-Base by 29.1% over SFT, more than doubling the gain of the state-of-the-art baseline. The gains hold on larger models up to 30B and across all three families. More importantly, from 1.7B to 8B, LoopRes scales more steeply than SFT as compute grows, reaching a higher ceiling while needing less compute on long outputs. These results establish LoopRes as an effective looping approach, delivering both better performance and better test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: LoopRes 通过 Attention Residuals 与循环感知键、限定残差窗口，把预训练 LLM 微调成循环结构，在 2x 计算下显著超越 SFT，并具备更好的测试时扩展性。
AI.motivation: 循环 Transformer 可用共享层增加计算而不增参数，但通常需从头训练且对 LLM 增益有限；直接将已有模型微调为循环结构虽便宜，却仅比 SFT 略有提升。作者希望让循环成为对预训练 LLM 显著且稳定的增益来源。
AI.method: 提出 LoopRes：在 Attention Residuals 基础上，让每个循环层直接关注更早循环的输出；由于这些输出是同一层迭代结果、难以区分，为每个输出加入编码结构身份的可训练循环感知 key；同时把每层的关注限制在最近 W 个循环的残差窗口，避免跳过中间循环，强制逐循环增量构建。
AI.result: 在 3 个模型家族、6 个预训练 LLM、9 个基准上验证：2x 计算下 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 相比 SFT 提升 29.1%，超过 SOTA 基线增益的两倍；增益在最大 30B 模型和三个家族上均保持；1.7B 到 8B 范围内 LoopRes 随计算增长扩展更陡、上限更高，长输出下所需计算更少。
AI.conclusion: LoopRes 是一种有效、可扩展且简单的循环方法，对预训练 LLM 同时带来更好的性能和更好的测试时扩展性。

title: WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce
summary: We present WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models that deliver frontier e-commerce capabilities while achieving state-of-the-art general-purpose performance at their respective scales. The family spans five sizes, from a 0.8B dense model to a 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters. Our training pipeline begins with two-stage continued pre-training that progressively raises the proportion of e-commerce data within a diverse multimodal data mixture, followed by hybrid-thinking post-training that combines on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning to support both non-thinking and thinking modes. For evaluation, we construct a comprehensive suite of 28 e-commerce benchmarks (23 in-house and five open-source) covering eight business scenarios and complement it with 64 public general-purpose benchmarks. On the e-commerce suite, WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B surpasses substantially larger open-source flagship models, including Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, HY4, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. On the general-purpose suite, every WeMM-Ecom model surpasses its similarly sized Qwen3.5 counterpart, with the lightweight variants (e.g., WeMM-Ecom-2B) showing clear advantages over leading lightweight models such as Qwen3.5-2B, MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B, and LFM3-VL-2B. Beyond benchmarks, WeMM-Ecom now powers hundreds of production use cases in WeChat, including catalog management, multimodal product search, and livestream commerce, serving billion-scale requests per day. We publicly release all model weights and detail our data curation, training recipe, and benchmark construction to facilitate future work on domain-specialized multimodal models. We have released the model weights and code to facilitate future research at https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Ecom.

AI.tldr: WeMM-Ecom 是一系列面向电商场景的多模态大语言模型（0.8B 稠密到 35B-A3B MoE），通过两阶段持续预训练与混合思考后训练，在电商任务超越更大旗舰模型，同时通用能力优于同规模 Qwen3.5，并已在微信大规模落地。
AI.motivation: 电商场景需要专用多模态能力，而现有通用大模型在电商任务上不足；同时专用化往往牺牲通用性能。作者希望在保持前沿通用能力的同时获得领先的电商能力。
AI.method: 模型家族含五个规模（0.8B 稠密至 35B MoE/3B 激活）。训练流程：先做两阶段持续预训练，逐步提高多模态数据混合中电商数据比例；再做混合思考后训练，结合在线策略蒸馏与强化学习，支持非思考与思考两种模式。评估构建 28 个电商基准（23 内部+5 开源，覆盖 8 类业务场景）及 64 个公开通用基准。
AI.result: 电商基准上 WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B 大幅超越更大的开源旗舰模型（Qwen3.8-Flash-Next、HY4、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）；通用基准上所有规模均优于同尺寸 Qwen3.5，轻量版（如 2B）领先 Qwen3.5-2B、MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B、LFM3-VL-2B。已在微信数百个生产场景（商品目录管理、多模态商品搜索、直播电商）落地，日处理十亿级请求。
AI.conclusion: WeMM-Ecom 证明领域专用多模态模型可在不牺牲通用能力的前提下达到电商 SOTA 并支撑超大规模生产。作者公开全部权重、代码及数据策展、训练配方与基准构建细节，以促进后续研究。

title: When Simpler Beats Learned: Dual-Weighted Sampling vs. Machine Learning for the Pricing Subproblem in Graph Coloring
summary: The graph coloring problem can be solved to optimality by branch-and-price (B&P), but its performance hinges on the column generation (CG) step, where each iteration requires solving a maximum weight independent set (MWIS) pricing problem. The state-of-the-art machine-learning (ML) pricing heuristic follows a prediction-sampling paradigm: a learned model scores each vertex of a graph, and independent sets are sampled from the induced distribution. We observe, however, that the scoring procedure does not need to be learned, and critically assess the role of ML by replacing the learned scores with the dual solution of the restricted master problem, resulting in Dual-Weighted Sampling, a proposed lightweight alternative that requires no feature engineering or training. Within a unified CG and B&P framework that varies only the pricing oracle, Dual-Weighted Sampling outperforms MLPH, hand-crafted heuristics, and exact solvers on the established graph coloring benchmark in both runtime and solution quality. In particular, it remains competitive on the DIMACS random family, where MLPH was shown strongest in the original evaluation, while achieving more than a two-fold speedup in CG runtime on recursive-sparse and real-world graph families.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dual-Weighted Sampling：直接用受限主问题的对偶解作顶点分数进行采样，替代机器学习定价启发式，在统一框架下于图着色基准上更快更好地求解。
AI.motivation: 图着色可经 B&P 最优求解，但性能受限于列生成中每次迭代需解 MWIS 定价问题。现有 ML 定价启发式（MLPH）采用"预测—采样"范式，需要特征工程与训练；作者质疑学习分数是否必要。
AI.method: 将 ML 模型学到的顶点分数替换为受限主问题的对偶解，基于该分布采样独立集，构成无需特征工程、无需训练的轻量定价启发式（Dual-Weighted Sampling）。在仅改变定价 oracle 的统一 CG 与 B&P 框架中进行对照实验。
AI.result: 在既定图着色基准上，运行时与解质量均优于 MLPH、手工启发式与精确求解器；在 MLPH 原本表现最强的 DIMACS 随机族上仍具竞争力，在 recursive-sparse 与真实图族上 CG 运行时加速两倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 定价采样的关键在于对偶权重信号而非学习得到的分数，简单无需训练的对偶加权采样即可超过 ML 方法，提示相关 ML 定价工作的收益应重新审视。

title: Look Back, Draft Ahead: Corrective Prefix Attention for Parallel Speculative Decoding
summary: Parallel speculative decoders propose an entire token block at once, yet one early inconsistency can cause the target to reject its remaining suffix. We introduce Corrective Prefix Attention (CPA), which combines prefix-aware selection with autoregressive supervision to improve these parallel drafts. CPA lets each candidate attend to earlier choices within the block. Fixed candidate shortlists allow all pairwise interactions to be computed before selection, reducing the sequential walk to table lookups, accumulation and lightweight scoring rather than repeated neural evaluations. An auxiliary autoregressive loss trains the shared backbone on clean prefixes without adding an inference pass. Across eight math, code and dialogue benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B targets on Ascend NPUs, CPA commits 13--15\% more tokens per verification round than DSpark and 25--26\% more than DFlash. Its mean speedups reach $3.35\times$ and $3.37\times$ under greedy decoding and $2.86\times$ under sampling for both targets. Ablations support both components, while capacity sweeps demonstrate that greater acceptance alone does not guarantee faster decoding. These results motivate correcting parallel proposals with causal information while keeping sequential computation inexpensive.

AI.tldr: CPA（Corrective Prefix Attention）通过前缀感知选择与自回归监督改进并行投机解码草稿，在Ascend NPU上实现约3.35×（贪心）与2.86×（采样）的加速。
AI.motivation: 并行投机解码器一次提出整个token块，但块内早期的不一致会导致目标模型拒绝其后的整个后缀，造成草稿浪费。作者希望用因果信息修正并行提议，同时保持顺序计算开销低廉。
AI.method: 提出CPA：让每个候选token关注块内更早的选择（前缀感知选择），并对共享骨干网络施加一个辅助自回归损失，训练其在干净前缀上预测，且不增加额外推理开销。通过固定候选短名单，在选前预先计算所有成对交互，把顺序遍历降为查表、累加和轻量打分，避免重复神经评估。
AI.result: 在8个数学、代码与对话基准，Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B目标模型、Ascend NPU上：每轮验证提交的token比DSpark多13–15%、比DFlash多25–26%；贪心解码平均加速3.35×/3.37×，采样下2.86×。消融支持两个组件各自的作用；容量扫描显示接受率更高未必带来更快解码。
AI.conclusion: 用因果信息修正并行提议、同时保持顺序计算廉价，是提升并行投机解码效率的有效方向。

title: Beyond the Black Box: A Diagnosis-Driven Agent for Interpretable MIP Solver Tuning
summary:
Tuning a mixed-integer programming (MIP) solver is an instance-specific problem, where a poor configuration can increase solving time by orders of magnitude.
  Existing Bayesian optimization tuners treat solver tuning as a black-box optimization problem: each evaluation returns a single score, allowing the tuner to learn which configuration is faster, but not why.
  Inspired by the use of profilers in GPU-kernel optimization, we introduce APEC (Agent for Per-instance Explainable Configuration), a log-grounded tuning agent for MIP solvers.
  APEC has three layers: a deterministic layer that profiles each log, an interpretation layer that guides hypothesis-driven diagnosis, and a system layer that controls evaluation, enabling more reliable and interpretable solver tuning.
  On the full MIPLIB 2017 benchmark set, APEC achieves a 1.58X improvement over the default configuration with over 38% fewer parameter changes than the baselines, making the results easier to read.

AI.tldr: 受GPU内核优化中profiler的启发，提出日志驱动的MIP求解器调参智能体APEC，在MIPLIB 2017上取得1.58倍加速且参数改动减少38%。
AI.motivation: MIP求解器调参是实例相关的问题，配置不当会使求解时间增加数个数量级。现有贝叶斯优化调参器把调参当作黑盒优化：每次评估只返回单一分数，只能学到哪个配置更快，却无法解释"为什么"。
AI.method: 提出APEC（Agent for Per-instance Explainable Configuration），一个基于日志的调参智能体，包含三层：确定性层（对每个日志做profiling）、解释层（引导假设驱动的诊断）、系统层（控制评估流程），从而实现更可靠、可解释的调参。
AI.result: 在完整MIPLIB 2017基准集上，APEC相比默认配置实现1.58倍提升，且相比基线参数改动减少逾38%，使结果更易解读。
AI.conclusion: 将性能剖析与假设驱动诊断引入求解器调参，可在更少参数改动下获得显著加速并提升可解释性，为可解释自动调参提供了新范式。

title: Constrained Diffusion from Binary Evaluations via Learned Doob h-Functions
summary: Conditional generation under constraints that can only be checked on a finished sample, such as a molecular property filter, remains challenging for diffusion models: most guidance methods require differentiable measurement operators, paired conditional data, or rollouts of the base model at every step. We present a framework grounded in the Doob $h$-transform that reduces conditional generation to learning a single function, the probability that a noisy sample denoises into the constraint set. We learn this function from binary clean-sample evaluations alone, by squared-error regression on forward-noised labels; the base model is frozen, one lightweight head is trained per constraint, and noisy-state classifier guidance arises as a special case. The exact guidance step fades where the constraint signal provably vanishes and carries a factor of the inverse probability across samples, which normalized guidance discards: with the schedule and mean step size held fixed, equalizing the step costs 17.0 to 18.5 points of constraint satisfaction on CIFAR-10 at comparable FID, across independently trained estimators. Guidance is more than 50$\times$ cheaper per satisfying sample than rejection sampling at a 1.7% base rate, raises a Lipinski-type property filter on QM9 from 54.3% to 96.8%, and lifts satisfaction on Stable Diffusion 1.5 from 7.2% to 60.0% at one sixteenth of the cost of derivative-free selection, which reaches 9.0%. These results demonstrate that binary evaluations of clean samples are sufficient supervision for constrained generation across pixel, latent, and molecular diffusion.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Doob h-变换的约束条件生成框架，仅用二值（满足/不满足）评估结果回归学习"噪声样本最终落入约束集的概率"，冻结基模型、每个约束仅训练一个轻量头，实现高效且理论上精确的引导。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在只能对最终样本检验的约束（如分子属性过滤）下难以条件生成：现有引导方法需要可微测量算子、配对的（条件）数据，或每一步都需对基模型做 rollout，代价高、适用性受限。
AI.method: 以Doob h-变换为理论基础，将条件生成归约为学习单一函数 h(x_t,t)=P(最终去噪样本满足约束)。用前向加噪标签上的平方误差回归，仅依赖干净样本的二值评估来训练该函数；基模型冻结，每个约束训练一个轻量头；噪声状态分类器引导成为其特例。推导出精确引导步：在约束信号可证消失处自动衰减，并带有逆概率因子（归一化引导会丢弃该因子）。
AI.result: CIFAR-10上保持相同时间步调度与平均步长时，计入该逆概率因子使约束满足率提升17.0–18.5个百分点且FID相当，跨独立训练的估计器一致；在1.7%基础满足率下，每个满足样本的代价比拒绝采样低50倍以上；QM9上Lipinski类属性过滤从54.3%提升到96.8%；Stable Diffusion 1.5上从7.2%提升到60.0%，代价仅为无导数选择法（仅达9.0%）的1/16。
AI.conclusion: 干净样本的二值评估即足以监督约束生成，方法在像素空间、潜空间与分子扩散上均有效，兼具理论精确性与实用效率。

title: KineState-SWAM: A Surgical World Action Model with Explicit Kinematics and Causal Interaction Dynamics
summary: Existing surgical world models often leave implicit how instrument motion drives localized tissue responses and how interaction history informs subsequent actions. We introduce KineState-SWAM, a surgical world-action model coupling action prediction and video generation through a persistent interaction state, separating kinematically determined instrument motion from learned scene evolution. A flow-matching policy predicts joint trajectories conditioned on interaction state, robot configuration, and task instruction. Kinematic Geometry Conditioning converts these trajectories into surface-motion tokens and spatially aligned instrument renderings using calibrated URDF kinematics. Causal Interaction Dynamics recurrently updates the state through geometry-guided attention and motion-aligned feature transport, carrying interaction history into subsequent action predictions without intermediate video synthesis. The State-Geometry Adapter combines state-dependent spatial modulation with localized geometric residuals to guide video generation. Interaction-aware supervision emphasizes tissue responses near instrument working regions. We introduce dVRK-Chole5.2k, comprising 5,255 videos spanning 17 surgical tasks. Experiments demonstrate improved action accuracy and video fidelity over evaluated baselines within matched action-conditioning settings. Ablations support preserving and transporting interaction states for long-horizon prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出 KineState-SWAM，一种以"持久交互状态"耦合动作预测与视频生成的手术世界-动作模型，将器械运动几何与场景演化分离建模，并发布 dVRK-Chole5.2k 数据集（5,255 段视频、17 项任务）。
AI.motivation: 现有手术世界模型未显式刻画器械运动如何驱动局部组织响应，也未把交互历史纳入后续动作决策，导致长时程预测与动作准确性受限。
AI.method: (1) flow-matching 策略以交互状态、机器人构型和任务指令为条件预测关节轨迹；(2) 运动学几何条件（KGC）用标定 URDF 将轨迹转为表面运动 token 与空间对齐的器械渲染；(3) 因果交互动力学模块通过几何引导注意力与运动对齐特征传输递归更新状态，无需中间视频合成即可携带历史；(4) State-Geometry Adapter 以状态空间调制加局部几何残差引导视频生成；(5) 交互感知监督聚焦器械工作区附近组织响应。
AI.result: 在匹配动作条件的设置下，动作精度与视频保真度均优于所比较基线；消融实验支持保留并传输交互状态对长时程预测有益。
AI.conclusion: 显式分离运动学确定量与学习式场景演化、并持久化交互状态，是提升手术动作-视频联合建模的有效途径；新数据集为后续研究提供基准。

title: Serialization and the Character-System: Measuring Narrative Concentration in French Fiction (1800--1940)
comment: Computational Humanities Research Conference (Manchester, january 7-9) 24 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables
summary: Every novel divides a finite quantity of narrative attention among its characters, and whether the shape of that division, between a narrative organized around a single figure and one spread across a crowd, has a history is far less settled than the abundance of critical commentary on protagonists might suggest. We operationalize Woloch's notion of the character-system, the distribution of narrative attention across a novel's cast structured by the tension between "the one" and "the many", as the inequality (Gini coefficient) of the PageRank distribution over a character network. We trace this measure of structural concentration across 12,011 French novels published between 1800 and 1940, drawn from the Hors d'usage corpus of Gallica fiction. Over the long nineteenth century the trajectory is U-shaped, with concentration declining to a trough in the 1850s-1860s and rising again through the turn of the century. The change is small, comparable to the difference between a novel built on two co-equal protagonists and one built on a single protagonist, but it is robust to the character cutoff, corpus density, cast size, and author effects. Detective and adventure fiction are less concentrated than the average novel of their period. Literary history reads the roman-feuilleton either as the novel of a superior hero or as a form of proliferating episodes, and on this structural measure our results support the second reading. Across the age of the feuilleton (1840-1914), authors whose careers were structured by newspaper serialization distribute centrality more evenly than a literary control, net of period, genre, and canon. Because such claims are only as trustworthy as the networks they rest on, we also evaluate the extraction pipeline against manually annotated novels, at the levels of cast and character identity.

AI.tldr: The paper operationalizes Woloch's "character-system" as the Gini coefficient of PageRank over character networks, and traces narrative concentration across 12,011 French novels (1800–1940), finding a U-shaped trajectory and a more even distribution in serialized feuilleton authors.
AI.motivation: Critics have long discussed protagonists, but whether the *distribution* of narrative attention between "the one" and "the many" has a historical trajectory is unsettled. The paper seeks a quantitative, corpus-scale measure of this structural concentration.
AI.method: Character networks are extracted from the Hors d'usage Gallica fiction corpus; narrative attention is modeled as the PageRank distribution over characters, and its inequality is measured with a Gini coefficient. The measure is traced over 12,011 novels (1800–1940) with robustness checks (character cutoff, corpus density, cast size, author effects). The extraction pipeline is validated against manually annotated novels at cast and character-identity levels.
AI.result: Concentration follows a U-shape: declining to a trough in the 1850s–1860s, then rising toward 1900. The effect is small (comparable to the difference between two co-equal protagonists vs. one) but robust. Detective and adventure fiction are less concentrated than period averages. Across 1840–1914, authors structured by newspaper serialization distribute centrality more evenly than a literary control, net of period, genre, and canon—supporting the "proliferating episodes" reading of the roman-feuilleton.
AI.conclusion: The history of the novel's character-system is quantifiable: structural concentration is U-shaped over the long nineteenth century, and feuilleton authorship is associated with more evenly distributed narrative attention. Trust in these claims depends on validated network extraction.

title: Uncovering Hidden Behaviours in Language Models via Limited-Parameter Finetuning
comment: Published at NeurIPS 2026. 53 pages, 19 figures, 6 tables
summary: Large language models can have behaviours which only arise in hard-to-anticipate contexts. These hidden behaviours pose a challenge to alignment audits, which seek to uncover problematic model behaviour but are limited by the scenarios the auditor can anticipate. To address this challenge, we explore limited-parameter finetuning (LPF) on examples of a target behaviour. While training 3-25% of LoRA parameters, LPF reveals whether the model has a hidden behaviour, even when standard behavioural evaluations cannot. LPF succeeds on a suite of model organisms with hidden behaviours (8-14B parameters), and also surfaces naturally occurring hidden behaviours in open-weight models (27-35B parameters). LPF can thus distinguish between models which appear behaviourally identical to an auditor, and does not require the context in which the hidden behaviour surfaces. LPF provides a novel affordance that may be useful for auditing frontier AI models. However, we do not evaluate LPF against baselines in a realistic auditing setting, so further work is needed to determine its practicality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出有限参数微调(LPF)，在仅训练3-25% LoRA参数的情况下即可揭示模型中难以预期的隐藏行为，用于对齐审计。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型存在只在难以预见的情境中才显现的隐藏行为，而对齐审计受限于审计者能设想到的场景，难以发现这些行为。
AI.method: 对目标行为的示例进行有限参数微调(LPF)：仅训练3-25%的LoRA参数，通过微调响应判断模型是否内隐该行为，无需知道隐藏行为实际触发的上下文。
AI.result: 在8-14B参数的"模型生物"(model organisms)隐藏行为测试集上成功；并在27-35B参数的开源模型中揭示自然产生的隐藏行为；即使标准行为评估无法发现，LPF仍能区分表面行为相同的模型。
AI.conclusion: LPF为前沿模型审计提供了新的可用手段，但尚未在真实审计场景中与基线方法对比，其实用性仍需进一步验证。

title: Learning Gaussian Process Priors with Linear Semigroups and Kinetic Regularisation
summary: We introduce a semigroup-based construction of Gaussian process (GP) priors. A linear semigroup transforms a source GP at $t=0$ into a prior at $t=1$, enabling computationally tractable regression. Linearity preserves Gaussianity, allowing us to characterise the evolution of the covariance and draw connections with optimal transport and convolution models. The semigroup is parametrised by its generator, which is learned through two competing objectives: the marginal likelihood encourages agreement with observations, while a kinetic-energy regulariser favours lower-energy trajectories and limits unnecessary mass displacement from the source GP. Experiments on independent GP draws show that, with sufficiently many training functions, the learned prior provides accurate predictions on held-out functions, while kinetic regularisation substantially reduces the energy of the generated trajectories without compromising prediction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出基于线性半群的GP先验构造方法，用生成元参数化学到的先验，借助边缘似然与动能正则实现可计算的回归。
AI.motivation: 标准GP先验（如核选择）较死板，难以从观测中自适应学习先验结构；希望构造既保持高斯性、又计算可行、且能刻画先验"演化"的灵活GP先验框架。
AI.method: 以线性半群把t=0的源GP变换为t=1的目标先验；线性保证高斯性，可解析刻画协方差演化，并与最优传输、卷积模型建立联系。半群由其生成元参数化，生成元用两个竞争目标联合学习：边缘似然（拟合观测）与动能正则（偏向低能量轨迹、抑制源GP的不必要质量位移）。
AI.result: 在独立GP采样函数上的实验表明：训练函数足够多时，学到的先验对留出函数预测准确；动能正则显著降低生成轨迹能量，同时不损害预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 半群视角为GP先验学习提供了理论清晰、计算可行的新框架，能统一最优传输与卷积类模型，动能正则起到有效控制作用。

title: SENSA: Visual-to-Brain Generation with Individualized Subject-State Transfer and Adaptation
summary:
Visual-to-brain encoding predicts neural responses to visual stimuli, supporting visual cognition research and neural decoding. However, challenges in disentangling shared from image-specific activity, together with inter-subject distribution shifts and representational heterogeneity, limit accurate encoding and cross-subject generalization with limited calibration data.
  We introduce SENSA, a structured continuous neural response generation framework that separates shared activity from image-dependent responses and calibrates a compact subject state. An independent response prior captures shared activity, while complementary visual descriptors drive separable sensor-time bases and a shared Response Refiner. Subject-Adaptive Factor Transport adjusts the spatiotemporal expression of shared bases, while Source-Grounded Residual Memory predicts image-dependent corrections in source-response coordinates. Together, they personalize a frozen generator using limited paired support.
  Experiments demonstrate that the generation backbone outperforms recent generators across three datasets, with image-identity perturbations confirming stimulus specificity. Using only 400 paired images, electroencephalography (EEG) and the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) calibration achieve residual Pearson correlations of 0.1091 and 0.2995, respectively, demonstrating effective brain-response generation and cross-subject adaptation.

AI.tldr: SENSA是结构化连续神经响应生成框架，将共享活动与图像特异响应解耦，并通过少量配对数据校准紧凑的受试者状态，实现视觉到脑的编码与跨受试者泛化。
AI.motivation: 视觉到脑编码面临三大难题：共享活动与图像特异活动难以解耦、受试者间分布漂移、表征异质性，且校准数据有限，导致编码精度与跨受试者泛化不足。
AI.method: SENSA用独立的响应先验捕捉共享活动，用互补视觉描述子驱动可分离的传感器-时间基与共享Response Refiner；Subject-Adaptive Factor Transport调整共享基的时空表达，Source-Grounded Residual Memory在源响应坐标中预测图像相关修正，从而用少量配对支持数据个性化一个冻结的生成器。
AI.result: 生成主干在三个数据集上优于近期生成器，图像身份扰动验证了刺激特异性；仅用400张配对图像，EEG与NSD校准分别达到残差Pearson相关0.1091和0.2995。
AI.conclusion: SENSA能有效生成脑响应并实现跨受试者适应，在有限校准数据下兼顾共享结构与个体特异性。

title: Deneb-Vritra: Descriptions, Edges and Names Examined by Blocking Via Restoring Token Representations and Attention
summary: Laya is a 421M-parameter encoder that answers a question about a text in one pass: each answer option, written as a name plus a description, gets a marker token, and one score is read from the network at each marker. We first confirm that such models can follow an option's name when it contradicts the description; the question is where in the network this happens. We locate it. On 951 synthetic questions we move each name onto another option's description and count how often the model picks the option with the right name (the name shortcut): 53% for the released checkpoint, 59% for our fine-tune v1, 11% for a fine-tune with name randomisation. On a 320-item sample, blocking attention from each marker to its own name tokens in layers 14 to 17 of 28 cuts v1's shortcut from 67% to 16% (19% on two schemas held out from component selection) while accuracy with the original names stays at 90%; blocking marker edges to the question, other options or text has no effect. No single head matters (largest effect 9 points), and restoring clean marker states undoes the swap from layer 16. Attention mass tracks the window by layer but not by head. Repeated on 5 checkpoints (released, fine-tuned, name-randomised, and a pair trained without two schemas), the knockout finds similar layers; in the name-randomised ones, blocking the description edges instead brings the shortcut back to 56-58%, so the read persists and is outvoted. Marker states decode the name from layer 0; a one-direction probe erasure changed nothing but was weaker than a random edit. Copying layers 0-13 or 14-27 of a name-randomised sibling into a fine-tune recovers 66% and 65% (v1); 21% and 45% (pair A) of its shortcut reduction. 9 of the 12 predictions we could score, written before running, failed. Head sweeps cover 5 of 5 checkpoints; data are synthetic and LLM-labelled; one architecture.

AI.tldr: Laya是一个421M参数的编码器，一次前向即可根据名字+描述选项回答问题；作者用"名字错配"实验定位到第14–17层（共28层）marker对自身名字token的注意力是名字捷径的关键通路，且该效应在5个checkpoint上可重复。
AI.motivation: 模型能以选项名称为依据作答，甚至宁可相信名称而非与之矛盾的描述。作者想弄清这种"名字捷径"发生在网络的哪一层、哪个组件，即机制层面的定位问题，而非仅报告行为现象。
AI.method: 构造951道合成问题：把每个名称移到另一选项的描述上，统计模型按名字选对的频率（53%原始/59%微调v1/11%名字随机化微调）。在320题样本上逐层阻断marker对自身名字token的注意力，并做对照阻断（问题、其他选项、文本）；再做单头扫描、clean state恢复、探针擦除与跨checkpoint层拷贝实验。
AI.result: 阻断第14–17层marker→自身名字注意力将v1捷径从67%降至16%（留出schema上19%），而原名准确率仍90%；阻断其他边无影响；单头最大效应仅9点；第16层起恢复干净marker状态可撤销swap。名字随机化模型中阻断描述边反而使捷径回升至56–58%，说明读取仍在但被压制。层拷贝可恢复部分捷径（v1 66%/65%）。预注册的12条预测中9条失败。
AI.conclusion: 名字捷径定位于中层的marker-名字注意通路（约第14–17层），由多个头分布式承担而非单一头；该读取信号自第0层即存在并可解码，跨checkpoint与留出schema可泛化。局限：合成数据、LLM标注、单一架构，且多数预注册预测未成立，结论需谨慎外推。

title: How Many Parameters Does Forecasting Need? A Survey and Code-Level Audit of Lightweight Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Long-term time series forecasting supports decisions in energy, transportation, weather and finance, where forecasts are produced continuously and often on constrained hardware. Recent work has moved in two directions. One scales Transformers and pre-trained foundation models to millions or hundreds of millions of parameters. The other shows that models with only hundreds to tens of thousands of parameters remain competitive on the standard benchmarks. Existing surveys organize forecasting models by backbone and treat efficiency as a side topic, so the reasons these small models work, and the way their sizes are reported, remain unexamined. This survey focuses on lightweight long-term forecasting. It provides a taxonomy of about thirty-five models in six families, with a common notation and an architecture diagram for each core model. It offers a structured-linear view in which the smallest models are linear maps restricted by frequency truncation or period folding, and it tests each restriction in closed form on eight benchmarks. It complements the literature review with an audit of sixteen official code repositories, which reproduces published parameter counts and reveals reporting gaps of up to 289 times. Finally, it gives practical guidance on model selection and reporting, and summarizes open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于轻量级长期时间序列预测的综述，构建约35个模型（6个家族）的分类体系，提出"结构化线性"视角解释小模型为何有效，并通过审计16个官方代码库揭示参数计数的报数差异最高达289倍。
AI.motivation: 现有综述按骨干网络组织模型，把效率视为次要议题，因而未考察小模型（仅数百至数万参数）为何仍具竞争力，也未审查其模型规模的报数方式。近期研究一是把Transformer与预训练基础模型扩展到百万乃至亿级参数，二是展示极小模型在标准基准上仍有竞争力，二者形成张力，需要专门审视轻量级长期预测。
AI.method: 聚焦轻量级长期预测：给出约35个模型、6个家族的分类，统一符号并为每个核心模型绘制架构图；提出结构化线性视角，指出最小模型本质上是受频率截断或周期折叠约束的线性映射，并在8个基准上以闭式解析形式检验每种约束；另对16个官方代码库进行审计，复现其公布的参数量。
AI.result: 在8个基准上以闭式形式验证了结构化线性约束的解释力；代码库审计成功复现公布参数计数，并发现最高达289倍的报数缺口。
AI.conclusion: 该综述以轻量级视角统一整理长期预测模型，解释小模型有效性来源，暴露参数报数的不一致，并给出模型选择与报数的实践建议及开放问题。

title: Information-Theoretic Analysis of Multi-Objective Bandits: Pareto Violations & Gap-Based Regret
summary: We study Bayesian multi-objective bandits and ask an information-theoretic question: what aspects of an unknown environment must be resolved to achieve low regret? We show that the answer depends on the regret criterion and the information needed to represent its loss. For Pareto-violation regret, which incurs unit loss whenever a dominated action is selected, the Pareto-optimal set is a natural information target. We introduce a predictive separation measure for competing candidate Pareto sets, connect it to information gain about the unknown set, and use this connection to analyze Thompson Sampling and develop an Information-Directed Sampling strategy. We establish sublinear Bayesian regret under uniform and polynomially decaying separation and prove a lower bound showing that weak separation can impose an unavoidable statistical cost. We then study gap-based Pareto regret, which quantifies the magnitude of Pareto suboptimality. Here, Pareto-set information is generally too coarse: distinct environments can share the same Pareto set while inducing different reward geometries and Pareto gaps, and averaging environments consistent with one Pareto set need not preserve Pareto dominance. This motivates retaining finer information about the environment. We develop parameter-level information-theoretic analyses of Thompson Sampling and Information-Directed Sampling to derive gap-based regret guarantees. Under sublinear information budgets, Pareto Thompson Sampling also achieves sublinear gap regret while recovering the full Pareto set on the same run, with a related guarantee for a fixed mixture with gap-based IDS. Together, our results reveal a hierarchy of information requirements: binary Pareto membership can be controlled through set-level information, whereas quantitative Pareto-gap suboptimality can require finer knowledge of reward geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息论角度研究贝叶斯多目标bandit，揭示实现低遗憾所需解决的"信息对象"取决于遗憾判据：集合级信息足以控制帕累托成员违规遗憾，而定量帕累托gap遗憾需更细的环境/奖励几何知识。
AI.motivation: 作者想回答一个信息论问题：为获得低遗憾，未知环境的哪些方面必须被辨识？已有工作多关注算法设计，缺少对"需要什么信息"的层级性刻画，尤其未区分不同遗憾判据（violation vs gap）对应的信息需求差异。
AI.method: 针对Pareto-violation遗憾，提出候选帕累托集之间的预测分离度（predictive separation），将其与关于未知帕累托集的信息增益联系起来，用以分析Thompson Sampling并构造Information-Directed Sampling (IDS)策略，给出均匀及多项式衰减分离下的次线性贝叶斯遗憾与下界。针对gap-based Pareto遗憾，指出帕累托集信息过粗（同集可对应不同奖励几何、平均不一定保持支配），改用参数级信息论分析TS与IDS。
AI.result: 在均匀与多项式衰减分离下得到次线性贝叶斯遗憾，并证明弱分离会带来不可避免的统计代价下界；在次线性信息预算下，Pareto TS可同时实现次线性gap遗憾并在同一轮次恢复完整帕累托集，基于gap的IDS固定混合亦有相应保证。
AI.conclusion: 结果给出信息需求的层级：二元帕累托成员（是否被支配）可通过集合级信息控制；定量帕累托gap次优性则可能需要更精细的奖励几何知识。

title: Eidetic Code World Model
summary: Executable code can preserve a world's structural layout, yet video renderers frequently alter the appearance of previously visited places once they leave the camera view. We present Paintress, a code-conditioned world model that couples an executable geometric proxy with an independently parameterized 3D Gaussian appearance memory in a shared metric coordinate frame. While the proxy enforces structural and visibility constraints, 3D Gaussians capture the visual realization synthesized by emitted observations. To balance stable incremental fusion with consistent readout, Paintress separates writing from reading: newly emitted frames update a persistent raw Gaussian map under confidence-gated selection, whereas a cloned reader copy is globally refined against the observation archive and rendered with coverage masks to condition generation. We also introduce Expedition-33, a benchmark for generated-appearance retention across 11 static scenes, five route families, and 15, 30, and 60 s target absences (165 settings per system). Excluded from the opening image, targets are synthesized during a shared prefix and scored against each system's own first visit at matched return cameras. Across ten systems (1,650 videos), Paintress achieves 0.1220 ROI-LPIPS, 0.0613 MAE, and 52.12% detail retention (vs. 0.2731, 0.1401, and 10.91% for CWM), with lower discrepancy at 60 s (0.1630) than CWM, AgentGarten, and Lyra 2.0 achieve at 15 s.

AI.tldr: Paintress 是一个代码条件的世界模型，用可执行几何代理 + 独立参数化的 3D 高斯外观记忆来保持已离开视野区域的视觉一致性，并发布 Expedition-33 基准，长期外观保持显著优于 CWM 等系统。
AI.motivation: 可执行代码能保留世界结构布局，但视频渲染器在区域离开相机视野后常改变其已访问过的外观，导致回访时出现不一致。现有方法缺乏对"生成外观保持"的评估手段。
AI.method: 将可执行几何代理与独立参数的 3D 高斯外观记忆耦合于共享度量坐标系：代理负责结构与可见性约束，高斯捕获发射观测的视觉实现。读写分离——新帧经置信度门控更新持久原始高斯地图；另一份克隆读者副本针对观测档案全局优化，并用覆盖掩码渲染以条件化生成。另提出 Expedition-33 基准：11 个静态场景、5 类路线、15/30/60 秒目标缺席（每系统 165 设置），目标首帧不可见、在共享前缀中合成，按各系统自身首访的匹配回访相机评分。
AI.result: 在十个系统共 1,650 个视频上，Paintress 达 0.1220 ROI-LPIPS、0.0613 MAE、52.12% 细节保持率，而 CWM 为 0.2731、0.1401、10.91%；且 60 秒缺席时差异（0.1630）仍低于 CWM、AgentGarten、Lyra 2.0 在 15 秒时的表现。
AI.conclusion: 读写分离的几何-外观解耦设计能有效缓解视野外外观漂移，实现长时缺席下的稳定回访一致性，并在新基准上大幅超越现有系统。

title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
summary: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.

AI.tldr: 提出ToolSmith框架，自动生成并复用多模态搜索智能体的工具模块，突破手工工具库的局限，在域内与域外基准上稳定提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态搜索智能体依赖小型手工工具库，维护成本高，且面对新查询类型、证据格式和失败模式时僵化无法适应；人类则能用熟悉的部件组装新工具并跨任务复用。
AI.method: ToolSmith是一个自动工具生成框架，在精简的基础工具库之上自动生长并复用新模块，模仿人类构造与复用工具的做法。
AI.result: 在三个域内多模态搜索基准和十个域外基准（VLM-as-a-Judge评估）上，ToolSmith相较基础工具库持续提升，且骨干模型越大收益越高，体现可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 自动工具生长与复用能有效增强多模态搜索智能体，兼具通用性与可扩展性，代码与数据已公开。

title: Skill-Composer: Requirement-Driven Skill Selection from Multiple Marketplaces
summary: Agent skills have become the primary vehicle through which agents reuse specialized capabilities, yet public skill marketplaces provide skills with individual items: a query, whether matched through keyword or embedding similarity, returns a list of single skills ordered by relevance or by popularity. Such an interface cannot answer the question a developer actually faces: which set of skills should be installed to cover a task's complete requirement? The highest-ranked skills are often functionally redundant, while capabilities that are genuinely required remain uncovered. In this paper, we argue that skill acquisition should be reframed from ranking to set selection. We propose Skill-Composer, an agent-native framework that selects a non-redundant skill bundle for the user requirement, which aims to cover all available required capabilities and report any gaps. Specifically, it clarifies user requirements into atomic requirement points, retrieves and merges candidate skills across fragmented marketplaces, decomposes each candidate's capabilities, and progressively discards overlapping ones, so that each retained skill provides different capabilities. This moves the decision of which skills to acquire from the developer to the agent itself. We position this reframing and sketch its workflow.

AI.tldr: 提出将智能体技能获取从“排序”重构为“集合选择”，并设计Skill-Composer框架为需求选出非冗余、可覆盖全部所需能力的技能组合并报告缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有技能市场以单项技能列表按相关度或流行度排序返回结果，无法回答“为覆盖任务完整需求应安装哪些技能”的问题：排名靠前的技能常功能冗余，而真正必需的能力可能未被覆盖。
AI.method: Skill-Composer：先将用户需求拆解为原子需求点；跨碎片化市场检索并合并候选技能；分解每个候选技能的能力；逐步剔除重叠技能，使保留技能各自提供不同能力。
AI.result: 论文为立场性/构想性工作，仅给出重构思路与工作流草图，未报告实验或量化结果。
AI.conclusion: 技能获取应由开发者决策转向智能体自主决策，以需求覆盖与去冗余为目标进行技能集选择，并显式报告能力缺口。

title: Model Immunization Cannot Reliably Protect Models from Harmful Adaptation
summary: Efficient fine-tuning techniques have substantially reduced the cost of adapting open-weight models, enabling malicious actors to readily fine-tune them toward harmful capabilities. In response, model immunization modifies a pretrained checkpoint to resist subsequent adaptation toward designated harmful capabilities while preserving its utility and adaptability for benign tasks. Furthermore, a few immunization methods have sought to keep their protection robust to some changes in the attacker's adaptation. However, fine-tuning offers attackers many more low-cost options, and we observe that existing methods still substantially overfit to the attacker configuration they are optimized against. Such overfitting stays hidden when immunization is evaluated under, or near, this configuration, so the reported protection may give a false sense of security. To rigorously evaluate model immunization, we conduct experiments, varying one component of this configuration at a time: the harmful data, the adaptation strategy, or the model initialization. Across four immunization methods on text-to-image generation and image classification, with additional results on language models, these variations substantially degrade the protection, and in many cases the immunized model relearns the harmful capability nearly as well as the un-immunized model. Existing immunization therefore cannot reliably protect models, leaving them vulnerable to harmful adaptation.

AI.tldr: 现有模型免疫方法严重过拟合特定攻击配置，改变有害数据、微调策略或初始化后防护大幅失效，免疫模型常能像未免疫模型一样重新学会有害能力。
AI.motivation: 高效微调降低了开源权重模型被恶意适配至有害能力的成本，模型免疫通过在预训练权重上做修改来抵抗后续有害微调并保留良性任务效用。尽管已有方法试图提升对攻击者适配变化的鲁棒性，但攻击者的低成本微调选项远多于受测情形，现有方法仍严重过拟合其优化所针对的攻击配置，而这种过拟合在接近原配置评估时被掩盖，导致虚假的安全感。
AI.method: 在文本到图像生成与图像分类任务上评估四种免疫方法，并补充语言模型实验；采用单变量消融式评估，每次只改变攻击配置的一个组成部分——有害数据、适配策略（微调方法）或模型初始化——以检验防护的泛化性。
AI.result: 跨任务、跨方法的实验显示，任一类变化都会显著削弱防护效果；在许多情况下，免疫模型重新习得有害能力的程度几乎与未免疫模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型免疫方法无法可靠保护模型，仍易受有害适配攻击；同时提示在该领域需采用更严格的评估协议以避免因评估接近优化配置而高估防护效果。

title: Controlled One-Click Benchmarking and Post-Fusion Recalibration for Support-Conditioned Medical Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
summary: Sparse-prompt medical segmentation is hard to compare when prompts, supports, thresholds, and splits differ. This paper uses a controlled one-click protocol: each test image receives one positive foreground click, training-only support, validation-only checkpoint selection, and no test-time threshold tuning. We propose {Support-Aware Recalibration (SAR)}, a late post-fusion recalibration block for MultiverSeg that combines large-kernel spatial gating with squeeze-and-excitation channel recalibration after support--query fusion. BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG are evaluated with matched 697 foreground-present sample budgets, shared splits/clicks, and threshold-free Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC. Compared with a protocol-matched raw-support MultiverSeg baseline, the main SAR configuration shows favorable mean Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC performance on BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG, while reducing logged training time in this implementation. These controlled results indicate that late post-fusion recalibration is useful under a leakage-controlled one-click protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出支持感知重校准模块(SAR)，在MultiverSeg支持-查询融合后加入大核空间门控与SE通道重校准，并在受控单击协议下验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 稀疏提示医学分割因提示、支持样本、阈值和划分不一致而难以公平比较，缺乏统一受控评估协议。
AI.method: 采用受控单击协议：每张测试图一个正前景点击、支持仅来自训练集、仅用验证集选检查点、不调测试阈值。SAR为MultiverSeg晚期后融合重校准模块，将大核空间门控与squeeze-and-excitation通道重校准结合，置于支持-查询融合之后。在BUSI、NerveUS-BP-present、Kvasir-SEG上以匹配的697前景样本预算、共享划分与点击、无阈值Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC评估。
AI.result: 与协议匹配的原始支持MultiverSeg基线相比，SAR主配置在三个数据集上平均Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC表现更优，同时本实现中记录的训练时间减少。
AI.conclusion: 受控结果表明，在防泄漏单击协议下，晚期后融合重校准是有效的。

title: Testing Quantized KV-Cache Maintenance: Encoding Layout and Historical Restoration
summary: Repeating rows then selecting originals retains layout-dependent drift despite equal encoding counts. We measure when existing checks fail to establish preservation contracts in fixed quantized KV-cache implementations. In four-bit HQQ axis zero at sixteen cycles, median paired relative-L2 increases over same-shape re-encoding are 7.22 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B and 11.59 for SmolLM3-3B. Matched encoded states cover sixteen shared questions per model at one and sixteen cycles. Axis one matches the shape-preserving control; lazy reorders preserve the initial state. On one known input, fixed update counts retain the difference; preserving group members removes it. Our prefix-view extension passes current-prefix checks yet changes history and next logits in six model/codec settings at residual capacities four and 128. Public lookup reaches this boundary, including one of four precommitted project-new GPU inputs; fixed query swaps isolate a conditional old-history effect. Checkpoint/dense rollback is exact. An explicit delayed lookup client admits a supported 129-token path excluded by native AR on one known context. Failed task-harm expansion precludes population failure-rate or general answer-degradation claims. Native MLX-LM fixtures expose stale caller caches; synchronization restores the tested in-place contract with native computations preserved. In rejection tests, stale callers change logits but not greedy tokens.

AI.tldr: 该文测量固定量化KV-cache实现中"布局依赖漂移"，发现现有校验无法建立保持性契约；4-bit HQQ下重复编码后相对L2中位漂移达7.22–11.59个百分点，前缀视图扩展可通过现有检查却改变历史与下一token logits。
AI.motivation: 现有KV-cache校验（如等编码计数、当前前缀检查）不能建立真正的"保持性契约"。作者要刻画这种"布局依赖漂移"何时出现、现有检查为何失效，并明确其边界条件。
AI.method: 在固定量化KV-cache（4-bit HQQ，axis 0/1，1与16周期）上，用配对相对L2比较"重复行后取原始行"与同形状重编码；每模型16个共享问题作配对控制（axis 1、lazy重排、组员保持等变量隔离）。再构造prefix-view扩展测试（残差容量4与128、六种模型/编解码设置），并用公开lookup（含预注册GPU输入）、固定query交换、checkpoint/dense回滚、显式延迟lookup客户端、MLX-LM原生测试及rejection测试界定效应。
AI.result: axis0/16周期中位相对L2增加：Qwen3-1.7B为7.22pp，SmolLM3-3B为11.59pp。axis1与形状保持对照一致；lazy重排保持初始状态；保持组员可消除差异。prefix-view扩展在全部6种设置下通过当前前缀检查却改变历史与下一logits（容量4与128）；公开lookup可达该边界，含4个预注册新GPU输入中1个。dense/checkpoint回滚精确。延迟lookup客户端在已知上下文上支持129-token路径（原生AR排除）。task-harm扩增失败，无法给出总体失败率或通用答案退化结论。MLX-LM fixture暴露陈旧调用方缓存，同步后恢复原地契约。
AI.conclusion: 布局依赖漂移在固定编码计数下仍可测量，现有检查不足以保证保持性；效应有条件、可隔离，且dense回滚与同步可恢复契约。但任务层面危害尚未扩增，不能外推为总体失败率或通用质量退化，相关主张需限定在已测条件内。

title: When Source-Domain Validation Fails to Transfer: A Staged Study of Hyperparameter Selection
comment: 25 pages, 2 figures. Expanded version of work accepted to the AAAI-27 Student Abstract and Poster Program
summary: Hyperparameters for an unseen domain are often selected using held-out examples from the available source domains. Withholding entire source domains during validation seems to better reflect deployment shift, but does this produce better selections on independent targets? We investigate this question through two complementary studies. A preliminary factorial experiment crosses particle swarm optimization and random search with pooled source validation and a leave-one-source-domain-out mean-minimum fitness on PACS and Multi-Domain Sentiment. The domain-aware fitness does not provide a consistent target advantage. We then separate selector development from confirmation using a shared pool of 64 configurations per task across four image benchmarks. Complete target-performance landscapes on VLCS and Office-Home inform one rule: retain the top 16 configurations by pooled source validation, then select the largest leave-one-source-domain-out mean-minus-standard-deviation score. The rule is frozen before evaluation on TerraIncognita and SVIRO. Across their 14 target domains, its equal-dataset-weighted balanced-accuracy difference from pooled validation is +0.097 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-0.685, +0.960]), with five wins and nine losses. Exploratory analyses reveal substantial variation across datasets, target domains, and training seeds. These results do not establish equivalence or a general failure of domain-aware validation. They show that the evaluated source-domain criteria did not establish reliable target gains under the tested protocols, and motivate assessing selection rules on datasets independent of those used to develop them.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验"在验证时留出整个源域以更好反映部署偏移"这一做法能否在独立目标域上选出更优超参数。两项研究均未发现域感知验证准则带来稳定的目标域优势，作者强调需在未参与规则开发的数据集上评估选择规则。
AI.motivation: 超参数通常用可用源域的留出样本选择。直觉上，在验证时留出整 个源域更能模拟部署时的域偏移，但这种方法是否真能在独立目标域上带来更好的选择，尚缺乏严格验证。
AI.method: 研究一：在 PACS 和 Multi-Domain Sentiment 上做析因实验，交叉比较粒子群优化/随机搜索与两种适应度——合并源域验证、留一源域的平均最小适应度。研究二：每任务固定 64 个配置的共享池，先在 VLCS 和 Office-Home 的完整目标性能景观上开发规则（按池化源验证保留前16，再取留一源域的均值减标准差最大者），冻结后在 TerraIncognita 和 SVIRO 共14个目标域上确认。
AI.result: 研究一中域感知适应度未带来一致的目标域优势。研究二的冻结规则相对池化验证，等数据集加权平衡准确率差为+0.097个百分点（95% bootstrap 区间[-0.685,+0.960]），5胜9负。探索性分析显示结果在数据集、目标域和训练种子间差异很大。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果既不证明两者等价，也不证明域感知验证普遍失效；只说明在所测协议下，所评估的源域准则未能建立可靠的目标域增益。作者主张在与规则开发数据独立的数据集上评估选择规则。

title: Gaze Graphs: A Scene-Level Representation of Visual Attention in the Operating Room
summary: Purpose: Analyzing clinicians' visual attention from exocentric camera views can support surgical scene understanding without requiring wearable eye trackers. However, existing gaze-following research in the operating room (OR) estimates only 2D gaze locations without identifying attended scene entities or localizing gaze targets in 3D space. In this work, we investigate gaze graphs as a scene-level representation of visual attention that connects clinicians to attended scene entities, and evaluate their utility for fine-grained surgical action recognition and semantic scene graph (SSG) generation. Methods: We extend the public EgoExOR dataset with gaze annotations to create EgoExOR-Gaze, the first benchmark for multi-view gaze graph generation in the OR. We propose a novel architecture that jointly estimates 3D gaze targets and predicts attended entities using only exocentric camera views. Specifically, our approach exploits 3D gaze geometry to sample local visual features across multiple views for attended entity prediction. We further utilize predicted gaze graphs for fine-grained surgical action recognition and SSG generation. Results: For gaze graph generation, our model outperforms both exocentric-only and combined exocentric-egocentric baselines. For surgical action recognition, our model incorporating predicted gaze graphs outperforms both exocentric and egocentric baselines across all evaluated metrics, with particularly strong gains in temporal metrics. For SSG generation, incorporating gaze graphs improves macro-F1 from 0.42 to 0.52 compared to exocentric inputs alone, although performance remains below that achieved with egocentric inputs. Conclusion: Our results demonstrate the value of gaze graphs for surgical action recognition and SSG generation, highlighting the importance of explicitly modeling scene-level visual attention even when egocentric views are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用"注视图(gaze graph)"作为场景级视觉注意力表示，仅凭外部相机视角联合估计3D注视目标与受关注实体，并构建首个多视角手术室注视图基准EgoExOR-Gaze，用于细粒度手术动作识别与语义场景图生成。
AI.motivation: 现有手术室(OR)中的gaze-following研究仅估计2D注视位置，既无法识别被关注的场景实体，也无法在3D空间中定位注视目标；同时希望不依赖可穿戴眼动仪。
AI.method: 扩展公开EgoExOR数据集加入注视标注得到EgoExOR-Gaze基准；提出新架构仅用外部视角联合估计3D注视目标并预测受关注实体，利用3D注视几何在多视角上采样局部视觉特征；再将预测的注视图用于手术动作识别与SSG生成。
AI.result: 注视图生成优于仅外部视角与外部+自我中心组合基线；动作识别在所有指标上优于外部与自我中心基线，时序指标提升显著；SSG生成的macro-F1从0.42提升至0.52，但仍低于自我中心输入。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明注视图对手术动作识别与SSG生成有价值，强调即使缺少自我中心视角，显式建模场景级视觉注意力仍十分重要。

title: Can Cities Have Personalities? Introducing the SCD City Personality Assessment
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Supplementary research materials: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24466311
summary: Descriptions of cities are shaped by human experience and institutional narratives. We introduce the SCD City Personality Assessment (SCD-CPA), a method that instantiates document-grounded ChatGPT city personas and interrogates each with an identical 24-statement instrument inspired by the four-pair structure of the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator. Rather than asking a general-purpose model to characterize cities freely, we configure a separate document-grounded conversational agent for each city and use alternative evidence portraits to compare documentary inputs. The resulting four bipolar dimensions and four-letter summaries use independently defined urban concepts and scoring rules. Tokyo, New York, and Paris form the methodological evaluation (33 assessments across repeated sessions, three GPT-6 effort settings, and alternative portraits): Tokyo's original portrait yielded 85.4% exact within-setting item agreement, while evidence substitutions shifted some dimension strengths. A five-city application to Shanghai, Dubai, Mumbai, Lagos, and Sao Paulo (15 assessments) yielded 77.8% exact and 99.4% within-one-point cross-setting agreement, indicating consistency under the tested configurations. By treating each city conversational agent as a reproducible, evidence-conditioned experimental configuration, SCD-CPA makes documented city-character perceptions comparable and exposes their sensitivity to source selection. Although the documentary evidence is explicitly controlled, the model's internal interpretation of that evidence cannot be fully observed. We also examine the robustness of SCD-CPA across three AI reasoning-effort settings. The observed consistency suggests that the methodology is relatively insensitive to the tested configuration differences and provides a framework for evaluating its stability as future generations of AI models become available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SCD-CPA 方法：为每座城市构建"文档接地"的 ChatGPT 人格体，用同一套 24 题（仿 MBTI 四对维度）量表测评，从而把城市形象刻画变为可复现、可比较的受证据约束实验配置。
AI.motivation: 城市描述受人类经验与机构叙事塑造，自由让通用大模型"随意描述城市"缺乏可比性与可复现性，因此需要一种受文档证据约束、可重复的城市人格测评框架。
AI.method: 为每座城市配置独立的文档接地对话代理（而非单一通用模型）；以仿 MBTI 四对结构的 24 条陈述量表统一提问，四个双极维度与四字母摘要均采用独立定义的城市概念与评分规则；用替代证据画像比较不同文档输入；以东京、纽约、巴黎做方法学评估（33 次测评，跨重复会话、三种 GPT-6 推理努力设置与替代画像），再对上海、迪拜、孟买、拉各斯、圣保罗五城应用（15 次测评）。
AI.result: 东京原始画像在设置内条目一致率达 85.4% 精确一致；替换证据会使部分维度强度发生偏移。五城应用中跨设置精确一致率 77.8%、误差在 1 分以内的一致率 99.4%，表明在所测配置下结果稳定、对配置差异相对不敏感。
AI.conclusion: SCD-CPA 将城市对话代理视为可复现、受证据条件化的实验配置，使有据可依的城市性格感知可比较，并揭示其对来源选择的敏感性；局限在于模型对证据的内部解读无法完全观测，但该框架可用于未来模型世代下评估方法稳定性。

title: World Models Are the Right Foundation for Simulating Mars Terraforming
summary: Terraforming Mars is a long-horizon, action-conditioned control problem that requires predicting atmospheric responses to interventions over centuries to identify effective policies. This position paper argues that physics-regularized recurrent state-space world models are the most promising foundation for this setting. Data-driven climate emulators lack action-conditioning, and physics-based general circulation models (GCMs) are too expensive for policy search. Among learned world models, recurrent state-space architectures with physics constraints are better suited than transformer-based alternatives: they provide native uncertainty quantification through their stochastic-deterministic decomposition, remain stable under sparse non-terrestrial training data, and enforce physical consistency at each rollout step. To make this position concrete, we describe a potential architecture combining JEPA-inspired latent encoding, universal differential equation constraints, and a Dreamer-lineage planning head. We also introduce MarsWorld, an open benchmark proposal for intervention-conditioned planetary world models, and discuss broader implications and objections.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，主张"物理正则化的循环状态空间世界模型"是火星地球化改造（长时程、动作条件化控制）问题最有希望的基础，并提出一个结合JEPA潜编码、通用微分方程约束与Dreamer规划头的候选架构及MarsWorld基准。
AI.motivation: 火星地球化是需预测数百年大气响应以筛选有效干预策略的长时程动作条件化控制问题。现有数据驱动气候仿真器缺乏动作条件化，物理GCM计算开销过大难以支撑策略搜索，因而需要合适的学习型世界模型作为基础。
AI.method: 立场论证加概念性架构设计：论证循环状态空间模型优于Transformer（随机-确定性分解带来原生不确定性量化、稀疏非地球数据下更稳定、逐步物理一致），并描述一个融合JEPA式潜编码、通用微分方程约束和Dreamer系列规划头的潜在架构；同时提出MarsWorld开放基准提案。
AI.result: 本文为立场论文，未给出实证结果；产出为架构构想与MarsWorld基准提案，并讨论了更广泛影响与可能的反驳意见。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为物理正则化的循环状态空间世界模型是火星地球化政策搜索最可行的建模范式，呼吁以MarsWorld等开放基准推动该方向，但仍需应对相关质疑并做实证验证。

title: From Dense to Sparse: Morton-Ordered Sparse Mapping for Efficient 3D Mesh Generation
summary: Unified 3D understanding and generation require compact sequences preserving spatial structure. Dense grids yield long sequences, while serialization can separate spatial neighbors. We propose Sparse Proximity Aware Compression (SPAC), a shared sparse SDF vocabulary combining sparse encoding with reversible spatial merging. A Sparse SDF VQ-VAE quantizes near-surface features while retaining explicit coordinates, using reconstruction supervision for surface fidelity and detail. 3D Byte-Pair Encoding (3D-BPE) merges recurring face-adjacent patterns using relative offsets before serialization. Macro tokens expand exactly into leaf tokens and coordinates. After Morton serialization, a shared LLM reads geometry for captioning and predicts tokens that decode into meshes for text-conditioned generation. With fixed geometry, architecture, and band width in voxels, sparse encoder cost grows approximately quadratically with resolution. 3D-BPE reduces mean complete LLM sequence length by 45.4 percent, including coordinates, text, and control tokens. SPAC achieves strong results in both 3D captioning and text-conditioned mesh generation. Ablations show gains over leaf tokens and Morton 1D-BPE in both tasks. The project page at https://yangjj007.github.io/spac/ .

AI.tldr: SPAC 用一个稀疏 SDF 词表统一 3D 理解与生成：稀疏 SDF VQ-VAE 量化近表面特征并保留坐标，3D-BPE 借助相对偏移合并相邻面片模式，共享 LLM 完成描述与文本条件网格生成。
AI.motivation: 统一 3D 理解与生成需要紧凑且保留空间结构的序列。稠密网格序列过长，而串行化又易割裂空间邻居。
AI.method: Sparse SDF VQ-VAE：仅量化近表面特征、保留显式坐标，以重建监督保证表面保真与细节；3D-BPE：在序列化前按相对偏移合并重复的面相邻模式，宏 token 可精确展开为叶 token 与坐标；Morton 序列化后由共享 LLM 读取几何做描述，并预测 token 解码成网格。
AI.result: 3D-BPE 使含坐标、文本与控制 token 的平均完整 LLM 序列长度减少 45.4%；在 3D 描述与文本条件网格生成上均取得强结果，消融显示优于叶 token 与 Morton 1D-BPE。
AI.conclusion: 共享稀疏 SDF 词表可在保结构前提下显著压缩序列，并有效支撑统一的 3D 理解与生成；固定几何、架构与体素带宽下，稀疏编码开销约随分辨率二次增长。

title: Transport-Safe Evaluation of LLM Agents: Trajectory-Dependent Judge Error and Anytime-Valid Auditing
comment: Author's accepted version (without the publisher's template) of a paper accepted at ICAART 2027 (paper \#38). The final version will be published by SCITEPRESS; DOI to be added upon publication
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are often ranked by an LLM judge whose error rates are measured once and reused for every agent. The corrected success rates can then be biased when the judge's errors depend on the trajectory and agents differ in the trajectories they produce for successes or failures. We derive the exact asymptotic bias and give a chain of checks from identification to simultaneous ranks. On a four-agent semi-synthetic benchmark, a scalar correction with oracle calibration has maximum bias 0.245 and mean pointwise coverage 0.016, and never recovers the full ranking (0/250 replications). Augmented inverse-probability weighting (AIPW) with a uniform or a design-aware random audit keeps the maximum bias below 0.003, with mean pointwise coverage of 0.939 and 0.950. In a 48-cell stress test, effective target support rises only from 0.209 to 0.805 as calibration grows from 600 to 4,800 labels, while audited AIPW keeps a mean absolute error of 0.018-0.020. Without calibration support, or with judge dependence within an externally justified bound, we report valid bounds or sensitivity sets and carry them into rank sets. An e-process confidence sequence stays valid, for a stable target, under predictable adaptive auditing and arbitrary stopping.

AI.tldr: LLM judge 的错误率依赖轨迹（trajectory），固定复用标量校正会使去偏后的成功率产生偏差，导致智能体排名不可靠。本文推导精确渐近偏差，提出从可识别性到同时排名的检验链，并用 AIPW（增广逆概率加权）结合随机审计实现有效校正与排名。
AI.motivation: 现有做法只用一次测量得到的固定 judge 错误率对每个 agent 的成功率做标量校正。但 judge 误差随轨迹变化，而不同 agent 在成功/失败时产生不同轨迹分布，于是校正后成功率出现偏差，排名失真。需要刻画该偏差并给出可靠替代方案。
