AI.method: 1）推导精确渐近偏差，构建从 identification 到同时排名的检验链；2）用 AIPW 配合 uniform 或 design-aware random audit 估计校正成功率；3）在 4-agent 半合成基准和 48 格压力测试上评估；4）无校准支持或 judge 依赖在外部可证界内时，给出有效界或敏感性集合并转为 rank sets；5）用 e-process 置信序列处理自适应审计与任意停止。
AI.result: 标量校正：oracle 校准下最大偏差 0.245，平均逐点覆盖率 0.016，250 次重复从未恢复完整排名（0/250）。AIPW（uniform / design-aware 审计）最大偏差 <0.003，平均逐点覆盖率 0.939 / 0.950。48 格压力测试中，校准样本从 600 增到 4,800 时有效目标支持仅从 0.209 升至 0.805；审计 AIPW 的 MAE 稳定在 0.018–0.020。
AI.conclusion: 标量 judge 校正不足以支撑 LLM agent 排名；审计式 AIPW 在小偏差与覆盖率上显著更优，且在缺乏校准支持或 judge 依赖受限时仍给出有效界、敏感性集合与 rank sets。e-process 置信序列在可预测自适应审计和任意停止下保持有效。

title: Safe Quantum Stochastic Linear Bandits
summary: We initiate the study of safe quantum stochastic linear bandits, in which a learner maximizes an unknown linear reward while satisfying unknown linear mean constraints at every interaction. Under coherent unitary access to the joint reward-and-constraint distribution, we develop QRS-COLTS, a staged quantum resampled-scaling analog of constrained linear Thompson sampling (COLTS). With high probability, QRS-COLTS plays only feasible actions and achieves regret that is polylogarithmic in the query horizon and scales only with the square root of the number of constraints. We also study a model in which the learner queries superpositions of actions while an unsafe-action flag, a "bomb" that terminates the interaction upon violation, is measured after every query. In this setting, the bomb provides exact membership access to the safe set, and query regret is evaluated over the action superposition. For this model, we propose BCO-QLinTS, which selects feasible actions via bomb-certified quantum convex optimization without estimating the constraint matrix. Its query-weighted regret remains polylogarithmic in the horizon, with the constraints entering the bound only through the geometry of the safe set.

AI.tldr: 本文开创性地研究"安全量子随机线性 bandit"问题，在奖励与约束均未知且需每步满足线性均值约束的设定下，提出 QRS-COLTS 与 BCO-QLinTS 两种算法，实现对查询时域的多对数级 regret 且仅依赖约束数量的平方根/安全集几何。
AI.motivation: 经典（安全）线性 bandit 已较成熟，但量子 bandit 在"安全约束"下尚无研究。作者希望借助量子相干访问（酉查询）在保证每步可行性的前提下，突破经典安全 bandit 的 regret 下界，实现超越经典的多对数级 regret。
AI.method: 1) QRS-COLTS：对约束线性 Thompson 采样（COLTS）的量子化改造，采用"量子重采样-缩放"(quantum resampled-scaling) 的分阶段策略，在相干酉访问联合奖励-约束分布下进行采样。2) BCO-QLinTS：针对"炸弹"模型（查询动作叠加态后测量不安全标志，违反即终止），利用炸弹提供的安全集精确成员查询，通过炸弹认证的量子凸优化选择可行动作，无需估计约束矩阵。
AI.result: QRS-COLTS 以高概率仅执行可行动作，regret 对查询时域为多对数级，并仅随约束数量的平方根增长。BCO-QLinTS 的查询加权 regret 同样为多对数级，且约束仅通过安全集几何进入界中，避免了对约束矩阵的估计。
AI.conclusion: 量子相干访问使安全线性 bandit 的 regret 显著优于经典情形，约束规模的依赖也被大幅削弱。两类模型分别对应"完整分布访问"和"仅安全集成员访问"的量子能力层级，为安全量子决策奠定了理论与算法基础。

title: Div3DAfford: Diverse 3D affordance grounding
summary: 3D affordance grounding aims to localize 3D regions specified by an interaction query. Existing methods predict a single affordance mask, overlooking the inherent diversity of human-object interactions. We introduce diverse 3D affordance grounding, a new task that requires predicting multiple plausible regions for a given object and affordance query. We then propose Div3DAffordNet, a transformer-based set prediction model capable of generating diverse affordance regions. To address the scarcity of diverse 3D affordance data, we develop an automated pipeline leveraging 2D generative models and 3D reconstruction techniques to synthesize 3D affordances, followed by lightweight human verification (reducing the annotation time by 72X), yielding the Div3DAfford benchmark. Extensive experiments show Div3DAffordNet effectively captures multi-mask affordance regions. Our method achieves the SOTA affordance grounding performance in the multi-mask setting, reducing GED-SIM from 0.745 to 0.492, while maintaining competitive single-mask performance on the standard benchmark of 19.0 mIoU.

AI.tldr: 提出多样化3D可供性定位新任务及Div3DAffordNet集合预测模型，并构建自动合成数据流水线与基准。
AI.motivation: 现有3D可供性定位方法只预测单一mask，忽略了人-物交互固有的多样性。
AI.method: 基于Transformer的集合预测模型生成多个码供性区域；用2D生成模型+3D重建的自动流水线合成数据并辅以轻量人工验证（标注时间缩短72倍），构建Div3DAfford基准。
AI.result: 多mask设置下SOTA，GED-SIM由0.745降至0.492；标准基准单mask性能19.0 mIoU保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 模型能有效捕捉多mask可供性区域，推动多样化3D可供性定位研究。

title: Intent-Conditioned Argument Mediation for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Blocking Trusted-but-Unauthorized Arguments
comment: Accepted at ICAART 2027; final version published by SCITEPRESS. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24233094
summary: LLM agents turn a user's request and retrieved content into tool calls, and a call can reach the wrong recipient, endpoint, file or participant. Argument-level provenance blocks such values when they come from untrusted content, but accepts a trusted value that the user never requested. IntentFlow, a mediation layer between an unmodified planner and its tools, checks each authority-bearing argument against an intent contract and a provenance policy. On a synthetic benchmark of 200 attacks (oracle intent and injection labels, declared roles), attack success falls from 50.5% with provenance alone to 12.0% [8.2-17.2%]; every remaining success alters a content or payload field. IntentFlow wrongly blocks none of 200 paired benign tasks and 4 of 50 hard ones. On 50 trusted-but-unauthorized attacks, provenance-only mediation executes all 50 and IntentFlow none; a CaMeL-style check also blocks all 50 but rejects 16 of 50 benign tasks. On an offline AgentDojo-derived replay, IntentFlow blocks all 20 attacks at 75% benign success, as does a CaMeL-style check; a Progent-style allowlist blocks 19 and keeps all benign tasks. With one live planner and the same oracles, the mediator blocked all 17 corrupted calls proposed in 110 attacks.

AI.tldr: IntentFlow 在规划器与工具之间加一层中介，用意图契约+来源策略校验每个携带权限的参数，将攻击成功率从仅用来源校验的50.5%降到12.0%，且几乎不误伤良性任务。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 会把用户请求与检索内容转成工具调用，调用可能指向错误的接收方、端点、文件或参与者。仅靠参数级来源(provenance)校验只能拦截来自不可信内容的值，却会放过"可信但用户从未请求"的值（trusted-but-unauthorized 攻击）。
AI.method: 提出 IntentFlow：一个位于未修改规划器与其工具之间的中介层。对每个携带权限(authority-bearing)的参数，同时对照"意图契约"(intent contract)和"来源策略"(provenance policy)进行检查，从而既阻断不可信来源值，也阻断可信但违背用户意图的值。
AI.result: 在200个攻击的合成基准上（含oracle意图/注入标签与声明角色），成功率由仅来源校验的50.5%降至12.0%[8.2-17.2%]，剩余成功均改变内容或payload字段；200个配对良性任务零误拦，50个困难任务误拦4个。50个"可信但未授权"攻击：仅来源校验全放行，IntentFlow全拦截，CaMeL式检查也全拦截但误拒16/50良性任务。AgentDojo离线回放中，IntentFlow与CaMeL式均拦截全部20个攻击（良性成功率75%），Progent式白名单拦截19个且保留全部良性。真实规划器实验中，中介在110次攻击提议的17个受损调用中全部拦截。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖来源的策略不足以防御"可信但未授权"的调用；IntentFlow 通过结合意图契约与来源策略，在低误拦率下显著降低攻击成功率，是一种有效的工具调用中介防护方案。

title: Bridging the Gap between Continual Learning and Test-Time Adaptation with Domain Preview
summary: Domain shift is a major problem for training machine learning models. While Continual Learning (CL) assumes distribution shift during training and Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) considers new domains at test time, setups that require explicit online adaptation to domain shift during both phases remain under-explored. We propose continual learning with domain preview (CL-P), a new combination of CL and TTA where both train and test data suffer from distribution shift. The training phase of CL-P is analogous to domain-incremental learning while the testing phase consists of a TTA phase on a future domain (which we call preview), and an evaluation phase on all seen domains. The model must then adapt to new domains at train and test time. In this paper, we evaluate mainstream CL and TTA methods that adapt only at train or test time, as well as their naive combination. Experimentally, TTA heavily damages the domain on which the CL method has just trained and increases forgetting. Notably, this damage mostly comes from the BatchNorm statistics shared by all domains. In that sense, we propose DOSE (Dosing by Online Statistics of Each domain), which allows a seamless combination of any CL and TTA methods by adaptive domain inference at test time, where the adaptation is applied to each image in proportion to the probability that it comes from the preview domain. Through extensive experiments with ResNet and ViT backbones, various combinations of CL and TTA baseline methods and datasets considering diverse domains, we show that DOSE matches or improves on CL methods alone in all 24 settings and on the naive combination in all but one. The code can be found in appendix.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"域预览式连续学习"(CL-P)设定，训练与测试阶段都存在分布漂移，并指出TTA会因共享BatchNorm统计量而破坏已学域，进而提出DOSE方法按域概率对每张图像按比例施加自适应，实现CL与TTA的无缝结合。
AI.motivation: 现有CL仅考虑训练期分布漂移，CTTA仅考虑测试期新域，而需要训练和测试两阶段都显式在线适应域漂移的设定鲜有探索；同时简单组合CL与TTA会导致性能退化。
AI.method: 定义CL-P设定：训练阶段类似域增量学习，测试阶段包含对未来域的TTA阶段(预览)和所有已见域的评估阶段。分析发现TTA对已训练域的损害主要源于所有域共享的BatchNorm统计量。据此提出DOSE，通过测试时的自适应域推断，按图像属于预览域的概率对每张图像按比例施加自适应，可无缝组合任意CL和TTA方法。
AI.result: 在ResNet与ViT骨干、多种CL与TTA基线组合及多域数据集上共24种设定中，DOSE在全部24种中匹配或优于单独CL方法，且在除1种外的所有设定中优于朴素组合。
AI.conclusion: 简单组合CL与TTA会因共享BatchNorm统计量造成遗忘加剧；通过基于域概率的按比例自适应(DOSE)可有效缓解该问题，提升两阶段域漂移下的鲁棒性。

title: PIAE: Physics-Informed Continuous Autoencoding for Compact 3D Human Motion
summary: Temporal compression reduces the sequence length that motion generators must model, but can damage articulated detail and global trajectory. These errors have unequal consequences: root-velocity and heading errors propagate through trajectory recovery and affect the placement of the entire body. We propose PIAE, a physics-informed continuous autoencoder that allocates a fixed token budget between explicitly retained kinematic signals and complementary learned features. At 8 x temporal compression, each 256-dimensional token contains 224 learned values and a 32-dimensional physical carrier. The complete token conditions neural decoding, while a parallel recovery path constrains selected outputs. On the official HumanML3D benchmark, PIAE achieves 8.936 mm global MPJPE, an 82.0% reduction relative to a same-width learned-only model. The benefit extends beyond trajectory restoration: facing-local neural-body error before analytical correction decreases by 76.6% in a frozen-checkpoint validation diagnostic, and supplying the same true trajectory to both models preserves the body-quality advantage. Targeted root-only and explicit-root hybrid controls establish strong trajectory-aware comparisons; alternative carriers reveal that torso references favor position accuracy, whereas stance anchors favor support quality. With the original 8 x AEs frozen, matched text-to-motion generators predict every carrier value and improve FID from 0.506 to 0.163. Frozen reconstruction also transfers to AIST++ without adaptation. The compressed carrier interface reduces measured generation time by 27.8% relative to its 1 x counterpart. Together, these findings demonstrate that selective preservation can use a fixed representation budget more effectively, improving neural articulated reconstruction and downstream generation in compact human motion.

AI.tldr: PIAE 是一种物理信息驱动的连续自编码器，在固定 token 预算下显式保留根速度与朝向等运动学信号，显著降低全局轨迹误差并提升下游文本驱动动作生成质量。
AI.motivation: 时间压缩降低动作生成器需建模的序列长度，但会损害关节细节与全局轨迹。根速度与朝向误差会在轨迹恢复中传播，影响全身位置，因此需要在不增加表示预算前提下选择性保留关键物理信号。
AI.method: 提出 PIAE：在固定 token 预算中分配显式保留的运动学信号与学习特征。8× 压缩下每个 256 维 token 含 224 维学习值与 32 维物理载体；完整 token 用于神经解码，并行恢复路径约束选定输出。设置仅根、显式根混合等对照与不同载体的消融实验。
AI.result: HumanML3D 上全局 MPJPE 达 8.936 mm，较同宽度纯学习模型降低 82.0%；冻结检查点诊断中面向局部神经身体误差在解析修正前降低 76.6%；匹配文本生成器可预测全部载体值，FID 由 0.506 降至 0.163；冻结重建可无适配迁移至 AIST++；生成时间较 1× 版本减少 27.8%。载体选择上躯干参照利于位置精度，支撑锚点利于支撑质量。
AI.conclusion: 选择性保留可更高效利用固定表示预算，在紧凑人体动作表示中同时提升神经关节重建与下游生成质量。

title: SchemaCaps: When a Compatible Tool Update Silently Widens an AI Agent's Authority
comment: Author's accepted version (without the publisher's layout). Accepted at ICAART 2027; final version published by SCITEPRESS. Artefact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24233014
summary: The tools users approve for their AI agents keep changing their JSON input schemas. Of 8 surveyed MCP clients and scanners, none is observed or documented to re-approve a tool whose input schema widens (two not determinable). We define non-amplification over the coordinates visible in the schema (declared arguments and undeclared fields, on effective values) and a re-binding rule decided by subschema inclusion, trusting no field labels by default and conservative up to its checker and tested case analysis. Evidence: a Coq proof of composition; 48 regression tests; an exact-reference benchmark, where the reviewed version of the rule silently re-bound 27 amplifying changes, now fixed; and a pilot on 604 releases of 39 public MCP servers. There, 412 of 580 compatible schema changes widen some coordinate, yet compatibility re-binds them silently. The authors' adjudicated double annotation finds at least 76 that add or widen an authority-bearing argument (66 of the 84 a name-based labeller flags, plus 10 it misses). On existing tools, the rule asks 645 re-approvals, against 1,197 for pinning the input schema (2,004 with descriptions) and 617 for compatibility. Behaviour change behind an identical schema remains out of reach.

AI.tldr: MCP工具审核后JSON schema变更会被静默自动重新绑定，无客户端重新审批。作者提出基于子模式包含的non-amplification与re-binding规则，并用Coq证明、回归测试和真实MCP服务器基准验证其能拦住放大权限的变更。
AI.motivation: 用户批准AI agent工具时，工具的JSON input schema会不断变化；调查的8个MCP客户端中没有一个会在schema扩宽后重新审批，导致权限在用户不知情下被放大。
AI.method: 定义在schema可见坐标（声明参数、未声明字段、有效值）上的non-amplification，以及由子模式包含决定的re-binding规则：默认不信任字段标签，保守至检查器与测试用例分析的范围。验证手段包括Coq组合性证明、48个回归测试、精确参考基准和39个公共MCP服务器604个版本的试点。
AI.result: 参考基准中，经评审的规则版本曾静默重绑27个放大性变更，现已修复。试点中580个兼容schema变更里412个扩宽了某些坐标却被静默重新绑定；双标注裁定出至少76个新增或扩宽了承载权限的参数（名称标注器命中84个中的66个，另漏10个）。现网工具规则需645次重新审批，对比固定schema的1,197次（含描述2,004次）、兼容性方案的617次。
AI.conclusion: 基于子模式包含的re-binding规则能在可接受审批成本内拦截schema扩宽带来的权限放大；但相同schema背后的行为变化仍是该方法无法覆盖的盲区。

title: Beyond PINNs: Boundary-Enriched Holomorphic Networks for Laplace Problems
comment: Accepted at the AI for Science Workshop, NeurIPS 2026. 24 pages, 9 figures
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) solve partial differential equations by penalizing their residual, but this formulation can be difficult to optimize for solutions with singular behaviour. We focus specifically on the two-dimensional Laplace equation, whose strong analytical structure allows the governing equation to be enforced directly in the neural representation. We compare a hybrid harmonic-neural model with a holomorphic neural network whose output is harmonic by construction and therefore requires only boundary training. We further enrich the holomorphic model with singular functions chosen according to the interior angle and boundary conditions at each junction of boundary segments. On six singular benchmarks, the enriched model is the most accurate of the neural models we compare. On the four with a closed-form solution, however, that solution lies in the span of the enrichment terms, and a least-squares fit of these terms alone is exact to rounding error. On Motz's problem and the cracked beam, the neural core reduces the relative error of the recovered leading singular coefficient from about $10^{-2}$, for a least-squares fit with the same four terms, to about $10^{-6}$, and on four variants whose solution has a smooth part outside the span, the network is $4\times10^{4}$ to $2\times10^{7}$ times more accurate than a fit of its singular terms alone; classical least-squares fits with more singular terms, or with harmonic polynomials and rational poles, are more accurate still. Our results demonstrate how exploiting problem-specific analytical structure can provide an alternative to base and residual PINNs for challenging scientific computing problems.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对二维Laplace方程中解的奇异行为难以优化的问题，比较了混合调和-神经网络模型与全纯神经网络（输出天然调和、仅需边界训练），并引入依据边界段交界处内角与边界条件选取的奇异函数进行增强。增强模型在六个奇异基准上最准，但在有闭式解的问题上其精度被简单最小二乘拟合超越；在Motz问题和裂纹梁上，神经核心将主导奇异系数的相对误差从约1e-2降至约1e-6。
AI.motivation: PINN通过惩罚PDE残差求解，但对具有奇异行为的解优化困难。作者希望利用二维Laplace方程强解析结构，将方程直接内置于神经表示中，从而绕开基PINN/残差PINN的优化难题，并探究问题特定解析结构能带来多少精度增益。
AI.method: 聚焦二维Laplace方程。构造输出按构造即为调和的全纯神经网络，因此只需边界训练；并采用混合调和-神经网络模型作对照。进一步按每条边界段交界处（转角）的内角与边界条件选取奇异函数对全纯模型进行增强。在六个奇异基准（含Motz问题、裂纹梁及若干变体）上进行比较，并与仅用奇异项/更多奇异项/调和多项式与有理极点的最小二乘拟合进行对比。
AI.result: 六个奇异基准中，增强模型是所比较的神经模型里最精确的。但在四个有闭式解的算例上，该解本就在增强项张成空间内，仅用这四项做最小二乘拟合即可精确到舍入误差。Motz问题与裂纹梁上，神经核心将主导奇异系数的相对误差从约1e-2（同样四项的最小二乘）降到约1e-6；在解含张成空间外光滑部分的四个变体上，网络比只用其奇异项的拟合精确4e4到2e7倍。更多奇异项或调和多项式加有理极点的经典最小二乘拟合仍更精确。
AI.conclusion: 利用问题特定解析结构可作为基PINN和残差PINN在困难科学计算问题上的替代方案；在奇异问题上，神经表示的价值主要体现在恢复奇异系数与拟合光滑部分，而非超越经典解析基拟合。

title: XShot: Cross-Shot Video Object Insertion from a Reference Video
summary: We present XShot, a framework for cross-shot video object insertion, which adds objects to a shot by watching another shot of the same scene. Video productions show a scene through many shots, and objects added to one shot must appear consistently in the others. Most video editors take the appearance of new objects from reference images and their location from a text prompt, a mask or an edited keyframe, leaving this consistency to the user. XShot reads both from a reference video of another shot, which need not be aligned with the target, and needs no mask, box or camera pose. We build on a video Diffusion Transformer and formulate the task as in-context generation over the reference video, a few images of the objects and the target video. A geometry-aware cross-shot attention estimates the epipolar geometry between the two shots from the model's own correspondences and uses it to guide where the target reads the reference and the exemplars. We train XShot with an erase-and-restore data engine: objects are erased from one shot of a film or a multi-camera recording and restored from another shot of the scene. Experiments show that XShot places objects more accurately and renders them more faithfully than open-source and commercial video editors, while leaving the rest of the shot intact.

AI.tldr: XShot 提出一种跨镜头视频物体插入框架，通过观察同一场景的另一个镜头来自动将物体添加到目标镜头，并利用几何感知的跨镜头注意力保证多镜头间的外观与位置一致性。
AI.motivation: 视频制作中一个场景通过多个镜头呈现，添加到某一镜头的物体必须在其他镜头中也保持一致。现有视频编辑器需用户从参考图像取外观、从文本/掩码/编辑关键帧取位置，一致性留给用户处理，且常需对齐或掩码等人工输入。
AI.method: 基于视频 Diffusion Transformer，将任务建模为对参考视频、物体示例图像和目标视频的上下文（in-context）生成。提出几何感知跨镜头注意力：从模型自身对应关系估计两镜头的对极几何，引导目标镜头从参考和示例中读取信息。训练采用“擦除-恢复”数据引擎：从影片或多机位录制的某镜头中擦除物体，再用另一镜头恢复。
AI.result: 无需掩码、框或相机位姿，也无需参考与目标对齐。实验表明 XShot 在物体放置准确性和渲染保真度上优于开源及商业视频编辑器，同时保持镜头其余部分完整。
AI.conclusion: XShot 通过读取另一镜头自动实现跨镜头一致性物体插入，减少人工输入并提升多镜头视频编辑的一致性与质量。

title: GameDojo: Benchmarking Real-Time Interactive Agents in Video Games
comment: 28 pages. Project page: https://gamedojo-benchmark.github.io/ , and code: https://github.com/THUSI-Lab/GameDojo
summary: Interactive intelligence requires agents to act on observations and adapt to the consequences of actions. Studying these abilities calls for diverse, challenging tasks under controlled conditions. We introduce GameDojo, a controllable interactive gameplay benchmark of 120 boss encounters across 20 games for evaluating model capabilities, learning algorithms, and agent harnesses. Coding agents reconstruct the environments and write gameplay scripts, producing GameDojo-Data with 600 hours of gameplay trajectories. Experiments reveal substantial challenges for frontier models, especially in real-time interaction. Training on GameDojo-Data brings GameDojo-4B to frontier performance, with the strongest real-time performance. We also find joint training improves individual tasks, and learned policies transfer across bosses. Together, these findings establish GameDojo as a challenging and valuable interactive gameplay benchmark for the community. Our project page is at https://gamedojo-benchmark.github.io/ , and our code is at https://github.com/THUSI-Lab/GameDojo .

AI.tldr: GameDojo:一个包含20款游戏、120个Boss战的可控交互式游戏基准,用于评估模型能力、学习算法与智能体框架;并配套600小时轨迹数据GameDojo-Data,训练出GameDojo-4B达到前沿水平。
AI.motivation: 交互智能要求智能体基于观察行动并适应行动后果,但研究这类能力需要在受控条件下、多样且有挑战性的任务,现有基准不足。
AI.method: 由编码智能体重建游戏环境并编写玩法脚本,构建20款游戏120个Boss战基准;生成600小时玩法轨迹数据GameDojo-Data用于训练。
AI.result: 前沿模型面临显著挑战,尤其在实时交互方面;在GameDojo-Data上训练的GameDojo-4B达到前沿性能且实时表现最强;联合训练能提升单项任务,学到的策略可跨Boss迁移。
AI.conclusion: GameDojo是一个有挑战性且有价值的交互式游戏基准,可为社区提供评测与训练资源。

title: Beyond Fixed Prompt Configuration: Alternating Policy Learning for Adaptive Topology-Based Prompting in Few-Shot Graph Learning
summary: Graph Prompt Learning (GPL) adapts frozen pre-trained graph models to few-shot graph tasks through a small set of trainable prompts that encode task-specific information. Topology-based prompting instantiates this idea by augmenting an input graph with new prompt nodes and edges, yielding promising performance. However, prompt content and propagation structure are coupled, making it difficult to assess their individual effects and learn compatible configurations. In this paper, we empirically analyze two challenges in learning adaptive policies for topology-based prompting: asymmetric performance effects and coupled configuration selection. We then propose TTPR, a two-stage reinforcement framework that alternately optimizes two policies to generate adaptive configurations, with each policy conditioned on configurations generated by the other fixed policy. These conditional updates separate policy evaluation while preserving configuration compatibility. Specifically, TTPR models an edge-level policy to construct connection patterns and optimizes it with Connection Relative Policy Optimization (CRPO) through group-wise comparisons of complete connection patterns. The other is a node-level policy that generates prompt-node schemes and is optimized with Incremental Node Proximal Policy Optimization (INPPO) through incremental prompt-count decisions and feature generation. Across diverse datasets and pre-training strategies, TTPR ranks first in 8/10 few-shot node classification settings and attains the highest average performance across graph classification benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 针对图提示学习（GPL）中拓扑提示的"性能影响不对称"和"配置选择耦合"两大难题，提出两阶段强化学习框架 TTPR，交替优化边级与节点级两个策略以生成自适应提示配置。
AI.motivation: 拓扑式提示通过添加提示节点和边来适配冻结的预训练图模型，但提示内容与传播结构相互耦合，导致难以单独评估二者效果、也难以学到相互兼容的配置。论文实证分析了学习自适应策略时的两个挑战：性能影响不对称、配置选择耦合。
AI.method: TTPR 采用两阶段强化框架，交替优化两个策略，每个策略以对方固定策略生成的配置为条件，从而在保持配置兼容性的同时解耦策略评估。其中：边级策略负责构造连接模式，用 Connection Relative Policy Optimization（CRPO）通过完整连接模式的组内比较来优化；节点级策略负责生成提示节点方案，用 Incremental Node Proximal Policy Optimization（INPPO）通过增量式提示数量决策与特征生成来优化。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种预训练策略下，TTPR 在 8/10 的少样本节点分类设置中排名第一，并在图分类基准上取得最高平均性能。
AI.conclusion: TTPR 通过双策略条件化交替更新，有效缓解了拓扑提示中的不对称性与耦合问题，在少样本图任务上验证了自适应拓扑提示配置学习的有效性与普适性。

title: Learning Land-Surface Hydrology World Model from Satellite Observations
summary: A world model should tell us not only what will happen, but what would happen under a different action. Learned Earth models now forecast remarkably well, yet forecast skill says little about what their state means or how it responds to a changed driver. We build LandWM, a world model of land-surface water in which rain is the action, learned from seven years of SMAP and CYGNSS observations: physical observation operators tie its latent state to soil water, and a mass-conserving balance governs how that state responds to rain. Over the U.S. Southern Great Plains, the model, never shown a soil-moisture value, tracks 28 in-situ probes as well as the operational SMAP Level-4 product, even from CYGNSS alone, and a storm added to the forcing of a station's cell wets its soil as natural storms wet the probes. Replace either piece and the forecasts stay, but the meaning goes: with neural operators, only a probe fitted to the stations finds the soil water; with a generic recurrent transition, rain on a single cell barely moves it. Yet when the same rain covers the whole region the two transitions swap roles, and the conserving one responds too weakly. Grounding makes a world model readable; its response to actions must be tested under more than one kind of intervention.

AI.tldr: LandWM 是一个以降雨为“动作”、由 SMAP 与 CYGNSS 观测学习的陆面水循环世界模型，通过物理观测算子和质量守恒的平衡方程把隐状态锚定为土壤水。它未见过土壤湿度数据，却能像业务化 SMAP L4 一样跟踪 28 个地面探针，甚至仅用 CYGNSS；但替换掉物理组件后，预测技能还在，“意义”却消失，说明世界模型的地基化（readable）与对动作响应的检验需多种干预方式。
AI.motivation: 现有地球学习模型预报精度高，但预报技能无法说明其内部状态代表什么、以及驱动变化时状态如何响应。作者希望构建一个“可读”的世界模型：不仅预测会发生什么，还能回答在不同动作下会发生什么。
AI.method: 以降雨作为动作，基于七年 SMAP 和 CYGNSS 观测训练 LandWM。模型用物理观测算子将潜状态与土壤水绑定，并采用质量守恒的水量平衡方程约束状态对降雨的响应。通过替换组件（神经算子 vs. 守恒转移、单格点 vs. 全区降雨）做干预实验，并与 SMAP Level-4 产品及 28 个原位探针比较。
AI.result: 在美国南部大平原，LandWM 从未见过土壤湿度标签，仍能跟踪 28 个原位探针，精度与业务化 SMAP L4 相当，仅用 CYGNSS 也能做到；在单站网格上人工加入风暴，能像自然风暴一样浸润探针土壤。替换为神经算子后，仅靠拟合站点的探针才能找到土壤水；替换为通用循环转移后，单格点降雨几乎不改变状态；但当同样的雨覆盖整个区域时，两种转移角色互换，守恒模型响应过弱。
AI.conclusion: 物理地基让世界模型可读，但对动作的响应必须在多种干预类型下检验；单靠预报技能或单种干预无法揭示状态含义与响应正确性。

title: Unpacking the Evaluators: How Configuration Shapes the Evaluation of Alignment in Explainable AI
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) evaluation fundamentally requires human-centered evaluation, assessing whether explanations align with human reasoning and expert knowledge. However, such evaluations often require expert-driven manual validation and are difficult to scale, leading to the widespread use of alignment-based metrics, where attribution maps are compared against predefined ground-truth (GT) representations. Despite their popularity, alignment evaluations are implicitly bias towards multiple design choices made during the evaluation process, for example GT representations, metric families, metric formulations (soft vs. hard), and thresholding strategies. In this paper, we formalize alignment evaluation as a structured evaluation configuration space through which the influence of these design choices can be systematically analyzed. We further introduce a structured alignment evaluation framework that models interactions between XAI methods, GT representations, metric families, metric formulations, and thresholding strategies across 2D and 3D synthetic and real-world datasets. In addition, we propose a novel taxonomy of XAI output behavior based on local entropy and boundary mass ratio, enabling structured characterization of attribution patterns for alignment evaluation. Our experiments reveal systematic flows (triples of XAI-GT-metric configurations), showing that alignment outcomes provide distinct behavior patterns under certain configurations, such as soft/hard metric implementations. We further observe varying levels of threshold sensitivity across metric families and attribution structures. These findings demonstrate that alignment evaluation cannot be treated as a fixed or invariant measure of explanation quality, and provide practical guidance for designing more reliable and behavior-aware XAI evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 该论文将可解释AI（XAI）的"对齐评估"形式化为一个结构化配置空间，系统分析GT表示、度量家族、软/硬度量实现与阈值策略等设计选择对评估结果的影响，并提出基于局部熵与边界质量比的XAI输出行为分类法。
AI.motivation: XAI评估本质上需要以人为中心的专家验证，但难以规模化，因此研究界广泛采用将归因图与预定义GT表示比对的对齐式指标。然而这些对齐评估隐式地偏向评估过程中的多种设计选择（GT表示、度量家族、软/硬度量形式、阈值策略），其影响缺乏系统分析，导致对齐结果被误当作解释质量的固定、不变的度量。
AI.method: 1）将对齐评估形式化为结构化评估配置空间，使各设计选择的影响可被系统分析；2）提出结构化对齐评估框架，在2D与3D、合成与真实数据集上建模XAI方法、GT表示、度量家族、度量形式与阈值策略之间的交互；3）提出基于局部熵与边界质量比的新XAI输出行为分类法，用于结构化刻画归因模式。
AI.result: 实验揭示了系统性的"flows"（XAI–GT–度量三元配置），表明对齐结果在特定配置下（如软/硬度量实现）呈现明显不同的行为模式；同时发现不同度量家族与归因结构对阈值敏感程度各异。
AI.conclusion: 对齐评估不能被视作解释质量的固定或不变度量；研究为设计更可靠、行为感知的XAI评估协议提供了实践指导。

title: Yggdrasil: Tree-Routed Recurrent Experts for State Tracking and Fast CPU Inference
summary: Parallel-trainable recurrences such as Mamba, linear attention, and DeltaNet offer constant-cost streaming inference, but they suffer from two limitations: 1) they struggle to track discrete state, and 2) they read every parameter at every step, tying model capacity directly to CPU latency. We introduce Yggdrasil, a recurrent architecture that decouples capacity from per-step compute by looking up each layer's transition in a large, tree-routed bank of recurrent experts. Each router addresses its bank using the current token and the state of the layer below. We prove that this cross-layer context is necessary---a single token-indexed layer of non-expanding transitions with finitely many reachable states cannot perform conditional resets---while avoiding feedback from the layer's own past preserves parallel-scan training. Because each step traverses one tree path and reads a single expert per layer, active weights stay within a few hundred kilobytes in CPU L2 cache while the full bank resides in RAM. Among the parallel-trainable models we evaluate, Yggdrasil is the only one to solve all five state-tracking tasks. At matched active parameter counts, it achieves the lowest test bits on enwik8 (1.540 bpb) and the human genome hg38 (1.567 bpb), while stepping $3.0\times$ and $3.3\times$ faster on a single CPU core ($6.7\,μ\mathrm{s}$ and $5.8\,μ\mathrm{s}$) than the fastest streaming baseline, and delivering the highest GPU throughput of all models at batch 1024. On the Genomic Benchmarks, it is the strongest causal model at matched active parameters (86.0% mean accuracy).

AI.tldr: Yggdrasil 是一种可并行训练的循环架构，通过“树状路由循环专家库”让每步只读取单个专家、把模型容量与每次计算/CPU延迟解耦。
AI.motivation: 现有可并行训练的循环模型（Mamba、线性注意力、DeltaNet）有两大缺陷：难以跟踪离散状态，且每步都读取全部参数，使容量直接绑定 CPU 延迟。作者希望在不牺牲并行扫描训练的前提下，既增强状态跟踪能力，又把容量与每步计算分离。
AI.method: 每层的状态转移从一棵大型树状路由的循环专家库中查表获得；路由器用当前 token 与下一层状态（跨层上下文）来寻址专家库。作者证明这种跨层上下文是必要的（有限的单 token 索引、非扩张转移层无法实现条件重置），同时避免使用本层自身的历史反馈以保持并行扫描训练。每步只遍历一条树路径、每层只读一个专家，因此活跃权重仅数百 KB（可驻留 CPU L2 缓存），完整专家库放在 RAM。
AI.result: 在评估的并行可训练模型中，Yggdrasil 是唯一解决全部五个状态跟踪任务的模型；在匹配活跃参数下，enwik8 测试达 1.540 bpb、人类基因组 hg38 达 1.567 bpb，均为最低；单 CPU 核每步 6.7μs/5.8μs，比最快流式基线快 3.0×/3.3×；batch 1024 时 GPU 吞吐最高；在 Genomic Benchmarks 上为匹配活跃参数下最强的因果模型（平均准确率 86.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨层路由的树状专家库，Yggdrasil 在保持并行训练与常数成本流式推理的同时，兼顾了离散状态跟踪、低 CPU 延迟与高吞吐，在语言建模、基因组建模和状态跟踪任务上均取得领先表现。

title: What the Background Hides: Thresholds, Vocabularies and Collisions in Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
comment: 33 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. Submitted to Computer Vision and Image Understanding. Code: https://github.com/WendongYao/ovss-background-audit ; data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24338613
summary: Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) built on CLIP has advanced rapidly, with methods typically ranked by mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) across standard benchmarks. On datasets with a background class, however, implementations rely on per-dataset thresholds and background word lists that are rarely documented or unified (11 of 13 surveyed methods configure per-dataset background decisions). We audit configurations and papers of 13 training-free OVSS methods, re-run seven from official codebases, and compare official settings against a strict unified protocol under pre-registered contracts. The protocol gap depends strongly on the benchmark---ranging from 22.8 mIoU points on PASCAL VOC (VOC21) to 0.1 points (indistinguishable from zero) on ADE20K---and alters pairwise method rankings. Despite large shifts in absolute mIoU, most of the reported improvement of later CLIP-only methods over SCLIP remains under the unified protocol (roughly 79% of the published gain). Decomposing official background handling shows that it combines numeric settings and class-name files whose dominant component reverses across benchmarks, while no tested tuning-free rule transfers reliably across all datasets. Moreover, exact collisions between background words and target names---present in six of seven official COCO-Object configurations through "bed"---make affected classes unpredictable under official post-processing, while the main per-class drops under language-model-generated vocabularies on VOC21 are largely attributable to a few generated terms. We offer reporting recommendations and release our evaluation code, frozen configurations, contracts, and a collision-check tool.

AI.tldr: 论文审计13个training-free OVSS方法的背景类处理配置，重新运行7个官方代码库，发现官方配置与统一严格协议之间的mIoU差距高度依赖数据集（VOC21达22.8点，ADE20K仅0.1点），并影响方法排名；但后续CLIP-only方法相对SCLIP的大部分提升在统一协议下依然成立（约79%）。
AI.motivation: 现有training-free OVSS方法以mIoU排名，但在含背景类的数据集上依赖未公开、未统一的per-dataset阈值和背景词表（13个方法中11个如此配置），导致比较不公平、结果不可复现。
AI.method: 审计13个方法的配置与论文，复现7个官方代码库，在预注册契约下对比官方设置与严格统一协议；分解官方背景处理（数值设置 vs 类名文件）；检验无需调参规则的可迁移性；检查背景词与目标类名的精确碰撞（如COCO-Object中"bed"）。
AI.result: 协议差距从VOC21的22.8 mIoU点到ADE20K的0.1点不等，并改变成对排名；79%的已发表增益在统一协议下保持；背景处理的主导成分随数据集反转，无统一免调参规则可靠迁移；7个COCO-Object官方配置中6个存在背景词碰撞，导致相关类不可预测；VOC21上LLM生成词表导致的每类下降主要源于少数生成词。
AI.conclusion: 官方背景处理配置显著影响绝对性能与排名，削弱横向比较可信度；提出报告规范建议，并开源评测代码、冻结配置、契约与碰撞检测工具。

title: AeroJEPA: A Two-Stage Framework for Aerosol Forecasting with Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
summary: Aerosol forecasting requires integrating sparse ground observations and modeling meteorologically driven concentration evolution and spatial structure. However, analysis-initialized forecasts make limited explicit use of historical observations, while pointwise regression tends to smooth local variations and provides limited constraints on fine spatial structures. In this work, we propose AeroJEPA, a two-stage joint-embedding predictive framework for regional surface PM$_{2.5}$ forecasting. Specifically, Stage I fuses historical observations, model backgrounds, and meteorological information to predict an initial future state, meteorological conditions, and multi-scale structures. Morphology-guided encoding and joint-embedding predictive supervision support learning future spatial representations, supplementing concentration regression with structural constraints. Stage II uses predicted meteorology to guide state refinement and incorporates coarse- and fine-scale structures into state updates and decoding to generate the concentration field at a single future time step. Experiments show that AeroJEPA reduces gridded and independent-station RMSE by 17.23\% and 7.90\%, respectively, relative to PFGNet, while improving spatial consistency with analysis fields. In a 48 h recursive forecasting case study, AeroJEPA generally achieves lower RMSE and MAE than the numerical forecasts across the forecast period, indicating promising short- to medium-range forecasting performance.

AI.tldr: AeroJEPA是一个两阶段联合嵌入预测框架，用于区域地面PM2.5浓度场预报，通过结构约束和气象引导改进预报精度与空间一致性。
AI.motivation: 气溶胶预报需整合稀疏地面观测与气象驱动的浓度演变及空间结构建模；但现有分析初始化预报对历史观测利用不足，逐点回归易平滑局地变化、对精细空间结构约束有限。
AI.method: 两阶段JEPA框架。阶段一融合历史观测、模式背景场和气象信息，预测初始未来状态、气象条件及多尺度结构，采用形态引导编码与联合嵌入预测监督，学习未来空间表征以补充浓度回归的结构约束；阶段二用预测气象引导状态细化，并将粗细尺度结构引入状态更新与解码，生成单一未来时刻的浓度场。
AI.result: 相对PFGNet，网格RMSE降低17.23%，独立站点RMSE降低7.90%，与分析场的空间一致性提升；48小时递归预报个例中，RMSE与MAE总体低于数值预报。
AI.conclusion: 结构约束与气象引导的两阶段设计能有效提升PM2.5空间场预报精度与一致性，具备中短期预报潜力。

title: Tracing Attacker Diversity Reduction in Adaptive LLM Red Teaming
summary: Reinforcement learning can increase the success of automated red teaming but it also narrows the attack vector. This study asks where in the attacker-defender-judge learning loop does the narrowing begin and which mechanisms lead to a narrowing attack. Six mechanisms (defender adaptation, success edge, reward reinforcement, row cap, update size, and measurement) are tested across three experiment arms (co-trained, frozen defender, half learning rate) for twenty-four iterations. A frozen defender narrows attack diversity retention (ADR) earlier 0.496 relative to co-trained 0.891 at iteration twelve. Defender updates delay narrowing but dont prevent it. Successful attacks ("winners") have narrower attack diversity than the full set of generated attacks. Attacks closest to previous winners succeed 10-15 percentage points more often than those closest to previous failures. This winner-neighbor advantage holds after a defender update and for a fixed defender too. Attacks with a common opening have a common-opening advantage of 5-16 percentage points. The training row cap and update size account for little impact on ADR, and attack length accounts for only part of the ADR decrease. Narrowing appears to originate from the success only reward through the group-relative training advantage to the attacker update, with a persistent success edge setting the direction.

AI.tldr: 该研究定位了强化学习自动化红队中攻击多样性收窄的起源与机制，发现收窄主要源于"仅奖励成功"经由组相对训练优势传导至攻击者更新，并由持续的成功优势设定方向。
AI.motivation: 强化学习能提升自动化红队攻击成功率，但会收窄攻击向量（降低攻击多样性）。作者想弄清收窄在"攻击者-防御者-评判者"学习环路中从何处开始、由哪些机制导致。
AI.method: 设计三个实验臂（联合训练、冻结防御者、半学习率），测试六种机制（防御者适应、成功优势、奖励强化、行数上限、更新幅度、测量），共运行24次迭代；比较成功攻击（"赢家"）与全体生成攻击的多样性，并分析攻击与历史赢家/失败者的邻近关系、共同开头（common opening）以及训练行数上限与更新幅度的影响。
AI.result: 冻结防御者时攻击多样性保留率（ADR）第12次迭代前降至0.496，而联合训练为0.891；防御者更新能延迟但不能阻止收窄。成功攻击的多样性低于全体生成攻击。最接近历史赢家的攻击成功率比最接近历史失败者高10–15个百分点，该"赢家邻居优势"在防御者更新后及固定防御者下均成立；具有共同开头的攻击享5–16个百分点优势。行数上限与更新幅度对ADR影响很小，攻击长度仅解释部分ADR下降。
AI.conclusion: 收窄起源于"仅奖励成功"通过组相对训练优势传导到攻击者更新，并由持续存在的成功优势设定方向；防御者适应、行数上限、更新幅度等并非主因。

title: AlignHand: Multi-View Hand Reconstruction from a Frozen Monocular Prior
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Project page and code: https://ada-zy2425.github.io/AlignHand/
summary: Modern monocular hand estimators recover detailed 3D meshes from individual images, yet effectively leveraging their predictions across multiple views remains challenging. Independently predicted meshes can disagree in scale, placement, and articulation, limiting the integration of complementary multi-view information. Hence, we present AlignHand, a calibrated multi-view framework that builds on a frozen monocular hand reconstruction prior to align and enhance its predictions. Specifically, AlignHand refines cross-view joint observations and estimates their reliability to establish a shared metric reference for alignment. Once the meshes are brought into a common frame, their complementary surface evidence is selectively fused across anatomical regions, followed by pixel-aligned refinement that predicts bounded residual displacements from local image features. This global-to-local integration enables AlignHand to exploit complementary observations while preserving the strong monocular prior. Extensive experiments on DexYCB-MV, HanCo, and HO3D-Eval-MV demonstrate that AlignHand achieves the lowest MPVPE and MPJPE among the compared methods under the respective evaluation protocols, reducing MPVPE by 30.1%, 29.1%, and 8.0%, respectively, compared with a matched geometry baseline.

AI.tldr: AlignHand是一个校准式多视角框架，在冻结的单目手部重建先验基础上对齐并增强多视角预测，通过跨视角关节精化与可靠性估计建立统一度量参考，再按解剖区域选择性融合表面证据并进行像素对齐细化，从而在多个数据集上取得最低MPVPE和MPJPE。
AI.motivation: 现代单目手部估计器能从单张图像恢复细节丰富的3D网格，但跨多视角有效利用这些预测仍具挑战：独立预测的网格在尺度、位置和关节姿态上可能不一致，限制了互补多视角信息的整合。
AI.method: 提出AlignHand：基于冻结的单目手部重建先验，先精化跨视角关节观测并估计其可靠性，建立共享的度量参考以将网格对齐到统一坐标系；随后在解剖区域层面选择性融合互补表面证据，并通过像素对齐细化从局部图像特征预测有界残差位移，实现由全局到局部的整合。
AI.result: 在DexYCB-MV、HanCo和HO3D-Eval-MV上，AlignHand在各评估协议下取得最低MPVPE和MPJPE，相比匹配的几何基线MPVPE分别降低30.1%、29.1%和8.0%。
AI.conclusion: AlignHand通过校准式多视角对齐与全局到局部的选择性融合，在保留强单目先验的同时有效利用互补观测，显著提升多视角手部重建精度。

title: Aggregation Rules Induced by KL-Regularised Preference Dynamics on Networks
summary: We study agents that each align a model to their own preference data while observing one another, and ask which aggregation rule the resulting policies implement. Each round, an agent takes one KL-regularised step. The step involves a reference that the agent is penalised for leaving and a challenger against which its responses are compared, and each of the two may be the agent's own or an average over the agents it observes; attention need not be reciprocal. Aggregating the reference makes the rule collective. Agent $v$ then has the weight $π_v/β_v$, its share of the network's long-run attention divided by its temperature. If, in addition, the challenger is fixed, the agents concentrate on the response maximising $\sum_v(π_v/β_v)r_v(y)$, where $r_v$ is agent $v$'s reward, and the rule is cardinal. If the reference is fixed and the challenger aggregated, the agents' policies at a fixed point generally differ, and any weighted mean of them is an approximate maximal lottery whatever the weights, so the dynamics select no weighting. If both are aggregated, the rule is ordinal: averaged over rounds, the collective policy is a maximal lottery of the influence-weighted preference kernel, up to a slack that we bound. Where a collective rule exists, its weights depend only on the attention weights and the temperatures.

AI.tldr: 研究多个智能体互相观察下各自对模型做KL正则化对齐时，最终实现的聚合规则取决于reference与challenger是否被聚合：可得到基数型、序数型或无权重的近似极大彩票。
AI.motivation: 探讨当多个智能体各自把模型对齐到自身偏好数据、同时又能观察彼此（注意力不必对称）时，所产生的集体策略究竟对应哪种社会选择/聚合规则，以及权重由何决定。
AI.method: 设定每轮每个智能体做一步KL正则化更新，更新含两个要素：被惩罚偏离的reference与被比较的challenger，二者可各自取自身或所观察智能体的平均。分析不同组合下不动点与长时间平均行为，推导聚合规则及其权重。
AI.result: 聚合reference时为集体规则，智能体v权重为π_v/β_v（长期注意力份额/温度）；若challenger固定则集中到最大化Σ(π_v/β_v)r_v(y)的响应，为基数规则；若reference固定而challenger聚合，则各策略不动点通常不同，任何加权平均都近似极大彩票，动力学不选出权重；若二者都聚合，则为序数规则，平均后集体策略是影响加权偏好核的极大彩票（含可界定的松弛）。
AI.conclusion: 存在集体规则时，其权重仅由注意力权重与温度决定；reference/challenger的聚合结构决定了规则是基数型、序数型还是无权重选择。

title: Training Dynamics of Large State-Transition Models
summary: Next-token prediction relies on learned token embeddings whose dimension $d$ is much smaller than the vocabulary size $V$. Existing analyses of training dynamics either fix the embeddings with $d\ge V$ or train them only in restricted settings. It remains unclear whether jointly training the embeddings by gradient-based methods from random initialization leads to accurate prediction when $d<V$. In this paper, we study this question in the simplest setting where it is already nontrivial, namely next-token prediction with a one-token context, which we refer to as a state-transition model. The model consists of an input embedding and an output embedding, either untied or tied, and is trained from Gaussian initialization by perturbed gradient descent with weight decay on the population cross-entropy loss. We consider ground-truth transition laws whose centered log-probability table has low rank and bounded entries, and measure the prediction quality by the relative prediction gain (RPG). It is zero for the uniform predictor and one for the optimal predictor. For the untied model, we show that when $d=Ω(\sqrt V)$, with probability at least $1-e^{-cd}$ for some constant $c$, the RPG is above $7/8$ at every iterate in the final $1-1/d$ fraction of training iterations. For the tied model trained on a subset of states, we prove that the RPG on the observed states is $1-O(V/d^2)$, and under a coverage condition on the ground truth and a bound on the learned embeddings, we further prove a prediction guarantee on the unseen states. Our analysis is based on the bounded trace of the Hessian of the softmax cross-entropy loss, which implies that the approximate second-order stationary points reached by training have high prediction gain. Numerical experiments with practical parameter choices illustrate the persistent training gain and the transfer of the tied model.

AI.tldr: 研究低维嵌入(d<V)下联合训练的下一词预测模型能否准确预测，证明在过渡模型上经扰动梯度下降训练可达到高相对预测增益。
AI.motivation: 既有理论要么固定嵌入且要求d≥V，要么只在受限设定下训练嵌入；当d<V时，随机初始化联合训练嵌入能否准确预测尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在最简单但非平凡的设定——单token上下文的"状态-过渡模型"上分析：模型含输入/输出嵌入(绑定或不绑定)，从高斯初始化出发，用带权重衰减的扰动梯度下降在总体交叉熵损失上训练。假设真实过渡律的中心化对数概率表低秩且元素有界，以相对预测增益(RPG，均匀预测为0、最优为1)衡量预测质量。核心工具是softmax交叉熵Hessian的迹有界，从而说明训练达到的近似二阶稳定点具有高预测增益。
AI.result: 不绑定模型：当d=Ω(√V)时，以至少1-e^{-cd}的概率，在训练最后1-1/d比例的每次迭代中RPG>7/8。绑定模型在状态子集上训练：观测状态RPG达1-O(V/d²)；在真值覆盖条件与嵌入界假设下，还可保证未见状态上的预测。
AI.conclusion: 即使d<V，梯度训练嵌入也能在过渡模型上获得持续的高预测增益，且绑定模型具备向未见状态的迁移能力；数值实验验证了参数选择的实用性与结论。

title: CLASP: Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling for Zero-Shot OOD Detection using Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable zero-shot out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in medical imaging, yet existing approaches often rely on final-layer confidence or entropy-based layer selection, potentially missing complementary information. We show that low in-distribution (ID) confidence entropy does not reliably predict OOD discrimination. We introduce CLASP (Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling), an ID-only framework that jointly models layer--prompt responses and visual features. CLASP ranks visual encoder layers using Gaussian conditional mutual information and selects a compact subset through anchored spectral selection, without fixing the number of layers. It then combines the selected layer--prompt profiles with PCA-compressed visual embeddings and fits a single shrinkage-regularized Gaussian. OOD scores are computed using squared Mahalanobis distance, without fine-tuning, OOD training data, or test-time adaptation. Across histopathology, chest X-ray, and brain MRI benchmarks with UniMedCLIP and BioMedCLIP, CLASP performs strongly under varied distribution shifts. On MIDOG near-OOD, it achieves 87.54% AUROC with UniMedCLIP, outperforming confidence-based baselines; with BioMedCLIP, it remains competitive but trails visual-only Mahalanobis modeling. Ablations highlight the value of layer--prompt interactions and cross-feature dependencies, while exposing shift-dependent contributions and limitations under semantic shifts.

AI.tldr: 提出CLASP：仅用ID数据，联合建模视觉编码器各层的层-提示响应与视觉特征，用高斯条件互信息排序层并经锚定谱选择，再用马氏距离打分做医学图像OOD检测。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM医学OOD检测多依赖最后一层置信度或基于熵的层选择，可能遗漏互补信息；作者并发现低ID置信熵并不能可靠预测OOD判别能力。
AI.method: CLASP框架：用高斯条件互信息对视觉编码器层排序，通过锚定谱选择自适应地选出紧凑子集（不预设层数）；将选中的层-提示画像与PCA压缩的视觉嵌入拼接，拟合单一收缩正则化高斯；OOD分数用平方马氏距离。无需微调、OOD训练数据或测试时自适应。
AI.result: 在组织病理、胸部X光、脑MRI基准上，配合UniMedCLIP与BioMedCLIP在多种分布偏移下表现强劲。MIDOG近OOD上，UniMedCLIP达87.54% AUROC，优于基于置信度的基线；BioMedCLIP下具竞争力，但略逊于纯视觉马氏建模。消融显示层-提示交互与跨特征依赖的价值，也暴露了依赖偏移的贡献及语义偏移下的局限。
AI.conclusion: CLASP提供了一种无需OOD数据的高效医学OOD检测范式，利用多层-提示互补信息优于置信度基线；但其收益随偏移类型变化，在语义偏移下存在局限，需进一步改进。

title: Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static. Existing benchmarks provide a strong foundation, but fixed difficulty ceilings, limited feature coverage, and coarse aggregate scores progressively weaken their discriminative and diagnostic value. We introduce CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence. It disentangles three objectives: benchmark evolution expands evaluation scope through cohort-calibrated difficulty and coverage growth; diagnostic evolution increases resolution through agent-conditional capability-boundary probes; and verifier evolution improves precision by translating changing requirements into state-grounded checkpoints with adversarial validation. Across multiple agents, applications, and rounds, CUA-SEE generates challenging, measurable tasks while preserving process-level evidence. Our results position adaptive evaluation as a scalable counterpart to self-evolving agents, continuously tracking what agents can do, where their boundaries lie, and how reliably progress is measured.

AI.tldr: 提出闭环评测环境 CUA-SEE，通过任务与可执行验证器的协同进化，解决现有CUAs基准难度封顶、覆盖面有限、粗粒度打分的问题。
AI.motivation: Computer-use agents 快速进步，但评测仍是静态的：固定难度上限、功能覆盖有限、聚合分数粗糙，逐渐弱化了基准的区分度与诊断价值。
AI.method: CUA-SEE 基于 rollout 证据让任务与可执行验证器共同进化，分离三个目标：(1) 基准进化——用 cohort 校准难度并扩展覆盖；(2) 诊断进化——通过 agent 条件化的能力边界探针提高分辨率；(3) 验证器进化——把变化的需求转成基于状态的检查点并做对抗验证以提升精度。
AI.result: 在多个 agent、应用与多轮实验中，CUA-SEE 能生成有挑战性且可测量的任务，同时保留过程级证据。
AI.conclusion: 自适应评测是自进化 agent 的可扩展对应物，可持续追踪 agent 能做什么、边界在哪、以及进展是否被可靠度量。

title: Damped Atomic Wave Integration Neurons (DAWIN): A Universal Primitive for Continuous-Time Spatiotemporal Learning
summary: Conventional artificial neurons separate spatial feature aggregation from continuous physical time, limiting their ability to model irregular observations. We introduce the Damped Atomic Wave Integration Neuron (DAWIN), a continuous-time primitive for replacing standard neural layers in MLPs, Transformers, and graph neural networks. DAWIN couples spatial projection with elapsed-time-dependent wave excitation and integrates it into a local complex state through closed-form damped evolution, avoiding numerical differential equation solvers. We show that DAWIN generalizes static sinusoidal and memoryless wave neurons on interval-augmented inputs, derive closed-form gradients, and establish bounded-input bounded-output stability for positive damping and sampling intervals bounded away from zero. An associative Triton prefix-scan implementation, DAWINLinear, uses FP32 accumulation and achieves O(log L) parallel depth for sequence length L. Across 11 parameter-matched tasks covering irregular oscillators, MuJoCo dynamics, pedestrian trajectories, and PhysioNet 2012 clinical sequences, DAWIN outperforms Neural CDE on 9 tasks and ReLU-MLP on 8. It achieves the lowest error on dense clinical dynamics (0.9531 NRMSE, winning across all 10 seeds) and ties for the best mortality prediction (0.9993 AUROC). Shuffling elapsed intervals increases error by 58.2%-77.4% on selected dynamics tasks, versus 0.06% on a time-irrelevant control, supporting reliance on physical timing. On NVIDIA B200 GPUs, parallel wave integration accelerates inference by up to 2,630 times over its serial implementation and reduces peak GPU memory by up to 97.6% relative to Mamba in the tested configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出DAWIN（阻尼原子波积分神经元），一种耦合空间投影与时间依赖波激发的连续时间神经元原语，用闭式阻尼演化替代求解微分方程，可替换MLP/Transformer/GNN层，在11项不规则时间序列任务上优于Neural CDE与ReLU-MLP，并具高效并行实现。
AI.motivation: 传统人工神经元将空间特征聚合与连续物理时间分离，难以建模不规则采样观测。现有连续时间模型（如Neural CDE）依赖数值ODE求解器，计算代价高、并行性差。
AI.method: DAWIN将空间投影与依经过时间变化的波激发耦合，通过闭式阻尼演化积分到局部复数状态，无需数值微分方程求解器；证明其推广静态正弦与无记忆波神经元，推导闭式梯度，并在正阻尼且采样间隔有下界时证明BIBO稳定性；实现DAWINLinear采用结合性Triton前缀扫描、FP32累加，序列长度L下并行深度O(log L)。
AI.result: 在11项参数匹配任务（不规则振荡器、MuJoCo动力学、行人轨迹、PhysioNet 2012）中，9项优于Neural CDE、8项优于ReLU-MLP；密集临床动力学最低误差0.9531 NRMSE（10个种子全胜），死亡率预测0.9993 AUROC并列最佳；打乱时间间隔使误差增加58.2%–77.4%（时间无关对照仅0.06%）；B200 GPU上推理较串行实现加速至多2630倍，峰值显存较Mamba降低至多97.6%。
AI.conclusion: DAWIN以闭式阻尼波积分在保持连续时间建模能力的同时实现稳定、可并行与高效率，是替代标准神经元层处理不规则时序的通用原语，且实验证明确实依赖物理时间信息。

title: Diagnosing Verbalized Confidence in a Medical Vision-Language Model for Selective Prediction on Colorectal Histopathology Patches
comment: 39 pages, 7 figures; supplementary material in ancillary files. Under review at Scientific Reports. Code and artifacts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23676823
summary: Flagging uncertain histopathology patches for specialist review needs a confidence that is higher when the model is right. We test whether an open medical vision-language model emits one. MedGemma-27b-it and its base Gemma-3-27b-it were run zero-shot under one prompt on 10,004 PathMNIST validation patches and 7,180 patches of a patient-disjoint external cohort. Both are too inaccurate to deploy (40.6% and 35.5%); the object of study is the confidence. MedGemma's verbalized confidence puts 96% of patches at one value; its confidence-correctness AUROC is 0.499 and 0.528, and routing by it moves selective-accuracy AUC by -0.004 and +0.037. Gemma-3 spreads its confidence over nine values, reaches AUROC 0.70, and gains +0.114 and +0.115. MedGemma's label-token probabilities do not rescue it: their validation advantage reverses where the top-20 alternatives include every class. On 1,800-patch subsets of each cohort, stratified on correctness and reweighted to the full splits, agreement across five prompt variants beats random by +0.123 and +0.106, and wording-only paraphrases give +0.100 and, externally and in direction only, +0.054; agreement's external margins over confidence do not survive slide-level clustering. Under one restructured prompt variant, MedGemma's stated confidence routes (+0.112, +0.141), so the failure is tied to a prompt chosen for macro F1.

AI.tldr: MedGemma-27b-it 零样本病理分类中，其口头置信度几乎退化为常数，无法用于选择性预测路由；提示词变体间的自一致性反而是更可靠的置信代理。
AI.motivation: 为病理切片标注"不确定、需专家复核"需要模型置信度在答对时更高。作者检验开源医学视觉语言模型 MedGemma 是否具备这种可靠的置信度信号。
AI.method: 在 PathMNIST 验证集（10,004 切片）与患者不重叠的外部队列（7,180 切片）上，以单一提示词零样本运行 MedGemma-27b-it 与 Gemma-3-27b-it，评估口头置信度、标签 token 概率、置信度-正确性 AUROC 及选择性准确率；另在按正确性分层的 1,800 切片子集上考察五种提示变体间的一致性，并与随机基线及置信度路由比较。
AI.result: 两者准确率过低（40.6%、35.5%）不可部署。MedGemma 的置信度把 96% 切片归为同一值，AUROC 仅 0.499/0.528，路由后选择性准确率 AUC 变化为 -0.004/+0.037；Gemma-3 置信度分布在 9 个值上，AUROC 达 0.70，增益 +0.114/+0.115。MedGemma 标签 token 概率无改善，其优势在 top-20 备选覆盖所有类时反转。提示一致性优于随机（+0.123/+0.106），改写变体为 +0.100 及外部 +0.054；但一致性的外部优势在切片级聚类下不显著。换用重构提示后 MedGemma 置信度可路由（+0.112/+0.141）。
AI.conclusion: MedGemma 置信度失效与为宏观 F1 选定的提示词相关，而非模型固有缺陷；提示一致性是较稳健但需谨慎解读的替代信号。

title: MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
summary: Automating clinical workflows requires vision-language agents that can navigate dense graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in electronic health records (EHRs) and execute precise actions, yet many medical agents still rely on text or structured tool calls. In this work, we introduce MedUIGym, a scalable interactive environment comprising 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families for training and evaluating clinical GUI agents. In MedUIGym, agents perceive EHR states from screenshots and execute mouse-and-keyboard actions, as well as a paired native-tool interface over identical clinical data. The environment verifies both final answers and required clinical actions, and supports parallel trajectory collection for training. Benchmarking twelve vision-language models shows that current agents struggle across diverse clinical workflows, and simply increasing reasoning effort fails to yield consistent gains. Furthermore, MedUIGym supports offline learning from GUI trajectories and online reinforcement learning from task rewards. After training, both Qwen3.5 models perform better on in-domain clinical tasks and generalize to tasks from external sources. By unifying tasks from existing benchmarks, dual-interface evaluation, and GUI trajectory collection, MedUIGym provides a testbed for studying how vision-language agents complete clinical tasks through the EHR's graphical interface. Our project page is available at https://github.com/yitong-qiao/MedUIGym.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MedUIGym，一个可扩展的临床 GUI 智能体交互环境，包含 17 个来源、6 类临床任务族的 15,739 个任务，支持截图感知+鼠标键盘操作与原生工具双接口，并可用于离线轨迹学习与在线强化学习训练。
AI.motivation: 自动化临床工作流需要能在电子健康记录（EHR）密集图形界面中导航并执行精确操作的视觉-语言智能体，但现有医学智能体多依赖文本或结构化工具调用，缺乏贴近真实 GUI 交互的训练与评测环境。
AI.method: 构建 MedUIGym：聚合 6 类临床任务族、17 个基准来源共 15,739 个任务的交互式环境；智能体从截图感知 EHR 状态并执行鼠标键盘动作，同时提供基于相同临床数据的配对原生工具接口；环境同时校验最终答案与所需临床动作，支持并行轨迹采集以用于训练；支持从 GUI 轨迹的离线学习与基于任务奖励的在线强化学习。
AI.result: 对 12 个视觉-语言模型的基准测试显示，现有智能体在多样临床工作流中普遍表现不佳，且单纯增加推理投入无法带来稳定提升；经离线或在线训练后，Qwen3.5 两个模型在域内临床任务上表现提升，并能泛化到外部来源任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一现有基准任务、双接口评测与 GUI 轨迹采集，MedUIGym 为研究视觉-语言智能体如何通过 EHR 图形界面完成临床任务提供了测试平台。

title: Fast 4-bit KV-Cache Decoding on Hopper GPUs: Why Existing Kernels Are Slow and How to Fix Them
summary: A 4-bit KV cache reads about half the bytes of FP8, but Hopper GPUs have no FP4 hardware and little instruction-issue capacity per byte of memory bandwidth, so 4-bit values must be decoded in software. On H200, vLLM's NVFP4 KV path (FlashInfer's decode) reaches 10-20% of memory bandwidth and is up to 1.7x slower than FP8. NVBit instruction counts show two causes: the kernels behind vLLM's 4-bit paths (FlashInfer NVFP4, Triton UltraQuant) execute 2-6x Hopper's issue budget per byte and serialize loading, decoding and matrix multiplies. Our Hopper-native decode kernel overlaps a TMA producer warp with two compute warpgroups, lays the cache out at write time so decoded values feed the tensor cores from registers, and swaps the matrix operands so small query groups need no padding. On H200 it reaches 67-75% of peak bandwidth at batch 32-128 and at all 11 shapes is 1.12-1.49x faster than the faster of XQA and FlashAttention-4's proposed native FP8. Inside vLLM, with an accuracy recipe (K mean removal and rotation, 4 BF16 sink tokens, BF16 layer 0), it decodes 1.12-1.64x faster per step on Llama-3.1-8B than vLLM's FlashInfer FP8 path at batch 8 and above (1.04-1.24x over FlashAttention-4's FP8), is level at batch 1, and holds 1.63x as many tokens. On one H200 under a reasoning-like request stream, the highest rate at which 99% of requests meet the latency targets is 1.23-1.32x FP8's on Llama-3.1-8B and 1.67-2.20x on Qwen2.5-72B, as the cache becomes the limit; prefill-heavy streams are worse (7% slower prefill). On five 7B-32B models, repeated runs show no significant accuracy difference from BF16 KV. In Qwen2-family models, whose reasoning variants collapse under FP8 KV, layer 0's key mean is almost entirely the key-projection bias identified by prior work, seen through RoPE and computable from the weights alone; keeping that layer in BF16 restores FP8 KV and, with K mean removal, 4-bit KV.

AI.tldr: 针对 Hopper GPU 无 FP4 硬件、4-bit KV cache 需软件解码导致带宽利用率低的问题，本文提出 Hopper 原生解码核（TMA 生产者 warp + 双计算 warpgroup、写入时布局、交换矩阵操作数），在 H200 上达到 67-75% 峰值带宽，端到端比 FP8 KV 快 1.12-1.64x 且精度不变。
AI.motivation: 4-bit KV cache 理论上只需 FP8 约一半字节，但 Hopper GPU 无 FP4 硬件，且每字节内存带宽对应的指令发射能力有限，4-bit 值必须软件解码。实测 vLLM 的 NVFP4 KV 路径（FlashInfer decode）仅达 10-20% 内存带宽，比 FP8 慢至多 1.7x；NVBit 指令计数显示相关内核（FlashInfer NVFP4、Triton UltraQuant）每字节执行量是 Hopper 发射预算的 2-6 倍，并把加载、解码与矩阵乘串行化。
AI.method: 设计 Hopper 原生解码核：1) TMA 生产者 warp 与两个计算 warpgroup 重叠；2) 在写入时即完成 cache 布局，使解码值可直接从寄存器喂给张量核心；3) 交换矩阵操作数，使小 query 组无需 padding。配套精度方案：K 均值移除与旋转、4 个 BF16 sink token、第 0 层保持 BF16；并发现 Qwen2 系列第 0 层 key 均值几乎完全来自 key 投影偏置（经 RoPE、可由权重算出）。
AI.result: H200 上 batch 32-128 达 67-75% 峰值带宽，全部 11 个 shape 比 XQA 与 FlashAttention-4 原生 FP8 中较快者快 1.12-1.49x。集成 vLLM 后 Llama-3.1-8B 每步解码比 FlashInfer FP8 快 1.12-1.64x（batch≥8），比 FA-4 FP8 快 1.04-1.24x，batch 1 持平，可容纳 1.63x token。单 H200 推理类请求流下满足 99% 延迟目标的最高速率：Llama-3.1-8B 为 FP8 的 1.23-1.32x，Qwen2.5-72B 为 1.67-2.20x；prefill 重型负载略差（prefill 慢 7%）。五个 7B-32B 模型多次运行精度与 BF16 KV 无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 软件解码的 4-bit KV cache 在 Hopper 上可通过核级重构（异步流水、布局与寄存器直通、操作数交换）摆脱指令发射瓶颈并逼近带宽极限，从而在保持 BF16 级精度的同时显著提升长上下文/大 batch 下的解码吞吐。第 0 层 BF16 是关键精度开关，其 key 均值可由权重解析得出。

title: Elicitation format changes zero-shot classification accuracy in a medical vision-language model: a two-center evaluation on colorectal histopathology
comment: 34 pages, 6 figures; Supplementary Table S1 and Supplementary Material S2 in ancillary files. Corrects one result reported in the companion preprint "Diagnosing Verbalized Confidence in a Medical Vision-Language Model for Selective Prediction on Colorectal Histopathology Patches" (Sinhal et al., arXiv, 2026)
summary: Background. Verbalized confidence from a hosted medical vision-language model is usually treated as packaging around an unchanged prediction. Methods. We held a nine-class colorectal histopathology prompt fixed except for the requested response format and evaluated MedGemma-27b-it on 10,004 validation and 7,180 external-center PathMNIST patches, with preregistered endpoints, randomized ties, and random floors recomputed for each patch set. Results. Requesting probabilities over all nine classes instead of a ranked top-3 reduced accuracy by 14.8 points on validation, -0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353], and 13.4 at the external center, -0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196], against chance accuracy of 0.1111. The nine-class prompt uniquely forbade commentary, reasoning, and a chosen answer; removing that prohibition at matched cardinality and token budget recovered +0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134] and +0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181], while changing cardinality with the prohibition absent moved accuracy by -0.0013 [-0.0300, +0.0280] and -0.0214 [-0.0494, +0.0071]. The nine-class format returned no parseable distribution on 7.6 and 7.7 percent of patches, mostly zero vectors in the two least-textured classes, and deferring these failures first explained its measurable selective-prediction gain. Across four vision-capable models, accuracy did not grade the cost: two models matched on accuracy differed five- to sevenfold. First-token logit entropy routed better than any elicited signal, +0.1820 [+0.1722, +0.1974] versus +0.0493 [+0.0377, +0.0649] relative to each signal's random floor. Conclusions. Response format changes a medical vision-language classifier, and the operative component here was the instruction suppressing an answer. Use logits when available; otherwise request a short ranked list without prohibiting reasoning or a chosen answer.

AI.tldr: 在结直肠病理图像九分类任务上，仅改变"要求模型输出全类概率"这一响应格式，就会让MedGemma-27b-it准确率下降约14个百分点；真正起作用的不是格式类别数，而是该提示词禁止了解释、推理和给出明确答案。可用logits时应用logits，否则应请求简短的排序列表且不禁止推理。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉-语言模型输出的"口头置信度"通常被当作不影响预测本身的包装，作者想检验：仅改变响应格式（而非问题内容）是否会改变模型的实际分类决策，以及哪种格式成分真正驱动了这一变化。
AI.method: 固定九类结直肠组织病理提示词，仅变化所要求的响应格式；在10,004个验证集patch与7,180个外部中心PathMNIST patch上评测MedGemma-27b-it。采用预注册终点、随机化平局处理、针对每个patch集重算随机下限；做匹配类别数与token预算的消融（移除"禁止评论/推理/选定答案"约束、改变类别数），并对比四个视觉能力模型的准确率与代价错配，比较首token logit熵与各类诱导信号的路径选择能力。
AI.result: 要求输出全部九类概率相比top-3排序列表，验证集准确率降14.8点（-0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353]），外部中心降13.4点（-0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196]），而随机准确率仅0.1111。九类提示词是唯一禁止评论、推理与选定答案的；在类别数和token预算匹配下移除该禁令可恢复+0.1878与+0.1911，而仅改类别数（无禁令）影响仅-0.0013与-0.0214。九类格式在7.6%/7.7%的patch上无可解析分布（多为两个纹理最少类别的零向量），延后这些失败后其选择性预测增益即可被解释。四个模型中准确率不能指示代价，两模型准确率相同但代价相差五到七倍。首token logit熵的路径能力（+0.1820）显著优于最佳诱导信号（+0.0493）。
AI.conclusion: 响应格式会实质改变医学视觉-语言分类器表现，本研究中关键成分是抑制给出答案的指令。建议在可用时直接使用logits；否则请求简短的排序列表，且不要禁止推理或明确答案。

title: Triage Accuracy of Jev and Open-Weight System One Decision Models and Their Use for Early Emergency Recognition in Symptom-Assessment Applications
summary: Laypeople increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for triage advice, but LLMs answer in variable free text, which makes it hard to evaluate them for use in medical devices. Decision models, which assign a probability to each predefined triage category, may be easier to evaluate. To test their triage accuracy, we evaluated 16 decision models (14 open-weight, 2 proprietary) on 233 synthetic and 10,000 real-world cases, yielding 163,728 total assessments. The best models triaged 72.1% of synthetic cases correctly and agreed with an existing algorithm in 56.1% of real-world cases. They were more promising for recognising emergencies early: given only demographics, chief complaints, risk factors and red-flag answers, the best model reached an AUROC of 0.87. At a 5% error margin, it could decide for or against emergencies for about half of users. Decision models should therefore not replace triage engines but could shorten symptom assessments at setting-specific error margins.

AI.tldr: 评估16个决策模型（14开源权重、2专有）在合成与真实分诊案例上的准确性：最佳模型合成案例正确率72.1%，真实案例与现有算法一致率56.1%，急诊识别AUROC达0.87，不宜替代分诊引擎但可缩短问诊流程。
AI.motivation: 普通人越来越多用LLM获取分诊建议，但LLM输出为自由文本、格式多变，难以作为医疗设备进行评估。决策模型对每个预设分诊类别输出概率，更便于评估，因此需要检验其分诊准确性。
AI.method: 评估16个决策模型（14个开放权重、2个专有），在233个合成案例和10,000个真实案例上共进行163,728次评估；输入仅限人口学信息、主诉、风险因素与红旗答案，考察正确率、与现有算法的一致率及急诊识别AUROC。
AI.result: 最佳模型在72.1%的合成案例中分诊正确，在56.1%的真实案例中与现有算法一致；急诊早期识别更有前景，AUROC达0.87，在5%错误率容限下可为约一半用户判定是否急诊。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型不应替代分诊引擎，但可在特定场景的错误容限下缩短症状评估过程。

title: PsyDrift: Healthy-Reference Latent Diffusion for Anomaly Scoring in Autism Spectrum Disorder
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at the CVPath-Vision4Neuro Workshop at WACV 2027. Includes expanded related-work and future-work discussion
summary: Individual heterogeneity and acquisition-site variability complicate neuroimaging-based characterization of autism spectrum disorder (ASD). We propose PsyDrift, combining ASD/healthy-control-supervised functional-connectivity representations with healthy-reference latent diffusion. An encoder produces 128-dimensional representations, and a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) learns exclusively from healthy training latents. Distance from a diffusion-denoised reconstruction provides a continuous deviation score. We evaluate 1,102 subjects from all 20 ABIDE-I sites using five-seed leave-one-site-out cross-validation. The classifier and DDPM achieve mean-site AUROCs of $0.798 \pm 0.003$ and $0.718 \pm 0.013$, respectively; uncertainties denote seed standard deviations. Matched healthy-reference scorers on the same representation achieve 0.68-0.71; the statistical significance of diffusion's modest numerical advantage remains unestablished. Within ASD, scores show weak associations with ADOS Total (Spearman $ρ= 0.108$, $p = 0.038$) and full-scale IQ ($ρ= -0.138$, $p = 0.002$), without adjustment for age, sex, site, or head motion. Frozen evaluation without retraining or hyperparameter adaptation yields pooled AUROCs of 0.69 on ABIDE-II and 0.61 on ADHD-200, providing preliminary evidence of cross-cohort and cross-disorder transfer. These results demonstrate healthy-reference deviation scoring within an ASD-supervised representation; incremental predictive and clinical value remains unestablished.

AI.tldr: PsyDrift将ASD/健康对照监督的功能连接表征与仅用健康样本训练的潜在扩散模型结合，以扩散重建距离作为偏离分数，在ABIDE-I 20站点上分类AUROC约0.798，但扩散相较匹配健康参照评分器的优势未确立，增量价值尚未证实。
AI.motivation: 个体异质性与采集站点差异使基于神经影像的ASD刻画困难；作者希望引入"健康参照偏离"这一连续度量，补充传统二分类指标。
AI.method: 编码器输出128维功能连接表征（ASD/健康对照监督训练）；DDPM仅在健康训练潜变量上学习；以扩散去噪重建的距离作为连续偏离分数。评估1102名被试、ABIDE-I全部20站点，采用五种子留一站点交叉验证；并在ABIDE-II与ADHD-200上冻结迁移评估。
AI.result: 分类器与DDPM的站点平均AUROC分别为0.798±0.003与0.718±0.013；同表征下匹配健康参照评分器为0.68–0.71，扩散优势的统计显著性未确立。ASD组内分数与ADOS总分（ρ=0.108, p=0.038）及全量表IQ（ρ=-0.138, p=0.002）仅弱相关且未校正混杂。冻结迁移AUROC为ABIDE-II 0.69、ADHD-200 0.61。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了在ASD监督表征框架内的健康参照偏离评分可行性，但增量预测与临床价值仍未确立；扩散模块相对简单健康参照评分的收益不明确。

title: Demystifying Classifier-Free Guidance for Auto-Regressive Image Generation
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) has been widely adopted in autoregressive (AR) models for high-quality image generation. Despite its strong empirical performance, its mechanism in AR models remains unclear. This paper demystifies the mechanism of CFG through both empirical and theoretical studies. By examining the top-ranked semantics of different components in CFG, we show that texture information is primarily encoded in the difference between the conditional and unconditional logits, whereas both logits share previous-token repetition as their leading semantics. This strong repetition semantics obscures the desired texture information, causing greedy decoding from the conditional logits alone to produce nearly pure-color images. Through a training-dynamics analysis of shallow transformers, we prove that this shared repetition semantics does not arise from limitations or failures of pretraining, but instead originates from the texture sparsity of images. We further show that CFG improves generation quality by rectifying this repetition bias during inference. Motivated by the shared semantics between conditional and unconditional logits, we propose Attention Weight Reuse (AttnReuse), which reuses intermediate attention computations from the conditional-logit forward pass to accelerate the unconditional-logit computation. AttnReuse reduces about $25\%$ of attention computation with little performance degradation across different models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证与理论研究揭示自回归图像生成中无分类器引导（CFG）的机制：纹理信息编码在条件与无条件logit之差中，而两者共享的“重复上文token”语义源于图像纹理稀疏性，CFG通过修正该重复偏置提升质量；据此提出Attention Weight Reuse方法加速无条件分支计算。
AI.motivation: CFG在自回归图像生成中经验效果很好，但其作用机制尚不清晰，缺乏理论解释。
AI.method: 分析CFG各分量rank最高的语义；对浅层Transformer做训练动力学分析，证明共享重复语义的来源；基于条件与无条件logit共享语义的观察，提出AttnReuse，复用条件logit前向传播中的中间注意力计算来加速无条件logit计算。
AI.result: 纹理信息主要编码于条件与无条件logit之差，两者共享“上文token重复”为首要语义；该重复语义并非预训练缺陷，而源于图像纹理稀疏性，且会掩盖纹理信息，导致仅用条件logit贪心解码生成近乎纯色图像；CFG通过修正重复偏置而改善质量。AttnReuse可减少约25%注意力计算，性能几乎无损。
AI.conclusion: 本文为CFG在自回归模型中的作用提供了实证与理论解释，并据此提出高效的AttnReuse加速方法。

title: ComputeWise: Measuring and Fixing GPU Waste by AI Research Agents
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Preliminary version; a revised version is in preparation. Code: https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/computewise. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Salesforce/computewise
summary: AI agents are given GPUs to do AI research on their own. Do they use those GPUs well? A busy GPU does not tell us, because it can be busy with work the answer did not need. This matters, because the tokens the agent spends cost almost nothing next to the GPUs its experiments run on, so using those GPUs better has a huge impact. So we built ComputeWise, an open benchmark of research tasks on which this waste can be measured and reduced. For it we developed our own simulated GPU, which replays recorded runs to the agent's code. With no real GPU needed, we ran hundreds of experiments, far more than would be reasonable on real GPUs. With no help, the agents put only 52% of their GPU time into work the answer needed. Another 22% went to work it did not need, and 26% sat idle. Asking the agent to finish the work faster, telling it to keep every GPU busy, or giving it a job scheduler does not fix this. So we built an open-source harness, part prompting and part deterministic code. Across five models, it removed over 80% of the extra time to the answer.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ComputeWise基准，用自研模拟GPU回放真实运行来测量AI智能体做科研实验时的GPU利用效率，并开源一套提示+确定性代码的harness，在五个模型上将"额外耗时"削减80%以上。
AI.motivation: AI智能体被赋予GPU自主做AI研究，但"GPU忙碌"不等于"有用功"。由于token成本远低于GPU实验成本，提升GPU使用效率收益巨大，而现有手段无法测量这类浪费。
AI.method: 构建ComputeWise开放基准与自研模拟GPU（回放记录运行），无需真实GPU即可跑数百次实验；提出开源harness，结合提示工程与确定性调度代码。
AI.result: 无辅助时智能体仅52%GPU时间用于答案所需工作，22%为非必需工作，26%空转；单纯催促加快、强制占满GPU或提供调度器均无效；harness在五个模型上消除超80%的多余耗时。
AI.conclusion: GPU浪费可被系统测量与显著降低，提示+确定性代码的轻量方案优于单点调度干预。

title: How Latent Transition Geometry Matters for Planning in World Models
summary: World models support planning by predicting how the environment evolves under candidate actions. However, one-step predictive accuracy alone does not characterize multi-step planning utility, which depends on distinguishing candidate futures. This raises a natural question: How does latent transition geometry shape planning? We investigate this through an action-conditioned transition-field view, using curvature regularization as a controlled intervention. Across four continuous-control tasks, appropriately tuned regularization improves planning, while excessive regularization can be detrimental. By decomposing the transition field into affine and non-affine components, we find that regularization reduces action sensitivity mainly through the non-affine component. To assess its role in planning, we directly manipulate the non-affine action response in frozen models and show that it affects candidate selection and closed-loop success. Further analysis shows that curvature generally brings predicted futures closer together, while preserving more of the differences along the goal direction. This helps explain why the planning effects vary across tasks. We observe broadly consistent planning trends across five sampling- and gradient-based solvers on LeWM and similar rollout-geometry trends on DINO-WM. Qualitative attention visualizations reveal accompanying shifts toward task-relevant visual structure. Together, these findings clarify how latent transition geometry influences multi-step planning.

AI.tldr: 研究潜空间转移几何（曲率）如何影响世界模型的多步规划效用；适度曲率正则提升规划，过度则有害，机制主要经由转移场的非仿射分量作用于候选选择。
AI.motivation: 一步预测精度无法刻画多步规划效用，而规划好坏取决于能否区分不同候选未来。作者因此追问：潜转移几何（曲率）如何塑造规划表现。
AI.method: 以动作条件的"转移场"视角建模，用曲率正则作为受控干预；将转移场分解为仿射与非仿射分量；在冻结模型中直接操纵非仿射动作响应；并在LeWM与DINO-WM上跨5种采样/梯度规划器验证。
AI.result: 四个连续控制任务中，适度曲率正则改善规划、过度则损害；正则主要通过非仿射分量降低动作敏感性；直接操纵非仿射响应会改变候选选择与闭环成功率；曲率使预测未来整体更接近，但仍保留沿目标方向的差异；五个求解器上趋势一致，DINO-WM上呈类似rollout几何趋势，注意力可视化显示转向任务相关视觉结构。
AI.conclusion: 潜转移几何（曲率与非仿射动作响应）是决定多步规划效用的关键因素，可解释曲率效应在不同任务间的差异，为世界模型设计提供可调控的几何视角。

title: RAGA: Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars from a Single Photo
summary: Avatars created from a single photo are fixed once made: regions the photo never showed, such as the back of a garment, are hallucinated and remain that way. We present Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars (RAGA), a full-body Gaussian avatar that is created from a single image in about one second and can be refreshed whenever new images of the same person become available, without retraining or gradient-based optimization. RAGA maps each new observation into canonical UV space, accumulates it as visibility- and angle-weighted running sums, and re-decodes the fused map with the same decoder used for the photo. Although this decoder is trained only on single images, it makes use of the fused evidence. On 163 clips from five datasets, RAGA created from one photo outperforms LHM, LHM++ and IDOL, including on three datasets never used in training. Refreshing from later frames adds 0.49 dB PSNR overall and 0.68 dB on views turned at least 135° from the photo, where SSIM and LPIPS also improve. Given the same 16 images on all clips, LHM++ gains 0.15 dB, against 0.48 dB for RAGA. Creating an avatar takes 1.08 s and animating it 48.1 ms per frame on a laptop RTX 3080 GPU, with body fitting and matting included in creation and pose estimation included in animation. Code will be released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: RAGA 提出一种从单张照片约1秒内创建全身高斯化身的方法，并可在有新图像时无需重训练或梯度优化地"刷新"以改进未见区域的渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 单照片化身一旦生成即固定：照片没展示的区域（如衣服背面）只能靠幻觉填补且无法修正。
AI.method: 将每张新观测映射到规范 UV 空间，按可见性与角度加权累加成 running sums，再用与单图创建相同的解码器重新解码融合后的特征图；该解码器虽只在单图上训练，也能利用融合证据。
AI.result: 在5个数据集163个片段上，单照片创建的 RAGA 优于 LHM、LHM++、IDOL（含3个训练未用数据集）；后续帧刷新增 0.49 dB PSNR，转向≥135°视角增 0.68 dB，SSIM/LPIPS 亦改善；16图设定下 LHM++ 提升 0.15 dB，RAGA 提升 0.48 dB。创建 1.08 s，渲染 48.1 ms/帧（RTX 3080 笔记本，含拟合、抠图与姿态估计）。
AI.conclusion: RAGA 实现了快速、可增量刷新的单图全身高斯化身，刷新机制显著改善未见视角质量，代码将开源。

title: AI-Assisted Auto-formalization for Trustworthy Scientific Computing: Case Studies and Lessons Learned
summary: Agentic AI tools have recently had success in mathematical reasoning. Both general purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex, and specialized mathematics agents such as Aristotle, have been used for formalizing mathematical problems such as Fermat's last theorem, Erdős problems and several IMO level math problems. However, much of these efforts are concentrated in the pure mathematics domain, which benefits from relatively self-contained theorem statements, fixed mathematical representation and extensive support in existing formal libraries. Applied mathematics, on the other hand, presents additional challenges because the source may describe a computational procedure or modeling transformation rather than a declarative theorem. In this work, we present a systematic study of AI-assisted auto-formalization for scientific computing (SC), a domain in applied mathematics central to U.S. Department of Energy applications. Through case studies spanning hierarchical abstraction layers in SC software stack, we evaluate not only whether AI agents can complete numerical proofs, but also where and why they fail across the stack. Our primary contribution is a cross-layer taxonomy of failure modes and an analysis of the form of expert feedback required at each layer to recover mathematical soundness. From these observations, we derive a workflow for recurring proof patterns and practical guidance for using AI agents while preserving mathematical soundness. Our results characterize both the practical value and the current limitations of AI-assisted formalization for trustworthy scientific computing.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究 AI 智能体在科学计算（应用数学）领域自动形式化（auto-formalization）的能力与局限，提出跨层失败模式分类法，并总结专家反馈需求与可复用证明工作流。
AI.motivation: 现有 agentic AI 在纯数学形式化（如费马大定理、Erdős 问题、IMO 题）上成果显著，但纯数学定理自包含、表示固定、形式库支持充分。应用数学（尤其科学计算）的源材料常描述计算流程或建模变换而非声明式定理，带来额外挑战，相关研究尚属空白。
AI.method: 通过覆盖科学计算软件栈各层级抽象（hierarchical abstraction layers）的案例研究，评估 AI 智能体能否完成数值证明，并定位其在栈中各层的失败点及原因；归纳跨层失败模式分类法，分析每层恢复数学严谨性所需的专家反馈形式。
AI.result: 给出跨层失败模式分类；刻画各抽象层对专家反馈的具体需求；识别可复现的证明模式，并据此提炼形式化工作流；同时说明 AI 辅助形式化在可信科学计算中的实用价值与当前局限。
AI.conclusion: AI 辅助自动形式化在科学计算中具备实际价值，但受限于非声明式源材料与跨层语义差异；通过分层专家反馈与模式化工作流可在保持数学严谨性的前提下有效使用 AI 智能体。

title: Regularizing Hard Examples Improves Adversarial Robustness
comment: 48 pages, 16 figures, 22 tables. Published in the Journal of Machine Learning Research (JMLR)
summary: Recent studies have validated that pruning hard-to-learn examples from training improves the generalization performance of neural networks (NNs). In this study, we investigate this intriguing phenomenon -- the negative effect of hard examples on generalization -- in adversarial training. Particularly, we theoretically demonstrate that the increase in the difficulty of hard examples in adversarial training is significantly greater than the increase in the difficulty of easy examples. Furthermore, we verify that hard examples are only fitted through memorization of the label in adversarial training. We conduct both theoretical and empirical analyses of this memorization phenomenon, showing that pruning hard examples in adversarial training can enhance the model's robustness. However, the challenge remains in finding the optimal threshold for removing hard examples that degrade robustness performance. Based upon these observations, we propose a new approach, difficulty proportional label smoothing (DPLS), to adaptively mitigate the negative effect of hard examples, thereby improving the adversarial robustness of NNs. Notably, our experimental result indicates that our method can successfully leverage hard examples while circumventing the negative effect.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究对抗训练中"难样本"对泛化的负面影响，理论上揭示对抗训练会显著放大难样本难度、且难样本只能靠记忆标签被拟合；据此提出难度比例标签平滑（DPLS）自适应缓解该负面效应，在利用难样本的同时提升对抗鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 已有研究显示剪除难以学习的样本可提升神经网络泛化，但该"难样本负面效应"在对抗训练中的机制尚不明确；同时如何选取剪除难样本的最优阈值仍是一大难题。
AI.method: 从理论与实证两方面分析：论证对抗训练中难样本难度增幅远大于易样本，且难样本仅通过标签记忆被拟合；基于此提出难度比例标签平滑（DPLS），根据样本难度自适应地平滑标签，以缓解难样本的负面效应。
AI.result: 理论与实验共同验证了剪除对抗训练中的难样本能增强模型鲁棒性；DPLS避免了对最优剪除阈值的依赖，实验表明其能成功利用难样本并规避其负面效应，提升对抗鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 对抗训练中难样本存在显著的记忆与鲁棒性损害问题，DPLS通过自适应标签平滑有效化解该矛盾，为提升神经网络对抗鲁棒性提供了新思路。

title: T2ISpec: Benchmarking Speculative Decoding for Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) generators produce detailed images but remain slow at inference. Speculative decoding can reduce this cost, yet its behavior across the rendering requirements of T2I prompts remains insufficiently understood. We introduce T2ISpec, a benchmark of 1,400 prompts balanced across seven rendering topics and two difficulty levels. It evaluates autoregressive and diffusion/flow accelerators by latency, work performed by the target model, and image quality. Our study reveals three key findings: (1) aggregate results hide large differences between topics, (2) alignment and preference scores can disagree with prompt constraint satisfaction, and (3) large reductions in target work can yield limited latency gains. Motivated by these findings, we propose TopicRoute, a plugin that combines prompt routing with speculative and cache controls without retraining the generator. Across six model--method pairs, it achieves a geometric mean speedup of 1.0308x over the native methods, and the speedup carries over to external prompts with the same settings, while quality gains and losses vary across configurations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出T2ISpec基准（1400条均衡覆盖7类渲染主题与2个难度层次的提示）系统评测文生图推测解码，发现三个关键问题，并提出TopicRoute插件，通过提示路由结合推测与缓存控制，在六组模型-方法对上实现1.0308倍几何平均加速。
AI.motivation: 文生图生成器推理慢，推测解码可降本，但其在不同渲染需求提示下的行为尚不清楚，缺乏细粒度评测与针对性加速手段。
AI.method: 构建T2ISpec基准，按主题与难度分层，以延迟、目标模型工作量、图像质量三项指标评测自回归与扩散/流加速器；基于发现提出TopicRoute，将提示路由与推测解码、缓存控制相结合，无需重训练生成器。
AI.result: 发现：(1)聚合结果掩盖主题间巨大差异；(2)对齐与偏好分数可能与提示约束满足度不一致；(3)目标模型工作量大幅降低未必带来明显延迟收益。TopicRoute在六组模型-方法对上几何平均加速1.0308倍，且同设置下可迁移到外部提示，质量变化因配置而异。
AI.conclusion: 分主题评测对理解文生图推测解码至关重要，主题感知的路由与缓存协同可在不重训练前提下获得稳定但有限的加速，质量收益需按配置权衡。

title: Boltz-Flow: Generating High-Quality Robot Action from Boltzmann Machine
summary: Flow-matching policies integrate a velocity field from a fixed, observation-independent Gaussian source. However, since the source is unimodal and identical across all tasks, the limited representational capacity of Gaussian distributions constrains how far a policy can scale with growing task diversity. Moreover, the source factorizes over time steps and control dimensions, discarding the coordination that manipulation requires. We introduce Boltz-Flow, which replaces Gaussian initialization with a more powerful, observation- and instruction-conditioned Boltzmann source while leaving the base VLA unchanged. Boltz-Flow parameterizes this source with a conditional Boltzmann machine that assigns an energy value to each binary source state. A listwise objective, supervised entirely by offline demonstrations, aligns this energy with the quality of actions produced after frozen flow integration. At inference, the energy defines an Ising instance whose solution is decoded into continuous noise before a single standard integration. We use a physical coherent Ising machine during training. Experiments show that Boltz-Flow improves $π_{0.5}$ across three benchmarks, outperforming the compared strong policy baselines and competing noise optimization methods on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 and ranking second only to LEAP on LIBERO-Plus. Additional experiments show gains under noise-adapted fine-tuning, with action-to-action warm starts, and on the SmolVLA backbone.
