comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Human visual intelligence enables efficient reasoning capabilities on abstract visual problems with bounded cognitive resources and minimal experience, and yields remarkable generalization to novel problems with its ability to draw relational analogies and modular abstractions. In contrast, deep learning models require exhaustive task-specific training on large datasets, making them prone to exploiting visual shortcuts and resulting in poor generalization. While neuro-symbolic approaches attempt to bridge this gap by decoupling perception from reasoning with dedicated computation units, existing solutions rely either on explicit rule supervision or parameter-heavy transformer architectures that reintroduce the computational inefficiencies they aim to solve. We introduce Slot-Dwn to address these limitations, a novel neuro-symbolic architecture that unifies unsupervised object-centric perception with logic-based symbolic reasoning. Our model utilizes a Multi-Head Differentiable Weightless Network (MH-DWN) that performs efficient reasoning entirely in Boolean space using look-up tables (LUTs). Our framework reduces visual perception complexity and introduces a LUT-based relational bottleneck with sparse input routing to minimize computational overhead. We evaluate Slot-Dwn across various abstract visual reasoning benchmark tasks targeting systematic rule generalization, sample-efficient anomaly detection, and multi-relational reasoning. We demonstrate that Slot-Dwn yields competitive performance with respect to the state-of-the-art, under extreme out-of-distribution regimes, while requiring up to 52% fewer trainable parameters, with significantly faster convergence.

AI.tldr: Slot-Dwn 是一种神经符号架构，将无监督物体中心感知与基于 LUT 的布尔逻辑推理统一，在多类抽象视觉推理任务上以更少参数和更快收敛取得有竞争力的 OOD 性能。
AI.motivation: 人类能凭有限认知资源和极少经验，通过关系类比与模块化抽象高效推理并泛化；而深度学习依赖大规模任务特定训练、易利用视觉捷径、泛化差。已有神经符号方法或以显式规则监督、或使用参数繁重的 Transformer，重新引入了它们本欲解决的计算低效问题。
AI.method: 提出 Slot-Dwn：无监督物体中心感知 + 逻辑符号推理。核心为多头可微无权重网络（MH-DWN），在布尔空间用查找表（LUT）完成推理；并以基于 LUT 的关系瓶颈与稀疏输入路由降低计算开销、简化感知复杂度。
AI.result: 在系统规则泛化、样本高效异常检测、多关系推理等抽象视觉推理基准上评测；在极端分布外（OOD）条件下性能与 SOTA 相当，可训练参数最多减少 52%，收敛显著更快。
AI.conclusion: 无权重布尔 LUT 推理结合物体中心表征是可行且高效的神经符号路线，可在低参数预算下实现强泛化，为高效抽象推理提供新方向。

title: Beyond Attention Maps: Understanding and Improving Medical MLLMs via Visual Values
summary: Current MLLM methods largely focus on whether models attend to the right visual regions, implicitly treating spatial attention map as the primary key of effective visual perception. To examine this assumption, we introduce a medical VQA dataset with paired non-contrast (NC) and contrast-enhanced (CE) images that share corresponding anatomy while providing different cues. We show that this view is incomplete: across paired NC and CE medical images, MLLMs often exhibit similar attention patterns despite producing contrasting answers, while controlled bidirectional interventions induce substantially larger prediction changes on visual values than attention weights. These results identify the visual content retrieved through values as a critical factor in improving perception beyond spatial attention alone. Guided by this finding, we propose VIVID (VIsual Value Intervention Distillation), which uses enhanced visual values to identify and refine teacher corrections aligned with useful visual evidence to improve on-policy distillation from CE to NC images. Across six internal and external test sets, VIVID consistently outperforms existing on-policy distillation methods across different model scales and architectures, requires only NC images at inference, and maintains strong zero-shot performance on general-domain VQA benchmarks. The project page is available at https://qiuzyc.github.io/VIVID.

AI.tldr: 论文指出MLLM视觉感知的关键不只在空间注意力，还在于value中检索到的视觉内容，并据此提出VIVID方法提升医学VQA。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM研究多假设"注意力是否落在正确视觉区域"是有效视觉感知的核心，忽视了value通道承载的视觉内容。作者用配对NC/CE医学图像来检验这一假设，发现注意力视角并不充分。
AI.method: 构建配对非造影(NC)与造影(CE)医学VQA数据集（同解剖、不同线索）；通过双向干预对比注意力权重与视觉value对预测的影响；提出VIVID（VIsual Value Intervention Distillation），用增强视觉value识别并修正教师纠错，改进从CE到NC的on-policy蒸馏。
AI.result: 配对图像上MLLM注意力模式相似却给出相反答案；干预视觉value引起的预测变化远大于注意力权重。VIVID在六个内部与外部测试集上稳定超过现有on-policy蒸馏方法，跨模型规模与架构有效，推理仅需NC图像，并在通用域VQA上保持强零样本性能。
AI.conclusion: 空间注意力并非有效视觉感知的唯一关键，value检索的视觉内容是重要补充因素；基于该洞察的VIVID在医学VQA上有效且具泛化性。

title: PVFormer: Proper Velocity Transformer for Stable and Scalable Hyperbolic Representation Learning
summary: Hyperbolic representations have shown remarkable success on hierarchical and tree-like data, and Transformers have become a central architecture for representation learning. However, a principled construction of hyperbolic Transformers remains challenging because the self-attention layer decomposes into three coupled primitives, transformation, similarity, and aggregation, that should all respect the underlying geometry. Existing hyperbolic Transformer designs are typically built in the Poincaré or Lorentz models, where bounded domains, time-like constraints, tangent-space detours, or projection steps make it difficult to keep the full block intrinsic and scalable. To address this gap, we propose PVFormer, to the best of our knowledge, the first Transformer architecture that operates natively in proper velocity (PV) space. The proper velocity model provides an unconstrained representation of hyperbolic geometry, and PVFormer exploits this structure to redesign the Transformer block in PV space. On the transformation side, we use PV homomorphism transformations to update query and value representations. On the similarity side, we generalize Euclidean inner-product attention with a PV Busemann score inspired by Busemann-based hyperbolic learning and a PV point-to-hyperplane key transformation. On the aggregation side, we replace Euclidean averaging with PV midpoint aggregation and further derive a scalable PV linear attention variant for large graphs. Extensive experiments support the effectiveness of PVFormer across graph, text, and vision benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出PVFormer，首个在proper velocity（PV）空间中原生运行的Transformer架构，重新设计了变换、相似度和聚合三个原语使其符合双曲几何，在图表征、文本和视觉任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 双曲表示在层级/树状数据上表现优异，Transformer是核心表示学习架构，但双曲Transformer构造困难：自注意力分解为变换、相似度、聚合三个耦合原语，都需符合底层几何。现有基于Poincaré或Lorentz模型的方案受限于有界域、类时约束、切空间绕行或投影步骤，难以保持整个模块的内在性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 利用proper velocity模型的无穷域无约束表示特性，在PV空间重构Transformer模块：变换侧使用PV同态变换更新query和value；相似度侧用受Busemann双曲学习启发的PV Busemann打分和PV点-超平面key变换推广欧氏内积注意力；聚合侧用PV中点聚合替代欧氏平均，并推导可扩展的PV线性注意力变体以处理大图。
AI.result: 在 graph、text、vision 三类基准上的大量实验支持 PVFormer 的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PV空间为构建内在且可扩展的双曲Transformer提供了可行且有效的基础，PVFormer作为首个PV原生Transformer，验证了将三个注意力原语几何化设计的价值。

title: Scenario Compliant Indoor Pedestrian Trajectory Reconstruction from Partial Observation
summary: Pedestrian trajectory reconstruction is vital for applications ranging from security surveillance to indoor navigation. While existing probabilistic and generative frameworks have shown success in outdoor GPS-based trajectory imputation, they often fail in indoor settings where movement is strictly governed by dense geometric constraints such as walls and corridors. Standard models typically treat trajectories as unconstrained coordinate sequences, leading to physically infeasible paths with high collision rates. To address this, we propose a map-conditioned generative framework based on conditional diffusion models. Our approach explicitly integrates dense scenario maps as structured spatial inputs via a CNN-based encoder, allowing environmental geometry to guide the iterative denoising process. Furthermore, we employ an endpoint-aware mechanism by embedding observations (start and end points) directly into the scenario map, providing critical spatial anchors through image-level features. Experiments on simulated indoor trajectories and the real-world Shopper trajectory dataset, with three training seeds, show that our method achieves the lowest errors among the compared generative methods. Scene conditioning reduces the collision and invalid rates by 19\% and 46\% on the simulated dataset, whereas on real shopper data the gains are consistent but small, mainly because the model rarely learns to route around obstacles between the endpoints. Compared with a shortest-path planner, which never collides, our method better captures the variability of real motion (31\% lower CRPS), but the timing of stops is reconstructed only partially. These results show that explicit environmental context improves physical consistency, while reconstructing realistic human motion in real indoor spaces remains challenging. Our code is available at https://github.com/dang-qi/trajectory_reconstruction

AI.tldr: 提出基于条件扩散模型的地图条件生成框架，将稠密室内场景地图经CNN编码来引导迭代去噪，并通过将起止点嵌入地图实现端点感知，从而重建物理可行的行人轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有概率/生成式方法在室外GPS轨迹插补有效，但室内运动受墙壁、走廊等稠密几何约束，把轨迹当作无约束坐标序列会产生高碰撞率的不可行路径。
AI.method: 条件扩散模型生成框架；CNN编码器将稠密场景地图作为结构化空间输入引导去噪；端点感知机制将起止观测直接嵌入场景图，以图像级特征提供空间锚点。在模拟室内轨迹和真实Shopper数据集上用三个随机种子评测。
AI.result: 在对比的生成方法中误差最低；模拟数据上场景条件使碰撞率和无效率分别下降19%和46%；真实Shopper数据上提升一致但较小，主因模型很少学会绕障；相比零碰撞的最短路规划器，CPRS低31%，但停留时刻仅部分重建。
AI.conclusion: 显式环境上下文提升了物理一致性，但在真实室内空间重建拟人运动仍具挑战。

title: NeuroMotion: Aligning EEG to Discrete Motion Primitives for Continuous Motion Decoding
summary: EEG-to-motion decoding remains challenging because noisy scalp EEG is difficult to map directly to continuous kinematics. We present NeuroMotion, a framework that aligns EEG representations to discrete motion primitives for continuous motion decoding across heterogeneous paradigms, including full-body free movement, lower-limb treadmill locomotion, and upper-limb freewill reaching and grasping. A VQ-based motion prior discretizes continuous motion into reusable primitives that serve as both alignment prototypes and intermediate prediction targets. Prototypical and supervised contrastive objectives align EEG embeddings to motion-derived prototypes and organize them according to primitive assignments. An E2M Transformer predicts motion-code sequences from the learned EEG representations, while a final geometric refinement stage improves continuous trajectory reconstruction through motion-level training. Under a last-session test protocol, NeuroMotion achieves the best mean reconstruction performance among the compared EEG decoding baselines across all three datasets, with the clearest gains on full-body motion in both reconstruction accuracy and distribution-level quality. Multi-subject ablations further support the contributions of EEG-to-primitive alignment, token prediction, and refinement. Code is available at https://github.com/Liuyi2351433/NeuroAction.

AI.tldr: NeuroMotion 提出将对齐EEG表征到离散运动基元（motion primitives）的框架，用于跨范式连续运动解码，并在三类数据集上取得最佳重建表现。
AI.motivation: 头皮EEG噪声大、难以直接映射到连续运动学量，导致EEG到运动的连续解码困难；同时需要跨异构范式（全身自由运动、下肢跑步机行走、上肢自主抓取）通用。
AI.method: 用VQ将连续运动离散为可复用基元，作为对齐原型与中间预测目标；采用原型对比与监督对比目标将EEG嵌入对齐到运动基元；用E2M Transformer从EEG表征预测运动码序列；最后经几何精修阶段以运动级训练改善连续轨迹重建。
AI.result: 在last-session测试协议下，三个数据集上平均重建性能均优于对比的EEG解码基线，其中全身运动在重建精度与分布级质量上提升最明显；多被试消融验证了EEG-基元对齐、token预测与精修阶段的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入离散运动基元作为中介，可有效缓解EEG到连续运动学的直接映射难题，并实现跨范式的连续运动解码。

title: ClothCast: Generative Cloth World Modeling under Partial Observability
summary: World models support robotic manipulation by predicting how the scene evolves under a planned action. For garments this prediction is notoriously difficult: deformations are complex, and self-occlusion leaves much of the cloth unobserved. Planned gripper trajectories provide a useful motion prior because cloth held by a gripper moves with it, while the remaining deformation must be predicted. We introduce ClothCast, a world model that applies this prior to the cloth's points and learns the residual motion. ClothCast takes one RGB-D observation, the camera pose, the robot's own model and the planned gripper trajectories, with no cloth mesh or material parameters. It lifts the observation to a layered point set that includes hypothesized occluded layers, carries the points with a blended rigid prior derived from the gripper poses, and predicts the residual motion with a video-diffusion point-flow model. Over entire 4- to 11-second episodes at 10 Hz, the moved points are rendered into depth, from which a geometry-conditioned completion model synthesizes RGB; after release, a hand-designed settling step replaces the learned motion. We further release ClothCastBench, 10,000 simulated dual-arm cloth-manipulation episodes with the ground-truth cloth mesh, including occluded layers, at every frame. On 492 held-out episodes, ClothCast achieves 2.5x lower sequence-averaged visible-surface Chamfer distance than Flex-π, the strongest baseline in geometry (14.0 mm vs. 35.6 mm), and 3.7 dB higher cloth-region PSNR than Cosmos-Predict2.5, the strongest baseline in cloth PSNR. On a 50-episode ablation subset, the rigid prior alone, applied to ClothCast's learned initial geometry with the same post-processing, already outperforms both geometry-capable baselines, and the learned residual lowers its error by about a third.

AI.tldr: ClothCast是一个面向衣物操作的world model，利用夹爪轨迹作为刚体运动先验，结合分层点集与视频扩散点流模型预测布料形变，并发布ClothCastBench数据集。
AI.motivation: 衣物形变复杂且自遮挡严重导致大量布料未被观测，传统world model难以准确预测布料随规划动作的演化。
AI.method: 输入单次RGB-D观测、相机位姿、机器人模型与规划夹爪轨迹（无需mesh或材质参数）；将观测提升为含假设遮挡层的分层点集，用基于夹爪位姿的混合刚体先验带动点集，再由视频扩散点流模型预测残差运动；把点渲染成深度并用以几何为条件的补全模型合成RGB；释放后用人工设计的稳定化步骤替代学习运动。
AI.result: 在492个留出episode上，可见表面Chamfer距离14.0mm vs Flex-π的35.6mm（低2.5倍），布料区域PSNR比Cosmos-Predict2.5高3.7dB；50-episode消融中仅刚体先验已超过两个几何基线，学习残差再降约三分之一误差。
AI.conclusion: 以夹爪轨迹为刚体先验并学习残差是有效的布料world model范式，同时发布含真值mesh（含遮挡层）的ClothCastBench（10,000个双臂仿真episode）以推动研究。

title: Doc-to-LoRA Analysis: Query Conditioning, Wrong Facts, and Distractor Interference
comment: 18 pages total: 11 pages including references, plus a 7-page appendix. 5 figures
summary: Doc-to-LoRA (D2L) compiles documents into low-rank adapters, allowing language models to use their contents without repeatedly processing the original text. We investigate its suitability for internalizing user memories through factual question answering, controlled interventions, and a production MidBrain memory pipeline. Across Gemma-2-2B and Qwen3-4B, D2L loses accuracy relative to in-context learning, with additional documents introducing substantial interference. Single-document errors frequently match answers to other questions about the same passage, suggesting unreliable question-answer attribution. Layer-wise interventions show that interference accumulates across depth, with more concentrated early damage at larger bank sizes on Gemma. With eight documents, applying the full bank in the initial layers gives similar accuracy to withholding all document contributions there. Source membership is detectable in intermediate states, but trained readers do not reliably resolve the interference. On PersonaMem-v2, joint compilation and normalized adapter composition achieve accuracy close to consolidated text memory when retrieved episodes remain text, but the resulting token savings are modest. Measured throughput gains also depend on model and batch size despite substantial reductions in analytical compute. Together, these findings limit the practical case for D2L as a replacement for text-based memory and motivate investigating online-learning methods that acquire personalized behavior from interactions in which memory is used.

AI.tldr: 本文评测 Doc-to-LoRA（D2L）将文档编译为低秩适配器以内部化用户记忆的可行性，发现其精度低于上下文学习、多文档干扰严重、问答归属不可靠，实际收益有限。
AI.motivation: D2L 可让模型无需重复处理原文即使用文档内容，作者想验证它能否替代文本记忆，实现用户记忆的内部化。
AI.method: 在 Gemma-2-2B 与 Qwen3-4B 上用事实问答、受控干预、逐层干预分析，并在生产 MidBrain 记忆流水线与 PersonaMem-v2 上评测。
AI.result: 精度低于 in-context learning；多文档引入显著干扰且随深度累积；单文档错误常匹配同一段落其他问题的答案，说明问答归属不可靠；文档归属在中间层可检测但读取器无法消解干扰；PersonaMem-v2 上联合编译与归一化适配器组合接近整合文本记忆，但 token 节省有限；吞吐提升依模型与批大小而定。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果削弱了 D2L 替代文本记忆的实用性，作者建议研究在使用记忆中通过交互获取个性化行为的在线学习方法。

title: SpectralGS: Spectral Gaussian Splatting for Unsupervised Spectral Super-Resolution
summary: Unsupervised spectral super-resolution aims to recover spectral information from RGB images without paired hyperspectral data. However, the limited spectral information in RGB observations makes learning an effective spatial-spectral representation challenging, requiring the incorporation of structured spectral modeling with sensor imaging. In this paper, we propose SpectralGS, a spectral Gaussian splatting framework comprising two components: Shared Spectral Gaussian Representation and Spectral Response Projection Rendering. The representation module constructs a continuous spatial-spectral representation via shared spectral and local spatial Gaussian primitives, exploiting the low-rank spectral structure of hyperspectral images. The rendering module utilizes the spectral response function (SRF) to apply integral projection to the continuous representation, blending it to generate an RGB image. Consistency between the rendered and observed RGB images provides training supervision. Our main contribution is a Gaussian splatting framework that integrates structured continuous spatial-spectral representation with imaging response-based rendering, enabling unsupervised spectral reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SpectralGS，一种基于高斯泼溅的无监督光谱超分辨率框架，通过共享光谱高斯表示与光谱响应投影渲染实现连续空谱建模，性能优于现有SOTA。
AI.motivation: 无监督光谱超分辨率需从RGB恢复高光谱，但RGB所含光谱信息有限，难以学习有效的空谱表示，需将结构化光谱建模与传感器成像过程结合。
AI.method: 框架含两部分：共享光谱高斯表示模块利用共享光谱原语与局部空间高斯原语构建连续空谱表示，并利用高光谱的低秩光谱结构；光谱响应投影渲染模块利用SRF对连续表示做积分投影并混合生成RGB；以渲染RGB与观测RGB的一致性作为训练监督。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 将结构化连续空谱表示与基于成像响应的渲染整合进高斯泼溅框架，可实现有效且领先的无监督光谱重建。

title: Potential Games for Self-Neighborhood Channel Mixing in Graph Neural Networks
summary: Graph message passing must balance two competing objectives: incorporating neighborhood signals while preserving node-specific information. We model this trade-off as a game in which nodes choose how to mix their own representations with strict-neighborhood aggregates. For fixed channel representations, task supervision defines a common-payoff game, while local distinctness payoffs induce an exact potential game whose potential is the degree-normalized strict Dirichlet energy. We introduce CG2, which amortizes these choices through a shared six-parameter policy per layer based on local channel statistics and can be trained using either objective. Controlled comparisons show that the shared task-trained policy improves mean performance over fixed mixing on three of five heterophily benchmarks, with significant gains on two, while free per-node actions trained with either objective rarely improve on the same baseline. On the ECHO long-range benchmark, the clearest contribution of the gate appears on eccentricity, where the task-trained policy substantially reduces prediction error.

AI.tldr: 将图消息传递中"融合邻域信号"与"保留节点自身信息"的权衡建模为博弈，提出共享六参数逐层门控策略 CG2。
AI.motivation: 图消息传递需平衡两个竞争目标：吸收邻域信息与保留节点自身信息。作者希望把这一权衡显式建模并可学习。
AI.method: 把每个节点如何混合自身表示与严格邻域聚合建模为博弈：固定通道表示下，任务监督定义共同收益博弈；局部差异性收益构成精确势博弈，其势函数为度归一化的严格 Dirichlet 能量。据此提出 CG2，用每层共享的六参数策略（基于局部通道统计量）摊销这些选择，并可用任一目标训练。
AI.result: 受控对比显示：共享的任务训练策略在五个异质基准中的三个上优于固定混合，其中两个提升显著；而用任一目标训练的逐节点自由动作很少能超过同一基线。在 ECHO 长程基准上，门控最明显的作用体现在偏心度（eccentricity）上，任务训练策略显著降低预测误差。
AI.conclusion: 共享参数门控比逐节点自由选择更有效，差异性能量可作为博弈论视角的合理目标，但任务监督训练总体更实用。

title: PINE: Point, Instance and Normal Estimation in One-Step Diffusion Model
summary: Understanding a scene requires both geometry and semantics: geometry recovers its spatial structure, and semantics separates it into objects. Current models obtain the two from separate networks or separate passes. We present PINE, a one-step Omni Diffusion Transformer that predicts the point map, the surface normals, and the instance map of an image in one forward pass. PINE treats each map as a token stream, and a stream mask decides which streams interact. A camera-aware ray encoding positions every token by its camera ray rather than its pixel. Grounding attention adds the affinity of pretrained DINOv3 features to the attention logits. Trained on only 139K synthetic images for geometry, PINE achieves state-of-the-art point maps whether or not intrinsics are given and the best average rank on surface normals. It also exceeds SAM on large objects with less than 1 percent of its training images, and it predicts all three maps 5.7x faster than MoGe-3 with SAM.

AI.tldr: PINE是一个一步式全模态扩散Transformer，单次前向同时预测点图、表面法线与实例图，统一了几何与语义理解，并在精度与速度上均达领先。
AI.motivation: 场景理解需要几何（空间结构）与语义（物体分离）两方面信息，但现有模型通常用独立网络或多次前向分别获取，效率低且不统一。
AI.method: 将三种图视为token流，用流掩码控制流间交互；相机感知的射线编码以相机射线而非像素定位token；在注意力logits中加入预训练DINOv3特征的亲和度（grounding attention）。仅用139K合成图像训练几何部分。
AI.result: 在有/无内参情况下点图均达SOTA，表面法线平均排名最佳；训练图像不足SAM的1%却在大物体分割上超越SAM；三图预测比MoGe-3+SAM快5.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 单步统一扩散Transformer可高效融合几何与语义预测，兼顾精度与速度，验证了多任务token流交互与相机感知编码的有效性。

title: The KL Divergence Is Never Negative, Except in PyTorch
summary: A Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence is never negative, yet PyTorch users have reported negative values for years, and the standard advice is to clamp them at zero. The sign is only the visible part of a silent failure. Many machine-learning applications compare nearby distributions, where conventional KL formulas lose accuracy. On 8.5 million inputs with certified references across 18 closed-form KL families and F.kl_div, we find widespread errors in values and gradients on CPU and GPU. Among scalar families in ordinary parameter ranges, over 85% of FP32 values have at least 1% relative error near KL 10^(-7) (FP16: 10^(-3)), and about 30% become negative at smaller divergences. More precision is not the cure: evaluated one precision higher, the same formulas still leave 7--51% of FP32 values significantly wrong for 22 of 23 configurations. Stable closed-form decompositions, compensated arithmetic, and analytic gradients remove over 97% of significant errors in the working format. Strict repairs eliminate significant errors on 7.2 million scored closed-form samples and correctly round all 567 million scored F.kl_div components. The errors affect parameter fitting, Bayesian decisions, identical-start distillation (up to 97% top-1 disagreement), KL-based layer rankings in a quantized LLM, and 19--59% of GPT-2 circuit edge scores. With the repaired code they all but vanish. Code and data: https://github.com/xi-xiaoran/stablekl

AI.tldr: PyTorch等框架中KL散度计算在小散度区域存在普遍且沉默的数值误差，甚至出现负值；论文提出稳定闭式分解、补偿算术和解析梯度修复方案，消除97%以上显著误差并验证了实际下游影响。
AI.motivation: 用户长期报告KL散度出现负值，标准做法是截断为零，但作者指出符号问题只是沉默失效的冰山一角：在接近分布的比较场景（如KL≈1e-7）中，传统KL公式精度严重丢失，而提高精度并不能解决根本问题。
AI.method: 在大规模基准上（850万输入、18个闭式KL族加F.kl_div，含认证参考值，CPU和GPU）系统评测数值与梯度误差；随后提出三种修复手段：稳定的闭式分解、补偿算术、解析梯度，并形成严格修复版本。
AI.result: 普通参数范围内FP32标量族超85%的KL≈1e-7值相对误差≥1%（FP16为1e-3），约30%在更小散度处变负；提高一个精度后23个配置中仍有22个遗留7–51%显著误差；修复方案消除>97%显著误差，7.2百万闭式样本与567百万F.kl_div分量全部正确舍入。
AI.conclusion: KL数值误差会实际影响参数拟合、贝叶斯决策、同起点蒸馏（最高97% top-1不一致）、量化LLM中KL层排序以及GPT-2电路边分数（19–59%受影响），采用修复代码后这些问题几乎全部消失，强调需要稳定实现而非简单截断或提升精度。

title: AgroVG+: Generalized Visual Grounding in Agriculture with Region-Supervised Action Generation
summary: Generalized visual grounding in agriculture requires localizing all objects that match a natural-language description and recognizing when no matching target is present. We introduce AgroVG+, a dataset whose referring expressions are all written and reviewed by agricultural experts based on image content and corresponding target sets. The dataset comprises 7,404 images and 10,081 query records across six agricultural scene families, covering single-target, multi-target, and target-absent cases. We also propose ReSAG (Region-Supervised Action Generation), a framework that couples regional evidence supervision with explicit box-generation and termination decisions. ReSAG assigns each target an equally weighted supervision term on a shared spatial evidence distribution computed before answer generation. The BOX/END protocol exposes a choice between generating another box and terminating the response at box boundaries, while coordinates are generated using the original language vocabulary. Regional and sequence objectives jointly train a shared language decoder. On AgroVG+, ReSAG outperforms coordinate-only fine-tuning on single- and multi-target exact-set accuracy, and achieves higher aggregate accuracy than either component alone in ablations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出农业广义视觉定位数据集AgroVG+（7404图像、10081条专家撰写查询，含单目标/多目标/无目标情形）及ReSAG框架，通过区域证据监督与BOX/END生成终止协议，实现农业场景下精确的目标集合定位。
AI.motivation: 农业场景的广义视觉定位需要定位所有匹配自然语言描述的目标，并在无匹配目标时正确判断“不存在”。现有数据与模型在专业表达、多目标集合定位和目标缺失场景上支持不足。
AI.method: 构建AgroVG+数据集：查询由农业专家依据图像与目标集撰写和复核，覆盖六类农业场景。提出ReSAG框架：在答案生成前计算共享空间证据分布，并为每个目标分配等权监督项；采用BOX/END协议在框边界处决定继续生成下一框或终止，坐标使用原词表生成；区域目标与序列目标联合训练共享语言解码器。
AI.result: 在AgroVG+上，ReSAG在单目标和多目标精确集合准确率上优于仅坐标微调；消融实验显示其总体准确率高于单独使用任一组件。
AI.conclusion: 区域证据监督与显式生成/终止决策相结合，能有效提升农业广义视觉定位中多目标集合定位与目标缺失判断的整体表现。

title: How Do Deep Networks Encode and Selectively Use Information? Shared Encoding and Conditional Signed Readout in Vision and Language Models
summary: How can trained deep networks retain contextual information across internal representations while using it selectively in a decision? We study this question through controlled background-texture edits in vision classifiers and entity-binding edits in frozen language models. Across both modalities, factor perturbations preserve recognizable structure across pre-fixed, mutually disjoint blocks of hidden units: visual channel blocks match their complements more closely for the same image than for other images under the same texture edit, while language blocks transfer a relational direction fitted under one query role to rank relational states within held-out name pairs under the other role. We then decompose the local output change into signed channel and pathway contributions. In a convolutional classifier, net channel-level reinforcement ($R^{(512)}>1$) coexists on individual images with cancellation between positive- and negative-weight groups ($R^{(2)}<1$). Holding weights, the paired relation edit, and red/blue answer words fixed, switching prompt presentation reverses the mean finite selection effect in Qwen2.5. Two held-out tests validate this mechanism. Attenuating development-selected antagonistic units amplifies edit effects on unseen inputs; in a vision transformer, attenuating the same frozen units in one forward pass increases the mean magnitude of the background-edit effect on one class margin and reduces it on another, with the opposite pattern for a second group (four-cell paired interaction $+78.30\times 10^{-5}$ logit). Finally, combining conditional channel variance with fixed downstream readout weights predicts single-channel pruning recovery across ten cuts. These results show how shared encoding and conditional signed readout can coexist in vision and language models.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过视觉分类器的背景纹理编辑与冻结语言模型的实体绑定编辑，揭示深度网络可在预置的不相交隐藏单元块间保留上下文信息，并通过有符号的通道与通路贡献实现条件性选择性读出。
AI.motivation: 作者想回答：训练好的深度网络如何在不同内部表征间保留上下文信息，同时在决策时选择性地使用它。
AI.method: 在视觉模型（CNN与ViT）做受控背景纹理编辑，在冻结语言模型（Qwen2.5）做实体绑定编辑；将局部输出变化分解为有符号的通道与通路贡献，并进行保持权重不变的提示呈现切换、拮抗单元衰减实验与单通道剪枝恢复预测。
AI.result: CNN中图像级通道级净强化（R^(512)>1）与正负权重组间抵消（R^(2)<1）并存；提示呈现切换可反转Qwen2.5中的有限选择效应均值。衰减发育中选出的拮抗单元会放大对未见输入的编辑效应；ViT中衰减同组冻结单元产生四格配对交互+78.30×10^-5 logit；条件通道方差结合固定读出权重可预测十个切点下的单通道剪枝恢复。
AI.conclusion: 共享编码与条件性有符号读出可在视觉与语言模型中并存，为理解深度网络的选择性上下文利用提供了机制性解释与验证。

title: MSBench: Benchmarking Script-Controlled Multi-Shot Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) models can now generate visually plausible short clips, but multi-shot generation requires a different set of skills: composing multiple shots with intended cut timing, transition style, camera language, and cross-shot continuity. How far this multi-shot output can be controlled from text remains unmeasured: existing benchmarks either evaluate single shots or, when they provide shot-level scripts, typically check whether the requested shots appear but not when they change or how they are joined. We introduce MSBench, a benchmark for controllable text-driven multi-shot video generation built around structured Scene-Entity-Shot mini-scripts that specify each shot's time span, camera state, content, and outgoing transition. MSBench defines a four-dimensional hybrid evaluation framework spanning Visual Quality, Dynamic Quality, Semantic Alignment, and Cross-Shot Consistency with 11 sub-metrics. Experiments on 14 commercial and open-source systems show that visual quality does little to separate the systems, whereas multi-shot control does: many models cut mainly on scene changes and render requested gradual transitions as hard cuts. Human evaluations further validate MSBench, with its system ranking reaching a Spearman correlation of 0.87 with human preferences. The project page is available at https://totalhuang.github.io/MSBench-page/.

AI.tldr: 提出MSBench，首个围绕Scene-Entity-Shot结构化剧本的多镜头文生视频可控性评测基准，含4维度11子指标，14个系统实验表明视觉质量区分度低而多镜头控制才是关键差异，且与人类偏好Spearman相关达0.87。
AI.motivation: 现有文生视频评测要么只评单镜头，要么虽提供分镜脚本却只检查镜头是否出现，而不评估镜头切换的时机、转场方式与跨镜头连续性，因此多镜头可控程度无法被衡量。
AI.method: 构建MSBench，基于结构化的Scene-Entity-Shot迷你剧本（规定每个镜头的时间跨度、相机状态、内容和出向转场），定义涵盖视觉质量、动态质量、语义对齐、跨镜头一致性四大维度共11项子指标的混合评测框架。
AI.result: 在14个商业与开源系统上评测：视觉质量几乎无法区分系统，多镜头控制能力区分明显——多数模型主要按场景变化切镜，并把要求的渐变转场渲染为硬切；人工评估验证基准有效性，系统排序与人类偏好Spearman相关0.87。
AI.conclusion: 多镜头可控性是当前T2V模型的核心短板，MSBench提供了与人类判断高度一致的标准化评测手段，填补了镜头切换时机与转场质量的评测空白。

title: MUNDO: a multiresolution generative framework for temporal downscaling
summary: Dynamical systems are often observed at coarse temporal resolution through sparse states or temporal aggregates, leaving the underlying fine-scale trajectories unresolved. Recovering these trajectories requires probabilistic models that capture the unresolved variability while remaining consistent with the observations. We present MUNDO (Multiresolution UNified DOwnscaling), a generative framework for temporal downscaling under general linear observation operators. MUNDO introduces a null-space parameterization that enforces exact observation consistency in a single network evaluation, unifying temporal interpolation and disaggregation. To capture complex multiscale dynamics, we leverage reverse Markov learning to factorize the observation operator into a hierarchy of successive coarsenings. Each level models only the degrees of freedom lost between adjacent resolutions. We evaluate MUNDO on two-scale Lorenz-96, four two-dimensional physical systems, and multivariate ERA5 reanalysis over Europe, for both temporal interpolation and disaggregation. Across datasets and tasks, MUNDO generally outperforms flow-based baselines. Single-step MUNDO achieves strong predictive skill, while recursive MUNDO generally improves temporal realism and ensemble calibration, with better spread-skill agreement and predictive coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出 MUNDO——一种基于零空间参数化与反向马尔可夫学习的统一时间降尺度生成框架，在单次网络评估中精确满足观测约束，统一了时间插值与分解任务。
AI.motivation: 动力系统常以粗时间分辨率、稀疏状态或时间聚合形式被观测，细尺度轨迹未被解析；恢复这些轨迹需要既能刻画未解析变异性又与观测一致的生成模型。
AI.method: 1) 零空间参数化：在一般线性观测算子下，单次前向即强制精确观测一致性，统一插值与分解；2) 反向马尔可夫学习：将观测算子分解为逐级粗化的层次结构，每层只建模相邻分辨率间丢失的自由度，以刻画多尺度动力学；整体为生成式概率框架。
AI.result: 在双尺度 Lorenz-96、四个二维物理系统以及欧洲 ERA5 多变量再分析数据上，对插值与分解两类任务评测，总体优于基于流的基线。单步 MUNDO 预测技能强；递归 MUNDO 通常提升时间真实性与集合校准，具有更好的 spread-skill 一致性和预测覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: MUNDO 证明了零空间参数化可实现单次评估的精确观测一致性，结合层次化反向马尔可夫建模可有效处理多尺度时间降尺度；单步与递归两种模式在精度与集合校准间提供互补优势。

title: A colour-marker tracker for pose estimation of slender surgical instruments: vision-language-model-guided adaptive colour calibration
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Extended version of a manuscript submitted to a journal
summary: Slender surgical instruments need small, narrow markers for camera-based pose estimation. A colour-stripe marker fits this requirement, but its colours in the image drift from the design values with lighting, printing and camera settings. Because the colours can only be corrected after the marker has been found, methods that rely on the design colours face a circular problem. We propose vision-language-model (VLM)-based adaptive colour calibration and compare it with two rule-based methods, which re-measure the colours from detections made with the design colours: Initial colour update does so once after tracking starts, and Colour adaptation continuously during tracking. VLM guidance uses a fine-tuned VLM to find the markers without relying on the design colours and builds the colour profile from their pixels. Recall/F1 (%) for Initial colour update, Colour adaptation and VLM guidance were 92.0/95.7, 87.8/93.3 and 98.2/99.1 on 672 synthetic image pairs; 51.3/67.2, 48.8/65.0 and 83.8/87.0 on eight degraded laboratory videos; and 38.9/55.2, 19.7/29.7 and 100/100 on a surgical-robot (da Vinci) video with strongly shifted colours. In that video the rule-based methods never found the purple/cyan marker, whereas VLM guidance found all 234 markers with no false positives. In a simulation, the hue boundary between the two stripes moved by less than 0.1 pixel for exposure gains of 0.5-2.0, compared with 2.9-4.0 pixels for a boundary found with a fixed brightness threshold. When the degradation is mild, the rule-based methods, which need no training and no GPU, are sufficient. When the colours change greatly, the gain comes from a VLM-guided candidate search that does not rely on the design colours. Combining colour-stripe markers with adaptive colour calibration enables tracking of slender surgical instruments with small markers.

AI.tldr: 针对细长手术器械的彩色条纹标记在光照、打印与相机参数下颜色漂移的问题，提出基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自适应颜色校准，并与两种基于规则的方法（初始颜色更新、颜色自适应）比较，实验显示VLM引导在颜色严重偏移时显著更优。
AI.motivation: 细长手术器械需要小而窄的标记做基于相机的位姿估计，彩色条纹标记满足尺寸要求；但其图像颜色会因光照、打印和相机设置而偏离设计值。颜色只能在找到标记之后才能校正，而依赖设计颜色的检测方法因此陷入"先有鸡还是先有蛋"的循环困境。
AI.method: 提出VLM引导的颜色校准：用微调后的VLM在不依赖设计颜色的情况下定位标记，并从其像素构建颜色轮廓。作为对照，实现两种基于规则的方法——初始颜色更新（跟踪开始后一次性重测颜色）与颜色自适应（跟踪中持续更新），它们均需先用设计颜色完成检测再重测。
AI.result: 在672对合成图像上，初始更新/颜色自适应/VLM引导的Recall/F1（%）为92.0/95.7、87.8/93.3、98.2/99.1；在8段退化实验室视频上为51.3/67.2、48.8/65.0、83.8/87.0；在颜色强烈偏移的达芬奇手术机器人视频上为38.9/55.2、19.7/29.7、100/100。该视频中规则方法从未找到紫/青色标记，而VLM引导找到全部234个标记且无误检。仿真中曝光增益0.5–2.0时，两条纹色相边界移动小于0.1像素，而固定亮度阈值法为2.9–4.0像素。
AI.conclusion: 退化轻微时，无需训练和GPU的规则方法已足够；颜色变化剧烈时，收益来自不依赖设计颜色的VLM引导候选搜索。彩色条纹标记结合自适应颜色校准可实现小标记下细长手术器械的跟踪。

title: AnchorCredit: Output-Anchored Credit Assignment for Structured Generation with Multiple Verifiable Rewards
summary: In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and related methods typically compute group-relative advantages from response rewards and broadcast the same advantage to every generated token in a response to guide policy updates. However, we identify a systematic problem of cross-component credit misassignment in tasks with multiple verifiable results, such as joint multi-attribute prediction: low rewards for some components can penalize a well-performing component and its associated reasoning. To address this problem, we propose AnchorCredit. The method uses the policy model's attention from output anchors to preceding reasoning sentences to estimate sentence-component associations and assign component-specific advantages to the relevant reasoning, without additional relevance annotations or a separate relevance discriminator. To support the study of credit assignment with multiple verifiable rewards, we construct ProductAttr, a benchmark of 7,200 real product image-text samples. Experiments show that AnchorCredit outperforms existing baselines on this benchmark. Experiments on the public Nutrition5k dataset further support the method's effectiveness in this setting.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出GRPO类方法在多可验证奖励任务中存在"跨组件信用错误分配"问题，提出AnchorCredit，利用策略模型注意力估计推理句与输出组件的关联，赋予组件级优势，并构建ProductAttr基准验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 在RLVR中，GRPO等把响应的组相对优势广播到每个token，但多可验证结果任务（如多属性预测）中，某些组件低奖励会错误惩罚表现良好的组件及其推理，造成信用分配系统性问题。
AI.method: AnchorCredit：利用策略模型从输出锚点到前序推理句的注意力来估计句子-组件关联，进而将组件专属优势分配给相关推理，无需额外相关性标注或独立判别器。同时构建ProductAttr基准（7200个真实商品图文样本）。
AI.result: 在ProductAttr基准上优于现有基线；在公开Nutrition5k数据集上的实验进一步支持方法在该设定下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过注意力驱动的细粒度信用分配可缓解多组件奖励下的优势广播缺陷，方法有效且无需额外标注，具备较好通用性。

title: HorizonFlow: Few-Step Video Distillation in 600 Iterations
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, 14 tables, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/XIANGLONGGUO/HorizonFlow-repo
summary: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) enables fast video generation by distilling a multi-step teacher into a few-step student. However, DMD-based methods often suffer from unnatural motion and costly training. We trace these limitations to the DMD gradient, which jointly optimizes appearance, layout, and motion without distinguishing their learning dynamics. Its static component, which carries appearance and layout, has a much higher signal-to-noise ratio than its motion component. As a result, per-frame quality converges within a few hundred iterations, whereas motion lags far behind. Beyond being noisy, the gradient also lacks two signals. (1) Video VAEs encode several frames into one latent frame (four in Wan2.1), and the gradient provides little guidance for spreading motion over these frames, causing periodic stutter. (2) DMD does not constrain the final sampling step to preserve the layout set by earlier steps, so objects merge and drift once the video moves. We propose HorizonFlow, which decouples the correction of motion from that of layout. It keeps the DMD loss and only shifts its regression target, with one training-only correction in the motion component and one in the orthogonal layout component. Chunk Evenness addresses (1) by spreading the motion of each latent chunk evenly over its frames, and Semantic Commitment addresses (2) by anchoring the coarse layout to the teacher's completion of the student's last step. In only 600 iterations, HorizonFlow distills Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B into a 4-step model using 8.4k training samples, 4.6-304$\times$ fewer than prior work. On VBench, HorizonFlow outperforms all released few-step Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B models. The same recipe transfers to Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B, where our student outperforms NVIDIA's distilled model. Code: https://github.com/XIANGLONGGUO/HorizonFlow-repo

AI.tldr: HorizonFlow 通过解耦运动与布局的梯度修正（Chunk Evenness + Semantic Commitment），仅用 600 步迭代、8.4k 样本即把 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 蒸馏为 4 步生成模型，并优于现有少步模型。
AI.motivation: DMD 类视频蒸馏存在运动不自然与训练昂贵的问题：DMD 梯度同时优化外观、布局与运动，其中静态分量信噪比远高于运动分量，导致逐帧质量几百步即收敛而运动严重滞后；此外梯度缺乏两个信号——VAE 将多帧编码为单 latent 帧（Wan2.1 为 4 帧）导致运动分配不均产生周期性卡顿，且最后采样步不受约束使布局漂移、物体合并。
AI.method: 保留 DMD 损失，仅偏移其回归目标，把运动修正与布局修正解耦：在运动分量上引入 Chunk Evenness，将每个 latent chunk 的运动均匀分摊到其各帧；在与运动正交的布局分量上引入 Semantic Commitment，以教师对学生最后一步的补全结果锚定粗布局。
AI.result: 仅 600 次迭代、8.4k 训练样本（比先前工作少 4.6–304 倍）完成蒸馏；在 VBench 上超越所有已发布的少步 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 模型；同一方法迁移至 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B，学生模型优于 NVIDIA 的蒸馏模型。
AI.conclusion: 将 DMD 梯度中的运动与布局解耦、并提供针对 VAE 帧压缩与最终采样步的显式信号，可显著提升少步视频蒸馏的运动质量与训练效率，且方法具备跨模型可迁移性。

title: Predicting Rare-Mode Collapse in Recursive Generative Training from Single-Generation Calibration
summary: Recursive generative training can preserve sample counts in a rare region while silently eroding its characteristic core. Mapping this finite-horizon collapse across real-data quotas, rare prevalences, and feedback perturbations via exhaustive multi-generation chains is computationally prohibitive. We develop a decoupled framework that forecasts multi-generation collapse probabilities and locates operating risk boundaries from independent single-generation conditional fits alone. Pairing an exact three-source multinomial count law with single-generation response banks propagates count marginals in closed form, backed by explicit calibration-error and boundary-resolution bounds. For additive Gaussian perturbations, we further prove that equal-variance all-row and sparse policies reverse their boundary-crossing order at a unique hyperplane distance. Across a 2,178-setting count benchmark, exact propagation cuts risk mean absolute error (MAE) from 1.85 to 0.49 percentage points (pp). Across ten two-dimensional learners, calibration achieves 2.60--5.69~pp six-round core MAE on nine stationary learners (65--81\% below an unperturbed baseline), diagnoses non-stationary outlier drift in standard DDIM (16.38~pp) via a stability probe, and resolves the predicted six-round geometric reversal. On Fashion-MNIST latent flow-matching chains, calibration outperforms direct-chain Gaussian-process interpolation at lower fit budgets and tracks the 20\% latent-perturbation boundary shift (3.14 versus 10.78~pp MAE for proportion copying) driven by opposing inflow to the rare region and outflow from its core.

AI.tldr: 提出解耦框架，仅用独立单代条件拟合即可预测递归生成训练多代崩塌概率并定位风险边界，无需穷举多代链。
AI.motivation: 递归生成训练会在保持稀有区域样本数不变的同时悄然侵蚀其"特征核心"。要跨真实数据配额、稀有比例与反馈扰动映射这种有限时域崩塌，穷举多代链在计算上不可行。
AI.method: 将精确的三源多项计数律与单代响应库结合，闭式传播计数边缘分布，并给出显式校准误差界与边界分辨率界；对加性高斯扰动的等方差全行策略与稀疏策略，证明其边界穿越顺序在唯一超平面距离处反转。
AI.result: 2,178 设置基准上，精确传播将风险 MAE 从 1.85 降至 0.49 pp；十个二维学习器中九个平稳学习器六轮核心 MAE 为 2.60–5.69 pp（较未扰动基线低 65–81%），稳定性探针诊断出标准 DDIM 的非平稳离群漂移（16.38 pp），并复现预测的几何反转。Fashion-MNIST 潜流匹配链上优于直接链 GP 插值且拟合预算更低，追踪 20% 潜扰动边界位移（比例复制 3.14 vs 10.78 pp MAE）。
AI.conclusion: 单代条件拟合足以低成本、有理论保证地预测多代递归生成崩塌与风险边界，并解释稀有区域流入/核心流出对立的失效机制。

title: Ride on Anything: Contact-Coupled Monocular 4D Reconstruction of a Rider and Horse in Camera and World Frames
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Code and interactive results: https://wengzehang.github.io/rideonanything/
summary: We address the reconstruction of a horse and its rider from a single video. When a human estimator and a horse estimator are applied independently, both meshes can fit their silhouettes well while the rider hovers beside or passes through the horse, slides along its back and jitters relative to it. These errors lie along the camera axis and are not visible in the input view. We present Ride on Anything (RoA), a general, training-free methodology for reconstructing a person riding an animal, which couples frozen estimators of the rider and the mount at test time. We instantiate it for horseback riding with SAM 3D Body and 4DEquine. RoA aligns both estimators on a common frame index, projects both subjects through one pixel-isotropic camera initialized from the horse estimator, and jointly optimizes bounded corrections under interaction terms defined in the horse's body frame, including a collision term based on generalized winding numbers that remains valid on the non-watertight horse mesh. The result is lifted to a levelled world frame using the camera rotation from the background and the field of view from MoGe-2. On our riding clips, the raw outputs of the two estimators leave the rider's pelvis 15 cm from the horse's back on average. RoA reduces this seat gap to 1 cm, the drift of the seat along and across the spine by 64% and 89%, the 90th-percentile penetration depth by 57%, and the share of rider surface inside the horse from 12.1% to 7.9%. The motion is markedly smoother (94% lower acceleration of the rider relative to the horse, 80% lower horse jerk), while the rider's silhouette IoU decreases from 0.59 to 0.52. Qualitatively, the rider stays seated on the horse and moves together with it. A quantitative evaluation of 3D accuracy awaits calibrated recordings of ridden animals. We also test a clip outside the task, a horse led on foot, and analyse the failure modes.

AI.tldr: RoA 是一种免训练的测试时耦合方法，将冻结的人体估计器与动物估计器联合校正，从单目视频重建骑马人与马的三维网格，显著减小悬浮、穿插与抖动。
AI.motivation: 独立运行人体与马匹估计器时，两者各自贴合轮廓，但因深度（沿相机轴）歧义导致骑手悬浮在马侧、穿透马身、沿马背滑动并相对抖动，且这些误差在输入视角中不可见。
AI.method: 提出 Ride on Anything（RoA）：在测试时耦合两个冻结估计器（SAM 3D Body 与 4DEquine）。统一帧索引，用从马匹估计器初始化的像素各向同性单相机投影两者，在马体坐标系下定义交互项（含基于广义环绕数的碰撞项，适用于非水密马网格）并联合优化有界修正；再用背景相机旋转与 MoGe-2 视场角将结果提升到水平世界坐标。
AI.result: 骑手骨盆与马背平均间距由 15 cm 降至 1 cm；座点沿脊柱与横向漂移分别降低 64% 与 89%；穿透深度 90 分位数降低 57%，骑手表面嵌入马体比例由 12.1% 降至 7.9%；相对加速度降低 94%、马抖动降低 80%，但骑手轮廓 IoU 从 0.59 降至 0.52。
AI.conclusion: 定性上骑手稳定坐于马背并随马同步运动，方法具通用性（可迁移到其他人与动物组合）；但缺乏带标定录制的三维精度量化评估，且存在任务外（牵马步行）场景的失效模式。

title: TrialAgentBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Clinical-Trial Analysis and Long-Horizon Drug-Development Decisions
summary: Clinical drug development is a long-horizon, high-stakes process requiring sequential decisions based on information that costs money and time to acquire. AI agents have demonstrated capabilities for scientific analysis, but there is no established way to evaluate them on these decisions, as real trials are expensive, involve people, and never reveal the counterfactual. We introduce TrialAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on clinical trial analysis and drug development decision-making using simulated trials where the truth is known, embedded within the data records of a fictional drug sponsor. We publicly release nearly 3,500 tasks, varying from analysing a single trial to managing multi-phase programmes with budget and time constraints. We score each analysis by rerunning its code on new trials, and each programme by the value its decisions achieve. Across 24 closed- and open-weight models, the strongest agents can analyse raw, messy trial records to within 6% of a process-aware analysis, even when an assumption is violated, with 95% confidence intervals containing the true effect 94--95% of the time. Over the prior year, the best model improved from 19% above this analysis, with serious misses on 15% of tasks, to 3.5% and 1%. What limits them is decision-making from evidence under uncertainty: when to correct, what evidence to buy, when to stop. The strongest agents are overly careful, correcting on 83% of tasks with equal recording errors, where it is unnecessary. On drug programmes, the best agent has substantial headroom, reaching 48% of the value an oracle achieves against 58% for a rule-based developer, with others falling 24 to 66% short. Model generations show ongoing improvements in handling data and evidence, with substantial variation. The strongest models can act as competent analysts, but do not yet make reliable long-horizon decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出TrialAgentBench基准，用模拟试验（真值已知）评估AI智能体在临床试验分析与药物开发决策中的能力。发布约3500个任务。最强模型分析能力已接近过程感知分析（误差6%内，95%CI覆盖真值94-95%），但决策能力仍弱：最佳智能体仅达oracle价值的48%（规则式开发者58%），且过度谨慎，在无必要处83%任务都做校正。
AI.motivation: 临床药物开发是长周期高风险过程，需基于需花金钱与时间获取的信息做序贯决策。AI智能体已展现科学分析能力，但缺乏评估其此类决策能力的既定方法——真实试验昂贵、涉及人且无法得知反事实。
AI.method: 构建TrialAgentBench，将模拟试验（真值已知）嵌入虚构药企的数据记录中；公开约3500个任务，从单试验分析到多阶段项目的预算与时间约束管理。分析方法通过在新试验上重跑其代码评分，项目则按决策实现的价值评分；评估24个闭源/开源模型。
AI.result: 最强智能体分析原始混乱试验记录误差在过程感知分析的6%内，即使假设被违反；95%CI含真值达94-95%。过去一年最佳模型从高出19%（15%任务严重失误）改进到3.5%和1%。瓶颈在于不确定性下的证据决策：最强智能体过度谨慎，在83%任务上做无必要校正。药物项目中最优智能体仅达oracle价值48%（规则式开发者58%），其他落后24-66%。
AI.conclusion: 最强模型可作为胜任的分析师，但尚不能做出可靠的长周期决策；模型代际在数据处理与证据利用上持续改进但差异显著，不确定性下的决策（何时校正、买何证据、何时停止）是主要限制。

title: Seeing Through Preferences: Recovering Hidden Local Preference Neighborhoods for Text-to-Image Alignment
summary: Aligning text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models with human preferences typically relies on large-scale pairwise annotations, which are expensive to obtain and provide only sparse supervision. Moreover, not all preference comparisons contribute equally to learning: comparisons between semantically distant images often reveal little about the fine-grained perceptual factors underlying human judgments. We argue that informative supervision can arise from local preference neighborhoods surrounding human-preferred images, where semantically aligned alternatives expose meaningful perceptual and structural differences. Motivated by this observation, we propose PrefLens, a framework that recovers local preference neighborhoods from sparse human feedback. Specifically, PrefLens generates controlled perceptual variations around preferred images that largely retain semantic identity and selects compact sets of informative neighbors in a reward-defined preference space induced by pretrained reward models. By transforming each human preference annotation into a structured neighborhood of informative comparisons, PrefLens enriches supervision without requiring additional human labeling. Our experiments and diagnostic evaluations show that the recovered neighborhoods capture human-relevant preference characteristics and provide effective supervision for preference alignment across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: PrefLens提出一种框架，从稀疏的人类成对偏好标注中恢复"局部偏好邻域"，以增强T2I扩散模型偏好对齐的监督信息。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I扩散模型偏好对齐依赖大规模成对标注，成本高且监督稀疏；且并非所有偏好比较都有同等价值——语义差异大的图像对比难以揭示细粒度感知因素。作者认为信息量丰富的监督来自偏好图像周围的局部邻域。
AI.method: PrefLens围绕人类偏好图像生成受控的感知变化（大体保留语义身份），并在由预训练奖励模型诱导的偏好空间中挑选紧凑的信息量高的邻居集合；从而将每条人类偏好标注转化为结构化的信息性比较邻域，无需额外人工标注。
AI.result: 实验与诊断评估表明，恢复的邻域能捕获与人类相关的偏好特征，并在多种设置下为偏好对齐提供有效监督。
AI.conclusion: 通过将稀疏偏好标注扩展为局部偏好邻域，PrefLens在不增加标注成本的前提下丰富了偏好对齐的监督信号，验证了局部邻域监督的有效性。

title: Beyond Patching: Consistent Circuit Discovery via Gradient Spectral Analysis
summary: Mechanistic interpretability seeks to reverse-engineer neural networks by identifying small, faithful subgraphs--circuits--that implement specific behaviors. The dominant paradigm scores each unit by replacing its clean activation with a corrupted counterpart as causal intervention. While effective, this approach rests on a brittle prerequisite: the structure prompt pairs are task-specific, expensive to engineer, and silently couple the discovered circuit to prompt-design choices. In this work, we propose Spectral Circuit Analysis (SCA), a gradient-spectral pipeline that achieves consistent circuit discovery along both axes: stable across input formulations of the same task, and natively exposing structure shared across tasks. Our contributions are threefold. First, we provide a counterfactual-free reframing of circuit discovery: causally relevant directions are recoverable from the spectral structure of forward gradients across paraphrases, with leading directions concentrating task signal and trailing ones absorbing paraphrase noise, yielding circuits tied to the task rather than the prompt. Second, we introduce SCA, a block-wise SVD pipeline that extracts a task subspace per architectural block and redistributes spectral energy onto constituent units via a consistency-weighted share, producing per-unit rankings competitive with attribution-patching baselines under strictly less supervision. Finally, on twelve circuit-discovery tasks in GPT-2 Small and Pythia-160M, SCA performs comparably or exceeds EAP-family methods under the standard recovery-score protocol and recovers IOI canonical heads with Precision@K = 1.0 in top-10 slices on GPT-2 Small; the same machinery extends to a unified cross-task analysis classifying units as universal, family-shared, or task-specific and exposing compositional structure invisible to per-task analyses.

AI.tldr: 提出Spectral Circuit Analysis (SCA)，一种基于梯度谱的无反事实电路发现方法，通过分块SVD从改写下的前向梯度谱结构中恢复因果相关方向，实现跨prompt表述稳定、跨任务共享结构的电路发现。
AI.motivation: 主流电路发现范式依赖"将干净激活替换为损坏激活"的因果干预，需要任务特定的结构prompt对；这种prompt设计昂贵、易变，且会使发现的电路悄然绑定于prompt设计选择，导致结果不稳定、难以跨任务比较。
AI.method: SCA将电路发现重新表述为无反事实问题：因果相关方向可从同一任务多种改写（paraphrase）下前向梯度的谱结构中恢复——主导方向集中任务信号，尾部方向吸收改写噪声。具体实现为分块SVD流水线：对每个架构block提取任务子空间，并通过一致性加权份额将谱能量重新分配到各单元，得到单元排序。
AI.result: 在GPT-2 Small与Pythia-160M的12个电路发现任务上，SCA在标准recovery-score协议下与EAP家族方法相当或更优，且监督更少；在GPT-2 Small上以Precision@K=1.0在top-10中恢复IOI规范头。同一机制还可扩展到统一的跨任务分析，将单元分类为通用、家族共享或任务特定。
AI.conclusion: SCA表明电路发现无需依赖脆弱的提示对设计：梯度谱结构足以提供稳定、任务对齐的因果方向。该方法在更少监督下匹配或超越归因修补基线，并首次以统一框架揭示跨任务 compositional 结构。

title: Exploring Attention-Driven Deep Learning for Accurate Lung Nodule Segmentation
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted manuscript of a paper published at IEEE EMBC 2025
summary: This study explores the application of various deep learning models for the segmentation of lung nodules using LIDC-IDRI. Unlike traditional approaches that utilize the full dataset, our work emphasizes the efficacy of training models on a filtered subset of 356 samples. Novel configurations, including attention mechanisms and advanced preprocessing strategies, were employed to optimize segmentation accuracy. Among the models evaluated, the DPL nkNet50 with a Channel Attention Bridge and ResNet backbone demonstrated the highest performance with a Dice score of 0.86, significantly outperforming conventional architectures. This work underscores the potential of leveraging data efficiency and tailored architectures in achieving robust segmentation performance, paving the way for improved computer-aided diagnosis in clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文在LIDC-IDRI数据集上仅用筛选后的356个样本训练多种深度学习模型进行肺结节分割，其中带通道注意力桥和ResNet主干的DPL nkNet50取得最高Dice 0.86，表明数据效率与定制架构可提升分割性能。
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖完整数据集训练，本文希望验证在筛选后的小样本子集（356例）上也能有效训练分割模型，强调数据效率与定制化架构的价值。
AI.method: 基于LIDC-IDRI构建筛选子集；采用注意力机制、先进预处理策略等新颖配置；评估多种深度学习模型，重点提出DPL nkNet50，结合Channel Attention Bridge与ResNet主干。
AI.result: DPL nkNet50（Channel Attention Bridge + ResNet主干）表现最佳，Dice达0.86，显著优于传统架构。
AI.conclusion: 在小规模精选数据上结合定制架构可实现稳健的肺结节分割，为临床计算机辅助诊断提供可行路径。

title: Evaluable Language-Model Treatment Policies for Sepsis Resuscitation via Offline Value-Guided Selection
summary: Offline treatment learning must balance imitation, which stays close to logged evidence but ignores outcomes, against value maximisation, which uses outcomes but drifts toward treatments the records cannot verify. Numerical reinforcement learning strikes this balance during training. For large language models (LLMs), directly using sparse retrospective outcomes for fine-tuning raises challenges of delayed credit assignment and limited evidence for alternative treatments. We present R-LLMC, which strikes the balance at inference for sepsis resuscitation. A behaviour-supervised LLM, decoded into an exact distribution over 25 vasopressor-fluid actions, proposes clinician-anchored candidates; an offline critic selects among them by estimated long-term value. The policy has a closed form for off-policy evaluation, and its rationale is written after selection, so explanation cannot steer treatment. In experiments on held-out MIMIC-III patients, R-LLMC exceeded the clinician reference in doubly robust value by +0.214 (95\% CI 0.091-0.300), with fitted Q evaluation agreeing.

AI.tldr: R-LLMC 将"模仿临床记录"与"价值最大化"的权衡放在推理阶段而非训练阶段：行为监督的 LLM 生成临床医生锚定的候选，离线 critic 按长期价值选择，在脓毒症复苏上取得优于临床医生的双重稳健价值。
AI.motivation: 离线治疗学习的核心矛盾是模仿（贴近记录证据但忽略结局）与价值最大化（利用结局但漂移到记录无法验证的治疗）之间的平衡。数值强化学习在训练中实现该平衡，但对 LLM 直接用稀疏回顾性结局微调会带来延迟信用分配、替代治疗证据不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出 R-LLMC：行为监督的 LLM 解码为 25 种升压药-补液动作上的精确分布，产生临床医生锚定的候选；离线 critic 按估计的长期价值从中选择。策略具有闭式解便于离线评估，且理由是选择之后才生成的，故解释无法反向影响治疗决策。
AI.result: 在留出 MIMIC-III 患者上，R-LLMC 的双重稳健价值比临床医生参照高 +0.214（95% CI 0.091–0.300），拟合 Q 评估结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 在推理时进行模仿-价值权衡是可行且有效的，可在保证可评估性与解释不干预决策的同时超越临床医生参照策略。

title: Fill in the Blanks: Non-Autoregressive Schema-Parallel Key Information Extraction with CTC Decoding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) extract structured data from documents by generating the requested JSON one token at a time, so their sequential steps grow with the length of the answer. Yet in key information extraction (KIE) the schema already fixes the answer's structure: keys, nesting and lists are known before decoding, and only the values are unknown. We exploit this with a non-autoregressive extractor that writes the structure from the schema, sizes every list with a count pass, and predicts all values in parallel, in a fixed number of passes that does not grow with the document. Each value is decoded with connectionist temporal classification (CTC) in its own block of slots, so its length never has to be predicted, and a value that is still open after its block gets a larger token budget. Zero-shot on VAREX, CORD and FUNSD, our 4B extractor is 3.5$\times$ faster than the diffusion-VLM competition on average (up to 5.6$\times$) and more accurate, with 4--6 forward passes per document where block diffusion needs 12--74. The same extractor also drafts for speculative decoding with its own autoregressive base: it runs 8.3$\times$ faster than autoregressive decoding (up to 10.4$\times$) within 0.4 points of its accuracy, and 3.3$\times$ faster than speculative diffusion decoding while 13.0 points more accurate. We release the model and code.

AI.tldr: 提出一种非自回归文档关键信息抽取器：结构由 schema 直接生成，列表长度用计数通道确定，所有值并行预测，每个值用 CTC 在独立的槽块中解码；前向次数（4–6）不随文档长度增长。
AI.motivation: VLM 逐 token 生成 JSON，解码步数随答案长度线性增长；但 KIE 任务中答案的键、嵌套与列表结构在解码前已由 schema 确定，只有值未知，因此顺序生成的绝大部分计算是浪费的。
AI.method: 非自回归抽取器：(1) 依据 schema 直接写出结构；(2) 用 count pass 为每个列表预测长度；(3) 并行预测全部值。每个值在自己的 slot 块内用 CTC 解码，无需预测长度；块结束仍未闭合的值分配更大 token 预算。此外该抽取器可作为投机解码的草稿模型，配合其自回归基座使用。
AI.result: VAREX、CORD、FUNSD 零样本下，4B 模型比 diffusion-VLM 基线平均快 3.5×（最高 5.6×）且更准，每文档仅 4–6 次前向（block diffusion 需 12–74 次）。作为草稿模型时比自回归解码快 8.3×（最高 10.4×），精度差在 0.4 点内；比投机扩散解码快 3.3× 且精度高 13.0 点。
AI.conclusion: 利用 KIE 的 schema 先验可把结构生成从解码中剥离，实现常数前向次数的并行抽取，同时兼作高效草稿模型；模型与代码已开源。

title: Explanation Selection in Abductive Learning
summary: Abductive learning (ABL) offers a promising framework that connects machine learning and logical reasoning in a mutually beneficial loop. However, this bidirectional feedback can also reinforce incorrect concept semantics, since different interpretations of intermediate concepts may explain the same observed reasoning outcomes. Static analyses characterize this ambiguity but leave open which explanation training selects and whether its labels can still be corrected. We develop a dynamical analysis of a fixed-feature binary ABL model that links the local stability of competing explanations to differences in their concept labels. We prove that Gram matrices with identical spectra can select different explanations even under the same supervision, objective, and initialization. When any two compatible explanations differ in at least two labels, legal evidence above one half guarantees during training that admissible changes in optimization geometry preserve the selected explanation. Even when only the true explanation satisfies all constraints under a shared predictor, training can still converge to a finite attracting state whose hard predictions violate some constraints and mislabel concepts. Experiments on visual ABL tasks verify these predictions, including wrong attraction from random initializations under identifiable supervision, and show that in ordinary end-to-end training SGD and Adam select different explanations of the same supervision, while unseen concept accuracy drops relative to true-concept references as training concept errors grow.

AI.tldr: 论文对固定特征二元溯因学习(ABL)模型做动力学分析，揭示训练可能锁定错误概念语义，且该选择受优化几何影响而不唯一。
AI.motivation: ABL中机器学习与逻辑推理双向反馈，但对中间概念的不同解释可能产生相同的推理结果，从而固化错误的概念语义；静态分析无法说明训练究竟选中哪种解释、标签能否被纠正。
AI.method: 对固定特征二元ABL模型进行动态分析，将竞争解释的局部稳定性与其概念标签差异联系起来；分析Gram矩阵谱相同情形下的解释选择，并在合法证据超过一半的条件下研究优化几何变化对已选解释的影响。
AI.result: 证明谱相同的Gram矩阵在相同监督、目标和初始化下可选出不同解释；当两个兼容解释至少在两个标签上不同且合法证据超过一半时，训练中允许的优化几何变化保持所选解释；即使只有真解释满足全部约束，训练仍可能收敛到违反约束、错标概念的有限吸引态。视觉ABL实验验证了这些预测，并显示SGD与Adam对同一监督选出不同解释，训练概念错误增加时未见概念准确率相对真概念参考下降。
AI.conclusion: ABL的双向反馈并不能保证收敛到正确概念语义，解释选择依赖优化几何并与数据谱细节相关；实践中需警惕错误吸引态及优化器差异带来的概念标签偏差。

title: RSWP: Robust SO(3)-Equivariant Watermarking for Panoramic Images
summary: Robust watermarking for panoramic imagery is impeded by the topological mismatch between spherical signals and planar representations. Conventional methods fail under $SO(3)$ viewing rotations due to non-linear geometric warping and struggle with viewport extraction, which typically necessitates computationally expensive inverse remapping. To address these challenges, we propose RSWP, a watermarking framework grounded in icosahedral group theory. Leveraging the property that the icosahedral group ($\mathcal{I}_{60}$) serves as the largest discrete subgroup of $SO(3)$, we decompose spherical rotations into tractable local planar rotations and combinatorial facet permutations. Accordingly, we introduce a decoupling architecture that embeds watermarks into discrete facets and a theoretically guaranteed Equivariance-to-Invariance decoding paradigm. By employing an equivariant feature extractor followed by a permutation-invariant sorting module, this paradigm rigorously synchronizes rotation-distorted features. Moreover, the dual-extractor design inherently supports direct, blind watermark retrieval from partial 2D renderings without geometric calibration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSWP achieves state-of-the-art robustness against continuous $SO(3)$ rotations and viewport transformations while preserving high visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出RSWP，基于二十面体群(I60)理论的球面全景图像水印框架，通过将SO(3)旋转分解为局部平面旋转与面片置换，结合等变特征提取与置换不变排序解码，实现无需几何校准的盲水印提取，在连续SO(3)旋转与视口变换下达到SOTA鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 全景图像水印受球面信号与平面表示之间的拓扑失配阻碍；传统方法在SO(3)视点旋转下因非线性几何扭曲而失效，且从视口提取水印通常需要计算代价高昂的逆映射(几何校准)。
AI.method: 利用二十面体群I60是SO(3)最大离散子群的性质，将球面旋转分解为可处理的局部平面旋转与组合式面片置换；设计解耦架构把水印嵌入离散面片；提出"等变到不变"解码范式——先用等变特征提取器，再用置换不变排序模块同步旋转扭曲后的特征；双提取器设计支持直接从部分2D渲染图盲提取水印而无需几何校准。
AI.result: 实验表明RSWP在连续SO(3)旋转和视口变换下具有SOTA鲁棒性，同时保持高视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 基于二十面体群几何先验的解耦与等变-不变解码设计，可有效解决全景水印的球面拓扑与旋转鲁棒性问题，并免去逆映射开销，为全景图像提供实用鲁棒水印方案。

title: Reinforcing Diffusion Models by Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching
summary: Forward diffusion reinforcement learning (RL)---enabling deterministic ODE sampling without trajectory backpropagation---has grown increasingly popular for efficiently aligning diffusion models. However, we reveal that existing methods essentially rely on signed reward-weighted regression (RWR), regressing the \emph{trainable policy} velocity onto rollouts from a \emph{behavior distribution}. Unbiased baseline subtraction implicitly assumes that the policy velocity equals the behavior marginal velocity---an idealized assumption violated under classifier-free guidance (CFG) rollouts, offline/off-policy updates, and imperfect online self-consistency. This \emph{behavior--policy mismatch} breaks baseline invariance and injects \emph{baseline-induced gradient drift}, destabilizing training. To resolve this issue, we propose \textbf{I}nstantaneous \textbf{T}rajectory \textbf{D}istribution \textbf{M}atching (\textbf{iTDM}), taking the infinitesimal limit of Trajectory Distribution Matching toward a time-local reward-guided target via the posterior-score identity to yield a sample-level gradient anchored at the behavior velocity without learning an additional reward-tilted target score. Tracking this velocity with an online auxiliary denoiser guarantees exact baseline invariance at the auxiliary optimum, effectively suppressing baseline drift across both online and offline RL. Extensive experiments across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment show that iTDM achieves state-of-the-art in-domain and out-of-domain performance. Notably, on the challenging GenEval2 benchmark, iTDM converges nearly $3\times$ faster than competing methods while scaling smoothly to $0.87$ without collapse. Code is available at https://github.com/Luo-Yihong/iTDM

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示现有前向扩散强化学习方法本质上是带符号的奖励加权回归(RWR)，在行为分布与策略分布不匹配时会产生"基线诱导的梯度漂移"，为此提出瞬时轨迹分布匹配(iTDM)，通过对轨迹分布匹配取无穷小极限获得锚定在行为速度上的样本级梯度，并借助在线辅助去噪器实现精确的基线不变性。
AI.motivation: 前向扩散RL（无需轨迹反向传播的确定性ODE采样）被广泛用于高效对齐扩散模型，但作者发现这类方法实质上依赖带符号的奖励加权回归，把可训练策略速度回归到行为分布的rollout上。无偏基线减法隐含假设"策略速度等于行为边缘速度"，而这一理想假设在CFG rollout、离线/离策略更新以及不完美的在线自洽性下被违背，导致行为—策略不匹配，破坏基线不变性并引入基线诱导梯度漂移，使训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出瞬时轨迹分布匹配(iTDM)：对轨迹分布匹配取无穷小极限，通过后验得分恒等式逼近时间局部的奖励引导目标，从而得到锚定于行为速度的样本级梯度，且无需学习额外的奖励倾斜目标得分。再用一个在线辅助去噪器跟踪该速度，在辅助最优处保证精确的基线不变性，在线与离线RL中均抑制基线漂移。
AI.result: 在组合生成、文本渲染和偏好对齐等大量实验中，iTDM在域内和域外性能上均达到SOTA。在具有挑战性的GenEval2基准上，iTDM收敛速度比竞争方法快约3倍，并能平滑扩展至0.87而不崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 现有前向扩散RL方法的基线漂移根源在于行为—策略不匹配；iTDM通过瞬时极限与锚定行为速度的样本级梯度配合在线辅助去噪器，实现精确基线不变性，带来更快收敛、更强域内外性能与更好的稳定性，代码已开源。

title: Separating Action Allocation from Image Matching in Visual Token Routing
summary: Adaptive visual token routers aim to save computation while preserving the image detail needed to answer each question. A higher average score could reflect better choices for individual images or more frequent use of high resolution on tasks that need it. We distinguish the two by keeping action counts fixed within each task and comparing the router's assignments with random pairings of the same actions and images. On equally weighted ChartQA and TextVQA, both Qwen2.5-VL-3B and -7B gain from matching but lose more from their action frequencies relative to a task table, with a 1.71-point gain and a 3.95-point loss on 7B. Exchanging the continuous resolutions chosen by the external selector CARES also lowers quality on 7B. When requests arrive with task labels, the table outscores the discrete router by 1.92 points and saves 31.76 ms per complete 7B request on average.

AI.tldr: 本文通过固定每个任务内的动作次数，比较路由器分配与随机配对，区分自适应视觉token路由的增益来源，发现路由器的任务级动作频率决策反而带来损失。
AI.motivation: 自适应视觉token路由器通常以平均分衡量优劣，但高分可能来自"为单张图像选得更好"或"在需要高分辨率的任务上更频繁地用高分辨率"两种机制，作者希望将二者分离。
AI.method: 在ChartQA与TextVQA等权设置下，对Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B固定每个任务内的动作计数，将路由器的(动作, 图像)分配与同动作、同图像的随机配对进行比较；另做交换CARES所选的连续分辨率的实验，并对比带任务标签时"任务表"策略与离散路由器的得分与时延。
AI.result: 7B上匹配带来+1.71分增益，但相对任务表的动作频率损失为3.95分；交换CARES所选连续分辨率也降低7B质量。请求带任务标签时，任务表比离散路由器高1.92分，且每完整7B请求平均节省31.76 ms。
AI.conclusion: 路由器的收益主要来自单图匹配，其任务级动作预算分配不及简单任务表；当任务标签可得时，按任务表固定分辨率更准确也更高效。

title: Neutron Imaging Enhancement for Lithium Batteries Based on Swin-Transformer and Image Fusion
summary: Neutron imaging is highly sensitive to light elements such as lithium and is therefore valuable for non-destructive testing (NDT) and analyzing internal structural evolution in lithium batteries. However, limited neutron-source flux and detector performance often result in images with mixed noise, low contrast, and blurred edges, hindering accurate assessment of battery internal states. To address these issues, this paper proposes a lithium-battery neutron image enhancement method combining an improved Swin-Transformer with spatial-domain image fusion. First, an improved Swin-Transformer incorporating Multi-Dconv Head Transposed Attention (MDTA) and Global Response Normalization (GRN) extracts and reconstructs image features to suppress high-density white spots and Gaussian-Poisson mixed noise. Second, guided filtering and a gradient-adaptive mask are used for selective edge enhancement, while Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) improves local contrast. Finally, a spatial-frequency (SF)-based local block-weighted fusion mechanism adaptively combines the edge-enhanced and contrast-equalized images to preserve microscopic details while suppressing noise. Experiments show that, compared with BM3D, DnCNN, and GAN, the proposed method achieves strong performance in full-reference and no-reference evaluations. Its best PSNR and SSIM reach 33.0517 dB and 0.9637, respectively, while the NR-IQA and Natural Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) scores are as low as 0.1794 and 4.0974. The method reduces artifacts and over smoothing, improving the visual fidelity and structural identifiability of lithium-battery neutron images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合改进Swin-Transformer与空域图像融合的锂电池中子图像增强方法，有效抑制混合噪声并提升对比度与边缘清晰度。
AI.motivation: 中子成像对锂等轻元素敏感，适合锂电池内部无损检测，但受中子源通量和探测器性能限制，图像存在混合噪声、低对比度和边缘模糊问题，影响电池内部状态评估的准确性。
AI.method: 方法分三步：1）改进Swin-Transformer，引入MDTA和GRN提取并重建特征，抑制高密度白斑与高斯-泊松混合噪声；2）用引导滤波与梯度自适应掩膜做选择性边缘增强，并用CLAHE提升局部对比度；3）基于空间频率(SF)的局部块加权融合机制，自适应融合边缘增强图与对比度均衡图，保留微观细节并抑噪。
AI.result: 与BM3D、DnCNN、GAN相比，在全参考与无参考评价中均表现优异：PSNR最高33.0517 dB、SSIM 0.9637，NR-IQA低至0.1794、NIQE低至4.0974。
AI.conclusion: 该方法减少了伪影与过平滑，提升了锂电池中子图像的视觉保真度和结构可辨识性。

title: Black-Box Comparator-Adaptive Network Regret
summary: We study comparator-adaptive decentralized online learning with network regret, which evaluates each node's prediction on the loss of every node in the network. We show that existing gossip-based algorithms are fundamentally limited for this task, and cannot achieve sublinear network regret with only one gossip step per decision round. To prove this, we construct a two-node counterexample, which shows that gossip-based algorithms can produce exponential regret despite bounded disagreement, resolving a previously open question in the literature. We then introduce a black-box reduction, which uses local learners with sublinear comparator-adaptive regret to obtain sublinear comparator-adaptive network regret. Each node exchanges predictions with its neighbors once per decision round, and a universal choice of edge weights works on every connected undirected graph without graph preprocessing. We also characterize admissible edge weights and show how weights adapted to the graph improve the regret bound. For example, for the complete graph, this improvement is quadratic in the number of nodes. Experiments on synthetic and real-world data illustrate the counterexamples we propose and compare the reduction with decentralized baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究比较器自适应的去中心化在线学习中的网络遗憾，证明基于 gossip 的现有算法每轮仅一步 gossip 无法达到次线性网络遗憾，并给出黑盒归约方法实现次线性比较器自适应网络遗憾。
AI.motivation: 网络遗憾衡量每个节点预测在整个网络所有节点损失上的表现，比传统局部遗憾更严格。现有 gossip 算法在此任务上是否存在根本局限尚不明确（含一个公开未解问题），且缺乏能达到次线性网络遗憾的通用方法。
AI.method: 1) 构造两节点反例：表明在有界不一致条件下 gossip 算法仍可产生指数级遗憾，从而证明每轮一步 gossip 无法实现次线性网络遗憾；2) 提出黑盒归约：利用具有次线性比较器自适应遗憾的本地学习器获得次线性比较器自适应网络遗憾；每轮每节点与邻居交换一次预测；3) 给出在任意连通无向图上通用的边权选择（无需图预处理），刻画可允许边权，并证明图自适应边权可改进遗憾界（完全图上改进为节点数的二次量级）；4) 在合成与真实数据上验证反例并对比去中心化基线。
AI.result: 证明 gossip 类算法不能每轮一步 gossip 达到次线性网络遗憾（反例显示指数级遗憾），解决文献中的公开问题；黑盒归约实现次线性比较器自适应网络遗憾；通用边权在任意连通无向图上有效；图自适应边权带来遗憾界改进，完全图上改进为节点数平方量级；实验验证反例与归约方法优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作明确了 gossip 方法在网络遗憾任务上的根本局限，并提出通用、无需图预处理的黑盒归约框架，实现次线性比较器自适应网络遗憾，同时指出边权设计对遗憾界的重要影响。

title: CAR: Reducing Decoder Output Shift in Visual Token Pruning via Coverage Selection and Attention Reallocation
summary: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods degrade substantially under aggressive pruning, especially on visual grounding (VG). We analyze the sources of this degradation from the perspective of the output shift that pruning causes in decoder layers, and decompose this shift in closed form into two terms, an image summary error and an attention allocation error. The summary error stems from the loss of visual information, and the allocation error from the drop in the share of attention assigned to visual tokens. To reduce both errors, we propose CAR (Coverage selection and Attention Reallocation), a token pruning framework that restores attention share while maintaining information. Specifically, to minimize the summary error, whose upper bound tightens as the retained tokens better cover all visual tokens, our coverage selection retains tokens that are both salient and non-redundant, with saliency from encoder heads chosen by a label-free probe. To minimize the allocation error, our attention reallocation reassigns the attention of the discarded tokens to the retained ones through a closed-form logit bias. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B with $90\%$ of the visual tokens pruned, CAR retains $93.0\%$ of the unpruned accuracy on visual question answering (VQA) and $77.9\%$ on VG, against $26.5\%$ for the best existing method on VG; the logit bias alone raises the VG accuracy of existing methods by up to $24$ points. Experiments on multiple MLLMs across VQA, VG and video understanding show that CAR generalizes well and consistently outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出CAR框架，通过覆盖率选择与注意力重分配，降低剪枝带来的图像摘要误差与注意力分配误差，在90%剪枝率下显著保持VQA和视觉定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法在激进剪枝下性能大幅下降，尤其在视觉定位（VG）任务上退化严重；作者从解码层输出偏移角度分析退化来源，希望针对性缓解。
AI.method: 将剪枝引起的解码层输出偏移闭式分解为图像摘要误差（视觉信息损失）与注意力分配误差（视觉token注意力份额下降）两项。为降低摘要误差，提出覆盖率选择：保留既显著又非冗余的token，显著性来自经无标签探针挑选的编码器注意力头（摘要误差上界随覆盖度提高而收紧）；为降低分配误差，提出注意力重分配：用闭式logit偏置把被丢弃token的注意力转移给保留token。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上剪掉90%视觉token时，VQA保留93.0%未剪枝精度，VG保留77.9%（最佳现有方法仅26.5%）；仅logit偏置即可使现有方法VG精度提升最多24个点。多模型在VQA、VG、视频理解上验证了泛化性与一致性优势。
AI.conclusion: 从输出偏移分解入手的CAR能有效缓解激进剪枝退化，尤其大幅改善视觉定位，并具备跨模型、跨任务的通用性。

title: RoFE: Rotated Frozen Embeddings for Low-Data Multimodal Tabular Learning
summary: Multimodal tabular learning combines tabular data with images and text, often in settings where labeled data are scarce. Tabular foundation models such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) offer a promising solution via in-context learning without task-specific training. However, modern image and text encoders produce embeddings with hundreds or thousands of dimensions, far exceeding the number of features encountered during PFN pretraining. Existing approaches bridge this gap using principal component analysis (PCA) to compress frozen embeddings. Surprisingly, we find that this PCA interface can underperform simple linear classifiers when labeled examples are scarce, even though PFNs are designed for small datasets. We identify the underlying failure mechanism: the PFN's per-column standardization removes the variances of the PCA scores. When the PCA keeps every direction of the labeled examples, the examples collapse into a regular simplex in which all pairwise distances are equal. To address this problem, we propose Rotated Frozen Embeddings (RoFE), a training-free method that rotates PCA scores before PFN inference. We theoretically show that rotation makes the column variances nearly equal, so that standardization approximately preserves the embedding geometry. Across image and text classification tasks, encoders, and tabular foundation models, RoFE improves low-data performance over the PCA interface and outperforms baselines that require task-specific training. The improvements also extend to regression.

AI.tldr: 提出无训练方法RoFE，通过旋转PCA分数解决PFN在多模态表格学习中因标准化导致样本坍缩为规则单纯形的问题，提升少样本性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态表格学习常面临标注数据稀缺，PFN类表格基础模型擅长小数据，但图像/文本编码器产出数百上千维嵌入，远超PFN预训练时特征数。现有用PCA压缩冻结嵌入的接口在标注样本少时甚至不如简单线性分类器，尽管PFN本就为小数据设计。
AI.method: 识别失败机制：PFN的逐列标准化会移除PCA分数的方差，当PCA保留标注样本全部方向时，样本坍缩到所有成对距离相等的规则单纯形。提出RoFE——在PFN推理前对PCA分数做旋转的训练无关方法；理论上证明旋转使各列方差近似相等，从而标准化近似保留嵌入几何结构。
AI.result: 在图像与文本分类任务、多种编码器和表格基础模型上，RoFE相较PCA接口提升低数据性能，并超越需任务特定训练的方法；改进也延伸到回归任务。
AI.conclusion: PCA压缩接口存在标准化破坏几何的隐患，简单旋转即可修复，使免训练PFN接口在少样本多模态表格任务中超越训练型基线。

title: STAGE: Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling for Cross-Subject Brain-to-Image Retrieval
comment: 38 pages, including the main paper and appendix
summary: Cross-subject brain-to-image retrieval aims to identify viewed images from unseen subjects' brain signals. However, inter-subject variability hinders alignment of brain-image representations, while independent query ranking tends to concentrate predictions on a few candidates, making accurate retrieval difficult without target labels. We propose STAGE (Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling), a structured test-time adaptation framework for recovering cross-subject alignment from uncertain brain-image correspondences. Moment calibration reduces statistical discrepancies between features, while coupling-weighted initialization establishes initial alignment. Coupling-guided adaptation further refines residual feature mismatches, and soft-coupling ranking coordinates candidate competition across queries to prevent overly concentrated matching assignments. Using only unlabeled target batches, STAGE maintains consistent matching from feature calibration to image retrieval while keeping both encoders frozen. Experiments on three public datasets validate STAGE's retrieval performance. On THINGS-EEG2, STAGE achieves 68.25% Top-1 and 90.47% Top-5, improving Top-1 by 18.52 percentage points over SCORE recovery and CSLS on identical frozen NICE features. Calibrated on 200 queries and a 200-image gallery covering their identities, STAGE retains 42.05% Top-1 when ranking 1,854 images with the transform frozen.

AI.tldr: 提出STAGE框架，用结构化测试时自适应恢复跨被试脑-图像对齐，无需标签即在THINGS-EEG2上达68.25% Top-1。
AI.motivation: 跨被试脑到图像检索中，被试间差异导致脑-图像表征对齐困难；独立查询排序使预测集中于少数候选，且无目标标签时精度低。
AI.method: STAGE包含：矩校准减少特征统计差异；耦合加权初始化建立初步对齐；耦合引导自适应细化残余特征失配；软耦合排序协调多查询间候选竞争避免过度集中匹配。仅用无标签目标批次，冻结双编码器。
AI.result: 三个公开数据集验证有效。THINGS-EEG2上Top-1 68.25%、Top-5 90.47%，较SCORE恢复+CSLS提升18.52个百分点；在200查询/200图像校准后扩展到1854图像库仍保持42.05% Top-1。
AI.conclusion: STAGE通过从特征校准到图像检索的一致匹配，在冻结编码器条件下有效提升跨被试检索性能，具备泛化到大规模图像库的能力。

title: Seeing vs. Knowing: Counterfactual Supervision and Correction for 3D-Aware Object Editing
summary: Rotating, translating, or rescaling an object in a photograph requires revealing unseen surfaces, preserving visible appearance, and updating shadows and reflections. Reconstructed 3D assets, rendered at the target pose as a 3D state, provide explicit geometric guidance, but their imperfect textures may conflict with the photograph, while standard paired training does not explicitly teach the editor which source to trust. To address this, we propose counterfactual state supervision, which constructs controlled photo--state conflicts through hidden-surface repainting, hidden geometry with re-rendered shadows and reflections, and visible-surface texture replacement. This teaches the editor to follow the 3D state for unseen content while preserving photograph-visible appearance. However, learning this distinction does not ensure that it is maintained during sampling. We therefore introduce symmetric counterfactual correction, which uses state-side and photo-side twins, which share the photograph and the state respectively, to construct directed latent perturbations toward condition-inconsistent targets and train recovery toward the target specified by the current condition. Both strategies operate only during training, requiring no architectural changes or additional inference steps. Experiments on OBJect and SpatialEdit-Bench demonstrate strong spatial editing performance and content preservation, while controlled ablations show improved source selection and sustained responsiveness to conditioning during sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出反事实状态监督与对称反事实纠正，让图像编辑器学会在3D状态与照片冲突时正确选择信息源，实现高质量空间编辑。
AI.motivation: 对照片中物体进行旋转、平移或缩放需要揭示未见表面、保持可见外观并更新阴影和反射。重建的3D资产能提供几何引导，但其不完美纹理会与照片冲突，而标准配对训练未明确教编辑器该信任哪一来源。
AI.method: 1）反事实状态监督：通过隐藏表面重绘、带重渲染阴影反射的隐藏几何、可见表面纹理替换，构造受控的照片—状态冲突；2）对称反事实纠正：利用共享照片/共享状态的状态侧与照片侧孪生样本，构造指向条件不一致目标的潜空间扰动，并训练向当前条件指定目标恢复。仅在训练期使用，无需架构改动或额外推理步骤。
AI.result: 在OBJect和SpatialEdit-Bench上展现强空间编辑性能与内容保持；控制消融实验显示源选择能力提升，且采样过程对条件保持持续响应。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练期反事实监督使编辑器在未见内容上遵循3D状态、在可见外观上保持照片，并通过对称纠正确保采样阶段维持该区分。

title: Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure for Subsurface Seepage Forecasting and Relief Placement
summary: Truncating a large heterogeneous diffusion model around a localized, threshold-activated outlet saves degrees of freedom but severs exterior feedback that governs when the outlet opens and how much it discharges. By separating forcing-driven background head from local withdrawal drawdown, Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure (SCBC) maps local physical descriptors to positive exchange coefficients at the cut boundary. Supervised on unforced donor-domain withdrawal responses, these coefficients yield a passivity-preserving reduced operator that generalizes across unseen forcing histories without refitting. We evaluate SCBC on flood-driven subsurface seepage beneath levee foundations against full-grid reference simulations (MODFLOW~6). Across three held-out foundation panels, a single frozen SCBC tree estimator reduced peak-discharge log RMSE by 26.1%, 30.9% and 42.6% relative to identical local patches using a shared boundary coefficient. We then test whether better screening forecasts improve constrained placement, minimizing peak landside toe head subject to a discharge capacity limit and a budget of three sequential full-grid checks. On a separate 36-foundation test using a coarser 30-state ring operator, a neural SCBC estimator improved discharge forecasts across candidates yet selected four over-capacity placements before checks, compared with one for a shared-coefficient ring, which recovered all 144 reference optima after three checks.

AI.tldr: 提出Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure (SCBC)，将局部物理描述映射为切割边界的正交换系数，在保持无源性的前提下实现异质扩散模型的降维，并评估其在堤基渗流预报与基础筛选布局优化中的作用。
AI.motivation: 在局部阈值激活出口处截断大型异质扩散模型可减少自由度，但会切断决定出口开启时机与排放量的外部反馈。
AI.method: 将强迫驱动背景水头与局部抽水降深分离，用局部物理描述符到边界正交换系数的映射构造SCBC；在无强迫供体域抽水响应上监督训练，得到保无源性的降阶算子；在MODFLOW 6全网格参考下评估洪水驱动堤基渗流，并做带三次全网格校验预算的约束布局实验（另用30状态环算子）。
AI.result: 三块留出地基面板上，单个冻结SCBC树估计器将峰值流量对数RMSE相比共享边界系数降低26.1%、30.9%、42.6%；但在36地基测试中，神经SCBC估计器虽改善候选流量预报，却在三次校验前产生4个超容量布局（共享系数环仅1个），后者三次校验后恢复全部144个参考最优。
