AI.conclusion: SCBC能跨未见强迫历史泛化且无需重拟合，显著提升局部峰值流量预报；但更准的筛选预报并不必然改善约束布局，需关注估计器与优化流程的不匹配。

title: SCRA-CLIP: Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models have facilitated zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) through transferable visual-semantic representations. However, detecting fine-grained anomalies remains challenging due to inadequate modeling of diverse anomaly patterns and their spatial context. To address these challenges, we propose SCRA-CLIP, a Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation framework that jointly enhances anomaly-aware textual semantics and context-sensitive visual representations. Specifically, we introduce Spherical Prototype-Conditioned Prompting (SPCP), which employs von Mises--Fisher mixtures to model the directional distributions of normal and abnormal patch features. These state-specific prototypes are incorporated into textual contexts to guide the learning of more discriminative textual representations. Furthermore, we develop Context-Deviation Guided Visual Adaptation (CGVA), which captures local feature deviations relative to multi-scale neighborhood contexts and refines patch representations through adaptive gating. By integrating distribution-aware semantic modeling with context-sensitive visual adaptation, SCRA-CLIP facilitates more discriminative cross-modal matching for fine-grained anomaly detection and localization. Extensive experiments on 11 industrial and medical benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization capability of SCRA-CLIP across diverse unseen categories and domains. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: SCRA-CLIP 通过球面原型条件提示与上下文偏差引导的视觉适配，联合增强文本语义与视觉表示，提升零样本细粒度异常检测与定位。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型虽支持零样本异常检测（ZSAD），但对多样化异常模式及其空间上下文建模不足，导致细粒度异常检测仍困难。
AI.method: 提出 SCRA-CLIP 框架，包含两部分：(1) SPCP（球面原型条件提示），用 von Mises–Fisher 混合建模正常/异常 patch 特征的方向分布，将状态特定原型注入文本上下文以学习更具判别力的文本表示；(2) CGVA（上下文偏差引导视觉适配），捕捉 patch 相对多尺度邻域上下文的局部特征偏差，并通过自适应门控细化 patch 表示。
AI.result: 在 11 个工业与医学基准上验证，在多样未见类别与领域上表现出有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 融合分布感知语义建模与上下文敏感视觉适配，可实现更具判别力的跨模态匹配，支持细粒度异常检测与定位；代码将于发表后公开。

title: Attention Latent Feedback
summary: During autoregressive decoding, the deeper representations of the previous token have already been computed, yet shallow layers at the current token cannot read them directly because standard self-attention connects positions only at the same depth. We introduce Attention Latent Feedback (ALF), an architecture that allows every sublayer to attend to the outputs of the deeper layers at the previous position. Training unrolls this cross-position recurrence into two parallel passes, whereas decoding remains single-pass using cached previous-token states. Across mixture-of-experts models with up to 4.0B parameters, ALF lowers held-out loss by 0.022-0.024 nats over the standard residual with about 1.1% decoding FLOP overhead, and consistently outperforms prior final-state feedback across all three scales on both standard and attention residual backbones. On MoE-1.6B, ALF matches a $1.38\times$ larger baseline token budget, and on MoE-4.0B it lifts average accuracy across seventeen downstream benchmarks from 45.1% to 47.0%. Analysis further reveals that intermediate and nearby deeper layers drive most of this benefit, allowing a fixed nearest-window variant to retain 89%-94% of the gain at linear read cost while learned attention widens its margin with scale.

AI.tldr: 提出注意力潜在反馈（ALF）架构，让每个子层可访问上一位置更深层的表示，在不改动解码单趟性的前提下降低损失并提升下游精度。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码时，上一token的深层表示已经算好，但当前token的浅层因标准自注意力只在同一深度连接位置而无法读取它们，深层计算被浪费。
AI.method: ALF让每个子层attend到前一位置更深层的输出；训练时将跨位置递归展开为两趟并行pass，解码仍为单趟并复用缓存的上一token状态；并分析引入最近窗口变体。
AI.result: 在至多4.0B参数的MoE模型上，ALF相比标准残差降低留出损失0.022–0.024 nats，解码FLOP开销约1.1%；各规模、标准与注意力残差骨干上均优于以往最终状态反馈；MoE-1.6B相当于1.38倍更大基线的token预算，MoE-4.0B在17个下游基准平均准确率从45.1%升至47.0%。
AI.conclusion: 中间及邻近深层贡献主要收益；固定最近窗口变体以线性读取成本保留89%–94%增益，可学习注意力随规模扩大优势更明显。

title: Align the Pair, Not the Sample: Representation Alignment for Faster and Better One-Step Generato
summary: Representation alignment markedly accelerates diffusion training, but one-step generators raise a question that diffusion does not: \emph{which training path should receive the loss?} A one-step generator sees two kinds of inputs. Corrupted real images come with their clean counterpart, which provides an instance-paired target. Samples generated from pure noise have no corresponding real image, yet this is where the final model operates. We study this question on Priming, which trains one-step generators from scratch by reconstructing corrupted images and then matching feature distributions with optimal transport. Aligning the generative path, the natural choice, collapses recall ($0.45\!\to\!0.15$--$0.25$) in all 17 configurations we test, including five target constructions and loss weights down to $0.05$. Aligning the paired reconstruction path with a frozen DINOv2 encoder instead helps in every setting we test. A short analysis explains this asymmetry: when the target carries no instance information about the input, the optimal aligned feature is constant within each class, so the loss pulls samples toward class prototypes. A control confirms this: aligning the paired path to a random same-class image instead of the input's own image removes most of the gain. Inside the generator, paired-path alignment creates an interface block through which post-training routes noise, and the image semantics carried through it predict sample quality across 16 models. The resulting recipe, \method, accelerates \emph{both} training stages on ImageNet $256\!\times\!256$: it matches the 160-epoch baseline with $2\times$ fewer priming epochs, surpasses its final quality with $4\times$ fewer post-training updates, and lowers FID to 1.30 (B) and 1.155 (L) at the standard budget. A joint single-stage variant trains native one-step generators and reaches FID 1.22 with 115M parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一步生成器中表示对齐损失应施加于哪条训练路径，发现应对配对重建路径而非生成（噪声）路径对齐，由此提出方法显著加速两阶段训练。
AI.motivation: 一步生成器有两条输入路径：配对损坏图像（有干净目标）与纯噪声生成样本（无对应真实图像）。表示对齐能加速扩散训练，但一步生成器应把对齐损失施加在哪条路径上尚不清楚。作者发现直觉选择（对齐生成路径）会严重损害召回率。
AI.method: 在 Priming 框架上（从头训练一步生成器：重建损坏图像 + 用最优传输匹配特征分布）系统比较两条路径的对齐效果；理论上分析非实例信息目标下最优对齐特征退化为类原型的问题；并用随机同类图像替换自身图像作对照实验；还分析了生成器内部因配对路径对齐形成的"接口块"及其传递的图像语义。
AI.result: 对齐生成路径在全部17种配置（含5种目标构造、损失权重低至0.05）均导致召回崩塌（0.45→0.15–0.25）；对齐配对重建路径（冻结DINOv2）在所有设定下均有益。对照实验证实随机同类目标会消除大部分增益。最终方法在ImageNet 256×256上：2×更少priming epoch匹配160-epoch基线，4×更少post-training更新即超过其最终质量，FID达1.30(B)/1.155(L)；单阶段变体以115M参数达FID 1.22。
AI.conclusion: 表示对齐应施加于配对重建路径而非生成路径；配对路径对齐形成可路由噪声的接口块，其携带的语义可预测样本质量。该配方同时加速priming与post-training两阶段，并在多个规模上取得领先FID。

title: Inspect Before You Decide: Evidence-Guided Visual Search for Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential for industrial anomaly detection and understanding. However, reliably identifying subtle anomalies remains challenging, as existing approaches often struggle to acquire and verify fine-grained visual evidence beyond global observations. To address this challenge, we propose EVAD, an evidence-guided visual search framework that enables MLLMs to actively seek and examine diagnostically informative visual evidence for reliable anomaly reasoning. Specifically, EVAD begins with a global visual assessment to identify potentially anomalous regions for further inspection. Building upon this observation, we introduce a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-guided exploration strategy that progressively acquires visual evidence through two complementary operations: semantic refinement for fine-grained inspection and spatial expansion for contextual verification. The acquired evidence is subsequently evaluated and integrated to support more informed and reliable anomaly decisions. Extensive experiments across multiple industrial anomaly detection tasks demonstrate that EVAD achieves state-of-the-art performance in most evaluated settings, highlighting the effectiveness of active evidence exploration for fine-grained anomaly understanding and reasoning. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出EVAD，一个证据引导的视觉搜索框架，让MLLM主动寻找并检验细粒度视觉证据，用于可靠的工业异常检测与推理。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型方法在工业异常检测中难以获取并验证超越全局观察的细粒度视觉证据，导致细微异常识别不可靠。
AI.method: 先做全局视觉评估定位潜在异常区域，再用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）引导的探索策略，通过两种互补操作逐步获取证据：语义细化（细粒度检查）与空间扩展（上下文验证），最后对证据进行评估与整合以支撑决策。
AI.result: 在多个工业异常检测任务的广泛实验中，EVAD 在多数设定下达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 主动证据探索对细粒度异常理解与推理有效；代码将在论文发表后公开。

title: EEG Decoding in Context: A Framework for Tuning-Free EEG Foundation Models
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding is a central route toward brain-computer interfaces for communication, rehabilitation, cognitive assessment, and neurological monitoring. Recent EEG foundation models have substantially advanced reusable signal representations, but their downstream use still typically requires a task-specific decoder, gradient-based adaptation, and validation-driven model selection. We investigate a complementary foundation-model paradigm based on in-context learning: labeled EEG recordings define the decoding task as context, and new recordings are predicted without updating model parameters. We first pair raw EEG features with a pretrained general-purpose in-context predictor. This direct formulation provides a promising starting point, but its performance remains limited and unstable and does not generalize reliably across EEG paradigms. We find that suitable context construction can address these limitations by improving the effective signal-to-noise ratio and exposing temporal and spatial structure. Building on this insight, we introduce a general framework that combines EEG-specific context construction with a frozen in-context predictor and a metric-based context adaptation mechanism, which matches each downstream task to an appropriate context representation without relying on validation data. Across ten datasets spanning seven EEG decoding paradigms, our method achieves the highest mean BAcc among eleven specialized and fine-tuned EEG baselines, without task-specific parameter updates or validation-based model selection. This framework provides a practical path toward tuning-free EEG foundation models in which adaptation is expressed through context rather than parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免调参的EEG基础模型范式，用EEG特定上下文构造＋冻结的上下文学习预测器＋基于度量的上下文适配，在10个数据集7类范式上取得最高平均平衡准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG基础模型虽提升了可复用表征，但下游使用仍需任务专用解码器、梯度微调和基于验证集的模型选择，流程繁琐且易过拟合。作者希望探索一种互补范式：以标注EEG构成上下文定义任务，对新记录直接预测而不更新参数。
AI.method: 先将原始EEG特征与预训练通用上下文学习预测器配对；发现直接使用性能有限且跨范式不稳定，进而提出框架：(1) EEG特定上下文构造以提升有效信噪比并显式暴露时/空结构；(2) 冻结的上下文学习预测器；(3) 基于度量的上下文适配机制，为每个下游任务匹配合适上下文表示，无需验证数据选择。
AI.result: 在覆盖7种EEG解码范式的10个数据集上，该方法在无任务特定参数更新、无验证集模型选择的情况下，平均BAcc超过11个专用及微调EEG基线。
AI.conclusion: 为免调参EEG基础模型提供了可行路径：适配通过上下文而非参数更新来表达。同时指出直接上下文学习需精心设计上下文构造才能可靠泛化。

title: GravHMR: Coupling SLAM and Human Mesh Recovery in a Shared Gravity Frame
summary: Recovering globally consistent 3D human motion from monocular videos remains challenging under dynamic camera motion. Although SLAM and human mesh recovery (HMR) provide complementary camera and body estimates, directly combining them often leads to inconsistent orientations and accumulated trajectory drift. We present GravHMR, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that couples SLAM and HMR through a shared gravity-aligned reference. By allowing gravity to be estimated independently of the HMR backbone, GravHMR accommodates world-grounded HMR models with or without explicit gravity-view representations. Specifically, Yaw-Aware Orientation Optimization (YAOO) resolves heading inconsistencies by correcting body and velocity orientations about the shared gravity axis. Conditioned on these corrected orientations, Gravity-Aware Trajectory Optimization (GATO) anchors root trajectories in the metric SLAM world by jointly leveraging 2D reprojection, the metric scale implicit in the human body, and the body's own motion. On EMDB-2, GravHMR achieves state-of-the-art performance with 154.0 mm W-MPJPE100 using ViPE and 189.8 mm using masked DROID-SLAM, outperforming TRAM (222.4 mm) under the same masked DROID-SLAM camera estimates. It further reduces W-MPJPE100 by 44.3% over GVHMR (276.5 mm) and by 20.0% over GVHMR + HTD-Refine (192.4 mm) with the same HMR backbone.

AI.tldr: GravHMR是一个免训练、即插即用的框架，通过共享的重力对齐参考系耦合SLAM与人体网格恢复，实现单目视频动态相机下的全局一致3D人体运动恢复。
AI.motivation: 动态相机运动下单目视频恢复全局一致的3D人体运动仍具挑战；SLAM与HMR虽提供互补的相机与人体估计，但直接结合常导致朝向不一致与轨迹漂移。
AI.method: 将重力估计与HMR骨干解耦，使框架兼容有无显式重力视角表示的世界接地HMR模型。包含两部分：Yaw-Aware Orientation Optimization（YAOO）围绕共享重力轴校正身体与速度朝向以解决heading不一致；Gravity-Aware Trajectory Optimization（GATO）在此校正朝向下，联合利用2D重投影、人体隐含的度量尺度和自身运动，将根轨迹锚定于度量SLAM世界。
AI.result: 在EMDB-2上取得SOTA：用ViPE时W-MPJPE100为154.0 mm，用masked DROID-SLAM时为189.8 mm，优于相同相机估计下的TRAM（222.4 mm）；相同HMR骨干下相较GVHMR（276.5 mm）降低44.3%，相较GVHMR+HTD-Refine（192.4 mm）降低20.0%。
AI.conclusion: 以重力对齐为共享桥梁可有效解决SLAM与HMR融合中的朝向与漂移问题，且免训练、可插拔，适配多种相机估计与HMR骨干，显著提升世界坐标下的人体运动精度。

title: Learning Neurovascular Codes for EEG-to-fMRI Synthesis
summary: In this paper, we introduce Neurovascular Codes as shared EEG representations for fMRI generation. We first train a separate EEG encoder to predict each fMRI signal, learning target-specific temporal and spectral features from the same EEG window. After training, we freeze the encoders and project their concatenated hidden features into a shared neurovascular code. Conditioned on this code, stochastic interpolant transforms Gaussian noise into a vector of fMRI signals, allowing different responses to be sampled for the same EEG window. We evaluate our approach on eight public simultaneous EEG-fMRI datasets, including four resting-state and four task-based datasets with 61,646 volume-level pairs. Under within-subject and held-out-subject evaluation, our model improves average Pearson correlation over the strongest encoder baselines by 19.1% and 19.8%, respectively. The corresponding improvements over the strongest generator baselines are 18.8% and 47.9%. Beyond reconstruction accuracy, we also evaluate the generated signals using subject-identification classifiers trained on real fMRI. Our method achieves the highest mean accuracy among the evaluated generators. We hope that our work opens up new opportunities for cross-modal brain modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 Neurovascular Codes（神经血管编码）作为共享 EEG 表征，用于由 EEG 生成 fMRI；在八个同期 EEG-fMRI 数据集上，重建相关性显著优于编码器与生成器基线。
AI.motivation: EEG 与 fMRI 是互补的脑成像模态，但采集成本与时序分辨率差异大；已有跨模态工作通常一对一地学习 EEG→fMRI 映射，忽略了同一 EEG 窗口对应多种、含噪的 fMRI 响应，缺乏可共享、可采样的跨模态表征。
AI.method: 1）先为每个 fMRI 目标信号训练独立的 EEG 编码器，从同一 EEG 窗口学习目标特异的时间与频谱特征；2）训练后冻结编码器，将其隐藏特征拼接并投影为共享的"神经血管编码"；3）以该编码为条件，用随机插值（stochastic interpolant）把高斯噪声变换为 fMRI 信号向量，从而对同一 EEG 窗口采样多个响应。
AI.result: 在八个公开同期 EEG-fMRI 数据集（4 个静息态、4 个任务态，共 61,646 个体积级配对）上评测：被试内与留出被试设置下，平均 Pearson 相关较最强编码器基线提升 19.1% 与 19.8%，较最强生成器基线提升 18.8% 与 47.9%；在真实 fMRI 上训练的被试识别分类器评测中，生成信号的平均识别准确率在所有对比生成器中最高。
AI.conclusion: 共享神经血管编码结合随机插值生成，可同时提升 fMRI 重建精度与信号的个体可辨识性，为跨模态脑建模提供了新思路。

title: Mass Forcing: On-Policy Mass-Aware Distillation for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for real-time video synthesis, distilling pretrained diffusion models into few-step autoregressive generators. However, its reverse-KL objective is mode-seeking and can collapse the student's conditional video distribution onto a narrow subset of modes, leading to reduced sample diversity, diminished temporal dynamics, and color oversaturation. Existing methods mitigate this issue mainly via coverage-oriented student initialization, but we observe that such coverage is transient: across three initializations, the fraction of dynamic videos drops sharply during subsequent DMD training, indicating that the mode-seeking objective, not the initialization, drives this degradation. We propose Mass Forcing, a probability-mass-aware framework that moves on-policy DMD supervision from whole videos to individual states. Each update branches several continuations from a shared student-generated prefix, making the student's probability mass at that state measurable against the teacher. First, Mass Forcing estimates relative teacher-to-student density ratios among these continuations through latent-space score integration and uses them to rebalance conditional DMD updates, amplifying rollouts underrepresented relative to the teacher. Second, since mismatched mode probabilities do not necessarily induce strong local score corrections, it aligns generated rollout sets with a reweighted reference distribution defined by the same mass estimates, providing cross-rollout supervision. Experiments on MovieGen and VBench show that Mass Forcing improves video fidelity and sustains temporal dynamics throughout training, achieving the highest Total scores among compared methods and a Dynamic Degree of 83% after 1,000 generator updates, versus 12-32% for the baselines, with no additional inference-time overhead.

AI.tldr: 针对DMD蒸馏视频生成器因reverse-KL模式寻求导致多样性、时序动态下降与色彩过饱和的问题，作者指出覆盖度下降源于目标函数而非初始化，提出Mass Forcing：将on-policy DMD监督从整段视频细化到单个状态，通过共享前缀分支续写估计师生密度比并对rollout重加权，同时对齐重加权参考分布，从而提升保真度并保持时序动态。
AI.motivation: DMD的反向KL目标具有模式寻求特性，会使学生的条件视频分布坍缩到少数模式，导致样本多样性下降、时序动态减弱和色彩过饱和。现有方法主要靠覆盖导向的学生初始化来缓解，但作者观察到这种覆盖是短暂的：在三种初始化下，动态视频比例在后续DMD训练中都急剧下降，说明退化由模式寻求目标本身驱动，而非初始化。
AI.method: 提出Mass Forcing，一种概率质量感知框架，将on-policy DMD监督从整段视频转移到单个状态。每次更新时，从共享的学生生成前缀处分支出多条续写，使该状态下学生的概率质量可与教师对比测量。第一，借助潜空间score积分估计这些续写之间教师相对于学生的密度比，并用其重新平衡条件DMD更新，放大相对于教师而言被低估的rollout。第二，由于模式概率失配并不一定带来强的局部score修正，方法进一步让生成的rollout集合与由同样质量估计定义的重加权参考分布对齐，提供跨rollout的监督。
AI.result: 在MovieGen和VBench上的实验表明，Mass Forcing提升了视频保真度，并在整个训练过程中保持时序动态，在对比方法中取得最高的Total分数；经过1000次生成器更新后动态程度（Dynamic Degree）达到83%，而基线仅12-32%，并且不增加推理时开销。
AI.conclusion: Mass Forcing通过状态级、概率质量感知的监督纠正DMD的模式坍缩，验证了退化根源在于目标函数而非初始化，能在无额外推理成本下同时提升保真度与动态性，为少步实时视频蒸馏提供更均衡的多样性-质量权衡。

title: Matching Under Metric Privacy
summary: We study how to represent and randomize points in $d$-dimensional Euclidean space to obtain accurate bipartite matchings under metric privacy. Given $n$ private and $n$ public points, we analyze local mechanisms that randomize each private point or its distances to the public points. Using the public points' affine span, we construct a smaller representation that preserves all matching costs. When a trusted server receives the private points, we establish privacy and utility guarantees for Gumbel matching, which randomizes edge costs and releases only the assignment. Through upper bounds and worst-case constructions, we establish the tight rate $Θ\!\left(n\min\{d,\log n\}/\varepsilon\right)$ for expected cost above the nonprivate optimum. Benchmark experiments support $d\approx\log n$ as a practical guide to the transition between directly randomizing point coordinates and using Gumbel matching. Extensions to squared Euclidean costs enable private nonparametric two-sample hypothesis testing. These results show how the application's trust model guides representation and dimension choices for better utility: under local privacy, low-dimensional point representations reduce excess cost, while under central privacy, distance representations achieve the optimal rate even in high dimension.

AI.tldr: 研究在 metric privacy 下如何表示和随机化 d 维欧氏空间中的点，以获得准确的双边匹配（bipartite matching）。在可信服务器（中心化隐私）下提出 Gumbel matching，证明期望代价超出非私有最优值的紧速率为 Θ(n·min{d, log n}/ε)，并给出 d≈log n 作为坐标随机化与 Gumbel matching 之间的实践分界。
AI.motivation: 私有数据点与公开点之间做匹配时，既要保护隐私又要保持匹配质量。已有工作缺乏对表示方式（点坐标 vs. 距离）与信任模型（本地 vs. 中心化）如何共同影响效用-隐私权衡的系统刻画，本文旨在填补这一空白并给出最优速率。
AI.method: 1) 利用公开点的仿射张成构造保持全部匹配代价的低维表示；2) 分析本地机制（随机化每个私有点的坐标或其到公开点的距离）；3) 在可信服务器场景下提出 Gumbel matching——对边代价加 Gumbel 噪声，仅发布分配结果；4) 通过上界与最坏情况构造证明紧速率；5) 扩展到平方欧氏代价，用于私有非参数两样本假设检验。
AI.result: 得到期望代价超出非私有最优值的紧速率 Θ(n·min{d, log n}/ε)；基准实验支持 d≈log n 作为直接随机化坐标与 Gumbel matching 之间转换的实用指导；平方欧氏代价的扩展可实现私有非参数两样本检验。
AI.conclusion: 应用的信任模型决定表示与维度选择：本地隐私下，低维点表示能降低超额代价；中心化隐私下，距离表示即使在高维也能达到最优速率。

title: Contamination at the Operating Point: Train-Test Identity Overlap Inflates Low-FMR Face Recognition Accuracy by an Order of Magnitude
summary: Face verification systems are deployed by selecting a decision threshold that achieves a target false match rate (FMR); performance is then reported as the corresponding false non-match rate (FNMR). In practice, deployed systems operate at FMR $\le 10^{-6}$, but widely used benchmarks can share identities with the models' training corpora. Prior work (Wu et al., 2024) measures the resulting optimistic bias as a small additive change in 10-fold accuracy (up to 1.01 percentage points). We show that the bias is neither small nor constant: it is a multiplicative error that grows as FMR falls. First, we audit train-test overlap with a detector calibrated against a null distribution (rather than a hand-tuned threshold). Relative to WebFace42M, we flag 88.6% of MS1MV3 identities and 14.3% of IJB-C subjects as present, despite WebFace260M's published de-overlap explicitly naming IJB-C. Manual review of 100 flagged IJB-C subjects confirms 69.2%, implying a residual overlap of roughly 9.9%. Second, holding the model fixed, removing only the contaminated identities from the test set increases FNMR by 3.6$\times$ at FMR=$10^{-4}$, 6.3$\times$ at FMR=$10^{-5}$, and 13.9$\times$ at FMR=$10^{-6}$, while a same-size random removal does not. The effect is traced to a shorter impostor tail that lowers the threshold. The magnitude of the shift depends on the training corpus and does not cancel betweent margin between our model and a publicbaseline by half. Third, we give the first direct measurement of the effective number of independent impostor comparisons in IJB-C: only 2.7 million effectively independent comparisons at FMR=$10^{-6}$, which is below all commonly accepted reporting rules. Finallyth a known training corpus, we build areal-face protocol with audited zero overlap that resolves FMR=$10^{-8}$.

AI.tldr: 论文指出人脸验证中训练-测试身份重叠导致评估偏差并非小幅固定值，而是随FMR下降而放大的乘性误差：在FMR=1e-6处误差达13.9倍。
AI.motivation: 主流基准（如MS1MV3、IJB-C）可能与模型训练语料（如WebFace42M）存在身份重叠，使得在低FMR（实际部署FMR≤1e-6）下报告的FNMR被乐观低估。此前工作仅用10折准确率的小幅加性变化衡量这一偏差，低估了其严重性。
AI.method: 1) 用基于零分布校准（而非手工阈值）的重叠检测器审计训练-测试重叠并对可疑身份做人工复核；2) 固定模型，仅从测试集中移除污染身份（与同规模随机移除对照）；3) 分析匹配分数分布与冒名者尾部及阈值变化；4) 直接测量IJB-C中有效独立冒名者比对数；5) 构建审计确认零重叠的真实人脸协议以解决FMR=1e-8。
AI.result: 相对WebFace42M，标记出88.6%的MS1MV3身份和14.3%的IJB-C受试者存在（人工复核100名中确认69.2%，估计残余重叠约9.9%）；移除污染身份后FNMR在FMR=1e-4/1e-5/1e-6分别增加3.6×/6.3×/13.9×，随机移除无此效应；该效应源于冒名者尾部缩短导致阈值下降；FMR=1e-6时IJB-C仅约270万有效独立比较，低于常见报告规则；此偏差还会将与基线模型的差距缩小一半。
AI.conclusion: 训练-测试重叠带来的乐观偏差是随FMR降低而放大的乘性误差，会严重扭曲低FMR下的性能报告并改变模型间比较结论；需用零分布校准的重叠审计、有效独立比较数量评估，以及零重叠的真实人脸协议来保证可信评估。

title: Agentic AI for Intent Management and Control in Autonomous Communication Networks
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Communications Magazine
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven automation will help future mobile networks translate high-level network intents into concrete network optimization or control actions. However, existing approaches often focus on intent management and orchestration, leaving the adaptation of underlying network optimization and control functions largely unaddressed. This article proposes a triadic agentic AI framework that co-designs intent management and intent fulfillment through three agents: an interpreter, powered by a language model, that translates and refines intents into machine-readable optimization templates; an optimizer that adapts controller policies to intent specifications; and a controller that performs fast decision-making. We discuss the design space of each agent and how the workflow can be embedded across network architectural domains. Finally, we develop a concrete realization combining a language-model interpreter with Bayesian optimization for the optimizer and multi-objective reinforcement learning for the controller, and evaluate it in a radio resource management case study for differentiated connectivity. Results demonstrate how the agentic AI framework can connect high-level intents with runtime network control, showing adaptability of intent specifications and control policies to service requirements and changing network conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个由“解释器—优化器—控制器”组成的三元智能体AI框架，将高层网络意图直接贯通到网络优化与控制，并通过语言模型+贝叶斯优化+多目标强化学习在无线资源管理场景中验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有意图驱动网络研究多集中在意图管理与编排层面，对底层网络优化与控制功能如何随意图自适应调整仍缺乏处理，导致高层意图与运行时控制之间存在断层。
AI.method: 提出三元智能体框架：由语言模型驱动的解释器将意图翻译并细化为机器可读的优化模板；优化器据此调整控制器策略；控制器执行快速决策。论文讨论各智能体的设计空间及跨网络架构域的工作流嵌入，并给出具体实现：语言模型解释器、贝叶斯优化作为优化器、多目标强化学习作为控制器，在差异化连接的无线资源管理案例中进行评估。
AI.result: 案例研究表明，该框架能够把高层意图与运行时网络控制连接起来，意图规格与控制策略可随服务需求和网络条件变化而自适应调整。
AI.conclusion: 协同设计意图管理与意图履行的三元智能体AI框架可弥合意图与底层控制之间的鸿沟，为意图驱动移动网络的端到端自动化提供了可行路径。

title: SuperFine3D: Efficient Global-Local Recursive Refinement for Extremely Detailed 3D Geometry Generation
summary: High-resolution images contain rich visual details that require fine geometric structures for faithful 3D reconstruction. However, generating extremely detailed 3D geometry from images requires substantial computational resources and training data, making high-resolution geometry generation challenging for existing state-of-the-art models. In this paper, we present SuperFine3D, an efficient framework for generating extremely detailed 3D geometry through global-local recursive refinement. SuperFine3D learns a shared refinement operator from paired coarse-to-fine representations and recursively reuses it to progressively synthesize finer geometry beyond the training resolutions, without requiring additional paired supervision at target resolutions. To make recursive refinement computationally efficient, we introduce spatial-cell attention, which restricts high-resolution interactions to local spatial neighborhoods while maintaining bounded communication across neighboring cells. We further propose spatially anchored cross-scale guidance, which leverages globally contextualized coarse geometry to guide local detail synthesis and preserve structural consistency. In addition, geometry-aware training objectives encourage the refinement process to preserve stable geometric structures while introducing fine-grained surface details. Experiments demonstrate that SuperFine3D generates geometry at a $4096^3$ decoder-grid resolution, corresponding to a sparse $256^3$ latent lattice, using a shared refinement operator trained only on $512^3$--$1024^3$ representations. Compared with a full-attention recursive baseline, SuperFine3D achieves a $9.4\times$ speedup in end-to-end inference and reduces peak GPU memory usage by $23.0\%$, while improving cross-scale structural consistency and producing cleaner surfaces with finer geometric details.

AI.tldr: 提出SuperFine3D，通过全局-局部递归精化，用仅在512³–1024³上训练的共享精化算子外推到4096³几何生成，并显著提速省显存。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像含丰富细节，重建需细粒度几何结构，但从图像生成极高细节3D几何需要大量算力与训练数据，现有SOTA模型难以做到高分辨率几何生成。
AI.method: 从粗到细配对表示中学习共享精化算子并递归复用，逐步合成超出训练分辨率的更细几何，无需目标分辨率配对监督；引入空间单元注意力，将高分辨交互限制在局部邻域并在相邻单元间保持有界通信；提出空间锚定的跨尺度引导，用全局上下文化的粗几何指导局部细节合成并保持结构一致；设计几何感知训练目标，在引入细节的同时保持稳定几何结构。
AI.result: 在4096³解码网格（对应稀疏256³潜格）生成几何，精化算子仅在512³–1024³表示上训练；相比全注意力递归基线，端到端推理提速9.4倍，峰值GPU显存降低23.0%，并改善跨尺度结构一致性，表面更干净、细节更细。
AI.conclusion: 递归复用共享精化算子可将高分辨率3D几何生成外推到训练分辨率之外，结合局部注意力和跨尺度引导可兼顾效率、显存与结构一致性，为超高分辨率几何生成提供可行高效方案。

title: How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
summary: Understanding how genetic perturbations affect cellular behaviour is essential for studying gene function and regulatory mechanisms. Large-scale CRISPR screens measure these effects across thousands of genes, but cover relatively few cellular contexts. Predicting perturbation responses in unseen cell types and identifying perturbed genes from their transcriptional effects therefore remain challenging. Here, we show that both tasks can be addressed through a common linear decomposition of transcriptional responses into shared and perturbation-specific components. Building on this principle, we introduce BiPert, a simple linear framework for both forward perturbation prediction and inverse identification. For forward prediction, BiPert outperforms existing methods that use no external biological knowledge when predicting gene expression changes in unseen cell lines. Its few-shot extension, BiPert-FS, adapts to new cell lines using as few as ten measured perturbations. For inverse identification, BiPert-ID identifies perturbed genes from single-cell expression profiles, outperforming deep-learning methods in unseen cell lines and donors. We further show that perturbations whose effects transfer more consistently across cellular contexts are also easier to identify, even after controlling for perturbation effect size. Together, these results establish a connection between perturbation transfer and identification, and demonstrate that simple linear models provide strong, interpretable baselines for both tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出BiPert线性框架，将转录响应分解为共享与扰动特异的成分，统一解决正向扰动预测与逆向扰动识别两个任务，并在未见细胞系/供体上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大规模CRISPR筛选虽能测量数千基因的扰动效应，但覆盖的细胞背景很少，导致在未见细胞类型中预测扰动响应、以及从转录效应反推扰动基因都很困难。
AI.method: 基于转录响应可由"共享成分+扰动特异成分"线性分解的原则，构建简单线性框架BiPert：正向预测模块及少样本扩展BiPert-FS（仅需10个实测扰动即可适配新细胞系），逆向识别模块BiPert-ID（从单细胞表达谱识别被扰动基因）。
AI.result: 正向预测在未见细胞系上优于不使用外部生物学知识的方法；BiPert-FS用极少样本即可适配；BiPert-ID在未见细胞系和供体上优于深度学习方法。此外发现，扰动效应跨背景迁移性越强，其可识别性越高，且该结论在控制效应大小后依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 建立了扰动迁移性与可识别性之间的联系，表明简单线性模型可作为两个任务上强而可解释的基线。

title: PROPS: Can Visual Generators Keep the Current Look of a Prop?
summary: Many generation tasks draw the next image from a visual history, such as storyboards, illustrated stories and multi-turn editing. A new request often states what happens next without restating how earlier objects look. Instead of recovering an object's current look from the history, generators often redraw it from the request alone or bring back an outdated look, and the error can carry into later steps. We call this failure prop drift. Existing evaluations rarely isolate it, because similarity to the history rewards copying and a judge that sees a single history cannot tell a look recovered from that history from one the generator happens to prefer. We introduce PROPS, a benchmark of 2,257 pairs of twin histories that end on the same request but show one prop in two different looks. A pair passes only if the generator draws the matching look on each side and carries out the request, so a look preferred by the generator or the judge passes at most one side. All 34 open and closed systems we test show prop drift, and even systems that carry out the requested action on most sides often lose the current look of the prop. Swapping the planners and editors of agents further shows that both history understanding and image generation limit agent performance. We also build PROPS-Train, 80,250 training chains in four tracks whose targets recover an earlier state or carry scripted changes forward, and fine-tuning on it clearly improves all four tested models. Both datasets will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并定义"prop drift"（道具漂移）这一生成失败模式，发布双历史配对基准 PROPS 与训练集 PROPS-Train，揭示全部34个系统均存在该问题，并证明微调可缓解。
AI.motivation: 故事板、绘本、多轮图像编辑等任务需从视觉历史中生成下一张图。新请求通常只说明"接下来发生什么"，不重述早期物体外观。但生成器往往直接按请求重画物体，或回溯到过时外观，且错误会累积传播。现有评测难以隔离该问题：与历史相似度会奖励照抄，而单条历史下的评判器无法区分"从历史恢复的外观"与"生成器恰好偏好的外观"。
AI.method: 构建 PROPS 基准：2,257 对"孪生历史"，两条历史以相同请求结尾，但其中某个道具呈现两种不同外观。配对通过需同时满足两侧各自画出匹配外观且完成请求，因此被生成器或评判器偏好的外观最多只能通过一侧。另构建 PROPS-Train：80,250 条训练链，四条轨道，目标为恢复早期状态或延续脚本化变化，用于微调。
AI.result: 测试的全部 34 个开源与闭源系统均出现 prop drift；即使多数情形能完成所请求动作的系统，也常丢失道具当前外观。交换智能体的规划器与编辑器表明，历史理解与图像生成共同限制智能体性能。在 PROPS-Train 上微调后，四个测试模型均明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 道具漂移是多模态生成系统的普遍缺陷，需用孪生历史配对评测才能真正隔离；该缺陷同时源于历史理解与生成能力，可通过针对性训练数据有效缓解。两个数据集将公开。

title: DeclareViT: Decoupling Early Classification from Feature Refinement with Exit Query for Efficient ViTs
summary: Vision Transformers achieve remarkable recognition performance but incur substantial computational cost during inference, limiting their use in latency- and compute-constrained deployment scenarios. Early-exit inference offers a promising solution by allowing easy samples to terminate at intermediate layers. However, existing approaches typically couple early classification with the shared backbone, requiring intermediate representations to support both early classification and subsequent feature refinement. Under joint training, the corresponding optimization objectives jointly update shared backbone parameters, which can lead to conflicting gradient directions. Motivated by this observation, we introduce DeclareViT, a framework that decouples early classification from feature refinement. Each exit uses a dedicated query to read intermediate features through one-way cross-attention without modifying the backbone token stream. The query branches are optimized for early classification while the backbone and final classifier remain frozen. Across ViT, DeiT, and Swin on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-1K, and Food-101, DeclareViT consistently establishes a state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-off: It achieves 1.58 times to 2.57 times multiply-accumulate (MAC)-based speed-up with only a 0.39-1.91 percentage-point accuracy drop. Wall-clock measurements on CPU and GPU further demonstrate practical inference acceleration. Code is available at https://github.com/TUDa-HWAI/DeclareViT.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeclareViT，将早退分类与特征细化解耦：每个出口用专用 query 经单向交叉注意力读取中间特征，且仅训练 query 分支、冻结骨干与最终分类器，在 ViT/DeiT/Swin 上取得 SOTA 的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: ViT 推理开销大，早退推理可让简单样本在中间层退出；但现有方法把早分类与共享骨干耦合，中间表示既要支持早分类又要支持后续特征细化，联合训练使优化目标共同更新共享参数，导致梯度方向冲突。
AI.method: DeclareViT 框架：每个出口使用独立的 query，通过单向交叉注意力读取中间特征，不修改骨干的 token 流；query 分支专门优化早分类目标，而骨干与最终分类器保持冻结，从而实现早分类与特征细化的解耦。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-1K、Food-101 上，针对 ViT、DeiT、Swin 均一致取得最优精度-效率权衡：基于 MAC 加速 1.58–2.57 倍，精度仅下降 0.39–1.91 个百分点；CPU 与 GPU 的墙钟时间测试也验证了实际推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过在冻结骨干上添加专用 query 分支，可避免早分类与特征细化的梯度冲突，是一种简单有效、具实际部署价值的 ViT 早退推理方案。

title: Ref2Light: From One Image to Interactive Glasses-Free 3D Characters
summary: Animating character illustrations on light-field displays demands coherent binocular parallax, real-time pose articulation, and fine-grained expression control. However, existing 2D animation and 3D reconstruction pipelines cannot combine these with rapid character switching. We present Ref2Light, a feed-forward framework that maps a single A-pose illustration and continuous pose and expression controls to display-native light-field animation, without per-character 3D reconstruction, rigging, or test-time optimization. Our key insight is to decompose light-field synthesis into static identity, view-dependent parallax, and control-driven articulation. A shared encoder caches multi-scale identity features once per character for rapid switching. A conditional decoder then synthesizes ordered angular anchors from these features via backward texture transport and direct color synthesis. A global-local control scheme deforms the anchors with head-body controls and uses the updated correspondence fields to track facial regions across views for masked local facial refinement. Finally, calibrated differentiable subpixel interlacing converts the anchors into the native panel raster, enabling end-to-end native supervision without rendering all views at full resolution. On held-out VRoid identities, Ref2Light reduces head-body LPIPS by 20.1%-55.6% over 2D and 3D baselines and lowers non-target change MAE in mouth closure by 95.6%-96.5% versus monolithic decoding, while running at 34.0-40.1 FPS for 1440x2560 native rasters on a consumer GPU. Code and demo are in the Supplementary Material.

AI.tldr: Ref2Light 是一个前馈框架，可将单张 A-pose 角色插画与连续姿态/表情控制直接映射为光场显示器原生动画，无需逐角色 3D 重建、绑骨或测试时优化。
AI.motivation: 光场显示上的角色动画需要一致的双目视差、实时姿态关节运动和细粒度表情控制，且要支持快速切换角色；现有 2D 动画与 3D 重建流程无法同时满足这些要求。
AI.method: 将光场合成分解为静态身份、视角相关视差和控制驱动关节三部分：共享编码器为每个角色缓存一次多尺度身份特征以支持快速切换；条件解码器通过反向纹理传输与直接颜色合成生成有序角度锚点；全局-局部控制方案用头身控制变形锚点，并利用更新后的对应场跨视角追踪面部区域做掩码局部表情细化；最后用标定的可微亚像素交织转成面板原生栅格，实现端到端原生监督。
AI.result: 在留出 VRoid 角色上，头身 LPIPS 相比 2D 与 3D 基线降低 20.1%–55.6%；嘴部闭合的非目标变化 MAE 相比单体解码降低 95.6%–96.5%；消费级 GPU 上以 34.0–40.1 FPS 生成 1440×2560 原生栅格。
AI.conclusion: Ref2Light 通过身份/视差/关节分解与原生交织监督，在保证实时性与快速角色切换的同时显著提升光场角色动画的视差一致性和局部表情可控性。

title: HandiVid: A High-Quality Dataset for Hand-Driven Interactive Video Generation
summary: Hand-driven egocentric interactive video generation aims to generate dynamic scenes with realistic interaction responses conditioned on hand movements and camera motion. However, existing egocentric video datasets struggle to provide scene diversity, meaningful hand-object interactions, and reliable motion annotations simultaneously. To address these limitations, we introduce HandiVid, a high-quality dataset comprising 200K curated and annotated egocentric interaction video clips for hand-driven interactive video generation. We develop a unified data processing pipeline that integrates public datasets, online videos and synthetic videos. Through video quality assessment, hand detection filtering, and multi-stage interaction validation using vision-language models (VLMs), we select high-quality video clips with meaningful hand-object interactions. Since 3D hand reconstruction relies on initial hand detections, we integrate SAM 3 into the hand detection pipeline to reduce missed detections and improve the completeness of 3D hand annotations. Each video clip is provided with high-quality hand renderings, camera trajectories, and interaction descriptions. Comprehensive dataset analysis and downstream video generation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of HandiVid in terms of data diversity, annotation quality, and controllable video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 HandiVid，一个包含 20 万条高质量自我中心手-物交互视频片段的数据集，配有手部渲染、相机轨迹与交互描述，用于手驱动交互视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心视频数据集难以同时提供场景多样性、有意义的手-物交互和可靠运动标注，限制了手驱动交互视频生成任务的发展。
AI.method: 构建统一数据处理管线，整合公开数据集、网络视频与合成视频；经视频质量评估、手部检测过滤和基于 VLM 的多阶段交互验证筛选高质量片段；将 SAM 3 引入手部检测以降低漏检、提升 3D 手部标注完整性。
AI.result: 数据集分析与下游视频生成实验表明，HandiVid 在数据多样性、标注质量和可控视频生成方面均有效。
AI.conclusion: HandiVid 为手驱动自我中心交互视频生成提供了兼具多样性、交互语义与可靠运动标注的数据基础，支撑高质量可控生成。

title: UniDR: Learning To Generate Anatomical Deformations From Images via Unified Diffusion Modeling and Registration
summary: This paper presents a novel framework, Unified Diffusion modeling and Registration (UniDR), which learns to generate arbitrary anatomical deformations from images with preserved topology. Existing approaches often model the generative process separately from registration-based deformation estimation; hence making them prone to propagated errors from the registration stage. To address this limitation, we propose a unified paradigm based on a conditional diffusion model over deformation fields that are jointly optimized from the registration process. A principled registration-guided score-matching objective function is then introduced to align the diffusion process with the deformation distribution induced by registration. As a result, our UniDR establishes an explicit connection between generation and registration: the diffusion model enables exploration of the space of plausible anatomical deformations, whereas registration provides structured supervision for learning transformations consistent with observed images. Once trained, UniDR is able to sample diverse, anatomically plausible transformations conditioned on any single input image. We evaluate UniDR across multiple real-world applications and demonstrate its effectiveness in generating high-fidelity image samples compared to the state-of-the-art. Additionally, we demonstrate that these generated samples improve performance in downstream medical image analysis and vision tasks.

AI.tldr: UniDR将扩散生成与配准统一在同一范式下，直接从图像学习保拓扑的任意解剖形变。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将生成过程与基于配准的形变估计分开建模，易导致配准阶段误差逐级传播。
AI.method: 提出基于形变场条件扩散模型的统一框架，形变场与配准过程联合优化；引入配准引导的score-matching目标，使扩散过程对齐配准诱导的形变分布，从而建立生成与配准的显式联系。
AI.result: 在多个真实应用中评估，生成高保真图像样本优于现有SOTA；所生成样本还能提升下游医学图像分析与视觉任务性能。
AI.conclusion: UniDR可在给定单张输入图像时采样多样且解剖合理的形变，验证了生成与配准统一建模的有效性。

title: ApexID: Hierarchical Learning for Multi-Species Animal Re-Identification
summary: Animal re-identification (Re-ID) must distinguish individuals across species and capture conditions. We introduce ApexID, a hierarchical SphereFace2-based loss that integrates global identity discrimination with balanced animal-category supervision. Using 132,533 images curated from 19 public datasets, we evaluate three model families and four objectives on four external datasets with observation-aware retrieval protocols. ApexID achieves a dataset-averaged Rank-1 accuracy of 64.89% with ConvNeXt-Small and an mAP of 32.54% with MIEW-ID, outperforming their pretrained reference models. On elephants, a category absent from animal Re-ID training, our ConvNeXt-Small variant achieves the highest retrieval performance among the fourteen evaluated configurations. Scores vary by backbone and dataset, and open-set evaluation reveals remaining discovery challenges. These findings support hierarchical category-identity learning to improve transfer to unseen datasets and species.

AI.tldr: 提出ApexID——一种分层SphereFace2损失的动物重识别方法，结合全局身份判别与平衡的动物类别监督，在132,533张图像上训练，显著提升跨数据集与跨物种检索性能。
AI.motivation: 动物重识别需在跨物种、跨拍摄条件下区分个体，现有方法在迁移到未见数据集和物种（如大象）时表现不足，缺乏对类别层级信息的有效利用。
AI.method: 构建分层SphereFace2损失（ApexID），将全局身份判别与动物类别监督结合；使用19个公开数据集共132,533张图像，评估3类模型家族与4种目标函数，并在4个外部数据集上采用观测感知的检索协议进行测试。
AI.result: ConvNeXt-Small配合ApexID取得数据集平均Rank-1 64.89%，MIEW-ID取得mAP 32.54%，均超过其预训练参考模型；在训练中未出现的大象类别上，ConvNeXt-Small变体在14种配置中检索性能最佳。
AI.conclusion: 分层类别-身份学习有助于提升对未见数据集与物种的迁移能力；但性能受骨干网络与数据集影响，开放集评估显示个体发现仍具挑战。

title: Reasoning Beyond Imitation: Observation Conditioned Distillation for Video LLMs
summary: Reasoning distillation offers a promising approach to transfer temporal reasoning capabilities of powerful Video-LLMs to open-source student models. However, teacher and student Video-LLMs may construct different temporal observations from the same video due to the adoption of distinct video sampling pipelines. A reasoning trajectory valid under the teacher's observations may rely on evidence inaccessible to the student and thus cannot be directly executed based on the student's observations. We formalize this as a conditional target mismatch, thereby revealing the Reasoning Acquisition-Execution Gap. To bridge this gap, we propose an acquisition-to-execution framework that first distills teacher trajectories into a student reasoning prior and then further optimizes the execution capability of this prior across multiple observations. We further introduce Execution-Aware Reference Regularization, which retains the existing prior when it is executable under current observations, while allowing a greater degree of adaptive adjustment when it is not. Experiments across multiple Video-LLM backbones and six video reasoning benchmarks show that explicitly optimizing observation-conditioned execution consistently outperforms supervised distillation and standard RL-based optimization, with gains extending to held-out out-of-domain benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文指出视频推理蒸馏中教师与学生因采样管线不同导致"条件目标不匹配"，提出"获取-执行"两阶段框架与执行感知参考正则化来弥合推理获取-执行鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 强Video-LLM的时序推理能力需蒸馏给开源学生模型，但二者视频采样管线不同，构建的时序观测不同；在教师观测下有效的推理轨迹可能依赖学生无法获取的证据，无法直接执行。作者将此形式化为条件目标不匹配，即"推理获取-执行鸿沟"。
AI.method: 提出获取到执行（acquisition-to-execution）框架：先将教师推理轨迹蒸馏为学生推理先验，再在多种观测下优化该先验的执行能力；并引入执行感知参考正则化（Execution-Aware Reference Regularization），当先验在当前观测下可执行时保留先验，不可执行时允许更大的自适应调整。
AI.result: 在多种Video-LLM骨干和六个视频推理基准上，显式优化以观测为条件的执行持续优于监督蒸馏和标准RL优化，且增益可泛化到留出的域外基准。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并优化观测条件下的推理执行是弥补教师-学生观测差异、提升视频推理蒸馏效果的有效途径，且具备良好的跨模型与跨域泛化性。

title: Seeing Beyond Names: Image-Grounded Concept Linking for Robust Vision-Language Recognition
summary: A zero-shot vision-language classifier is highly sensitive to the class names it receives. Even when images remain unchanged, replacing familiar labels with synonyms, abbreviations, or ontology terms can significantly alter predictions. We investigate this \emph{vocabulary shift} using a leakage-free evaluation protocol across Tiny ImageNet, ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, and ImageNetV2. With CLIP ViT-B/16, alternative class names reduce top-1 accuracy by $14.8$--$17.6$ percentage points. To address this issue, we propose \emph{image-grounded concept linking}, a training-free method that maps class names to visual concepts and uses a reliability gate to improve predictions. The method outperforms a template ensemble across all four datasets, achieving a pooled gain of $1.8$ points. We further evaluate five vision-language backbones across four datasets. Our method improves performance in $16$ of $20$ backbone--dataset combinations, with no significantly negative results. It also reduces pooled negative log-likelihood across all five backbones. Stronger text linking and transductive refinement provide no consistent improvements, suggesting that accurate visual class-name linking remains the main challenge. A second CLIP ViT-B/16 seed confirms the improvement on ImageNetV2, but not on ImageNet-A.

AI.tldr: 零样本视觉语言分类器对类别名称高度敏感，作者提出无需训练的"图像接地概念链接"方法，通过将类别名映射到视觉概念并用可靠性门控改善预测，在多种骨干和数据集上取得平均1.8个点的提升。
AI.motivation: CLIP等零样本分类器即使图像不变，仅将熟悉标签替换为同义词、缩写或本体术语就会显著改变预测（词汇迁移问题），在无泄漏评估下CLIP ViT-B/16的top-1准确率下降14.8–17.6个百分点，亟需缓解这一脆弱性。
AI.method: 提出image-grounded concept linking：一种免训练方法，先把类别名称映射为视觉概念，再用可靠性门控（reliability gate）来修正/改进预测；在Tiny ImageNet、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-A、ImageNetV2上用无泄漏协议评估，并跨5种视觉语言骨干、4个数据集进行验证，同时测试更强的文本链接与直推式细化。
AI.result: 方法在四个数据集上均优于模板集成，合并增益1.8点；20个骨干—数据集组合中16个有改善且无显著负面结果；五个骨干的合并负对数似然均降低。更强的文本链接与直推式细化无一致提升。第二个CLIP ViT-B/16种子在ImageNetV2上复现提升，但ImageNet-A上未复现。
AI.conclusion: 类别名到视觉概念的准确链接仍是主要挑战；图像接地概念链接能稳健缓解词汇迁移，但结果存在一定种子/数据集依赖，未来应聚焦更精准的视觉—名称链接。

title: MISeg-Agent: A Human-in-the-Loop Agentic Framework for Error Diagnosis and Executable Prompt Review in 3D Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Despite the strong performance of modern medical image segmentation models, their predictions can still contain localized errors that compromise segmentation quality. Identifying and correcting these errors is therefore essential for improving the reliability of existing segmentation results. While interactive segmentation models enable targeted corrections, identifying potential errors, determining where to intervene, and evaluating corrective actions remain challenging. Moreover, each correction changes the current mask, requiring subsequent error diagnosis and recommendations to adapt accordingly. To address these challenges, we propose MISeg-Agent, a human-in-the-loop agentic framework that diagnoses segmentation errors and provides evidence-based correction recommendations. MISeg-Agent first selects a suitable pretrained segmentation model based on benchmark performance and computational requirements. Given its predicted mask, the framework identifies potential missing and excess foreground regions and recommends suspicious slices and corrective points for review. The framework then evaluates candidate point prompts using an interactive segmentation model and presents the resulting corrections for human verification before applying them. By operating directly on images and predicted masks, the error diagnosis process remains independent of the underlying segmentation model architecture. Evaluations on CT datasets demonstrate that MISeg-Agent improves initial segmentation results and produces final masks closely aligned with reference annotations. By integrating adaptive error diagnosis with validated correction recommendations, MISeg-Agent provides an interpretable approach to identifying and reducing residual errors in existing medical image segmentations.

AI.tldr: 提出MISeg-Agent，一个human-in-the-loop智能体框架，用于诊断医学图像分割错误并提供基于证据的修正建议。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割模型预测仍存在局部错误，需识别与修正以提升可靠性；交互式分割虽能修正，但错误定位、干预点确定与修正成效评估仍困难，且每次修正都会改变掩码，需诊断随之自适应。
AI.method: 框架先依据基准性能与算力需求选择预训练分割模型；基于其预测掩码识别潜在缺失/多余前景区域，推荐可疑切片与修正点；再用交互式分割模型评估候选点提示，将修正结果交人工核验后再应用。全程直接作用于图像与掩码，诊断与模型架构无关。
AI.result: 在CT数据集上，MISeg-Agent改善了初始分割结果，最终掩码与参考标注高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应错误诊断与经验证的修正建议相结合，MISeg-Agent为识别与减少医学分割残余错误提供了可解释的途径。

title: DREAM: Dual-Memory Reasoning for Anticipatory 3D Perception in Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving systems must not only interpret the current scene but also anticipate perceptual challenges such as occlusions, sparse observations, and recurring failure patterns. However, most existing LiDAR semantic segmentation methods operate in a frame-centric manner, processing each scan independently and discarding past contextual experience, which limits robustness under dynamic scene changes. We propose DREAM, a Dual-memory REAsoning framework for continual LiDAR seMantic segmentation that reframes perception as an experience-driven and anticipatory process. DREAM maintains two complementary memory banks in a strictly online setting: a latent memory that stores compact semantic abstractions of previously observed scenes, and an error memory that records representations associated with uncertain predictions. At each timestep, relevant memory entries are retrieved via cosine similarity and integrated into the feature space through a lightweight modulation mechanism, enabling the model to reinforce consistent semantic patterns while suppressing recurring failure modes. The backbone remains frozen and no past scans are replayed, ensuring computational efficiency and bounded memory growth. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale LiDAR benchmarks demonstrate that DREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with consistent improvements on dynamic and small-scale objects, highlighting the effectiveness of persistent and error-aware memory for robust long-horizon perception.

AI.tldr: DREAM 提出双记忆推理框架，把 LiDAR 语义分割从"逐帧独立处理"改为"经验驱动、可预判"的在线持续感知：用潜在记忆存语义抽象、误差记忆存不确定预测表征，检索后轻量调制特征，主干冻结、不回放历史扫描。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需预判遮挡、稀疏观测与重复性失效模式，但现有 LiDAR 语义分割多为 frame-centric，每帧独立处理并丢弃历史上下文，动态场景下鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: 严格在线设置下维护两个互补记忆库：latent memory 存储既往场景的紧凑语义抽象，error memory 记录与不确定预测相关的表征；每步用余弦相似度检索相关条目，通过轻量调制机制融入特征空间，以强化一致语义模式、抑制重复失效模式；主干冻结，不回放历史扫描，内存增长有界。
AI.result: 在多个大规模 LiDAR 基准上取得 SOTA，在动态目标与小尺度目标上均有稳定提升，验证了持久化、误差感知记忆对长时序鲁棒感知的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DREAM 表明将记忆与误差反馈引入在线感知，可在无需重训练与回放的条件下显著提升长时序 LiDAR 语义分割的鲁棒性与效率。

title: DictaRashi: A State-of-the-Art OCR Model For Rashi Script
summary: We release DictaRashi, a Tesseract OCR model for scanned Hebrew books printed in the so-called "Rashi" font. We trained DictaRashi on over one million manually corrected lines of text from over 100 different books of Rabbinic and post-Rabbinic literature. On a held-out set of 1,120 manually transcribed lines from scanned Rashi-script pages, DictaRashi reaches a character error rate (CER) of 0.86% and a word error rate (WER) of 3.38%, setting a new state-of-the-art for publicly-available Tesseract models. We provide a full comparison of our results to those of the 31 other publicly available Hebrew Tesseract models; the best of those models achieves a 2.98% CER and 11.86% WER. We further demonstrate that DictaRashi outperforms the current frontier LLMs on this OCR task. We release the test set of Rashi-script documents so that it may be used as a benchmark for future work in this area. We are pleased to release the model and test set to the community under a CC BY NC 4.0 license.

AI.tldr: DictaRashi 是一个面向"Rashi"字体希伯来古籍扫描件的 Tesseract OCR 模型，CER 0.86%、WER 3.38%，超越现有公开模型与前沿 LLM，并公开模型与测试集。
AI.motivation: Rashi 字体希伯来古籍印刷体缺乏高质量 OCR 方案，现有公开希伯来 Tesseract 模型在该字体上表现不佳。
AI.method: 基于 Tesseract 训练，使用来自 100 多本拉比文献、逾一百万行人工校正文本作为训练数据；在 1,120 行人工转录的 Rashi 字体测试集上评测，并与 31 个公开希伯来 Tesseract 模型及前沿 LLM 对比。
AI.result: CER 0.86%、WER 3.38%；最佳对比模型为 2.98% CER / 11.86% WER；性能优于前沿大语言模型。
AI.conclusion: DictaRashi 刷新公开 Tesseract 模型的最优水平，并以 CC BY NC 4.0 许可公开模型与测试集，供社区作为基准使用。

title: CivicBench: Robust Detection of AI-Generated Political Video
summary: AI-generated video of politicians can pass for real footage, and once such fakes are common, real footage can be dismissed as fake. Platforms address both problems with detectors, but whoever uploads a clip controls its pixels. Existing datasets of political video are small, show real politicians, and test no attacks. We introduce CivicBench, with 10,800 generated clips of invented politicians from eight open generators and 2,632 public-domain or openly licensed real clips. Each clip can be attacked, to hide a fake or to frame real footage. Published detectors trained on a general benchmark reach at most .781 AUC on CivicBench. Adversarial changes of 1 gray level per pixel hide nearly every generated clip from the detectors not built to resist attacks. An attack's reach is how far it can move a clip's score. A clip keeps its label when its margin from the threshold exceeds this reach, and we find that the reach grows almost linearly with the budget. On this basis, we propose Tau-Anchor, which fine-tunes an encoder pretrained on attacked images. It attacks real and generated clips during training and adds a margin term at its deployed threshold. It reaches .941 AUC on CivicBench. It also keeps .668 of generated clips flagged at 2 gray levels, against at most .289 for published detectors. When real clips are framed at the same 2 gray levels, Tau-Anchor's false alarms rise only from 8% to 14%, whereas four published detectors flag nearly every framed real clip at just 1 gray level. External political footage and two general benchmarks show the same pattern under attack. Code and data are available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/CivicBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CivicBench 政治视频真伪检测基准，并给出抗攻击检测器 Tau-Anchor。
AI.motivation: AI 生成的政治人物视频难辨真伪，真实视频也可能被诬为伪造；但现有政治视频数据集规模小、只用真实政客、且不测试攻击。
AI.method: 构建 CivicBench：10,800 条由 8 个开源生成器合成的虚构政客片段 + 2,632 条公共领域/开放许可真实片段，每条均可施加攻击（隐藏伪造或诬陷真实）。提出“攻击触及范围”分析：标签在样本距阈值余量大于触及范围时保持不变，触及范围随预算近乎线性增长。据此提出 Tau-Anchor：微调在受攻击图像上预训练的编码器，训练时同时攻击真实与生成片段，并在部署阈值处加入余量项。
AI.result: 通用基准训练的已发布检测器在 CivicBench 上 AUC 最高仅 .781；每像素改变 1 个灰阶即可让几乎所有生成片段逃过非抗攻击检测器。Tau-Anchor 达 .941 AUC；2 灰阶下仍保留 .668 的生成片段被标记（已发布检测器至多 .289）；真实片段被诬陷时误报仅由 8% 升至 14%，而四个已发布检测器在 1 灰阶即几乎全部误报。
AI.conclusion: 外部政治视频与两个通用基准在攻击下呈现相同规律，说明余量—触及范围框架与 Tau-Anchor 具有可推广性；代码与数据已公开。

title: S1Arena-MM: Which Multimodal Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
comment: 26 pages. Lang Lin, Tianyu Chen, Yi Gu, Yang Zhao, Xinran Song and Xinyang Liu contributed equally. Code and data: https://github.com/zhaoyang02/S1Arena-MM ; media: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Swindl/S1Arena-MM
summary: Perception systems often make discrete decisions: flag a hateful meme, predict whether a pedestrian will cross, detect a spoofed voice, or select the next move in a game. System-1 models, such as OneJev and Jev-Omni, read the media and return probabilities over the options in a single forward pass, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate text. Which multimodal decisions can System-1 models handle, and where do MLLMs perform better? We introduce S1Arena-MM, a benchmark that gives every model the same decision requests and scores the probabilities it returns. It contains 51,060 questions across 94 tasks with image, video, and audio input, drawn from 94 public datasets and three program-generated ones. It also includes 102 closed-loop game environments that a model plays from screenshots; in real-time mode, the game continues while the model decides. We evaluate 33 open models: 12 System-1 models and 21 MLLMs read at the answer token. On static decisions, the best System-1 model leads the best MLLM by 4.9 percentage points on images and is within one point of it on video and audio. Post-training for decisions mainly improves the probabilities: on video, a System-1 model has a lower Brier score than the MLLM that it is post-trained from in 10 of 12 pairs. With up to 2,048 thought tokens per question, the most accurate MLLMs pass the best System-1 models only slightly, and thinking raises the Brier score of most MLLMs. Closed loops separate the models: three System-1 models built on a 27B MLLM reach 22.0-33.3% progression in BALROG, and no other model exceeds 9.7% with thinking off. In real-time GameWorld, latencies of up to 1.1 s per decision cause no measurable loss of progress for System-1 models. Code and data: https://github.com/zhaoyang02/S1Arena-MM.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 S1Arena-MM 基准（51,060 题、94 任务、图文音多模态，含 102 个闭环游戏环境），统一评测 12 个 System-1 模型与 21 个 MLLM。结论：静态决策上 System-1 略优且概率校准更好，闭环/实时游戏中优势显著。
AI.motivation: 感知系统需要离散决策（判定仇恨模因、预测行人过街、检测伪造语音、游戏选动作）。System-1 模型单次前向输出选项概率，MLLM 则生成文本；两者能力边界与适用场景缺乏统一、可比的评测，尤其缺少闭环与实时约束下的对照。
AI.method: 构建 S1Arena-MM：统一决策请求与概率打分协议；94 个任务共 51,060 题，覆盖图像/视频/音频，来自 94 个公开数据集与 3 个程序生成数据集；102 个闭环游戏环境，模型从截图决策，含游戏在模型思考时继续运行的实时模式。评测 33 个开源模型（12 System-1、21 MLLM，均读答案 token 概率），并分析思维链 token 与 Brier 分数。
AI.result: 静态决策：最佳 System-1 在图像上领先最佳 MLLM 4.9 个百分点，视频与音频差距在 1 点内。决策后训练主要改善概率质量：视频上 12 对中有 10 对 System-1 的 Brier 分数优于其来源 MLLM。每问最多 2,048 thought token 时，最强 MLLM 仅略超最佳 System-1，且思考使多数 MLLM 的 Brier 分数变差。闭环任务差距明显：基于 27B MLLM 的三个 System-1 在 BALROG 达 22.0–33.3% 进度，其余模型（关闭思考）不超过 9.7%。实时 GameWorld 中，System-1 每步最多 1.1 s 延迟未造成可测的进度损失。
AI.conclusion: 在统一协议下，System-1 模型在离散感知决策上以概率质量与实时闭环表现为核心优势；MLLM 的生成式文本与思维链并未带来决策层面的显著增益，甚至损害校准。因此应根据任务形态（静态分类 vs 闭环实时）选择建模范式，而非默认 MLLM。

title: Beyond Language Optimization: Enhancing Visual Representations for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Accurate chest X-ray radiology report generation (RRG) requires recognizing clinically relevant abnormalities and accurately describing them. Although Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves the clinical accuracy of generated reports, our analyses suggest limited improvements in visual representations for abnormality recognition. To address this limitation, we propose a selective regional visual distillation framework that enhances visual representations of challenging abnormalities while preserving existing visual capabilities. Specifically, we train a region-aware teacher with targeted supervision on challenging anatomical regions to acquire complementary visual knowledge. Rather than transferring all teacher features, we verify their utility through regional feature replacement and select only those that improve the original student's performance. We further introduce a Spatially Gated Residual Adapter (SGRA) to distill these verified features while minimizing interference with the student's existing visual representations. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray demonstrate improved clinical report accuracy and region-level abnormality recognition across different multimodal large language model backbones, while largely preserving performance on non-target findings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种选择性区域视觉蒸馏框架，通过训练区域感知教师模型并筛选真正有益的教师特征，再用空间门控残差适配器（SGRA）蒸馏，提升胸片报告生成中困难异常识别的视觉表征。
AI.motivation: GRPO虽能提升生成报告的临床准确性，但对异常识别所需的视觉表征改进有限，因此需要针对性地增强困难异常的视觉表示，同时不损害已有能力。
AI.method: 1) 在困难解剖区域上做定向监督，训练区域感知教师模型以获得互补视觉知识；2) 通过区域特征替换验证教师特征的实用性，仅保留能提升原学生模型性能的特征；3) 提出空间门控残差适配器（SGRA）蒸馏这些经筛选的特征，最小化对学生原有表征的干扰。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray上，跨多种MLLM骨干均提升了临床报告准确性与区域级异常识别能力，且基本保持非目标征象的性能。
AI.conclusion: 选择性、经验证的区域视觉蒸馏可有效弥补GRPO在视觉表征上的不足，实现更精准的胸片报告生成。

title: A Cascaded Framework with a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN Model for Pre- and Post-Treatment Glioma Segmentation
summary: Accurate glioma segmentation is vital for diagnosis and follow-up, but manual segmentation is time-consuming, subjective, and variable across interpreters. Gliomas are heterogeneous in size, shape, and location. Deep learning has therefore emerged as a potential solution. CNNs excel at local features but may struggle with long-range dependencies, whereas Vision Transformers capture global context efficiently but incur higher computational complexity. Most previous studies focused on pre-treatment gliomas; post-treatment cases with resection cavities (RCs) remain less explored. This study proposes a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN (CMC-Seg) model within a cascaded framework for pre- and post-treatment diffuse glioma segmentation, aiming to balance accuracy and computational cost. Experiments used BraTS 2025 mpMRI of diffuse glioma patients. After preprocessing, a coarse segmentation model extracted tumor-centered patches, which were fed to CMC-Seg for fine-grained segmentation. CMC-Seg was compared with 3D U-Net, SegResNet, SwinUNETR, UNETR, nnFormer, and SegMamba. On the test set, CMC-Seg achieved the highest mean Dice (81.20%) and non-enhancing tumor core (NETC) Dice (77.09%). It also achieved an RC Dice of 78.63% and the lowest 95% Hausdorff distance (HD95; 4.39 mm). Results were comparable to CNN and Mamba baselines and significantly better than Transformer-based baselines (P < 0.05). CMC-Seg required the fewest inference GFLOPs (381.49). Ablation experiments indicated that multi-direction scanning and cross-attention improved performance, particularly for RC (P < 0.05). Grad-CAM explainability experiments showed that CMC-Seg focuses on diagnostically relevant tumor regions.

AI.tldr: 提出CMC-Seg（交叉注意力引导的Mamba-CNN）级联框架，用于胶质瘤术前与术后分割，在BraTS 2025上以最低推理GFLOPs取得最优Dice（81.20%）与HD95（4.39mm）。
AI.motivation: 胶质瘤手工分割耗时主观且一致性差；CNN擅长局部特征但缺乏长程依赖，ViT能捕捉全局上下文但计算复杂度高；且以往研究多针对术前胶质瘤，术后含切除腔（RC）的病例研究较少。
AI.method: 采用级联框架：预处理后由粗分割模型提取肿瘤中心patch，再输入CMC-Seg进行精细分割。CMC-Seg结合Mamba与CNN，并引入交叉注意力引导和多方向扫描模块。基于BraTS 2025 mpMRI数据，与3D U-Net、SegResNet、SwinUNETR、UNETR、nnFormer、SegMamba对比，并进行消融与Grad-CAM实验。
AI.result: 测试集上平均Dice最高（81.20%），NETC Dice 77.09%，RC Dice 78.63%，HD95最低（4.39mm）；推理GFLOPs最少（381.49）。与CNN和Mamba基线相当，显著优于Transformer基线（P<0.05）。消融显示多方向扫描与交叉注意力有效，尤其对RC提升显著（P<0.05）；Grad-CAM显示模型聚焦诊断相关肿瘤区域。
AI.conclusion: CMC-Seg在精度与计算成本间取得良好平衡，适用于术前和术后胶质瘤分割，尤其改善切除腔分割，并具备可解释性。

title: Revisiting RadioGalaxyNET: modern detectors for radio galaxy detection and host identification
summary: RadioGalaxyNET is the public benchmark for finding extended radio galaxies in EMU pilot-survey images, classifying them and locating their infrared hosts. Its best published results date from 2023: 54.5 box AP (Gal-YOLOv8) and 48.1 host keypoint AP (Gal-DINO). We train three current detectors, D-FINE-seg, YOLO26-pose and RF-DETR, on the same data and score them with the benchmark's own evaluation code, which reproduces the published Gal-DINO numbers exactly. All exceed the published results. D-FINE-seg M reaches 67.1 box AP and 72.4 host AP, 12.6 and 24.3 points above the best published results, and the highest host AP of the detectors we tested; on boxes it is level with YOLO26. Its host lead over YOLO26 comes from host-centered images, which make up most of the benchmark. End to end, D-FINE-seg S is the fastest model at 1.9 ms per image; engine against engine, YOLO26 is faster at the same size. We also report what matters for anyone using the benchmark: its scoring protocol adds 5 to 10 AP, its host labels sit at the image center, its box labels are offset from the image by 1.5 pixels, and its images can be rebuilt from the public survey data, which recovers sky positions and doubles as extra training data. We suggest that future work report host identification F1, as a measure closer to catalog use: D-FINE-seg M 71.8, YOLO26-pose M 70.5, RF-DETR 63.8, Gal-DINO 59.2.

AI.tldr: 在RadioGalaxyNET基准上训练D-FINE-seg、YOLO26-pose和RF-DETR三个新检测器，全部超过2023年发表的最好结果，D-FINE-seg M达到67.1 box AP和72.4 host AP；论文还揭示基准评测协议和标注中的多个问题。
AI.motivation: RadioGalaxyNET是EMU试点巡天图像中寻找延展射电星系、分类并定位红外宿主的公开基准，但其最好成绩仍停留在2023年（Gal-YOLOv8 54.5 box AP、Gal-DINO 48.1 host AP），缺乏对最新检测器的检验，且基准本身的使用细节尚未被充分记录。
AI.method: 在同一数据集上训练三个当代检测器D-FINE-seg、YOLO26-pose和RF-DETR，并使用基准自带的评测代码打分（该代码可精确复现已发表的Gal-DINO数值），同时分析评测协议、标注几何偏差、图像可重建性及端到端推理速度。
AI.result: 三个模型均超过已发表结果：D-FINE-seg M为67.1 box AP、72.4 host AP（分别高出12.6和24.3点），host AP最高，box AP与YOLO26持平；其host优势来自以宿主为中心的图像（占基准多数）。D-FINE-seg S端到端最快（1.9 ms/图），同尺寸下引擎对引擎比较YOLO26更快。宿主识别F1：D-FINE-seg M 71.8、YOLO26-pose M 70.5、RF-DETR 63.8、Gal-DINO 59.2。另发现：评测协议会使AP虚高5–10点、宿主标签位于图像中心、box标签相对图像偏移1.5像素、图像可由公开巡天数据重建并恢复天球位置以扩充训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 新检测器显著刷新了RadioGalaxyNET基准；建议未来工作报告更贴近星表使用的宿主识别F1，并注意基准评测协议与标注特性对结果的影响。

title: Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head for Tiny Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Real-time onboard robot control calls for a lightweight vision-language-action (VLA) model, yet shrinking the backbone leaves less capacity for deliberation at inference time. Chain-of-thought decoding, dual-system architectures, and larger backbones can restore deliberation but reintroduce the latency and memory costs that motivated going small. Recurrent action heads offer a lighter alternative by iterating in latent space before committing to an action, but existing designs refine a single undifferentiated state that must simultaneously encode slowly evolving task context and rapidly changing motor commands. We propose the Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head (HR-AH), which maintains two latent states updated at different frequencies: a low-level state that updates fast, grounded in action tokens and proprioception, and a high-level state that updates slowly, grounded in visual understanding and the instruction-informed low-level state. The two states exchange information through nested reasoning cycles. Because all iteration occurs in the compact head after a single backbone pass, HR-AH adds hierarchical reasoning without increasing the backbone size. With a 22.5M-parameter head, 3-4.3x smaller than those of RD-VLA and VLA-Adapter on the same backbone, HR-AH reaches 97.0% success rate on LIBERO and a 4.40 average chain length on CALVIN ABC->D, at the lowest latency among compared methods. We show that this hierarchy improves performance over a parameter-matched single-state head, and that routing distinct modalities to each level yields further gains in both accuracy and inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出分层推进行动头 HR-AH，用两种不同频率更新的潜状态分离慢变任务上下文与快变运动指令，在不增大主干的前提下实现轻量级分层推理。
AI.motivation: 实时机载机器人控制需要轻量 VLA 模型，但缩小主干会削弱推理能力；CoT 解码、双系统架构和更大主干虽能恢复推理，却重新引入延迟与内存开销。现有循环行动头虽轻量，但只精炼单一未分化状态，难以同时编码慢变任务上下文与快变运动指令。
AI.method: HR-AH 维护两个以不同频率更新的潜状态：低层状态快速更新，基于动作 token 与本体感知；高层状态缓慢更新，基于视觉理解与受指令引导的低层状态。两者通过嵌套推理循环交换信息，全部迭代发生在紧凑行动头内，主干仅前向一次。
AI.result: 行动头仅 22.5M 参数，比同主干的 RD-VLA 和 VLA-Adapter 小 3–4.3 倍；LIBERO 成功率 97.0%，CALVIN ABC->D 平均链长 4.40，在对比方法中延迟最低。相较参数匹配的单状态头性能更优，且将不同模态路由到不同层级可进一步提升精度并降低推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 以层次化潜状态代替单一状态的循环精炼，可在不增加主干规模与延迟的前提下为轻量 VLA 提供分层推理能力，且模态分层路由带来额外收益。

title: Data-Quality-Aware Fundus Classification with Anatomy-Guided Glaucoma Assessment and Cross-Dataset Evaluation
summary: Background: Deep learning fundus classifiers often perform well internally, but duplicated images, inconsistent labels, acquisition differences and poor threshold transfer can undermine their reliability. We assess nine-class classifiers beyond internal accuracy, using a data audit, frozen-model external evaluation and an anatomy-guided specialist. Methods: Nine-class experts (ConvNeXt-Small, EfficientNetV2-Small, DenseNet169) were trained with three seeds. Auditing 5,318 images for exact duplicates and cross-label conflicts removed 464 conflict groups (942 images) and six same-label copies, leaving 4,370 images. An anatomy-guided glaucoma specialist read disc-centred crops with vessel and disc/cup segmentation maps, plus cup-to-disc features. Frozen models were evaluated on RFMiD and JSIEC, and a prespecified comparison on REFUGE was replicated on ORIGA, G1020 and PAPILA. Results: ConvNeXt-Small reached an internal accuracy of 0.910, macro-F1 of 0.917 and AUC of 0.982; disc and cup Dice scores were 0.966 and 0.915. Across seeds, the fixed anatomy-guided mix left internal accuracy unchanged relative to equal soft voting (-0.001) but raised mean external closed-set accuracy by 4.9 percentage points on RFMiD (positive in two of three seeds) and 2.3 on JSIEC. On REFUGE (800 photographs) it improved balanced accuracy by 7.4 percentage points (95% CI 5.1 to 9.5), and by 2.1 on ORIGA, with positive gains on G1020 and PAPILA. Thresholds transferred poorly (REFUGE sensitivity 0.950, specificity 0.411). Conclusions: Retinal classifiers should be judged by data-quality auditing, anatomy-informed modelling and multi-cohort evaluation. Anatomy-guided fusion improved transfer at no internal cost, but gains varied by cohort and thresholds did not transfer, so internal metrics alone do not establish reliable performance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数据审计、冻结模型外部评估和解剖引导专家模型，系统评估九类眼底分类器的可靠性；解剖引导融合在不损失内部性能的前提下提升了跨队列泛化，但阈值迁移性差。
AI.motivation: 深度学习眼底分类器在内部测试中表现良好，但重复图像、标签不一致、采集差异和阈值迁移差会削弱其可靠性，仅凭内部精度不足以证明其真实性能。
AI.method: 采用三种骨干网络（ConvNeXt-Small、EfficientNetV2-Small、DenseNet169）各三个随机种子训练九类分类器；对5,318张图像做重复和跨标签冲突审计（剔除464个冲突组共942张及6张同标签重复，剩余4,370张）；构建以视盘为中心裁剪、结合血管与视盘/视杯分割图及杯盘比特征的解剖引导青光眼专家模型；在RFMiD、JSIEC上做冻结模型外部评估，并在REFUGE上预设比较后在ORIGA、G1020、PAPILA上复现。
AI.result: ConvNeXt-Small内部准确率0.910、macro-F1 0.917、AUC 0.982，视盘与视杯Dice为0.966和0.915。解剖引导混合相对等权软投票内部准确率几乎不变（-0.001），但外部闭集准确率在RFMiD提升4.9个百分点（3个种子中2个为正）、JSIEC提升2.3；REFUGE（800张）平衡准确率提升7.4个百分点（95% CI 5.1–9.5），ORIGA提升2.1，G1020与PAPILA亦有正向增益。阈值迁移差（REFUGE灵敏度0.950、特异度0.411）。
AI.conclusion: 视网膜分类器应以数据质量审计、解剖信息建模和多队列评估来评判；解剖引导融合在无内部代价下改善迁移，但增益因队列而异且阈值未能迁移，内部指标不能单独证明其可靠性。

title: Continuous-time 4D Reconstruction via Event-guided Latent Feature Interpolation
summary: Recent geometric foundation models can successfully convert a video sequence into frames of registered point clouds, but cannot predict moments beyond the observed temporal resolution. We propose a continuous-time 4D reconstruction method that extracts 3D structure and camera poses at any time instant, with additional guidance from event-camera measurements. While event cameras provide evidence at microsecond resolution to continuously fill the temporal gap, integrating them into existing RGB-based foundation models remains challenging. We formulate the problem as interpolation in the latent feature space and augment event-based losses in the image space as an auxiliary task to boost accuracy. Operating in the latent space leverages the powerful geometric priors of foundation models, while the event loss provides physically grounded guidance. To effectively address the lack of paired training data, we further propose a self-supervised training framework that uses pseudo-ground-truth labels of estimated geometry and simulated events generated from high-frame-rate RGB videos. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that the proposed pipeline outperforms baselines that temporally interpolate either the input RGB videos or the estimated geometry, and that it generalizes to unseen real-world scenarios. Controlled experiments with synthetic corruptions show that it remains robust under motion-blur and low-light conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出连续时间4D重建方法，结合事件相机在潜空间插值，实现任意时刻的点云与相机位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 现有几何基础模型可将视频转为配准点云，但无法预测观测时间分辨率之外的时刻，存在时间间隙问题。
AI.method: 将问题建模为潜特征空间插值以利用基础模型几何先验，并在图像空间加入事件损失作为辅助任务；同时提出自监督训练框架，用高帧率RGB视频生成模拟事件与伪真值几何标签来解决配对数据缺失。
AI.result: 实验表明该流程优于对RGB视频或几何结果做时间插值的基线，可泛化到未见真实场景，并在运动模糊与低光条件下保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间插值结合事件引导能有效实现连续时间4D重建，自监督框架可行且鲁棒性强。

title: Dynamics Forcing: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Causal Video World Models
summary: Causal video world models generate block by block from their own previous outputs. Small errors in early blocks are fed back as history and grow until the scene and the robot fall apart. Teacher forcing trains on clean ground-truth history, so the model never sees the history it will actually condition on, and it also finds a shortcut: copying the previous frame instead of predicting how the scene changes. We present Dynamics Forcing, a training scheme that keeps real video as the only supervision and reshapes how history is presented. History is perturbed in three ways: random noising, self-resampling by the model itself, and joint denoising, in which the most recent blocks are still partly noisy when the next block is predicted. On top of this we move history guidance and first-frame anchor guidance from inference into training, so that the model is pushed to use its history and its reference frame rather than ignore them. Dynamics Forcing needs no teacher model, no distillation, and no additional model at inference. Applied to a 5B video model with LoRA on 77 hours of manipulation video on a single GPU, it better matches unseen real continuations and reduces error accumulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dynamics Forcing 训练方案，通过三种历史扰动（随机加噪、自采样、联合去噪）并把历史引导与首帧锚定引导移入训练，缓解因果视频世界模型的误差累积与"复制上一帧"捷径，单卡 LoRA 微调 5B 模型即可更好匹配真实后续。
AI.motivation: 因果视频世界模型逐块生成，早期块的微小误差作为历史被反馈并放大，导致场景与机器人崩坏。Teacher forcing 用干净真值历史训练，模型从未见过推理时真实的条件历史，且会走捷径：直接复制上一帧而非预测场景变化。
AI.method: Dynamics Forcing：仅用真实视频作监督，重塑历史的呈现方式。三重历史扰动：随机加噪、模型自重采样（self-resampling）、联合去噪（预测下一块时最近若干块仍部分带噪）。此外将历史引导与首帧锚点引导从推理阶段移入训练，迫使模型使用历史与参考帧。无需教师模型、蒸馏或推理时额外模型；在单 GPU 上用 LoRA 微调 5B 视频模型，77 小时操作视频。
AI.result: 与未见过的真实后续片段匹配更好，并减轻误差累积。
AI.conclusion: 将推理时的历史条件现实地暴露于训练（尤其保留部分噪声的联合去噪）并内化引导信号，是提升因果视频世界模型长时稳定性的有效且低成本途径。

title: Ego2Wrist: Bootstrapping Wrist-View Synthesis from Egocentric Video
comment: 27 pages (13 main + 14 appendix), 9 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://adonis-galaxy.github.io/Ego2Wrist/
summary: Wrist cameras provide an action-centric view that is directly relevant to robot manipulation. However, collecting human wrist-camera videos at scale is challenging due to cumbersome setups that can interfere with natural hand movements. In contrast, head-mounted human egocentric videos are much easier to scale. We introduce Ego2Wrist, which synthesizes synchronized wrist-camera views from human egocentric videos and task descriptions. Trained on approximately 940 hours of paired head- and wrist-camera recordings, Ego2Wrist jointly generates three views. To evaluate generated wrist views without ground truth, we propose hand-centric cross-view consistency (HCC), which measures consistency between generated wrist views and corresponding hand regions in the input head view. HCC ranks model checkpoints comparably to ground-truth-based LPIPS, and human evaluators prefer HCC-selected generations in 77% of responses. Evaluated on four datasets, Ego2Wrist outperforms fine-tuned WorldWander, reducing LPIPS by 28% and receiving human preference in 76% of responses. More importantly, HCC facilitates recursive self-improvement on in-the-wild egocentric videos by selecting generated wrist views for further training. Generation quality progressively improves over three rounds. These results demonstrate a scalable approach to generating real-world wrist-view human manipulation videos for robot policy training.

AI.tldr: 提出Ego2Wrist，从第一人称头戴视频合成同步手腕视角视频，并提出手-centric跨视角一致性(HCC)无真值评估指标，可支持递归自提升。
AI.motivation: 手腕相机视角对机器人操作任务最相关，但大规模采集人类手腕视频因设备笨重、干扰自然手部动作而困难；头戴第一人称视频更易规模化。
AI.method: 用约940小时成对的头部-手腕相机录制训练，联合生成三个视角的同步手腕视图；提出HCC指标，衡量生成手腕视图与输入头视图中手部区域的一致性，并以HCC筛选生成结果进行递归自训练。
AI.result: HCC排序模型检查点效果接近真值LPIPS，77%人工评审偏好HCC选出的生成；在四个数据集上优于微调WorldWander，LPIPS降低28%，76%人工偏好；递归自提升在三轮中逐步改善质量。
AI.conclusion: 提供可扩展方案，生成真实世界手腕视角人类操作视频，用于机器人策略训练。

title: LexiDet-OVD: Benchmarking Lexical Sensitivity in Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
summary: Open-vocabulary object detectors localize objects from free-form text prompts, but their reliability depends on how users describe the target. Standard evaluations usually test a fixed class name, leaving prompt-induced failure modes underexplored. We introduce LexiDet-OVD, a benchmark and metric suite for studying lexical sensitivity in open-vocabulary object detection. We organize prompt sets into equivalent, conditional, and broad semantic scopes, and evaluate four detector families on fixed COCO and LVIS samples, each covering 30 classes (800 held-out COCO images and 1,000 LVIS images). Beyond mean and worst-prompt AP50, we report P10, CVaR at 20%, leave-one-prompt-out influence, detection agreement, box consistency, and confidence variance using one-to-one multi-instance matching. Equivalent-prompt best-to-worst gaps range from 5.3 to 23.4 points on COCO1000 and from 5.1 to 29.9 points on LVIS1000-30c, showing that strong average accuracy and lexical stability are distinct properties. We compare maximum-score selection, weighted-box fusion, Prompt Consensus, and an exploratory fusion rule. Aggregation recovers performance in several settings, but no method dominates all model-dataset pairs. A controlled Detic/SHiNe comparison further shows that semantic hierarchy enrichment does not by itself eliminate lexical sensitivity. These results support reporting prompt-distribution robustness alongside conventional open-vocabulary detection accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出LexiDet-OVD基准与指标套件，系统研究开放词汇目标检测的词汇敏感性，揭示高平均精度与词汇稳定性是两种不同属性。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇检测器依赖用户提示文本，但标准评测多用固定类名，提示诱导的失效模式研究不足。
AI.method: 构建LexiDet-OVD，将提示集划分为等价、条件、宽泛三类语义范围；在固定COCO(800图)与LVIS(1000图,各30类)样本上评测四类检测器；除均值与最差提示AP50外，报告P10、CVaR@20%、留一提示影响、检测一致性、框一致性与置信方差（一对一多实例匹配）；并比较最大分数选择、加权框融合、Prompt Consensus及探索性融合规则。
AI.result: 等价提示最佳-最差差距在COCO1000为5.3–23.4点、LVIS1000-30c为5.1–29.9点；聚合可部分恢复性能但无方法全面占优；Detic/SHiNe对照显示语义层级增强本身不能消除词汇敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 建议在常规开放词汇检测精度之外，同时报告提示分布鲁棒性。

title: Towards Agentic Video Corpus Moment Retrieval
summary: Video corpus moment retrieval (VCMR) requires finding the video and time interval that match a text query in a corpus of videos. We present RELAY, a training-free framework for VCMR that shares memory across queries. RELAY processes a batch of queries in three stages: search with a query bank, ranking with video notes, and localization with video prompt caching. In the search stage, an embedding model scores each video by its best-matching frame. The query bank penalizes videos that score highly for many other queries in the batch. In the ranking stage, a vision-language model (VLM) writes notes on each candidate video's scenes, people, objects, and actions once. Then, a large language model (LLM) reranks the candidates from these notes. In the localization stage, a VLM predicts the time interval of the moment in the top-ranked video. When multiple queries select the same video, prompt caching lets the VLM reuse its frames. On the three VERIFIED benchmarks, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in video retrieval R@1 without training. Without any labeled moment, its predicted intervals are shorter than the annotated ones. In VCMR, it achieves similar performance to VideoSearch-R1 on one benchmark and trails it at IoU 0.5 on the other two. Human annotators also mark shorter moments than the original annotations of the benchmarks. A single margin, calibrated on a few labeled queries, widens the predicted interval to the annotation convention of the benchmarks. With it, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in VCMR at IoU 0.5.

AI.tldr: RELAY 是一个免训练的视频语料库时刻检索（VCMR）框架，通过跨查询共享内存（查询库、视频笔记、提示缓存三阶段）实现检索、排序与定位，在 VERIFIED 基准上无需训练即超越有监督基线。
AI.motivation: VCMR 需要在视频语料中同时找到匹配视频和精确时间区间，通常依赖大规模训练；本文希望不训练也能高效完成，并利用批量查询之间的冗余性（多个查询可能命中同一视频、同一视频的视觉内容可被复用）来降低重复计算。
AI.method: 三阶段流程：(1) 搜索——用嵌入模型以最佳匹配帧给视频打分，并用"查询库"对在批次中多个查询上都高分（易混淆）的视频施加惩罚；(2) 排序——VLM 一次性为候选视频撰写关于场景、人物、物体、动作的"笔记"，再由 LLM 依据笔记重排；(3) 定位——VLM 在排名最高的视频上预测时间区间，当多个查询选中同一视频时，用提示缓存复用其帧特征。另引入一个在少量标注查询上校准的 margin 参数，用于调整预测区间长度。
AI.result: 在三个 VERIFIED 基准上，视频检索 R@1 免训练即优于有训练基线；无标注时刻的情况下，预测区间比标注更短（人类标注者同样倾向于标注更短的片段）。VCMR 任务上，一个基准上接近 VideoSearch-R1，另两个基准在 IoU 0.5 上落后；加入单一校准 margin 使区间扩展到基准标注习惯后，在 IoU 0.5 上超越有训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 批量查询间的共享内存式设计可在零训练条件下取得强检索性能，定位差距主要源于标注惯例（区间长度）而非定位能力；用一个简单校准 margin 即可弥补并对齐基准约定。整体证明了免训练、可复用、模块化流水线在 VCMR 中的可行性。

title: Reparameterizing Your Object Detectors for Weight Space Programming
summary: Weight-Space Programming (WSP) edits network weights without backpropagation, yet directly editing converged object detectors stalls or collapses because set prediction penalizes duplicate boxes as false positives while compact parameterizations trap weights in an isotropic Euclidean minimum. We propose Inverse-Reparameterized Object-Detection WSP (IR-ODWSP), lifting detector layers via exact function-preserving operators (E, C) into decoupled moment, 2D-DCT, PCA, and Stiefel-Procrustes subspaces. Solving winner-exclusive updates and folding back (Delta Params=0%, Delta FLOPs=0%) induces an anisotropic Riemannian metric, improving all 26/26 MS COCO settings across 17 YOLO26, EdgeCrafter, and RF-DETR detectors (up to +0.31 APs), +1.42 mAP cross-basin COCO-O, zeroimage repair (+2.95 mAP), and label-free weather adaptation (+2.79 AP).
