Without retraining, IR-ODWSP supports -100% to +100% latency budgets across bridged contraction, 1.00x folding, dynamic (IR-ODWSP-DYN), and static (IR-ODWSP-SG) graphs: -10% retains 51.62 AP / 33.48 mAP, while positive budgets scale monotonically (+0.30 AP at +10%, +1.12 on RF-DETR-N; 54.83 AP at +100%; 55.91 AP / 35.44 mAP in IR-ODWSP+). Source code is released at https://github.com/WongKinYiu/ODWSP.

AI.tldr: 提出IR-ODWSP，将检测器层通过保函数精确提升到解耦子空间做权重空间编程，零参数/零FLOPs回折叠，在26/26个COCO设置上提升AP，并支持-100%~+100%延迟预算。
AI.motivation: 现有Weight-Space Programming直接编辑收敛后的目标检测器权重会导致训练停滞或崩溃：集合预测把重复框当假阳性惩罚，且紧凑参数化使权重困在各向同性欧氏极小值中。
AI.method: 用精确保函数算子(E,C)提升检测器层到解耦的矩、2D-DCT、PCA、Stiefel-Procrustes子空间；求解winner-exclusive更新后折叠回去（Delta Params=0%，Delta FLOPs=0%），诱导各向异性黎曼度量；并给出IR-ODWSP-DYN与IR-ODWSP-SG等图变体。
AI.result: 17种检测器（YOLO26、EdgeCrafter、RF-DETR）26/26个MS COCO设置全部提升（最高+0.31 APs）；COCO-O跨域+1.42 mAP；零图像修复+2.95 mAP；无标签天气自适应+2.79 AP。-10%延迟保留51.62 AP/33.48 mAP，+100%达54.83 AP，IR-ODWSP+达55.91 AP/35.44 mAP。
AI.conclusion: 无需重训练即可在-100%~+100%延迟预算内编辑检测器权重并稳定提升精度，验证了子空间提升+各向异性度量的有效性。

title: Segment Anything In-Context via Visual Demonstrations
summary: We present the Segment Anything Model via Visual Demonstrations (SAYD), a foundation model for in-context segmentation. Given visual demos comprising prompt images and their segmentation masks, SAYD segments coherent regions (e.g., objects or their parts) in a query image by establishing visual correspondences between the prompts and the query. SAYD generalizes to previously-unseen segmentation tasks, including those requiring tacit visual knowledge or involving concepts that are difficult to articulate unambiguously in language. We train SAYD on 12 public datasets originally curated for panoptic segmentation using our proposed techniques, including a lightweight mask decoder for prompt-agnostic mask generation and a learning mechanism for recognizing novel query classes absent in the prompts. These innovations enhance both computational efficiency and out-of-domain generalization. Consequently, SAYD significantly outperforms existing methods of in-context segmentation and open-vocabulary segmentation across 24 out-of-domain benchmarks, spanning natural, biological, ecological, cosmological, medical, pathological, and satellite imagery.

AI.tldr: 提出SAYD，一种基于视觉示例（prompt图像及其分割掩码）的in-context分割基础模型，通过在提示与查询图像间建立视觉对应来分割查询图像中的连贯区域，可泛化到难以用语言表达的分割任务，并在24个跨领域基准上超越现有in-context与开放词汇分割方法。
AI.motivation: 现有分割方法往往依赖语言提示或固定类别，难以处理需要隐性视觉知识、或难以用语言明确表述的概念（如生物、医学、遥感、天文等专业图像中的目标）。作者希望利用视觉示例作为提示，让模型直接从示例中理解待分割目标，从而泛化到未见过的分割任务。
AI.method: 以成对的提示图像及其分割掩码作为visual demos，通过建立提示与查询图像间的视觉对应来分割查询图中的连贯区域（物体或其部件）。训练方面，作者在12个原本用于全景分割的公开数据集上进行训练，并引入两项技术：一个轻量级mask decoder用于与提示无关（prompt-agnostic）的掩码生成，以及一种学习机制用于识别提示中未出现的新颖查询类别。
AI.result: 在24个域外（out-of-domain）基准上，SAYD显著优于现有的in-context分割方法和开放词汇分割方法，基准覆盖自然、生物、生态、天文、医学、病理和卫星影像等多个领域；所提出的技术创新同时提升了计算效率与域外泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 视觉示例驱动的in-context分割是一种有效且通用性强的分割范式，SAYD作为该范式下的基础模型，兼顾效率与跨域泛化，为处理难以用语言定义的分割任务提供了可行方案。

title: SpectralRoute: Adaptive Spectral Routing for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Hyperspectral Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation enables the recognition of arbitrary categories through natural language descriptions and has recently been extended from natural images to remote sensing. However, existing approaches primarily focus on three-channel optical imagery or limited-band multispectral data, while pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to directly exploit the rich spectral information of hyperspectral imagery (HSI) without additional adaptation. More importantly, different land-cover categories rely on distinct spectral cues, which may be weakened by uniform fusion. To address these challenges, we propose SpectralRoute, a training-free framework for open-vocabulary hyperspectral segmentation. Specifically, we construct complementary spectral views from HSI and enrich category descriptions with external spectral knowledge, enabling frozen vision-language models to extract diverse spectral-semantic responses. We then introduce a class-adaptive spectral routing mechanism that selectively amplifies discriminative spectral responses for each category, overcoming the limitations of uniform fusion. Furthermore, physical spectral priors are incorporated to refine predictions for visually similar land-cover categories. Experiments on three hyperspectral benchmarks demonstrate that SpectralRoute consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods without additional training.

AI.tldr: SpectralRoute是一个免训练的高光谱图像开放词汇语义分割框架，通过构建互补光谱视图、类别自适应光谱路由与物理光谱先验，使冻结的视觉-语言模型适配高光谱数据并超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇语义分割主要针对三通道光学影像或有限波段多光谱数据；预训练视觉-语言模型难以直接利用高光谱的丰富光谱信息；且不同地物类别依赖不同的光谱线索，统一融合会削弱判别性信号。
AI.method: 从高光谱数据构建互补光谱视图，并用外部光谱知识丰富类别描述，使冻结VLM产生多样的光谱-语义响应；提出类别自适应光谱路由机制，为每个类别选择性放大判别性光谱响应；引入物理光谱先验细化视觉相似地物类别的预测；全程无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在三个高光谱基准数据集上，SpectralRoute无需额外训练即可一致优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 表明通过光谱视图构造、类别自适应路由与物理先验注入，可有效将冻结视觉-语言模型扩展到高光谱开放词汇分割，且免训练即具竞争力。

title: Dynamic Gaussian Scene Reconstruction by Integrating Events and Structural Priors
summary: Existing approaches to event-based dynamic Gaussian reconstruction rely on two assumptions for support augmentation and reliability estimation. First, existing Gaussians can absorb reconstruction errors. Second, photometric optimization has converged sufficiently to estimate reliability using analytical variance. Both assumptions can fail under fast motion. When the first fails, regions without Gaussian support cannot generate densification candidates. When the second fails, Gaussians in moving regions where optimization has not converged may be excluded as motion references. We propose Event-Structure Collaborative Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction (ESC-DGR), using event observations independent of both conditions. Events first identify changes that require additional support, placed only where rendered depth is valid. The augmented representation still needs reliable motion references. Online rendering statistics and historical event evidence therefore propagate displacement estimates from reliable Gaussians to weakly observed neighborhoods. These references describe dominant motion at the frame-interval timescale. Target-time events therefore further condition bounded position residuals for active Gaussians. Support placement, reference selection, and residual prediction thus operate on the same evolving representation within one optimization run. For event-driven monocular dynamic scene reconstruction, our method achieves the best reconstruction quality among the evaluated methods on the E-D3DGS benchmark. Relative to E-D3DGS, dynamic-region PSNR (dPSNR) improves by 1.02 and 1.45 dB on synthetic and real scenes, respectively. The total dynamic Gaussian count across eight synthetic scenes decreases by 8.5%. Although mean frame rate decreases by about 21%-25% relative to E-D3DGS, rendering remains above 80 FPS in all twelve scenes. Code: https://github.com/zh-yu1/ESC-DGR.

AI.tldr: ESC-DGR 利用事件相机观测，在统一优化流程中实现支撑放置、运动参考选择与残差预测，提升事件驱动单目动态场景的高斯重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有事件驱动动态高斯重建依赖两个在快速运动下易失效的假设：现有高斯能吸收重建误差（否则无高斯支撑区域无法产生致密化候选），以及光度优化已充分收敛可用解析方差估计可靠性（否则未收敛的移动区域高斯会被排除为运动参考）。
AI.method: 提出事件-结构协同动态高斯重建（ESC-DGR）：用独立于上述两假设的事件观测定位需额外支撑的变化区域，且仅在渲染深度有效处放置；用在线渲染统计与历史事件证据，将可靠高斯位移估计传播到弱观测邻域作为运动参考；再用目标时刻事件对活跃高斯的有界位置残差进行条件约束。
AI.result: 在 E-D3DGS 基准的 E-D3DGS 数据上取得最佳重建质量；相较 E-D3DGS，合成与真实场景的动态区域 PSNR 分别提升 1.02 和 1.45 dB；八个合成场景动态高斯总数减少 8.5%；平均帧率下降约21%–25%，但十二个场景均保持 80 FPS 以上。
AI.conclusion: 摆脱对原有两假设的依赖，将支撑放置、参考选择与残差预测统一于同一演化表示的单次优化中，验证了事件观测在快速运动动态重建中的有效性，且以少量速度代价换取质量与紧凑性提升。

title: Benchmarking VLM Medical Hallucination across 5 Modalities
summary: Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) within the medical domain remain a difficult and not well-understood problem, and it is still unclear where these models break down. Although several benchmarks targeting medical hallucination have been introduced, they often lack broad coverage across different medical imaging modalities. We introduce Multi-Med, a medical hallucination benchmark containing 1,000 image-question pairs spanning five distinct modalities. Using this benchmark, we perform an in-depth experimental study of 10 widely used VLMs across five modalities and four question categories. Our findings indicate that model performance differs substantially depending on the imaging modality and question type, and that the differences among the best-performing models are not statistically significant.

AI.tldr: 该文提出Multi-Med医学幻觉基准，含1000个图像-问题对、覆盖5种影像模态，评测10个主流VLM在5模态与4类问题下的幻觉表现。
AI.motivation: 医学领域VLM的幻觉问题难以理解，现有医学幻觉基准常缺乏跨多种影像模态的广泛覆盖，且不清楚模型在何处失效。
AI.method: 构建Multi-Med基准：1000个医学图像-问题对，横跨五种影像模态，问题分为四类；在此基准上对10个常用VLM开展系统实验分析与统计检验。
AI.result: 模型表现随影像模态与问题类型差异显著；表现最好的若干模型之间差异在统计上不显著。
AI.conclusion: 医学VLM幻觉随模态和任务类型高度异质，现有领先模型间无实质性差距，亟需更细粒度的模态与问题类型导向评估与改进。

title: KGLP-Net: Kalman-Reliable Global--Local Learning With Group Fisher Pruning for Hyperspectral Image Classification
summary: Accurate hyperspectral image (HSI) classification requires both the effective integration of broad spatial context and fine-grained spectral--spatial information surrounding target pixels. However, the reliability of these complementary representations may vary considerably across heterogeneous scenes, and uncertainty estimates obtained during feature fusion are rarely exploited to guide subsequent model compression. To address these challenges, we propose Kalman-Reliable Global--Local Learning with Group Fisher Pruning (KGLP-Net), a unified framework that couples uncertainty-aware feature fusion with reliability-guided structured pruning. Specifically, an asymmetric dual-view architecture employs a Global Mamba Encoder to capture long-range spatial dependencies and a Local CNN Encoder to extract fine-grained spectral--spatial features from target neighborhoods. To adaptively integrate these complementary representations, Kalman-Reliable Fusion (KRF) estimates their relative uncertainties in feature space and performs a Kalman-inspired posterior update, treating global features as a contextual prior and local features as an observation. Building upon the resulting posterior uncertainty, Kalman-Reliable Group Fisher Pruning (KRGF) quantifies group-level reliability through normalized posterior precision and integrates it with Group Fisher importance to identify and prune Kalman-coupled channel groups, enabling structurally consistent model compression. Experiments on four public HSI datasets demonstrate that the resulting Compact48 model, with a hidden width of 48, achieves the highest overall accuracy among ten representative competing classifiers. Compared with the unpruned Dense64 model, Compact48 reduces the number of parameters, FLOPs, and inference time by 38.5%, 34.8% and 37.6% on average, respectively, while incurring only a 0.03-percentage-point decrease in mean overall accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出KGLP-Net统一框架，将不确定性感知的特征融合与可靠性引导的结构化剪枝相结合，用于高光谱图像分类，得到紧凑的Compact48模型。
AI.motivation: HSI分类需同时整合广域空间上下文与细粒度光谱-空间信息，但两类表示在不同异构场景下可靠性差异很大；且特征融合中获得的不确定性估计很少被用于指导后续模型压缩。
AI.method: 采用非对称双视图架构：Global Mamba Encoder捕获长程空间依赖，Local CNN Encoder提取目标邻域细粒度特征。引入Kalman-Reliable Fusion (KRF)，在特征空间估计二者相对不确定性，以卡尔曼式后验更新融合（全局作先验、局部作观测）。基于后验不确定性提出Kalman-Reliable Group Fisher Pruning (KRGF)，用归一化后验精度量化组级可靠性，结合Group Fisher重要性识别并剪枝Kalman耦合通道组。
AI.result: 在四个公开HSI数据集上，Compact48（隐层宽度48）在十个代表性分类器中取得最高总体精度；相比未剪枝Dense64，参数量、FLOPs和推理时间平均分别降低38.5%、34.8%和37.6%，平均总体精度仅下降0.03个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将不确定性感知融合与可靠性引导结构化剪枝耦合，可在几乎不损失精度的前提下显著压缩模型，验证了融合不确定性指导压缩的有效性。

title: When Should We Trust Medical Image Models? Evaluating Confidence Reliability under Cross-Dataset Shift
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Course research project, CS585 Image and Video Computing, Boston University, Spring 2026
summary:
Deep learning models for chest X-ray analysis often achieve strong performance on benchmark datasets, but their reliability under cross-dataset deployment remains unclear. In clinical practice, models trained in one hospital system may be applied to data from another, where distributional and labeling differences can affect both prediction accuracy and model confidence.
  We conduct a controlled empirical study of model confidence under cross-dataset transfer. We train ResNet-50 and DenseNet-121 on CheXpert and evaluate them on MIMIC-CXR across five experimental settings, focusing on Pneumothorax and Pleural Effusion. We measure predictive performance using AUC and confidence reliability using Expected Calibration Error (ECE), Brier score, and average confidence on incorrect predictions, all reported with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. We further evaluate post-hoc temperature scaling fit on the source validation set and use Grad-CAM to examine the mechanism behind cross-domain performance differences.
  Cross-domain AUC drops 7-13 percentage points, and the best in-domain model is not the best cross-domain model. Source-domain temperature scaling produces marginal ECE changes but systematically increases confidence on incorrect predictions across all four model-pathology combinations. Grad-CAM reveals that DenseNet relies on a concentrated spatial prior that fails to transfer, while ResNet's more distributed attention generalizes better. These findings argue for cross-site validation and safety-specific calibration metrics in medical AI evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过受控实验检验胸片模型跨数据集迁移时的置信度可靠性，发现跨域AUC下降7-13个百分点，源域温度缩放会系统性提高错误预测的置信度，且DenseNet的集中空间先验难以迁移而ResNet的分布式注意力更稳健。
AI.motivation: 深度学习胸片模型在基准数据集上表现优秀，但跨医院部署时分布与标注差异会影响预测准确率和模型置信度，其可靠性尚不清楚，而临床实际中存在跨系统应用的现实需求。
AI.method: 在CheXpert上训练ResNet-50与DenseNet-121，在MIMIC-CXR上测试，围绕气胸与胸腔积液设计五种实验设置；用AUC衡量性能，用ECE、Brier分数及错误预测平均置信度（均附95% bootstrap置信区间）衡量置信度可靠性；并评估在源域验证集上拟合的后验温度缩放，用Grad-CAM分析跨域差异机制。
AI.result: 跨域AUC下降7-13个百分点；域内最优模型并非跨域最优模型；源域温度缩放对ECE影响甚微，但在全部四组模型-病理组合中系统性提高了错误预测的置信度；Grad-CAM显示DenseNet依赖难以迁移的集中空间先验，而ResNet的分布式注意力泛化更好。
AI.conclusion: 研究主张医学AI评估应纳入跨站点验证，并采用面向安全性的校准指标（如错误预测置信度），而非仅依赖域内性能与传统校准度量。

title: FASCIA: Seeing Beneath the Surface with Queryable, Personalized Anatomy in Any Pose
summary: We present FASCIA (*Functional Anatomical Structures and Composition via Implicit Atlas*), a Momentum Human Rig (MHR)-anchored framework that predicts and poses a person's internal anatomy from their external body shape and skeletal proportions. FASCIA maps a single 290-structure population template onto each individual through a smooth, invertible warp. As people with the same shape can differ internally, a body-dependent Gaussian prior predicts both average warp coordinates and their inter-subject variability. The warp deforms a learned base template into bones, muscles, organs, and fat depots. Extending MHR skinning into the interior enables direct supervision of this model across four automatically labeled CT cohorts and one whole-body MRI cohort. On 82 held-out CT scans, FASCIA reaches a mean volumetric Dice (volume agreement) of 0.48 on named bones and 0.63 on muscles, keeps the majority of bones and muscles in one piece, and yields calibrated voxel probabilities. On 33 held-out whole-body MRI subjects, FASCIA's pointwise field improves tissue overlap over HIT across all compartments, predicts between-person differences in whole-body adipose percentage ($R^2 = 0.88$ vs. $0.38$ in women and $0.54$ vs. $-0.01$ in men), and recovers segment centers of mass within 1.1 mm. Because it needs only an MHR fit, FASCIA can be driven from images, video, or any system that outputs MHR. This opens the door to fitting individualized calibrated musculoskeletal digital twins to video motion data.

AI.tldr: FASCIA 以 Momentum Human Rig (MHR) 为锚，通过平滑可逆形变将 290 结构的群体模板映射到个体，从外部体形与骨骼比例预测并摆姿内部解剖结构。
AI.motivation: 现有外部人体建模（如 MHR）已成熟，但个体内部解剖（骨、肌、器官、脂肪）难以获取，且"同外形、不同内部"的个体差异未被建模；希望仅凭外形即可获得个体化、可动、校准的肌肉骨骼数字孪生。
AI.method: 构建以 MHR 为锚的框架：用单一 290 结构群体模板，经平滑可逆 warp 映射到每个个体；引入依赖体形的 Gaussian 先验，同时预测平均 warp 坐标与受试间变异；warp 将学习到的基模板变形为骨、肌、器官与脂肪库；将 MHR 蒙皮扩展到内部以支持直接监督，用于 4 个自动标注 CT 队列与 1 个全身 MRI 队列。
AI.result: 82 例留出 CT：命名骨平均体积 Dice 0.48、肌肉 0.63，多数骨与肌肉保持单连通，输出校准的体素概率。33 例留出全身 MRI：点式场在所有分区上组织重叠优于 HIT；预测个体全身脂肪百分比 R²=0.88（女性，HIT 0.38）、0.54（男性，HIT −0.01）；分割中心质心误差 <1.1 mm。
AI.conclusion: 仅需 MHR 拟合即可驱动，可由图像、视频或任意输出 MHR 的系统驱动，为从视频运动数据拟合个体化、校准的肌肉骨骼数字孪生开辟路径。

title: One Size Doesn't Fit All: Input Adaptive Class Activation Mapping for Improved Visual Explanations
summary: Despite their widespread use in tasks such as image classification, object detection and semantic segmentation, the limited interpretability of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) can undermine trust and hinder adoption in safety-critical applications. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods seek to address this by providing human-understandable explanations for model predictions. Class Activation Maps (CAM) constitute one such widely used XAI technique for visualizing discriminative regions. However, existing CAM methods may exhibit limitations in channel weighting, localization, and adaptability across network architectures potentially resulting in noisy or imprecise explanations. To address these issues, we propose ADAPT-CAM, a gradient-based, parameter-adaptive CAM framework. The method combines first-order gradient energy with activation-weighted second-order curvature to derive channel contributions. It further incorporates adaptive local contrast normalization and knee-guided soft channel selection to refine the resulting explanations. Importantly, key parameters are estimated independently for each input, allowing the framework to adapt to variations in feature representations across network architectures. We validate ADAPT-CAM on ImageNet and Oxford 102 Flowers across CNN and ViT architectures. Quantitative results demonstrate competitive or superior performance against established CAM methods across multiple evaluation metrics. In parallel, qualitative comparisons illustrate its ability to highlight discriminative image regions. Further parameter analysis and ablation experiments examine the behaviour and contributions of the individual adaptive components. These findings demonstrate the applicability of ADAPT-CAM across different architectures and datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出ADAPT-CAM——一种基于梯度、参数自适应的类激活映射(CAM)框架，通过融合一阶梯度能量与激活加权二阶曲率计算通道贡献，并结合自适应局部对比度归一化与拐点引导的软通道选择，在CNN和ViT架构上取得竞争性或更优的解释性能。
AI.motivation: CNN与ViT广泛应用于图像分类、目标检测、语义分割等任务，但其可解释性有限，影响在安全关键场景中的信任与部署。现有CAM方法在通道加权、定位精度及跨架构适应性方面存在不足，易产生噪声大或不精确的解释。
AI.method: ADAPT-CAM综合一阶梯度能量与激活加权的二阶曲率来推导通道贡献；引入自适应局部对比度归一化与拐点(knee)引导的软通道选择以精炼解释；关键参数针对每个输入独立估计，从而适应不同网络架构的特征表示差异。
AI.result: 在ImageNet和Oxford 102 Flowers数据集上，跨CNN与ViT架构的定量评估显示其在多项指标上达到与现有CAM方法相当或更优的性能；定性对比表明其能突出判别性区域；参数分析与消融实验验证了各自适应组件的作用与贡献。
AI.conclusion: ADAPT-CAM在不同架构和数据集上均具有良好适用性，验证了其作为通用CAM框架的有效性。

title: Antiphony: A Dual-Process Agent for Deepfake Video Detection with Real-Video Calibration
summary: Reliable video deepfake detection requires generalization to unseen generators while limiting false alarms on authentic footage. Although existing detectors capture diverse visual cues, they may produce overconfident errors under generator shift, limiting the reliability of confidence-based fusion. Threshold calibration is further complicated by shifts in authentic capture domains and the lack of future-generator examples. To address these challenges, we present Antiphony, a framework that combines calibrated fusion of four visual experts with selective investigation. Authentic videos serve as a shared reference for score fusion and threshold calibration, enabling threshold updates without target deepfakes. For this expert-fusion stage, we establish finite-sample false-alarm control when the scoring procedure is fixed independently of calibration and authentic samples are exchangeable. To refine decisions near the calibrated threshold, a tool-using multimodal investigator examines these videos and contributes an additional fusion score. We train the investigator on generator-held-out predictions and counterfactual expert outputs, to improve robustness to unreliable expert evidence. Across six benchmark protocols, Antiphony achieves a mean benchmark score of 88.3%, exceeding the strongest evaluated MLLM and conventional detector baselines by 14.7 and 11.5 points, respectively. It also outperforms ARGUS by 20.2 points on average and by 3.6 balanced-accuracy points on FaceVid's 20 unseen generators.

AI.tldr: 提出Antiphony框架，通过四个视觉专家的校准融合加选择性调查，实现可泛化的深度伪造检测并在未见生成器上控制误报。
AI.motivation: 视频深度伪造检测需泛化到未见生成器，同时在真实视频上控制误报。现有检测器在生成器漂移下会产生过度自信的错误，削弱基于置信度融合的可靠性；阈值校准又受真实拍摄域漂移和缺乏未来生成器样本的困扰。
AI.method: Antiphony = 四视觉专家的校准融合 + 选择性调查。以真实视频作为共享参考进行分数融合与阈值校准，无需目标伪造样本即可更新阈值；在评分程序独立于校准、真实样本可交换的前提下给出有限样本误报控制。对接近校准阈值的样本，由工具调用的多模态调查员复核并贡献额外融合分数，该调查员在生成器留出的预测与反事实专家输出上训练以增强对不可靠专家证据的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 六个基准协议上平均基准得分88.3%，分别超过最强MLLM与常规检测器基线14.7和11.5分；平均优于ARGUS 20.2分，在FaceVid的20个未见生成器上平衡准确率高3.6分。
AI.conclusion: Antiphony通过真实参考驱动的校准融合与选择性多模态调查，兼顾了未见生成器泛化与误报控制，显著优于现有基线。

title: MORSE: Optimizing Streaming Memory Design via Open-World Auto-Research
summary: A streaming video system must decide in a single pass what evidence to retain under bounded frame storage, before it knows which details a future question will require. Recent recursive self-improvement methods automate the design of the harness that stores and retrieves this evidence. They revise the harness in response to failures, but the editor must still devise each repair from its prior knowledge and a predefined set of tools. A failure that recurs across videos, however, may point to a problem that prior work has already addressed. We introduce MORSE (Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement), an open-world auto-research framework that uses recurring failures to guide an online search for solutions. Its editor groups failures in training traces by cause, then searches papers, model cards, and code for methods it can adapt or pretrained perception models it can use. When the editor introduces a new perceptual capability, it can also revise how the harness stores and retrieves the resulting evidence for a frozen video-language model. On held-out validation streams, MORSE first selects revisions that improve answer quality, then seeks faster revisions that preserve those gains within a specified tolerance. Across three streaming video benchmarks, MORSE consistently achieves the highest answer accuracy within each frozen-backbone comparison. On OVO-Bench, our Qwen3-VL-8B harness answers queries in 0.30 seconds on average while achieving 75.1% accuracy, 3.1 percentage points ahead of the next-best evaluated harness using the same frozen backbone.

AI.tldr: MORSE 是一个"开放世界"自动研究框架，用跨视频反复出现的失败作为线索，在线检索论文、模型卡与代码，改写流式视频系统的记忆/证据harness，从而在冻结的视频语言模型上同时提升答案质量和响应速度。
AI.motivation: 流式视频系统必须在单次通过、帧存储有界的条件下决定保留哪些证据，而未来问题需要哪些细节事前未知。现有递归自我改进方法虽能自动设计存储与检索的harness，但编辑器只能依赖自身先验知识和预定义工具集来设计修复方案，遇到反复出现的同类失败时容易"重新造轮子"，忽略了已有工作可能早已解决该问题。
AI.method: MORSE 让编辑器先按成因对训练轨迹中的失败进行分组，再检索论文、模型卡和代码，寻找可迁移的方法或可直接使用的预训练感知模型。当引入新的感知能力时，编辑器还会相应修改harness的存储与检索方式，以适配冻结的视频语言模型。在留出验证流上采用两阶段选择：先挑选提升答案质量的修订，再在给定容差内寻找保持该收益的更快版本。
AI.result: 在三个流式视频基准上，MORSE 在每个"冻结骨干"对比组中均取得最高答案准确率。在 OVO-Bench 上，基于 Qwen3-VL-8B 的 harness 平均 0.30 秒完成回答，准确率达 75.1%，比同冻结骨干下次优 harness 高 3.1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将反复失败与开放世界的外部知识检索相结合，可有效自动演化流式视频记忆harness，在严格延迟约束下兼顾准确率与效率。

title: FlexGaze: Weakly Supervised Gaze Estimation at Scale
comment: 23 pages, including 12 pages of supplementary material
summary: Most gaze estimation models are trained on data collected using specialized equipment. The limited diversity of subjects, scenes, and head poses in these datasets hinders generalization to new conditions. We present FlexGaze, a family of 3D gaze estimators pretrained with weak supervision from gaze labels (pseudo-labels) automatically generated from in-the-wild images. We use off-the-shelf models to predict 2D gaze targets and scene depth, then combine these predictions to generate 3D gaze labels for approximately 3.24 million head instances. At inference, FlexGaze predicts gaze from a head crop alone and can handle profile and rear views without requiring face detection or head pose estimation. We use data augmentation during training to improve robustness to variations in crop position and scale. Pretrained using only these generated gaze labels, FlexGaze generalizes to unseen benchmarks. After supervised fine-tuning on public gaze datasets, we evaluate FlexGaze on eight benchmarks under a unified evaluation protocol. Our models match or outperform publicly available gaze estimators with several times as many parameters on most benchmarks. We release our dataset of generated gaze labels, all trained models, and code via https://github.com/ihp-lab/FlexGaze.

AI.tldr: FlexGaze：用现成模型自动生成约324万头部实例的3D注视伪标签做弱监督预训练，仅凭头部裁剪图即可预测3D注视方向，在八个基准上以更少参数媲美或超越公开模型。
AI.motivation: 现有注视估计模型多在专用设备采集的数据上训练，受试者、场景与头部姿态多样性不足，导致跨条件泛化能力差。
AI.method: 用现成的2D注视目标预测模型和场景深度模型，将两者结合自动生成3D注视标签（约3.24M头部实例）；在此伪标签上弱监督预训练一组FlexGaze 3D注视估计器。推理时只用头部裁剪图，无需人脸检测或头部姿态估计，并可处理侧脸与后脑视角；训练时采用数据增强提升对裁剪位置与尺度变化的鲁棒性。随后在公开注视数据集上有监督微调，并在统一评测协议下评估八个基准。
AI.result: 仅用生成标签预训练即可泛化到未见基准；监督微调后在多数基准上匹配或超过参数量为其数倍的公开注视估计器。
AI.conclusion: 利用野外图像自动生成的伪3D注视标签进行弱监督预训练，是摆脱专用采集设备依赖、提升泛化性的有效途径；作者开源了生成标签数据集、全部训练模型与代码。

title: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
summary: Animating arbitrary 3D assets from instructions requires both structural inference and motion control, yet existing motion benchmarks mostly cover conventional human or animal skeletons with simple instructions. We introduce DivDynBench, which evaluates rigging and motion generation across six morphology categories, with instructions requiring multi-phase part coordination and explicit timing, angle, repetition, and trajectory constraints. With large language models, we systematically compare three common paradigms: specialized motion generation, video generation followed by motion recovery, and direct agent-driven generation. We analyze their control capabilities, cross-morphology adaptability, and generation costs. Guided by this comparison, we propose an Agentic Motion Framework in which an agent writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs, and a deterministic executor performs rigging, kinematic solving, and geometric correction. Compact parameter control reduces generation overhead and improves rigging reliability and motion-control accuracy, providing practical guidance for deploying complex 3D motion generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 DivDynBench 基准，覆盖六类形态，指令含多阶段部件协调与时间、角度、重复、轨迹约束，并系统比较三种范式，进而提出 Agentic Motion Framework（智能体写参数化骨架与运动程序，确定性执行器完成绑骨、运动学求解与几何修正）。
AI.motivation: 从指令驱动任意 3D 资产动画需同时具备结构推断与运动控制，但现有运动基准多限于常规人体/动物骨架且指令简单，无法评测复杂形态与精确约束下的能力。
AI.method: 构建 DivDynBench 基准，含六类形态类别与多阶段、带显式时间/角度/重复/轨迹约束的指令；借助大语言模型系统比较三类范式：专用运动生成、先视频生成再运动恢复、直接智能体驱动生成；据此提出 Agentic Motion Framework，由智能体生成紧凑的参数化骨架与运动程序，确定性执行器负责绑骨、运动学求解与几何修正。
AI.result: 对比分析揭示了三种范式在控制能力、跨形态适应性与生成成本上的差异；紧凑参数控制降低了生成开销，并提升了绑骨可靠性与运动控制精度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为复杂 3D 运动生成的部署提供了实用指导，表明"智能体规划 + 确定性执行"的参数化路线在可靠性与成本上更具优势。

title: ReplaySAM: Zero-Shot 3D Particle-Pack Segmentation with SAM 2
summary: X-ray computed tomography (XCT) provides non-destructive three-dimensional (3D) images of particle packs, making their internal structure accessible for quantitative analysis. Extracting particle-level measurements from these volumes first requires identifying and separating individual particles, a task that remains challenging in dense, irregular packs. Existing workflows often require manual correction or task-specific training, while promptable models need a strategy for automatically locating individual particles and recovering their instance masks. We present ReplaySAM, which adapts the pretrained Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) to three-dimensional particle-pack segmentation without additional training. It generates point prompts from foreground geometry and fuses SAM2 predictions across orthogonal slice sequences to recover particle instances. On XCT volumes of real quartz and iron-ore particle packs, ReplaySAM achieves higher mean instance Dice scores than expert-assisted watershed and nnInteractive under the evaluated protocols. ReplaySAM thus provides a training-free framework for 3D particle-pack instance segmentation, with geometry-based prompting that eliminates manual prompt placement.

AI.tldr: ReplaySAM 是一个免训练框架，基于预训练 SAM2，通过几何点提示与正交切片预测融合，实现三维颗粒堆积体的实例分割。
AI.motivation: XCT 能无损获取颗粒堆积的三维图像，但从稠密、不规则堆积体中提取单颗粒测量需先分离个体颗粒，这一步仍很困难。现有流程常需人工修正或任务特定训练，而可提示模型又缺少自动定位颗粒并恢复实例掩码的策略。
AI.method: 将预训练 SAM2 适配到三维颗粒堆积分割，无需额外训练：根据前景几何自动生成点提示，并对正交切片序列上的 SAM2 预测进行融合，以恢复颗粒实例掩码。
AI.result: 在真实石英和铁矿石颗粒堆积的 XCT 体数据上，在所评估的协议下，ReplaySAM 的平均实例 Dice 分数高于专家辅助的分水岭方法和 nnInteractive。
AI.conclusion: ReplaySAM 提供了免训练的三维颗粒堆积实例分割框架，其基于几何的提示方式消除了人工提示放置，具备实用性与可推广性。

title: MOVER: Planning Beyond Motion
summary: Residual world models forecast a driving scene through its temporal change, so feature components that stay constant over time vanish from the residual pathway. We ask whether evidence with weak temporal change, such as a waiting pedestrian or a stopped vehicle, can be used more effectively for planning, and introduce MOVER, a complementary event-routing mechanism. A training-time teacher measures how each spatially grounded event query responds when a past frame is removed from shared history and contrasts that sensitivity with the event's pooled temporal residual, prioritizing events that depend on history but receive weak residual evidence. A student predicts the resulting priorities from unperturbed history, so the teacher adds no inference cost. Under fixed total routing mass, one distribution scales a low-rank future bird's-eye-view update and biases trajectory-conditioned event reading. On nuScenes, MOVER reduces ResWorld's UniAD-style average L2 from 0.65 to 0.55 m and its collision rate from 0.23% to 0.12% without direct planner ego status (0.50 m and 0.09% with it), adding 4.1 ms per frame. Matched controls show that the complementary teacher outperforms either signal alone and that the allocation acts mainly during training. Adapted to BridgeDrive-LEAD, MOVER reaches a 96.52 +/- 0.65 driving score over three seeds on the 220-route Bench2Drive closed-loop benchmark, exceeding matched controls in each paired seed by a margin within seed variation.

AI.tldr: 提出MOVER事件路由机制，弥补残差世界模型对弱时变证据（如等待的行人、停止的车辆）的忽视，在nuScenes上降低L2与碰撞率，在Bench2Drive闭环上取得96.52驾驶分数。
AI.motivation: 残差世界模型通过时间变化预测驾驶场景，导致随时间几乎不变的特征成分从残差通路中消失，弱时变但关键的事件（等待行人、停止车辆）证据难以被有效用于规划。
AI.method: 训练期教师移除历史帧，测量每个空间事件查询对共享历史的敏感度，并与该事件的池化时间残差对比，优先选出"依赖历史但残差证据弱"的事件；学生网络从无扰动历史预测这些优先级，故无额外推理开销。在固定总路由质量下，一个分布缩放低秩未来BEV更新并偏置轨迹条件的事件读取。
AI.result: nuScenes上ResWorld的UniAD式平均L2从0.65降至0.55 m，碰撞率从0.23%降至0.12%（无规划器自车状态）；含该状态时为0.50 m与0.09%；每帧仅增4.1 ms。匹配对照表明互补教师优于任一单独信号。迁移至BridgeDrive-LEAD，在220路线Bench2Drive闭环基准上三种子得分96.52±0.65，配对种子均优于匹配对照。
AI.conclusion: 通过历史敏感性教师挖掘弱残差但关键的事件，可在不增加推理成本下提升规划安全性与精度，且具跨框架可迁移性。

title: QSRadar: Query-Conditioned Sparse Radar-Camera Fusion for Efficient 3D Object Detection
comment: Radar-camera fusion, 3D object detection, autonomous driving
summary: Reliable 3D object detection for autonomous trucks requires both the semantic detail provided by cameras and the geometric and motion cues measured by 4D radar. Existing radar-camera detectors commonly construct global radar bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations, whose computational and memory costs grow with the perception range. Sparse query-based detectors offer greater efficiency, but global feature construction can obscure point-level radar geometry and motion information. We present QSRadar, a query-conditioned sparse radar fusion framework for efficient long-range 3D detection. Built on a Sparse4Dv3-style visual-temporal detector, QSRadar retrieves a compact set of raw radar points around each evolving object hypothesis. The selected points are represented in an anchor-aligned coordinate frame, augmented with motion residuals, radar cross section, and sweep timing, and aggregated by a query-conditioned set encoder. Radar neighborhoods are retrieved again after each anchor refinement, coupling evidence selection with object estimation. Under the official MAN TruckScenes validation protocol, QSRadar achieves 38.09 mAP and 52.20 NDS, compared with 37.08 mAP and 50.78 NDS for our reproduced Sparse4D-Radar global Radar-BEV baseline. In matched tests on an RTX 4090 D, QSRadar reduces latency by 45%, peak memory usage by 49%, and GFLOPs by 43%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QSRadar，一种面向长距离 3D 检测的查询条件化稀疏雷达融合框架，通过在锚点附近检索原始雷达点并进行查询条件化编码，在保持精度提升的同时显著降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶卡车需要相机的语义信息和 4D 雷达的几何与运动线索。现有雷达-相机检测器多用全局雷达 BEV 表示，其计算与内存开销随感知范围增长；而全局特征构建会模糊点级雷达几何与运动信息。
AI.method: 基于 Sparse4Dv3 风格的视觉-时序检测器，QSRadar 对每个演化中的物体假设检索其周围一小部分原始雷达点；将所选点表示在锚对齐坐标系中，并加入运动残差、雷达截面积和扫描时间信息，由查询条件化的集合编码器聚合。每次锚点细化后重新检索雷达邻域，使证据选择与目标估计耦合。
AI.result: 在 MAN TruckScenes 官方验证协议下，QSRadar 达到 38.09 mAP 和 52.20 NDS，优于复现的 Sparse4D-Radar 全局 Radar-BEV 基线的 37.08 mAP 和 50.78 NDS。在 RTX 4090 D 上匹配测试中，延迟降低 45%，峰值内存降低 49%，GFLOPs 降低 43%。
AI.conclusion: 查询条件化的稀疏雷达点检索是一种高效、有效的雷达-相机融合范式，兼顾长距离检测精度与计算效率，优于全局雷达 BEV 方案。

title: Teaching How to Reason, Beyond What to Answer: Evidence-Faithful On-Policy Distillation for streaming video understanding
summary: Moment Retrieval (MR) aims to localize the temporal segment in a video that corresponds to a given textual description. However, a textual query often provides only a sparse semantic description of the target event, whereas the video contains rich and fine-grained visual variations. This mismatch creates an inherent gap between textual semantics and visual content, making a single textual input insufficient for precise cross-modal alignment. As a result, when multiple temporally adjacent or semantically similar segments exist, the model may struggle to distinguish the target moment from confusing candidates. To address this challenge, we propose a Multi-Perspective Auxiliary Representation (MPAR) framework, which aims to bridge this alignment gap by enriching a single textual input with complementary visual cues from multiple perspectives. Specifically, MPAR consists of three key components: (1) Auxiliary Representation Initialization (ARI) constructs multiple learnable representation slots from the original query, preserving the query intent while preparing flexible carriers for subsequent visual cue injection; (2) Visual-Induced Semantic Structuring (VISS) injects target-specific visual attributes into each representation while preserving semantic coherence with the original query; and (3) Multi-Perspective Semantic Aligner (MPSA) aligns each auxiliary representation with corresponding video regions to enhance discriminative localization. By constructing multi-perspective auxiliary representations and guiding the model to attend to relevant visual regions across these representations, our model achieves more accurate moment localization. Extensive experiments on MR benchmarks demonstrate that our MPAR outperforms state-of-the-art methods, validating the effectiveness of MPAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多视角辅助表征框架MPAR，通过在原始文本查询基础上注入多角度视觉线索，缓解文本语义稀疏与视频视觉信息丰富之间的不对齐，从而提升时刻检索定位精度。
AI.motivation: 时刻检索中，文本查询往往只提供稀疏的语义描述，而视频包含丰富细粒度视觉变化，形成文本-视觉间的固有语义鸿沟。单一文本输入不足以精确跨模态对齐，导致在时间相邻或语义相似片段中难以区分目标时刻。
AI.method: MPAR框架包含三部分：(1) 辅助表征初始化ARI——从原始查询构建多个可学习表征槽，保留查询意图同时为视觉线索注入提供灵活载体；(2) 视觉引导语义结构化VISS——向每个表征注入目标相关的视觉属性，同时保持与原查询的语义一致性；(3) 多视角语义对齐器MPSA——将各辅助表征与对应视频区域对齐，增强判别性定位。
AI.result: 在时刻检索基准上的大量实验表明，MPAR优于现有最先进方法，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建多视角辅助表征并引导模型在这些表征下关注相关视频区域，可实现更精确的时刻定位，弥合文本语义与视觉内容间的对齐鸿沟。

title: Bi-Refine: Semantic Verification-Guided Progressive Refinement for Moment Retrieval
summary: Moment Retrieval (MR) aims to identify the temporal segment in an untrimmed video that corresponds to a natural language query. Existing approaches commonly refine temporal predictions within the localization pathway, without explicitly verifying candidate-level semantic consistency. Moreover, directly reusing semantic scores as feedback can cause over-correction when the verification signal is unreliable. To address these issues, we propose Bi-Refine, a semantic verification-guided progressive refinement framework that formulates MR as a closed-loop verification-and-refinement process. A Heuristic Localization Branch first generates candidate moments, while a Semantic Verification Branch evaluates their query consistency in a semantically enriched latent space. Query supervision further trains the verifier with the same candidate moment but different queries, encouraging it to distinguish the matched query from semantically similar mismatched queries. The resulting verification features are incorporated into a Progressive Refinement Loop that updates both query representations and multimodal features. To suppress potentially harmful updates, a lightweight reliability estimator gates query updates and reweights candidate contributions in feature feedback. A convergence-based adaptive stopping strategy additionally terminates unnecessary refinement during inference. Experiments on three standard MR benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and state-of-the-art performance of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出Bi-Refine框架，将视频时刻检索建模为闭环的"验证-精炼"过程，用语义验证引导渐进式精炼，并用可靠性估计门控抑制有害更新。
AI.motivation: 现有MR方法仅在定位路径内部精炼时间预测，缺乏候选级别的语义一致性验证；且直接把语义分数当作反馈信号，在验证不可靠时会导致过度校正。
AI.method: 1) 启发式定位分支生成候选时刻；2) 语义验证分支在语义增强的隐空间中评估候选与查询的一致性，并用"同候选+不同查询"的查询监督训练验证器以区分匹配查询与语义相似的不匹配查询；3) 渐进精炼环将验证特征回传，更新查询表示与多模态特征；4) 轻量可靠性估计器门控查询更新并对候选贡献重加权以抑制有害更新；5) 推理时使用基于收敛的自适应停止策略提前终止精炼。
AI.result: 在三个标准MR基准数据集上验证了方法的有效性，取得领先（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 候选级语义验证与受门控约束的渐进精炼能有效提升时刻检索精度，可靠性门控与自适应停止可避免过度校正并减少冗余计算。

title: FireDesmoke: Fire Smoke Removal via Real Smoke Transfer and Semantic Rectification
summary: Fire smoke removal must restore dense and medium smoke regions while preserving the clear (smoke-free) content. Existing methods either leave the smoke or alter the visible content, and generative models may hallucinate people or remove flames. Real fire smoke is spatially local: the degradation and its corruption of semantic features are both concentrated in the smoke regions. We propose FireDesmoke, built on this locality: Real Smoke Transfer calibrates smoke fields on real-fire recordings and transfers their spatial layout onto clean images to synthesize training pairs, and Semantic Rectification uses pixel features to rectify the tokens of a frozen foundation encoder where smoke corrupts them. With matched training budgets, replacing the transferred pairs with SmokeBench pairs lowers dense-smoke PSNR by 0.74 dB, and removing Semantic Rectification leaves clear regions 1.31 dB below the input. On what is, to the best of our knowledge, the first paired dataset of real fire smoke for image restoration, with 1,500 test frames from a held-out viewpoint, FireDesmoke improves dense- and medium-smoke PSNR by 3.73 and 2.63 dB while keeping clear regions at the input level (+0.41 dB); no other compared method gains at least 1 dB in dense smoke without lowering clear-region PSNR, and no hallucinated person is found in its outputs. It achieves state-of-the-art overall results on this benchmark and, trained on SmokeBench, the highest PSNR with the second-best SSIM and LPIPS.

AI.tldr: 提出 FireDesmoke，利用真实火灾烟雾的空间局部性，通过真实烟雾迁移与语义校正实现去烟并保持清晰区域不变。
AI.motivation: 现有去烟方法要么残留烟雾、要么改变可见内容，生成式模型还可能幻觉出人或抹除火焰；核心观察是真实火灾烟雾在空间上是局部的，其退化与语义特征污染均集中在烟雾区域。
AI.method: FireDesmoke 包含两部分：Real Smoke Transfer 在真实火灾录像上标定烟雾场，并将烟雾空间布局迁移到干净图像以合成训练对；Semantic Rectification 用像素特征校正冻结基础编码器中被烟雾污染的 token。
AI.result: 相同训练预算下，用 SmokeBench 数据替代迁移数据使浓烟 PSNR 下降 0.74 dB；移除语义校正使清晰区域比输入低 1.31 dB。在首个真实火灾烟雾成对数据集（1,500 帧留出视角测试）上，浓烟与中烟 PSNR 分别提升 3.73 与 2.63 dB，清晰区保持输入水平（+0.41 dB），无幻觉人物；在 SmokeBench 上训练也取得最高 PSNR、次优 SSIM 与 LPIPS。
AI.conclusion: 基于烟雾局部性的设计可同时实现浓/中烟去除与清晰区保真，并在真实烟雾基准上达到 SOTA，避免生成式幻觉。

title: Beyond Binary Correctness: A Surrogate for Confidence Learning in Large Language and Vision-Language Models
summary: Confidence estimation for large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) aims to assess how likely a particular generated response is to be correct. We investigate how learning this assessment can benefit from the model's predictive reliability on the underlying query. Binary correctness supervision, however, assigns identical labels to occasional errors and frequent failures, as well as isolated successes and consistent success. These outcomes can arise from substantially different predictive behavior under stochastic decoding. We propose a confidence-learning framework that supplements realized response correctness with query-level predictive reliability. We estimate reliability through repeated generations under a fixed model and decoding configuration, then combine the empirical success rate with individual correctness to construct a graded confidence surrogate. The surrogate differentiates responses sharing the same correctness label while preserving the average predictive reliability of the sampled response pool. To learn this target, we condition an independent confidence estimator on the query and its full generated response, and optimize backbone LoRA adapters together with a projection and scalar confidence head using mean squared error. Repeated sampling is required only for supervision construction; inference scores an individual response without additional generations. We establish ordering and mean preservation properties of the surrogate and derive a selective-risk bound connecting population surrogate prediction error to the error rate among accepted responses. We evaluate the framework across language and vision-language models, examining confidence calibration and selective prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种置信度学习框架，用查询级别的预测可靠性（重复采样得到的经验成功率）与单条响应的对错标签结合，构造分级置信度替代目标，训练独立的置信度估计器，改善LLM/VLM的置信度校准与选择性预测。
AI.motivation: 现有置信度估计使用二元的对错监督，会把"偶发错误"与"频繁失败"、"偶然成功"与"稳定成功"赋予相同标签；而在随机解码下这些结果的预测行为差异很大，二元标签损失了大量信息。
AI.method: 在固定模型与解码配置下重复生成，估计查询级经验成功率；将该成功率与单条响应的正确性结合，构造分级的置信度替代目标（保持采样响应池的平均可靠性）。用一个以查询和完整生成响应为输入的独立置信度估计器学习该目标，联合优化骨干LoRA适配器、投影层与标量置信头，使用MSE损失。重复采样仅用于构造监督，推理时无需额外生成。理论上给出替代目标的排序性与均值保持性质，并推导选择性风险界，将总体替代预测误差与被接受响应的错误率联系起来。
AI.result: 给出替代目标的排序与均值保持性质，以及连接总体替代预测误差与接受集错误率的选择性风险界；在语言模型与视觉语言模型上进行了置信度校准与选择性预测的实验评估。
AI.conclusion: 用查询级预测可靠性补充二元正确性监督，可在不增加推理成本的前提下为LLM/VLM提供更细粒度、更可靠的置信度估计，并具备理论保证。

title: FolioWeaver: A LayerGraph-Grounded Agent for Layered Image Generation and Editing
summary: Layered image generation separates images into compositable layers, allowing users to manipulate individual elements independently. However, such asset-level editability does not enable the generation system to interpret successive feedback, perform targeted edits, and preserve unaffected content. We introduce FolioWeaver, a LayerGraph-grounded agent that unifies layered-image generation and iterative editing through a persistent Executable Scene State. FolioWeaver constructs a LayerGraph and generates independent visual assets conditioned on a shared scene reference. An Editing Agent performs feedback-driven modifications and self-repair through scoped actions, selective layer execution, and visual verification, enabling targeted updates while reusing unchanged assets. We also publicly release LayerFolio, a dataset of 100,377 human-reviewed layered scenes spanning six visual domains, together with two evaluation protocols: AtomicQA for measuring requirement satisfaction and CBLP for assessing layer organization. Experiments demonstrate that FolioWeaver achieves superior layer organization and composite fidelity compared with direct layered-generation methods. Analyses validate the contributions of component adaptation, execution-grounded repair, and cross-domain training. FolioWeaver advances layered-image generation toward persistent, controllable, and iterative visual creation. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/FolioWeaver/LayerFolio.

AI.tldr: FolioWeaver 提出以 LayerGraph 为基座、基于持久化“可执行场景状态”的智能体，统一分层图像生成与迭代式编辑，并发布含 10 万级人工审核分层场景的数据集 LayerFolio 与两套评测协议。
AI.motivation: 现有分层图像生成虽支持资产级独立编辑，但生成系统无法理解连续反馈、执行定向修改并保持未受影响内容不变，缺乏持久可控的迭代创作能力。
AI.method: 构建 LayerGraph 并基于共享场景参考生成独立视觉资产；由 Editing Agent 通过范围受限动作、选择性图层执行与视觉验证实现反馈驱动的修改与自修复，复用未变动资产；同时发布 LayerFolio 数据集（100,377 个人工审核分层场景，覆盖六个视觉域）及 AtomicQA（需求满足度）与 CBLP（图层组织）两套评测协议。
AI.result: 实验表明 FolioWeaver 在图层组织与合成保真度上优于直接分层生成方法；消融分析验证了组件适配、执行接地的修复机制与跨域训练的贡献。
AI.conclusion: FolioWeaver 推动分层图像生成向持久、可控、迭代式的视觉创作方向发展，并公开数据集以支持后续研究。

title: SalivaryHSI-Seg: A New Challenging Benchmark for Ex Vivo Salivary Gland Hyperspectral Tissue Segmentation
summary: Salivary gland tumors are common lesions in oral and maxillofacial practice, and accurate identification of tumor regions and surrounding salivary gland tissues is important for tissue assessment, pathological sampling, and clinical decision support. Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) records continuous spectral responses together with spatial imaging information, providing a promising way to capture fine-grained tissue-discriminative information. Nevertheless, the development of salivary gland HSI tissue segmentation remains limited due to the lack of standardized benchmarks with pixel-level annotations and unified evaluation protocols. To address this issue, we introduce SalivaryHSI-Seg, a hyperspectral tissue segmentation benchmark for ex vivo salivary gland specimens, containing 119 HSI samples from 31 patients with multi-class pixel-level annotations. We establish a patient-level five-fold cross-validation protocol and evaluate different input representations, model architectures, and challenging subsets with small tumor and complex boundary. Based on this benchmark, we further propose HyBSD, a hyperspectral boundary-guided spectral-difference network for full-HSI salivary gland tissue segmentation. HyBSD exploits boundary-guided spectral-difference cues to improve tissue delineation in ambiguous transition regions. Extensive experiments show that full-HSI input provides more discriminative information than sampled spectrums, and that HyBSD achieves 74.97% mDice and 87.76% Tumor Dice, with further advantages on the challenging subsets. Dataset and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出唾液腺高光谱组织分割基准 SalivaryHSI-Seg（31名患者、119个离体样本、像素级多类标注）及患者级五折交叉验证协议，并提出边界引导的光谱差异网络 HyBSD，实现全高光谱唾液腺组织分割。
AI.motivation: 唾液腺肿瘤在口腔颌面部常见，准确识别肿瘤区域与周围腺体组织对组织评估、病理取样和临床决策很重要。高光谱成像可提供精细的组织判别信息，但该方向缺乏带像素级标注的标准化基准和统一评测协议，制约了唾液腺高光谱分割的发展。
AI.method: 构建 SalivaryHSI-Seg 基准：119 个离体唾液腺高光谱样本、31 名患者、多类像素级标注，并设定患者级五折交叉验证；系统评测不同输入表示、模型架构及小肿瘤/复杂边界等困难子集。在基准之上提出 HyBSD，一种面向全高光谱输入的边界引导光谱差异网络，利用边界引导的光谱差异线索改善模糊过渡区域的组织勾画。
AI.result: 实验表明全高光谱输入比采样光谱更具判别性；HyBSD 取得 74.97% mDice 与 87.76% Tumor Dice，并在困难子集上进一步体现优势。数据集与代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了唾液腺高光谱分割的基准空白，验证了全光谱输入与边界引导光谱差异建模的有效性，为后续研究提供了标准化评测平台。

title: SF-Flow: Spectral Flow Matching with High Structural Fidelity for Hallucination-Suppressed Scientific Image Generation
summary: Scientific image generation focuses on reproducing experimental appearance while following a prescribed spatial layout. A key challenge is acute data sparsity, which requires operating with unpaired collections of materials (real images and prescribed layouts), where no direct supervision is feasible. Work on unpaired translation has shown that it is possible to reproduce the texture and intensity variations of real images, but it is extremely hard to retain the intended phase boundaries in the prescribed locations. This paper tackles this challenge and introduces SF-Flow, a flow-matching model trained only on real material images that imposes spectral constraints during generation, producing images that are high-fidelity and consistent with the prescribed layouts. Because layouts enter only at generation time, the approach extends to layout maps outside the distribution of any available training layouts. We evaluate the method on synchrotron tomography of concrete, lens-coupled laboratory microCT of powders, and industrial XCT of additively manufactured metal. Without instrument-specific modeling, we show that SF-Flow achieves substantially higher template agreement and joint fidelity--structure score than previous methods, including contrastive unpaired translation.

AI.tldr: SF-Flow：仅在真实材料图像上训练的流匹配生成模型，在生成时施加频谱约束，无需配对数据即可按指定空间布局生成高保真科学图像。
AI.motivation: 科学图像生成需复现实验外观并遵循规定的空间布局，但存在严重数据稀缺问题——只能获得不成对的真实图像与布局集合，无直接监督。现有非配对翻译方法虽能复现纹理与强度变化，却难以在指定位置保留相界。
AI.method: 提出流匹配模型 SF-Flow，仅用真实材料图像训练，在生成过程中引入频谱约束；布局仅在生成阶段输入，故可泛化到训练分布之外的布局图。
AI.result: 在混凝土同步辐射断层、粉末透镜耦合实验室显微CT、增材制造金属工业XCT三类数据上评测。无需仪器特定建模，SF-Flow在模板一致性与联合保真度-结构得分上显著优于包括对比非配对翻译（CUT）在内的先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 频谱约束的流匹配可在无配对监督下兼顾真实纹理与布局边界保真，并具备跨仪器、跨分布布局的泛化能力。

title: RadarOSV: Unified 3D Scene and Motion Perception from mmWave Radars
summary: Millimeter-wave radar offers weather-resilient sensing for 3D occupancy prediction. Existing radar occupancy methods mainly model geometry, with limited joint modeling of semantics and motion. Cascaded imaging radar provides fine spatial detail but has a limited unambiguous velocity range, whereas single-chip radar offers a wider range but coarser spatial resolution. We propose RadarOSV, to our knowledge the first radar-only framework that jointly predicts occupancy, dynamic object semantics, and ground-relative velocity from raw radar data in unified voxels, by exploiting complementary measurements from both radars. Its Polar-to-Cartesian Geometry (PCG) backbone maps polar imaging-radar features into Cartesian voxels through fixed and deformable sampling, guiding cross-radar fusion for geometry and attribute prediction. Single-chip detection outputs provide class evidence, while raw Doppler spectra supply motion features and radial-velocity candidates. The velocity readout selects from these candidates using fused features to resolve aliasing, then combines the selected radial estimate with learned motion. Ego-motion compensation uses radar-estimated velocity, so inference requires no external odometry or other sensors. On K-Radar, single-frame PCG achieves 40.7% mIoU within 12.8 m, compared with RadarOcc's reported 34.3%. On the BRIDGE-Liv dataset, compared with a cascaded-radar baseline predicting the same outputs with external ego velocity, RadarOSV improves macro-averaged accuracy across four dynamic object classes within annotated object regions from 63.1% to 75.5% and reduces object radial-velocity MAE against manual Doppler annotations from 1.03 to 0.51 m/s, while maintaining geometric occupancy mIoU.

AI.tldr: RadarOSV是首个仅用雷达原始数据、在统一体素中联合预测占据、动态物体语义与地面相对速度的框架，利用成像雷达与单芯片雷达的互补性，无外部里程计，几何、语义与测速均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有雷达占据方法主要建模几何，对语义与运动的联合建模有限；级联成像雷达空间细节好但无模糊测速范围窄，单芯片雷达测速范围宽但空间分辨率粗，需融合两者互补优势，并摆脱对外部里程计/其他传感器的依赖。
AI.method: 提出Polar-to-Cartesian Geometry (PCG)主干，通过固定与可变形采样将极坐标成像雷达特征映射为笛卡尔体素，引导跨雷达融合以预测几何与属性；单芯片检测输出提供类别证据，原始多普勒谱提供运动特征与径向速度候选；速度读出模块用融合特征从候选中选择以解算模糊，并与学习的运动结合；用雷达估计速度进行自运动补偿。
AI.result: K-Radar上单帧PCG在12.8m内达40.7% mIoU（RadarOcc报告34.3%）；BRIDGE-Liv上，相较预测相同输出但用外部自车速度的级联雷达基线，四类动态物体标注区域内宏平均准确率从63.1%提升至75.5%，径向速度MAE从1.03降至0.51 m/s，同时保持几何占据mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 融合级联与单芯片雷达可实现统一体素内的占据、语义与速度联合预测且仅靠雷达；无需外部里程计仍显著提升语义与测速精度，同时保持几何性能，验证了互补雷达融合与多普勒解模糊策略的有效性。

title: When "A or B" Is Less Likely than A: Coherent Probabilities for Vision Decision Models
summary: Vision decision models answer a multiple-choice question about an image with one probability per option, and software uses them directly. We show that the probabilities depend on how the options are grouped: a merged option "A or B" receives on average 11.5 points less probability than the sum of A and B. This under-additivity appears at every model size from 0.85B to 26B and remains after fine-tuning on labels. We propose CORE, which asks each training question with its options regrouped and trains the answers to all these questions toward one target distribution over the original options, summed into each question's groups. On 1,050 items from seven benchmarks, CORE reduces the total variation distance between the answer to a regrouped question and the original answer summed into the same groups from 14.8 to 5.8 points on the 0.85B model, against 9.4 for the best baseline trained on the same questions. At all five model sizes, CORE reduces this distance without lowering accuracy.

AI.tldr: Vision decision models assign option probabilities that are not additive under option merging (under-additivity ~11.5 pts); CORE fixes this by training on regrouped options toward a shared target distribution.
AI.motivation: Vision decision models output one probability per option, and software consumes these probabilities directly. However, the probabilities depend on how options are grouped: merging "A or B" yields far less probability than P(A)+P(B), breaking downstream reliance on calibrated option probabilities across model scales and after fine-tuning.
AI.method: The authors diagnose under-additivity across model sizes 0.85B–26B and after fine-tuning. They propose CORE: each training question is re-asked with options regrouped, and answers to all regroupings are trained toward a single target distribution over original options, summed into each question's groups.
AI.result: On 1,050 items from seven benchmarks, CORE reduces total variation distance between regrouped-question answers and original answers summed into the same groups from 14.8 to 5.8 points on the 0.85B model (best baseline: 9.4). Across all five model sizes, CORE reduces this distance without lowering accuracy.
AI.conclusion: Option-granularity inconsistency is a systematic, scale-persistent flaw; consistency-aware regrouped training (CORE) substantially improves probability additivity while preserving accuracy.

title: LMnOP: Pruning 3D Gaussian Splatting via Leave-Many-Out Importance
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting renders photorealistic views in real time. However, a single scene often needs millions of Gaussians, so these models are costly to store and render. Pruning reduces this cost by keeping a subset of the Gaussians. A common score is the leave-one-out importance, which is the loss increase when a Gaussian alone is removed. At high pruning ratios, many Gaussians are removed together, so Gaussians that are redundant alone but essential together are lost. We present LMnOP (Leave-Many-Out Pruning), which estimates the importance of each Gaussian under the removal of the other Gaussians. This leave-many-out importance is the average loss increase when a Gaussian is removed while the others are also removed at random. We compute the exact mean and variance of each pixel's color under random removal in closed form, and approximate the importance from them without sampling removal patterns. We refine each Gaussian's probability of remaining with its importance and prune once at the end. Without fine-tuning, LMnOP achieves the best results in 16 of 18 metrics on three datasets at 90% and 99% removal. It improves SSIM and LPIPS over GaussianPOP in all 13 scenes.

AI.tldr: LMnOP提出"去多"（leave-many-out）重要性来衡量3D高斯在同时随机移除其他高斯时的损失增量均值，并用闭式解精确计算像素颜色的均值与方差，无需采样即可剪枝，在高压缩率下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯溅射模型常需数百万个高斯，存储与渲染开销大。剪枝可降成本，但常用"留一"（leave-one-out）重要性在高剪枝率下失效：多个高斯同时被移除时，单独看冗余但组合起来不可或缺的高斯会被误删。
AI.method: 提出LMnOP：估计某高斯在其他高斯也被移除情形下的重要性，即在该高斯被移除、其余高斯按随机方式移除时损失增量的平均值。对随机移除下每个像素颜色的均值与方差给出闭式精确解，从而在不采样移除模式的情况下近似重要性；再用重要性迭代修正每个高斯的保留概率，最终一次性剪枝。
AI.result: 无需微调，在三个数据集、90%与99%移除率下，18项指标中有16项取得最佳。相比GaussianPOP，在全部13个场景上SSIM与LPIPS均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 考虑高斯间联合移除效应的"去多"重要性是更可靠的剪枝判据，闭式统计量使其计算高效，实现高压缩率下的高质量渲染。

title: Thermal-Guided Low-Light UAV Image Enhancement: A Reliability-Aware Guidance Network and a Unified Benchmark
summary: Thermal-guided low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is promising for nighttime unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) perception because thermal imagery remains informative under severe visible degradation. However, the degraded visible image serves as both the alignment reference and the enhancement target, making thermal guidance uncertain in its spatial correspondence and local utility under low illumination, sensor differences, and UAV motion. Misaligned or unsuitable thermal cues may introduce artifacts, while spatially varying degradation requires region-specific restoration rather than uniform enhancement. To address these challenges, we propose a Reliability-Aware Multi-Strategy Guidance Network (RMGNet) for thermal-guided UAV LLIE under weak optical-thermal alignment. Its Reliability-Aware Guidance Calibration Module (RAGCM) performs coarse-to-fine displacement estimation and jointly evaluates the reliability of aligned thermal guidance and the usability of degraded visible evidence. Based on calibrated guidance, degradation, and reliability cues, the Multi-Strategy Enhancement Routing Module (MSERM) generates candidates for detail preservation, highlight-protected relighting, and thermal compensation, then spatially routes their contributions. We further construct the UAV weakly aligned Optical-Thermal dataset (UWOT), the largest UAV-oriented benchmark to date for weakly aligned optical-thermal low-light enhancement, containing 5,000 triplets. Extensive experiments show that RMGNet outperforms representative single-modal and multimodal state-of-the-art methods in enhancement quality while retaining competitive computational efficiency and greater robustness to practical cross-modal misalignment. The dataset and code will be publicly available at https://github.com/mmic-lcl/Datasets-and-benchmark-code.

AI.tldr: 提出可靠性感知多策略引导网络RMGNet，用于弱对齐条件下热成像引导的无人机低光照图像增强，并构建最大规模UWOT基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 夜间无人机场景中可见光图像退化严重，热成像仍具信息量，但退化可见光图像同时充当对齐参考和增强目标，导致热引导在空间对应和局部效用上不确定；错位或不适用的热线索会引入伪影，且空间变化的退化需要区域化恢复而非统一增强。
AI.method: RMGNet含两个模块：可靠性感知引导校准模块（RAGCM）做由粗到细的位移估计，并联合评估对齐后热引导的可靠性与退化可见光证据的可用性；多策略增强路由模块（MSERM）基于校准引导、退化和可靠性线索生成细节保持、高光保护重光照、热补偿三类候选，并进行空间路由融合。同时构建UWOT数据集（5000组三元组）。
AI.result: 实验表明RMGNet在增强质量上优于代表性单模态与多模态SOTA方法，同时保持有竞争力的计算效率，并对实际跨模态错位具有更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 面向弱光-热对齐的无人机LLIE，可靠性感知与多策略空间路由能有效利用不确定的热引导；UWOT数据集与代码将公开，为该方向提供基准。

title: What Remains After Concept Erasure? Sparse Autoencoder Probes for Auditing Diffusion Models
summary: Concept erasure aims to remove selected visual concepts from text-to-image diffusion models while preserving the generation of non-target concepts. Evaluation typically measures target suppression and non-target preservation in generated images, but a concept's absence from these outputs does not establish its removal from the model. We introduce SAE-Audit, a white-box audit using sparse autoencoder (SAE) probes to test whether activation interventions can restore target-concept generation without changing model weights or test prompts. After verifying target suppression, we compare the original and edited models using a shared SAE representation learned from original-model activations, identifying features whose target-related responses weaken after erasure. We inject sparse directions derived from the original-model responses into the edited model, keeping these directions fixed across test prompts, and evaluate recovery on held-out scene families. Experiments span six erasure methods and four domains: objects, artistic styles, copyrighted content, and nudity. Interventions using a few dozen selected SAE features yield higher average recovery rates than matched random-feature interventions, with recovery concentrated in objects and nudity following cross-attention edits. Most styles and copyrighted concepts show limited recovery under the tested intervention settings. These findings show that output suppression can coexist with responsiveness to sparse concept directions supplied from the original model.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAE-Audit 白盒审计方法，用稀疏自编码器探针检验概念擦除模型中被抑制的概念是否真正从模型中移除，发现输出抑制与稀疏概念方向响应可并存。
AI.motivation: 概念擦除的常规评估只看生成图像中目标概念是否消失、非目标概念是否保留，但"输出中不出现"并不等于"概念已从模型中移除"，缺乏对内部机制的检验。
AI.method: 先在确认目标被抑制后，用原模型激活训练共享 SAE，比较原模型与擦除模型中与目标相关的特征响应强弱；再把原模型响应导出的稀疏方向固定注入擦除模型（不改权重、不改测试提示），在留出场景族上测恢复率，并与随机特征干预对照。覆盖6种擦除方法与4个域（物体、艺术风格、版权内容、裸体）。
AI.result: 用几十个选定 SAE 特征的干预平均恢复率高于匹配的随机特征干预；恢复集中于物体与裸体域（交叉注意力编辑后）；多数风格与版权概念在测试设置下恢复有限。
AI.conclusion: 输出层面的抑制可以与模型对原模型提供的稀疏概念方向仍具响应性共存，说明仅凭生成结果不能证明概念已被移除，需内部白盒审计。

title: AxE: Benchmarking Agent-Environment Generalization of Video World Models via Grounded Events
summary: Edge cases are not the long tail; they are the norm. An embodied system deployed across changing environments, bodies, objects, and tasks will routinely encounter combinations that were absent from its training data. General-purpose physical intelligence therefore requires world models that reuse prior knowledge, predict consequences, and adapt with little or no additional training. Yet current evaluations of conditional video generation emphasize visual quality, prompt alignment, or isolated physical plausibility, leaving systematic generalization difficult to measure. We introduce AxE Bench, a benchmark that organizes condition changes along eight factors of the acting agent and of its environment, and pairs every original condition with controlled variants that change one side or both. WBench-plus applies the same structure to an existing multi-turn benchmark, pairing each WBench scenario with variants on the environment side, through its world setting or camera behavior, or on the agent side, through its interaction instructions. Additionally, to score generated futures, we develop an evaluation harness that combines vision-language reasoning with targeted computer-vision evidence, converting each video into temporally localized events and comparing generated events with reference events in both time and semantics. We summarize each model with the AxE Score, event Fidelity weighted by its Stability across original-variant pairs. Across twenty models, generated events match reference events far more often in timing than in content: no model exceeds a Fidelity of 13.01, the highest Stability is 0.55, and the highest AxE Score is 7.10. Together, these components turn world-model generalization from an informal aspiration into a falsifiable evaluation program for real and simulated interactions. Our project website can be found at: AxEBench.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出 AxE Bench 基准，沿智能体与环境的八个因素组织条件变化，并配套视觉语言推理与计算机视觉证据结合的评测框架，用 AxE Score（事件保真度×稳定性）衡量世界模型的泛化能力；20 个模型均表现不佳（最高 AxE Score 仅 7.10）。
AI.motivation: 具身系统部署中"边缘情况"实为常态，会频繁遇到训练分布外的环境、本体、物体与任务组合，因此需要能复用先验知识、预测后果并少样本适应的世界模型。然而现有条件视频生成评测侧重视觉质量、提示对齐或孤立物理合理性，无法系统度量泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建 AxE Bench：将条件变化组织为作用智能体与环境两侧共八个因素，为每个原始条件配对受控变体（单侧或双侧变化）；并将同样结构扩展到已有 WBench，形成 WBench-plus（环境侧为世界设定或相机行为，智能体侧为交互指令）。评分方面开发评测工具链，结合视觉语言推理与针对性计算机视觉证据，将每段视频转化为时序定位事件，在时间与语义两个维度对比生成事件与参考事件；最终以"事件保真度按原始-变体对的稳定性加权"得到 AxE Score。
AI.result: 在 20 个模型上，生成事件在时间上匹配参考远多于内容匹配；无一模型保真度超过 13.01，最高稳定性 0.55，最高 AxE Score 7.10。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将世界模型泛化从非正式愿景转变为可证伪的评测计划，适用于真实与模拟交互，并揭示了当前模型内容泛化能力的显著不足。

title: Separating Protocol Effects from Spatio-Temporal Evidence in Person Re-Identification Re-Ranking
summary: Spatio-temporal priors re-rank person re-identification matches using the camera pair and the time gap, and are reported to add large gains on Market-1501. We ask how much of such a gain encodes the evaluation protocol rather than learned spatio-temporal evidence. Starting from a course-project re-ranker that adds log camera-transition and log time-gap terms to cosine similarity, we train a strong ResNet-50 baseline (Rank-1 94.3 %, mAP 86.2 % over three seeds), choose the fusion weights on an identity-disjoint validation split and evaluate on the official test set with control priors. The repository form adds 2.30 mAP points, but a one-parameter penalty on same-camera pairs alone adds 2.19: the protocol never places a true match in the query's camera, so the penalty removes distractors for free. The time term of that form is almost unused; a pair-level diagnostic traces this to its modelling the time gap given a match without dividing by the gap distribution of all candidate pairs. A likelihood-ratio prior adds 4.04 points without the penalty and 5.62 with it; shuffling the time stamps removes the extra gain, so about 3.43 points are tied to identity. The prior fixes the first-ranked match of 4.2 % of the queries and breaks it for 0.1 %. The gain shrinks as the visual baseline improves (11.9 to 5.62 points between a 70.5 % and a 86.2 % mAP model) and concentrates on queries whose true matches share the query's video sequence. The study covers one dataset, one backbone and three seeds.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑时空先验在Re-ID中的收益来源：大部分增益来自评测协议漏洞而非真正的时空证据。
AI.motivation: 已有工作报告时空先验（相机对、时间间隔）在Market-1501上带来大幅提升，但作者想辨析其中多少是评测协议本身的产物，多少是真正学到的时空证据。
AI.method: 从课程项目的重排器出发（余弦相似度加对数相机转移项与对数时间间隔项），训练强ResNet-50基线（Rank-1 94.3%，mAP 86.2%，三种子），在身份不重叠的验证集上选融合权重，并用控制先验在官方测试集评测；对比仅同相机惩罚、似然比先验、时间戳打乱等消融与诊断。
AI.result: 仓库形式的先验带来+2.30 mAP，而仅对同相机对施加单参数惩罚即+2.19（协议从不把真实匹配放在查询相机中，故惩罚免费剔除干扰）；原形式的时间项几乎无用，因未除以全体候选对的时间间隔分布；似然比先验无惩罚+4.04、含惩罚+5.62，打乱时间戳则额外增益消失，约3.43分与身份相关；先验修正了4.2%查询的首位匹配，仅破坏0.1%；增益随视觉基线增强而缩小（70.5%到86.2% mAP间由11.9降至5.62分），并集中于真实匹配与查询同视频序列的查询。
AI.conclusion: Market-1501上时空先验的显著增益主要反映评测协议特性与基线的强弱，而非稳健的时空证据；研究仅覆盖单一数据集、单一骨干与三个种子，需谨慎推广。

title: RMR-VLA: Recurrent Memory Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Long-horizon, history-dependent robotic manipulation often requires acting on visual cues that have disappeared, such as an object indicated earlier or a target hidden under a moving cup. The key challenge is to maintain what past evidence means for the next action as the scene changes. We introduce Recurrent Memory Reasoning (RMR), an explicit reasoning step that connects memory to action inside a vision-language-action model (VLA), with no external reasoning model. At each update, the VLA first infers an event from visual evidence, then revises the task state and grounds a subgoal in the current scene to guide action generation. Carrying the state and subgoal across updates lets remembered identities and task progress determine the current target, doubling RoboMME success over an otherwise identical model without recurrence. Joint training lets one VLA both reason and act; because its memory decisions are text tokens with exact likelihoods, GRPO refines them from rollout rewards without making action generation stochastic. Among the compared methods, RMR-VLA achieves the best results on RoboMME (66.46% overall, 79.83% on the Reference category) and LIBERO-Mem (90.08%).

AI.tldr: RMR-VLA在VLA模型内引入显式的循环记忆推理步骤，将记忆与动作连接，无需外部推理模型，在RoboMME与LIBERO-Mem上取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 长时程、依赖历史的机器人操作常需依据已消失的视觉线索行动（如先前指示的物体、移动杯子下的目标）。核心挑战是在场景变化时保持"过去证据对下一步动作的意义"。
AI.method: 提出Recurrent Memory Reasoning（RMR）：在VLA内部加入显式推理步骤。每次更新时，VLA先从视觉证据推断事件，再修正任务状态，并在当前场景中定位子目标以引导动作生成；状态与子目标跨更新传递。采用联合训练使同一VLA既能推理又能行动；因记忆决策为具精确似然的文本token，可用GRPO从rollout奖励中优化，且不使动作生成随机化。
AI.result: 相对无循环的相同模型，RoboMME成功率翻倍；在对比方法中取得最佳：RoboMME整体66.46%（Reference类别79.83%），LIBERO-Mem 90.08%。
AI.conclusion: 显式循环记忆推理能有效将历史证据转化为当前动作目标，且与强化学习微调兼容，验证了在VLA中内嵌记忆推理的可行性。

title: Preserve to Compress: Beyond Low-Dimensional Latents in One-Step Diffusion Codec
summary: Pretrained latent diffusion models bring powerful generative priors to ultra-low-bitrate image compression, but their latent spaces reflect a reconstruction--generation tradeoff. Low-dimensional latents reduce modeling cost but can discard image details, while higher-dimensional latents improve reconstruction yet make diffusion optimization harder under a fixed computational budget. Generative codecs that adopt these pretrained spaces also inherit this compromise, even though compression requires fidelity to a specific source image. In particular, low-dimensional latent interfaces can discard source details before coding and restrict how much decoded information reaches the image decoder. We propose Preserving Information for Compression and Synthesis (PICS), a one-step generative image compression framework that adapts these interfaces to preserve source information. Our Information-Preserving Adaptors (IPAs) expose richer features for coding and retain decoded information throughout reconstruction, while deferred decoder adaptation stabilizes training and helps the image decoder exploit the expanded representations. Experiments on Kodak, DIV2K, and CLIC 2020 show average BD-rate savings of 52.64% and 39.61% over StableCodec at matched LPIPS and DISTS, respectively.

AI.tldr: PICS：一步生成式超低码率图像压缩框架，通过信息保留适配器（IPA）改造预训练潜扩散模型的低维潜在接口，保留源图信息，在Kodak/DIV2K/CLIC 2020上较StableCodec取得显著BD-rate提升。
AI.motivation: 预训练潜扩散模型的潜空间存在"重建—生成"权衡：低维潜变量建模成本低但丢失细节，高维潜变量重建好但在固定算力下扩散优化更难。采用这些预训练空间的生成式编解码器继承了该折中，而压缩本应对特定源图保持保真；低维潜接口在编码前就丢弃源细节，并限制解码信息流入图像解码器。
AI.method: 提出Preserving Information for Compression and Synthesis（PICS），一种一步生成式图像压缩框架。核心是信息保留适配器（IPAs）：为编码暴露更丰富的特征，并在重建全过程中保留已解码信息；同时采用延迟解码器适配以稳定训练，并帮助图像解码器利用扩展后的表示。
AI.result: 在Kodak、DIV2K、CLIC 2020上，分别以LPIPS与DISTS匹配时，相比StableCodec实现平均52.64%与39.61%的BD-rate节省。
AI.conclusion: 通过改造预训练潜扩散模型的潜在接口以保留源信息，PICS在超低码率下同时兼顾重建保真与生成质量，证明适配潜接口是提升生成式压缩效率的有效途径。

title: UUBench: Understanding the Unspoken toward Full-Duplex Multimodal Interaction
comment: 49 pages, 37 figures, 9 tables, including appendices. Preview version; work in progress
summary: Effective real-time, full-duplex multimodal interaction requires systems to understand not only what users say, but also the communicative needs conveyed through prosody, facial expressions, gestures, and context, and to generate audiovisual responses that appropriately address those needs. Existing evaluations offer limited insight into whether systems translate an understanding of such unspoken needs into effective responses. We introduce UUBench, a benchmark for assessing how well multimodal interactive systems Understand the Unspoken intent and address users' implicit communicative needs. The inherent subjectivity of implicit intent inference poses a key challenge for evaluation. To address this, we introduce Process-Oriented Scoring, which grounds the assessment of intent fulfillment in observable auditory and visual cues, such as prosody and gestures. Rather than relying solely on a single overall score, it evaluates how well a response addresses the communicative needs conveyed by each applicable primitive dimension. We aggregate the dimension-level scores according to each dimension's relevance to the annotated evidence. Beyond intent fulfillment, Outcome-Oriented Scoring evaluates the naturalness, appropriateness, and human-likeness of the reply itself under audio-only, visual-only, and audiovisual conditions. To make these judgments traceable to observable evidence, we propose a Fact-Grounded Scoring JEV module, which uses structured, timestamped audiovisual observations of the user and the digital human's reply to assess one dimension or criterion at a time. UUBench provides a foundation for assessing whether multimodal interactive systems respond effectively to meaning beyond literal wording, supporting progress toward context-aware, real-time, full-duplex interaction.

AI.tldr: UUBench 是评估多模态交互系统理解"未言明意图"（Unspoken intent）并作出有效响应的基准，通过过程导向评分（锚定韵律、表情、手势等可观察线索）与结果导向评分（自然性、恰当性、拟人性），配合事实锚定的 JEV 模块实现可追溯评估。
AI.motivation: 实时全双工多模态交互需要系统不仅理解字面内容，还要理解韵律、表情、手势和语境传达的交流需求并生成恰当的视听回应。现有评测难以判断系统是否将这种隐性需求的理解转化为有效回应；且隐性意图推断本身具有主观性，给评估带来挑战。
AI.method: 提出 UUBench 基准；采用 Process-Oriented Scoring，将意图满足度评估落地到可观察的听觉与视觉线索（如韵律、手势），按各原始维度的相关性加权聚合维度级分数而非单一总分；同时用 Outcome-Oriented Scoring 在纯音频、纯视觉、视听三种条件下评估回复的自然性、恰当性与拟人性；并提出 Fact-Grounded Scoring JEV 模块，基于带时间戳的、结构化的用户与数字人回复视听观察，逐维度/逐标准进行判断。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值；主要产出为基准框架及两套评分机制与 JEV 模块，使评分判断可追溯至可观察证据。
AI.conclusion: UUBench 为评估多模态交互系统能否有效回应字面之外的语义提供了基础，推动面向语境感知、实时、全双工交互的研究进展。

title: WaDiS: Boundary-Preserving Diffusion Segmentation via Multi-Scale Wavelet Conditioning and Frequency-Aware Gating
summary: Diffusion models have shown strong potential in medical image segmentation due to their generative capabilities and robustness. However, existing methods often struggle to preserve fine anatomical boundaries and to retain multi-scale structural information due to the loss of spatial and frequency details during feature encoding, particularly in complex clinical imaging conditions. This work presents WaDiS, a wavelet-powered conditional latent diffusion framework for medical image segmentation that addresses these limitations through multi-scale wavelet conditioning and frequency-aware information filtering for boundary preservation. The model adopts a multi-scale wavelet conditioning encoder to retain rich structural features, leveraging its lossless nature to better preserve semantic priors critical to the diffusion process. In addition, a Frequency-Aware Gating Block (FAGB) is introduced into the skip connections of the diffusion U-Net, enabling adaptive spectral filtering and residual fusion to better emphasize boundary structures while reducing irrelevant content. To improve generalization across clinical domains, we adopt a structure-preserving color augmentation strategy during training. Specifically, global color statistics are transferred between samples in the LAB color space, allowing the model to decouple appearance from structure and focus more on anatomical shape rather than color bias. Experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate that WaDiS consistently outperforms existing diffusion-based and conventional segmentation methods, with notable improvements in boundary accuracy, robustness to noise, and generalization under color variation. The code for this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: WaDiS：小波驱动的条件潜扩散医学图像分割框架，通过多尺度小波条件编码与频率感知门控保持解剖边界，并用结构保持颜色增强提升跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式分割方法在特征编码中丢失空间与频率细节，难以保留精细解剖边界和多尺度结构信息，尤其在复杂临床成像条件下表现不佳。
AI.method: 三点设计：(1) 多尺度小波条件编码器，利用小波无损特性保留语义先验与结构特征；(2) 在扩散U-Net跳跃连接中引入频率感知门控块（FAGB），实现自适应频谱滤波与残差融合，突出边界、抑制无关内容；(3) 训练时采用结构保持颜色增强，在LAB空间跨样本迁移全局颜色统计，解耦外观与结构。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上，WaDiS 一致优于现有扩散式与传统分割方法，在边界精度、噪声鲁棒性及颜色变化下的泛化性方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 小波多尺度条件与频率自适应滤波相结合，是提升医学分割边界质量与跨域泛化的有效途径；代码将在录用后公开。

title: Multimodal View Training: Learning More Through Different Modalities
summary: Can a language model learn more from the same information simply by encountering it in different forms? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing Multimodal View Training (MVT), a simple training approach that presents identical information through text, speech, and images, without requiring new facts or supervision. Starting from a text sample, MVT generates corresponding audio and rendered-text image views, and trains a multimodal language model to produce the same target output across all three views. To further bring these benefits to text-only large language models (LLMs), we train lightweight connector modules to pretrained audio and vision encoders, allowing the LLM to learn from multimodal inputs while retaining its text-only architecture at inference. Across question answering, machine unlearning, and knowledge editing, adaptive MVT improves QA recall by +15.2 percentage points, forget quality by +40.7 points, and editing generality by +25.2 points over text-only training. Combining MVT with standard augmentation further improves QA and editing generality. Our theoretical analysis illustrates how training across modalities can shift weight updates toward shared factual content and reduce their reliance on features specific to each view.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态视图训练(MVT)：同一事实以文本、语音、图像三视图呈现并训练模型输出同一目标，可提升QA、遗忘质量与知识编辑效果。
AI.motivation: 探索语言模型能否通过同一信息的不同呈现形式获得额外学习收益，且不引入新事实或额外监督。
AI.method: 从文本样本生成音频与渲染文本图像视图，训练多模态模型在三视图上输出相同目标；并为预训练音频/视觉编码器训练轻量连接器，使纯文本LLM在训练时利用多模态输入、推理时保持纯文本架构。另给出权重更新偏向共享事实内容的理论分析。
AI.result: 自适应MVT相比纯文本训练：QA召回+15.2个百分点，遗忘质量+40.7点，编辑泛化性+25.2点；与标准数据增强结合可进一步提升QA与编辑泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态一致训练可减少对视图特有特征的依赖、强化共享事实内容的权重更新，是一种无需新数据的通用增益手段。

title: PathStream: Towards Streaming Diagnostic Copilots for Whole-Slide Pathology
summary: Pathologists reach a diagnosis by integrating morphological evidence across regions and magnifications along viewing trajectories. Existing pathology AI rarely reflects this process: models predict from selected image regions, answer questions within fixed visual contexts, or navigate slides autonomously. We formalize pathologist-led streaming diagnosis, in which the pathologist controls navigation while a copilot selectively describes incoming views and synthesizes accumulated evidence into a final diagnosis. We record five pathologists' viewing trajectories on 1,791 TCGA whole-slide images (WSIs) spanning ten organs, with response labels, morphological descriptions, and session-level findings and diagnoses. We construct PathStreamBench to assess response timing, morphological description, and session-level diagnosis, alongside auxiliary video understanding. We introduce PathStream, which jointly learns streaming responses and diagnosis through two-stage training, with a diagnosis-attention loss guiding attention during diagnosis to relevant visual and textual evidence accumulated as the examination unfolds. PathStream outperforms 14 vision-language models and three domain-fine-tuned baselines on the core tasks, achieving a trajectory WSI Relevance score of 77.87, surpassing the strongest domain-fine-tuned baseline's 62.76. Without additional training, its diagnostic capabilities generalize to new educational pathology videos, three external centers, and an unseen organ.

AI.tldr: 提出“病理学家主导的流式诊断”范式并构建基准PathStreamBench与模型PathStream，在流式应答与时程级诊断上显著优于现有VLM与领域微调基线。
AI.motivation: 现有病理AI多基于选定图像区域预测、固定视觉上下文中作答或自主导航切片，未体现病理学家沿观察轨迹整合多区域、多倍率形态证据得出诊断的过程。
AI.method: 记录5位病理学家在1791张TCGA全切片（10个器官）上的观察轨迹及应答标签、形态描述、会话级发现与诊断，构建PathStreamBench评估应答时机、形态描述、会诊级诊断及辅助视频理解；提出PathStream，两阶段训练联合学习流式应答与诊断，并用诊断注意力损失引导注意力聚焦随检查累积的相关视觉与文本证据。
AI.result: 核心任务上优于14个视觉语言模型与3个领域微调基线，轨迹WSI相关性得分77.87，超过最强领域微调基线的62.76；无需额外训练即可泛化到新的教学病理视频、三个外部中心及未见器官。
AI.conclusion: 将诊断建模为病理学家主导、模型辅助的流式过程可行且有效，诊断注意力引导带来显著性能提升与较强泛化能力。

title: GUI-Q: Task-Sensitive Granularity and Relation-Preserving Quantization for GUI Agents
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents enable automated interactions with mobile, web, and desktop interfaces. However, their large memory footprint and repeated model calls hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices, motivating post-training quantization (PTQ) without full retraining. Quantization can degrade GUI response accuracy and distort the instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations needed for GUI target selection. Small coordinate errors can cause missed clicks, while early action errors can alter subsequent interface states and disrupt task execution. Local reconstruction error alone does not directly assess whether these responses and relations are preserved. We propose GUI-Q, a PTQ framework that targets response and relation preservation with 4-bit weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16). Task-Sensitive Granularity Allocation (TSGA) allocates finer groups under a scale-byte budget by combining response sensitivity with the measured reduction in activation-weighted distortion. Relation-Preserving Symmetry Selection (RPSS) then selects symmetric or asymmetric grids to preserve instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations in GUIs. Across three GUI-capable models, GUI-Q improves mean grounding TargetHit by 8.04 to 12.55 points over the strongest evaluated 4-bit configurations, while reducing static peak graphics processing unit (GPU) memory by 49.9% to 56.2% relative to bfloat16 (BF16). Fixed-output replay with packed 4-bit execution provides 1.7 to 2.8 times model-call speedups. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: GUI-Q 是一个面向 GUI 智能体的训练后量化框架（W4A16），通过任务敏感粒度分配与关系保持对称选择，在显著降低显存的同时提升 GUI 定位准确率。
AI.motivation: GUI 智能体参数量大、调用频繁，难以部署在资源受限设备上；而量化易损害 GUI 响应准确率，破坏指令-视觉亲和性与局部空间关系，微小坐标误差即导致点击失败，早期动作错误还会引发误差累积。仅用局部重建误差无法直接评估这些响应与关系是否被保留。
AI.method: 采用 4-bit 权重、16-bit 激活（W4A16）的训练后量化。提出 Task-Sensitive Granularity Allocation（TSGA）：在尺度字节预算下，结合响应敏感度与激活加权失真的实际下降量，为敏感任务分配更细的分组；再用 Relation-Preserving Symmetry Selection（RPSS）在对称与非对称量化网格间做选择，以保持指令-视觉亲和性与局部空间关系。
AI.result: 在三个具备 GUI 能力的模型上，平均 grounding TargetHit 相比最强 4-bit 基线提升 8.04–12.55 点；静态峰值 GPU 显存相比 BF16 降低 49.9%–56.2%；结合打包 4-bit 执行的固定输出回放带来 1.7–2.8 倍模型调用加速。
AI.conclusion: 将量化误差评估从局部重建转向任务响应与关系保持，是 GUI 智能体低比特部署的可行路径；GUI-Q 在精度、显存与速度上同时获益，代码将开源。

title: OmniSenMo: A Unified Multisensory Language Model for Generalizable Human Motion Estimation, Understanding, and Prediction
