summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) estimate, understand, and predict human motion, but mainly from RGB cameras. Depth, LiDAR, mmWave, and WiFi complement RGB under poor lighting, through occlusions, and in privacy-sensitive applications, but existing multisensory models cover only some of these sensing tasks. Covering all of them from any sensor subset is challenging, since the tokens of heterogeneous sensors are semantically inconsistent and spatially misaligned, paired multisensory data are scarce, and the tasks need different temporal granularities. We present OmniSenMo, a multisensory language model that takes the human skeleton as a common reference for all sensors. Its skeleton-grounded motion representation turns each sensor into joint tokens, one per body joint, so that any sensor subset is fused joint by joint and expressed in the motion vocabulary that the language model learned from motion capture and text. We pretrain it on all five sensors generated by our multisensory simulator, and Multi-Granularity Observation gives each task the frames it needs. On a cross-action split of MM-Fi, the same model with all five sensors outperforms the models compared on each task, including LEO-Fuse in pose estimation (84.1 vs. 89.0 mm MPJPE) and HoloLLM in unseen-action recognition (69.2% vs. 42.8%). Even without RGB, it outperforms both methods that use RGB, and in a cross-dataset validation on XRF55, it recognizes unseen actions far better than HoloLLM.

AI.tldr: OmniSenMo 以人体骨架为统一参照，把 RGB、深度、LiDAR、mmWave、WiFi 等多传感器转成逐关节 token 进行逐关节融合，并用多粒度观测适配不同任务，实现任意传感器子集下的人体运动理解与预测。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 主要依赖 RGB 摄像头理解人体运动，而深度、LiDAR、mmWave、WiFi 可在弱光、遮挡和隐私敏感场景下补充 RGB；但现有多传感器模型只覆盖部分感知任务。要支持任意传感器子集并覆盖全部任务存在三大挑战：异构传感器 token 语义不一致且空间未对齐、成对多传感器数据稀缺、任务所需时间粒度不同。
AI.method: 提出 OmniSenMo 多传感器语言模型：以人体骨架作为所有传感器的共同参照，采用 skeleton-grounded motion representation 将每种传感器转为逐关节的 joint token，从而任意传感器子集都能按关节逐一融合，并映射到语言模型从动作捕捉与文本中学到的运动词汇空间中；用自研多传感器模拟器生成五种传感器数据进行预训练；并通过 Multi-Granularity Observation 为不同任务提供所需帧粒度。
AI.result: 在 MM-Fi 的跨动作划分上，使用全部五种传感器的同一模型在各任务上优于对比模型：姿态估计 84.1 vs. LEO-Fuse 的 89.0 mm MPJPE，未见动作识别 69.2% vs. HoloLLM 的 42.8%；即使不使用 RGB，也优于两种使用 RGB 的方法；在 XRF55 跨数据集验证中，对未见动作的识别显著优于 HoloLLM。
AI.conclusion: 以骨架为共同参照的关节级 token 化与多粒度观测，能有效统一异构多传感器并支持任意传感器子集输入，在姿态估计和未见动作识别上取得领先，且在缺失 RGB 时仍具优势，展现出良好的泛化能力。

title: Visual-RFT++: Extending Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning to Multimodal Tool Use
comment: Our code is available at https://github.com/Liuziyu77/Visual-RFT
summary: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) has recently become a central paradigm for advancing Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), as demonstrated by systems such as OpenAI's o3 and the R1 series. Despite significant progress in LLMs, how to leverage RFT to unify visual perception, step-by-step reasoning, and agentic tool use into one coherent training paradigm remains an open challenge. In this work, we present Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning++ (Visual-RFT++), a unified framework that extends RFT to both visual perception tasks and multimodal agentic workflows, enabling LVLMs to reason with images, act upon images, and evaluate their own outputs using verifiable reward. With Visual-RFT++, open-source LVLMs not only show significant gains on diverse visual perception tasks, but also acquire agentic abilities such as web searching for real-time information and code-based image manipulation (e.g., cropping, rotation, and analysis). Across visual perception tasks, including fine-grained classification, few-shot detection, reasoning grounding, and open-vocabulary detection, Visual-RFT++ delivers strong gains over SFT, including a +24.3 percentage points improvement in one-shot fine-grained classification and +21.0 percentage points on COCO's 4-shot setting and +15.4 percentage points on LVIS with around several hundred samples. To evaluate agentic behaviors, we introduce the Multimodal Agentic Tool Bench (MAT) with MAT-Search and MAT-Coding. Visual-RFT++ surpasses its baseline by +18.6 F1 / +13.0 EM percentage points on MAT-Coding and +10.3 F1 / +8.7 EM percentage points on MAT-Search. It also shows gains of 29.3 F1 and 25.9 EM percentage points on multi-hop QA benchmarks such as 2Wiki and HotpotQA, demonstrating strong cross-modal generalization. Visual-RFT++ introduces a data-efficient and reward-driven framework that strengthens both visual reasoning and agentic adaptability.

AI.tldr: 提出 Visual-RFT++，将强化微调（RFT）统一扩展到视觉感知任务与多模态智能体工作流，使开源 LVLM 能"读图推理、操作图像、自我评估"，并配套发布 MAT 基准。
AI.motivation: RFT 已成为提升大型推理模型（如 o3、R1）的核心范式，但如何用 RFT 把视觉感知、逐步推理与工具化智能体行为整合进统一的训练范式仍属空白。
AI.method: 构建统一框架，以可验证奖励（verifiable reward）驱动 LVLM 在视觉感知任务与多模态智能体任务上训练；智能体能力涵盖联网搜索实时信息与基于代码的图像操作（裁剪、旋转、分析）。同时提出多模态智能体工具基准 MAT（MAT-Search、MAT-Coding）用于评测。
AI.result: 视觉感知任务显著优于 SFT：one-shot 细粒度分类 +24.3pp，COCO 4-shot +21.0pp，LVIS（约数百样本）+15.4pp；MAT-Coding +18.6 F1 / +13.0 EM，MAT-Search +10.3 F1 / +8.7 EM；多跳 QA（2Wiki、HotpotQA）提升 29.3 F1 / 25.9 EM，体现跨模态泛化。
AI.conclusion: Visual-RFT++ 提供了一个数据高效、奖励驱动的统一框架，同时增强视觉推理与智能体适应性，并通过 MAT 基准推动多模态智能体能力的标准化评测。

title: Quantization for Action, Execution for Deployment: Joint Precision and Execution Selection for World Action Models
summary: World action models guide robots by predicting the effects of actions or generating commands from observations. A model may compare hundreds of candidate futures before acting, repeatedly reading weights that must fit in device memory. Post-training quantization reduces the number of bits used to store pretrained weights, but a smaller model is not necessarily a deployable one: temporary tensors can exceed graphics processing unit (GPU) memory limits, while even small prediction errors can change the selected action. This creates two coupled challenges: identifying bit assignments that preserve task performance and determining which of them meet real execution constraints, without exhausting costly task trials. We present PTQ4WAM, a framework for choosing layer-wise bit assignments and execution routes under memory, latency and task-evaluation budgets. Calibration measurements guide candidate proposals, optionally with a language model agent. We profile full-model routes on the GPU before spending task trials on feasible assignments. Fusing group rescaling and reading visual history in place can make an otherwise infeasible assignment deployable. Across 15 workloads from four model families, the median task score is 99.2% of the corresponding 32-bit floating-point (FP32) score. On fixed GPU replays, the median speedup over FP32 is 2.36 times and the median reduction in peak allocated memory is 71.5%. The code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: PTQ4WAM：面向世界动作模型的训练后量化框架，在内存、延迟和任务评估预算约束下联合选择逐层位宽分配与执行路径，15个工作负载中位任务分数保持FP32的99.2%。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型需反复读取权重并比较大量候选未来，权重须放入设备内存；训练后量化虽减小模型，但临时张量可能超出GPU内存，且微小预测误差即改变所选动作，故需同时保证任务性能与真实执行约束，且不能消耗过多昂贵任务试验。
AI.method: 提出PTQ4WAM：用校准测量指导候选位宽提议（可选语言模型智能体辅助）；先在GPU上剖析全模型执行路径，再对可行分配投入任务试验；采用分组重缩放融合与原地读取视觉历史，使原本不可行的分配变得可部署。
AI.result: 在4个模型家族的15个工作负载上，任务得分中位数为FP32的99.2%；固定GPU回放中相对FP32中位加速2.36倍，峰值分配内存中位降低71.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将位宽分配与执行路径共同优化、并用剖析前置筛除不可行方案，可在有限试验预算下实现世界动作模型的可部署量化。

title: ToWo-VTON: Take-Off Wear-On Virtual Try-On via Topology-aware Decoupling
summary: Virtual Try-On (VTON) aims to synthesize garment transfer without physical trials. Although recent methods perform well on upper-body garments, they still struggle in lower-body and full-body scenarios with complex occlusions and large silhouette changes. To address this limitation, we introduce ToWo (Take-Off Wear-On), a two-stage paradigm that decouples body structure estimation from garment synthesis. Take-Off first generates a tight-fitting body proxy that provides estimated structural guidance, and Wear-On then synthesizes the target garment conditioned on this prior. This decoupling reduces source-garment interference, supporting garment placement under substantial silhouette variations. Built on this paradigm, we propose ToWo-VTON, a unified topology-aware framework with structure-aware supervision. We construct the Body-Fitting DressCode (BFDC) dataset via body-aware diffusion and VLM-based filtering to provide body-proxy supervision across upper-, lower-, and full-body cases. We instantiate ToWo-VTON on both diffusion-based and MLLM-guided backbones. For diffusion-based models, we fine-tune on BFDC using the body proxy as the person input. For the MLLM-guided model, we use native backbone conditioning for the body proxy and target garment, and add Garment Boosting Attention (GBA) to preserve garment details. Experiments on VITON-HD and DressCode demonstrate improvements over the evaluated baselines, with KID reductions of 26.1% and 58.6% for diffusion-based and MLLM-guided implementations, respectively. The combined BFDC-training and Take-Off/Wear-On strategy also produces more coherent limb layouts and garment boundaries across the evaluated garment categories.

AI.tldr: 提出ToWo两阶段范式，将人体结构估计与服装合成解耦，统一框架ToWo-VTON在上下身及全身虚拟试衣中均取得更优效果。
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟试衣方法在上身服装上表现良好，但在下身和全身场景中面对复杂遮挡和大轮廓变化时仍存在困难。
AI.method: ToWo范式：Take-Off先生成紧身人体代理提供结构引导，Wear-On再以此先验合成目标服装；构建Body-Fitting DressCode (BFDC)数据集（身体感知扩散+VLM过滤）提供人体代理监督；在扩散和MLLM引导两种骨干上实例化，扩散模型用人体代理作人体输入微调，MLLM模型用原生骨干条件并加入Garment Boosting Attention (GBA)保留服装细节。
AI.result: 在VITON-HD和DressCode上优于所评估基线，扩散与MLLM实现的KID分别降低26.1%和58.6%，并生成更连贯的肢体布局与服装边界。
AI.conclusion: BFDC训练结合Take-Off/Wear-On策略可有效支持大轮廓变化下的服装放置，适用于上、下、全身多类服装场景。

title: Benchmarking Geospatial Foundation Models under Calibrated Label Errors
comment: 100 pages (15 pages main text and references, 85 pages appendix), 78 figures, 68 tables. Extended version including supplementary material
summary: Earth-observation labels from maps, older products or hurried annotation arrive misaligned, coarse, loosely outlined or incomplete. Geospatial foundation models (GFMs) are nevertheless benchmarked with labels taken as correct. A practitioner therefore cannot tell which encoder to choose when the labels are imperfect. We present a benchmark protocol for fine-tuning under such labels. Four spatially structured error types are calibrated to equal label mIoU and applied identically to every model and seed. Every contrast is paired and read against an equivalence margin of $\pm 3$ points and a minimum detectable effect. We apply it to nine encoders, six decoder heads and ten datasets. In an exploratory reading at a matched learning rate the satellite-pretrained and web-pretrained DINOv3 encoders are equivalent within the margin on 8 of 9 datasets. Multispectral GFMs and an ImageNet ResNet-50 are equivalent within the margin on about half of them. Labels with random offsets cost the least at equal label quality. Under other decoder heads the verdicts mostly hold on FLAIR-2 and are decoder dependent on HLS Burn Scars. On four of five real label pairs the real label costs more than its matched simulated type. No choice of pretraining data makes an encoder consistently more robust, so the encoder is better chosen by its accuracy under imperfect labels.

AI.tldr: 提出一个在不完美标签下微调地理空间基础模型的基准协议，将四类空间结构化标签误差校准到相同 label mIoU，用配对比较与±3点等效边界检验9种编码器、6种解码头和10个数据集，发现编码器选择应以其在不完美标签下的准确率为依据，而非预训练数据。
AI.motivation: 遥感标签常来自地图、旧产品或仓促标注，存在错位、粗糙、轮廓松散或不完整等问题，但地理空间基础模型（GFM）的评测却把这些标签当作正确标签，导致实践者无法判断在不完美标签下该选哪个编码器。
AI.method: 设计一套"不完美标签下微调"的基准协议：将四种空间结构化误差类型校准到相同 label mIoU，并同等施加于每个模型与随机种子；所有对比采用配对设计，以±3点等效边界和最小可检测效应判读；在9个编码器、6个解码头、10个数据集上实施，并额外比较5对真实标签与模拟误差。
AI.result: 在匹配学习率下的探索性分析中，卫星预训练与网络预训练的 DINOv3 编码器在9个数据集中的8个上落在等效边界内；多光谱GFM与ImageNet ResNet-50 约在一半数据集上等效；随机偏移类标签误差代价最小；更换解码头后，FLAIR-2上结论基本保持，HLS Burn Scars上则依赖解码头；5对真实标签中有4对显示真实标签代价高于其匹配的模拟误差类型。
AI.conclusion: 没有任何预训练数据选择能使编码器始终更鲁棒；因此应按编码器在不完美标签下的准确率来选择，而不是按其预训练数据来源。

title: RoomTokens: Masked Diffusion over Structured Tokens for Indoor Scene Synthesis
summary: Generating 3D indoor scenes requires a representation that captures object semantics, instance identity, height structure, and orientation while respecting room geometry. Methods that model scenes as sequences of object vectors learn spatial constraints implicitly, leaving collisions and boundary violations to losses or post-processing; semantic-map methods make occupancy explicit, but collapse instance and directional structure. We introduce RoomTokens, a sliced structured-token representation in which each token stores semantic class, instance-color identity, and facing field. This representation allows a scene to be generated as a discrete grid while preserving cues for instance grouping, orientation estimation, and 3D extent prediction. To learn the RoomToken distribution, we propose MDIRT (Masked Diffusion over RoomTokens), a masked discrete diffusion model that denoises semantic/instance-color/facing channels jointly with a shared cross-slice backbone. Architectural tokens are clamped as explicit floor- plan constraints, so the model samples furniture layouts that respect room geometry while retaining instance and object-attribute structure. Experiments on 3D-FRONT show that RoomTokens with MDIRT improve layout fidelity and physical consistency over sequence/vector- and map-based methods, suggesting structured spatial tokens as a practical choice for discrete 3D scene synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoomTokens：一种切片结构化 token 表示，每个 token 同时编码语义类别、实例颜色标识和朝向场；并配套提出 MDIRT（基于 RoomTokens 的掩码离散扩散模型），联合去噪语义/实例/朝向三个通道，从而实现兼顾布局保真度与物理一致性的 3D 室内场景生成。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 室内场景生成方法存在两难：向量序列方法把场景建模为对象向量序列，空间约束只能隐式学习，碰撞与越界需靠损失函数或后处理修复；语义地图方法显式表达占用，但丢失了实例身份与朝向结构。因此需要一种同时保留语义、实例身份、高度结构和朝向且尊重房间几何的表示。
AI.method: 提出 RoomTokens 切片结构化 token 表示：每个 token 存储语义类别、实例-颜色身份与朝向场，使场景可在离散网格上生成并保留实例分组、朝向估计与 3D 范围预测的线索。学习该分布使用 MDIRT——一种掩码离散扩散模型，以共享跨切片骨干网络联合去噪语义/实例颜色/朝向通道，并将建筑元素 token 钳制为显式平面图约束。
AI.result: 在 3D-FRONT 数据集上，RoomTokens + MDIRT 相比基于序列/向量和基于地图的方法，在布局保真度和物理一致性（碰撞、边界遵守）上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构化空间 token 是离散 3D 场景合成的实用选择；显式编码实例与方向信息、并以扩散方式生成，可在保证房间几何约束的同时保留对象属性结构。

title: EditGRN: Inversion-Free Image Editing by Source-Target Generative Synchronization
summary: Text-guided image editing faces a persistent trade-off between preserving source content and realizing coherent target semantics. We explore this challenge through training- and inversion-free image editing based on discrete generative models. Existing inversion-free discrete editors primarily rely on post-hoc probability correction, creating a disconnect between local token-level adjustments and globally coherent semantic generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce EditGRN, a training- and inversion-free framework with trajectory-wide source-target generative synchronization in discrete space. EditGRN adopts a dual-branch design---the source branch constructs source references and the target branch generates the target image-enabling trajectory-wide synchronization between the two. Exploiting GRN's ability to recover clean tokens from arbitrary binary corruptions, the source branch directly constructs corrupted source states at each refinement step to extract useful editing features, without recovering a specific source-generation trajectory. The target branch synchronizes with the source branch through the same corruption schedule, fusing the corresponding source context with editable representations intra-model. By synchronizing source context with target generation along the entire trajectory, our approach faithfully preserves the background while producing high-quality edits that blend seamlessly with the surrounding scene through intra-model fusion. PIE-Bench show state-of-the-art performance on background preservation and text alignment across diverse editing tasks against continuous and discrete baselines.

AI.tldr: EditGRN是一个免训练、免反演的离散空间图像编辑框架，通过双分支在整个生成轨迹上同步源与目标语义，兼顾背景保持与文本对齐。
AI.motivation: 文本引导图像编辑存在"保留源内容"与"实现连贯目标语义"的权衡。现有免反演离散编辑器依赖事后概率校正，导致局部token级调整与全局语义生成脱节。
AI.method: 提出EditGRN双分支设计：源分支利用GRN从任意二值腐化中恢复干净token的能力，直接在各精修步构造腐化源状态以提取编辑特征，无需恢复特定源生成轨迹；目标分支通过相同腐化调度与源分支同步，在模型内部融合源上下文与可编辑表示，实现全轨迹源-目标生成同步。
AI.result: 在PIE-Bench上，相比连续与离散基线，在背景保持和文本对齐上达到SOTA，可生成与周围场景无缝融合的高质量编辑。
AI.conclusion: 沿全轨迹同步源上下文与目标生成，通过模型内融合可在保持背景的同时实现高质量、连贯的编辑。

title: PixelOne: From Options to Pixels in a Single Forward for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI grounding requires precise clicks at low latency. Recent models such as GUI-Decisions and GUI-Swift predict coordinates in one forward pass using fixed global bins with local refinement. However, screenshot downsampling removes detail needed to locate small controls, while fixed bins cover larger pixel ranges at higher resolutions. We introduce PixelOne, which transfers spatial knowledge from a search teacher to a student that predicts clicks directly from screenshots at native resolution. The teacher uses VideoJEV's text-option scorer to select rows and columns and progressively zoom into candidate regions. The student inherits the teacher's parameters and matches its distributions over explored regions through spatial distillation alongside box supervision. At inference, the same decision head selects a visual token, and a lightweight pixel head predicts the click within it, all in one forward pass. A click-aligned loss encourages pixels inside the target box to score above those outside. Across four benchmarks, PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B achieves 83.8% mean accuracy, the highest among the evaluated single-forward grounders, with a mean latency of 0.43 s per target.

AI.tldr: PixelOne通过将搜索教师的空间知识蒸馏给学生模型，使GUI点击预测可在原生分辨率下一次前向完成，兼顾精度与低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI grounding模型用固定全局bins加局部精修一次前向预测坐标，但截图降采样会丢失定位小控件所需的细节，而高分辨率下固定bins覆盖的像素范围过大，导致精度与效率难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出PixelOne：教师模型借助VideoJEV文本选项打分器选择行/列并逐步放大候选区域；学生继承教师参数，通过空间蒸馏匹配其在探索区域上的分布，并结合框监督训练。推理时同一决策头选出一个视觉token，轻量像素头在其内部预测点击，单次前向完成；另引入点击对齐损失，使目标框内像素得分高于框外。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B取得83.8%的平均准确率，为所评估的单次前向grounder中最高，平均每目标延迟0.43秒。
AI.conclusion: 原生分辨率下的空间蒸馏加token内像素预测，可在单次前向、低延迟条件下达到领先的GUI grounding精度。

title: AIGI-26: A Benchmark for AI-Generated Image Detection Across Diverse Modern Generators
summary: Existing AI-generated image (AIGI) detection benchmarks predominantly rely on earlier synthesis systems with limited content diversity and conspicuous artifacts, failing to fully reflect the detection challenges posed by high-fidelity images from contemporary models. We introduce AIGI-26, a benchmark of 253,200 images covering 26 recent open- and closed-source generators. Its novel, diverse, and heterogeneous sources provide a basis for systematically evaluating detection methods on modern generated imagery. Additionally, to capture subtle statistical discrepancies across complementary forensic views, we propose the multi-aspect forensic detection network (MAFDNet). Its fixed forensic operators expose complementary texture, local prediction, resampling, and chromatic responses, summarized by a hierarchical encoder using multiscale means and standard deviations. In parallel, a spectral branch captures Fourier log-magnitude and neighboring-frequency phase variation across radial bands and directional axes. Fusing these descriptors combines local inconsistencies with global spectral organization for authenticity detection. Trained on 12,660 AIGI-26 images, MAFDNet achieves 88.5% accuracy and 94.9% average precision on the 240,540-image test set, with only 1.04M parameters and 1.39 GFLOPs per $256\times256$ input. MAFDNet also demonstrates effective cross-dataset generalization on DailyBench and Treasure-37.

AI.tldr: 提出新基准AIGI-26（25.3万张、26个新近生成器）及多视角取证检测网络MAFDNet，用固定取证算子+层次编码器与频谱分支融合检测高保真AI图像。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGI检测基准多基于早期合成系统，内容多样性有限、伪影明显，无法反映当代高保真模型带来的检测挑战。
AI.method: 构建AIGI-26基准（253,200张图，26个近期开源/闭源生成器，异质多样来源）。提出MAFDNet：固定取证算子提取纹理、局部预测、重采样与色度响应，用多尺度均值/标准差的层次编码器汇总；并行频谱分支捕捉傅里叶对数幅值及径向带、方向轴上的邻频相位变化；融合局部不一致与全局频谱组织。
AI.result: 仅用12,660张训练图，在240,540张测试集上达88.5%准确率、94.9%平均精度，参数1.04M、1.39 GFLOPs（256×256输入）；在DailyBench与Treasure-37上展现出良好跨数据集泛化。
AI.conclusion: AIGI-26为现代生成图像检测提供系统评测基础，MAFDNet以轻量高效方式融合局部与频谱取证线索，兼顾性能与泛化能力。

title: TriSegAgent: Context-Efficient 3D Annotation with MLLMs via Tri-Planes
summary: Interactive segmentation models turn a few clicks into a segmentation prediction across domains, so annotators only decide where the prediction still needs correction. Annotation thus becomes a loop of inspecting the prediction and clicking again. Each step of this loop is a visual judgment, which suits general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents. In this work, we focus on letting these agents run this loop on 3D volumes. However, the MLLM in such an agent takes only 2D images as input, so the agent must observe the 3D volume in 2D. Since the loop calls the MLLM many times, this observation must be token-compact enough to keep every call cheap, yet informative enough to show error regions in the 3D prediction. We meet both needs with tri-planes, the three orthogonal planes that cross at one point in the volume. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that tri-planes are context-efficient yet keep sufficient detail to show error regions in the 3D prediction. Building on tri-planes, we introduce TriSegAgent, an MLLM agent that refines the 3D prediction iteratively. Within the agent, the MLLM only judges the prediction on tri-planes, while a visual harness turns each judgment into a 3D action in code. To make the loop reliable, the harness places each click at an exact voxel in the volume and checks whether to accept the 3D prediction. To evaluate the agent, we build a diverse benchmark of 690 regions of interest (ROIs) from 35 public medical datasets across three imaging modalities. With frontier MLLMs, TriSegAgent reaches an overall Dice about 10 points above the strongest baseline, and its lead is even larger on targets below 3 cm. With flash-level MLLMs, it outperforms a recent 3D segmentation agent built on a frontier MLLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TriSegAgent，一个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的 3D 交互式分割智能体，使用三正交平面（tri-planes）将 3D 体积以 token 高效的方式呈现给仅支持 2D 输入的 MLLM，从而迭代修正 3D 分割预测。
AI.motivation: 交互式分割本质上是"查看预测—再点击修正"的视觉判断循环，适合由通用 MLLM 智能体驱动。但 MLLM 只接受 2D 图像输入，如何在 2D 观察下高效、信息充分地展示 3D 体积中的错误区域，是让智能体在 3D 体积上运行该循环的关键难题：既需 token 紧凑以降低多次调用的成本，又需保留足够细节以显示错误区域。
AI.method: 以过体积内一点的三个正交平面（tri-planes）作为 3D 观察表示，从理论和实验两方面论证其上下文高效且保留足够细节；在此基础上构建 TriSegAgent：MLLM 仅在 tri-planes 上判断预测，视觉执行层（visual harness）将每次判断转化为代码形式的 3D 动作，将点击精确落在体素上，并判断是否接受该 3D 预测。同时构建了包含 35 个公开医学数据集、三种成像模态、690 个 ROI 的评测基准。
AI.result: 在前沿 MLLM 下，TriSegAgent 总体 Dice 比最强基线高约 10 分，在小于 3 cm 的目标上优势更大；在使用 flash 级 MLLM 时，仍优于基于前沿 MLLM 的近期 3D 分割智能体。
AI.conclusion: tri-planes 是一种兼顾 token 效率与信息量的 3D 观察表示，配合精确的体素级动作执行层，可让 MLLM 智能体可靠地在 3D 体积上迭代精化分割，且在精度和模型成本效率上均优于基线。

title: OCCA-Seg: Object and Channel Context Aggregation for Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images
summary: Semantic segmentation, which assigns a class label to each pixel, is a key task in computer vision. However, semantic segmentation of remote sensing images (RSIs) remains challenging because of complex scenes and objects at multiple scales, which limits segmentation accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose a context aggregation scheme called object and channel context aggregation (OCCA), consisting of three components: object contextual attention module (OCAM), channel contextual attention module (CCAM), and aggregation module (AM). Firstly, motivated by the observation that each pixel shares the class label of the object to which it belongs, object-level context represents each pixel through aggregating context from its corresponding object class. Secondly, because feature channels are correlated with object categories, channel-wise context models channel-wise contextual dependencies conditioned on object categories. Finally, the context information from OCAM and CCAM are fed into AM and used to weight and modulate the object context, enhancing the discriminative ability of the segmentation model. The experiments on several public remote sensing datasets including LoveDA, UAVid, ISPRS Potsdam, and Vaihingen datasets demonstrate competitive improvements over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出OCCA上下文聚合方案（含OCAM、CCAM、AM三模块），用于遥感图像语义分割，在LoveDA、UAVid、Potsdam、Vaihingen数据集上取得有竞争力的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像语义分割面临场景复杂、目标尺度多样的问题，导致分割精度受限，需要更有效的上下文建模方式来提升精度。
AI.method: OCCA由三部分组成：(1) OCAM对象上下文注意力模块——基于"同一目标的像素共享同一类别标签"的观察，通过聚合其所属目标类别的上下文来表示每个像素；(2) CCAM通道上下文注意力模块——利用特征通道与目标类别的相关性，建模以目标类别为条件的通道间上下文依赖；(3) AM聚合模块——将OCAM与CCAM的上下文信息融合，用于加权和调制对象上下文。
AI.result: 在LoveDA、UAVid、ISPRS Potsdam、Vaihingen等多个公开遥感数据集上的实验显示，相比现有方法取得有竞争力的改进。
AI.conclusion: 结合对象级与通道级上下文并进行聚合调制，可增强分割模型的判别能力，有效缓解遥感图像复杂场景与多尺度目标的挑战。

title: RigidAnchor: Cross-View Geo-Localization for UAV via Iterative Planar Rigid Alignment
summary: A UAV that flies without GNSS has to estimate its absolute position and heading without any external signal. Most existing methods for UAV-to-satellite cross-view geo-localization (U-S CVGL) treat the task as image retrieval: they compress the UAV image and each satellite tile into separate descriptors, rank the tiles by their similarity, and return the center of the best tile. The output can therefore only lie on a pre-defined grid, its accuracy is limited by the tile size, and no heading is produced. Regressing the pose in a single pass removes the grid, but it leaves no chance to correct the estimate afterwards. We observe that satellite tiles are not independent samples. They are laid on the map at a fixed spacing, scale and orientation, so neighboring tiles join into one continuous satellite block with a consistent metric, and a nadir UAV view of that block differs from it by a planar rigid transform only, i.e. a 2D translation plus an in-plane rotation. We therefore reformulate U-S CVGL as solving for this transform between two images of different sizes. Position and heading then become parts of one geometric quantity, and the accuracy is no longer limited by the tile grid. We propose RigidAnchor, which solves the transform iteratively. The network encodes the two images and builds a multi-level correlation pyramid between them. At each iteration, it indexes the pyramid with every aerial cell carried through the current estimate, pools the descriptors of all cells into one hidden state, and lets two decoupled heads predict a translation increment and a rotation increment, the latter being composed rather than added. On Bearing-UAV-90K, the cross-view mean errors are 78.6% lower in position and 69.7% lower in heading than Bearing-UAV, and HSR@15 increases by 19.06 points. Code is available at https://github.com/wwsource/RigidAnchor.

AI.tldr: 论文将无人机-卫星跨视角地理定位（U-S CVGL）重构为求解两图之间的平面刚性变换（2D平移+平面内旋转），提出迭代式方法 RigidAnchor，用多级相关金字塔与解耦的平移/旋转增量头预测位姿，在 Bearing-UAV-90K 上位置误差降低 78.6%、朝向误差降低 69.7%，HSR@15 提升 19.06 点。
AI.motivation: 无 GNSS 的无人机需自主估计绝对位置与朝向。现有 U-S CVGL 方法把任务当作图像检索：分别编码无人机图像与卫星瓦片、按相似度排序并返回最优瓦片中心，导致输出只能落在预定义网格上、精度受瓦片尺寸限制且不输出朝向；单次回归位姿虽摆脱了网格，却无法后续修正误差。
AI.method: 作者观察到卫星瓦片并非独立样本：它们按固定间距、尺度和朝向铺设在地图上，相邻瓦片可拼成具有一致度量的连续卫星块，而正下视的无人机视图与该块之间仅相差一个平面刚性变换。于是把 U-S CVGL 转化为求解两幅不同尺寸图像间的该变换，使位置与朝向统一为一个几何量。RigidAnchor 迭代求解：网络编码两幅图像并构建多级相关金字塔；每次迭代用当前估计传递每个空中单元在金字塔中索引，将所有单元描述子池化为一个隐状态；再由两个解耦的头分别预测平移增量与旋转增量（旋转采用复合而非相加方式更新）。
AI.result: 在 Bearing-UAV-90K 上，跨视角平均位置误差比 Bearing-UAV 降低 78.6%，朝向误差降低 69.7%，HSR@15 提升 19.06 点。代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 将 U-S CVGL 表述为图像间平面刚性变换求解，可摆脱瓦片网格对精度的限制并同时输出朝向；迭代式、旋转复合更新的设计支持对估计的逐步修正，实验验证了该范式的有效性。

title: AdvMTO: Multimodal and Temporal Adversarial Object Attacks via 2D Gaussian Splatting for BEV-Based 3D Object Detection
summary: Adversarial object attacks pose a threat to BEV-based 3D object detectors in autonomous driving. Existing attacks typically target a single modality, coordinate camera and LiDAR observations at the current timestamp, or model temporal persistence mainly in camera streams. Without a unified construction of current and historical observations, attacks can leave part of the detector's accumulated evidence unsuppressed, limiting their effectiveness. In this paper, we propose AdvMTO, a 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) framework for suppressing detection of persistent adversarial objects. Its oriented surfels encode appearance, geometry, and opacity in one object state, from which camera images and scanline LiDAR returns are generated. AdvMTO then constructs current and historical inputs through detector-native processing, regenerating LiDAR returns in each native source sweep for fusion detectors. We optimize bounded appearance perturbations for each detector, propagating gradients through historical BEV memory for temporal camera detectors. For fusion detectors, bounded geometry refinement along local normals further perturbs both sensing modalities. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate effective suppression of traffic-cone detection across three BEV detectors. Temporal ablations further highlight the importance of detector-native history modeling for both attack construction and optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdvMTO，一个基于 2D 高斯泼溅（2DGS）的统一框架，用有向面元同时建模物体的外观、几何与不透明度，生成相机图像和 LiDAR 扫描回波，从而构造一致的历史与当前观测，实现对 BEV 3D 检测器对持续性对抗目标的检测抑制。
AI.motivation: 现有针对 BEV 3D 检测器的对抗攻击存在局限：通常只针对单一模态、仅在当前时间戳协调相机与 LiDAR 观测，或仅在相机流中建模时间持续性。缺少对当前与历史观测的统一构造，会导致检测器累积的证据未被完全抑制，从而削弱攻击效果。
AI.method: 以有向面元（oriented surfels）将外观、几何、不透明度编码为单一物体状态，并渲染出相机图像与扫描线 LiDAR 回波；通过检测器原生处理流程重建当前与历史输入，对融合检测器在每个原生 LiDAR 扫描源中重新生成回波；对每个检测器优化有界外观扰动，并将梯度通过历史 BEV 记忆传播以应对时序相机检测器；对融合检测器额外沿局部法向做有界几何微调以同时扰动两种模态。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 上于三种 BEV 检测器上有效抑制了交通锥的检测；时间维度的消融实验进一步说明，检测器原生历史建模对攻击的构造与优化都至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 统一建模当前与历史、相机与 LiDAR 的观测（并尊重检测器原生处理流程）是提升对时序 BEV 检测器对抗攻击有效性的关键，2DGS 提供了一种自然的统一物体表示。

title: Uncovering Separable and Composable Skill Mechanisms in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent work has sought to localize the internal mechanisms underlying visual reasoning skills in vision-language models. These methods largely overlook separability and composability in both mechanism identification and evaluation. We propose separability and composability as two important desiderata for skill localization. Separability requires identified mechanisms to contribute primarily to their target skills while having limited effects on other skills, enabling precise diagnosis and targeted intervention. Composability requires skill mechanisms to be combinable to support complex tasks, allowing a small set of mechanisms to account for broader capabilities. In this work, we propose a multi-skill interpretability framework DISCO, built around these two properties. For identification, we propose Separable Head Selection, which selects skill-specific attention heads based on their contributions across skills. For evaluation, we are the first to design metrics for measuring separability and composability of identified heads. Extensive experiments on three VLMs and four fundamental visual reasoning skills demonstrate the effectiveness of DISCO. It achieves the highest separability, outperforming the strongest baseline by 24.80, 18.38, and 13.75 points across the three models, respectively, while also achieving the highest composability on all three models.

AI.tldr: 提出多技能可解释框架DISCO，以可分离性和可组合性为核心需求定位视觉推理技能机制。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型中视觉推理技能的内部机制定位方法忽视了机制的可分离性与可组合性，导致难以精确诊断和可组合地支持复杂任务。
AI.method: 将可分离性与可组合性形式化为技能定位的两大需求；提出DISCO框架，识别阶段用Separable Head Selection基于注意力头跨技能贡献挑选技能专属头，评估阶段首次设计量化可分离性/可组合性的指标。
AI.result: 在3个VLM和4种基础视觉推理技能上测试，DISCO可分离性最优，分别超出最强基线24.80、18.38、13.75分，且三个模型上可组合性均最高。
AI.conclusion: 可分离性与可组合性是技能定位的关键准则，DISCO在识别与评估两方面均有效，优于现有方法。

title: Accuracy Is Not Evidence: Measuring and Training Evidence Dependence in Video Temporal Grounding
comment: Preprint, 47 pages. Code, models and data: https://jinzijie-bupt.github.io/Accuracy-Is-Not-Evidence/
summary: In video temporal grounding, a correct interval can come from finding the event, answering blind or fitting one annotation style, and Recall at IoU scores them alike. We measure evidence dependence, how much the answer rests on the event's frames. Our fixed-answer audit edits either the frames inside the annotated interval or, as a placebo, as many frames elsewhere in the same video, and compares the two drops in the annotated answer's likelihood. Supervised fine-tuning and three public checkpoints trained with IoU-reward reinforcement learning raise the accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 9 to 20 points, partly by answering blind and by fitting one annotation. Yet their answers rest on the event no more than the base model's, and the same holds for IoU-reward training on our data at the audit's frame rate. This comparison is a difference of the model's own likelihoods, so we can train on it. A placebo contrast and a bound on the placebo drop rule out learning to react to any edit. With them, evidence dependence rises in all five base models we train, and the weight on clean supervision controls how much. Added to IoU-reward training, the objective raises evidence dependence while keeping the accuracy gain. Masking the event's frames makes the trained models decline or miss the event more often than their base; masking as many other frames does not. The dependence moves to another event when the query names it, and holds on a second dataset and under patch scrambling, an edit never used in training.

AI.tldr: 视频时序接地中，Recall@IoU无法区分模型是"真正看事件"还是"盲答/拟合标注风格"。作者提出基于固定答案的证据依赖性审计，并可将其作为训练目标，提升模型对事件的真实依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有视频时序接地评测用IoU/Recall分数，把"找到事件"、"盲答"和"拟合单一标注风格"一视同仁，无法衡量答案是否真正依赖事件帧。监督微调与IoU奖励RL虽提升准确率，但可能只是学会盲答或迎合标注习惯。
AI.method: 设计"固定答案审计"：分别编辑标注区间内的帧、或同视频内同样数量的其他帧（安慰剂），比较两者对标注答案似然度的下降。将该对比（模型自身的似然差）作为可训练目标，并加入安慰剂对比与安慰剂下降上界约束，防止模型学会对任意编辑敏感。
AI.result: 监督微调和三个用IoU奖励RL训练的公开checkpoint使Qwen2.5-VL-7B准确率提升9–20点，但其答案对事件的依赖不超过基座模型；在审计帧率下用IoU奖励训练同样如此。加入新目标后，五个基座模型的证据依赖均上升，干净监督权重可调控幅度；与IoU奖励联合训练时依赖上升且保持准确率增益。掩蔽事件帧令模型更常拒绝或漏检事件，掩蔽同等其他帧则不会；查询改名时依赖会转移到另一事件，并在第二数据集与patch scrambling（训练未见的编辑）下成立。
AI.conclusion: 准确率提升不等于证据依赖提升。该审计与训练目标能有效衡量并增强模型对事件的真实依赖，且具有跨数据集与跨编辑的泛化性。

title: PinGround: Pinning Queries to Points for Parallel Grounding in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can localize through their text interface, grounding open-vocabulary objects, complex referring expressions, text lines and layout regions with strong semantic understanding. They write the boxes one after another as a single sequence, although the instances of a query, unlike the words of a sentence, form an unordered set with no sequential dependence. The number of decoding steps therefore grows with the number of instances, which makes dense scenes the most expensive. Decoding the instances in parallel avoids this growth, but streams that cannot see each other duplicate some instances and miss others. We propose \method, which writes a single point into each query as a spatial anchor and asks for the matching instance nearest to that point within a local radius, or \none. Given the image, the anchored queries are independent, so they are decoded in parallel as leaves of a prefix tree that shares the image and the query, and the model is trained on the same tree. Coarse-to-fine anchors refine only the regions where instances are found, duplicate suppression keeps one box per instance, and set-level reinforcement learning optimizes the set F1. Only the prompt and the attention mask change, not the architecture. On three different VLMs and 12 benchmarks covering detection, OCR, layout and referring, \method is at most 5.5 F1 below sequential decoding trained on the same data, while its speedup grows with instance density and reaches 21.9$\times$ on dense scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出 \method，用"锚点+局部最近实例"的并行解码替代VLM的顺序框解码，在不改架构的情况下将密集场景解码加速至21.9倍而精度损失有限。
AI.motivation: VLM 通过文本接口将目标实例的框逐个写入为单一序列，但同一查询的多个实例本质上是无序集合、无序列依赖。顺序解码的步数随实例数线性增长，使密集场景代价最高；而朴素并行解码因各流彼此不可见，会导致实例重复与漏检。
AI.method: 为每个查询写入一个点作为空间锚，要求模型返回局部半径内离该点最近的匹配实例（或无）。给定图像后各锚定查询相互独立，作为共享图像与前缀的树叶子节点并行解码，训练也在同一前缀树上进行。辅以由粗到细的锚点（仅在有实例的区域细化）、重复框抑制（每实例保留一框）以及集合级强化学习优化 set-F1。仅修改 prompt 与 attention mask，不改变模型架构。
AI.result: 在 3 种不同 VLM、12 个基准（检测、OCR、版面、指代）上，\method 相比同数据训练的顺序解码最多低 5.5 F1；加速比随实例密度增长，在密集场景达到 21.9×。
AI.conclusion: 将实例定位视为无序集合的并行锚点解码是可行且高效的，在保持接近顺序解码精度的同时，显著缓解密集场景的解码开销瓶颈。

title: SafeRank-ReID: Candidate-Conditioned Re-Ranking under Identity Conflicts for Multimodal Person Re-Identification
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia Asia 2026 (MMAsia 2026). 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: Multimodal Person Re-Identification (ReID) exploits complementary identity cues from different sensing modalities to mitigate the performance degradation caused by challenging imaging conditions. Existing methods typically estimate Modality Reliability at the query level, making it difficult to identify conflicting inputs that retain normal visual quality but correspond to an incorrect identity. Such inputs may receive high confidence, promote irrelevant gallery candidates, and lead to negative fusion. To address this issue, we propose SafeRank-ReID, a candidate-conditioned safe re-ranking framework for Multimodal Person Re-Identification (ReID). To capture the varying support of the same modality for different candidates, we introduce a candidate-conditioned evidence arbitration mechanism that integrates unimodal retrieval evidence, input quality, and cross-modal consistency to estimate trust and conflict logits for each modality-candidate pair. Together, these logits contribute to the normalized modality weights, allowing support strength to vary across modalities and candidates while reducing the contribution of potentially unreliable evidence. A candidate-set refinement module subsequently applies self-attention to jointly model candidate representations and predicts residual scores from their competitive relations, thereby refining the initial fused ranking. For fusion results that remain uncertain after refinement, a query-level fallback gate estimates an interpolation coefficient from the overall conflict level and cross-modal uncertainty, adaptively combining the fused scores with those of the most reliable unimodal branch. Experiments on RGBNT201 and MSVR310 show that SafeRank-ReID maintains competitive clean-input retrieval while improving robustness to Identity Conflicts across person and vehicle benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 SafeRank-ReID，一种候选级条件化的安全重排序框架，通过证据仲裁、候选集精炼与查询级回退门控，缓解多模态行人重识别中的身份冲突导致的负融合问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态ReID多在查询级估计模态可靠性，难以识别"视觉质量正常但身份错误"的冲突输入，这类输入会获得高置信度、推广无关候选，造成负融合。
AI.method: 1) 候选条件化证据仲裁：融合单模态检索证据、输入质量与跨模态一致性，为每个模态-候选对估计信任与冲突logit，归一化得到随候选变化的模态权重；2) 候选集精炼模块：用自注意力联合建模候选表示，基于竞争关系预测残差分数以修正初始融合排序；3) 查询级回退门控：对精炼后仍不确定的结果，依据整体冲突水平与跨模态不确定性估计插值系数，将融合分数与最可靠单模态分支分数自适应结合。
AI.result: 在 RGBNT201 与 MSVR310 上，保持有竞争力的干净输入检索性能，同时在行人与车辆基准上提升了对身份冲突的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将可靠性估计从查询级细化到候选级并辅以候选间关系建模与回退机制，可有效抑制多模态融合中的负向效应，提升多模态ReID的安全性。

title: LiveMirror: Real-Time Diffusion Virtual Try-On on a Consumer GPU and Its Self-Supervised Adaptation to Indian Ethnic Wear
summary: Diffusion virtual try-on (VTO) models produce convincing garment transfers from a single product photograph, but at hundreds of milliseconds to seconds per image every deployment today is offline or falls back to AR mirrors that need a rigged 3D asset per product. We present LiveMirror, a live-camera try-on mirror that renders a flat garment photograph onto a moving person with a diffusion model on one 16 GB consumer GPU. Its core is asynchronous keyframe try-on: generation never blocks the display, every displayed frame is an optical-flow warp of the latest generated keyframe, and keyframes are replaced only through a cross-fade. The display runs at camera rate (25 FPS at 720p) while a new try-on arrives every 370-490 ms; we measure the residual flicker, give a stage-by-stage latency budget, and report which accelerations (step count, consistency LoRA, tiny decoder, compilation) keep garment prints intact. We then show that the same GPU fixes the model's biggest cultural blind spot: try-on models trained on VITON-HD and DressCode render a knee-length kurta or sherwani as a torso-length top or a dress over bare legs. A thigh-covering mask, self-supervised pairs built automatically from 24.9k on-model e-commerce photographs, and 3.2 GPU-hours of attention-only fine-tuning of CatVTON halve the perceptual error on ethnic wear (LPIPS 0.137 to 0.077 on IndoFashion, 0.135 to 0.073 on Atlas; 200 held-out pairs per source) with no regression on Western tops. A two-pass hem-aware mask then removes the remaining failure, recoloured trousers below the hem, on all but 3-4% of pairs at no training cost; in the mirror the hem comes from the previous keyframe for free. The adapted model beats FASHN VTON 1.5 on every aggregate ethnic-wear metric at about $20\times$ lower inference cost, and its weights drop straight into the mirror.

AI.tldr: LiveMirror: a single 16GB-GPU live-camera virtual try-on mirror using asynchronous keyframe generation (flow-warp between keyframes, cross-fade swaps), plus an ethnic-wear adaptation of CatVTON via thigh-covering masks and 24.9k auto-built pairs.
AI.motivation: Diffusion VTO takes 100s of ms to seconds per image, forcing offline use or rigged-3D AR mirrors; existing models also misrender South Asian ethnic wear (kurta/sherwani as short tops or dresses).
AI.method: Asynchronous keyframe try-on: display never blocked, each frame optical-flow warped from latest keyframe, cross-fade replacement; stage-wise latency budget with step reduction, consistency LoRA, tiny decoder, compilation. Ethnic adaptation: thigh-covering mask, self-supervised pairs from 24.9k on-model e-commerce photos, 3.2 GPU-h attention-only fine-tuning of CatVTON, two-pass hem-aware mask.
AI.result: 25 FPS at 720p with new keyframes every 370-490 ms; LPIPS improved 0.137→0.077 (IndoFashion) and 0.135→0.073 (Atlas) with no Western regression; hem failures reduced to 3-4%; beats FASHN VTON 1.5 on all aggregate ethnic metrics at ~20× lower cost.
AI.conclusion: Real-time diffusion VTO is feasible on consumer hardware, and cheap targeted fine-tuning can fix cultural coverage gaps; weights transfer directly into the mirror pipeline.

title: Video Generalized Category Discovery
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to categorize unlabeled data from both known and unknown classes using labeled data from only the known classes. While recent GCD methods have shown promise on static images, their performance degrades in videos due to temporal dynamics, larger intra-class variation, and the lack of temporal consistency in existing approaches. We introduce VideoGCD, a framework tailored for video action recognition under the GCD setting. Our method integrates (i) a partitioned Mixture-of-Experts module that encourages specialization for known and novel categories, (ii) a novel-class balancing loss to reduce bias toward known classes, and (iii) a temporal optimal transport loss that promotes consistent routing across frames. Experiments on three video benchmarks demonstrate that VideoGCD significantly improves performance over existing GCD methods, particularly on novel categories. Our findings highlight the importance of combining temporal modeling and expert specialization for video GCD.

AI.tldr: VideoGCD 是面向视频动作识别的广义类别发现框架，通过分区混合专家、新类平衡损失与时序最优传输损失解决时序动态与类内差异问题，在三个视频基准上显著优于现有 GCD 方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 GCD 方法在静态图像上表现良好，但迁移到视频时性能下降，原因包括时序动态、更大的类内变化，以及缺乏时序一致性建模。作者因此希望将 GCD 扩展到视频动作识别场景。
AI.method: 提出 VideoGCD，包含三个组件：(i) 分区式 Mixture-of-Experts 模块，促使专家分别对已知类与新类形成专门化；(ii) 新类平衡损失，降低对已知类的偏置；(iii) 时序最优传输损失，使路由在帧间保持一致。
AI.result: 在三个视频基准上的实验表明，VideoGCD 相比现有 GCD 方法有明显提升，尤其在新类上改善突出。
AI.conclusion: 结合时序建模与专家专门化对视频 GCD 至关重要，是该场景下有效且必要的设计方向。

title: Assembly-JEPA: Using World Models for Fine-Grained Industrial Image Verification
summary: Automated verification of industrial assembly processes remains a challenging problem due to substantial visual variability, limited availability of labeled defect data, and the fine-grained nature of many assembly errors. Existing approaches often rely on object detection, CAD models, or supervised classification pipelines, which can struggle to generalize across changing products and assembly configurations. In this work, we propose a novel self-supervised assembly verification framework based on Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs). Starting from the JEPA-based world model LeWorldModel, we investigate how the architecture must be adapted to verify the correctness of fine-grained assembly operations. To this end, we formulate assembly verification as a predictive world modeling task operating on before-and-after observations of assembly processes. Experimental results on industrial assembly tasks demonstrate that the proposed approach reliably detects both fine-grained incorrect assembly states and action-state mismatches, achieving an AUROC of 86.9% on a newly introduced assembly verification dataset. These results indicate that JEPA-based predictive representations constitute a promising foundation for robust and data-efficient industrial assembly verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的自监督装配验证框架，将装配验证建模为对装配前后观测的预测性世界建模任务，在工业装配任务上以86.9% AUROC检测细粒度错误装配状态与动作-状态不匹配。
AI.motivation: 工业装配自动验证面临视觉变化大、缺陷标注数据稀缺、装配错误粒度细等挑战；现有基于目标检测、CAD模型或监督分类的方法难以跨产品与装配配置泛化。
AI.method: 以JEPA为基础，从基于JEPA的世界模型LeWorldModel出发，研究架构如何适配细粒度装配操作的验证；将装配验证重构为在装配过程前后观测上的预测式世界建模任务，进行自监督训练。
AI.result: 在工业装配任务实验中可靠检测细粒度错误装配状态及动作-状态不匹配，在新提出的装配验证数据集上取得86.9% AUROC。
AI.conclusion: JEPA式预测表征是稳健且数据高效的工业装配验证的有前景基础。

title: BEND: Spectral Bregman Losses for Multi-Image Unlearning in Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models memorize training images and reproduce them almost verbatim when prompted, creating copyright and privacy liabilities. Data unlearning erases the influence of specific training samples from a trained model without retraining, and is two-sided: it must forget the targets while preserving generation quality on everything else. Prior methods use the squared-L2 diffusion loss, at most with a hand-set frequency mask; however, it is known that every Bregman divergence is a mathematically valid choice and the squared-L2 is only the simplest example. BEND is the first to search this family: it fits a spectral Bregman divergence to the unlearning task through a bilevel loop, so the loss itself is shaped to forget thoroughly while protecting quality. It also redirects a memorized image to the mean of its retain images, where ReTrack, the state of the art, redirects it to a single near-copy. On Stable Diffusion, a single BEND model erases all 48 verifiably memorized benchmark images at once. It forgets at least as much as per-target, sequential, and jointly trained ReTrack (SSCD 0.084 versus 0.094-0.120), at the quality of the model before unlearning (CLIP-IQA 0.81 versus 0.64-0.69). BEND also outperforms the state of the art on CelebA-HQ in all three measures of the benchmark, and matches or exceeds it on MNIST and CIFAR-10.

AI.tldr: BEND 提出首个在 Bregman 散度族中搜索遗忘损失谱形式的方法，通过双层优化为扩散模型遗忘任务定制损失，在遗忘彻底性与生成质量上均优于 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型会记忆并几乎原样复现训练图像，带来版权与隐私风险。遗忘需要"双向"平衡：既要彻底遗忘目标样本，又要保持其余生成质量。已有方法只用平方 L2 损失（至多配手工频率掩码），而实际上任意 Bregman 散度都是合法选择，这一族未被探索。
AI.method: BEND 用双层循环拟合一个频谱 Bregman 散度以适配遗忘任务，使损失本身被塑形为"彻底遗忘+保护质量"。同时将记忆图像重定向到其保留图像集的均值，而非 SOTA ReTrack 指向的单张近副本。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion 上，单个 BEND 模型一次性擦除全部 48 张可验证记忆图像；遗忘程度不低于逐目标/顺序/联合训练的 ReTrack（SSCD 0.084 vs 0.094–0.120），且保持遗忘前质量（CLIP-IQA 0.81 vs 0.64–0.69）。在 CelebA-HQ 三项指标全面领先，MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: 将损失函数形式纳入可学习的设计空间是扩散模型遗忘的有效方向，BEND 以损失谱搜索+均值重定向实现了更好的遗忘-质量权衡，并可推广到多数据集。

title: TAED: Trajectory-Aligned Encoder--Decoder Distillation for Detection Transformers
summary: Distilling localization knowledge into compact detection transformers (DETRs) requires consistent teacher-student query correspondence across decoder layers. However, in DETRs with encoder-based query selection, the teacher and student select top-K proposals independently. Same-rank queries can originate from different spatial locations and correspond to different objects, making rank-based layer-wise supervision unreliable. To address this problem, we propose Trajectory-Aligned Encoder-Decoder Distillation (TAED), a framework for knowledge transfer between DETRs of different capacities. Encoder feature distillation matches normalized multi-scale features to strengthen student representations and increase the number of teacher-student query pairs from the same encoder locations. Source-indexed query alignment pairs native queries from the same encoder locations and retains pairs associated with the same object for which the teacher provides reliable and more accurate final localization than the student. Trajectory-aligned localization distillation maintains these correspondences and uses teacher proposals and corresponding decoder-layer box predictions to guide student refinement, without introducing additional queries. On COCO, TAED improves DINO-R18 and two-stage Deformable DETR-R18 by 2.5 and 1.7 AP, respectively. Further gains on D-FINE and ECDet demonstrate applicability to recent real-time DETRs at no additional inference cost.

AI.tldr: TAED：通过对齐编码器来源索引与查询轨迹，实现DETR类检测器的可靠逐层定位知识蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 在基于编码器查询选择的DETR中，教师与学生独立选取Top-K候选，同排名查询可能来自不同空间位置、对应不同物体，导致基于排名的逐层监督不可靠，定位知识难以有效传递。
AI.method: 提出Trajectory-Aligned Encoder-Decoder Distillation (TAED)框架：1）编码器特征蒸馏，匹配归一化多尺度特征，增强学生表征并增加同源查询对数量；2）源索引查询对齐，配对来自同一编码器位置的查询，并仅保留对应同一物体、且教师最终定位比学生更可靠的查询对；3）轨迹对齐定位蒸馏，保持上述对应关系，用教师提议及对应解码层框预测指导学生细化，不引入额外查询。
AI.result: COCO上，DINO-R18和两阶段Deformable DETR-R18分别提升2.5和1.7 AP；在D-FINE与ECDet上也有增益，表明适用于近期实时DETR且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过编码器-解码器联合的对齐策略，可在不同容量DETR间建立可靠的查询对应关系，实现有效的定位蒸馏且不增加推理成本。

title: JONES-19: A Cultural Image Dataset Based on The Grammar of Ornament
comment: 13 pages. Published in the Proceedings of the 22nd International Conference on Culture and Computer Science (KUI '25), Berlin, Germany, September 2025. Dataset available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/harvardseas-cultural-ornaments/JONES-19
summary: We introduce JONES-19, a high-quality image dataset documenting 1,901 ornament designs belonging to nineteen human cultures. The images and their annotations are based on an open access archive of The Grammar of Ornament (London, 1856), by Owen Jones. The dataset poses numerous challenges as a benchmark for computer vision classification tasks and for research at the intersection of machine learning and art and design: a small sample size, image samples of human-designed artifacts rather than common objects in-context or natural scenes, imbalanced class distribution, and image distinctions based on fine details involving line patterns, reliefs, and colors. As a design-inspired dataset, JONES-19 can serve as a benchmark for various research fields, such as visual recognition, data-efficient learning, art-historical research, architectural style analysis, and cultural heritage. This paper describes the curation of the JONES-19 dataset and reports a baseline classification benchmark that evaluates the suitability of the dataset for training classifiers and exposes insights into inter-class relationships--particularly cultural similarities--by examining patterns in misclassification errors. The dataset and its accompanying documentation are available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/harvardseas-cultural-ornaments/JONES-19.

AI.tldr: JONES-19是一个包含1901个装饰图案、覆盖19种人类文化的高质量图像数据集，基于Owen Jones《装饰法则》(1856)整理而成，论文介绍了其构建过程并给出分类基线基准。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机视觉基准多为自然场景或常见物体，缺乏针对人类设计的人工制品（装饰纹样）的挑战性数据；同时该领域存在小样本、类别不平衡、依赖细粒度线条/浮雕/颜色差异等问题，亟需可用于视觉识别、数据高效学习、艺术史与文化遗产研究的基准数据集。
AI.method: 基于开放获取的《The Grammar of Ornament》(London, 1856)档案，构建并整理JONES-19数据集：1901幅装饰设计图像，标注为19种人类文化类别，并附带完整文档；随后训练分类器进行基线评测，并通过分析误分类错误模式揭示类间关系（尤其是文化相似性）。
AI.result: 提供基线分类基准结果，验证了数据集用于训练分类器的适用性，并通过对误分类模式的分析暴露了类间关系，特别是文化之间的相似性。
AI.conclusion: JONES-19可作为多领域基准，服务于视觉识别、数据高效学习、艺术史研究、建筑风格分析与文化遗产保护等研究；数据集及文档已在Hugging Face公开。

title: Draft Forcing: Target-guided Speculative Drafting and Learned Verifier for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models enable streaming synthesis chunk by chunk, yet invoking the large model for every chunk remains costly. While chunk-level speculative decoding can offload chunks to a lightweight draft model, existing approaches suffer from two limitations: (1) an off-the-shelf draft diverges from the target's trajectory, compounding errors in history; and (2) they either omit verification or rely on costly post-decode aesthetic scores rather than verifying consistency against the target. We address both with Draft Forcing, a framework coupling target-guided drafting with an on-policy trained verifier. Specifically, to align the draft for high acceptance, we opt for feature-level drafting, conditioning it on multi-layer target hidden states persisted from committed chunks, whose outputs are pushed to match target trajectories with multi-aspect losses. For verification, we propose an on-policy trained feature-space verifier predicting CDF-calibrated frame-wise relative RMSE against the target. It is trained on speculative rollouts as contexts anneal from random to inference-aligned mixtures, and gates proposals without VAE decoding. On the 14B Self-Forcing target, Draft Forcing achieves $1.63\times$ DiT and $1.57\times$ end-to-end speedups on VBench with minimal quality loss, and up to $1.93\times$ DiT ($1.82\times$ end-to-end) when combined with orthogonal KV compression. It generalizes to accelerate a streaming variant of MiniMax-H3, generating over $50\%$ draft frames with competitive quality.

AI.tldr: Draft Forcing 通过目标引导的起草（特征级草稿模型）与在线策略训练的验证器，提升自回归视频扩散的块级投机解码效率与一致性。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型逐块流式生成成本高；现有块级投机解码存在两点问题：现成草稿模型偏离目标轨迹导致历史误差累积；要么省略验证，要么依赖昂贵的解码后美学评分而非与目标一致性验证。
AI.method: 提出 Draft Forcing 框架：1) 特征级起草——以已提交块持久化的多层目标隐藏状态为条件，并用多面向损失将输出对齐到目标轨迹，提高接受率；2) 在线策略训练的特征空间验证器——预测经 CDF 校准的逐帧相对 RMSE，训练时上下文从随机逐步退火到推理对齐混合，无需 VAE 解码即可对提案进行门控。
AI.result: 在 14B Self-Forcing 目标上，VBench 上实现 1.63× DiT 与 1.57× 端到端加速且质量损失极小；结合正交 KV 压缩可达 1.93× DiT（1.82× 端到端）。可推广至 MiniMax-H3 流式变体，生成超 50% 草稿帧且质量有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过目标引导起草与在线训练的轻量验证器相耦合，Draft Forcing 在无需昂贵解码的前提下有效加速自回归视频扩散，并具备与其它加速技术组合的扩展性。

title: Advancements in Diabetic Retinopathy Classification Using Novel Multi-Stacked U-Net Architectures
summary: Diabetes leads to several health complications throughout the body, with the complication in the eyes being Diabetic Retinopathy. It leads to damaging or abnormal changes in the blood vessels' structure, causing vision loss. The need for massive screening of a large population of diabetic patients has created a necessity for computer-aided, fully automatic diagnosis of DR. CNNs have shown great promise in the classification of DR based on the Fundus images. Building a reliable model faces considerable challenges due to the limited availability of high-quality annotated datasets and issues with varying image quality and class imbalances. This paper aims to demonstrate the UNET, and its Stacked Architecture variant and their performance across several datasets. This paper has compared and studied the UNET architecture's performance across multiple stacks and has come to a soft conclusion that the architecture performs its best at three stacks, and any more leads to deterioration of its performance. The model aims at classifying the images into five categories, 0 to 4, where 0 is no DR, and 4 is proliferative DR.

AI.tldr: 本文比较UNET及其堆叠架构变体在糖尿病视网膜病变(DR)五分类任务上的性能，发现三层堆叠效果最佳，更多堆叠反而使性能下降。
AI.motivation: 糖尿病视网膜病变需对大量糖尿病患者进行筛查，全自动计算机辅助诊断十分必要。但高质量标注数据有限、图像质量参差、类别不平衡，使构建可靠模型面临挑战。
AI.method: 采用UNET及其Stacked Architecture变体，在多个眼底图像数据集上进行实验，比较不同堆叠层数( stacks )下的分类性能，将图像分为0–4五类（0为无DR，4为增殖性DR）。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上对比不同堆叠层数的UNET架构，结果显示三层堆叠时性能最佳，进一步增加堆叠层数会导致性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 作者给出"软结论"：堆叠UNET在三个堆栈时性能最优，更多堆叠会损害性能；该架构在DR五分类上是可行的候选方案。

title: AirVT-15k: A Query-Diverse UAV Video-Text Dataset and Query-Adaptive Evidence Alignment Network for Retrieval
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle video-text retrieval (UAV-TVR) requires matching language to both scene context and subtle object changes. A harbor-layout query relies on global scene context, whereas a departing-vessel query requires local functional cues and motion states. Existing benchmarks provide diverse aerial descriptions but give limited attention to distinct evidence needs within the same video. We introduce AirVT-15k, a benchmark of 15,504 UAV videos and 155,040 captions, with ten complementary bilingual captions per video describing scenes, object states, and temporal changes. We also propose AirFocus-CST, which selects query-relevant frames and patches, encodes temporal feature differences, and combines coarse-to-fine interaction (CFI) with optimal-transport alignment (OTA). Average mean recall reaches 63.67% on AirVT-15k and 24.41% on CapERA, improving over the strongest baselines by 2.96 and 1.91 percentage points, respectively. The dataset and code are available at https://chenxi000233.github.io/AirVT-15k-site/.

AI.tldr: 本文针对无人机视频-文本检索（UAV-TVR），构建了含15,504段视频、155,040条中英双语描述的新基准AirVT-15k，并提出AirFocus-CST方法，在AirVT-15k和CapERA上平均mR分别提升2.96和1.91个百分点。
AI.motivation: UAV-TVR需同时匹配场景上下文与细微目标变化：如“港口布局”类查询依赖全局场景，而“离港船只”类查询依赖局部功能线索与运动状态。现有基准虽提供多样航拍描述，但对同一视频内不同证据需求的区分关注不足。
AI.method: 构建AirVT-15k基准（每段视频配10条互补双语描述，覆盖场景、目标状态与时间变化）；提出AirFocus-CST，选择与查询相关的帧与图像块，编码时序特征差异，并融合由粗到精交互（CFI）与最优传输对齐（OTA）。
AI.result: 在AirVT-15k上平均mR达63.67%，在CapERA上达24.41%，分别比最强基线提升2.96和1.91个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过细粒度、多证据维度的基准与聚焦选择+时序差分+多层对齐的方法，提升了无人机视频-文本检索性能，数据集与代码已开源。

title: Shift by Analogy for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
summary: Compositional zero-shot learning recognizes attribute-object pairs absent from training. An unseen pair has a semantic description but lacks an observed visual reference. We propose Shift by Analogy (SBA) to make unseen compositions visually seen through a shift-then-match process. Its core add-subtract-add rule transfers an attribute change between two seen image-text residuals on a source object to a reference residual on the target object. This shifts the target's own text feature toward its visual center; learned refinement produces a proxy for matching query images. During training, each target is excluded from its supports, and recognition is learned using references constructed from other pairs. An analogy library and same-object attention extend this construction across candidates, while joint learning integrates proxy matching with semantic and primitive evidence. Visual-center analysis confirms substantially improved correspondence for unseen compositions. Experiments across three standard benchmarks show that SBA consistently outperforms strong CZSL baselines under both closed- and open-world evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出Shift by Analogy (SBA)，通过"平移-匹配"流程借助已见组合的图文残差将属性变化迁移到目标物体，为未见组合构造视觉代理，实现组合零样本识别。
AI.motivation: 未见属性-物体组合只有语义描述而缺乏可观测视觉参考，导致语义与视觉中心对应不佳，识别困难。
AI.method: 核心为add-subtract-add规则：用两个已见图像-文本残差间的属性变化作用于目标物体的参考残差，把目标自身文本特征平移到其视觉中心；经学习式细化生成可匹配查询图像的代理。训练时排除目标自身作为支持，并引入类比库、同物体注意力与联合学习（代理匹配+语义+原语证据）。
AI.result: 视觉中心分析显示未见组合的对应关系显著改善；在三个标准基准上，闭世界与开世界评测均稳定优于强CZSL基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过类比平移构造视觉代理是提升未见组合视觉可见性与CZSL性能的有效途径。

title: Reconstructing 3D+t Cardiovascular Flow From Sparse Planar Velocity Fields With Neural Fields
summary: Reconstructing time-resolved three-dimensional (3D+t) cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements is challenging because each plane observes only the two in-plane velocity components, on a small part of the volume. We propose a plane-aware neural-field framework that learns a continuous 3D velocity field from space and time coordinates through a per-plane projection, and then investigate the potential benefits of physics constraints. We evaluate the framework on computational aortic and aneurysm datasets, and on planes resampled from a real cardiac 4D Flow MRI scan. A plain multi-layer perceptron (MLP) was more accurate than classical radial basis function (RBF) interpolation on both computational datasets. For the aorta, a physics-constrained SIREN (PC-SIREN) reduced the rRMSE further to $0.3756$, compared with $0.4273$ for the plain MLP and $0.7256$ for RBF, and it was the most accurate model in every anatomical segment of the MRI data. For the aneurysms the plain MLP remained the most accurate model, with an rRMSE of $0.07$ to $0.16$ against $0.55$ to $0.71$ for PC-SIREN. Further experiments investigated scanning configuration, number of scans, and spatial resolution. These findings show that continuous neural fields can reconstruct volumetric cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements, and that physics constraints have to be matched to the flow.

AI.tldr: 提出平面感知神经场框架，从稀疏平面测量重建3D+t心血管流场，并研究物理约束的收益与适用条件。
AI.motivation: 每个测量平面仅观测面内两个速度分量且只覆盖小部分体积，从稀疏平面测量重建时空三维心血管流场具有挑战性。
AI.method: 平面感知神经场框架：以时空坐标为输入、经逐平面投影学习连续三维速度场；在计算主动脉与动脉瘤数据集及真实心脏4D Flow MRI重采样平面上评估，对比RBF插值与物理约束SIREN（PC-SIREN），并考察扫描配置、扫描数量与空间分辨率。
AI.result: 计算数据上普通MLP优于RBF；主动脉上PC-SIREN将rRMSE降至0.3756（MLP 0.4273，RBF 0.7256），且在MRI各解剖节段最准；动脉瘤上普通MLP最优，rRMSE 0.07–0.16，PC-SIREN为0.55–0.71。
AI.conclusion: 连续神经场可从稀疏平面测量重建体积心血管流场，但物理约束必须与具体流场特性相匹配才能带来增益。

title: SceneCast: Learning Indoor Scene Synthesis from Curated Synthetic Videos with LLM Reward
summary: 3D indoor scene synthesis requires generating objects to form a complete and coherent scene. Existing approaches rely heavily on manually annotated datasets, leading to high costs and limited generalization. We present SceneCast, an annotation-free framework that trains on large-scale, unlabeled videos, addressing two key challenges: (1) Videos provide only partial views of a scene, requiring the model to extrapolate unseen 3D regions, which is inherently error-prone; (2) Raw videos available online are uncurated, suffering from uncontrolled conditions and variable data quality. First, we design a Transformer-based model that predicts objects sequentially and is fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL), where an LLM acts as a spatial common-sense evaluator. The LLM provides reward signals through chain-of-thought reasoning and code-executable geometric checks to refine object configurations. Second, we introduce \trim, a data curation approach that generates training videos with controllable video generation models. Crucially, it retains only high-quality prefix clips via multi-criteria quality assessment with an entropy-based weighting strategy. Evaluated on curated synthetic video sets, our annotation-free approach outperforms state-of-the-art supervised methods in scene quality.

AI.tldr: SceneCast 是一个无需人工标注的 3D 室内场景合成框架，直接在大规模无标注视频上训练，通过 Transformer 顺序预测物体并用 LLM 强化学习评估空间合理性，结合可控视频生成与高质量前缀剪辑筛选，在场景质量上超越有监督 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 室内场景合成方法依赖人工标注数据集，成本高且泛化能力有限。利用海量无标注视频可规避这一问题，但面临两大挑战：视频只提供场景的部分视角，需要模型外推未见 3D 区域，容易出错；网络原始视频未经筛选，条件不可控、质量参差。
AI.method: 1）设计基于 Transformer 的模型，顺序预测物体，并用强化学习微调，其中 LLM 作为空间常识评估器，通过思维链推理与可执行代码的几何检查提供奖励信号，优化物体配置；2）提出 \trim 数据策展方法，用可控视频生成模型生成训练视频，并通过多准则质量评估与基于熵的加权策略只保留高质量前缀片段。
AI.result: 在策展后的合成视频数据集上评估，该无标注方法在场景质量上优于当前最先进的有监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 无标注视频训练加上 LLM 奖励的 RL 微调与可控数据策展，可有效替代人工标注数据，实现高质量且泛化性更强的 3D 室内场景合成。

title: Can Multimodal Fusion MakeSense for Embodied Vision in Degraded Sensing?
summary: Embodied vision systems rely on complementary sensors to perceive and act as conditions change. Even models that accept arbitrary sensor subsets can exhibit negative fusion: adding a sensor increases prediction error. We propose MakeSense, a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and combines information through shared bottleneck tokens. Training pairs full and subset views of the same degraded observations, penalizing higher error with more sensors. Where geometry permits, the distance readout uses range measurements alone, while the rest of the prediction draws on all available inputs. Paired tests across five datasets reveal helpful and harmful sensor additions. MakeSense reduces negative fusion on MM-Fi. With lightweight adapters and per-dataset training, the same design improves UAV localization on MMAUD, cooperative 3D detection on V2X-Real, few-shot pose transfer to RELI11D, and command prediction on Humanoid-Everyday, where a world model trained on the frozen core's outputs forecasts future fused states more accurately than a linear baseline at longer tested horizons. MakeSense supports embodied sensing across human activity, aerial systems, robotics, and autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 提出MakeSense多模态融合框架，用私有流保留各传感器证据并以共享瓶颈token融合，配对训练全/子集视图以抑制"负融合"（加传感器反而更差）。
AI.motivation: 具身视觉系统依赖互补传感器，但即使支持任意传感器子集的模型也存在"负融合"：增加传感器反而提高预测误差。需要一种在传感器增减时不劣化的融合机制。
AI.method: 私有流保留传感器专属证据，经共享瓶颈token组合信息；训练时配对同一退化观测的全视图与子集视图，对传感器更多却误差更高的情形施加惩罚；在几何允许时，距离读出仅用测距数据，其余预测使用全部可用输入。
AI.result: 五个数据集的配对测试揭示了有益与有害的传感器添加。MakeSense在MM-Fi上降低负融合；借助轻量适配器和逐数据集训练，同一设计在MMAUD的UAV定位、V2X-Real的协同3D检测、RELI11D的少样本姿态迁移与Humanoid-Everyday的指令预测上均有提升，且基于冻结核心输出的世界模型在更长预测时域上优于线性基线。
AI.conclusion: MakeSense可支撑人类活动、空中系统、机器人与自动驾驶等具身感知场景，具备良好的通用性与可迁移性。

title: NNS-GS: Non-Local Neural Scattering for Relightable Gaussian Splatting
summary: Creating relightable 3D assets of translucent objects is challenging because changing the illumination at one surface location can affect the appearance elsewhere through subsurface scattering. Existing Gaussian-based scattering models typically predict scattering from local features, making this dependence difficult to capture. We present Non-Local Neural Scattering for Gaussian Splatting (NNS-GS), which learns non-local scattering together with geometry-guided local reflection. The scattering module learns how illumination from light-visible surface regions in light space contributes to the shading point in view space, conditioned on regional diffuse responses and spatial relationships. The reflection module supplies these diffuse responses and uses additional geometric guidance to better capture specular highlights and sharp shadow boundaries. To reduce component mixing and support controllable scattering appearance, anchor-based progressive training establishes the diffuse-scattering base before introducing specular reflection and supervises the components separately. Under calibrated point lighting, NNS-GS improves mean PSNR over existing methods by 2.47 dB and 0.81 dB on the synthetic and real translucent scenes, respectively. Additional synthetic comparisons further show that NNS-GS better matches the reference when adjusting scattering attenuation.

AI.tldr: NNS-GS 提出非局部神经散射与几何引导局部反射联合建模的 Gaussian Splatting 方法，实现半透明物体的可重光照 3D 资产，PSNR 提升显著。
AI.motivation: 半透明物体的可重光照 3D 资产生成困难：在一个表面位置改变光照会通过次表面散射影响其他区域外观。现有 Gaussian 散射模型通常只从局部特征预测散射，难以捕捉这种长程依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出 NNS-GS。散射模块在光空间学习可见表面区域的光照如何贡献到视空间的着色点，并以区域漫反射响应和空间关系为条件；反射模块提供这些漫反射响应，并利用额外几何引导以更好捕捉高光和锐利阴影边界。采用基于锚点的渐进训练：先建立漫反射-散射基础，再引入镜面反射，并对各分量分别监督，以减少分量混合、支持可控散射外观。
AI.result: 在校准点光源下，合成半透明场景平均 PSNR 比现有方法提升 2.47 dB，真实场景提升 0.81 dB；额外合成对比显示在调整散射衰减时 NNS-GS 更接近参考结果。
AI.conclusion: 非局部散射建模结合渐进式分量分离训练，能有效提升半透明物体重光照的渲染质量与散射外观可控性。

title: DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers
comment: 46 pages, 29 figures, 33 tables. Code, weights and project page: https://oneboxcream.github.io/DyLoMo-DiT/
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), which reuses parameters rather than adding them: a weight-shared loop repeatedly applies the middle layers, while sparse experts allocate parameter capacity across tokens. This design deepens the network without adding parameters, freeing the parameter budget for other uses, such as more experts or more distinct layers. It also allocates compute dynamically, varying the number of passes across noise levels. Experiments show that DyLoMo-DiT makes more effective use of parameter and compute budgets, with further gains from assigning more passes to low-noise steps. On ImageNet $256\times256$, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 11-24% relative to DiT and 36-56% relative to DiT-MoE at matched parameter and compute budgets. For text-to-image generation, a scaled DyLoMo-DiT achieves a higher GenEval score than FLUX.1 (0.714 vs. 0.673), with less than one tenth of its active parameters (1.05B vs. 12B).

AI.tldr: DyLoMo-DiT：结合权重共享循环层与稀疏专家的扩散Transformer，在不增加参数的情况下加深网络并动态分配计算，显著提升参数/计算效率。
AI.motivation: DiT通过增加参数和计算扩展容量，MoE虽扩大参数容量但保持每token计算固定，仍需大量参数存储。作者希望复用而非新增参数，将参数预算释放给更多专家或独立层，同时根据噪声水平动态分配计算。
AI.method: 提出DyLoMo-DiT：权重共享循环反复应用中间层以在无新增参数下加深网络；稀疏专家在token间分配参数容量；并按噪声水平动态调整循环次数（尝试给低噪声步骤分配更多传递次数）。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256上，在匹配参数与计算预算下，FID相对DiT降低11-24%，相对DiT-MoE降低36-56%；文生图任务中缩放版DyLoMo-DiT的GenEval得分0.714超过FLUX.1的0.673，且激活参数不足其十分之一（1.05B vs 12B）。
AI.conclusion: DyLoMo-DiT更有效地利用参数与计算预算，低噪声步骤多传递带来额外收益，并在文生图上以极小激活参数超越大模型，验证了参数复用+动态计算的有效性。

title: STAR: Structure-Aware Temporal Action Recovery for Point Supervised Temporal Action Localization
summary: Point supervised temporal action localization is becoming the need of time in this era of ever growing and non-stop video data. Existing method mainly rely on snippet level action response to generate pseudo labels. However, these labels often suffer from boundary ambiguity, over extended proposals, and weak temporal structure. To address these issues, we propose STAR, a structure-aware Temporal Action Recovery framework for point supervised temporal action localization. STAR works by enhancing the base S model with temporal difference interaction with attention module to capture forward and backward snippet changes, and introduces the learning of start, core, and end roles to model the internal temporal structure of actions. In addition, STAR further improves the pseudo label generation through All point proposal ranking and Rolebank based structural re-ranking, which suppress neighbor crossing and structurally inconsistent proposals. Finally, temporal action detector to STAR feedback supervision transfers high quality detector prediction back to the STAR model through soft start, core, end, action, and background targets. This helps to further refine the pseudo labels. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks shows the effectiveness of STAR. By using I3D features, STAR achieves 67.2% at AVG@0.1:0.7 on THUMOS'14, 58.1% on GTEA, 74.6% on BEOID, and 31.7% at AVG@0.5:0.95 on ActivityNet-1.3, outperforming previous point supervised methods across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: STAR：一种面向点监督时序动作定位的结构感知时序动作恢复框架，通过时差交互、起/核/止角色建模、全点提案排序与Rolebank结构重排、以及检测器反馈监督，显著提升伪标签质量与定位精度。
AI.motivation: 在视频数据快速增长背景下，点监督时序动作定位需求迫切。现有方法主要依赖片段级动作响应生成伪标签，但这些标签存在边界模糊、提案过度延长、时序结构弱等问题。
AI.method: STAR在基础S模型上引入带注意力模块的时差交互以捕捉前后片段变化；学习start、core、end三类角色来建模动作内部时序结构；通过All-point提案排序与Rolebank结构重排改进伪标签生成，抑制相邻跨越与结构不一致提案；最后将时序动作检测器的高质量预测以软start/core/end/action/background目标回馈给STAR，进一步精炼伪标签。
AI.result: 在四个标准基准上使用I3D特征，STAR在THUMOS'14的AVG@0.1:0.7达67.2%，GTEA达58.1%，BEOID达74.6%，ActivityNet-1.3的AVG@0.5:0.95达31.7%，在多个基准上优于以往点监督方法。
AI.conclusion: STAR通过结构感知建模与反馈式伪标签精炼，有效缓解了点监督下的边界模糊与结构弱问题，验证了该类方法在点监督时序动作定位中的有效性。

title: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://pawteam-eai.github.io/native-lam/
summary: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.

AI.tldr: 提出Native LAM：将预训练视频扩散Transformer同时作为IDM和FDM，用可学习"动力学寄存器"作为唯一因果桥梁，从反事实时间对中蒸馏紧凑潜在动作；并据此构建VLA预训练范式PAWlicy。
AI.motivation: 大规模异构视频（第一人称人类视频、机器人录像）蕴含丰富动力学，但要么缺少动作标注、要么动 作空间不统一。现有潜在动作模型（LAM）从零训练IDM/FDM，在像素重建与潜在容量/精度间权衡；而预训练视频世界模型能生成高保真动力学，却以密集、跨层纠缠的方式表示。
AI.method: Native LAM：单一预训练视频扩散Transformer兼顾IDM与FDM，仅引入可学习动力学寄存器作为二者间唯一因果通道；训练于仅在运动上不同的反事实时间对，使寄存器将视频动力学蒸馏为紧凑潜在动作。PAWlicy：以此为大规模视频上的动力学教师预训练VLA策略，且不生成视频（区别于world action models）。
AI.result: 在LARY基准上动作分类与控制回归均优于现有LAM；无需任何迁移目标即可在新机器人、新场景、以及人手到机器人之间重放相同运动。3.8B模型PAWlicy在RoboTwin 2.0（域随机演示）上平均成功率93.6%，为VLA中最高；RoboDojo各维度具竞争力，Precision与榜首持平；真实机器人上两项任务均优于pi_0.5基线。两阶段仅用公开数据与公开世界模型。
AI.conclusion: 将预训练视频世界模型直接视作LAM，仅需极小改动即可提取可迁移的紧凑潜在动作，并可作为VLA的有效动力学教师，实现跨具身/场景的运动迁移与领先的机器人操作性能。

title: Boosting zero-shot learning through neuro-symbolic integration
summary: Zero-shot learning (ZSL) aims to train deep neural networks to recognize objects from unseen classes, starting from a semantic description of the concepts. Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) integration refers to a class of techniques that incorporate symbolic knowledge representation and reasoning with the learning capabilities of deep neural networks. However, to date, few studies have explored how to leverage NeSy techniques to inject prior knowledge during the training process to boost ZSL capabilities. Here, we present Fuzzy Logic Prototypical Network (FLPN) that formulates the classification task as prototype matching in a visual-semantic embedding space, which is trained by optimizing a NeSy loss. Specifically, FLPN exploits the Logic Tensor Network (LTN) framework to incorporate background knowledge in the form of logical axioms by grounding a first-order logic language as differentiable operations between real tensors. This prior knowledge includes class hierarchies (classes and macroclasses) along with robust high-level inductive biases. The latter allow, for instance, to handle exceptions in class-level attributes and to enforce similarity between images of the same class, preventing premature overfitting to seen classes and improving overall performance. % CHECK: original sentence had no verb ("Both class-level and attribute-level prototypes through an attention mechanism ...") FLPN learns both class-level and attribute-level prototypes, the latter through an attention mechanism specialized for either convolutional- or transformer-based backbones. FLPN achieves state-of-the-art performance on the GZSL benchmarks AWA2 and SUN, matching or exceeding the performance of competing algorithms with minimal computational overhead. The code is available at https://github.com/FrancescoManigrass/FLPN

AI.tldr: 提出Fuzzy Logic Prototypical Network (FLPN)，将零样本学习表述为视觉-语义嵌入空间中的原型匹配，并用逻辑张量网络(LTN)把背景知识（类层级、属性例外等一阶逻辑公理）作为可微损失注入训练，在AWA2和SUN的GZSL基准上达到SOTA且计算开销小。
AI.motivation: 零样本学习希望仅凭概念的语义描述识别未见类；神经符号(NeSy)方法可将符号知识与深度网络结合，但目前少有研究探索如何在训练中利用NeSy技术注入先验知识以提升ZSL能力。
AI.method: FLPN在视觉-语义嵌入空间中以原型匹配完成分类，并通过优化NeSy损失进行训练。具体用逻辑张量网络(LTN)框架，将一阶逻辑语言落地为实数张量间的可微操作，从而把逻辑公理形式的背景知识（类层级，即类与宏类；以及鲁棒的高层归纳偏置）纳入训练。归纳偏置可处理类级属性中的例外情况、强制同类图像相似，防止对已见类的过早过拟合。模型学习类级与属性级原型，属性级原型通过分别针对卷积或Transformer骨干定制的注意力机制获得。
AI.result: 在GZSL基准AWA2和SUN上取得SOTA性能，以极小的额外计算开销达到或超过对比算法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 用可微逻辑公理注入先验知识是提升零样本学习的有效途径，且不牺牲计算效率。

title: REACT: Response-based Expert Assembly from Contextual Trajectories
summary: Dense feed-forward networks are unaffected by how their neurons are grouped: every neuron is evaluated. Sparse execution makes this grouping consequential, because each input can access only a few experts. An arbitrary partition can therefore retain pretrained weights while separating computations that an input needs together. We argue that upcycling should organize neurons according to their responses to similar inputs. To establish this correspondence, we introduce a context-guided upcycling approach REACT, Response-based Expert Assembly from Contextual Trajectories, that uses frozen denoising trajectories to connect input contexts with pretrained neuron responses. We first identify contexts after timestep-wise centering to account for distribution shifts across noise levels, then use their associated responses to allocate intact neurons to routed experts. The same contexts initialize the corresponding router entries, aligning expert contents with their intended inputs, while global activation statistics select an always-active shared expert. Layer-wise reconstruction and end-to-end adaptation refine this initialization for sparse execution. On ImageNet-1K, our approach achieves better generation quality while activating only 37.5% of the original FFN parameters and reducing total per-token activated parameters by 27.6%.

AI.tldr: 提出 REACT，一种基于响应（Response-based）的上下文引导 upcycling 方法，将预训练稠密 FFN 神经元按其在不同输入上下文下的响应模式分组为稀疏专家，在 ImageNet-1K 上以 37.5% 的 FFN 参数获得更优生成质量。
AI.motivation: 稠密 FFN 中所有神经元都被计算，因此神经元如何分组无关紧要；但稀疏执行下每次输入只访问少数专家，任意划分虽能保留预训练权重，却会把某输入需要协同使用的计算拆散。因此分组应依据神经元对相似输入的响应来组织。
AI.method: 1) 利用冻结的去噪轨迹把输入上下文与预训练神经元响应关联；2) 对时间步做中心化以消除不同噪声水平的分布漂移，先识别上下文；3) 用上下文对应的响应把完整神经元分配（upcycle）到被路由的专家中；4) 用同一上下文初始化路由条目，使专家内容与目标输入对齐；5) 依据全局激活统计选取始终激活的共享专家；6) 通过逐层重构与端到端适配精调该初始化以适配稀疏执行。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上，生成质量优于基线，同时仅激活原 FFN 参数的 37.5%，每 token 总激活参数减少 27.6%。
AI.conclusion: 神经元的组织应遵循其对相似输入的响应而非任意划分；基于响应的上下文引导 upcycling 能在显著降低激活参数的同时提升稀疏模型的生成效果。

title: Mind the Gaps: State-Guided Supervision Allocation for Object Detection Dataset Distillation
comment: Jiehui Xie and Zhengxun Jin contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Sung-Ho Bae and Chaoning Zhang
summary: Recent advances in dataset distillation have enabled large-scale training datasets to be compressed into compact synthetic sets. However, dataset distillation for object detection remains challenging, as it requires preserving diverse classification and localization signals under limited image budgets. Existing approaches often emphasize individual-image informativeness without explicitly accounting for supervision accumulated across the distilled dataset, potentially leading to redundant supervision and uneven class-scale coverage. To address this limitation, we propose State-Guided Supervision Allocation (SGSA), a framework that formulates object detection dataset distillation as a dataset-level progressive supervision allocation problem. SGSA establishes class-scale supervision quotas and maintains a global state that tracks detector predictions accumulated from previously selected synthetic images. The remaining gaps between the target quotas and accumulated supervision guide adaptive object sampling, detector-guided canvas refinement, and marginal-gain-based candidate selection, encouraging complementary supervision across images. On MS COCO, SGSA outperforms a matched OD3 baseline by 3.73-4.06 mAP points across three image budgets (0.25%-1.0%). On PASCAL VOC, SGSA outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 4.53-6.90 mAP50 points across three image budgets. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of dataset-level supervision allocation guided by accumulated detector feedback under limited image budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出SGSA框架，将目标检测数据集蒸馏建模为数据集级渐进式监督分配问题，在MS COCO与PASCAL VOC上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有目标检测数据集蒸馏方法侧重单图信息量，未显式考虑整个蒸馏数据集累积的监督，易导致监督冗余和类别-尺度覆盖不均。
