AI.method: 建立类别-尺度监督配额，并维护记录已选合成图像所累积检测器预测的全局状态；以配额与累积监督间的剩余差距指导自适应目标采样、检测器引导的画布精修，以及基于边际增益的候选筛选。
AI.result: MS COCO上三种图像预算（0.25%-1.0%）下比匹配的OD3基线高3.73-4.06 mAP；PASCAL VOC上比最强基线高4.53-6.90 mAP50。
AI.conclusion: 在有限图像预算下，由累积检测器反馈引导的数据集级监督分配是有效的。

title: ColonoWorld: Camera-Controlled Full-Procedure Colonoscopy Video Generation
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld
summary: Navigation systems in colonoscopy are advancing from guiding the endoscopist to steering the scope autonomously. Since an incorrect motion can injure the patient, developing and evaluating these systems calls for a world model of colonoscopy. Such a model must follow a commanded scope motion, keep the colon anatomy consistent, and show lesions and procedural events. Yet camera-controlled generators trained on general scenes lose the colon's structure under motion, and endoscopic generators offer no camera control. We present ColonoWorld, a colonoscopy world model conditioned on a camera trajectory and a coarse 3D tube of the colon, trained on in vivo videos. From a whole-colon tube, it generates a full cecum-to-rectum procedure, even for unseen colon shapes. It also places polyps, instruments, and irrigation at specified locations and times. ColonoWorld outperforms state-of-the-art video generators, reducing camera trajectory error by 32% and FVD by 29%. Our code and annotations will be released at https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld.

AI.tldr: ColonoWorld 是一个以相机轨迹和粗略 3D 结肠管为先验条件的结肠镜世界模型，可生成全结肠（盲肠到直肠）手术视频，并按指定位置和时间放置息肉、器械、冲洗等事件。
AI.motivation: 结肠镜导航系统正从辅助医生走向自主操控内镜，而错误运动可能伤害患者，因此需要可用于开发和评估的世界模型。该模型须具备三点：跟随指令运动、保持结肠解剖一致、呈现病变与手术事件。现有通用视频生成器在运动下丢失结肠结构，内镜专用生成器则缺乏相机控制能力。
AI.method: 在体（in vivo）视频上训练；以相机轨迹和粗略 3D 结肠管为条件进行可控生成；由整段结肠管生成完整术程，并可泛化到未见过的结肠形状；支持在指定空间位置与时间注入息肉、器械和冲洗。
AI.result: 在相机轨迹误差上降低 32%，FVD 降低 29%，优于当前最先进的视频生成器。
AI.conclusion: ColonoWorld 首次实现了兼具几何一致性与相机可控性的结肠镜世界模型，可用于导航系统的训练与评估；代码与标注将在项目主页公开。

title: BASE: A Backend-Agnostic Streaming Embodiment Layer for Full-Duplex Conversational Avatars
summary: Many end-to-end spoken dialogue models can now converse in real time and full duplex, and turning them into 3D avatars requires full-body gestures, listening feedback, and turn-taking. Existing methods couple the motion generator tightly to one dialogue model by reading its internal states or training speech and motion jointly. The motion module must then be retrained whenever the dialogue model changes, cannot be attached to cloud APIs that expose only audio, and entangles role, voice, and motion style. We propose BASE, a backend-agnostic streaming embodiment layer whose only interface to the dialogue model is its emitted speech. First, a conversation state manager driven solely by audio handles speaking, listening, idling, barge-in, and proactive turns on one timeline, while role, voice, motion style, and 3D appearance are set independently. Second, to run an offline 2 s flow-matching gesture model on live audio, we reformulate inference as sliding-window continuation with overlapped look-ahead ensembling, which removes seam jitter. Third, we show that the remaining streaming gap comes from errors accumulating in the self-generated motion history rather than missing future speech; our Drift-Aware History Perturbation (DAHP) reduces this gap in about 50 min on one GPU by injecting inference-like drift into ground-truth training histories, and transfers to a second generator. On BEAT2, streaming BASE reaches an FGD of 0.342, on par with the tightly coupled MIBURI (0.333), and viewers prefer its body motion over MIBURI's in 82% of forced-choice judgments. Without retraining, the same layer drives a cascaded pipeline, three open full-duplex models, and a cloud API in real time.

AI.tldr: BASE 是一种与对话模型后端无关的流式 3D 虚拟化身层，仅以对话模型输出的语音为接口，即可实时驱动全身手势、聆听反馈与轮次转换。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 化身方法把动作生成器与某个对话模型紧耦合（读内部状态或联合训练），导致换模型就要重训、无法接入仅提供音频的云 API，且角色、音色与动作风格纠缠在一起。
AI.method: 1) 由音频独驱的对话状态管理器，统一时间线处理说话、聆听、空闲、打断与主动轮次，角色/音色/动作风格/外观可独立设定；2) 将离线 2 秒 flow-matching 手势模型改为滑窗续接+重叠前瞻集成推理，消除接缝抖动；3) 提出 Drift-Aware History Perturbation (DAHP)，向真实训练历史注入类推理漂移以缓解自生成历史误差累积。
AI.result: BEAT2 上流式 BASE 的 FGD 为 0.342，与紧耦合的 MIBURI（0.333）相当；强制二选一中 82% 的观众更偏好 BASE 的肢体动作。DAHP 约 50 分钟单卡训练即缩小流式差距，并可迁移到另一个生成器。无需重训即可实时驱动级联流水线、三个开源全双工模型及一个云 API。
AI.conclusion: 解耦式、仅依赖语音接口的流式化身层可在质量上媲美紧耦合方案，并具备即插即用与后端无关的实用优势。

title: SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning
summary: Preference tuning of text-to-image diffusion models spends most of its compute generating candidate images, yet training prompts are typically sampled uniformly at random, wasting compute generating images that provide too little signal for model alignment. To best utilize the available compute, we study prompt selection, where at each iteration we identify the most useful prompts for preference tuning. We separate prompt selection into a utility score, an estimator of that utility score, and batch selection. Within this framework, we propose Selection by PRedicting Objective-grounded UTility (SPROUT). The utility score is predicted on every prompt in the pool, including unseen prompts, by a text-only model, refit after every iteration on all utilities observed so far. A randomized acceptance rule then turns these predictions into a batch, so no images are generated beyond those used for training. For direct group preference optimization (DGPO), the objective-grounded utility is the norm of the gradient that the objective produces from a prompt's group of images. Fine-tuning Stable Diffusion 1.5 with DGPO on GenEval, SPROUT matches the final score of uniform sampling in about 44% of the iterations and improves the area under the learning curve with respect to both uniform sampling and CGPO, a recent variance-based prompt sampler. The efficiency gains hold under four held-out reward models never used in training, and the ranking of methods carries over to DPG-Bench and T2I-CompBench++. Our code is available at https://github.com/ADDAPT-ML/SPROUT.

AI.tldr: SPROUT：用文本模型预测基于目标的提示词效用，结合随机接受规则进行提示词选择，减少偏好微调中的图像生成开销，约44%迭代即达均匀采样最终分数。
AI.motivation: 偏好微调文本到图像扩散模型的计算主要花在生成候选图像上，而训练提示词通常均匀随机采样，常生成对模型对齐信号不足的图像，浪费算力。因此研究提示词选择，以最大化利用有限计算。
AI.method: 将提示词选择分解为效用分数、效用估计器与批次选择三部分。提出SPROUT：用仅文本模型对池中所有提示词（含未见提示词）预测效用分数，每次迭代后用已观测效用来重新拟合；再用随机接受规则把预测转为批次，不额外生成图像。针对DGPO，基于目标的效用定义为目标函数对提示词图像组产生的梯度范数。
AI.result: 在GenEval上用DGPO微调Stable Diffusion 1.5，SPROUT约44%迭代即达到均匀采样的最终分数，相比均匀采样和基于方差的CGPO均提升学习曲线下面积；在四个未参与训练的留出奖励模型下效率提升仍成立，方法排序可迁移到DPG-Bench和T2I-CompBench++。
AI.conclusion: 预测式提示词选择能显著提升偏好微调的计算效率，且不增加图像生成成本，具有良好的泛化性与跨基准可迁移性。

title: LiquidGazeNet: Towards Event-Based Near-Eye Gaze Estimation under Low-Light Conditions
summary: Near-eye gaze estimation under low-light nighttime conditions is challenging because the quality and effective temporal resolution of conventional intensity frames can be reduced. This paper presents LiquidGazeNet, an event-only gaze-estimation framework that combines polarity-aware spike-latency encoding with a custom LTC-based recurrent module. Positive- and negative-polarity events are represented in separate channels, while exponentially decayed time surfaces retain per-pixel temporal recency across successive event windows. A shared convolutional encoder extracts spatial features from each window, and a two-layer recurrent module composed of LTC-inspired cells integrates them causally over short temporal sequences. The network is trained using a hybrid objective that combines screen-space coordinate regression with centre-referenced directional consistency. The framework is evaluated on Gaze-FELL under cross-subject and cross-scene protocols and is further assessed through event-representation, temporal-module, window-duration, and computational ablations. LiquidGazeNet achieves mean errors of 3.75 degrees and 2.41 degrees under cross-subject and cross-scene evaluation, respectively. The results indicate that polarity-aware temporal-recency encoding, together with recurrent integration, is effective for event-only gaze estimation under the evaluated low-light nighttime conditions.

AI.tldr: LiquidGazeNet：一种仅用事件相机、结合极性感知脉冲延迟编码与LTC循环模块的夜间注视估计框架，跨被试误差3.75°、跨场景2.41°。
AI.motivation: 低光照夜间条件下近眼注视估计困难，传统强度帧的质量与有效时间分辨率下降，因此需要不依赖强度帧的纯事件方案。
AI.method: 正/负极性事件分通道表示，用指数衰减时间面保留逐像素时间新近度；共享卷积编码器提取每个事件窗口的空间特征；两层LTC启发式细胞的循环模块做因果时序积分；混合损失结合屏幕坐标回归与中心参考的方向一致性约束。在Gaze-FELL上做跨被试、跨场景及事件表示/时序模块/窗口时长/计算量消融。
AI.result: 跨被试平均误差3.75°，跨场景2.41°；消融显示极性感知时间新近度编码与循环积分均有效。
AI.conclusion: 极性感知时间新近度编码加循环时序积分，是低光照夜间纯事件注视估计的有效方案。

title: Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models
summary: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories. Yet for autoregressive (AR) video generation, existing few-step models still rely on distribution matching distillation (DMD) to remain competitive, sacrificing sample diversity and requiring a large bidirectional teacher. In this work, we analyze what limits standalone AR FlowMap distillation and introduce two complementary guidance mechanisms to close this gap: (1) anti-drifting guidance, which helps the AR teacher correct drifted student rollouts by training an auxiliary model to mimic student drift and using it as a negative guidance branch; and (2) motion-aware guidance, which makes motion easier for a FlowMap student to learn by locating motion patches and selectively applying skip-layer guidance. Empirically, our approach applies to $π$-Flow, MeanFlow, and consistency distillation with 1.3B AR teachers, improving generation quality and reducing drift over 30 s rollouts. Notably, our 4-step $π$-Flow students match DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers, demonstrating that pure FlowMap distillation is effective for few-step autoregressive video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自回归（AR）视频生成中FlowMap蒸馏的局限，提出反漂移引导与运动感知引导两种互补机制，使纯FlowMap蒸馏在少步AR视频生成中可与DMD媲美，并保留样本多样性。
AI.motivation: FlowMap蒸馏本可自然实现少步生成，但在AR视频生成中，现有少步模型仍依赖DMD才具竞争力，代价是牺牲样本多样性且需大型双向教师模型。作者希望分析并突破独立AR FlowMap蒸馏的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出两种引导机制：(1) 反漂移引导——训练辅助模型模仿学生漂移，作为负向引导分支，帮助AR教师纠正漂移的学生展开；(2) 运动感知引导——定位运动区块并选择性施加跳层引导，使运动更易被FlowMap学生学习。方法可套用于π-Flow、MeanFlow与一致性蒸馏，教师为1.3B AR模型。
AI.result: 在30秒以上的长展开中提升生成质量并减少漂移；4步π-Flow学生模型在VBench上与由14B教师蒸馏的DMD学生相当，同时保留其AR教师的样本多样性。
AI.conclusion: 纯FlowMap蒸馏对少步自回归视频生成是有效的，配合所提引导机制可摆脱对DMD、大型双向教师与多样性损失的依赖。

title: GeLiFiSH: Recursive LiDAR Keypoint Estimation with Ground and Moving Object Segmentation
summary: LiDAR registration and loop closure often rely on sparse keypoints, which must remain repeatable across sessions, viewpoints, and sensors. To handle differing scan patterns, detectors typically operate on accumulated submaps, which introduces latency and processes each submap independently, so repeated observations are never fused. Height-based detectors also reference structure to an estimated ground, so its inconsistency across sessions propagates into the keypoints. Moreover, dynamic objects leave ghost trails that can be mistaken for static structure. We present GeLiFiSH (Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing), a learning-free filter that recursively estimates persistent keypoints at scan rate. A height-structure detector runs on a rolling voxel map, and detections initialize tracks with a position, covariance, and existence probability, accepted or rejected by a sequential probability ratio test. Ground segmentation provides a sensor-agnostic height reference, and moving object segmentation removes dynamic points before map insertion. On SemanticKITTI, HeLiMOS, and HeLiPR, spanning five LiDARs and multiple sessions, GeLiFiSH attains the highest average keypoint repeatability among the compared detectors and the second-highest cross-session registration recall from keypoints alone, behind ISS which extracts four times as many keypoints. With one parameter set and no sensor-height prior, both ground and moving object segmentation modules outperform their baselines on average.

AI.tldr: GeLiFiSH：一种无需学习、以扫描频率递推估计持久关键点的滤波框架，融合高度-结构检测、序贯概率比检验、地面分割与动目标剔除，显著提升跨会话关键点可重复性。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR配准与回环依赖稀疏关键点，但关键点需在跨会话、视角和传感器间保持可重复。基于累积子图检测有延迟且不融合重复观测；高度检测依赖估计地面，跨会话不一致会传播到关键点；动态物体留下"鬼影"被误认为静态结构。
AI.method: 在滚动体素图上运行高度-结构检测器；检测初始化带位置、协方差与存在概率的轨迹，并用序贯概率比检验（SPRT）接受或拒绝；地面分割提供与传感器无关的高度参考；动目标分割在插入地图前剔除动态点。整个流程无需学习，以扫描频率递推估计持久关键点。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI、HeLiMOS、HeLiPR（5种LiDAR、多会话）上，GeLiFiSH在对比检测器中取得最高平均关键点可重复性；仅用关键点的跨会话配准召回率排第二，仅次于提取四倍关键点数的ISS。单一参数集、无传感器高度先验下，地面分割与动目标分割平均均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 统一的在线滤波框架可同时解决子图延迟、地面不一致与动态鬼影问题，在跨传感器、跨会话场景中以更少关键点实现高可重复性与竞争性配准性能。

title: LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be
summary: The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better. This leads to slightly improved performance. For example, on ImageNet-100, our modified regularizer reaches the final accuracy of SIGReg in 1.3$\times$ fewer epochs. Our second result argues that self-supervised encoders should not have isotropic Gaussian features. We show that the alignment term in LeJEPA conflicts with SIGReg, because it couples the magnitude of the features with their directions. In contrast, isotropic Gaussian features would entail independent magnitude and directions. Features obtained with LeJEPA are, in fact, not isotropic. So LeJEPA has two issues. Its regularizer is weak, and the isotropic Gaussian target is too strict. Our third result is about reformulating the isotropic Gaussian regularizer to enforce only the marginal distributions of the magnitude and direction, without enforcing independence. This leads to a simple regularization term, PolarReg, that can be optimized reliably across many different datasets, batch sizes and embedding dimensions without any hyper-parameter changes. On ImageNet-1k, our technique matches the accuracy of LeJEPA and its variants in 4.7$\times$ fewer epochs. It improves the final accuracy by 1.8 points.

AI.tldr: 论文分析LeJEPA中SIGReg正则化的两个缺陷（正则器太弱、各向同性高斯目标过严），提出只约束幅值与方向边际分布而不强制独立性的PolarReg，在多种设置下无需调参即可稳定优化，ImageNet-1k上以4.7倍更少epoch达到LeJEPA精度并提升1.8个点。
AI.motivation: 作者质疑LeJEPA的核心设计：SIGReg在实践中无法真正实现各向同性高斯特征；且对齐项将特征幅值与方向耦合，与SIGReg所隐含的幅值-方向独立性相冲突，说明各向同性高斯目标本身对自监督编码器过于严格。
AI.method: (1) 设计改进版正则器以更好实现原目标；(2) 分析对齐项与SIGReg的冲突，指出LeJEPA特征实际非各向同性；(3) 将各向同性高斯的约束重新表述为只约束幅值与方向的边缘分布、不强制独立性，得到简单可稳定优化的PolarReg，对数据集、batch size和嵌入维度不敏感。
AI.result: 改进正则器在ImageNet-100上以1.3倍更少epoch达到SIGReg最终精度；PolarReg在ImageNet-1k上以4.7倍更少epoch匹配LeJEPA及其变体精度，最终精度提升1.8个点，且无需超参调整。
AI.conclusion: 自监督编码器不应追求各向同性高斯特征；放弃独立性约束、仅约束幅值与方向边缘分布的PolarReg更有效、更鲁棒，替代SIGReg可显著加速收敛并提升精度。

title: Spatial-Zero: Self-Evolving Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models from Zero Data
comment: 19 pages, including appendices. 4 figures and 3 tables in the main text
summary: Spatial reasoning requires a vision-language model~(VLM) to understand metric distances, three-dimensional relationships, and viewpoint-dependent geometry. Learning these capabilities typically requires externally curated training data. This paper introduces Spatial-Zero, a VLMs' training framework that can self-evolve through autonomous spatial exploration with zero data. Spatial-Zero addresses two key challenges in autonomous spatial exploration: reliably generating valid spatial interaction tasks and providing accurate supervision for learning from these tasks. Specifically, a proposer specifies object configurations and questions, and a Coder turns them into executable scene programs that produce multi-view images and explicit scene geometry. A Geometric Oracle checks spatial constraints, visibility, and answer uniqueness and derives ground-truth labels from executed geometry; these labels supervise the Solver and ground difficulty feedback, while validation outcomes guide subsequent task generation. Across six spatial reasoning benchmarks and three VLM backbones, Spatial-Zero yields consistent gains through iterative self-evolution. After three iterations, Qwen3.5-9B improves average accuracy by 3.23 percentage points; with Qwen3.5-4B, Spatial-Zero also outperforms existing VLM self-evolution methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/YutongLi2024/Spatial-Zero

AI.tldr: Spatial-Zero 是一个无需外部数据的自演化训练框架：通过Proposer提出空间任务、Coder生成可执行场景程序、Geometric Oracle校验约束并导出真值标签，迭代监督求解器并反馈难度。
AI.motivation: 空间推理需要VLM理解度量距离、三维关系与视角依赖几何，但现有方法依赖人工整理的外部训练数据，成本高。自动空间探索面临两大难题：可靠生成有效的空间交互任务，以及为这些任务提供准确监督。
AI.method: Proposer指定物体配置与问题；Coder将其转为可执行场景程序，产生多视图图像与显式场景几何；Geometric Oracle检查空间约束、可见性与答案唯一性，从执行几何中导出真值标签，用于监督Solver并给出难度反馈，同时校验结果指导后续任务生成，形成自演化闭环。
AI.result: 在6个空间推理基准、3个VLM骨干上迭代自演化均有一致提升；三次迭代后Qwen3.5-9B平均准确率提升3.23个百分点；Qwen3.5-4B上亦优于现有VLM自演化方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过可执行几何驱动的任务生成与自动校验标签，VLM可在零外部数据下自主提升空间推理能力，验证了自演化训练范式的有效性。

title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出MIPA，一种自监督数据集蒸馏方法，将合成图像视为可学习原型，通过最大化跨增强视图的原型分配互信息来保留增强不变信息，在图像分类上取得更优表示且降低蒸馏时间与存储。
AI.motivation: 数据集蒸馏在有监督学习中效果显著，但在自监督学习中研究不足。SSL蒸馏数据需保留学习增强不变表示所需的信息，现有方法欠缺对此的针对性设计。
AI.method: 将合成图像作为可学习原型，用冻结编码器按特征相似度把真实样本分配给原型；要求同一真实图像的多增强视图产生稳定的原型分配，通过最大化跨视图分配的互信息实现，并避免所有样本集中到少数原型造成的平凡解。
AI.result: 在图像分类基准上，MIPA生成的合成数据比现有蒸馏方法产生更高质量的表示，同时减少蒸馏时间和存储需求。
AI.conclusion: MIPA为SSL场景下的数据集蒸馏提供了高效有效的方案，兼顾表示质量与蒸馏成本。

title: Decompose and Describe: Narrowing the Diagnosis-to-Report Gap in 3D CT Report Generation
summary: Automated 3D CT report generation could support radiology workflows, yet medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) often omit diagnostic findings from generated reports. We ask whether the diagnostic ability of these models carries over to free-form reporting. Across five MedVLMs, diagnostic VQA achieves higher macro-F1 than reports generated from the same CT studies and evaluated on the same disease categories. We call this task-dependent discrepancy the diagnosis-to-report gap. Conventional Report Adaptation improves reporting for most models but does not close the gap. To investigate and narrow it, we introduce DeCAD (Decompose CT Analysis and Describe), which progressively decomposes CT report generation at diagnostic, regional textual, and regional visual levels. The model identifies positive findings before writing a report, organizes diagnosis and description into regional tasks, and restricts each task to visual tokens from the corresponding region. Diagnostic and regional textual decomposition improve report-level diagnostic performance across the five MedVLMs, whereas regional visual decomposition provides limited additional gains. In a standard VLM without medical VQA pretraining, the first two levels remain effective; regional visual decomposition also provides further gains with a region-level contrastively pretrained encoder. Full DeCAD achieves state-of-the-art performance on CT-RATE and Merlin. Analyses show greater CT-token attention during diagnosis and higher recall of reference-positive findings in both the diagnostic output and final report than with Report Adaptation. These results show that explicitly organizing diagnosis improves diagnostic reporting and helps narrow the diagnosis-to-report gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"诊断到报告差距"（diagnosis-to-report gap），并设计DeCAD框架通过诊断、区域文本、区域视觉三层递进分解来缩小该差距，在CT-RATE与Merlin上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 自动3D CT报告生成有助放射科工作流，但医学视觉语言模型（MedVLM）生成的报告常遗漏诊断发现。作者质疑：模型的诊断能力能否迁移到自由文本报告？实验发现同一CT研究的诊断VQA宏F1高于报告生成，即存在任务依赖的"诊断到报告差距"，且传统Report Adaptation无法弥合。
AI.method: 提出DeCAD（Decompose CT Analysis and Describe）：在诊断层、区域文本层、区域视觉层逐级分解CT报告生成。模型先识别阳性发现再写报告，将诊断与描述组织为区域任务，并把每个任务限制在对应区域的视觉token上。在五个MedVLM及无医学VQA预训练的普通VLM上做消融分析。
AI.result: 诊断层与区域文本分解在五个MedVLM上均提升报告级诊断性能；区域视觉分解增益有限，但在区域级对比预训练编码器下可带来额外收益。完整DeCAD在CT-RATE和Merlin上达SOTA；诊断阶段CT token注意力更高，诊断输出与最终报告对参考阳性发现的召回均高于Report Adaptation。
AI.conclusion: 显式组织诊断过程可提升诊断性报告质量并有助于缩小诊断到报告差距；区域视觉层收益依赖编码器质量。

title: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
summary: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, a closed-form recipe motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin. Computed in seconds from 25,000 labelled pairs, it requires no model-specific tuning and leaves the architecture and inference cost unchanged. TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval by 16.8 RSUM and Flickr30k test retrieval by 6.6 on average across all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints, including 8 unseen by the agent, while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to 0.5 points. It also reduces hubness on all 21 checkpoints and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种配对统计量定位两个塔在难负样本上比匹配对更一致的"伪对齐"方向，通过闭式权重编辑（TowerBridge）削弱这些方向，在不改变架构和推理成本的前提下显著提升CLIP检索性能并缩小模态间隙问题。
AI.motivation: CLIP式双塔将图文映射到共享空间但存在模态间隙，检索失败的常见原因是难负样本排在正确匹配之前。作者发现事后消除模态间隙反而会降低所有CLIP检查点的检索性能，说明"间隙"并非问题根源，需要找到真正导致错误排序的方向。
AI.method: 引入配对统计量，识别两个塔在难负样本上比在匹配对上一致性更高的方向；用权重空间编程（weight-space programming）：由该统计量引导LLM智能体检查两塔并写出闭式权重编辑，无需反向传播。将智能体反复修正的模式提炼为TowerBridge——基于难负边距一阶分析的闭式配方，用25,000对标注数据在数秒内计算完成，无需针对模型调参。
AI.result: LLM智能体在全部13个CLIP检查点上提升COCO测试检索，其中12个编辑了输出投影层。TowerBridge在21个CLIP检查点（含8个未见）上平均提升COCO测试检索16.8 RSUM、Flickr30k测试检索6.6，ImageNet零样本精度下降不超过0.5点；在全部21个检查点上降低hubness，并在其他家族的5个双编码器中4个上提升检索。
AI.conclusion: 模态间隙本身并非检索失败主因，真正问题是特定"伪对齐"方向。通过统计量引导的闭式权重编辑可有效修正该偏差，TowerBridge作为一种通用、计算廉价、免调参、不改变推理成本的方法，可推广到多种双编码器架构。

title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
summary: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.

AI.tldr: Integral 通过构建理解与生成共享的视觉表征空间，将预训练视觉语言模型转化为统一多模态模型。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型需同时具备视觉理解与生成，但二者使用的视觉表征异构，导致预训练VLM的知识难以有效用于生成。
AI.method: 提出 Integral，含两个组件：Abstraction Fusion 聚合冻结视觉编码器的层次化表征得到共享视觉token；Block-wise MoT 引入轻量生成流，仅在块边界与VLM交互。
AI.result: 在保留预训练理解能力的同时获得强生成能力；控制实验表明共享表征比独立表征显著提升生成学习，即使重建保真度相当。
AI.conclusion: 预训练VLM学到的表征已能为视觉生成提供有效基础。

title: Struct2Det: Grounding Category Structure in Visual Evidence for Few-Shot Object Detection
summary: Few-shot detectors struggle to distinguish categories that look alike but differ in local components, because a few examples rarely reveal which differences determine category identity. Category descriptions specify components and relations but do not establish their presence in an image. We propose Struct2Det, which uses category structure to guide detection and verify candidates in three stages. Relational Structure Encoding maps category graphs to component embeddings and a global condition. Component-Grounded Detection uses component queries to retrieve multi-scale image evidence that, with the global condition, modulates category text embeddings for initial detection. Verification-Guided Refinement matches candidate regions with components expected by their top-scoring categories; when class scores are close and matches are reliable, matched pairs correct region features before the shared detector predicts again. Category structure informs both classification inputs: text embeddings integrate image-wide component evidence, while region features incorporate candidate-specific matches. We also construct InduSym, with 88,912 symbol instances across 275 categories from 674 engineering drawings and a structural graph per category. Struct2Det improves few-shot-category AP over the strongest baseline by 6.02 points on InduSym and 9.68 on Digitize-PID, with the highest base-category AP on both. InduSym ablations show few-shot gains from correct category structure, image-level retrieval, and candidate verification. Further tests show gains in few-shot natural-object detection and zero-shot Chinese character recognition.

AI.tldr: Struct2Det利用类别结构（组件与关系图）引导少样本检测，通过结构编码、组件查询检索与候选验证三阶段提升相似类别的区分能力，并构建工程图纸符号数据集InduSym。
AI.motivation: 少样本检测器难以区分外观相似但局部组件不同的类别，因为少量样本难以揭示决定类别身份的关键差异；而现有类别描述虽给出组件和关系，却无法确认其在图像中的存在。
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架：1）关系结构编码，将类别图映射为组件嵌入和全局条件；2）组件接地检测，用组件查询检索多尺度图像证据，并结合全局条件调制类别文本嵌入进行初检；3）验证引导细化，将候选区域与最高分类别期望的组件匹配，在类分数接近且匹配置信时修正区域特征后二次预测。
AI.result: 在InduSym上少样本类别AP比最强基线提升6.02点，在Digitize-PID上提升9.68点，且两个数据集基类AP均最高；消融显示增益来自正确的类别结构、图像级检索和候选验证；在少样本自然物体检测与零样本汉字识别上也有提升。
AI.conclusion: 将类别结构同时注入分类的文本嵌入与区域特征两个输入，可有效提升少样本检测性能；同时构建了包含674张工程图纸、275个类别、88,912个符号实例及类别结构图的InduSym数据集。

title: Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action
summary: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning with MoOP performs comparably to or slightly better than the strongest baselines in driving, while retaining 94.0% of the dense model's LingoQA score, far above all other methods. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, MoOP degrades much less than every other method, as it is the only one whose reasoning does not collapse. Removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels increases total parameter reduction to 39.4%, with nearly unchanged open-loop errors relative to VLM-only pruning and competitive closed-loop performance. The resulting model achieves a 1.37x end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory than the dense model, without post-pruning fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动驾驶推理式VLA模型的结构化剪枝，发现推理与轨迹目标对VLM结构重要性不同，据此提出MoOP方法，在显著降低参数量的同时保持推理与驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: 推理式VLA模型用思维链指导动作生成，但内存与计算开销大；需要剪枝，同时保留场景理解与轨迹预测两种能力。
AI.method: 基于Alpamayo-1.5-10B的Taylor重要性分析：(1) VLM剪枝融合推理目标与轨迹目标的重要性排名(MoOP)；(2) action expert中聚合逐步去噪的重要性，选固定MLP通道子集（MLP比query head跨步更稳定）。
AI.result: 24.0%参数削减下驾驶性能持平或略优于最强基线，LingoQA保留94.0%；30.0%削减下退化最小且唯一推理不崩溃；剪除93.75% expert MLP通道使总量达39.4%，开环误差几乎不变。1.37倍推理加速、峰值内存降低36.6%，无需后剪枝微调。
AI.conclusion: 融合多目标重要性的结构化剪枝能有效压缩推理式VLA模型，且在不微调情况下兼顾推理能力与驾驶性能。

title: Inclusion of obstacles in ground point classification in ALS data for terrain models used for analysis of vehicle traversability
summary: Classification of ALS point clouds has been studied for decades, but it remains challenging in forest contexts due to the great variety of terrain types, sensor equipment, flight parameters, and resulting point densities. Point cloud density has increased significantly in recent years, and existing algorithms, developed for lower density point clouds, may no longer be effective. It is beyond the scope of most existing algorithms to classify obstacles, such as boulders, while also distinguishing non-obstacles, such as bushes and undergrowth. We evaluate the performance of different algorithms for ground point classification in ALS data in a context where obstacles are included in the ground class, resulting in terrain models useful for offroad machinery route planning and navigation. The evaluation is performed using metrics directly on the point clouds (Precision, Recall, $F_1$-score) and on resulting terrain models (RMSE and maps of differences). The results show that there are several algorithms that perform well, but performance is highly affected by the parameters used. The best results in terms of terrain model RMSE are obtained with the CSF-algorithm, with an average RMSE of 0.08 meters. The results indicate that existing algorithms can be adapted to include obstacles in the ground class under the tested conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文评估多种ALS点云地面点分类算法，在将障碍物（如巨石）纳入“地面”类以生成越野导航可用地形模型的场景下，比较点云层指标与地形模型精度，发现CSF算法地形RMSE最优（平均0.08米）。
AI.motivation: 森林场景ALS点云分类受地形类型、传感器、飞行参数和点密度差异影响，仍具挑战；近年点密度显著提升使原为低密度设计的算法可能失效；且现有算法难以在分类障碍物（如巨石）的同时区分非障碍物（灌木、林下植被），而越野机械路径规划与导航需要包含障碍物的地形模型。
AI.method: 在多类条件下评估不同ALS地面点分类算法，将障碍物归入地面类；采用点云直接指标（Precision、Recall、F1）与生成地形模型指标（RMSE及差异图）进行对比评估，并分析参数影响。
AI.result: 多种算法表现良好，但性能对参数高度敏感；地形模型RMSE最优为CSF算法，平均RMSE为0.08米。
AI.conclusion: 现有算法在测试条件下可经调整以将障碍物纳入地面类，从而支持越野机械路径规划与导航所需的地形模型构建。

title: Target-Part Preference Optimization for Part-Aware 3D Generation
summary: Part-aware 3D generation requires not only globally plausible objects but also complete, well-separated semantic parts, yet high-quality part decompositions remain too scarce to support large-scale supervised fine-tuning. We study whether preference fine-tuning based on Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) can adapt a pretrained part-aware generator from limited part-annotated data without architectural changes. We rank candidates generated with different random seeds against ground-truth (GT) geometric metrics, and select the (object, target-part) examples with the largest across-seed quality gap. Each selected example stores a seed pair whose two flow trajectories share one clean GT compositional latent and differ only in Gaussian noise. We derive a reference-relative target-block preference loss from FlowDPO that compares the two trajectories against a frozen reference model. GT flow-matching losses on the target block and complete part set provide absolute supervision, while only the diffusion transformer (DiT) is updated. Human-ranked controls test an alternative ordering source, and synthetic cropping provides controlled loser targets that are incomplete by construction. Among the three training-set scales, the medium-scale setting gives the strongest result on held-out Objaverse and outperforms both the pretrained generator and the reported direct supervised fine-tuning baseline on the multi-part aggregate. Further analysis shows sensitivity to pair ordering, target-part coverage, and the balance between pairwise and GT supervision. Cross-dataset experiments show less consistent gains under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究能否用基于DPO的偏好微调，在不改动架构的前提下，把预训练零件感知生成器适配到稀缺的零件标注数据上。作者用不同随机种子的生成结果与GT几何指标排序、挑选质量差距最大的样本构建偏好对，并提出FlowDPO的参考相对目标块偏好损失。
AI.motivation: 零件感知3D生成需要全局合理且完整、分离良好的语义部件，但高质量零件分解数据太少，难以支撑大规模有监督微调。
AI.method: 用不同随机种子生成候选并按GT几何指标排名，选出跨种子质量差距最大的(object, target-part)样本；每个样本由一对种子构成，两条流轨迹共享同一个干净GT组合隐变量、仅高斯噪声不同。基于FlowDPO推导参考相对的目标块偏好损失，与冻结参考模型比较；同时以目标块和完整零件集上的GT flow-matching损失提供绝对监督，仅更新DiT。
AI.result: 三种训练集规模中，中等规模在留出Objaverse上效果最好，在多部件汇总指标上超过预训练生成器和已报告的直接有监督微调基线。分析显示结果对配对顺序、目标部件覆盖度以及成对监督与GT监督的平衡敏感；跨数据集实验在分布偏移下收益不一致。人类排序对照检验了替代排序来源，合成裁剪提供了天然不完整的受控负样本目标。
AI.conclusion: DPO式偏好微调可在不改架构的情况下有效适配零件感知生成器，中等数据规模最优并能胜过直接SFT基线，但方法对多种设计因素敏感，且在分布偏移下泛化收益不稳定。

title: Test-Time Latent Computation to Improve Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Recent work on Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests that reasoning capabilities can be enhanced at test time not only through longer token-level reasoning traces, but also through additional computation in latent space. This raises a natural question for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs): can additional computation in latent space improve visual perception at test time? In this work, we first verify that MLLMs contain stable reusable layers that can be re-forwarded at inference time without disrupting normal generation. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{Lo}ok \textbf{Ba}ck in the \textbf{L}atent \textbf{S}pace (\textbf{Lobals}), a training-free decoding method that identifies the contiguous layer window with the strongest visual-token attention and re-forwards through it, allowing the model to revisit visual evidence in latent space. We demonstrate that this latent-space revisit strategy can improve MLLMs' performance across diverse multimodal settings, including general vision-language tasks, visual hallucination tasks, and vision-centric tasks.

AI.tldr: Lobals 是一种免训练的解码方法，通过在潜空间中重新前向传播注意力最强的连续层窗口，让多模态大模型在推理时"回看"视觉证据，从而提升视觉感知能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 研究表明测试时推理可通过潜空间额外计算增强，作者由此提出问题：MLLM 能否也在潜空间增加计算来提升视觉感知？
AI.method: 先验证 MLLM 中存在稳定、可复用的层，可在推理时重复前向而不破坏正常生成；据此提出 Lobals，免训练解码方法，识别对视觉 token 注意力最强的连续层窗口并对其重新前向传播。
AI.result: 该潜空间回看策略在多种多模态场景（通用视觉语言任务、视觉幻觉任务、视觉中心任务）中均提升 MLLM 表现。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间中的额外计算可作为测试时增强视觉感知的有效手段，且无需额外训练。

title: Do learned image captioning metrics generalize? Auditing duplicated samples in human-judgment benchmarks
summary: Learned image captioning metrics are trained and tested on human judgments, so their reported correlation is a claim about generalization. We audit this claim for the three most recent collections of such judgments, Polaris, Nebula, and Spica, matching images at the pixel level. First, test samples reappear in training sets: the Spica training set contains about two-thirds of the Polaris test set, with identical human ratings. Second, controlled retraining shows that duplicates can inflate a metric: for Pearl, the gain is confined to the duplicated samples and grows with every epoch; for DENEB, it stays below one point. The gain depends on the learner and on how often a training set repeats a sample. Third, Kendall's $τ$ over all samples is the sum of two terms, detecting captions with the lowest human score and ranking the others; the first supplies most of the reported correlation and is nearly saturated. The recent test sets cannot order Polos, DENEB and Pearl consistently, and a ridge regression on frozen features matches or exceeds all three. Fourth, we propose a protocol that ranks a learned metric only with a model trained without test samples, reports both terms, and compares metrics by paired tests. Under it, zero-shot vision--language judges rank first on the three recent test sets, and a fine-tuned judge ranks first on the three earlier benchmarks. The same analysis applies to any evaluator learned from human judgments; filter lists and code are released at https://github.com/morninghut/ic-dataset-audit .

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了图像描述学习型指标（Polaris、Nebula、Spica等）的泛化性宣称，发现测试样本泄漏到训练集、重复样本会虚高指标、Kendall τ主要来自"最低分检测"这一近饱和项、近期测试集无法稳定区分不同指标；作者提出更严格的评估协议，并发现零样本视觉语言裁判在近期测试集上最优。
AI.motivation: 学习型图像描述指标以人类判断为训练和测试依据，其报告的相关性本质上是对泛化的宣称。但现有基准可能因数据泄漏、重复样本和单一聚合指标（如Kendall τ）而高估性能，因此需要系统审计这些宣称是否成立。
AI.method: 在像素级匹配三个最新人类判断集合（Polaris、Nebula、Spica）：(1) 核查测试样本是否出现在训练集中及评分是否一致；(2) 通过控制性重训练检验重复样本对Pearl、DENEB等指标的虚高效应；(3) 将Kendall τ分解为"最低分检测项"与"其余样本排序项"；(4) 比较近期测试集能否一致排序各指标，并用冻结特征上的岭回归作对照；(5) 提出新协议：仅用不含测试样本训练的模型排序指标、报告两个τ项、用配对检验比较指标。
AI.result: Spica训练集约含三分之二的Polaris测试集且评分相同；重复样本可使Pearl收益集中于被重复样本并随epoch增长，而DENEB增益低于1分，增益大小依赖学习器和样本重复频率；Kendall τ主要由近饱和的最低分检测项贡献；近期测试集无法一致地排序Polos、DENEB和Pearl，冻结特征上的岭回归可匹敌或超过三者。在作者提出的协议下，零样本视觉语言裁判在三个近期测试集上排名第一，微调裁判在三个较早基准上排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 当前图像描述学习型指标所报告的相关性存在被泄漏和聚合指标掩盖的隐患，不能作为可靠的泛化证据。作者提出的严格评估协议（排除测试样本训练、分解报告τ、配对检验）更具可信度，并揭示零样本视觉语言模型是强有力的评估者。该分析框架可推广至任何从人类判断中学习的评测器，同时发布了过滤列表与代码。

title: When Do Spatial Plans Help Text-to-Image Generation? Causal Control, System Utility, and Text Responsiveness
summary: A generator can follow a spatial plan, but the benefit of supplying that plan depends on what the model can already do from text. In a controlled study with 18 paired training seeds, correcting predicted positions and sizes improves spatial intersection-over-union by 0.030, yet direct text is non-inferior at matched training compute. In a pretrained generator, a fixed rule layout improves two-object task success over the same text-only adapter by 12.50 percentage points, mostly by separating objects that already appear in the correct order. We then ask whether a more precise instruction can achieve the same separation across conditioning paths. On 288 new task families, adding a minimum-gap instruction improves success by 37.15 points with the text-only adapter, by at most 0.69 points with widely spaced regions, and by 6.94 points with tightly spaced regions. Under tight regions, 230 of 288 baseline images have the correct objects and direction yet miss the required gap, ruling out a high baseline success rate as the sole explanation for the weak text response.

AI.tldr: 在受控实验中，纠正空间计划中的位置和尺寸仅带来+0.030 的空间 IoU 提升，且与纯文本条件在等算力下非劣；而精细的空间指令（最小间距）在纯文本通路上可提升 37.15 个百分点，在稀疏区域仅 0.69、密集区域 6.94 点，说明增益取决于模型在文本下已具备的能力。
AI.motivation: 探究"提供空间布局计划"对生成器的实际收益是否依赖模型从文本已能完成的能力，并检验更精确的指令能否在不同条件通路上取得同等效果。
AI.method: 1) 18 个配对训练种子的受控实验，比较位置/尺寸矫正与直接文本（等训练算力）；2) 预训练生成器上比较固定规则布局与纯文本适配器（两物体任务）；3) 在 288 个新任务族上比较最小间距指令在纯文本、宽间隔区域、紧间隔区域三种条件下的增益。
AI.result: 位置/尺寸矫正使空间 IoU +0.030，但直接文本非劣；固定规则布局使两物体任务成功率较纯文本适配器 +12.50 点，主要源于把已正确排序的物体分开；最小间距指令在纯文本通路 +37.15 点，宽间隔区域最多 +0.69 点，紧间隔区域 +6.94 点。
AI.conclusion: 空间规划的收益高度依赖模型已有能力与条件通路；紧间隔下 288 张基线图中 230 张物体与方向正确但缺少所需间距，排除了"高基线成功率"作为文本响应弱的唯一解释。

title: Field-Level Crop Classification via Similarity-Induced Supervision from Imperfect Labels
summary: Regional-scale crop mapping is critical for food production monitoring, yet remains challenging in tropical regions, where persistent cloud cover limits optical imagery. Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) enables continuous observation throughout the agricultural cycle, but a second obstacle is label quality: national-scale land cover products exhibit systematic biases that underestimate less prevalent crops, and training directly on them inherits and amplifies their errors. This work proposes a methodology to build large-scale crop classification models from imperfect public land cover products, requiring no new field campaign, ground survey, or manual label correction. The approach combines two mechanisms. The first reduces the semantic inconsistency of the labels by shifting supervision from the sample level to the group level: a similarity-based clustering model organizes SAR time series into coherent groups, and noisy labels are used only to assign each group its most representative class. The resulting clusters are highly pure with respect to the reference classes (89.0% and 91.2% in the two study regions). The second reduces the spatial inconsistency of the predictions: a segmentation model delineates crop field boundaries from optical imagery, and patch-level predictions are consolidated by majority voting within each field, yielding spatially coherent maps. Evaluated in two Brazilian municipalities, Campo Verde (Mato Grosso) and Luís Eduardo Magalhães (Bahia), the approach consistently outperforms the noisy baseline in mean class accuracy, with gains of up to 10.14 percentage points, especially for minority crops. A state-scale analysis across Mato Grosso and Bahia shows stable behavior without further model adjustment, and the derived municipal crop areas are consistent with official IBGE/PAM statistics, an independent estimate the model never observes.

AI.tldr: 提出无需新标注的作物分类方法，用SAR时序聚类将样本级监督转为组级，再借地块分割和多数投票生成空间一致作物图，在两巴西市镇提升平均类精度最高10.14个百分点。
AI.motivation: 热带地区持续云覆盖限制光学影像，SAR可全程观测；但公共土地覆盖产品存在系统性偏差、低估少数作物，直接训练会继承并放大这些错误标签。
AI.method: 1) 基于相似度聚类将SAR时序组织成语义一致组，仅用噪声标签为每组分配代表性类别，降低标签语义不一致；2) 用分割模型从光学影像勾画田块边界，在田块内对patch级预测多数投票，降低预测空间不一致。
AI.result: 两研究区聚类纯度达89.0%和91.2%；在Campo Verde与Luís Eduardo Magalhães平均类精度较噪声基线最高提升10.14个百分点，少数作物收益尤明显；跨Mato Grosso与B州尺度稳定无需重调，导出市镇作物面积与官方IBGE/PAM统计一致。
AI.conclusion: 可从有缺陷的公共土地覆盖产品构建大尺度作物分类模型，无需野外调查或人工纠错；分组监督与地块级空间整合有效抑制标签噪声与预测碎片化。

title: GeoRead3D: Grounding Part Descriptions for 3D Pointing and Reorientation
summary: Language often refers to an object by its parts, as in asking to point to a part or to turn an arbitrarily posed object so that two named parts lie in given directions. Both tasks need the direction from the object's center to the part's center, not the part's own orientation. A natural approach segments the part and takes the centroid of its mask. However, high mask overlap predicts the pointing direction poorly when a part is spread out relative to its distance from the object center. Language-guided part segmentation is trained and evaluated by mask overlap, which leaves a gap between the masks it produces and the part geometry that these tasks use. We close this gap by learning point evidence, weights over the observed points whose weighted centroid gives the part's location. Geometric Readout Supervision (GRS) trains these weights through the centroid's position and adds direction supervision on the parts used in reorientation commands. GRS improves both tasks even with a single frozen encoder and a single input pose. We implement this supervision in GeoRead3D, a system for pointing and reorientation from part descriptions. A language model maps each description to a known part name. Dual-Route Part Evidence combines refined segmentation evidence with directly predicted point evidence to locate each part. On PartNeXt and Artiverse, GeoRead3D points within $22.5^\circ$ for 74.1% and 60.0% of queries, 5.8 and 7.3 percentage points above the strongest baselines. Its reorientation success exceeds the strongest baselines by 10.4 and 7.8 points.

AI.tldr: 论文提出几何读出监督(GRS)与GeoRead3D系统，通过学习点证据而非分割掩码来定位物体部件，显著提升语言引导的指向与重定向任务性能。
AI.motivation: 语言常通过部件指代物体，但指向和重定向任务真正需要的是从物体中心到部件中心的方向，而非部件自身朝向。现有方法用分割掩码质心近似部件位置，且训练评估都基于掩码重叠；当部件相对距物体中心较远而分散时，掩码重叠无法很好预测指向方向，导致掩码与任务所需几何之间出现鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出几何读出监督(GRS)：学习观测点上的权重(点证据)，其加权质心给出部件位置，并通过质心位置训练权重，同时对重定向指令涉及的部件额外施加方向监督。实现为GeoRead3D系统：语言模型将描述映射到已知部件名；双路部件证据(Dual-Route Part Evidence)融合精化后的分割证据与直接预测的点证据来定位部件。
AI.result: 在PartNeXt和Artiverse上，GeoRead3D分别对74.1%和60.0%的查询在22.5°内指向成功，比最强基线高5.8和7.3个百分点；重定向成功率比最强基线高10.4和7.8个百分点。即使使用单一冻结编码器和单一输入位姿也能提升两个任务。
AI.conclusion: 用点证据加权质心的几何读出监督替代掩码重叠训练范式，能弥合分割掩码与任务所需部件几何之间的差距，有效提升语言引导的部件指向与重定向性能。

title: VeriOrigin: A Proactive Image Protection Framework for Provenance, Tamper Localization, and Lossless Recovery
summary: Versatile watermarking, which seamlessly integrates provenance and tamper detection, has recently attracted widespread attention. In this paper, we propose \textbf{VeriOrigin}, a comprehensive and unified image protection framework that not only robustly achieves provenance and highly precise tamper localization under various complex distortions, but also guarantees perfect recovery of the original cover in lossless channels. To realize this framework, we depart from conventional flow based architectures. Instead, we design \textbf{XOnet}, a CNN based invertible encoder. XOnet comprises two standard CNN based watermarking sub networks, Xnet and Onet, which achieve reversibility through cross residual prediction. Based on XOnet, we train the proactive protection scheme via a two stage strategy: first optimizing the watermarking branch, followed by the tamper localization branch. During inference, the cover image undergoes sequential watermarking and tamper residual embedding. Extensive experimental results on four datasets demonstrate that VeriOrigin achieves precise tamper localization and strong robustness, while guaranteeing lossless cover recovery for integrity authentication. Project page is available at https://veriorigin.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出VeriOrigin统一图像保护框架，基于CNN可逆编码器XOnet，同时实现鲁棒来源认证、高精度篡改定位与无损原图恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有versatile watermarking需在复杂失真下兼顾来源追溯与篡改检测，但传统flow-based可逆架构存在局限，难以同时满足鲁棒性、精确定位与无损恢复。
AI.method: 设计XOnet：由两个标准CNN水印子网Xnet与Onet通过交叉残差预测实现可逆性的CNN可逆编码器；采用两阶段训练策略，先优化水印分支，再优化篡改定位分支；推理时对cover依次进行水印嵌入与篡改残差嵌入。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上实验表明，VeriOrigin实现精确篡改定位与强鲁棒性，并在无损信道下保证cover的无损恢复以支持完整性认证。
AI.conclusion: VeriOrigin以CNN可逆架构替代flow-based方案，统一了来源认证、篡改定位与无损恢复，为综合图像保护提供可行框架。

title: ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusion Model for Oriented Object Detection
summary: The diffusion model has been successfully applied to various detection tasks. However, it still faces several challenges when used for oriented object detection: objects that are arbitrarily rotated require the diffusion model to encode their orientation information; uncontrollable random boxes inaccurately locate objects with dense arrangements and extreme aspect ratios; oriented boxes result in the misalignment between them and image features. To overcome these limitations, we propose ReDiffDet, a framework that formulates oriented object detection as a rotation-equivariant denoising diffusion process. First, we represent an oriented box as a 2D Gaussian distribution, forming the basis of the denoising paradigm. The reverse process can be proven to be rotation-equivariant within this representation and model framework. Second, we design a conditional encoder with conditional boxes to prevent boxes from being randomly placed across the entire image. Third, we propose an aligned decoder for alignment between oriented boxes and image features. The extensive experiments demonstrate ReDiffDet achieves promising performance and significantly outperforms the diffusion model baseline.

AI.tldr: ReDiffDet将旋转目标检测建模为旋转等变去噪扩散过程，用2D高斯分布表示有向框，并设计条件编码器与对齐解码器解决随机框与特征错位问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型用于旋转目标检测存在三大挑战：任意旋转目标需编码方向信息；随机框难以准确定位密集排列与极端长宽比目标；有向框与图像特征存在错位。
AI.method: 1) 将有向框表示为2D高斯分布，并证明在该表示下反向过程具有旋转等变性；2) 设计带条件框的条件编码器，避免框随机散布全图；3) 提出对齐解码器实现有向框与图像特征的对齐。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ReDiffDet取得有竞争力性能，并显著优于扩散模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 将旋转等变扩散过程与高斯框表示、条件编码、对齐解码相结合，可有效提升扩散式旋转目标检测的定位与性能。

title: Where Compositionality Hides: Shared-Content Interference in Vision-Language Retrieval
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Code in ancillary files
summary: Paired compositional benchmarks such as Winoground ask each image to prefer its matching caption and each caption to prefer its matching image. A failed Group decision can come from a wrong caption preference or from the cross-image comparison alone, and Group Score merges the two. Choosing between retraining the encoder and changing the scoring rule therefore requires separating them. We study mean-erasure, which projects each frozen image embedding away from the mean of the two normalized candidate captions. We prove that the projection preserves every within-image caption ranking and makes Group Score equal baseline Text Score. On Winoground, mean-erasure raises CLIP ViT-B/32 Group Score from 9% to 31%, and five CLIP and SigLIP checkpoints gain 21 to 27 percentage points. ColorSwap shows a similar gain for color-object binding. A score decomposition shows that about 60% of Image failures already score the correct joint assignment above the swapped one and fail only on an offset between the two images. Fixed corrections and a learned bilinear scorer gain under one point. A direction estimated from retrieved captions gains about five points with two captions and falls below baseline with sixteen. Before retraining an encoder for paired retrieval, measure the Group loss that mean-erasure recovers: gains beyond baseline Text Score require changing the caption decisions themselves.

AI.tldr: 提出"均值擦除"(mean-erasure)：将冻结的图像嵌入投影到两张候选句归一化均值正交的方向上，证明其保持图内排序不变且使Group Score等于基线Text Score。在Winoground上CLIP ViT-B/32 Group从9%提升到31%，五个CLIP/SigLIP检查点提升21–27点。分解显示约60%的Image失败仅源于跨图偏移，需改动caption决策才能超越基线。
AI.motivation: 配对组合基准(如Winoground)的Group Score混合了两类失败来源：单图内错误选句，以及跨图比较带来的偏移，无法判断失败究竟来自编码器能力不足还是评分规则不合理，因此难以决定该重训编码器还是改评分规则。作者希望将二者解耦。
AI.method: 提出mean-erasure：对冻结图像嵌入，减去两张归一化候选句嵌入的均值方向分量（投影到其正交子空间）。理论证明该投影保持每张图内部的caption排序，并令Group Score恰等于基线Text Score。在Winoground与ColorSwap上评测多个CLIP、SigLIP检查点，并与固定修正、学习式双线性打分器、检索估计方向做对比。
AI.result: Winoground上CLIP ViT-B/32的Group Score由9%升至31%，五个检查点普遍提升21–27个百分点；ColorSwap上颜色-物体绑定也获类似增益。成绩分解显示约60%的Image失败中，正确联合分配其实已高于交换分配，只是因两图之间的偏移而失败。固定修正与学习双线性打分器提升不足1点；检索估计方向在2句时约+5点，16句时降至基线以下。
AI.conclusion: 配对检索前应先测量mean-erasure可恢复的Group损失，以判断瓶颈所在：若提升已由mean-erasure逼近，则瓶颈在跨图偏移（评分规则）；超越基线Text Score则必须改进caption决策本身，即重训编码器。mean-erasure是一个轻量诊断兼修正工具，而非编码器能力提升方案。

title: SVUBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Proactive streaming video understanding requires models to interpret unfolding events, respond timely, and retrieve relevant historical evidence. To systematically evaluate these capabilities, we introduce SVUBench, a comprehensive proactive streaming video benchmark comprising 12,131 questions and 62,881 answer points across ten proactive tasks spanning Perception, Understanding, and Reasoning. Constructed through model-assisted annotation and human verification, SVUBench introduces two complementary interaction modes. Basic evaluates sustained proactive responses from video onset, while Trajectory requires historical recovery and continuous response updates following task activation during streaming. A Duration-Scaled Challenge further evaluates these capabilities across four video duration tiers. We develop the Proactive Response Score (PRS) with task-adaptive answer windows to jointly assess answer correctness, response timeliness, historical consistency, and content quality. Extensive experiments and analysis reveal the strengths and limitations of existing models, highlighting directions for advancing proactive streaming video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出SVUBench，一个面向主动式流式视频理解的大规模基准，含12,131题、62,881答案点、10项主动任务，并配套PRS评测指标。
AI.motivation: 主动式流式视频理解需要模型解读未展开事件、及时响应并追溯历史证据，但缺乏系统性评测手段。
AI.method: 构建SVUBench，覆盖感知、理解、推理三类共十项主动任务，采用模型辅助标注加人工校验；设计Basic与Trajectory两种交互模式，并引入四档视频时长的Duration-Scaled Challenge；提出Proactive Response Score（PRS），以任务自适应答案窗口综合评估正确性、时效性、历史一致性与内容质量。
AI.result: 大量实验与分析揭示了现有模型在该任务上的优势与不足。
AI.conclusion: SVUBench为主动式流式视频理解提供统一评测框架，并指出未来改进方向。

title: Reliable Recursive Memory for Causal Multi-scale Video Polyp Segmentation
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures, 9 tables. Extended version of CMSA-Net (MICCAI 2026). Submitted to Medical Image Analysis
summary: Video polyp segmentation (VPS) is essential for computer-aided colonoscopy, as it localizes and tracks polyps frame by frame. However, VPS remains challenging because polyps resemble the mucosa and change quickly in scale, which calls for history beyond a short clip, and because blur, specular highlights, and occlusion often degrade only part of a frame. Existing methods keep history as whole frames, so their cost grows with the history length, and a partly degraded frame carries its degraded content to later predictions. To address these issues, we propose STREAM, a streaming framework for VPS that extends the causal multi-scale aggregation (CMA) of our conference work from a fixed clip to an online stream. STREAM introduces a Recursive Slot Memory (RSM) that summarizes multi-scale features and soft foreground and background cues into a constant number of slots, which the current features read and pass to CMA, supplying long-range history at a constant cost. Furthermore, we design Reliability-Aware Slot Writing (RASW), which estimates a pixel-level quality map from the current frame, supervised by its local error, and uses it to control which locations are written into RSM and how much each slot is updated. Experiments on SUN-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB demonstrate that STREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the Dice of the conference model from 81.3% to 85.7% on the hardest subset while running at 48 FPS with a constant state of 0.32 MB. Code will be released at https://github.com/wangtong627/STREAM.

AI.tldr: STREAM是一个用于视频息肉分割的流式框架，通过递归槽记忆和可靠性感知写入，在恒定开销下融合长程历史并抑制退化区域，在SUN-SEG上Dice从81.3%提升至85.7%，48 FPS、状态仅0.32 MB。
AI.motivation: VPS中息肉与黏膜相似且尺度快速变化，需要超出短片段的历史信息；同时模糊、高光和遮挡通常只损坏帧的一部分。现有方法以整帧保存历史，导致开销随历史长度增长，且部分退化帧会把退化内容带入后续预测。
AI.method: 将会议工作中因果多尺度聚合（CMA）从固定片段扩展到在线流：提出递归槽记忆（RSM），把多尺度特征及软前景/背景线索压缩为常数个槽，供当前特征读取并送入CMA；并提出可靠性感知槽写入（RASW），用局部误差监督估计像素级质量图，据此控制写入位置与槽更新程度。
AI.result: 在SUN-SEG和CVC-ClinicDB上取得SOTA，最难子集Dice由81.3%提升到85.7%，运行速度48 FPS，恒定状态占用0.32 MB。
AI.conclusion: STREAM以恒定代价实现长程历史建模，并有效抑制部分退化帧的污染，兼顾精度与效率，适合在线结肠镜应用。

title: Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
summary: 4D occupancy forecasting predicts the 3D semantic occupancy of a driving scene seconds ahead. Over a few seconds, the scene changes little while the vehicle moves, so most of the space ahead has already been seen. Sorting the future into unchanged, changed, and unseen space, we find that current camera-based world models fall short on the unchanged part: they fail to hold on to what they have already seen, rather than to forecast what will change. We therefore make what the model has seen its state. PersistWorld streams camera frames into a persistent 3D world state anchored in the scene, writing each frame once instead of rebuilding the state from past frames. The state is learned end to end with the forecast, and an evolver predicts it at any queried time along the ego trajectory. On Occ3D-nuScenes, PersistWorld raises the IoU of the best camera-based world model by 19 points at 1-3 s and by 18 to 24 points up to 8 s, while running more than twice as fast. Code and models: https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld. Project page: https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld

AI.tldr: PersistWorld 把相机流写入一个以场景为锚点的持久 3D 世界状态，每个帧只写一次而非从历史帧重建，并与预测端到端学习，在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上将最佳相机世界模型 IoU 提升 18-19 点以上且速度超两倍。
AI.motivation: 4D 占用预测中，几秒内场景变化很小而车辆在移动，未来大部分空间其实已被看到。把未来划分为未变、变化、未见三部分后发现：现有相机世界模型的短板在"未变"部分——它们保不住已观测到的内容，而非无法预测变化。
AI.method: 将已观测内容作为模型状态：以场景为锚点维护持久 3D 世界状态，相机帧流式输入、每帧仅写入一次，避免逐帧重建；该状态与预测任务端到端联合学习；由 evolver 在自车轨迹上任意查询时刻预测该状态。
AI.result: 在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上，1-3 秒 IoU 比最佳相机世界模型高 19 点，8 秒内高 18-24 点，运行速度提升两倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 以持久场景锚定状态替代历史帧重建，是提升相机 4D 占用预测精度与效率的有效方向，作者开源了代码与模型。

title: A Search Worth a Billion Pixels: Explaining Gigapixel Classifiers
summary: Perturbation-based attribution methods explain model predictions without accessing their internal representations, but scaling them to high-resolution images requires balancing perturbation granularity and computational cost. Fine-grained perturbations require many model evaluations, whereas coarse masks may overlook small but relevant evidence. We introduce Wavelet Find-and-Refine (WaFR), a model-agnostic attribution method combining adaptive hierarchical search with sparse multiscale regression. By selectively refining regions that influence the prediction, WaFR maintains fine-grained localisation with a computational cost that depends on the spatial distribution of the evidence. As image resolution increases to 8,192 pixels per side, WaFR maintains a Pointing Game score of at least .995 in controlled localisation experiments, including at matched forward-pass budgets. On gigapixel whole-slide images, it requires a median of 176 forward passes and achieves the highest mean patch-level AUROC among the evaluated perturbation-based methods (.949).

AI.tldr: WaFR结合自适应层次搜索与稀疏多尺度回归，实现高效细粒度的扰动归因，可扩展到8192像素级图像和十亿像素全切片图像。
AI.motivation: 扰动式归因无需访问模型内部，但高分辨率图像下扰动粒度与计算成本难以兼顾：细粒度需大量前向评估，粗掩码又易漏掉小而关键的证据。
AI.method: 提出Wavelet Find-and-Refine（WaFR），模型无关的归因方法，用小波式自适应层次搜索加稀疏多尺度回归，只对影响预测的区域选择性细化。
AI.result: 在8192像素/边的受控定位实验中Pointing Game得分≥0.995（同等前向预算下亦然）；在十亿像素全切片图像上中位176次前向即达最高平均patch级AUROC（0.949）。
AI.conclusion: WaFR的计算成本取决于证据的空间分布而非总分辨率，兼顾细粒度定位与效率，适用于超大图像归因。

title: Foundation Model and Radiomics Distance Scores for Post-Hoc Segmentation Failure Detection
comment: Accepted at the UNSURE MICCAI 2026 Workshop
summary: Medical image segmentation models can fail silently when clinical data differs from training data. Deployed models rarely ship with quality control, and are often black boxes. Prior methods that work in this post-hoc failure detection setting still need a separate regression or segmentation model, registration, or access to model internals. We instead propose two failure scores based on the Mahalanobis distance to a labeled reference set. The first uses radiomic shape features of the predicted mask. The second uses frozen foundation model (FM) features, made mask-aware by overlaying the mask on the image, encoding it with a frozen DINOv3, and pooling patch features with more weight on the mask region. We test on multi-site prostate and hippocampus MRI under imaging-protocol and population shift. Ranking cases by predicted failure risk within each site, both scores are competitive with the registration-based (Atlas-RCA) and ensemble-based (pairwise Dice) baselines, without registration that can fail silently or access to individual predictions. Our results show that pooling all test cases into one ranking, as prior work does, rewards ordering sites by difficulty, so a detector can rank sites well, miss failures within them, and still look strong. Within-site evaluation measures true per-case failure. The two evaluation schemes reward different behavior, so we recommend reporting both. The code is available at https://github.com/imigraz/fm-radiomics-failure-detection.

AI.tldr: 提出两类基于马氏距离的后验失败检测分数（放射组学形状特征、掩膜感知的冻结DINOv3基础模型特征），在无需配准或模型内部信息的情况下，与配准和集成基线相当，并指出现有跨站点排序评估会掩盖站内失败，建议同时报告站内与全局评估。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割模型在临床数据分布偏移时会静默失败，部署时通常缺乏质量控制且是黑箱。现有后验失败检测方法仍需额外回归/分割模型、配准或访问模型内部，成本高且配准本身也可能静默失败。
AI.method: 构建带标签的参考集，计算测试样本到参考集的马氏距离作为失败分数：1）基于预测掩膜的放射组学形状特征；2）基于冻结DINOv3基础模型特征，将掩膜叠加到图像上使特征"掩膜感知"，并对掩膜区域加权池化patch特征。在多中心前列腺与海马MRI上，分别在成像协议偏移和人群偏移下评估，与Atlas-RCA（配准）和pairwise Dice（集成）基线对比。
AI.result: 在各站点内按预测失败风险对病例排序时，两种分数均与配准基线和集成基线具有竞争力，且不需要会静默失败的配准，也不需要访问个体预测。同时发现：将所有测试病例合并为单一排序（如先前工作）会奖励"按站点难度排序"，检测器即使漏掉站内失败也能表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 站内评估才能衡量真实的逐病例失败；两种评估方案奖励不同行为，因此建议同时报告站内与全局两种评估。代码已开源。

title: DARE: Dual-Level Adversarial Learning with Domain-Aware Regularization for Whole Slide Image Classification
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 22 pages, 7 figures, including the appendix
summary: Pathological whole slide images (WSIs) exhibit substantial domain shifts across hospitals due to variations in scanning devices, staining protocols, and tissue preparation procedures, leading to significant performance degradation when models are applied to data from different sources. Although unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has shown strong performance in transferring models from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain in natural images, it remains relatively underexplored in computational pathology. The ultra-high resolution of WSIs and their pronounced inter-slide and intra-slide heterogeneity pose unique challenges for domain adaptation, often rendering existing UDA methods unstable and susceptible to negative transfer. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-level Adversarial learning with domain-aware REgularization (DARE), a plug-and-play UDA framework for WSI classification. DARE incorporates adaptive pseudo-labeling within a teacher-student architecture to provide stable supervision for the target domain, alongside adversarial alignment of both patch-level and slide-level embeddings. Together, these components enable the joint optimization of semantic representations at both levels for cross-domain alignment. We further introduce domain-aware attention masking to regularize attention and improve cross-domain generalization. Extensive experiments on four public WSI datasets demonstrate that DARE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across various domain shifts.

AI.tldr: DARE：一种用于病理全切片图像分类的即插即用无监督域适应框架，通过双层级对抗对齐与域感知正则化解决跨医院域偏移问题。
AI.motivation: 病理WSI因扫描设备、染色方案和组织制备差异存在显著域偏移，模型跨院部署时性能急剧下降；UDA在自然图像上有效但在计算病理中探索不足。WSI超高分辨率及切片间/切片内异质性使现有UDA方法不稳定，易发生负迁移。
AI.method: 提出DARE框架：1）在教师-学生架构中引入自适应伪标签，为目标域提供稳定监督；2）在patch级和slide级嵌入上同时进行对抗对齐，联合优化两层语义表示；3）引入域感知注意力掩码（domain-aware attention masking）正则化注意力，提升跨域泛化能力。
AI.result: 在四个公开WSI数据集上大量实验表明，DARE在多种域偏移场景下持续优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DARE作为即插即用框架有效缓解WSI跨域分类中的负迁移与不稳定性，为计算病理的UDA提供了可行且通用的解决方案。

title: HOSE: Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure for Concept Unlearning in Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate harmful or sensitive content, such as pornographic or violent imagery, raising serious security concerns. Model editing has recently emerged as an efficient approach to mitigate this issue. It modifies pretrained models with minimal parameter updates to alter specific concepts while preserving overall model capabilities. However, due to the entangled representations of different concepts in diffusion models, direct modifications inevitably disrupt non-target concepts. Meanwhile, U-Net's hierarchical heterogeneity hinders unified strategies from balancing erasure and quality. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure (HOSE). This method projects parameter updates into the subspace orthogonal to general knowledge, thereby eliminating interference with non-target concepts. Considering the hierarchical heterogeneity of the U-Net architecture, we further propose a hierarchical adaptive mechanism, constructing differentiated subspace projections for different layers to precisely adapt to the model's hierarchical structure, thereby resolving the inherent trade-off between erasure and image quality in unified constraints. Experimental results demonstrate the proposed method reduces harmful content generation by 80% compared with the unedited model. While it inevitably incurs some image quality degradation, it still outperforms other editing-based baselines in terms of quality preservation, and achieves a significantly better trade-off between harmful content suppression and quality loss than these baselines. Notably, our approach demonstrates higher adversarial robustness than existing SOTA method, indicating that the target concepts have been more thoroughly erased. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sevenqiiu/HOSE.

AI.tldr: 提出层次正交子空间擦除（HOSE）方法，通过在正交子空间内更新参数并针对U-Net分层异构构建差异化投影，实现扩散模型有害概念擦除与图像质量的更优权衡。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型可能生成色情、暴力等有害内容，存在严重安全隐患。现有模型编辑方法因概念表征纠缠，直接修改会干扰非目标概念；且U-Net的层次异构性使统一约束难以兼顾擦除效果与图像质量。
AI.method: HOSE将参数更新投影到与通用知识正交的子空间，避免对非目标概念的干扰；并针对U-Net层次异构性提出分层自适应机制，为不同层构建差异化的子空间投影，精确适配层级结构，从而缓解擦除与质量之间的固有权衡。
AI.result: 有害内容生成相较未编辑模型降低80%；虽不可避免地带来一定画质下降，但在质量保持上优于其他编辑类基线，且在有害内容抑制与质量损失之间取得显著更优权衡；对抗鲁棒性高于现有SOTA方法，说明目标概念被更彻底地擦除。
AI.conclusion: HOSE通过正交子空间投影与分层自适应机制有效解决概念纠缠与U-Net异构性问题，在安全擦除、画质保持与对抗鲁棒性上均表现优异，代码已开源。

title: ViDiHand2: Unifying Video Diffusion Priors and Hand Geometry for 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild
comment: Main text 8 pages with supplementary material, 54 pages in total
summary: Learning robot manipulation from egocentric human videos requires accurate metric 3D hand motion. Recent methods leverage pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) priors to recover occluded hands directly from full-frame videos, but their appearance-based depth regression generalizes poorly to unseen cameras. In this work, we propose ViDiHand2, a geometry-driven framework that reformulates VDM-based hand depth estimation from direct regression into fine-grained geometric constraint solving. Specifically, we introduce Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting and Clip-Level Ray Fitting, which recover metric depth by enforcing geometric consistency between pixel-aligned 2D joints and the metric structure of MANO hands, while leveraging temporal observations across the clip. Since the lifting relies on these 2D joints, to improve robustness under occlusion and image truncation, we further develop Confidence-Gated Fusion to adaptively combine geometrically lifted joints with MANO predictions according to localization confidence. Finally, we enhance the VDM backbone to better capture spatial-temporal representations and produce the per-frame 2D joint and MANO predictions that both steps rely on. Extensive experiments on seven public datasets demonstrate that ViDiHand2 consistently outperforms 18 baselines, reducing in-the-wild absolute joint error by 42% and detection failures by 8.82x compared with the best baseline on each metric, while running at 57 FPS. The code is available at https://github.com/NTUYWANG103/ViDiHand.

AI.tldr: ViDiHand2 将基于视频扩散模型的手部深度估计从直接回归改为细粒度几何约束求解，实现更鲁棒的度量三维手部运动恢复。
AI.motivation: 从自我中心人类视频学习机器人操作需要准确的度量三维手部运动。现有基于视频扩散模型（VDM）先验的方法通过外观驱动的深度回归恢复遮挡手部，但对未见相机泛化差。
AI.method: 提出几何驱动框架：Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting 与 Clip-Level Ray Fitting，通过像素对齐的2D关节与MANO度量和结构间的几何一致性恢复度量深度，并利用片段内时序观测；引入 Confidence-Gated Fusion，依据定位置信度自适应融合几何提升关节与MANO预测以应对遮挡与截断；同时增强VDM骨干以更好捕获时空表征，输出每帧2D关节与MANO预测。
AI.result: 在七个公开数据集上持续优于18个基线；野外绝对关节误差降低42%，检测失败减少8.82倍，运行速度57 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 几何约束求解替代外观深度回归可显著提升跨相机泛化与鲁棒性，兼顾精度与实时性。

title: GSDet: Gaussian Splatting for Oriented Object Detection
summary: Oriented object detection has advanced with the development of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformers. However, modern detectors still rely on predefined object candidates, such as anchors in CNN-based methods or queries in transformer-based methods, which struggle to capture spatial information effectively. To address the limitations, we propose GSDet, a novel framework that formulates oriented object detection as Gaussian splatting. Specifically, our approach performs detection within a 3D feature space constructed from image features, where 3D Gaussians are employed to represent oriented objects. These 3D Gaussians are projected onto the image plane to form 2D Gaussians, which are then transformed into oriented boxes. Furthermore, we optimize the mean, anisotropic covariance, and confidence scores of these randomly initialized 3D Gaussians, using a decoder that incorporates 3D Gaussian sampling. Moreover, our method exhibits flexibility, enabling adaptive control and a dynamic number of Gaussians during inference. Experiments on 3 datasets indicate that GSDet achieves AP$_{50}$ gains of 0.7\% on DIOR-R, 0.3\% on DOTA-v1.0, and 0.55\% on DOTA-v1.5 when evaluated with adaptive control and outperforms mainstream detectors.

AI.tldr: GSDet将 oriented object detection 建模为 Gaussian splatting：在由图像特征构建的 3D 特征空间中用 3D Gaussian 表示定向目标，投影到图像平面形成 2D Gaussian 再转为定向框，并通过含 3D Gaussian 采样的解码器优化均值、各向异性协方差与置信度。
AI.motivation: 现有 CNN 与 transformer 定向检测器依赖预定义候选（anchor 或 query），难以有效捕捉空间信息，限制了检测性能。
AI.method: 从图像特征构建 3D 特征空间，在其中用随机初始化的 3D Gaussian 表示定向目标；将 3D Gaussian 投影到图像平面得到 2D Gaussian 并转换为定向框；用集成 3D Gaussian 采样的解码器优化其均值、各向异性协方差和置信度，支持推理时自适应控制与动态数量的 Gaussian。
AI.result: 在 3 个数据集上，采用自适应控制时 AP50 在 DIOR-R 提升 0.7%、DOTA-v1.0 提升 0.3%、DOTA-v1.5 提升 0.55%，并优于主流检测器。
AI.conclusion: 以 Gaussian splatting 替代预定义候选可行，能更有效地建模定向目标空间信息，且具备灵活的自适应推理机制。

title: Towards an Armenian Epigraphic Corpus
summary: The Divan hay vimagrut'yan (1960-2017), the printed corpus of Armenian inscriptions, comprises nearly 7,600 records; a growing number of the inscriptions they describe, damaged or destroyed in recent decades, survive only in its pages. Armenian epigraphy nevertheless lacks a digital resource of the kind available for Greek, Latin or Georgian. This paper presents the Corpus Inscriptionum Armenicarum Electronicum, which turns the ten volumes of the Divan into an open digital corpus. Layout detection, OCR and a vision-language model produce a first structured reading of each record, which specialists then check on a proofreading platform. First corrections show that letters are read reliably and that residual errors concentrate in the editorial signs. The corpus is designed as a lasting platform for documenting Armenian inscriptions and as a source of silver data in Classical and Middle Armenian for language models and computational linguistics.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了亚美尼亚铭文电子语料库（CIAE），将十卷本《Divan hay vimagrut'yan》转为开放数字语料。
AI.motivation: 亚美尼亚铭文散见于1960–2017年出版的十卷印刷集《Divan hay vimagrut'yan》，约7600条记录，其中许多碑刻近几十年已损毁，仅存于纸页；而亚美尼亚铭文学长期缺乏希腊、拉丁、格鲁吉亚文那样可用的数字资源。
AI.method: 采用版面检测、OCR与视觉-语言模型生成每条记录的初步结构化文本，再由专家在校对平台上核验。
AI.result: 首轮校订显示字母识别可靠，残余错误集中于编辑符号。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库可作为亚美尼亚铭文记录的长效平台，并为古典/中古亚美尼亚语的语言模型与计算语言学研究提供银标准数据。

title: Tri-DNO: Trilateral Diffusion Noise Optimization for 3D Human Object Interaction
summary:
Generating realistic 3D human object interactions (HOI) is essential for applications, such as augmented or virtual reality (AR/VR) or character animation of interactive entertainment. A particular challenge lies in the faithful generation of hand grasps in human object interaction scenes, where even minor geometric inconsistencies, such as insufficient contact or interpenetration, can significantly compromise realism. While diffusion-based generative models have shown promising results in HOI synthesis, ensuring physically plausible hand-object interactions remains challenging.
  We present Tri-DNO, a diffusion noise optimization strategy to sample from a pretrained multimodal HOI diffusion model, improving hand-object contact. Rather than modifying or retraining the generative model, our approach iteratively optimizes the initial noise of the diffusion generator, thereby generating firm hand object contact, while mitigating penetration and keeping the hand position realistic. Experiments on the GRAB dataset demonstrate improvements over the baseline in grasp quality without additional model training or increased computational cost compared to existing methods. We further demonstrate the applicability of our approach to practical media production scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出Tri-DNO，一种对预训练多模态HOI扩散模型的初始噪声进行迭代优化的策略，以提升手-物接触质量，无需重训模型即可生成更真实的手抓取。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在3D人-物交互（HOI）生成中难以保证手部抓取的物理合理性，轻微的几何不一致（接触不足或穿插）就会显著损害真实感。
AI.method: 不修改或重训生成模型，而是对扩散生成器的初始噪声进行迭代优化，使采样结果产生牢固的手-物接触，同时减少穿插并保持手部位置合理，基于预训练多模态HOI扩散模型。
AI.result: 在GRAB数据集上，相比基线提升了抓取质量，且无需额外模型训练、相较现有方法未增加计算开销；并展示了在媒体制作场景中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 噪声空间优化是一种高效、低成本地提升扩散式HOI生成物理真实性的途径，具备实际生产应用潜力。

title: CineAct: Interaction-State Agents for Playable, Branching Film Generation
summary: Open video generators such as MiniMax-H3 produce short clips of only several to a dozen seconds per run. To synthesize longer sequences, existing methods either rely on agentic systems following preset scripts, or roll out autoregressively from the previous clip's last frame, losing off-screen states and accumulating hallucinations across turns. Consequently, users still cannot take an explicit goal, choose how to accomplish it, and see that choice persist across subsequent clips. We study goal-grounded interactive video generation, where one goal admits multiple valid approaches, the user's chosen approach must be executed on screen, and its consequences must persist across clips. To this end, we propose CineAct, a state-first agentic framework in which language-model agents handle reasoning while frozen image and video generators serve purely as renderers. Before interaction, the Architect initializes the world as a spatial layout with cameras, an asset library, and a scene graph; at each turn, the system deduces the planned state change, generates a target end frame with an image generator and rigorously verifies it, and synthesizes intermediate motion with an FL2V model. We further introduce a multi-space benchmark covering two suites: long-horizon step execution and open-intent branching admissibility. Experiments show that explicit world-state modeling boosts multi-step rollout consistency over the pixel-only baseline (+11.4 automated, +23.1 human points) and raises paired branching success toward a shared goal by +30.8 points.

AI.tldr: 提出CineAct，一个"状态优先"的智能体式框架，用LLM智能体做推理、冻结的图像/视频生成器只做渲染，实现目标锚定、可持久化的交互式长视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有开源视频生成器一次只能生成几秒到十几秒短片；扩展方法要么依赖预设脚本的智能体系统，要么从上一片段末帧自回归滚出，导致丢失画外状态、跨轮次幻觉累积。用户无法指定显式目标、选择实现方式并让其选择跨片段持续生效。
AI.method: 研究"目标锚定交互式视频生成"任务（一个目标多种有效路径、所选路径需在画面上执行且后果跨片段持续）。CineAct中语言模型智能体负责推理，冻结的图像与视频生成器仅作渲染器。交互前由Architect初始化世界：带相机的空间布局、资产库、场景图。每一轮：推断计划的状态变化→用图像生成器生成目标末帧并严格验证→用FL2V模型合成中间运动。
AI.result: 提出多空间基准，含两个套件：长程分步执行与开放意图分支可采纳性。实验表明显式世界状态建模相比纯像素基线，多步展开一致性提升+11.4（自动指标）和+23.1（人工评分）分；朝向共同目标的成对分支成功率提升+30.8分。
AI.conclusion: 显式世界状态建模是长视频交互生成的关键，将推理与渲染解耦的智能体框架能有效保持跨片段一致性并支持用户意图分支。

title: Motion on Demand: Adaptive Optical Excitation for Event Cameras
summary: Event cameras respond only to brightness changes, so whether an edge is visible depends on image motion perpendicular to it---a motion that constantly shifts with camera and scene dynamics. Rotating a wedge prism in front of the lens introduces controlled image motion to reveal static or slow edges. However, a fixed rotation speed cannot adapt to changing motion conditions: when natural motion is already sufficient, additional optical excitation generates redundant events and introduces unnecessary alignment errors. Inspired by the division of labor between fast haltere feedforward and slower visual feedback in fly gaze control, we present EvGaze, an event camera system that adaptively regulates prism rotation speed. EvGaze employs a learned multimodal controller that integrates luminance, event, and inertial observations, with a fast inertial pathway that refines speed decisions between visual updates. To preserve geometric consistency during speed changes, we compensate for prism-induced image motion at individual event timestamps using measured encoder angles. On EvMotion, EvGaze recovers more edges than full-speed prism rotation with 39% fewer events. On DSEC with simulated optical modulation, it reaches 0.73 feature-tracking success (compared with 0.55 on native events and 0.67 at 180 RPM) while generating 26% fewer events than 360 RPM. Real-device experiments further demonstrate online closed-loop adaptation, reducing average event rates by 17% relative to full-speed rotation.

AI.tldr: EvGaze 用类苍蝇视稳控制的自适应旋转棱镜系统，按需调节光学激励速度，实现更少事件下恢复更多边缘。
AI.motivation: 事件相机只响应亮度变化，边缘可见性依赖垂直于边缘的图像运动；旋转楔形棱镜虽可人为引入图像运动揭示静态/慢速边缘，但固定转速无法适应变化场景——自然运动已足够时额外激励产生冗余事件并对齐误差。受苍蝇平衡棒（haltere）快速前馈与较慢视觉反馈分工启发，需自适应调节棱镜转速。
AI.method: 提出 EvGaze：学习型多模态控制器融合亮度、事件与惯性观测，含快速惯性通路在视觉更新间细化转速决策；为保持变速时几何一致性，利用编码器角度在每个事件时间戳补偿棱镜引起的图像运动。
AI.result: EvMotion 上比全速棱镜恢复更多边缘且事件少 39%；DSEC（模拟光学调制）上特征跟踪成功率 0.73（原生事件 0.55、180 RPM 0.67），事件比 360 RPM 少 26%；真实设备在线闭环适应，平均事件率较全速旋转降低 17%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应光学激励能在保证甚至提升边缘/特征信息的同时显著降低事件冗余，验证了仿生前馈-反馈控制在事件相机感知中的有效性。

title: Beyond Naming Accuracy: Template Composition and Species-Name Decisions
summary: Vision-language classifiers identify species by matching images to text prompts containing species names. BioCLIP2 changes its predicted species less often than BioCLIP 2.5 Huge across four photographic templates, but the ranking reverses across a bank of 80 templates. This comparison leaves open whether the reversal depends on the number of templates or their wording. We hold the count at four and compare the classifiers on every four-template subset of the 80-template bank and of a second pool of 24 reviewed photographic templates, keeping images and candidate names fixed. Huge is more consistent across the reviewed pool as a whole, yet 19.09% of its four-template subsets favor Bio-CLIP2 on iWildCam and 5.10% do so on Rare Species. We then test whether both rankings hold on 5,487 frames from previously unused iWildCam sequences. Among 4,356 subsets containing two photo and two photograph templates, simultaneous 95% intervals support lower disagreement for Huge in 1,526 subsets and for BioCLIP2 in 43. Even with the same prompt count and noun mixture, the choice of sentences can determine which classifier appears more consistent.

AI.tldr: 模板数量相同时，句子的具体措辞仍可决定哪个视觉-语言分类器表现更一致，提示词选择本身是结论的关键变量。
AI.motivation: 已有比较发现BioCLIP2在四种摄影模板下比BioCLIP 2.5 Huge更少改变预测物种，但在80个模板的模板库中排序反转。为弄清反转是源于模板数量还是措辞，需要控制模板数量进行系统比较。
AI.method: 将模板数固定为4，在80模板库与另一组24个经审核的摄影模板池的所有4模板子集上比较两分类器，保持图像与候选物种名不变；再用5,487帧未使用过的iWildCam序列做验证，并用同时95%区间评估子集层面的排序。
AI.result: 整体上Huge在审核模板池中更一致，但在iWildCam上19.09%的4模板子集偏向BioCLIP2，Rare Species上为5.10%。在含两"photo"与两"photograph"模板的4,356个子集中，1,526个子集支持Huge分歧更低，43个支持BioCLIP2。
AI.conclusion: 即使提示词数量与名词构成相同，句子的具体写法也能决定哪个分类器显得更一致，因此一致性结论对提示模板选择高度敏感。

title: Part-wise Certified State Estimation of Articulated Objects from Passive Stereo
summary: Robots in manufacturing often handle thin, hinged objects known from CAD models that change shape during the task, like folding cartons. Monitoring such tasks requires estimating the object's articulation state, its pose and the shape of any semi-deformable part. Learning-based estimators generalise across objects but lose precision while handling thin parts. Model-based fitting is precise but often needs accurate depth, a close initial estimate and a clean object mask. We present part-wise certification of an articulated object's state, estimated from passive stereo. Our estimator rivals the precision of the best model-based fitting method without using depth, a close initial estimate or a mask. We detect the corners that the CAD model defines in both stereo images and fit the articulated model to them. Geometric certificates, which we extend from rigid to articulated objects, then tell whether to trust each part, because the fit returns a state even for hidden parts. Certified estimates on unlabelled video become labels that improve sim-to-real transfer.
